Probably wouldn't come back., As you walk through the entrance with the glass panelled kitchen, you immediately feel special in this place of warm welcome sophistication.. from the beautiful black and white portrait prints that adorn the walls, to the head chef Benjamin coming and introducing himself to customers. But wow.. it’s the the tastes & the fusion of flavours, combined with the quality of service that you must come and experience. There is so much creativity in the combination of flavours & spices that pair so well together. Do yourself a favour when looking for a special meal. Come to this place. They have well priced degustation lunches that change weekly or simply try their individual meals… whichever you choose you won’t be disappointed.
description: Founded in December 2008, La Badiane -French for Star Anise spice- is heralding its claim to be one of the best restaurants in Vietnam, dedicated to fusion of flavors and international gastronomy. As reference, La Badiane is rated top 500 Restaurants in Asia by The Miele Guide, has been recommended by The New York Times, and has received 5 consecutive Certificates of Excellence by Trip Advisor -since 2011. Indeed, with more than 300 upvotes as “EXCELLENT”, La Badiane knows a high rating deserved to top-end restaurants. Yet, if most is about tastes, fusion of flavors and international gastronomy, great attention is also constantly paid to the quality of the service provided as well as to the overall atmosphere, so guests have a unique culinary experience by enjoying every aspect of their meal. When coming in, one’s attention is instantly caught by the multitude of perfumes & aromas flowing out from the open front kitchen. The entrance corridor planted with harmonious luxuriant vegetation leads you towards the heart of the restaurant, and its glass covered patio. Surrounded by carefully chosen leaf plants, walls predominantly white, and large B&W photo portraits, the place provides for a true feeling of calm and elegance. The combination of tablecloths, two-color curtains, and the green vegetation gathers all conditions to let guests’ visual and gustative senses fully express themselves. The attentive and discreet lightening in the evening makes it very romantic, and live classic music concerts every Wednesday evening levels-up La Badiane restaurant to turn it into a complete place. On the upper floor, two rooms available provide for perfect intimate spaces, appropriate for guests either looking for privacy, or mid-size groups wishing to enjoy a private lunch or dinner on a special occasion. As opposed to the ground floor and its B&W photos, the first floor presents large-size color portraits. A must-see.

name: Bun Cha Huong Lien
address: 24 Le Van Huu, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: This spot well-known on webs and we found it packed with visitors. Bun Cha and grilled pork skewers were excellent, we all too loved the broth soup that we asked for a second. And it was served quite fast. This dining spot seemed private, however, it' quite cramped so it' unconvenient anyway., We just enjoyed a tasteful lunch at this small but famous restaurant. Food was very fresh and service was good although the restaurant was crowded and it all went very quick. Would certainly recommend to visit this restaurant if you stay in Hanoi. It definitely is worth visiting, I was told to by the glove driver, but I had made a mistake. But I had never eaten Buncha before, so I tried it. I eat a sweet dipping sauce with vegetables and noodles. By the time I finished eating, I was bored with the sweetness and greasyness. Fried spring rolls are delicious.
description: This spot well-known on webs and we found it packed with visitors. Bun Cha and grilled pork skewers were excellent, we all too loved the broth soup that we asked for a second. And it was served quite fast. This dining spot seemed private, however, it' quite cramped so it' unconvenient anyway.

name: TUNG Dining
address: 2C Quang Trung, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: One of the most expensive Western restaurants I've ever been to and enjoyed. The Nordic food menu is extremely diverse, including ordering by portion or individual dishes. We got to try a lot of strange dishes that we have never tried before. When the wait staff brought it out, they fully introduced the name of the dish and even the main ingredients of the dish. Each dish is served in a fairly small quantity, we came here to determine this in advance and the price is also very luxurious. Professional and polite service staff, luxurious space., I have been to this restaurant since attracted by reviews. I must say that what I tasted was partly amazing, partly normal. There are some things that, perhaps out of Italian habit and not only, did not convince me so much, like the fact that wine and water are not left at the table, but the waiter, every time he sees the empty glass comes with the bottle and pours what you need. Too bad that the white wine we chose arrived at the right temperature only at the end from dinner! That said: - pros: environment and dishes, some dishes with exclusive taste, attentive service, but not too much; - cons: drinks not left available to diners, some dishes with a bit 'flat flavor, price in my opinion not justified compared to the offer and prices of the place (although I understand it is a high-end restaurant), the waiter who once outside the room (right on the street), asks which dishes were liked more and which ones you liked less ... even today I do not understand why these questions are asked outside the restaurant. Otherwise, would I come back? Safe not. Would I recommend it? Yes, if you have an additional budget to spend differently... as I said above, some dishes are really crazy!, Giving T.U.N.G. Dining anything less than five stars is a travesty and does a disservice to creative cooking. Listen, I’m 74, was part owner of three restaurants, and have dined at the culinary temples of the world including many three star Michelin restaurants. T.U.N.G Dining is on par with most of them. Our 17 dishes tickled our senses of smell, taste, and sight. The culinary journey was a trip to Wonderland and Oz. The photos tell part of the story, but everything also tasted delicious. Service was charming and helpful, and everyone displayed pride in what they were serving. Pricing is extremely high for Vietnam, coming to around $280 for two including tax and tip. T.U.N.G. Dining is worth every penny.
description: T.U.N.G Dining is Vietnam’s first pioneering tasting menu restaurant, where innovation knows no bounds. Our vision is to offer diners an extraordinary experience—one that transcends limits and redefines expectations. Chef TUNG’s approach to food is inspired by culinary influences from around the world, thoughtfully combined with the finest local ingredients and flavors. Join us on this journey of discovery!

name: Maison Vie
address: 28 Tang Bat Ho Street, Pham Dinh Ho ward, Hai Ba Trung district Hai Ba Trung district, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Wonderful classy French restaurant. My wife and I went on a recommendation from a tour guide and were not disappointed. Beautiful setting and excellent food and service. We had the four course option with wine and everything was great. I’m not a real big dessert person, but with the 4 courses I selected the strawberry/orange cheesecake and it was flavorful, smooth and light as air. Amazing. And for those who come from another big city (we come from NYC) the cost is very reasonable. Highly recommended., We had a price fix dinner that include a voice of appetizers and a selection of entrees. Included were dessert and wine. Food was excellent. I had the Basa Fish Bouilabaisse style entree which was quite different that other Bouilabaisse dishes I have had in the past. This did not have a broth, yet it was terrific., We were very impressed with the quality of the food, the ambience in the restaurant, and the attention the staff paid to us. We could not fault anything. A well-informed local recommended to us the restaurant for fine French dining. We ordered two sets comprising Starter, Soup, Maim and Dessert. The choices for the sets, which we consulted with the staff, as well as for wine, turned out to be perfect. The beef cheeks, particularly, were juicy and delicious. A meal like this for one person would easily set us back by more than A$100 in Australia, but we paid under US$60 for two. Thank you for giving my wife and I such a beautiful dining experience. You are an important addition to Hanoi's fine culinary scene.
description: Based on 28 Tang Bat Ho Street, Maison Vie Restaurant is an indispensable destination for French cuisine lovers in Hanoi. With 20 years of in-depth experience in French restaurant business, Maison Vie promises awesome dishes and services delivered by skilful chefs and dedicated staff. Inspired by "Brasserie" - imperial and crowded French restaurants with Neoclassical architecture, characterized by meticulous and subtle sculptures, Maison Vie Restaurant owns ancient but luxurious beauty, partly forming an elegant trait among a busy street. Mansion perspective with light white color and gently patterned arches not only forms graceful and moderate architectural portrait but also creates open space of fresh air and natural light. Enjoying characteristic and superior French dishes in a classical and opulent space will be splendid memories for any choosy clients. On the second floor, outdoor dining area under green liana truss will be ideal composure for nature lovers. Simultaneously, 4 VIP rooms with cosy brown interior will well fit intimate and private appointments. Maison Vie means "house of life", which derived from the desire to establish a familiar address for family get-together, friend reunions, colleague gatherings in a subtle, deluxe French-originated dining space. Nothing is more marvelous than the period of relishing meals together with our dear ones, temporarily forgetting daily anxieties and appreciating sweet relaxation. Maison Vie logo with the simulation of a Gaulois cock, French national historic emblem, features goodwill, closeness, generosity, hospitality. Slogan "Let's taste better now" not only signifies determination to set up a superior nutritious French food spot, but also accumulates dedication to innovate combination of fresh high-class ingredients with native spices, which brings clients ultimate appetite. Maison Vie is the perfect dining site of gourmets, the must-try paradise of French cuisines once in a lifetime, the "third place" cementing family sentiment and nourishing intimate camaraderie. Maison Vie Restaurant - "Taste better now"

name: Hill Top Curry Indian Restaurant
address: 6 P. Hàng Lược, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Very conveniently close to the Masjid an Noor. V good quality Indian/Pakistani cuisine , very reasonably priced. Friendly and efficient service. No long wait for good food. Be cautious when ordering especially on a hungry tummy...The portions are very generous and the meals on the menu are often substantial enough for 2 adults to share. If you've over ordered management will gladly oblige if you have leftover food to be packed for taking home., One of the best Indian Restaurant in Hanoi city and is very close to maximum hotels. Food is so Delicious and Tasty in reasonable best price. The team is very polite and humble. I recommend people to prefer this Restaurant without any doubt., Vietnamese people may not like Indian food, and the price is higher than the average of local restaurants, but I love it! Authentic spice cuisine, you can eat delicious vegetarian or meat, masala, thali, biryani... It is worth exploring here. In Hanoi, a city full of imagination, eating delicious South Asian food is totally worth the money!
description: At Hill Top Curry Restaurant, we serve you fresh, and healthy food. All dishes are cooked by Experienced Chefs as our desire is to create a place where you can enjoy the beauty of food. Enjoy your meal! With more than 100 dishes and drinks on the menu.

name: Pasteur Street Craft Beer - Cua Bac Taproom
address: 30 Cua Bac, Truc Bach, Ba Dinh,, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We found Pasteur Street Craft Beer – Cưa Bắc Taproom & Restaurant on our first night in Hanoi, and ended up coming back multiple times! The beer is fantastic, and the food is just as impressive. They have 16 beers on tap—10 of their signature brews and 6 rotating seasonal options—so there’s always something new to try. On our first visit, I ordered a tasting flight of six beers and loved every single one. My favorites were the Pomelo IPA and the Passion Fruit Wheat Ale, and I could easily sip the Bia Chanh Muối (a low-alcohol salted lime beer) all day long. My husband, an IPA fan, really enjoyed the Session IPA, and we both loved the Double Jasmine IPA. David was incredibly friendly and helpful, encouraging us to explore the different styles and offering great suggestions along the way. The food was awesome, too! The menu is extensive, ranging from burgers and wings (both excellent!) to creative salads and dishes featuring Vietnamese ingredients. Even better—they sell their beer in affordable 1-liter growlers, so you can bring your favorites home. If you love craft beer and great food in a relaxed setting, this spot is a must-visit! If I could give Pasteur Street Craft Beer more than 5 stars, I would!, So much life passing by, great beer...the Blonde was fab but sadly ran out. It would have been 5 stars but the nuts were crap. Sweet otatoe fries were battered but still tasty. Lovely staff., The atmosphere of this place is great, quite bustling and modern. Some of the beer flavors I tried were delicious. We also had some spicy chicken, which was great. The staff are also very friendly. Overall, this place is bang for our buck
description: A charming, cozy but lively taproom in the historic Ba Dinh district. The taproom has two floors, each with a unique atmosphere and view. The ground floor is warm and inviting with artwork posters, while the balcony is cool and relaxing, with a stunning view of the bustling streets from a nice balcony.

name: Co Vietnamese Restaurant & Vegan
address: 21 Hàng Cân, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews:
Super friendly and cozy restaurant with locals and tourists. The staff is very nice. Zin Zin was the one who served me and he taught me how to eat the Vietnamese pancake. Also had shrimp with coconut and rice yogurt for dessert. All very delicious. There’s an 8% tax added to the prices and if you pay with card an extra 3%, Very friendly staff, and could speak decent English. Helped me to pick the right amount of food and showed me photos of what I was ordering. The menu was also in English. Delicious food, and fair prices., We were impressed by the excellent dining experience at this restaurant. We tried the Vietnamese spring rolls, crispy on the outside, bitten down to make a slight crunch, and the filling was very fresh, full of vegetable aromas and meaty, layered taste. The service was also impeccable, the staff were very warm, friendly, always smiling, attentively answered all our questions and made us feel at home. In addition, the restaurant's environment is comfortable and welcoming, with chic and Vietnamese decor, perfect for parties, family dinners or a drink with friends. Enjoying food in such an environment is such an enjoyable experience that we look forward to coming back again! Co Vietnamese Restaurant & Vegan is celebrated for offering authentic Vietnamese cuisine that reviewers find both flavorful and fresh. Guests have called out the establishment's reasonable pricing, considering the quality of the meals served.

The service at this restaurant earns rave reviews for its quick, attentive, and knowledgeable staff, contributing to a superior dining experience. Many travelers also find the atmosphere cozy and welcoming, providing a lively yet intimate setting that is perfect for a range of occasions.
description: A distinctive, well-preserved and comfortable space, high-quality products, authentic cuisine, food and drinks are done flawlessly.

name: La Table du Chef Restaurant Hanoi
address: 59A Ly Thai To 3rd Floor, Press Club Building, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Ordered the set dinner so the dishes were pre-set. The starter, soup and main were good. Not quite like the dessert because we were not a sweet person. Overall, happy with it., I visit this place a few times and have a quite mixed opinion. Sometimes it's amazing and other times can be just average., As soon as arrived in Hanoi bt plane my family wanted to eat western food so I reserved lunch in La Table du Chef. As I expected the presentation was excellent and the food was delicious! There was a 3 course special lunch meal for 600,000 and it was more than you can expect for this price. The staff was friendly and offered an excellent desert dish for our son athough he did not order as he was tired and dizzy from his flight. I definitely recommend this to restaurant for a treat during your stay in Hanoi. (Note that it seemed around me there were mostly formal business luncheons and I regret i didn’t wear a more formal atire)
description: Set in its original colonial décor from the 1920's, La Table du Chef is a subtle journey into fine crafts, paintings, culinary and winemaking arts sourced from Vietnam and France. In the same way that Hermès workshop was once defined as a song of gestures, lovers of haute cuisine are invited to hunt for traces left by the hand's gestures embedded into many aspects of the decoration of the restaurant. This story appealed to two Michelin-star chef Alain Dutournier who had selected La Table du Chef to bring his art of haute cuisine for the first time outside of France. He adheres so intimately to the concept that Alain now personifies the soul of La Table du Chef and his hands are the expression of the highest culinary art. Together with his talented Vietnamese Resident Chef, Dao Van Son, he brings to La Table du Chef the highest standard of excellence in French cuisine, with a touch of Vietnamese taste. In this artistic atmosphere, gastronomes will have a chance to discover an exceptional menu, highlighting the best local and imported products delivered daily, such as Foie Gras from Landes, Truffle from Perigord, Fleur de sel from Guerande, Duct from South Western France, Sapa's honey, Phu Quoc's pepper... These exquisite dishes are carefully paired with the most refined selection of wines to create a memorable culinary experience in the heart of Hanoi's French quarter. The very explanatory wine menu proposes 450 labels from most famous producers of the world, a majority of French wines, as well as wonderful discoveries from Alain Dutournier, all stored in the open cellar on site.

name: Vie L'essence De Cuisine
address: 99B Hang Gai St, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 11015 Vietnam
reviews: L’essence de cuisine is a good spot to go for dinner, but I’m not sure it deserves to be ranked as one of the best in Hanoi. I don't specifically have anything bad to say - the food just didn’t blow me away. The service was very good, the ambience was nice and the presentation of each dish was carefully thought out. However, I don’t believe it should be ranked in the top 5 of the city. I did not feel that the food on the couples tasting menu was that memorable or flavourful enough to justify the price. It was definitely tasty, but not super unique. They are always looking to improve so I’m sure that this restaurant can work it’s way up to be a top location in Hanoi., Had a wonderful dinner at L’essence de la Via Cuisine. The food was absolutely delicious — every dish full of flavour and beautifully presented. The cocktails were expertly made and really added to the experience. What stood out most was the exceptional service — the waiting staff were warm, attentive, and made us feel so welcome throughout the evening. Highly recommend this place for a special night out. Top marks all around!, On our last evening in Vietnam we went to eat at this place, hoping to end on a high note. Instead, despite the pleasant environment, we ate poorly, in fact we almost didn't eat, because after the first tastes we didn't like the food. Unfortunately, our evening was ruined, because we had no alternatives for that evening, we didn't trust ourselves to go, at a late hour, to another random restaurant in the center of Hanoi, and so we were left disappointed and fasting. My husband gave it a negative review. This fact and this unpleasant situation cannot be erased. However, after a few days, when we had already returned home to Italy, the owner, not present on the evening of dinner, refunded us the bill paid, after having been asked, through the email with which we had booked, for the data banking. Making mistakes in the kitchen, or in the dining room, can sometimes happen, and it has already happened even in the best restaurants. Fully refund the amount paid, days later and 13,000 km later. It had never happened to me before. Compliments. It seems right to me to also review this correct behavior.
description: Vie L'essence De Cuisine là nhà hàng đầu tư chỉn chu về chất lượng và dịch vụ. Nó được trang trí bằng những đồ vật quen thuộc với cuộc sống đời thường của người việt như ngói, sen,… Mỗi góc phòng đều trang trí tỉ mỉ và mang lại không gian như nhà. Bạn có thể thưởng thức hơn các món ăn truyền thống Việt tại đây.

name: Gent Steak+
address: 95 Bùi Thị Xuân, Hanoi 84 Vietnam
reviews: Just happened to pass by this restaurant and decided to come in for a try. My first impression was that the staffs here take care of their customers really well, they even prepared birthday dishes as gifts for the reserved tables. The food here is quite wonderful and diverse, from classics to fusion dishes while still made it easy for customers to consume, definitely recommend the Beef Rossini and the Wayu Salmon . Beverages are not as diverse but didn't make it less delicious, we ordered some cocktails for the evening and I feel like the Golden Hour and Whisdream are must try. This approach has clearly resonated with diners, as the place was buzzing with both locals and tourists alike. The service was top-notch. The staff were friendly and knowledgeable, making sure our dining experience was enjoyable from start to finish. Whether you’re a fan of Indian food or someone looking to try something new, RK Spice should be at the top of your list when in Hanoi. If you’re in the Old Quarter and craving a taste of India, don’t miss out on this gem! description: Chibo brand was created in Osaka in 1973. In 1992, 7-storey Okonomiyaki building in downtown Dotonbori was completed, including luxury brands Purejidento Chibo specializing in Teppanyaki, meanwhile, has created buzz Culinary large community in particular and in general all over Japan. Osaka is a land famous for culinary Kuidaore neighborhood, among them, typically cakes Okonomiyaki and grilled octopus Takoyaki . Currently, Okonomiyaki are specialties, won the love of not only the parts of the country throughout Japan but also foreign tourists. However, it is still considered unique culture, born from the soil of Osaka. Okonomiyaki plump cake, smear mayonnaise, sprinkle seaweed, fish tissue have great taste when enjoyed by Teko. For diners can enjoy delicious cuisine and attractive at Chibo, we always pay attention to the following factors: Mae aji, Naka AIJ, Ato aji, including: Mae aji impression about food and restaurants ; Naka aj: Taste cakes Okonomiyaki, Ato aji: Comment of the customer after eating and left the restaurant. We absolutely do not take any light of it at all! Okonomiyaki pancake dish was strange, not traditional Japanese cuisine, dishes nor Chinese, European dishes. It's great when everyone gathered around the grill, enjoy a hot Okonomiyaki cake, talking incessantly, creating a closed loop inside of the excitement, enthusiasm. Loved the big variety of dumplings and the broth was ace., We popped in here for a quick lunch. First of all, it is super cheap and great value. Only 5 dishes on the menu - super quick service, fresh food, tasty and also seems popular with the locals. Suited us perfect for a quick lunch., After walking for a long time in the Old Quarter, my friend and I were hungry by 9pm. We had lots of Pho Bo and Bun Cha in the last few days, and we wanted some alternatives. This stall offers very good egg noodles (Wonton noodles) and also the Dry Phnom Peng Noodles were fantastic! We will certainly return to this stall again!
description:
If you love dumplings and soup, this is your place.
I was looking for a Vietnamese Dumpling Soup and so glad I came across this little gem. Quick service, great prices and yummy food! Loved the big variety of dumplings and the broth was ace.

name: SunKat's
address: 172 Yen Phu street, Tay Ho district 150m down along Yen Phu street from Thang Loi hotel inter section., Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: We had an amazing lunch at SunKat's! We loved the various options available to build our own burger. The fries were fantastic, both garlic and rosemary, as well as the animal fries. We loved the paper burger holders that are provided on the tables allowing you to eat your burger as tidily as can be possible., My partner and I came here for dinner for an escape from noodles every day and we LOVED it. It's like a Vietnamese version of Five Guys or ShakeShack and building our own burgers was great and also cheap. Theres loads of options of what to put inside your burger/sauces/patty/bun as well. Great service and cute little location too. Also, if you visit here, get the rosemary and garlic fries!!! Would recommend for sure!, Service was good. Food was delicious. Burgers can be customized, or picked from a list of Signature selections. Vegetarians and vegans will have options. A meal for two with a shared desert (we couldnâ€™t fit more into our tummies) and 2 non-alcoholic beverages set us back around VND 450K. Go check it out if you like your burgers and fries.
description:
We had an amazing lunch at SunKat's!  
We loved the various options available to build our own burger.  
The fries were fantastic, both garlic and rosemary, as well as the animal fries.
We loved the paper burger holders that are provided on the tables allowing you to eat your burger as tidily as can be possible.

name: Baek Jeong Korean BBQ Restaurant
address: N05, Lot TT3, My Dinh Residence, Nam Từ Liêm, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: We were able to have a special family dinner in a room that could fit 12 people on the second floor in a cozy and comfortable atmosphere. It was even better that the lively and friendly servers provided attentive service. Satisfied with the taste, atmosphere, and service!, I really loved this restaurant! Not many English speakers or menu but we got by as the staff were so friendly !, The food and service here is exceptional. Highly recommend this restaurant. The price is moderate but the quality of meat here is wonderful.
description: We were able to have a special family dinner in a room that could fit 12 people on the second floor in a cozy and comfortable atmosphere. It was even better that the lively and friendly servers provided attentive service. Satisfied with the taste, atmosphere, and service!

name: El Loco Tapasbar
address: 65/52 To Ngoc Van Front of the lake, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: The bar is well placed in a quiet neighborhood. Still suffering the aftermath of the pandemic, need some refurbishment to offer such an Spaniard atmosphere, as the name suggests. Not much customers when we dropped by, Saturday noon. Dishes are small but tasty and well seasoned, bread is outstanding and his owner Rodrigo is a nice guy and used to be around and keeping an eye on everything., This made a nice change from local cuisine and was a treat. We ordered way too much food but is was all delicious, if ordering a meat platter this comes with bread already so best not to order more bread on the side as you end up with like a loaf, same with the alioli dip, pretty much everything came with this so ordering a side was unnecessary. The Spanish omelette was tasty, cheeae empnadias and mushroom croqueetes were good too. All of the food came out together and well presented, we just know to order less next time! The staff were super friendly and welcoming here also, Great value for money and tasty food. Generous portions. Potatoes a bit too oily. Service staff look depressed, no smile and walking around very sad...owners must be in kitchen but service team need to cheer up.
description: Tapasbar, spanish food.

name: 21gam of Hanoi
address: 26 Trương Hán Siêu, Hoàn Kiếm, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: I like the old fashioned. My wife got too many of the signature cocktails and she ran away with another man. I am currently trying to sway her back by brooding at the bar. No amount of cologne has helped., Classy atmosphere but with great energy. Went with my friends and we had such a fun night. If you are looking for an elegant and unique space (favorite design choice: the giant amber egg hanging overhead) and like grooving along to music from the DJ, it’s a must-try. The space feels cozy and lively. Enjoyable for many age groups., I went there with my best friends and had a great time. I love the ambience, decoration was impressive. The staffs were very nice and supportive. They managed to give us 2 seat without prior reservation. Overall a very nice experience!
description: Located on Truong Han Sieu street, which is neither long nor short, noisy during the day and quiet at night, the old house with red paint of 21GAM is like a different world as soon as you step in. Just behind a door, there is a space filled with music, the sound of a lively crowd, and the clinking of glasses from the bartenders who are busy mixing drinks behind the bar… All these will captivate you, occupy all your senses, and make you forget about life outside. That explains why 21GAM is one of the most popular nightlife spots for Hanoians, and tourists seem to also agree with that. Hey, if you have 8 hours of work in the office, a busy day with meetings and unfinished deadlines, a little hectic life, then let 21GAM soothe your soul

name: The Taj - Indian Restaurant & Bar
address: 71 Hang Buom, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Great little find when we were out walking last night. The food was fresh and tasty for a great price. Service was excellent. We ordered a rice each and nan to share which was a mistake as one portion of rice was big enough for two of us and the nans were individual sized. We would recommend the chicken tikka masala. Will definitely go back before we go home., Wow, our meal here was absolutely delicious!! We ate the best butter chicken and garlic naan we have ever had!!! Rich and creamy sauce, tender fresh chicken and authentic spices and flavour!!! The rice was perfect and fluffy and the garlic naan was out of this world - cooked perfectly with the freshest garlic embedded in the bread and the dipping sauces took it all to the next level! The restaurant is just around the corner from Hanoi Beer St in the old quarter so a fantastic, vibrant area to wander through. The atmosphere inside and out was great! You can choose to sit outside or inside, ground floor or upstairs where the aircon was perfectly cool! A very high quality yet affordable meal (and drinks) with great service from lovely Indian and Vietnamese staff! If you feel like a change from Vietnamese food on your trip, this is a must try!!!, YOU can’t Go Wrong with The Taj Indian and Vegetarian Restaurant. We started with the samosas which were flaky and not greasy. Nans were like pastry with a good selection of fillings. The vegetable masala was spicy deliciousness, and the spinach was smooth and flavorful. Mahdab, the owner was delightfully friendly and attentive. Priced and portioned for families. I highly recommend a visit at least once during your stay in the Old Quarter, Hanoi. It’s also on a street that is bustling with all sorts of candies, nuts and bottled booze! ENJOY ☺️
description: Welcome to "The Taj" a culinary oasis in the heart of Hanoi, where the essence of India meets the energy of the Vietnamese capital. Named after the iconic Taj Mahal, our restaurant offers a modern twist on traditional Indian cuisine. At The Taj, experience a harmonious blend of authentic flavors and contemporary flair.Our menu showcases culinary masterpieces that transport you through the diverse landscapes of India. Whether you are a connoisseur or a newcomer to Indian cuisine, The Taj promises a delightful journey for your taste buds. Join us at The Taj for an unforgettable dining experience, where the spirit of India converges with the heart of Vietnam. Welcome to a place where every dish is a celebration of flavor and tradition.

name: Cinebar Cocktail & Wine
address: 41 Hang Bai, Hoan Kiem 2nd Floor, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Cinebar is one of the top cooktails in Hanoi, located near by Hoan Kiem lake. Excellent live music every friday. Good spot fora date or chilling with friends, Great cocktail bar. The bartenders take great care making the drinks and also checked to make sure we were happy with them after we’d had a few minutes to taste them. Planning to go back again soon!, Really nice bar tucked away up a stairs. You could so easily walk by it and not even know it’s there! The bartenders were very attentive and we had a lovely chat, giving us great recommendations for our travels. I tried the 500 days of summer cocktail, I would really recommend it.
description: Every corner in has a way to speak to all movie and music lovers out there. The most special thing in Cinerbar is the bar which imitates ticket-selling counters in movie theatres, and a screen showing teasers. When you look around, the bar surrounds you with a vintage atmosphere with its warm dark colours, classic movie posters, and vinyl records. One couldn’t help but feel a little nostalgic. You can pick a seat at the “ticket-selling” bar, or at the rows of red sofas to enjoy your drinks of choice in this cinema-inspired space.

name: WOOMASTER - Korean Aging Steak House
address: 2B Ngô Thì Nhậm Hàng Bài, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Very nice ambience, cozy lighting. Charcoal barbecue at the table is awesome. We had the Wagyu set (USA) for two people (3*130 gr) and additionally ordered an Angus Ribeye (130 gr). Meat quality excellent, we found the best Wagyu pieces with higher fat content. Due to the ripening, the meat has a special taste - extremely delicious. Just add some salt and pepper and you're done. As a side dish we had a green salad, grilled vegetables and potato wedges and as starter fried dumplings. The quality of the side dishes was also top. We paid 90 € (including beer, water, cocktail), which is of course expensive for Vietnam but quite inexpensive for this enjoyment. Also the service was top. Our waiter Trinh has a very pleasant attentive nature and helped us with the barbecue (the meat is pre-grilled medium-rare and then finished grilling at the table grill according to taste). Conclusion: If you like to eat meat and want to treat yourself, this is the place for you., Excellent place to eat grilled beef and pork. A great combination of cuts that serve with very delicious Korean tapas. The salads are very delicious too. The price is a little higher than the average of other restaurants; but it is well worth it for the quality of the meat, the combinations of sauces and different types of salts., Dining at this Hanoi steakhouse is a world-class experience, unique in its charm. The quality of meat is exceptional, rivaling the best steakhouses globally. Their cocktails are a delightful journey in flavors, adding to the exquisite dining atmosphere. The staff strikes a perfect balance between attentiveness and discretion; they're not only highly professional and fluent in English but also intuitively responsive, ensuring comfort without intruding on your privacy. It's a place where culinary excellence meets impeccable service.
description: WOOMASTER - The First Korean Aging Steakhouse in Vietnam provides high-quality American Wagyu & USDA PRIME Beefs combined with unique Water Aging technique.

name: Khang Japanese Restaurant
address: 322 Ba Trieu Street, Le Dai Hanh Ward, Hai Ba Trung Dist, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Would not recommend. Two of us spent 1.7 mill but you could have spent 1/2 or 2/3 the money somewhere else with much more satisfaction. Sashimi wasnâ€™t fresh. Portion was small and expensive., This restaurant looks small outside but amazing inside. the food is really delicious and safe. I love eating Khang restaurant., khang is one of my favourite Japanese restaurant in town. could'nt remember when was my first time there back in early 90s of the last centuryðŸ˜€. You would find the Japanese family style restaurant. menu is extensive and I guess there are not few chinese or vietnamese mixed disks. the modest lunch sets for single customers are very popular. the foods are generally good. sashimis are quite fresh, mostly from local fish. the prices are on the above average side. the shop looks small outside but quite big inside and very busy at lunch time. better book your table in advance. note that all shoes off entering the shop. Services are average.
description: Would not recommend. Two of us spent 1.7 mill but you could have spent 1/2 or 2/3 the money somewhere else with much more satisfaction. Sashimi wasnâ€™t fresh. Portion was small and expensive.

name: Hoa Sua Training Restaurant
address: No 2A, Hang Chuoi Alley Pham Dinh Ho, Hai Ba Trung, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: We loved the Idea of this Cafe. It is for people with mental health problems.. The all learn English and work to serve people like us that stop and visit. The sevice was good and the cocktails and food were really good., What a cool place! This place trains young Vietnamese kids and prepares them for a career in the restaurant industry. The kids were really engaged and excited. The food was really tasty and well-presented. I really enjoyed my lemongrass chicken and banana flower salad., Wonderful cooking class at Hao Sua, a vocational school designed to teach teens from poor villages a trade (sewing, embroidery, French cooking, Vietnamese cooking, baking, table service) then places them in local restaurants and hotels post-graduation. Started the day at the local market. Fresh vegetables, spices and meat. Seeing chickens in a cage was bothersome for my 13 year old son and my husband made sure he didn’t see chickens being killed. In retrospect, we should have asked our guide to avoid the meat section of the market although can’t get a more authentic experience. The ingredients for our food had already been bought but we picked up some mangosteen and vegetables. After a quick tour of the school, we made our way to the kitchen. Spent the morning making a delicious papaya salad, fresh spring rolls (rolling them perfectly is definitely an art) and grilled chicken. The chef guided us through the prep and cooking process. After we finished, we sat down at a beautifully set table to our feast. One of the best meals we had on our trip thanks to a great chef. Highly recommend this class as family fun and a great way to learn about Vietnamese food.
description: Hoa Sua is an organization that is designed to give disadvantaged youth life and vocational training skills. Hoa Sua's Training Resturaunt gives it's students a place to learn and deliver an excellent customer dining experience. Our students serve great Vietnamese and French cuisine in an elegant setting.

name: Paolo and chi Italian restaurant
address: 284 Nghi Tam Street Yen Phu Ward, Tay Ho district, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: We ordered from this place a number of times while we were in lock-down for COVID. The food was so good that I really wanted to visit and eat in the restaurant itself. The ambiance isn't much. The dining room is quite small and because it's all concrete, the loud party next to us was quite annoying. And, we saw some of the kitchen staff smoking in the kitchen. Perhaps that's OK in Vietnam but for a westerner, it's a bit of a turn-off. Either way, the food was good. Yes, most of my friends prefer Pizza Belga but I find Belga to be overpriced and "under-cheesed" if that's a word. We actually really enjoyed everything we got from Paolo and I hope to return soon., We had a late dinner cause we couldn't find anything else but we were surprised by the prices,food and staff, everything was good,the restaurant is clean,wasn't too crowded when we got there, This place is quite expensive, so because of that we probably wouldn't order with them again. But the food was ok, nothing special, just average.
description: Paolo and Chi is located at 284 Nghi tam, a main street of Yen Phu, Tay Ho. We are a family owned operated business and offer a dine in, take out and delivery all day long to late night. We have always given the people excellent "home cooked" food as well as fast delivery and friendly customer service, all at a palatable price. Our pizza, pasta, salad and meat are prepared fresh daily in our kitchen and that is our guarantee

name: Ramen Iroha
address: 25 Duong Thanh Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Was really craving a good ramen and wanted to try a new spot in Hanoi and after googling best Ramen in Hanoi this spot popped up. Trust me you won't be disappointed. The ramen was AMAZING, and the BEST part was the pork was roasted instead of boiled. More importantly, the service was INCREDIBLE. Our waitress was extremely polite, friendly and attentive, one of the best waitresses I've ever seen. Definitely try out this spot when you have the chance., we eventually got to try Iroha ramen after they opened again after being closed over the recent Tet new year celebrations and it was definitely worth the wait. One of my favourite restaurant dishes is Ramen and having tasted ramen in 5 of the 7 continents I certainly rate Iroha up there with some of the best outside of Japan. The broth was both flavoursome and not too salty, with a nice selection of ingredients. This is a highly recommended ramen restaurant., Was looking for a quality ramen 🍜 place in Hanoi and stumbled upon Iroha after looking it up. Arrived right after they re-opened for the dinner service, so had the place entirely to myself. The staff were second to none and they were extremely attentive and courteous. Food-wise, I went for the Miso Ramen, which was as good a bowl I could have hoped for. Noodles were spot-on, broth was great, the pork slices were tender and flavorful, and the egg yolk was just as it should be with a gorgeous consistency. Price was a bit high by local standards, but well-worth it if you’re craving the good stuff like it is back in Japan. As someone who lives in this city, I’ll definitely come back for more.
description:
Was really craving a good ramen and wanted to try a new spot in Hanoi and after googling best Ramen in Hanoi this spot popped up.

Trust me you won't be disappointed. The ramen was AMAZING, and the BEST part was the pork was roasted instead of boiled.

More importantly, the service was INCREDIBLE. Our waitress was extremely polite, friendly and attentive, one of the best waitresses I've ever seen.

Definitely try out this spot when you have the chance.

name: Nam Phuong
address: 19 Pho Phan Chu Trinh French Quarter, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Recommended by hotel concierge upon checking in. 10 mins walk form Meliá Hanoi and find this traditional Vietnamese food. Is is definitely an upper class Vietnamese food for sure but the quality is guaranteed! Love the pomelo salad as I always look forward it. The fried squid looks like chrysanthemum flower rather bland inside but with the special prepared dipping sauce , pretty good. The grilled chicken thigh with fried rice cake! Rather bland for the chicken meat for sure and need more marination ! The rice cake is great and brought me back to my nostalgia time that my grandma prepared for us ! The decor is very traditional Vietnamese setting and service is great..!, Although this place was recommended by our tour guide and has a lot of accreditation- I personally was very disappointed with the food. It was not tasty and also ratio of value for money did not exist. They have portraits of many dignitaries who are in this place but perhaps it was a good restaurant in the past. The only highlight for me was life music performance, very clean and warm welcomed french and local vietnamese marriage food not too spicy also not too much strong herbs everybody can enjoy at this restaurant for food and atmosphere
description: Recommended by hotel concierge upon checking in. 10 mins walk form Meliá Hanoi and find this traditional Vietnamese food. Is is definitely an upper class Vietnamese food for sure but the quality is guaranteed! Love the pomelo salad as I always look forward it. The fried squid looks like chrysanthemum flower rather bland inside but with the special prepared dipping sauce , pretty good. The grilled chicken thigh with fried rice cake! Rather bland for the chicken meat for sure and need more marination ! The rice cake is great and brought me back to my nostalgia time that my grandma prepared for us ! The decor is very traditional Vietnamese setting and service is great..!

name: AHA Cafe
address: Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: We happened to walk by this place and thought we saw a sign for Che Thai (Thai fruit dessert) so we came in. Turned out they didn’t have it. But we’re glad we sat down because the coffee is sooo good! Dark and strong and sweet, what real Viet coffee should taste like. I think this is more of a local spot, but if you want strong Viet coffee this is one of the spots to check out (they don’t have egg coffee though, but quite a selection of drinks and dessert drinks. And it’s at a busy intersection so you can sit and enjoy the traffic and people watching., Got to the nearest AHA cafe to get am fix and was not disappointed. The straight black without any sweetening energised me immediately!, Mango smoothie was delicious, but the service forces rather bored. Wie sat in the 1. floor and have watched the bustle on the road junction. Unfortunately, the waiter was told that he was quite unmotivated. But our mango smoothie was very delicious
description: VIetnamese Street Style Coffee Shop

name: Ashima Giang Van Minh
address: 60 Giang Van Minh Ba Dinh, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: The service was great and the staff were super friendly. Tons of mushrooms to try! Just a heads-up: the beef wasn’t super fresh and the hotpot felt a bit oily and salty., My father and I had dinner at Ashima tonight (16th Jan 2019) and I can honestly say this was a breath taking experience. We are foodies and know are food. The quality of the fresh ingredients (morilles and cepes mushrooms, Japanese wagyu beef etc) was just outstanding. We were brought a whole plate of fresh morilles which are extremely expensive. We were amazed by the profusion of high quality ingredients specially in such quantities for each customer. The resulting hotpot was... Well... The best I have ever had. It was not cheap but certainly worth more than we were charged. Highly recommended, The dishes that this restaurant have were very tasty and I really enjoyed eating the mushroom and the noodles.
description: The service was great and the staff were super friendly. Tons of mushrooms to try! Just a heads-up: the beef wasn’t super fresh and the hotpot felt a bit oily and salty.

name: Banh Mi Ba Dan
address: 32 Lo Su, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: What a great find! Cute and clean little white and blue bahn I’m restaurant serving perfect bahn mi and other delicious goodies - their tofu and avocado salad topped with freshly fried shallots with a tangy dressing was sublime! Owner was very accommodating and also served our kuds plain bahn mi with cheese (which wasn’t on the menu and lots of other placed refuse to do for some reason). We loved this place and went back 4 times in 3 days!!, Absolutely fantastic food. The restaurant is beautiful. Highly recommend. Really good, fresh bread, delicious hotpots and Banhmi, Delish. They warm it up and it goes all crispy. Better than other places I’ve had Banh Mi. You would never think to go in here as no tourists. But it’s great! A steady stream of locals come here.
description: What a great find! Cute and clean little white and blue bahn I’m restaurant serving perfect bahn mi and other delicious goodies - their tofu and avocado salad topped with freshly fried shallots with a tangy dressing was sublime! Owner was very accommodating and also served our kuds plain bahn mi with cheese (which wasn’t on the menu and lots of other placed refuse to do for some reason). We loved this place and went back 4 times in 3 days!!

name: Tony Vu's Brewing 2 - Local Craft Beer
address: 79 P. Đường Thành, Hàng Bông, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Great street beer experience- not sure that this isn’t the definition of high tempo atmosphere in Hanoi. Lohe looked after us royally with a great recommendation on street beer and a chilled bar. Come on down!, Craft beer in Vietnam… absolutely wild how far the industry has come. This is an excellent little spot, bringing a handful of beer varieties - from hazy hops to stouts - on par with what you’d expect in the UK or US. You’d be mistaken that the Hop Bullet IPA is, in fact, not Sierra Nevada’s Torpedo. Solid stuff - highly recommend if you enjoy your beer!, Best service, beer is nice and cold, beautiful view, friendly service, in the old town of Hanoi- capital of Vietnam, see u again tomorrow
description: Great street beer experience- not sure that this isn’t the definition of high tempo atmosphere in Hanoi. Lohe looked after us royally with a great recommendation on street beer and a chilled bar. Come on down!

name: Tatsuya Japanese Restaurant
address: Tầng 1, Tòa L1 Le Grand Jardin, Kđt Sài Đồng, Phường Phúc Đồng, Long Biên, Hanoi 11800 Vietnam

name: Loving Hut Hoa Dang
address: 33A Ba Trieu. Ward Hang Bai, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: It's the people that count, and here I was blessed to be provided wonderful food by the warmest and most hospitable people you could have. Thank you a thousand times over, loving hut is simple service but the foodis great, the veg seemed to be really fresh to us and we enjoyed the small spice, what a great dining experience! More like fine dining - staff were so polite and lovely. We found this through the happy cow app and so pleased we did. Wonderful food :) great place to eat.
description: Delicious food and good vibes

name: Nhà Hàng Sen Vàng - Bắc Từ Liêm
address: BT90, TT4 Khu Đô Thị Thành Phố Giao Lưu Đường Số 11, Hanoi 11917 Vietnam
description:
Nơi hội tụ của mọi hương vị. Từ món ăn cao cấp đến mâm cơm gia đình giá ưu đãi, Sen Vàng đáp ứng mọi nhu cầu của bạn. Phòng riêng sang trọng, nơi tổ chức sự kiện chuyên nghiệp, không gian rộng rãi phục vụ được nhiều quý khách hàng.
HOTLINE: 0994.89.89.89

name: Tomato Seafood
address: 33 Nguyen Thi Dinh Street Trung Hoa, Cau Giay District, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Delicious food (grilled oysters with cheese, garlic butter snails, jellyfish salad, gourd crab hotpot), enthusiastic service. Yummy. This is the 5th time eating at this restaurant., The seafood at this place is really nice, especially the fried seafood noodle and egged squid. It's a shame I was the only one enjoying it. I definitely plan to come back with a group next time., My husband and I had a fabulous seafood dinner at this restaurant during our visit to Hanoi last week. The staff did not speak much English but they were friendly and helpful. We had 2 seafood dishes, the crab in sour sauce and mantis shrimp with garlic and butter and both dishes were excellent. Sauteed morning glory and seafood with glass noodle were both also very tasty. The best part was that they had a promotion for week night dining which made the meal very reasonable (even our tour guide thought so). This restaurant is located a bit away from the main tourist area in the old quarter but definitely worth the trip to get there.
description: Fresh seafood everyday, in a clean and modern restaurant with reasonable price and friendly staffs. This seafood restaurant brand has 2 locations in town: 82 Le Van Huu, Hoan Kiem & 33 Nguyen Thi Dinh, Cau Giay.

name: Tannin Wine Bar
address: 46 Hang Vai, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Lovely little place in Hanoi - a place with a sophisticated European feel in the hustle & bustle of Hanoi Old Town. We visited a couple of times, once on a Wednesday which is Jazz night - beautiful soft jazz, not too loud, gave the place a lovely atmosphere. Would recommend if in Hanoi Old town - good wines, & though not extensive, the menu has a good selection - can certainly recommend the cheese board. Hope it continues to thrive!, Nice wine bar with a very good selection of wines, delicious cheese and very fresh, crispy baguettes. The music is tailored to European tastes and fits perfectly in this bar. Everything is very pleasant and atmospheric. The bubbling sound with which mucus is drawn up from the nose into the throat is certainly not one of the more pleasant acoustic experiences. Unfortunately, the young bartender doesn't know this and is constantly busy with his slime, which is especially disgusting when you are eating. Unfortunately, the staff is not very friendly to the guests. We were here practically every evening during our stay in Hanoi and the behavior hasn't changed. It's a shame, we would expect that at this price level and in a bar that is obviously aimed at European customers., This is a proper wine bar in Hanoi. A range of red and white wines by the glass and an extensive wine by the bottle list. Happy hour 4pm to 7 pm with 30% reduction was sadly missed by us but fir top quality wines this is still a great venue The cheese plate was substantial and will be easily sufficient for two Don’t miss Ajax Wednesday. Soft mellow jazz beautifully song and played by two local musicians. Overall this is a place to plan into any trip to Hanoi
description: A few things to know about Tannin Wine Bar - A cozy, international, specialized wine bar in the heart of Hanoi - Over 500 wines listed and in stock - Old World & New World fully represented to suit all budgets - Curated list of 10 wines by the glass, from entry level to premium - try something new! Changes every 2 weeks - A nice range of premium spirits, digestifs & aperitifs - Relaxed, cozy atmosphere with good music and professional but friendly service - Delicious dishes, charcuterie, cheese boards and our great breads to go with your wines - Main bar, also with back room for groups, and our mezzanine wine cellar overlooking the bar - Tannin was opened by a team of wine professionals and long-term Hanoi residents from France, Vietnam, and the UK - a place built as somewhere we wanted to spend time in and we hope that you enjoy as well! - Convenient central location on a quiet, classic Hanoi street on the edge of the Old Quarter with plenty of parking.

name: Bep lang Duong Lam
address: So 8, xom Dinh, lang Mong Phu, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
description: Bep lang Duong Lam - The restaurant serves fresh food with traditional dishes of the old village in Vietnam

name: Som Tum Thai
address: 37 Trần Hưng Đạo, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: This is a great spot for some pretty amazing Thai food. It's nicely presented, and there's a few stories to there's a bit of room (although it seems to be popular with office lunches so it can be a bit raucous). The food was amazing. We over ordered with grilled chicken and fishcakes, followed by half a baked fish and some very good Thai red curry. It was all cooked perfectly. Service is great, Tiger beer was cold and the flavours authentic. Well worth a look if you're in the area., Lovely place to enjog with family and frineds to try some Thai food, Will bring my friends here the next time, lovely food in the winter, Everything is good. We had wonderful meals here and will go again. We had nice lunch with the couple in an aesthetic restuarant
description:
This is a great spot for some pretty amazing Thai food.  It's nicely presented, and there's a few stories to there's a bit of room (although it seems to be popular with office lunches so it can be a bit raucous).  

The food was amazing.  We over ordered with grilled chicken and fishcakes, followed by half a baked fish and some very good Thai red curry.  It was all cooked perfectly.

Service is great, Tiger beer was cold and the flavours authentic.  Well worth a look if you're in the area.

name: Nhà hàng Cafe Thủy Tạ
address: 1 Lê Thái Tổ, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Excellent location, overlooking Hiam Kiem Lakr and the Ngoc So Temple. I loved it so much i went twice. The service is prompt as the place is really busy. First visit I had the fresh spring rolls then the banana prawns and stir fried pork salad with peanuts noodles bamboo shoots on my second visit., My recent visit to Thuy Ta Cafe on the banks of Hoan Kiem Lake in Hanoi was a mixed experience. The picturesque lakeside setting and view of Hoan Kiem Lake were certainly major draws for this property. The quality of drinks and food was acceptable, but not exceptional. However, the main negative was the price. I found that the prices were a little too high compared to the quality of the products offered. It's important to note that prices shown on the card do not include taxes and service fees, which may result in a final bill that is higher than expected. The service at Thuy Ta cafe was OK, but not particularly attentive. I would have appreciated an additional touch of friendliness to make the experience more pleasant. Despite these drawbacks, the lakeside location was lovely, and the place was conducive to relaxation. It's a nice place to have a coffee or a snack while enjoying the beautiful view of the lake., Beside good service and tasty vietnamese food, this restaurant is “must visit” place in Hanoi due to its location! I love the view toward Hoan Kiem Lake! Amazing
description: Excellent location, overlooking Hiam Kiem Lakr and the Ngoc So Temple. I loved it so much i went twice. The service is prompt as the place is really busy.  First visit I had the fresh spring rolls then the banana prawns and stir fried pork salad with peanuts noodles bamboo shoots on my second visit.

name: Westlake Station
address: 24 To Ngoc Van Street, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: This is a decent spot for food and drinks. They have seating in the patio and also Air-Conditioned seating upstairs if you want to escape the Hanoi summer. The The food was good, my suggestion is to stick to the salads, appetizers and pizza. The service is very good, staff there were very friendly. Check it out., Interesting and fun place.. A pool table for added fun. There’s plenty of space to sit outside surrounded with greenery. We had pizza & fries which were tasty., This place was a great find whilst here in Hanoi with my work for 6 weeks. Thursday nights they do mussels in a fantastic tomato and garlic baste - very tasty. They do wood fired pizzas and various other foods, which are delicious. Not local Viet food, but not over priced either. Very friendly team there and always happy to help. We went on Thursday night 19/12 for mussels. Last night for pizza and beers. We will be back tonight again.
description: WLS is a new Bar & Bistrot located in To Ngoc Van. WLS offers you a bistronomy's experience with daily specials, lunch and night's Bistrot menu. WLS is your new place to enjoy craft beers, craft food & great selection of wines around the pool table or simply in our garden. Enjoy our fresh pizza cooking in real wood oven pizza... If you like the typical Bistrot you will appreciate the new talent and the delicate touch of our French Chef Morgane and the typical design of the different Bistrot and Estaminet from France. Find also a great selections for the veggie fans on menu or in daily specials... Come to visit us shortly, and enjoy WestLake Station day and night.

name: OAK Wine Boutique
address: 6 Trang Thi, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This little wine bar is a must do in old Hanoi. Nestled above the street, walking distance from Hoan Kiem lake, they have an extensive, yet reasonably priced selection of wines and some simple, but fabulous dishes. We sat out on the balcony and watched the city drift past! The staff were incredibly friendly, and you would be hard pressed to have better warm fresh bread and butter in all on Vietnam (or France for that matter)! Definitely recommend giving this place a try!, We came here (almost) by accident as the tour bus stopped outside and it looked so nice we said we must come back - and did. Even though we interrupted Thao and Minh’s break they made us so welcome - and served us a number of delicious wines in a stunning environment. Recommended., We went to the Oak Wine Boutique yesterday. Love that the entrance is down an alley and up some stairs. We sat on the balcony above the fray and enjoyed a glass of white wine while the city bustled below. Some friends joined us for dinner- lamb chops, steak and noodles shared between us - and of course more wine. The service was great, very friendly and just close enough. Also the music was so nice, all of us remarked on it - jazz, but did not compete with the conversation. ☺️

name: L'Mo Dinning
address: 34 Nguyen Thi Dinh, Trung Hoa, Cau Giay, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Recommand this new restaurant in new Hanoi area with excellent manager director Ms Uyen and top chef M.Thu!! Nice 5 floors restaurant with lift and private room. Nice Tournedos Rossini , will come back next Hanoi trip!! Bravo !
description: L'Mo impresses by its own charming architecture design, outstanding quality menu which every single dish is cooked to perfection, creative cocktails from experienced mixologists.... L'Mo delivers to you a sense of intimacy which makes you feel like you are set in your "second living room". The right place to welcome your guests, friends or family in the cozy European environment.

name: Family Restaurant
address: 39 Hang Hanh Street, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant was very close to our hotel and was a perfect location for a light evening meal prior to a massage. All plates were well presented and were great examples of popular local dishes. Beers and wines are also available and all at very reasonable prices., and definitely the best in Hanoi. Charming local family owned restaurant, master chef selects best local ingredients and you can taste it. has an upstairs patio where you can enjoy a Hanoi beer and watch the disarray of scooters and shoppers below, Very good place, ideal for solo travellers looking for good meal, local flavor, while on the way. No frills, just good food nice and peaceful place,
description: FAMILY RESTAURANT - Welcome to Family Restaurant in Hanoi. We are a family restaurant with an experience team and friendly family service. Family Restaurant is also offered a beautiful look and nice view from the terrace with 3 floors & spacious balcony facing to Hang Hanh Street, that made our customers more happy to enjoy the view and our delicious food. We are expert in Vietnamese Food with a best chefs for Vietnamese Cuisine, so we ensure that our restaurant will bring you a relax and happy time to enjoy delicious dishes with local price. Family Restaurant promise to bring guests a best experience of local food and local price. As well as, we also offer a good taste of European, Asian, Australian... to make sure that tourists can taste their delicious food during your travel in Vietnam.

name: Rajbhog Hanoi Indian Restaurant
address: Lan Ong Street 47, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This place is very near to Hanoi Night Market , Food Choices are limited but taste is good. Service can be a little faster. But Overall the food tasted good and has mix of Veg and Non-Veg choices., Rajbhog is the best option for Indian tourist looking for authentic Indian food. The service is very fast and food is toasty too., The service was slow but that was worthy as the food was very tasty not too much oil. It was just like home food. I give 9/10. I highly recommend.
description: We are serving Delicious Indian food with varios menu options. our restaurant have a capacity of 100+ guest at same time for lunch and dinner with an authentic taste for Indian food.

name: Paolo & Chi Pizzeria Old Quarter
address: 48 Hàng Buồm, Hoàn Kiếm, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: One evening we were hungry for pizza. Since Paolo was near our hotel, we just went there with no expectations. We just wanted to eat pizza and sat down outside on the small terrace. We were very pleasantly surprised by how friendly the service was and how tasty our pizzas were! It was a hit! We can recommend the "Paolo & Chi Pizzeria" without hesitation., EXCELLENT thank you Hieu and the team! This is a must, the food was very tasty. Pizza and pasta, great ingredients fresh. Great service great atmosphere and staff! If you fancy a change this is a must!! We need to up the reviews here!, Great pizza! We had the 4 cheese & the capriciosa. The 4 cheese was a little sickly due to being a purely white base but overall very yummy
description: Welcome to Paolo & Chi Old Quarter! Proud of 12 years of serving Italian cuisine in Hanoi, we welcome a new member located on Hang Buom street. The special combination of Pizza - Bar - Music in a spacious and modern space is waiting for you to discover. Come and enjoy great flavors with us!

name: Little Tipsy Pub, Hanoi
address: 33B Nguyen Huu Huan str. Ly Thai To ward, Hoan Kiem DIST., Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: There are hundreds of bars selling cheap beer in Hanoi. However, if you are after higher quality beers and drinks, still well priced, you really should make your way to this excellent small place in central Hanoi. Friendly owner and staff help make this new bar a really pleasant place to chill., We came in for an afternoon beer but little did we know that we would enjoy a genuine chat and amazing experience. Stephen (owner) shared his captivating story with us along side the best beer in Vietnam! Highly recommend for everyone!, Great cosy bar. Really welcoming owner and staff with fantastic knowledge of the wide range of beers and wine on offer. Told us the story behind the beers we had. Just sad we only found it on our last night!
description: The small pub offers you a wide range of Belgian, Dutch and local beers, various kinds of cocktails in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Lamai Garden
address: 36B Đê Quai, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: The couple wants to be quiet, enjoy delicious food, share happy and sad stories about their children or work... Or find a simple place to sit and meditate, listen to Le Cat Trong Ly's music, enjoy Vietnamese food but Cooked and presented in a minimalist style but not boring. The arrangement of the dishes and the order are all intentional by the chef. I'm the type that can eat anything, but with the message the chef conveys through every detail and flavor, the feeling of last night's dinner is like a gentle, deep song but filled and filled with happiness, laughter and joy. understanding. This is suitable for dating for parents, after many days of hard work taking care of grandparents and children, they deserve to sit there, make funny flirtatious jokes and enjoy delicious food, fragrant wine and reminders. about our difficult but exciting journey together., This is an amazing experience in a special place that looks more like a living room than a commercial restaurant. 10 minutes taxi ride from the old city, this is a residential area and the restaurant is hided behing a wall that conceals a beautiful garden and villa. We sat at the bar which allows for full view of what happens in the open kitchen. The tasting menu is balanced, very special and based on local produce and Vietnamese ingredients. Everything was so beautifully presented and the taste was always subtle and yet exciting. The price is also friendly for what you get so it is a highly recommended experience when in Hanoi. DONT MISS IT !, Lamai Garden Restaurant in Hanoi is a delightful place for dinner. They specialize in authentic Vietnamese cuisine, and the dishes are full of flavor and freshness. The cozy atmosphere and attentive service make it a top choice for an authentic dining experience in the city.

name: Coffee 24
address: 24 Bat Dan Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 110802 Vietnam
reviews: Visited this centrally located café in Hanoi and the prices are very cheap, between 30,000 and 40,000 ish for a banh mi. We also ordered a very nice coffee (25,000) and a mango smoothie (40,000) and both were delicious. Staff are very friendly and the food is so good - highly recommend., Beef pho was delicious and so cheap 50k dong!! We also asked for vegetable egg fried rice which they did and was big portion 50k done also. Nice cheap eat place, not to much on the menu though!, This is a wonderful place. You feel welcome. The lady is taking care very well of all her clients . It's such a pleasure to have drinks, tea, coffee, coconut water on this little terrace in the fans breeze. I love to stop here every day. 😁
description: This is a local coffee shop in the Old Quarter in Ha Noi with very cheap price. There are some kind of local coffee such as : coffee with milk, black coffee etc... Beside that, local fast food is one of the most delicious food in my restaurant like : Bread with pate,with egg,grill meat... It costs only from 1$ to 5$/ person. Come to us to enjoy a part of local lifestyle of Vietnamese.

name: Pepperonis
address: 98 Hang Trong Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: After a morning of sight-seeing, we were looking for an "easy" lunch, and Pepperonis (right next to the Oriental Jade Hotel where we were staying) was both convenient and offered a familiar western-style menu. I ordered the lunch special offered that day (salad bar, pizza, pasta, 145,000 VND) but misunderstood that apparently both a small pizza and a small portion of pasta was included; as I declined the pizza I received a double portion of pasta. Had I ordered both the pizza and pasta, it would have been far too much food. The salad bar was incompletely stocked at 1:30 PM but what I found was good. The "spaghetti bolognaise" didn't taste a bit like what you'd find in Italy and had a tomato-based sauce that resembled what would come from a bottle of Ragu. My partner had a BBQ beef pizza that was "okay." The total bill with two bottled waters was 387,720 VND (about $16). Despite only an average experience at lunch, the easy option appealed to us again several days later for dinner. We split a large Hawaiian pizza that was good but not great. With three local beers, the charge was 337,000 VND (about $14). Service for both meals was good but not polished. We sensed tension between the wait staff and their manager. The menu is extensive and extends far beyond pasta and pizza. The other diners were mostly local, and at dinner included families enjoying huge platters of ribs and other western items. I found the experience at Pepperonis to be like going to Denny's in the USA. Never great, but it gets the job done., Located between the Hanoi Cathedral and our Minerva Premium Hotel, we saw that the menu out front had lots of salads and pizzas and then noticed all the Asian customers. On our 1st visit, we enjoyed Avocado salad with shrimp, Lime drink and Brownie with ice cream. The 2nd visit, we ordered the large split(Hawaiian/Marinara) thin crust pizza, Lime Drink, Zero Heiniken, then caramel dessert and apple crisp with ice cream. Excellent food and service with both bills under $19. Noise level is high especially with families on the weekends., Decent place for a quick pizza dinner. We had the family combo with a large pepperoni pizza, six ribs, garlic bread and an Australian sausage. About what we expected for a pizza in this area of Hanoi.

name: Madam Tu Hong
address: 5 Hoi Vu Alley, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: We had the best Cha Ca at Madame Tu Hongs restaurant. We stumbled on it down a back alley behind our hotel, the Beryl Charm Hotel and did we ever luck out. We ordered fresh spring rolls and they were delicious. We then ordered the Cha Ca and they brought out a plate of vermicelli and a tray with peanuts, chili 🌶️ peppers as a topping. A young man cooked the vegetables and fish at our table. We put the vermicelli in a bowl followed by the vegetables and fish and topped it with a fresh shrimp paste. It had to be one of the most delicious meals we have had in Vietnam. The vegetables and fish were so fresh and the mixture of the shrimp paste with the fish was sublime. If only we could go again we certainly would. The price point was very affordable for any budget., The cha ca was amazing. I am normally not a big fan of shrimp paste, but this restaurant knows how to make it easy for first-timers like me to give it a try. I changed to fish sauce after but overall it was great., This place is one of the best and nicest restaurants I have been to in Hanoi. Super friendly staff, super delicious food, super great ambiance and the price is perfect. Complete value for money. 10/10. No complaints. 100% recommend.

name: Thang Tran Quan
address: 14 Hang Ca Street 14 Hang Ca Street - 14 Cha Ca Street, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Really great place. We came here by a group of 4 hugry people after 8h of walking around city and we recived even to much food to eat all of it. Prices are really fair, from my point of view, and personel is really friendly. Only one thing to notice - noodles = soup, but it was great, so who cares XD, We went twice it was that good, owner is so so so lovely gave us free bananas as dessert. Food was great, we had the steamed chicken both times it was that delicious. Good prices too compared to similar places around the old quarter and very generous portions. Cafe is small and cozy sealed off from the busy road so less noise, good air con, very clean. In summary just eat all your meals in Hanoi here, We had walked around trying to find a small cafe restaurant that wasn’t eating on the side of the road. They were friendly, good the best we had whilst on our stay in Hanoi and with wifi and a good fan, it was perfect. We ate bbq pork and seafood dishes with noodles
description: The iconic dishes of Hanoian & Vietnamese cuisine for you to enjoy in a cozy setting right in the heart of Hanoi. Walk-ins and takeaways are all welcomed.

name: Anbien Eatery
address: 111 Trieu Viet Vuong Bui Thi Xuan Ward, Hai Ba Trung District, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Coming with few friends to Anbien, feeling Hai Phong's breeze. Such a cozy and simple nice decor restaurant., Nice small but very clean restaurant's the food was very tasty and cheap compared with other restaurants in the area. Very local cuisine and they have some English speaking waiters, I really like to enjoy meal here. All foods are famous-street-foods of HaiPhong. Taste is delicious with nice decoration. Variety selections are from low to high prices and suitable for slight to main meal, for single to family with kids. Restaurant is quite clean with feeling cozy. Highly recommended for family with kids because restaurant has Air Con and of course, that is the best thing we wish in summer of Vietnam :)
description: An Bien is the first restaurant which severs Haiphong's street food as daily dishes in an warm and creative space in Hanoi.

name: Vine Restaurant & Wine Bar
address: 1A Xuan Dieu Tay Ho, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Great food with amazing service. They make westerners feel at home. Our servers were great and the quality and value were outstanding., Romantic, cozy & beautiful! Perfect for groups or date nights- wine quality is excellent-they do offer a happy hour as well from 4-8pm Staff is friendly and attentive, prices reasonable too!, 5 minute walk from both the Sheraton and Intercontinental hotels. The food quality, selection, and presentation are excellent. The prices are extremely reasonable. We started with duck pate matched with a variety of breads. We were served an amuse bûche of beef relish. Hummus was provided to go with the bread baskets. I ordered a set menu of spring rolls, duck confit, and crème brûlée. My partner ordered the fish and panna cotta. We loved everything. They have an extensive wine cellar, VERY reasonably priced. The meal was excellent and the staff were very attentive and engaging with a good command of English. The decor is beautiful - brick walls with a selection of modern paintings. We had a table by a very large window so we could watch Hanoi nightlife while we ate. I recommend the Vine to anybody staying in the area.
description: Vine Quality Hospitality Group began in 2003, and was the first to be certified as an ISO 9001 for Quality Management System and as an ISO 22000 Food Safety Management System in Vietnam.Wine Spectator award-winning fine dining experience.

This place will be the best choice I want to go back again., Walked to the restaurant at night and dark soi... almost missed the restaurant. Walking in and asking for a table, those available only half had reserved signage and others (small two seated French coffee table) set as two table for four guest and only having seated two guests each). The waiter did not try to make any effort and the-arranging anything and told me all reserved (!!!!!!!) and showed me out. Most unprofessional and unfriendly.....

name: Pacifica
address: 1 Thanh Nien Road, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: I chose from the a la carte menu: 1 soup, 1 salad and 1 wagu beef steak. The steak is really impressive, soft and delicious, and the degree of doneness is just right. Polite and enthusiastic service, price is about 100 USD/person including mineral water and beer. Highly recommend 👍, We stayed at the Pan Pacific Hanoi from the 23rd Dec 2019 to the 30th Dec 2019. We had breakfast at the place for about 3 times and the rest we upgraded to the club house. The spread of the food is large and they have nice healthy freshly blended fruits and vegetable juices too., I have never encountered a better buffet! Vietnamese, Korean, Japanese, American and other cuisines too numerous to mention. The choices are overwhelming and uniformly delicious! Located off the lobby of the Pan Pacific hotel, the Pacifica can’t be beat!
description: An all-day dining venue with Asian and international buffet as well as a delectable a-la-carte selection, this restaurant provides the perfect backdrop for socializing luncheons as well as relaxing family dinners or romantic dates. The weekend seafood buffet offers a wide array of prawns, oysters, and other fresh seafood.

name: Jinro BBQ
address: Opposite 63 Huynh Thuc Khang, Thanh Cong, Dong Da, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: I had a great lunch with friends here. As a person who loves Korean food, I chose a Korean restaurant with my friends. So great for the taste of Korean when eaten at hanoi, it reminds me of my previous trip to Korea. The space is too small, you should book a table before coming. The staff is agile. Will definitely come back to enjoy the food here😋
