name: Tokyo Red Grill
address: 23 Phan Chu Trinh Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Delicious Japanese dishes in French Quater of Hanoi. It usually crowds in lunchtime caused by many offices out there. But for dinner, it is a very good place which quite and peaceful. Prices are reasonable., this joint is the best sushi I've had in Ha Noi hands down. Its in the middle of n office building which makes for strange ambiance but if you can tuck in with your partner, they have cute private booths where you can enjoy the food and each other <#, Among lots of Japanese restaurants in Hanoi, Tokyo Red Grill can provide a variety of Japanese dishes of best quality in a reasonable price. Sushi is also nice.
description: Delicious Japanese dishes in French Quater of Hanoi. It usually crowds in lunchtime caused by many offices out there. But for dinner, it is a very good place which quite and peaceful. Prices are reasonable.

name: Ngân Đình Hanoi Restaurant
address: 360 Kim Mã 2nd Floor - Hanoi Daewoo Hotel, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Yum Cha buffet lunch…in a fairly new 5 star hotel ! Impressive classy hotel foyer… restaurant has white table clothed tables.. Impressive comfy chairs..and expected classy fit out! It was a “ table buffet”..where U order a Yum Cha dish ,and it is brought to the table..next dish ordered, and the process continues. Order n eat!! Then, I turned over the menu, to discover Cantonese Roast Duck, and a couple of “ side dishes”. We were almost finished when discovering the back page .. so ordered a Roast Duck dish…!!! At first sight, it would have to be the best looking 1/4 Roast Duck, that I have seen to date.( and Cantonese Roast Duck, is my favourite dish !!! Looked absolutely “ perfect colour wise”..but lacked the flavour marinade , that is the epitome of Cantonese Roast Duck! Rate 4/10 The Yum Cha menu, is Very good, basic.(cf HK) no offal or deep fried taro , or savoury dumplings, etc, etc.. but what was available was 7.5/10. The service was a let down.. 3 staff for 5 tables ( 4..5.. and 3x2 diners) They were too occupied doing nothing, and had to virtually shout, to get their attention.. my arm was sore staying up! 3/10..a disgrace !!!, Mongolian food is, shall we say, interesting. It is a little bit Chinese and a little bit Russian and a little bit mutton and potatoes oriented. But here, at Silk Road, we were served a three course lunch (salad, soup, and main) that was a lovely blend of all of the above. It was such a pleasant luncheon and delicious too. The meat wasn't fatty or tough. The soup wasn't too salty. It was quiet inside, and well decorated, and the wait staff was intent on doing their jobs. It was a lovely lunch!, Dimsum was great, around 250.000vnd for a set, they have set A and B, only available for lunch! From 12-2pm everyday
description: Located on the 2nd floor of the iconic Hanoi Daewoo Hotel, Ngan Dinh Hanoi Restaurant celebrates authentic Cantonese cuisine through finest ingredients. From the creative dim sum menu, to a selection of exquisite Chinese delights cooked with style and flair, Executive Chef Li from Hong Kong and the talented culinary team will impress even Hanoi’s most glamorous diners. 08 VIP dining rooms available for private event, business lunch or special occasion.

name: Xoài Đu
address: No 1, Alley 5, Tu Hoa Street The Big Alley 5 And Between Intercontinental Hotel & Kim Lien Pagoda., Tay Ho, Hanoi 11207 Vietnam
reviews: My fr led me to this hidden gem! Though small and a tad slow with the batch cooking, the food was out of this world. The beef noodle salad stole the show - simple, flavorful, and made with fresh ingredients. Must-try in Hanoi!, We had the pleasure of dining at Xoai Du Bistro during our recent stay at the InterContinental Hanoi Westlake. Their beef noodle soup was absolutely delightful, packed with fresh vegetables and a delightful nutty crunch from the peanuts. It's the perfect spot to unwind and enjoy a comforting, home-cooked meal. And for those with vegan preferences, they have a variety of plant-based options available. If you're looking for something a bit more interactive, they host chess gatherings every Sunday and even offer wine and coffee appreciation workshops.Xoai Du Bistro is truly a hidden gem worth seeking out., Everything inside is neat and clean, what makes experience even more enjoyable. Cozy and lovely place to come for a bite to eat (and a drink if you want as well!). Tucked away and quiet spot near the lake. Loads of vegetarian and vegan options of both traditional Vietnamese and other fusion style dishes. Tried my first vegan Bun Bo, huge portion for a good price and really tasty! Staff are so fast with the service, and this place is popular with both locals and tourists.
description: Our service are Vietnamese coffee, cocktail and food. It is a beautiful hideaway and located between Intercontinental Hotel and Kim Lien Pagoda (one of the famous attractions for tourist). Our menu is many creative and delicious drinks. Local beers and ginger beers are must try at our place. Our place is open-air, friendly and great place for you to find a lot activities : Cocktail, Vietnamese Specialty coffee, Chess club, Events, Hand made & High quality products from local...

name: Benaras Terrace Hanoi
address: A 25 Luxury Hotel 684, Minh Khai , Vinh Tuy, Hai Ba Trung, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Delicious food served in a calm and relaxing atmosphere… perfect brake! We loved it! Thanks to all the stuff! We will be back., Wonderful food, wonderful stuff thank you very much food was very tasty. Place was very clean. Great sitting outside watching the world go by., The food was excellent. Staff of the hotel were cooperative Service was also Excellent. Even the manager was very very good taking care of his staff and customers.in whole we are 100 percent satisfied.
description: BENARAS TERRACE: A Taste of Authentic Indian Cuisine in Hanoi BENARAS TERRACE is one of the newest branches in Hanoi of the famous BENARAS Indian restaurant chain in Vietnam. It is the perfect place for food lovers who want to experience the most authentic Indian cuisine. What makes BENARAS TERRACE different? 100% Indian chefs: All dishes are prepared by experienced Indian chefs, ensuring the authenticity of every bite. Natural ingredients: All ingredients are imported directly from India, ensuring freshness and quality. Healthy cooking: BENARAS TERRACE is committed to using no additives, no artificial colors, and healthy cooking methods. The amount of oil is also reduced by 80% to suit the Vietnamese taste. Professional and friendly service: The restaurant is staffed by professional and friendly Indian staff, ensuring a genuine and unique dining experience.

name: Kiez Vegan Cafe & Bistro
address: No. 2A Alley 12 Dang Thai Mai Tay Ho, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: The first day we got there we bought something similar to kebab with bread, it was so good. The bread was crispy and tasted homemade. What was supposed to mimic kebab meat was amazing, really soft and flavorful. I, who usually have a hard time with textures, had no problems with this. Then a hamburger was taken which was served with several different toppings, everything was so good there too. Good "meat" and mix of vegetables. Everything felt carefully selected. The bread was soft on the inside and crispy on the outside. Just from this first dining experience, we have ordered from here every day since we arrived in Hanoi. Everything has been 5/5., I love this place so much! It isn't my first time here😄 Delicious food, yummy beverages- I loved everything I have tried here so far! Also great vegan condiments & vegan products are available. Lovely atmosphere and a warm & welcoming team are always here😻 A heartwarming place with great food ❤️ Thank you so much for being so awesome😍, Ate at Kiez once or twice every week for like two years. Brunch, lunch, dinner, snacks are all fantastic. The staff, owners, and chefs are outstanding. The menu changes every few months so you get great new options constantly. Some of the best vegan flavors you've ever had! The butcher shop variety and chocolate chip cookies are must tries. Thank you Kiez for being consistently the best!
description: Kiez - vegan cafe&bistro is a 100% plant-based, vegan coffee and bistro. We are driven by the motivation of offer a good and diverse alternative of vegan food with a tiny touch of Germany. Our dishes are made fresh, using only high quality ingredients.

name: Quan Bun Cha Nem
address: 25 Gia Ngu Hang Bac, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We went here in a small group with our tour guide. It was busy but we got seated and ordered Bun Cha. It was so tasty, that we will be going back for more! The restaurant is great, the food cooked out front, a great atmosphere, full of life and a fun experience., Hidden in this humble and small eatery is the best bun cha that I have tried during my stay at Hanoi. Had my first bun cha here as this place was strongly recommended by the hotel staff. I then tried bun cha at other places as well but I had to come back here because they really have the best taste. The pork and bacon were charcoal-grilled to perfection! Will definitely come back again next time!, This small restaurant is all about bun cha and there is a reason it can get crowded, it simply has fantastic bun cha. We were recommended by our hotel and were so glad we went. Delicious yet cheap. We had bun cha and ordered the crispy spring rolls to go with it. All were delicious and fresh. They even have ice cold drinks. While locals are the vast majority that eat here, they love foreigners and recently even added English to the small menu.
description:
We went here in a small group with our tour guide.
It was busy but we got seated and ordered Bun Cha.
It was so tasty, that we will be going back for more! The restaurant is great, the food cooked out front, a great atmosphere, full of life and a fun experience.

name: Tropicana Restaurant
address: 23 Dao Duy Tu Hang Buom, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Hi. Had beef spaghetti in dinner at this place. Its a nice place just next to the street and has a good vibe to it. Food is delicious with reasonable prices. Drinks are good too. Their staff is very courteous especially this lively female Poppy, who is very nice and tries her best to ensure that you enjoy a good meal. Good place to be at for friends, family, business or solo, The pizza here is very good and the Prices are reasonable. Especially considering that there aren't many places for Pasta and Pizza around than you might think. Poppy the friendly waitress was very kind and the service was also good., We had a very nice dinner here. We had pasta and pizza. Both very well prepared and tasty. We also had the local beer which was very good. The prices are excellent! We where attended by Poppy and she was very nice and friendly. The local also has a very nice terrace to enjoy the view of the area. I would totally recommend this place and surely come back!
description: Hi. Had beef spaghetti in dinner at this place. Its a nice place just next to the street and has a good vibe to it. Food is delicious with reasonable prices. Drinks are good too. Their staff is very courteous especially this lively female Poppy, who is very nice and tries her best to ensure that you enjoy a good meal. Good place to be at for friends, family, business or solo

name: CCraft Beer Restaurant  -  45A Luong Ngoc Quyen
address: 45A Luong Ngoc Quyen Street, Hang Buom Ward, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Large selection of both on tap and bottled craft beers. Cheap prices. Surprised this isn't more popular, He came here around 6pm and we were the only patrons- which was surprising- all the tourists were at the the bigger joints drinking Hoeegaarden and other bottled beers. We picked this beer garden because it offered Craft beer and boy were we surprised. It was amazing! We told the bar tender what type of beer we liked and she let us taste test a few before picking our beer. It really was the best beer in Vietnam or even Best beer in the world! More people should come and enjoy local beer- not the commercial stuff!!, I have tested 6 kinds of beers with the name of old streets as Hang Bac, Hang Bo, Hang Ngang, Hang Dao, Hang Bong and Nga Tu Quoc Te. Very excited place, a lot of people enjoy together in the crossroads of Ta Hien and Luong Ngoc Quyen Str. That’s real funny, but when you are falling in love of Ha noi, you must to try 🍺😀🥰 Cheers!
description: The Vietnamese authentic taproom More than 50 types of C-Brewmaster craft beer Real Vietnamese foods

name: La Bete
address: Alley 431 Au Co Nhat Tan, Tay Ho, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Good for me and my friends. I love steak here, the dry aged meat is so delicious. I will comeback soon. The space is also beautiful and suitable for dating, I think this is best dryaged steak in hanoi I've tried. It's the first restaurant dryaged about fish, Nice steak restaurant in the alley of Au co. Very nice atmosphere, quiet and friendly staff. Aged-beef was provided and it was nice. Starters and salad was very sophisticated and nice. One negative point was less dessert menu and no espresso to finish the dinner. But this is the steakhouse, enjoy the protein.
description: Specialist in dry aging beef, lamb and pork (Wild Boar) . We are serving full range of dryaged beef from USDA Prime to Premium Hereford and Wagyu. Our pork is sourced from moutains of Northern Vietnam where they raised in a huge farm and running freely.

name: Hai Cang Noi Bai Restaurant
address: Noi Bai International Airport 4th Floor, Terminal 2, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Airport restaurants come in all sizes and standards. Hai Cang at Noi Bai airport is definitely not the worst I have been to. My partner chose a Pho bo-beef noodle soup and was happy with that. I had a Ca chien kieu Anh and cannot complain. Ha Noi beer to go with it. .The staff was there but more interested in chatting to each other than caring for their guests. All in all, not the worst airport experience. Next time I will try one of the other restaurants at the airport. There must be something better!, Good Vietnamese food at a reasonable price in an airport. Very clean restaurant. English not so much. No Coke -Pepsi. Would eat hear again., If you look like a Vietnamese, and started speaking English to the staff, they will start their bullying like assuming that you could not pronounce "hot" when you really meant "pot", and refuse to serve you as fast as those who did not look like Vietnamese. Not all of them were like that, some of them were nice, but those staffs who were not bullies were forced to apologize on behalf of those who were, thus an average 3 rating, otherwise, it would be 1 rating only. But why risk spoiling your mood with bullies working here, especially when you are honestly a different nationality but look like Vietnamese? To the restaurant, you might want to teach these bully staffs how to behave so that it is fair to your other nice staffs and fair to the customers as well.
description: Serving business lunch and delicious fast food that is inspired Vietnamese – European style and Hai Cang specialties, Hai Cang Noi Bai is suitable and convenient for quick and busy. Hai Cang Restaurant has an area of over 500 m2 and modern decoration with brown – yellow interior that is cosy, luxury and elegant, gives fantastic culinary space at Noi Bai International Airport.

name: Hummingbird Craft Beer Restaurant & Brunch
address: 56B Tran Quoc Toan, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Popped in here with a friend for dinner on a Tues evening after work, it was very quiet. It was my first visit here and I loved the decor, it was just a shame it was lacking atmosphere. It was happy hour so we enjoyed 2for1 draft beers and shared two plates of food. The chicken nachos were fairly average, if it didn't have the tiny cubes of bland chicken meat it would have actually been better! However the lamb and flatbread with dips was simply delicious. The lamb was cooked beautifully and went very well with a skewer of chargrillwd vegetables, and I would happily order that again., 100% worth a visit if you are craving western food or are starting to get a bit bored with Vietnamese food for breakfast, lunch and dinner. The food is truly amazing, as is the service from both the owner and the front of house waiter. We never repeat restaurant on holiday but came back a second time which was just as good., Great cocktail bar in the heart of Hanoi. Cocktails were stunning, beer was delicious and ice cold. The music and ambiance was perfect. Also the cool smelt and looked incredible (although we had already eaten). Will be back to try. Also we loved Frank!!
description: A cozy craft beer restaurant & bar serving up BBQ comfort food; BBQ ribs, chicken wings, chargrilled chicken, wraps, rice bowls, burgers, nachos, lamb kebabs & brunch.

name: The Kneipe
address: 52 to Ngoc Van Str. Tay ho Dist, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Really nice band, nice German dishes, really good burgers. Good options of Draft beers and very good service from the attendants. Good experience!, Came here for the first time for an early dinner, it was a little odd being the only people in the bar, but like like said we were eating early We both ordered the curry sausages with a side each, mine was mash which was tasty and my husband had the side of potatoes and bacon which he enjoyed too, the other side of purple cabbage that came with the dish was tasty but I think would have been better warm not cold. For me the absolute standout was their pretzels, perfect blend of salty and doughy and I would come back again and again for those! Can't comment on th bar atmosphere on a typical evening but they played skme great chilled out music while we were there, Not a bad option for german food while taste is not super great for their homemade sausage and sauerkraut. Singer on thursday 6-8pm available. Cozy place for a drink too
description: A modern German- American pub with authentic German food and some fusion. Atmosphere is nice and cozy with classic Rock and Roll music background which brings you back to the good old day. Live music at weekends and catering in site or outside is available.

name: Odeon Brasserie
address: 5 Tran Phu Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We had the warmest of welcomes at this comfortable and friendly bar. The manager is helpful and chatty and her team are kind, caring and attentive. We made friends with Linh who we spent lovely hours talking to over a couple of visits. Linh's English is amazing and puts our non-existent Vietnamese to shame! She is an outstanding member of the team. I can't recommend this place highly enough for a relaxing drink and to watch the world go by., What a great find. A bar/bistro on the edge of the Old Quarter with chill, unpretentious atmosphere, an amicable staff, and an impressive selection of whiskeys and beers. I happened on this place because it’s close to my hotel and paid a return visit because it’s got such a great vibe. Five stars., We were in Hanoi for 4 days, staying in a hotel nearby. We came in here on the first night we arrived because it was close and I am so glad we did. They make fantastic cocktails and a good selection of Vietnamese craft beer. We liked it so much we ended up coming every day we were here, later discovering that it is a great place to watch the hustle and bustle of Hanoi and to see the train passing down Train Street. The food here is also of astounding quality, the atmosphere is relaxed and the staff are extremely friendly. If you're looking for somewhere to chill out for a few hours, have a nice bite to eat, a few drinks, and watch the world go by I don't think there's a better place in Hanoi.
description: Come to ODEON and enjoy typical French Brasserie atmosphere in Hanoi.

name: Bella Vita Italian Restaurant
address: 48 Tô Ngọc Vân, Quảng An, Tây Hồ, Hà Nội, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Brilliant spot serving a great range of real Italian food. We had some drinks and anti-pasti followed by some steak. Honestly the best fillet steak I have eaten in Hanoi. Cooked on a real fire. Normally I much prefer rib eye but this was so tender and full of flavour. He also tried the cocktails which were very good. There is a beautiful dining room but we chose to sit in the cosy outside area., My husband and I ate here our last night in Hanoi towards the end of the Lunar New Year and we were thrilled they were open. The food was delicious as was the wine and we loved the atmosphere., Amazing food. If you want to get in Hanoi original Italian burrata and pasta which is made in from of you by Italian owner with excelent taste this is the best place to go
description: Brilliant spot serving a great range of real Italian food. We had some drinks and anti-pasti followed by some steak. Honestly the best fillet steak I have eaten in Hanoi. Cooked on a real fire. Normally I much prefer rib eye but this was so tender and full of flavour. He also tried the cocktails which were very good. There is a beautiful dining room but we chose to sit in the cosy outside area.

name: Banh My PaTe
address: 11 Hang Ca Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Good variety of Banh Mi here at good prices, mostly around VND 25,000. Banh Mi toasted crispy. You can sit on the small stools and watch people go by., This is the place you want to go to have Banh Mii... At the street, next to the famous "Banh Mii 25"...has no comparison. Delicious local ingredients, and THE BEST PATE EVER!! so cheap as well, you can have 2 , 3, you can't stop eating. I have been here so many times I can't count, Best Bahn mi in Hanoi. I have tried Bahn Mi 25 and this one was my favourite. Authentic local Bahn mi place for the proper Vietnamese street food experience.
description: Traditional Vietnamese sandwich with over 30 years of history. Vietnamese sandwich or another name called “pate bread” have mix dishes like eggs, hotdog, vegetables. The crispy hot crust, delicious fillings. Vietnamese people eat pate bread every day at every meal. Street food is extremely cheap, only about 1 USD for one. Traditional Vietnamese flavors that you can not miss when coming to Hanoi.

name: Quán Abc
Huyen Dung Restaurant
address: 4 Ly Thai To Street, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We searching for a local Vietnamese restaurant and we found restaurant by accident. Many choices of food, rice, noodle, hotpot, salad with a reasonable price. English menu is available and staffs can speak english, This place is the one if you want something that is clean and done in a prober kitchen. Nice staff - with a prober menu card - and food is average but better than soooo many other places on the street. Prices are defiantly reasonable - and shopping just outside the door., This place is small but the customers love it as there are testimonials all over the walls. I watched my pho cooked immediately out front of the restaurant and it was served as I sat down. It was excellent, even on a stiflingly hot day.
description: Located in the center of the Old quarter of Hanoi, right near the Hoan Kiem Lake.The restaurant offers high quality of Vietnamese food, for every pocket's budget. In the restaurant you can enjoy our family and friendly atmosphere: most of our costumers are regular costumers. We invite you to try our traditional food, made to the top quality everyday !

name: Bia ZUBR
address: 103 Nguyen Truong To, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Turned into our local bar while in Hanoi for 3 days. Great selection of beers,snacks, never tried the full food menu to be honest. But a great watering hole,owner very helpful and friendly along with a happy and cheerful staff. Recommend highly if your in the area., Taste is almost like in the Czech republic. Dumplings could be thicker. Small portion for the price. Great draft beer 65k for 500 ml. Good wifi and possible to pay by card. On menu I missed svickova. (Vegetable, cream sauce), The Czech beer is quite good, as you would expect. We tried the salami appetizer, and it was pretty good. Three of us had the chicken schnitzel and I had the pork schnitzel. I would say it was decent food. The chicken was more successful than my pork, which I found too heavily breaded, a little greasy, and the breading didn't stick well to the meat. It was a nice change from all the Asian food.
description: Turned into our local bar while in Hanoi for 3 days. Great selection of beers,snacks, never tried the full food menu to be honest. But a great watering hole,owner very helpful and friendly along with a happy and cheerful staff. Recommend highly if your in the area.

name: Chef Dzung's BBQ & Hotpot buffet
address: Level 2, No 71 Nguyen Chi Thanh, Lang Ha, Dong Da, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: We went to Chef Dzung with friends on a weekend to eat the dinner buffet on the 3rd floor. There were too many people, narrow and there was too much noise. The price is acceptable for the quality. Food was fresh, service was quite good. If I get a chance to go there again, i'll go., Went here on my bday with my boyfriend. The price is same as other buffet grill restaurant in town. The food is ok seafood isn't fresh, nothing special compare to other restaurant (same type). The service is fine; however, some staffs when we called they just ignored us. Should give it a try., This restaurant serves various foods for buffet (raw and cooked seafood, meat, soups, deserts, salads, Vietnamese traditional food...)
description: We went to Chef Dzung with friends on a weekend to eat the dinner buffet on the 3rd floor. There were too many people, narrow and there was too much noise. The price is acceptable for the quality. Food was fresh, service was quite good. If I get a chance to go there again, i'll go.

name: Quán Cơm Tay Cầm
address: Số 5 Ngõ Tràng Tiền, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Delicious food gives the warm feeling of a family meal - the restaurant is delicious, reasonably priced, clean. Most impressive, the owner is also a friendly and likable chef, the music is gentle and suitable for the warm space. I will come back and introduce my friends to the restaurant to enjoy other dishes, Simple but clean place, very central. Attentive service, although not very multilingual. A good start with spring rolls with original filling, then a vegetable soup to introduce the next dish of spaghetti (rice?) with seafood which we were unable to finish due to the quantity. All for less than €8 for two!, This was a tremendous meal - a real find on a back street. Chinese influenced Vietnamese - fried rice with chicken, caramelized fish, steamed water spinach. Small and unassuming. Kudos to the US Embassy advance staff, who presumably found it for a visit by the US Secretary of State. We are only in Vietnam for a short visit but we are definitely going back to this gem of a restaurant before we leave.
description: Delicious food gives the warm feeling of a family meal - the restaurant is delicious, reasonably priced, clean. Most impressive, the owner is also a friendly and likable chef, the music is gentle and suitable for the warm space. I will come back and introduce my friends to the restaurant to enjoy other dishes

name: Restaurant Binh 86
address: Gom Nhat Tan Street Thai Phu, Noi Bai Airport, Soc Son, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant was suggested by our hotel, Airport Classic Hotel, which was nearby. I had the grilled shrimp with salt and chili, which was delicious. My wife had roasted chicken with ginger, which was good but my shrimp was better. I drank draft beer that was tasty and very cold. The staff was very attentive and friendly, and the prices were very reasonable. We ate quite early and by the time we were finished, many locals were there. Give it a try!, We came here as it was close to the airport classic hotel that we stayed in the night before returning to UK. it is a family run restaurant and very popular with the locals. It serves cheap draught beer which was very good. The staff found a couple of westerners in the restaurant quite amusing I think judging by the looks we were getting, but they also were very pleasant and did their best to look after us. The menu is also for locals with dishes that you will not see in the tourist areas of Vietnam, chickens feet, toad and bile secretion to name but a few. There were more usual dishes too, we had a chicken dish and some rice and chips which were good. I should add that the prices were extremely cheap, We were expecting a restaurant with pizza and fruit smoothies per another review, so perhaps that review belongs elsewhere since they serve neither. Extensive menu, almost too many choices. Once we were there we couldn’t leave with so few other choices around the airport. There were lots of locals by the time we left and it seemed like a popular place for draft beer. We enjoyed the grilled shrimp with chili although not much flavor on its own. Nice to have an English menu and Google translate helped. Friendly staff but not one of our better meals in the past three weeks in Vietnam.
description: Located in a prime location near Noi Bai International Airport, The Restaurant Binh 86 is an ideal destination for diners to rest and relax after tired flights or prepare for business trips away from home Interesting tour. Traditional space, open design with a diverse menu bringing together famous chefs in Vietnam, building a menu of delicious delicacies promising to be a restaurant near noi bai

name: Nhà Hàng Nhật Toshi Fusion
address: 26 Trần Hưng Đạo, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Skilled and smiling staff who introduced and cooked the menu of fresh ingredients and cow meat at the table for One Pot. A fantastically lovely experience. In addition, appetizers and an aperitif at the house's expense., The place so Japanese, the food is good, the service also good and enough, all fresh seafood and vegetables. Enjoying Japanese food in vietnam, My family and I had dinner here and the staffs were very supportive. All dishes were nicely decorated! Especially the sashimi, fresh and delicious 👍🏻
description: Skilled and smiling staff who introduced and cooked the menu of fresh ingredients and cow meat at the table for One Pot. A fantastically lovely experience. In addition, appetizers and an aperitif at the house's expense.

name: Delisa - Fresh Salad Bar Hanoi
address: 8A Ly Dao Thanh Street, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Delicious, fresh, generous portion of salad and a lovely smoothie. The restaurant is light and clean with mellow gentle music. Service was with a smile and a well set out menu that was easy to understand. Everything about this little restaurant was good. Unfortunately I ate my food before writing this, so no photo, Very good food, fresh and delicious. The only bad thing it’s that smells a little like fish (my mother doesn’t eat seafood) and the entrance is not to clearly pointed., spectacular! delicious and very fast! would come back everyday. Clean, fast, fresh! Good price quality. We love it!
description: Delisa aims to satisfy the crave of not only salad lovers in Hanoi but also those who want to enjoy healthy and delicious food but lack time to prepare them. We use fresh ingredients, traditional recipe, and homemade sauce to give you an authentic taste. All food is made with love and care of the owner and Chef. We have a wide range variety of salad, wholegrain baguette, and smoothies for you to enjoy.

name: Che Ba Thin
address: 1 Bat Dan Quan Hoan Kiem, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: The best sweet soup in Hanoi old quarter! I love "Xoi che" most. Even it's not cheap like other Vietnamese sweet soup, but its taste is very good. Foreign visitors should try it!, Unassuming stall here have been serving Che, a form of Vietnamese dessert since 1930. The menu changes according to seasons. Hot day like this you will want to stop for a bowl of che or if you like, you can mix everything in a cup with ice. The main ingredients are mung beans, grated coconut, and kidney beans. Stop by and sit on the stool like the locals or have it on the go., Came to know about this dessert shop on TripAdvisor and I tried it when I was in Hanoi. Staff couldn't understand English so I show him a photo of the dessert which I want. I sat on a stool by the roadside to eat the bowl of bean, sticky rice, coconut, ginger with some sweet sauce added to it. It is surprisingly nice! Highly recommended!
description: The best sweet soup in Hanoi old quarter! I love "Xoi che" most. Even it's not cheap like other Vietnamese sweet soup, but its taste is very good.  Foreign visitors should try it!

name: Minh´s Family Cooking
address: 2D Ta Hien Street, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Great experience, in the middel of beer street. We tryed the meat BBQ and a couple of beer, costed us 280.000. Staff friendly, and gave us a hand, since it was our first time trying it. Great taste., This place was absolutely delicious.. We ventured back twice (something we don't usually do) as we really enjoyed it, can't rate this place highly enough, A great place to go for authentic food in the heart of the Old Quarter. It specialises in hotpot and barbecue. We had the seafood hotpot - great value at 200,000 for two. Delicious, fresh, quick and cheap. Very good friendly service and lively street atmosphere.
description: Great experience, in the middel of beer street. We tryed the meat BBQ and a couple of beer, costed us 280.000. Staff friendly, and gave us a hand, since it was our first time trying it. Great taste.

name: Nguyen Sinh
address: 17 Ly Quoc Su, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: This shop seems to be around for a long time. As usual, they don't welcome you in but you just need to step in. They will hand over the menu to you. The beef steak is above average but the price you paid, it is decent. The banh mi and pate was better though slightly pricy., We ordered a simple banh mi and they ended up brining us the most expensive one on the card. Well, we ate it anyways and it was very good but compared to the customer service i would recommend other banh mi places that serve a bigger variety and have friendly staff., The first banh mi I had here was good. The bread was really great and the pate was really good. I mean really good pate. My first sandwich had a decent amount of meat. I return two other times and got less meat each time. That was a disappointment.
description: This shop seems to be around for a long time. As usual, they don't welcome you in but you just need to step in. They will hand over the menu to you. The beef steak is above average but the price you paid, it is decent. The banh mi and pate was better though slightly pricy.

name: Trau Ngon Quan
address: 15 Lê Văn Thiêm, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: it seems doing well with water buffalo meat chain Trau Ngon Quan. There are many of them now in Hanoi. We got to this place with a tip that this offers local draft beer (Bia Hơi). As usual, it's local beer joint type restaurant. Very large open place, very crowded. lots of people, very noisy. zô zô everywhere 🤣🤣🤣. as usual, all the disks are very dilicious. draft beer was nice. prices were not so expensive. Staffs were friendly. will be back.
description:
it seems doing well with water buffalo meat chain Trau Ngon Quan. There are many of them now in Hanoi. We got to this place with a tip that this offers local draft beer (Bia Hơi).

As usual, it's local beer joint type restaurant. Very large open place, very crowded. lots of people, very noisy. zô zô everywhere 🤣🤣🤣.

as usual, all the disks are very dilicious. draft beer was nice.

prices were not so expensive. Staffs were friendly.

will be back.

name: Cha Ca Lao Ngu Restaurant
address: 171, Thai Ha Street, Lang Ha Ward, Dong Da District, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Definitely one of the best "Cha ca" restaurant in town with very reasonable price. also with quick service and nice staff., I have visited this place more than 3 times during a week as it offers best Hanoi grilled fish. Unlike other restaurants serving similar dishes, it also serves fish congee and fried fish rolls. These dishes must be tried at all cost. The price is reasonable. Service is fine. However it is often packed with guests at noon time. Make sure you phone to the restaurant to for booking first and try to be on time. The old owner seems to be grumpy to late comers :-), Hanoi is famous with many special food, one of that is ‘Cha Ca’. In Hanoi, there are several restaurants famous for Cha Ca such as La Vong, Thang Long, Lao Ngu, Gia Ngu. I had tried 3 of 4 restaurants above and Lao Ngu is one of my most fav restaurant. The grilled fish is very fresh, the shrimp paste is delicious & suit your taste 😍 Also after the meal, u will be served tofu & hot green tea to remove the smell of shrimp paste, only at Lao Ngu u’ll experience this :)
description: Definitely one of the best "Cha ca" restaurant in town with very reasonable price. also with quick service and nice staff.

name: Bay Buffet Restaurant
address: 167 Hoang Ngan Cau Giay Dist., Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Fresh, taste ok! Friendly staffs always crowded! The car park is a little bit far! Reasonable price!, Stepped in by chance, crowded with families , you find more or less all food you can find in 5 star venues in good quality, mainly seafood and sushi, salads , fruits , price was 380.000 total. Drinks extra. If you are hungry this place is ok, has some food court atmosphere . Prefer for lunch ., We’ve been there for a company function with our Hanoi team. Ideal for functions with many participants and good and large selection of dishes. Reasonable priced for the services received
description: Located in most beautiful location in urban Trung Hoa Nhan Chinh - golden land of Hanoi and Tay Ho, Bay Buffet Restaurant with modern space, impressive design promises to be one of the interesting options for gourmet taste. With more hundreds of dishes tasty, delicate, made from the skillful hands of professional chefs and service quality, Bay buffet is ideal location to organize large and small events, or simply just as the family, friend reunion dinner. Come to the Bay buffet to experience and discover a unique space!

name: Dim Sum Corner
address: 182 Hang Bong Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Don't waste your time. Other dimsun restaurant nearby was busy so we tried this place. Nicely decorated with Hong Kong and Bruce Lee memorabilia. Got to table waited about 5 minutes for a menu. Finally ordered dumplings and sweet corn soup. Dumplings were nothing special and soup was too sweet. The bill for 9 Dumplings and soup was over 200 VND. Atmosphere was cold, staff couldn't have cared less if we were there or not. Had to get there attention for the bill. There was only 1 other group. Go elsewhere for a better meal and experience., The dim sum is really good here. Service was a bit slow but friendly. We loved the spicy wontons and steamed shrimp dumplings., We had a variety of Steamed Dumplings. So fresh and tasty, we actually watched them making a fresh batch. Not much ambience, very busy however service was quick, food excellent and prices very affordable.
description: Best dim sum in town. Serving noodle in Saigon's style as well.

name: Kaiba
address: 16 Phan Chu Trinh Str. Hoan Kiem Dist, Ha Noi Rooftop Corner Stone Building., Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant is located on the rooftop of the office building. The space is spacious and airy, with a super beautiful garden. The food is authentic Japanese. Diverse menu. There is a delicious puffer fish dish here, but you have to order it in advance. If you come and not order in advance, it won't be enough. I recommend Ozaki beef. The staff introduced it as a premium beef. The meat is tender and juicy and delicious. Attentive service, extremely thoughtful hostess. In general, this is my favorite restaurant and I always recommend it to friends and partners., The food is delicious. I often eat Japanese food, so the food here is very Japanese, and the fish is also fresh. The garden space is airy, sitting outside is better than sitting in a private room. The staff are also attentive and enthusiastic. In general, I like my stomach, the food overall tasted really good because they use fresh products. this is a high end quality fish with the prices not so high. we went there 2 times. once with a group of friends at night outside. and it was a great vibe with nice breeze. another time was at lunch with their lunch set. this place is for everyone. family and business or even friends.
description: Kaiba sushi is a Japanse restaurant being well-known for: All ingredients and seasonal fishes are flesh and directly imported from Japan. Food are made under skillful hands of chef and cooks with years of experience. Ensuring food safety.

name: Pho Hanh
address: 65 Lan Ong, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We loved this restaurant which is tucked away down an alley. They only serve one dish and it is excellent. We will be going back again! It was full of locals 👍🏻, Ended The Night With The Beautiful Street Of The Famous Local Vietnamese Delicacy Of “White Kampung Chicken” With “Keuy Teow” White Chicken On The Street Along Old Quarters ☺️ Thankful to Carter Chadway for bringing us around the street of Hanoi ☺️, If you blink, you will miss the entrance to this excellent pho place. Opens at 6PM....so the small tables and stools are set up on the sidewalk in front the front and across the street. Or you can go down this narrow alleyway/corridor to some interior tables. Their specialty is 'pho ga'.....chicken pho in soup or the dry variety. I was lucky to find this little hidden gem and you should seek it out also if you wish to experience real authentic pho.
description: We loved this restaurant which is tucked away down an alley. They only serve one dish and it is excellent. We will be going back again! It was full of locals 👍🏻

name: 1915Y Grille6 Restaurant
address: 54 Trung Hoa Cau Giay, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Lovely staff, really great food. Thanks for making our first meal in Vietnam so amazing! The ambiance was really good as well, sit upstairs!, After the commantaire's so kind people leave the reviews on the 1915y restaurant, I want to eat well so I went to dinner, it was really delicious !!! a green mango salad, cold rolls, a tender green pepper beef on a hot plate and to finish a superb fish dish prepared in 4dischs and green leaves had an amazing taste of oyster flavors. a carrot juice and two beers. all this costs 1155000 dong, = 45 € for 3 people, with friends, we can not take desserts, eat too much. To recommend this restaurant and a young master hotel Mr van is too kind as the other hostesses are so helpful. all give off the charms of Hanoi ..., On my daughter's birthday. My family came this restaurant to have a small party here. The foods were delicious with traditional lavour. The staffs were very polite and religious. I think this place suit for meeting friends, couples and family. The price suit for everyone.
description: Lovely staff, really great food. Thanks for making our first meal in Vietnam so amazing! The ambiance was really good as well, sit upstairs!

name: My Oshi 03
address: Số 9 Ngõ 25 Triệu Việt Vương, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: The food in this place is outstanding. We are expats in Hanoi and we come here once a week and to be honest that's not enough. I can't even recommend something to eat as everything is so tasty (but curry chicken ramen is a personal favourite) excellent service, outstanding value, great portions and all round treat of a place to come. Make sure you're hungry!!! It's worth taking a 10min grab from the old quarter to experience in my opinion Hanoi's best Ramen., Best place to get ramen and Japanese curry with a very reasonable price as well! I've visited many ramen places across Hanoi and this restaurant cannot be beat.You can tell the head chef/owner is passionate and cares about each dish. My favorite is the miso ramen which had a rich flavor while not being too salty like others I've tried. The noodles are very filling and delicious! I've recommended this to many people I know and taken my friends on multiple occasions. Must try!!, Second time eating here. Service is great and the staff are extremely friendly and the Ramen is even better.
description: The food in this place is outstanding. We are expats in Hanoi and we come here once a week and to be honest that's not enough. I can't even recommend something to eat as everything is so tasty (but curry chicken ramen is a personal favourite) excellent service, outstanding value, great portions and all round treat of a place to come. Make sure you're hungry!!! It's worth taking a 10min grab from the old quarter to experience in my opinion Hanoi's best Ramen.

name: Ministry of Men Concept Lounge
address: 44 Ly Thuong Kiet, Tran Hung Dao, Hoan Kiem Melia Hanoi Hotel, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Ended up coming here twice this week. Had a social group Tues which is the first time I had been here, and all of us ladies were impressed with the bar, decor and friendly staff. So much so a few of us were persuaded to go back on Friday night for a free flow prosecco evening they were having which was so much fun. Friday evenings are busy though so possibly best to book a table in advance., The music and light are so awesome, i’m so into the signature cocktails and cigars. Service is the best. I love the atmostphere at here, Good, cool design and friendly staff. Recommend to try new experience. There is a library inside but unfortunately there a event so hopefully we can visit next time
description:
Ended up coming here twice this week. Had a social group Tues which is the first time I had been here, and all of us ladies were impressed with the bar, decor and friendly staff.

name: BeTo Bistro and Tealounge
address: 1B Hai Ba Trung Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: great service, nice dishes, calm and cozy place. absolutely visit again! 모든 것이 잘 정돈된 레스토랑입니다. 음식이 맛있었고, 응대도 빠르며 훌륭합니다. 인테리어도 깔끔하고 산뜻해서 가족 모두 만족한 브런치타임이었어요!, Stopped here for lunch with family of 5. English menu available we had steak / ribs/ special rice with chicken. Good portions although rather too much sauce on the steak. Delicious cocktails too. Entrance hidden behind a large food stall., The restaurant ambience is typical local. The food is good ( their speciality as beef are good) The Personal is playing with their phone instead of doing the service witch is pity because can be a very good place. The place is on the first floor

name: King BBQ Hai Ba Trung
address: 20 Hai Ba Trung Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Meats bbq perfectly by staff who can speak Chinese. Very satisfied with service of a 20years old waitress that recommended us on what to order from our buffet menu. My family enjoyed our dinner., we had fun, beer and BBQ. staff was friendly. let us stay longer than opening hours. Korean style but finally we can get hot chilli, The men and women here are friendly and also the service is fantastic. One of the better locations for BBQ around Hoan Kiem Lake. Thank you King BBQ for the entire great experience.
description: King BBQ is the brand of a Korean barbecue restaurant chain developed by Redsun-ITI Corporation bringing original Korean cuisine to Vietnamese customers. What makes the difference from these other restaurants is the food, especially Korean popular barbeque beef made by 40-year-experienced Korean Chef Park Sung Min.

name: Green Inn - Plant-based Restaurant
address: 41 Hàng Nón, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: The outside made us want to dine in this restaurant. We did the right thing. The welcome was very good. Being 8 people, we found a table in a quiet place. The mushrooms in donuts were excellent. For dessert we asked for fresh fruit that was not on the menu. We had 3 different kinds of fruit. Very good experience in a vegetarian restaurant for carnivores., I found this restaurant by coincidence and it was the last and also by far the best meal during my four weeks in Vietnam. I went to the lunch buffet that takes place 3 times a week and the all vegan food was amazing. The best Pho in my life, phantastic choise of vegetables, mock fish and meat, even desert. 95.000 Duong including green tea! Everything had a different and unique taste. I took another portion away for a friend and they were extremely generous by giving me all kind of food containers. I just wish I had discovered this restaurant on my first day in Hà Noi., The restaurant creates a peaceful ambiance, even though it is situated in one of the most bustling areas of Hanoi. The cuisine is delightful, healthy, and cooked with minimal oil, making it both satisfying and easy to digest. What's even better is the reasonable price (we have three girls and order 5 dishes and 3 drinks). Strongly recommend !
description: A Haven In The Heart Of Hanoi. Located on Hang Non Street, bustling in the heart of Hanoi, Green Inn always strives to create a sense of tranquility and gentleness for diners when they come to enjoy their meal. Like a sanctuary for vegetarian souls seeking tranquility amidst the bustling and crowded Old Quarter, Green Inn serves as a place for those looking for peace in the heart of the lively ancient streets. As you step through that small wooden door, it seems like all the noise has been left behind. Bringing Vietnamese Culinary Culture To Foreigners. Green Inn not only aims to promote the growing popularity of vegetarianism among everyone but also hopes that foreign guests, who follow a vegetarian diet, can still enjoy traditional Vietnamese dishes. That's why Green Inn aims to offer Vietnamese dishes with familiar and refined flavors. All vegetarian dishes at Green Inn are inspired by traditional Vietnamese cuisine, adjusted to suit different palates.

name: Banh Mi Zoon - Bami Bread
address: 33 Ngo Huyen Str Hang Trong Ward, Hoan Kiem Dist, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: It is good to taste the cake here. The menu offers a wide variety of sandwiches that you can order or choose from. The food is reasonably priced., The sandwiches at this place are hard to beat. The menu offers many custom made sandwiches you won't find elsewhere. Price is equal to other places., We had the pork/pate banh mi and it was by far the most delicious enjoyed to date. Even better, there were no issues with my hubby's "delicate" tummy.
description: We are one of the best restaurants in Hanoi. Our Banh Mi (Vietnamese Bread) are most special about taste, materials, etc and famoust with foreign travelers who come to Hanoi. We make sure will bring all best quality of Vietnamese breads to our customers. Please come for enjoying our Banh Mi !

name: Long Phung Restaurant
address: Rd Hoang Dao Thuy 2nd Floor, 29T2 Tower, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: I was recommended this restaurant by a friend but I was totally disappointed. Service is not good, the waitress, at least the one who served us was not happy and conscientious. Most of the dishes are very oily and heavy as Chinese cooking style, but the seasoning is good enough. Space is quite small, and environment is very noisy (due to the guests)., Not very good, bad sausage, rice okay, chicken, beef not good, soup a little better. If I go again, I won't go, not delicious, expensive, few dishes, bad. General opinion.
description: The Chinese Cuisine has long been famous around the world. With its thousand-year history, the art of Chinese cooking is saturated with cultural impacts and uniqueness. Learning from its neighbours’ cookery, Long Phung Restaurant with its finest Chinese chefs, working with passionate, creative Vietnamese cooks, creates an interesting mix of Chinese dishes that can satisfy the Vietnamese’s palette.

name: Pho Vui
address: 25 Hang Giay Hang Buom, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant is located in the busy area of the Old Quarters Hanoi near the busy Beer Street area. Family-run business. This is one of the local foodie blogger's favorites. The large stock pot simmering in an open kitchen. Plastic tables with low stools spread out on the sidewalk. I ordered the Jumbo Special bowl. It is topped with sliced beef, fatty briskets. The broth is clear but beefy very rich taste, on the sweet side, and must be for simmering the beef bones and bone marrow. Squeeze some lime, add chile and some pickled garlic to take it up another notch. Make sure to order the quay, the fried chinese donut and dip it in. You can order lemon tea and some strong coffee from the lady across and she will bring it to your table. The lady is happy with a smile and made sure that I enjoyed my bowl. Well-maintained and clean., As a westerner with over 75 trips to Hanoi and my favorite cuisine being Pho Bo, I feel somewhat now ready to give this review. I have eaten hundreds of bowls of Pho Bo around Hanoi over the past 15 years and many bowls at Pho Vui, the happy pho place. They have the best. It is without question my favourite. I go back, and back and back again. Consistent every time and beautiful 😍, I order big mix beef pho on 12h pm, the portion is bigger than I thing. Its really delisious flavorful and alot of topping . Highly recommend for all guy visiting Hanoi
description:
The restaurant is located in the busy area of the Old Quarters Hanoi near the busy Beer Street area. Family-run business. This is one of the local foodie blogger's favorites.

The large stock pot simmering in an open kitchen. Plastic tables with low stools spread out on the sidewalk. I ordered the Jumbo Special bowl. It is topped with sliced beef, fatty briskets. The broth is clear but beefy very rich taste, on the sweet side, and must be for simmering the beef bones and bone marrow. You can order lemon tea and some strong coffee from the lady across and she will bring it to your table.

The lady is happy with a smile and made sure that I enjoyed my bowl. Well-maintained and clean.

name: Buffet Poseidon Times City
address: Hầm B1, Tttm Vincom Mega Mall Times City, 458 Minh Khai, Hai Bà Trưng,, Hanoi Vietnam
description: Buffet Poseidon is the largest chain of hotpot, BBQ, and seafood buffet restaurants in Vietnam. Inspired by Poseidon, the Greek god of the sea, the brand is dedicated to bringing a diverse and exquisite culinary experience to all diners. At Poseidon, guests can enjoy a lavish selection of over 200 meticulously crafted dishes, with premium seafood as the highlight, including crabs, lobsters, mantis shrimp, sea snails, salmon, shrimp, squid, and many more delicacies. Diners are invited to indulge in an unlimited feast, featuring a fusion of Asian and European flavors, expertly prepared by top-tier chefs, ensuring an unforgettable gourmet experience.

name: Củi Restaurant
address: 31 Hoang Cau street No 3, Alley 31, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Wow that was delicious! The restaurant is beautiful and the service was excellent. We were grateful for the man on the street who had signs in English asking if we were looking for the restaurant. There’s no signage and even though google maps showed us it was very helpful to have his confirmation that we were in the right place.
description: A Southern Vietnamese restaurant in the heart of Hanoi which offer an authentic taste in a green and quiet place with a nice touch of Indochina décor. Ideal corner for: - Business dinerA Southern Vietnamese restaurant in the heart of Hanoi which offer an authentic taste in a green and quiet place with a nice touch of Indochina décor. Ideal corner for: - Business dining - Couple - Friends & Family And for expat and international travelers to taste the authentic Northern Vietnamese food in the heart of capital.

name: 37 Hùng Vương Restaurant
address: 37A Hung Vuong, Dien Bien, Ba Dinh, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Everything in this restaurant tasted authentically Vietnamese and deliciously good! We ordered a feast and I super enjoyed the oysters! The staff were friendly and helpful. Especially the beautiful young lady at the reception. She took excellent photos of me and my daughter!, Although the stone bowl pho is a bit expensive, it has delicious broth, supple noodles, fresh meat, expensive but suitable quality, you should try it!, Cheap bia hoi, 12.000VND…this is outside the main restaurant and is like a beer drinking hall. If you are Aussies/Euros come here for drinking but I would not recommend ordering food. I ordered spring rolls and instead received these pork things steamed in banana leaf…I ate 2 of them, chewy and not that nice. When I got the bill and asked about the spring rolls after lots of laughing I had eaten 2 steamed pig knobs, wangers doodles, p3n1s. As a tough Aussie bloke not normally a hat I eat but I more feel sorry for the 2 pigs more than myself. if you love a steamed pig knob, check out the photos.
description: Hệ thống Nhà hàng 37 Hùng Vương gồm nhiều cơ sở với món Phở, và các món ngon Việt Nam được giới thiệu phong phú và đặc sắc.

name: TungLok Heen
address: Hoa Lan, Vinhomes Riverside Long Bien, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Head Chinese Chef Adrian Chua is Singaporean and puts on a culinary extravaganza in extravagant surroundings. His presentations are spellbinding and served up by an amazing staff. Vui, Hien, and Nhan made our visit especially memorable. Kudos for assembling a world-class team., This is one of my favourite restaurants in hanoi. I've been in tunglok Singapore twice so this place is really brought me the "wow" feeling like I was in Singapore The decor concept is remained, the food have the same taste and staffs here are really nice & helpful I just wonder why the restaurants is not so crowded as it should be. I think they should promote it more one social, i was here with my family 2 weeks ago by the recomendation of my friend. i had heard many "wow" before really in here tasting this awesome dimsum and indeed it did not let me down even a bit. The dimsum is served in the traditional way with a a steamer, thin crust, spicy sauce and alot of meet inside. we also order some other dishes but dimsum's still impressed me most the total payment is quite high for the daily meal but worth for an outside family lunch/dinner
description: Head Chinese Chef Adrian Chua is Singaporean and puts on a culinary extravaganza in extravagant surroundings. His presentations are spellbinding and served up by an amazing staff. Vui, Hien, and Nhan made our visit especially memorable.  Kudos for assembling a world-class team.

name: Cousins Tran Quoc Toan
address: 19 ngõ Doan Nhu Hai, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: If you're looking for western food at big-city western prices, I suppose you'll be happy. The ambiance here is really great. The service is impeccable. And the food was tasty - but the portions were really small for the high prices. The restaurant is located on a small, charming little alley. The bar is extensive but we didn't have alcohol. The pesto was delicious - but again, USD 2 for four tiny slices of ham was ridiculous., Loved the extensive wine lists and their black squid ink risotto. Had a nice Prosecco to pair with and the bill was less than 60 for three people, My company had year end party in Cousins Tran Quoc Toan last Dec. Didnt know there’s a place like this in such a small valley Doan nhu hai. The resto was very warm and cozy, a fireplace during cold Hanoi weather inside a 100 years-old villa made our diner really impressive, not to mention we had great tarta beef and perfect trout with pasta. Since then, Cousins was one of my favorite place
description: Western Cantine and Bar

name: Club Opera
address: 5 Dang Thai Than French Quarter, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Attentive service and tasty food. Had the usual spring rolls, bun cha and a very tasty mango salad. Ambience was lacking as it was dead - surprising for a Friday evening. At 60$ with no alcohol thought it was a bit pricey for Hanoi., Nice staff Starters are just alright nothing special Main course chicken was dry and cold very disappointing Not worthy of the price at all, We stumbled upon Club Opera while window shopping in the streets of the French Quarter. For hungry, clueless pedestrians, what a lucky find! Although we'd had several great food and dining experiences during our time in Vietnam, our dinner at this sweet little restaurant in Hanoi turned out to be the very best of all of them. In both flavor and presentation, our seafood dinners were excellent. We also very much enjoyed the ambience of the room which, similar to our hotel at the nearby Sofitel Legend Metropole, offers a historically elegant fusion of French and Vietnamese cultures. Like others, we agree that our meal was expensive by Vietnamese standards. Nevertheless, as New Yorkers enjoying a humongously generous USD-VND exchange rate, we cannot not fairly complain that our tab was inappropriate for such fine dining. We highly recommend Club Opera!
description: Attentive service and tasty food. Had the usual spring rolls, bun cha and a very tasty mango salad. Ambience was lacking as it was dead - surprising for a Friday evening. At 60$ with no alcohol thought it was a bit pricey for Hanoi.

name: Khai's Brothers - The Hanoi Taste
address: 26 Nguyen Thai Hoc St., Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: My first meal in Vietnam was lunch and what a treat. You enter the restaurant and out at the back there is a beautiful shaded courtyard with plenty of seating. Around the outside of the area is the food freshly prepared and cooked while you wait. It was very tasty and you could return to the buffet as many times as you wished. A good way to try local food and experience some new tastes. Staff very friendly and helpful., We really enjoyed our options at this buffet style every style of cooking. Their patio is outstanding and setup is amazing., Offering a range of traditional Vietnamese dishes, Khai's Brothers has a very pleasant atmosphere with good service and attentive staff. Whilst the prices were not as keen as other establishments in the locality, the setting is very relaxing and service was nicely paced.
description: The charming hundred year old temple at 26 Nguyen Thai Hoc Street. Khai's Brother is a wonderful destination that you really find a subtle service with the cultural treasure of Vietnamese cuisine in different traditional flavors. By the exclusive original tastes and dining experience, your feelings will be stylized as a part of the local followed by a variety of drinking, dishes offering under Lunch and Dinner Buffets

name: Dong Phu 1932 Vietnamese Cuisine
address: 12 Hang Dieu Street Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant has very nice, upscale decor, so you are dining upstairs in very pleasant surroundings. The tables are nicely separated and the atmosphere is quiet and subdued. Fortunately the food is a match for the nice surroundings. We had fresh spring rolls, grilled catfish Hanoi style and lemongrass chicken, and tasty and very well prepared and presented. They also have a few good wines, including by the glass. Service was very efficient and quick. This was a very nice dinner!, We discovered the restaurant simply by walking by and decided to take a look. The interior is really nice and the food even better. We loved absolutely everything we ordered there - Green Mango Salad with Prawns and Bamboo rice with Beef were definitely the highlights. Ended up going there twice simply because the food and service was so good., We were walking by and saw this wonderful restaurant and decided to stop here for lunch. Food was beautiful, my friends soup came served in a beautiful bowl. We had beef in black bean sauce and beef with seasonal vegetables, all our dishes were lovely. Would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting Hanoi! Service was great too!
description: This restaurant has very nice, upscale decor, so you are dining upstairs in very pleasant surroundings.  The tables are nicely separated and the atmosphere is quiet and subdued.  Fortunately the food is a match for the nice surroundings.  We had fresh spring rolls, grilled catfish Hanoi style and lemongrass chicken, and tasty and very well prepared and presented.  They also have a few good wines, including by the glass.  Service was very efficient and quick.  This was a very nice dinner!

name: Phở Còi
address: 19 Mã Mây, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Sometimes you walk into a place and feel at home, where the language differences mean you cannot understand each other and yet you do. We ate a variety of spring rolls, which were delicious , however, tte beef and chicken pho was simply one of the best things I have ever eaten . Go here, relax, have a beer and enjoy simple, beautifully cooked food. It doesn’t get much better than this, Excellent traditional Vietnamese food. The restaurant's space is clean, airy, beautiful, air-conditioned, and has live music, making eating sound like a real restaurant. Reasonable price., Nice location in the middle of a very lively neighborhood, clean and beautiful sized dining room. very good local menu with fresh ingredients cooked before our eyes. Their specialty is phò, but don’t hesitate to try everything it’s top. The service is impeccable!
description:
Sometimes you walk into a place and feel at home, where the language differences  mean you cannot understand each other and yet  you do.

We ate a variety of spring rolls, which were delicious 
, however, tte beef and chicken pho was simply one of the best things I have ever eaten .

It doesn’t get much better than this

name: Indinam Restaurant
address: 33 Hang Bun Street, Ba Dinh, Ha Noi Ba Dinh, Ha Noi , Viet Nam, Nam Từ Liêm, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Popped in here on our second night in Hanoi,just around the corner from our hotel, very clean and welcoming,had a lovely,hot,spicy curry.service fast,staff pleasant.good price., Only one Luxury and Tasty Restaurent in Hanoi who can give authentic North Indian food. Highly recommend all visitors to Hanoi should visit Indinam, The food and service in Indinam is incredible! I had punjabi chicken and the daal and it tasted amazing and looked good too! The staff were really friendly and accommodating and nothing seemed a bother with them! they always had a smile on their face and made me and my friend feel very welcome so I would 100% eat here again. :)
description: Indinam proud to bring the Indian Mughlai authentic food to the home town of Hanoi people and to my Indians fellows working in Hanoi & off-course for the foreigners tourist from North to south and east to west part of the globe who love Indian tasty food. We begin with slogan “TASTE IT LIKE IT“. Indinam brings not only Indian food also serves Vietnam authentic food in one umbrella who proudly say that the only One and the first one in the World INDINAM to bringing under one umbrella Indian and Vietnamese cuisine.

name: Kobala Bar Events Rooftop
address: 13, Xuan Dieu Street Tay Ho, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant has quite a lot of dishes and most of them are related to hamburgers, but the side dishes are also very diverse and rich, you can choose the type of hamburger meat filling. In addition, there are also some dishes with fries or fried squid, although it is fried food, it has been used to absorb oil to remove excess oil, so I find it very delicious. The restaurant's tables and chairs are also kept very clean and tidy, The service staff here are very polite and attentive, so this will be a plus point of the restaurant., Cool place with nice people, great music, amazing cocktails and super nice vibe! Will go again as soon as we can, Enjoyed the veggie tempura and fries very much. The veggie and chicken pad Thai as main courses also very tasty. Service great, and food arrives in good time. Recommended.
description: Kobala Bar. Events. Rooftop. Kobala is a Home Cocktail Bar with disco, funky, house, electro music, jazz and blues. It's our living room to welcome everybody to come and enjoy the view, drinks and making friends. A rooftop bar with a West Lake view and the one and only staff also known as Kobala's lover will bring you into our exciting world. Every Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays, in our living room, we organize parties with DJs from 9pm until 1am. Come to Kobala and one thing you need to do is just relax, look good and be nice

name: Tracy's Pub
address: 114 Xuan Dieu Street Tay Ho District, Hanoi 99999 Vietnam
reviews: Food is good, beer is good but the place can't hold many people due to the size. However don't let this stop you, it is cozy and the price is resonable for Hanoi., Wonderful little spot to get a cold beer and great burger. Have eaten here three times and the food is consistenly good with most excellent burgers and fries. Just a hole in the wall with limited bar type seating but enjoyed with my mate on a walk about in Tay Ho., It's extremely difficult to find the delicious burger in Hanoi. However, that is first time I ate best burger taste which is more different than fastfood. You should try in there.
description: The BEST burgers in Asia! - Cold beer and great prices on drinks. Big Screen satellite TV's.

name: KOTO Cafe at Tan My Design
address: 61 Hang Gai, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Our guide took us to this cafe for lunch. The food served in abundance was fresh and tasty. Lovely presentation and the service was impeccable. This is a foundation business setup to encourage young adults to acquire a skill in hospitality business,, training them not only to serve, but cook, manage and learning how to run a business. Fantastic work!, Arrived, received a friendly welcome, geared towards tourists but almost perfect. The whole thing is a know one / teach one project. The food was super tasty, more than enough. The only thing was the drinks, which took too long to arrive, which means the score is reduced to 5., What an amazing social enterprise that has been going for over 20 years. Food is amazing. Service is fabulous. I was served by Mai who was attentive and friendly. I had a chicken salad. It was great. While you are there you can buy gifts there made by other social enterprises so I got some gifts that made me feel good as well. It’s near the temple of literature which is also worth a visit
description: In addition to our restaurant located in Tay Ho, KOTO Cafe at Tan My Design is our latest partnership. Located in the heart of Hanoi’s Old Quarter, on the old famous Silk Street of Hang Gai, KOTO Cafe at Tan My Design is a place where art lovers, fashion lovers, good friends and good food meet. ​ KOTO and Tan My Design are proud to partner with KOTO Cafe at Tan My Design. This new partnership showcases the very best of Vietnam in food & culture. Tradition is preserved with this third-generation family business and Vietnam's first social enterprise as we come together to create a brighter future for empowering at-risk and disadvantaged Vietnamese youth.

name: Quiri Pub & Restaurant Hanoi
address: 25 Hàng Lược, Hàng Mã, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 110000 Vietnam
reviews: I stayed here for 10 days and organised my ha Giang tour through the hostel. It’s very friendly and has a great social atmosphere. Free beer from 7-8 brings everyone together, breakfast omelet is also really nice., I stayed here for a week, was a great hostel, friendly staff, attractive guests, free breakfast and free beer from 7-8pm. Was worth every penny. They have a pool on the roof, though it was cold for that, but there was karaoke and social games., loved this hostel for the activities and freebies (breakfast, drinks) that come with the room. I actually extended my stay because I met such great people (Duc, Kathleen, Salvador) who work at the hostel. I booked the ha Giang loop through Quiri as well, which was an incredible experience! would recommend :))
description: Experience Authentic Vietnamese Cuisine With 7 years of experience, our restaurant is proudly located in the heart of Hanoi’s Old Quarter and has expanded to branches in Hanoi, Cát Bà, and Hà Giang. Serving over 20,000 international customers, we specialize in bringing the rich flavors of traditional Vietnamese dishes, offering an unforgettable culinary journey. ✨

name: The Greek Taverna
address: 77 P. Trịnh Công Sơn, Nhật Tân, Tây Hồ, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: I stayed in Hanoi for 2 weeks and our accommodation was very near this gem of a restaurant. On our first visit, Christophe, the owner, a very charming and charismatic Greek man gave us a very warm welcome. The food is suberb, the meats, breads, dips and vegetables are so fresh and super tasty. He even gave us the most most delicious chocolate and biscuit pots as complimentary desserts which finished off our meal so perfectly. On several occasions we popped in for a glass of vine when passing and the most beautiful herb tomatoes and olives were landed on our table. It’s the small touches that make this restaurant so great. I would highly recommended The Greek Taverna, thank you Christophe and team ., This is by far one the Best restaurant I haven been to in Ha Noi. The service is great and the food is even better. The owner is delightful and very kind. Food is terrific and I am really happy to get good Greek authentic food and even dessert. Please come and see this hidden jewel.,

name: Botanica Restaurant
address: 07 Kim Ma Thuong Cong Vi, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam

name: Loving Hut
address: 192/4, Quan Thanh Street Ba Dinh District, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Delicious Vegan Food!! The go to spot!! Prices are excellent!! Open until 10:00pm- the food is always fresh and flavorful. Some of the best dishes are their Hue noodle soups, fried pineapple and fried pumpkin; the seafood spring rolls & the vegetables are delicious also! Honestly they have tons of options and everything on there menu is delicious. Staff is friendly and great english speaking skills also! Follow @travelingypsey on Instagram & Google Maps!, About 40k/person at least for a full serving. Less than that you pretty much don’t have a full meal, so this place isn’t cheap. Food taste okay, if not too salty for me. It will take a while for the chefs to cook. So don’t be rushed here. What I like most is the atmosphere. Very quiet and tranquil. Maybe I’ll comeback to try some other food., Being vegetarians, we were looking for vegan restaurants. Loving Hut was recommended by Sofitel. The Menu had many choices of dishes. We ordered Wonton Soup and their special fried rice. Both dishes were amazing. Highly recommended.

name: Yakiniku Sakura
address: 90B Bui Thi Xuan, Hai Ba Trung, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Food is fresh, service the best, bit expensive but really good quality. If you need fresh fish in Japanese style that's probably one of the best place in Hanoi., Very nice yakiniku restaurant. Clean room, kind staffs, nice meat, , , etc. are excellent but the cost are quite expensive than others. Still, you will be satisfied. You can eat nice Sashimi too. It's a good Japanese restaurant., japan food r usually expensive but they prepared well. good food and nice mood. clean and excellent workers.
description: Food is fresh, service the best, bit expensive but really good quality. If you need fresh fish in Japanese style that's probably one of the best place in Hanoi.

name: Hilton Hanoi Opera's Lobby Lounge
address: 1 Le Thanh Tong St Hilton Hanoi Opera Hotel, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: I have stayed at a few hotels in Hanoi and I would say the location of this hotel is pretty good. However the service and the rooms are pretty ordinary and dated. The hotel is old and is in need of renovation. Breakfast for vegetarians is so so. The concierge and hotel reception can be a lot better. Rooms itself are old and need to be modernized., exhibit an old design and atmosphere. does not picture the normal grand ambience of hilton. friendly staff, Nice place to sit and watch the international community move through the hotel, but if you are going there for the food you will be slightly disappointed. They have some baked goods and smoothies, but not much else and what they have is average.
description: I have stayed at a few hotels in Hanoi and I would say the location of this hotel is pretty good. However the service and the rooms are pretty ordinary and dated. The hotel is old and is in need of renovation. Breakfast for vegetarians is so so. The concierge and hotel reception can be a lot better. Rooms itself are old and need to be modernized.

name: Bit Tet So 3 Hoe Nhai
address: 3, Hoe Nhai Street, Nguyen Trung Truc Ward, Ba Đinh District, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Great flavor and authentic Vietnamese food. Nice spot for some drinks and a taste of some local food- would recommend to try it! Prices are decent as well! Follow @Travelingypsey on Instagram & GoogleMaps!, If you go along Hoe Nhai street, there are at least 10 places for beef steak and I have mostly tried those. Was brought here last year by my VN friend, had a chance to go back recently which still keeps the quality of meat, sauce and price. Yummy is the word to describe, it is reasonable and worth trying for a different taste of steak. The sizzling including 2 small pieces of beef, pork pate, fried egg, onion, fries and lots of sauce, served with bread. And it costs only 70,000VND ~ 2.5 GBP, a great deal then!! Stew beef is also available, Very good beef quality, tasty, with big portion. The price is reasonable and quickly service. Recommended!
description:
Great flavor and authentic Vietnamese food. Nice spot for some drinks and a taste of some local food- would recommend to try it! Prices are decent as well! 

Follow @Travelingypsey on Instagram & GoogleMaps!

name: Phở Lý Quốc Sư
address: Số 5 Cát Linh, Đống Đa, Hà Nội, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: My boyfriend and I decided to try Phở Lý Quốc Sư, and it quickly became one of our favorite spots! The moment we walked in, we were greeted by the delicious aroma of simmering broth, setting the stage for an amazing meal. We both went for the classic Phở Bò (beef pho), and it was incredible. The broth was rich and flavorful, perfectly balanced with a hint of sweetness and savory depth. The noodles were just the right texture – soft but not mushy – and the thinly sliced beef was so tender, it practically melted in our mouths with every bite. It was clear that a lot of care and skill went into making the broth. The fresh accompaniments, like the herbs, bean sprouts, and chili, really added to the experience, giving us a chance to adjust the flavors just the way we liked. The portion sizes were generous, and we left feeling completely satisfied but not overly full. The service was quick and friendly, making the whole experience even more enjoyable. The atmosphere was cozy and lively, adding to the charm of the place. We loved that it felt like a genuine local experience.
