name: King cafe
address: 44 Luong Ngoc Quyen Street Hoan kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant sells dishes to go with rice that make me feel quite similar to the usual Vietnamese meals. At first, I didn't think that eating food with rice was so delicious, it gave me a strange feeling, the rice here is cooked from quite delicious and flexible rice. the restaurant has many dishes such as fried chicken, stir-fried beef with cabbage, fried spring rolls, tomatoes and braised meat with eggs,.. all dishes are quite strange to me but I feel it is very delicious., You can also see that the restaurant's name is King Cafe, they sell food and coffee too. The milky coffee here is very fragrant, has a fatty taste of milk, the aroma of freshly brewed coffee makes me feel so awake. The food here mainly sells dishes with white rice, the white rice is quite delicious, the rice grains are very flexible and fragrant, the dish with fried beef with onions is very delicious, it is a great dish when combined with stir-fried beef served with white rice., Unfortunately my husband dropped by to see the owners ( we have been going there to eat for years) and it has closed!!! Anyone who knows how to find them we would greatly appreciate to hear!
description: Next door to sinh tourist office ( address is 52 luong ngoc quyen street

name: Bep Cua Me
address: 07 Chan Cam, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We first came here for dinner, had very delicious bun cha. We then discovered that they offered cooking classes, so on our last day in Hanoi, we went for it! Maria is an incredibly attentive and hospitable host, and an excellent teacher. There isn’t a set menu for the class; instead what you cook depends on what is available on the market that day, and what your preferences are- so it’s very personalized! Had a very fun time chatting and going around the market, and an even better time cooking! This family has an amazing history and countless stories to tell. Absolutely recommend coming here and experiencing the cooking class for yourself if ever you visit Hanoi., The restaurant is held by a very welcoming family. We have enjoyed a great Time with my family, I recommand 100%! And the awarded chefs make an amazing job, We were walking in the street and saw the beautifull restaurant full of vietnamese people. We tried the set menu for 2 and 1 ban xeo. The food was amazing. The staff was extremely friendly and answered all our questions about what we were eating. With 3 beers and one tea the total bill was under 400 vnd (16 eur).
description: Authentic traditional Vietnamese food. Just little kitchen for cooking class. We do have 4 kitchen with different food from all Vietnam.

name: Luc Thuy Restaurant & Lounge
address: 16 Lê Thái Tổ, Hàng Trống, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Stopped here for a cold drink during my sightseeing. Lovely location with a view of the lake. The staff had an aloof air, blank gazes when I walked in, earpieces (are they Secret Service?). I had to approach one of them who was standing there looking at me curiously to even get a look at the drinks menu. The iced chocolate was fairly mediocre, and at 106,000 vnd (though it only said 98 on the menu) around twice as expensive as a similar drink anywhere else around here. When it came time to pay I was treated to more of the same haughtiness, like I was inconveniencing them. These people need to turn that frown upside down. It’s not pleasant to get a frosty reception like this. Maybe someone can convey the message through their earpieces. :), I’m sitting here now! Nice spot near the lake. Cool drink. All good so far. It’s not the amount of money I’m being ripped off, it’s the fact that I’m blatantly being ripped off. I don’t usually look at the bill, however, I ordered two items and there were three charges (as well as the added tax line). Ok, to the point … they charged for the small hand towel they placed on the table when I sat down. I know it is a small amount, but it could easily be absorbed in the significantly overpriced items here. Moral … isn’t really one. Reading other reviews helped to make sense of this place. Love Vietnam 🇻🇳, love Hanoi!!!, After walking around Hoan Kiem lake for a while, i stepped into the Luc Thuy cafe facing directly to the lake. The price is acceptable in this area. I was asked if i would like to have a cup of ice tea and wonder myself it will be free like other cafe shops. Then i was charged for a 15k vnd. If Anyone like to have a drink, just go around nearby for better deal.
description: The restaurant is known not only for its traditional and modern Vietnamese cuisine but also for its classic, sophisticated atmosphere.

name: The Church
address: No.1, Nha Tho Street Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: This is a fun place to stop by. They have a great choice of cakes all served in huge portions and my partner is saying that the Americano Coffee is the best ever (?). Service is friendly and you can just sit back on the internal sofas and see the world pass by outside., Friendly staff who very quickly cleared a table outside for us. Perfect spot to watch the comings and goings. Also have good selection of drinks. Both hot and cold., The drinks and lunch were great. The location was easy to get to and the facility was clean and upscale. Service was excellent.
description: A New Place To Be in Hanoi. Welcome to The Church :)

name: La Cheminee Restaurant
address: 40 Cat Linh, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Typical in-hotel restaurant which provides a taste of local cuisine. A noodle in the morning is tasty. The place is tidy. A little English-speaking lesson for the staff is warranted., So I basically tried all three meals here in La Cheminee, which was named after the Cat Linh Chimney in front of the hotel. However, the food was not French, rather than a typical hotel coffee shop serving a mix of Western and Vietnamese food. For lunch and dinner, I just stuck with typical Vietnamese dishes because the Western dishes did not look too promising. The Hanoi Fried Rice was pretty good, but the Pho Ga (Chicken noodle soup) was a bit on the weak side. I also had breakfast buffet here at the restaurant too. It was surprisingly good with a good amount of typical Vietnamese and Western choices. There is an egg station, a great fruit and yogurt station, along with a Congee station, a Vietnamese hot food station, and a Noodle Station. I was very impressed with the breakfast offering. There were plenty of staffs but wish they could not be more proactive to refill tea and coffee. However, Pullman Hanoi needs a second full service restaurant serving a specific themed food. They need a Chinese, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean or Mediterranean restaurant., I hope you will provide better language training for your staff . They don’t understand numbers in English. Yes like ‘3’ poached eggs . Staying here right now, they made this mistake 2 mornings in a row. Both days they got it wrong . Sent me 1 egg and then 2 and then 3 after I corrected . Yes it is frustrating if you just want to have your breakfast and leave. In addition , the staff does not appear to be too happy when I corrected him.
description:
Typical in-hotel restaurant which provides a taste of local cuisine. A noodle in the morning is tasty. The place is tidy. 

A little English-speaking lesson for the staff is warranted.

name: Highlands Coffee -
address: 28A Dien Bien Phu Next to the Military History Museum, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Vietnam has a variety of coffee which is extremely popular.. egg coffee, weasel coffee are interesting options. The more commonly had is the black coffee served with sweetened condensed milk. This can be had hot or cold with ice & the ones available at Highland coffee is nice. My favourite though is the Iced Komquat drink, Peach Mousse & Banh me Que which is a warmed bun with chicken filling. Prices are fair., We had breakfast at this cafe while waiting for our bus to arrive for our halong bay one day tour. The seatings were ample and the cafe located within the compound of the opera house. The coffee and bread was ok, but I happened to see a rat around where we were seated. The service was a bit slow as well and ordering was messy too., great spot to enjoy a cup of coffee while taking in the stunning views of Hanoi from above. It a good spot for both relaxing and working, but it's quite expensive compare to other coffee shops

name: Top Chef
address: 151 Thuy Khue Golden Westlake, Tay Ho, Ba Dinh, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We were out looking for another place to eat actually and found this gem instead. We were lost (again lol) and standing outside Top Chef. The assistant manager came out and his friendly demeaned convinced us to come inside and try the food. He escorted us upstairs and sat us beside a wonderful air conditioner. You have no idea how lovely that is. It was 44 degrees c outside!! We had wine and a wonderful meal. Best spring rolls I’ve had here (mango were the best). Food was fresh and made to order. The herbs were fragrant and all of the food was plated beautifully as well. He insisted we have dessert which was a delish chocolate lava cake. It was one of my favourite meals in Vietnam. Thanks to the kind assistant manager, Wonderful time and hidden gem away Great to do something different ! It’s part of a culinary school so every thing is over reaching., I keep coming back because you never get bored of food here. They have both an asian and western menu that constantly innovates while you know you are getting good quality ingredients and freshness. Service and space is good. And it's cheap. Yep, I know it's not nice to call things cheap but this place is more than just reasonable price - it's an incredible value for money
description: TopChef fun cooking offer you variety choices of classes: Vietnam, Western, Oriental cuisine. Our Chefs are from Vietnam and foreign, and have many years experience in the kitchen.

name: Ola's Steak
address: Số 5 Cát linh Đống đa Hà nội, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Great food, clean and nice premises. Very smiling staff and not least very reasonable for such good food! Hard to find anything other than Vietnamese food around Vietnam, so nice to find a place that had something different😃, Wamly welcomed by Hung at this family friendly and reasonably priced steakhouse. Newly opened. Fun. Great service. Great place for quiet couples dinner. Thanks to all., Great steak house next to the Grand Mercure Hanoi. The service was quick and very friendly. The owner Hung looked after our family and we had a great night. The music was great and at the perfect volume. I had the burger and it was superb!
description: Great food, clean and nice premises. Very smiling staff and not least very reasonable for such good food! Hard to find anything other than Vietnamese food around Vietnam, so nice to find a place that had something different😃

name: Nectar Hideaway: Rooftop Cocktails Bar
address: 20 Tràng Tiền Hoàn Kiếm, Hanoi 128260 Vietnam
reviews: Lovely find in the city, up a few flights of stairs in an unassuming residential type building to the 4th floor to find the cutest speakeasy. The staff were so welcoming, friendly, and helpful, and the atmosphere was perfectly laid back with light jazz music. Delicious exciting signature cocktails too! Would highly recommend at least a few drinks here, alongside their complimentary sesame cracker snacks., We were out for a few cocktails before dinner and had seen Nectar come up on a few searches of "best cocktails in Hanoi". We weren't disappointed. As others have said it's a bit of a challenge to get to - down a side alley and up several flights of stairs (be warned for your return trip after a few drinks...). There are some pretty elaborate but tasty cocktails. The personal favorite was Boulevard of Broken Dreams but their Penicillin is worth it too. Prices are quite reasonable. Staff are attentive and know their stuff. Definitely worth a visit and a nice little spot for a few pre or post dinner drinks., Popped in for a G&T one evening. If you can manage the 4 flights of stairs, this little gem is worth the effort. Sit inside our outside. Outside has views to the opera house. Great service and a good offering of cocktails, spirits and some wines. Pretty cool. New venue and young lads are eager to please.
description: Hidden on the fourth floor above Hanoi's bustling streets, Nectar Hideaway offers craft cocktails with stunning Opera House views. Our intimate rooftop space combines signature drinks, professional mixology, and panoramic cityscapes. Experience our daily happy hours (5:30-7:30 PM) featuring innovative cocktails and mocktails crafted by our skilled bartenders. Each drink is balanced with precision and creativity, perfect for both cocktail enthusiasts and those seeking alcohol-free options. From our private smoking area to cozy indoor seating, we've created different spaces to match your mood. Join us for elevated moments as the sun sets over the Opera House, where every visit becomes a memorable hideaway experience in the heart of Hanoi. Perfect for: Sunset cocktails Date nights Small gatherings City views Craft cocktail appreciation

name: Les Oubliés
address: So 3, Ngo 462, Ngọc Thụy, Long Bien, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Difficult to find because Grab has not updated the address, so rely on Google map. Excellent bistro where we shared a white pudding as a starter followed by a delicious Australian sole meunière washed down with a glass of red wine from Spain and we took away an almond pancake, a real treat, the best in Hanoi without a doubt. Well done Geoffrey., Les Oubliés, “not to forget”, extra French cuisine, tasty, classic for lovers of authenticity, a Chef keen to delight his guests, a daily slate, a tempting menu, in French and Vietnamese, see: beef cheek extra flavored with mulled wine, homemade smoked salmon, sauerkraut, bourguignon, sole meunière (600g!!!), lamb shank, imported beefsteak, salads made with vegetables, seasonal citrus fruits, but also snacks: spaghetti, panini, sandwiches richly garnished, wines and beers, seasonal fruit juices from Vietnam, in short, enough to delight all gourmets at the risk of having to return often or passing through. In short, I liked it, Geoffrey is a Chef we appreciate, assisted by Ly, his charming and smiling wife. A unique bistro-restaurant in Hanoi in its authenticity Ah, one last word, the prices are reasonable for everyone. Enjoy your food. Gérard, a veteran of the French restaurateur profession in Hanoi, Oh it's been several times and become common that I go to the Oubliés of Ngoc Thuy Long Well and good, I bring a lot of friends there who are happy about it, we understand why, it's nice, welcoming and welcoming. eat there and even relax with a drink, it's worth the trip. Furthermore good, well cooked by a Chef and, and, and not expensive value for money. You can be modest and enjoy it the French way. I really encourage anyone to discover The Forgotten by Ngoc Thuy Long Bien Ah, 12’ from the center of Hanoi Gerard
description:
Difficult to find because Grab has not updated the address, so rely on Google map.
Excellent bistro where we shared a white pudding as a starter followed by a delicious Australian sole meunière washed down with a glass of red wine from Spain and we took away an almond pancake, a real treat, the best in Hanoi without a doubt. Well done Geoffrey.

name: Kampong Chicken House
address: 107 Lo Duc Giảng Võ, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Nice space. Tasty food. Been there almost 4-5 times and still counting. Recommend fou you guys who find a restaurant with nice decor, good services and orginal food to enjoy with family or friend.
description: Nice space. Tasty food. Been there almost 4-5 times and still counting. Recommend fou you guys who find a restaurant with nice decor, good services and orginal food to enjoy with family or friend.

name: Bami King
address: 161 Lang Ha Street, Dong Da District, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: a very good adress, all is fresh and clean, very good qualty for the price. you can order from grab and get it delivered, very effective service. i recommend., This place was recommended by our hotel that was across from it. They have a few selections of Banh Mi and drinks too. If you’re looking for local foods such as Vietnamese bread, this has to be on your list!, We went to this place probably three or four times. They have three different sandwiches. We liked the pork with BBQ sauce and the beef. This place is a good regular place, sort of in lieu of going to a burger joint (or like having a McRib). While we toured the city, we noticed there were a bunch. Not really a place to eat at, but good to pick up, and eat on the go.
description: "BAMI KING® Banhmi Chain" The idea was born in 2013 and went through a meticulous process of product research and market evaluation until June 2015, when BAMI KING® opened its first store at 2 Trung Hoa, Cau Giay, Hanoi, which was well received by many customers. BAMI KING® marked a turning point in the high-end bread segment - a product that had long been perceived as common among Vietnamese people. Within 8 years, BAMI KING® has developed into a chain of 9 stores (2 Trung Hoa, 11 Thai Phien, 27 Nguyen Phong Sac, 3 Lang Ha, 116 An Trach, 56 Quan Thanh, 122 Lac Trung, 31 Dao Tan, 152 Le Duan) and is still expanding. As the FIRST brand to introduce grilled beef into bread, BAMI KING® has been given the nickname "THE KING OF GRILLED BEEF BANH MI" by a large number of customers, and is proud of this achievement.

name: SoftWater Restaurant
address: No 42, Road 9, F361, An Duong Street, Yen Phu Ward, Tay Ho District, Ha Noi, Hanoi 0844 Vietnam
reviews: We came as a big group after being recommended to visit this place by SIA. As there are not much review in TA aside from the wedding events, I was not sure of what to expect. To get to this place, do not follow Google Map. It will lead you to a dead end. The locals knows their way in bests and a call to the restaurant might be needed. This place is gorgeous! I love the garden and the dining area we were in were built on a pond. I suppose as there are not many people who dines here, we get the whole place to ourselves. The service is great, though they are a little wobbly on the drinks. Spilled our drinks on two occasions while serving. The food was good too and they had a wide range of food. But for that price in Hanoi, you might want to explore just in Old Quarters. I chose this place for it's exclusivity. They serve vegetarian food, but you need to make sure to let them know that you do not want egg with it as they served ours with egg. Overall, I would come back again if I hold the same type of event with a big group of people but I most probably will not come back here if I am travelling alone., My Vietnamese wife and I held our wedding ceremony & reception here in October. The location is a little removed from the bustle of Ha Noi and the garden setting is exquisite. We had 110 people attend and although the weather was hot (not Soft Water's fault) the entire evening was first class. The menu was negotiable the Soft Water people very amenable to making sure we had what we wanted. On the evening I heard nothing but great reports about the food...quality and quantity. The decor for the wedding was simple yet stylish and complemented the garden setting well. The willingness of the Soft Water staff to work with us to make our day special was much appreciated. Special thanks to Ms. Tam for all of her help. Overall this is great function venue and I would recommend even dining there to experience the unique setting and relaxing atmosphere., Scenery was very peaceful and zen. We had high expectations. Unfortunately the food did not match the cost. We ordered the steak and the fried chicken. Both were overcooked. The chicken was so dry that was barely edible. The chicken pieces were all bones.
description: SOFTWATER - is the destination bringing unique life experience to guests. Sophisticated combination between art of cuisine and nature bestows on guests strange feeling as well as familiar one, making deep impression in their mind. Especially, with European-American and Asian typical cuisine with excellent taste and plentiful choices of beeswings and drinks at bar, guests can perfectly enjoy their delicious meal in wood-designed restaurant. This is the unique characteristics making guests interested in SOFTWATER. Experiencing four years of operation, SOFTWATER becomes a prestigious name that is easy to remember in many guests' hearts and a familiar address for numerous meetings. At present, SOFTWATER continues researching for service diversification in order to meet valued guests' increasing demand. The restaurant welcomes all of guests who have demand of enjoying cuisine, holding birthday or wedding parties and meetings among family members, friends or companies that need to hold parties for staff, customer meetings, parties for launching new products, conference, etc. With the maxim: "Guest is God, prestige is given first priority", SOFTWATER is the best choice for all guests who want to experience a natural, ordinary and deep destination, a sophisticated and unforgettable space for cuisine with the combination of such factors as HEART - LOVE - TALENT. Visit SOFTWATER and enjoy your life everyday!

name: Bamboo Restaurant
address: 34 Hang Be Street, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: We ate at this resteraunt a lot as it was across the road form where we stayed. Great couple running the place. Say hello to Henry for me, Great food, including vegetarian and gluten free options. Food not oily unlike other places. Cheap beer. Fresh and varied vegetables., This was my second meal in vietnam and loved it! Got the fried rice with beef and it was cheap, fast and yum plus the waitress was really friendly. Also got a coffee and an iced tea and they said they use bottled water for it - both were great.
description:
We ate at this resteraunt a lot as it was across the road form where we stayed.
Great couple running the place.
Say hello to Henry for me

name: Kem Caramen Duong Hoa
address: 29 Hang Than Ba Dinh, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We ordered seconds, and then thirds. The Kem Caramen was a perfect wobbly consistency, with a nice eggy flavour. Served cool, it made for such a refreshing treat., They have varieties of caramen combinations, and other cheap local desserts. It's rich, small and super cheap. It's a kind of place you rest for a bit and have some sweets with your friends between shopping briefly. You should try a few different kinds. Eat like a local on a small plastic chair. The menu is only in Vietnamese without a photo so it's a bit tricky going unprepared without a Vietnamese speaking person. I guess you can always point with your fingers., Featured in one of the guide book I read for the coconut ice cream which is vanilla ice cream served in a coconut with coconut shavings , this turned out to be a disappointment but the caramel pudding would be what I would go back for....a great place to mingle with the locals
description: We ordered seconds, and then thirds. The Kem Caramen was a perfect wobbly consistency, with a nice eggy flavour. Served cool, it made for such a refreshing treat.

name: Sky Cafe Fastfood (sky 1)
address: tầng 2, Khu cách ly Quốc tế đi T1 Sân bay Nội Bài, Phú Cường, Sóc Sơn,l, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Awful. Staff were rude and unhelpful and prices are completely unreasonable. I would give it zero stars if I could. We ordered two coffees which came iced, it didn’t say this on the menu and when we questioned it the woman on the till just said all coffees came iced and she wouldn’t change it. It’s a shame as we’ve enjoyed Vietnam and all our coffees so far and this one left a bad experience as our last memory. Definitely chose another cafe in the airport., Terrible service very few food options even at 2 pm. Apparently they had run out of a considerable selection. We ordered four beers but when delivered one was warm and flat. We requested for it to be exchanged. They refused and then put it in the fridge for two minutes. Unfortunately the magic fridge didn’t create a cold fizzy beer after two minutes! We requested a refund but that was refused also, stating that we had drunk half the beer despite us taking the beer in the cup and the bottle as proof that only a sip was taken. Avoid at all costs unless you like overpriced warm flat beer and poor service. Wish we had read the other reviews before trying here., Worst coffee and customer service experience in Vietnam. If it wasn't so expensive it would have been almost comical. Staff were so rude and the products are awful barely any coffee basically just a cup of ice. Whoever owns this establishment should be ashamed of the service they are offering customers and the competence of the staff they have employed. Avoid at all costs genuinely awful.
description: Awful. Staff were rude and unhelpful and prices are completely unreasonable. I would give it zero stars if I could. We ordered two coffees which came iced, it didn’t say this on the menu and when we questioned it the woman on the till just said all coffees came iced and she wouldn’t change it. It’s a shame as we’ve enjoyed Vietnam and all our coffees so far and this one left a bad experience as our last memory. Definitely chose another cafe in the airport.

name: Cafe Van Mieu
address: 150 Nguyen Khuyen Van Mieu and Nguyen Khuyen crossroad, Dong Da District, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: The rice with black pepper beef is good (out of expectation), but the rice noodles shrimp is an okay (not so bad, though). The rice with poached shrimp is an okay too. But the traditional tea is good, it has a beautiful taste. Overall it's a good place with the reasonable price., A nice and cozy little restaurant. Food tasted really good - both the seafood and meat dishes. Prices were cheap compared to the old quarter of Hanoi. Clearly recommended for everyone., Small cafe, nice food, and fast! We had the beef in pepper sauce and fried seafood rice, both really nice!
description: The rice with black pepper beef is good (out of expectation), but the rice noodles shrimp is an okay (not so bad, though). The rice with poached shrimp is an okay too. But the traditional tea is good, it has a beautiful taste. Overall it's a good place with the reasonable price.

name: Hung Ben Rolls
address: 33 Ngu Xa, Ba Dinh District, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: We came here because one of my friend was recommend this place. This famouse about the rice spring rolls and other style of cooking it. We order few signature and it's was really good, the noodle with egg was crispy, the sour Phở (as they called) it's also very tasty. We definately come back, Pho is delicious with many ways of making noodles. With typical flavors of Hanoi people, rolling pho, fried pho, fried pho, soft stir-fried Pho all bring interesting emotions when enjoying these dishes here. The inadequacy here is the location in the narrow alley, very difficult to find and the campus is quite cramped, My local friend introduced me this eatery. The day I came, it was not crowded. Service is ok (a little bit slow), price is affordable. But because I dont like fried food, and there are many fried dishes in the menu, they are tasty but not my favorite in Ha Noi.
description: We came here because one of my friend was recommend this place. This famouse about the rice spring rolls and other style of cooking it. We order few signature and it's was really good, the noodle with egg was crispy, the sour Phở (as they called) it's also very tasty. We definately come back

name: Himalaya Indian Restaurant
address: 6 Hang Luoc Hang Ma, Hoan Kiem,, Hanoi 111000 Vietnam
reviews: One of the only true Halal, Indian food (veg and non veg) restaurant available in Hanoi. Walking distance from most of the hotels near the lake area and night market. They have almost all Indian chicken and mutton dishes along with good vegitarian options. They also have some great Pakistani dishes. They have a la carte as well as combo meal options and their prices are reasonable. Owner is a very friendly guy with heart of gold. He extends his guidance and support on any local areas to guests. Highly recommended to all Indians and Desi friends looking for some good Indian meal options in Hanoi. Must visit., Great for athentic South Asian food. Felt at home. Service was equally south asian warmth . With Indian food getting to main street, this south asian place is great addition, Best curry in Hanoi. Really enjoyed every bite. Would defo return at some point when I come back to Vietnam. Tasty and delicious
description: The perfect dining experience with a variety of Pakistani, Indian, Arabic, and Italian cuisine, as well as BBQ and seafood items, all at an affordable price.

name: Wild Rice
address: 6 Ngo Thi Nham Street, Phan Chu Trinh Ward, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Not sure why our tour company booked us here. The food was just average. The service was fine but the meal felt rushed. With so many really great places to eat in Hanoi had I known this was where we were going I would have booked someplace else independently., We had a multi course meal here with a large group of people. The seafood soup was excellent. All of the dishes served were well prepared. The staff was attentive and helpful., Visited as part of a tour group, so had a set Dinner Menu provided. There are lots of courses but thankfully they are not too large. I am sure there were Spring Rolls, soup, rice, vegetables ,fish , chicken ,meat , noodles , followed by fresh fruit & coffee / tea. We were a group of 23, service was good but fairly fast. Had we just been a couple we would rather have taken another 30 minutes or so over our dinner.
description: Not sure why our tour company booked us here.  The food was just average.  The service was fine but the meal felt rushed.  With so many really great places to eat in Hanoi had I known this was where we were going I would have booked someplace else independently.

name: Leo's - Cocktails & Co.
address: 16 Lo Su street 2nd Floor, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: This cocktail bar is beautiful with a classic and cozy atmosphere. The menu is diverse, from classic to modern cocktails, all delicious and attractive. Service staff are friendly, professional and always willing to advise customers. Prices are affordable compared to the quality, creating an enjoyable and memorable experience for anyone who visits., On our last night we found this little gem of a place, perfect (and I mean PERFECT) cocktails. Its tucked away on a quiet street but this should be sometging to add to your trip! The manager Thuong was an absolute star and so helpful, knowledgeable and welcoming and so we're the other staff. I can't wait to come back here! 😍, The best handcrafted cocktails in the city! My friends and I stumbled upon this place after we had an evening walk by the river. We only came in for one drink but ended up having 6+ drinks. All the drinks on the menu are so good but best drinks were created by Lee, who was our bartender. He is so talented and is able to concoct any cocktails to our preference. All the servers there were really fun and cool. Ask for the one to beatbox and do magic card tricks. This cool and chill bar is one of the best cocktail places we’ve ever been to. We will be back for sure. Highly recommend coming here!
description: Discover a cozy cocktail bar nestled in an ancient Hanoi house, steps from Hoan Kiem lake. Handcrafted cocktails with only the freshest local ingredients created by our welcoming crew. Come see why we are a local favorite!

name: Rue Du Camp Cafe & Bistro
address: 50 Trang Thi Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We visited Rue Du Camp cafe/bistro early on a Saturday evening. We went up to the 1st level seating area. Waitress was attentive and friendly. We ordered a battered prawn appetiser followed by Szechuan beef and Teriyaki beef. Both were nicely presented on a large platter with smaller dishes - one vegetable broth, one salad and the main plate with rice and beef. The broth was very lightly flavoured and not very hot (in keeping with all establishments we've used in Hanoi - lukewarm broth seems to be the way of things here!). The salad was fresh and tasty, the beef and rice were delicious. We had a beer and a Rosebud tea. The tea was presented in a glass teapot on a glass burner/tealight stand. The rose buds slowly infused and opened to release their flavour. It was lovely. All in all we spent VND560,000/GBP20/USD24 + tip as no service charge was included. Excellent value for money., As we were walking from the Temple of Literature to the Opera House along Trang Thi we noticed this restaurant's beautiful interior wood work and decided to check it out. Returned later for supper and the food was fantastic. Had meet some people in Siagon who were also in Hanoi and invited them to join us for supper a few nights later and the restaurant did not disappoint us again. On the North East corner of Trang Thi and Hoi Vu, it is not difficult to find and well worth it. The cost of the meals was also very reasonable., First time here as introduced by friends. nice location, close to everything in town. u should note that bearing 50 of trang thi str., but there're a few 50s there and this shop is actually at the joint with Hoi Vu. nice settings out and inside, mix of east and west, lot of sunshines and greens the shop now has lotus theme for drinks and foods. I tried the lotus cofee a mixture of vietnamese cofee with minced and sweet lotus. interesting. we ordered lotus trunk salad, beefsteak and lotus roasted pigeon vemicelli soup. foods was so so 3 over 5 scale
description: From Arabica coffee beans nourished in soil with fragrant aroma of roasted fire, processed into elegance Italian coffee cups; To quintessential bowls of Chicken Pho in the luxury atmosphere or the green pearls color of the soup from Vong village, bearing the essence of autumn Hanoi. Together, all of elements harmonized in a “surreal” atmosphere, subtly sophisticated at Rue Du Camp. Each decoration evokes Vietnamese features that are both strange and familiar in contemporary inspiration.

name: Vamos - Tapas Kitchen & Bar
address: 19A đường Tây Hồ, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant's space is extremely cozy, friendly with a bit of Spanish, Latin, and Mediterranean style, looks very pleasant, I haven’t found any tapas restaurant similar with this style in Hanoi. If I had to choose, I would choose to sit outside near the open kitchen bar. Foods is Spanish Fusion, I ordered some dishes, all is truly impressive, excepted sweet potation chips, it is a bit hard, pale and oily About drink, you guys if come here must try cocktail named Frambuesa, it has light pink color, so good and looks beautiful too. Ah, that night I also ordered one shot tequila named “clase azul resposado” just because of curious, really it’s most expensive tequila i have known 🫣 😰, it costs equal one my dinner 😱 but it’s worth, Had a great dining experience in Vamos!! Especially the chic atmosphere in the restaurant, friendly staffs, wide selection of food and drinks and the decoration of the restaurant is so perfect for photos on insta🤭. I personally love the roasted suckling pig a lot which is always my favourite Spanish dish. Definitely will go again !!, At the end of a tour of Vietnam from south to north. I wanted something other than the beautiful Vietnamese food that we had been eating. I was told how extraordinary this place was in Hanoi. I was not disappointed, we started with a few tapas dishes and then had the Spanish Seafood Paella, finishing off with the cheesecake. The authenticity of the food is amazing, I am aware they source a lot of their product from Spain, so it’s no wonder it’s authentic. Has the opportunity of meeting Mr Tam and Miss Thuy. What beautiful people. Please support this restaurant, I am not easy to please, but I thought it transported me back to Spain or South America.
description: Inspired by Spanish cuisine and culture, Vamos Tapas Kitchen and Bar was born to blow a new breath into the Hanoi culinary map. Vamos offers the most authentic experience of Tapas culture - the essence of Spanish cuisine. The combination of Asian and European cuisine in the OPEN KITCHEN SPACE and Mediterranean atmosphere will be fully displayed at Vamos Tapas Kitchen & Bar (No. 19A, Tay Ho st, Tay Ho dist, Ha Noi, Vietnam)

name: The Australian Bistro and Coffee
address: 126 Yen Lang Thinh Quang, Dong Da, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: I highly recommend The Outback Australian Bistro and Coffee, I went there for diner with my friend, staff is very friendly, gave us good advises on foods and drinks. And the food was awesome ! Pizza and Spaggetti were so delicious and i cannot describe how good it was . I will come back for sure !!, My husband and I accidentally had dinner at this restaurant. However we were so supprised and thought it was worth every single penny. The price was so cheap and delicious that we def will comeback soon. My steak was so tender and creamy sauce was so yummy. My husband had chicken roulade with mashed potato also nice and juicy. Staff were soooo friendly and hospitable. We def will comeback The Outback., Had dinner here with a group of friends and we all had a good experience. Food was really good and service was exceptional. Our server, Chu Bá Thông, was very attentive and friendly. Would definitely come back again with friends.
description: The OB located in the heart of Hanoi which is run by an Australian chef. We offer all high-standard food and services at a reasonable price so that everyone can come to enjoy the romantic, cozy atmosphere. Besides, all freshest ingredients are bought from reliable suppliers and imported directly from Australia.

name: El Gaucho | Ba Dinh
address: Unit L1-16A, Vincom Center Metropolis, 29 Lieu Giai Ngoc Khanh Ward, Ba Dinh District, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Had been to El Gaucho in Trang Tien previously and found the lunch set to be good value. Same could be said here at Vincom in Ba Dinh. Had the salsicha this time as the starter. The spicy sausage was a good complement to the mixed green salad and proved a good appetizer for the main course. I had the rib eye and it was cooked to the medium I asked. Nicely seasoned and juicy. The steak fries were too big for my liking and perhaps normal cut fries would be a better pairing for the steak. In any case, good value for lunch. Expensive, certainly. Service was prompt and I had no complaints., Ate a good steak served with excellence by the young staff there. No complaints. I DO however have a bone to pick with El Gaucho itself: They make things up that don’t exist. There is NO SUCH THING AS “Platinum USDA Prime”. It is quite simply NOT a thing. It does not exist. Which leads me to ask: What are we really getting? Is the “USDA Prime” not really prime? But something lower? Is the “Platinum USDA Prime” (which again, Google it, DOES NOT EXIST except in the fertile minds of El Gaucho marketing staff) actually exactly the same thing as the USDA Prime on the menu? Just an idiot trap? If you Google “Platinum USDA Prime” you will find only references to El Gaucho. They fabricated it out of whole cloth. This “grade” of meat does not exist anywhere else. There is no explanation anywhere about what it is. It is BS. El Gaucho serves BS along with their bull meat. So something is dishonest about El Gaucho. Either the USDA Prime is not “prime” but “Choice” or lower, or if you are dump enough to pay a premium for “Platinum USDA Prime” you will probably get the same steak you would have gotten if you had ordered the USDA Prime for MUCH LESS MONEY. I would love El Gaucho Management to explain themselves. I hesitate to return, due to the corporate dishonesty. Again, my meal was fine (I had a USDA Prime Ribeye, 300 grams, because I wasn’t about to order a side of BS with my steak) and the service was excellent. I just don’t think they are selling what it says on the tin. False advertising. “Platinum USDA Prime” is NOT A THING., From the moment we walked in, my family and I were greeted by the friendly staff. We ordered off the cheesburgers off the lunch menu. The food tasted amazing and for incredible value. תודה לך ושיאיר פני אלוהים עליך ועל ישראל
description: Food is our passion and it is our aim to establish the benchmark in Southeast Asia and beyond for a contemporary, specialised steakhouse concept. We are proud to serve you the finest steakhouse-style food, using only the best available meat products sourced from selected farms in Victoria, New South Wales and individual farmers and ranchers in the United States.

name: Banh Mi 14
address: 14 Ngo Huyen Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We ate here twice, once on an amazing food tour (shout out to Vietnam is Awesome) and once on our own. We tried several different sandwiches and they were all amazing. Highly recommend!, It is interesting how is not famous on Tripadvisor. I think it´s the best shop of Banh mi. We went there a couple of times. The prices, the food, the place. AWESOME!, The baguettes, as well as the yoghurt meals, are superb and cheap. The owner is really friendly and quick.
description: Our Banh Mi store is very small but very good, clean and cheap! I can make one Banh Mi in about 5 minutes, you can take away very easy! Come and check it out guys!

name: Bo De Quan Vegetarian Restaurant
address: 164 Au Co Street, Tay Ho District, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: this is a vegan/vegetarian restaurant with a wide variety of dishes served buffet style. We went with a guide as part of a larger evening tour and he explained all of the food to us. Without a guide you may be guessing what each dish actually is, but it all tastes good. No worries about accidently eating meat. There are a lot of Mock Meats (which are important for cultural reasons). Definitely a place to come if you are vegan., Good Experience with the Guide. Near by area Buddhist monuments that contains number of text, Images of Buddha Bodhi satva, I came here, because of the holidays, other place i looked for was closed. How happy i am that i did. Variety of veggie dishes, everything is fresh, You can eat as much as You want. Soups are amazing. You have also fresh fruits, salads, fried options.
description: this is a vegan/vegetarian restaurant with a wide variety of dishes served buffet style.  We went with a guide as part of a larger evening tour and he explained all of the food to us.  Without a guide you may be guessing what each dish actually is, but it all tastes good.  No worries about accidently eating meat.  There are a lot of Mock Meats (which are important for cultural reasons).  Definitely a place to come if you are vegan.

name: Tu Lun Beef Noodle
address: 23 Hai Ba Trung, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: the Beef Pho was really nice, the broth obviously had a lot of time and effort put into it and it really showed. nice hand done noodles, One of the best Pho that i've had in Vietnam so far. However this place is small with rather little seats and you will likely need to share table with others. Not the cleanest eatery but really really good Pho., Simple, but great taste. Cant say anything more. Just try it! Every incredient you can order more if its not enough.
description: the Beef Pho was really nice, the broth obviously had a lot of time and effort put into it and it really showed. nice hand done noodles

name: Thien Tra Dao
address: 29 Alley 26 Vo Van Dung Dong Da, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: My fave place to have healthy vegan food. I came here many times before, usually had bun cha or the fresh rolls, now they have less food options but I don’t mind cuz my fave dishes are still there. Will definitely come back to try more tea (there are a lot!). P/s: they persuaded me to try the Pad thai because the weather was cold. Worth it! Hot and spicy and the portion is big!, In a peaceful neighborhood with delicious food!! This is a hidden gem. The Cinnamon Orange tea (I got it hot) was amazing!!! Best tea I have had by far. The sticky rice was delicious as well and the salad hoa qua nhiet doi was perfect!! A must visit place- even if your not vegan 😊 Follow @travelingypsey on Instagram & Google Maps Safe Travels!, Very creative dishes and arrangements. Its nice to find a restaurant in hanoi that is clean & takes pride. The staff is warm and mindful as well. Will def be ordering again. Thank you!
description: Thien Tra Dao serves artisan tea and vegan food in a peaceful place with two floors and zen music played in the background. Located in a quiet alley. Menu is in Vietnamese and English. Has English speaking staff. Est. 2017. Open Mon-Sun 9.am to 10.pm

name: Sushi Bar II
address: 51 Xuan Dieu, Tay Ho, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Awesome sushi, and we ordered way more than we could eat. It's mostly made fresh for you, and we got a few extras like miso soup and a starter thrown in for free. Excellent service and great food. We live nearby and will be back., We were a group of five who booked a table last min on Sat night that they managed to fit us in. The menu is a little overwhelming as there is so much choice. We opted for a selection of sushi, tempura dishes with edamane beans. All was super tasty and fresh, perfect sharing as a group with a few tiger beers on tap. Bill worked out less than £10 each for decent amount of food and a couple of drinks each., After three times at this place I can recommend without any doubt, Service is fast, if you are a sushi fan everything is prepared fresh open to the guest. I had several non sushi dishes , always hot And fresh. So if you do shopping in the mall and want to eat something fresh and healthy it is better than fat fastfood you get around.
description: Awesome sushi, and we ordered way more than we could eat.  It's mostly made fresh for you, and we got a few extras like miso soup and a starter thrown in for free.  Excellent service and great food.  We live nearby and will be back.

name: Parosand Sky Bar Restaurant
address: 9th Floor, 537 Lac Long Quan Xuan La, Tay Ho, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Overall we were impressed with the restaurant and sky bar. The food was of good quality, comparable to some other popular Western cuisine restaurants in the Old Quarter. There were a variety of drinks and they were delicious too. However, we were generally disappointed with the music, as it was a little too loud and the playlist seems to have had only pop songs. There weren't any classical songs or house ones, which are what we expect on the sky bar. If you don't mind chilling in mediocre music then this place should probably be on your to-go list. Oh, and we must also mention that the view here is spectacular. You'll love it., Sensational place to have breakfast. Value for money sensational and the staff can not do enough for you
description: Pilot Restaurant is located on the 9th floor that offers both Vietnamese and Western food. It is a perfect place to catch up with friends and family and enjoy fusion cuisine as well as wide selection of wine.

name: Local Bar
address: 16 Ta Hien Street Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Small place. It was a good experience. Cheap drinks. Lucky to have 2 rounds of Sheesha served in happy hours. Happy Us !! Happy High !!, I love my visit. The staff are eztremely friendly. They speak a little english but that’s okay, all you need are the basics. The people are crazy fun but you will be left alone if you wish to. It’s a fun and safe place to hang out. The crowd maybe wild most of the time but it is a decent place and you’ll feel secure. The sounds ^high five^ took me back to the 90s disco and lead me to present. Plus, you’ll feel at home. The staff will even walk you to your ride (when you go there alone). Thank you guys!!! Will surely comeback. Can’t wait, I have been there at the midnight , music so nice , i can dancing with my friends, and drink not so expensive !
description: Great bar on the Old Quarter's busiest street where regulars and new friends come together for great drinks and cool music to party the night away.

name: Pizza 4P's Lotte West Lake Hanoi
address: 272 Vo Chi Cong street., Hanoi 11210 Vietnam
reviews: Visited here twice over 3 days. The second time (Monday) the staff were excellent. The food was served quickly and was delicious. The only downsides: Vietnamese need to respect eating environments - 2 fellow diners were coughing and constantly clearing their throats; they had finished eating and were just lounging about. No-one can be seated next to them and be expected to enjoy a meal., My wife and I ate here twice whilst in Hanoi. Each time we had to queue and now I know why. The chicken teriyaki pizza and crab pasta are fabulous, so it you fancy an Italian, then please.have a look here., A fun place to eat, lots of energy, friendly and accommodating staff and the food was great too. I would definitely return
description: Visited here twice over 3 days. The second time (Monday) the staff were excellent. The food was served quickly and was delicious. The only downsides: Vietnamese need to respect eating environments - 2 fellow diners were coughing and constantly clearing their throats; they had finished eating and were just lounging about. No-one can be seated next to them and be expected to enjoy a meal.

name: Cho Que Restaurant

The service was just okay, the food was great though., This restaurant serve many traditional Vietnamese dishes. The food is very good. Nice staffs. The atmosphere is like a rural village in Vietnam., Well, recently, my company held a year-end party in this restaurant. It's a little bit difficult to find this place but when you arrive, it won't make you disppointed with nicly and warmly decorated atmosphere like you are in countryside. I recommend you to try beef grilled in bamboo. It's delicious. Also, a quite simple dish is a fried sweet potato. The dessert is decorated well.

reviews: Yes, it was expensive if you compare with other streetfood restaurant in average. The price is a little higher as they served seafood. I paid 1 mio VND for 2 persons. name: Chops Lotte
address: 56 Pham Huy Thong, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Absolutely superb burgers here including vegetarian, smoothies and juices also available as well as a gorgeous bar with interesting pale ales. Very cheap for what you are getting too., I have been living in Hanoi for 4 years and haven't found better place with burgers. The location near the lake is great and staff is super nice., Perfect burgers, amazing place, would 100% recommend!!!! Really great meat and atmosphere. Thesauces were very nice too

Serving gourmet burgers, tempting starters and salads coupled with a fine selection of craft beers on draught and bottles. Great atmosphere with a non stop playlist of classic rock. The restaurant is over 3 floors and has an outside seating area on the top floor overlooking the lake.

name: Cutisun Restaurant
address: No. 3, Alley 120, Hoang Hoa Tham Street, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: I ate at a different restaurant of the same chain but I think they would be similar in quality. The foods were not special but the main plus is their affordable price, Cute little diner. Attractive decor. Low prices for steak. I had the rib eye and, yeh was ok but nothing to write home about. The sauce though was shocking and the chips and salad portions so small you could have put it on your fork in one go. I think this is a complaint others have highlighted in TA. The staff were strange, insisting we sit in the corner as there was not enough of us to fill a big table. We were the only customers for the entire time we were there so I don't know what that was about. My girlfriend had the lamb and it was considerably better than the steak., Visited here after a 2 year gap. The waitress could not understand the simple menu presented in English - ‘French Fries’ was looked at in amazement. The glass of red wine was dirty. We had to remind them about the coke we had ordered. The food was simply plonked on the table as the waitress and her male colleague woofed down bread rolls within clear sight of customers.

name: Xôi Bà Hiền
address: 25 Ngõ 622 Minh Khai, Vĩnh Tuy, Hai Bà Trưng, Hà Nội, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: I went there almost every morning during my 3-week trip for breakfast. Chewy stick rice with various toppings to combine. Best stewed pork belly I ever have., If you’re looking for the ultimate Vietnamese experience, this sticky rice is a true standout. The sticky rice is delightfully chewy and aromatic, paired with tender, well-seasoned meat that melts in your mouth!

address: 100 Hai Bà Trưng, Cửa Nam, Hoàn Kiếm, Hai Ba Trung, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Before, I ate shrimp cakes and vermicelli noodles that were very delicious... this time I had a chance to go out with my family and saw that the restaurant had a location here so I went in to eat... the food was prepared very quickly, the dipping sauce was brought out to the guests, the meat was still hot. ,,, I ordered a roasted bird, it was well marinated, the meat was not dry... especially I really like the raw vegetables served here, which are abundant, clean, and look very delicious... name: Quan Bia Minh
address: 7A Dinh Liet, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: I ate here on my last night in Hanoi. I was on my own so sat upstairs on the balcony overlooking the busy street below. I ordered a beer and started with the pork spring rolls, which were really delicious. I ate a lot of spring rolls in Vietnam and these ones were up there with the best. For main meal I ordered a beef dish with chilli and lemongrass and was disappointed. I was served a huge plate of onion, with beef and carrot scattered throughout. Unfortunately I’m not a fan of onion, so I found myself picking around it. The flavour was a bit bland also. Had I just had beer and spring rolls, it would have been much better., Hot day and really just stopped by for a local Bia Hoi. Sat on the terrace and people watched, which is something even novice people watchers like me can get into. The rhythms of this city are strangely recognizable under the superficial appearance of randomness. Service a bit slow … and it was not busy. But, good local beer and viewing of life., Many choices in the menu, nice local upstairs and delicious pho. The only problem was that our dishes arrived with 15 minutes difference...
description: Just 2 minutes walk from the north end of Hoan Kiem lake at the lake end of Dinh Liet St

name: Manwah Taiwanese Hotpot Thai Ha
address: 1 Thai Ha 2nd Floor, Dong Da, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: If you are familiar with haidilao, then you may imagine this chain as an attempt to copy it. Which is fine, if it is done well. Unfortunately it falls short of the following issues: (1). Soup base. The Taiwanese special soup was good, but there were too many lotus seeds inside. The tomato soup, my favourite for hotpot, was average. (2). Meats. This is the first steamboat restaurant I have ever been to, that does not have chicken in the menu. The waiter said there is duck, but he himself cannot find it in the menu. He then served us a plate of duck… (?!). However, fried chicken is offered in the buffet. Since I’m on missing items, this is also the first steamboat restaurant I have ever been to, that does not have plain steamed rice in the menu. Yup, NO RICE but noodles. (3). Desserts. Although there is a large variety, some items tasted “funny” eg the black glutinous rice, the red ruby. The “raindrop” was amazing, though it tasted rather bland. (4). Service. There are minor attempts to provide a high level of service eg. One waiter came to help us peel the prawns - unfortunately, he came only after we were done with two of four prawns. No one came to remove the foam from the soups. Soup refilling needed to be asked for. Soup ladles were not sufficient. I note that the condiments were not regularly refilled either. Our first and last visit,, This is the best hotpot in Hanoi with excellent services from restaurant manager and their staff. Truly 5 Star rating, A broad range of options, for all budgets. The most important in hotpot is the control of the temperature and you are provided with an effective tool to modify it depending on the food you put inside (e.g. octopus, red meat, meatballs, etc.). The deserts are average. The tables at the periphery are right next to the shopping mall pathway so not recommended as they are noisy. Better choose inside tables. Need to book in advance as it is popular.

name: Tomato Seafood

reviews: New place for who want to try seafood combo. 765.000 vnd for 2 pax. Included : baked oyster. Sauteed vegetable. Fried bebe. Crab hot pot. Service is ok. reviews: The food was fresh and staff were attentive! I particularly enjoyed the Bun Cha! Our family left full and happy. We would recommend :)

reviews: Originally was going for the fish fry, but changed my mind and got German food. Great atmosphere, friendly attentive servers, food was presented in large quantities. Excellent scenic view., This was a good place to have a beer or two, with western style food, while watching the world go by on the round-a-about from the 4th floor. All very clean and reasonably priced., And we did manage to get one of the edge tables that give a great view over Hoan Kiem Lake. But personally the reason I really liked it was that it did two draft house beers and one of these was a really good dark beer. We found it a very good elevated spot to take a break from walking the lake and rest with a decent beer for a while. Oh and the Free Wi-Fi worked well as well..

reviews: Now when I go alone, I order Butter Chicken. Will come back thanks, - delicious food, chicken curry sauce is quite suitable, rich and creamy. Long grain rice is sticky and fragrant. Eat with roll sauce - You order Khanh something lovely + friendly staff - The minus point is that the food I ordered was quite spicy and had a lot of flour, so I got bored eating it quickly. Few green vegetables because I'm used to eating green vegetables in Vietnam., Yummy curry! We had Paneer tikka masala and Daal Makhni. We also had buttered Naan, garlic butter naan and Mango Lassi. name: Cincin Hà Nội
address: 80 Hang Trong, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Found this little gem by chance on a hot Friday afternoon looking to escape the heat for a cool wine and snack. Greeted by a young fresh exuberant team who went out of their way to look after us for what ended up being a couple of hours of relaxation, soft background music, great wines and fantastic cheese platter and pate which is no mean fete given the location. The small restaurant is brilliantly decorated but what made it extra special was to watch a team of four young, polite, attentive and jovial staff who clearly enjoy their work and love being with and attending to customers. What a refreshing and positive experience to see positive enthusiastic young people at work. Definitely on our visit again list and highly recommended., Cincin was an unexpected delight to encounter. Great food and drinks in a modern contemporary setting. The staff were attentive and the ambience was lovely. We were able to take a break from the hustle and bustle of Hanoi to enjoy a small bite to eat. I chose the chilli and garlic prawns, truffle chips and the profiterole's. I also had the oolong milk tea. All was delicious! I would recommend this place to all.

name: Swing Lounge
address: 21 Trang Tien, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant first floor ambiance is interesting and the food is good. We went on a Saturday night before the show and it was extremely quiet, almost empty. Around 21:00 we then went up to the second floor where is the stage and it felt suddenly more crowded. I might be wrong but it seems that the place is mostly frequented by a young Vietnamese middle class. The staff kindly gave us the possibility to get a table and it looked like everyone else had their seats reserved in advance. Before the band there was 2 lady singers performing each 3 recorded songs as a warm up. The rock band was very talented, the atmosphere very cool but the sound was so loud that eventually we needed to cover our ears most of the time. After an hour we decided to leave before bursting our eardrums... Maybe it is not always loud like that but if that's the case then it is a bit of a shame as it makes it really hard to appreciate what is being played. Drinks are a bit pricy but you don't pay any entrance fee so it balance up the value. A cool place to hang out and if I may suggest bring some ear plugs just in case..., Really cool ambiance here, it seems like a popular music (live band) venue over the restaurant, the food was really delicious but getting the order and getting a waiter after was so hard just to get some pepper and salt. Thankfully one of them speak English the price was quite decent, spent 480000 for 3 people (3 meals and 1 fresh juice and 2 teas) I recommend this place if you have time and patience it's worth it., We have really enjoyed the quality food, actually snacks, some finger foods, and softdrinks. Seem that evything went smooth but it just overall, this place a bit lack of smiles. From the satff. Great if the manager could look into this issue.
description: Swing Cafe & Restaurant offer you a classic but trendy atmosphere right in the heart of Hanoi. It's a great place to meet your business partners, hang out with your friends, or simply finish your ongoing novel with a cup of tea by the window overlooking the crowded Hanoi street. We offer various Vietnamese and Italian cuisines, as well as a large selection of teas, coffee, juices and delicious desert cakes. Swing Music Lounge opens every evening and it's truly a place where you can enjoy LIVE singers perform the best Vietnamese and English songs every nights. A dazzling perform stage, a romantic candle lit table, a delicious signature cocktails, a glass of the finest wine, or just simply a cold beer... we have it all!

name: Let's Sushi
address: 13B Quoc Tu Giam Van Chuong, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: The sashimi is fresh and soft. It melts long in my mouth. The sushi is flavorful and chewy. The Japanese beef is tenderly soft and with the sauce, it explodes a good taste in my mouth. For dessert, I have the mochi ice-cream. Overall, this deserves to be 100/10., It was really good sushi. Good service too. The toilet is a bit dirty but this seems to be quite normal in Hanoi. If you are around pop in and enjoy. Yummy Sushi. And fresh., Very decent sushi which was enjoyed by all. Close to train station which was useful for us. Kids enjoyed the gyoza and prawn tempura.

name: Ete Resto Cafe
address: 95 Giang Van Minh Ba Dinh District, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: I’ve been dropping into Ete/Resto Bar for the past 4-years and it never disappoints. It reminds me of an East Village dive, a saloon, a place to chill, drink booze and beer (cheaper than the average Hanoi bar) and eat good food (burgers, pizza for me). There are three floors, each with its own personality but its the main floor, with the winding bar and comfortable stools and funky ambiance that keeps me coming back. I can smoke thuoc loa (outside) and mingle with a collection of locals and expats. The service is exceptional and debit cards are welcome. Oh, and it opens early and stays open late. My kinda joint…, My wife and I stumbled across this place by accident on our recent trip to Vietnam. We enjoyed the Vietnamese food so much that we went back for a second visit., My first time went to Ete bar was 10 months ago. First impression about the atmosphere was quite good. It was clean, music was relaxing and people were nice. If you don't know them well, they might show you very cold faces, but trust me all the staffs here are really really awesome and funny. Most of the staffs can speak both English and Vietnamese. So it's easy to order things on menu. Foods are so amazing. They have the best tastes ever. You maybhave chance to see three fat cats sometimes( around 4 pm till 7pm ).
description: ETE offer a choice of western food. We are known in Hanoi for our burgers that in large size are quite impossible to finish! We also have food such as tartines,sandwiches, salad, fish and meat like 'tournedos' beef, chicken etc... We also have a vietnamese food. ETE is also a cafe/bar that offer a really big choice of drinks (soft,fresh fruit juices, belgium & local beers cocktails, spirits, wines). We are very near to B52 Museum, Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum and Museum.

name: New Sphinx Beer Bar
address: 02 Lang Ha, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: A very good place if you would like to have beer, Vietnamese Foods and Great Shows! Great selection of beers and good foods! Waitress are very friendly but not really good in English! Shows are great and all dancers are really energetic! If you would like to feel the night life of Vietnam, here is the place!

address: No. 6, Bao Khanh Lane, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: We had a great experience here. We occupied the terrace seating , open to the sky and stars. With the lights and music and gentle breeze, it made it all the more special. I highly recommend this gem in the Hanoi Pearl Hotel.😊👍, Fantastic food, a lot of variety. Western and Vietnamese. Impeccable service! We had a birthday that night. They went out of their way to decorate!

There are plenty of traditional local specialities and international dishes in an intimate and informal setting to tempt you in our gorgeous restaurant. In-room-service is available from 06.30 am to 10.00 pm so you can enjoy delicious meals and snacks in the privacy of your room or suite.

name: Crust Pizzaria
address: 3 Alley 12 Dang Thai Mai, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: For me The best pizza in Hanoi. The crust is perfect, thin and crunchy and a can hold the ingredients well. I do missing more toppings options such as corn, eggplant, green olives, etc. I do think extra cheese is necessary especially with the pepperoni. Wood oven would have make it even better, but still it's very good pizza, The pizza is absolutely fantastic here. If you have a western taste palate you will love it. Staff very friendly and service good. I will return here for sure., Pizza and pasta are good, OK, but not other things. Friendly staffs. Good for young couple or teenages

name: Double B's Coffee & Brunch
address: Số 6, Ngõ 28 Đường Tây Hồ Bamboo House, Tay Ho, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: We've just moved to the area and this place is just down the road, and we'll be back in future. It's reasonably quiet although the usual bike/car horns can get irritating. description: With a fresh and ventilated garden and an extra cozy room, Double B's is more than a perfect place for both working and meeting friends. name: Ms Hương Ly Vietnamese Restaurant & Cafe
address: 44-46 P. Phùng Hưng, Hàng Bông, Hoàn Kiếm, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: After experiencing the noise and chaos of the other end of Train Street, this peaceful location was a lovely surprise. The owners were very friendly and attentive whilst not hovering. The outlook to streets beyond were lovely and the food was delicious. I'll definitely come back here if I return to Hanoi., Me and my mate enjoyed a lovely dinner whilst watching the train go by! The hostess was so caring to us and made sure we had a great time. The food was authentic and delicious and filling!! Couldn’t recommend it more!, Amazing food, lovely people and great chilled place to watch the train! Hu’o’ng really makes the restaurant special. Would definitely recommend!

I'll definitely come back here if I return to Hanoi.

name: Vietnamese street food
address: 8 Quan Su, Hanoi, Vietnam, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: We went on a street food tour with 'Long' who was a very experienced and entertaining guide. Our hotel, The Angel Palace, organised this for us. We tasted some amazing food and Long explained all the ingredients so we knew exactly what we were eating.......and it was all fantastic., Lots of street food & its worth trying. Most all of it is good & cheap. We tried it all & didn't get sick., We were treated to some amazing street food and culture by eating here, just be patient with communicating if you don't speak Vietnamese
description: Authentic Vietnamese street food. We offer a variety of dishes featuring Vegetarian options. No MSG is found here, ensuring that you leave feeling just as good as before, or better! Our staff is friendly and the location is situated in the old city. An affordable restaurant for everyone! Our sign at the front features a lit up sign with 008 on of, address is found beneath. Hope to see you here!

name: Citadel Skybar
address: 12 - 14 Dinh Ngang 9th Floor, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: I went to the sky bar in the afternoon to watch the beautiful sunset and the open space. Moreover, I was served by bartender Hung Cao, who was great, professional working style, enthusiastic with customers, drinks were delicious and suitable for me. I have been to many restaurants but this is the best experience because the space and staff make me very satisfied and memorable., Frenkie Viet was the best person we met in Vietnam, very friendly to guide on dishes based on our personal choices and suggesting the best way to eat and spend quality time with friends . Thank you Frenkie!!!! Thank you Citadel Sky Bar, It was such an awesome choice to spend my birthday here!! The room was awesome, clean and comfortable, and the balcony was a bonus. I think what made it special was the service from the staff. I feel so so welcome! This afternoon while I was in my room, I had a knock on the door and it was two of the the service staff with a cake in hand, singing HBD to me. I honestly didn’t expect that and it really made my day. At the sky bar, I also got a little free shot for my birthday. They pay super attention to details and I think the only way I could properly thank them is to leave a review (which I am usually too lazy to). So thank you to the receptionist Minh (he looks like a superstar) and Trang, and the friendly bartenders Tu, Haivu and Viet for being so welcoming! I will definitely come back again when I’m at Hanoi next!

From handbrew coffee to hearty meals, the ingredients are carefully selected and well prepared. We aspire to bring you the best experiences with full of love, passion, and of course, high quality.

name: Buffet Poseidon Long Biên
address: Tầng 2, TTTM TASCO Megamall, số 7-9 Nguyễn Văn Linh, Long Biên, Hà Nội, Hanoi 11800 Vietnam
description: Buffet Poseidon is the largest chain of hotpot, BBQ, and seafood buffet restaurants in Vietnam. Inspired by Poseidon, the Greek god of the sea, the brand is dedicated to bringing a diverse and exquisite culinary experience to all diners. At Poseidon, guests can enjoy a lavish selection of over 200 meticulously crafted dishes, with premium seafood as the highlight, including crabs, lobsters, mantis shrimp, sea snails, salmon, shrimp, squid, and many more delicacies. Diners are invited to indulge in an unlimited feast, featuring a fusion of Asian and European flavors, expertly prepared by top-tier chefs, ensuring an unforgettable gourmet experience.

name: Rural Tonkin & Banh Mi Nhé
address: 9 Hang Voi 2 Fl., Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This is a hidden gem in Hanoi! At the end of our trip, both my partner and I agreed that this had been the best Bahn Mi we had during our week in Hanoi. It’s difficult to find as you must walk up some stairs as the restaurant is on the second floor. They serve vegan options, and we’re attentive to my partners nut allergy, Great spot off the beaten track and best Banh Mi we have tried whilst in Hanoi. Omelette, mushroom and cheese was the veggie option which was lovely and well priced at 30k VND (£1 ish). Very friendly host., Hard to spot, because it’s upstairs on a fairly busy through fare, but it’s a cute little nook. The food was stellar. The spring rolls were fresh and tasty and the banh mi sandwiches were next level. Slightly crispy baguettes, with perfectly cooked chicken (maybe done in coconut oil?). Tasted exquisite.
description: A Vietnamese cozy restaurant in Hanoi, offering truely authentic local food in Tonkin, which is tasty & healthy & freshly nature made!

name: Nha Hang Long De
address: Căn 92 TT4 - Đường 11, KĐT Thành Phố Giao Lưu, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: 今天 我们 在 这，那 是 好， 我 也 爱 这 个， 我 一定 今 来 We go there last month with family and friends, the food are yummy, we will come back soon, The restaurant is enthusiastic and thoughtful. Hygienic food, delicious food. Space is spacious, airy and clean, Ninh Binh is a very famous place by Trang An Eco, Hoa Lu ancient capital, Bai Dinh pagoda, Cuc Phuong national park....But other side of this beautiful & attractive land, it is about the local foods: goat meat, fried rice, fresh vegetables.... Now you no need travel so far over 100KM to Ninh Binh province for tasting these all delicious foods. You could come to this restaurant, only 5KM away from Hanoi Old town. - Local Ninh Binh foods, fresh meats & vegetables... all you could have it here.
description: With more than 30 years of experience in mountain goat restaurant in Ninh Binh, Long De Restaurant specializes in providing fresh goat meat and dishes from Ninh Binh mountain goat meat. With the advantage of having a business base in Ninh Binh, we are committed to providing you with the freshest food from Ninh Binh mountain goat. When you need to buy fresh meat, please contact and order 1 day in advance for us to prepare. Because we do not sell frozen goods, we only sell fresh goods for slaughter, so the order and payment procedure must be completed before 15:00 of the previous day.

name: Ba Mien
address: 1 Le Thánh Tong Street Hilton Hanoi Opera, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant has a lot of different dishes, most of the dishes are quite delicious. The salad is made from many other ingredients such as vegetables, meat and shrimp, and the sauce is also processed separately. The restaurant's beef noodle soup is quite delicious, the beef is plentiful and the broth is seasoned quite well. The restaurant space is quite spacious but it will be really hot during the day, making us quite uncomfortable because they use transparent glass layers to make the roof, hope the restaurant will improve., This restaurant is located at 1 Le Thanh Tong Street Hilton Hanoi Opera, Hanoi. The restaurant has many delicious dishes such as vermicelli with spring rolls, desserts with many different fruits, which I really like. The beef noodle soup here is made quite well, the broth of the beef noodle soup is seasoned very well, as I know this is one of the delicious dishes in Vietnam. Besides, there is also sushi here, I never thought that a Vietnamese restaurant would have this dish. The restaurant space is quite hot and uncomfortable, I think the restaurant should replace the glass roof with another material., The buffet spread at Ba Mien was excellent in filling us up with energy for the day to enjoy our day tours. Ambience at Ba Mien was lovely and the waitress were attentive.

address: 38 Tran Phu Dien Ban, Ba Dinh, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Excellent purely Vietnamese restaurant. Fondue with seafood and very fresh meats in an extremely tasty and tasty broth. To try without worries. A great experience!, I have ordered a wake and fish egg salad for 80 duong and they brought me a super cheap cabbage leaves salad with a touch of wakame and fish egg on the top. I understand why they don't have pictures on their menu.
description: Excellent purely Vietnamese restaurant. Fondue with seafood and very fresh meats in an extremely tasty and tasty broth. To try without worries. A great experience!

name: Cafe Hieu
address: 28 Bat Dan, Hang Bo Ward, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: I saw this cafe being reviewed and photographed by many foreigners, so I was curious about this place. The tables and chairs here are very clean and all are made of wood but it's a bit small for me. The space of the shop is also quite cramped, but I am still quite excited to have the experience of drinking coffee on the street like Vietnamese people. I highly appreciated the service and I ordered a cup of black coffee but I felt that the black coffee was not very appetizing, it was quite bitter. I wonder why Vietnamese people drink black coffee so often so., We ate here twice and it was a great place to people watch ass they went about their business. The menu was like reading a book and both times i ate a banh my while my wife was more adventurous. The place was quite busy in the evening., Exquisite food, cozy environment and very (very) affordable prices. My partener and I have been travelling in Vietnam for about a month and this little cafe has the most delicious and generous spring rolls. Also we had the Vegetarian fry rice two times and the flavor its just amazing. Toilet very clean and lovely people working there.
description: Bong đa K+ va internet Wifi Free

name: Bach Phuong Restaurant - Southern Beef Noodle
address: 67 Hang Dieu Street, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant was recommended by my daughter from a previous visit to Hanoi and was just fantastic. Basically it specialises only in variations on beef noodle salad but it was just delicious and very cheap. It really was one of the top 3 highlights of our 3 days in Hanoi., We all tried the Bun Bo Nam Bo (beef noodle bowl) it was good. The service was good, the food came quick and it was pretty darn tasty. Worth a try if you want to try something different in terms of Vietnamese cuisine., Go here and try this out. You get the same as everyone else, noodles with beef. I think they have a vegan option as well. It's the best beef noodle soup I've had so far. I'm a picky eater and I ate all of it despite not being very hungry. It's only around 70k which equals to about $3.5. Worth every penny.

reviews: It is a good and clean restaurant and tasty food. There is also plants at the front of the entrance. I am so happy about this.

name: Dê Ngon Quán
address: Nguyễn Xuân Khoát, Khu Ngoại Giao Đoàn Bt2-7, Bắc Từ Liêm, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: I have rarely seen a Goat restaurant with such a beautiful, clean and luxurious space. That's the first look, as for the food, it's really impressive 😅 Goat is not difficult to eat, still retains its characteristic flavor and is prepared extremely delicately. Particularly impressed with the Roasted Goat and Mongolian Goat Hot Pot 😊 The restaurant is in the Diplomatic Corps area 👍, The Vietnamese restaurant that I was most impressed with recently. Spacious space and beautiful restaurant. Last time I passed by I saw a sign of a Thai Chef holding a Michelin but I didn't think it would be so good. Delicious food, beautiful decoration and extremely spacious. The most stable point is probably that all goat dishes do not have a bad smell. The roast dish is delicious, the Mongolian goat hot pot is also very suitable. Will definitely come back more times.
