name: Naruto Kitchen Viet Nam
address: 1 P. Tống Duy Tân, Hàng Bông, Hoàn Kiếm, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: 5/5 great food, service and location. We ate at this spot while we were in Hanoi. I enjoyed the fried garlic chicken and fries. The chicken was perfectly fried and seasoned. Great staff and location. We had the opportunity to see the train pass while we ate. Such an awesome city., The chicken was sooooo good. It was moist and flavorful. I got both the ginger and the garlic and both were amazing. Definitely worth checking if you are in the area., Great Zangi and udon 🍜. Friendly staff and taking care. Specially auth favor from Hokkaido Japan. Best recomment. I will come again 😍😍😍
description: NARUTO KITCHEN – Hương vị gà chiên trứ danh từ Hokkaido, Nhật Bản. Ra đời từ năm 1952 tại Otaru, Hokkaido, Naruto Kitchen là nhà hàng Izakaya nổi tiếng với món gà chiên trứ danh, mang hương vị truyền thống qua nhiều thế hệ. Bắt đầu từ một quán nhỏ do ông của anh Satou sáng lập, món gà chiên Naruto nhanh chóng trở thành biểu tượng ẩm thực của Hokkaido. Đến năm 1980, bố anh Satou tiếp nối truyền thống và sáng lập New Naruto, mở ra một chương mới cho thương hiệu. Năm 2016, sau khi được cha truyền dạy và không ngừng học hỏi, anh Satou đã thành lập Naruto Kitchen, đưa hương vị này vươn xa hơn nữa. Giờ đây, Naruto Kitchen đã có mặt tại Việt Nam! Hãy đến và thưởng thức món gà chiên trứ danh, cùng với rất nhiều món nhậu chuẩn vị Nhật Bản!

name: Long Vi Dung
address: 107 Ma May Street, Hang Bac Ward, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: I came here to try the dried beef salad, nom bo kho. I enjoyed the taste, some of the beef was a bit chewie but sweet and tasty. I would return, it is more of a quick bithe than a full meal., Small place on food street very close to Hoan Kiem lake offering just few traditional Hanoi cuisine dishes. Dry beef 🥩 salat, fresh spring-rolls, dumplings 🥟, fried pork…..great combination with local beer. When not raining ☔️ sitting outside on small chairs. You are served just after order and enjoy 😉 Hà Nội taste, unique experience, The dumplings were not of my taste but the salad was okay. Nice street atmosphere and cheap prices. Service was nice and fast.
description: I came here to try the dried beef salad, nom bo kho. I enjoyed the taste, some of the beef was a bit chewie but sweet and tasty. I would return, it is more of a quick bithe than a full meal.

name: Au Lac Club
address: 3 Nguyen Khac Can, Hanoi 1383 Vietnam
reviews: We tried the Au Lac as it was close to our hotel and we had a good experience. Reasonable prices and decent food - I had a noodle soup and my wife the bbq pork washed down with some local beer. We did sit outside though as they still allowing smoking inside in Vietnam, Second time eating lunch here, good selection on the menu fast service and nice atmosphere well worth a try, We were about to get some supper after a fairly long trip from Laos and wandered down the hotel to the back bar. I noticed the restaurant over the road which was full of clients on the footpath having a great time so I talked the wife into going there instead. We sat inside and watched the wine flow outside, the order which wasn't large was placed and we ordered a wine and waited and waited and waited. I stopped our waiter who was racing outside with carafes of expensive wines several times but he would smile and indicate "just a moment". After an hour we gave up and plodded back to the hotel. I am sure it was a lovely restaurant but we will never know.
description: We tried the Au Lac as it was close to our hotel and we had a good experience. Reasonable prices and decent food - I had a noodle soup and my wife the bbq pork washed down with some local beer. We did sit outside though as they still allowing smoking inside in Vietnam

name: The Deli Restaurant
address: 52 Bat Su street, Hoan Kiem district Hanoi Delano Hotel, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Great place to get a bite to eat and escape the busy streets of Hanoi's Old Quarter. Our waitress Mai was extremely attentive and did everything to make our experience a memorable one., Fabulous food to be enjoyed here. We have had Vietnamese food, steak and burgers and everything tasted great. The staff is very friendly and makes sure that your every need is attended to. Def will recommend this place, Nice and cozy ambiance that is perfect for a dinner date, or family gathering. They offer a wide range of food from Vietnamese cuisine to hamburgers, spaghetti, pizza, etc. Great staff and they speak fluent English! I love the Fuji beef dish that I ordered. It's sooooo TENDER and JUICY and I love the sauce that goes with it. The Deli Restaurant is definitely A MUST TRY if you want to escape the hustle and bustle of the city for a while and enjoy the great ambiance with various food options.
description: The Deli Restaurant & Bar is situated on the ground floor of Hanoi Delano Hotel- an upscale and stylish boutique located right in the heart of The Old Quarter at 52 Bat Su Street.The Deli offers a classy and contemporary vibe for a tasty lunch or dinner, Includings: - Vietanmese Cuisine - Set Menu Vietnamese, Western Menu - Ala Carte Menu - Cooking Class ( Vietnamese ) - Pub served wine, Beer, Drink - Happy Hours from 15:00 until 18:00 Daily ( Buy 1 get 1 Free )

name: Surf'n'Fries
address: 17 Nha Tho, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: a little good fatty food to taste and to have fries with cheezy fries, nice, not too expensive, near the church, peaceful and coloured, I kept walking by this place near my hotel, and after a few days I decided to try it. The large fries are just 59,000 VND and are served in a cone shaped container (the tables have holes built in to hold it upright), one choice of seasoning, and two dipping sauces. The two sauces (I chose spicy cheese and hotino) were the stars of the meal. It was a bit of a wait, although understandable for a Saturday night. There's a play area on ground level for children, so sit upstairs if you want some peace and quiet., The burgers are really tasty, especially the hamburger ! The fried potatoes are so nice too, cut in many different ways with a big variety of sauces to choose! We visited this place twice and it was a dinner that we really enjoyed. The stuff doesn't speak very good English but they are very willing to service you. Normal prices. I would suggest you to eat on the 1rst floor if you are annoying of the children playing on the ground floor.
description: European franchise with restaurants in 11 countries. We serve best fries in town with specially marinated chicken,corn dogs and burgers. All of our food is served in specially designed environmentally friendly packaging. You can either dine in or enjoy our food while strolling historic sites of old quarter. We are happy to serve you!

name: 5th Royal Rajhistan Indian Restaurant

reviews: Amazing ambience and the food is simply brilliant, awesome taste and don't miss this place if you want mouth watering Indian food. name: Botanica Restaurant
address: 116/ D4 Giang Vo, 3 Thai Phien, 7 Kim Ma Thuong, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: If you like a good steak at a reasonable price, then Botanica is the place for you. A great variety of beef cuts on offer, great salad and crispy baguette. Situated close to VinCom, Ba Trieu, it is very central and yet not touristy. You won't be disappointed., Had the pork ribs at 150,000 Dong. They were tender and juicy, came with fries and a small portion of very good salad including 2 small buns. Will definitely go back. Waiter and waitress spoke very good English. Read on for more detailed unnecessary information. We went on Christmas Eve specifically for the ribs. They weren't on the menu because we were told it was a holiday menu. They made us 2 sets of rib dishes anyways because we asked for them. I noticed that some items were blanked out on the menu. For a restaurant in Asia offering Western Style food, this place was excellent. Went to S&L's dinner last week which is actually run by an expat and both dishes we ordered (fish&chips, entree platter) were below average, very expensive and disappointed us to the point of never wanting to return, feeling that we had wasted our money. I am a Canadian with 18 months of experience travelling Asia. Botanica is an excellent place to go for really good steak meal at a reasonable price., I happyned to eat lunch. I feel good food,friendly service,beautiful space. I think the ideal place to date with friend. Thanks very much!

name: The Great Wall
address: 19 Dang Thai Mai Quảng An, Tay Ho, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Delicious 🤤 and excellent prices and portion sizes!!! Staff is knowledgeable and friendly!! It’s a quite, yet festive and relaxing atmosphere. Perfect for a casual evening with friends or a date. It was beautifully decorated for Christmas 🎄 as well! The veggie chow main was delicious, along with the peppered chicken and seafood dishes. They are open late, yet the food is always hot and fresh! Very happy with the service, price and taste!!! We will be back! Follow @travelingypsey on Instagram & GoogleMaps!!!, I had an amazing time at Opium bar and The Great Wall restaurant last night! The food surpassed my expectations, incredibly delicious. The ambiance was stunning, with a romantic and cozy feel. The lighting truly set the perfect mood. What stood out the most was the exceptional hospitality – the staff was unbelievably friendly and inviting. A fantastic experience overall!, This is a decent spot; came across it and ordered home. The prices are ok and the portions and big. If you're craving Chinese, try it out.
description: The first western Chinese restaurant in Hanoi serving up classics such as peking duck, beef in black bean sauce, chow mein, dimsum and sweet n sour chicken balls. Also a range of authentic dishes. Set in westlake the restaurant has an award winning design and is also the home to Opium cocktail bar serving Asian themed cocktails and classics into the small hours.

name: Oc Nong Ha Trang
address: 1A Dinh Liet Hang Dao, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Delicious snails! We got the big ones. They reminded me of the ones I used to eat in Italy as a child. My granfather used to pick them up and my grandmother used to cook them with tosato sauce. These ones are served with a sweet sauce. Really nice., This is clearly a local hotspot! First I noticed it was very crowded, not even a free table, on the contrary, they even put extra table opposite and those were also occupied. People seemed to be enjoying very much, and that intrigued me and wanted to eat there. It took some 10 minutes to get a table. Seated on small plastic chairs, in the midst of the locals we were excited for the experience. We ordered snails, frog legs (they bring them from a neighbour lady), kumquat juice and beer. Omg!!! The freshness and taste of everything! First, they brought us a huge bowl of garlic and chilli, and another one of very flavourful green herbs, all to accompany the dishes. What followed was a real feast of joy and awe! While we were enjoying our meals, we noticed some clams at our table neighbours and we ordered a portion of those too. Omg!!! The broth the clams were cooked in was something out of this world: pineapple, lemongrass and I don’t know what else, but it was amazing! Very fragrant, fresh and nourishing! It’s a small restaurant but oh, they cook amazing, besides the quality ingredients they put a lot of soul and smiles into their dishes. We both felt very satisfied and left excited to dive deeper into the exquisite Vietnamese. Highly recommend them!, Snails here is good! But the best is dipping sauce! Fast serving but only snails, the rest of the menu will take quite sometime to prepare! Price is ok!
description: Delicious snails! We got the big ones. They reminded me of the ones I used to eat in Italy as a child. My granfather used to pick them up and my grandmother used to cook them with tosato sauce. These ones are served with a sweet sauce. Really nice.

name: Su Buffet
address: 64 Nguyen Du Street Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Nice restaurant with white color designate. Clean and good service. Buffe with lot of choice, good quality. but the price a bit high. easy to find, near the Lake (Thien Quang lake)., This buffet has a lot of variety from Vietnamese, to meat to seafood. Ok priced and food is good. Check it out if you're in the area and very hungry., The restaurant is opulent. Chandeliers and spiral staircase Three rooms laid out with a multitude of different foods - just help yourself I was part of a large party We were served a selection of dishes including oysters, baked oysters, salmon sushi, large shrimps, beautifully cooked steak with a spicy sauce, roast ham with pineapple, roast pork, grilled fish, salads etc.The waiters were discretely removing the clutter of shells, bones etc. We were then told to help ourselves to the buffet on the floor below It was like Aladdin's cave. Just so many choices The food is beautifully laid out - tureens of soup, rice, noodles, sushi, large fish, chicken feet, clams, cockles, sardines, bahn mi, Vietnamese sandwiches etc. etc.(Also pizzas for teh kids) Another room with a myriad of deserts I sampled a few items - too full to do the buffet justice All the food was well prepared - most was very, very good, I tried a desert of a warm coconut broth with sago - really nice and at my host's insistence a mango pudding - also really nice An absolute foodie' paradise Really worth trying out - make sure you come here hungry
description: Nice restaurant with white color designate. Clean and good service. Buffe with lot of choice, good quality. but the price a bit high. easy to find, near the Lake (Thien Quang lake).

name: Mum
address: 36 Hang Mam, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: The best restaurant in Hanoi! Fresh food, beautiful presentation, economic prices and lovely staff! If you´re lucky enough, you´ll get to meet "Mum"!, Visited late evening and found it to be so busy, always a good sign in this little eateries! We decided to stay in line and wait for a table to become available. We looked at the menu before sitting so not to waste any time, good customers we are. The staff told us about how they cook everything fresh to order in a tiny kitchen so we were shocked and quite happy to see nothing wasted or being sat around in the kitchen for too long. The food was delicious, we ordered a variety of items, Pho, Bulgogi and coconut rice along with some snack starters and we couldn't be happier with the meal. Very good value for money and generous portions. Everything was seasoned well and tasted delicious!, This little restaurant doesn't look like much from the street but there's a nice seating area upstairs where you can get off the busy Hanoi street and have a great dinner. They have several veggie and vegan options and the prices are great. Definitley worth a visit while in Hanoi.
description: We are committed to provide at a fair price-nutritional,well-prepared meals only using the finest ingredients in our recipes.No food leaves our kitchen that we ourselves would not eat.

name: Com Tam Chat
address: 4 Dinh Ngang Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: I tried it in Saigon, and luckily it was in Hanoi. The restaurant offers the foods are cheap & super delicious. It is a must to try their pork belly cos once you eat & you will never stop having it again., I just have one word to talk about tasting of foods here is wonderful. I believe that Cơm Tấm Chất will become a famous food brand in the nearly future!!!, Had 1 full plate of broken rice covered with pork chop, fried egg, etc. Impressive taste. Great meal.
description: Com Tam Chat(Cơm Tấm Chất) is a well known broken rice restaurant in Hanoi, probably the most famous place to eat the simple combination of a grilled pork chop over the top of a bed of rice, known in Vietnamese as com tam suon nuong (cơm tấm sườn nướng).

name: Nachos2go
address: 39 Ta Hien Street Corner of Ta Hien & Hang Bac Streets, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Not a review, but FYI the proprietor has opened MexMix, a full menu restaurant serving authentic Mexican cuisine made with fresh baked tortillas and dried chilies imported from Mexico. Plus there are other home cooked recipes from around the planet. Yep, those addictive margaritas are still being served. It's about a 10 minute taxi ride from the Ta Hien address of Nachos2go. Or check out MexMix on Trip Advisor., We went here at midnight, it’s a hole in wall stall with plastic stools on the pedestrian walk. We were tired of Vietnamese food and wanted to have nachos and burritos. The nachos were one of a kind, homemade, tasted very unique, thick chips, I for one preferred the good old style nachos chips, this was a miss for me. On the other hand, the burritos tasted like heaven. There were beers and tequilas available too. Won’t mind going back to having another of these although for Hanoi the prices of 3-4 USD seemed on the higher side., Stumbled across this place yesterday and ended up going there twice in the one day! The nachos were delicious on both occasions. Beef nachos weren't on the menu but they were happy to make them for us. All made on site and the owner prepares some of the ingredients from home. Met the lovely owner and was good to have a chat to her! Might pop back later today for the burrito!!
description: Real nachos. Really good. Our nachos are made with pure corn tortillas and ingredients like cheddar cheese, jalapeño peppers & fresh cilantro, topped with our medium spicy salsa & sour cream. A hearty meal for one. A tasty snack for two or more. Beer, soft drinks and tequila shots! Street side seating next to the Trung Vang Theater - a great place to people watch. Open daily from noon to past midnight.

name: Bangkok Thai Kitchen
address: 15C Dao Tan Ba Dinh, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Went there to see a friend and had ordered a lot of food from this Thai restaurant during my stay in HANOI. Loved all the food there. close to Thai food we have in Thailand but not 100% i give them 85%, Perfect vegeterian green curry, you can order with toVfu or without. So good we ate there 3 times already. Very friendly place and great service. For all you craving for some GOOD thai food after all the fried rice THIS IS THE PLACE FOR YOU!, I've been to the Giang Vo location a number of times but this was my first time here. I cannot get over how delicious Bangkok Thai Kitchen is. My massaman curry was phenomenal with the perfect sweetness and without so many potatoes that they overwhelmed the dish. The chicken and rice perfectly absorbed the amazing sauce. I know that I often say that I plan to return to places...but I actually already have plans to go back next week!
description: Went there to see a friend and had ordered a lot of food from this Thai restaurant during my stay in HANOI. Loved all the food there. close to Thai food we have in Thailand but not 100% i give them 85%

name: Pho Thin Lo Duc
address: 19B Hoang Ngoc Phach, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Same simple, clear, authentic and tasty bowl of pho. No need to write much. I love the traditional setting in Lo Duc, but this branch can be for bringing my friends and families., Amazing pho!! Plenty of green herbs, very very busy and an 'in and out' kind of vibe. Don't think they serve any beverages or at least the don't advertise it at all. Come for one thing, just pho! 60,000 for 1 pho. The tastiest we've had so far., We visited a well-established local Four specialty store. We stood in line, but it was well worth the wait! I was impressed by the beefy soup and the perfectly textured noodles. The two of us finished our meal while staring at each other's deliciousness. I was able to experience the essence of Vietnamese cuisine, including the local atmosphere.
description: The short introduction in CNN Travel tell everything about Phở Thìn 13 Lo Duc: "Trying street food is a really important part of understanding and experiencing Hanoi culture. People here love food. They are passionate about it and very picky. "They won't eat at restaurants unless they're very good. So, if you see an empty street food restaurant -- don't go. "While in Hanoi you must eat the national noodle soup: Phở, usually made with thin slices of beef, a slow-cooked beef broth and spices like cinnamon, anise and ginger. "There is not a week that goes by where I don't eat at least one bowl of phở. I'd suggest a local stall called Phở Thìn. "It's just one lady who has been doing the same soup for years. She has no fridge, so she goes every day to the market and the food is always fresh." https://edition.cnn.com/travel/article/hidden-hanoi-nancy-chandler-map/index.html

address: 40 Ling Lang, Ba Dinh, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: This is the best ramen that I've found in Hanoi - it is as good or better than the ramen that you would eat in Japan. Rich, buttery broths, fresh noodles cooked to perfection, generous slices of meat, all the right flavors and tastes. The tonkotsu is my favorite so far. Service was great when I ate at the restaurant, though they also deliver, which is quick, easy, and hassle-free. Great experience!, Not a ramen or food connoisseur in general, but I'd say this is the best ramen restaurant in Hanoi after visiting several other places. Distinctive and flavourful broth. If it weren't for the long distance, I'd be a more frequent visitor. Recommended., Been trying a lot of ramen spots in Hanoi a came across Ramen Haron after reading the reviews online. It's down a small alley so don't let that throw you off. The ramen was absolutely incredible and the staff were very friendly and attentive (given how busy they were). The prices are very reasonable for what you get. Definitely check this out if you are in the mood for REAL ramen.

name: Milk And Honey
address: 46 Tu Hoa Cong Chua, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: We returned here for a second time as we had been just after tet before and they were running low on a lot of food and we didn't feel the first time reflected the restaurant very well. There were four of us for brunch on a Sunday morning, and we could see that they had updated their menu since our last visit. The two men ordered salmon eggs benedict and a sandwich and us ladies both ordered the Dutch cinnamon waffles but hence there was only 1 portion available. So not the best start, one of us changed the order to a sweet waffle instead. The service was the same as last time and very slow, drinks arrived one at a time and spread out, to the point where some ordered a second drink waiting for the food. The eggs benedict looked amazing when it arrived and apparently tasted as good as it looked, lots of food envy! The cubano sandwich was large but also quite greasy with the melted cheese and a but hard going to eat for that reason. My portion of dutch waffles arrived and it was huge, there was so much cream and cinnamon apples on top of the waffle, to be honest it was so unnecessarily large that it could have been divided between the 2 of us who wanted it. The worst part was the other sweet waffles ordered as a replacement was pathetic in comparison, it had a small dollop of cream in the middle and looked rubbish compared to the Dutch portion and the prices were so similar., The coffee was perfectly prepared – a really delicious taste experience. It was served along with a lune blueberry-scone and a lune brownie, both of which tasted heavenly. A real pleasure! We were so excited that we have already decided to come back tomorrow. Can highly recommend!, We booked in advance for four people on Saturday afternoon but needn't have bothered with how many tables were available. What was super frustrating was that the menu had little stickers over about a third of the menu saying the items were not available. We manage to navigate round the and placed our order only for the waitress to return and let us know that some of the items we ordered - the sweet waffles were also no longer available, which ss we had chosen here for a waffle brunch was annoying. We managed to get 4 sandwiches which were actually really tasty along with a fruit smoothie. Hopefully if we returned on another day they actually have most of the menu available to taste

reviews: This is my second visit in a few days. What a hidden gem. Massive choice of craft beer, great decor and a balcony overlooking the lake. There’s a few craft beer bars in the old quarter now but really impressed how roomy this place is. Well worth a visit. Although it’s in a prime location it can be easily missed but 100% worth it., What an amazing place, food and beer are awesome. Staff are so friendly, and the place is so modern but with some outstanding touches, like hand made tables and chairs. It’s hard to find, not well advertised, so try it before word gets around and it’s gets too popular. I normally don’t go for beer but really enjoyed the salted lime beer and pilsner., Funky little bar over looking lake in the Old Quarter that provides a great selection of local craft beers. A hidden gem that can be hard to find but well worth finding it. The balcony was so great to sit on and watch the traffic go by. Highly recommended.

reviews: Restaurant near our hotel in old Hanoi... Probably a recent establishment... Large rooms on the ground floor and upstairs... Very designer modern decor... I like Thai vegan hotpot in here. Good meal and good experien in Hanoi.
description: An Phuc serves fresh vegetarian dishes bursting with so much flavor that the absence of meat will not be felt. The venue offers a warm interior that is the perfect spot to people-watch as you dig into your delicious meal. The menu includes tofu, spring rolls, vegan rice, vegan hotpot... The staff are warm, with smiles all around, adding to the experience. The portions are also rather large and the prices extremely cheap. You will find yourself returning here time and time again during your stay.

address: 41 Hang Non, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Many restaurants advertise vegetarian food and itâ€™s just five dishes in the menu. The Green Inn is 100% vegan. The dishes are inspired by traditional flavors but itâ€™s the ingredients that make them unique and delicious. The dishes feature many kinds of mushrooms which in the USA are at a premium. But the prices here are great. I had the pumpkin soup, Pho and mango sorbet. All delicious. I will be back in the area in a few days and plan to go back to try the rest of the extensive menu., Stumbled across this restaurant and so glad I did! Really serene ambience, good service and delicious food. I had the Nam Bo mixed noodle from the Autumn menu. Great flavours! Ordered the Banh my to go and very excited to try. Menu has a good selection and you can pay by card., Best vegan food we had in Hanoi. Lovely ambience and terrific food. Vietnamese food. Papaya salad was amazing. Also had lunch specials. Excellent service. A must visit
description: Located beside Hoan Kiem Lake, Green Inn - the plant-based restaurant will give you enjoyable experience of traditional vegan cuisines. Our warm and friendly staff will make sure your dining time will be best served in our unique modern folk restaurant.

name: La Vong Grilled Fish
address: 14 Cha Ca Hang Bo, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: One dish only at VD170,000 per person, serve on a mini cooking plate with boiling oil, the dish is quite special but consider expensive base compare to local food, restaurant is on the second floor and need to walk up via narrow staircase, It is the original cha ca,located at no 14, cha ca street,the street name after the dish.but beware of another cha ca la vong,it used no 14 too,but different place.the original one dont use 14 cha ca as sign,so if you see the shop sign like 14 cha ca or something,then it is another one.anyway,the original one is not very luxury look,it is very normal place.so you may miss it.they sell one dish only,that is cha ca the grill fish.it is a traditional northern vietnam food,you hardly find it in the south.the price for one person is VND170,000,(cannot share),not cheap.the marinated fish in hot pan will arrive at the table, alongside a basket of think vermicelli, fresh herbs, roasted peanuts, chili.it may oily,but the taste is good,and the portion not big,so make it a bit expensive. service is nothing special to say,but ok,the staff or owner wont ignore you,due to language barrier,they dont speak much,instead,they will do everything for you,so order is not a problem.if you are the first time in Hanoi,this place still worth a visit,at least try once., Full of locals which is always a good sign, the food was tasty and the novelty of cooking the fish and herbs yourself on a burner is fun. However, this restaurant is really aimed at locals and takes tourists for a bit of a ride. Although not expensive by Western standards, it becomes very apparent that theyâ€™re charging you 3-4 times what theyâ€™re charging the locals for what felt like an overly small portion. While it seems somewhat petty to complain over 6K VND (25 cents), they added this to the bill for wet wipes that they gave us without asking. Knowing that theyâ€™d already charged ya a lot more than locals this felt galling. Finally, although the food came very quickly service was otherwise non existent - the English speaking member of staff did nothing to be proactive and only explained the meal and process after we had flagged him down and asked several times.
description: Visit this street after a long day of sight-seeing for a traditional dish of fish fried tableside with herbs, spices, onions, peanuts, and rice noodles.

Lovely food - local and western both were fresh and great tasting! Would recommend!!

name: Tam Cuisine - Hanoi Cooking Class & Culinary Experience
address: 481 Ngoc Thuy, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Incredible experience and highly recommend. Shopped in the market and continued to a beautiful home on the Red River to prepare (with expert assistance) one of the most delicious meals we’ve had on our Vietnamese trip! Meal was customized for us (I have a shellfish allergy)…delicious, unique, authentic food experience!, An Incredible and a must do cooking experience, from shopping in the local market to expertly guided preparation for the most delicious authentic meal. We felt so welcome in the beautiful home on the Red River to enjoy conversations, questions, & learning new techniques, It was one of our most favorite meals and special times while visiting Hanoi., The setting in the river was lovely and the food was delicious. We learned some good techniques as well! We will visit again, for sure!
description: Taste Hanoi, the heart of the Red River Delta! Explore Hanoi's culinary legacy through the enchanting tale of Tấm Cuisine. Inspired by the folklore of Tấm Cám, our venture embodies the spirit of Tấm—a resilient, diligent woman symbolizing Vietnamese strength. From cooking classes to private dining, we celebrate Hanoi's rich traditions while preserving its authentic flavors. Join us on a gastronomic journey steeped in folklore, where every dish tells a story. Inspired by Tradition: Dive into Hanoi's culinary legacy rooted in Vietnamese folklore. Experience Authenticity: Join local women-led cooking classes & workshops. Seasonal Menus: Discover Hanoi's flavors, served harmoniously with each season. Sustainable & Authentic: Engage in genuine cultural exchanges, supporting local communities ✨ Preserving Tradition, Crafting Memories: Explore Hanoi's culinary secrets.

reviews: I was looking for the BEST seafood in Hanoi and found the Bien Nho seafood. restaurant. On arrival I was shown to the tanks of fresh seafood along the far wall that included Lobsters of all sizes, Crabs of several different verities, clams, oysters, dozens of large and small fish types along with sea urchins and abalone. I chose 12 Oysters on the half shell and 2 extra large lobsters for me and my girl to enjoy. WOW what a meal. We were both stuffed when after we had our coffee at the end of the meal. With our drinks, salads and sides we spent $250.00 that night. It ant cheep but I can't wait to go back and enjoy this fine restaurant again., The Bien Nho Seafood Restaurant offers enjoyable dining in an elegant setting and a diverse array of really tasty seafood dishes :)) It is located a short distance from the southwest corner of Hoan Kiem Lake (and a few minutes walk south from St. Michael's Cathedral). This is one of those places where your meal can be comprised of really, really fresh foods (i.e. live fish and crustaceans), which are priced by the kilogram. While many of the dishes seem to be best suited for a larger dining party, solo folks and couples can still find yummy items on the menu (eg, the soft-shell crabs, which are fried and served with your choice of a delicious sauce). And the service -- having eaten at dozens of places across the city, I would say that the wait staff (with several English speakers) at Bien Nho are at the top of the list in this category... every single person was super friendly, extremely attentive, and provided the most outstanding and courteous service... Enjoy this great restaurant :))

description: India Palace brings authentic, grandeur Indian sub-continental cuisine to your table. From the 'simple and straightforward' roti and dal, to the delectable, sophisticated creations that have come out of the imperial kitches of the Mughal Empire, think succulent kebabs, exotic curries, and uniquely fragrant biriyanis. Our focus is to serve our royal 'gods' with delicous and authentic Indian food with recipies, as old as time, in a luxurious and elegant manner.

We went here because it’s on Michelin recommended list for food to try when in Hanoi Restaurant is clean and bright, Introduced by the hotel staff across the street to try it, I really liked the flavor of the pho restaurant, which is not as strong as beef pho. address: 8b/52 To Ngoc Van Street, Tay Ho District, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: We visited the 100 garden brewpub in Tay Ho on a wet Tuesday night but there was plenty of seating undercover. Lots of beers and a really good menu. We enjoyed a really tasty Hot Dog and nachos and then a fabulous smoked meat platter. Lucky for me it was adult paint night which I enjoyed immensely chatting to others there to paint and meeting the owner Trung. Worth the trip out of the centre of Hanoi for a relaxing evening., Just outside of the old quarter of town, only a 15min cheap cab ride. They had 20 different taps on. Happy hour was from 4-6pm when they open. Good variety of beers, it was a bit hit and miss but ok. They serve food as well but we didn’t eat. The staff were all friendly., This is a cozy, 2-story taproom in Tay Ho with a wide range of craft beers. Note that they have a larger facility with a beer garden nearby. We visited here twice in November 2019. With 20 beers on tap and many more in bottles (go upstairs). Many of the bottled beers seemed over-priced but the draft beers are reasonable. Beer flights (4 beers) are available from the beers on tap. The service is very good with enough spoken and printed English to put us at ease. For food, they offer service from 2 local places, one of which was recommended by friends living in the area. I recommend a visit but enjoyed nearby Turtle Island Brewing a bit more.
description: Furbrew is a craft beer bar. All our beers are made in Hanoi by Furbrew. We allways have six beers on tap. Our beers are modern craft beers. IPAs, wheats, ales. We do the beer. Food is available from nearby restaurents.

name: Hidden Gem Restaurant
address: No. 42, Hang Cot Street Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: What a cool restaurant this is! Loved its mission of recycling, sustainability, living "green" & respecting the neighborhood in this alley. Check out the posters on the stairwell, reminding you to not pollute, respect the earth, recycle, etc. Dining is on the open aired third floor, where so much cool recycled furnishings are. Wooden window shutters are recycled into benches for seating, beer bottles have their second life as hanging lights, motorcycles continue to vroom as tables. And the food...colorful noodles dyed pastel colors with natural plant colorings (check out my pictures!), eye candy colored purple-topped, refreshing lemonade, chicken banh mi presented with an eye for beauty & more. And the egg coffee! The coffee may be a bit bitter, but the whipped egg "cream" top is a painting unto itself. You can even learn how to make it here, if you like. Come for the food, come for the mission, but DO come here, just outside of the bustling Hanoi center, but remember, be respectful of the neighbors: no loud motorbikes., What a find. Wide variety menu good selection of drinks. Food was excellent the steak we had was superb. Very friendly and helpful staff. A true hidden gem a must to visit, Good food, quick, clean and nice setting. Cleaniness was important since most of family restaurants in Hanoi didn't look hygien.

reviews: Wow! What a find. We popped in for a drink and ended up with the most incredible cocktails and tapas! It was so good we booked to return with friends for dinner and they didn’t disappoint we were a largest group and we all order something different…. Covering most of the menu and everything was exceptional! We had a wonderful evening here a real stand out spot!, Wow! Fabulous interior design of old Hanoi with soft lighting and comfortable high chairs. Dapper dressed staff, polite and offering attentive service. The cocktails range from the fabulous well known to the artful sculptures of creativity with the wow wow wow factor. We sat in our own area just off the street, eating fresh duck salads, tomato carpaccio, duck with taro mash. The desserts of brownie and a mango sorbet delicious. We washed it down with a chilled French red after the cocktails. We weaved our way happily back to our nearby hotel in Old Hanoi., Staff was amazing! Drinks were amazing! Atmosphere even better. When they didn't have what I ordered they just made me a custom drink based on what I described! This bar is ART!

reviews: We picked this place at random and were not disappointed. We probably over ordered so it was a bit expensive but worth it. My (Indonesian) wife has been disappointed that Viet Nam food is so "mild", but the hot pot broth at this meal was awesome, with plenty of kick. I don't know exactly what we ordered due to language difficulties, but the pig brain was a winner for her, whereas the marinated wagyu was my personal favorite. Add a beer or to in the mix, a (quite small) included salad and dessert bar and you've got a great day out. Well worth another visit for us, even if just for the spicy broth/soup., As this restaurant is in the Lotte Center food hall it felt like being fed in a zoo as people walk by and watch you eating, Not really my thing but the food was excellent and the service outstanding., Worth it. We took the buffet style hotpot during lunchtime weekday for 319k VND all inclusive. The service was fast. Make sure you get there early because people from work usually go and eat there. Our favorite hotpot was their cheese tofu. They also served desserts like mango sago and ice cream, appetizers like edamame and black fungus.

reviews: I'm not a huge fan of soups. But every once in a while, I love 💙 the comforting sensation of a hot ♨️ broth. But that broth has to be rich and strong in taste. Take me to a ramen 🍜 spot and I'll always order the more tasteful one (if there's a choice). There's an exception though: pho. I find pho, in general, kinda dull. But for some reason, I love 💙 it... when in Vietnam 🇻🇳! Cause I wouldn't order it out of Vietnam 🇻🇳... ✋ This is the kind of dish I only feel like eating in the country, not sure why. When in Vietnam, pho 🍜 is my go to breakfast. 🙌 On that first day back in Hanoi 🇻🇳, we all felt like having something simple for dinner so we headed to Pho 10 Ly Quoc Su in the old quarter for a simple yet comforting bowl of pho. 🤗 Note that this place is in the Michelin guide... but in Asia, in my opinion, this does not mean a thing and this definitely isn't the reason why we chose that place. 🙅 The menu is quite simple:1 broth, a few combinations of 3 types of meat 🥩 (all beef 🐄) and 2 types of cooking for these meats. Period. And that night, some of these options weren't even available! 😓 The noodles were perfect, the beef quite tasty (although, sincerely, it was hard to feel the difference between the types of meat we were served) and the broth, well, kinda dull, as expected... until I added some garlic 🧄 and chili 🌶️. Then it became so enjoyable! 👍 This is the magic 🪄 of pho 🍜: I never expect anything of it, yet I always enjoy it. 😃 The place was crowded, noisy, messy and kind of dirty, which is normal in Hanoi, and the service was... let's say sufficient. 🤷 We paid VND 70K... €2.5 per person... 🤭 Quality & taste: 8/10 Quantities: 9/10 Atmosphere: 5/10 Originality: 4/10 Ratio price / quality: 9/10 Service: 5/10 How I felt afterwards: 8/10 More on IG: @runnerandfoodie, I don't really get the hype for this place. There is often a queue, the food is okay, prices are normal, the place is a bit loud., The hype and the queue make NO sense for the below average, tasteless soup we were offered in this restaurant. The broth was TRULY tasteless, the boiled filet beef badly boiled and a little smelly. Had much better Vietnamese soup in other restaurants with less or NO accolades, all over Hanoi. NOT recommended

Provate,provate!!!, Delicious food and clean facilities. Warm service from Water and her family. Icy cold beers! Can highly recommend the pho, bun cha and beef salad. Other than that enjoyed the hotpot. Make sure you get it with the cheese! It’s awesome. Every time I go there which had been well over 20 times it’s been good. Great! I do recommend this place. Atmosphere is very cool., If you fancy a place to eat sushi in Ha Noi at reasonable rate, this could be the best choice. Sashimi was good, I loved their Salmon belly. Sushi rolls were also delicious, cannot remember the name but was with prawns, crunchy salmon skin and some eels. They do offer hot pot as well. reviews: Found this restaurant by accident and glad we visited during our time in Hanoi. Service food and view all fantastic - thank you!, Wandered in for lunch before heading out to the airport on our last day in Hanoi, was not disappointed. Bun Cha was simply outstanding, chicken skewers almost too much food to finish. Great little find on a non-descript back street in the old quarter., Went to this restaurant for dinner and lunch. Tried and loved the banh cuon, pho, bun cha, nem nuong (spelling approximate). All delicious, and I know my Vietnamese food. A nice mix of locals and tourists (more tourists at night). The staff are extremely friendly and will kindly provide guidance on how to eat certain dishes. A great place to recommend.
description: Found this restaurant by accident and glad we visited during our time in Hanoi.  Service food and view all fantastic - thank you!

name: Banh Mi Bami Hipp
address: 56 Ngo Huyen Street, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: I’m a vegetarian and my family are meat eaters, and this is our favorite Banh Mi. We came here every morning I was in Hanoi and was never disappointed., It's a very nice place, good service and fast serving. I had a lovely chat with the owner. I would come any time again., 10/10 brekky. Lovely jubbly would reccomend. They’re connected to the hostel so i didn’t even have to step foot outside to get a quality bahn me for the same price as everywhere else .

Bread Hipp opened with the aim of serving Vietnamese and foreign customers from all countries in the world who are familiar with snack from Vietnam. If you come to Hanoi, please stop at Banh Mi Hipp and enjoy the hot, tasty and great pate sandwiches, eggs, and ham.

address: 80 Ma May, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Food is too good and staff is very cooperative.I never tested such a good paneer receipe food even in india.Best indian restaurant in serbia, Good food and nice staff at very reasonable prices...their claypot meals were so good. It's not a large place but very relaxing, with lovely soft seating and cushions in abundance., Freshly cooked Indian foods available here, if looking for Indian food at Vietnam then visit this hotel.

name: Tiem an phuc
address: 14 Hang Phen, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Went there hungover to have breakfast. The owner suggested his hangover cure "special lemon & lime bitter" which was amazing. We each had bahn mi, they were fresh and tasty. The owner sat with us and chatted and gave us good advice. Well worth trying. Prices were very good we paid around 215k (£7) dong for three drinks, three bottles of water and three sandwiches (bahn mi) which we felt was good value., Touring southeast Asia from Canada. address: Ground floor, Lot 1-68 Lotte Mall Westlake Hanoi Alley 683, Lac Long Quan Street, Phu Thuong Ward, Tay Ho District, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: El Gaucho serves up hearty, savory Argentine cuisine in a slick contemporary setting. The empanadas were stuffed with tasty beef, onions, olives and eggs. The provoleta cheese was ooey-gooey goodness. The grilled steak was juicy and full of smoky, charred flavor. The Malbec wine list does the food justice. Service slipped a bit as the restaurant got busy. Overall, a great introduction to the irresistible flavors of Argentina.
description: Food is our passion and it is our aim to establish the benchmark in Southeast Asia and beyond for a contemporary, specialised steakhouse concept. name: Hem Quan - 96 Chua Ha
address: 96 Chua Ha Street, Cau Giay District, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Great find on a pretty quiet street not far from the Ethno Museum. Can sit on nice outside patio, if desired. Food was excellent. We had a stir fried calamari,grilled pork,bak choi cucumber and tomato salad, and rice. All very good. Service was excellent. Prices reasonable., Came across the restaurant on a platform (Foody) that widely use in Vietnam to search for nice places to eat/dine at. I decided to give this place a try and went there with my husband and my mother in law. The food turned out to be tasty and not bad for the price as well. The restaurant has a nice ambience, very airy (because we were sitting at the outdoor sitting area) and clean. The staff were pretty helpful, quick and attentive. Which is quite rare in Hanoi to be honest. Food: Grilled chicken with beer: I have had not seen such tiny and skinny chicken in my entire life (it was so small) - However, it was surprisingly tender and tasty. Minced beef porridge: Smell super great, tasty and after taste sweetness. Lotus shoot salad with shrimp and pork belly: this is a standard starter dish as a starter, but it arrived after we had done with our main course, which is super weird. Deep fried tofu with salted egg: Surprisingly good, really soft and the salted eggs gave the creamy and thick taste - However abit too oily. Fried Kangkong (Water spinach) : My most favourite dish of all, it tasted so good that I was amazed with such simple dish can bring so much happiness. It was crunchy, greeny, flavourful and the deep fried garlic together with fresh garlic, it just simply tasty. Price: Affordable Reasonable Overall the experience was good, the food is tasty and I would definitely want to come back here again. Would recommend this place for a family gathering or a small event., Beautiful menu with a wide range of options for local foods and drinks. The cenue is so beautiful and the staff are so friendly. Great find!!
description: Traditional style, rare fine dishes from Southwestern regions of Vietnam.

name: Réno Bar
address: B1 Floor, 7-9 Hang Thung St, Hoan Kiem Dist,, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Class vibes, great cocktails, very welcoming and lovely staff. Harry (supervisor) sorted us out with a table shortly after we were in. Djs were playing class chilled house vibes, best bar we found so far in Vietnam. Would highly recommend.
description: Class vibes, great cocktails, very welcoming and lovely staff. Harry (supervisor) sorted us out with a table shortly after we were in. Djs were playing class chilled house vibes, best bar we found so far in Vietnam. Would highly recommend.

name: Kann Cafe & Lounge
address: 44 Hàng Trống Street, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We stopped mainly curious about the place. We ordered, without much expectation, an Egg coffee and a Salted Coffee, the guy kindly informed us about the promotion take 3 and pay 2, so we decided to add a Milk. We had already tried these varieties of coffee in other places, but I assure you that I had never drunk them so good! Congratulations to the guy who prepared them, you see that he knows how to do his job! We were super satisfied!, This Cafe is very relaxing with a vibrant and stylish atmosphere. The staff are very professional and friendly. Would recommend 👍, Staff was so friendly and made delicious cocktails. We had a special request for a cocktail that wasn’t on their menu and they went above and beyond to meet our needs.
description: KANN Cafe & Lounge is a modern and cozy destination where coffee culture meets vibrant nightlife. Located in a stylish setting, KANN offers a perfect blend of premium coffee, handcrafted beverages, and a curated menu of special cocktails to satisfy your cravings at any time of day. Kann serves as a tranquil cafe, ideal for casual meetings, work sessions, or simply enjoying a quiet moment with a cup of expertly brewed coffee. At KANN Cafe & Lounge, attention to detail is evident in every aspect—from the quality of ingredients to the thoughtfully designed interiors and exceptional service. Whether you're here to unwind, celebrate, or catch up with friends, KANN offers a warm and welcoming space tailored to your mood and needs. Discover KANN Cafe & Lounge, where every visit is an experience to remember

name: Tam Claypot Rice
address: 14 Nguyen Huu Huan Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This lively, colorful restaurant serves delicious food to locals and tourists alike. Their coffee was outstanding, and I'm not much of a coffee drinker. Their egg rolls and their rice with beef and veggies were outstanding., Their egg coffee was tasty. This coffee was suggested to me by my friend once he tried it in Hanoi and loves it after. And it was not disappointed me too. My friend tried Vietnamese milk ice coffee this time and he loves it as well., I just found out that there is a small hostel for backpackers on the second floor of the restaurant after the staff introduced to me while I was having a meal there. So I decided to stay at their hostel for 2 nights after coming back from Halong Bay. The price was reasonable when it is only $5 for a night, including Vietnamese breakfast. The room and toilet was very clean and organized. I highly recommend this hostel for any backpackers who want to save money on accommodation.
description: Tam Claypot Rice located in center of Hanoi old quarter very near famous place as Hoankiem lake, nice market, Ho Chi Minh museum, Hoa Lo Prison. With very nice decoration and Vietnamese special cuisine we sure you will have good experience when come with us. Special we have "Broken rice" with beef, chicken, fish...have name " Com Tam" is one of traditional dish of Vietnam, we sure you will enjoy.

name: Long Play Bar
address: 46 Ngo Huyen Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Great find in Hanoi. funky bar with music selection, best cocktails in Hanoi, great prices, friendly service, We saw this place off the coach to Ha long ,and found it when we returned . Good friendly bar great music and sports on tvs too fair priced drinks . The owner lovely man, Good music. Brilliant service. Excellent draft beer served very cold in frosty glasses. Best Mai Tai ever. Highly recommend
description: open from 5pm every day with longest happy hours 'TIL WEE HOURS . a block from the Hoan Kiem lake, serving ice cold beer with gr8 music, since 2010. 46 NGO HUYEN STR.

address: 51 Đ. Xuân Diệu, Tay Ho, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Came here as part of a large group, some of which wanted the BBQ option and the rest chose various single items from the menu to make up their meals. They were super quick to bring out all of the food for the BBQ options - however painfully slow with everyone else's dishes. I think they could have been better coordinated with the food so half the tables were not sat there with nothing to eat at the same time as the rest had lots of food. That being said the food we had was tasty and I would be tempted to come back. Again the same issue with slow service at the end, we asked for the bill and it turned out they had done separate bills, which was fine, but they only bought over half of them and there was 2 couples who had to chase for theirs to be brought over so they could pay - especially seeing as most of the group had paid and were leaving by this stage., I rarely review any restaurant except through language or too bad. But this restaurant exceeded expectations. Enthusiastic staff, Chill restaurant, Korean standard food. You guys must try it, will come back again, This was third time I've eaten here in 3 months. We always choose the BBQ. This comes with a selection of amazing sauces and salads. Excellent service. Great value for money.

name: Daebak Korean Restaurant
address: 14 Ly Nam De, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: If you want to eat Korean food at Inam University, it's the best!!! The end of the Hoan Kiem tourist course is always a big hit.. haha You can eat really delicious k-BBQ in a comfortable atmosphere. This time I had daechang and tripe and it was really fresh and delicious. I highly recommend it., Despite being really busy at the end of the year, staffs did a really really great job at taking care of their customers, our order come fast and they stay to help us with the BBQ even without us asking, it’s their job, yes, but they manage everything so well that there is nothing I can complain. Food is fresh and delicious, price is a bit high compare to other places but I think it’s worth it, Went here on our last night in Hanoi. The food was excellent and our server Quang was very helpful and spoke very good English. Highly recommend this restaurant
description: Referring to Korean cuisine is mention to Kimchi, Tokbokki, hot pot and especially BBQ. With fresh tasty grilled slices of meat by special sauces marinated in each fiber of slices of meat, every single bite will melt in your mouth and awakens all of your senses. Come along with that is abundant kinds of "panchan" which will definitely bring you from one surprise to the others. At Daebak Korestaurant, Chef - Kim Sung Sam, a gourmet expert, will bring you such delicate and unforgettable dining experiences from "kimchi" homeland, with the high class of ingredients and typical spices from Korea and the talent and love of cooks. How wonderful a party with friends, family members gathering around, smelling the interesting aromatic of barbecue and enjoy it with "fondly" Korean beverage at Daebak Korestaurant. By a spacious space with 5 comfortable floors, staffs of professional service, we definitely will bring to you the wonderful experiencing at Daebak Korestaurant.

name: GAON - Korean BBQ House
address: 29 Lieu Giai L3-02-03, Vincom Metropolis, Ba Dinh, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam

description: Founded since December 2018, GAON has been well-known as a premium Korean BBQ house located at one of the most populated district of Hanoi. Here at GAON, we not only embrace the authenticity of Korean cuisine, but also deliver the specific features of Korean culture among the cozy yet dignified ambiance.

name: Chez Pierre Bistro & Lounge
address: 5 Hoi Vu Alley, Hang Bong, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi  11000 Vietnam
reviews: It’s a cute little restaurant in a quiet street that serves some great food and they have a good liquor bar. We dined at this place twice and the food was always good. We tried a variety of pastas, bruschettas and garlic bread. The food is towards the expensive side as compared to similar places in the city and their portion sizes are small. But then they promise quality of food and offer a good variety of continental that was a little rare to find in the outlets in the city. I would say it was totally worth it.We found the liquor quite reasonable priced. The owner himself overlooks all the operations and service. He is a good guy , passionate about his food business and great to talk to. He is very courteous and always gives his guests a personalised touch. They have nicely done up interiors with a fancy bar as well as some outside seating in a cute covered courtyard. Quite recommended., We went there for lunch, and the place wasnt ready. It was 12 noon Saturday. The staff communicate well in english, good is alright, but more on the expensive pricing. Bottled water cost 40kVND, carbonara pasta with little cut of hams costing VND 238k. Food taste not too bad. Maybe it will be much better for dinner., What a spectacular experience at Chez Pierre, seated at a table in the charming courtyard! We absolutely loved the friendly staff and the time taken by the charismatic owner, Pierre, to chat us through the origins of this new restaurant and his ethos to the food. The signature Nicoise Salad was exceptional. Most of us had the rib eye steak and everything about the dish was wonderful. The mushroom sauce and pepper sauce were incredible examples of refined French sauces - amongst the best versions of these we have had. Definitely a marvellous restaurant to visit in Hanoi and we wish Pierre and the team all the best.
description: Where you can savor the authentic flavors of France

name: Don Chicken Hang Bong

reviews: Don Chicken in Hanoi is a delightful restaurant that specializes in Korean-style charcoal chicken. The marinated chicken is perfectly grilled, offering a smoky flavor that's hard to resist. The menu boasts a variety of other Korean dishes, which complement the main attraction wonderfully. The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, making it an ideal spot for casual meals or gatherings. Service is typically friendly, adding to the overall positive experience. Prices are reasonable for the quality of food served, though it can get busy during peak hours. Overall, Don Chicken is a must-visit for anyone craving delicious Korean cuisine in Hanoi!, Don Chicken on Hàng Bông offers some of the best tteokbokki and meat dishes in Hanoi. The tteokbokki is perfectly chewy with a great balance of spice, and the meat is tender and flavorful. The staff are friendly and attentive, providing excellent service. The restaurant itself is cozy and inviting, making it an ideal spot for a casual meal. Highly recommend for anyone craving authentic Korean flavors!, 10 pop star:) the food is great and staffs are kind and friendly. Definitely coming back and will recommend it to our friends :) pak ang chicken for da gooooo!
description: Donchicken has been in Korea since 2007 and is by far one of the leading brands in the domestic dining industry with more than 400 restaurants in more than 6 provinces / cities across the country and JEJU Island. Donchicken has been expanding its brand to China since 2014 with nearly 20 restaurants. In 2015, the Donchicken brand, we bring the wonderful Korean-traditional flavor to Vietnam.

address: 15 Dao Tan Street Ba Dinh Dist., Hanoi Vietnam

The children loves the meat sticks with the rice paper and abundant herb salad. Super yum., This was a lovely little street food restaurant with a simple selection of food - crispy rice paper rolls. The food was fresh and tasty, and the staff were happy to demonstrate how to prepare the rolls. The food was beautiful and very cost effective!, We saw the banh xeo being made on the street and were sent upstairs which is a part of their house. There is a wardrobe in the room and the owner sits watching the TV. A small room with the usual low seating. We were the only foreigners in midst of lots of girls only for some reason eating there. name: Le Art Cafe Wine Bistro
address: 66 Nguyen Thai Hoc Located On Grounds Of The Vietnam Fine Arts Museum, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Le Art Cafe is located on the grounds of the Fine Arts Museum. Initially, we thought it was just a coffee shop, but it actually has a reasonably extensive menu, perfect for lunch. The interior space was attractive, but the outdoor tables in the garden were even more enticing on this sunny day. I chose the grilled chicken Caesar salad (145,000 VND) which was a generous serving with what seemed to be an entire chicken breast with just the right amount of tangy dressing. It was delicious and filling. My partner enjoyed his pasta carbonara (also 145,000 VND). With two bottles of water, the total charge was only 364,000 VND (about $16). Service was polished and professional. The menu included English translations; the wait staff also spoke English. It was a perfect lunch in a perfect location., Decided to find a cafe nearby while exploring the Vietnamese capital. This is a place for coffee and quick meal right outside the fine arts museum. Price is modest for tourists and coffee with milk is always the perfect option. Sitting in front of a colonial building and sipping freshly brewed coffee is the ultimate Hanoi experience., Located in a prime location of the capital, Le Art Cafe Wine Bistro restaurant is located inside the campus of the Vietnam Fine Arts Museum, 50m from the Temple of Literature, 200m from Uncle Ho's Mausoleum. With a spacious, airy and very private space. The food was very tasty and good quality. The server was helpful with the menu.
description:
Le Art Cafe is located on the grounds of the Fine Arts Museum.  Initially, we thought it was just a coffee shop, but it actually has a reasonably extensive menu, perfect for lunch.  The interior space was attractive, but the outdoor tables in the garden were even more enticing on this sunny day.  

I chose the grilled chicken Caesar salad (145,000 VND) which was a generous serving with what seemed to be an entire chicken breast with just the right amount of tangy dressing.  It was delicious and filling.  My partner enjoyed his pasta carbonara (also 145,000 VND).  With two bottles of water, the total charge was only 364,000 VND (about $16).

Service was polished and professional.  The menu included English translations; the wait staff also spoke English.  It was a perfect lunch in a perfect location.

name: Bun cha, Nem cua be
address: 38 Mai Hac De, Hai Ba Trung, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Typical Buncha is too sweet for me. This store has the right combination for me. Enjoyed it very much. The fried meat roll is splendid too Try not to have too many belongings with you as you dine here. Not much space for bags, Street food at its best, first time trying bun cha and cannot forget it. So much flavour and so fulling, loved this place!!
description:
Typical Buncha is too sweet for me. This store has the right combination for me. Enjoyed it very much. 

The fried meat roll is splendid too 

Try not to have too many belongings with you as you dine here. Not much space for bags

name: Dung Hoa Pho Co
address: 23 21, Hang Hom, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Bia Pho Co is the street where many foreigners come by the evening to have their dinners especially is famous for seafood, pork grills and off course beefs. It is also famous for its night chills of light beers and liquors, an awesome place to chill at night with friends ☺️, It was short walk from our hotel in hang Quat. Menu was all local dishes and prices were reasonable. I order the hot pot steak and my crab spring rolls. Both were tasty. Service was fast. Mostly patronise by local., We ate dinner here twice. We enjoyed the food and suffered no ugly aftermath (unlike with a couple other places in Hanoi). The place was busy, but we didn't have to wait for a table. Local people also seemed to enjoy the food, as we were the only white people there both nights. The portions were fairly large, and we were both quite filled by one entree.
description: Bia Pho Co is the street where many foreigners come by the evening  to have their dinners especially is famous for seafood, pork grills and off course beefs. It is also famous for its night chills of light beers and liquors, an awesome  place to chill at night with friends ☺️

name: Peace vegan
address: 45 Nhat Chieu Nhat Tan, Tay Ho, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: I've lived in Hanoi for five months now and Peace Vegan is my favorite restaurant. I go on almost a daily basis, if not every second day and have yet to grow tired of it. Most Vietnamese cuisine isn't highly nutritional, ie. Rice and noodles, and it's difficult to find cheap meals with lots of vegetables. Peace vegan is nutritious, by far the best value vegan buffet I've found (Please let me know if anyone knows where a vegan buffet of the same price is?). Everything is absolutely vegan too, a lot of restaurants labelled vegan sell vegetarian dishes too, which include cheese or eggs. Good atmosphere, lovely location, great food, nutritious, dirt cheap. 10 starts from me. ðŸ˜ŠðŸ˜ŠðŸ˜ŠðŸ˜Š, Great selection buffet. Clientele mostly young foreigners, all you can eat tasty vegan food. Tofu prepared 10 ways or more! Relaxed atmosphere., One of the first cheap vegan buffet opened in Hanoi, 40,000 VND per person. In the heart of expat area, together with English menu they attract lots of expats living in Hanoi. Around 10 dishes for buffet together with free tea, they have a stable amount of frequent customers. Though more vegan buffet opened now with the same price, and better food, they need to improve the buffet menu to compete with other restaurants. Food is good, fresh, though its pretty similar everyday. Cheap menu drinks seperated from buffet. They also serve alacarte menu for dinner.

name: Vivienne Cafe Restaurant
address: 4 Au Trieu Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We stopped there to have a glass of wine, unfortunately we did not read the reviews before. When they served the wine they put a dish of cashews on the table. I wanted to pay immediately the 200k for the wine but she said to pay later. I asked about the nuts and she said it is a additional 200k so I sent it back. When we finally went to pay the wine they told us there was 10% additional charge. We refused to pay it as it was not mentioned anywhere. They insisted saying it was normal in Vietnam ! It is normal when it is written ! In a few words a rip off ! We checked their rating on google and it says it is closed, which is not true ! Another scam ! Too bad it has a nice location and a nice view ! Just next to the cathedral, but they are many other choices around., I went in for dinner. They gave us bad food which was exorbitantly priced. They had given a tiny bowl of rice which we thought was a side dish, but later in the bill they had added it as a separate item for 50k vnd. They had also added 10% service charge for horrible food and the waitress gawking at us incessantly. I argued my way out of the bill and paid only for 2 items we ordered, didn't pay service charge too. They make their own people sit in the cafe for make it look active to attract tourists. They have such a nice location and they can do great honest buisness here, but these people don't know better. Such a beautiful country and such beautiful people, but people like these ruin it for all :-(, We stopped for a drink and ordered a beer, my husband pointing at and saying “Hanoi” (beer). The older waitress / manager said “2 Vietnamese beer, very good” and then brought us over two 330ml bottles of a local beer I had not heard of. We didn’t mind it wasn’t Hanoi, and went on to order two more. When was came to pay they said the four beers were 660,000 (over £20). It became apparent that this is a scam to give customers a different beer at inflated price and hope they pay it. We stood our ground and paid the 200,000 the Hanoi beer would have cost. On reflection, the younger waitress looked very miserable and was constantly sent into the square by the older woman to try and ‘snare’ western looking tourists in an overly aggressive way. They tried to give us a plate of cashews which thankfully we refused (on hygiene grounds) and am very relieved we did since reading people were charged 200,000 for them! Nice location for people watching, but avoid like the plague.
description: Great location with a super nice balcony on the first floor facing the plaza in front of the cathedral. Awesome for watching people come and go. Very comfy chairs. Extraordinarily friendly staff. Thank You !!!

name: Daikon Foods - Restaurant & Café
address: 212A Lac Long Quan, Buoi Ward Tay Ho District, Hanoi, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: During the quarantine period in Hanoi, isolated in a hotel room, Daikon delivered us delicious and comfort food., fundamental to have positive feelings. We´re very gratefu., This restaurant is on the ground floor of the Somerset West Lake. It has a small but complete menu. Food was good and served well. The ambiance of the restaurant was warm and cosy. The service staff was attentive and helpful. I am especially satisfied with one of their service staff, Ly. She speaks good English and provided good service., We dined twice and had an excellent culinary experience across fish, beef, pork and chicken dishes. All servings are well-priced and the bento box is a great package. Very delicious.
description: Daikon or white Radish is a simple yet important ingredient in Japanese cuisine.At Daikon Foods, we aim to bring a different side of Japanese culinary art to our beloved customers: Simple Yet Delicious Home-made Food in a comfortable and relax setting.

name: Sushi Station
address: 84 Tran Vu Ba Dinh, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Don't go to this place. When we visited it was closed, but they recommended us to go to their second restaurant. So we took a cap through the whole city just to land in front of another closed restaurant, despite them telling us its open. These people didn't even care. How would ever eat something from them? Avoid this place., Walked for 20 minutes to find out the place no longer exists and is just a pile of rubble. Not many other eating places around either, After the covid epidemic, sushi station has changed for the better. Sushi station has 3 branches, all of them are excellent from the quality of sushi to the quality of service, and the prices are reasonable. Highly recommended!
description: A small sushi shop by Truc Bach Lake with a beautiful Lake view. The Sushi Chef was working in New Zealand for 3 years so he knows exactly the western Taste. Manager and Staff are very friendly and helpful.

name: Banh Mi by Minh Nhat
address: 13 Hang Khay Str., Hoan Kiem Dist Old Quarter, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Well, there is nothing too special about this banhmi comparing to all those that street vendor sold me. Quite disappointing for a master chef winner, The sandwich here is OK. But on the streets you can get better. This feels like fastfood mass produced Bahn Mi., Went here as cane across it when looking for a nearby cafe. Just average banh mi and more expensive than what you get elsewhere. The shop is small, old and needs a good clean and to be refreshed. There’s a couple of seats but it’s not a shop you’d want to sit and relax in anyway. They also didn’t have 2 of the meats we tried to order on the day. Best to get your banh mi in another old quarter street location.
description: Banh Mi Minh Nhat is owned by Masterchef Vietnam winner season 2: Hoang Minh Nhat Each Banh mi has her own recipe to make it special. Shop style is clean, high quality product, amazing view of Hoan Kiem Lake. Located in the heart of Ha noi.

name: New Gentry Beerhouse
address: 7 Hang Manh, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Decent sized café-style venue with table seating and lots of retro-beer posters on the walls. They stock only bottles from a range of local not easily available craft and more common international major brewers. The beer list is extensive with limited editions (10 in all from Overmorrow, Labtory, Heart of Darkness, Mixtape; VND110-140000), commercial (8 in all from Vietnam, Laos, Mexico, Japan, Slovakia; VND50-100000), local craft brewers (16 in all from Ha Noi & Saigon; VND100-140000 for 330ml bottle), Belgian (14 in all) and Trappist (7 in all). Prices listed are a bit expensive for the local scene. Non-beer includes ciders (7) and wine. Didn't try the food which consists of snacks and mains. The service is basic (not with-standing language barriers) however, as staff seem to be more focused on their mobile phones, they don't annoy you. NOT a place for lager drinkers but a great place to visit to taste some hard to get local craft beers!!, Wow, stumbling upon New Gentry in Hanoi was like finding a hidden gem in the craft beer universe! The service was top-notch, and my wife's delight in their French and Italian wines was matched only by the blissful chill they kept them at on that warm evening. Now, let's talk beer – their local craft brews were a delight, although that farmhouse-leaning stout had me scratching my beer-loving head. Maybe an infected batch? But hold on to your mugs, because the real magic happened with their exquisite selection of Belgium beers. Oh, the joy of sipping on a Chimay Blue or the Duvel Triple Hop Citra Belgium IPA – pure liquid nirvana that hit the spot every single time. The food, the cozy setting, and that A++ service sealed the deal – this place is an absolute must-visit. Just remember, it's a tiny haven that fills up fast, so make sure to hop in early. In my books, New Gentry stole the show during our short Hanoi escapade, and it's hands down my favorite spot in the city! 🍻, Wandered past and was lured in by the name. I was surprised by the extensive beer list. From fairly cheap local beers to pricier imports. You can drink for cheaper in Hanoi but you won’t be as comfortable
