name: RICO Seafood & Grill
address: 56 Trần Quốc Toản Hà Nội Hai Ba Trung District, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Excellent spot for a quiet and intimate meal in Hanoi. Our server Nghia was outstanding and very friendly. I recommend the seafood platter with lobster (you must order ahead of time when booking reservation) and the tomahawk steak., My wife and I had dinner here and it is fabulous. High end dining very good food and service and by European standards reasonably priced. The restaurant is housed in a beautiful old house and I have no hesitation in recommending it, I went to the Penfolds wine dinner last night hosted by Rico Seafood and Grill. It was an absolute pleasure! Delicious dishes with an amazingly creative touch and impeccable service. They have a oyster special on Wednesday's and I am certain I will be a regular there. Gorgeous interior decoration as well...just a fine place to enjoy with family and friends.
description: Situated in the bustling Hanoi’s French Quarter, RICO Seafood & Grill offers a stylish, contemporary space. It houses a range of interconnected projects, including multiple dining rooms, a raw bar, open kitchen, butcher, and two outdoor dining areas. It is ideal for entertaining, celebration or corporate meetings.

name: Annam Café Gourmet
address: 51 Xuan Dieu Syrena Shopping Center, Quang An, Tay ho District, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: My wife and son liked their crepes. They charred my burger though. Had to send it back. They also need to do something about the flies..... Service is average., Very nice atmosphere. Me and my man enjoy 2 cups of coffee here cappuccino and latte. Yummy. The manager is attentive, enthusiastic and cosy. Recommend, We frequented this cafe 3 times and tried different things. It was always clean and the staff were exceptionally friendly and attentive. The food preparation didn’t always match the expectation but was still OK. The fruit punch smoothie was fabulous each time. The quiche Lorraine was very nice but the hot fries where not consistent. The pancakes where disappointing , an unusual heavy consistency.
description:
My wife and son liked their crepes. They charred my burger though. Had to send it back.
They also need to do something about the flies.....
Service is average.

name: Tung Ban Quan
address: Chợ Cầu Giấy, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Stopped at this place by coincidence & so glad we did! Amazing place with great elements from Sa Pa, Food was also incredible & good in proportion! We truely recomend to try the local ricewine From Sa Pa witch they serve there! At last you can leave the place with wonderfull memories & new friendships! The owner is very friendly and sweet and can talk good english. Greetings Dean & Ellen, We went here because of the review saying it was a hidden gem. The food is cooked in North Western Vietnamese style. The fish had a coriander based stuffing. We also had the Mam Da - a local green vegetable. Really good meal., What a great hidden gem in the old quarter! The food is all made fresh, portions are generous and there are many different options on the menu. The atmosphere is a relaxed fun one, with people playing a guitar, singing local and internationals songs tho it is no way intrusive on a meal. If you are looking for local food at excellent prices without anything being geared towards the tourist then I highly recommend this for you! Miss Ha is very helpful with great English in choosing what to eat and drink, so if you are from abroad ask for her for help!
description: With many delicous dishes from the North to the South Vietnam, especially Pa Pinh Top ( grilled fish followed Thai people), Grilled beef with dry sauce from ant, grilled chicken by Dam San style, Fresh spring rolls made by yourself, etc... The place decor in North West style and staffs are very friendly. Some wine from rice and corn, specially "Bach Nhat" wine - jars of rice wine (including yolk of egg) were hidden under the land 100 days before using. Start from 11.00AM you can come to drink beer, Bach Nhat wine, taste delicous food here and see the local train in Vietnam.

name: Lucky Cafe & Fast Food
address: Terminal 1, Noi Bai Airport, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: The food here at the Lucky Restaurant in T1 was fine, but service was slow, it took forever to get the bill, and there was smoking at the table next to us. You’ll be better off at the T2 restaurants, as far as I can tell there is no indoor smoking., Plenty of souvenir and cafe at 2nd floor before entering immigration. Tried latte was bit cold setvice good. Many food options available., We came here because the menu looks interesting. We had corn soup and omelete. Soup is okay not great. Omelete is nice. Abit hard to get the waiters attention even though they wander around.
description: The food here at the Lucky Restaurant in T1 was fine, but service was slow, it took forever to get the bill, and there was smoking at the table next to us. You’ll be better off at the T2 restaurants, as far as I can tell there is no indoor smoking.

name: Banh My Tram
address: 252 Cua Nam Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Good food - clean - friendly staff. Price fair and not cheating foreign. Can sit on street or inside. Will be back soon. Must try other dishes too, Delicious and really filling. Rammed with locals which is always my benchmark when traveling. It’s very basic street food but soooo good., Warning about tram restaurants to Perfume Pagoda! There is a scam to try to trap tourists to eat at crap restaurants with super high prices, by telling them at the entrance that they must pre-book. This is not true! Better to pick something when you arrive!
description:
Good food - clean - friendly staff. Price fair and not cheating foreign. Can sit on street or inside.

Will be back soon. Must try other dishes too

name: Van Hoang Group - L'amour Steak Văn Quán
address: Đường 19/5, KDT  Văn Quán Tầng 1 Toà New Skyline, Hà Đông, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: When my friend invited me to come here to try it, I was surprised that the food was quite delicious and suited my taste. My friend also complimented me on the delicious food. Everyone can come here and try it. I found the price reasonable., I have visited this restaurant and I have been surprised that they have not only asia food, but own chief specialist for European cuisine. I highly recommend this place., Romantic environment with Italian style. The design of this restaurant looks like an old and classic cellar. Delicious foods and tasty Italian wines.
description: International standard European restaurant. Pofessionally trained chef from Europe. Beautiful, luxurious space. Cheapest price in Hanoi, friendly staffs. Especially, VAN HOANG GROUP IMPORT & EXPORT JOINT STOCK COMPANY choose this Restaurant as a selling point to introduce Italian wine products for distribution activities in Hanoi, this is the reason you can use wine at the restaurant with the price of listed companies on the market. No extra charge. Come here and you'll want to come back again

name: Rising Dragon Restaurant
address: Nguyen Quang Bich St Old Quarter, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Rising Dragon Restaurant is an interesting place to visit and enjoy local food! Try it!! You will Like it!, Randomly called in for a meal. We were wanting normal local atmosphere and we got that. Nothing classy but comfortable to sit and watch happenings around. Food was very flavoursm and different from Kiwi food. Excellent friendly service and as all things in Vietnam very inexpensive. A great start for our adventure., All great, staff, service, quality of the food, the outdoor roof top setting. I was recommended to try Banh Xeo (Rice pancakes), and had a mini training session how it should be put together, eaten- not to make a total mess of yourself, and sauces to be used.
description: Rising Dragon Restaurant is located on the rooftop at 12-14 Nguyen Quang Bich Street.Rising Dragon Restaurant offers the ultimate Vietnamese dining experience. The food menu has been specially crafted over the last decade, using traditional Vietnamese flavors and ingredients whilst also adopting modern and innovative cooking styles and imported foodstuffs to meet the demands of today's society.Vietnamese food is considered as an art, and that is the way we do for both tasty food in high quality and nice decoration. Let's try to discovery a part of Vietnam culture!

name: Gu Bistronomy
address: 60, Nguyen Thi Dinh B12, Cau Giay, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant is a must for anyone in Hanoi who wants to experience fine dining at its best. The setting is impeccable - the restaurant is clean and stylish. The decor is beautiful. Tables are generously spaced apart, and there are those overlooking to kitchen and others that provide a street view. The staff were FANTASTIC! Knowledgable, friendly, attentive. We had a wonderful time chatting to the staff. Special mention goes to Dong, the General Manager for her hospitality. Last, but not least, the food! Hands down the best piece of meat Iâ€™ve ever had. Cooked to utter perfection. The sides were also delectable. Drinks were perfect too. Could not fault a thing., Delightful experience for my lady and I, especially on our anniversary. One of the best gems to experience in Hanoi. They really made you feel like youâ€™re somebody. They gave me a tour of the whole restaurant and even the wine cellar with their vast selection. From the decor to their service. Nothing but the best. A very fine dining experience. Very refreshing especially having eaten mostly local and street food. We had a table side server, Duy Anh. He was amazing! Glass never empty and even if I had a look of curiosity he was by my side ready to answer any question. He even drank a glass wine with me ( I even made him pour a bigger glass so he can enjoy himself at work). The food was amazing. My lady surprisingly licked each plate clean ðŸ˜‚. I highly recommend this place to anyone wishing to treat themselves. They offered to call a taxi and never left us thirsty. Always supplied water even while waiting for a taxi. Thank you so much for the wonderful experience here at GU. A memorable anniversary dinner., We have never been to a place in Hanoi that has this quality of wine for the price that was offered.
description: GU Bistronomy The finest wine restaurant & bar & winecellar in Hanoi A grandeur of Indochine style blended in Art Deco architecture, GU Bistronomy is a true destination for any gastronomy and wine lover to explore the art of food and wine pairing. Savour the modern and innovative French-based cuisine in all its finery matched by our extensive wine list boasting more than 1000 international wines from famous wine regions around the world.

name: Pizza 4p's Aeon Mall Long Biên
address: 27 Cổ Linh, Long Biên, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: As a first-time visitor, I was impressed by the friendly and attentive staff. They made me feel welcome and were happy to offer recommendations. The pizza was delicious—crispy, chewy, and topped with fresh homemade cheese. I tried the Burrata Parma Ham Pizza, and it was fantastic. The ingredients tasted high-quality and well-prepared. The restaurant had a cozy, modern vibe, perfect for a relaxing meal. Prices were a bit high, but the quality made it worth it. Overall, a great experience, and I’d love to come back!, Pizza 4P's Aeon Mall Long Bien has delicious pizza, beautiful space, good service, worth trying! I will definitely come back here
description: An Earth to People restaurant on a mission to make the world smile for peace, one pizza at a time. Earth to People is our commitment to serve safe and fresh foods directly from Mother Earth to you. Located in Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Danang and Nha Trang.

name: Backstage - Capella Hanoi
address: 11 Le Phung Hieu, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Wonderful ambience, attentive service, creative cuisine and a special setting. This was our favorite meal in Hanoi. The kids menu was appreciated by my young teen - with good portion sizes and tasty food. I had a stunning red wine, fresh salad and exotic black sesame dessert. It felt very glam!, Fine dining at its best. Every food we tasted was simply perfect. From salad, soup and entree to dessert, they were not only delicious, but also thoughtfully plated. Indeed, well-deserving of the Michelin star rating. It was an experience that will linger for a long time., I’m a sucker for designer decor and wanted to lunch at Backstage to check out the highly rated Capella Hotel. Perhaps a bit erroneously named, the opulent and glitzy interior of the restaurant qualifies it to be centrestage. It was a feast for the eyes! We were the only patrons for lunch on a Saturday and the staff danced attention on us so they get full marks for impeccable service. Food was a bit of a hit and miss. The bread basket was outstanding. No complaints about the food in general. Plating was nice. My heritage duck rolls and fish dish were a bit pedestrian. A bit more dramatic flair is required to elevate the culinary standard to match the drama of the decor. Perhaps the high prices were the cause of the poor patronage but coming from Singapore, lunch at a fancy restaurant priced at US$40-50 per head was still acceptable to us. I may not dine there again but would recommend it for a one time experience to soak in the ambience, only if you like maximalist dr or style.
description: An elevated pairing of intricate décor and sheer epicurean indulgence awaits. Our all-day restaurant presents a magnificent backdrop of vibrant murals and stunning costumes curated from opera’s greatest performances. Expect bold renditions of Northern Vietnamese cuisine that pay respect to long-forgotten traditions and local seasonal produce while championing modern culinary techniques.

name: Poke Hanoi
address: 11B Hang Khay Alley | Level 3, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This is my first time eating here, and the restaurant is really cosy, calm, and serene. In terms of the cuisine, I must state that it's standard, healthful, and excellent . However, the servings are excellent. The amount of food appears excessive for one person, making it somewhat challenging to finish it all by oneself. The price is quite high, but this is also likely due to the high calibre of the dish. Although the restaurant was a little busy at midday and the service was a little slow, I can perceive that the personnel at the restaurant is also quite amiable and transparent with their patrons. To sum up, everyone The portion will actually be very enormous, therefore people should try coming to eat once and should go with many of people., It’s a nice restaurant by the Lake. It’s tucked away in alley so look out for the sign. The food here is very healthy and fresh and you can customise your dish to suit what you desire and there is lots of variation and choice. The dish is cheap too considering you get very good portion sizes. Linh was very helpful and friendly. Would definitely come back again., Poke is very delicious, every time I eat the fish is fatty and feels fresh, even though the restaurant is not too crowded. Beautifully designed space, both inside and outside the garden. I suggest that the shop should have ice to drink soft drinks, and play music to make it feel less empty and more cozy. Been back many times!!
description: Poke Hanoi serves Hawaiian Poke. Poke Is a Hawaiian dish made of raw cube of fish marinated, in sauces. We serve our poke with rice, salads and a variety of toppings which you can choose yourself. Perfect place to eat healthy, we also serve smoothie bowls.

name: Banh Mi 25
address: 25 Hàng Cá, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews:
I didn’t know of this place beforehand. It was on a list of recommendations from our Hanoi hotel. When we reached it, we were amazed at how popular it is. It occupies three shops, across the road from each other: one seems to be for takeaway and where the orders are taken; the other two are opposite and provide casual seating. The queue seems really long but it’s a well-oiled machine. When you join the line, you’re handed a menu. After a couple of minutes your order is taken, while you’re still in line. They give you a large number tag and ask if you’re sitting or taking away. You find a seat in one of the two shops opposite and, within ten minutes, your order is brought to you. Great value, delicious filling, light soft bread with thin, crispy crust. My best Banh Mi experience in Vietnam., Very diverse options including vegetarian and vegan options. They have a spot to place the order and 2 shops facing the main place to sit and eat- you order, prepay and they serve at your table. Price is reasonable and taste and service is good . There is also a cute small bar called the hidden bar inside one of the two seating shops. Very cute. There’s almost always a line here but you get your food fresh and hot within 15-20 minutes. Takeaway option and coffee available too., We went to this spot from an online recommendation and it didn’t disappoint. The service was great with lots of seating options and fast service. The Banh mi was delicious and although this was more expensive that some of the road side vendors and other shops, it was still money well spent. Banh Mi 25 is a hit among many travelers seeking authentic Vietnamese flavors, with a variety of Banh Mi that ranges from crispy and fresh to the occasional underwhelming dish, including vegetarian selections. Guests have called out the restaurant for its excellent value, offering a diverse menu at reasonable prices.

The service at Banh Mi 25 earns rave reviews for its speed and efficiency, even when the place is bustling. While the atmosphere is generally described as casual and inviting, a few reviewers warn it may feel a bit too Westernized for some.

name: Seafood 68
address: 68 Dao Duy Tu Hang Buom, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: I was around Hanoi Old Street, and very suprised i found out this place. The Hanoi Fresh Beer here only 10k/glass app..0,4$. Very cheap right, but the most amazing is the beer is very nice, i could drink 4-5 glass easily. You can choose many kind of foods in the menu here. Many fresh seafood or simply get some fried rice.app 2.2$. Recommended place to have some drinks here and view the street., This place has a lot of reviews and comes up whenever you search for seafood. It's easy to see why. Fresh product and cooked perfectly. My wife is a critical judge and loved it. There's a wide range of seafood available. Personal favorites were small clams (cockles maybe) and some grilled prawns. Be warned, you are sitting either in or on the street and the noise of cars/bikes/engines/horns can be a bit irritating. But it's a good feed and there's cold beer too. Well worth a look for seafood lovers., A great local seafood restaurant. Must try salt n pepper prawns, steam crab, BBQ squid, freid rice, steam clams. Reasonable price. Good Draft Beer Hanoi. Payment in Dong.
description: Seafood 68 Hanoi Old Quarter is a must-visit restaurant for seafood lovers and bia hoi Hanoi - fresh beer. Located in the heart of Hanoi's Old Quarter, this dining venue offers a wide selection of fresh seafood dishes, ranging from crab and lobster to clams and prawns. Prepared by skilled chefs, the dishes are flavorful and well presented. The restaurant's cozy atmosphere and friendly service make it a great choice for a casual night out or a special occasion. If you're a seafood enthusiast, be sure to put Seafood 68 Hanoi Old Quarter on your list of places to eat in Hanoi.

name: El Gaucho | Tay Ho
address: Lot G2, Ground Floor, Somerseet West Point, No.2 Tay Ho, Quang An Ward, West Lake District Ha Noi, Hanoi 710000 Vietnam
reviews: Came as a table of four with friends, and it was my first time there. Friends had let us know about the first Tues of the month having 50% off steaks, not that I wat steak! The restaurant was fairly busy, clearly that offer rumours had spread!! The restaurant is very nice and well decorated, tables well spaced out and the staff friendly and the right level of attentive. I thoroughly enjoyed my salmon with mash and vegetables, it was so tasty, and the rest of the group enjoyed their steaks., We went to Il Gaucho Steak House for lunch. It was great. I had Iberico pork ribs, which I’d never had, and they were amazing. The fries were perfect. Piping hot, light brown, and soft inside. They also served the meal with crusty hot bread, a whole roasted garlic clove to smear on the bread, as well as herb butter and chimichurri sauce. The service was also spot on. At the end of heh meal we were even given a free shot of frozen caramel vodka that was a nice palate cleanser. I highly recommend this restaurant., but...it is very expensive, and to be honest my steak wasn't that great. I tried a USDA rib eye but just found it a bit tasteless. Still, the bearnaise sauce was good, the mashed potato was excellent, and the provoleta starter was awesome. The bread, roasted garlic and dipping sauce was a definite bonus - if I'd known it was coming I wouldn't have ordered the starter. Decor is excellent, staff are quick and responsive (mind you there was only one other table of people, probably because I was pretty early). The beer was OK, and the whisky sour was very very good. But don't forget your wallet because it was about AUD 200 for a single person.
description: To our valued customers – We remain open NOW for take out or delivering food ( check our menu link for delivery options) while striving for excellence in health & food safety for all. In view of the coronavirus, we have taken additional precautionary steps on top of our routine health and safety practices to ensure everyone is safe and comfortable. All sanitizing and cleaning procedures are reinforced at all levels by increasing the frequency so as to ensure optimal hygiene and sanitation levels. We continue to monitor the situation closely and do more if necessary. Stay healthy and strong and Eat Well! Food is our passion and it is our aim to establish the benchmark in Southeast Asia and beyond for a contemporary, specialised steakhouse concept. We are proud to serve you the finest steakhouse-style food, using only the best available meat products sourced from selected farms in Victoria, New South Wales and the United States.

name: Grill63
address: 54 Lieu Giai Street Lotte Hotel Hanoi, Ba Dinh, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: The number 1 choice every time a holiday comes because the restaurant's space is always beautifully decorated, polite, and has a view from above to see Hanoi, especially the small details set up for each table. Regarding food and drinks: the food is very diverse, the quality is number 1 for me personally and especially thanks to Huyen, my husband and I can eat our favorite dishes to our heart's content. The staff always takes care of customers thoughtfully and politely., The meal was very delicious, the location was very OK for family and meeting friends and partners because the location was quite convenient and central, the service staff were attentive, warm and professional, Huyen and Thao helped me enthusiastically. Love quickly, I'm quite satisfied. Will be back, The price for lunch is so cheap, it's always in a 5-star hotel with a very beautiful view of Hanoi. Enthusiastic and friendly staff (Le Duc + Le Thao). Will come back to SD and experience more food here
description:
The number 1 choice every time a holiday comes because the restaurant's space is always beautifully decorated, polite, and has a view from above to see Hanoi, especially the small details set up for each table.
Regarding food and drinks: the food is very diverse, the quality is number 1 for me personally and especially thanks to Huyen, my husband and I can eat our favorite dishes to our heart's content.
The staff always takes care of customers thoughtfully and politely.

name: Bella Lake View Sky Bar & Restaurant
address: 11 P. Cầu Gỗ, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This place has the most welcoming and inviting staff with really good English Beautiful scenery, cool breeze and feels so calming being out of the hustle and bustle. Cocktails were actually incredible, best we've had our whole trip and we all found a favourite from back home in Aus. Even the kids juices came out in a fancy cup which made the kids feel special. Quote a big variety of food to choose from which was so delicious. This place is so worth visiting, we will be back multiple times before the end of our trip! So thankful we found this place, The drinks and view here are amazing. I came and told the bartender that I didn't want to drink alcohol, and he made me a cup of passion fruit mango tea that he thought of himself. The drinks were really great and she was very enthusiastic and cheerful. Thank you Shaw for giving me a wonderful evening. If I have the chance, I will bring my friends here to enjoy ❤️, The friendliest rooftop bar in Hanoi. Thanks to Shaw! I was made welcome and looked after. Great atmosphere, music not too loud, drinks to perfection with excellent quality and care. Absolute Masterpiece 10/10 would recommend.
description: Bella Lake View Skybar & Restaurant is located on the 8th floor of Bella Premier is one of the best ways to end a long day in Hanoi. There are many rooftop bars and restaurants in the city, but Bella Lake View Skybar & Restaurant is always one of the most favorite destinations. The entire top of the building is occupied by Bella Lake View Skybar & Restaurant which makes a special impression of being on a spaceship in the sky and also the view directly to the Hoan Kiem Lake. With a unique design, Bella Lake View Skybar & Restaurant will bring a totally different experience with a panorama overviewing Hanoi Old Quarter,Hoan Kiem Lake, and the maze streets. You can sip a hand-crafted cocktail or local beer and enjoy a breathtaking view of a truly Hanoi atmosphere & also the Vietnamese cuisine. You'd better not be afraid of height as Hanoi will be right below your feet from the moment you step outside.

name: The Moose & Roo Pub & Grill
address: 170 Xuan Dieu Tay Ho, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: A nice compact restaurant with attentive staff. We had pork ribs and beef stroganoff. The food standard was decent and reasonably priced. Our salad was also pretty good. The two teenager waiting staff were helpful. Food was served reasonably on time. The upper deck where we dined could be noisy as the sound proofing is only normal. We had a Taiwanese girl in the next table rattling off her personal staff and we could catch all the details. At times, we were embarrassed by what she said. Maybe a little high spirit. We have no complaint about the noise though but to warn others that it could be noisy at times. Overall, we were happy to walk into this restaurant and we thank Moos and Roo for feeding us with decent food., We stopped by this nice joint after walking around and checking out some local Hanoi haunts recommended by our friends. Itâ€™s on the main road so itâ€™s noisy and busy and really quite cool. We sat at the bar and took it all in. It is really worth a visit if you can. Friendly service and an excellent selection of whiskey and beers. Also a nice Malbec. The garlic bread was ok, but hey, itâ€™s garlic bread. Filled the need. However, the Scotch egg was terrific! An unexpected treat. Quirky art adorns the walls and the washrooms are very clean. Trust me, clean washrooms can be tricky to find in Hanoi. Itâ€™s all part of the adventure. Check it out if you can. Would definitely go back., Ok, So Iâ€™m in Vietnam and I fancy western food, Found this place by accident, its sort of semi open air, with a childrenâ€™s play area next to it, including a small football pitch. Service was excellent, food to be honest I enjoyed. Just strange eating western food in Hanoi.. Well done.
description:
A nice compact restaurant with attentive staff. We had pork ribs and beef stroganoff. The food standard was decent and reasonably priced. Our salad was also pretty good.  The two teenager waiting staff were helpful. Food was served reasonably on time.

The upper deck where we dined could be noisy as the sound proofing is only normal. We had a Taiwanese girl in the next table rattling off her personal staff and we could catch all the details. At times, we were embarrassed by what she said. Maybe a little high spirit. We have no complaint about the noise though but to warn others that it could be noisy at times.

Overall, we were happy to walk into this restaurant and we thank Moos and Roo for feeding us with decent food.

name: Botan Bar & Dine
address: 9th Floor, No. 151-153 Hang Bong Street, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Very friendly and delicious. Ryun & tony & Thanh are all so kind and sweet, sweet and sweet, and those who don't drink are also hot cocktails! We were given a coupon while staying at our Merit Hotel and we had a 30% discount and ate cheaply and took the potato chips twice and three times !!!!!, The staff are very friendly It's a rooftop bar at the top of the hotel, and it's pretty and has a great atmosphere. I think it's fun to be able to see the panoramic view of Hanoi city. I ordered the signature cocktail twice and I liked the smooth, sweet taste of banana milk. It would be good to note that there is a 30% discount between 7 and 9 o'clock. Open until 11 o'clock, Outdoor atmosphere after 8pm in the first week of Jan felt like indoor air conditioning. 🤩 The service crew were very attentive, and aside from the typical bar-food menu, we were also able to order from the hotel restaurant menu, which has a really good crispy roast pork (so good that we had it for 2 nights in a row!) We had an engaging conversation in english with a young Mr Will, whose recommendations on the drinks were spot-on. (We had a “mad” and “count of monte cristo”) Fortunately Tony the bartender ably supported Will throughout the night; as the conversation with Will strayed into education, economics and life in general in Hanoi; eventually I had more drinks than I intended for my last night in Hanoi, yet it was a pleasant experience to cap of my first trip here.
description: Rooftop Bar & Dine of Meritel Hanoi is located on the 9th floor with panoramic city views, our sky bar will gaze you up with a shape-shifting metropolis of buzzing downtown. You may relax and unwind in the evenings while watching the west-facing patio's sun set into the city horizon.

name: Hanoi Fusion Restaurant 54
address: 54 P. Nguyễn Trường Tộ Quán Thánh, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Restaurant several times. The food has been excellent every time, and the atmosphere is pleasant. The service provided by all the waitstaff is also highly professional, friendly, and polite. This time, we were served by Zo, who took care of our comfort in an extremely pleasant manner, ensuring the food arrived quickly, asking if we enjoyed it, and so on. She also speaks good English, which made our customer experience even smoother and more enjoyable., stumbled on this spot after a chaotic landing in hanoi — we were so grateful for our server Ro who easily sat our group of 5 + a baby and provided a lot of great suggestions on what to eat, and helped us with small tweaks for the baby as needed. Ro was the best part of our night!! prices for the food were great value too — highly recommend!!!, Ro was a great waiter for the night. He took time to recommend the best meals on the menu and the ones he would suggest! This was super helpful and he was very efficient making sure everyone had their meals quickly and explained when there was a delay. He was friendly, approachable and hardworking! Lovely service Ro!!!
description: Hanoi Fusion Restaurant Summary Default (GPT-3.5) User Translate in to Vietnamese this paragraph "Welcome to Hanoi Fusion Pub & Restaurant, a charming and cozy restaurant nestled in a narrow tube house at the edge of the old quarter of Hanoi. This unique eatery aims to cater primarily to tourists, providing you with an unforgettable culinary experience that combines the best of local traditional flavors and well-selected Western delights. At Hanoi Fusion Pub & Restaurant, we take pride in showcasing the rich tapestry of Vietnamese cuisine, offering tourists the chance to savor authentic local & fusion dishes that embody the essence of Hanoi's culinary heritage. From steaming bowls of pho, vibrant fresh spring rolls, and flavorful banh mi sandwiches to delectable Vietnamese desserts, our menu takes guests on a culinary journey through the heart of Vietnam's food culture.

name: Sadhu - Ly Thuong Kiet
address: 87 Ly Thuong Kiet Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Stumbled on this gem by accident - the definition of serendipity! You can order anything from the 50-ish item menu for 270,000 Vietnamese dongs (about $12 USD). Even though they call it a "buffet", you're not actually walking around looking at pre-cooked items and selecting what you want. Instead, you look at the menu, and tell the waiter what you want. 5-10 minutes later, your cooked-to-order item is at your table. I like this model better because everything's fresh and you're not overloading your plate...Just note that you want to order 2-3 items at a time, and while you work on them, you can decide on the next set of items. Every single thing was delicious. Liked it so much that I went back thrice the week I was there. The decor and the ambience are upscale. The service is a bit laid back, but I was OK with that. It was very relaxing., During my six weeks trip to Hanoi, Sadhu became my daily vegetarian dinner place. A unique creative combination of various food dishes is something which is rare to be found in one place. The service was exellent. With special care received by Ms Hien and Ms Phuong; we felt special. Strongly recommended to people who enjoy unique vegetarian food in a great eating environment with great service., I don’t know how this place doesn’t have perfect reviews. For just $15 AUD you get an all you can eat menu that has options for everyone! Every dish is perfectly presented, balanced and packed with flavour! There’s no waiting around for food here, it comes out promptly and you can continue to order as you desire. The fresh coconuts are cold (many places serve them warm) and they have a good selection of drinks too, including bottled water. The restaurant is spacious and modern and not to be missed, whether you’re a vegan, vegetarian or otherwise! I would eat here every day if I could!
description: The Verse of Sadhu (pronounced: sa-du) originates from the Pali language, and when translated into Vietnamese, it means: ‘Benevolent.’ Sadhu Vegetarian Restaurant is established with the intention of bringing blessings and well-being, akin to the spirit of the Sadhu verse to every diner. Beyond special occasions, Sadhu aspires to share the art of vegetarian cuisine with all patrons—whether through traditional feasts or daily offerings of exquisite, nutritious plant-based dishes. Sadhu hopes that within the simple and serene ambiance of our vegetarian meals, diners will find moments of rest and tranquility. May these experiences infuse their bodies and souls with renewed energy, allowing each visitor to embark on a path of kindness and embrace the peace bestowed by the Buddha. In benevolence, Sadhu

name: Cai Mam Vietnamese Restaurant
address: 07 Luong Van Can, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Great food. Had the vegan spring rolls, ban xeo which were flavorful BUT what really got the taste going was the pho (beef). I wish I could have had another bowl but … stomach was full. Total bill was about 17-18 dollars so reasonable priced also. Would like to thank the service also. Particularly NGA who made it easier to order……;-) Would I return ? Yes., We had a delicious meal with excellent attentive service from Thuy Trang 🙏 The spring rolls and especially mango salad were fresh and tasty, and we really enjoyed our chicken and beef main dishes as well. It looked like reservations were optional but this is a cozy space distributed over 2 or 3 floors so if you’re able, reserve in advance. Thank you Trang., Oh, it was a really good shop! It was my first trip to Vietnam and I was a little worried, but all the food here was delicious and very satisfying. I especially liked the calm atmosphere of the restaurant and the slow food. Besides, the male staff was very kind and good at Japanese, so I could ask them a lot of questions with peace of mind. It was really helpful to learn about recommended dishes and to listen to local stories. My wife was very happy. I was really lucky here to be the first shop I entered when I came to Vietnam. If I had the chance again, I would love to come. Thank you very much.
description: "Located at 07 Luong Van Can, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi, Cai Mam Vietnamese Cuisine Restaurant was opened in 2014, with the aim of offering exceptional Vietnamese traditional food, street food and vegan options in Hanoi Old Quarter competed with attentive service in a relaxing atmosphere. Food was made from the fresh, local ingredients, and prepared in a clean and hygienic kitchen to prevent cross contamination. Cai Mam is named after a communal serving plate, around which entire Vietnamese families can share daily meals every day. Shared plates feature predominantly on the menu. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, local music plays in the background, to entertain the dining experience and introduce a part of local culture". The staff take pride in their work, and strive to delivery perfect service every day. Cai Mam restaurant is dedicated to making each meal unforgettable, and to not just create a meal, but a unique local dining experience.

name: Met Vietnamese Restaurant & Vegan 3
address: 110 P. Hàng Bạc, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews:
(Late review. Was there in Jan 2025) We discovered MET 3 by accident, it is in same street as our hotel. We were just coming from a day-trip in Halong Bay and there was a group of tourists (8 of them) with us who asked for help in booking a certain restaurant coz they knew it is a good one. We usually do not bother to go out our way to find the recommended restaurants. When we went it, we saw the group which made sure they have a booking when we were still in our day-tour. We got out of the tour bus earlier than them. Apparently, they wanted to eat in MET 3. We were almost coming in too late for our first dinner. The kitchen would close in 30 mins but we can still sit for an hour. Food was delicious, prices very reasonable and very friendly service. On our last day, we made sure we came back and eat lunch there. Still same level of excellence - good food, reasonable prices and very good customer service. I would recommend it to any friend who will go to Hanoi., This was one of the best meals we had in Vietnam! The grilled pork in bamboo was full of flavor and cooked perfectly. The vegetable spring rolls were very crispy and absolutely delicious. The restaurant was decorated with beautiful oriental items, giving it a cozy and vintage feel. There were also many vegetarian dishes to choose from, so everyone can find something they like. The waitress Hana was very friendly and helpful, giving great suggestions and making us feel welcome. A great place to eat that we would recommend to anyone!, We came during peak hour for dinner on NY eve but the staff managed the queue well and we got seated without too long of a wait. The food offering was as good as any restaurants we’ve been to in Hanoi, and I’d highly recommend it to anyone. Big shout out to our server Hana who was absolutely on the ball despite the crowd and attended to our questions and requests very promptly with a huge smile. She’s a star! Met Vietnamese Restaurant & Vegan 3 is celebrated for its cozy ambiance that beautifully captures Vietnamese culture, a detail that guests have called out with appreciation. The restaurant's value is another high point, offering generous portions at fair prices, according to reviews.

Patrons are enamored with the authentic Vietnamese cuisine, noting a rich selection of both traditional and innovative dishes, including many vegan options. Additionally, the service at Met Vietnamese Restaurant & Vegan 3 is frequently lauded for its exceptional friendliness and efficiency, with a staff that's eager to accommodate special dietary needs and provide personalized recommendations.
description: Welcome to Mẹt Vietnamese restaurant ( Authentic Vietnamese Cuisine) Dear valuable customers . Vietnam has a very distinct and sophisticated food culture. Every area has its own distinctive qualities. We are without a doubt the perfect place for you to visit if you want to sample and learn about Vietnamese cuisine. For you to have the best options, our menu offers authentic Vietnamese cuisine that harmoniously blend flavors from the north, center, and south as well as a vegan menu.

name: Ignite Sky Bar
address: 33 Duong Thanh Street, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Had this place on my bucket list for Hanoi and I was not disappointed! I came here for my last night in Hanoi and what a perfect way to spend my last evening. I was served by Quyen who was the most attentive and friendly waiter who provided a 5*service and some amazing tips on where to visit and what other foods to try whislt on my travels. The ambience was just perfect with beautiful lighting, offering a great relaxed and chilled atmosphere with amazing upbeat music making it hard to want to leave! I ordered the eel Tacos, nachos,sliders and fries and all were amazing..... especially the eel!!!! Definitely a must try whilst in hanoi. Would love to visit again if I ever get the chance to come back to Hanoi. Although the place is very classy I did arrive dressed casual. Despite this I felt very comfortable and welcomed! Thanks for a great experience!, One of the best tips I got when I came to Hanoi was to look for sky bar. Lucky for me, there are lots of sky bars in town, but I doubt they have the kind of hospitality we were given at night. You walk through this beautiful hallway towards the entrance of the hotel, and are lead to this amazing glass elevator that gives you 180 degree views of Hanoi. While the views are beautiful and the weather definitely gets cooler as the high elevation breeze hits, itâ€™s the hospitality and the really incredible beverages that make this place special. We had multiple cocktails, and each were prepared with great skill. The flavors were great, the pricing was of great value, and the snacks we ended up ordering were also delicious. If you find yourself near Ignite, do yourself a favor, come in to cool off and drink a tasty drink., My husband and I came here for our 1st year wedding anniversary. The service was fantastic from the start. Everyone was so welcoming and friendly. We had drinks from 6pm watching the sunset in a relaxed atmosphere with a stunning view. We went for dinner at the downstairs restaurant at 7.30pm but then came back up to the sky bar again to enjoy live music where we were greeted by the manager Drake who got us seats right at the front and gave us complimentary drinks to celebrate this special occasion. We had a beautiful evening and canâ€™t thank the staff enough.
description: Unwind with 360 degree views of Hanoiâ€™s scenic Old Quarter in the newest, largest and most beautiful rooftop bar. Ignite Sky Bar is your best choice for a night out. Indulge in signature cocktails and an assorted selection of tapas and Vietnamese specialties, accompanied by vibrant DJ beats or live music performance.

name: La Vegarie
address: 4A Tràng Thi, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: The entire experience was absolutely fantastic. We had the Hummus Platter, Faux Gras, Spring Roll, Fettuccine, Masala Curry, and Kombucha; and they were all extremely delicious. The ambiance was very cozy and they also provide additional condiments on request. I would recommend this place 10/10!!!, Amazing spot for veggie food! You can tell they really care and put a lot of love into their dishes. Great ambience, friendly service, and delicious food. We had the green curry and Schezuan eggplant and both were super tasty and served piping hot. The portions are large, so this would be a great spot for family style dining., One of the best vegetarian restaurants I have ever had the pleasure of dining at. We went here on a whim, and were surprised at the very reasonable prices for such a quality establishment. We had the morel and mochi starters, both beautifully presented and tasty, but the star of the show was my stuffed cabbage - simple, delicate, delicious. My partner had the rigatoni which was also lovely. The staff were attentive and pleasant throughout, offering assistance at all times without being over bearing. Only wish we had discovered this place sooner, could not recommend enough!
description: Fusion Vegetarian Restaurant; a cozy gallery-style decor venue with edible arts. Open for Lunch & Dinner from Mon - Sat, closed on Sunday.

name: S'Patisserie
address: 17 Hang Khay Street Hoan Kiem district, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: We have eaten at their cafe as well as ordered custom-made desserts for our functions—truly cannot say enough positive things about this bakery! To celebrate my MIL’s 80th birthday, our family had a destination celebration in Vietnam, and we celebrated the entire day! - Mango cupcakes for breakfast - Red Velvet cake for lunch - Strawberry Cream cake for dinner S’Patisserie offered excellent customer service from inquiry to pick up. Being overseas, it was very much appreciated that the bakery was easily accessible for communication via Facebook, and they always responded in a timely manner. They worked with me to create a creative dessert menu for all three meals, and they were extremely helpful in providing coolers for transporting the cakes from Hanoi to Ha Noi Long Bay. Most importantly, the cupcakes and both cakes were absolutely stunning! I was so pleased with the outcome, and everyone (15 of us) loved the desserts, especially the birthday lady! I highly recommend S’Patisserie!, The view outside the shop was great. The cakes are amazing! And the ambiance is also wonderful. However, a small cup of hot tea that cost 60k is too expensive. I don't like egg coffee here, either. It has a fishy taste. I would recommend Neo Cafe and All Day Coffee to those who want to experience the best egg coffee taste., We passed by this cafe that is strategically located near the Hoan Kiem lake. They happened to have a 1-1 cake special from 5 to 7pm on weekdays and we tried their tiramisu and velvet cake. The tiramisu was dainty looking in a chocolate cup and the velvet cake was moist. Both weren't very sweet. The staff Tam was very courteous and patient to make recommendations. We like the friendship tea with fragrant cinnamon and orange slice, and would recommend friends to drop by and chat over drink and cafe while looking at the lake.
description: S'Patisserie is a naturally - inspired bakery which uses naturally - based ingredients and makes organic products

name: Sen Trang An Vietnamese Restaurant
address: 43 Hang Be, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This place is amazing and one of the best meals I’ve ever had! The owner will is so good and shows you how to eat the different foods!! It’s incredible value for money as the portions are big and you get a few free extras. He also has a vegetation/vegan menu and asks you at the start of your meal if you eat meat or not. The restaurant is hidden down a side street and the whole thing is an experience as well as a meal out as the owner has an amazing story about how he grew up and achieving his dream of running a restaurant. If you’re in Hanoi you have to try this as this has been one of my favourite experiences so far!, Just great and the title says it all. Fabulous food, great hospitality and an all round must do experience. The food is simple and delicious. They give you free rice, salad and tofu to which we added a main and a couple of entrees and we could not get through it all…. My highlight was the vegan spring rolls and guava juice was just so good! Goo yourself a favour, don’t hesitate walk in!, Highly recommended place, traditional Vietnamese food very homemade and in abundance. It has been a very good experience. They recommended what dishes to order and it was a very good choice, everything was very delicious. I would 100% repeat and recommend it. Example of improvement.
description: I am a Restaurant worker who desires to express my very personal journey from street kid to social entrepreneur

name: Estrella Sky Bar
address: 32 Lo Su Street 12th Floor, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant has a good service attitude, the location of the restaurant's dining area is located on a high place, so at night we can look around, quite romantic when you go with your lover, the dining room is also quite spacious and airy. The food here is quite satisfying to me and it is decorated by the chef quite beautifully and artistically. I think this place will be one of my favorite places, you can also invite your lover to come here, I'm pretty sure they will love it, Visiting this sky bar in Hanoi was one of the highlights of my trip! From the moment I arrived, the staff made me feel like a valued guest. The service was exceptional—attentive but never intrusive, with staff always ready to recommend drinks or ensure I was comfortable. The atmosphere was perfectly balanced between lively and relaxing, with great music that complemented the stunning 360-degree views of Hanoi’s skyline. Watching the city lights sparkle from above while sipping on a beautifully crafted cocktail was an experience I won’t forget. The drinks were top-notch, with a great selection of classic cocktails and unique local-inspired creations. The bartenders clearly take pride in their craft, and the presentation was as impressive as the taste. If you’re looking for a place to unwind, soak in breathtaking views, and enjoy five-star service, this sky bar is an absolute must-visit in Hanoi!, We are staying at La Nueva Hotel for our time in Hanoi and have enjoyed a beverage on the rooftop at the Estrella Sky Bar each night of our stay so far (3 and counting!). The drinks are delicious (both the seasonal signature cocktails and the regular cocktail menu), the service has been excellent (the server is so kind, and I love the chip snacks that come with our drinks), and we really love the views, the music, and the overall vibe. I would highly recommend a visit to the Estrella Sky Bar if you're in the Old Quarter of Hanoi!
description: Your experience - Our special moment Asian - European fusion restaurant Like a Shining star between Old Quarter of Hanoi, we will lead you to your final destination with great experiences and perfect products.

name: Ivegan Supershop Westlake Ha Noi
address: 16 Tô Ngọc Vân, Tay Ho, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: YUM! For veggies and vegans I 100% recommend this place! The owners are really kind and knowledgeable and so are the staff. That Buddha bowls are worth the money, they are filling and make you feel healthy. Same with the smoothy bowls. I recently tired their tempeh bagel and I will be going back for more. Also good coffee with alternative milks., The Ivegan vegetarian restaurant is an excellent destination for those who love plant-based cuisine. The cozy atmosphere and diverse menu offer a variety of delicious options. The staff is friendly, providing prompt service and ensuring a positive dining experience. With reasonable prices and quality dishes, Ivegan is an ideal spot for anyone looking to enjoy high-quality vegetarian food., Delicious food, friendly service, a cozy environment, and speedy wifi all in one place! I first found iVegan Super Shop when ordering food delivery and was immediately impressed with the taste, presentation, and even earth-friendly packaging. I knew I had to come see it in person. The variety of dishes, drinks, and desserts here is incredible, and there's no way to choose incorrectly when everything on the menu is fantastic. In addition to the food and kind waitstaff, they even have a mini shop with select items like nooch and oatly which I've missed dearly in my travels. Incredibly grateful for all that this restaurant offers <3
description: YUM! For veggies and vegans I 100% recommend this place! The owners are really kind and knowledgeable and so are the staff. address: 23 Dao Duye Tu 3 Floors, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: We had the catfish dish and a banana salad accompanied by a good glass of wine. The moment we walked in, OMG, we were amazed by the sights, sounds, and smells of Vietnam. The staff was welcoming and attentive, and the food was simply divine. We ordered the hotpot with beef, and the flavors were perfectly balanced, with lots of fresh herbs and veggies. We also had some grilled fish and tofu. They were all delicious! description: From north to south, from urban to rural areas of Vietnam, Cai Mam" is a very familiar object. For each family, "Cai Mam" appears twice in everyday; at lunch and at dinner. "Cai Mam" is a round tray used to contain objects, especially food. In the past, "Cai Mam" was made of wood. Today, the majority of "Cai Mam" trays are made of aluminum or stainless steel. During a meal, everyone in the family gather round “Cai Mam" with various and delectable food. It is the time for the family to care of each other, to share and to show solidarity. An indispensable cultural feature of Vietnamese tradition; at each "meal invitation", before eating, younger people invite the elders to show their deep gratitude with appreciation of the parents. Meanwhile, elders will nod affectionately, and the whole family will begin a meal in a fun atmosphere. What could be more touching than a New Year dinner, people reuniting with loved ones around the familiar "Cai Mam", and enjoy tasty homeland dishes.

reviews: This restaurant is unassumingly tucked away in an alley. Little did we know the pleasant surprise that was awaiting us. We were blown away by the quality of the dishes, cocktails, and service provided by Peter. We ordered their bun cha, cha ca (“Lang” fish), and braised pork belly. We had a difficult time picking our favorite dish since they were all delicious and interesting. Peter was very attentive to our requests and questions. We value that their staff consists of students. If we visit Hanoi, we will definitely return to this spot., We were recommended to visit this lovely little restaurant which had a huge drinks menu and plenty of Vietnamese and also Western foods to choose from. We had seafood spring rolls and pork spring rolls for entree. The special Chicken Vietnamese curry & rice to share and I had a passionfruit panacotta for dessert. All fresh & delicious. Our lovely waitress Trang couldn’t do enough for us and we were very happy with the cost. The only problem we had, was finding the restaurant as it’s down a little alley but using google maps we eventually went down the right alley and then met a beautiful & helpful little 9 year old girl who grabbed me by the hand to show us where the location was. She didn’t expect anything from us and was just glad to practice her English with us. She gave me a big hug after I gave her some VND ❤️, The food is amazing. Don’t be turned off by the posh appearance of the place - prices are very low, in the region of US$5-10 per main. The Bun Cha is exquisite and amazing value for money. Thu was very helpful and provided candid, warm service and gave honest advice regarding the quantity of food I was about to (over)order. I will be back.
description: Hanoi Food Culture located in Phat Loc Street-Old Quarter a secluded food alley, housed in a vintage old French villa constructed in 1911. Come join us for unforgettable experience, featuring outstanding dishes from our chef Nguyen and very friendly service from our student staff. Our best dishes recommended by our chef: - Roasted duck breast with Tamarind sauce - Grilled chicken with lime leaf and lemon grass - Green mango salad with prawn and pork - Summer rolls - Slow cook Pork with Radish root - Special Egg Coffee

address: 63 Pham Hong Thai str, Ba Dinh dist,, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: We were very happy with the meal, with the service and with our talk with the general manager. The first room on the 8th floor that we were brought to was empty and had no seat cushions. We asked for another room and were brought to an ornate room on the 9th floor that had 5 out of 6 tables filled. The table and chairs (with cushions) looked very Chinese but were Vietnamese (and very heavy with very straight backs). The menu that we had found on facebook actually existed so we were able to order the dishes we had identified. We ordered a lime juice (VND 75,000) and water and were brought a bowl of pretty good peanuts and very good pickled celery. Our first dish was a crab and scallop soup (VND 165,000) which was good and had tasty pieces of crab and scallop in it. The next dish to arrive was the sticky rice (VND 75,000) which were a delightful surprise. Very light puffs of sticky rice that were also tasty. We were getting to like this restaurant. The salad with young coconut, shrimp and pork belly (VND 175,000) was very good and flavorful. The last dish to arrive was the hemibagrus fish (VND 295,000) made with galangal was delicious and served with an excellent sauce. That fish is a type of catfish and was tender and juicy. Our sever spoke good English and was very efficient. The general manager stopped by our table a couple of times and later sat with us. He told us we were in the VIP room and that one table had Vietnamese government people and another had tourists. He said his customers were about half Vietnamese. He recommended a restaurant to us that he thought we’d like and told us about his family. It was great fun. We had delightful evening and excellent food. We spent VND 1,271,600 US $52.93., This must be the most exquisite Vietnamese restaurant I've ever seen or visited. The entry takes your breath, the 9 different floors are so spectacular. The food, I cannot express how magnificent the food is, elegant and sophisticated, lite, but with a punch. The Pineapple rice came in half pineapple, the colours, flovour and taste lit up our faces. The pigeon, rice paper wraps, beef in coconut all blew our minds., The kind staff and elegance of the service are of global quality, so much so that I have to say it is simply the best Asian restaurant I've ever been to. Magnificent!!!, The restaurant not only boasts good food, it is also filled with historical artefacts worth millions of dollars. Spectacular and really eye-opening. Go to the roof top for a great view before you dine. Spread over eight floors, the fare is mostly Vietnamese and these were deliciously excellent. It is a fantastic experience and all agreed that they would come back when they next visit Hanoi. What an evening, thank you Com Viet.

address: 57 Đường Thành, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: As veterans of UK Indian restaurants, we thought it our duty to give a Vietnamese take on Indian cuisine a try. Initial impressions were decent but not stellar, as we were shown to the 1st floor. The place could do with a lick of paint, as the grey was missing in lots of places, showing large swathes of the white undercoat. You don't eat paint of course, and the waiters made up for any shortcomings in the decor with a friendly welcome. We tried the popodoms + chutney, and a tikka paneer for starters. The pops were much smaller than their Uk counterparts, and came with a green chutney and a tamarind runny chutney. Ok in our opinion. The paneer was also not unpleasant, but not memorable. The beers in their ice cold glasses, really did hit the spot, and our two teens enjoyed their milkshakes. Our mains consisted of a butter chicken, and a chicken tikka massala, accompanied by rice and two naans (garlic + butter). The c.t.m was a lot more spicy than we were used to, but was nice and went well with the tasty naans. The star performer was the butter chicken, which to coin a phrase from our favourite Manchester Indian restaurant, was "a truly lovely dish". Absolutely spot on, and possibly our favourite single dish on our Vietnam holiday. The whole meal came in at around D1.3m for 4 people with a drink each. Broadly recommended, but we'd try different starters if we ate here again., Dining at Maazi Restaurant was a memorable experience, especially with the enchanting candlelight setting that added a romantic touch to our evening. The ambiance was complemented by impeccable service, with Shreyas ensuring every detail was attended to, making us feel truly special. The delectable Indian cuisine and restaurant clean ness made it an evening to remember., Wow wow wow. Western family (UK near Bradford) and this is one of the best curries I’ve ever eaten. Strongly recommend for anyone wanting an authentic Indian meal. Even our fussy children (aged 11 & 14) loved the chicken biriyani.

reviews: It turns out it’s a fish restaurant and very popular with the locals. As we were waiting for our table we watched what other people were doing because the food appeared to be cooked at the table. We understood some of the food was fish inners which we decided wasn’t for us quite yet We were shown to our table and the waiter kindly used google translate to help us order and explain food We started with a fish which was sauté in front of us with beans and dill very tasty Our main was a short of fish stew all cooked in front of us and we added lettuce and a short of shredded cabbage. Lots of lemon grass flavour What an experience certainly different fish was a bit boney but to be expected Glad we tried it, they have clearly found some thing that works and executed it perfectly. very efficient service and happy staff. Staff know their clientele and what u will want, and set menu works great no matter ur feeling. had the grilled snakehead with dill which they customise depending on the size of your group. no complaints at all. lovely building and choice of design creates a welcome atmosphere. everyone seems happy with their meal. love love love. will be coming back. also located in a great part of hanoi old quarter, Chả Cá is a well known dish from Hanoi that has a century old heritage. It’s a special & flavourful dish made from grilled fish marinated with turmeric, galangal, and other spices, it is then served with vermicelli noodles, fresh herbs, peanuts, and a fragrant shrimp paste sauce. The fish & fish guts were served in a sizzling pan right at the table, we could either cook ourselves or request the waiters to show us how to cook by adding fresh dill and spring onion. I highly recommend the flavourful and tender fish that was pre-marinated with turmeric until golden brown. The combination of the fresh herbs, crunchy peanuts, and the rich, savory shrimp paste created a symphony of flavors and textures that was simply unforgettable. Has a cart out front showcasing their freshly made pancakes which were are airy and crispy. Had the Banh Xeo Nam Bo (with pork and shrimp) for 135,000 VND and the Banh knots (6 small fried tarts with a shrimp) for 95,000 VND. Hanoi beer was 25,000 VND. Huge plate of fresh good quality vegetables for the Banh Xeo. Perfect mix of flavors and textures. Was clean and organized. Has instructions on how to assemble Banh Xeo. Two- level restaurant with views overlooking a busy intersection for good people-watching. Menu / staff speak English. Mostly tourists. Cash only. Quite tasty!, Delicious food, was awarded Michelin star. The Banh Xeo was fresh and the egg was crispy. The flour rolls were made fresh and had just the right amount of vegetables in there. We also ordered the meat skewers. Meat was tender and had the smokiness to the taste. The whole meal was only 235k VND. The whole experience of making your own Banh xeo was fun! Definitely worth a visit., Do not hesitate to eat at this restaurant! The food is absolutely delicious, so fresh and tasty. I have eaten many, many Banh Xeo in my time and this is by far the best one I have ever had. The homemade chilli sauce on the table was superb and the prices very cheap by European or Australian standards. Family business and they seem to take a lot of pride in their food. The lady working there has amazing English, the best I encountered in Hanoi which made ordering very easy and she was happy to accomodate dishes and make them vegetarian which was very helpful. I will definitely eat here again and highly recommend it.

The restaurant space has a creative bar design with lighting through cups, the color space is soft, but the lighting is not right at each table position, the dishes are decorated. Beautiful decoration, beautiful ceramics, but the spotlight is evenly lit so it can't be turned on. Because the light is even, not focusing on the table, taking photos of people or dishes often ends up in shadows. Regarding the service, you guys are gentle, enthusiastic, very nice, but the dishes don't seem to be in the right order, the main dish comes before the soup, so you should add them gradually in order so that the dishes don't get cold and the eating experience will be better. will be better. Regarding drinks, the fizz leaf juice is delicious, and the apricot tea, I think, should be less of the tea flavor so the apricot flavor will be clearer. Regarding the food, most of the dishes are very delicious, I really like them (mushroom soup, beef rolled in lolot leaves, lentil fish). The remaining rambutan salad with onions made it a bit too pungent for me, the beef taste of the bland dish made the pungent taste even more obvious. The pork banh mi dish has a strong bread taste, so the color of the lolot leaf flavor is not strong, and the flavor of the dish is not clear. Today is my birthday so I should write a bit long. I am satisfied with my experience at the shop. I wish the shop to develop better!, This restaurant is located in Hanoi old quarter on 3rd floor of building. Last night, we visited the restaurant was busy but comfortable and dinning experience was incredible. Although the food was bit a low due to the crowd, the staff there were very attentive, they apologized and served us snacks while waiting, The restaurant serves mainly Vietnamese dishes at affordable prices. Enthusiastic and attentive service staff, worthy of 10 points for service quality. I think the food suits my taste, in addition, there are a few dipping sauces that I find quite impressive. Recommend for everyone to visit the restaurant to dine with family/relatives ^^

name: Bao Wow
address: 31A Alley 12 Dang Thai Mai Tay Ho, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Busy little informal restaurant, delicious food, enjoyable atmosphere. Easy to miss but you'll regret it. Ended up eating and ordering takeout from here a number of times on my holiday. Indoor and outdoor seating, cocktails, occasionally live music. It's a vibe. Traditional Vietnamese cuisine at a very reasonable price, I recommend the entire menu., We tasted about 4 dumplings, edamame with butter, chicken popcorn and dessert (some little bags in powdered sugar with chocolate). Of the dumplings, we got a great chicken - 11/10, the others (I think it was pork, shrimp and I can't remember the others) we would rate 7/10 - they were all good, but nothing special. Edamame with butter was great. We got free popcorn chicken to taste, but unfortunately it wasn't our cup of coffee - the meat was good, but it was covered in some kind of sauce that was too much for our taste and not to our liking. Maybe if the sauce was on the side it would be better. The dessert was absolutely brilliant, 20/10!!! The service was great, the communication in English was great! We visited the establishment mainly because we needed a change for a while from classic Vietnamese dishes, which are great, but after two weeks we were already a little overeaten., The food and atmosphere at this restaurant was second to none. Whilst the dishes were of Vietnamese influence they weren’t the traditional rice and noodles which made a very pleasant change. Value for money was also on point! The staff were super attentive but not in your face. A range of Bao Buns, Bao-less bowls and a selection of sides were just to die for. Flavours and textures were just heavenly. They also have a very good range of cocktails, wines and beers. We got a taxi from Hanoi’s old quarter (which was so cheap) and the trip was so worth the visit. I would highly recommend going to this restaurant!!

name: Viet Restaurant Hanoi
address: 16 Hang Da Street JM Marvel Hotel & Spa, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Fantastic experience all-round at Viet Restaurant! Service is exceptional with a feeling of being well-looked after by your server, and provides a very welcoming and hospitable atmosphere throughout your stay. The quality of food is also excellent and everything is fresh; we ordered summer spring rolls with bun cha and beef in bamboo which were all cooked to perfection. The service also continued here with a concise demonstration on eating practices from your server. The relative medium-high price (compared to UK and other western countries) are very much worth it as you the quality of the food, service and atmosphere fully justify what you will pay. A great way to end our stay in Vietnam!, This may be the most expensive meal in this trip to Vietnam, but it is only about 100 RMB per person. The restaurant is on the upper floor of a hotel, and you need to walk up from the 7th floor. The decoration of the restaurant is very distinctive. I ordered the special Bun Cha, which is charcoal grilled pork, served with basil and rice noodles. The pork is very tender and slightly chewy, and it is very delicious with the sauce. The lotus root salad is very refreshing, with a lot of shrimp and boiled pork. I also greedily ordered mushroom spring rolls, which are a bit average. In addition to seafood mushrooms and vegetables, there are also rice noodles, which are too filling. The dipping sauce is a bit too salty. The service of a high-end restaurant, the waiter Scott will introduce each dish. At the end, the restaurant gave chopsticks as a gift., Very interesting dishes. Surprising and delicious. I recommend ordering the main dish “Bun Cha”. Dishes are well served and reasonably priced. We were especially taken care of by Hieu Nguyen, who was very attentive and helpful.
description: Located in the bustling heart of the Old Quarter, Viet Restaurant on the 8th floor of JM Marvel Hotel stands out like a culinary gem, offering an intriguing fusion of traditional Vietnamese flavors. Upon entering, the tantalizing scents of aromatic dishes and spices beckon you into a realm of culinary delights. At Viet Restaurant, authenticity intertwines with creativity in every dish, with each recipe meticulously crafted and passionately prepared to honor Vietnam's diverse culinary heritage while satisfying a range of tastes. The warm ambiance of the restaurant invites guests to relax and indulge in the dining experience. Viet Restaurant boasts a refreshing space on the high floor of the building, where diners can admire the panoramic view of Hanoi's Old Quarter through large windows. In a bid to exceed the expectations of travelers and offer a distinct departure from street-level eateries, the 9th floor houses a sky full of Hanoi, where guests can relish their meals while marveling

name: Tép Vietnamese Restaurant & Vegan Food
address: 53 P. Hàng Gà, Hàng Bồ, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: The food was very good, we were served by Mike and he did a fantastic job, came to check on us, gave us everything we asked for, very quickly. The food here is good, a little more expensive than than normal streetfood in Vietnam, but you get what you pay for 100%. Rather than "just" giving you the food they help you with tops and tricks to make the food taste better and provide excellent service!, Tep Vietnamese Restaurant is definitely worth a visit! The food is delicious, full of authentic flavors, and the cozy atmosphere makes it a great spot to hang out with friends or enjoy a meal with family. What impressed me the most was the amazing service, especially from Na – she was super friendly, attentive, and gave great recommendations. She made us feel so welcome, like we were eating at home. If you're looking for a place with great Vietnamese food and fantastic service, Tep is the place to go!, We loved our experience at Tép Vietnamese restaurant! The atmosphere is so nice and inviting and the food was incredible. Our waiter Lin was so cheerful and welcoming and he made us feel very comfortable and happy. As a coeliac, this restaurant was very reassuring, Lin was well educated on whether the dishes I ordered (pho ga and spring rolls) were gluten free. I was very happy to eat here and would highly recommend to anyone.

name: Seichou Machi Ramen Thi Sach
address: 7 Thi Sách, Ngô Thì Nhậm, Hai Bà Trưng, Hà Nội, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: I recently had lunch at Seichou Machi Ramen – Thi Sách with my friends. The restaurant is spacious with a friendly, modern vibe, and the staff were very welcoming. I tried the Tantanmen, which arrived piping hot in a creamy sesame soup with just a touch of spice. The noodles were chewy and held up well in the broth. Tasty minced pork and a little chili oil added flavor without being too strong. The soft‑boiled egg was smooth and rich, and fresh green onions with bamboo shoots gave a light, fresh touch. Portions were large and prices fair. I highly recommend this Tantanmen and can’t wait to come back to try their Naruto Ramen and Curry rice!, I was looking for a cosy place to hang with my friends and Machi Ramen is truly a hidden gem !! One of the highlights is their handmade noodles—you can really taste the difference! I had the Naruto Ramen, and it was excellent: rich broth, fresh toppings, and those chewy, fresh noodles made it stand out. My friends love their noodles too. We also tried the Yakisoba, Karaage, Chicken Nanban, and Ebi Fry. The Chicken Nanban and Ebi Fry were especially impressive—perfectly crunchy on the outside yet juicy and moist inside. You can tell everything is made sooo fresh. Even the side salad that comes with some of the dishes was surprisingly refreshing and well-balanced—crisp veggies with a light, tangy dressing. The prices are very reasonable for the quality, and the location is super convenient, right in the heart of the lake. Highly recommend this place if you're in Hanoi and craving Japanese comfort food!, We stumbled upon this place in the Old Quarter. They created a tiny little Japanese wooden house inside a Vietnamese traditional house, and sold Ramen, Japanese rice sets and side dishes. We had the best Gyoza - the wrap was thin and the filling was juicy and fresh. The vegetarian Ramen was huge and had these little lucky money bags. Tantanmen had the richest soup; it looked red but it was not that spicy. Very good value for money, only around 3.5 to 4 bucks for a bowl of Ramen.

name: Namaste Hanoi
address: 46 Tho Nhuom Street, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: The service was outstanding and the owner Gopi is just the best , he ask us all what our preferred tastes where and then selected the most delicious meals for us . This is possibly one the best Indian restaurants in Hanoi and would recommend it to anyone passing through or if they live here . I will definitely be going back asap . The food is very reasonably priced in fact very cheap and so is the beer . Thank you Gopi for another great meal ., Amazing Indian food in Hanoi and the owner is a wonderful man with incredible passion. He’s been running this gem for over 25 years with a number of chefs who have been with him over 20 years - that speaks volumes. Prices are reasonable for going out and the food quality is great, with a number of dishes he and his chefs personally came up with and you won’t find anywhere else. To the owner: it was great getting to know you a bit, and if I’m back in Hanoi, I’ll be back at your restaurant, Gopi (the owner) greeted us with a smile and walked us through the huge menu to help us choose the exact right dish for each of us, and it was one of the best curries I have ever had (same for my partner). Incredible flavour for an inexpensive price, food came very quickly and all staff were attentive. No complaints, would recommend.
description: Experience authentic India with Namaste Hanoi. We offer immersive, locally guided tours that reveal hidden gems, vibrant markets, and rich culture. Go beyond typical tourist experiences and dive into daily life. Our tours provide unique insights and encounters, showcasing the heart of the country. Join us for an unforgettable journey.

name: King Roti
address: 34 Hang Gai Street, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Thereâ€™s always a queue here so it builds on the curiosity and the fragrance wafting through the street is a good invitation. Itâ€™s like a Pappa Roti bun priced at 20,000 VND each and comes in 4 flavours. Not too sweet, good crunch on top. Can try it once while walking around the old quarters but nothing to go out of your way for., Its a takeaway shop for buns to die for. They are cooked as you wait outside in a queue and come in a few flavours, vanilla and chocolate being two. I think one option was savory but they melt in the mouth and we returned each evening we were in Hanoi. These are not to be confused with roti found in India For anyone from the UK who has watched Nick Knowles Vietnam railway TV programme, it is 50 meters from Cafe Pho Co where they serve egg coffee! I would return to Hanoi just for these!, This is quite an old place in Hanoi serving buns in multiple flavors. Cost of a bun is 20k VND and it comes freshly out of an oven. It feels so fresh and nice. It is definitely a worth try in Hanoi.
