name: Maii Bistro
address: 46 Tay Ho, Quang An, Tay Ho, Hanoi, Vietnam, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: At westlake, out of mainstream touristic places. Delicious food ( modern Vietnamise with love! ) and very good service. The staff helped me ordering a Birthday cake to celebrate my husband and also offered us their best seller dessert as a gift. The location is so cute! And nice playlist! We had a perfect dinner!, Stumbled on this gorgeous little fine dining Bistro. The atmosphere was divine and air conditioned. The staff super attentive and friendly. And the food was street food but in a fine dining style that never lost any of its flavours. You can taste that the fresh ingredients used are top of the range. Definitely worth visiting., This is a cosy little place on a busy road but nice and quiet inside. The service is excellent, limited English but there are enough photos etc. on the menu to get by. Our meals were excellent, perfectly cooked and full of flavour. The local Truc Bach beer was served warm for sun reason but it was cool enough that it wasn't an issue. It's near my place and we will definitely be back.
description: Maii Bistro is a cozy haven in the heart of Tay Ho District that offers contemporary Vietnamese cuisines with a little twist and lots of love

name: Always Cafe
address: 8B Hang Tre Street, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 109999 Vietnam
reviews: The drinks are really delicious and well coordinated with each other. The location is definitely for Harry Potter fans and the music takes you to Hogwarts far away from the muggle life on the street. The service was very friendly and accommodating. We felt very comfortable here and the Iced Butterberry is definitely something special., This Harry Potter café is a must-visit for Potterheads looking to immerse themselves in a magical dining adventure. From the moment you step inside, you’re greeted by the friendly staff dressed as witches and wizards. The atmosphere with enchanting décor and house banners transport you straight to Hogwarts. The cafe also allows you to immerse yourself fully by letting you wear the different houses costumes for free. The staff is incredibly friendly and the menu is enchanting great! The butterbeer, hot chocolate, and viet coffee are so delicious. This cafe is a must-visit when you come to Hanoi, Firstly, the ambiance sets the tone, encompassing decor, lighting, and overall atmosphere that enhances the dining experience. Service plays a crucial role, from friendly interactions to efficiency in serving orders. Quality of food and beverages is paramount, encompassing taste, presentation, and freshness. Price relative to the quality offered influences value perception. Lastly, the overall experience encapsulates how all elements harmonize, creating a memorable visit that defines the cafe's rating. Integrating these factors ensures a comprehensive evaluation, guiding others seeking enjoyable cafe experiences.
description: Always cafe is a Harry Potter themed coffee shop in Ha Noi. Come with us and drink Butter beer, dress up and be a wizart;;)

name: Terraço Sky Bar & Restaurant
address: 33-35 Hang Dau Street 8th Floor La Sinfonia Del Rey, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant's view is beautiful, overlooking Hoan Kiem Lake, classical music is quite chill, the staff is very nice and friendly. Staff Ngoc Diep takes care of my desk enthusiastically and lovingly. I ordered both mocktails from the shop, twilight and eclipse, both of which are easy to drink and delicious, with a fragrant mixed fruit flavor. Twilight has a strong tropical fruit flavor, Eclipse has a light green rice flavor, cool green color and smells like autumn in Hanoi. I highly recommend this shop for cool summer evenings to chill with friends or for couples to date ^^, Although I have only experienced 4-5 skybars in the old town, I feel very satisfied with Terraco's service quality. I went to the shop with 2 friends on the evening of the 2nd day of Tet. We also asked bartender Tuan Anh to spontaneously make a few light drinks and chat for a while. We felt that he worked very professionally and talked very well with us. client. In addition, the restaurant also has a variety of snacks, the outdoor view is very good, I booked a seat right at the counter in advance, the view is very beautiful for photos. This restaurant is worth experiencing., Terraco Skybar in Viet Nam is a culinary haven that impresses with its warm and inviting atmosphere. The tasteful decor, soft lighting, and soothing music create a sophisticated yet welcoming ambiance. The menu is a culinary masterpiece, with dishes that blend international flavors and local influences. Each plate is a delight, with a symphony of flavors, textures, and presentation. During my visit, I was particularly impressed by the impeccable service provided by Hiền, a member of the Terraco Skybar team. Hiền's dedication and attention to detail enhanced my dining experience, making it truly exceptional.
description: Located on the top floor of La Sinfonía del Rey Hotel, Terraço Bar offers 360-degree paranomic views over Hanoi’s legendary Hoan Kiem Lake, Ngoc Son Temple and Turtle Tower, three of the city’s most iconic attractions. Taking a sip of our signature cocktail whilst feasting your eyes on a shape-shifting city of buzzing motorbikes, architectural mismatch, and dazzling street life couldn’t be more perfect for a chilling nightout.

name: The East - The Taste Of Indochine
address: 5B Tong Duy Tan Street, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Myself and my parents ate lunch at this restaurant on 4th January 2025 as part of a private tour of Hanoi we booked. We were eating from a set menu - menu attached in photos. There was plenty of food to share between three of us, it was a good selection of options and nicely presented. I can’t comment on the price of food vs quality etc. as the lunch was included as part of our tour so we didn’t see this specific cost. However, we paid for our own drinks (Coke/Sprite etc), and these prices were very cheap compared to others in the area. The decor isn’t quite a nice/clean as the photos show on their page, but it’s not awful and didn’t affect our experience. The tables, crockery and cutlery were clean which is the main thing. The upstairs toilet is unpleasant (not clean, bad smell, no toilet paper etc.), I would advise avoiding using those facilities if you can. The service was very good, all the staff were very polite and friendly, and many had great English they were happy to speak with us. Overall, a nice experience and we all enjoyed the food!, The restaurant is great, the best typical meal we had in Vietnam. The service is excellent (attentive staff, communicate well, give tips besides being always available - what is expected from a Big Gourmand restaurant), the simple but functional environment, the food is local but different, has a taste that pleased us very much (frit rice with Lotus seeds and beef in bamboo, even the dessert we ordered - banana with a very tasty rice empanado) and the whole work pleased us very much. Worth a close-eyed visit., Authentic, fresh, delicious, prompt service!! Ticked a lot of boxes! After travelling Vietnam for 2 weeks (this is now my 8th trip to the country), The East provided an enjoyable experience at a moderately good price! Whilst you’re most likely paying close to 3X more than the same food from a street vendor, it was undoubtedly still worth it! Definitely include in your dining plans when visiting Hanoi. Tip for travelers: in the peak times, ensure to make a booking. We got turned away in our first night when we attempted as a ‘walk in’.
description: The East is established to answer all the questions about how Eastern food is cooked and delivered to customers from small streets to upmarket setups with the progression of flavors and exceptional service. Here, we focus on presenting beautiful Vietnamese food that appeals to a sense of the divine, but the honest and inherent natural flavor.

name: Le Club Bar
address: 15 Ngo Quyen St Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: A Michelin Select restaurant, prices are international Michelin service level restaurant prices. There are many other aspiring Michelin type restaurants in Hanoi that offers the same service and quality at a much better price value. Certainly a place to impress your date, or guests. I would recommend for a special occasion., We had a wonderful and elegant experience here. We started with the lobster bisque which is made at your table. What a treat to watch. And the soup had just a touch of cream and they flambe at the table which is incredible. Had to be the best soup ever and reminded me of being in Paris. Then we were lucky enough to have the lamb which was cooked perfectly and the presentation is magical. The chocolates at the end are equally spectacular and the service was perfect throughout the meal. The meal was better than any we have had in France and the prices reasonable for this class of service and quality of cuisine. Can't wait to return!, We were told that this brunch is a seafood lover's paradise, and as my wife is obsessed with good seafood, we had to try. We weren't staying in the hotel due largely to the price, but we decided to splurge on this brunch (VND 2.5 M per person with a glass of champagne and no other drinks included, 3.5 M with wine, 4.5 M with wine and champagne). We didn't think we would drink much wine at brunch so we went with the food only package. You should consider that some of the cheapest glasses of wine were around 450,000, so more than a couple of glasses and you might as well go with the inclusive package. The decor is very good, staff exceptionally attentive and helpful. It is a relatively small place so the food is a little spread out but there are also cook at the table options. We ate quite a lot but possibly having been spoiled by fresh seafood at home in South Aussie we weren't overly impressed with the oysters. Despite being freshly shucked they didn't see quite right. The prawns, crayfish and crabs were good, we especially like how they take the crabs and break it down for you so it's not so messy to eat. The lobster bisque cooked at the table is very nice. The beef roast (??) at the table is very rare, so be prepared for that. The selection of cold meats and cheeses is not huge but there is plenty there. We were also given some salad choices to give it a slightly more healthy vibe. Probably pretty good for what it was, but very expensive. I'd be a little disappointed if I'd saved up for a special event. Worth a look, but consider your budget before going.
description: Overlooking beautiful hotel garden courtyard, this airy venue offers Hanoi’s legendary cocktail lounge experience. In addition to the scrumptious menu, Le Club Bar features a delectable chocolate indulgence and afternoon tea. Having undergone renovation in 2016 to increase its seating capacity to 120 and to introduce a new live-cooking station, Le Club Bar at the Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi is a sparkling destination. With a design that calls to mind aristocratic smoking rooms with a hint of 1920s speakeasy, there is history here underneath the new coat of paint. Where Le Club now stands used to be the former Metropole Hall, the venue that hosted the first gala meeting of the Nouvelle Entreprise Cinématographique. The first movie ever shown in Indo-China played right here on the 3rd of June, 1916. You are invited you to experience the authentic live jazz music and swing with Metropole from Tuesday to Sunday (starting from 8pm onwards).

name: Maison Sen
address: 61 Tran Hung Dao Street Hoan Kiem Ward, Hanoi 11000 Vietnam
reviews: This place will have everything you want to eat but when in vietnam and paying this type of price (which is cheap for Western Stds) but pricey for what you can get in Vietnam...... EAT THE SEAFOOD ! Forget the hot dog, the Pho, the pasta, or fried rice. Go for the Sashimi Salmon with shiso leaf, raw oysters, Welk, snail and all sorts of snails, Mussel/oysters filled with std garlic, ginger and onion (yum). Then there crab which are not too meaty but the giant prawns were great (not the sweetest), the scampi is just that lots of shell. We went up so many time. Yes, it's loud and like disney land with Minions going from table to table singing happy bday to many groups. It's a place where vietnamese go to celebrate something. It's not a formal romantic place. The dessert were ok nothing to write home about..... typical Che ingredients to make your own (lots of jellies etc... and ice). But their gelato is really good and good to eat to clense the pallet before your next round of seafood. You do have to make a reservation in advance - call or do it online. The price was 430k VD pp at night and did not include any drinks. They do accept credit card which was a savour as we came here the last night before our flight and used part cash and part card to get rid of our extra Dongs. There is a service charge and tax so 4 people without drinks came to $93 Cdn or about 75$US. For vietnam, that's a lot of bowls of Pho but what the hell sometime you have to live a little and you know you won't get sick here compared to some street stalls selling seafood. Family enjoyed it. See my youtube video to see what they had to offer under davetravels. Easy just to take an uber there from main area Hanoi., Amazing experience of 100's of dishes ( yes literally) vietnamese, Japanese, Chinese, European cuisine buffet of all you can eat. Beautiful surroundings and family friendly. Lovely staff. Great value for what it offers ( $30 NZD per person) Booking essential and is checked by name on entry Highly highly recommended both for the food and the experience., I was treated to a nice dinner at this restaurant by business associates. This buffett restaurant offers a very large selection of food to patrons. The staff were very nice to us, when they noticed we took small portions of food, they came to us offering to bring more food for us, they did. I enjoyed the meal and will go back anytime I am back in Hanoi.

EAT THE SEAFOOD !  Forget the hot dog, the Pho, the pasta, or fried rice. Go for the Sashimi Salmon with shiso leaf, raw oysters, Welk, snail and all sorts of snails, Mussel/oysters filled with std garlic, ginger and onion (yum). Then there crab which are not too meaty but the giant prawns were great (not the sweetest), the scampi is just that lots of shell.  We went up so many time. Yes, it's loud and like disney land with Minions going from table to table singing happy bday to many groups. It's a place where vietnamese go to celebrate something. It's not a  formal romantic place. The dessert were ok nothing to write home about..... typical Che ingredients to make your own (lots of jellies etc... and ice). But their gelato is really good and good to eat to clense the pallet before your next round of seafood.  You do have to make a reservation in advance - call or do it online.  The price was 430k VD pp at night and did not include any drinks. They do accept credit card which was a savour as we came here the last night before our flight and used part cash and part card to get rid of our extra Dongs. There is a service charge and tax so 4 people without drinks came to $93 Cdn or about 75$US.  For vietnam, that's a lot of bowls of Pho but what the hell sometime you have to live a little and you know you won't get sick here compared to some street stalls selling seafood. Family enjoyed it. See my youtube video to see what they had to offer under davetravels.  Easy just to take an uber there from main area Hanoi.

name: Banh Cuon Gia Truyen
address: 14 Pho Hang Ga Old Quarter, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: We came here as part of a street food tour and loved it so much that we came back on our own the next day. Between the 2 visits, we had the pork banh cuon, shrimp banh cuon, and some sausage. Our favorite was probably the pork banh cuon. The dipping sauce is so good!, We tried the pork and chicken banh cuon and both were good - so much better than the ones we tried for breakfast at our various hotels., This was on the recommendation of the hotel, which was just 20 metres away. We really liked this; light and tasty. Reminded us much of rice rolls in chinese restaurants. Really good.
description: We came here as part of a street food tour and loved it so much that we came back on our own the next day. Between the 2 visits, we had the pork banh cuon, shrimp banh cuon, and some sausage. Our favorite was probably the pork banh cuon. The dipping sauce is so good!

name: Vũ Kiều Tú Seafood Old Quarter Restaurant
address: 47A P. Hàng Bè, Hàng Bạc, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant might not look like much from the outside, but don’t let that fool you—it’s an absolute gem and one of the best places to eat in the Old Quarter of Hanoi. It’s simple, fast, and everything is homemade by the family. You can truly see how hard they work, especially the older ladies in the kitchen, who put so much love into every dish. The portions were generous, the food incredibly tasty, and to top it off, they even bring you free starters. And the total bill? Shockingly inexpensive for the quality and quantity you get. What makes it even more special is the heart behind the place—the owner actively supports underprivileged people and gives back to the community. So by eating here, you’re not just having a great meal, you’re supporting something meaningful. Highly, highly recommended., After having an incredible dinner with exceptional and welcoming customer service, I got the privilege to read Williams story and learn so much about what he’s doing for street children. Despite have little and working multiple jobs, William still goes out of his way to donate to organisations. He really is making such a positive impact on kids lives. We need more people like you, William, in this world…I absolutely love what you’re doing. He’s inspired me to start donating to multiple meaningful organisations to help those in need. If you’re ever in Hanoi, make sure to stop at his restaurant. You’ll get to experience delicious food, alongside wholesome customer experience and be able to meet William and get to know how powerful he and his goals are. Thankyou William, you made my night!, Vũ Kiều Tú Seafood Restaurant offers a delightful dining experience with fresh, flavorful seafood dishes. The ambiance is relaxed, and the staff is friendly and attentive. Portions are generous, and prices are reasonable, making it a great spot for seafood lovers looking for quality and value
description:
This restaurant might not look like much from the outside, but don’t let that fool you—it’s an absolute gem and one of the best places to eat in the Old Quarter of Hanoi. It’s simple, fast, and everything is homemade by the family. You can truly see how hard they work, especially the older ladies in the kitchen, who put so much love into every dish.

The portions were generous, the food incredibly tasty, and to top it off, they even bring you free starters. And the total bill? Shockingly inexpensive for the quality and quantity you get.

What makes it even more special is the heart behind the place—the owner actively supports underprivileged people and gives back to the community. So by eating here, you’re not just having a great meal, you’re supporting something meaningful. Highly, highly recommended.

name: PePe la Poule
address: 22 Quang Khanh Quảng An, Tây Hồ, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: We stumbled upon this restaurant our last day in Hanoi. Had a light lunch there and was struck by the authentic taste, and therefore came back for dinner. The menu has a mixture of Japanese, Chinese and European food. We ordered mostly European food, 7 plates in all, and they were all delicious and very well prepared. They were brought out one dish at a time, with plates changed after each dish, so it seemed like we had a 7 course dinner! They have two home-made pasta dish which are both amazing. The price was also right. This is in contrast to the night before when we had a so-called expensive Italian dinner at an upscale hotel nearby which turned out to be made believe mediocre fare., My husband and I met a friend for dinner. Pépé had good reviews, so we decided to try it, even though the mix of food offerings was a bit odd. We ordered the pork and crab dumplings and the regular dumplings. Both were solid choices. We also ordered the fried mozzarella, which was delicious. Main dishes were good but nothing amazing. My husband had the carbonara, and I had the clam linguini. Our friend ordered mushroom pasta and didn’t seem too impressed; she sent it back half eaten. After the main, the servers never came back to offer additional drinks or dessert. That part of service was odd. For the three of us with one drink each, the total was 1.5 mil VND., We just started living very near by so we tried it out. It's pretty good, nice views and ambience. Deep fried cheese was great, as was the Korean tofu. The mushroom cannelloni was so so - I don't know why, maybe I'm just not a proper Italian connoisseur. A few nice drinks and cocktails. Service was OK, but probably a bit tricky when it's full. Definitely worth another look as there are some interesting menu items. We'll be back.
description: MODERN CHINESE - TAPAS - PASTA WINE SELECTION At lunch, you can enjoy a nice set lunch, with a really reasonable price. At diner, we would advice you to reserve before coming, the restaurant may be busy! Come and try our wine selection, tapas and specialties: on the rooftop, you will have an amazing view of Hanoi at night! Last order 10.30pm (Sunday 9.30pm) We're looking forward to meet and share with you! Pepe la Poule team

name: Vi Hanoi Restaurant & Cafe
address: 25 Nguyễn Trường Tộ, Ba Dinh, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Very interesting food in a wonderful calm atmosphere. The waiters are really friendly and helpful, the food is excellent and you can see that there is a research to mix traditional vietnamese food with new ways of cooking and presenting it. It is the perfect spot to conclude a long sightseeing day in Hanoi., The restaurant Vi Hanoi I can fully recommend. After a round trip in Vietnam, Laos, Cambodia and a lot of restaurant visits, we can say afterwards that we ate very well there. The fried spring rolls with seafood were particularly recommended. I hadn't eaten any better on the whole trip. On our second visit we had found that you can not only sit downstairs, but there is still a very nice dining room on the first floor, to which a balcony is connected. Sitting there facing the hustle and bustle of the street, with delicious food and a cool local beer, is a pleasure. Rounding off the visit does the very good and very friendly service., Our tour guide took us here for lunch on our first day in Hanoi. Others had a set menu but 6 of us just ordered what we wanted. The waiter ensured that the 3 couples were billed separately which was greatly appreciated. Most of the staff could speak English well enough for us to communicate easily. The food was delicious and there was a good variety of drinks available. Credit card were accepted which made it very convenient. We were so impressed 4 of us caught a taxi to have dinner there again on our last night. Once again the meal and service were excellent. Highly recommend this restaurant.
description: "Step into Vi Hanoi and experience an unique culinary journey of Vietnam. This is a spot to delight your senses by a fusion of the flavors of each local ingredient and the ancient culture of Vietnam’s Northern Delta. There is a strong desire to celebrate the authentic essence of the sensory experience of savoring the dish, our team dedicates meticulous effort to created the different selections of dining space. From open gardens to private dining rooms are designed as various themes for both individual guests and big group dining guests. Come and experience the union of “Hanoi taste” and the passion of a team who always accompany you for the most satisfying experiences."

name: Met Vietnamese Restaurant & Vegetarian Options 2
address: Phố Lương Văn Can 42, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant was clean and the service was friendly, so I was able to eat in a relaxed atmosphere. I appreciated the air-conditioned room. A Hanoi beer was 35,000 VD, the main fish was 110,000 VD, and the fried rice and spring rolls (6 pieces of 3 types, raw, boiled, and fried) were both 100,000 VD. The fried rice and spring rolls were delicious, with a very easy-to-eat flavor. The tilapia was deep-fried and served with a sweet sauce. This is a great restaurant where you can order anything with confidence., Had a laugh, loved the delicious vegetarian menu. When we asked Quy showed us how to eat the Vietnamese vegan pancake with rice paper after we had embarrassingly ravaged half of it in our haste as it was sooo tasty. Best vegetarian/vegan food we've had in Vietnam so far, 1000% recommend. Shared a feast of 4 delicious meals between us 3 and paid just 130k dong each (~£4). The deep fried noodles with veg was astonishing and the vegan pancake, aubergine and tofu, and sweet and sour tofu (recommended by our gracious waiter Quy) did not shy away from their glory., I had the most delicious clay pot green banana tofu dish with fresh noodles and a passion fruit juice prefer by the most exquisite spring rolls Loved it The staff wore rindeer headpieces which were very endearing
description: "Welcome to Mẹt Vietnamese restaurant 2 ( Authentic Vietnamese Cuisine) Located in the heart of Hanoi Old Quarter , just a couple of steps away from Hoan Kiem Lake . Small and cozy Vietnamese restaurant & Vegetarian options in Hanoi. We serve Vietnamese traditional dishes from three parts in Vietnam including the north , the central and the south.""

name: Capos Hanoi - Spanish Tapas Bar
address: 12 - 14 Đ. Au Trieu, P. Hang Trong, Q. Hoan Kiem 4th & 5th Floor, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: The tapas here is better than Spain! We loved the iberico ham and chorizo starters. The salad with egg was spectacular as was the gambas with ajillo. The seafood paella was the best we have very had anywhere. Loved the way they prepared the rice. And the joselito pork prepared perfectly by chef Bryan Serrano was absolutely the best pork we have ever had anywhere. The som selected a great Cava for our meal and the churros with chocolate at the end was incredible. Not to sweet and sugary but served warm and delicious. All the staff are friendly and helpful and the view of the church is really impressive. All the croquetas are prepared in an innovative and wonderfully flavorful. Chef Serrano has honed his talents in Madrid and Ecuador and has added a special flair to traditional dishes. The entire experience was just unforgetable!, I had a dinner at Capos Hanoi recently. Fantastic experience in a stunning and cosy environment. The open kitchen definitely brings a great vibes and the Spanish chef and the Team are there to guide you. The food is very creative from authentic Spanish recipes. The wine bible is extensive offerings an outstanding choices of Spanish wines representing all the regions. Great food, friendly and attentive service, definitely a place you can’t miss. I’ll definitely come back, I can’t recommend Capos enough—it’s easily the best tapas meal I’ve ever had. The highlight for me was the grilled octopus entree, but every dish we tried was fantastic. There is a unique, lively, and creative atmosphere due to the setup of having an open kitchen surrounded by bar seating. Finding the restaurant can be a little tricky—just know that it is on the top floor of a different restaurant called godmother, and you can use an elevator in the back of that restaurant to reach Capos. If you stand at the base of the cathedral, you can also see the Capos sign high up on the building.
description: Nestled on a 4th floor and facing Hanoi's St Joseph cathedral, Capos is the first 360 degree open kitchen tapas concept in Vietnam.

name: The Majesty Sky Bar
address: No. 1 Cau Go Street 8th Floor, La Sinfonía Majesty Hotel & Spa, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant has a very chill view overlooking the romantic sparkling Hoan Kiem Lake. The bartenders Tung, Duong, Hoang are extremely friendly and approachable. Arriving a little late on a Saturday night, I was alone, with three brothers confiding in unison, and making a delicious recipe, which helped relieve a lot of sadness. Thank you so much bar Majesty 😁, The negroni that MaruNguyen mixed for me was really delicious and she varied it a bit to create a sweet herbal aftertaste along with the bitter taste that I still want to have another chance to try again. Majesty has a breathtaking view of Hoan Kiem Lake and The Huc Bridge. Thanks for this experience!, The view to Sword Lake is quite chill, the space is comfortable, suitable for all purposes such as dating or chatting with friends. It seems like sitting at the counter will help you talk more with the bartenders. Thank you Ha for introducing the drink and taking care of it enthusiastically. The Holy Grail cup is very delicious but will be suitable for those who like a greasier taste. Will come back for future events
description: Discover the allure of Majesty Sky Bar, Hanoi’s premier rooftop destination that exudes unparalleled elegance and charm. Nestled in the heart of the city, our breathtaking venue offers panoramic views of Hanoi’s iconic landmarks, creating an enchanting backdrop for an unforgettable experience. Immerse yourself in the sophisticated ambiance, indulge in exquisite cocktails crafted by our skilled bartenders, and savor delectable culinary creations that will tantalize your taste buds. Indulge in handcrafted cocktails infused with unique flavors, while soaking in the stunning panoramic vistas of the city’s skyline. With its unrivaled panoramic view over Hoan Kiem Lake, Majesty Sky Bar offers a remarkable experience that will leave you captivated and longing for more. Majestic in every sense, Majesty Sky Bar invites you to experience a truly extraordinary journey that will leave a lasting impression.

name: Gia Restaurant
address: 61 P. Văn Miếu, Dong Da, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We came to discover a starry Vietnamese. On the service side, a team with little care very attentive to customers, on the sommelier side a real passionate who knew how to make the right choices and justify them. In the kitchen, nothing wrong m, the quality is there and discovering Vietnamese gastronomy was a pleasure. Only downside the price, which certainly aligns with the standards in France but excludes the premises., We enjoyed the experience immensely. Each waiter had quite good English however a few things were lost in translation. We agreed to have the wine pairings. We were offered a sparkling wine to commence the meal but did not realise it was additional to the cost. The price of the lunch was clear on the website, however, the surcharges and VAT came to an extra 15% on the final bill. We had paid a deposit but were not offered to have the deposit deducted from the final bill. We were told we would receive a refund on the card. This is not made clear on the website., We had the summer tasting menu, it was very good value for money for this kind of food, service and environ. The welcome began when we stepped out of the taxi, with a staff ready to greet and escort us from the car to the place. Outside it was nondescript, but inside it was tastefully designed of a Vietnamese home with a modern twist (I assume Gia means home). It was adequately tranquil as there were just a few tables upstairs. The service was very attentive as the waiting staff from time to time went around to make sure things were okay. The food was contemporary cuisine made with mainly local ingredients and the courses were as good as some starred restaurants we had dined at. The progression from one to another was carefully crafted. Presentation was top notched. They even matched some courses with table mats and utensil holders to present the changing of courses. This price was very reasonable for what it was — 2.6m dongs (US$110) for our elaborated summer tasting menu (about 8 courses) paired with wine. A rising gem in Hanoi’s surely up and coming culinary scene. Highly, highly recommended.
description:
We came to discover a starry Vietnamese. On the service side, a team with little care very attentive to customers, on the sommelier side a real passionate who knew how to make the right choices and justify them. In the kitchen, nothing wrong m, the quality is there and discovering Vietnamese gastronomy was a pleasure.
Only downside the price, which certainly aligns with the standards in France but excludes the premises.

name: Ha Thanh Mansion
address: 14 Ngo Van So str., Hoan Kiem Dist., Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Ha Thanh Mansion offers a wonderful dining experience with delicious food and talented chefs. Thanh staff is very professional, well-trained and knowledgeable in their field, introducing the dishes and prices in detail, helping us save a lot of time in choosing dishes. Highly recommend the service provided by the restaurant., delicious food! I would like to order seafood soup and beef soup next time I come here. The service attitude is very good. The food is unique, including delicious beans and delicious tofu curds and spring rolls. I feel that the owner is very careful in running this restaurant. The decoration is very distinctive and the price is very reasonable. It was recommended by a friend and it is indeed good. Thank you to the service staff of this restaurant for their dedication. Will want to come again in the future, Dinner at Ha Thanh Mansion is a wonderful experience. Traditional dishes are served in an elegant setting. The professionalism of the chef brings the flavors of old Northern Vietnam to the food. The richness and diversity of the menu offer many choices.
description: Heritage is not just a remnant of the past, but a living embodiment of values that have stood the test of time.” Ha Thanh Mansion, situated on Ngo Van So Street, is a century-old villa that stands as a testament to the rich history of Tonkin. We are dedicated to provide a complete experience of Northern Vietnam's essence through the authentic flavors of traditional dishes and refined delicacies that have been handed down through generations.

name: Spice Garden
address: 15 Ngo Quyen Hanoi Vietnam Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Excellent lunch in the posh Sofitel restaurant. We had the staff almost entirely to ourselves for a set lunch with tasty, original dishes. 3 starters included a banana blossom salad with slices of chicken breast, onions, bean sprouts and carrots, followed by a small basket with three spring rolls: a hot fried pork version, a less convincing fresh nem with a salmon stuffing and a fried shrimp roll, and to top it up a decent pho bo. Grilled pork shoulder cuts from Sapa were announced to be served in a bamboo cylinder though came in banana leaves instead but were juicy nonetheless. We closed out a great meal with some slices of grilled pineapple served with a scoop of yoghurt ice cream and some almond crumble. An excellent lunch, as said before! Friendly highly spontaneous service, The Sofitel in Hanoi is so beautiful, and I love the French Quarter in Hanoi. We weren't able to stay here overnight, so I insisted on coming to the Spices Garden for dinner. We had reservations, but they didn't seem necessary, as there weren't many people in the restaurant that night. Our place settings at our table were beautiful, and the staff very attentive. The food was very good -- a little on the pricey side for Hanoi, where you can get an excellent bun cha on the street for a few dollars -- but it was definitely worth it. We had live traditional Vietnamese music which was the cherry on the top., We booked well ahead for dinner on 14 February, Valentine's Day. The gourmet Vietnamese cuisine was just what we wanted for the romantic couple's dinner. Anytime, however, the kitchen prepares the best of local traditional recipes with a personal enhancement by the Chef de Cuisine. This is a go once leads to go again and again dining destination.
description: Nestled in the vibrant heart of Hanoi, Spice Garden has been a beloved culinary destination since its inception. This vibrant, modern oasis not only stands as a testament to the rich heritage of Vietnam but also serves as a place where the captivating magic of Vietnamese flavours comes alive, offering an unforgettable dining experience for all to enjoy. In 2023, Spice Garden embarked on a remarkable transformation, blending timeless tradition with contemporary allure. The restaurant sought to infuse its space with a brighter and more modern ambiance, while retaining its connection to the hotel’s heritage. The new design aimed to create intimate spaces that are perfect for a memorable dining experience. ❊ Lunch & Dinner: À La Carte Menu & Chef Tasting Menu (except Saturday evening) ❊ Saturday BBQ Buffet Dinner: Featuring live cooking stations, an array of fresh seafood, traditional Vietnamese barbeque, Hanoi specialties, savoury dishes, and delectable desserts

name: Katze Vegan & Vegetarian Restaurant
address: 43C Hang Be, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: With your command you will receive extra dishes selected from the restaurant itself, all absolutely delicious. At the end of the meal the owner will tell you his story and the good cause he has been following for years. A meal at Katze Restaurant will allow you to enjoy delicious food at a low price, and allow them to help homeless youth through their fundraising. Assolutamente consigliato!, Generosity and thoughtfulness- the two words to describe the meal here. An all vegan menu- the place has expanded and has two shops next to each other and still its almost always full. The service is quick and no fuss. Now the story behind the owner is very interesting- best to go there and see it for yourself I would say but this man loves to feed people. Order cautiously here as not only are the portions generous, with whatever you may order they give you a an almost bottomless bowl of the most fragrant local rice, a bowl of the best tofu in tomato sauce (a Vietnamese signature), a bowl of salad and bean sprouts, a green clear soup and a banana flower salad. I ordered the rice paper rolls, a young corn stir fry and a morning glory stir fry. Our tummy and hearts were full. Everything was so delicious but if like me you don’t like wasting food, start by ordering small cause you would lap up that soup and the tofu for sure. A must visit for vegans and vegetarians., This place was a bit hard to find as the entryway is between buildings in an alleyway. Thankfully, neighbors are very kind and were able to point us in the right direction…totally safe and absolutely worth the adventure to find! A few steps down an alley and a short flight of stairs later, we were delighted to find this cozy restaurant filled with the most amazing aroma of Vietnamese deliciousness!! 😋 We must have gotten there at a good time as we didn’t wait long to get seated, but the place was packed!! It felt like we were in a locals home since the kitchen, while tucked in the corner, was open and visible like we were getting ready to eat with family, cool experience. The tables and backless chairs were on the smaller side- fine for me being 4’-11”, but for taller people just be prepared! Everything on the menu is in English and everything is completely vegan… and oh so delicious! While the staff may speak minimal English, communication was easy and smiles are always universal. We ordered 2 main dishes and an order of fresh spring rolls, which was more than enough and honestly could have done with ordering 1 less dish since several sides come complimentary with the meal. The dipping sauce was also amazing and made fresh for us right at our table! We were lucky that the owner Will was there! He showed us a brochure that talked about his entrepreneurial journey… very inspiring!! Can’t wait to visit Hanoi again just to eat Katze!!
description: I am a Restaurant worker who desires to express my very personal journey from street kid to social entrepreneur

name: Tam Vi
address: 4B Yen The, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: 3 couples with some culinary experience were unanimously expectant, had made a special reservation and were prepared to spend a lot of money on good food. The unanimous experience was that they had been much better pampered in smaller restaurants. Not only were some orders forgotten, but the service was otherwise characterized by a lack of attention. Not a plus for us, but it should be noted that the portions are (too???) large and the prices are very moderate. We all ordered different dishes, none of which were a real highlight, but none of which were completely unsatisfactory either. As can be read from other reviews, it remains completely unclear how the Michelin * that is advertised can be justified (if it really is one)., We ordered 5 dishes- 2 were delicious, 2 were average and the veal with lemongrass and chilli dish was terrible. The veal had a lot of hard fat on it which made the dish inedible. We showed the waitress the fat but she said she was unable to exchange it or take it off the bill as we had tried it. Not a dish that you would expect from a Michelin starred restaurant. Overpriced and overrated., This was highly recommended, and you do need to make a reservation. I wasn’t particularly impressed from start to end. Service was not attentive; items were slow to come and needed reminders. Maybe they were busy, but there definitely isn’t a shortage of staff. Food was above average. The fried prawn with star fruit sounds cute, but the tiny prawns could have been deshelled. Crab meat soup was ultra-bland. The caramelised egg and braised pork belly in Claypot was excellent. Roast chicken was the other saving grace, but its presentation can be improved. In fact all the dishes’ presentation can do better. We’ve seen significantly higher standards in taste and presentation in multiple other restaurants in Hanoi. They have many offerings, but not many that jump out of the page. Won’t recommend to my friends, sorry.
description:
3 couples with some culinary experience were unanimously expectant, had made a special reservation and were prepared to spend a lot of money on good food. 
The unanimous experience was that they had been much better pampered in smaller restaurants. Not only were some orders forgotten, but the service was otherwise characterized by a lack of attention. Not a plus for us, but it should be noted that the portions are (too???) large and the prices are very moderate. We all ordered different dishes, none of which were a real highlight, but none of which were completely unsatisfactory either.
As can be read from other reviews, it remains completely unclear how the Michelin * that is advertised can be justified (if it really is one).

name: MIAs Restaurant
address: 22 P. Báo Khánh, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: So we were having a little wander with rumbling tummies looking for food, when we came across MIAS, and boy am I pleased that we went in! We were greeted by Johnnie, who sat us quickly and came with menus. He gave us enough time to browse the extensive menu before he came back to take our order. There were 4 of us so we decided to share the Norhern Family Banquet, then we chose some morning glory (an extra portion to what was included in the banquet) spring rolls, and a chicken dish ( the name escapes me) The food was presented beautifully and it was all so tasty, the serving bowls were all empty when we finished. I would say my favourite dish was the braised pork with coconut and the pork scratching with the most delicious herby sauce I’ve ever tasted! But yes it was all so delicious & flavoursome. We had a bottle of Chardonnay & a couple of cocktails. The restaurant itself was beautiful & the ambience was lovely, so chilled. We were all full after the food so declined desserts. I highly recommend this restaurant for authentic, quality & gorgeous food. Huge shout out to Johnnie for his attentive service! The bill for the 4 us worked out under £30 per head and was absolutely worth it!, First night at Ha Noi, recommended by a local, we try Vietnamese cuisine for the first time in this restaurant. Prices are higher than other restaurants but the quality you pay for. We found Son who offered us impeccable service as well as several tips on dishes to try. Fresh, good and carefully cooked food. Unfortunately I can not upload the video but the preparation of their Pho soup with thin strips of raw meat that is cooked at the pouring of a broth of spiced meat Clean and well maintained room. We haven't tried their cocktails but, judging by the paper, they deserve a lot., One word: AMAZING! Looking for a typical restaurant here in Hanoi, we came near Hoan Kiem Lake (a real focal point for the life of any citizen of Hanoi, like our city-centers) and came across this restaurant already reviewed ultra favorably on Trip Advisor; my friends and I entered and already the reception was superb, as it is in typical Vietnamese style! The menu features all original Vietnamese dishes, from appetizers to desserts, including drinks. We had a South Vietnam Tipical dinner consisting of a mega “chopping board” with different dishes of meat, fish, and vegetables (I attach the photo of the menu with the precise list of dishes), two typical Hanoi beers and two desserts based on coconut ice cream. The other similar option is the North Vietnam Tipical Dinner with a slight variation on the type of dishes included. The chopping board is mandatory for two people but I guarantee you that in the end both people will be ultra-satiated ) and consider that we had skipped lunch! All excellent and a big thank you and a big hug to the legendary CIARA that from the reception served us and satisfied our every request, until the end of dinner! Definitely ultra-modest price for the Italian pockets; everything cost us the equivalent of about 25 euros per person, taxes and service included. My review is 5 stars ultra deserved, we will definitely be back!!!!
description: With a huge dream, we together build MIAs, with an ambitious of sharing the simplicity but truly elegant of Vietnamese food culture to the world. Each of dish in MIAs, we will introduce you all to interesting stories of our people, regional distinctions of geography or sub-culture across our beautiful Vietnam. Welcome you to our MIAs. We hope that you might find joy and excitement on your journey discovering our food map.

name: Sente - The Flavour of Lotus
address: 20 Nguyen Quang Bich Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This is a shophouse situated near our hotel (Lotte). It came highly recommended by a friend so we decided to eat dinner here tonight. Well, we are so thankful for this suggestion. It’s GOOD. The main theme is lotus, so most of the offerings come with some part of lotus. And lotus is an easy, safe and forgiving adjunct to accompany most foodstuff, so that’s very clever of the eatery to think of this concept. Everything we ordered was tastefully presented, and was very delicious! Staff spoke reasonably good English. The prawn ball soup was rather small in portion, though. Lots of brown rice used for their carbs (no jasmine white rice, unfortunately). The pad Thai was also brown rice noodle, but we didn’t think it was pad Thai - more like beef kway teow. Anyway it was still yummy. I didn’t eat the unagi but my friends loved it. The mushroom wrapped with skin tofu was amazing - such a clever thought! Duck and prawn salad were excellent. For drinks, again, most had a touch of lotus somewhere. How interesting! I had lotus ice cream for dessert - you can probably imagine it can be pretty bland so my second scoop was black sesame to give the overall dessert some robustness. We strongly recommend this eatery for the innovative use of lotus, and the good value. Just to be clear, my review is based on the Metro branch of the restaurant, not the original one., Lotus cuisine is not familiar in Japan, so we went there as a memory of Hanoi. The food was delicious and very beautifully presented. The interior was lovely, and the space was comfortable, allowing us to dine at our leisure. The restaurant staff were also very warm and kind. We asked for a taxi on our way back, and when it arrived, we told the driver our destination and he politely saw us off. It was our first time in the city, and we were still unsure of the geography, but we were able to return to the hotel with peace of mind. If we go to Hanoi again, this is a restaurant we'd like to visit., Located just a street off a busy road and secluded. The environment felt slightly tropical. Service was excellent, the dishes were served promptly and staff were responsive to needs/questions. English was good. The menu is self explanatory. Prices were extremely fair for the quality. Tried numerous dishes and all were excellent. Higher recommend trying if you are into quality food with a unique twist of lotus root.
description: Sente is located in a small corner of old quarter, with the cozy and gentle atmosphere Vietnam style. The healthy food and drinks in Sente are based on the main ingredient is SEN of Vietnam. With the slogan EAT CLEAN and say NO to PLASTIC, Sente uses only environmentally friendly materials. Welcome!

name: Bo Nuong Xuan Xuan 47 Ma May
address: 47 Pho Ma May, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Dropped by for a meal and was extremely surprised with the experience. Got a beef 🥩 for 2. Struggled to get through it all. We were shown how to go about it by the helpful staff who got a big laugh when I asked for a fork… Beef, mushrooms, tomatoes, spring onions, onions, garlic and aubergines were all on the plate. Plus lettuce and dipping sauces were provided. It was a good change to the normal offerings in Hanoi., Korean bbq type meal. Very helpful staff who got the burner going and regularly checked temperature & replaced the foil to make sure our food was cooked perfectly. We chose beef and had tender meat in generous portions with accompanying veg, tamarind sauce and seasoning. It made a very nice change for lunch., Had the best lunch here! Thinking we were going to have quick snack for lunch, we walked past and saw some people cooking their own food over a bbq and could not resist! Food was so tasty and for 4 of us we could not fit another bite in for about AUD 8 each.
description: Xuan Xuan has been here nearly 10 years and this is a traditional restaurant beef BBQ. Beef soft with special sauce will make you can not forget. It’s still packed every evening, with both locals and travellers, which guarantees a good turnover of food and a lively atmosphere. Aim for a table outside on the pavement or just inside the main entrance so you can watch the goings-on on busy Ma May, enjoy beers and beef BBQ with friends that so cool.And 1 importance thing that price is very suitable and dishes quite clean.Welcome everyone to come and try our perfect delicious food. .

name: The Eroica Restaurant & Skybar
address: 12 - 14 Dinh Ngang Street 8th Floor, La Sinfonía Citadel Hotel & Spa, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This rooftop bar is absolutely amazing! From the ambiance as soon as you walk in to the warm reception by the staff, every detail makes you feel comfortable and delighted. Located atop a high-rise building, the bar offers a stunning view of the city skyline. At night, with the city lights sparkling, the view is breathtaking and makes it a perfect spot for taking photos. The drink selection is impressive, and the bartenders are exceptionally skilled. The cocktails are smooth and full of creativity, with each one offering a unique and layered flavor experience. I highly recommend trying their signature cocktails – they’re truly unforgettable. The snacks are also well-paired, providing the perfect complement to the drinks, whether you’re looking for something to munch on with your drink or just a light bite. The staff are friendly and professional, always eager to offer recommendations, so you can easily find drinks and snacks that suit your taste. The whole experience made for an unforgettable night. Overall, this rooftop bar has not only mesmerizing views but also top-notch service and delicious drinks, making it a fantastic spot for friends gathering, date nights, or simply relaxing on your own. Highly recommended for anyone who loves nightlife!, Absolutely wonderful experience. The restaurant space, music and lighting are very suitable. The food is suitable for taste, but the price is very commensurate with the quality. Staff member Huyen Trang is very lovely and enthusiastic, helping our table take photos. When you sit down to eat, you will also receive two delicious mocktails!! Should be experienced for a light dinner, date or birthday. The restaurant also supports beautiful and luxurious birthday balloon decorations, The quality of the food is uniform, quite fresh (salmon) and delicious, well seasoned as well as moderately cooked for duck meat. The waiters are very attentive and polite, interested in asking questions when they see you and your family. My friend was missing something, especially Tuan Anh, who served very attentively and enthusiastically
description: Toạ lạc trên tầng 8 của khách sạn La Sinfonía Citadel tại địa chỉ 12-14 Đình Ngang, The Eroica Restaurant sẽ dẫn dắt thực khách tới một hành trình ẩm thực nhiều tầng hương vị với thực đơn đa dạng mỹ vị Á Âu kết hợp. Không gian fine-dining được thiết kế sang trọng, thanh lịch và hài hoà đến từng chi tiết, The Eroica hứa hẹn là điểm đến lý tưởng cho bất kì buổi hẹn đặc biệt: từ bữa tối lãng mạn cho cặp đôi, buổi hẹn gia đình hay bữa tiệc công ty...Quý khách sẽ được trải nghiệm dịch vụ ẩm thực hoản hảo với sự phong phú của các món ngon đặc sắc đến từ những đầu bếp tài hoa của chúng tôi.

name: Puku Cafe and Sports Bar
address: 16 Tong Duy Tan, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100 Vietnam
reviews: We found this place by accident and were quite impressed. We had four drinks each and ordered nachos with beef, fish and chips and mushroom and chicken Penne. This all came to about £40 Waiters were very attentive so overall would recommend., I had a fantastic lunch at Puku restaurant! I ordered the beef fajitas, and they were absolutely delicious—tender, flavorful, and cooked perfectly. The staff was incredibly accommodating with my dairy and nut allergies, making sure everything was safe for me to enjoy. I really appreciated their attention to detail and care. Highly recommend for both the food and the service!, We discovered this amazing gem during our street adventures, and it was an absolute delight! Despite the scorching day, the ice-cold beers and mouthwatering pizza made everything perfect. The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, adding to the fantastic experience. Thank you so much, Puku Cafe & Bar! 🌟✨
description: Located in the middle of Hanoi's Food Street, at the heart of the Old Quarter, Puku Café & Sports Bar provides a range of different cuisines, served in a cozy ambiance with great vibes either inside or outside. We are also known as one of the city's best 24/24h sports bar.

name: Tacos fresh and more
address: No 1: 54 Dao Duy Tu Street- Hoan Kiem and No2: 45 Truc Bach - Ba Dinh - Ha Noi, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: An actual hole in the wall but they have vegetarian and gluten-free options which is such a blessing for anyone with these dietary needs- they also had a vegan section. We ate the gluten-free vegetarian enchiladas and burrito bowl and loved it. We didn’t like the vegetarian gluten-free taco but the regular (with gluten) vegetarian crunchy taco was nice. The churros (not vegan, not veg or gluten-free) were good too. There’s one server and one cook so it takes time but you can enjoy a beer and there’s a cleanish toilet too., This place is a hidden gem. The food is delicious. We went there twice in three days. The hard shell tacos and the nachos were particularly tasty. The only drawback is it is a tiny place in a small alley so doesn’t have great vibe. And the service is a bit slow as there’s just one guy handling the customers., Best Spicy Margaritas and Nachos, waiter was funny and was always up for banter, was the highlight of the evening. Upstairs area had beautiful views of the city and lake. We came here twice while in Hanoi and would recommend.
description: An actual hole in the wall but they have vegetarian and gluten-free options which is such a blessing for anyone with these dietary needs- they also had a vegan section. We ate the gluten-free vegetarian enchiladas and burrito bowl and loved it. We didn’t like the vegetarian gluten-free taco but the regular (with gluten) vegetarian crunchy taco was nice. The churros (not vegan, not veg or gluten-free) were good too. There’s one server and one cook so it takes time but you can enjoy a beer and there’s a cleanish toilet too.

name: Gia Ngu Restaurant
address: 27 29 Gia NgÆ° Street, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Many people often hear the saying "eat for yourself in the morning, lunch for your friends, dinner for your enemies". After a long night, our bodies often lack the most serious energy in the morning. Breakfast is the way to go. Best for replenishing lost energy and providing the body with necessary substances during the day. Morning food is also a signal for our brains to work to start a new, more active day. During a recent business trip, I randomly chose a random restaurant to enjoy breakfast before going to the airport to return to the US. I was really surprised when enjoying breakfast at Gia Ngu restaurant. The restaurant space is very beautiful, the food is not only delicious but also extremely eye-catching decoration, the staff's service is also very dedicated and thoughtful, giving me a very complete breakfast. Thanks to that breakfast, I had a lot of energy for the 16-hour flight back to the US. If I have the opportunity to return to Vietnam, I will definitely come here again and spend more time enjoying the restaurant's other dishes!, Accustomed to starred restaurants in France and Europe, while we were planning a trip to Vietnam, we learned that for the first year, the Michelin guide had awarded one star to the GIA Hanoi restaurant, and were therefore able to make a reservation. What a joy to discover this establishment and its teams: The setting is very refined, very beautiful dishes for each dish and a very warm welcome. The service is very attentive, each dish is presented and explained in a very pleasant way. The tasting menu is beautifully designed, with beautiful presentations for each dish, in which we find truly exceptional flavor combinations. The only downside is that the food and wine pairing is not very generous and does not really allow you to appreciate the wines served. In a recently starred restaurant, it is very pleasant to be able to spend some time with the Chef. What a pleasure to be able to chat at length with the young Chef Sam TRAN, who is adorable. We were able to visit the kitchen, chat in a very relaxed way and take photos with this young female Chef, who was very smiling and available. Without a doubt, it will be awarded a second star within a year or two., Excellent restaurant. Very welcoming, I eat alone and the young waiter takes the time to explain the dishes to me with the translation on his cell phone. I went back to eat there 3 times; my hotel, the Foyer, is next door. The food is very good. Beautiful and refined presentation. I highly recommend.
description: Gia NgÆ° Restaurant Legends of Gia NgÆ° Conveniently located on the large basement floor, the Gia Ngu Restaurant is first restaurant ever, dating back to early 2000. At the time, Hanoiâ€™s restaurant scene lacked the concept of small sized restaurants which offered a casual fine dining service and outstanding attentions to detail. Ever since its launched, this venue has been a leading trendsetter in Vietnamâ€™s boutique dining scene. A color scheme of steel blue and warm greys complementing dark brown dining furniture and warm lighting engender a cozy sophisticated atmosphere. Stunning city views across Hoan Kiem Lake and just 2 minutes walking, stretches of the Red River and its bridges as well as the Hanoiâ€™s ever-expanding skyline create the perfect backdrop, particularly at night..

name: The Gourmet Corner Restaurant
address: 22 Ta Hien Street 9th Floor, La Mejor Hotel & Sky Bar, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: The food is very delicious ~ I highly recommend the steak! 🥩 The chocolate cake tastes like fondant au chocolat, but it's really delicious 😋😋 The staff is friendly and the service is top-notch. Good luck!!! You can eat hotel cuisine with the best service at a low price by Korean standards. Trang and Ngoc 👍🏻, I was celebrating my birthday and Ngoc made me feel very special! The food was lovely and they provided me with a free dessert and discount for my birthday. I would highly recommend this restaurant. The price may be slighter higher than some other places but the service and food more than makes up for it. Plus there is a beautiful rooftop too!, Great time spent in this restaurant, the view was just superb!! We were lucky enough to be served by Ngoc who was super nice and helpful to us:) We highly recommend this pretty restaurant at affordable Awards for its taste pleasure!!
description: Located on the 9th floor of La Mejor Hotel & Sky Bar in the heart of Hanoi Old Quarter, The Gourmet Corner Restaurant's mission is to bring masterclass dishes, with top-notch services to our customers. Founded in 2010, throughout the years of operating, The Gourmet Corner Restaurant thrive to become one of the top restaurants in Hanoi, using the freshest and finest quality of ingredients. Beside some iconic "fine-dining" dishes, our vision is to present the Vietnamese cuisine to the customers, with some fusion touches from the Chefs. Resulting in a special Menu, with exquisite ingredients pairing with excellent craftsmanship in cooking, combining into an unforgetable dining experience.

name: KOTO VILLA
address: 44 Tay Ho Road Tây Hồ, Quang An Ward, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: KOTO founder, Jimmy Pham, lives this mantra every day. I had the pleasure to meet Jimmy while dining, and was impressed seeing his vision for training at-risk children in Hanoi at work all around me. Trainees demonstrated professional service skills, and produced a delicious and visually appealing lunch for our group. My KOTO t-shirt is also a favorite souvenir of my Vietnam trip, and reminds me to seize small Know One, Teach One opportunities in my own life. Thanks Jimmy, for your inspiration and for making an important difference in our too often indifferent world., My wife and I had a excellent lunch at this restaurant on our recent visit to Hanoi. Koto also trains young people in food services and hospitality. It is a non profit so we also contributed to the local community. We each had a app and main as well as desert. Mixed cocktails were well done. We would suggest this to anyone visiting Hanoi., KOTO Training Restaurants (Hanoi, Vietnam) what a great place and a great concept. Speaks to my heart of some many levels thanks Chad Anderson for the tour. Customer service is the best I have experienced in Vietnam. It reminded me of our training restaurant William Angliss Institute. Most of the time all it takes is a little bit of guidance and some encouragement and these kids can match it with the best of them and they really put in an amazing effort to provide great customer service. Food was tasty and well presented. It was served super fast. Prices were a bit expensive for Vietnam but the price matched the quality of the food and service if you in Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh city please add to your list.
description: KOTO Villa is the soulful celebration of twenty-one successful years of changing lives. KOTO stands for "Know one, teach one." KOTO is one of the most unique experiences in Vietnam for travellers who can enjoy a meal at KOTO Villa which serves as a vocational training ground to empower our trainees. KOTO is a unique not-for-profit social enterprise that started in 1999 in Hanoi. The program targets at-risk and disadvantaged youth—aged 16 to 22—with a 24-month-long training program in vocational hospitality, life skills and English. KOTO’s Vision is a permanent change for at-risk and disadvantaged youth through the transformative power of social enterprise. We believe at-risk and disadvantaged youth should have access to a holistic program that provides career training and life skills in a nurturing environment. It's dining with social impact.

name: Tadka Indian Restaurant Hanoi
address: 26 Phung Hung Hang Bong Ward, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Tadka restaurant in Hanoi is a culinary gem! From the vibrant ambiance to the tantalizing aromas and flavorful dishes, every aspect of the dining experience at Tadka is top-notch. The menu boasts a diverse selection of Indian cuisine, expertly prepared with fresh ingredients and authentic spices. Whether you're a fan of classic favorites like butter chicken and biryani or eager to explore new flavors, Tadka delivers consistently delicious meals. The attentive staff adds to the overall enjoyment, providing excellent service with a warm and welcoming demeanor. For a memorable dining experience in Hanoi, Tadka is definitely worth a visit!, "One of the best Indian Restaurant, Had a great experience at Tadka indian restaurant hanoi, vietnam . Welcoming gesture from the starting to suggest there best dishes with gulab jamun to till the end they give their best service to us... They have 2 outlet in Hanoi,if you are a south indian food lover you must visit their Tadka 2 Restaurant.. Food.... Awesome. Service... Great. Ambience...Neet and clean. Parking Available. Smoking zone Available. Staff were very Friendly and helping. They can help you to book grab and guide few places in hanoi or apart from hanoi..... Overall The Best".... 😊, The owner of the restaurant has his own business and brand of spices manufacturing here in India and so, the taste of the food here is really awesome. The portions and servings are perfect for 2. If in Hanoi, definitely give it a try, as the Indian food here turned out to be the best among various Indian restaurants at Old Quarter that we tried and that too, at reasonable prices. The location is very close to Hanoi Train Street. We were attended to by Mr. Prashant and Mr. Sagar and their services were just awesome. The interaction with Mr. Prashant made our lunch all the more enjoyable. Special shout out to him!
description: Tadka restaurant in Hanoi is a culinary gem! From the vibrant ambiance to the tantalizing aromas and flavorful dishes, every aspect of the dining experience at Tadka is top-notch. The menu boasts a diverse selection of Indian cuisine, expertly prepared with fresh ingredients and authentic spices. Whether you're a fan of classic favorites like butter chicken and biryani or eager to explore new flavors, Tadka delivers consistently delicious meals. The attentive staff adds to the overall enjoyment, providing excellent service with a warm and welcoming demeanor. For a memorable dining experience in Hanoi, Tadka is definitely worth a visit!

name: Local Craft Beer - Tony Vu's Brewing
address: 66 Hàng Bông Street, Hoàn Kiếm, hà nội, Hanoi 11017 Vietnam
reviews: A nice clean and tidy small bar on a busy street. I had the Belgian Trippel IPA which was good and my partner had the cider which was a touch to sweet. This bar is not cheap by local standards but you get good quality., Really good beer at reasonable prices We sat with both our girls and got good beer as well as lovely snacks. It is worth looking past for spec. Beer and hygge at the edge stone, Good beer and drinks! Staff is super friendly and speaks great English! So good drinks, nice staff and an overall enjoyable way to end the day in the old quarter of Hanoi:)
description:
A nice clean and tidy small bar on a busy street. I had the Belgian Trippel IPA which was good and my partner had the cider which was a touch to sweet.
This bar is not cheap by local standards but you get good quality.

name: KENKŌ - Healthy Poke Bowls
address: 11 Ng. Hội Vũ, Hàng Bông, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: This poke bowl is absolutely delicious! Fresh ingredients, perfect flavors, and a great portion size Absolutely loved this poke bowl! So fresh, flavorful, and satisfying—definitely coming back for more, The quality and freshness of the ingredients used in their poke bowls were absolutely exceptional. The fish was incredibly fresh and perfectly sliced, while the vegetables and toppings were crisp and bursting with flavor. The staff at here were not only knowledgeable about the menu but also displayed genuine warmth and attentiveness throughout my visit., Best poke bowl I’ve ever had! You get to choose exactly what you want (think subway but with poke bowls) and it tasted so fresh. The portion was massive too! Would definitely recommend to anyone craving a fresh meal with plenty of goodness
description: This poke bowl is absolutely delicious! Fresh ingredients, perfect flavors, and a great portion size Absolutely loved this poke bowl! So fresh, flavorful, and satisfying—definitely coming back for more

name: Highway4 Hang Tre
address: 5 Hang Tre Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Lovely shabby chic restaurant full of charm. Some really imaginative dishes, such as the sweet potato croquettes (more like a beignet), and the pork and coconut. Great ribs. The sesame crisp bread, complimentary, was amazing. With 4 beers and 4 dishes the bill for 2 of us was under £20. Further evidence that Vietnam is a foodie heaven., We found this restaurant in the Michelin Guide, described as a "tavern". Nice old building, and nicely done inside. It does describe on the menu, that it is a place to come and "get drunk" and it seemed like the group next to us had taken that instruction. They were playing music on their phones and were extremely loud. Not the place to come if you want a quieter dinner. We ordered a selection of food. It was OK, but not brilliant. None of it was particularly highly flavoured, for example, we struggled to detect any hint of Sichuan Pepper on the ribs. Not our best meal in Hanoi and we won't be visiting again. We chose: - Cá Sụn Sịn Nướng Muối Ớt: "Sụn Sịn" Fish grilled w/Chili & Salt - Dẻ Sườn Nướng Mắc Khén: Spare Ribs grilled w/Sichuan Pepper - Free-range Duck in a Son Tinh Plum Liquor Sauce - Sauteed Chayote Stalks & Leaves (Also posted to my food blog on Instagram @AbbeyKing16), Was recommended to go to this place by our hotel. Was pleasantly surprised to find that it’s in the Michelin guide. The place had a nice vibe and a pretty good menu. The pomelo salad was yummy with juicy chunks of the fruit tossed with a piquant sauce. We also ordered the banana flower salad, which was my first time eating this dish. Also very yummy. Would recommend ordering this too since it’s uniquely Vietnamese. The highlight dish was the mini octopus dish. It was steamed with a bunch of vegetables and topped with lots of dill. The octopus was cooked perfectly so it was tender and juicy. Really fresh flavors. We also ordered the viet rolls with wasabi sauce. That was ok; nothing to write home about. We also got the crabmeat glass noodles, which was ok. The dish we were disappointed with was the grilled pork jowl. Don’t know if it’s just the quality of the meats in Vietnam, but the pork was really tough and difficult to eat.
description: The Original Highway4, opened in December 2000! Highway4 offers the ultimate Vietnamese dining experience. The food menu has been specially crafted over the past 15 years, serving traditional Vietnamese flavours as well as the opportunity to explore another side of Vietnamese culinary culture. At Highway4 you can try the wide range of fruit, herbal and plain liquors under the brand "Son Tinh" - Vietnam's first and ONLY internationally-awarded liquor. Highway4 is perfect for discovering and exploring Vietnam's culture of food and drink or getting together with a group of friends or colleagues for an evening of fun and feasting. Highway4 Hang Tre is on the far eastern side of Hanoi's Old Quarter, near the beginning of Chuong Duong Bridge.

name: The Market
address: 36 Đ. Lê Đức Thọ, phường Mỹ Đình 2, quận Nam Từ Liêm Sheraton Hanoi West, Nam Từ Liêm, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: "I had an exceptional dining experience at your restaurant on 20/10 Vietnamese women's day with my family. The ambiance was delightful, the staff were incredibly attentive, and the food was absolutely delicious. Each dish was crafted with great skill and presented beautifully. I was particularly impressed with the wine selection and the impeccable service. Thank you for an unforgettable meal!", Absolutely amazing experience from the service to the comfortable and pleasant decor and the food was top notch!!! Emma, Dich and Selina took really good care of us - excellent service and delicious food makes this place not only unforgettable but must go back again and again!!!we are currently staying at this amazing newly renovated hotel and the restaurant adds a perfect touch ❤️the menu is fantastic because it offers something for everyone like local food pasta pizza meats chicken many varieties makes it easy for everyone to enjoy - I tried the Vietnamese food at this restaurant and I was so impressed!!!!! The quality of the food the elegance of the place and great hospitality makes me feel like queen ☺️I will definitely return, The restaurant is very clean, with a welcoming atmosphere for everyone. The staff are highly professional, enthusiastic, and well-trained. I really enjoy the food here, especially the sushi and sashimi station, where the dishes are fresh and delicious.
description: "I had an exceptional dining experience at your restaurant on 20/10 Vietnamese women's day with my family. The ambiance was delightful, the staff were incredibly attentive, and the food was absolutely delicious. Each dish was crafted with great skill and presented beautifully. I was particularly impressed with the wine selection and the impeccable service. Thank you for an unforgettable meal!"

name: Mẹt Vietnamese Restaurant & Vegetarian Food 5
address: 110 P. Hàng Gai, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Outstanding service from Sullivan whose English is exceptional and who has a lovely, engaging character and gave us very good advice with the menu. (Only problem - he’s an Arsenal fan 🤪). Went for dinner and had lovely Vietnamese food of beef with black pepper, and duck with lemongrass and chilli which was delicious and spicy but not too hot. The morning glory (like spinach) with garlic was plentiful and lovely and fresh too. With rice for two, a glass of beer and a white wine the bill came in at a very reasonable 490,000 VND (around £15). Excellent evening., Authentic Vietnamese Food. I would say Hanoi does lack in places to go to but that is overcompensated by its food quality. Met stands outs particularly due to its cheap price while offering a large serving of food every last one a nice balance of lightness with veg and the richness of meat.Customer service is also exellent, my waiter Finn always checks on his customers regarding food quality and taking into the food serving size so you don’t order too much. This guy together with the rest of the waiters are incredibly friendly. Excellent, Met includes a professional but relaxed setting with a great atmosphere. We had the Pan Fried Chicken in Bamboo along with Banh Xeo (vietnamese Pancake) with each dish bringing fresh and delicious Vietnamese tastes. Food came within 10 minutes and it was a busy night. Our waiter Miles was very friendly and attentive; being helpful and informative about dishes and providing local knowledge. Thanks heaps Met, Highly recommend
description: Welcome to Mẹt Vietnamese restaurant ( Authentic Vietnamese Cuisine) Mẹt 5 is situated right on the central road of Hàng Gai – a street known for its stunning views of Hồ Gươm (Sword Lake) and just 300 meters away from the pedestrian street, surrounded by reputable souvenir shops and pottery stores in Hanoi. Mẹt N0.5 is fully prepared to cater to groups of up to 100 guests from various tour groups, with easy access for large-sized tourist buses. Mẹt Restaurant takes pride in being the first destination for foreign tourists to experience authentic Vietnamese cuisine. Its ambiance is a delightful blend of modernity and Hanoi's nostalgic charm, creating a warm and familiar space to enjoy Vietnamese delicacies.

name: Mẹt Vietnamese Restaurant & Vegetarian Met 4
address: 13 P. Hàng Bè, Hàng Bạc, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: We came for dinner after being recommended by a local hotelier. The restaurant was welcoming on arrival, with a varied menu. We ordered a selection of traditional dishes, and were pleasantly surprised with the quality, and quantity (for the price) Our Waiter, TUNA, offered expert advice on the best dishes to have, and then he took the time to make sure we knew how to correctly eat, and enjoy, the dishes (for example making pancakes/ spring rolls. If you visit ask for TUNA to serve you, great guy, very knowledgeable, and helpful, I was there with a friend and Ron did a great job introducing us to the Vietnamese food, including sharing with us where to get the nice mung bean cake which was served with the ginger tea. The restaurant is conveniently located and with extensive list of good food offerings. Price is really reasonable. We ordered a fried noodles, a special Vietnamese spring roll, a Claypot stew with rice, a vegetable and 2 drinks, total bill was about US$24. Will be back again if I’m back in Hanoi., Excellent dining experience in Hanoi at a very reasonable price. I took the grilled fish specialty and the waiter, Jinx, was very eager to show me how to eat it the proper way. The quality of the food and the combination of flavours were outstanding, this combined with a cosy place in the heart of the Old Quarter, with soft music in the background and lovely paintings on the walls. Highly recommended!
