We ordered a selection of traditional dishes, and were pleasantly surprised with the quality, and quantity (for the price)

Our Waiter, TUNA, offered expert advice on the best dishes to have, and then he took the time to make sure we knew how to correctly eat, and enjoy, the dishes (for example making pancakes/ spring rolls.

If you visit ask for TUNA to serve you, great guy, very knowledgeable, and helpful

name: Hello Hanoi Restaurant
address: 7B Dinh Liet Street, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: It was great to be able to go upstairs away from the crowds and traffic. We were greeted by Tu who was very helpful explaining the menu and showing me how to wrap the Lemongrass pork. Food was delicious. Thank you Tu for a great experience., This hidden bar has been one of the highlights of our trip to Hanoi. Tucked away near all the action, it’s the perfect spot to unwind and soak in the local atmosphere. From the moment we walked in, we felt so welcomed by the incredible staff. Viet, in particular, made every visit special—his friendly chats every night and thoughtful service truly added a personal touch. He’s an absolute gem and made us feel like part of the family. The food here is outstanding. We loved the Bún Chả and fried rice, but mainly the spring rolls a perfect companion to a a few drinks looking over the busy street A huge thankyou to Viet and the team for going above and beyond to make our trip so memorable. This place feels like a home away from home, and we’ll be recommending it to anyone visiting Hanoi., My husband and I came here because we were told by locals that there are many Vietnamese dishes prepared in a classic style. Coming here, I really like the atmosphere of the beautifully decorated restaurant, the open space on the 2nd floor overlooking the bustling neighborhood. My husband and I tried Vietnamese banh xeo, beef pho, and coconut coffee. The food is delicious, beautifully decorated and clean. The Vietnamese banh xeo was very large and we were instructed by the waiter how to wrap it in rice paper. We are very satisfied with our experience.
description: Small restaurant and cozy on 2nd floor of bussy street in hanoi old town, with delicius vietnamese and vegetarian food

name: Shining View Restaurant
address: 20 P. Lò Sũ, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews:
Thank you Anna for her recomendation She give us 25% discount for the diner and voucher add value 100.000 and for the present for promotion for dinner. Delectable dishes! Worth the wait cueing because of many customers. All the dishes we ordered satisfied us, made our tummy happy!, Had dinner at the Shining View Restaurant on the night we arrived. We opted for the prawn springroll and the duck. Meals were well portioned and flavorful. Presentation was also on point. The host Ky was accommodating and very helpful with making recommendations and understanding the ingredients of the dish… would definitely recommend., The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented, offering great value for money with reasonable portions. Felix, our server, provided exceptional service—friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable. The combination of delicious food, fair prices, and outstanding service makes this a must-visit. Highly recommended! Shining View Restaurant in Old Quarter Hanoi is lauded for its inviting ambiance, perfect for a relaxing dining experience. Guests have called out the fresh and flavorful dishes that artfully merge Vietnamese and international cuisines, served in generous portions.

Many visitors appreciate the restaurant's value, finding the combination of quality food and reasonable prices to be exceptional. Additionally, the service at Shining View earns rave reviews for its attentive and personable staff, who contribute to the overall positive dining experience.
description: Well-located in the very heart of the vibrant Old Quarter of Hanoi, also in the walking street Lo su , Shining View Restaurant is one of the best choices for Traditional Vietnamese ,european Food

name: The Alchemist Cocktail Bar
address: 25 Bat Su, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: I had a really lovely meal tonight at the Peace lounge. We had a big group of 20 hungry people, and Ben made sure that we where all happy with good food and drinks. The honey chicken was lovely. Would recomend. Thanks Ben!, Been to many bars/lounges in Hanoi and this one definitely stands out. The ambiance is awesome and the way the interior is designed is really cool. I usually sit upstairs with friends. Both their drinks and food are incredible. It has a perfect lounge setting with a very diverse playlist (for music). It's a great place to catch up for drinks and snacks with friends with light music playing in the background, definitely check it out. The best part is their service. The staff there are very professional, attentive, and accommodating. I will be going back for sure (been here 4 times and the service has been consistently perfect)., Lovely evening stop at the Alchemist. The service was attentive, the bartenders were talented, and the live jazz on Tuesday nights was a great surprise. Really delicious cocktails and a beautiful ambience. Worth a visit if you are in the Old Quarter!
description: An enthusiasm for cocktails. The Alchemist offers large range of classic cocktails created from various recipe (even old recipe in books). We evolve each day to make cocktail better. Please come and enjoy the atmosphere.

name: Luna D'Autunno - Italian Pizzeria & Restaurant
address: 27 P. Nam Ngư, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Excellent service, located upstairs and the welcome was delightful. They have recently re-opened and the food was great! Very reasonably priced (comparative to London) I would eat here again, their menu is limited to pizza and pasta, they have a good selection of starters. feedback : more desserts and more main dish varieties needed. Excellent service, We have to be honest, after weeks of Vietnamese food, we craved something different. We thoroughly enjoyed our meals here, all washed down with a lovely Italian rosato. We chose Pilchardus Crostino, Burrata Caprese, Saltimbocca alla Romana, Ravioli con Crema di Zucca e Zucchine and Tiramisu. All fresh, generous and delicious., Just WOW. Had carbonara and pesto pasta they were both absolutely amazing. Homemade, tasted fresh and cooked perfectly al dente. We paired it with Italian Pino griogio it was amazing. A nice little break from Vietnamese food. Really recommend was 10/10
description: LUNA is a reputable Italian restaurant located in the heart of Hanoi. Established in 1999, our restaurant places strong emphasis on using premium ingredients and preserving traditional Italian recipes. We especially pride ourselves for our renowned pizza and pasta. Our first floor also doubles as a shop for authentic Italian ingredients. Come and savor the tastes of Italy at LUNA!

name: New Day Restaurant
address: 72 Ma May Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: New Day Restaurant in Hanoi offers a fantastic dining experience with authentic Vietnamese flavors. The menu features a variety of delicious dishes at affordable prices, and the service is friendly and efficient. The cozy atmosphere adds to the overall charm, making it a great spot for both locals and tourists to enjoy traditional Vietnamese cuisine., We absolutely loved our food and are so glad we chose to eat here. Our food was beautiful and full of flavour, it was cooked to perfection. I had the sautéed beef with garlic, my partner had the roasted chicken with chilli and lemongrass and we shared some deep fried chicken spring rolls - easily the best meals we’ve had in the whole of Vietnam! Service was very quick and we felt so welcomed from the staff who were really friendly. The food was also a great price - costing just over £12 for our two meals, side, and two soft drinks! Definitely a place to visit when in Hanoi!, Our family came here on recommendation of a friend. We were glad that we came. You can order a là carte, fixed menu for one or two persons, or order dishes to eat family style. We opted for the last choice. This was easy since the dishes are prepared and on display. All we had to do was point at what we wanted. The dishes are typical Vietnamese family fares, ranging from vegetables to pork, chicken, beef, shrimp, fish etc. The staff even suggested we order less rather than more (a case of our eyes being bigger than our stomach.) Everything we ordered was excellent except the skewered pork which was tough. It was a fun meal. We were able to sample a good range of Vietnamese dishes without breaking the bank. The total bill, with drinks, was 1.1 million dong. This amount would not pay for a single dinner in Monterey, California or Frankfurt, Germany where I was just prior to this trip to Việt Nam.
description: New Day Restaurant in Hanoi offers a fantastic dining experience with authentic Vietnamese flavors. The menu features a variety of delicious dishes at affordable prices, and the service is friendly and efficient. The cozy atmosphere adds to the overall charm, making it a great spot for both locals and tourists to enjoy traditional Vietnamese cuisine.

name: Chao Ban Vietnamese Restaurant
address: 98 Đường Tô Ngọc Vân, Quảng An, Tây Hồ, Hà Nội, Tay Ho, Hanoi  100000 Vietnam
reviews: This is a warm restaurant experience. We (2 people) ordered four dishes, including a salad, 2 appetizers, and 1 main course. We were very satisfied with the meal👍, we could eat local dishes and the food was clean The comfortable environment allows you to chat and enjoy your meal, which is a comfortable experience. Although the price is on the high side compared to other restaurants, I think the experience the restaurant gave us is worth our time., This small restaurant barely seats 24 indoors and no more outdoors. Between taste, kindness, delicacy we could even have created a perfume. They actually made one, the scent of their cooking. The crab spring rolls may surprise you because the freshness of it gives them an extreme taste that we are not really used to but it really makes for a gourmet tasting. As for dishes, coconut prawns just hearing the name made me vomit, but I had the courage to take them... and what a SURPRISE Delicate, balanced, fragrant and iodized. Their duck with basil turned out to be very delicious. As an aperitif, their passion cocktail puts you in the atmosphere. We do not regret our choice, and thank you to Michelin for having inspected them and allowing us to taste this beautiful address. To be continued, A must-try! I got a patio seat at Chao Ban not too long after sunset and they have a very warm and relaxing atmosphere. Service was quick and super friendly. I was even provided with bug spray when my kind server noticed I scored a giant mosquito bite on my forehead :) Everything was cooked to perfection and full of flavour. Highly recommended, many thanks!
description: RELOCATION - NEW ADRESS - REOPENING ON 1/5/2025. Welcome to Chao Ban Vietnamese Restaurant, In our new house, we propose to you a traditional and contemporary Vietnamese cuisine of the highest quality prepared by Ms. Hang, former Chef of one of the most reputated Hanoi's restaurant. In Vietnamese, "Chào Bạn" means "Hello, my friend!". It is with that spirit that we have the pleasure of welcoming and serving you in an atmosphere of great conviviality.

name: The Little Hanoi
address: 21 Hang Gai Street Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Found this place on our way home from JazzDocks. Large and hoping restaurant and we could quickly see why. Food came out quickly and service was pleasant. We've eaten our share of Vietnamese and this was quite good ...with the exception of a far too greasy spring roll. Really enjoyed the Pho on the cold, grey day. Reasonably priced and near the mall if you need one., We went to the restaurant on the back of The Hotel recommendation and the Trip advisor recommendation on the outside of the Restaurant. It was ok. Perhaps it was because it was lunch...we were the only customers and the atmosphere was quiet. But the food was ok...just not much to write about as different. The service was again ok...nothing special and the staff were a bit stand offish. So the experience was all ok...but not one that I would have expected given the Hotel recommendation the Trip Advisor signage., 該当の住所にはコンビニみたいなものが入っており、店はありません。 すぐ傍の観光案内所に確認すると 「12 Tạ Hiện, Hàng Buồm, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, ベトナム」（屋台街のあたり） に移転したと教えてもらったのですが、 その場所には同名の違う店が2件ありました。残念。 Probably 'LITTLE HANOI' closed, we couldn't reach there.
description:
Found this place on our way home from JazzDocks.  Large and hoping restaurant and we could quickly see why.  Food came out quickly and service was pleasant.  We've eaten our share of Vietnamese and this was quite good ...with the exception of a far too greasy spring roll.

Really enjoyed the Pho on the cold, grey day.  

Reasonably priced and near the mall if you need one.

name: Muoi Tieu - Salt n' Pepper Kitchen
address: 90A P. Hai Bà Trưng Trần Hưng Đạo, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: I visited here on a Friday afternoon with some colleagues who had thankfully booked a table. It was busy and a nice blend of locals and westerners. We sat outside on the balcony and I loved the view with the lanterns across the road and the old style French building opposite with green shutters. I enjoyed my main of Moroccan style chicken with couscous and salad, good portion size, well presented and tasty., Food was so good here we went twice. We had the shrimp sliders to start on our first visit and then I had the harissa chicken and my partner had the wagyu cheeseburger. The Harrisa chicken was delicious and just what I wanted but on our second visit we both had the cheeseburger and agreed it was one of the best burgers we have ever had. Would highly recommend., Found this place not more than a short stroll from our accommodation. Now being an Aussie traveller I appreciated the Aussie influence in the menu and settled on the Wagyu beef burger……. It didn’t disappoint. Great atmosphere, great wait staff.
description: Located on the second floor of an old French style villa in Hanoi, with relaxing both indoor & outdoor seats. Our menu is inspired by Australian brunch culture from a chef who lived in Sydney for over 10 years. We aim to develop the healthy lifestyle through our food for the local and to be uptrend with the world

name: Quan An Ngon
address: 25T2 Hoang Dao Thuy Street 1st floor, 25T2 Building, Hanoi 084 Vietnam
reviews: We arrived around 12:30 on a weekday. There were seats available outside, but we had to wait about 15 minutes if we wanted to sit inside. It was so hot that it was uncomfortable to sit outside, so we waited about 15 minutes and were shown to a seat inside. It was like an open kitchen, so it was interesting to watch while we waited. What I learned at this restaurant: When I looked at the receipt after paying, the charge for the wet towel was included. In Vietnam, if you use a wet towel with the restaurant's name on it, you are charged for the wet towel. For the dish, we had the restaurant's specialty, Banh Xeo. It was an extra-large Banh Xeo, and the staff cut it for us with scissors when they brought it to us. I ordered it because I wanted to try Bun Cha, a Hanoi specialty. Banh Xeo 155,000VND Bun Cha 75,000VND Bia Hanoi 38,000VND Fresh pineapple juice 45,000VND Wet towel 2,000VND Total for two people 391,720VND (2,355 yen) Credit card, We ate in this Michelin Guide listed restaurant on our last visit to Hanoi, some years ago, and loved it. The restaurant is located in a lovely old colonial house, and has a wide ranging menu of excellently prepared authentic Vietnamese food. We chose one of their specials: - Bánh xèo tôm thịt: Vietnamese fried pancake with shrimp & pork The waiter chopped up the pancake with scissors and showed us how to roll it into the rice paper skin. We also had: • ﻿﻿Bánh cuốn nhân tôm: Steamed shrimp & minced pork rice flour roll • ﻿﻿Ngọn su su xào tỏi: Stir-fried chayote buds with garlic All the dishes were really good and full of flavour. Very delicious! Service was efficient and friendly. We will be back! (Also posted to my food blog on Instagram @AbbeyKing16), I ate banh xeo and fresh spring rolls. The banh xeo was delicious, but the portion was so large that I couldn't finish it all by myself. Also, I didn't really care about how to eat it and just ate it, but the staff at the store probably thought it was funny and taught me to wrap the contents in a leaf and eat it. (Thank you)

There were seats available outside, but we had to wait about 15 minutes if we wanted to sit inside.

name: Madam Tran Restaurant
address: 42 Đào Duy Từ St. Hàng Buồm, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Anna A tourist restaurant in the downtown area of Hanoi's Old Quarter. The prices are a little high, but you can enjoy a full range of famous Vietnamese and Hanoi dishes in a clean indoor environment. The food is not bad either. There are many Western tourists, and the staff can speak English, so I recommend it!, Madam Tran Restaurant in Vietnam offers a delightful dining experience with a focus on traditional Vietnamese cuisine. The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, making it a great place for both locals and tourists. The menu features a wide variety of flavorful dishes, including fresh seafood, pho, and vibrant salads, all prepared with high-quality ingredients. The service is attentive and friendly, enhancing the overall experience. Prices are reasonable for the quality of food, making it a must-visit spot for anyone looking to enjoy authentic Vietnamese flavors., I cannot recommend this place enough, Tran and her team work so hard to ensure you receive the best food you will ever taste in Vietnam! Their vegetarian menu is superb and even tho at home I do eat meat. You do not need to here. I loved all the flavours and the delicious salads which accompanied them. This is not a place to miss!
description: Located in the heart of Hanoi Old Quarter, Madam Tran Restaurant Offers the Authentic & the best of traditional Vietnamese of both Vegetarian and original cuisines international. Our menu offers a wide range of meals, from traditional countryside dishes to western inspired, all at a very affordable price. Our skilled kitchen team sources only the freshest and finest ingredients to guarantee the high standard ...etc. we also organize the daily cooking class which is really amazing performed by the Master Chefs at the private culture space. The restaurant has opened the Vietnamese Cuisine Cooking Class to invite our guests to discover how authentic Vietnamese food is cooked for themselves.Cooking is a valuable way to experience and immerse yourself into Vietnamese life, since so much Vietnamese culture is based around food.

name: Cugini - Ristorante Italiano
address: 67 To Ngoc Van, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Authentic Italian cuisine executed with a touch of innovation that makes it excellent. Carefully selected and high quality raw materials. You can enjoy first and second courses and also a tasty pizza well leavened. Particular note for the choice of cold cuts. Excellent selection of wines by the glass. All in a truly attractive location, where they have been able to combine oriental charm with Italian elegance. Three-storey building in the city center with very romantic tree-lined terrace and tables inside with air conditioning. Owner, as well as chef, welcoming and available to entertain customers with grace and discretion. Service and staff adequate to what is written in the room. Top top top!!, At Cugini the décor and ambiance immediately suggests that the meal will be a little special. It doesn't disappoint and an almost full house doesn’t lie. The white wine arrives promptly in a cooler without having to ask. The starters are presented artfully with thick slices of beef for the carpaccio with rocket garnish and a perfectly soft burrata. For mains the linguine di mare was cooked just as we requested (not al dente). The sea bass (brazino scottato) was superb with contrasting textures of crisp skin and white meat with a delicate sauce. The owner, Nico, made time to chat: such attention is always appreciated. His recommendation of grappa with panna cotta made a wonderful finish to the meal. We hear the menu will shortly be changing: we will certainly be back to try some of the new dishes or daily specials., Cugini is one of the finest Italian restaurants in Vietnam, hands down, if not Southeast Asia. Chef Nico continually amazes me with high-end casual fare that genuinely has heart and soul. I don't know where to start with respect to recommendations. I keep coming back for a katsu sandwich and was extremely impressed to see that Chef Nico had developed a suite of eight take-away sandwiches during the pandemic. Dining in is always a treat, especially sitting outside on the second level with a glass (or bottle) of Donnafugata. I can't say enough good things about Cugini. Try it, you'll thank me later.
description: A Chef's bistro with modern Italian cuisine. And wood fired pizza!

name: Huong Viet
address: 13 Hang Ca Street, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Best local food in Hanoi Old Quarters. Family own small restaurant, lovely service. Thank you so much 💓 one of the ladies recommended a type of pho and it was delicious! We had traditional pho, stewed beef pho, fried tofu and beef, and papaya salad ❤️, Delicious food. Crispy fresh spring rolls and steamed rice with pork and beef. Lots of vegetables, everything fresh and very affordable. Nice service, which (unlike in some other places) is also friendly to each other., This family-run business provides the flavours expected for Vietnamese dishes. We tried their stew and grilled pork, and both were amazing. The servers understood both English and Vietnamese and made sure we were welcome. This building is down the same street as the trendy restraunt so that it may be missed. Also have a lot of other attractions nearby.
description: Best local food in Hanoi Old Quarters. Family own small restaurant,  lovely service. Thank you so much 💓 one of the ladies recommended a type of pho and it was delicious! We had traditional pho, stewed beef pho, fried tofu and beef, and papaya salad ❤️

name: Hue Restaurant
address: 36 1, Dao Tan St., Ba Dinh Dist., Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Good good and service My Supervisor arrived Vietnam from Japan for interview JDS scholarship. I booked a room at this restaurant last Wednesday for 9 guests. Despite of pretty steep price (~400,000 - 500,000 each) this fancy restaurant serves the yummy food and good service. I will be back again. Recommend!, Having tried all Hue restaurants in Hanoi, this is the one that we love the most. The dishes are flavourful and carefully prepared. Restaurants managers are attentive and considerate. Staff are quick and helpful. Location is also convenient to access Suitable for family with small kids as well. My daughter loves the rice steamed jn lotus leaf a lot., We ate here twice during a recent visit to Hà Nội and loved the food - fresh and quickly delivered. The restaurant itself is OK but almost has a bit of a fast food feel about it rather than being a fine dining establishment - but if you love food from the Hue region I can highly recommend
description:
Good good and service 

My Supervisor arrived Vietnam from Japan for interview JDS scholarship. 
I booked a room at this restaurant last Wednesday for 9 guests. Despite of pretty steep price (~400,000 - 500,000 each) this fancy restaurant serves the yummy food and good service. 
I will be back again. Recommend!

name: Lach Ca Lach Cach Lotte Mall West Lake
address: 272 Võ Chí Công, Quận Tây Hồ, Hà Nội Tầng 4, Lotte Mall Tây Hồ, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: I rarely review, but this restaurant is worth spending some time writing a few lines. The meat is tender, well-prepared, and there are some strange but delicious dishes! Cozy space, friendly staff. Reasonable prices, 3 people ordering 4 dishes for only about 500k. Will definitely come back to try the whole menu! ..., The first impression is that the restaurant is super spacious and the decor is cozy and traditional Vietnamese style. The banh xeo is delicious, the cake batter is fragrant and the filling is also full. The music is soft, suitable for sitting and relaxing, chatting, and sipping. The staff is enthusiastic but no upsale 🙂, I've been to this restaurant many times, and I'm always satisfied. The food is fresh, whether it's hotpot or crispy fried dishes. My favorite is the bánh xèo—perfectly crispy but not dry. The staff is friendly and attentive!
description: "Lách Ca Lách Cách" – Thanh âm thân thuộc từ chạn bát trong căn bếp xưa, khi bát đũa chạm nhau cùng ngân vang. Đó là cảm giác gần gũi, gợi nhớ những bữa cơm gia đình sum vầy. Lấy cảm hứng từ âm sắc giản dị này, nhà hàng Lách Ca Lách Cách ra đời, mang đến cho thực khách những món ăn Việt Nam truyền thống đậm đà hương vị ba miền. Lách Ca Lách Cách mang đến tinh hoa ẩm thực Việt, kết hợp không gian hoài cổ và hương vị nguyên bản. Sứ mệnh của nhà hàng là bảo tồn và lan tỏa giá trị ẩm thực truyền thống, đồng thời khơi nguồn kết nối gần gũi, chân thành qua không gian ấm áp, xen lẫn nét chấm phá đương đại. Mỗi món ăn là một mảnh ghép gọi nhớ về ký ức tuổi thơ, hương vị quê hương và những khoảnh khắc sum vầy. Đó là câu chuyện văn hóa được kể qua từng hương vị mộc mạc, đậm đà bản sắc vùng miền.

name: d'Lions Restaurant
address: 92 Le Duan Hoan Kiem District, 1st & 8th floor, Cosiana Hotel, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: This is centrally located, halal certified place. The beef- pepper pan fried dish was simply delicious, also the Vietnamese soup noodles with fish. It’s a quiet and clean place. Affordable, lunch for 4, ordered 4 main dishes cost us INR 2600. The servings were generous., My friends and I decided to visit this restaurant as one of my friends is muslim. Generally, it is very difficult to find halal vietnamese food in Hanoi. The other cuisines would be mainly Indian, Pakistani or Turkish food which is commonly halal. The restaurant offer a mixture of Vietnamese, Singaporean and Western dishes. The prices are decent, starting from 100,000 VND ++. The restaurant also offers a hotpot option for chicken or seafood, but one has to make a reservation and to pay in advance. It will be great if the restaurant could offer more vietnamese dishes. Overall, it was a decent experience., I ate the foods and it was really good. The taste is soo vietnamese. I recommenc to try "The shrimp spring rolls", "Tofu with three mushroom", "Pineapple fried rice" I forgot the name 😂 because it's written with Vietnam Language, so I forget. And the service also really good all of them always put smile and also take care of me and my sister well. The place also good, and cozy. Plus this is a halal restaurant. It's really recommended restaurant for moeslims traveler.
description: This restaurant in Hanoi Waking up in the morning, guests will have international breakfast buffet. Situated on the ground floor of Cosiana hotel, with d'Lions Restaurant impresses diners with a warm space and an interesting view to Hanoi station.

name: Moo Beef Steak
address: 59A Tran Quoc Toan, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Steak was great, salad appetizer was great, bread as well great. Timing on when things arrived and how hot things were was a little off - one side was scalding hot on arrival. Drink menu is limited unless you’re ordering bottle service. The cocktail I ordered was mediocre. I would come back and focus on ordering bread, salad, and steak., Beautiful, sophisticated restaurant with really delicious dishes. I tried their rib eye steak with pepper source, potato gratin, salad, bread with pate and cheese today. I was delighted the moment I put the juicy piece of steak i to my mouth, so succulent. My beverage was passion fruit juice and dont know why (out of hospitality?) the waitress suddenly served me a dish of cameramen with passion fruit gelatin on top - it was On the House. I had a wonderful time at MBS. Lovely atmosphere, friendly staff, top notch service from the very moment a guard politely told me he would take care of my motorcycle, to the moment I left the place. Highly recommend MBS for steak lover ☺️, I am big fan of steak! I knew this restaurant chain for long time ago but never try before! So decided give them a try! +Positive: good quality of steak for the money you pay for. 50% off for monday +negative: poor chef +Sauce: i ordered foiegrass & bluecheese Bluecheese sauce 6 Foiegrass sauce 3 completely tasteless Cooking temperature medium however the fat on the ribeye is not grill enough. +atmosphere: negative Too bright for a steakhouse not cozy at all No music make it worst. Should i come back!? Yes & No Yes i will try another outlet where they might have better atmosphere No i will not come back to this place if they dont change the light :) Thanks
description: Steak was great, salad appetizer was great, bread as well great. Timing on when things arrived and how hot things were was a little off - one side was scalding hot on arrival. Drink menu is limited unless you’re ordering bottle service. The cocktail I ordered was mediocre. I would come back and focus on ordering bread, salad, and steak.

name: Cloud Nine Restaurant
address: 27 Hang Be La Siesta Premium Hang Be, Old Quarter, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Sometimes you book a restaurant and think: "I hope it's as good as in the reviews". And then it gets even better. Immediately after reservation it will be confirmed by email and WhatsApp. Asking if there is a special occasion and before you know it you are sitting at a stylishly decorated table and you get a personalized dessert. With in-between dishes you dream of what they will be like when you order them. In a special setting and a wonderful service that does everything to make it your own. You can finish on the rooftop bar with a 360° view of Hanoi. 4 courses a la carte with drinks for no 50 euros pp.... Cloud Nine is literally and figuratively really of a high standard., We stayed at La Siesta Premium Hang Be for four nights and had breakfast each morning at the Cloud 9 restaurant. In addition we had dinner there several times ( it was so good, why not?) . The servers were informative but not obtrusive and the food quality, presentation and service were outstanding. Hanoi was our last stop in Vietnam and we had excellent food throughout but Cloud 9 was just the perfect combination for us. Highly recommend whether you are staying at the hotel or not., What a lovely evening we spent here! Cloud Nine was a haven of civilised comfort in the rather busy (frantic) streets of Hanoi's old quarter. The restaurant is a plush, pleasant and well-decorated space with a good view and good service; it feels quite swish. I would say you are paying for the setting and the excellent service more than for the food, which was very nicely presented but, in terms of flavour, pleasant rather than delicious. That’s not a criticism, though – there was nothing wrong with it, we greatly enjoyed our meal, and we felt it was good value for money. We will most likely never return to Hanoi, but if we did, we’d probably go back to Cloud Nine.
description: To be on Cloud Nine is to be in a blissful state of happiness. A number of conflicting theories abound as to the origins of this phrase. One of the most popular attributes it to the fluffy white cumulonimbus. This is the ninth cloud out of ten types first identified in the 1896 International Cloud Atlas which rises as high as a cloud can go, hence the sense of being ‘on top of the world’.

name: Oven D'or Restaurant
address: 11 Xuan Dieu K5 Nghi Tam, Tay Ho, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: I had an amazing experience at Oven D'or! The variety of dishes was incredible, with something to suit every taste. From fresh seafood to beautifully prepared meats and a wide range of salads and desserts, everything was delicious and of high quality. The staff (Ms. Ngan) was attentive and friendly, always making sure our table was clean and take really nice photos. The atmosphere was lively yet comfortable, making it a perfect spot for both family gatherings and casual dining. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for great food and excellent service!, Sauce, baked salmon, sauce salmon world's best 👍 The clean taste calmed my mind on the cold spring days of Hanoi. The chefs and waitresses were very friendly and introduced to the culinary characteristics of Vietnam. Chicken salad is delicious, so I ate 3 dishes. Good food. I'll be back next month., All the food today is delicious and delicious We were very satisfied with today's meal, especially the seafood dish at the seafood counter and the lobster dish served at the table.... You guys served very well. Sang and Ngoc
description: Oven D'or Restaurant serves up an intriguing blend of international buffet and à la carte menu either breakfast, lunch, brunch or dinner. Explore a buffet feast of premium seafood, grill, fresh sushi, sashimi and much more delicious dishes awaiting.

name: Bellissimo Restaurant
address: 195 - 199 Hang Bong Street (g Floor, Silk Path Hotel Hanoi), Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: We almost couldn’t find this place as didn’t realise it is located inside the Silk Path hotel. Lovely restaurant - immaculate and very friendly staff. The menu offers Italian choices and also Vietnamese at very reasonable prices. I would recommend the pasta and lasagne but the pizzas also looked amazing! Definitely worth a visit., My family of 3 came to have dinner at Bellissimo's house, a restaurant located inside the Silk Path hotel. Quiet space, we ordered pizza and grilled salmon. I feel like the food is delicious, pizza is easy to eat with a lot of cheese. Enthusiastic staff, attentive service. Thank you Thuy Nguyen for your enthusiastic advice and service to my family., I had dinner at the restaurant. Eat pizza and drink egg coffee, the restaurant's food is very delicious and delicious. Especially the restaurant staff is very enthusiastic, thank you Duy Luong for supporting me a lot... The restaurant is a suitable place for people to choose dinner on the Old Quarter. Very happy and hope to see Bellissimo again one day soon. Thank!
description: Bellissimo Restaurant takes gourmets on a journey to the Beauty of Vietnamese Cuisine with authentic flavours, and also delightfully offers one of the freshest pizzas in town!

name: Ngon Garden
address: 70 Nguyen Du Hai Ba Trung, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant is in a very welcoming landscaped garden. Myriads of mini light garlands fall from the trees making it a magical place. The entrance path was lined with hundreds of branches of white lilies (about 20 meters) one or even 2 meters high. Efficient and welcoming service. The dishes tested were excellent but relatively expensive. The wipes given for washing hands were chargeable and the restaurant does not have cold water, although this exists everywhere in Vietnam. The bottles are on the table and you have to ask for ice. Despite this, it is a must where you will have an excellent evening, My DIL booked this beautiful restaurant for our two families to enjoy a great meal. We had a private room to dine and thus we could have a great time to chit chat while we enjoyed the excellently cooked meal. The food we ordered was typical Vietnamese fare and cooked to perfection. The boiled chicken was great, so did the beef cubes. In fact all the dishes were great. My DIL's sister also order a piece of steak to share and they loved it. The waiting staff was very attentive and always ready when called. Dining in the clean and well apportioned room, with attentive staff was a great pleasure. Thank you Ngon Garden for a super meal., Went for a late lunch. In a lake , the restaurant is big enough with inside and outdoors sitting.I had a bum cha , the traditional grilled pork meat with rice and some veggies. The portion was good enough. Initially they said they were closed at 2 PM but after consulting the kitchen , they let me in. As it was very hot I asked for an inner seat although the doors are wide open.It is a good garden but they brought me a big fan to refresh, what was very appreciated. Good servicing! After serving the food, they saw I didn't know how to eat , the waitress came to get the pork meat from the grilling sticks. They have a good assortment of vietnamese food. I recommend for a meal.
description: Ngon Garden is the new line of Quan An Ngon. Garden is a all-day-dining restaurants with 540 seats, serving both traditional and modern Vietnamese Cuisine. Located in the heart of Hanoi near Thien Quang Lake with area up to 2.500m2, Ngon Garden is a great venue for Vietnamese and foreigners to enjoy the cuisine throughout Vietnam, with Indochine style, reminding people of the beautiful Hanoi. We have 3000m2 tropical garden in the center of Hanoi. 300+ Vietnamese dishes. Lake view and elegeant taste.

name: Moonlight Sky Bar
address: 94 P. Mã Mây, Street, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Lovely bar, good views and wonderful team. I was staying at the hotel and went up to see the bar before dinner. It was such a nice vibe. The team was wonderful, instead of going down to the restaurant or ordering from the bar menu which was mainly snacks, they brought the restaurant menu to me so i didn't have to go down to eat. I had my dinner upstairs with good music, amazing views and good conversations with dear Long. He was so nice to talk to, it was so refreshing 😌 can't wait to come back 🍸, An ideal place for couples to date on autumn weekends. The space is very airy and spacious, with many cocktails at reasonable prices and suitable for young people coming here for dates. Hoang Le takes care of us very carefully and thoughtfully, First impression at Moonlight I found out about this restaurant through a friend's recommendation and tried it out I ordered Old Quater and my friend ordered a special cocktail, both of which were quite good and especially the attitude and customer care at the restaurant were very attentive, even though it was a skybar and the day I arrived it was quite rainy, but from the moment of reception outside the door, He took me to the counter to sit and place my order. He always took care of me and asked if I needed any further help
description: Moonlight, meaning ‘by the light of the moon’, is the 4th and most ambitious of the La Siesta sky bars. Glass, metal and wood complement a monochromatic color palette of black, grey and hints of cream creating an Indochina feeling. 360-degree views circle Hanoi across Hoan Kiem Lake, the Red River and the Old Quarter rooftops.

name: Railway Cafe
address: Số 5, 112 Chắn Tàu, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Railway Tuan Café is an exceptional place that combines a warm atmosphere with unique décor. Ideally located near the rails, it offers a memorable experience, mixing train charm with a friendly atmosphere. The service is impeccable, with friendly and attentive staff. The dishes, expertly prepared, delight taste buds with fresh ingredients and authentic flavors. The café also stands out for its delicious drinks, ideal for a relaxing break or a gathering with friends. In short, Railway Tuan Café is a must-see destination for lovers of good food and pleasant moments., This place was great. As recommended by our hotel, we WhatsApp messaged the owner to align our visit with the train passing through. Awesome service, cocktails and food. We stayed for a few hours and had a great time. Definitely recommend visiting and chilling as the train come round. Great vantage point also., We had a blast here. We stopped because there was no employee flagging us down and asking us to eat there. Had a smoothie, mojito, and coffee while hanging out there - all very good and reasonably priced. The waiter, Khang, was hilarious and we enjoyed chatting with him. We saw 3 trains and could have stayed for more.
description: Railway Tuan Café is an exceptional place that combines a warm atmosphere with unique décor. Ideally located near the rails, it offers a memorable experience, mixing train charm with a friendly atmosphere. The service is impeccable, with friendly and attentive staff. The dishes, expertly prepared, delight taste buds with fresh ingredients and authentic flavors. The café also stands out for its delicious drinks, ideal for a relaxing break or a gathering with friends. In short, Railway Tuan Café is a must-see destination for lovers of good food and pleasant moments.

name: Cha Ca Anh Vu
address: 116k1 Giang Vo, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: What an excellent find. We read about this on the net, and it was a short walk from our hotel. There was a young waiter who spoke good English, and assisted us in demonstrating what to do with all the ingredients. Which is - heat the fish, add the greens, mix it up in the pan. Take some vermicelli, put the fish/greens on top, add some fried onions, mint, peanuts.. and what a perfect meal. Definitely worth a visit. Very economical, and excellent service; even thugh we don't speak Vietnamese., The owner is friendly and you should definitely try it at least once! My dad hates new foods and hates salted fish, but he ate it quite well! The fish porridge is not too strong and tastes like mung bean porridge, so you will enjoy it!!, Found this place from a few reviews plus tour guide recommendation. Seats readily available. There were more local customers streaming in after so maybe we were just lucky. The menu was not in English but nothing a Translate app can’t overcome. Staff were friendly and they helped with some of the cooking, the “way” to eat. Overall it was a great experience.
description:
What an excellent find. We read about this on the net, and it was a short walk from our hotel. There was a young waiter who spoke good English, and assisted us in demonstrating what to do with all the ingredients. 

Which is - heat the fish, add the greens, mix it up in the pan. Take some vermicelli,  put the fish/greens on top, add some fried onions, mint, peanuts.. and what a perfect meal. 

Definitely worth a visit. Very economical, and excellent service; even thugh we don't speak Vietnamese.

name: Comida Hanoi Restaurant & Café
address: 52B Luong Ngoc Quyen, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Incredible dinner. We just had a wonderful dinner at the Comida Hanoi. I chose the restaurant because if it had 5 stars Google reviews. It certainly earns it. The nice thing is that it also has a good air condition/fan inside the restaurant so they’re not sweltering eating on the street. Also, for those of us who are wary of eating street food where the vendors wash their dishes and bowls on the street this was a much safer bet. Our hostess Katy has excellent English speaking skills. We highly recommend the Bun cha (braised pork on a lemongrass skewer with pork meatballs, rice, noodles, basil, and lettuce in a delicious broth). We also highly recommend the Banh Xeo,(Vietnamese crêpe with shrimp and pork, wrapped in rice paper.) Katy even demonstrated for us how to properly wrap the crêpe. Finally, the cocktails were creative. I had the Milky Way, which was made with Peaberry tea. The peaberry tea doesn’t really have a flavor, but it has this gorgeous purple coloring., It was very delicious. Be sure to try the grilled fish, which you then put in summer rolls. This is a typical dish in Hanoi and was recommended to us by the very hospitable Kathy. Also she could give us some tips for vietnam as far as food is concerned and recommended us aucz where we can still get delicious local desserts. Even if the prices are more expensive, I can only recommend this restaurant. Food was extremely delicious, tonight it was quiet here which was good after a busy day and the service was very accommodating and the service very friendly. Hence also 5 out of 5 stars., Amazing new restaurant in the old quarter of Hanoi. Lovely waitress Katy recommended a delicious fish dish and showed us how to make the perfect rice paper roll. Very clean and gorgeous decor. Just a few steps away from the hustle and bustle of the city. Would 100% recommend to anyone visiting. Everything was so fresh and tasty ☺️
description: First of all, Comida Hanoi Restaurant would like to extend our warmest greetings to you and your esteemed company! Comida is a restaurant that is well-suited for a diverse clientele, including European, Asian, American, Japanese, and Korean guests, due to its unique concept and exceptional menu featuring fresh ingredients and refined preparation that showcase the distinct identity of Comida. Comida Hanoi Restaurant is located in the heart of the ancient Old Quarter of Hanoi, a city with a thousand years of history.The interior design of Comida combines classic and modern styles, creating a luxurious, elegant, and aesthetically pleasing space. The warm colors of the restaurant provide a memorable first impression as you step into Comida Hanoi. With a dedicated, enthusiastic, and creative team, Comida Hanoi is confident in our ability to provide excellent service and deliver wonderful culinary experiences for your guests.

name: MAY TRE DAN Restaurant
address: 151-153 Hàng Bông Meritel Hanoi, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant is located in a prime location on a busy street, a top destination for tourists. The space and design inside the restaurant is very luxurious and creates a cozy feeling. The service staff is very enthusiastic, and the food and drink menu is delicious. The important thing is that the price is reasonable compared to locations for foreign tourists. I really enjoyed it and will definitely come back., Wow. This is a new (not one year old) restaurant within the Meritel Hotel in the Old Quarter. It was superb. We were welcomed and made to feel at home even though we were staying at a neighbouring hotel. The service throughout was a delightful mix of the friendly, the personal and the efficiently informative. The food was always of a high quality but the seafood spring rolls were probably the best single dish I have eaten in many visits to Vietnam. The Tempura Vegetables were a delicious accompaniment to both my wife's chicken dish and my belly pork - a common dish elevated by one or two very clever and tasty little twists. There was a generous portion of complimentary prawn crackers with sauces whilst waiting and the drinks menu was very fairly priced. Overall the experience was remarkable, not least for the total quality of surroundings, service and cuisine provided at such an affordable price., had the opportunity to enjoy dinner at this Vietnamese restaurant within the hotel, and I was truly impressed. The cozy atmosphere creates a relaxing feeling as soon as you step inside. The menu is diverse with traditional dishes full of rich flavors. I tried pho with beef and fried spring rolls, both perfectly prepared, maintaining the distinctive taste of Vietnamese cuisine. The pho broth was clear and fragrant, the beef tender, and the noodles just the right texture. The service was professional, with attentive and helpful staff always ready to assist. The prices are reasonable for the quality and elegant setting of the restaurant. In short, this is an ideal place to enjoy Vietnamese cuisine in a sophisticated environment. I will definitely return! 5 stars!
description: Named and inspired by a traditional culture with a history of development spanning nearly 400 years, at Mây Tre Đan restaurant, we are not just a place to savor cuisine, but a journey deep into the heritage of each region in Vietnam. Here, every detail, every dish tells intriguing stories and ignites curiosity about the diverse culture of the S-shaped country. Ultimately, it is a hopeful aspiration for the beautiful cultural essence of Vietnam to leave a lasting impression on international travelers. Where flavors and traditions blend to create a unique cultural experience.

name: Sachiko Japanese Restaurant
address: 54 Luong Van Caan Hang Gai, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Here you will find an authentic sushi selection including local specials. High quality fish, at prices that can be classified as low by international standards. In the area probably also the most beautiful baths, Called in to this restaurant after some very disappointing hanoi sushi experiences, and we are so glad to have done so. If I was solely scoring the sushi, it would be 10 stars. We sat on the balcony and watched the mayhem unfold beneath us, and this is probably why my review is 4-star. We were a little "out of sight out of mind" and had to seek service a number of times, whilst one dish appeared to have been forgotten about entirely. However, that aside, the sushi we did get served was simply sublime. I've eaten a lot of sushi in my time, and for the first time ever, I ordered fatty tuna imported from Japan, and boy, was it worth the price. The tuna simply tantilised the palate before melting away with hardly a need to chew. The salmon and eel were very discernible in each piece of maki and futamaki, which supprisingly isn't always the case. We thoroughly enjoyed the meal, so much so that we are returning next week for our final meal prior to leaving Vietnam, and I don't mean to be to hard on the service as I'm sure the servers will redeem themselves., Do not miss this restaurant between the busy stands and traffic of the Old Quarter! The multiple floors were a bit startling at first but we quickly grew to appreciate it as the room felt cosy and fun once we sat down. The menu has a variety of sashimi, savoury sushi rolls, crispy tempura and noodles which we decided to share instead of ordering our own mains. There was something for everyone to try and every dish caused a little quarrel over the last piece! The waitresses were very attentive, helpful and kind, checking in on us every so often. At the end of our dining, they were very keen to know our honest feedback and about our experience as they had just recently opened after Covid. Please do go visit this lovely place, you are in for a treat!
description: SACHIKO, the Japanese restaurant has one of the most beautiful views to Hanoi old quarter and is the ideal rendezvous. Located in 54 Luong Van Can, Hoan Kiem District), our topmost gourmet food style is a must-known get-together place of food lovers. It would be the perfect recommendation for giving Japanese’s culinary delights a try and drowning in Japanese subcultures in the middle of Hanoi. We have many private areas, from cozy to spacious area, esteemed guests can comfortably enjoy homey meals with family or relaxing with friends or business partners. SACHIKO has a diverse menu with many types of Japanese food. Our restaurant is renowned not only for its sashimi, sushi, gunkan from the fresh source of ingredients but also for famous Japanese ramen such as udon, soba,... and rice sets. Besides, grilled or barbeque is a must - try with a cup of SAPPORO Beer or sake. Furthermore, we confidently have the most affordable price that you can't find in anywhere else.

name: Pho Suong
address: 24B Trung Yen Lane Dinh Liet, Hang Bac, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Best Tai Tien and a wonderful local spot. We each got some of the fried dough and let it soak in our soup - delicious. We were the only foreigners present and the locals seemed just as happy with their food. Highly recommend., Don't let the minimalist facility scare you off. The staff was friendly and helpful and the Pho was amazing! The family is said to have been making broth for generations and it shows. With subtle cinnamon and star anise flavors, the broth itself was worth coming for. We tried the headlining Beef Pho at a rediculous $3 USD. Adding the pickled garlic and chile peppers found on the table took the dish to a whole new level. This is can't miss!, Nearly walked past this place as the eating area is across the narrow alley from the cooking. Superb, well flavoured broth, nicely cooked noodles and huge quantities of mixed beef all for 80k. Not the cheapest but amongst the best hanoi has to offer.
description:
Best Tai Tien and a wonderful local spot. We each got some of the fried dough and let it soak in our soup - delicious. 

We were the only foreigners present and the locals seemed just as happy with their food. Highly recommend.

name: Pho 10
address: 10 Ly Quoc Su Street Corner of Chan Cam St, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: My recent visit to Pho 10 restaurant in Hanoi was simply phenomenal! As a fan of Vietnamese cuisine, I was expecting delicious pho soup, but what I found exceeded all my expectations. The undisputed star of this restaurant is the pho broth, and it is simply divine. It is perfectly balanced, neither too fatty, nor too sweet, nor too salty. Each spoonful was a feast for the taste buds, and I was impressed with the quality of this broth. The service at Pho 10 was also top notch. The staff was attentive, friendly and willing to answer any questions we had about the menu. They knew how to create a warm atmosphere which added to our gastronomic pleasure. A takeaway option is available, which is perfect for those who want to enjoy this wonderful soup at home. When it comes to price, Pho 10 is incredibly affordable considering the quality of the cuisine. The value for money is simply exceptional, and I am convinced that this restaurant fully deserves to be listed in the Michelin guide., Top-level pho soups, tasty, hearty, very inexpensive (from 65 to 90k dong). This address is emblematic of street food in Hanoi. The place is very simple and we eat on collective tables but you will enjoy it. There is sometimes a bit of a queue on the sidewalk but the wait is very short (10 minutes at most on average)., Michelin star beef pho. There is about 6 to 7 items on the menu pasted on the table. They are only selling beef pho in different varieties. So don't expect to come here and order chicken or pork pho. Staff are non - English speakers and discriminate against foreigners. I asked for some coriander and pointed to the picture of coriander on my mobile and gestured to the waitress I wanted this. But she just mumbled " sold out" which I understand. Next moment, a local guy walked in and shared table with me and she habitually just provide him a small bowl of coriander. I was in shock. I told the guy in English and hope he understands what I mean about my coriander request which was plainly rejected. Other than such discrimination against foreigners, the pho is good and I had my breakfast there 3 days in a row. So, if you don' t come here early ( I arrived between 6:30am to 7am as my hotel is down the road) ;then expect to queue and to be treated like a foreigner. No fancy service here.

The undisputed star of this restaurant is the pho broth, and it is simply divine. It is perfectly balanced, neither too fatty, nor too sweet, nor too salty. Each spoonful was a feast for the taste buds, and I was impressed with the quality of this broth.

A takeaway option is available, which is perfect for those who want to enjoy this wonderful soup at home.

When it comes to price, Pho 10 is incredibly affordable considering the quality of the cuisine. The value for money is simply exceptional, and I am convinced that this restaurant fully deserves to be listed in the Michelin guide.

name: Bun Cha 34
address: 34 Hang Than Ba Dinh, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: A small, but Very Popular Restaurant that serves only the Local Vietnamese Specialty - BUN CHA - which is Barbecued Pork in a Vietnamese Soup served with Local Rice Noodles and plenty of Fresh Greens. Bun Cha is very popular in Hanoi, as it is an all time food - can be had for Breakfast, Brunch, Lunch or Dinner. Since this place specializes in only serving Bun Cha, it is Very Authentic and Superbly Well Made. Everything is Freshly Made and Absolutely Yummy too. Being a Small Place and Very Popular, you may have to wait to get a Table and may also have to share a Table with others at times, but the Bun Cha more than makes up for this. Truly a Must Visit every time you are in Hanoi and in the area., I hadn’t eaten this much Bun Cha (50,000) as a meal for a while. As I ordered a piece of deep-fried spring roll (10,000), it made me more than full. Even without the roll, it is a rather big portion. Lots of barbecue pork and meatballs as well as sliced papaya in the broth. Fresh vegetables are plenty on the side and I ate most of them. I shouldn’t have been greedy. I wasn’t hungry for dinner on the day. If you want to drink tea, it costs 5,000. I stayed on Ma May Street. It isn’t too far from there but it is a bit too far if you stay near St.John cathedral. You may want to grab a motorbike or cyclo. This eatery is very local. I found most customers local rather than tourists. The Staff won't speak English very well. You will have to share a table with others. If you can, avoid the busy time., This place is what they call “a hidden gem”. Probably you won’t bump in to this place when strolling through the streets, you will have to specifically look for it. You won’t tell by the looks, but the bun cha they serve at this place is beyond delicious! Also it is mentioned in the Michelin guide, and for good reason. There is not a heck lot of space, and there will always be locals eating here, but if there is space do not look any further!

name: Ikka Wagyu Yakiniku
address: 118 Nguyễn Khánh Toàn Next to KAFA coffee shop, Cau Giay, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We held a birthday party at IKKA Wagyu Yakiniku, and it was a pleasant experience through and through. From the general cozy atmosphere, to the friendly staff, to the amazing tender wagyu beef that just melts in your mouth, I honestly couldn’t find a thing to complain about. We picked one of the premium sets so prices weren’t too low, but it’s one of the most affordable wagyu houses in Vietnam from what I’ve seen. Overall, I can definitely see myself returning to IKKA for another special occasion., IKKA is very suitable for meals with family. Coming to IKKA, you will experience soft wagyu beef that melts in your mouth. Fresh and clean beef. Cozy space suitable for dining out with friends and family, I travel between Japan and Hanoi every month. You can eat quality Wagyu beef that is hard to find in Hanoi. If you ask the staff, they will grill it for you, so you can enjoy high-quality yakiniku while in Hanoi. When I asked the owner, he said they are constantly thinking about the quality of the meat and making improvements. I'm looking forward to going again!

From the general cozy atmosphere, to the friendly staff, to the amazing tender wagyu beef that just melts in your mouth, I honestly couldn’t find a thing to complain about.
