name: Hanoi Corner Restaurant
address: 45 Hàng Bạc, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 11011 Vietnam
reviews: We relied on the great reviews in choosing the place to go for lunch to finally try the authentic and delicious Vietnamese cuisine and... We were not wrong! In addition to the extreme kindness of Wayne (who also helped us talk to the airport for clearly extra restaurant matters) and Han, we really enjoyed all the dishes. Not only delicious but also well presented. Han and Wayne were kind and very helpful in explaining the dishes, compositions, how to make rolls, etc. Vietnamese cuisine really deserves it and this place can best represent it. Stra recommended!, We came for dinner attracted by these little places that offer traditional dishes, many and varied. They turned out delicious too! Both vegetables and more protein-based fish dishes. The environment is simple, yes 2 floors. The waiters have always been careful not to seat guests, even 2 of them, at the only table facing the door, therefore exposed to possible drafts. N & V were thoughtful and kind: impeccable I would say., Dining at Hanoi Corner Restaurant in Hanoi was an exceptional experience from start to finish, elevated significantly by Wayne, our fantastic waiter. His attentive and warm service made the evening memorable, offering insights into the menu and providing thoughtful recommendations. The food was top-notch, showcasing authentic Vietnamese flavors with modern flair. Wayne's service truly stood out—he was friendly, efficient, and clearly passionate about the cuisine and culture. He checked in frequently without being overbearing, ensuring we had everything we needed and more. His knowledge of the dishes and personal touch made the experience not just a meal, but a delightful journey through Vietnamese cuisine. Highly recommended for anyone looking for five-star flavors and standout service in Hanoi, with Wayne making it an unforgettable experience!
description: With many years of experience in the profession. Hanoi Corner Restaurant want to bring our customers the best and most desirable service experiences. Our attentive staff is dedicated to providing exceptional service, ensuring that each visit is a memorable one. From recommending the perfect wine pairing to accommodating special dietary requirements, we go the extra mile to satisfy our customers' needs and preferences. Let our menu take you on a Vietnamese culinary journey that stimulates your senses and taste buds. The colors, flavors and aromas of our famous and not so famous national and regional dishes are combined and presented in an exquisite way. Let's enjoy to love Vietnam more

name: Red Bean Central Restaurant
address: No: 21 Hang Thung Street, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Wonderful food- ordered a seabass in banana leaf. Super delicious, lots of fish, beautiful sides. My waitress, PHG, was lovely!, We had two evening meals here and were looked after by Yen, who couldn’t do enough for us. Yen was lovely, polite, very attentive and helpful and went to great effort in making us feel special. Without being intrusive. Yen was also very patient helping us with all our questions, she even helped us with a little translation from English to Vietnamese. The food was excellent and after a busy day in Hanoi it was nice to relax in the ambient surroundings of the restaurant. Which was just a perfect ending to the day. A very enjoyable experience!😀👍, We had a great time at Redbean restaurant in Hanoi. The service provided by Vi and his colleague was impeccable, combining careful advice on dishes with efficiency. The cuisine is delicious, authentic (no unnecessary nonsense) and I was served the best Pina Colada I have ever had. To top it all off the view of Hanoi is very beautiful. In short not to be missed!
description: Indulge in the exquisite world of Red Bean Central, a luxurious fine dining restaurant located on the 11th floor of the prestigious La Siesta Classic Hang Thung. With a seating capacity for up to 80 esteemed guests and a private dining room, this culinary gem offers an amazing view of the cityscape. The elegant interior, adorned in white and black, creates a sophisticated ambiance that perfectly complements the delectable creations of our top chef. Red Bean Central is not just any restaurant; it holds a special place in our hearts as our very first Red Bean establishment, welcoming guests since 2014. Since then, the Red Bean family has grown, and now there are three Red Bean restaurants scattered all over Vietnam, each embracing the spirit of culinary excellence and creating memorable dining experiences. Whether it’s a romantic dinner, a gathering with friends, or a special occasion, Red Bean Central is the perfect destination for an unforgettable dining experience. With its exquisi

name: Blue Butterfly Restaurant & Cooking Class
address: 69 Ma May, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant is situated in the old quarter close to the famous beer corner, a junction away. The road it is on is considered reasonably quiet in an otherwise bustling area of Hanoi. It is a two storey restaurant situated in quite a narrow shophouse of Hanoi. There are not many tables in the restaurant so it is advised to make a reservation. Most hotels will be able to do that for you. The food in this restaurant is a mix of western and Vietnamese which the 4 of us ordered. Both types of food were found to be quite well prepared and delicious. The rosemary chicken was moist and not dry, the spring rolls were fresh and the pumpkin soup was more savoury than sweet. The 4 cocktails and mocktails we ordered were quite ingeniously prepared and original to the restaurant. The service in this restaurant also deserves mention. The ratio of staff to patrons is high and the staff are very attentive to details such as a misplaced servette, water than needs to be topped up and so on even though they do not wait at your table. It was never difficult to get the attention of any of the staff when needed. And finally price. We ordered 4 full dishes, 3 sides, 4 cocktails/mocktails and it all came up to 1,900,000 dong which is very reasonable in Hanoi. In conclusion the 4 of us had a wonderful experience in this establishment without burning a hole in our wallet., The fish is very good as is the duck, the sauce is very good, the fried rice is excellent. The service is attentive and the servers explain the dishes and their origin to you. The service is very pleasant. The atmosphere is on the first floor with a view of the beams and the brick walls, the restaurant is in an old house over 100 years old, the decoration is careful., This pretty restaurant not to be missed is a pleasant discovery, the staff is very attentive, dedicated and what can we say about this charming boss Chris who listens very attentively and who exercises his French with good listening We recommend you without hesitation. This is a detour not to be missed. Norman and Manon Quebec, Canada
description: If you want to find a place with the interfering between traditional and modern food culture, the multinational cross cultures and the inheretation culture among genarations then the Blue Butterfly Restaurant- Cooking Class would be a place that you should not miss. Founded in 2006 and located in an 100 years old house in the Hanoi's Old Quarter, the Blue Butterfly Restaurant- Cooking Class is a favorite space for customers and chefs all over the world.

name: Mammom Restaurant - Vietnamese Cuisine
address: 23b Phan Dinh Phung, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: The perfect place to enjoy Vietnamese local food. I'm impressed by the taste of food here, like explosing in your mouth. The must try dish is crab. It's big crab, and the sauce is so good. Highly recommend!, Remarkably fresh ingredients and a great combination of different flavors. Some of our favorites: The old quarter duck with star fruit was a huge hit. The simplicity of fried rice with garlic. Fried tofu and the eggplant with minced pork are must tries., The food and service were amazing. The place looks really nice and clean, and the staff is great! So attentive and lovely.
description: Here, you can savor the unique and distinctive flavors of the North, Central, and South. With a diverse and rich menu, MAMMOM Restaurant offers diners traditional dishes meticulously prepared from the freshest ingredients, capturing the essence of Vietnamese culinary traditions from each region

name: The Hanoi Cafe
address: 10 Hang Manh st, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi, Hanoi 56000 Vietnam
reviews: Hanoi Cafe is a chill place off a busy street that was excellent. The best part was that the owner helped choose our food and she picked items partly based on the weather! Everything was excellent and I’d come back again. Our only disappointment was we found out they give egg coffee making lessons but unfortunately it was our last day so we had no time for egg coffee learning :(. Next time we visit!!!, Found this little Restuarant by mistake and what a little beauty. The young man that served us ( wish I had gotten his name ) was absolutely outstanding as far as explaining the Restuarant and menu to us thank you so much young man. We dropped in for lunch and ordered the smoked pork belly, duck spring rolls and mango chicken salad. Yum, Yum Yum. Loved it so much we are going back tonight for dinner and a bottle of wine. If you are ever in Hanoi and around the old quarters don’t go past this place you won’t be disappointed., Fantastic cafe, brilliant coffee and food. You can sit inside with A/C or in their private garden The staff speak great English and are proud of the food they make. I’d highly recommend the duck Pho.
description: The Hanoi Cafe is a small cafe and eatery with a beautiful relaxing outdoor seats and cozy indoor areas, serving the premium single origin coffee beans farmed in Da Lat area and some famous local coffee drink like egg coffee, coconut coffee, peanut butter coffee as well as the tradition Phin filter coffee. The Hanoi Cafe is also a great place for a nice breakfast, brunch, lunch and dinner in Hanoi old quarter. The menu offes great choice of food with our home-made sourdough breads, sourdough burger with some vegan food option, even gluteen free dietary with our smoothie bowls, granola bowls. The Hanoi Cafe is also a nice cozy place for dinner in the heart of old quarter. The Egg coffee making class is also a nice coffee experience for your travel time in Hanoi.

name: Ibiero Beer Club - Times City
address: 458 Minh Khai, Hai BÃ  TrÆ°ng, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: This is really a great place for beer lovers. The food is truely amazing and the admosphere is quite good. I really recommend this place., Terrible experience! Just as our food arrived, a loud crowd started singing karaoke at maximum volume. The staff took no action to manage the noise, making it impossible to enjoy our food or drinks. We ended up leaving immediately. Complete waste of time and money
description: When seeing the way that sexy artistic modern craft beer is seducing worldwide classes, the founders of iBiero believe they are exploring the most amorous and mellifluent way to express their love to people and nature of their motherland.

name: Bun Cha Nem Cua Be Dac Kim
address: 67 Duong Thanh Street Old Quarter, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Authentic, local taste in a nice area of the city. You can expect one serving (1 bun cha + 1 nem cua be) to be about 100k. Its worth it and unless you are very hungry, one is fine for two people., The best Bun Cha in all of Hanoi. Frequented by tourists, therefore slightly higher prices, but it's really worth it. Delightful. I recommend eating outdoors, as the interiors (3 floors of the building) are not as impeccably kept as their Bun cha., This restaurant is highly rated for their Bun Cha however we were not very impressed. The meat was not freshly grilled and was served barely warm. Compared to the serving size of the locals sitting next to us, our portions were 1/2 size for the same combination set (cost D95,000). The restaurant was dirty even though we are very accustomed to eating in local style restaurants. The floor was lined with littered napkins, herbs etc. We were recommended a different (dirty but delicious) Bun Cha restaurant located in the Old Quarter, they cooked the meat fresh to order and served the same quantity/combination for D35,000.
description: Authentic, local taste in a nice area of the city. You can expect one serving (1 bun cha + 1 nem cua be) to be about 100k. Its worth it and unless you are very hungry, one is fine for two people.

name: Vegan Banh mi
address: 66b Trần Hưng Đạo, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Incredible vegan restaurant. Such hard working staff aiming to provide delicious vegan food for the price of street food. Only a very small restaurant with a few tables but doesn’t seem to get too busy. They are very passionate about the environment and animals, as is indicated by the menu and the art decor that they have. A must visit for vegetarians and vegans looking for yummy food in Hanoi., Wow, the Banh mi sandwich was absolutely delicious - full of flavor, crispy, and generously portioned. The restaurant, which is run by a lovely family, is a hidden gem that serves fresh, delicious vegan food at a great price. Highly recommended!, One of the best places for vegan food in Vietnam tastiest food at the most reasonable price. They have Banh Mi, Pho and all the Vietnam street foods. Entirely vegan (not vegetarian). Thus very safe for vegans to try anything and everything on menu without worrying about whether there will be dairy in the food. And I was happy to see the owners are all vegans for ethical reasons. Owners and staff are lovely and kind. Must visit- not to be missed
description: Small vegan food cart opened inside a narrow alley. This food cart serve mainly Vegan banh mi (Vietnamese sandwich), vegan Vietnamese pillow donut ( like samosa), fried spring rolls. Menu may be changed a bit due to season. Customers can choose to sit in the alley or outside on the street by small chair - Staff does not speak English well but ingredients in each dish are listed in the menu - Suitable for people who want to discover Vietnamese Vegan Banh mi and snacks.

name: Noodle & Roll
address: 39C Ly Quoc Su Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Visited here when they were really busy so we sat on the balcony. Service was a little slow and took a while to get cutlery, napkins etc but they were very friendly. Food was really good, we had some spring rolls and seafood fried rice and beef noodles. Would definitely recommend, Got plates of gluten free food for 69,000 VND each. Pretty happy w that! Boosted its size by adding steamed rice for 20,000 VND, so basically, gluten free man-sized meal for 89,000 VND., A very small shop selling locals dishes. Dropped by to have a late lunch and there wasn’t any patrons. Literally had the restaurant to ourselves. We ordered the beef pho and the Vietnamese fried spring rolls to share. The broth of the pho was flavourful and the beef used was fresh. I just find that the fried spring rolls a tad too oily for me. Other than that, they tasted great as well. Food was served fast and I found the price to be reasonable.
description: We serve noodles and spring rolls, summer rolls, and also vegetarian, typical Vietnamese food at reasonable price in the central, old quarter district of Hanoi.

name: Cloud Sky Bar Hanoi
address: 16 Hang Da Street Floor 9th JM Marvel Hotel, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Tony and Huyen were outstanding hosts, providing detailed insights into the menu and offering excellent recommendations. This beautiful and serene place offers great music, ideal for appreciating the sunset. Moreover, they generously shared valuable tips to explore more about the local culture. A spot highly recommended - a 100% must-visit!, We visited the hotel to go to restaurant and the sky bar but we will definitely be staying at this hotel on our next trip!!! Wow! But the hotel books up quickly so we’ll have to plan in advance. We were greeted by the bellman and front desk upon entry and shown to the top floors. The staff working throughout the hotel is so friendly, professional, and speak great English - we felt so comfortable and treated well. The restaurant has an extensive menu with items of all regions of Vietnam, very traditional flavors with a high class tough. The views from the restaurant are astounding and beautiful decorated. Our favorite dishes were beef stew( you can ask for extra bread to dip in the sauce), coconut beef, mango salad with fried shrimp, and beef wrapped in leaves. You can also order food from the restaurant at the roof top bar and be served there. The roof top bar is top notch with almost a 360 degree view of the Hanoi skyline which can also be witnessed inside the restaurant.. definitely instagram worthy day, sunset, and at night!! The bar’s music was just our style - we enjoyed the atmosphere tremendously. The bar can get busy so don’t arrive too late as it can get crowded. There are some seats sheltered if it rains and there is a TV to watch sports. Again the staff was very friendly attentive and friendly. We again were able to order in English and also had some nice conversations with the staff. Our favorite drinks were the mellow sunset and and shining moonlight from the cocktails and the “fresh”watermelon jug for shots. This is a high end hotel. Restaurant, and bar at affordable prices! Great for special occasions. We will be back!, Our idea was to go to Sky Bar and have a drink close to the cool sunshine in Hanoi, but finally we had a really nice Sea Food Pan wich We just can say that the sauce was really amazing and the sea food was so fresh. We were attended by Hoang who was actually professional, friendly and kind so we are sure that the experience deserves to go. We recommend it 100%!!
description: Stunning View of Hanoi Old Quarter. A mesmerizing rooftop destination for sky lovers, stargazers, and those who like to dream. Where the sky is so close that makes your soul and spirit soar. Be in time to catch one of the good spots to watch the city light up as the sun goes down with a glass of cocktail in hand. On the menu are creative sensations that will awaken all the senses. While the music sets the tone for the night ahead, it will be for sure an unforgettable moment when drinking in the skyline surroundings and feasting upon tantalizing tastes of Hanoi infused with exquisitely crafted traditional flavors.

name: Luna Restaurant & Skybar
address: 04 Ng. Báo Khánh, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Chloe was a wonderful as a host and waiter. She was especially patient explaining the options because we came here for a specific local dish. Needless to say, we came back twice after that. You must catch the free entertainment and Vietnamese tea. Yummmy! Did I say FREE!, We had a fantastic meal here and were very well looked after by Xuan Anh. The food was really good quality as well as the drinks and the vibes and views up on the roof were excellent, would highly recommend Xuan Anh and his team if looking for somewhere to relax and enjoy with excellent food and service in Hanoi. We even had a lovely live music act , a great night for my family including a fussy eating 11 year old! Thank you ;-), I ate chicken rice sauce and seafood fries. Chicken rice sauce was a cool sauce and the clean taste was the best! The staff also took care to have a friendly and comfortable meal and could have had fun. It was the best meal in Hanoi 😊
description: Chloe was a wonderful as a host and waiter. She was especially patient explaining the options because we came here for a specific local dish. Needless to say, we came back twice after that. You must catch the free entertainment and Vietnamese tea. Yummmy! Did I say FREE!

name: Comet Restaurant
address: 61 Hang Be Level 11, Aurora Premium, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant is luxurious, the view overlooking Sword Lake is very chill, the feeling is very healing, the food is good, and the service quality is very good, coming here automatically takes beautiful photos because the staff here serve very enthusiastically. I am very impressed with the service of Huong (Dora) and Huyen. Will definitely come back for the second time., The location of this place is really great.Every place is nearby The overall service was really great Maria was really helpful and was there at every point of time, My dinner at Comet restaurant was nothing short of spectacular. The ambiance was warm and inviting, with elegant decor that set the tone for an unforgettable evening. The menu offered a wide variety of dishes, each crafted with precision and creativity. I opted for the fuji steak, which was cooked to perfection and bursting with flavor. The staff were attentive and knowledgeable, ensuring every detail was taken care of. From the impeccable service to the exquisite presentation of each course, every moment was a treat. To top it off, the dessert was the perfect ending. Comet restaurant truly delivered an exceptional dining experience. Highly recommended!
description: Perched on the 11th floor of Aurora Premium Hotel & Spa, Comet Restaurant offers breathtaking views of the heart of Hanoi - Hoan Kiem lake. With its contemporary western design, delicious fusion cuisine, and excellent customer service, Comet Restaurant is the perfect place to experience the best of Vietnamese and international flavors. Featuring a menu of delectable dishes and a selection of fine wines and drinks to match, Comet Restaurant is an unforgettable dining destination. Whether you're looking for a sumptuous international standard breakfast buffet, a professional a la carte lunch, or a sophisticated dinner, Comet Restaurant has something for everyone. With a capacity of 52 seats, it's the perfect place to enjoy a memorable meal and savor the authentic taste of Vietnam.

name: Batavia Restaurant & Cafe
address: 116 Ngoc Ha Street Ngoc Ha Ward, Ba Dinh District, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Food in Indonesia. When having trouble choosing a menu in Hanoi, for a few days in the city, always eat western fast food. Iseng Iseng googling Halal Food in Indonesian version, it turns out there is Resto and Cafe Batavia - Taste of Indonesia Hanoi. Finally can Eat Enak, Goat Tongseng, Chicken Preset, Dendeng Balado and Grain Asem, not forgetting Mendoan tempe and corn bakwan. The story of revenge along with other Indonesian comrades. Good Job Batavia, Great Food, The food here is incredible, authentic Indonesian food. I've both eaten here and also ordered home. Its a hidden gem. The prices are very reasonable and the staff are very friendly. Will definitely be going back. Definitely check out this spot because its very different when compared to the other available cuisines in Hanoi., We tried the Ayam Penyet. Of course not as spicy as back in Malaysia or Indonesia but decent enough to allay my craving. The interior is cozy and spacious. We liked the place. Price range from 300-400k dong for 2 people.
description: Batavia Hanoi, brings authenticity of Indonesian Culinary with Traditional recipe, modern ambience & sincere hospitality. Certified as Halal Restaurant, we guarantee all the goods and food handling according to the Muslim law.

name: Chapter Dining And Grill
address: 12C P. Chan Cam Hang Trong, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Exceptional food in an stylish setting. The restaurant is just off a busy street and is set among some local eateries but don't let the location fool you, this is an establishment of the highest quality. You go into the waiting area which is overlooks the open kitchen, you immediately see the care and passion of the chef's. The attention to detail I have only seen in some of the best restaurants. This was a tasting menu paired with no alcoholic or alcoholic (+ cost), we tried both. This was the only minor gripe that some of the pairings did not go so well, weren't bad but this could have been due to availability in the local market. The food was exceptional, the items I was unsure of were outstanding, highlights, the cone!!!, fois gras and buffalo and the kumquat (what a dish). Everything flowed possibly a little quick could of had a couple more minutes between dishes to read the postcards about the next course but nothing off putting and the staff were outstanding and had great understanding of the food. Highly recommend as a treat, Chapter was truly one of our most memorable dining experiences to date. We had the 10 course tasting menu which was delicious, creative, and made from locally sourced ingredients. The chef’s passion for Vietnamese history, food and culture is reflected in each dish. We also had the pleasure of speaking to the chef about his inspiration for the various dishes, which was an informative and insightful experience in itself. The restaurant made last minute accommodations for our special dietary requirements and the service was truly exceptional. The wine pairings with the tasting menu were sublime! We would highly recommend this gem in Hanoi for a truly unique Vietnamese fine dining experience., I have been to many fine dining restaurants in vietnam and all were amazing but at the end of the day it's just a dinner, at chapter it felt like more then a dinner the chef brought us on a journey of local produce and fantastic taste. With the new campfire menu we tried, it really felt like eating at a fine dining camp site. The non-alchaholic pairing was a pleasant surprise that I honestly didn't expect. It was vietnamese tastes and ideas at its core but presented in a fashion that turns every dish into a painting. The staff were incredible and extremely attentive and never missed anything, described each dish to its core, and were fun and bubbly to talk to. Would recommend and will be going back when the menu changes.
description: Vietnamese Contemporary Dining with focus in Charcoal Grill technique by Chef Quang Dung - Tasting Menu only

name: Yalla Kebab&grill
address: 41 Dao Duy Tu, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Friend and I came by this little gem in Hanoi for dinner last night. We both had the chicken Fattah and fresh lemon juice. Everything was delicious! Portion sizes were very generous and we also had a sweet treat of traditional Arabic rice pudding. The host was very bubbly and service was 10/10 -was also nice to be seated in a comfortable booth for a change!, Great experience at Yalla Kebab & Grill! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Dinner at Yalla Kebab & Grill was amazing in every way! The restaurant serves authentic Halal and Arabic food and everything was delicious. The flavors are rich and authentic, making you feel like a traditional homemade meal. I tried Chicken and Meat, Humming, Grilled Chicken, Rice, and each dish was prepared and full of great flavors. The meat was perfectly grilled, the hummus was creamy and delicious, and the grilled chicken was perfectly grilled with delicious rice to complement. The service was excellent, and the atmosphere was warm and friendly. I would highly recommend this place to anyone seeking an authentic Arabic and delicious Hanoi experience . Will be back soon! #Eat_Arabic #Restaurant_Hall #Shorma #Barbecue #Delicious #Vietnam, Enjoy egyptian menu in the heart of Vietnam. Hanoi. The resto served mediteranean cuisisine like shawarma and kebab. The taste is delicious and they served happily. The price is reasonable and not to expensive. Good job btw
description: Yalla Kebab&Grill is a middle eastern HALAL restaurant located in the heart of Hanoi (the old quarter).

name: Rice Bistro
address: 32 Hang Manh Street, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews:
Vietnamese restaurant. But the price is not very expensive, of course compared to the local water prices, the rice is expensive, but it is very valuable for clean food, one by one fresh ingredients. Everyone was friendly with the air-conditioned clean bathroom and had mango and shrimp in the afternoon. I think a little like this is too good! More than anything really delicious!!! Especially salad and mango salad should be roasted., Exquisite Vietnamese experience ... close to our hotel...fab food served by Linda. We had grilled seafood, morning glory, rice and cocktails for under 1 million dong. Great value for money in a peaceful, elegant setting. We're coming back tomorrow as more wed like to try on the menu, A gem of a restaurant! Lovely decor, relaxing ambience , well staffed and excellent food. A large menu to choose from at very reasonable prices for the quality . Our waitress, Amber, was very polite and well spoken. She was very attentive to our needs without being overly intrusive while we enjoyed our meal. Highly recommend this restaurant. Rice Bistro has garnered high praise for its combination of value and authenticity, offering a menu of high-quality Vietnamese dishes that are both varied and reasonably priced. Guests frequently commend the tranquil and elegantly adorned environment, which enhances the dining experience.

The cuisine, bursting with traditional Vietnamese flavors, from bun cha to sea bass, consistently earns rave reviews. Additionally, the service at Rice Bistro is often highlighted for its attentiveness and friendliness, contributing to the overall exceptional experience many travelers enjoy.
description: The original Rice Bistro started in 1994 in Old Quarter, Hanoi. Our restaurant is where you can enjoy an exclusive experience of the Vietnamese culinary tradition redefined with Western flair. Inspired by age-old native flavours and western food style, our Chef has created a variety of delicious dishes.

name: Summit Lounge
address: 20th floor - Sofitel Plaza Hanoi 1 Thanh Nien, Ba Dinh District, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: The Bar is now called THE SUMMIT and is located on the 20th floor of the Pan Pacific hotel. To get the only 2 elevators go to that floor so check the elevators before you get in. Once there the view of the city is amazing, and if it gets a bit cool sitting outside you can either ask for a blanket from the staff or move to the comfortable tables and chairs inside., For a romantic date , a Friday drink with co-workers or just to watch the sunset, it is an awesome place to chill out and enjoy the rivers and lakes that Hanoi skyline offers the visitors. Interesting cocktails and drinks. There is food options as well., Sit there to embrace the sunset and enjoy the night scene with a glass of wine. Lovely place to chill out
description: Renowned for having the "best view in Hanoi" with spectacular panoramic views of the city skyline, this rooftop bar is ideal for evening cocktails or get-together while watching the sunset on West Lake. Indoor and outdoor seating are available.Open daily:4:00 pm - midnight.

name: Red Bean Ma May
address: No.94 Ma May St, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: During our 2017 visit to Hanoi, my partner and I lucked into finding the Red Bean. We loved it and i wrote a Trip Advisor review at the time. Fast forward to 2025 ... back in Hanoi and wanted to again try the Red Bean. We needed a bit of refined dining after the chaos and noise of the city. There were 7 of us and the restaurant was about a 1/2 walk from our hotel. We passed a number of restaurants along the way and some members of the group suggested just stopping at one of them instead of trekking so far. My partner and I were pretty set on the Red Bean though and our friends stuck with us. We we just hoping we hadn't oversold it. And we hadn't! It was every bit as wonderful as the first time. It is elegant - white table clothes, lovely serving dishes, etc. but no need to dress fancy. We were all in pretty casual clothes. Food was AMAZING (upscale Vietnamese) service IMPECCABLE, and SO REASONBLE. To give you an idea of the price, we shared the tasting menu (many dishes and all delicious) and shared a few bottles of wine and the bill for each of us was around $55 Canadian. Everyone agreed that the trek was well worth it. Highly recommend!, We had a delicious meal here. Lots of choice, Vietnamese food but also European food. It is more expensive compared to other restaurants here, but you get what you pay for. The food tasted delicious and the service is very nice and really ready to help you. Definitely recommended if you are in Hanoi and want to eat delicious food, Ly Nguyen was our server and she was fantastic! Food was amazing and presentation was beautiful. We got a 5 course meal of authentic Vietnamese food for the equivalent of 25 USD. Ly was VERY helpful in answering questions, educating us on the food and providing other recommendations for Hanoi. She went above and beyond. Service in general from all staff was excellent. Would DEFINITELY come back here.
description: Red Bean Ma May is an oasis of cozy calm, with an atmosphere made even more soothing by a color scheme of creams and browns bathed in warm lighting. The space is designed with both classical and traditional Southeast Asian features. This restaurant specializes in serving authentic Vietnamese cuisine, offering a culinary journey through Vietnam's rich and diverse flavors.

name: Ivegan Supershop Old Quater Hanoi
address: 56 Hàng Điếu, Cửa Đông Hoàn Kiếm, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We have eaten at iVegan several times in Hanoi and we love it. We appreciate that we can be certain the food here is completely vegan as many other places who claim to be vegan also serve egg or milk products and you need to ask to make sure. We had the Saigon bowl and the vegan chickpea tuna sandwich, which we really enjoyed. The blueberry muffin smoothie is my favourite drink and I’ve ordered it just about every time. Pricing is a little higher than other vegan places, but the quality of food (as well as the aesthetics), the service, and the atmosphere are fantastic. A few steps up, there is a completely air conditioned floor, which we always choose as a break from the Hanoi summer heat while we eat. Today, when we came up, a gentleman working here turned on additional fans and checked on us to make sure we were comfortable. We thought that was so kind. We absolutely recommend iVegan if you’re looking for a plant-based place to eat!, I stumbled upon this lovely vegan food spot in Hanoi. Despite being in a central area, it’s so quiet and peaceful inside. The menu is extensive with lots of choice. There’s so much fresh food to try from and lots of different protein options. I enjoyed my Tempeh Bagel so much that I came back the next day for another one and also had a fresh orange juice and blueberry smoothie. I’d definitely recommend and come back again. The food and drinks are inexpensive considering the quality. Nice option if you’re looking to get away from the street food within the old quarter., I was there for breakfast and was very happy about the vegan cafe in Hanoi! A very delicious bagel, totally delicious juice and good coffee, as well as free, treated water - a great breakfast! A must for all blant-based fans:)
description: We have eaten at iVegan several times in Hanoi and we love it. We appreciate that we can be certain the food here is completely vegan as many other places who claim to be vegan also serve egg or milk products and you need to ask to make sure. We had the Saigon bowl and the vegan chickpea tuna sandwich, which we really enjoyed. The blueberry muffin smoothie is my favourite drink and I’ve ordered it just about every time. Pricing is a little higher than other vegan places, but the quality of food (as well as the aesthetics), the service, and the atmosphere are fantastic. A few steps up, there is a completely air conditioned floor, which we always choose as a break from the Hanoi summer heat while we eat. Today, when we came up, a gentleman working here turned on additional fans and checked on us to make sure we were comfortable. We thought that was so kind. We absolutely recommend iVegan if you’re looking for a plant-based place to eat!

name: Victor Rooftop Bar & Restaurant
address: 10th Floors, 58 Hang Gai Streets, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: I can’t recommend victor hotel enough, we were looked after from the minute that we arrived. Breakfast was served in the rooftop bar, a nice selection of hot and cold with freshly prepared eggs and omelettes. The room (Premium) was very comfortable and a good size. The food is very nice and kim chi 😍 is good We weren’t disturbed by any of the road noise., Captain Skybar & Restaurant in Hanoi is a vibrant dining destination with Japanese, European, and Vietnamese cuisines. The rooftop Skybar offers stunning city views, making it an excellent spot for a memorable meal or a night out with friends. A must-visit for diverse and delightful dining experiences in Hanoi., Had some funs while visiting this place in Hanoi. Centrally located in Hanoi, from the rooftop you can see the lake and everything else in Hanoi. The bartender was very decent, he gave some of his signatures which were fabulous and worthy. Definitely will come back to this bar when i'm back in Hanoi in near future.
description: Welcome to Victor Rooftop bar & restaurant is one of beautiful rooftop bar & restaurant in Hanoi city. We're opening our French style - Vietnamese Restaurant with delicious decor foods and Our rooftop bar have many signature Cocktail, Mocktail, Beer, Teas, coffee, cake ... with many choice. We're hope to serve all of you soon !!

name: Cinnamon Restaurant
address: 08 Hang Buom Phường Hàng Buồm, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Great place, clean and with very helpful staff. We tasted duck and highly recommended the traditional catfish dish served on a stove. Tiger beer and saigon in the bottle. Prices in line with the market of ha noi, 5 people the expense is about 14 euros each, with 2 beers and appetizer and a plate served, Super friendly staff and great customer service. The food is excellent, cooked using very fresh herbs and vegetables. The portion size of each dish is also very generous, excellent value for money!, We asked our hotel To make a reservation here for us because our tour guide had recommended. We were not disappointed, we didn’t opt for the set menu as there seemed a lot of food and we had to order 1 set menu per person . We shared a Papaya beef salad to share between us then I had chicken fried rice and my husband had stir fried beef in peanut sauce served with rice . We then shared flambé banana and ice cream ( a dessert a rare treat in Vietnam ) The service was excellent- very friendly owners , who mentioned post Covid that they had had to relocate from a good position by the lake to a few streets back and they were nit as busy because if the location until People find them again . They have I my been reopened a few months . Highly recommend as an alternative to all the street food surrounding
description: Vietnamese Traditional & Vegetarian Food

name: Uu Dam Chay, Hanoi
address: 55 Pho Nguyen Du, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: A phenomenal experience! We saw the reviews and thought that they might oversell the location and the food. But this is really an exceptional restaurant that creates a unique ambiance with high quality foods - many of them we never tried before. The menu is highly creative and the service is incredibly attentive. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone that wants to try out something unique and wonderful in Hanoi., The place and atmosphere is very quiet and all the details from the menu itself to the plating are super nice and very careful. We ordered avocado and mango rolls, pad thai, tofu with tomato and some crispy tofu balls with a very rich cream cheese. The food in general is fine, but for that price we have eaten more delicious on our trip to Vietnam. The drinks themselves have seemed especially expensive (e.g. small water 85,000 dongs...)., We dined at this restaurant after seeing the water puppet theatre (recommended). It is vegetarian; I am not a vegetarian but I was able to find some tasty dishes to try and found them very good, beautifully presented and good value. Service was attentive and there was a good level of choices on the menu. Well worth seeking out this restaurant - it is fairly central, about 10 minutes walk from the Lake.
description: A phenomenal experience! We saw the reviews and thought that they might oversell the location and the food. But this is really an exceptional restaurant that creates a unique ambiance with high quality foods - many of them we never tried before. The menu is highly creative and the service is incredibly attentive. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone that wants to try out something unique and wonderful in Hanoi.

name: Downtown Restaurant & Lounge
address: 09 Ô Quan Chưởng Str, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: The food was so good. I am allergic to shrimps they made us a tasting menu without shrimp!!! We loved the hanoi spring rolls, sautéed eggplants, and grilled chicken with honey the most!!! When you visit hanoi vietnam you should come and try their delicious food 🫶🏻, We came back here for Traditional Hanoi Grilled Fish and Fried Vegetarian Spring Rolls. They are very nice and tasty as we tried before in Jan 2024. Plus the waiter Quyet is very charming and helpful. This Downtown Cafe & Restaurant is really recommended., The guide took us while visiting the city and I was a little suspicious. The experience was excellent. The waiter welcomed us with excellent English, first illustrating the menu and then patiently explaining to us how to consume the various dishes, all excellent, always being available but without ever being intrusive. Highly recommended
description: Well-located in the vibrant Old Quarter of Hanoi, near O Quan Chuong Gate - one of historical site of Hanoi, Downtown Restaurant & Lounge is one of the best choices for both locals and international travelers. Downtown Café & Restaurant is founded in 2017 by a group of well-experienced trip leaders who have been working in the travel and hospitality industry for many years. We find ourselves so fortunate to have traveled to many parts of the country and tasted a variety of food throughout different regions of Vietnam. We fall in love with our country’s food. Therefore, the team nourishes an aspiration to expose gourmets to a wide range of the authentic Vietnamese cuisines as seeing that Vietnamese food has become more popular in over the World.

name: Mau Restaurant - Vietnamese & Vegetarian Food
address: Số 88, Hàng Bạc, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant was perfect, the interior was beautiful but the food was incredible. I had the Vietnamese pancake and the lovely staff showed me how to put it together and eat it and it was genuinely the best food I’ve had in Vietnam. My friend also had the pork bun cha and she similarly loved it. The prices were good for the amount and quality of the food you get (90,000 dong for mine) however they do add 10% tax but she was nice enough to take this off as we prearranged prior to choosing the place., We have been on holiday in Vietnam now for 2 weeks and we have finally found our absolute favorite Vietnamese restaurant!! All our dishes were amazing but in particular we really enjoyed the skewers. The waitress showed us how to assemble the options arranged on the plate into a rice paper wrapper and then roll up and dip into the dipping sauces (which I also have to specially mention were soooooo good!). There were lemon grass chicken skewers, rice noodles, pineapple, cucumber, carrot, mint and lettuce to roll up inside. I will remember it forever!, We visited this restaurant on no less than three occasions during our stay in Hanoi . The food was excellent and the atmosphere, warm and friendly . The Bun Cha was totally delicious. The staff team members under the guidance of Tuyet were keen to speak English and make the eating experience fun . Thank you
description: "Welcome to Mau restaurant ( Authentic Vietnamese Cuisine) Mau Vietnamese restaurant is Located in the heart of Hanoi Old Quarter , just a couple of steps away from Hoan Kiem Lake . Small and cozy Vietnamese restaurant & Vegetarian options in Hanoi. We serve Vietnamese traditional dishes from three parts in Vietnam including the north , the central and the south.""

name: Alsultan Hanoi Restaurant
address: 178B Xuân Diệu, Tay Ho, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Popped in here during Tet as it was open and we had been meaning to go for a while. The inside is very well decorated and has a cool vibe to it. Not sure if it was due to Tet that they seemed light on staff, when we went in we didn't see a member of staff for the first 10mins, but we were happy enough to find a table and grab a menu to browse through. We both really enjoyed the chicken shawarma wraps, the had great flavour and were well filled. The side pitta bread and hummus was tasty, we were not too keen on the falafels though, they were a little on the dry side. They were out of vine leaves, so we will just have to go back and try them another time The member of staff we had was a little cold and didn't make much effort to interact, but otherwise the food was tasty and good value so we enjoyed that, This spot offers one of the most delicious meals in Hanoi. I ordered Beef Shawarma Fattah, Fries and Yoghurt Cucumber Salad that goes great with rice that is in Fattah. The price of what i ordered 8.5$., Al Sultan serves some of the best Egyptian food we've ever had, and we lived in the Middle East and visited Egypt. We're willing to bet this is the best Egyptian food in Vietnam. If you know Egyptian and Middle Eastern food, just choose your favorites and enjoy. We like the koshari, falafel, and shawarma. What's even more fun about Al Sultan is all the football, Mo Salah, and ancient Egypt swag. Good times!
description: Alsultan restaurant Hanoi is an Egyptian halal restaurant in the heart of Hanoi, Vietnam, serving an authentic menu that lets you savor the flavors of Egypt.

name: Masala Art Indian Restaurant & Bar
address: No. 9 P. Nha Tho Street Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: If you are looking for true authentic Indian food in Vietnam, a country where getting good Indian food is a challenge, then Masala Art, Hanoi is the answer. We were a group of 6 friends from New Delhi, India, came to Vietnam for holidays for 10 days with Hanoi as our last destination. After having Vietnamese food for 8 days, decided to try Indian food at Masala Art. Thoroughly enjoyed the food. Our experience was so good that we repeated our visit for Dinner next day too. Each dish was excellently well prepared, delicious and flavourful. We had mix of Vegetarian and Non Veg dishes. Each was truly delicious. In sweets, we tried Gajar Ka Halwa; OMG, really mouth watering and authentic Red Carrot Halwa. Service and hospitality was superb; very attentive, highly personalized; always smiling. Please reserve a table when you plan to visit and enjoy the lunch / dinner at Masala Art. This place is fairly occupied and busy., Ok, I was a little nervous based on the reviews which seemed overly positive but I am very pleasantly surprised. I decided to give this place a try since my previous preferred Indian restaurant has recently changed ownership after 15 years. This was a 3 person business dinner. We spend roughly a but under $100 for a table packed full of food. A few apps, the meat kebab platter, several mains, a biryani, and two types of naan. I would say all the dishes except for one were good to excellent. The one dish that was disappointing was the palak paneer which was still ok but it was incredibly bland. I like palak paneer so I was not expecting it to be some huge flavor explosion because it's a simple white cheese with creamed spinach but I expect it to have some flavor and good palak paneer usually has a creamy but subtle richness to it. This palak paneer was flavorless. The manchurian cauliflower app was not what I would consider an Indian dish but it was really good. The rest of the dishes were yummy and more traditional (not that I would know) compared to what I have had at other Indian places. I will happily return there in the future. Service was fast and attentive., Masala Art in Hanoi offers a delightful dining experience with its elegant and ambient atmosphere, featuring a regal Rajasthan-style interior that exudes luxury. The food is delicious, and the staff is friendly and attentive, making you feel right at home. Located in a convenient spot, it's the perfect place to relax and enjoy authentic flavors while on holiday. Highly recommended for anyone seeking a blend of comfort and sophistication.
description: A chic Indian restaurant located in the heart of Old Quarter serving delectable vegetarian & non-vegetarian halal Tandoori Kebabs, Kathi Rolls, Biryani, Curries & more!

name: 3 Spoons
address: Plot E6, Pham Hung Road 62nd Floor, Landmark 72 Building, Nam Từ Liêm, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: I had a very fun and happy experience at the restaurant while on vacation with my family. The waiters and uncles were very enthusiastic and polite. Ms. Huong and the other aunts and uncles are very dedicated to the children and grandparents. The food is not much but delicate and delicious, the place to get buffet food is also very convenient. Thank you and I will definitely come back. I had a very fun and happy experience at the restaurant while on vacation with my family. The waiters and uncles were very enthusiastic and polite. Ms. Huong and the other aunts and uncles are very dedicated to the children and grandparents. The food is not much but delicate and delicious, the place to get buffet food is also very convenient. Thank you and I will definitely come back., Visited 3Spoons for a weekday family lunch. Beautiful Restaurant with a spectacular panoramic views of Hanoi. The restaurant offers both an a la carte menu, as well as a buffet for lunch. We opted for the buffet as there is such a substantial offering, ranging from Italian dishes, local Vietnamese and an amazing array of sushi, and not to forget the delectable dessert room!!! Needless to say we all thoroughly enjoyed our meal, and finished off with some of the best coffee we've experienced in Vietnam. A very special mention to the wonderful service from all the staff, especially the professional Ms. Huong who took our reservation and explained the menu to us, and our waitress Ms. Thuy Duong who made sure we never had an empty glass, and provided friendly and efficient service to us. 5 star food, 5 star service, 5 star location!, My wife and I very much enjoyed our meal. The restaurant manager could not have been more polite. The customer service was outstanding from start to finish. Most importantly, the food was delicious as always.. 😋 The Intercontinental brand never fails to impress me... We have eaten in Intercontinental hotels in Ho Chi Minh City and Da Nang as well... Wow! Three Spoons is very highly recommended, along with all of the other Intercontinental hotel restaurants!!
description: A lively restaurant with amazing skyline views over Hanoi, 3 Spoons not only offers the best, most extensive and energetic breakfast buffet, but also a choice of three wonderful cuisines in the world. Sample the most authentic dishes from the Vietnamese and Chinese cuisines, savour the freshest seafood from the Japanese kitchen, or enjoy fragrant Italian breads, pasta and stone-oven pizzas. 3 Spoons Restaurant is also the main setting of InterContinental Hanoi Landmark's monthly Edition Brunch – the most exclusive Sunday Brunch experience in Hanoi, organized with a different monthly theme on the first Sunday of every month. The brunch features the best in culinary from world-famous brands and all 4 of the hotel’s restaurants and bars. Live music and captivating entertainment, from fashion show to art gallery, are also offered every month, for the ultimate Sunday indulgence for all guests.

name: Pho Thin 1955
address: 61 Dinh Tien Hoang Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: After receiving a recommendation from a local tour guide, I visited on the evening of the last day of the trip. I actually liked the unique atmosphere of a local restaurant where English was not widely spoken. Even though I only said a simple greeting, I felt like everyone was looking at me favorably, so I felt relieved. The rice noodles came out just a minute after ordering, and the soup was thick. The fried food that my grandfather sold separately only cost 10,000 dong, and it was eaten dipped in soup. I think it is a restaurant with the right level of difficulty that allows you to feel the atmosphere and taste of a local restaurant, but is not too hard., The restaurant serves only one type of pho, beef pho, which features a thick broth and plenty of green onions. It is made by slowly simmering beef bones and is characterized by its deep richness and flavor. The noodles are soft and topped with plenty of green onions and herbs, which blend perfectly with the broth. On the table are condiments such as lime, garlic vinegar, and homemade chili sauce, allowing customers to change the flavor to their liking. The prices are quite reasonable, and those who want to enjoy the Vietnamese specialty pho in Hanoi should try it at this restaurant!, If you are a Pho lover, then you absolutely must check out this Pho restaurant. This is highly recommended by my Airbnb host, as well as other local foodie experts. It's a good sign when you see locals only. The place, a hole in the wall or actually in an alley with two long tables, shared table. This place only offers Beef Pho and does it very well! This is the original Pho Thin, the first location. A hole is the wall, situated on an alley. From the moment you walk in, you can smell the aroma of the rich broth and beef permeating the air. The clear broth looks simple however it packs a beefy and flavorful with a perfect balance of spices and seasoning that creates an authentic, one-of-a-kind taste. The beef is tender and generous portion. The noodles are perfectly cooked. Topped with a generous amount of green onions. Make sure to pair it with the Fried donuts and tea from the older man next door and must be paid separately. They have condiments available at the table to customize your taste. The garlic vinegar is great, chili oil paste, sliced chili, and lime. The service is fast, despite the language barrier. Just point out what you want. It's an outdoor dining, on an alley. No AC, just fans. Overall, this Pho restaurant is a must-visit for any food lover.
description: Pho Thin Bo Ho is the Phở restaurant established since 1955 by Mr Thin. From now, Pho Thin Bo Ho has 3 shops in Hanoi and 1 shop in HCM city, that has operated by Mr Thin' sons and daughters. The 1st one is located at 61 Dinh Tien Hoang street, Ha Noi, which has run by my father- mr Thin's 1st son. Pho Thin Bo Ho gets a good standing in Hanoian's heart and also visitors around the world.

name: Hanoi Oriana Restaurant
address: 38 Lo Su Street Eliana Signature Building - 8th Floor, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We enjoyed our meal on the 8th floor very much! The traditional Hanoi grilled pork was delicious, and the service was great. Everyone was very kind and welcoming. Ly, our waitress, was kind enough to show us how to eat the traditional dish. We would recommend this to anyone., Thanks for all the good food and comfortable ambience to do work Special gratitude to Ms. Ly who have been very kind in providing the guidance on the possible cuisine that i should have, to experience Vietnamese food & explaining very well in English Appreciate your overall team's kindness & hospitality., Oh my god! The food and service was out of this world! Alex was the star of the show and made the experience more than 5 stars.. he showed us how to eat the food to ensure we had the best experience, and it wouldn’t of been the same without his guidance and presence. This man (Alex) really is a testament to the place!
description: Oriana Restaurant located on 8th floor where you could get the great view of Old quarter We serve Vietnamese traditional food with Vegetarian and Vegan option we ensure that we will bring the fresh, tasty of authentic cuisine beside the friendly and informative staff team Welcome to Oriana Restaurant!

name: 5 Spice Restaurant
address: 27 Hong Phuc Nguyen Trung Truc Ward, Ba Dinh District, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This is a great place for dinner, service was outstanding the beer was superbly cold with a great variety of local beers. The food was delicious and our waiter Harry along with his colleague walked us back to our accommodation with umbrellas as it was raining heavily. Admittedly it was only a short distance but that is what i call fantastic service. We will be back for another meal tonight, We went to the restaurant as it was recommended by our tour guide. We went here early evening without booking and we were lucky to get a table as many tour guides use this as a restaurant serving a set menu for their tour groups. The restaurant is situated near the Old Quarter and serves traditional Vietnamese dishes. We found the food was excellent and service very good. I strongly recommend this restaurant but advise booking as it is used by tour groups., You can get a good meal here. The dessert (flambe banana crepe with slivered coconut, vanilla ice cream and chocolate syrup) was delicious. The birthday cake they served was good. There are framed traditional musical instruments mounted on the wall as decoration.
description: Located in the old quarter of Hanoi, 5 Spice is easily accessed from diffirent direction. It is surrounded by virant streets but also easy to stroll around, 5 Spice is ideal place to dine. Built in 1923, 5 Spice building is an old French house which belong to Frech family then Vietnamese deputy minister of finance. After many rich families lived here,since 2012, 5 Spice Restaurant was moved in running upto now. Is has 3 storeys with 4 dining room and 1 open terrace dining area. The restaurant capacity is 120 – 140 seats. Each room has diffirent style is design and decoration, also a private cosy atmosphere with diffirent size of dining rooms. It can accommodate varied sizes of groups. With our experiences, 5 Spice is always confident and ready in service of your valued passengers. Come to us and enjoy your meals!!!

name: An Bread
address: 04 Đình Ngang, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Excellent food, service and location. Beautifully presented food and drink. So tasty! Best Pho! Lovely people serving us. Can watch the train from train street pass by as you are eating and if you sit by entrance the people/moped watching is fabulous! Great value food! 👏, What a great little find, we sat on the footpath and enjoyed wonderful egg coffees, wine coffee, salted coffee we also ordered food spring rolls. Staff were nice my favorite thing was their art coffees. Definitely worth a visit., We ended up here by chance this evening and were absolutely delighted: for the usual small sum for Vietnamese cuisine, we had the best meal of our trip so far. And the exceptionally friendly service here is also worth mentioning. Absolutely recommended!
description: Excellent food, service and location. Beautifully presented food and drink. So tasty! Best Pho! Lovely people serving us. Can watch the train from train street pass by as you are eating and if you sit by entrance the people/moped watching is fabulous! Great value food! 👏

name: Nabemono Wagyu Hotpot Buffet
address: 8th Floor, 12-14 Nguyen Quang Bich, Cua Dong, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Wow! What a fabulous meal. Huyen Yu, was our server and brought her beautiful smile to serve us along with the tastiest of food. The 2 of us ordered the medium priced wagyu hot pot along with a side mango salad and summer rolls. Everything was so fresh and tasty. Highly recommended! If I wasn’t leaving the city, I’d most definitely be back. 😋, The restaurant is located inside the hotel, and provides 10% off for guests staying at the hotel. It serves Japanese style hot pot with Wagyu beef. The quality of the beef tasted like Angus but I guess any beef that comes from Japan could be called Wagyu? No idea. It just tasted very rough and not like a regular Wagyu eaten in Japan. It was a slow night at the restaurant and there were only 4 tables including us. The environment was nice, veggies were all-you-can-eat free refill, and we generally had a nice time. The service was pretty great, and our server, Huyen, has been helpful and nice!, Really sweet. If you're missing a meal (but lunch) Come on. Well, I've been here for four hours for dessert meals and fruit. If you ask for Kim Chi, you'll have Kim Chi at breakfast. Beef and Vegetables 3 mins per person!!! The servers were very friendly and we were the only ones in the hall who asked us what we needed.
description: All you can eat buffet served with 100% authentic wagyu beef

name: Spice Viet
address: 46 Nguyen Truong To Ba Dinh Dist., Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We were so pleased to have found Spice Viet Hanoi after a full day of sightseeing. The food here is beautifully presented and the flavours are incredible. We enjoyed mixed and vegetable spring rolls followed by chicken pho and pork belly with noodles. The service was second to none, both our servers were very attentive. All in all a great place to enjoy some great food!, We went with a group of 10 . A beautiful night had by all - the food was delicious, well presented and thoroughly enjoyable - we all enjoyed all that was served. Congratulations to the staff for their professionalism, eagerness to please - all with a pleasant disposition. Thank you for a wonderful dining experience., Verrrrry kind staffs so glad to your great service! All servers care for us any time we want. It was very happy dinner at this restaurant. Foods taste delicious (especially duck spring roll she-maybe kind manager recommended us). Have to visit once again another time. Today meal was the best thing I've experienced in Hanoi. Thank you for your service again!
description: Just a 10-minute walk north of Hanoi’s Old Quarter, Spice Viet Hanoi Restaurant specialises in farm-to-table Vietnamese cuisine in a cosy, contemporary setting. Our extensive menu features both Hanoi specialties like West Lake-style shrimp fritters and pan-fried fish flavoured with turmeric and galangal as well as favourites from the length of Vietnam.

name: Timeline Coffee & Restaurant
address: 7 P. Đinh Liệt Hàng Bạc, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Great spot to sit - eat, drink and watch people pass below. Annie was a pleasure to be served by - she was lovely, very polite and happy to help with directions and generally with our food, I hope to see Annie in Australia one day! We also had the pleasure of being joined by two kids; who were very well behaved and always left when you said ‘okay time for me to eat!’ Food was priced higher than most places, but worth it for the view and the experience from the staff. Thank you again Annie!, The spot is nice for dinner. Unfortunately it rained, but the waiters quickly rearranged the parasols so we didn't get wet outside. You can order a variety of local vietnamese food that tastes good. We recommend the vegetarian spring rolls., I Would highly recommend this place for food and drinks, very chilled vibes and great staff, catered to all my needs and I was well looked after. The pho was top notch and great draft beer, perfect for solo travelers and couples, anyone who wants some great food and drinks with a nice view of the street below from the balcony. Please visit you will not be disappointed.
description: we are know as local restaurant in Hanoi old quarter, with special vietnamese foods...

name: May De Cuisine - Vietnamese Restaurant
address: 107 Ma May Ward Hang Buom, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: From the warm greeting at the door, to the polished but friendly service, May De Cuisine excels in all areas. The menu is a broad representation of northern Vietnamese cooking, with extensive a la carte and set menu meals, including vegetarian choices. Set on three or four floors of a quaint restored old building in the bustling Old Quarter, May De Cuisine is a quiet oasis of comfortable seating and large portions. The set menu of four courses ordered was almost too much for one meal, but we tried our best, as the food was prepared and presented with such care. In particular, the young server named Timber was charming and attentive without fail, with excellent English skills., Recently visited a restaurant and the experience was extremely positive. From the very first minutes, attention to detail was noticeable – the interior is cozy, with pleasant lighting and comfortable atmosphere. The staff is polite and friendly, the waiters (Timber) are excellent at navigating the menu and are always available to help with the selection., We were taken to this fine restaurant by or guide Sammy N. She ordered a variety of dishes to try and I wish I could tel you what they were in Vietnamese. We had a delicious smoked duck salad, fried crispy white fish, chicken and cashew stirfry, steamed vegetables, soup and a chocolate dessert. Great service and nice location.
description: May De Cuisine – The perfect destination for ALL who love Vietnamese culture expressed in food!! In the middle of the bustling Old Quarter of ancient Hanoi, May De Cuisine's Oriental cuisine is like a romantic stopover for tourists from all over Vietnam. Come to May De Cuisine, and you, too, will have a unique Vietnamese culinary experience, where delicate and beautiful dishes are created from the heart of our artisan chefs. Not only delicious, Vietnamese dishes with rich menus and seasonal updates, are created through the rich and the loving care of our incredible chef. In a rustic and intimate historic space, the symphony between the emotions of taste, smell, sight and touch will be our great gift to you on your journey as you explore our beautiful capital, Hanoi. May De Cuisine – The perfect destination for ALL who love Vietnamese culture expressed in food!!

name: Xoi Yen
address: 35b Nguyen Huu Huan Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: I visited at dinner time, so the big three-story store was crowded with what looked like tourists and locals. There are also English words on the menu table, so first, I choose from three types of base okowa: turmeric, corn, and white rice. Next, you choose toppings, which can be chicken, grilled pork, boiled egg, or deep-fried fish, but there is also a mix if you don’t have to choose. It was quite voluminous so I was full. The bill is a postpaid payment at the cash register, but the price is written on the slip, so even if you don’t understand the language, you can still do something about it., At the end of the Ninh Ben tour, we were taken to a Bun Cha restaurant for free, but I had eaten there the day before and didn't really like it. When I told the guide, he took me to this restaurant because it is famous for its okowa. I arrived around 7pm, but it was very crowded and I finally managed to get a seat. To order, first you ask if you want your okowa plain or with corn, and if you want chicken, pork or beef as toppings. The local guide helped me with the order, such as whether I wanted it steamed or fried, which was helpful. I ordered a simple okowa with steamed chicken. It was refreshing and easy to eat even in the heat, and it was delicious. I added soy sauce halfway through and it changed the flavor and was delicious., Excellent!!! The place was crowded with Vietnamist people. They have rice with different toppings you can choose. Rice could be traditional sticky rice, turmeric sticky rice etc and toppings like chicken, beef, mushrooms etc The price was really cheap, we paid around 4-5€ for everything.

name: Som Tam Thai
address: 11B Hai Bà Trưng Phường Tràng Tiền, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Great spot. Just me being pedantic and rarely giving out 5’s. Would recommend to anyone looking for Nice clean and tasty dinner., This restaurant has excellent location. Not too crowded in the evening but busy during lunchtime due to all the office buildings around. Better go in the evening for leisurely atmosphere, Good food. Good location. Portion sizes were a bit hard to guess. Portion of some dishes are so small and some unexpectedly huge. Overall good taste.
description: Great spot. Just me being pedantic and rarely giving out 5’s. Would recommend to anyone looking for Nice clean and tasty dinner.

name: SportivO Bar
address: 39 Hang Buom Street, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 11010 Vietnam
reviews: Great sports bar with multiple screens. Ice cold beer and bar food available; can highly recommend the spring rolls. Professional and friendly bar staff make for a wonderful experience!, A great sports bar in Hanoi with a number of large screens in order to watch sports late at night or during the day. The beer on offer covers the north and south of Vietnam and there are a selection of craft beers available. The food was good and I would recommend it to any sports fan in the area. We also liked the football team pillows., This great sports bar went out of their way to make sure that I could watch a UK rugby match late in the Ha Noi night - despite my being the only person there who was interested in te game. I dropped in earlier in the day and made an enquiry. Half an hour later Ha Anh, the brilliant manager, dropped me a note to confirm that all systems were go (despite all sorts of technical difficulties). Sure enough, when I turned up all was ready: I saw the game (don't ask!) and enjoyed several pints of excellent witbier to accompany the action. Many, many thanks. This is a place worthy of recommendation.
description: The best sport bar in the heart of Old quarter where you can find Premium draft beers, classic/signature cocktails, sports events broadcasting with 4k tv screen. In addition we offer a variety of selections for exquisite food with both western and local fusion. With outstanding location, open environment for family gatherings or intimacy dates , great options for team-building events, information exchange spot for tourists. A place that will be the highlight of your staying in Hanoi.

name: Pizza 4P's Phan Ke Binh
address: 05 Phan Ke Binh Ba Dinh, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We walked to this branch from our Airbnb soon as we dropped our bags. We went to the Hoan Kiem branch 3 years ago. Service crew are amazing as expected. Not all speaks good English but they all do speak a lot of English. The cheese are all home made and the dishes are very reasonably priced., We have an amazing dinner with Pizza 4Ps. Never ever disapointed me. I love all kind of cheese in here. And burrata salad also. The staff is friendly and attentive, always making sure to provide excellent service. Overall, Pizza 4P's is a top-quality pizza joint that offers unique and delicious pies that will leave you wanting more. The fantastic ambiance and friendly service make for a truly enjoyable dining experience., Overall, this place was very good. The staff was very accommodating even though our wait time for our pizza and seats was well over an hour each. They offered good service and provided our table with complementary dessert due to the issues that we unfortunately experienced; which is why I gave them 4stars. This type of customer service was excellent and is not very common. The pizza itself was good, I donâ€™t think itâ€™s the very best in Hanoi, but it was good. Very crowded and busy, with a nice atmosphere, the prices are decent and you do get a good portion size. Follow @travelingypsey on Instagram & GoogleMaps!!! Pictured is the Mushroom Pizza!
description: An Earth to People restaurant on a mission to make the world smile for peace, one pizza at a time. Earth to People is our commitment to serve safe and fresh foods directly from Mother Earth to you. Located in Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Danang and Nha Trang.

name: La Table Hanoia
address: 12 Lý Đạo Thành Tràng Tiền, Hoàn Kiếm, Tầng 3 tòa nhà Press Club, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Small five stars. My boyfriend and I had three courses for lunch and drinks. Close to four stars, which is because the elements on the plate were anonymous, and without particularly interesting taste or texture. The rest was excellent though. The waiter recommended the Pho cocktail to me, which was the most interesting feature of the lunch, both in the way it was made and the way the drink tasted. Great decor and wonderful staff., Came here with my mom for a fine lunch. 1. Location: in the middle of Hanoi, luxury area but not too vibrant. Should come here on a sunny day to take marvellous photos on the street 2. Space: The restaurant has different areas to choose based on your interest, I chose a perfect table next to the window with an outstanding view to Sofitel Metropole Hotel across the road. Design is high-end but not overwhelmed, not too crowded. Such a perfect place for lowkey people like me. 3. Food: We got Temptation Set Menu with 3 courses, freshly start with smoked salmon salad & creamy cauliflower soup. Beef filet with red wine sauce was too good to be true. The most impressive thing was strawberry sorbet, fantastic ending. It’s was a pity that seafood quenelle failed though…the French oyster’s smell wasn’t processed well. 4. Suitable for: family, couples 5. Price: 690,000++vnd/ 3 courses (drinks excluded) Overall: definitely gonna come back to discover more, The food was excellent and the service was very efficient and friendly. The whole evening was made perfect with a live piano performance during the evening. We ate 2 of the beef dishes and both were lovely and share a prawn dish to start which really was delightful
description: La Table Hanoia aspires to be more than a fine dining establishment or a modern cocktail bar. Our foundations are inspired by inspiration itself. That drive to find beauty wherever it may hide. But the pursuit of beauty is understanding the process behind it. The journey it takes from nothing to perfection. And that is what we attempt to achieve here. Set above the famous Journalist Association, home to writers and journalists since the war, we are intended as a tribute to the finest creations by the gesture of the hand. Here at La Table Hanoia we strive to offer creations of beauty. From our fine gourmet selection of foods to the location’s elegant design. The seamless service to the atmosphere of casual grace, not to mention our unique and award-winning cocktails. La Table Hanoia welcomes you.

name: Pho Ly Quoc Su
address: 18 Le Truc, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: A Michelin starred restaurant (previously) so we definitely have to try, right? Came here for dinner and it had a snaking queue when we arrived. I think we queued for 30mins+ before finally having a table to sit. And even then, they put us beside another family haha. Prepare to sit with anyone as long as there are available seats! Dinner was great and I spent about 90K VND- $5 sgd for a steaming bowl of delicious soup. Beef was half done as I requested and the broth was really good as well. Would come back here again for sure. The time taken to queue though leaves the experience a bit unsatisfactory., We visited this restaurant because they sell mainly vermicelli noodles. The dish is called pho it was mentioned quite a lot before we came to Vietnam. Most people complimented this as a delicious dish that definitely we must try when we come here we ordered two bowls of beef pho, it was really good. But what I don't like is that the beef noodle soup has too many onions and the wait staff is also quite long so I don't like it very much., I quite like the food here, I find the broth of the dish very delicious and rich, the noodles are soft and the beef that is cooked with is also seasoned very well. You can also order more cakes to eat with vermicelli noodles, I see they also give me an extra portion of raw vegetables. The restaurant staff said that the Vietnamese way of eating is to mix raw vegetables and eat with vermicelli noodles. It really tastes so much better
