name: Hanoi 1930 Bistro
address: 2 floor, 1 Dinh Tien Hoang Hang Bac, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We were there on 1st jan and we wanted to have a seat on the outside to njoy the view but was said no by the rude manager who wasnt willing to let us sit outdoors even though there were empty seats. We were willing to wait for the guest to leave to sit outside but the rude manager didnt even feel the necessity to listen to us. One of the worst human interaction ever experienced. Very let down The food was very good and the other staffs were very helpful althought they all seem hungover from the new year celebrations The chicken claypot rice is a must try, Very central location, right on the lake. Go up to the first floor and you are greeted with great courtesy. I'm not an expert on Vietnamese cuisine but we ate well. Everything seemed good and the service was very attentive to the customer. I would definitely go back, This restaurant is perfectly situated in the Old Quarter, opposite the Hoàn Kiem Lake, you have an aerial view of the bustle below. We ordered the coconut palm heart salad with prawn and pork. This is the most flavoursome salad I've ever tasted, complimented with crushed peanut, a light sweet 'n sour sauce and mint leaves. We shared crab spring rolls as an additional treat. A simple, light refreshing lunch, perfect in this climate. The restaurant has a lovely relaxed vibe and our waitron, Hong Van, was attentive and very welcoming. This was another awesome experience.
description: HANOI 1930 BISTRO-A must-stop destination for tourists coming to Hanoi!Coming to HaNoi 1930 Bistro, do not forget to enjoy European cuisine with pizza, burgers, spaghetti,...and discover the famous traditional dishes of Hanoi such as Hanoi spring rolls,Traditional Cha Ca, bun cha..!You can see the beautiful Hoan Kiem Lake with the ancient Turtle Tower-an unforgettable place when coming to HaNoi!

name: Pizza Lovers
address: Số 7 Chợ Gạo Hàng Buồm, Hoàn Kiếm, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We found this place by accident whilst looking for somewhere to eat. We ate at the 2c Nguyen Truang To location. With just a small seating area, a great menu catering for westerns who like Pizza, Pasta and Nachos. I had a vegetarian lovers pizza (medium size) and it was delicious. Good range of drinks, including a cider (the first I had in Vietnam). They understood English well and catered for vegetarians and gluten free diets., The Bacon Mushroom pizza was fantastic. Our waitress spoke English very well and helped us select a good bottle of red wine to go with our pizza. We ate on the 2nd floor overlooking the street below. Many pictures of celebrities eating pizza, we assume these pics were taken here but we don't know for sure. The pizza is a 'must try' we found it to be exceptional., I love this place. We were in Hanoi for 4 days and ate here twice. Could have happily gone a third time. The pizza is excellent. New York style thin crust. Service is solid and the 80’s/90’s hard rock vibe only enhances the pizza eating experience. Also, great beer selection. We’ve been traveling for about 4 months and this is the best pizza we’ve found so far. Do it!
description: We found this place by accident whilst looking for somewhere to eat.  We ate at the 2c Nguyen Truang To location.  With just a small seating area, a great menu catering for westerns who like Pizza, Pasta and Nachos.  I had a vegetarian lovers pizza (medium size) and it was delicious.  Good range of drinks, including a cider (the first I had in Vietnam).  They understood English well and catered for vegetarians and gluten free diets.

name: Green Farm Restaurant
address: 44B Dao Duy Tu, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: My partner and l pulled into this restaurant and had a fantastic experience. It was extremely busy tho they separated 2tables and sat us down with ease. Because it is busy one must take into consideration that there will be a waiting process. We only ordered on main set dish between us which took around 30minutes which was fine. The meal was well presented, fresh and extremely flavourful. I must say the wine was extremely overpriced or the young fella didnâ€™t really know the prices and may have got it mixed up with another bottle of wine so l let it go. Itâ€™s quite an interesting layout as thereâ€™s rooms further into the restaurant and they seem to keep going as l ended up near a clay pizza oven looking for the toilet ðŸ˜€, The scallops were delicious, the meat was cooked perfectly, I really enjoyed the dauphinoise with truffles and the lobster mac and cheese. We shared the cherry pie, which was delicious. All together, we had a very pleasant evening and the waiters were very attentive, constantly refilling our water and wine glasses. The service is very great, Great food we loved it They had a separate vegetarian menu which made my wife very happy. Anna the waitress who served us was so helpful and gave great advice on what to choose and how to eat it. Eat here you wonâ€™t be disappointed
description: Green Farm Restaurant combines the best of traditional Vietnamese of both vegetarian and original cuisines international. Our menu offers a wide range of meals, from traditional countryside dishes to western-inspired, all at a very affordable price. Our skilled kitchen team sources only the freshest and finest ingredients to guarantee the high standard of all our dishes. The vintage-styled restaurant offers more than just great food, but also a home away from home. The friendly and helpful staff ensures everyone leaves satisfied. Our upstairs private dining area is the perfect venue for any special event or celebration. Our barmen produce the finest fresh fruit juices and shakes, as well as delicious cocktails and beer. We open at 9: 00am to 10:30pm from the Breakfast to the late night meal. We also the foods delivery. Our Cooking Class is open daily from 9 am or 3 pm . Cooking Class to invite our guests to discover how authentic Vietnamese food is cooked for themselves.

name: Le Jardin - French Bistro
address: 54 Quang An, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We went for brunch due to the reviews. However to our surprise, the brunch/breakfast menu is limited. Having said that, it was very good. We had a couple of special "pho" dishes, with some other bits and pieces and some Vietnamese coffee (remember to specify "hot" if you like it that way). Despite me planning on a very different brekkie, the pho with a couple of poached eggs was excellent. We practically rolled out of the place. Not very busy, and pretty good service - just try to time your visit when the place next door is not undergoing construction so you don't have to listen to the concrete mixer and pump operating at full noise. Will be back one day to try out the French cuisine., Fantastic food and service! This restaurant offers a full menu with both fish and meat. We had the lamb chops and the osso bucco which were not delicious! Topped it off with a lavender crème brûlée. If you’re in Hanoi and want a change of food, this is the place!, We got a Grab cab to take us to this location as it was across from one of the many little lakes in and around Hanoi. It just made the feel of the place like we where somewhere in France. The Food was really good and it was as good as anything we have consumed in Brisbane. The cocktails where good too and we had a few. Would go back there again for a great meal!
description: Le Jardin, French Bistro - Overlooking at the beautiful Westlake "Tay Ho" Newly open, enjoy seating in the relaxing open air garden or cozy indoor bistro Private room also available upon reservation Our talented chef's prepare a French Mediterranean cuisine, using the best of local and imported ingredients Our friendly expat and local service team will be glad to host you and guide you through an unforgettable dining experience The wine list offers a selection of over 40 wines from the new and the old world

name: Aummee Vegetarian Restaurant
address: 26 Chau Long Street Ba Dinh District, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: I came here for the first time on my close friends' birthday and surprisingly we did order almost every dish in the menu. Each of the dish really satisfied us with great flavour and nice decoration. Another advantage is the cozy atmosphere and well-designed interior!, Really enjoyed our meal at Aummee! Really easy to find situated in the Old Quarter. There was a fantastic range of Vietnamese food with a good range of vegetarian options as well as meat served. Fantastic service and the staff even spoke some English! Would definitely recommend! Thank you so much, Excellent food and very nice staff. We ordered the spicy soup and the square spring rolls. The spice level of the soup was high but tolerable even as an european.
description: Aummee was born from the desire to create a high - end vegetarian dining space, where each guest comes not only to eat, but to savor and rediscover a sense of inner peace. With four spacious floors, each covering up to 130m² and accommodating up to 150 guests in total, Aummee offers a serene, Zen-inspired atmosphere. Every corner is thoughtfully designed to evoke relaxation and tranquility amidst the bustle of the city. Each dish at Aummee is crafted from the freshest, cleanest ingredients - free from preservatives, excessive additives, or artificial meat substitutes - preserving the natural purity and nourishment of plant-based cuisine.

name: A Bản Mountain Dew
address: 76 Trần Phú, Điện Biên, Ba Đình, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Such a great place to try excellent food, and learn about some of the ethnic minorities in Vietnam. The servers make you feel at home, carefully providing tips and tricks for how to eat the various dishes. In terms of ambiance, the restaurant is a work of art. Natural wood, mixed metals, lush foliage, lanterns and a waterfall make the space truly exceptional., Very authentic experience right from the very first steps of entering the restaurant: it feels like you are in the mountain forest with ethnic music and waterfall sounds on the background. The menu is very diverse featuring the cuisine of minorities of Tay Bac and all the ingredients and marination come from those areas. Highly recommend the grilled pork with Mac Khen berries, colorful sticky rice naturally colored by various herbs and the steamed chicken with rice in the leaf. A wonderful night out!, In the heart of Hanoi, you can cross a door and being projected in a place far away from the crowded streets of this beautiful town. Here you can taste a bite of the northern cosine, finally something different from the week known Pho. Dish selection is amazing, but many are either seasonal, or pre-order ones, hence remember to ask. Service is very professional and super kind. Price are more then honest and affordable. My suggestion: don't miss it if you're looking for genuine taste
description: We bring the culinary traditions of ethnic minorities to the city.

name: Pho Cuon 31
address: 31 Ngu Xa Ba Dinh, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: The have an English menu and it has a whole page of vegetarian dishes. Located along a street with other restaurants - many who also have the words Pho Cuon in name, this one is number 31 and in a corner. At first, it looked like place was full, but a waiter ushered us upstairs via a staircase behind the cashier. L2 was also full, so we went up to level 3 - where u have to put your shoes in a cabinet, and eat seating on the floor as the tables were low. I enjoyed my food, which came fast enough, seeing how busy the place was. I had the rice paper sheet rolled with tofu, and shared a plate of stir fried vegetables. The portions were hearty. We spent less than VND 300K for 3 dishes and 2 non-alcoholic drinks. Would definitely recommend this as a place to go to for some good and affordable local food., Stopped here on a Vespa Adventures tour and had GREAT food, plus Truc Bach beer -- only found in this area of Vietnam. Both food and beer were EXCELLENT. The food is totally authentic and the story of how the owner developed his special pho recipe is fun. HIGHLY recommend!!, We were touring Viet Nam with our guide David Nguyen. He suggested this restaurant and we couldn't be happier. The food was delicious. We ate upstairs and were very comfortable. David did the ordering and we had a wonderful lunch.
description:
The have an English menu and it has a whole page of vegetarian dishes. 

Located along a street with other restaurants - many who also have the words Pho Cuon in name, this one is number 31 and in a corner.

At first, it looked like place was full, but a waiter ushered us upstairs via a staircase behind the cashier. L2 was also full, so we went up to level 3 - where u have to put your shoes in a cabinet, and eat seating on the floor as the tables were low.

I enjoyed my food, which came fast enough, seeing how busy the place was. I had the rice paper sheet rolled with tofu, and shared a plate of stir fried vegetables. The portions were hearty.  We spent less than VND 300K for 3 dishes and 2 non-alcoholic drinks. 

Would definitely recommend this as a place to go to for some good and affordable local food.

name: Dana Vegan House - Nhà Chay Dana
address: 12 Phố Đông Thái, Phường Hàng Buồm, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Had dinner here with my family and friends in this cozy restaurant. The atmosphere was good. Decoration is great We love the fried mushrooms dish. Ordered 1 and add 2 more plates afterwards. the mushroom with powdered grilled rice from Nam Định was nice too. Price is reasonable., An incredible hidden gem in Hanoi. The vegan food is excellent, the restaurant is stylish, there is air conditioning and a bathroom, and the staff are attentive and friendly. I do not speak Vietnamese but they let me pick off a menu of images to choose what I would like to eat. I appreciate them accommodating me despite my lack of language skills. You should be happy to eat lunch and dinner there every day you are in town. Non-vegans and any kind of foodie would enjoy!, Went for a tasty dinner at Dana, a new vegan restaurant in Hanoi, after walking past earlier in the day. The menu is reassuringly small but still with enough variety to make it interesting. We had a salad, gnocchi curry, rice and pickled veg - the rice with seaweed and salt garnish was surprisingly good, the pickled veg crunchy and light, and the curry was nicely spiced without being too heavy. Only the salad was less than perfect, lacking cohesion with a seemingly random selection of fruit and nuts included. But it was all fresh and light enough to not be a problem. The other dishes worked well together and served in just the right quantity for the 2 of us. As good as, if not better than, the food is the interior decor. Solid wood furniture, beautiful lighting and an open design made it feel relaxed and it was a pleasure to eat here.
description: Vietnamese Vegan Cuisine with a touch of modern. A Vegan spot in Hanoi Old Quarter with a full-filled vibe of Vietnamese Culture and a rice gain story concept.

name: Pizza Belga - Hang Be street
address: 47 Hang Be, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: I don't know if I will be impartial in this review, probably not, but I had been eating rice, noodels and spring rolls for a week now, and I needed a proper pizza. I ordered the Caprichosa, I think it was, with mushrooms, black olives and bacon but the bacon is not fat, it's like bacon, it's very thin and very cooked, it's delicious. The dough and tomato sauce are also very good, very Neapolitan. The price is Western, yes, I think the pizzas were around 10-12 euros in exchange, but it was worth it to me, the truth is that it saved the day., Occasionally you fancy a change from the standard (delicious) Vietnamese food, and this place came well reviewed. Its close to "Beer Street" in the Old Quarter and was a good mixture of busy, but with enough tables to accomodate us easily. The real pizza oven was a welcome sight as you enter the restaurant. We ordered 3 pizzas - a standard Margarita, a hot honey (with pepperoni and soft, sweet cheese), and one with anchovies and olivies. Surprisingly they only had a single Saigon beer left in the whole restaurant, which we thought might be a ploy to upsell the more expensive craft and Belgian beers. The Saigon cider wasn't a bad substitute at D100k. All 3 pizzas were good - probably quite similar to a good Uk Pizza Express standard, perhaps a bit better, if not quite Naples or Rome levels. Nice thin bases, doughy edges, with tasty toppings - the anchovies in particular combined nicely with the capers. We thought the price a bit on the high side by Vietnam standards - D950k or around £34, hence the one star off. Nice pizza though., The pizza’s are very good tasting, the restaurant is very neat and the staff is very friendly. They also serve some Belgian beers, the price for them is of course higher because they are imported. Highly recommended if you want to eat pizza in Ha Noi. I would personally skip the Belgian beers, and consume them in Belgium, and stick to Vietnamese beers or some other drinks.
description: Pizza Belga is Hanoi’s most authentic Neapolitan pizzeria, located in the heart of Hanoi. Our pizzas are baked in a wood-fired oven and generously topped with fresh and carefully selected ingredients. The food menu including a selection of homemade pasta and signature desserts is accompanied by a large choice of craft beers. Join us to discover the real taste of Naples

name: Veggie Castle - Nha Hang Chay Vegan
address: 7 Yen Ninh Ba Dinh, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Don't judge a book by its cover! The road that leads to this restaurant might put u off! But this is a hidden gem for vegetarians! The food was excellent! They had so many Asian choices, Italian choices, dessert, fruits, fresh juices, soups, rice variety(white and brown), noodles etc. The ambience, decor of the restaurant was nice and calm. The buffet price for one person was SGD$6 . It was just a 3 mnt walk from our accommodation. There is an over bridge road construction going on in the main road, so little difficult to find this restaurant if you are travelling from another area in Hanoi., We went to this restraint two times because the food was so good. It’s a small place run by a lady and her family. She is happy and friendly to everyone. The food was different both times but it’s all very delicious and we liked to try all the different ones. The fruit juices are nice too. We want to recommend for you to go here., This place was like no other I have eaten at all over Southeast Asia for the last six weeks.The vegan buffet was such an incredible deal at 80,000 dong ( less than 3,50 US dollars) Every item available was tasty, very varied and not real greasy or salty. I would recommend this place to anyone who is looking for vegan or vegetarian options and is on a budget. Thank you Veggie Castle!
description: Fresh vegan buffet, no mock meat.

name: The Symphony Restaurant
address: 7th Floor, 01 Cau Go, Hang Bac, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 7th Floor Of The La Sinfonia Majesty Hotel And Spa, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: I have to give a lot of praise to The Symphony restaurant. The location and view are super nice for taking photos, with a panoramic view of Hoan Kiem Lake. The restaurant manager and other employees are enthusiastic, friendly and always pay attention to how guests feel when dining. I only stayed 2 nights so I didn't have a chance to try many dishes at the restaurant, but the breakfast food was very delicious, rich and beautifully presented. In addition to the buffet counter, ask the staff to enjoy more Hanoi pho and egg dishes. I will definitely introduce my friends to this restaurant if I have the opportunity to visit Hanoi. 🤍, The dinner room is very well designed and decorated, a very relaxed and romantic environment that comes with delicious food and great service. Waiter was proactive, responsive and smiling. A great time and place for dinner., The dining experience at the hotel restaurant was characterized by a stylish, elegant, and warm atmosphere. We were serve by gentle guy - Thai , exuded friendliness and warmth, providing attentive service throughout. We enjoyed a delightful French Sauvignon Blanc paired with a flavorful beef bourguignon..... The restaurant offered lovely views overlooking the Old Quarter rooftops, enhancing the overall experience.
description: Fine Dining restaurant in Hanoi serving Fine dining food, fusion food and Vietnamese cuisine

name: Pho Ga Nguyet
address: 5b Phu Doan Street Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This is a famous chicken pho restaurant in the old town, my favorite restaurant since before it was so famous. The restaurant opens late for people like me who come home from work late at night. The restaurant on the sidewalk of Phu Doan street is very easy to find. I often eat pho wings because the chicken skin here is very delicious and crispy. I like it. In terms of price, the price is high because it is sold late at night. The pho is moderately delicious, but some days the broth has a lot of ginger flavor, which I don't like, but it's okay, the restaurant is still delicious. If you order at once, you'll have a delicious hot bowl of pho with peach branches after a stressful day at work. Delicious and nutritious, We ate here on our first night in Vietnam and then again 3 weeks later on our penultimate night, it was that good. They do the dry and the soupy pho, you pick the type of chicken you want (I recommend the thigh & breast combo) and then whether you want it dry or as soup. Both are amazing. The dry one is Hanoi speciality and comes with a small bowl of the broth. Definitely get the fried beef sticks too (they are 10k VND). The chilli sauce and pickled garlic on the tables are great accompaniments. Meal & drinks for two people for around £6. Amazing!, Chicken pho is famous in Hanoi. When you visit the restaurant at 12 o'clock at night, you will still be served very enthusiastically and quickly. Delicious pho, especially mixed pho, chicken breast but still attractive and filling. Ideal place to eat at night..!
description: This is a famous chicken pho restaurant in the old town, my favorite restaurant since before it was so famous. The restaurant opens late for people like me who come home from work late at night. The restaurant on the sidewalk of Phu Doan street is very easy to find. I often eat pho wings because the chicken skin here is very delicious and crispy. I like it. In terms of price, the price is high because it is sold late at night. The pho is moderately delicious, but some days the broth has a lot of ginger flavor, which I don't like, but it's okay, the restaurant is still delicious. If you order at once, you'll have a delicious hot bowl of pho with peach branches after a stressful day at work. Delicious and nutritious

name: Ming Restaurant
address: 1 Thanh Nien road, Ba Dinh district, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: We were staying at the Pan Pacific for three nights as part of our Viking Mekong river cruise. Aside from the Pan Pacific being a wonderful hotel, Viking made special arrangements for our breakfast buffet at the Ming restaurant. It was great to have the whole restaurant to ourselves for about 80 people. Outstanding breakfast buffet including both Western and Asian options. The woman who made Pho each morning was cheery and so very friendly though she spoke little English. The Pho was outstanding. The Asian options varied each day so you got to try different dim sums and other dishes. Plenty of pastries, fruit, juices, yogurts, etc. Can certainly get eggs., A fabulous Chinese Restaurant inside Pan Pacific Hotel. We wanted to have dim sums. It was the best choice. The menu is extensive and our hostess Anh was very knowledgeable so we let her bring us her recommendations. The buffet menu has everything you can imagine. We loved the shrimp and scallop dumplings. They were just perfectly steamed and crunchy. Just heavenly! Don't have breakfast so you can enjoy all that the menu has to offer. We had a feast! Great place for a big group to share. The price is very affordable compared to Singapore., The restaurant is located on the 2nd floor of the hotel, beautiful view, open space, delicious food, especially dimsum dishes. Reasonable price, free wifi and parking. The staffs are very enthusiastic and professional. Suitable for both family and company parties. My family's favorite restaurant ❤️
description: A fine destination for people who wish to enjoy Chinese cuisines in an Oriental ambiance. Over 80 courses of Dim Sum specials and two private rooms make it an ideal venue for family gatherings as well as business luncheons.

name: Nhà hàng Thai Opera
address: 33 Trang Tien Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: We are from Thailand. To be at the Thai restaurant in another country is always a little skeptical. However we have to say the food here is really authentic. We don’t miss home another more after our visit! The service staff is really polite and friendly. It is the best choice of us to be here!, One of best Thai cuisine restaurant I’ve ever tried in Hanoi. I had the chance to meet the Thai chef and followed his recomendation. You all should try pad Thai, seafood hotpot. Service is also excellent., We had low expectations when we decided on this restaurant but it definitely exceeded our expectations. It is owned by a Thai owner and has Thai chef.
description:
We are from Thailand. To be at the Thai restaurant in another country is always a little skeptical. However we have to say the food here is really authentic. We don’t miss home another more after our visit!
The service staff is really polite and friendly. 
It is the best choice of us to be here!

name: Green Mango
address: 16-18/52 To Ngoc Van Tay Ho District, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Hai is not only a brilliant chef and a gifted teacher but also a lovely person. We really can’t decide which of the eight dishes we made was the best! The techniques we learned were invaluable, and the conviviality was unforgettable. If you are interested in Vietnamese food this is something you should not miss., Came here for the Baileys Milkshake- was going to stay for dinner but the restaurant was completely empty so decided against it. Drink was fabulous though., I just finished the cooking class at Green Mango. The experience was awesome, the chef instructor Mr Han was very helpful, he took us to the local market to pick out the ingredients that we will be cooking. He explained step by step what he was doing, got the class to participate in the preparation and cooking of our lunch app/ entree/ desert!❤️ I definitely recommend Green Mango for cooking classes or for dining! Thanks so much Mr Han for the unforgettable experience !!! Kind regards Mike from Bermuda 🌴
description: After nearly 10 years Green Mango changed its location from 18 Hang Quat, Hoan Kiem, Ha Noi to 22 Tong Duy Tan, Hoan Kiem. The menu has been slightly changed but we kept our concept and our standards: Asian and international food fusion​ using only the best fresh products. Our new venue provides different areas and atmospheres. We do have an outside seating for you to watch the passing crowd while sipping your cocktail and also a backyard garden with fans and coolers for a more lounge/intimate dining experience. Upstairs, two private rooms with air conditioning can host your special events such as birthday parties or wine tastings. If you are looking for a nice atmosphere and a wide option of food and beverages in the center of Hanoi then Green Mango is definitely the place to go. We are open from 7:00 AM to 2 AM, late night dinner, early breakfast, happy hour... Plenty of reasons to step in! Our young and dynamic team is looking forward to welcoming you!

name: Bún Chả
address: Số 46 Nguyễn Hữu Huân Lý Thái Tổ, Hoàn Kiếm, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Whilst on my travels in Hanoi, my brother asked me to try Bun Cha - we were recommended this place by a local Vietnamese person and it did not disappoint! We went for set menu 1 which consisted of rice noodles with a broth, a pancake roll (their own version) 4 pork skewers (2 meatball and the other sliced marinated pork) together with a drink of your choice. The whole thing was delicious and an amazing experience - we even saw the skewers being made. We would definitely recommend and return here. Cam on 🙏🏻, I love this Bun cha place so much! I first visited in August 2022 along with a friend, and it was by chance. Since then i have already been here several times. I love their bun cha here. The broth is so light and refreshing while the grilled meat is so flavorful (but not overwhelming) and you have the option to adjust based on your preference w/ the spices and condiments available on every table. The prices of their food is very reasonable, even cheap depending on what protein source side you pick. I highly recommend this place for anyone in Hanoi., It was included in the dinner plan of the local tour. The bowl contains a slightly sweet sauce, which is served with bamboo-skewered, charcoal-grilled pork, meatballs, and a separate dish of rice flour noodles (pho). You can adjust the taste to your liking with garlic and peppers. Herb leaves also changed the taste. Hanoi's specialty Buncha is delicious.
description: Ô Bun Cha is honored to serve and bring you the distinctive, traditional flavors of enjoying bun cha with grilled pork. We offer Hanoi’s specialty bun cha, featuring pork grilled over charcoal on bamboo skewers, capturing the authentic style of Hanoi.

name: The Blues Bar Hanoi
address: 2 P. Tạ Hiện Hàng Buồm, Hoàn Kiếm, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: My first time in Hanoi, the staff and owner were welcoming and friendly. During my 2 weeks in Hanoi I stopped by 3 times. More of a late night bar, but great if you wanna meet some global travelers. He lets the customers request the music, great sound system cold beer and dancing. Music varied from German drinking songs, American pop, to Indian pop! Lol ,What else can you ask for partying right on beer street., I've been coming to this bar on a regular basis in the past five months. The music, drinks, and setting are all great!!! But what puts this place ahead of other bars in the district is their amazing service. A special mention to Yennie, who always go above and beyond when it comes to guest satisfaction!!, Blues' has want you want on a holiday pub crawl. New location but still the same owner who will make you feel like an old friend. Great place and good drinks. Love this place.
description: Blues Bar Pub is perfectly located in the Hanoi Old Quarter. Lively pub atmosphere with live music, DJ's and you can choose your own music. In/Outdoor seating, TVs, Projection Screen, Full Bar, Cocktails, Daily Happy Hours, Brunch / lunch and dinner specials and free WIFI. The best place to people watch in the Old Quarter

name: Pine & Dine Skybar And Restaurant
address: No 25-27 Lo Su Street Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: The drinks of the Pine & Dine Skybar truly take you to the skies with their delicious taste and creative, Vietnamese-style decorations. Pampering for taste buds and photogenic visual art at the same package. I had personally planned to try some skybar while in Hanoi, but after checking out the bar on top of my hotel I didn’t feel any need to go anywhere else. The entrepreneur of the bar, Tuan Anh, is the most welcoming and warm person and has the best recommendations to find a drink suitable to your taste. I had such enjoyable discussions with him in addition to the lovely drinks. I personally love trying new fruits, so I got for example a fruit tea that introduced some of the local fruits. Also the whole staff at the bar is extremely helpful and friendly, and do their best to make sure you enjoy your visit. The bar is located on top of a hotel and has a huge selection of both alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, from coffees and smoothies to cocktails. There is for sure something for everybody, and guests at the hotel under 18 years old will for sure find their favourites from the menu. Whether in need for an evening tea or an elegant night out enjoying the spectacular views from the top of the hotel, this is for you. In case you get hungry, they also serve traditional foods. The location is very easily accessible and just on the corner of the old quarter. I especially enjoyed how the hotel and the bar are not in the middle of the most noisy areas, offering a more enjoyable and relaxin experience. As a Western tourist I would have expected that the prices on a skybar on top of a hotel would be skyhigh, but to my surprise the prices are really affordable and totally in line with the general price level. The same applies to the food: the prices vary between approximately between only 4-10 euros., Great venue, half price cocktails at happy hour with option of combining two different types. Ultra friendly staff up for a chat and laugh, even letting me play my spotify playlist through their sound system. Will drop in again, may even stay at hotel when returning to Hanoi, We were very satisfied with our stay. I came with my girlfriend for my birthday dinner. We were greeted by the host and wished me a happy birthday with a friendly smile. We were seated at the patio, it has a really great atmosphere and we were able to enjoy the great weather. Except the insects, since it's outside it can't be helped.Other than that our night was amazing. The servers were very accommodating and friendly and was greeting me and wishing me be the best day throughout our stay which was very nice. And the main event was the dessert, our server asked if I wanted the dessert menu for my birthday but as I was so full I didn't want it but as it was my birthday he insisted and just asked if I would like a birthday surprise instead and so he did and it was such a great surprise because I loved it and finished it even though I was full. Im glad he insisted on with the cake because I would definitely have regretted not having it. It was my first time coming here, the service and the servers was just amazing and made a really great impression on me.
description: On level 13 & 14 floor, Pine & Dine Skybar And Restaurant - an upscale and stylish boutique located right in the heart of Hanoi Old Quarter. Pine & Dine Skaybar and restaurant offers a classy and contemporary vibe for a tasty lunch or dinner. Enjoy the elegant ambiance with the touch of enchanting décor. Embark on an adventure of intangible cultural heritage with the exotic flavors of Vietnam’s bustling cuisine

name: Pasteur Street Craft Beer - Au Trieu Taproom
address: 1 P. Ấu Triệu, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: …after originally visiting six years ago. We came here several times when visiting Hanoi recently and I liked it even loved all of the beer I tried. Really cool space too and the street is a really pretty space to spend some time., This was the first time we visited and we came with family visiting from the UK. Managed to get a table on the outside area on the patio which was lovely with the breeze. Cool to see the cathedral lit up behind us like some gothic cartoon picture! The menu choice for me was a little limiting as I don't drink craft beer and they were out of half their fruit juices. They did persuade me to try a tropical beer which essentially tasted like a Fanta or origina. The others in the group enjoyed their IPA and stouts., What a superb place! I was literally lost and walked passed. I nearly didn't stop. So glad I did. I had their signature Jasmine beer which was very good. Trung served my beer. I told him I'd like a snack but didn't eat meat. Trung went through the options. He recommended the enchilada abd said they could make it without meat for me. It was absolutely delicious. I as a fair way from my destination. Trung offered to order me a Grab. Not only did he do that but used a discount voucher he wouldn't use. What can I say. Talk about going the extra mile. Cảm ơn, Trung!
description: Right behind the famous St. Josephs Cathedral, the Au Trieu Taproom features two floors including a lovely terrace. Get your favourite craft beer in Hanoi!

name: The One Rooftop Pool & Bar
address: 70 P. HÃ ng MÃ£, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: what a great hostel good social atmosphere and all the staff were really friendly. special shout out to connall the volunteer he did a great job of making sure we all had a sick time. also a big thanks to plien !!, The One Hostel is probably the best hostel I have stayed in while in Vietnam! The rooms were clean and comfortable and all the other facilities were great. The staff were always on hand to help you when needed, especially Lilly and Ale who always ensured everyone was having a great time!, The hostel has a vibrant energy and a fun atmosphere and a fun crew. Special thanks to our rep Ale, she was accommodating and a great vibe that spread throughout the travelers staying here. Thanks Ale!
description: Enjoy the rhythm of good music and escape the street as you enjoy the vibrant energy of our lounge/pub, and sip on handcrafted cocktails, spirits, craft draft beers, and local beer bottles. Enjoy the pub from 6:30am till Midnight. Drink by the rooftop pool from 10am til 10pm and soak up the vibes. Maybe a nice juicy cheeseburger and a Sangiovese, chicken caesar wrap and local craft beer on tap, or a fresh chicken and avocado salad with a zesty citrus cocktail. Let your taste buds lead the way as you discover the delightful flavors that come alive when you pair the right drink with your favorite dishes. Fancy a game of pool?

name: The Snug Irish Pub
address: 19 Dang Thai Mai, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This is not quite the whole hog as far as Irish pubs are concerned, but it's close. Food is pretty good, drinks all good and nice cocktails. Guinness by the can only unfortunately. Staff are great. A bit hit and miss - we've been unable to get in some nights because it's so full, other nights it's just you. But a nice vibe and worth a look., I had a long day and was looking to find a cheeky spot with a bit of energy and some good tunes. I pulled into the snug grabbed bar snack and got an ice-cold draught! The place was lovely not packed out and they had a duet performing a few originals that were pretty damn impressive. I’d say worth a shout if you’re in Hanoi and looking for a unique experience., You can always gage a place on their handsoap and this place doesn't cheap out. Great soap, great banter, I had a wonderful time
description: A Neighborhood bar with friendly staff, live music and a great selection of beers & cocktails.

name: Aura - The Orange
address: Số 8 P. Nhà Chung Hàng Trống, Hoàn Kiếm, Hanoi 010000 Vietnam
reviews: This is an absolute gem of a bar in Old Quarter Hanoi. The ambience is dark and cozy, the staff are incredibly friendly and drinks fantastic! This was without a date the highlight of our Hanoi visit., This place is fantastic - atmosphere, drinks and staff were all faultless. The bar man was able to recommend cocktails to each of our tastes and every single one was perfect. We would have stayed much longer if we hadn’t needed to be up sp early the next morning!, Cozy vibes, beautiful place. Nice drinks n affordable price also. Very friendly staffs. Especially good music btw, good place to enjoy along with myself. Highly recommend!!
description: The way we create Aura is like how to paint an artwork, with colors that are delicious cocktails, adding skillful strokes from contemporary valuable art paintings. Yet most importantly, the true artist of Aura is you who is intoxicated with beauty. Aura is a space for you to enjoy cocktails with a wide selection of contemporary paintings.

name: Cocina Restaurant Hanoi
address: 36 Hang Trong str., Hoan Kiem dist., Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: The best dining experience i have ever had in Hanoi. A restaurant with breathtaking views of St.Joseph Cathedral and excellent service. The foods were flavorful with reasonable prices for a 4 star hotel’s restaurant. The staffs were very helpful and knowledgeable about the foods and Vietnamese cuisine in general. Definitely recommend and worth for return., “I had a wonderful experience at this restaurant late at night. Although it was quite late, the service was still attentive, with staff being warm and friendly.The menu was diverse with many delicious dishes, especially vegetarian options. I was quite surprised that they offered a full menu at such a late hour. A big plus is that the restaurant maintained both the quality of the dishes and the speed of service, even though it was close to closing time .And I was especially invited to dine on the top floor, where I enjoyed a very delicious cocktail. I’ll be back next Saturday to enjoy dinner while listening to live traditional music.”, I had a wonderful experience at this restaurant late at night. The cozy atmosphere and soft lighting created a relaxing ambiance, perfect for a late-night meal. Despite the late hour, the service was still very attentive, and the staff was warm and friendly.The menu was diverse with many delicious dishes, and I was particularly pleased to find a wide range of vegetarian options, as I was observing a vegetarian day. It truly exceeded my expectations. A big plus is that the restaurant maintained the quality of the food and the speed of service even though it was close to closing time.Overall, this is an ideal place to enjoy a meal late at night, and I will definitely come back.
description: The best dining experience i have ever had in Hanoi. A restaurant with breathtaking views of St.Joseph Cathedral and excellent service. The foods were flavorful with reasonable prices for a 4 star hotel’s restaurant. The staffs were very helpful and knowledgeable about the foods and Vietnamese cuisine in general. Definitely recommend and worth for return.

name: Hveggie
address: 06-08 P. Lãn Ông Hàng Đào, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 111000 Vietnam
reviews: I stumbled upon this smoothie bar during a hot afternoon stroll through Hanoi, and it turned out to be one of the best discoveries of my trip! From the moment I walked in, the place had a chill, welcoming vibe—clean, cozy, with a hint of tropical flair. The menu is packed with fresh, vibrant options—everything from classic banana-mango blends to more adventurous mixes like dragon fruit with mint and chia seeds. I tried the avocado-coconut smoothie (highly recommend!) and it was incredibly creamy, rich, and naturally sweet—no added sugar needed. You can really taste the quality of the ingredients. What really makes this place stand out, though, is the service. The staff are super friendly and clearly passionate about what they do. They’re happy to customize your order and even offered some local fruit recommendations I’d never tried before. Whether you’re a health nut or just craving something refreshing and delicious, this smoothie bar is a must-visit in Hanoi. Five stars all the way! If you’re looking for a place that serves up sunshine in a cup, Blended Bliss Smoothie Bar is it. This cozy little spot quickly became my go-to for post-gym fuel and mid-day pick-me-ups. The menu is packed with fresh, nutrient-rich options — think acai bowls piled high with fruit, protein-packed green smoothies, and creamy peanut butter blends that taste like dessert (without the guilt). What really sets this place apart is the quality of ingredients. Everything tastes fresh and natural, never overly sweet or artificial. The staff is super friendly and happy to customize your order — extra ginger? Sub almond milk? No problem. The vibe is relaxed, with comfy seating and chill music, making it a nice spot to hang out or catch up on some work. Prices are fair for what you’re getting, and they even offer loyalty rewards if you’re a frequent sipper like me. Highly recommend the “Tropical Recharge” if you like a mix of mango, pineapple, coconut water, and a kick of lime. It’s basically a beach vacation in a cup., On a relaxed afternoon stroll around Hanoi's Old Quarter, I stopped by Hveggie – a cozy little café with a charming street view. I ordered an iced cappuccino and was immediately impressed by its presentation. Served in a beautifully ribbed glass, the drink featured delicate latte art on top of a smooth layer of foam, giving it a truly artistic feel. The flavor was well-balanced – not too bitter, not too sweet. The creamy milk paired perfectly with the coffee, creating a smooth and refreshing experience. Serving it in a tall glass not only kept it cold longer but also added a touch of elegance compared to the usual coffeehouse cups. Sitting by the glass window, watching the bustling street life go by, sipping my cappuccino while mellow music played in the background – it was a genuinely relaxing moment. Hveggie isn’t just a place for coffee; it’s a cozy little hideaway where you can slow down and enjoy a peaceful break from the city rush., I went here for breakfast and ordered a pink smoothie bowl and a hot coconut coffee. Both was really yummy! I appreciated especially the consistency of the smoothie bowl as it was not too liquid as I have experienced in other places before. I also liked the staff and the decoration indoors :)
description: Welcome to Hveggie, where every bite tells a story and every meal nourishes both body and soul. At Hveggie, we curate a symphony of vegan and vegetarian creations, blending the rich heritage of Asian and European cuisines. Whether you seek a quick, wholesome bite in the midst of a busy day or a delightful feast for the family, our dishes are crafted with the freshest organic and sustainably sourced ingredients. Every plate is an invitation to embark on a new adventure. Step into our world and let us ignite your senses with an inspired culinary journey like no other!"

name: S 9 Duck Restaurant
address: 45 Hang Be, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: This place is absolutely amazing and a really thought provoking back story behind it. Which I hadn’t known until after we paid our bill. I have to say this was the best meal I’d had since our travels in Vietnam. Could be easily missed and I only found out about it on Trip Advisor! The advice was to order 1starter and 1 main between two, but feeling hungry we ordered two starters and a main. Seriously, just the bun cha would have been sufficient for us both…. Loads of side dishes that accompanied the meal which we didn’t know about. The pak choi soup was fantastic ( one of the side dishes ) The owner even shows us how to put different items in the bowl and how to eat it. All in all we ordered bun cha, 2 fried rolls, half duck and 2 beers and paid around £13! In the UK just one bowl of Pho would cost this!!! This place is clearly one of Hanoi’s hidden gems. Thank you, Some of the nicest food I've had in Hanoi and as a vegetarian who previously ate meat it was great to be able to find some high quality mock meat. Superb value for money, I ordered spring rolls and some fried vegan chicken with vegetables but they also brought out a large portion of rice, some tofu and soup. I highly recommend this restaurant if you're in the area :), Delicious local dining experience! The owners were extremely friendly, service was fast, and the food was incredible! Recommend the roast duck, fried spring rolls, and scallops! Be careful though - the portions are MASSIVE! The restaurant is generous enough to give a plethora of side dishes, and we ended up ordering way more than we expected to be able to finish!
description: Very close to north east exit of Dao Hoa Binh park in Hanoi on a quiet street. Small Resturant with amazing food. It is in the beginning of the street,counting from the park,nice and tidy interior. Wonderful staff,no English menu,but english speaking staff,went out of their way to get us vietnameese coffe from next door when they were out. Wonderful clams,and the best nems we had in all Hanoi during our stay.great little place worth a mention.

name: Tadka 2 Indian Restaurant Hanoi
address: 105 Hàng Bông, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: After we had dinner at Tadka 1 there staff tell us that they have bigger restaurant and serving south indian food near very near to our hotel we decided to give try for tomorrow lunch. But THis restaurant big as compare to Tadka 1 and ambiance seating was so comfortable we try PIZZA DOSA was unique items we tried in the world so so tasty our kids enjoy much. over all all food and service very very good must try worth for it ., After we had lunch at Tadka 1 there staff introduced they have another branch near where served south indian food. We try their Pizza dosa most unique items and 4 chutney it was amazing authentic taste. must try Pizza Dosa, Amazing Culinary Experience! I had the pleasure of dining at this fantastic restaurant, and I can confidently say the food was absolutely exquisite! From start to finish, every dish was a delight. The ingredients were fresh, the flavors were perfectly balanced, and the presentation was stunning. The appetizers were a great start each bite bursting with flavor. For the main course, I had the dal makhani, kadhai paneer Matar maethi malai , breads which was cooked to perfection—tender, flavorful, and rich in taste. The dessert was the perfect ending, sweet but not overwhelming. Service was impeccable, with staff being both knowledgeable and attentive. If you're looking for top-tier food and a memorable dining experience, this place is a must-visit. Highly recommended!
description: Welcome to Tadka 2 Indian Restaurant in Hanoi, where we continue our legacy of delivering authentic Indian cuisine with a touch of global flavors. Building on the success of our original Tadka Indian Restaurant, Tadka 2 offers an expanded menu featuring North, East, South, and West Indian delicacies, Desi Chinese favorites, and Continental dishes. Located in the heart of Vietnam's capital, Tadka 2 is a premier dining destination for locals and travelers alike. We use handcrafted spices and our Our signature SEL Brand spices to ensure the highest quality. Beyond dining, we offer online deliveries, group services, and event catering. Whether you're enjoying a cozy meal, gathering with friends, or hosting an event, we aim to make every occasion memorable.

name: Benaras Mantra
address: 15 Trang Tien alley, Trang Tien ward, Hoan Kiem district, 15 Tràng Tiền, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: An authentically great meal. Every single dish was perfect and this is a very rare event at any restaurant. As fussy vegetarians, we were very impressed by the fantastic cuisine and a very warm welcome by Rahul. The Seekh kebab was melt in your mouth. The spice pani puri stuffing and perfect “Khatta” pani was more than enough for 8 puri., Delicious original Indian cuisine, polite staff consists of real Indians, both cooks and waiters. You can choose a table both in the hall and on the terrace. A varied menu, everything is delicious. Quiet place, few visitors. Recommend!, One of the finest place to have chhole bhature & south Indian.. being indian you get good food options both for veg & non veg, fantastic ambience... Superb vibe... Courteous staff... Akshay (From Maharashtra) & Rakesh (From Paunjab) are best care takers... Chef Ravindara & Chef Pradeep prepares delicious food to elevate your taste buds experience ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
description: Benaras Mantra: Authentic Indian Cuisine in a Vibrant Setting Benaras Mantra is a popular spot for authentic Indian cuisine in a vibrant and inviting setting. The restaurant offers a wide variety of dishes, from classic favorites like chicken tikka masala and butter chicken to more regional specialties. All of the dishes are made with fresh, high-quality ingredients and prepared with care by experienced chefs. In addition to its delicious food, Benaras Mantra is also known for its excellent service and warm atmosphere. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable, and we are always happy to help guests choose the perfect dishes and drinks. Whether you are a seasoned Indian food lover or a first-time visitor, Benaras Mantra is the perfect place to experience the rich and diverse flavors of Indian cuisine.

name: Sunset Bar
address: 5 Tu Hoa Street, Tay Ho District Intercontinental Hotel, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Stayed at the hotel so on first night went for a cocktail on the way back to our room. The food looked good so we ended up going for 3 out of our 5 nights stay. Food was very good and they were very accommodating of my friend's dislike of anything salad. The cocktails were very good. The staff were very friendly and the views stunning in the light as well as the dark., How romantic is this place! Beside the West Lake and this place is one of the most beautiful places you must come with your friends or maybe your boyfriend if you are not single like me. The service was great and the staffs were friendly and polite - it’s essential in every 5-stars hotels and they did it perfectly. Food and drinks are great. Best place for me to chilling & healing., This is located on the grounds of the intercontinental hotel on the lake in Hanoi. It has a beautiful view and a slow pace. If your looking to escape the crowds of Hanoi and a drink or light snack this is the place. The staff is very attentive and everything is very clean.
description:
Stayed at the hotel so on first night went for a cocktail on the way back to our room.

Food was very good and they were very accommodating of my friend's dislike of anything salad. The cocktails were very good. 
The staff were very friendly and the views stunning in the light as well as the dark.

name: Cousins Dang Thai Mai
address: 15 ngõ 12 Đặng Thai Mai Tây Hồ, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: What a wonderful restaurant. An interesting menu that offers such delights as escargots and oysters in the heart of Tay Ho, a comfy yet casual atmosphere, and excellent service. The homemade potato crisps are probably the best I've ever had (served warm) and my mushroom gnocchi was delicious, as was my husband's tuna steak -- all perfectly prepared and beautifully presented. Cousins is a winner., My husband and I are British but we have a home in France. I now am based in Hanoi and thus crave French cuisine. When he was visiting last month, friends suggested we try Cousins as I live only around the corner. Both he and I had fabulous steak and I had the cuises de grenouilles as an entree which was heavenly (although I did wonder why 3 rather than two pairs! HAHAH). Reasonably priced wine and one suggestion is that they ought to carry Heineken 0 for the teetotalers. We shall be sure to return! Merci a vous, Chez Cousins. A bientôt!, The menu contains dishes from a variety of European countries with France being the main country to hold the menu together. The wine list is similar with a decent selection of French wine complimented with wines from other European regions. We chose the Spanish Rioja which was not overpriced. It was a 2017 vintage and full of flavour. The crème brûlée is just about as perfect as you can get it! The staff are very attentive .
description: What a wonderful restaurant. An interesting menu that offers such delights as escargots and oysters in the heart of Tay Ho, a comfy yet casual atmosphere, and excellent service. The homemade potato crisps are probably the best I've ever had (served warm) and my mushroom gnocchi was delicious, as was my husband's tuna steak -- all perfectly prepared and beautifully presented. Cousins is a winner.

name: Unicb Eatery
address: 50 BÃ¹i Thá»‹ XuÃ¢n Hai Ba Trung, Hanoi 112300 Vietnam
reviews: The food here is outstanding, every detail is worked out with great care. The dishes offer an exciting fusion of Chinese cuisine with surprising flavors. The staff is extremely accommodating and attentive. A highly recommended place in Hanoi!, Gastronomic Good! Unique twist of Taste of Asian Cuisine . Try the Liliaceae soup , note its good for 3 serving . Thier Main Grilled Beef tongue has a nice Spice to it . Yet the Grilled Mushroom is a Great mix definitely a must visit, Enthusiastic staff. Professional staff. The food was delivered at their their best quality. Easy to be found in the heart of Hanoi.
description: At UnicB, our founding team strives to provide customers with a truly unique experience of contemporary Chinese cuisine. We specialize in the Jiangsu culinary school, known for its refined dishes with delicate presentation, balanced flavors, and less oil and spice. Furthermore, our menu features modern dishes that artfully combine Asian and European influences. Each dish is carefully crafted to offer diners a completely new and exciting culinary adventure. Become the main character in your own gastronomic journey and let UnicB leave a lasting impression on your heart and taste buds. UnicB - A Modern Chinese Eatery

name: Bamboo Bar
address: 15 Ngo Quyen Street, Trang Tien Ward, Hoan Kiem DIstrict Sofitel Metropole Hanoi, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: I had a business meeting with my customers at this Bamboo bar. Still a very nice and peaceful place as before. We ordered a basket of pastries but not really impressed with it given the standard of Sofitel Metropole, I would expect more delicious pastries rather the one had (it could score 7/10 if you compare with authentic French pastries). Beverages were ok as we went for mixed juices and coffee and water. The only disappointing that I should highlight here is that Sofitel Metropole no longer provides printed newspapers like The New York Times or Vietnam News to read anymore and you would have to read on your small screen via PressReader which was unpleasant experience. Ans I hope that Metropole would think again about setting out a few copies at its restaurants and bars., Under the rattan ceiling fans inside the Bamboo Bar pavilion in the Metropole courtyard or at poolside, a relaxed lunch, brunch, or snack with drinks would be in order. The French onion soup is a must, and a Charlie Chaplain cocktail is a must. We were joined by two other couples and each of us had favorites from the can't-miss menu., Although we did not stay at the Sofitel, we were curious to visit this iconic hotel so we went twice for lunch to the bamboo bar. Service is very upmarket and the personnel is kind and friendly. I can highly recommend the salade niçoise and the beef pho. Beautifully presented and both delicious. On our second visit, we ordered burgers and got the wrong ones. They offered to replace them, but we decided to eat the ones we had been served which were a bit bland, so they probably needed the foie gras or cheese to be more tasty. Our coffee was then offered in compensation which was a classy gesture. It’s a lovely place to spend time on a sunny afternoon and the objects in the glass case in the hall are very interesting, underlining the varying fortunes and misfortunes of the hotels past.
description: The Bamboo Bar with its thatched roof and wooden floor is an ideal spot to relax beside the delightful swimming pool with a refreshing cocktail. The casual setting of this poolside venue invites guests to unwind with the Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi signature Graham Greene Martini. Adjacent to Le Club, Bamboo Bar serves light meals, gourmet ice cream, desserts, fruit juices, coffees, teas and refreshing cocktails. Light snacks are offered throughout the day. This is always the busiest spot in the hotel, but also the most storied as underneath it lies the historic Metropole Bomb Shelter.

name: Pizza 4P's Lotte Center Hanoi
address: 54 Lieu Giai Cong Vi, Ba Dinh, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Good place. Their signature burrata cheese pizza and 4 cheese pizza are absolute must tries, featuring house-made cheese anf perfectly crispy crust. They have open kitchen showcasing the chefs at work. Service is attentive and professional, making our experience more enjoyable, Surprisingly different pizza experience than we're used to in the States. The service is impeccable but the pizza honestly stands well beside that service. The pizzas are well balanced in dough and toppings,and are reasonably priced for that quality. Flavors are imaginative (from our limited Vietnamese pizza experience). We tried the recommended seafood and beef kabob as a half and half. Their selection isn't incredible diverse, but the things they do are great. Would come here again., I am a frequent visitor to their outlets and love the food there. However, today I was a bit lazy about going out and yet wanted their food, so decided to have it delivered home. Usually there is a slight difference in the taste of the food by the time it comes but here I must mention that the food tasted just as nice. Only negative was, that not all dishes are available for home delivery.
description: An Earth to People restaurant on a mission to make the world smile for peace, one pizza at a time. Earth to People is our commitment to serve safe and fresh foods directly from Mother Earth to you. Located in Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Danang and Nha Trang.

name: Garden House Villa Restaurant
address: 15 P. Lương Ngọc Quyến Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: If you're looking for a delicious, good-sized pizza at an affordable price you won't find anywhere better than this fabulous restaurant. Welcoming and warm staff, relaxed and friendly atmosphere, I recommend this little corner of paradise to everyone... Thanks to our server Jay for the exemplary service:)), I had the pleasure of dining at Garden House Villa restaurant and it exceeded all expectations. The inviting ambiance set the tone for a delightful experience, complemented by attentive staff who added a personal touch to the evening. The culinary masterpiece, tender beef with mushroom gravy sauce, carbonara, roasted squid with five flavors showcased perfect seasoning and a harmonious blend of flavors, making each bite a true delight for the taste buds. The service of TEAMG was prompt, and the presentation of dishes was impeccable, contributing to an overall wonderful dining experience. Highly recommend for those seeking a memorable and enjoyable meal., We had a late meal, made a last minute reservation for 10 people and they accommodated us with the best service without any complaints. We were very warmly welcomed, the cocktails were delicious and the food was exquisite. We spent a wonderful evening in a pleasant and friendly setting. We will return with pleasure, Thank you all for the warm and professional welcome.
description: Located in the heart of the Old Quarter, Garden House Villa combines the best of traditional Vietnamese cuisine and Western inspired dishes. Our menu offers a creative range of meals, including a separate vegetarian/vegan menu, all at very affordable prices. Our skilled kitchen team source only the freshest organic ingredients to guarantee the high quality of our dishes. We pride ourselves on our MSG free policy to ensure we serve the healthiest food. The freshness continues to our drinks. Our bar staff produce delicious real fruit juices and smoothies as well as cocktails, cold beers and a selection of wine. The rural-style restaurant offers more than just great food, also providing a cosy dining experience where customers can relax under coloured lanterns and enjoy the smell of fresh flowers on the tables. You will be greeted by genuine smiles from our helpful staff who ensure everyone leaves happy! We also hold cooking classes for those who wish to cook Vietnamese foods.

name: Etēsia • kitchen counter + wines
address: 14B Lò Sũ, phường Lý Thái Tổ, Quận Hoàn Kiếm, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: The food is presented well and sitting by the counter watching the cooking happen is a cool concept. However, I found that most of the dishes are too expensive for what you are served. The main courses are not really a main course but a tapas portion. 690k for two small pieces of lamb with dots of pea puree when the menu indicates "lamb rack" feels like a rip off. The other main course that my friend ordered also didn't fully satisfy. Great for the experience and one-off, but not a place to regularly frequent if you want to eat well and fully., I rarely review anything anymore but this was such a delight from beginning to end I had to share and encourage locals and visitors alike to try it for themselves. Delicious food, lovely wine and home made iced tea and infused gin, and the bonus of viewing the chefs prepare your dish for you and friendly attentive service. 5 stars guys thank you., Restaurant in the center that a friend told us about. Nice welcome in a restaurant where we were alone. A long corridor restaurant, with the kitchen on the left with a bar counter where we dine. We had a dinner of shrimp flambéed with pastis and a proscuito melon salad with a glass of Burgundy, September, followed by scallop ravioli and duck breast washed down with Chateau Dauzac. They have a very large choice but be careful, the first wine tasted which was a Bordeaux cru bourgeois was gone. For dessert we chose chocolate mousse and flambéed bananas. Everything was excellent, the very small shrimps, only 2 ravioli and 3 pieces of duck breast, left us hungry. The addition of 3.5 million VND or 150 USD seemed excessive to me for Ha Noi

name: Cumulus Vietnamese Restaurant
address: 45 Hang Be 2nd Floor, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: The Bun Cha is the best we've had in Vietnam, so much flavour and wow do they deliver on food quantity. He recommends one starter (bun cha) and one main course for 2 people. The portions are incredible and so tasty. We got the half roast duck and was amazing. The owner is so kind and his story is inspiring. He donates 100m dong per year to a charity that helped him get to where he is today. It was 400k for both dishes and they gave us so much extra food that we didn't realise was part of the dishes. We have pretty big appetites but we were blown away by the meal we were served., One of the best vegetarian meals we had on our trip. So many great sides came with the meal and the owner showed us how to eat them. Overall, a really amazing meal and the owner had a phenomenal life story., Before we knew anything we went there because it had good reviews. They really give you a lot of food, very good and they are very nice. At the end of the dinner the owner of the place handed us a token where he told his story of how he was a child with nothing and went through many hardships until he decided to become an entrepreneur of his food place. This person today helps children who are currently in the same situation that he was in. A place to go, eat and talk a little with the owner of your story. Highly recommended.
