The portions are incredible and so tasty. We got the half roast duck and was amazing. The owner is so kind and his story is inspiring. He donates 100m dong per year to a charity that helped him get to where he is today. It was 400k for both dishes and they gave us so much extra food that we didn't realise was part of the dishes. We have pretty big appetites but we were blown away by the meal we were served.

name: Sparta Beer Club
address: 165 Thai Ha Song Hong Building, M Floor, Hanoi 122003 Vietnam
reviews: Evening came with 3 friends. They give priority to table visitors better than others. We arrived early, 7pm they have DJs. Dancers perform 1 hour later, about 15 dancers. They are very beautiful and fiery. Their food is also easy to eat, we use the same beer. This was a good experience and I think I will be back. One advice is that you should book a table in advance to have a nice table, I came to Hanoi and visited the shop because it is a famous place. Too large, including foreign guests but mainly Vietnamese. Friendly staff, delicious food. I like the dancers because they are so beautiful, the music is also fun. I am satisfied and will come back if I have a chance, I was a little hesitant when it was only 2 people but fortunately they were very sociable. The girls who are the staff of too have had a drink with and chatted with us like friends. Grandmasters here are also very beautiful and fiery, they are not afraid to drink with us. A wonderful experience of hospitality. I really like the atmosphere here
description: Located at the M floor of Ly Thai Hoc Apartments and Office Complex 165 Thai Ha, SPARTA BEER CLUB is a fresh beer club incorporating top-class entertainment programs in Hanoi. With an area of over 800m2 simulating a special "beer arena", DJs play music every day and the event takes place continuously, SPARTA BEER CLUB will be one of the hottest destinations in Hanoi next time.

name: Kasaya Vegetarian Restaurant
address: 14 HÃ ng Than Nguyá»…n Trung Trá»±c, Ba Dinh, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We first saw the stunning entrance to Kasaya when we were going to eat at another place on the same street. We heard it was a special vegetarian place so we went back 2days later. Itâ€™s important to know that there is no alcohol served. You can get non alcoholic beer or soft drinks. We ordered cinnamon apple tea which was a lovely experience in and of itself. The interior is breathtaking. It looks like a beehive with a spiral staircase in the center leading up to multiple floors. The art on the walls is different in every room and on every floor. The ambience was very spa like and serene. The attention to every detail prepares you for a wonderful culinary experience. For example, the carved wooden chopsticks are wrapped in leaves. Itâ€™s a small plates type of place so we ordered about 10 different dishes. Each one was beautiful to behold and so delicious. Unusual combinations perfectly prepared. Kasaya leaves wrapped lemongrass, Kasaya signature spring rolls, Lotus leaf wrapped black rice, vegetarian Gimbap and vegetable tempura were some of the dishes we had. We spoke to the owner and his son after our meal. They explained their concept of Buddhist art and serenity in combination with good, healthy food. The whole experience totally unique in Hanoi where the streets are crowded, noisy and chaotic. This place is not to be missed, especially for vegetarians but really for anyone. And to top it all off, it was extremely affordable. The bill for 2 of us was about $40., My wife is vegetarian and they're are surprisingly few options in Hanoi. Obviously a salad here she a salad there. We stumbled on this restaurant by accident after our intended restaurant closed early. It is on a fairly busy street where they survey look out for one another because we asked one for 'an chay' and he pointed out our destination. You go up a lovely spiral staircase and are seated. Most of the clientele are younger women. The menu is presented by an enthusiastic waiter. It is enormous, containing seven courses. For your price fixe, you can have as many of each course as you want. They are brought out topas style rather than in order of course. All were very interesting and tasty. Approximately $17 usd per person., Going to make this a go to spot on my future visits to Hanoi. The building makes a great impression for guests, and a great spot for instagram photos. The food and service are the best. Even more interesting is how they can make these vegetarian dishes - good taste and presentation.
description: A Vegetarian restaurant with beautifully interior design and amazing cuisine, bringing the nature and Vietnamese tradition close together. In here, you can find inner peace while enjoying our great food

name: Quan Vi Saigon
address: 21 Gia Ngu, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Really delicious seafood in the heart of the old town, mostly full of Vietnamese families. Name on wall is Oi Vi and menu all in Vietnamese but they will give you an English menu if you are a westerner. I had razor clams in tamarind sauce and baked oysters with spring onions. Gorgeous. Little English spoken but you’ll manage. Waitress wasn’t unfriendly, just not as friendly as I’ve normally experienced but the restaurant was very busy and seemed a wee bit short on waiters/ waitresses so understandable. Didn’t try the snails but they are supposed to be great. Surprisingly ( to me) they don’t serve rice or noodles with the seafood - just hot bread rolls to mop your sauce up with. Definitely recommended and reasonably priced., Really great seafood at reasonable prices. This is only a small Restaurant with limited seating, a limited menu but all very tasty and good value. Don’t be put off by the look. It’s the taste and quality of the food that matters. Lots of shellfish to choose from., In the wake of COVID-19, many restaurants in the Old Quarter have not reopened. So I found myself wandering aimlessly when I came across Quan Vi Saigon. The place was so welcoming and the food, mainly seafood, looked amazing. I absolutely loved the new (fried spring rolls) and the stir-friend noodles with seafood. The quantity and quality of the food were excellent and the prices quite reasonable. In fact, I'm tempted to return again in the next few days!
description: Vietnamese cuisine, majoring in seafood with Saigonese style. We have clam, sea shell, snail, oyster,prawn, squid, fried rice, fried noodles.

name: Bếp Chay Huệ Nhiên
address: 39 Phố Hàng Quạt, Quận Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Hanoi 11000 Vietnam
reviews: A restaurant that serves both vegetarian and vegan options, the menu is labeled with ingredients so you can choose to have eggs or no eggs. The space is simple but cozy with many paintings by young Vietnamese artists. Affordable prices, enthusiastic staff. Highly recommend!, Amazing experience in the middle of Hanoi! When you enter, the chaos of the city stops immediately. You can experience super good food... All the choices are vegetarian or vegan. Everything was really good tasting, there are lots of options. Highly recommend!!!, In surroundings it is very nice and the food very tasty. I agreed with some local people who noticed that I would be in the puasa of the food at the same restaurant and the truth is that it is a super nice place to eat and be at ease. Super recommended and completely different from all the ones I found on the Hanoi tour. Superb!
description: A small humble vegan & vegetarian restaurant in Hanoi with a reasonable price for everyone. We do everything with love and dedication!

name: Cồ Đàm
reviews: I was with my family headed to another restaurant when we walked by and was literally stopped in our tracks by how beautiful a restaurant this appeared to be. We saw that this was Michelin selected, and changed our plans immediately. We ended up getting the only table available without reservations and wow. There were 4 of us, and one of us had significant dietary restrictions, and the staff worked with the restrictions so professionally! We were able to order 2 of each of the set menu options to try everything. And let me say, I'm not one to Instagram my meals, but I took pictures of each dish. They were presented in such a creative and aesthetically pleasing way, and the food was amazing. I found myself excited for the each next dish, even though my stomach was telling me I was full. The whole dinner was an experience, not just a meal, and one I won't soon forget. I went on to travel in Vietnam another 3 weeks and have been back home now for a week, and I'm still thinking about how good this restaurant is., I am not an expert in vegetarian food, but I liked what they served us. We ordered two different menus, consisting of about eight dishes each. Before the last one I already felt full. The restaurant draws attention for its decoration, as it resembles a temple. There were very few diners, I imagine because it is not cheap. It's okay as an experience if you don't mind paying more than other restaurants in Hanoi., It's my fourth time at the restaurant within a year, and I always enjoy the food and the service. The last time I was there, the server didn't explain the dishes like the other servers in the past, so my friends who were there the first time didn't understand the presentation and the food itself. I think the servers were busy, and the restaurant was pretty full, so understandable, hence the 5 stars. But, it is worth the visit.
description: /Co Dam Vegetarian Fine Dining Restaurant. Each vegetarian restaurant has its own philosophy and takes that philosophy as the foundation to develop the most complete menu for diners. Mother nature's quintessence and the best nutrients. Are you ready to discover the beautiful story of Co Dam?

name: Tascus Food & Drinks Dinh Liet
address: No 9B, Dinh Liet street Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: I have to travel far from home for work, which makes me feel really homesick. Every time I dine at Tascus, I experience a taste of home that’s both familiar and refreshingly unique—a delightful blend of Vietnamese style with a hint of my own hometown’s flavor. Tascus isn’t just a stop for quick bites; it’s a place that preserves the warmth and nostalgic essence of a cozy home kitchen. If you’re looking for a fast, yet soul-satisfying dining experience, Tascus is sure to exceed your expectations., The spot is unique. You can easily spot it while walking along the street of Dinh Liet. The staff were warm & accommodating. They even gave us a free gifts. As for the food, it’s a mix of american & Vietnamese flavors. It was nice & flavorful., Arrived in Hanoi after an 18 hour flight and needed something to eat but wanted to start off eating something which was safe and from a clean kitchen. A beef, cheese and egg baguette and I asked the young girl to cook meat well. Food perfect and would happily return.
description: Located right in the heart of Hanoi's Old Quarter, on the bustling Dinh Liet Street, Tascus Food offers tourists appealing and tasty fast food at very reasonable prices. Tascus Food's diverse menu includes delicious burgers, crispy banh mi, sweet crepes, nutritious sandwiches and refreshing drinks, ensuring to meet all diners' needs. In particular, Tascus Food always focuses on food quality and safety, providing tourists with delicious and worry-free meals. With its convenient location near Hoan Kiem Lake, Tascus Food is the ideal stop for tourists to recharge after hours of exploring the capital.

name: Pioneer Beer - Local Craft Beer
address: 84 Hàng Quạt, Hoàn kiếm, hà nội, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Nice little friendly bar. Try the taster selection of 3 beers. Better still have 2 sets as try all 6 beers. Tasty and very different. Especially the chocolate beer! Smells like chocolate mouse and tastes great. Watch out for the strong beer 🤣., Nice cute place with good selection of local craft beer. Sit and chill with a tall glass of beer after a good meal. Excellent., Love the small but interesting selection of locally crafted beers. I had the passion fruit which was lovely and refreshing on a warm night. Small and cozy space
description: Nice little friendly bar. Try the taster selection of 3 beers. Better still have 2 sets as try all 6 beers. Tasty and very different. Especially the chocolate beer! Smells like chocolate mouse and tastes great. Watch out for the strong beer 🤣.

name: AZABU
address: 84 Tran Nhan Tong 2nd Floor, Hotel du Parc Hanoi, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Lunch here at Azabu had a mix of highs and lows. The meal started on a strong note with the steamed egg custard and foie gras, a perfect pairing of rich flavors and smooth textures. For the main course, I opted for special-grade sashimi assortment, alongside a grilled eel rice box. The fatty tuna belly sashimi was remarkable, but the inconsistent temperatures of the sashimi — some pieces slightly frozen and others at room temperature — compromised the experience. The grilled eel failed to leave a lasting impression., This was the best food from our trip in Vietnam. Totally 5 star deliciousness top class. Absolutely everything was amazing. The tuna amuse Bouche full of flavour. Shrimp tempura big juicy with crunchy light batter. The crab croquettes and dip oh my the flavours just melted in your mouth. The best cod roe I have ever had my partner said he didn’t like cod roe until I made him taste this yet again just melted in your mouth, I wished I hadn’t encouraged him to try it because he scoffed half. He loved the tender teriyaki beef. The lobster was HUGE and cooked to perfection. Loved the Hanoi craft ales. The sake flights were mmmm particularly loved Dassai 45. The crab with roe on top had such fresh flavours. I think I will dream about this restaurant forever is was absolutely amazing and should be Michelin star. Love mango tarts for dessert so tasty. Dream restaurant if only all food tasted this good., Me and my husband had a lovely dinner at this restaurant on my birthday last year. We love Japanese food and after doing the research on the internet, we chose this one eventually. Everything turned out awesome and we really had an incredible time here. The staff were so friendly from we made the reservation via phone to the moment we turned up at the restaurant. 5* for Isabella who helped us a lot with the food wise. She gave us different options and advised what's the best to order. The food was so delicious, well presented and if you're lucky to have Isabella on your day, you would have a great dinner with your friends or family. Highly recommended this restaurant to everyone and will definitely come back soon ! Ps: special thanks to Isabella and all the staff made my birthday so special.
description: The Michelin-starred concept, Azabu, houses various experiences under one roof; tied together with the spirit of Omotenashi, the essence of Japanese hospitality. Located inside the HÔTEL du PARC HANOÏ, Azabu elevates the local culinary scene with authentic Japanese cuisine and experiences. You are able to enjoy the truly authentic Japanese cuisines like 9 dishes of “Wakaiseki” menu, course menu or a la carte menu, that are prepared by our Executive Chef Katsuhiro Ichomoto coming from the more than 400 years old Kawabun Nagoya restaurant.

name: Banh Xeo Zon Pancake
address: 25 Lo Su Street, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: The service was amazing, very helpful and friendly. Not only did they explain to us what each serving was but they also explained to us how to eat it and which seasoning would match the cuisine best. At first we wanted to order less than we actually did. They recommended us to order more, not because they wanted to profit from it, but rather because the portions turned out smaller than we thought. A great experience overall, fair prices just like on their website, ranging from 30k to 90k per serving. One of the cheapest and greatest restaurants we had during our trip in Hanoi., We were looking for a Banh Xeo as it has become our new favourite meal! I googled Banh Xeo near me and this came up with 4.3 stars on Google reviews so we thought we would give it a try. When we arrived it looked a bit run downed and empty but may I admit that I was wrong!! This place had the BEST Banh Xeo and Spring Rolls I have EVER had!!! It was amazing!! There was soo many options. We had the vegan options and it was soo good and fairly cheap! The owner was soo helpful in offering to teach us how to eat Banh Xeo, Dropped in here for lunch. Delicious banh xeo rice pancakes with all the extra bits and pieces - we had a serve of pork ones and a serve of shrimp ones. Spring rolls were also delicious plus cold beer and a lovely ginger tea. Really good food and friendly people.
description:
The service was amazing, very helpful and friendly. Not only did they explain to us what each serving was but they also explained to us how to eat it and which seasoning would match the cuisine best. At first we wanted to order less than we actually did. They recommended us to order more, not because they wanted to profit from it, but rather because the portions turned out smaller than we thought.
A great experience overall, fair prices just like on their website, ranging from 30k to 90k per serving. One of the cheapest and greatest restaurants we had during our trip in Hanoi.

name: Polite & Co
address: 5b Bao Khanh Street Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: We stayed at this Bar for a few drinks and had the 4 cheese pizza. All were delicious and well priced even if it’s considered above average cost in Vietnam it’s definitely worth the price! For 5 beers and a full pizza was $35 CAD. The interior of this bar is beautiful. Softly lit with warm lighting and candles, dark brown aesthetics with pictures lining the walls and hundreds of beautiful bottles of drink to choose from. Copper overtones and leather seats. It’s definitely cozy and wants you to stay longer. They played excellent music. If you feel like sitting a while and enjoying your atmosphere with yummy food or drink, this is it! Highly recommend!, A smart place for a pre or post dinner cocktail. Great atmosphere (gentleman’s club style) with a fantastic selection of cocktails. If you like whisky, this is the place to come with over 100 to choose from and on Tuesday it’s 2 glasses of whisky for the price of one! I saw nothing of the rude service or slow service highlighted in some of the recent reviews., This a great place in which to unwind over a cocktail or glass of wine and escape the chaotic bustle of Hanoi. We took full advantage of their Happy Hour and sat back with a Magherita enjoying the background jazz music and the excellent olives. They offer a wider range of food options but these are more accompaniments to the drinks as this is essentially a wine/cocktail bar than a restaurant. A highly recommended ‘escape room’!
description: Inspired by 1920s gentleman's club, Polite & Co (previously Polite Pub) offers an informal setting for the enjoyment of specialty coffee during day time... and a cozy/speakeasy atmosphere to indulge in craft cocktails, whisky for a memorable night out.

name: Che Huong Hai 93 Hang Bac
address: 93 Hang Bac Road Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: I have eaten dessert here 3 times. Vietnamese restaurants serve these type of dessert in Oakland Ca. I feel lucky that I came across this gem. If your a foodie and want to try something different come here. It’s similar to Philippine Halo Halo or Korean Bingsu., Must Try in Hanoi if you want an authentic and amazing tasting desert. We got addicted to the sticky rice with Coconut Ice cream, so much so that we came back three nights on the run. I was shocked at how much I loved this as it's usually not my type of thing. Try it, you won't be disappointed. Also the prices are so cheap that it's silly., When I accidentally chanced upon this desert store, I got hiked after trying the 1st time. I ended having it 3 times in 2 days! I tried a different desert each time and they were all very delicious. The only thing I did not like is the calories that come with it. I think I had gained an extra pound from it.
description: I have eaten dessert here 3 times. Vietnamese restaurants serve these type of dessert in Oakland Ca. I feel lucky that I came across this gem. If your a foodie and want to try something different come here. It’s similar to Philippine Halo Halo or Korean Bingsu.

name: Golden Dragon Restaurant - Hanoi Hotel
address: D8 Giang Vo D8 Giang Vo - Tran Huy Lieu street, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Excellent service with high qualitied food, nice view, enthusiastic, professional, sofisticated staff. I am impressed by excellent service of staff named Mr. Luan with good listenning skills. Other staff are very helpful and cheerful. My favorite dishes are in these picutures. Thanks and I am very satisfactory with the first meal in the beginning of new year. I think I will have a year with delicious food., best dimsum restaurant in the town, we went there for dinner and they welcomed us like friends. highly recommend to you guys, The grand restaurant in Hanoi Hotel, it is beautifully decorated and service is top notch. The Peking Duck skin is crispy and the sauce is balance and nice. The Beef cube is delicious, tender with a wonderful tasting sauce. The tofu and Kai Lam is done to our liking. Highly recommended if you want to eat Chinese food in Hanoi. 4.5 Stars for me.
description: One of the most famous Chinese dining in Hanoi, experienced chefs guarantee the traditional flavor of Dimsum and cuisine of your choice. Weddings and parties are well known to be held at the Golden Dragon Restaurant to ensure all guests enjoy both the environment and beverages.

name: Garden House Restaurant
address: 45B Hang Dau, Ly Thai To Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: My boyfriend and I had the opportunity to visit this restaurant, located in the middle of old street, the price is a bit high but it's worth the money, the food comes out quickly only about 15 minutes. Besides, my waiter, Phong he is very friendly and hospitable, he recommend and help me choose dishes easier. Once again recommend everyone to come here, The restaurant is in the heart of the Old Town, it has air conditioning, with various salts, and all the waiters are very pleasant and give you very good recommendations. At all times, we are aware of whether we like it or if we are comfortable. The Vietnamese food is very delicious, and in case you've been in Vietnam for days and you fancy something else, they also have pizzas. We have repeated twice., The honey grilled chicken here is really a great choice. The chicken is grilled until tender, imbued with the sweet flavor of honey, creating a unique and attractive flavor. Each piece of chicken stays moist and crispy, making every mouthful a true delight. Thank you, brothers and sisters and the restaurant owner here for giving me a wonderful meal
description: Warmly welcome to Lake Side Viet Garden Cuisine! We offers best local Dishes! Our menu offers a wide range of meals, from traditional countryside dishes to western-inspired, all at a very affordable price. Our skilled kitchen team sources only the freshest and finest ingredients to guarantee the high standard of all our dishes. The vintage-styled restaurant offers more than just great food, but also a home away from home. The friendly and helpful staff ensures everyone leaves satisfied. Our Lake view private dining area is the perfect venue for any special event or celebration. Our barmen produce the finest fresh fruit juices and shakes, as well as delicious cocktails and beer. We open at 9: 00am to 10:30pm from the Breakfast to the late night meal. We also the foods delivery. Our Cooking Class is open daily from 9 am or 3 pm . Cooking Class to invite our guests to discover how authentic Vietnamese food is cooked for themselves.

name: Banh My Pho Hue
address: 118 Pho Hue, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: So, I am not sure I fully get the banh mi obsession here. Reviewers on TA and elsewhere are raving about crunchy baguettes (the smaller version we back home call piccolo’s for some reason) with fluffy white bread inside. That’s, frankly how all baguettes should be and they typically are where in Europe they’re sold. What’s different is the non-descript liver pâté and an adventurous jet of Chili sauce. So yes this banh mi was really tasty and mostly locals often queue as you can see on the pics here, and at 30k VND they are really cheap but that won’t make this quick ‘n simple lunch a national heritage culinary delight, if you ask me. Nonetheless, if you’d like to sample a good one with local flavours and couleur locale, you can’t go wrong here., Pate is delicious, chili is delicious. The cake is delicious but not crispy yet. But the service is not good. There was a time when a grabber asked for an extra piece of nylon but he didn't give me one and said he was very condescending. My family traveled 7.8 km to come here because we like the noodles here. Once when we passed by, we even bought them to take home. We eat spicy food. Even if we add a bag of chili, we don't want to give it away. Then he told me to buy a 10K bottle of chili. Okay, why don't you say it sooner to save time? If the service spirit is friendlier, customers will love the store more., Came here as part of a food tour to try some of their famous bread. The bread really is delicious, it was so soft and fluffy, I loved it
description:
So, I am not sure I fully get the banh mi obsession here. Reviewers on TA and elsewhere are raving about crunchy baguettes (the smaller version we back home call piccolo’s for some reason) with fluffy white bread inside. That’s, frankly how all baguettes should be and they typically are where in Europe they’re sold. 

What’s different is the non-descript liver pâté and an adventurous jet of Chili sauce. 
So yes this banh mi was really tasty and mostly locals often queue as you can see on the pics here, and at 30k VND they are really cheap but that won’t make this quick ‘n simple lunch a national heritage culinary delight, if you ask me.

Nonetheless, if you’d like to sample a good one with local flavours and couleur locale, you can’t go wrong here.

name: Coffee Club Cafe Restaurant
address: 3B Le Thai To, Hang Trong Ward, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: We popped in here two or three times, while we were in Hanoi - nice roof top atmosphere away from the traffic. Nice view over the lake and friendly staff. We only had drinks (no food), but what food we saw looked acceptable. We also found the QR code menu amusing as the waiters still came and checked the order we had sent! All adds to the fun and no complaints., We enjoyed our drinks and the view from the outside terrace of this place. Our waiter, Dat, is a very personable young man who speaks excellent English he learned from song lyrics. He recommended the blend of passion fruit and guava juices, which was very good!, It was hot out side. The air conditioning wasn’t on but they gladly turned it on when we asked. Great service. Good steak on a sizzling plate. Garlic butter sauce was delicious. Creme brûlée was also delicious
description: Located in the French colonial building at 3B Le Thai To Street next to famous Hoan Kiem Lake, Hanoi. Coffee Club Cafe Bistro's culinary favorite destination of local tourists and foreigners, bringing a wide selection of international flavors and unique Vietnam. On portion of 4th floor of the building, a terrace overseeing the famous scenic Hoan Kiem lake.

name: S&L's Diner
address: 24 Duong Thanh, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: I went the first time with friends and really enjoyed the experience. The food was delicious, reminded me of food back in the US, Minh the waiter spoke great English and was very accommodating. We sat on the second floor, second table from the window on the right and had a great view of everything outside and in. When I returned with my wife, we got the same table - lucky, I guess. The prices were quite reasonable, delicious food, friendly staff and the atmosphere kind of reminded me of the American chain Steak & Shake. I just got off the phone with a friend from South Africa, I'm sharing it with him after Tet., Delicious food with a great menu choice. Atmosphere was spot on with the American Theme. It was slightly overpriced in my opinion. We have been travelling in Vietnam for a month now and similar restaurants to this have been quite a bit cheaper., There was so much food on this menu I wanted to eat. We went for a steak sandwich with loaded fries and a quesadilla which came on a lunch meal with a salad and drink. The food was brilliant - big portions. The woman who served us was really helpful. Worth every penny and look forward to eating here again.
description: S&L’s Diner is the first restaurant in Hanoi that represents young locals and expats with the experience of a classic American Diner. Established in December 2016 and currently has two locations: 24 Duong Thanh, Hoan Kiem and 109 Hoang Cau, Dong Da

name: Olé
address: 10 P. Quảng An, Tay Ho, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Prepare to be transported to culinary heaven at gem of a tapas restaurant! Impeccable decor sets the stage, each floor has its own personality. Each dish is a masterpiece of flavor, from the starters, to mains and desserts. The staff's passion for service ensures an unforgettable visit and I’ve never seen staff smile so much! Trust me, you’ll be counting down the days until you can return for more, because I am! P.s Highly recommend the BMW cocktail and the crème brûlée dessert. Thank me later!, The Spanish food is excellent and authentic, with just a few unusual hints of different flavours to make it really interesting. The Sangria is different but well worth it. Tapas mushrooms excellent. The music is contemporary Spanish, Mexican, Argentinian. Service is attentive and helpful. We will definitely come back., I recently dined in this Spanish food restaurant and was blown away by the authentic flavors and cozy atmosphere. The food was all perfectly seasoned and scrumptious. The service was top-notch and the staff were friendly. I can't wait to go back and try more dishes! 5 stars.
description: Olé is a Spanish inspired Tapas Restaurant, Cocktail & Wine Bar

name: The Local Sports Bar
address: 83 Xuan Dieu Tay Ho, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Called in to watch an NRL game recently & met Matt ,the owner, who the invited me to try a few of the beers available bcs I hadn't previously tried any of them. The Local has a great pub style atmosphere with comfortable seating inside & out & cheap beer prices. Will definitely be back on a regular basis, Great for watching sports. Lot’s of screen showing different sports, good view and staff really friendly and helpful also. Cold beer and food was delicious. Highly recommend!!!, Nice pub/sports bar next to West Lake. Popped in after lunch for a drink or two. It’s pretty cool. You will need to like AFL and football ⚽️ to really enjoy it. I would recommend staying away from the wines by the glass. Disappointing that none of the excellent sounding craft beers were available on tap. Clean bathroom and a nice dog. We were there during the day so cannot comment on the scene at night. Our friends tell is it’s busy at the weekends and most evenings. They do a pub quiz as well.
description:
Called in to watch an NRL game recently & met Matt ,the owner, who the invited me to try a few of the beers available bcs I hadn't previously tried any of them.
The Local has a great pub style atmosphere with comfortable seating inside & out & cheap beer prices.
Will definitely be back on a regular basis

name: Nhà hàng Nguyễn Gia
address: 64B Quán Sứ, Hoàn Kiếm, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: You could walk past this place and not bat an eyelid and to be honest there was no one inside so I was a bit dubious. There were very few reviews online but I am honestly thrilled to say the food was all wonderful. I had the tofu, rice and glass noodles and everything tasted wonderful and with so much flavour. The staff were wonderful especially the waitress we had who went out of her way to help us and translate what she was saying!, Nice Vietnamese northern food restaurant. Large menu of northern food inluding options of north-western tribal foods or home-cook dishes. This restaurant is also wellknown for its ricefield crab with green veggies hotpot originally from its first syster restaurant opened in Hoa Lac, 30km away in the north west of Hanoi. They serve free teas. Prime location in Quan Su street and close to few famous tourist spots like Quan Su Temple (the house of VN Buddist Shanga) and Hoa Lo (Hanoi Hilton Prison). You may feel warm inside with traditional northern setup wooden decors and furnitures. Staffs are friendly. Prices are moderate. If you come by car you may need to find a parking a few blocks away from the restaurant, I quite like the restaurant space: spacious, airy, tables are far apart to ensure privacy. Friendly staff from security to waitress. The food I tried was bun cha, spring rolls, crispy fried goby, chicken and burnt rice. The bun cha dipping sauce also includes spring rolls so it's a bit strange. But the spring rolls are delicious without being greasy. Soy milk also has a rich milky taste.
description: You could walk past this place and not bat an eyelid and to be honest there was no one inside so I was a bit dubious. There were very few reviews online but I am honestly thrilled to say the food was all wonderful. I had the tofu, rice and glass noodles and everything tasted wonderful and with so much flavour. The staff were wonderful especially the waitress we had who went out of her way to help us and translate what she was saying!

address: 3 Ngo Yen Thanh, Off 61 Cua Bac, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Really enjoyed eating upstairs with the traditional style low tables on the floor. We loved the fried pork rib with salt and chilli, and the beef in betal leaf, very cheap cut of meat but still tasty. We ordered the chicken hot pot and unfortunately it was disappointing, the broth didn’t have a great base flavour and the chicken was more bone than meat. We were given peanuts and some strange water that I had one sip of, and didn’t touch again, it tasted like sweet corn water. However I was quite cranky that we were charged for these items when we didn’t even want them. It’s a cheap trick for such a nice restaurant and soured my experience at the end., Recommended by a local and it was not a disappointment. This restaurant is located in an alley slightly off the main street, visible by a “1946” neon red sign. The interiors were nicely decorated. Food was tasty and the portions are generous. Staff were friendly and attentive. The pork ribs were too dry for our liking though., We found this place via tripadvsor, Since it was expetionally rted and as it was only around the corner, we gave it a try. We were not disappointed. Great food at reasonable price and a truly Vietnamese experience

However I was quite cranky that we were charged for these items when we didn’t even want them. It’s a cheap trick for such a nice restaurant and soured my experience at the end.

name: Lach Ca Lach Cach The Loop Xuan Thuy
address: 241 Xuân Thủy, Cầu Giấy, Hà Nội The Loop Xuân Thủy, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: The name of the restaurant is curious, I tried the branch at The Loop & liked the salted egg tofu, a must-try for a fun snack. The staff is very enthusiastic in advising on dishes, the space is cozy, feels like home. It will be cheaper if you go with a large group, the experience is worth the money., I passed by twice and found it charming, so I decided to stop in. We went as a pair and ordered about 3-4 dishes, including main courses and some light bites, which felt just right. The prices are mid-range, but in return, you get an elegant space with a cozy Vietnamese home-style vibe., Great choice for rainy days when you're craving Ha Noi grilled fish. Served piping hot, perfect to enjoy while it's still steaming. The staff recommended this set for us, and it was just right—plenty for two people to feel full. Families with kids will also find dishes that suit everyone's taste.
description: "Lách Ca Lách Cách" – Thanh âm thân thuộc từ chạn bát trong căn bếp xưa, khi bát đũa chạm nhau cùng ngân vang. Đó là cảm giác gần gũi, gợi nhớ những bữa cơm gia đình sum vầy. Lấy cảm hứng từ âm sắc giản dị này, nhà hàng Lách Ca Lách Cách ra đời, mang đến cho thực khách những món ăn Việt Nam truyền thống đậm đà hương vị ba miền. Lách Ca Lách Cách mang đến tinh hoa ẩm thực Việt, kết hợp không gian hoài cổ và hương vị nguyên bản. Sứ mệnh của nhà hàng là bảo tồn và lan tỏa giá trị ẩm thực truyền thống, đồng thời khơi nguồn kết nối gần gũi, chân thành qua không gian ấm áp, xen lẫn nét chấm phá đương đại. Mỗi món ăn là một mảnh ghép gọi nhớ về ký ức tuổi thơ, hương vị quê hương và những khoảnh khắc sum vầy. Đó là câu chuyện văn hóa được kể qua từng hương vị mộc mạc, đậm đà bản sắc vùng miền.

name: Hanoi Cider House - Restaurant & Bar
address: 278 Nghi Tam Yen Phu, Tay Ho, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: First visit here last night for some dinner. First impressions from entering from the street to downstairs was not great, it certainly didn't scream welcoming. But when we were directed upstairs it was much more impressive, very cool decor with good vibes, shame they haven't put the same thought into downstairs. The staff are plentiful and friendly if not a little slow or difficult to get attention of sometimes. They had cherry belgo beer on tap which was a massive bonus. We ordered chicken wings as a starter and they bought 6 instead of the 12 we ordered but it turned out to be a good thing. My husbands lamb smash burger with mac and cheese side was pure stodge in the right way. I braved fish and chips, which js always a gamble so far away from the UK. The fish was tasty with a good batter ratio. The chips were fairly average and on the greasy side but all was forgiven when they brought over malt vinegar, this can transform any dish so made it soooo much more yummier!!, Came here for a spot of brunch with friends on a Sunday. We booked a table in advance as we were a large group. The staff were very organised and divided the table into different billing cards, which saved the hassle at the end of dividing up the bill. The downside of this approach was that the food came out at different times, and it felt a bit disjointed. I enjoyed a chicken pesto sandwich with thick cut fries, and they made my day by having malt vinegar to soak the chips in!! Everyone seemed happy with the food and service, and it was a nice pace to sit and chat with friends without feeling rushed., Ok, so let me tell you, I am a big ribs fan. And coming from Australia I can polish off a full rack. So when I ordered a full rack and the server advised the half rack, I was skeptical. But that sizing was perfect !! A full rack would have been double the size I am used to. You can pick your sauce for the ribs, and for a white guy… I like my spice. So when I opted for the hottest spice, the server kept giving me an out.. but I kept to my guns and oh boy… It wasn’t the hottest, but it was as hot as you want it to be without the heat stopping the enjoyment. Bang on point ! The ribs fell off the bone and went down like a treat. You get 2 options of sides and I went with Mac and cheese and chips. The chips and the lemongrass sauce was amazing! The Mac and cheese was swimming in cheese! I can’t fault this place at all! The cocktails and cider are also amazing!! Definitely recommend!
description: A lively restaurant & bar serving soul food including BBQ ribs, chargrilled chicken, nachos, burgers, craft beers, ciders, signature cocktails, wine & more

name: Handi Restaurant Hanoi
address: 97 Âu Cơ Quang An Dist, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Absolutely delicious!!! The best food around this area when ur craving flavor and a great variety!! Everything on their menu is delicious; including vegan options as well! Good atmosphere and the staff is so friendly and attentive. English is excellent for ordering as they have never gotten any order incorrect. A must try and prices are excellent! Follow @travelingypsey on Instagram & Google maps Safe Travels!, The restaurant is quite comfortable and spacious, here I heard the staff tell them to serve Indian, Vietnamese, Pakistani, Afghan, Arabic dishes. The dishes on the list are quite diverse and look very attractive, the food is neatly arranged and looks quite good, the taste of the food seems new to me but in my opinion it is delicious, I find that the food here is mostly dry or fried and grilled dishes, in addition, the restaurant has mixed rice dishes which are also quite good., Indian food is really great, it has a unique character compared to other cuisines in the world, Indian food seems to be very popular when combined with coriander or chili, the food is quite unique, I especially like the rice that is cooked and mixed with the food in an earthen pot and then they bring it out and we eat it directly. There are also many other dishes at the restaurant, you can come here and experience them.
description: HANDI PAKISTAN CUISINE is the first authentic PAKISTANI cuisine in Hanoi. We have the best chef from Pakistan, they leave no stone to serve you better. We are committed to bringing you the best quality ingredients and we take great pride in exceeding your expectations. We prepare each dish with the highest degree of care and with your specific preferences in mind. Welcome to our Restaurant.

name: Lan Ong Restaurant
address: 26 Phố Lãn Ông, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: My family and I have been traveling around Vietnam for about two weeks and have found it slightly difficult to find cafes or restaurants that have options for everyone. But Lan Ong restaurant was perfect. My sister and I shared the vegetarian fried rice. They very kindly put the vegetables on the side so my sister could enjoy her plain rice while I could enjoy the rice and vegetables. It was great to have some vegetables because it can be hard to find while on holiday and in a foreign country. One suggestion would be that if you order the vegetarian green curry tell the staff about your spice tolerance. My sister didn't and it was delicious but too spicy hot for her to finish. We had the fantastic waiter Whiskey. He was very sweet and friendly chatting to us and answering our questions. His smile was very welcoming and he made our time fabulous. One last tip would be to make a reservation beforehand because as the night passes it got busier. It is not essential but just something to consider., I hosted a dinner party of 52 people in the private area on the second floor that has a beautiful ambience. The food was excellent and was specially selected with the great assistance of the manager who was very accomodating. The service was great., Today, we gathered here for our monthly meeting, and it turned out to be much more than just a meal. The venue—a beautifully preserved 100-year-old house—was once owned by a Chinese-Vietnamese tycoon. After the war, it came under government control, but its charm remains intact. The ceiling and floor are original, giving you a real sense of history. If you’re looking to enjoy Vietnamese cuisine with a touch of innovation while still honoring traditional flavors, this is the place. The food was fantastic, and the service truly elevated the experience. The staff were incredibly friendly, helpful, and attentive—especially Christina and Thomas, who brought such joy to our visit. Would 100% recommend!
description: Located at 26 Lan Ong Street, Lan Ong Restaurant offers a delightful culinary experience that celebrates the authentic flavors of Vietnamese cuisine. With a menu highlighting traditional dishes made from the freshest local ingredients, guests can savor favorites such as Pho Duck, Bun Cha, Cha Ca Grilled Fish and a variety of delectable spring rolls, Vegetarian dishes, gluten free dishes . The restaurant boasts a warm and inviting atmosphere, making it an ideal spot for both casual dining and special occasions. Whether you’re a local or a visitor, Lan Ong Restaurant promises a memorable dining experience rich in culture and taste.

name: My Pho
address: 67 Hang Bong, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: We stumbled on My Pho on arrival from SaPa as it was just near our hotel, whatever there for lunch The food is so fresh and tasty with a good amount to chose from Service is quick and price very reasonable for such good quality food Very enjoyable watching the kitchen at work and the service provided. As we enjoyed it so much we went back again for dinner abs it did not disappoint. Woukd highly recommend Always appears busy with both locals and tourists so that says a lot., Walking streets all day and the rain started and we needed somewhere to sit in and have dinner. We managed just to get a table at this little restaurant. Looks can be deceiving and it wouldn’t strike you as a goto restaurant, but they didn’t half look after us I asked for my beef to be well cooked and the beef fried rice came with a smile. The older gentleman who served us really cared that the food was as expected and that we enjoyed the food. Service outdone the food, however the food was still good., We enjoyed two meals in this restaurant in the middle of the Old Quarter and both were delicious. The menu offers a good range of traditional Vietnamese dishes, with an emphasis on pho, and we tried and enjoyed a number of different dishes. The place was busy with both locals and tourists and offered not only very good food but also excellent value for money and prompt and friendly service.
description:
We stumbled on My Pho on arrival from SaPa as it was just near our hotel, whatever there for lunch
The food is so fresh and tasty with a good amount to chose from 
Service is quick and price very reasonable for such good quality food 
Very enjoyable watching the kitchen at work and the service provided.
As we enjoyed it so much we went back again for dinner abs it did not disappoint.
Woukd highly recommend 
Always appears busy with both locals and tourists so that says a lot.

name: Duong's 2 Restaurant & Cooking Class
address: 101 Ma May Street, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We were a group of four on this cooking class, it was easy to book from the UK and we were picked by taxi from our hotel in time, Bella our cooking instructor met us and we arrived at the restaurant to a welcome drink, after preparing a meal that would cook whilst we were transported by cyclo bike to the market, where we sampled several fruits and bells was very informative on all the items at the market, after a short walk we stopped for a refreshing drink and then back to the venue, we continued our cooking class making spring rolls and grilled pork. After all this (about 3 hours) we were sat at a lovely rabble and ate the food we had prepared during the day. The meal was lovely and the staff were great. Overall, we were very impressed with the value and experience and would highly recommend., We were offered a dinner by our tour operator for our honeymoon so we went through a set menu. The atmosphere of the location was very nice, food was delicious and very well presented, service was quick, attentive but not oppressive. Surely recommended., We went here for our last night in Vietnam and the food was great. We were there early 4:45 for dinner and asked if we had reservations we did not. They said they had a large group coming at 6 and if we would be done then we could eat. (we were) I order the fillet and it was done to perfection. This is what is considered a fine dinning establishment I think so the sides were prepaid elegantly but not large volume. My sides were a mashed potato and pumpkin. The pumpkin was delicious as well as the potato just not like having a big serving of food while at home. My wife had the duck said it was the best she had ever had.
description: Located at 101 Ma May, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi, the center of Hanoi Old Quarter, Duong Restaurant Ma May has the elegance of unique contemporary architecture that harmonizes with the sophistication and nostalgia of the old quarter atmosphere. The sophisticated inerior design and layout makes customers feel immersed in the memory of Hanoi’s ancient and contemporary lifestyle. Coming to Duong Restaurant Ma May, diners will enjoy an elegant and charming menu designed by a talented and experienced chef. Chef Duong, the founder of Duong Restaurant, is in the top 4 of Top Chef Vietnam program. Chef Duong and his team built the menu by focusing on traditional Vietnamese dishes with Western influences. There are not too many dishes on our menu because we aim to create perfect dishes with delicious food and splendid decorations. Duong Restaurant Ma May is reviewed by travelers on Tripadvisor as one of the best restaurants in Hanoi Old Quarter, and gets a rating of 4.7/5 points by diners on Google.

name: Sky Bar
address: 36 Lê Đức Thọ, Phường Mỹ Đình 2, Quận Nam Từ Liêm Sheraton Hanoi West, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: The chill music and relaxing atmosphere make it a perfect place to enjoy a cocktail while admiring the city from above. The service here is truly impressive, with attentive and professional staff. In particular, Dustin was very enthusiastic and knowledgeable about drinks. He made me an Espresso Martini and introduced me to the signature drinks that his team is preparing to launch. I was really excited because everything they aim to bring is the authentic taste of Vietnam. I will definitely come back to try those drinks, The service quality at Sky Bar is truly impressive. Especially under the supervision of Dustin, who made me a perfect Old Fashioned and showed me some new mixology ideas that his team has been working on. He also consistently demonstrates professionalism, dedication, and attention to detail, making me feel specially cared for. By the way, I will definitely come back here, not only for the service but also for the amazing view., Great view, delicious drinks, and friendly staff—especially Dustin, who was very enthusiastic and helpful. Both my friend and I were impressed by the service here. If I have the chance, I will choose the skybar at Sheraton Hanoi West to host a party.
description: The chill music and relaxing atmosphere make it a perfect place to enjoy a cocktail while admiring the city from above. The service here is truly impressive, with attentive and professional staff. In particular, Dustin was very enthusiastic and knowledgeable about drinks. He made me an Espresso Martini and introduced me to the signature drinks that his team is preparing to launch. I was really excited because everything they aim to bring is the authentic taste of Vietnam. I will definitely come back to try those drinks

name: Banh Canh Ghe Ut Coi
address: 2B Quang Trung Street, Hang Trong Ward, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Banh Canh food here is quite delicious, here they call it Banh Canh Ghe. The broth here is really delicious, inside each part of Banh Canh Ghe comes with meat and shrimp, very fresh shrimp. The noodles are both tough and soft, however, I don't like eating onions very much, maybe next time I will tell the staff not to put green onions in the food. The service staff here is very friendly, the food is just ordered, about five minutes later the food will be brought out. This gives me a quite comfortable feeling, I appreciate this quite a lot., They call this dish Banh Canh Ghe Ut Coi. I heard people say it's quite delicious so I had to try it too. At first glance this dish looks like a soup, it has a lot of different ingredients that make the dish very fragrant, even from a distance, I can still taste it. You can smell the aroma from this dish. My meal is very tasty for a lot of meat and eggs, the soup is very delicious and rich, people around here eat both Vietnamese and foreign, the service of the restaurant is also very good, the staff Serve food very quickly., My wife is Vietnamese and she's a fan of these dishes. Both their noodle and fresh rolls are very delicious. The soup sauce is very thick with umami flavor, unlike pho and absolute lovely. We ordered food from Grab so don't know what the restaurant is like, but the food is worth the try.
description: Banh Canh food here is quite delicious, here they call it Banh Canh Ghe. The broth here is really delicious, inside each part of Banh Canh Ghe comes with meat and shrimp, very fresh shrimp. The noodles are both tough and soft, however, I don't like eating onions very much, maybe next time I will tell the staff not to put green onions in the food. The service staff here is very friendly, the food is just ordered, about five minutes later the food will be brought out. This gives me a quite comfortable feeling, I appreciate this quite a lot.

name: Viet Deli Restaurant
address: 58 Hang Dao, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This place has some of the best local food in the area. The staff is nice and friendly. However, the price is a bit more expensive compare to other nearby restaurant., Had dinner here with two friends. Arrived during happy hour. We had entree’s, mains, desserts and cocktails/beers for 2.5 hours. Total bill for four people 850,000VDN. Really excellent food at an amazing price. Would recommend to anyone., We had our first dinner in Hanoi here. Very tasty food - especially the Braised beef in bamboo and the the Grilled fish!! Recommended!
description: Welcome to Viet Deli Restaurant. Our aim is very simple - to provide the very best and most authentic Vietnamese food in old quarter. To do this we use only the freshest ingredients, prepared and served by our highly skilled chefs and friendly staffs.

name: San Dining
address: 2 Ng. Cầu Gỗ, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Breakfast buffet was very delicious with some different variations every morning. We stayed for a total of 4 days and 3 nights. The hospitality and genuine conversation(s) with the waitresses were also very good. In particular, Susan was highly accomodating and gave us numerous good “local” recommendations such as the Michelin star restaurant Don Duck; she informed us that they provide foreigners with local prices. We had some great conversations with Susan and she provided us with some other recommendations as well. On our last day, Susan also gave us a taste of a special tea that wasn’t on the breakfast buffet menu out of her genuine generosity. The experience was fantastic, dining room was air conditioned, everything was kept clean and tidy, fantastic atmosphere. The view was also probably one of the best in Hanoi. Every time, we were able to sit next to a window and have the view of Hanoi right next to us. Particularly the red bridge., A nice restaurant with a view of Hoan Kiếm Lake, tasting Hanoi cuisine is really romantic. The staff is very welcoming, each dish has a significant history, Vietnamese cuisine is delicious and beneficial to health, with lots of herbs in the dishes, it is very interesting. I will introduce you to my friends, Our stay at the San Grand Hotel Hanoi was nothing short of spectacular. Our visit to San dining for breakfast was fantastic, the warm and welcoming atmosphere set the tone for our entire visit.Special commendations to the Food and Beverage Managers, Susan and John, who went above and beyond to cater to our food requirements. Their attention to detail and commitment to ensuring our culinary needs were met was truly impressive. Susan was quite attentive to our Toddler's food requirements and ensured we were well taken care of.
description: San Dinning - where Hanoi cultinary eilite converges in the heart of the old town. With a luxurious, sophisticated design that harmonniously blends with the traditional breath of Hanoi. Located at the 10th floor of San Grand Hotel - No. 02 Cho Cau Go. San's Rooftop Bar is with a panoramic view to Hoan Kiem Lake and Hanoi Old Quarter with beautiful and atmospheric designed, you can enjoy foods, drinks and feel the peace of Hanoi.

name: La Fiorentina - Restaurant & Gastronomic
address: 20 Dang Thai Mai Quang An, Tay Ho, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: My boyfriend and I usually go there almost every Sunday for lunch. The pepperoni pizza and four-cheese pizza are our favorites! The truffle pasta is incredible too – it’s prepared right in a whole wheel of cheese, with a generous amount of fresh truffle. Truly delicious! The service is friendly and professional, always attentive to our requests, and the dishes come out quickly. The restaurant itself is clean, tidy, and has a cozy ambiance, making it great for a date night as well. They often treat us to homemade nut cookies at the end of the meal, which is a lovely touch. The prices are very reasonable for the quality. I also recommend the salmon appetizer and the penne arrabbiata!, This was one of the best dining experience that we had in Hanoi during our short stay. It was located very close to where we were staying, the Oakwood residence. We were attracted by the very nice decoration at the courtyard to the restaurant. It was a great decision as the service staff was very friendly and hospitable during our dinner. We ordered the cheese barrel carbonara with truffle, salad, premium rib eye steak (medium rare) and tiramisu. All the dishes were well executed and tasted great, especially the rib eye. It was cooked to our instruction. There were very generous with the truffle on our pasta as well. It was a joy to watch the service staff putting the final touches to our carbonara. Prices were reasonable considering the quality ingredients that they used for their dishes., We had the absolute pleasure of dining here with friends. It’s one of their favourites and it is easy to see why. We sat at a table in the back, after passing through a somewhat more casual looking area that was alive with guests enjoying what looked like great food and company. Chefs were busy at the wood fired pizza oven and the main grill. I was excited to experience the food. The servers are attentive and the owner/head chef greeted our table with a platter of prosciutto, mortadella, mixed olives and breads. Then came some truly excellent food and wine. Our first wine selection was sold out but our other choices were available and quite good. Two local craft beers are also very good. We started with carpaccio and a caprese salad. We ordered lamb, but we were too late as it had sold out, along with the tenderloin. The ribeye was an excellent substitute, and was cooked with skill. The black truffle ravioli is finished table side in a giant wheel of Parmesan cheese, and was excellent. We finally had a beautiful burrata, prosciutto and rocket pizza arrive hot from the oven. We of course shared everything, and would recommend that style of dining here. To cap off a superb evening we were given homemade limoncello . My one and only ‘negative’ ? There is a giant tv blocking the view of the bustling kitchen. Go here if you get the chance. You will be really glad you did.
description: At La Fiorentina, our mission is simple: enhance and educate the palate with the freshest ingredients and flavors, while surprising and exciting each guest with personal care and service

name: Habibi
address: 70/31 Xuan Dieu, Tay Ho, Hanoi, Tay Ho, Hanoi 11000 Vietnam
reviews: I would like to write a review for an excellent restaurant in Hanoi: This is my favorite place to eat in Hanoi. As soon as you enter, you are greeted by a warm and friendly atmosphere. The service is impeccable, the staff is attentive and always ready to help you with a smile. The manager is super friendly and really cares about his guests. What really sets this restaurant apart is the variety and quality of Lebanese dishes on offer. Each dish is prepared with care and the flavors are absolutely delicious, exceeding all my expectations. The portions are generous and each bite is a pure delight. The setting is elegant but unpretentious, making it a perfect place for a casual evening or special occasion. The prices are very reasonable for the quality and standing of the restaurant, which is a great plus. In short, you will never be disappointed by this restaurant. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a memorable dining experience in Hanoi. There is really nothing wrong, everything is perfect from start to finish., We absolutely loved Habibi. The restaurant is down in the Old Quarter on Hang Buôm and is co-located with Factory 47. So, look for the Factory 47 sign or else you may have difficulty finding it. The experience will be well worth it. We have now eaten here many times and we are always so warmly greeted by one or both of the owners (Richy and Soul). The food, like them, is authentic Lebanese and is also Halal, unlike so many other restaurants in Việt nam. The experience is casual with great music and impeccable service. The food is anything BUT fast food. Everything on the menu is lovingly homemade from scratch, as if it came out of someone's mother's kitchen, and is always absolutely delicious. Before coming here, my go to middle eastern meal was always shish taouk, but now I have no favorites. I've tried their shish taouk, shawarma, falafel, kofta, tabbouleh, Fattoush.....etc.... Their hummus and garlic sauce are so good, you'll want to eat them with a big spoon. We have NEVER had a mediocre meal here...let alone a bad one The food is amazing! The price is so reasonable. Try it once and you will be, like us, regulars for life!, What a wonderful place to eat. We were strolling along the street, we stopped here and sat to escape the heat. We were not expecting much but the food was fresh, clean and amazing. A hidden gem and a nice break from the local food. Sultan was the greatest host.
description: Lebanese cuisine is among the healthiest food in the world because of their ingredients and the way they cook their food. Health Line puts Lebanese food in #10 for the world's top healthiest cuisines because of its low-fat.

name: Beirut Kitchen & Lounge
address: 37A Xuan Dieu St. Tay Ho District, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: I went with my friend for the first time in a Lebanese restaurant- we didn't regret it. The place is so classy, the design and decorations are great. The restaurant has very accommodating staffs and employees. They'll all give you a big smile. Both the local and foreign staffs are friendly and all of them seems amicable. They do make great shisha. Had our first shisha here, and it was well-made by their staff (As far as I remember, he is the filipino staff-Denver,I think is his name). Had a great time drinking plus talking with the staffs. Ps. This restaurant do have great dancer, also. She's so graceful. ☺, We found this restaurant by pure luck and I’m soooo happy we did! The food was amazing and authentic. We ordered a variety of things from the menu and I cannot find 1 thing to complain about. Rachel and Imad were our hosts and they were so welcoming and lovely. If you’re in Hanoi, deffo visit!, Stopped here for lunch New Years Day. Good sound system / ambience. Excellent mezze, halloumi wrap. Rachel provided friendly efficient service with a great smile. 💜🧡💛💚💙❤
description: Located in the heart of Tay Ho District, Beirut Kitchen & Lounge brings exciting Mediterranean flavors to diners in a gorgeous Mediterranean-inspired modern covered outdoor garden designed space. Beirut Kitchen & Lounge offers the full Arabian fine dining experience, feast on fusion Mediterranean dishes, Shisha, Live Belly Dance.

name: Pho Cuon Huong Mai
address: 25 Ngu Xa Ba Dinh, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This was recommended by the locals as the best place to have pho cuon. They were amazing. I could have had another plate. They also have a fried version of pho xao bo which was delicious too. And their fried corn is worth a go too., I am no expert when judging the quality of local food. How I decide is by looking to see what clientele are there. Here it was full of locals. That told me all I needed to know. The food here is authentic. That does not mean you will like it but this is how it is meant to be served and cooked., Delicious cool pho rolls and dipping sauce were so refreshing in the Hanoi heat. Then we had fun filling the pillows up with meat and bok choy under the careful instructions of our lovely motorcycle tour guides
description: As we know, Pho is kinda typical soup noodles in Vietnam, this shop serve the "dried version" of Pho, includes the spring roll which is pho uncut version wrap with beef, fried pho with spinach, and so on, all food here goes good with beer, and ideal because is cheap !!

name: Ibiero Craft Beer Station
address: 48 Le Van Luong, Thanh Xuan Diamond Flower Tower, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: We were at a meeting at Diamond Flower Tower. It was lunchtime, and the owner of our partner company from Vietnam invited us to this restaurant. Actually, I've seen quite a few Kraft beer brewery signs. Apparently, such establishments are popular with the people of Hanoi. This establishment is one of several in the city. We had a separate office that was decorated as a room, with a bookcase and Soviet posters on the walls. An interesting solution is beer in small 0.2ml glasses. It's not much, but it's always the cold beer that the waiter brings all the time. Meat was cooked right in front of us, set on fire right on the table, everything is delicious and beautiful. I really enjoyed it, I recommend it!, Great beer, excellent service, and a unique selection of Vietnamese-inspired flavors like rice malt and pomelo beer. Perfect for introducing to friends and hosting guests!, Went there last night with my colleagues from Hanoi. We were a party of 20 and we were seated at a long table. Food was good and portion size very decent. Of all the dishes served, the best was their Ox tail Soup. With plenty of potatoes and carrots and chunks of ox tail, the broth was full of flavor and it was perfectly paired with warm crusty baguettes. Although this is a beer joint, I think they should provide more non alcoholic options apart from lemonade and Coca Cola. Service was decent and for a party of 20, they did well to attend to the different requests. One major comment on the negative side is that SMOKING IS PERMITTED, in the restaurant. I find this rather going against the grain of F&B establishments that I have been to.
description: When seeing the way that sexy artistic modern craft beer is seducing worldwide classes, the founders of iBiero believe they are exploring the most amorous and mellifluent way to express their love to people and nature of their motherland.

name: Mother's Kitchen Vietnamese Restaurant
address: 12A Hang Than Ba Dinh, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: We went for lunch with our sightseeing group.The restaurant had a warm atmosphere. Lemongrass shrimp fried on a plate Fried meat with garlic Fried duck meat with lemon grass Seasonal vegetables fried on a plate Steamed rice on panda leaves We had the black sticky rice dessert.The sweet was not very good for our taste buds.But the other dishes were delicious., We arrive this restaurant around 4.30pm, one of the waitress name Triang approached us, told us that restaurant open 5pm but we can have a seat and order drinks first. Trang really good attitude and grab customers as much as possible, this is called "business mindset". Before we enter this restaurant when to many others restaurant not ready for operation but not welcoming customers at all, Trang did a very good job, well done Trang we will be back again., Incredible food, location is lovely, it is central yet peaceful on the street it is located. With a great vibe and relaxed atmosphere. Very friendly staff and above all else the food was AMAZING. I feel content, happy, and totally pacified haha. This is delicious, I mean one of my favourite meals ever. I will be back again and again. Oh, and fantastic value for money. You will not be dissapointed.
description: Mother’s Kitchen Vietnamese Restaurant would like to wish you good health and warm welcome! It would be a great honor for us to introduce you our cozy bright space situated in a center of Hanoi. All’s these elements will bring you a fresh and relaxing space to enjoy the best cuisines served by our professional and devoted team. Come to Mother’s Kitchen Restaurant, the all-encompassing menu features varieties traditional dishes of the staple crop to celebrate the heritage of VietNam with reasonable prices. With the slogan “Mother home taste”, we always try our best to serve and to bring you the best food with exceptional services. We will be very happy to receive your valuable feedback and support. Please come to Mother’s Kitchen Restaurant and enjoy our traditional Vietnamese cuisine to nature in the heart of Hanoi!

name: Cay Cau Restaurant
address: 17 Tran Hung Dao Str, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Lunch in Hanoi. Since breakfast was at a restaurant with a local atmosphere, for lunch they took us to a restaurant where we could enjoy various Vietnamese dishes. We were seated on the second floor, and the restaurant was frequented by both locals and tourists, including groups of tourists like us and locals who were celebrating with their families. The menu was very extensive. You can compare the fresh spring rolls and fried spring rolls. The crispy fried squid had a crispy batter. The braised pork in clay pot came out and was different from what I had imagined. It tasted like braised pork, with a slightly sweet and spicy taste like Taiwanese lu rou fan. It was a taste that made me want to have white rice. Fresh spring rolls Fried spring rolls, Saigon style Fried spring rolls, Hanoi style Stir-fried spinach Crispy fried squid Braised pork in clay pot Alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks for each person Total 1,300,000VND (about 7,900 yen), We arrived just a few minutes before lunch closing, and we first told that we could not be seated. Then a manager came over and said he would cook for us. He escorted us out to the patio and shortly after we received five substantial spring rolls, a plate of wheat noodles with vegetables and chicken and two beers. The food was excellent. After a second round of beers our bill came to $23 US. The manager was very kind to let us have lunch while the restaurant was closing and we highly recommend this place., a nice neat clean busy restaurant. the staff very friendly and helpful.treated us like royalty. the menu has a great verity of food in it. didn't not have one bad meal there would highly recommend it
description:

Since breakfast was at a restaurant with a local atmosphere, for lunch they took us to a restaurant where we could enjoy various Vietnamese dishes.
