name: Bromigo - Fine Street BBQ
address: 81b Đ. Xuân Diệu, Quảng An, Tây Hồ, Tay Ho, Quang An, Ha Noi, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: When you want a meal with actual protein rather than unfilling local food, Bromigo is the bomb. You are given a paper form where you can decide everything from cuts, to how well cooked to the sauces and side order options including sala./fries allocation. Service was friendly and prompt, and price very reasonable for the quality. The lime juiceis calamansi vrom the Philippines served in a large goblet full of ice for 60K dong, brilliant value and taste., Came here 2 nights ago. In all my traveling it is some of the best food I have ever had, all 4 of us found it amazing and really well priced. We loved it so much after a long day tour we wanted some food and called them knowing we would be late to see if we could get food again and they kept the kitchen open for us to come back again. Amazing service and amazing food, We had an excellent dinner in a chill atmosphere on the terrace. The food was excellent, whether it was the meats or the homemade fries (almost impossible to find in Hanoi) accompanied by different very good and original sauces. We had wine which went very well with the meal. Excellent address that I definitely recommend. You will not be disappointed.
description: French style BBQ in Tay Ho, Hanoi. Grilled meats & homemade sauces. Inside bar with AC and outside terrace with a beautiful green & airy view.

name: Red River
address: 54 Lieu Giai Street, Ba Dinh District 36-37F, Lotte Hotel Hanoi, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: The food was very much delicious and great presentation but the portion is quite big for 1 person. Hope next time I comeback I can get a suitable portion in order to try other dish. And the waitress with short hair (her name was Nhi i don’t remember exactly) was so nice and gentle with my complicated order. Thank you so much for the experience and I will defenitely comeback., Thanks for sussgetion of Miss. Ha, Restaurant Manager. We had such a nice experience with Chinese foods. They are excellent with good service. The seats had lovely view and many thanks to those friendly servers. 5 stars for all of you, Well, the views from the restaurant help to account for the high prices. And, the service is top notch too. I've seen some negative reviews of Red River and really don't understand them. I did not find anything about the experience to be cheap and tacky. I found the service to be highly professional. The food, especially my beef dish, was one of the best I've ever had! I also loved my noodles in red bean sauce. Yes, it was heavy but red bean sauce tends to be!! This is a great place for professional meetings or a special meal with loved ones. No, I wouldn't come often (because of the prices) but I would highly recommend people visit.
description: Red River offers authentic Chinese cuisine originally inspired by China`s culinary traditions with exquisite ingredients. Experience a unique culinary journey full of genuine Chinese traditions in the heart of Hanoi.

name: Olivine Restaurant
address: No. 33 Duong Thanh Str, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Great atmosphere atop the Peridot Grand in Hanoi. The food was Western style with some nice Vietnamese twists available. The creamy mushroom soup was particularly good and after the first bite of fish and chips from the kids menu, my daughter was asking if we could come back again. Our server, Phuc Dao was highly attentive and helpful. It was clear he truly enjoys hospitality and he made me and my children feel like very welcome guests., This is the best restaurant around the old quarter. The food is very delisious and reasonable. I want to highly recommend because the service of the staff, especially Aloi - he’s very helpful and professional. He always smile with us during our meal so that make us feel comfortable and so friendly, Excellent restaurant. Very tasty food. Service at the best international level. The girl who served us, her name was Shoa Son Hoa, spoke very good English and we received service from her at the level of the best restaurants I've been to. And I've been to quite a few restaurants. Definitely a great experience.
description: Located on the rooftop, the fine dining Olivine Restaurant is the jewel in the hotel’s crown overlooking the mesmerizing infinity pool and the panoramic Hanoi views. For an exclusive experience, a private dining room is available.

name: Gánh Hà Nội Restaurant
address: 115 P. Hàng Buồm, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant in Hanoi's old town offers guests a calming and culinary break from the hectic hustle and bustle of the Hoan Kiem district. As we were escaping the crowds in Hanoi's old town, who were in the mood for New Year's Eve, we discovered a very pretty place with a view of the busy street when we looked through the window. The service staff, a young girl and a slightly older woman, were extremely friendly and accommodating. We ordered a variety of smaller dishes from the very extensive menu, which is also interesting for vegetarians, including water spinach, a vegetarian curry, fried tofu, noodles with egg, a very tasty fish dish (catfish) that was served on a traditional-looking bamboo board with two super tasty dips, noodles and peanuts, samosas and spring rolls with vegetarian fillings and much more. We tried all of the dishes and there really was something for everyone. We paid for everything with Hanoi beer for everyone and an orange juice, which came to around €10 per person. It was totally worth it, just brilliant!!!, We stumbled across this charming restaurant by chance, and it was a real revelation! The atmosphere is incredibly warm and soothing, with impeccable cleanliness and soft backgro🥘und music that invites you to relax. The menu is a culinary journey through Vietnam, with a special mention for the vegetarian options and food-allergy-frie🥬🥒ndly dishes. Whether you're a carnivore or a vegetarian, there's something for everyone! The icing on the cake? The🙋🏻‍♀️ waitress, with her infectious kindness and passion, guided us through the local specialties. Her detailed explanations of how to taste bánh xèo, Cha Ca and pork skewers with lemongrass turned our meal into a memorable experience. His good humor and smile added a special touch to the evening. If you're looking for an authentic culinary experience in a pleasant setting, don't miss this restaurant! We highly🎏 recommend it and look forward to returning., Great service from Duong the waiter who served us. Family of 5, we were seated right away. We’re able to accommodate a vegan, halal only eater and meat eaters also. Restaurant was clean, food was full of flavour and friendly staff. Only comment was that some food took a while to arrive (all dishes brought out at different times) but not an issue for us. Would recommend, especially for vegans searching for vegan friendly food!
description: Welcome to Gánh Hà Nội Restaurant & Vegetarian Food, your gateway to authentic Vietnamese cuisine. Perfectly situated at 115 Hang Buom, Hoan Kiem, in the heart of Ha Noi’s Old Quarter, we're your ideal post-adventure destination after visiting the walking street and night market. Delight in our signature Pho, Bun Cha, and Banh Xeo, alongside a variety of classic Vietnamese home-cooked dishes. Our menu caters to all, with traditional vegan food ensuring everyone in your family or large travel group savors the true taste of Vietnam. Let’s experience the essence of Hanoi's culinary magic together. #bestvietnamesefood #vietnamesecuisine #bestplacetoeat #vegetarianfood

name: Banh Mi Tam Cam
address: 114 Quán Thánh, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam

name: La Place
address: 6 Au Trieu, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: We dined here on several occasions as we found the food tasty and cheap. There were Western options but we opted to eat traditional Vietnamese. Set upon 2 floors we ate both upstairs and down. The view from the upstairs balcony was amazing of St Josephâ€™s Cathedral and for people watching. The owner was friendly., Our new favourite restaurant in Hanoi. The menu is extensive with both Asian and Western dishes and reasonably priced. Charming interior and a lovely balcony with a view of St.Joseph's Cathedral. The staff are an absolute delight - so kind and helpful. We visited many times during our stay and tried many different dishes - all met our expectations and more. CÃ¡m Æ n!, We had a few hours to kill in Hanoi before our night bus and wanted something a little different, so we headed to La Place. With a great balcony overseeing St Josephâ€™s Cathedral, itâ€™s a great way to eat, drink, and watch the world go by. We ordered a bacon cheeseburger and an Australian beef steak. Both were unique and delicious! I will say, the prices are a little steeper than the vast majority of restaurants in Hanoi. This, I believe, is due to the variety of the menu. They sell some dishes (like salmon or steak) that can be quite hard to find in Hanoi.
description: We dined here on several occasions as we found the food tasty and cheap. There were Western options but we opted to eat traditional Vietnamese. Set upon 2 floors we ate both upstairs and down. The view from the upstairs balcony was amazing of St Josephâ€™s Cathedral and for people watching. The owner was friendly.

name: The Old Well Cocktail Bar
address: 11 Trang Thi, Trang Tien, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi Close to the Ho Guom, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: What a venue! Truly amazing ambiance and architecture. The staff are attentive and so very cool. Last night I witnessed true alchemy as the mixologist did his thing. Young Kiên was waiting on me and he was extremely professional with a good command of English and a very cool sense of humour. The range of drinks is outstanding. As others have mentioned in their reviews here, the pho cocktail is astonishing. I’m talking out of this world! Heading back there now to savour the whole box and dice before leaving for Hue in the morning. If you come to Hanoi and don’t check this bar out, you will never know what you’ve missed out on. Just do it., This is a hidden gem, down a side alley and into a fantastically decorated bar with beautiful garden with a 100 year old well. Even the toilets are exquisitely decorated. The owner and bartenders are extremely welcoming and friendly and the cocktails are delicious. Well worth a visit if you’re looking for refreshment., Whenever I travel to a new major city I like to play a little game I call Bartender’s Roulette. I find one good cocktail bar on google maps or Yelp, then go have a drink. After said drink, I ask the bartender to suggest the next spot I should go drink. The Old Well was bar #2 for the night and did not disappoint. The cocktail list was small but mighty, and really distinct. The vibe is fun, there is a patio to smoke on. It’s a classy yet fun bar I’d happily visit next time I am in Hanoi :) The bartender also suggest the next bar and drink that I should visit.
description: Located just a stone's throw away from the iconic Hồ Gươm, The Old Well bar is a harmonious blend of nature and heritage. Set against the backdrop of an ancient well, this establishment offers an array of exquisite cocktails, spirits, and delectable bites. With the pulsating beats of modern hip-hop and RnB filling the air, it's a haven where history meets contemporary charm. Visit us at 11 Trang Thi, Trang Tien, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi, and immerse yourself in a unique experience.

name: Anh Hoa restaurant
address: Da chi 429 Au Co, Tay Ho, Hanoi Vietnam
reviews: Bakery & Restaurant! Went into the bakery only and it was delicious! Perfect treats and amazing cakes that are decorated beautifully for the holidays or any occasion. Prices are great as well, especially for the quality! Fresh, sweet and we will be returning customers! Can’t wait to try the restaurant! Follow @travelingypsey on Instagram Safe Travels!, first restaurant we tried in Hanoi during the group tour. Good taste, but quite crowded. I think many tour groups have meals here. Halal options available, On the last night at Hanoi, I had dinner at Anh Hoa restaurant. Unexpectedly the location is close with Tha Vi that I've visited before. Anh Hoa restaurant occupied second to fourth floor, while the first floor is occupied by a bakery that own by Anh Hoa restaurant too. The lift for access to higher floor was small due to space limitation. Possibly aimed toward large group for party, some of the menu seem more special. Although taste of menu was good, it was paid a lot with cramped area.
description: Well known bakery on street level - side street down from main highway towards area where US embassy people are living. BEST spring rolls and squid

name: Dieu's Cuisine Kollektiv
address: 27 Thai Phien Phường Lê Đại Hành, Hai Bà Trưng, Hanoi, Vietnam, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Walked passed this huddled away spot after arriving in Hanoi late a few evenings back, absolutely starving and keen to find a hot meal, a couple from Australia stopped us as we was having a snoop and told us to give it a go, we ordered a pizza and some fresh spring rolls, the owner is an absolute delight! She is honestly one of the loveliest people we have ever met and she was so accommodating with our meals, we got a takeaway and I stood chatting to her whist she was cooking, we popped by yesterday and said how lovely the food was, me and my partner agreed to return for dinner tonight, having mentioned that I’m trying to source papaya salad on my return tonight, Dieu had gone out and sourced a papaya to make me the salad tonight! Safe to say I was very happy, she made us a homemade curry and we spoke about life! If you’re visiting, this lovely independent lady is cooking good quality homemade food, one of those people I will never forget! 🥰, I was thrilled by the variety at Dieu’s Cuisine! In addition to Vietnamese specialities, there are real Swiss classics such as fondue, raclette and braid – the special thing: The cheese comes directly from Switzerland! The dishes are incredibly authentic and taste like home. I've never seen this before in Hanoi. Especially the warm and open nature of the hostess, makes you feel more than welcome. With her you can talk about God and the world and she could give me many insider tips for my further Hanoi trip. A place I can only recommend to anyone – I will definitely come back! Thank you Dieu for the super delicious food and your hospitality., Since I happen to be her neighbor, I have the opportunity to easily order her food every day. Just ask what kind of food do you want, and she will always surprise you with her creative talent. Whenever she places food on my table, I can't help but be amazed. Nothing tastes better than cuisine. She genuinely attends to each customer like a royalty. You will receive service from your very own 5-star chef here when visiting Hanoi, and you will undoubtedly have an unforgettable experience. A restaurant you must try!
description:
Dieu's Cuisine now offers Fusion Cuisine crafted by Chef Dieu, blending international culinary knowledge with her unique touch. Drawing inspiration from Swiss, Italian, French, Greek, Mexican, Japanese, Thai, Chinese, and Vietnamese cuisines, each dish reflects Chef Dieu’s personal flavor and style.

From Fondue, Raclette pizza and spaghetti to ramen and pho, discover an array of creative dishes on her menu.

Chef Dieu also offers an exclusive “12-Course Surprise Menu – Dieu’s Fusion Cuisine,” served as a private dining experience as requested. This intimate service, for a maximum of four guests, includes a drink pairing and lasts between 2 to 4 hours. The experience is priced at 2,100,000 VND per person and is available upon request via email at swisshuthanoi@gmail.com or directly through Instagram at @dieuscuisine.

Expect a memorable dining experience where international flavors meet life’s experiences. Welcome to Dieu’s Cuisine Kollektiv!

name: Valhalla Grill
address: 40 Đ. Xuân Diệu Tứ Liên, Tây Hồ, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: This is tiny place near beer street, we needed a western food fix, found this place, it was ligit better then most burgers we have had in aus. My husband already wants to go back. We got a beef (tasty) burger, with 3 extra toppings including caramilised onion, cheese and jalapenos, bia Saigon, softdrink and onion rings for a total of 190k dong. It's so cheap for how crazy good it is! Not many seats cause it's small, but so worth it if your a fan of burgers! Thanks guys, hope you expand soon!!, This restaurant is all about burgers and they have many choice like beef, chicken and vegan. But now the restaurant is already close from 9 2022 and replace to Lang Ha - Ha Noi ( pls notice that), After a lot of Vietnamese food I just needed something Western and this hit the spot. Soo good I will be raving about it for weeks!
description: Valhalla Grill is ALL about quality homemade items, we have our own production in Vietnam. All products are made with healthy and clean ingredients by a Danish butcher living in Vietnam. We produce all our own meat products (patties, sausages, pulled pork and bacon) plus we make all our own sauces and salads from scratch. Our bacon 3 days dry salted, 6 hours hot smoked and then 3 days rested - A real Danish butcher bacon. Our pulled pork is 54 hours slow cooked and smoked, to make sure it is juicy and tasty. For pattys we have a South American 90g patty and a 100g Grade A grass fed Angry. Please enjoy!

name: Dreamers & Seekers
address: 1 Tho Xuong, Hanoi 111000 Vietnam
reviews: Such a fabulous breakfast here at Dreamers and Seekers! Their Dream Board is perfect for indecisive people like me as it offers a sweet and savoury option in one meal as well as an orange juice included for a very reasonable price of around 150.000. Everything was delicious particularly the granola it was so sweet and the yoghurt used was coconut. 10/10 will be coming back, I popped in to eat something before leaving for the airport, and was pleasantly surprised by the quick service and the food. I ordered avocado on toast, which was, firstly a visual delight, and tasted superb - coming as it did with two poached eggs and a tasty beetroot sauce. My first ever coconut coffee was delicious. Definitely a must visit restaurant in Hanoi. Big thanks to DK and Thai., This morning we had a fantastic Europenian/Western breakfast. Having English breakfast, Grilled Cheese Bacon and Egg Sammie and Spinich and Feta Sammie we could not fault a thing. Meals were generous and delicious. Well trained local staff, a modern dining area and ability to pay with card were great. Thanks for having us 😊 2 Adults and 10 year old 🥝
description: Melbourne style brunch during the day with great coffee and tunes. Craft beer and comfort food at night time.

name: India Gate Restaurant
address: 15 P. HÃ ng ThÃ¹ng, P, HoÃ n Kiáº¿m, HÃ  Ná»™i 100000, Vie HoÃ n Kiáº¿m, Hanoi 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Friendly greeting and got a table...then ignored for 10 mins! Ordered drinks and food which took a while to arrive, albeit we weren't in a hurry so didn't hurt too much. Poppadoms, starters and mains all arrived at once...a trait I have got used to outside the UK. Food was reasonably tasty although my veg jalfrezi lacked spice and flavour. Starters were good and the cauliflower masala very good (albeit not a massla as I know it). Great value for money including drinks 600,000 (about Â£25) Give it a go it's not bad!, We came to this venue for dinner and we greeted by the owner who was very respectful and had a lovely chat with us. The food was great, what you would expect from Indian food which was lots of flavour and spiciness. The service was also fast and the waiters were very respectful. Would recommend to anyone in Sapa who wants some classic Indian food., Ambience: Its a small set up, fine dine and just decent. Nothing fancy but the food quality and the hospitality is great. Mr. Anuj Goel who was managing the place is an awesome host. Few recommendations besides main course can be Onion Pakoda's and Chai ( Tea). They serve delicious snacks and was the best Indian food we had in all three cities we visited in Vietnam. A must visit if you crave for Indian food in Hanoi. They also help to exchange the currency.
description: We serve authentic indian cuisine including vegen and non-veg (separate kitchen) the resturaunt is wheelchare accessible jain food is also served without any extra cost the food will also be made as per your requirement and liking

name: La Terrasse
address: 15 Ngo Quyen Street, Hanoi 10000 Vietnam
reviews: A Parisian sidewalk café in the heart of Old Hanoi serves French-Vietnamese fusion cuisine at its legendary best. The service is matched by the iconic Charlie Chaplain famous since his honeymoon here in 1936. Enjoy the most relaxing setting in Hanoi, drinks, and dinner. This is a must-repeat affordable luxury., We dined for breakfast while staying in Hanoi. The service is impeccable in the restaurant and throughout the hotel. Bao, Ly and Margo looked after us and were great. The cold food is available on a buffet and we love the fresh fruit. We ordered eggs, an omelet and eggs Benedict. All were tasty and prepared very nicely. The juice selection has many detox options and we tried and enjoyed a number of them. A highlight of our trip., Best service! Staff are attentive and friendly. Had a chillaxing time there. Food was great though we just had lunch elsewhere and just had small bites and drinks. The drinks variety was really extensive.
description: At La Terrasse, inspired by the famous Parisian cafes, visitors are plunged into the heart of Hanoi's bustling urban life. Observing passers-by, reading the papers, sipping a glass of Perrier, time slips by imperceptibly. Cafe furniture, antique ceiling fans and the street life ... a whiff of France wafting right in the heart of Vietnam.

name: Xliii Coffee
address: Lot 422 Ngo Thi Si, My An, Da Nang 550000 Vietnam
reviews: We ordered a pour over using Finca Soledad Syndra roast, a single source bean from Peru. The pour over was clean, light, high acidity with floral tones. It paired well with the custard croissant we ordered. The cafe feels clinical, very clean, bright and basically furnished. The barista who made our pour over was knowledgeable about the bean and its origins, and informative about their brand and how they source their beans which are roasted onsite. We would recommend this to anyone who enjoys a good brew and reasonably priced beverages and pastries. We enjoyed ourselves while we were there., If you are having too much of condense milked- Vietnamese coffee and fancy for more decent experience, it is where you should stop by. Relaxing atmosphere comfortable sitting demonstrated their keen on giving you a solely- coffee experience . They are very experienced and passionate in coffee beans. Staff can tell you all the stories about the beans., Introduced by my friend as we are heavy coffee drinkers with espresso machine at home. The coffee is special with high score beans sourced directly from farm. The staffs are also very knowledgeable and give us very details about each type of beans, what method to use, which pastry is compatible with the coffee choice. Although the price may not be suitable for normal daily coffee dosage, we think it’s worth it
description: XLIII Coffee is a coffee brand serving Specialty Coffee to customers who are always concerned about the taste of Origin. With the continuous efforts of excellent farmers worldwide, we will experience the true taste of this fruit. XLIII Coffee has been aiming to become a big, impactful company with social responsibilities, have access to high-quality raw materials and convey the complete original values of coffee to our customers. We follow the Five Strategies: Transparency | Traceability | Ethic | Responsibility | Transitioning Towards Sustainability XLIII Coffee transforms from the original brand - 43 Factory Coffee Roaster. We respect the achievements and values built since the beginning of the journey to discover the world of pure coffee and cherish the starting point of the first shop. On the journey ahead, XLIII Coffee continue to hold philosophy and maintain consistency in our overall activities, core values, and strategic direction.

name: All Seasons Buffet - Da Nang
address: 193 Nguyễn Văn Thoại, Da Nang 550000 Vietnam
reviews: My daughter and I chanced upon this restaurant and thought it would be worth trying, given its clean and professional appearance, as well as its reasonable prices and moderate clientele. Upon entering, we were greeted warmly by the staff, who took the time to explain the menu and offer recommendations. We decided on the all-you-can-eat seafood option, which included complimentary water, although we did order additional drinks. We began by ordering a tower, and the waiter kindly offered to peel the prawns and crab for us. As we waited, we ordered another tower for four, and the food continued to arrive as we placed our orders. The cuisine was expertly prepared, aromatic, and flavorful. Dessert was also included in the meal. I would highly recommend this restaurant and was impressed by their desire for feedback on the service and food., 5 star Food fresh and delicious, choose more Top service, specialized people to remove chickpeas for you, very convenient There's half of the shrimp, taste fresh. Pricing economically affordable, will definitely come again to eat, also recommend to relatives, We celebrated my girlfriend's birthday here. It was very tasty. The staff is very fast and attentive. The choice of dishes is large and everything is quite tasty. I really liked that my girlfriend was brought out a separate cake and given a souvenir as a keepsake.
description: Welcome to All Seasons Buffet Da Nang, the pioneer in delivering an unparalleled dining experience with the introduction of Unlimited Lobster service. Our menu boasts an extravagant selection, featuring not only Unlimited Lobster but also an array of delectable seafood and over 50 local dishes. The unique twist lies in our innovative all-you-can-eat concept, where the buffet is served directly to your table, elevating your dining experience. Nestled in the heart of the captivating beach city, Da Nang, All Seasons Buffet offers an ideal haven for enthusiasts of Lobster and Seafood. The restaurant's charm is further enhanced by its industrial, rustic design, creating a gem-like ambiance for a memorable dining rendezvous.

name: Thìa Gỗ Restaurant Da Nang
address: 53 Phan Thuc Duyen, My An, Da Nang 50507 Vietnam
reviews: If you're in Da Nang and craving authentic Vietnamese cuisine, this cozy gem is a must-visit! From the moment you step inside, the warm, welcoming atmosphere makes you feel right at home. The menu is a delightful mix of traditional dishes, each bursting with fresh flavors and expertly crafted. Everything we tried was absolutely delicious – from the aromatic pho to the perfectly seasoned banh xeo. The best part? The prices are incredibly affordable, making it easy to indulge without breaking the bank. A special shout-out to Huy, the attentive and friendly staff member, who went above and beyond to ensure our dining experience was top-notch. His hospitality truly made the meal even more enjoyable. Highly recommend this spot to anyone in Da Nang looking for great food, excellent service, and a cozy vibe!, My family and I came here for dinner, and we were lucky to be seated right away because the food was sooo delicious here. Everyone was extremely happy about the price, serving size, and our waiter An was so friendly and helpful, thankfully he helped me eat Bánh xèo correctly bc I did it wrong the first time jahahah, would definitely recommend to anyone who comes here. Completely understandable that this restaurant has a Michellin star! If I come back to Da Nang in the future, I’ll definitely make it a point to return here 🥰, The food is very good. The beef bone broth of the pho is rich in flavor. The pho is soft and glutinous. The stir-fried vegetables are delicious and the price is reasonable. Baozhu can speak Chinese and help us order food. She is smiling and the service is very good. Thank you.
description: Located on one of the quietest roads of the city center and within riding distance to the attractions, Thìa Gỗ Restaurant Da Nang has received many praises to the sky about one of the best restaurants in Da Nang. Our menu features famous cuisine from Saigon and Mekong delta such as banh xeo, lau mam hot pot, southern pho, spring rolls, etc. Our restaurant also serves Vietnamese specialties for a variety of diners ranging from meat-free, vegetarian, muslim friendly and low-carb.

name: Le Petit Bistro Da Nang
address: 81/09 Phan Tứ, Da Nang 550000 Vietnam
reviews: We decided to have dinner at Le Petit Bistro based on reviews and after looking at the menu. The restaurant and experience were amongst the best we've had in Vietnam. The authentically French food, ambience and staff were outstanding. We enjoyed talking to Peter who co-owns the restaurant with his wife. The chef also came and talked to us after we'd finished our meal. It was nice of them to take time to talk to us and we had nothing but positive feedback from them. As noted in other reviews, there are many high end French restaurants in Danang that charge near US prices. Peter noted that the restaurant is only a little over a month old and they want to build a customer base so are committed to providing the highest quality food, generous portions, at competitive prices. The meal we had last night would have cost three to four times what we would have paid in the US and we had superior service. Try this restaurant before everyone else figures it out!, A welcome contrast to Asian cuisine in a city with such a vast choice of seafood. This was without doubt the most enjoyable dining experience during our month long stay in DaNang. The French onion soup with garlic baguette was a generous bowl, but light and delicately sweet with a sprinkle of cheese. The ribeye was tender and cooked to perfection, medium rare, with beautifully seasoned fries and a creamy dauphinoise side. My partner had the Duck a l’orange which was cooked sous-vide style at low temp and it was tender and succulent. The desserts were also quintessentially French with Crème Brûlée and a Chocolate Soufflé to finish. We enjoyed meeting the English chef who clearly enjoys his profession and sourcing the very best ingredients for their menu. If you are looking for unpretentious sophistication with very reasonably priced menu then Le Petit Bistro is a great choice., An alley located cozy restaurant with impressive service and crusine. Highly recommend the Duck A L’Orange served with Dauphinoise Potato 😋 Partner loves the Steak Frites Chargrilled House Cut of Steak with Rosemary Salted Fries, Garlic Parsley Butter. Thank you for arranging the window seat, we had a great night and looking for tasting menu next time we visit
description: Welcome to Le Petit Bistro Da Nang, where exceptional dining meets warm hospitality. Building on the success of our Hội An location, we bring the same cosy charm, exquisite cuisine, and attentive service to Da Nang. Your hosts, Peter and Thuy Lawson, ensure every detail reflects their passion for quality. Guests love our French, Italian, and European dishes, including Duck Confit, Beef Bourguignon, and Mediterranean-style Lamb Shank. Our handmade fresh pasta elevates dishes like Spaghetti Vongole, Napoletana Fusilli, Chicken & Mushroom Mezze Maniche, and Mushroom Pappardelle. With Peter’s family heritage in breeding Aberdeen Angus cattle in Scotland, we serve only the finest Aberdeen Angus beef. A warm, inviting atmosphere, paired with a curated European wine list and the owners' personal touch, makes every visit special. Discover an unforgettable culinary experience at Le Petit Bistro Da Nang.

name: Bếp Cuốn Đà Nẵng
address: 31-33 Trần Bạch Đằng, Da Nang 550000 Vietnam
reviews:
I don’t normally go to the same restaurant twice when there is so many places to go, but we did here ! You should reserve a table as it gets busy from 6pm so if you don’t book expect to queue! First time we had beef noodles for my 9 year old he ate the lot with steak n chips! We had the beef rolls and they show you how to make it so don’t be afraid to try it, the chicken clay pot is amazing chicken very tender, morning glory with garlic and beef with peppers. The lemon grass juice is delicious, you can’t buy wine by the glass but they have a few cocktails and beers. They only thing is that they don’t do starters and main everything comes at once so the table can get very crowded and dishes can go cold while your trying to finish the wraps etc so I’d order as you go, staff are lovely the place is busy so second time we got there for 5.30 and was ok to sit inside in the aircon area., This is a restaurant that serves delicious banh xeo. I chose the pork version. The staff taught me how to eat it. You put the banh xeo on rice paper, top with lettuce and herbs, and dip it in the sauce. It's said that it's better to blend the two types of sauce available. The portions are large, so if you're alone, this one dish is enough to fill you up. The non-alcoholic mojito was also incredibly delicious. It's clean, reasonably priced, and the food is reasonably high quality, so I think it's a convenient restaurant to visit. You can also take away any leftovers., It was a great experience. I think I’ve never had such a tasting in vietnamese cuisine like i did in such a place. It’s common sense that when you see a crowd struggling for a seat in a restaurant it means that it’s a great one. Well it was a great one, yea, not because of the crowd, but rather the food was really excellent. It’s a place to go back to, whenever i visit Da Nang! 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻 Bếp Cuốn Đà Nẵng has carved out a reputation for its cozy ambiance that masterfully combines modern and traditional Vietnamese design, creating an inviting space for diners. The value is lauded by many patrons, who appreciate the generous portions of authentic and flavorful Vietnamese cuisine at reasonable prices.

While service is generally highlighted as attentive and informative, helping guests navigate the menu, there have been occasional reports of inconsistency. The food consistently earns rave reviews for its freshness and variety, satisfying travelers in search of traditional Vietnamese dishes.

name: Le Comptoir Danang
address: 16 Che Lan Vien, Ngu Hanh Son, Da Nang 550000 Vietnam
reviews: This is undeniably one of the best French restaurants we have ever been to in the world! We arrived in Da Nang yesterday and the restaurant at our hotel was closed, so we went out to find place to eat. And it was just there on the street in front of us after we walked for only a few minutes. We didn’t have a reservation, and they normally cannot accommodate walk-ins, but it was our lucky day because they found us a table. (Please don’t just show up because you really must make reservation.) Everything was amazing, Including the butter for the bread (they have 4 kinds to choose from!) The sommelier (wine professional) helped us choose the perfect pairing for our meal. They have two set menus, but because I am gluten intolerant, we chose appetizers and entrées from their a-la-carte menu. Not everything I chose was gluten-free, but they were able to make changes so that I could eat everything! Thank you so much to the chef and the sommelier and the wonderful servers who took such good care of us. We love this restaurant, and we will definitely be eating here again., A friend recommended me to celebrate my birthday in this restaurant. The price is reasonable and the taste is ok, especially the black snowfish, which is very delicious. The staff has good service attitude and the restaurant atmosphere makes you comfortable. They also gave me a free dessert and took a photo for me. I was very happy when the photo was taken. Thank you to the owner for the arrangement💕It is best to make a reservation, otherwise you may have to wait a long time to be seated., I went to dinner in Da Nang with my wife. It's a bit of a distance from the city, so I took a GrabCar. The shop is in a quiet residential area. The appearance of the shop is also very nice. I was a little nervous because it was a famous restaurant, but they welcomed me with a friendly smile, and I was relieved that the atmosphere inside the restaurant was relaxing. Also, the work of the staff is crisp and comfortable. I asked for a five-course course of Wagyu beef and ordered black tea because I couldn't drink. Cooking has given my brain a very good pleasure in complex flavors that I have never tasted from a single item. All five dishes were wonderfully delicious and I had a satisfying time. The black tea was so good that I ordered the same again and he gave me a little secret recipe. I can't believe it's in there! I was so happy until the last dessert (the smell of bushkan) that I was really glad to include this restaurant on this trip. It was a very good memory. Thank you for the best food and service.
description: Indulge in Chef Olivier's culinary delights, paired perfectly with wines by Sommelier Myriam. Savour local ingredients & French finds on our menu, explore unique wineries & grand crus, and feel at home in our warm, elegant bistro. Le Comptoir: where food & wine become an experience.

name: Fatfish Restaurant & Lounge Bar
address: 439 Đ. Trần Hưng Đạo, Da Nang 550000 Vietnam
reviews: Came across this restaurant whilst walking through the town and stopped for an afternoon cocktail. Funny thing was I didn’t realise until seated that I had read good reviews on trip advisor and had chosen this as one of the places we would eat at over the weekend as it is was close to the dragon bridge for the fire and water display. Had a fabulous meal all dishes had great flavours we had share plates all were delicious cocktails were yummy and hubby had a desert which he enjoyed. Staff were attentive and friendly. Price is midrange four cocktails, four small meals and one dessert AUS $104, I highly recommend visiting this restaurant. The food is incredible, full of knowledge and very well made! We ordered a starter, recommended by the house, the “falafels”, a dish to share with “ribs”, the best I have ever eaten, they melted in the mouth! and to drink passion fruit juice it is a soda. While we waited for our orders, we were offered some kind of fried bread with a delicious tomato sauce! We loved the experience. The only problem was that on Google the restaurant said it was closed, but we decided to go anyway and were surprised to find it open. We have alerted staff to correct this issue., This was my favorite restaurant in Danang before Covid. And amazingly, they only have gotten better. The menu has been revamped with stronger seafood options. The scallops and whole fish special were both cooked and presented perfectly. The pork ribs were awesome and great value for the money. The crispy pork belly was the best I’ve ever had. In addition, they now are offering heart of darkness beers on draft. Hart of darkness is my favorite microbrew in Vietnam and I am so happy they’re not offering it at fat fish! Also the cocktails have improved. The signature Fat fish cocktail is now served with a BFC (big f’ing cube) so it retains the strength and flavor that was intended. Honestly, this is one of the best restaurants ever visited in all of my travels.
description: Fatfish was created by gastronomes, for gastronomes! Our concept is simple: fresh, stunning quality ingredients, prepared with passion . We offer contemporary cuisine in a stylish, relaxed, riverfront venue, and are proud to be ranked as Lonely Planet’s top pick for dining in Da Nang. With our own in house bakery, outstanding craft beers, and a carefully selected wine and cocktail list, Fatfish is the place to indulge your taste buds!

name: Mộc Seafood
address: 26 Tô Hiến Thành, Da Nang 550000 Vietnam
reviews: I was genuinely surprised by how packed Mộc Seafood Restaurant was! Even at 9pm, there was still a line of people waiting, so I’d definitely recommend making a reservation in advance if you don’t want to wait. The atmosphere has a charming Vietnamese style, warm and welcoming. However, because it was so crowded, it was a bit noisy and made conversations a little difficult. Now, let’s talk about the food — absolutely worth the hype. The seafood is incredibly fresh, and the prices are very reasonable for the quality. The menu offers a wide variety of options, including live seafood. I highly recommend trying the lobster and grouper sashimi — both were sweet, tender, and full of flavor. Every dish we tried was well-seasoned and delicious. Overall, despite the crowd, it’s a fantastic spot for seafood lovers. Just plan ahead and come hungry!, Delicious fresh seafood dinner. We did not have a reservation and waited for about 20 minutes to get a table. We were not seated outside but in the multi-story building ext door. The waitress escorted us to our table. Incredibly fresh. We all had lobster and prawns. They took us out to choose the lobsters and weighed them for us so we knew how much we were paying up front. The tamarind prawns were amazing (minimum order was 300gms). We ordered 500gms between 2 people. We also had a 750gm lobster with garlic butter sauce- very rich. Prices are amazing with it working out around $50Aud / head including drinks and bread for mopping up the sauce. There are also several non-seafood meals for those who do not eat seafood. They also peel your prawns as well!, Exactly what we hoped and wished for. You had seen the reviews, photos and a few YouTubes about the restaurant and made it our first meal when we landed in DaNang. We had some trouble with reservations, but contacted them via FB messenger and it was promptly and efficiently sorted. Arrived to a lovely greeting and given time to look over the menu but it wasn’t really needed as we knew exactly what we wanted and was promptly taken to the tanks to select our dinner. Service was amazing, friendly and it was a real treat to have our freshly cooked seafood peeled and prepared for our very ravenous tummies after a long 24 hour traveling. We thought the garlic butter would be our favorite but to our surprise the salted egg was outstanding. (Garlic butter still very yummy) We over ordered but the price compared to home costs was still totally worth it. We are now totally spoiled as we will always compare this delicious food and brilliant service and we have all agreed, there won’t be anywhere else that can do it better.
description: Moc Seafood Restaurant space is characterized by ancient Vietnames with deep color and warm. This gives dinners a cozy and comfortable space like being in their own home. In addition,Moc Seafood Restaurant also offers a rich menu and reasonable price,not only suitable for foreign guests but also Vietnamese people.Come to Moc Restaurant and enjoy the ancient atmosphere of Vietnam!

name: La Maison 1888
address: InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort, Da Nang 550000 Vietnam
reviews: A restaurant well deserving of its Michelin star. Beautiful surroundings, excellent friendly service, fabulous food. After reading a number of reviews on Trip Advisor giving La Maison’s food low ratings, I was anxious to make my own decision. The conclusion is that those reviewers could have been eating in different restaurant or the food has improved exponentially since they were there. The meal that my wife and I enjoyed was as good as any Michelin one star restaurant that we have been to. Some dishes, such as the GRATINÉE D'OIGNONS, were what one might typically enjoy in a 3 star restaurant. I had asked for a pescatarian menu degustation, which resulted in only one change from lamb to spaghetti. I then imagined a bowl of spaghetti bolognaise or similar, but received an imaginative and very tasty creation in which I only found the spaghetti forming a wall of 2 cm pieces when I dug into it. I suspect that the vegetarian menu would be well worth trying. The 8 course menu was expensive but very good value for money. The dishes involving truffle had a very generous quantity of Perigord truffle shaved over them. There were two choices or wine menu paired with dishes. One involved 8 wines, including older vintages, and cost the equivalent of about USD298 per head, while the other, which we had, consisted of 5 generally younger wines costing the equivalent of about USD156 per person. The five wines were well matched and a couple were quite special but, considering they amounted to about 2/3rds of a bottle in total, if I went again I’d probably choose a couple of older wines from the wine list for a similar or larger cost. The beautiful surroundings and the cable car ride to the restaurant add to a memorable evening. I’d recommend La Maison 1888 to any food lover visiting Danang., We had an enjoyable dinner at this famed French restaurant in Da Nang. The ambience of the restaurant is very homely and feels like you are in a small upscale bistro in Europe. We had the Spring tasting menu designed and curated by Pierre Gagnaire. In keeping with Pierre’s signature style, both the source of ingredients and gestronomic techniques had the nice balance of classic French cooking with a detectable octave of Asian note. The staff was very professional rendering the right level of attentive service respecting the customers’ enjoyment of each course leisurely. The wine pairing selection made by the sommelier was a perfect match to each course and complimented the special flavour meant to be enjoyed. Gastronomy is an artistry. Like any art form, personal preference, taste and experience all play a factor in its appreciation and enjoyment. We were glad that we picked La Maison 1888 during our visit to Da Nang despite some not so positive comments and reviews. We would not be surprised that La Maison will get its own star if Michelin has decided to include Da Nang in its guide in the near future., Had dinner in this highly acclaimed French restaurant in Danang. The setting was beautiful as the restaurant was housed in a French-styled mansion on the slope of the very exclusive Intercontinental Danang hotel. The restaurant interior deco was nice and the service attentive but not intrusive. The ambiance was excellent and romantic. However, the food served, although nice, fell short of expectations of a restaurant of such reputation and pricing. If you have to pay about VND6 million (USD244) per head in Vietnam for a dinner, you'd better expect something very extraordinary. There wasn't any wow factor. For less than 5% of the pricing, you could actually eat an excellent Vietnamese meal in a local restaurant in Danang city!
description: La Maison 1888, the only One Star Michelin restaurant in Central Vietnam, captures the essence of haute French dining, with the distinct gourmet experience of delectable à la carte menu of distinguished classic French cuisine in Danang. This signature restaurant has already becoming the number one gastronomic destination in Vietnam.
