address: 79 Hà Bổng, Da Nang 50000 Vietnam
reviews: It's so delicious. Especially the Jjamppong pasta. The price is similar to Korean Jjamppong, but when you look at the ingredients, it makes sense. And the staff is very friendly, the restaurant has a classy atmosphere, and the entrance has a Korean Instagram feel. There is a separate lunch menu, so I recommend trying it., The modern and stylish restaurant in Vietnam's Danang, the spacious seats and coolness were impressive, the Vietnamese food was similar in every restaurant, and it was too good to taste. Vietnamese meats were very popular, and the pink-solt restaurant is soft, rich in juicy steaks and delicious, so it's easy for the family to eat at a price, and lovers think it's perfect for tasty food and atmosphere. Steak Recommendation, cream paste tomato paste, salad. Especially the Seafood Cream Pasta. I put the steak in the set menu, and the family had enough and good meat, especially the liver, and the ganish was very good! Recommendation for flavoring in Batman!, The quality of the food is really good, and the staff are very friendly. They changed us to a good spot and took care of each and every detail, and their sensible response stood out. You may think the prices are expensive compared to local restaurants, but the individual items were not that expensive and the portions were larger than expected, so the prices felt more reasonable. The pink salt pasta was delicious, and the seasoned octopus was also good, but I think I'll try the puffo next time. The lamb ribs were good because they didn't smell and were just right👍 If you want to have a delicious dinner in Da Nang with a nice atmosphere, I recommend this place~! I think it would be better if you asked for a sofa seat assignment when making a reservation^^ (We didn't use it, but a seat opened up in the middle, so we changed it💝)
description: Pink Salt restaurant is located in a beautiful area in Da Nang city, close to the beach, the Dragon Bridge, and other famous sites. We offer a wide variety of food, with a special focus on fresh and delicious seafood prepared by our talented chef. Pink Salt also features a tempting selection of steaks, perfect for those who love a great meat dish. We invite you to come and enjoy a wonderful dining experience with us!

name: Citron Restaurant
address: InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort, Da Nang 550000 Vietnam
reviews: 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 A True Taste of Vietnam at Citron! Dining at Citron was an exceptional experience from start to finish. This Vietnamese restaurant offers a perfect blend of authentic flavors, stunning ambiance, and impeccable service. Open for lunch and dinner, it’s the ideal destination for anyone looking to indulge in high-quality Vietnamese cuisine. The menu showcases traditional dishes with a refined touch, using fresh, locally sourced ingredients. From the perfectly crispy crab spring rolls to the rich and aromatic Pho broth, every dish was bursting with authentic flavors. The DaNang blue bone garfish was a standout—expertly cooked and beautifully presented. The restaurant’s design is breathtaking, with elegant Vietnamese-inspired decor and a relaxing atmosphere. Whether dining indoors or on the terrace, the setting enhances the experience, making every meal feel special. Service at Citron is truly five-star. The staff is professional, attentive, and knowledgeable about the menu, always ready to recommend the perfect dish or wine pairing. They ensured we had a seamless and memorable dining experience. If you’re looking for an authentic yet elevated Vietnamese dining experience, Citron is a must-visit. Highly recommended for both locals and travelers!, This restaurant truly lives up to its 5-star rating. The food is delicious, creatively prepared with fresh ingredients, and each dish offers a distinct, rich flavor. The service is exceptional; the staff is professional, attentive, and makes you feel like you're being specially cared for. The ambiance is elegant and spacious, with stunning views that create a relaxed and comfortable atmosphere. It's the perfect place to enjoy a special meal with family and friends, offering both a culinary delight and an unforgettable experience., We had afternoon tea and breakfast. Afternoon tea time was such a strong wind that napkins flew on the table, and the tea cooled quickly. The sweets were all delicious, especially canelé and scones. Breakfast was not the first thing in the morning, but when I told them what I wanted to eat outside, they took turns to show me around. There was so much alcohol, I was dazzled. In particular, the bread was plentiful and everything looked delicious. Some of them were made on the spot, such as pho and egg dishes. erika, who was in charge of the table at breakfast, was very kind and took nice pictures from various angles. The views are so great that I think it's worth stopping by or just sitting back and getting a taste of the atmosphere. Please note that some photos are quite dark depending on the time and place, so you may not be able to take them beautifully with your phone.
description: Savour artisanal cuisine amidst a masterpiece of design and the best views of InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort's main restaurant, Citron. The most coveted seats in the house - private dining booths - float over the hillside, 100 metres above sea level. Each unique space suspends you mid-air and takes the form of a traditional Vietnamese conical hat. Your chef's artistic palette spans a variety of flavours, with a focus on local regional Vietnamese delicacies and beautifully crafted Mediterranean specialities.

name: Madame Lân
address: 04 Bach Dang Street, Da Nang 550000 Vietnam
reviews: Nice restaurant atmosphere and service is OK nothing more nothing less. Needs to be taken off the Michelin guide definitely. Food seemed fairly priced until the portion sizes came out then I felt that I was ripped off completely. Beer and coke served in cans and were warm (asked for cold and they didn’t have any) Extremely average you’d be better off just having street food., We tried out this restaurant followed the review on Tiktok from a food blogger. The food is good, some dishes portion are not worth the price, for example the grilled chicken. We ordered 1/2 grilled chicken but the portion looks like there’s only 1/4 of a chicken. The Madame Lan grilled fish is truly a must try one, plus the stirring squid with pineapple. The Luk Lake beef we requested medium well but it too hard for chewing like well-done instead. The restaurant is an open space, no AC so it will be hot for lunch, but ok for dinner with fresh air. Design with lantern decorations bring Hoi An atmosphere. The location is just right behind the fireworks station. Price is a bit high for a local restaurant, it is more touristic nowadays as many travelers visit, not much local residents. Staff is not attentive at all, especially the girl that serve our table. She delivered the drinks but pour it all over the table and my friend’s clothes, no apology nor clean it after that. Very bad attitude, they are more focus on foreigners than Vietnamese. My tour guide booked the table under my name but the hottest apparently said there’s no table reserved under my name, it took 10mins to find out my reservation but then the table had someone else used it. Overall experience is not really pleasant except some of the food, Nhà hàng Madame Lân: A Feast for the Eyes, But Not the Palate Located beside the charming river in Danang, Nhà hàng Madame Lân welcomes guests with its elegant décor and picturesque setting. While it offers a delightful feast for the eyes, it leaves something to be desired when it comes to the culinary experience. Pros: Beautiful Decor: Nhà hàng Madame Lân is dressed to impress. The décor is beautifully put together and offers endless opportunities for those picture-perfect moments. From the intricate design details to the well-thought-out placement of decorative items, the visual aesthetics are indeed commendable. Great Selection of Food: One of the highlights of Nhà hàng Madame Lân is its extensive food selection. Catering to different tastes and preferences, the menu provides a wide variety of options that promises to tempt every palate. Great Location: Situated next to the river, the restaurant enjoys an enviable location that not only adds to its charm but also makes it easily accessible. The view of the river complements the dining experience, enhancing the restaurant's overall appeal. Cons: Mediocre Food: Despite its great variety and impressive appearance, the food at Nhà hàng Madame Lân falls short in taste. Described as extremely average and lacking any distinct or memorable flavors, the culinary experience does not live up to the expectations set by the venue's lovely ambiance and décor. Pricey by Local Standards: Considering the mediocrity of the food, the price range at Nhà hàng Madame Lân might seem a bit steep, especially when compared to local standards. The disconnect between price and taste quality might leave some patrons feeling underwhelmed. Conclusion: Nhà hàng Madame Lân is a beautiful dining spot in Danang, perfect for those who appreciate visual beauty and a fantastic location. However, if your primary focus is on a satisfying culinary experience, you might find it lacking. The restaurant's broad selection of dishes and wonderful ambiance make it a place worth visiting, but set your expectations appropriately regarding the food's taste and price. Ideal for special occasions or for those looking to enjoy a picturesque dining environment, Nhà hàng Madame Lân serves as a reminder that beauty doesn't always translate to flavor.
description: Founded in 2012, Madame Lân is the ideal destination to fully experience Vietnamese cuisine by the Han riverbank – the heart of Da Nang City. Inspired by the sophistication of Vietnam’s culinary tradition and its emphasis on building connections over shared meals, we created a place where the flavours of Vietnam can be enjoyed in a warm and inviting atmosphere. With a diverse menu that captures the breadth of our country’s regional tastes, we deliver dining experiences that embody both traditional values and modern sensibilities.

name: Ezi Legend Of The Sea
address: 298 Võ Nguyên Giáp, Da Nang 550000 Vietnam
reviews: Lovely place, very friendly, lovely decoration, good English and delicious coffee and fresh juices. Highly recommended, and right by the beach., Best coffee ever in the best neighbourhood! Chocolate taste with cacao. Just perfect😎They can make it hot or cold. As you wish. Great place also with natural wood. Very original
description: We are a traditional coffee and sandwich shop in Da Nang + Iced milk coffee with filter + Iced black coffee with filter + Iced silver coffee + Egg coffee + Grilled meat sandwich + Fish sausage sandwich

name: Le Four - European Restaurant
address: 268 Võ Nguyên Giáp, Phường Mỹ An, Quận Ngũ Hành Sơn, Da Nang, Vietnam, Da Nang Vietnam
reviews: Excellent service by Thai bao. We walked in at this place cause we loved the ambience and vibes and it proved to be the best decision. We had Pumpkin soup and fresh seafood pizza for dinner and both were served at the right temperature and we don't have enough words to describe it's taste. Very strongly recommend this place., This place is honestly the perfect place to go in da neng if you have had enough of Vietnamese food for the night, and want something Italian. I went here with family and the atmosphere when I first came here gave me the feeling that I can hold high expectations for this place and it would somehow meet my expectations. The food that we ordered consisted of pizza and burgers which served a generous amount of toppings in the meat lover pizzas and the pizza being cooked straight out was delicious. I would highly recommend going here again, We had a wonderful late lunch here today. The food was presented beautifully, everything was very well made and flavourful. The mushroom soup, the burrata salad and the chicken were all top notch and the prices are unbelievable. The most luxurious meal for a great price. The staff were really friendly and the service was super quick. We can only recommend!
description: Excellent service by Thai bao. We walked in at this place cause we loved the ambience and vibes and it proved to be the best decision. We had Pumpkin soup and fresh seafood pizza for dinner and both were served at the right temperature and we don't have enough words to describe it's taste. Very strongly recommend this place.

name: Bếp Lụa Restaurant
address: 94 Bạch Đằng, Da Nang 550000 Vietnam
reviews: If you are looking for a nice place to start sampling local cuisine try here. Really helpful and food excellent (we cheated as we had tried some dishes we ordered here during a hanoi street food tour). They really couldn’t be more helpful - vegetarian food as well if you ask for the menu, The food is delicious, well-seasoned, and made from fresh ingredients. Their dishes is absolutely amazing! The dipping sauce is flavorful, perfectly complementing every bite. Definitely coming back for more!, Amazing food and such a cozy restaurant! The people who work there delivered incredibly good service! Recommend everyone to stop by and have a lunch.
description: Bếp Lụa Vietnamese food restaurant. Say no to advertising, bring the taste and quality of Vietnamese food to customers

name: NHÀ VIỆT BÁNH MÌ &CAFFEE
address: 04 Hà Chương phường Phước Mỹ quận Sơn Trà tp Đà Nẵ 04 Hà Chương, Da Nang Vietnam
reviews: The banh mi shop has air conditioning to eat on the spot and delicious salted coffee to suit your taste. The shop is small, clean, and has comfortable seating. If you have the opportunity, you will come back., Nha Viet is an excellent spot for Bahn Mi and coffee lovers! The food was delicious, packed with authentic flavors, and the coffee was just perfect. The ambiance of the restaurant is warm and welcoming, making it an ideal place to relax and enjoy a meal. Additionally, it's very tourist-friendly with staff who are accommodating and attentive. Whether you're a local or a visitor, this is a must-visit spot for a great dining experience., After I had eaten lunch I came here for coffee. I haven’t had coconut coffee before so I came here to try my first coconut coffee. All the coworkers are so friendly and kind. One of the workers could even speak Korean very fluently which is my homeland language. It was heartwarming to have someone speak to me in my home language. The coconut coffee was also amazing. It came with a separate shot of espresso that you can pour onto the coconut drink. It was very tasty. Before I left I had wanted to try another coffee so I bought the Saigon milk coffee. The person who took my order is so nice and friendly. Sadly today is my last day here I will definitely come back to try the bahn Mi sandwiches next time!
description: The banh mi shop has air conditioning to eat on the spot and delicious salted coffee to suit your taste. The shop is small, clean, and has comfortable seating. If you have the opportunity, you will come back.

name: Olivia's Prime Steakhouse
address: 74 Bach Dang, Hai Chau 1 Ward Unit G1-G4, the Ground Floor, Da Nang 550000 Vietnam
reviews: We came to Olivia's Prime Steakhouse to celebrate our girl's birthday after search many Da Nang fine dining restaurants. We ordered salad, chicken bbq, ribeye steaks. Salad was fresh, chicken bbq was delicious and steaks were fresh, wonderful and cooked as our request. I have never had such delicious steaks before. They use wood grill instead of gas grill like other restaurants, that is why the steaks are so special. Staffs were very attentive to take care of our group. They offered a free cake for birthday and also chocolate vodka for everyone at the end. Although it was pricey but we both agreed that it was worth: luxury restaurant, 5 star service, perfectly cooked steaks - can not expect more. Many thanks for hosting our group. Sure to go back. Highly recommended., Wow, what a culinary delight! Olivia's Steakhouse in Da Nang exceeded our expectations in every way. The steaks were cooked to perfection - tender, juicy, and full of flavor. The lamb cutlets were equally impressive, with a beautiful char on the outside and a deliciously pink interior. But what really made our experience stand out was the exceptional service. Our server was attentive, knowledgeable, and friendly, making great recommendations and ensuring our glasses were always full. The atmosphere was sophisticated yet cozy, making it perfect for a special occasion or a night out with friends. We can't wait to come back and indulge in Olivia's incredible steaks again. 5 stars isn't enough - we'd give it 10 stars if we could!, Was craving a steak and found this place through google, food and drinks were great and service was also excellent. Steaks are very expensive but all the beef is imported from Australia, USA and Japan so it’s expected other non steak meals are reasonably priced. Would happily go back 👍
description: The family-owned and only Michelin Guide Selected Steakhouse in Da Nang. Newly built, fully air-conditioned restaurant specializing in cooking over a wood-fired grill. We serve Japanese A5 Wagyu, USDA Prime, Premium Australian grain-fed beef, as well as Australian lamb. We also serve pork, chicken, home-made pork and beef sausages, and other specialty foods, all cooked over a wood-fired grill. Our salads are made with the freshest greens and our home made salad dressings. Good selection of wines from around the world at reasonable prices and wines by the glass. Round off your meal with our grandma's desserts. We take pride in our food, service, and staff.

name: Cardi Pizzeria Bạch Đằng
address: 124 Bạch Đằng Phường Hải Châu 1, Da Nang 55000 Vietnam
reviews: I ordered margherita pizza, T-bone steak, and carbonara, and I recommend the steak the most! I ordered it medium and it was well cooked and good. The sauce that came with the steak was also delicious. I came around 11:30 a.m. on a weekday, there were hardly any people and the food came out quickly., We had dinner two nights, the food was delicious. We have ordered pizzas, two varieties one day and two varieties another day and they were all delicious. The two waitresses who served us on the two different days were both wonderful. We sat at the top and at night you could see the entire river with views of the ships. It was a super nice experience One of the girls was trying to speak in Spanish which we found very nice. Thank you very much, highly recommended place in terms of quality, price and location., While in Da Nang, Vietnam on vacation my friend, and I decided stop in at the Cardi Pizzeria on Bach Dang, which we learned is one of 4 Cardi Pizzerias located there. We’re so glad we did, because we ended up having a delightful encounter with their wonderful waitress, Anna. She began by greeting us with a big smile, and a lot of enthusiasm. To our great relief, since we speak no Vietnamese, she spoke excellent English, so we asked her how she had learned to speak it so well. She told us she had learned it on her own, mostly by watching American movies, which was quite a surprise. When taking our orders, she repeated them back to us, word for word, to verify them, which demonstrated her professional attention to detail. Unlike most other places we’ve eaten at, throughout Southeast Asia, she delivered our food, and drinks together, which was another nice, and very welcome touch that we were grateful for. We each had a small pizza, which is just about the perfect size for one person. I had a coconut smoothie that was absolutely fantastic, but I can’t remember what my friend had to drink. Anna was attentive, outgoing, personable, friendly, and quite frankly, very refreshing. We ended up having a somewhat lengthy conversation, interspersed with lots of laughter. Anna’s an excellent waitress, and it’s obvious that she enjoys her job, because her happy-go-lucky attitude shines through. By the time we finished eating, and left, we felt we’d had a good meal, and found a new friend. If you’re ever in Da Nang, and stop in at the Cardi Pizzeria on Bach Dang, and you’re lucky enough to have Anna as your waitress, you’ll be able to make some marvelous memories, while having a thoroughly enjoyable experience. Our only regret is that we had such a fun time, that we forgot to get a selfie with Anna to memorialize our time there. I think it’ll be okay, though, because we’ll make sure to remember to do it the next time we stop in.
description: Premium Steak & Pizza Certified Imported Steak, Fresh Italian Standard Pizza, Premium Wine Cellar Millionaire Han River view.

name: Bistecca Restaurant Da Nang
address: 20 Dong Da Street 7F New Orient Hotel, Thuan Phuoc Ward, Da Nang 550000 Vietnam
reviews: I had an amazing experience at this restaurant! The food was absolutely delicious, with flavors that were perfectly balanced and beautifully presented. The staff were friendly and attentive, making sure we had everything we needed for a great dining experience. The ambiance was warm and inviting, making it a perfect spot to relax and enjoy a meal. Highly recommended – I’ll definitely be coming back!, Very swanky restaurant on the river side of Da Nang. Probably one of the quickest dinner services I’ve ever experienced for a higher end establishment, with no complaints. Thought it was odd that they were playing Christmas music, being that it’s early April… friendly and attentive staff. The wagyu was my favorite dish of the evening, along with the yuzu cake. It wasn’t too sweet and the perfect tartness. Thought the pizza was a miss… the cheese was a bit too thick and hardened fairly quick., Everything here is wonderful. Extremely friendly staff from the waiter, manager to the chef. Delicious food, clean restaurant, top view, quiet and luxurious space. And the prices are very reasonable for everything here and in my opinion it's quite cheap. Well, if you come here, if you want to live virtual, you don't have to worry about anyone taking pictures. The staff proactively helped me and was very happy and enthusiastic. I didn't expect it. The day I went, Chau served me. The advice on dishes and types of service was very attentive, my birthday was even more perfect. In general, I can only thank you very much and wish the restaurant to always develop ❤️
description: I had an amazing experience at this restaurant! The food was absolutely delicious, with flavors that were perfectly balanced and beautifully presented. The staff were friendly and attentive, making sure we had everything we needed for a great dining experience. The ambiance was warm and inviting, making it a perfect spot to relax and enjoy a meal. Highly recommended – I’ll definitely be coming back!

name: Cabanon Palace
address: 27-29 Loseby Street Cordial Grand Hotel 21st Floor, Son Tra, Da Nang 550000 Vietnam
reviews: It was a special meal to celebrate my birthday. The oysters were particularly good as well as the crab bisque. The chef took time to chat to all diners, explaining the restaurant’s history, full menu and suggested wine pairings. Whilst not the cheapest place in town the standard of service, food and general experience was definitely value-for-money., I ate at Cabanon Palace just before Covid hit and it was amazing. They've moved location, but the food is still fantastic (phew). The perfect place for an anniversary dinner. We started with Fois Gras, followwing some delicious canapes. The Fois Gras was perfectly cooked which can be an issue in VN. We followed with a Steak and Stuffed Squid. Both delicious. A must do if you are in Da Nang!, Amazing food, wonderful service. Started with some freshly shucked French oysters and foi grois. The hanger steak was perfectly cooked - so much flavour and beautifully tender. Paired with amazing handcut chips and a jus that was a major highlight. Lobster bisque sauce with scampi and cote de boef an interesting and wonderful combination. Some calvados before dessert helped clear our stomachs for the French cheesecake, an old family recipe (paired with a beautifully balanced sorbet). Could not recommend this restaurant enough , very authentic and extremely well priced for the quality of food. Every dish was very well thought out and considered, and the service was welcoming and knowledgeable. Also a very good wine list with many great French reds that do not break the bank.
description: FRENCH RESTAURANT & ROOFTOP WINE BAR Experience an authentic french culinary dinner at Cabanon Palace restaurant: a family legacy of tastes and traditions, proud of the authentic flavors from French Riviera.

name: Banh Xeo Cuoi - Ha Noi Egg Coffee
address: 29 Phan Tôn, Da Nang 50000 Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant offers hand-crafted traditional dishes in a premium setting. We tried the Seafood Fried Rice and Crab Spring Rolls - both absolutely delicious. The Vietnamese coffee selection is impressive, with the salted coffee providing an interesting contrast to the sweet egg coffee. The attentive service and lovely music created a relaxing atmosphere perfect for couples. A must-visit for authentic Vietnamese cuisine in Da Nang!, This is a restaurant with a bright cafe atmosphere. Although located off the street, the environment is very clean and the staff are friendly and uninhibited, so enjoy a comfortable dining experience here. Korean green bean pancakes are crisp and tender on the outside, with a rich meat filling that complements vegetables, rice paper and fish sauce. The watermelon served later was also very refreshing, adding a pleasant ending to the meal., This cozy restaurant was such a great find! The food here was absolutely phenomenal! The texture of the pancakes here reminded me of my mama’s pancakes from when I was little, which left me feeling very nostalgic. Every dish I tried was delicious. The restaurant was very clean. The service was fast. The staff was very friendly and helpful; my non-Vietnamese speaking friend was explained about each dish he inquired. The hostess spoke perfect English. I would recommend everyone to try this place! 10/10!
description: We are proud to offer traditional Vietnamese dishes in premium versions. All dishes are made by hand to retain the original flavor arranged in a cozy space. We has selected typical dishes of 3 regions: North - Central - South to introduce to you. The most special thing that makes "Bánh Xèo Cuội" different from others is that Bánh Xèo is made from rice flour ground in the traditional way, while most other restaurants prefer using industrial rice flour because of its convenience. This helps us create the crispy texture and special delicious flavour of Bánh Xèo that you can hardly find elsewhere!

name: Lan Gio Restaurant
address: 169 Tran Phu, Da Nang 550000 Vietnam
reviews: Lan Gio offers an exceptional fusion dining experience that merges Chinese and Vietnamese cuisines. The restaurant’s seafood dishes stand out for their freshness and creativity, while the smaller appetizers, such as the delightful money bags, are both light and flavorful. The service at Lan Gio is commendable; the staff are attentive The restaurant's interior is also noteworthy, featuring a beautiful, warm design. Located near the scenic Han River, Lan Gio is ideally situated for anyone in Da Nang looking to enjoy a meal in a prime location. Additionally, it offers affordable pricing, making it an accessible choice for both locals and visitors. Highly recommend stopping by to try this experience., Lan Gio Dam Da Huong is a fantastic Vietnamese restaurant that truly stands out! The food is absolutely excellent, with authentic flavors and fresh ingredients that make every dish a delight. The staff is incredibly friendly and attentive, always ready to help with a smile. What’s more, the prices are very reasonable, offering great value for such high-quality meals. Highly recommend this spot for anyone craving delicious Vietnamese cuisine in a warm and welcoming atmosphere!, Fabulous Vietnamese restaurant just opposite the Pink cathedral in bustling and super noisy Da Nang. Beaten by unusually strong wind and busy rush hour streets, we found a sanctuary of peace, serenity, warm smiles, wonderful hospitality and delicious food. Very nice minimal decoration- which is super pleasant for the eye after all the colourful lanterns and illumination around- pleasant instrumental music, very generous portions charged with taste and flavours. I would absolutely recommend it for any traveller! A small touch - they even have bamboo baskets for lady purse:-)
description: Located in the heart of Da Nang, on Tran Phu Street, Làn Gió Restaurant combines modern elegance with traditional Vietnamese charm to create a high-end dining experience. We proudly offer authentic Vietnamese cuisine and innovative fusion dishes, all crafted with the freshest locally sourced ingredients. Enjoy a relaxing and cozy dining atmosphere enhanced by warm rattan lighting and sophisticated interiors.

name: Nhà Bếp Xưa
address: 64 Hà Bỗng phường Phước Mỹ  quận Sơn Trà tp Đà Nẵng, Da Nang 550000 Vietnam
reviews: Food is delicious and reasonable price, staffs are helpful and gave a good recommendation. The owner is very nice. We found this place accidentally but not disappointed at all, even the seats are busy but food came out pretty quick, tables were full but we waited less than 10 mins and food are hot and freshly cooked, I went there because it seemed easy to enter near the hotel. The menu says this is a bestseller, so I asked for the bestseller pho on the very first page. Seasoning was my favorite. The passion fruit juice was delicious. The service is good. The cold tea was also delicious. I went there at about 5:30 and it was empty, but around 6:00 the crowd kept coming in and it was full., We loved this place and went back twice. The Pho, Mi Quang and Prawn spring rolls were stand outs. Service is excellent, prices are terrific and the place really shows off a variety of Vietnamese dishes. I put the stand outs in but we really loved all the dishes, including Sweet and Sour Pork, Braised Pork, Spring Rolls and Chicken Wings. We would go back again if we were not leaving. Go early to avoid the queue for a table. A stand out of our 2 weeks trip.
description: Food is delicious and reasonable price, staffs are helpful and gave a good recommendation. The owner is very nice. We found this place accidentally but not disappointed at all, even the seats are busy but food came out pretty quick, tables were full but we waited less than 10 mins and food are hot and freshly cooked

name: TinTin Seafood Restaurant
address: 100 Pham Van Dong Street, Da Nang 50409 Vietnam
reviews: The service was excellent, they were very attentive and even offered to shell the prawns for us. Like me, the staff was incredibly polite, spoke excellent English, and made excellent recommendations. In addition, the location was spotless. The lobsters at TinTin Seafood Restaurant are huge, live, and caught right from the tank. They are so fresh and delicious, and they are very reasonably priced and the overall atmosphere is very beautiful. I highly recommend TinTin Seafood Restaurant to anyone who wants to enjoy a delicious and memorable meal., TinTin Seafood Restaurant is hands down one of the best seafood restaurants I've ever been to. I ordered a 1.2 kg grilled lobster that cost a little over $50. The food was prepared with care, and the grilled lobster was cooked perfectly. The meat was firm, delicious, and fresh. The staff even helped me peel the lobster, which I really appreciated. I was very satisfied with the service here. Everything was excellent, from the atmosphere to the staff., The best seafood restaurant in Da Nang After receiving a recommendation from an acquaintance, I made a reservation directly through Google Maps. It's very convenient with free pick-up service to the hotel. As soon as you get out of the car, employees will wait in front of the door and guide you with a large parasol. The menu is written in various languages, making it easy to understand and order without a translator. The seafood in each dish was very fresh, and when I personally selected the lobster from the aquarium, they not only cooked it deliciously, but also prepared it so it was easy to eat, so I was satisfied with both the taste and the service. The store has a spacious and cozy atmosphere, and the private VIP room is equipped with karaoke facilities, so it was even better to enjoy drinking and singing together. There is a massage shop on the second floor, and the staff skillfully massages the desired area and intensity according to your needs, so your fatigue is completely relieved. This place has the advantage of offering a full course including meals, drinks, and massage. All of the people I went with had a delicious meal and were satisfied, so I plan to visit again when I travel again. If you travel to Da Nang, I highly recommend you go there. I think it will soon be selected as a Michelin 5-star restaurant.
description: TinTin Seafood & Bar Da Nang is the perfect destination for seafood lovers, offering a wide variety of the freshest and finest live seafood. From lobsters, crabs, fish to unique seafood delicacies, all are prepared fresh on-site, ensuring the most delicious and flavorful dishes. Whether you are looking for a traditional seafood platter or something special, TinTin has something for everyone. In addition to our outstanding seafood, we also offer a luxurious karaoke space for you to unwind and enjoy time with friends, family, or colleagues. The restaurant is also an ideal venue for hosting parties, birthdays, and gatherings, with a spacious, cozy atmosphere and full amenities. Come to TinTin Seafood & Bar to indulge in a memorable seafood feast and fun-filled karaoke moments with your loved ones. We promise an unforgettable experience that combines high-quality seafood, entertainment, and lasting memories!

name: Golden Meat House
address: 100 Tran Bach Dang, Da Nang 550000 Vietnam
reviews: I had an amazing experience at this Korean BBQ restaurant! The staff was incredibly friendly and attentive, making sure we felt comfortable the entire time. The food was absolutely delicious — the meat was fresh and perfectly seasoned, and the variety of dishes really impressed me. The ambiance was also great with a beautiful view, which made the meal even more enjoyable. As it was March 8th, they also gave flowers to all the women, which was such a lovely gesture! Overall, everything was perfect, and I would rate it 10/10. Highly recommend!, This is the most premium samgyup barbecue place I’ve ever been to. The staff are very, very accommodating. Each table gets a dedicated server who cooks the meat for you, so all you have to do is sit back and enjoy. It really makes you feel pampered while you eat, like you’re getting dinner and a show at the same time! Everything was so yummy, and the quality of the food really stood out. As expected, it’s expensive, but you definitely feel like you’re paying for a premium experience. I really enjoyed it!, We had a fantastic dining experience at Golden Meat House! From the moment we arrived, the staff were incredibly welcoming and attentive — always ready to assist with grilling, give recommendations, and ensure we were comfortable throughout our meal. Their service was top-notch and made us feel well taken care of. The food was equally impressive. Every cut of meat was fresh, well-marinated, and full of flavor — especially the pork belly and beef short ribs. The side dishes were generous and delicious, and the overall quality of the ingredients really stood out. Golden Meat House is a must-visit for Korean BBQ lovers. Great service, excellent food, and a warm atmosphere — we’ll definitely be back!
description: Golden Meat House - Stone Grill BBQ & Meat Shop For those who love barbecue, immediately come to Golden Meat House Barbecue Restaurant at 100 Tran Bach Dang, Da Nang to enjoy delicious grilled dishes processed right on the stone table. Combined with grilled dishes are tofu soup, kimchi soup with pork, steamed egg coming with aromatic and richly sweet flavor, filling warm stomach in the cold Fall and Winter. Golden Meat House Barbecue Restaurant: Airy and large space. Unique and modern interior. Fresh and premium materials. Best place to dine with your passion for BBQ cuisine in general and Korean cuisine in particular. Golden Meat House - Stone Grill BBQ & Meat Shop Opening hours: 10:00 ~ 22:00

name: Riverside Terrace Restaurant
address: 493 Đ. Trần Hưng Đạo, Da Nang 550000 Vietnam
reviews: PLEASE VISIT! This is an absolute gem of a restaurant. The food was delicious from start to finish, staff were absolutely brilliant and the owner was so kind to come round with the biggest smile on his face checking how our food was. He told us all about his restaurant and even offered us a table on the top rooftop floor so we could get a superb view of the dragon bridge. The team were absolutely fantastic! My partner and I couldn’t recommend this place any more! Thank you team!, A home run. Owner Carmen is charming. Food was excellent. Bonus: view of dragon bridge from roof top dining area. We ordered: bruschetta, pumpkin soup, pasta carbonara, pasta bolognese, and the tiramisu. All authentic and delicious. The menu doesn’t say what the house red wine is but Carmen said it was a Merlot from Sicily. The meal cost somewhat higher than traditional Vietnamese food but less than you’d pay in the West. Also: paper, not plastic,straw used :), Halfway through our trip we could not resist the temptation to eat Italian and we decided to try this place and.... surprise!!! We really found a place that made us feel really at home! Credit to the kitchen made with quality products, and the Owner who welcomed us and made us feel like lifelong friends! Super recommended, to feel at home and why not to make friends as happened to us!!!
description: Your home away from home. Comfort food straight from the heart of Italy. Let us take care of you just like Mamma would!

name: Brilliant Restaurant
address: 178 Ho Nghinh An Hai Bac, Son Tra, Da Nang 550000 Vietnam
reviews: A large, charming and well decorated restaurant which offers a wide range of fresh fish, shellfish and shellfish. Here, you simply choose the cooking method and pay the price based on the weight of the chosen animal. Prices per kilo are displayed directly on the aquariums and the waitresses tell you directly the final prices according to the quantity chosen. The staff is very pleasant and smiling. An excellent experience and exceptional products!, Da Nang is full of seafood restaurants, so I was wondering where to go, but I decided to go here because the atmosphere looked good. We went in November without a reservation for two people, but we were able to sit at the open table on the first floor. It's a huge restaurant with the whole building as a restaurant, so it seems that you don't need to make a reservation. The casual yet high-class atmosphere was great. You choose the fish from the fish tank. There are pictures on the menu, so I think it's best to choose the food you want to eat and then the fish. Most of the staff can speak English and are kind. The menu is well-written, so it's fine even if you only speak Japanese. We ordered a bottle of wine and a la carte dishes, and it cost about 10,000 yen for two people in Japanese yen. I think it would be more expensive if you ordered shrimp or something. The streets around here are lively, so you can take a stroll on your way home or stop by a beach bar., It's a very delicious restaurant. It was so delicious that I went there for dinner three days. My was very kind and told me about the market price of seafood, so even Japanese people can feel at ease. If you don't eat the market price, it will cost about 5,000 yen for two people. On the last day, we had a luxurious lobster meal and it cost about 12,000 yen. The portions are large, so a small size is enough for two people. I want to go again. Thank you My 😊
description: With the design emphasized on the longstanding rice civilization of the ancient Vietnamese, stepping into Brilliant Restaurant, you will have the opportunity to immerse yourself in the cultural space and national cuisine. Brilliant Restaurant aims to become a cuisine center in the heart of Danang, collecting the culinary essence of Asian countries in harmony with the traditional cuisine of Vietnam.

name: Ari Sushi - Japanese Sushi Restaurant
address: 268 Võ Nguyên Giáp, Phường Mỹ An, Quận Ngũ Hành Sơn, Đà Nẵng, Việt Nam, Da Nang Vietnam
reviews: Super delicious! We had fried rice, sushi, and karaage – everything was a solid 10 out of 10. The staff is super friendly and the atmosphere is really pleasant. I’ve been in Da Nang since April 7th, 2025, and this was already my second time here this week. Don’t miss out on the chance – definitely come and eat here if you’re in Da Nang! Super delicious! We had Fried Rice, Sushi and Karaage – everything was a smooth 10 out of 10. The staff is super friendly and the atmosphere very pleasant. I have been here in Da Nang since April 7th, 25 and have been here for the second time this week. Don’t miss the chance and definitely stop by when you’re in Da Nang!, This is just the best sushi we've ever had! Just super tender rice, delicious fish, just a delight, everything is so fresh and delicious! I highly recommend this place for Japanese food lovers! We went together with the baby and she ate it all with pleasure! And a very nice girl waiter., Amazing premium quality shabu and sushi. Price is more than affordable compared to Bangkok. Service is very friendly and helpful. Fish is really fresh and beef is soft. The atmosphere is relaxing and not crowded. So far this is my favourite place to eat in Da Nang

name: La Cabana - House of BBQ
address: 505 Đ. Trần Hưng Đạo An Hải Trung, Sơn Trà, Da Nang 55000 Vietnam
reviews: I found this place while looking for a restaurant that suits the local atmosphere rather than Korean tourists. I was able to eat Tomahawk for half the price in Korea, the owner was friendly, and I was able to get a T membership discount, which was nice. Satisfies., Was the perfect location to see the dragon bridge light up. The staff were so attentive and the food excellent. The waiter was very friendly and attentive making sure we were completely happy with everything. One of the best meals we have had in na nang, This is a great restaurant for a steak dinner. Lots of family-friendly options too like pasta and hamburgers. We came on a Friday night and booked for 7.30pm. The timing was perfect as we were ready for coffee and desert by the 9pm Dragon Bridge show. Top tip: get your reservation in early and request a table upstairs on the veranda. When we booked the veranda was fully booked, but a group left around 8.30pm and the restaurant staff very kindly let us move tables onto the veranda for our desert. It was a great spot for the kids to see the Dragon Bridge show.
description: La Cabana is a Cozy Argentinian Steakhouse in Da Nang. Located right in front of Dragon Carp, Love Pier, Han River with amazing Dragon Bridge view, La Cabana has spacious space, comfortable seats, excellent air conditioner suitable for couple and group dining. Our sparkling balcony gives you an overall view of the Han river and Dragon bridge. La Cabana's signature includes perfect grilled Argentinian Steaks with a very reasonable price. Have yourself a memorable experience with soft music, excellent food, imported wine at La Cabana restaurant.

name: Pause And Enjoy Da Nang
address: 17 Yên Bái, Hai Chau, Da Nang 550000 Vietnam
reviews: It’s our first time to visit Vietnam, we arrived at Hoi an. Our hotel was Bel Marina, they recommended us to try out this restaurant which was located in the buzzing area of Hoi An. When we were there, the staff welcomed us warmly and the decorations was vibrant and illustrated the culture of Vietnamese. The staff then went on to recommend some of the signature dishes which is a must try. Oh Boy! I love their Pho Ga (noodles with chicken), it was light yet flavourful and warms up your stomach and alleviate my fatigue especially after a long day touching down in Vietnam. My husband ordered their bun cha, we have never seen nor eaten this dish in Singapore. So it was really a surprise and the sauce goes really well with the rice noodles and a great pairing with the meat platter. Each meat has different texture and taste varies slightly. It was a delightful and dimensional dish. At the end of the meal, the staff served us complimentary fruits! We were amazed by their service and hospitality! Thank you so much Miss Oanh! Oh and yes she speaks perfect English and took pride to explain each dish patiently. Definitely would recommend anyone in Hoi An to drop by and try!!! It was so nice that we went to their Danang outlet as our journey was from Hoi An to Danang. Needless to say I ordered my favourite pho ga. My husband tried their garlic butter prawns. We also tried their spring rolls and fried wantons! It’s really yummy. Though it was fried but it doesn’t taste cloying nor greasy. Please try !, You know the food is good when the tourists dined in from Hoi An and also their new place in Danang! Ordered their pause special starter which consists of fried wonton, fried spring roll and fresh spring roll. Their fried wonton is really amazing, is easy to eat and every mouthful is a burst of flavours that will just explode in your mouth. Their fried spring roll is nicely executed! Though it was fried but it doesn’t taste greasy nor cloying! I ordered the pho ga again! It’s just me! Really love their soup that warms your stomach after a long day! We also ordered their stir fried prawns with garlics, the sauce goes really well with the garlic (add a sunny side up like us) because it goes really well with the sauce and rice and everything! I would definitely recommend this place to first time tourists to try out! The guy speaks good English and very welcoming, I don’t feel intimidated as I don’t speak a single word of Vietnamese. Prices are stated clearly, so don’t worry. Food: 5/5 | Service: 5/5 | Atmosphere: 5/5 Vegetarian options They can cater to non meat eater too! Dietary restrictions Can share with them, The service was outstanding and the food was top quality and very delicious. We had the mango papaya salad with tofu. It was very tasty and juicy. The mixed plate with starters was amazing especially the wontons. Very fresh shrimps in delicious tamarind sauce.
description: Pause and Enjoy Restaurant -Top 5 the best restaurant in Hoi An city. We are thrilled to announce about our new restaurant branch at Da Nang! After months of preparation and hard work, we are excited to finally welcome you to our latest location, where we will continue to offer the same exceptional dining experience you have come to love. At our new branch, we aim to bring a fresh and inviting atmosphere, combined with a delectable menu that features both your favorite dishes and exciting new flavors. Whether you're coming for a special occasion or simply want to enjoy a cozy meal, our restaurant is the perfect place to gather with friends and family. To celebrate this special occasion, we offer exclusive promotions during our opening week, along with special events and surprises you won't want to miss! Come join us as we embark on this new journey. We look forward to serving you and making every meal a memorable one! **Location:** 17 Yen Bai str, Da Nang city, Vietnam ⏰ **Openin

name: Missteak
address: 15 restaurant not busy, waitress very welcoming, only 2 other
reviews: Missteak - Da Nang: A Must-Visit for Steak Lovers Missteak in Da Nang is a must-visit for steak lovers or anyone seeking a refined yet relaxed dining experience. The restaurant offers top-notch food, excellent service, and a welcoming atmosphere that makes it perfect for special occasions or a casual treat-yourself meal. The service is excellent, with attentive staff who speak English, making the dining experience smooth and enjoyable for international visitors. On top of that, Missteak has a delightful surprise for popcorn fans—their spiced popcorn is simply amazing and worth a try. Though on the pricier side, the overall experience at Missteak justifies the cost, delivering one of the finest steakhouse experiences in Da Nang., The staff are very friendly. In particular, the male manager's smile is very bright and pleasant. It's formal yet casual and friendly, so it feels like you're eating in a nice place. The quality of the meat is good and it's nice that you can order various sauces. The meat is served warm on a stone plate, and the pepper and salt popcorn is addictive., Wow! We almost didn’t come because of the limited menu but I’m so glad we did! My husband had the ribeye and I had the flat iron steak which was upgraded to a wagyu steak to celebrate the lunar new year. Both steaks were cooked perfectly! I also recommend the corn ribs and penicillin cocktail. We finished off with the carmel cheesecake which was great without being too sweet. We went to a couple other steak places in Da Nang and this was by far the best one. It’s a fairly new restaurant so not a ton of reviews but this was our favorite place in Da Nang!

The staff was also very kind and courteous, and the overall meal experience was very pleasant. If you are looking for a textual, memorable meal, this restaurant is definitely a good choice., Locate at District 1. Good service. Nice ambience. This is an awesome Cantonese restaurant. Definitely will come back again., Great place with tasty dishes. Good services. Suitable for both lunch and dinner. Should reserve for best experience.

name: Phở Phát Tài
address: 34-36 Đ. Trần Hưng Đạo, Phường Phạm Ngũ Lão, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Fantastic experience! Phong was such an attentive host, we had 12 people in a group and he helped us choose what to have on the menu, and how to add the condiments! We had teens that are fussy eaters and he was patient and they ate majority of their food which was a win for us. Thanks Phong you are a legend!, Super Phở, delicious beef noodles soup with authentic favors. Great and inviting design, English speaking staff and helpful. We think this restaurant is new but best soup in town. A must-try soup shop., The Phở Tái Lăn was simply exquisite, with fragrant herbs and perfectly cooked noodles. The atmosphere felt nostalgic, reminiscent of traditional Vietnamese eateries. The staff made us feel at home, offering recommendations and sharing stories about the dishes. Plus, the complimentary parking was a nice bonus. We left with full stomachs and happy hearts, eager to come back for more!
description:

name: Nossa - Italian Steakhouse
address: 36 Pham Hong Thai Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: After almost a fortnight in the Far East we were keen to eat something without rice! Found this atmospheric Italian restaurant about 100yards from the New World Hotel and were seated on the first floor balcony. Food was delicious with a couple of us having Lasagna and others fish served by delightful staff., After two weeks on the road in Vietnam, we wanted something a bit different for dinner. We found this place online and decided to try it out. It was a great decision ! . Walking distance from our hotel, we went upstairs and sat outside to watch the happenings on the street. It's not too noisy and the weather was warm. The very nice waitress was with us in minutes and we ordered a glass of red and white house wine, a salad, and some pasta with prawns and a pizza. The salad was fantastic, the wine very good and the pasta and pizza as good as you'd get in Italy !! . The dinner was that good that we actually went BACK the following night for dinner and it was brilliant yet again ! Same waitress, very nice - and friendly service. . Around $80 Australian dollars for 2 and that included bottle of wine. . Highly recommend., The restaurant was close to our hotel and after a long trip walking around the area looking for dinner. We both ordered pasta dishes finished off with the passion fruit panna cotta. The pasta was ok, the dessert very good. What warranted the rating was the attentiveness of the staff which makes all the difference.
description: Established in 2014, Nossa located in the heart of Saigon (opposite to five star New World Saigon hotel), NOSSA is a cozy & romantic restaurant featuring Western steak house and Italian cuisine. We offer a wide selection of chilled premium Australian Black Angus & Wagyu beef like striploin, tenderloin, ribeye, TBone and many choice of pasta, riíotto & pizzas. To complement with the aforesaid statements, the restaurant comes with an bar counter at first floor, indoor and outdoor terrace at second floor with flower and candle. The restaurant is good for couple with romance ambience and businesses or family dinner with a private room.

name: Carpaccio - Italian Restaurant
address: 79 Hai Ba Trung Street, District 1 Dong Khoi Area, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: A very good indication is always if an Italian restaurant outside of Italy, has many Italian or native speaking Italian guests. Long story short: service, food, drinks – summarized – very good. You can spend a nice evening there in a relaxing atmosphere with good music in the background. Price - value is in a very good ratio, A trip to Italy even in these times is possible, no visa nor CoVid test required. This restaurant serves the very best of Italy: atmosphere, great flavours and dolce vita. The refreshing Aperol Spritz creates the first WoW, awesome al dente pasta, homemade minestrone, antipasti della casa follow before the main course. We love the pizze e calzone, also the grilled fresh tuna steak with olives, capers, oregano and tomato sauce. Prosecco sweetens our lunch before delicious Tiramisu and Panna Cotta with berries. Not to forget the sound of the typical Italian coffee machine producing worldclass espresso. Adriano Celentano & Monica Bellucci join us for the grappa and Amalfi coast limoncello... Viva l’ Italia, Maybe the best Italian in town with homemade fresh pasta like linguine alla Sarda with fresh prawns, mussels in a slightly spicy tomato or white wine sauce. We love the original Napoli style pizze and the house special ravioli and truffle risotto. Feels like a trip to Italy 🇮🇹 despite travel restrictions! Cheers, btw their Aperol Spritz is fabulous, followed by delicious Panna Cotta or Tiramisu and iced Amalfi style Limoncello... buon appetito
description: Carpaccio - Authentic Italian Restaurant Since 2000s with 25 years brand history in Vietnam We are proud being the ambassador of Italian culinary culture, where you can immerse yourself in a refined experience from the charming yet romantic Venice. From the traditional pizza, the handmade pasta, to the classic Italian cocktails are greatly combined to create a cozy and intimate dining experience. Buon Appetito!

name: Au Lac Do Brazil Nguyen Hue

reviews: Best place for meat lover and gymer 🔥 Many types of Churrasco hot grilled meat flavored Brazil ingredients, free flow soft drinks I had premium buffet with 1,250,000++ per person. More than 10 types of Churrasco, baked lobster with cheese, picanha, cupim, etc. They also have samba performance at weekend, so perfect for group of friends and family. ALDB feasted so much fun 🥳, Good food but confused and maybe new (?) tableware. All tables had to ask for napkins and we did not get all the food we ordered, for example. If you want to eat a lot of good meat, you can go here, but no place that is memorable., Go with my colleague on Friday, Set lunch is really tasty, decoration suitable for Brazilian style and nice music vibe.

name: Phở Việt Nam
address: 66 Trần Quốc Toản, Phường 8, Quận 3 163 Tran Nao Ward Binh An, Dist. 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Affordable price, i came and ask the staff if they accept card for payment but the staff cant speak english, so i need to wait until 1 staff come and talk to me, i think only one staff who can speak english. Order the one with hot stone, so we need to put by ourselves the noodles, meat and other vegetable into the hot stone fill with the soup. Because i not put all of them in one time, the soup not boil enough and my meat not cooked well, lol, so i ask the staff who can speak english to boil again my soup, and voila..they also adding my soup. The taste really yummy, the meat so tender, the noodles also fresh and they give so many vegetables, the soup is super tasty, love it. The restaurant really crowd, but more guest come with family. The condiment available in the table and the drink (looks like tea) also avail in the table, free charge, free refill. I got trouble with my payment, but thanks for the cashier want to wait until the issued solved. The restroom also clean and provide westafel., We found this place by accident, as it’s not centrally located and has such an unimaginative name. It was such a pleasant surprise, as this is undoubtedly among the best phở in Vietnam! Go for the house special; the delicious pho broth and cooked meat (which includes brisket and oxtail) is served in stone bowls, so remains piping hot for almost the whole meal. You can order extra sides, like tendon, blood, an egg, etc, but sadly no tripes. The raw meat and noodles come separately, and you throw them into the bowl. Unique among phở restaurants anywhere in the world, they make their noodles fresh from scratch here, and you can observe the whole process through the glass window. Boy, it makes a difference, freshly-made noodles are much, much better than the packaged dry ones served elsewhere. Crispy yu-tiao (extra price) is left on the table; I highly recommend you dip it in the broth for additional delish texture. Service is excellent, they’re super quick at bringing you requests for extra stuff, like fresh lime, etc. Our go-to, Crowded restaurant, mainly frequented by Vietnamese. Just pho with fresh pasta and beef (your choice of fillet meatballs, tail ribs, etc.). Served either in bowls (small, medium, large) or cast iron casseroles filled with boiling broth into which you throw the raw meat, your fresh pasta, your Thai basil and your bean sprouts. From 70,000 to 110,000 VND. It's exotic, it's noisy, it's fast. Everything we love about Vietnam.

name: Cocotte Sila
address: 21 Ngô Thời Nhiệm, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Firstly I’d like to say thank you to Xavier and his staff for a lovely experience in Ho Chi Minh City for their friendly approach making you feel very welcome in Cocotte, a truly beautiful restaurant. We were both blown away with the quality of food and drinks at a very reasonable price. Signature dish is the French Onion soup covered in Emmental cheese which tasted like a traditional dish. We also had the Tuna with Wasabi beurreblanc and the beef ravioli, both were excellent and washed down with a very nice bottle of Cremant which was excellent. Many thanks for a great evening., I discovered Cocotte through a friend's recommendation. Located in Sila Urban Hotel, I tried the food here last week and found myself smitten with the pan-fried duck breast served with a fragrant black pepper sauce. The dish stands out more when paired with a glass of red wine, stimulating the dish's richer taste. In addition, the space is also very chill, and the service is extremely friendly. I will definitely come back., This is a French restaurant that really impressed us. The food was delicious and the price is really reasonable. Another nice surprise was that we found the exact taste we had in France (some of my us are french). A place you should try! And enjoy some of the best dishes that are also signature dishes of this restaurant: duck magret, duck confit, rosbif
description: Located on the ground floor of SILA Urban Living, Cocotte SILA is a fantastic space between two terraces from pool side to the main street decorated with designer furnitures and a large wine cellar filled with amazing and rare bottles. Near War Remnants Museum, in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City, Discover Traditional Authentic French Cuisine for everyone, with great value, warm and friendly professional service. There are 3 inside area's including a mezzanine that can be privatized for events. Our Cocotte French Bistro menu is available, it is complemented by a SILA only menu offering items only available here (Foie gras, Scallops, Veal, Lamb, Tarte tatin , etc..). The wine and cocktail selection as well as our A La Carte & special SILA menu are available all day long from 10am to 10pm. You can enjoy our Stylish French Bistro at anytime of the day, and every day of the week. Come visit, it is truly a beautiful setting with an amazing food and beverage selection at great value for money.

name: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese Cuisine & Vegetarian Food
address: 258 De Tham Street Pham Ngu Lao Ward, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Wonderful food! Would definitely recommend if you are vegetarian too - my friend is and she really enjoyed her meal. Our waiter Kien was very helpful and he showed my friend how to eat her “traditional Hanoi pork” with rice paper. He also had a lot of patience with us when we were sorting the bill., The food at this restaurant was some of the best my wife and I have eaten in Vietnam. Went back twice in 4 days and both times the food was excellent, portions generous and service quick and friendly all at a very reasonable price. The make your own Vietnamese pancake was especially delicious. The restaurant was clean and welcoming but not fancy decor wise but that doesn’t matter as the food is the main event. We booked a table through their Instagram. They do walk ins but each time we went there was a queue for that which seemed to have around a 15 minute wait time. Would highly recommend for great food and service, My husband was looking for somewhere for our last dinner in HCMC and found De Tham. We were warmly greeted and fortunately for us, a comfortable table had just opened up so we were quickly seated. The menu is good with plenty of regional options plus a fairly extensive vegetarian/vegan selection. Our waiter, Jack, was very attentive, knowledgeable and friendly so any questions we had were answered and we felt very well taken care of. My husband ordered us the fried eggplant as a starter and had the grilled beef served in bamboo as his entree while I enjoyed the caramelized pork and quail eggs. I had a glass of red wine from Dalat Vietnam and a lime soda (lime juice, a can of soda water and a small jug of simple syrup so you can mix it to your palate!) and my husband tried a couple of the Vietnamese beers they offered. The eggplant was crispy and tasty and we enjoyed the chili sauce for dipping so much that Jack brought us more. The beef was delicious, tasted chargrilled and looked appealing served up in bamboo. My bowl of pork and quail eggs was so comforting, the broth tasted like it had been simmered with love for hours at Grandmas house. We shouldn’t have ordered the banana split to share but we did and had no regrets, it too, was well executed. Prices are reasonable for District 1 and portions quite generous. Thank you Jack for taking such good care of us!
description: Welcome to De Tham Restaurant - We are proud to be a famous Vietnamese restaurant located in District 1 - considered the center of Ho Chi Minh City. Famous for its authentic Vietnamese cuisine, the restaurant offers a diverse menu with classic dishes such as Traditional fried pork, Traditional fried fish and Vietnamese Pancake. Whether you are a meat eater or a vegetarian, De Tham has a dish to please every palate. With a commitment to using fresh, locally sourced ingredients and traditional cooking techniques, De Tham is considered one of the best Pho restaurants in District 1 and is a must-visit for anyone looking for a truly memorable dining experience.

name: The Monkey Gallery Dining
address: 3F 91 Mạc Thị Bưởi, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Culinary experience of the highest level, where flavors of Asian cuisine steeped in spices and aromas give life to an alchemy that demonstrates the personality of the chef, less experienced in molecular techniques, expressed in many courses between spherification and gelation not perfectly successful. The rest very well worked out. Michelin is rigid in its 360-degree evaluations... here it has blindfolded in the service, albeit sympathetic waiters. Minimal tone in the mise en place. Too bad they replaced the wine glass with a beautiful water glass in fine Hungarian crystal .. Modest location , jap style but advanced technologies that maybe make you feel in an interstellar space and that, fortunately, you forget as soon as you are out to find yourself in the magical Saigon.... long live Vietnamese Cuisine!!, We comeback to this wow place after a short period of time since our last visit to enjoy their new festive menu. Staffs are kind and well trained and food is super delicious. We love our experience here and definitely will comeback many more times!!, This was an excellent meal! If you're looking for a fine dining experience in Saigon that is beyond worth the price point, please do check it out! I tried the 'Stylish' menu, and although it was 4 courses, there were loads of complimentary nibbles in between. Rita was our server, and she was so helpful that it made the entire experience seamless. Highly recommended!
description: Host by Chef Hậu and our Monkey. The Monkey Gallery DINING is one of the first fine dining restaurants in Ho Chi Minh City, opening in 2019 with a passion for bringing a new gastronomic destination with a Vietnamese soul to local and international diners. The dining room features an ultra-high ceiling with a central open kitchen that acts as the heart of the gallery, where our artists work on their imaginative creations. The 200m² area has 12 seats, 7 chef's table seats, and a Private Gallery, all designed for the best comfort to enjoy the chef’s creativity. The Monkey Gallery DINING has received Michelin-selected awards for 2023 and 2024, the Best 50 Discovery award, and Tripadvisor’s Traveller Choice 2023.

name: Ngon Restaurant
address: 160 Pasteur, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: The setting is superb. Fast and efficient service despite the size of our group. The dishes are very generous (too much) but not as fragrant as in the other restaurants where we stopped during our tour. The spring rolls for example were huge but only tasted like meat. Spring rolls not as good as elsewhere. Completely incomprehensible: we asked for towels to replace the wet towel intended to cool our hands. There are no paper towels and wet ones are charged extra..., This restaurant downtown was suggested by our guide. The façade of the restaurant is very lit and richly decorated with plastic plants and flowers. The interior consists of various rooms and other tables are in a large courtyard in front, all lavishly decorated. The tables are pretty close. The menu was very varied and enriched with photos to illustrate the individual dishes. Food is normal and portions plentiful. The service was efficient considering the considerable number of tables but completely impersonal. There are no architectural barriers to get to the front tables., In the central area of Ho Chi Minh City, this restaurant offers a well-kept environment both inside and outside. The service does not shine for friendliness but you eat well and with a wide choice. I definitely recommend it also in light of the now 2 weeks of local cuisine. I count around 30 euros for 4 dishes and 4 beers.
description: Exquisite and heavenly dishes in an elegant, spacious and sophisticated interior. Tastefully decorated with elaborated wooden frames, slide doors and comfortable armchairs with cushions. Soft died cloth drapes its sealing and red lanterns illuminates its interior at night. Its beautiful outdoor seating has a traditional theatre where water puppet shows and Vietnamese cultural music are held weekly. The chef’s ability to marry ingredients & flavours results in multi-dimensional dishes that are a pleasure to eat. We also offer a fine wine section that caters for those wanting to indulge.

name: Xliii Coffee
address: 178A Pasteur Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Came here for specialty coffee (i.e. pour over) after touring at the independence palace. The entrance and ambiance of the shop is minimalist style, pretty special for a coffee shop. Apparently they have another store in Danang and the shop looks even more amazing (from pics shown to us). The staff was very friendly and spent time to explain the steps for us to order coffee. He also explained how they sourced the beans and how the beans taste. He also recommended us the beans and types of coffee to try based on our preference. The price is not cheap consider it is in HCM, some could be even pricier than in HK. So, not really for budget drinkers or if you just want to have a dose of caffeine, it is more for experience., Delicious the hand poured coffee tasted like tea. No bitterness and the quality of the beans were superb. The staff were extremely knowledgeable of the business ethos and how they value not just quality coffee but genuine relationships with their coffee suppliers and methods of growing coffee that are sustainable., Staff is friendly and study coffee well. They can recommend suitable coffee based on your demand. They serve tasty cascara tea for free after you enjoy the coffee. Only a pity is that some pastry are already sold out even I came early in the morning. Not easy to find this kind of cafe for special coffee beans. Price is quite expensive compared to the typical Vietnamese coffee shops, however it worth trying !
description:
Came here for specialty coffee (i.e. pour over) after touring at the independence palace. The entrance and ambiance of the shop is minimalist style, pretty special for a coffee shop. Apparently they have another store in Danang and the shop looks even more amazing (from pics shown to us).

The staff was very friendly and spent time to explain the steps for us to order coffee. He also explained how they sourced the beans and how the beans taste. He also recommended us the beans and types of coffee to try based on our preference.

The price is not cheap consider it is in HCM, some could be even pricier than in HK. So, not really for budget drinkers or if you just want to have a dose of caffeine, it is more for experience.

name: The Lounge - Sheraton Saigon Grand Opera Hotel
address: 80 Dong Du Street, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The Lounge, located adjacent to the lobby, has first class food, drinks, and service. I happened to arrive during happy hour (daily from 5-8pm) and drinks were 50% off, which made my Mai Tai extra tasty. I also tried "Banh Xeo" for the first time, which is a traditional Vietnam dish made with Pork and Shrimp, and served with mint, basil, lettuce leaves, and a wonderful dipping sauce. Absolutely delicious and would highly recommend., Coffee & Tea & cookies are perfect,,, Service team are good as well. Space is warm & quiet We feel relaxing and will be back 😍😍, We stayed at this hotel recently for a couple of nights and had a bite to eat at The Lounge on the ground floor of the hotel at lunchtime on our first day. We were very happy indeed with the food and service so decided to do the same the next day, too. The bar/restaurant offers a good choice of plates, both local and international, plus drinks. It is a very spacious, modern area with tables, more relaxed seating and chairs at the bar as well. The mostly young staff are well trained and have great communication skills. Our waitress on both occasions, Huyen, was extremely attentive and eager to please. She recognised us the second day and greeted us warmly which was lovely. We were very impressed!
description: The place to meet, work and relax. The Lounge offers all-day dining menu themed with &More by Sheraton concept encompassing a gathering place at the hotel lobby, serving everything from coffee, tea, fresh juice to craft beer, wine, and afternoon tea.

name: Lagom Café - Belgian Beer & Coffee Lounge
address: 87 Vo Thi Sau Ward 6, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This is a super cute little Belgian beer bar, cafe and restaurant just a couple of minutes walk from The Pink Church and directly opposite Quan Pho Huong Binh for those of you on the Michelin credited pho restaurant trail, as we were. We noticed it across the street and stumbled in out of curiosity. Lovely, rustic wooden decor over several floors in a typically narrow HCMC-style dwelling squeezed, almost impossibly, into the shaft of space between buildings. A huge selection of bottled Belgian beer and several good quality staples on draft as well (I had a draft Vedette, she had a bottle of Grimbergen blonde). Really lovely staff - the young lady who served us was particularly helpful in recommending the best pho places to visit if you want to eat like a local. Hint: they are not on the Michelin credited list. But if you want to find out more about that, I suggest you pop in and ask yourself…, The first time I came here, I was impressed by the cozy feeling and the unique decoration style with beer bottles, creating a very suitable space to enjoy beer. The shop has many varieties from Belgium and has many choices from light to heavy, serving many customer groups. The service staff are very enthusiastic and attentive. I will definitely come back again!! ✨✨, I had the opportunity to visit Lagom and was really impressed with the way the shop represents the culture of Belgian beer. First, the restaurant's space is very comfortable and cozy. I feel like I'm in a little corner of Belgium. There are many unique decorative details, including paintings of famous Belgian beers. Soothing European-sounding background music creates a relaxing atmosphere ideal for enjoying beer. The shop's biggest strength is its diverse Belgian beer list. I tried many different beers and each one was interesting in story and rich in flavor. The bar's staff is very knowledgeable about Belgian beer and helped me choose the one that suits my taste. In addition, the shop also has a variety of snacks to pair with beer. I tried a few dishes such as a delicious cold charcuterie cup and a plate of beef with fragrant red pepper sauce. Although the prices are somewhat higher than some other shops, for all that the shop offers, it is a worthy experience investment. If you are a Belgian beer lover and want to experience the country's authentic beer culture, this is a great destination. I will definitely return to this restaurant in the future.
description: Based on the idea of combining 3 interconnected F&B services: Cafe, beer lounge and mini retail shop specializing in selling Belgian beers directly to the end-users. Lagom Cafe has become known not only as one of most relaxing place for savouring Belgian craft beers but also as the only location in the country selling the most diversified collection of Belgian beers at the most reasonable prices

name: Latest Recipe
address: 3C Ton Duc Thang Street Le Méridien Saigon, Mezzanine Floor, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Residing at Le Meridien Saigon where this restaurant is located, I tried it for both breakfast and dinner. The breakfast buffet is of a good standard, not a lot of choice and variety but what is there remains of quality. The fruit and/or vegetable juice freshly centrifuged to order is very appreciable. For dinner, however, I ordered a la carte, again not a lot of choice but well-prepared dishes in a mix of international and local cuisine. The price is very high for Vietnam but considering that this restaurant could be in any other metropolis in the world, you choose when you want to be safe, Tonight I dined at Le Meridien restaurant on Ton Duc Thang Street, District 1. Although the restaurant is buffet, I tried à la carte to experience the food here. I must say that the dishes I ordered to try were Mekong salad, cod fish eaten with rice... especially the fries served with shaking beef were delicious, very delicious. And the attentive, cheerful, enthusiastic waiters made the atmosphere as well as the meal more delicious. Thank you Yen, Van, Ngoc, My Dung, and Thu, for your very dedicated service., Came here for breakfast and was impressed by the service. The waitstaff are responsive and kind, and speak English well for those who do not speak Vietnamese. Maru Nguyen served us and was polite and friendly. She speaks English well and was able to answer our questions with ease. The food was good, with choices of American breakfast, Chinese food, pastries, and Vietnamese food. Nguyet or Luna, the head chef who makes Pho, is very personable and greets you when you come to her station. She is very helpful and makes great food recommendations. The pho that she and her staff makes is delicious! My family and I had a great experience.
description: Overlooking the vibrant Saigon River, Latest Recipe is one of Ho Chi Minh City's most sought-after dining destinations. Featuring a stunning open showcase kitchen, guests can enjoy live seafood, fresh noodle selections, wood-fired pizza, and made-to-order dishes crafted by our talented culinary team. Indulge in an extensive international buffet available for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and Sunday brunch, or explore our à la carte menu for a personalized dining experience. Whether you're looking for a delicious meal, a lively gathering, or an intimate dining experience, our diverse menu caters to every palate.

name: L'entrecote - Social Meating
address: Level 2, 63 Đông Du, Phường Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews:
Once again, L'Entrecôte Social Meating did not disappoint us! The formula is simple but effective, with excellent Value for Award. We took advantage of the "60,000 VND" offer to taste sautéed vegetables and pepper sauce, a delight! The service was impeccable and the atmosphere very pleasant., The restaurant's understated and elegant décor is a perfect interpretation of French sophistication. The specialty steak is served with a secret butter sauce, and the meat is tender and juicy. The wine list is impressive, with a selection of wines from Burgundy to Bordeaux. The service team is professional and welcoming, giving us a true sense of French hospitality. The most amazing thing is that they follow the traditional French recipe strictly and each dish is full of craftsmanship. It's expensive, but it's definitely worth a special occasion. This is a rare romantic dating spot in Saigon!, The signature entrecôte steak was cooked to perfection, swimming in their secret sauce. Generous portions had us swooning, while the authentic French atmosphere transported us straight to Montmartre. Absolutely smitten with their crème brûlée! L'entrecote - Social Meating wraps guests in an atmosphere that exudes both elegance and comfort, complete with a French charm that's perfect for both romantic dinners and business meetings. The service at this establishment has received high marks for its professionalism and warmth, enhancing the authentic French culinary experience.
