Diners often feel they receive excellent value, with the quality of ingredients and exceptional cooking justifying the cost. The prime sirloin, praised for its perfect preparation and irresistible secret sauce, along with an array of delightful sides and desserts, consistently earns rave reviews.
description: L’Entrecôte, the iconic Parisian eatery since 1959, now graces cities worldwide. Savor our famed single-course meal; fresh organic walnut salad, Prime Sirloin with its famous secret sauce, and unlimited daily prepared crispy french fries.Enjoy this Legendary Dining Experience in Vietnam!

name: Oriental Pearl Restaurant
address: 720A Dien Bien Phu 66th Floor, Vinpearl Landmark 81, Autograph Collection, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Honestly, one of the best restaurants I’ve been too. The location and the view is beautiful, and they have live music with a good variety on music type on saturdays that made the vibe even better. Now, the first impression, except from the view was the staff. All the staff were smiling and seemed happy which for me is very important that you can see and sense that they do wanna be there and work, and that you’re not bothering them or that they just wanted the evening to be over. Our waitress of the evening was Mocha and the service she gave was first class in my opinion as a former waitress. She went out of the way to explain the dishes to us, recommending dishes and ordered small portions for us to try. One thing I was impressed by was that she noticed that I ate the oysters raw, and therefore she recommended other dishes that contained raw fish like ceviche. She made sure that we had everything needed and didn’t mind to do everything so the evening would turn out the best for us as customers. The food was so fresh and seasoned so well. The range of seafood wasn’t very big but here it’s definitely quality over quantity and honestly, you don’t need much more than what they have. The only thing I can point out was the pasta dish that they prepare upon order. If you start with it, it might turn out great. But we had it for last and after all the fresh seafood it tasted a bit too salty for us. But definitely nothing wrong with the seasoning or so. In conclusion, I would not even hesitate to eat here again., Great service and great quality of food! Our server Mocha was the best, she was very attentive and gave us great hospitality, truly a 5 star rating. The A4 Wagyu and fresh seafood was Devine and worth the price, definitely would recommend!, My wife and I went on her birthday and we thoroughly enjoyed the late lunch, we had the 990,000 dong Pho (which was a whole different experience - the meat quality of the Pho is better here but the flavor of the Reverie pho is better in my opinion. Com ga Hoi A was a pleasant partner to the Signature Pho. The service from Mocha was exceptional. We also appreciated the birthday cake (gratis) and Mocha taking endless pictures of us and the surrounding breathtaking views. Landmark is also known for its great seafood buffet.
description: The Oriental Pearl, the city’s finest and highest all-day restaurant, serves elevated local dishes such as pho prepared with Wagyu beef set against a stunning view of the city so diners can sip on the clouds. A focus on local fare that blends tradition and creative re-imagination embodies Vinpearl Landmark 81 - Autograph Collection’s emphasis on immersing guests in modern Vietnam.

name: Sol Kitchen & Bar
address: 110 - 112 Ly Tu Trong Ben Thanh Ward, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This place has a nice vibe, staff are attentive and efficient and the food and cocktails were excellent - the pork and lamb option are melt in the mouth delicious! Couple of dissatisfaction points: mains a little lacking for vegetarians - we asked for vegetarian fajitas instead of chicken but restaurant was not willing to improvise to accommodate; If you are wine drinkers make sure you check they have enough bottles in stock for your group (12 people), ours ran out after 2 bottles - restaurant had no equivalent price alternative, the next option was almost twice the price. Could improve with accommodating customers better., We had anniversary dinner here and were absolutely blown away with the food we received. It was beautiful and some of the best food we have ever eaten. Wasn't cheap by Vietnamese standards but to have the same quality meal at home we would've paid double the price we paid here. Would recommend this restaurant for any couple that want to treat themselves whilst on holiday 10/10, This is a great, vibrant restaurant with excellent food, cocktails/drinks and service! The atmosphere was lively as it was busy with lots of young people enjoying HCMC at night. There was a couple of birthday celebrations that staff supported with a cake and singing. My partner chose the chilli con carne and duck and I chose the warm cheese & chorizo and seafood with orzo. All of the food was delicious, hot and plentiful. We were given a cheesecake dessert free as there was a very slight delay in the main courses not arriving together. Staff were helpful, efficient, smiley and created a lovely atmosphere for a great dining experience! I would highly recommend this restaurant 😊
description: Sol kitchen bar, a new dining destination right at the heart of District 1, Ho Chi Minh City. Our cuisine is inspired by the flavours of latin America. We draw most of our influence from Mexico & Argentina. We look forward to welcoming you to Sol kitchen & bar.

name: A Taste Of Saigon - Kitchen
address: 272 Đề Thám Quận 1 Hồ Chí Minh, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The staff were so friendly and helpful in this restaurant and their service seemed genuine. We were served by Blink, who had a lovely smile, and nothing was too much trouble for her. The food was really good and we didn't have to wait long for our meals. If you want to sample authentic Vietnamese food in a restaurant that provides good value for money, then this is a good choice for you, Amazing food and excellent service! The papaya salad, spring rolls, and tofu balls were all delicious—fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. The servers were attentive and made our experience even better. Highly recommend this spot!, A fantastic meal. June our waitress was very attentive, taking time to explain the menu options to us. She was extremely friendly and her use of the English language was excellent. The food and drink were delicious and good value. We shall be recommending this establishment to our tour guide.
description: At “A Taste of Saigon,” we are committed to providing a memorable dining experience that celebrates the essence of Saigon’s culinary culture. Join us for a journey of flavors, where every dish tells a story and every moment is a celebration. Discover the heart and soul of Saigon through the exquisite offerings at “A Taste of Saigon.”

name: Hải Sản Hoàng Gia Cn 46 Phạm Văn Nghị
address: Đ. Phạm Văn Nghị, 46-48 Khu Phố Hưng Gia 4, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Good location Fresh seafood Booking table in advance is better. Price is medium range compared to others seafood restaurant.
description:
Good location
Fresh seafood
Booking table in advance is better.
Price is medium range compared to others seafood restaurant.

name: Phở Việt Nam - Phạm Hồng Thái
address: 14 Pham Hong Thai Phường Bến Thành, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews:
Great food! Loved the pho. I had the beef and tendon pho. They have large portions for a great price and there are plenty of condiments. I also had the egg soup. The pho was great but I’ve never really had a bad pho since I have been here. For foreigners the pho is a bargain but compared to other places it is slightly more expensive. It’s a great place to chill inside and the customer service was amazing. It’s a Michelin star restaurant so totally recommend checking this out. I’ve had heaps of pho and personally I like stopping into family owned shops with the locals. I wouldn’t pass this by whilst you are in HCM so have a try!, Phở Việt Nam - Phạm Hồng Thái is a popular spot in Ho Chi Minh City, known for its rich, flavorful broth and fresh, house-made noodles. Their phở thố đá (served in a hot stone bowl) keeps the soup warm till the last bite. With fast service and a clean, bustling atmosphere, it’s a great choice for authentic Vietnamese phở. Michelin Guide-approved!, Whow what an amazing restaurant & soo cheap. We had their best seller in the sizzling pho, the staff were super friendly and showed us how to make the sauces to go with it. The herbs ect to accompany the dish were fresh and well presented. There was heaps of beef in the soup and they make their noodles fresh onsite. It was busy, we weren’t rushed, it was clean, but mostly the food was soo delicious. We had a great experience here and if we had more time would have gone back. So worth finding this restaurant to have their Michelin Star Pho. Thank you for an enjoyable meal. Phở Việt Nam - Phạm Hồng Thái receives accolades for its authentic pho, which guests have called out for its rich flavors and freshly made noodles. Nestled in the convenient location of district 1, the restaurant offers a warm and inviting atmosphere that many find enhances their dining experience.

The swift and amiable service contributes to the positive reviews, while the exceptional value for generous portions of delicious, authentic meals is consistently praised by patrons.
description: Great food! Loved the pho. I had the beef and tendon pho. They have large portions for a great price and there are plenty of condiments. I also had the egg soup. The pho was great but I’ve never really had a bad pho since I have been here. For foreigners the pho is a bargain but compared to other places it is slightly more expensive. It’s a great place to chill inside and the customer service was amazing. It’s a Michelin star restaurant so totally recommend checking this out. I’ve had heaps of pho and personally I like stopping into family owned shops with the locals. I wouldn’t pass this by whilst you are in HCM so have a try!

name: 5ku Station
address: 29 Thai Van Lung Ben Nghe Ward, Dist. 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We had dinner at 5ku Station today. After reading the map, we decided on shrimp, octopus and fish stomachs. Since we didn't know exactly what to expect with the last dish, we were curious. Then came the charcoal table grill for the ordered food, the fish stomach looked quite nice on the plate and we thought this was his normal fish. Far from it, it was actually fish stomachs that resumed their original shape on the grill. We tried a piece and then it was clear that this is not for us. The waitress noticed that we don't really like the ordered fish stomach and took it back with us and didn't calculate it, just great, because we had ordered this. All in all a nice experience with the barbecue at the table, the ambience is Vietnamese, but the service just super nice, for this 5 points with star., First of all, the restaurant is more than rustic, the chairs and tables are hand-made, the floor is bare concrete; the air is quite smoky due to the various table grills. The restaurant is always busy, however, as it is comparatively cheap. The barbecue itself is an experience, you grill yourself at your table on small charcoal grills, we tried beef and pork, both very nicely marinated and nicely flavorful! In conclusion, it's not for a quiet dinner for two, but if you like grilled food and a good beer, you're in good hands here., Great place for cook your own bbq - great atmosphere and service. Ordered the eggplant which was amazing along with the morning glory with garlic. For the bbq the pork and beef were both delicious but the octopus was very tough. The accompanying sauces were all delicious too. Beers were ice cold.
description:
We had dinner at 5ku Station today. After reading the map, we decided on shrimp, octopus and fish stomachs. Since we didn't know exactly what to expect with the last dish, we were curious. Then came the charcoal table grill for the ordered food, the fish stomach looked quite nice on the plate and we thought this was his normal fish. Far from it, it was actually fish stomachs that resumed their original shape on the grill. We tried a piece and then it was clear that this is not for us.
The waitress noticed that we don't really like the ordered fish stomach and took it back with us and didn't calculate it, just great, because we had ordered this.
All in all a nice experience with the barbecue at the table, the ambience is Vietnamese, but the service just super nice, for this 5 points with star.

name: Cocotte
address: 136/11 Le Thanh Ton, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Delicious lunch & good French wine for a nice price👌🏼 We went back for top dinner, the best we had in Vietnam in 3 weeks. French master chef level. Very friendly staff, who do their utmost to offer you great service. Strongly recommended. Great value for money. Must-do-in-Saigon, We had a great time with a really festive athmosphere that made us feel like in a Parisian bistro. The duck magret with pepper sauce, the oignon soup and the Bread were all delicious. The price was very reasonable with a bill of just 50€ for 3 of us including a bottle of delicious Bordeauw wine. We highly recomend and will go again!, Great French food at a reasonable price. Good selection of wine and the house wine, red or white, are as good as any in Saigon. The seafood stew is a must and ask for baguettes on the side to slurp up the sauce. Delicious
description: Near Ben Thanh market, the heart of Ho Chi Minh, Discover Traditional Authentic French Cuisine for everyone, with great value, warm and friendly professional service. Indulge in our carefully selected wine selection. Cocotte is the address of French Bistro food and wines in Ho Chi Minh City.

name: ST25 by KOTO
address: Lê Duẩn/17 Ward Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews:
We were looking for a romantic setting with Vietnamese cuisine, knowing how much my girlfriend loves Vietnamese dishes. As Vietnamese ourselves, we’ve tasted countless dishes across the country, but KotoSt25 redefined our palate of how Vietnamese cuisine can be presented in such an elegant and exuberant setting. We opted for a set menu at Koto, which was authentically Vietnamese, rich in flavors that brought us back home, yet delivered with a Western twist that elevated our dining experience. Every bite was a rediscovery, from the spring rolls with well-braised Vietnamese-style Wagyu beef to the perfectly steamed ST25 rice. My girlfriend indulged in three cocktails, each beautifully mixed and served, with the standout being the “Canh Chua”— which amazes us enough as its taste uniquely captured quiet much resemblance to the Vietnamese tomato soup but still fit itself nicely to indulge as a cocktail. Staffs were incredibly attentive, friendly, and took lots of their effort to explain the ingredients and stories behind each dish (though we barely remembered all the details 😂). Their warmth made us feel truly appreciated and cherished. We were even greeted by the hotel’s GM and the restaurant manager, who made their rounds to ensure every guest was enjoying their meal—a truly memorable touch. It was a night that brought us even closer as a couple, and we would highly recommend KotoSt25 to anyone looking to share a lovely evening with their loved one., Lovely dinner with braised Australian wagyu beef cheek spring rolls and the Halong Bay oysters for entrees. Springs rolls were hot, flavourful, and a nice start, as were the oysters, which were huge. Our mains were the slow roasted half bbq chicken and the crispy pork belly porchetta with seasonal asian greens and the fried rice with mushrooms and baby corn. The bbq chicken was well worth the wait and was tender, moist, and full of flavour while the porchetta was very tasty but huge and more than enough for two people. Finally, our desserts were rice pudding and the pandan waffle with strawberries, cream, and soursop ice cream. The coconut and mango rice pudding was the best we ever tasted with a beautiful texture and was simply genius. The waffle for me was the perfect finish to a lovely meal. Our server, Thuy / Mille was friendly, patient and very attentive with a very strong interpersonal skills. Very approachsble and professional at the same time. 10/10, Large open kitchen restaurant with lovely attentive staff, explained the dishes when presented etc etc topped up water when the glasses got low. Food was fantastic, we had the half chicken (knowing it would take 45min) and some Asian greens and of course a bowl of ST25 rice. Spring rolls for entree were great, full of beef and a great way to start. Was offered to have greens and rice whilst we wait for the main but chosen to have it together. Fantastic flavours and topped it off with dessert. We would def come back here again. Looking forward to it already. At the time of our visit they were open for lunch but only on weekends. Last dinner orders taken I think was 1030pm so a great option for late dinner. Accor Plus discount applied, I think the max discount was 30% food and the usual 20% for drinks) ST25 by KOTO garners high praise from patrons for providing exceptional value, with its high-quality, flavor-rich dishes and commendable social mission. Guests have called out the staff's attentiveness and warmth, enhancing the dining experience.

The restaurant's atmosphere is often described as stylish and luxurious, perfect for both intimate dinners and group gatherings. Moreover, the fusion of traditional Vietnamese flavors with contemporary twists in the food presentation consistently earns rave reviews from travelers.
description: ST25 by KOTO pays tribute to the renowned Vietnamese rice variety, ST25, which earned the prestigious title of "World's Best Rice" in 2019, representing the essence of Vietnamese culture. It's a place where every meal can be a force for good, where the quintessence of Vietnamese cuisine and the mission of contributing to community development go hand in hand.

name: Secret Garden - Vietnamese Restaurant
address: 158 Pasteur, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We recently tried the Vietnamese rice pancake with mushroom, and it exceeded our expectations. The pancake was perfectly crispy on the outside, while the mushrooms added a burst of earthy flavors. It was a delightful combination that left us craving for more! What sets Secret Garden Restaurant apart is not only the delectable food, but also the affordable prices. You can enjoy a fulfilling meal without breaking the bank, which is a rare find in such a bustling city. The ambiance of the restaurant is charming, with a cozy garden setting that creates a tranquil atmosphere amidst the hustle and bustle of the city. The attentive staff were friendly and knowledgeable, eager to provide suggestions and ensure our dining experience was enjoyable., It would be very easy to think the directions / location were wrong for this restaurant as you walk down a semi dark lane and then you find yourself climbing up a stairs past many busy apartments occupied by local Ho Chin Minn families. However, on arriving at the semi open roof top restaurant you are greeted by welcoming staff of this atmospheric culinary experience. Food was superb set out a very comprehensive menu. Can highly recommend but again, trust the directions 👍, Looking for a delectable dining experience that won't break the bank? Look no further than Secret Garden Restaurant. The affordable prices and generous portions ensure you get a satisfying meal for a reasonable price. The attentive and helpful staff are knowledgeable about the menu, making sure you get exactly what you desire. The authentic Vietnamese cuisine, made with fresh ingredients, will leave you craving for more.
description: Secret Garden 158 Pasteur is the original restaurant established since 2012 offering patrons signature home-cooked Vietnamese dishes and drinks, located on the rooftop of old building in town as a perfect view of the whole city life in day and night time.

name: Soul Classic Pub
address: 06 Đoàn Văn Bơ, Phường 9, Quận 4, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: awesome place to habe a good drink and an incredible view to Saigon City Center. Cocktails looks and taste very nice! recommend to visit after sundown, Various cocktails, good price, and supper windy on this high rooftop, that will blows away your stress and frozen your brian., Beautiful day to visit soul, open space, nice view on the terrace, reasonably priced wine and beer to enjoy, very friendly staff, chill and vibrant music, where love and friendship can sit together, my leisure time will be here...
description: When you see these lines, you may be on a trip to Vietnam. I hope you have a meaningful and joyful journey while you are here. Looking forward to meeting you. We are Soul, a bar with a comfortable atmosphere and friendliness, always welcoming everyone.

name: Octo Tapas Restobar
address: 75 Ho Tung Mau 2nd Floor, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Went here on the complete off chance. My wife found it looking on the internet as she fancied some tapas and it did not disappoint. Food and service was excellent. The waitress was very helpful and would not let us over order and the food arrived in the perfect amount of time. Not too quick but slow enough to know it was all being prepared freshly. Open kitchen so you can see the action. Very clean and a very nice ambiance. Would highly recommend the sucking pig., Excellent food , tasty small plates to share. You won’t get tired of the same flavors ( like in a large portion) try lots of different and interesting dishes. The waiters are very friendly and attentive, and good suggestions if you’re not sure what to try. Open kitchen was fun to watch the dishes being prepared! We went there twice and was not disappointed!, Our group of 6 selected the We Pick, You Eat 6 course tapas menu for 900k/per person and it did not disappoint. Everything was delicious and the service excellent. Our only complaint and it's a small one, was that the wait time between dishes was quite long.
description: Here to kick off a country with spanish food frenzy!! Highest quality ingredients married with modern techniques and exquisite style!! In the heart of Saigon, the first premier Spanish open kitchen experience! Most extensive Spanish winelist in Vietnam with over 65 vineyards to choose from!

name: Dogalbi Saigon
address: 31e Lý Tự Trọng, Phường Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Tp. Hồ Chí Minh, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Probably the best meal we have ate in our two weeks in Vietnam. We have been to Korean grills before in the uk but they do not compare to this. The service was fantastic from start to finish. A waiter cooks the food on the grill for you are the table which ensures it is cooked to perfection. The quality of the meat was fantastic and it all came in big steaks (rather than the little slivers we are used to in uk grills). There was so much food that we could not eat it all and we have big appetites!! They keep bringing the little plates and sauces out as soon as they see an empty pot Would highly recommend this place. The prices are brilliant too and there was more food than we could eat. 10/10 from us!🥰🥰🥰, We were taken to this place by a local employee... the place looked nice but the food was way too expensive. She ordered japanes wagyu beef, black pork mini burgers... I was surprised because it was delicious, the meat was fresh, soft and sweet... We've been to other Korean places downtown and we found them to be even better here than the original. Wow Korean restaurants in Vietnam are better than Korea, very surprising!, Really good option if you're looking for something a little bit different to the local food but don't want to go for the stock options of Pizza, Burger, Pasta. We ordered a Combo meal - so a selection of different meats BBQ'd on the hot coals in front of us and it came with a wide selection of Korean style sides. Very filling and overall and excellent option. Unlike Korean BBQ I have been to in the UK/Ireland, the food is cooked for you and in front of you.👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼
description:
Probably the best meal we have ate in our two weeks in Vietnam. We have been to Korean grills before in the uk but they do not compare to this.

The service was fantastic from start to finish. A waiter cooks the food on the grill for you are the table which ensures it is cooked to perfection.

The quality of the meat was fantastic and it all came in big steaks (rather than the little slivers we are used to in uk grills). There was so much food that we could not eat it all and we have big appetites!! They keep bringing the little plates and sauces out as soon as they see an empty pot

Would highly recommend this place. The prices are brilliant too and there was more food than we could eat.

10/10 from us!🥰🥰🥰

name: Café Marcel
address: 28 Ngo Quang Huy, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Today I went to meet a friend at Cafe Marcel. Stepping from a busy street I was instantly greeted by friendly staff and a relaxing environment. As it was my first time going there, the server politely explained both the food and drink menu and allowed me time to make my choices. I was promptly given my drink and without being rushed given a generous plate of food. The house made sausages had the perfect level of spice and my eggs were perfect for dipping the crunchy sourdough toast. All in all I can not recommend this place enough. Great addition to Saigon if you’re looking for a meeting point or delicious, fresh breakfast!, Amazing breakfast!!! The first time we went we were served by giang and the second time by phuong both were really lovely and helpful explaining the breakfast menu which is great value by the way. You can choose your eggs then your bread and sauce etc, they also have a really good brunch deal. The portions were really big and the food and iced coffee was so so good, would highly reccommend!, This little cafe popped up in the search when we were looking for a flavorful meal on our last day in HCMC and it didn't disappoint. This is a tiny little cafe with seating on the first floor. Interiors are beautifully done and the staff is very courteous. Food items we had were Spicy Shakshuka, avocado tartine & iced phin coffee. Shakshuka wasn't very spicy, just the right amount for beautiful flavors. Avocado tartine was full of fresh avocado mash and cheese. And the coffee was just the right companion to top the entire meal. I would say it's the perfect place for breakfast/brunch. Prices are a little high as compared to other food options in the vicinity - but absolutely worth it...
description: Breakfast & Brunch All-Day in Thao Dien. At Café Marcel, we do everything ourselves, from scratch. Chef Brian Chu selects only the best products, sourced locally from trusted suppliers. Homemade and fresh, that’s how we like it at Café Marcel.

name: Viet Kitchen
address: 8-15 Ton Duc Thang Street Renaissance Riverside Hotel Saigon, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The chef's food is very delicious and diverse, the service is very attentive, and the staff are very cute Thank you Manager for being very enthusiastic and applying the 2-for-1 program for our group Will definitely recommend friends and colleagues to experience it, the price is very reasonable for a lunch at a 5-star hotel., We were warmly greeted by the host and watched the food being prepared and cooked in an open kitchen. Our host chose for us and the food was first class, ample in size and very well priced. Family atmosphere , not pretentious and well worth a visit, This restaurant has great food and if you are staying at the hotel you get 20% off. Specifically, we felt our server named Phat was outstanding. Truly above and beyond, one of the kindest most genuine people I’ve experienced in the service industry. Thank you to him and to the amazing staff for making us feel so welcome.
description: Viet Kitchen is a trendy lifestyle-driven dining and networking spot in Ho Chi Minh City, where modern design and ambiance meet traditional and global flavors. International dishes combined with local Vietnamese flavors offer a unique, innovative take on classic cuisines near and far. Fresh produce, exotic herbs, and international favorites come together in our crowd favorites. Coupled with warm and friendly service, the venue’s funky design and communal tables make space a social hub for those wanting a high-paced, tasty lunch or an indulgent dinner with friends and loved ones.

name: Mayonaka Sushi
reviews: Phenomenal. Probably the best sushi I have had to date. Fish was fresh and melted in your mouth, wasabi was strong and prices are really cheap. Staff were really accommodating and the whole experience felt authentic., Thank you very much for giving me the chance to talk about my favourite restaurant. The name of my favourite restaurant is Mayonaka and it’s situated in the centre place of the city (175 De Tham street , Pham ngu lao ward, District 1. I like the spacious, serene environment, serves and tasty food. It is a two storeyed restaurant 2nd floor is reserved for different parties or special events. The room is large and The restaurant offers several dishes including exotic desserts, sashimi , sushi, ice-creams the food is more than great) The prices are reasonable and the foods are served quickly and discount for regular customers are two other reasons I like it more than other restaurants in Ho Chi Minh city, If you are looking for sushi at the very highest level in Ho Chi Minh City, you cannot avoid this address. The fish is simply extra class and even Wagyu fillet is served to Fine Dining Fans - and all at a price that is more than just reasonable, because in Europe a dinner in a Japanese restaurant of this class would be good and happy to cost three times as much and then probably not nearly as perfect! Just a big praise to the service and the kitchen! However, since the restaurant is not too big, it is definitely worth the Reservation in advance.
description:
A little gift, beautifully crafted.

From today, get a complimentary Salmon Rose sashimi when you book in advance and have a bill from 699,000 VND.

This elegant dish is our chef’s signature

name: Italiani's Pizza
address: 17 Han Thuyen, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews:
Italiani's Pizza Han Thuyen - The children fancied pizza after all the pho they had eaten. From the moment we entered, the customer service was impeccable. Tracy the staff went above and beyond not just with the service but also when we asked about where to get mangosteen she researched where we could get some as the season for this fruit was over. After the children devoured the pizza we had to order another as it was so delicious! After leaving to go to the recommended spot for mangosteen, we realised we forgot our backpack and the manager/owner went out of his way to drop the bag to us! How kind! The staff are so lovely here and food is of high quality so if you ever fancy a pizza definitely would recommend this establishment! This will be somewhere we will definitely return to eat!, We ordered salad, pasta, and pizza, and everything tasted amazing. Highly recommend the pesto pasta with chicken. Our server Rambo was always attentive and help us through out our ordering with excellent recommendations! He even suggested some nice places to visit during the night., Accommodating staff and tasty pizza. be mindful it’s a little pricier than the usual Vietnamese dinner prices. We paid 1,400000 VND for 4 pizzas and drinks for 3 adults and 3 kids. Air conditioning is worked well. Italiani's Pizza comes highly recommended by many guests who extol the virtues of its friendly and attentive staff. While the atmosphere receives mixed reviews—some patrons describe it as cozy, others find it lacking—the authentic, wood-fired pizzas consistently earn rave reviews for their flavorful crusts and varied toppings.

Although a few visitors mention that prices can be steep, the majority agree that the delicious offerings provide good value.
description: Italiani’s specializes in beautifully crafted individual wood fired pizzas and Italian-inspired dishes. We poured our hearts into creating a local Pizzeria that provides exceptional food, a welcoming environment for families and business professionals, and a fun date night spot for couples. We use the most flavorful tomatoes, cheeses and other fresh locally-sourced ingredients when possible to make our wood fired pizzas and Italian-inspired dishes. Our pizza dough is also made with “secret” ingredients that are hand worked and tossed to ensure that our pizzas have a deliciously thin crispy crust, with a chewy center, topped with the freshest ingredients. They are then fired to perfection in our authentic wood fired oven to seal in flavor and transform our menu items into fine crafted masterpieces. Our appetizers, salads, homemade gelato, and local craft beers are just a few more reasons to enjoy a meal at Italiani’s Homemade Pizza.

name: The Olive Steakhouse
address: 151 Dong Khoi, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1 2nd Floor, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Looking at older reviews I had become a little worried, but after being served two beautiful medium rare pieces of meat by a lovely waitress, I'm happy to say this is a lovely little spot found in the art arcade in saigon. With wonderful service from the staff and pleasant Aussie cuts of beef which are about A3 rating. As someone who normally enjoys a good rib eye fillet or sirloin cut at home along with tomahawk, I know when I'm eating a well cut and cooked piece of meat. I highly reccomend the second serving platter consisting of a 350g rib eye and 350g sirloin which is cheaper than buying them separately. These also come with 2 complimentary side dishes, I don't reccomend the potato wedges and it would be a sin to eat such good quality meat with the mac and cheese, highly reccomend the sauted mushrooms. Don't be afraid to try a red with these lovely cuts as it develops overtime. To us, this was a wonderful experience with calming atmosphere., Really great food. -I went back a second time. (And I heard the table near mine raving about how good their meals were as well) Excellent service. When you rock up with an allergy list nearly as long as your arm and they accommodate that. You know the waiting staff are attentive, when you order a drink and they bring it to you, without ice, because that is how you ordered it the other time. You know they paid attention when it comes to ordering the side and they say 'you didn't eat the mushrooms last time would you like to try the salad or something else this time?' Cute location too., Absolutely delicious meal, my husband had the wagyu steak which was cooked to perfection and I had the beef steak with rose cream pasta which came with a whole steak! Absolutely delicious, wonderful ambience and lovely host. I would highly reccomend coming here over the commercial restaurants on the square. Thank you very much!
description: The Olive is where everything is made from quality ingredients. Right in the heart of downtown Saigon and with only 7 tables in our restaurant, we are able to focus on providing excellent service in a cozy environment.

name: Anan Saigon
address: 89 Ton That Dam Street, Ho Chi Minh City 710000 Vietnam
reviews: Genuinely excellent food, a class above most fine dining restaurants and it was absolutely delicious throughout. I’d strongly encourage a trip even at the high costs, but… Two things stick out to me: 1. I’m still hungry. Every dish of the tasting menu was very small, and despite being very tasty I’d have gladly had a decent amount more food even if it meant sacrificing a dish or two to balance the costs. 2. A little bit of a bitter taste left in my mouth by the staff at the end. We’d made a point to ask for the bill early and to pay quickly because we had somewhere to be, yet they genuinely seemed to be making no effort to facilitate this (and indeed collecting payment from other tables ahead of us even though they were clearly not finished with their food/drinks and in one case had just had fresh drinks delivered). Overall though despite these (meaningfully frustrating) complaints I can’t bring myself to go less than five stars because the food really was exceptional., This was an excellent Michelin star experience. Know that it’s not like say an Alinia in Chicago, it’s a casual but food centric pleasure in a Vietnamese food market sort of way. Think like say Direkte Boqueria in Barcelona,(but at a typically lower Viet price point). The premises are very tall and very narrow but they manage to space everyone out in an appropriate way. They even quickly upgraded us to the air conditioned first floor from the breezy rooftop We opted for an à la cart experience although there were several rave reviews about the more expensive mixed fixed menus. The Foi Gras egg roll, while small, was loaded with taste. The duck mango salad was perfectly seasoned and very ample. My wife and I then shared the main course, choosing the pork chop specialty. Very tasty and tender. A nice surprise dessert cake for our anniversary, along with the fish sauce caramel vanilla ice cream topped off our meal and sent us off very happy and very satiated As I said, simply adjust your lense from an elegant high end Michelin to a casual but very flavourful Michelin experience. It’s all part of the fun. By the way, the staffing was very ample, all knowledgeable, warm and efficient., Service and food are very good at this Sài Gòn Michelin star eatery. The layout is on five floors, all small spaces. We ate in the roof- dry pleasant. Creative cocktails, tho’ my berry mocktail was too sweet for my taste. The fried rolls of shrimp & crab were terrific, and the deep fried fish was delicious, with the meat served in chunks on the crisp body of the whole fish. Plating of all the dishes was creative. We felt the vanilla ice cream dessert with fish sauce was a bit much-excessive showmanship that bordered on tacky. That sauce was served in a little cologne spray bottle. Fish sauce by Dior😂? The food here is expensive, which it always has been. 6 of us ate for more than $200, and we did not order wine, just drinks. I’ll still return here for a special occasion & memorable meal.
description: About Anan Saigon: The name of the restaurant is ănăn, which also means ‘eat eat’. It is located in Chợ Cũ Tôn Thất Đạm, a wet market right in the center of bustling Saigon. We specialize in street food-inspired dishes created by the award-winning chef Peter Cuong Franklin. Chef Peter’s creative Vietnamese cuisine reflects his vision of a Vietnam that is deeply respectful of its history and traditions yet progressive and international in its outlook. He takes inspiration from the country’s vibrant food culture and uses fresh ingredients often sourced from local markets while incorporating French culinary techniques. The result is a focused menu of deeply flavorsome dishes that are all intended to pair perfectly with our bar’s diverse selection of local craft beers, carefully curated wines, and tropical inspired cocktails.

name: Tandoor
address: 39A-39B Ngô Đức Kế, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We have been coming to Tandoor for two years now and it does not fail to please. The dishes are perfectly spiced to the level that you ask for, presentation is always excellent and the portions are spot on. Service from the staff is always excellent and you are served with a smile. The restaurant itself is very pleasing and clean. This is a very popular Indian restaurant for a reason and has a well deserved reputation for being managed to a very high standard., I found this Indian really nice, good service, great food and the staff were really efficient and helpful. I will definitely be going again in the next 6 weeks. I would recommend it to anyone who enjoys Indian food., Found this by mistake we were looking for a steak restaurant but found they weren’t what we were looking for, so wondering around we’d seen the steak restaurant upstairs opposite but couldn’t find our way in (yes we’re slack sometimes) found this so decided on a curry instead with it being our last night, very pleasant restaurant and staff were lovely. Ordered a couple of beers to be going on with them our starters !! 1 starters each big mistake portion sizes are quite large, wife had the chicken tikka, I had onion pakora both were lovely and the touch of putting you first piece on your plate was quite nice, pakora were spicy and really nice best I’ve had for a while, tikka were lovely big pieces and so succulent. Then we had mains wife had keema mutta (probably spelt wrong) she said it was best she’s ever had just enough spice for her, I had chicken vindaloo, loads of chicken (loads of curry if I’m honest) not quite spicy enough for me usually have them a little hotter but very nice all the same. Portion sizes were quite large neither of us could finish our dishes ! I’d had a garlic naan wife had 2 chapatis not really nice, if we’re ever in HCMC again we shall definitely be back
description: Tandoor Indian Restaurants has been serving the best Indian food in Ho Chi Minh City since 1997. Our first restaurant is located on 39A Ngo Duc Ke street, at the intersection with the Nguyen Hue Walking street, and next to the famed Dong Khoi street. Witness the pinnacle of Indian cuisine through our experienced team composed of dedicated Indian veterans. Beyond our charming two venues in the heart of historical Saigon, we also offer Indian food delivery and catering. We persevere to serve delicious non-vegetarian, vegetarian, vegan, and halal Indian food to guests of all origins. At Tandoor Saigon, the freshest authentic spices are ground in-house and combined with quality local produce for the ultimate Indian dining experience.

name: Hum Lounge
address: 34 Võ Văn Tần, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: I went to this vegetarian restaurant with friends, relaxing and welcoming atmosphere, attentive to detail. We tasted dishes at the beginning of the dinner, which we shared (fried tuber, potato type ..) and each we chose a dish (fried rice with mushrooms, rice with pineapple and raisins ..). All very good, accompanied by fruit drinks (orange, lime and pineapple). Recommended dinner to enjoy a different evening, from the usual bars that are in the city. Cost for the city above average, we spent about 25 € each. Recommended!!, The photos people have shared are excellent, but there’s so much more to experiencing all that is this building and what goes on within. The food is on another level when it comes to creativity and deliciousness. The design of the interior design compliments the beauty of the plates being served. The staff are outstanding. The photos are outstanding, but the smells and flavors are something you must experience yourself., After a stressful day, Hum truly felt like an oasis of peace. The atmosphere was calming, and the food was amongst the best we've ever tasted, with plenty of delicious vegan options to choose from. The staff were wonderful, going out of their way to help us select the perfect dishes. Special thanks to Phoung Vu for his exceptional hospitality—he looked after us so well, making sure we were 100% happy and satisfied throughout our meal. It was a dining experience we won't forget, and we highly recommend Hum to anyone seeking incredible food and warm service.
description: Hum Lounge offers a cozy, tranquil atmosphere amidst the hustle of District 3. We are proud to pioneer a plant-based cuisine with fresh vegetables, flowers, beans, nuts, and fruits sourced from local regions and prepared new on-site daily. There is no artificial flavoring; we only add creativity and attentiveness to our dishes. Check out the drinks, too - they complement the food in intriguing ways that will please both your eyes and palette. Last but never least, our team maintains the highest hospitality standard every minute of the hour. Whether for a large gathering or a personal meeting, your time with Hum will delight the senses.

name: Vo Roof
address: 113 Ton That Dam Street Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: First time in Ho Chi Minh and wanted somewhere relaxed to eat. Vo Roof is an absolute must if you want some genuinely tasty food (chicken skewers and dry noodle bowls are awesome), and really good prices. Staff are lovely and super friendly, young, fun and helpful. Please do visit as sure you will be delighted. Oh, and book as only small and reserved signs on table, use Facebook., I had lunch with friends in this restaurant. Recommendation if you want to dine here to book or arrive early because it is always very full and in fact we the evening of the day before we could not sit down. The next day we ate at the counter and had a great time: dishes with good tastes (meat sandwich, fried chicken with vegetables...) and low prices in the average Saigon prices. Super recommended!, From start to finish, Vo Roof, exceeded all expectations, and provided a superlative dining experience in a relaxed and inviting environment. From the moment we entered, the friendly and attentive staff made us feel incredibly welcome. Upon being seated we were served a refreshing starter of cool juice along with wet towelettes to freshen up and clear the dust from our journey through the busy Saigon streets. The menu was extensive and the prices were surprisingly low compared to other restaurants in District 1. Our dishes were served quickly and the food was excellent. My wife and I were discussing whether we could possibly make room for a light dessert when to our delighted surprise our waiter appeared with two small dishes of delicious cubed fruit which was provided free of charge as if they had read our minds. A perfect finish to a wonderful evening out. We will absolutely be returning to enjoy more of the wonderful food, superb, friendly service, and joyful atmosphere provided. Do yourself a favour and track down this hidden gem on your next visit to Saigon.
description: Welcome to Vo Roof - Modern Vietnamese Kitchen & Bar! We take great pride in offering you a delightful dining experience with our healthy Vietnamese cuisine. Our dishes are cooked in a modern Vietnamese kitchen, using family recipes that have been passed down for three generations. Our food is free from MSG, and instead, focus on using fresh ingredients and moderate seasoning to bring forth the authentic flavors of Vietnam. At Vo Roof, our commitment to providing a memorable dining experience goes beyond just the food. We also feature a cozy and chilling tropical-inspired ambiance, where you can relax and unwind with your loved ones. To complement your dining experience, we offer a selection of classic cocktails prepared with utmost care and artistry. Visit us and embark on a culinary journey that combines tradition and innovation, all wrapped up in a warm and inviting atmosphere.

name: Ngon 138 Restaurant (Quán Ngon 138)
address: 138 Nam Ky Khoi Nghia Ward Ben Nghe, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Central location, atmosphere of a rich man’s home in the countryside, and most comprehensive menu of typical dishes from all regions of Vietnam. Only missing are fertilised egg embryos (trứng vịt lộn or balut in the Philippines). None of the dishes is the best in its category, but they’re all pretty good. Excellent service from friendly staff. Prices are very reasonable; ignore comments from cheapskates who would be better home eating at the market or just staying home!, We ate here twice during our stay. First time we ordered nine dishes as we didn’t have a clue about Vietnamese food. Next time we went we had a better idea on what and how much to order. The prawns were excellent and the waitress put on gloves and peeled them for us. Very informal dining but a lovely way to spend an evening. I would class it as outside dining and maybe the floor could be cleaner but that’s down to untidy diners. First evening was £40 nine dishes, bottle of wine and two beers. Second time £32 less dishes same amount of drink., No air conditioning, but plenty of fans to keep cool. Right across the street from the Independence Palace. Good place for lunch, but also okay for dinner. This place is rather informal in a good way. Menu has lots of pictures and English translations of each dish. Perfect restaurant to experience local cuisine in a setting that isn’t too fancy (not like those white tablecloth french colonial restaurants). The menu is quite extensive—like the Cheesecake Factory in the USA, so you can try a variety of Vietnamese exotic dishes if you’re feeling adventurous. Bathrooms reasonably clean.
description: Ngon 138 Restaurant is located in the heart of Saigon, in an ancient house of Hue, and offers a rich and delicious banquet menu since 2001. It is ideal for organizing event parties for friends, partners, and company year-ends, as it brings together all the typical dishes of the country under one roof. It has been a reliable destination for many locals and foreigners who love Vietnamese food.

name: Moo Beef Steak - 109 Ly Tu Trong
address: 109 Lý Tự Trọng Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Highly recommend. A nice treat for when in HCMC. Great service, food, wine and setting. A lot more than what you would price but it's really worth it as a one off treat when on holiday. Highly recommended going on Mondays for the 50% off selected steaks to make it even more value for money., Every ingredient in our meal was of a high standard and prepared with great skilk. The steaks were succulent and cooked just to the right standard. The same could also be said for the fresh and delicious mussels as well as the mushrooms, asparagus, and chips. The wine menu was also excellent as was the care given to presentation and pouring. I also enjoyed the decor and the music created an intimate atmosphere that allowed our family to enjoy our time together without being intruded upon or intruding on others. My was an excellent waitress, ever solicitous of our enjoyment and comfort., Monday night is 50% off night and just as well as prices on the menu don’t include VAT or Service charge. Monday night is quite busy. The restaurant has a great ambiance. You get a great pate aperitif with lovely hot bread rolls. The beef is really good quality and tasty. We had one strip loin (a bit of fat rind but really good) and a tenderloin (like fillet, no fat). Cooked medium rare perfect. The wines are very expensive so went for the beer option. The water was the most expensive in Vietnam 140,000 plus tax plus service! It came from France… no idea why! So it came out as the most expensive meal so far in Vietnam - in spite of the 50% discount. But great meal, good quality and service.
description:
Highly recommend. A nice treat for when in HCMC.
Great service, food, wine and setting.
A lot more than what you would price but it's really worth it as a one off treat when on holiday.
Highly recommended going on Mondays for the 50% off selected steaks to make it even more value for money.

name: Ciao Bella District 1
address: 11 Dong Du Street District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam Vietnam
reviews: Best Italian Food in Ho Chi Minh City I visited 4 times. The quality and freshness is incredible and so is the service. Freshly grated pepper and Parmesan cheese, a free welcome sparkling and hands down best spaghetti puntanesca and Cesar salad. A must visit if you look for a real Italian Restauanrany and atmosphere, Ciao Bella in District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, offers a cozy Italian dining experience with warm service and delicious dishes. Highlights include complimentary prosecco and the signature Posh Carbonara prepared tableside. A great spot for a hearty Italian meal, though it can get busy during peak hours., We needed a non Vietnam meal. Fabulous. Starts with glass of Prosecco, then they bing bread with 3 small samples of black olive puree, and dipping balsamic, and roasted garlic before you order. We had the beet salad(fabulous) spaghetti and meatballs, spinach and ricotta ravioli with house wines
description: New York Italian. Warm casual eatery

name: Reflections Restaurant
address: 19-23 Công trường Lam Sơn 3rd Floor, Caravelle Hotel, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: The quality of the food was very good and the service attentive and prompt. We enjoyed the setting and the fact that there was no loud or inappropriate music. Less agreeable was the fact that all courses of a three course lunch were served on a tray simultaneously. This inevitably meant that the main course was cold by the time we had consumed the entrées. Perhaps the management interpreted a Business Lunch as placing the emphasis on speed and efficiency. In our judgement this should be reviewed in favour of a "course by course" serving approach rather than "all at once". (The day we ate there were only a handful of other diners so there was no time pressure on the staff.) This would considerably have enhanced our enjoyment., First class service in a building of a long and vital heritage. The menu was well combined und delicious prepared while everything was of a high quality standard fitting to the higher prices here. Especially if you search for a location which is quiet and has a great view this restaurant is a good pick., I feel quite satisfied I suggest that the lamb dish in the set needs more fat in the sauce. Because sheep don't eat dry food. Dessert and appetizers are okay for me The waiters here are very cute, Tran is very enthusiastic and gives thoughtful advice
description: A fine-dining restaurant with a cosmopolitan outlook, Reflections’ award-winning team is dedicated to serving creative dishes from around the world to diners in the heart of Saigon. Claiming a discreet perspective above one of the city’s most prominent intersections, this third-floor restaurant is a fitting space to reflect on the changing faces of Vietnam. Photographs on the walls pay tribute to Saigon’s heritage, and patrons have a front row view of the lights of Lam Son Square and the Saigon Opera House. Enhanced by the warm, intuitive service the Caravelle is known for, Reflections aims to create a magical, memorable dining experience every time.

name: Mặn Mòi - Tao Đàn
address: 34 Vo Van Tan Vo Thi Sau Ward, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Second visit to this restaurant and really worth the trip: DELICIOUS, fine, tasty. Bcp people but it was Friday night, better book. After a small papaya salad with beef jerky grilled absolutely divine and to finish in style of banana grilled with coconut juice and here even the decoration and service were at the rendezvous., Excellent service and amazing food. We ordered several dishes to taste and all of them 10/10. We were told we were ordering too much food for 2 people so they advised us which dishes to remove, which proves they care about customer satisfaction over financial gain. Loyal to the service and the food. The building itself is unique and deserves a mention. Highly recommend if you find yourself in Saigon!, This restaurant is fabulous from the stunning external design, the interior decoration, the interesting menu and the helpful and attentive staff. We had been recommended to this restaurant by some travellers we met in Hoi An. When we got to HCMC we tried to book online but there was no availability. We took a gamble and turned up shortly after opening time and helpfully they managed to fit us in. Ms Nhu Lam patiently helped us through the interesting local menu and we had a chicken with sticky rice under a dome, a beef dish, some greens and from memory we had a rice dish with duck. They really get the attention to detail right without being over fussy. Mr Phuong Vu and his team do a great job!
description: Mặn Mòi serves authentic Vietnamese cuisine, which we relish. Having set foot in foreign lands, we've come to appreciate local, homely dishes even more. This is our reason for opening this bistro to share our love for Vietnamese delicacies with friends worldwide. Let us share a few notes here and there about the origins of our dishes so that your meal takes on this air of leisure. We draw inspiration from the hearty meals our Grandmothers and Mothers prepared and select the freshest local produce to turn into homely dishes, be it a salad, a stew, a soup, or a dessert. We do everything with care because we want to convey the elegance of Vietnamese cuisine and the warm hospitality of Vietnamese people. Please note that we also have a takeaway option. If you can't dine in, ask our staff to wrap savory Saigon delicacies to enjoy at home. May you have a festive meal.

name: Towa - Japanese Cuisine & Lounge
address: 92-94 Nam Ky Khoi Nghia Saigon Centre, Level 28, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The food is great. We had a set menu and it was delivered without to much waiting times and tasted great. Service was very punctual and able to explain all the varieties of food. It is on the 28th floor so the view is great and the restaurant is decorated nicely. I do think they could choose different type of music with more ambiance, but it is not loud, so this didn’t bother me too much., Beautiful location with a great view of the city. Right in the center next to the shopping mall so it was convenient. We came for the omakase experience and it was around $100 per person which was reasonably priced and the food was delicious. I thought it was little at first but by the time we finish the whole tasting, I was so full. Hung, our server, was very attentive and took good care of us. My husband loved it and we would come back next time we are in the city., A very upmarket dining experience in a private Japanese dining room just for the two of us (yes, shoes had to come off before entering, tatami mats everywhere). We could order from two menus one Japanese “Towa”, the other Cantonese “Lai”. We started off with an incredible sashimi spread prepared by Towa’s chef before moving onto a selection of Cantonese dishes from Lai and finished up with a huge bowl of fruit. There is also a great selection of teas available by the pot in the Towa drinks menu if like me, that is your preference over alcohol. Tonight a perfect pot of black Oolong tea was a great match to the cuisine. Faultless service, Delicious food, Great atmosphere. What else could you ask for?
description: Towa offers an interpretation of the art of Japanese cuisine through originality and flavor. Our guests are encouraged to discover or rediscover the authentic Japanese cuisine alongside classic Ginza Style Japanese Cocktails known for their minimalism and sublime attention to details in an intimate ambiance. Towa's uniqueness makes it an unforgettable visit where a wealth of sensory experiences

name: Banh Mi Huynh Hoa
address: 26 Le Thi Rieng P. Ben Thanh, Q.1 26 - 30 - 32 Lê Thị Riêng, P. Bến Thành, Q. 1, Tp. Hcm, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I think this is one of the most well-known banh mi in HCMC. I went there late at night, roughly 9 pm., there was a queue (10 people) so we joined. The queue processed fast, as there was only one thing to order, one banh mi costed 68,000 VND and the queue for walk-in order was separated from food delivery. Then we were moved to another queue after payment, where we would get bahn mi with separated vegetables, pickles and cucumber. You can also ask the staff to cut bahn mi in half so it’s easier for you to share. Eating whole banh mi is too much for me, so I think half for a meal is about right. It was meaty, there were at least 4-5 types of meat and sausages inside. My recommendation is to open the sandwich and put all the pickles and vegetables in it, since the vegetables like coriander, spring onion and pickles added such a nice touch. The green chilli (came mixed with the vegetable) might be too spicy for some westerners, but it spiked the flavour. If you don’t like spicy, please try to pick it off the vegetable before you add the vegetable to the filling. Overall, it’s a big hit for me. I’d definitely come back or else, I would order Grab to my hotel next time in HCMC., A friend recommended this place to us and said "it's the best Banh Mi you'll ever have" and he was not wrong! As we turned onto the street we saw two large queues - one was JUST for delivery drivers to pick up for take out/delivery, and one was for people on foot to takeaway. We knew from the queues it must be good! They don't have a menu as it's just one option - again - sign of someone who knows what they're doing vs a jack of all trades and master of none. Queue was big but wait wasn't long bas they have such a good system and production line going on in there! Can't remember exactly the cost but think around $3USD or something equally as cheap for what really could've been split between two not just for one person! They give you the bread with various cuts of meat with the pate and mayo wrapped up, and then little bags of the salad bits to add inside (1 x cucumber, 1 x pickled radishes, 1 x spring onions and herbs). I honestly can't describe how tasty the whole combo was! Gotta try it!, The French bread, crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside, is crispier, fluffier, and softer than the real French bread, which seems to be due to the fact that Vietnamese bread is made from rice flour. I liked this better than the real French bread, which is filled with at least five different kinds of ham, pate, pork char siu, chicken ham, meat floss, onion chips, etc., and vegetables such as fresh cucumber, radish and carrot namasu, pak choi, green onion, fresh chilies, etc., are served separately and can be topped according to your preference. Vegetables such as fresh cucumber, radish, carrot, pak choi, green onion and fresh chili are served separately and can be topped as desired. The price is reasonable and the food is too good to be true.

name: Vietnam House Restaurant
address: 93-95-97 Dong Khoi, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Very delicious local food and great service. Super attentive and helpful. In particular Nu, an exceptional waitress. Everything is very clean and, in addition, a very very beautiful decoration of the land. Air conditioning is appreciated. Super attentive and different dishes: transparent lobster rolls, purple rice with shrimp and chicken with lemon sauce, highly recommended. This is the only reason I would go. And a delicious coffee. It is not the cheapest but the price is worth it. I recommend it., We decided almost at the end of our holiday. In Vietnam to treat ourselves to a dinner in one of the best and elegant restaurants in Saigon. The restaurant is located in the center, a stone's throw from the best hotels and tourist attractions of the city. The location, although a little dated, is very elegant with crystal booths with colored inlays. The menu includes typical local dishes with dishes not so dissimilar from others tasted in other restaurants, I ordered a classic as a starter, Fresh Rolls with prawns and pork followed by a duck breast cooked in two ways with tomato and pepper sauce with bok choi and smashed potatoes, both very elegant dishes and truly excellent on the palate. The service is absolutely professional, you are accompanied and followed right from the moment you enter the room. Naturally the prices are much higher than the Vietnamese average, absolutely normal for us Italians, Having the opportunity to enjoy the anniversary special course dinner was truly wonderful. On previous visits to Vietnam, my schedule never aligned, so I was thrilled to finally seize the chance to dine there this time. Each course was a masterpiece, meticulously crafted and beautifully presented. While it wasn’t inexpensive compared to typical prices in Vietnam, I believe it was a unique and memorable experience worth every penny. The servers were highly professional and impeccably trained, contributing to what was, in every way, a perfect dining experience.
description: A Vietnamese cuisine with a Modern Twist restaurant lies in the heart of Saigon that amaze your appetite The restored colonial building on the corner of Dong Khoi and Mac Thi Buoi in the heart of the city once housed the famed Café L’Imperial in the early 1900s, and was a popular destination for the city’s affluent business class. The new Vietnam House Restaurant is set to bring back the nostalgia and charm of this storied street corner, and introduce a new generation to the sublime qualities of of Vietnamese food at its finest.

name: 33 De Tham Restaurant
address: 33 De Tham Street Co Giang Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Perfect quiet restaurant amidst the hustle and bustle with extremely nice staff and very delicious food. I didn't know I ordered a dish to be rolled with rice paper, but my waiter Jack taught me that well. A clear recommendation !, What a delightful surprise find this restaurant is! Fresh and delicious ingredients - the seafood! - at a ridiculously cheap price. Serving sizes are also very generous. The food more than compensates for basic surroundings. Limited English skills from the very hospitable staff counteracted by pointing at menu (in English and on website) and Google translator. Part of the adventure being the only non-locals there! After our first visit, we brought decent wine glasses and wine. No corkage, they provide an ice bucket. Perfection!, This was our revisit after our last visit in 2019 (before Covid19) and that left us great impression and so decided to revisit again. The restaurant is located in De Tham street, where many family restaurants are located. If you are a first time visitor, you maybe spoiled for choice which restaurant to visit as all look "good"! For us, without hesitation, we went to this restaurant. And surprisingly it was quite empty although it was 7.30pm in the evening. Only 2 tables were occupied (on 2nd storey, including ours). Think Covid19 has hit hard on the small and medium businesses here. We ordered the pork ribs with fried rice, BBQ clams, stir fried cauliflowers and water spinach and deep fried chicken. We didn't order the BBQ oysters and beef dishes as we just had them the night before and wanted something "light". Portions were huge, And the food were yummy, well marinated and cooked to perfection, consistently good no doubt in that! And prices were reasonable too, despite of inflation, the price did not rise or rise slightly like 5000 dong only. Our dinner at around 220,000 dong. We didn't order any drink as we had plan to visit a cafe for iced beverages as the weather was warm. And it took us 10mins via Grab to get back to Saigon Center for our drinks then!
description: Our restaurant was founded in 1997, and offers an extensive menu of freshly cooked authentic Vietnamese food, at a reasonable price. We pride ourselves on great food, warm friendly service and a memorable dining experience. No matter if you are a solo traveler or large group, we can accommodate you with a wide variety of meat, seafood and vegetable dishes. You will never be disappointed when eating in our restaurant. Welcome!

name: Li Bai Authentic Cantonese Restaurant
address: 88 Dong Khoi Street Ben Nghe Ward, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Libai Dim Sum Brunch – A Place That Feels Like Home For 17 years, my family and I have been coming to Libai Dim Sum Brunch, and it never fails to bring us warmth and joy. Every visit feels special, like stepping into a familiar place filled with delicious food and heartfelt hospitality. The dim sum here is simply perfect—char siu bao is soft and flavorful, the pastries are crisp and golden, and every bite is crafted with authentic flavors. The service is truly five-star, with staff who are always welcoming and attentive, making us feel valued and at home. Whether for a celebration or a casual brunch, Libai never disappoints. It’s more than just a restaurant; it’s a cherished tradition where love, family, and great food come together. For the best dim sum in HCM, this is the place to be!, The service of "Man" is good and today we had a nice night with family. Duck is delicious and the atmosphere is good. About $50 per person. Mega Members also enjoy a 10% discount. If you stay here, it is recommended to eat., A wonderful dim sum buffet. Lot of choice and amazing quality. Maybe the best one in HCMC. And quite affordable during the week. And if you are lost regarding the extended menu, the team can advise you on the dim sum relevant to your taste. And by the way, the main dishes, apart from the dim sum, are quite tasty too.
description: Experience authentic Cantonese cuisine reimagined for the modern palate curated by seasoned chefs.

name: The Deck Saigon
address: 38 Nguyen U Di Thao Dien, Ho Chi Minh City 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Fusion menu,you can have full vietnamese or full western or everything in between, pages of cocktails service is velvet perfect.costs less than a cafe in Aust. We had chefs degustation ,5 star just go! It is incredible value and a wonderful outing. 10-20 minutes from district 1 by taxi, We dined at The Deck Saigon in Thao Dien recently and while the food was satisfying, we found the pricing and service to be disappointing. Despite being forewarned by some locals, my wife and I decided to give it a shot. The riverside seating offered a pleasant ambience, but the service left much to be desired. The main drawback here is the prices, considering that similar quality can be found with service to match. It wasn’t bad service, just inattentive and seemed to not know the menu. We are willing to give it another shot in the future to see if the experience improves. Everybody has off days., Well worth the short trip through the suburbs, The Deck offers a stunning example of intelligent "fusion" cuisine with a perfectly orchestrated mix of local (pancakes or spring rolls ) and Western classics ( carpaccios or ceviches). The impeccable service is in tune with the flawless freshness of all the products. Everything, including the bread and amuse-gueules, was delicious. The team in the kitchen got an unanimous approval from our group of six seasoned travellers who all chose different dishes. Surrounded by magnificent orchids, we enjoyed the peaceful view of Saigon River at our feet, as the meal progressed so smoothly that we forgot for a moment that Saïgon was re-baptized nearly 50 years ago. The Paris of the East is still well alive in many places across the city and this is definitely one of them . Heartfelt congratulations.
