name: Ros Yacht Club
address: 10B Ton Duc Thang Bach Dang Harbor, Ben Nghe, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Have a chance to have lunch here with your family. The space is decorated modernly and luxuriously. My family ordered the set menu - Vietnamese food including 1 salad, 1 stir-fried vegetable, 3 salty dishes, 1 soup. The food is seasoned very well, the family really likes the braised fish dish - suitable for entertaining after the Tet season with braised eggs and meat. Seating space is available indoors and outside at noon, from evening outside, very suitable for romantic dates. The reception and service staff are very enthusiastic. My family and I went to the room that they helped us arrange to sit in the VIP room, and Duyen served our family wholeheartedly throughout the afternoon today., Last Saturday morning, my girlfriend and I went to have breakfast at ROS restaurant. We accidentally found out about the restaurant because we took the Water bus in District 1. The two of us ordered shrimp noodle soup and beef pho. The noodle soup is delicious, the broth is light, rich in shrimp flavor but a bit off for me. Beef pho is served in a stone bowl so the broth stays hot, has a strong flavor of cinnamon and anise, and is quite delicious. In particular, I find the milk coffee here delicious because I like to drink strong, sweet, bitter coffee. However, because the morning is quite sunny, I think sitting indoors will be cooler and less glare. If I have a chance, I will come back again., I came one afternoon waiting for my friends to start dinner. Since you haven't arrived yet, I decided to sit at the bar to enjoy a cocktail. Right at happy hour, it's only 89k per drink. The drinks recommended by the bartenders are very suitable to my taste, they are very enthusiastic and fun. After that, I moved to the river bank to have dinner. The food is delicious and unique, there is a slight minus point: I came on the weekend so I had to wait a bit but it's okay, the experience is still very good, the service people are very enthusiastic. Will come back in the near future.
description: Inspired by the restaurant “La Pointe Des Blagueurs”, then the café “Jokers’ Point”, built in the same place at Bach Dang harbor - a popular destination of Saigon during the country’s tumultuous 1950s, after nearly 7 decades, ROS was established and revivified in 2019. Building on the history of the area while sewing ourselves into the fabric of future gives us the opportunity to become a gatekeeper to the city – a key player in Saigon’s food and drink scene. ROS is a day-to-night, Pan-Asian restaurant with nautical vibes and a hint of Cote d’Azur style. More than just an exquisite meal with a panoramic riverfront view, dining experience at ROS meant to engage all of the senses by offering a chance to savor an innovative Pan-Asian cuisine, sip on a range of exotic cocktails, and immerse yourself in the serenity of Saigon river.

name: Cafe de L’Opera
address: 19-23 Lam Son Square Caravelle Hotel, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Opera Café, nestled within the opulent surroundings of a five-star hotel, is an ideal destination for those who appreciate a refined atmosphere and top-notch service. From the moment you step inside, you'll be captivated by the modern interior design, which seamlessly blends with classic elements to create a space that is both cozy and elegant. Hoai and Tram very cute., During my short visit to Caravelle Saigon, I found myself captivated by the enchanting atmosphere of the Opera Caffe. The elegant décor and soothing music created a classy and sophisticated ambiance. The staff were incredibly attentive and always ready to engage in delightful discussions. Whether it was sharing travel stories or exploring cultural nuances, their genuine warmth and knowledge made the experience truly memorable. I highly recommend visiting this gem in Saigon for a tranquil and inclusive environment that fosters connections., The cafe is located in a very prime location, it covers a central area with impressive views. Coming here to drink morning coffee, eat a bowl of pho, read a newspaper and look at the street is something worth experiencing. They also have attentive friendly service. What a perfect way to start my day!
description: Cafe de l’Opera is quite possibly in the best location in our city, that’s if you enjoy your views with a dash of history and a slice of modernity all rolled into one. The cafe is located on the ground floor of the hotel on the corner of historic Dong Khoi Street and Lam Son Square, just metres across from Saigon’s iconic municipal theatre, better known as the Opera House. During the day, as temperatures soar and the heavens threaten to open, Cafe de l’Opera becomes a refuge for travellers and the like, just as it always has been since the hotel doors opened in the 50s. Over high-tea, things slow down, friends catch-up, business associates meet and lovers hold hands. By night, things become lively again with tapas, cocktails and wine to the sounds of jazz and the excited chatter of guests enjoying an extended Happy Hour as the city comes alive again.

name: Hoa Túc
address: 74/7 Hai Ba Trung, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Very tasty and well presented dishes served very competently by Oanh. Four diners shared veggie and other dishes and all were more than satisfied. Wine was reasonably priced and we enjoyed eating outdoors in this very busy restaurant. Hard to find but worth looking for., Been to this restaurant twice on a business trip. It's a little hard to find without special knowledge ) but eventually figured out the location. In the evening you usually need a reservation, but we were lucky and waited no more than 5 minutes . Good service, waiters give good advice on choosing and eating some special dishes. Pleasant atmosphere and interior. And of course, Asian food is delicious., We had the pleasure of dining at Hoa Túc during our recent trip to Ho Chi Minh City, and it was a fantastic experience. We believe we first visited this restaurant 25 years ago, and it’s just as impressive today! Set in a beautifully restored colonial building that once served as an opium refinery, Hoa Túc offers a charming atmosphere and a unique culinary experience. Their concept of “Vietnamese Cuisine with a Contemporary Twist” is both creative and authentic. The Food: • Starters: • Cá thác lác chiên giòn (Crispy featherback fish cakes): Perfectly cooked and full of flavor. • Bò lá lốt (Grilled minced beef wrapped in betel leaf): A standout dish, tender and packed with aromatic spices. • Mains: • Sườn non mật ong nướng (Grilled honey pork ribs): Sweet, savory, and perfectly tender, complemented by pickled shallots and lemongrass. • Cà tím xào sốt sa tế / Cà tím nướng (Eggplant with saté sauce / Grilled eggplant): Both variations were delicious, but the saté sauce added a delightful kick. The Service: The staff were friendly, attentive, and genuinely welcoming, which enhanced our overall dining experience. Hoa Túc is a must-visit for anyone looking to explore the vibrant flavors of Vietnamese cuisine in a unique and historic setting. We can’t wait to return!
description: Hoa Tuc - "Poppy" - came from the owners’ desire to explore new avenues in Vietnamese cooking. Food in Vietnam has been stuck in a stiff “mold” with every chef in the country churning out the same food over and over, year after year.

name: Mrsimple Steakhouse
address: 62 Truong Quyen Ward Vo Thi Sau , District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: To enjoy the ultimate French dining experience in Saigon, look no further than @mrsimple.steakhouse. Even though I have been to HCMC several times, but this is the 1st time we patronized a fine-dining. Located away from tourist areas and near popular pink façade Tân Định Catholic Church, it gives out a calm and relaxing vibe. With crystal chandeliers hanging over high ceiling and French paintings and décor, it make a posh fine dining restaurant, to celebrate special occasions. We go for their most expensive set for 2, which consists of starters, salad, soups, main course and desserts. Using quality ingredients and fine to attention details, every dishes was presented exquisitely, with nice blend of flavour and savoury, fresh and sweet in taste. Steak was cooked using sous vide technique, ensuring that it was tender and juicy, best to pair with a glass of red wine to elevate the flavour. Price was surprisingly reasonable, given the ambience and quality of food served. We were definitely be back when we visit Saigon again!!, Tucked away in a smaller alley in Ward 6, District 3 in Ho Chi Minh is this unique restaurant. I had seen online when home in Australia then when in Ho Chi Minh went a few days earlier to make arrangements re: specifics of what I wanted and paid deposit. On arrival all looked as expected. We were given menu immediately and needed to make selections for the night as 4 of the 5 courses had choices ! Easy enough . Had to ask for drinks menu and placed our orders and then courses started to arrive . The cake and happy birthday song came out after the first course. After having our final bite of our 3rd course the assistant waiter had our main course signalling the main waiter to take our current plate away to put main course plate down. We then had to ask as our cocktail was finished could he now get us our bottle of wine we had ordered as would obviously like to enjoy with the main course. Pace seemed very rushed . I had to use google translate to get this message across . This being said food was very nice . Ambience very was lovely . I would definitely recommend for a special occasion. It was also in mine opinion excellent value for money . The waiter was very attentive to all requests when asked and a great picture taker for all different couples , groups celebrating an event that evening Just please don’t rush the food., Service was perfection as well as the food We were amazed with the foie gras and the angus beef was cooked at the or its best The fish with its crusted top was very good Desserts are ok but not the restaurant best I would not recommend espresso as it was a simple shot of black coffee and not a real espresso

name: Mad Cow Saigon Wine & Grill
address: 148 Đ. Trần Hưng Đạo Level 30, Pullman Saigon Centre, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We had a great experience thanks to Nhi, who was incredibly friendly and helpful. She gave us great recommendations on what to order and clearly explained the ingredients when we had questions — very thoughtful, especially for those with dietary needs. Nhi also shared some great local tips on places to eat and visit nearby, which really added to our trip. Thank you, Nhi, for making our visit extra special!, The private dining room with a phenomenal view was the perfect spot for a big family birthday. The staff were so helpful in setting up balloons and decorations - Tien was just delightful! The food was spectacular - my fillet steak with bernaise sauce was just glorious. My only reservation was with the wine: any kind of deep full bodied red would really rattle the purse., We were all very impressed with the breakfast, lunch and dinner, especially the seafood dinner on the 6th of April. The hotel staff, especially those in the 3rd floor dining room, maintain an excellent standard and are a credit to the hotel. Thank you all for a very enjoyable stay. Ken Butler and Carol Humble. Room 1706 [4th until the 7th of April 2025].
description: Mad Cow Wine & Grill, the signature restaurant of Pullman Saigon Centre, redefines the dining scene with its innovative steakhouse concept. Located on the 30th floor, this venue offers stunning rooftop views of Saigon. Our menu features the legendary Tomahawk steak and a selection of locally sourced tapas. Whether for a special occasion or an intimate dinner, Mad Cow Wine & Grill delivers unforgettable dining experiences in a vibrant, cosmopolitan setting. Discover why it’s one of Saigon’s finest dining destinations.

name: Miwaku Premium - Japanese Fusion Cuisine
address: 772 Dien Bien Phu Level 80.02-03, Vincom Center Landmark 81, Ward 22, Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Wonderful Birthday in my life at Miwaku. Everything is prepared at restaurant by friendly staffs (Flowers, Cake, Present) as well as requests Good services, delicious dishes in set menu. Nice city view from 80th Floor in Landmark 81, We picked this restaurant because we wanted to impress our Italian customers, wow, they were indeed impressed. The food,the service,the view,the wine, just out of this world. Well done., Delicious Japanese cuisine with a stunning view. While it may be perceived as expensive, you do pay for what you receive - that is good quality food and a phenomenal view over Ho Chi Minh.
description: Japanese Fusion Cuisine Hidden on the 80th floor of Landmark 81 Tower as a luxurious destination. It is not only a finely crafted restaurant and transformed into a Japanese village. That's we are - Miwaku

name: Anatolia Turkish Cuisine
address: 63/13 And 65 Pasteur,ben Nghe ,quan 1 ,hcmc, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Our family had the most incredible dinner experience at this charming Turkish cuisine restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City! From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with warm hospitality and a cozy, inviting atmosphere that immediately set the tone for an unforgettable meal. The menu was a delightful blend of traditional Turkish dishes, and everything we tried was absolutely delicious. We started with a mezze platter that was beautifully presented and full of rich, vibrant flavors – the hummus, baba ganoush, and stuffed grape leaves were just the beginning of what turned out to be an amazing feast. For the mains, we had the lamb kebabs, chicken shish, and a Turkish pide (similar to pizza but much more flavorful). Every dish was cooked to perfection; the lamb was tender and juicy, and the chicken was bursting with aromatic spices. The pide was crispy on the edges and wonderfully soft in the middle, topped with fresh ingredients that took it to the next level. The service was outstanding. The staff was friendly, attentive, and made great recommendations based on our preferences. They also took the time to explain some of the dishes, which added a nice personal touch to the experience. The desserts were a real highlight as well. The baklava was a sweet, flaky masterpiece, and the Turkish tea was the perfect ending to our meal. All in all, this restaurant offers an authentic taste of Turkey right in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City. The combination of amazing food, exceptional service, and welcoming atmosphere makes it a must-visit for anyone craving Turkish cuisine. We’ll definitely be back with more family and friends! Highly recommend!, Loved it - we were wondering what to expect but from the friendly greeting through to when we left it was great. First great service and good staff. Plenty of menu options that reminded us of Istanbul AND a good selection of wines at reasonable prices. We chose the variety platter for 2 and matched it up with a French Rose. Ice bucket kept the wine cold and we ate the shredded lettuce with no after dinner stomach complications. So good we went back again and had a long chat with the owner who knows a lot about wine. Well done., Good Turkish restaurant serving halal food. The menu has a large variety of dished to choose from and all the food tasted good. The Baklava was absolutely wonderful. Great service from Jenny. Would recomened.

name: Marukame Udon Restaurant
address: 342 - 344 Hai Ba Trung Street, Tan Dinh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam

name: Topping Beef Restaurant
address: 16L Le Ngo Cat Street, Ward 7, District 3 Ward 7, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The first evening in Saigon, we went to this European sounding restaurant. The staff has been very kind and the ambience is pleasant. The menu offers different meat cuts with a choice of sauces. Steaks are a bit small, but well-cooked and tender. The prices are high, reported to the average prices in town. Suggested in case of scared tourists, it seems to have good food safety standards., Had lunch with 2 friends and we all ordered what they claim as USDA grain fed rib eye. Asked for medium cooked. Got medium rare. The worst part is...the steak is so chewy!! I’m a meat lover, specially steak so I know my steak and embarrassing part is, I was with a friend who is a seasoned meat trader. We were all so disappointed. Will never eat here again. Looks like a rip off. If only the beef were right quality, the value is good., Friendly and stylish service. Maybe new waitress. My wifes steak was exellent and its most important to me. We ate same kind menu. My steak was littlebit corner meat
description: A delicious beefsteak restaurant which uses 100% US beef - at a lowest cost ever in a warm and cozy atmosphere (only 7USD for 300g US Top Blade or 10USD for 300g US Rib Eye). The materials are completely safe and fresh, daily imported from trustworthy suppliers. Topping Beef also serves wine by glass (French, Argentina, Chile & US wine)

name: Buddha Chay
address: 31 Dang Tat, P. Tan Dinh, Q1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Good vegetarian food with various options. Well presented. A bit more pricey than other places but fairly since higher standards., vegetarian delight in local Vietnamese kitchen, nice atmosphere. Get suprised with their wonderful kitchen and offerings, It’s definitely one of the Vegetarian restaurant I must visit in Sai Gon, service and the quality of the food is excellent!
description:
Good vegetarian food with various options.
Well presented. A bit more pricey than other places but fairly since higher standards.

name: Vesper Gourmet Lounge
address: 5b Ton Duc Thang District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: I have been coming to Vesper since the opening and it remains a great spot for a casual lunch, relaxed dinner or a night of cocktails. Nicola and the bar staff are true experts at the cocktail and whatever your drink, they will most likely make the best version of it that you will have anywhere in Saigon. Nicola is really a true mixologist. Great to just tell him “whatever you suggest” and see what inventive and delicious concoction he comes up with. If you’re looking for a regular bar that’s easy to settle into, easy to come back to over and over with friends or by yourself, Vesper is the spot. Staff is friendly and cool., Vespers is well known in the city as a great place for incredible food and equally incredible staff! They never disappoint on either front and we dine here regularly. We also enjoy sharing Vespers with business clientele and visitors. One of our favorites!!!, This is a repeat visit to this establishment. The food is still excellent and the service very professional. I especially enjoy the atmosphere, business like, yet friendly and casual. The crowd is a mix of business people and young entrepreneurs. I highly recommend both the bar where you can mingle and the dining room for a quiet more formal dinner.
description: VESPER is an intimate and sophisticated destination for great cocktails and fine food. Chef Andreas Ertle has used his years of experience in Michelin star kitchens across the world to create a menu that is unparalleled in Ho Chi Minh City. From Asian inspired Tapas for light and easy dinners to great steaks, pastas and salads for those seeking a more substantial meal. In addition, taking inspiration from his mother's kitchen in Bavaria, Andy has included some true German favourites. VESPER also offers Al Fresco dining options for both lunch and dinner. With ateam of mixologists trained by some of the finest in the world, coupled with a well stocked bar offering a range of international spirits,Vesperis an ideal destination for after work drinks or a fun night out. Watch this space for more exciting news and promotions to be announced soon.

name: Phuong Cua Seafood
address: 1019A Binh Quoi, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Although this seafood restaurant is not in the heart of the city .. it is 30 minutes drive from Ben Thanh Market to this Seafood restaurant by the river. Not an up market kind of settings or layout, more to the local style seafood restaurant. One need to k ow the drills or ordering here .. after getting a table, you will be given a table number, with the table number then one will proceed to select or pick the live seafood that you want to have .. weight them and decide how you want it to be cooked. I think about 10 different way of cookings. We have 5 female crabs .. cooked in two version .. one Curry Crab version and the other cooked with tamarind sauce. We had some steamed Squid with Spring Onions, Cheese Oysters, BBQ prawns, Clams two variations, Cockles - big and small varieties, some green vegetables, Vietnamese spring rolls and Salted fish fried rice, fried chicken .. and lots of beers. Price wise it is indeed cheaper than those Seafood restaurant in the heart of HCMC that we had tried. The crabs were the main highlight and crabs with roe. Definitely the place to go for good crabs and cooking styles. I would recommend it., Food is fantastic, the prawn is fresh and huge, lala soup is nice, fried noodle is thumb up. We ordered 4 crabs in 2 type cookings but the size is pretty small. Price for 8 dishes for a family members of 5 is reasonable., Delightful family vietnamese restaurant opposite Calista Hotel . Great atmosphere friendly delicious. Perfect hotpot, great vermicelli we went there 2 nights running would be more but we had to leave HCMC.

name: Sushi Hokkaido Sachi
address: 139 A-B Nguyễn Trãi, Phường Bến Thành, Quận 1, TP.HCM. Ben Thanh Ward, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: After a week of consuming local Vietnamese cuisine, decided to go “foreign”. One of the few outlets in a local chain, the food was excellent. The salmon sushi was my favourite. It was just simply delicious. The salad that we wondered also went down a treat. The timing of the arrival of the other menu items at our table was spot on. Empty dishes were cleared with a quiet efficiency. If the crowd when we were there is anything to go by, I would suggest you make a reservation, The best sushi restaurant chain in town!!!! Fresh - delicious - affordable - professional is 4 keywords appearing in my mind after leaving this restaurant. They offer dental toothpick and toothbrush in toilet, brilliant, Japanese profession full-filled. Must have: sake, steam fish, waygu beefs., The space is luxurious, clean and polite. Staff are also enthusiastic and very thoughtful! I was most impressed with the salmon sashimi here, looking at the quality of fresh fish, putting the piece in the mouth that feels cool, melting right in the mouth very like. The food is almost delicious and the quality is very well presented. However, due to the architectural construction, the phone here is very poor and missed many calls
description:
After a week of consuming local Vietnamese cuisine, decided to go “foreign”.

One of the few outlets in a local chain, the food was excellent. The salmon sushi was my favourite. It was just simply delicious.

The salad that we wondered also went down a treat.

The timing of the arrival of the other menu items at our table was spot on. Empty dishes were cleared with a quiet efficiency.

If the crowd when we were there is anything to go by, I would suggest you make a reservation

name: Lost In Saigon
address: 49 Bui Vien St, Pham Ngu Lao Ward, Dist 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Had a really great night out in a pretty well managed venue that wants to look after its customers. Whilst it feels quite edgy, you Def feel safe and up for a good time. Well done on the Brothers Club event last night!!, Great place to have a few beers, watch some really good live music and people watch as hoards of tourist converge on walking Street., I love the vibe of this bar, load music, dancers, dj is perfect. the price is expensive but this is a bar, not a beer shop outside the street.
description: Lost in Saigon is a funky cocktail bar and restaurant on the busy Bui Vien street. We have full Vietnamese and Western menu including burgers, pizza, steak, Mexican burritos and fajitas, plus we cater for vegetarians as well. Sit inside in the air conditioning or sit outside on our comfy chairs where it is perfect for people watching. There is always something happening on Bui Vien! Lost in Saigon is proud to only use the highest quality ingredients. Our steak comes from Australia, our salmon from Norway, and our vegetables are sourced fresh daily direct from the farmers market. Please also come try our shisha, we only use genuine tobacco imported from Middle East and our staff are experts in making the perfect flavor combinations. We only use the highest quality alcohol in our cocktails. For example we only use Captain Morgan in our Mojito's, and you can choose from Hendricks, Tanqueray, Bombay Sapphire or Gordon's for your Gin and Tonic. We are confident our food, shisha, and cocktails are the best in Bui Vien and we hope to help you find yourself Lost in Saigon soon!

name: Sushi Hokkaido Sachi
address: 70-72 Le Thanh Ton B3-07 Vincom Center, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Last year I went to Vietnam in the summer. My friend invited me and my family to eat at this restaurant. Weo, I was quite surprised to see the cherry blossom tree as soon as I entered the shop. The space is cold like I'm in Japan. - Cool and clean What a surprise! oh my god, the restaurant gives each table a portion of ginkgo hmm GINNAN!!! yes, it resembles lotus seeds - FOOD : - I recommend you try ebi tempura, hanasaki salad, zuwai kani miso yaki,……… so delicious, so delicious (so craving. I will come back) And I love king salmon sashimi. It is fattier than normal salmon → All the dishes are very delicious. But I haven't used it all yet Service quality and staff are extremely cute. If the food takes too long to come out, the staff will come and say sorry. The restaurant is quite crowded so many dishes take a long time to come out. But the staff will say sorry and they and the kitchen will take advantage (Everyone should book a table in advance to not have to wait long). The staff will refill your tea if it runs out. If there is no table, you will wait and the staff will invite you for a drink. Everyone is friendly. My friend's family really likes this restaurant. They eat here once a week., Sushi Hokkaido Sachi is a fantastic Japanese restaurant located in the heart of the city. I had the opportunity to dine there recently and was blown away by the quality of the food and the overall dining experience.First and foremost, the sushi at Sushi Hokkaido Sachi is top-notch. The fish is incredibly fresh and the cuts are expertly made. Each piece of sushi simply melts in your mouth, leaving you craving for more. The presentation of the dishes is also beautiful, with each plate looking like a work of art.Aside from sushi, Sushi Hokkaido Sachi also offers a variety of other Japanese dishes. The tempura is light and crispy, and the ramen is flavorful and comforting. The menu has a good selection of options, catering to different tastes and preferences. Whether you're a sushi lover or not, there is something for everyone.The service at Sushi Hokkaido Sachi is also worth mentioning. The staff is attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable about the menu. They are more than happy to provide recommendations and ensure that your dining experience is enjoyable.The ambiance of the restaurant is elegant and inviting. The interior is tastefully decorated with a modern Japanese aesthetic. The seating arrangements are comfortable, and there is a sense of privacy despite being in a busy area.Overall, I highly recommend Sushi Hokkaido Sachi for anyone looking to indulge in high-quality Japanese cuisine. From the delicious sushi to the impeccable, Last night, I had dinner with my friend at Sushi Hokkaido Sachi, and it left us feeling extremely satisfied. The service was excellent, and the food exceeded our expectations. The Boat Sashimi was incredibly fresh and flavorful, especially when paired with wasabi and ginger. The Wagyu Katsu was a must-try dish; it was slightly rare, and served with a hot stone, allowing us to cook it to our liking. Lastly, the Eel Roll was simply fantastic. The eel on top was tender and complemented beautifully by the Japanese sauce.

If there is no table, you will wait and the staff will invite you for a drink. Everyone is friendly. My friend's family really likes this restaurant. They eat here once a week.

name: Roka Fella
address: 44-46 Nguyen An Ninh Street, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Definitely the best Omakase in Saigon. They have some signature dishes with many twists that other traditional Omakase restaurants do not have. You must go for the premium set, super worthy rather than the basic set. They have 2 slots to serve you at Omakase counter, cannot just walk in spontaneously Highly recommend for all Japanese cuisine lovers, So far the best Omakase meal in Vietnam. A must try while in HCM city. I chose the 3.6mil+ set with 16 dishes for me and my cousin. Food was fresh and delicious. I believe chef Sean said Friday and Tuesday are the day they get shipment. And all their fish are from Japan, not Indonesia, Malaysia or VietNam. Thumbs up 👍 I like Hamachi and Otoro but unfortunately those wasn’t offered in the meal. Chu Toro was, and it was as good as Otoro without the “necessary fat” 😂😂 Main course I had the cold noodle made with angel hair, sadly not with my prefer Soba noodle. But the chef explain that Soba noodle is too thick for this dish. My cousin chose the beef with foie gras over rice and he said it was heavenly melted in his mouth. All in all food was excellent, not too much nor too little. Services was attentive. I noticed plum wine or any wine is extremely expensive in Vietnam. They marked up x8-10 at least. I paid $9.94 for a bottle of Choya plum wine at Costco but here it was 1.8mil~$70-75. This is fine with me because I like to sip on plum wine while dining on sushi and sashimi. Thus, this is just a head up and don’t be surprised. I am planning to go back for another meal as I write this review. My mouth is actually watering as I reminiscing on the food. Again highly recommend, go try if you’re around. P/S: it situated in a small alley without any sign so call when you get there and the staff will escort you in. Enjoy!, The place is near the city, The food is good and delicious. Go too many place and feel the atmosphere is good. Sure come back and eat again. . .
description: Roka Fella is a contemporary Omakase restaurant by Chef Raymond Tan. Focused on the highest quality Japanese produce and spirits, we offer a dining experience unlike any other in Ho Chi Minh City.

name: AmDang Typhoon
address: 23 Đồng Khởi, Bến Nghé, quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: This place I had walked past at least a dozen times, it is near the hotel we were staying at and one night another couple and ourselves were just going to walk down the street to find somewhere to eat for dinner. I stopped in front of the restaurant which from looking in the front window looked empty, but we went inside anyway. Escorted down a set of railway tracks to the main eating area, which was almost full of people. Our party was 4 people, we ordered 4 starters and 4 mains, some drinks and after a short wait the food started to arrive. Wonderful. that is all I can really say, wonderful. The service was great, the seafood was great, the variety and choice were great, and the bill was surprising, it did not cost what we thought, far cheaper. We left HCMC the next day, so unfortunately we did not have a chance to go again., Superb!! Best Thai cuisine tasted ever in Ho Chi Minh. The staff were courteous,helpful and welcoming especially their Operations Director Willie. I personally enjoy most of the food on the menu. The staff there are also very quick and efficient.Price is relatively reasonable, if you combine all the factors, such as location of the restaurant, speed of serving, portion of the serving, this is a decent place to have a good meal. The tastes and flavours are superb. . Loved the creamy Tom Yum Soup , Fried Fish with Mango Salad Dressing and the Durian sticky rice dessert! Definitely the best place to visit if you are having thai food cravings., Sooo sold on the specialities of Amdang's selection, especially dishes with seafood choice. Pad Thai was a bit under my usual palettes, but crab curry was totally worth the wait - creamy just right, generous crab cooked to perfection that goes so well with rice. Definitely worth a try while in Saigon if you crave some hot and spicy Thai dishes. Moreover, they also have Thai tea cocktails!
description: Amdang Typhoon - A restaurant from the 2021 Michelin Guide. Amdang’s signature dishes of Chinese-inspired crab in combination with traditional Thai shrimp paste. Amdang Typhoon sawadee kha!

name: NHÀ HÀNG NÀNG CUA
address: 56 Mạc Đĩnh Chi Dakao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 084 Vietnam
reviews: Just had a delightful meal at Nhà hàng Nàng Cua. The ambiance is cozy and inviting, perfect for a relaxed dining experience. The seafood dishes were fresh and flavorful, truly a delight. The staff was friendly and attentive, making the visit even more enjoyable. Highly recommend for a great seafood experience!, Nang Cua Restaurant is not only a culinary destination, but also a delicious adventure for crab food lovers. The crab dishes here are not simply a meal, but a sophisticated and unique experience. The unique feature of Nang Cua is the creativity in the way they handle and process crabs. Each dish reflects the chef's meticulousness and dedication. In particular, Crab Rice here is a culinary masterpiece with fresh crab, delicious rice mixed with unique spices., So satisfying, great tasty food, fresh and flavourful! Highly recommended! You have to try the noodles with mushrooms too!
description: Just had a delightful meal at Nhà hàng Nàng Cua. The ambiance is cozy and inviting, perfect for a relaxed dining experience. The seafood dishes were fresh and flavorful, truly a delight. The staff was friendly and attentive, making the visit even more enjoyable. Highly recommend for a great seafood experience!

name: Phở Chào
address: 52 Nguyễn Công Trứ, Phường 19, Bình Thạnh, Thành phố, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: A little Vietnamese restaurant with a little atmosphere. They have chicken pho and beef pho, and even northern-style Hanoi pho. They also have some special dishes of their own, but I only love pho. It just so happens that you can order a small portion of pho for only 50,000 yuan a bowl. So I ordered one portion of chicken pho and one portion of beef pho, plus a piece of special fried chicken. As a carnivore, it is really satisfying! By the way, you can choose multiple toppings for their beef pho, so you can choose any type of beef you like., Among the restaurants I visited in Ho Chi Minh, this is the only restaurant I visited more than twice. In fact, I visited 3 times in 2 weeks. I recommend the poutine and beef stew, a mix of Vietnamese and Canadian cuisine. As soon as you eat it, exclamations will come out of your mouth. I've tried pho, fried rice, and other noodles, but they're a bit ordinary compared to the 2 foods above., I came there on a holiday, mid afternoon for a late lunch. There are top 3 that you MUST TRY: 1. I ordered pho-tine (a lovely creation & combination between Vietnamese & Canadian cuisine). Lots of crispy fries, tonnes of cheese, beef gravies, & stir fried vegetables around the bowl. Quite a big portion to me but I consumed it well since too hungry. 2. For the drinks, I got recommendation for a sparkling fermented organic Kombucha Tea, which tasted lovely, feeling like I was having a light sour cider or bubble rosé. 3. Last but not least, the dessert, man you need to try the chilled coconut dessert. Soft coconut gel, creamy coconut milk & fresh coconut flesh, served with ice. I was feeling like in heaven haha
description: Small family run restaurant in Saigon's coolest dining district. The family have been serving Pho since 1986. Using filtered water and a traditional cooking method from the birthplace of Pho, we are confident this will be one of the best bowls of Pho you will have in Saigon.

name: Glamisque - Fusion Dining
address: 7th Floor, 59 Nguyen Huu Cau, Tan Dinh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The place is super unique decorated, perfect for a romantic dinner to chat happily with friends, super quiet place. In addition to delicious food with wine, the service was very attentive, thoughtful and let us enjoy. Big thanks to Glamisque - Fusion Dining for a great meal and we will definitely be back!!, Quite impressed with the experience at this restaurant. Luxurious and cozy. The receptionist is polite and kind. The waiters give professional advice on dishes. They really know about the dishes they have. Really delicious and wonderful 10/10 points, The atmosphere exudes luxury, the steaks are of the finest quality and the staff's meticulous attention to detail is evident throughout. From start to finish, every element of the experience is exceptional. The space is luxurious and romantic and the staff are professional and friendly.
description: Where U’d be served the most surprising fusion dishes ever in town. Let’s treat ur belove our recipes’ fascinated stories, from asia to the whole world | Nơi bạn và người thân yêu trải nghiệm các món ăn quen thuộc mà độc đáo, khó mà có cái thứ 2 ở Saigon!

name: El Baron - Whiskey & Cigar Lounge
address: 42 Hưng Phước 4, Tân Phong, Quận 7, Ho Chi Minh City 72906 Vietnam
reviews: Most bars usually focus only on drinks, but El offers a more complete experience with a good selection of delicious food. Not only do they have a great collection of fine whiskeys and well-crafted cocktails, but they also pay close attention to their food — tasty, clean, and well-prepared. The main dish I had was the Grilled Salmon Fillet, which was very fresh and flavorful. One of the staff also recommended a wine to pair with the salmon — it was really good (though I forgot the name of the drink ☺️). The space here is classy and elegant. From the moment I walked in, I could feel the cozy and vintage atmosphere, highlighted by soft lighting and smooth jazz music. It made my time here truly memorable. If you're looking for a place to dine, have a drink, and enjoy a good conversation, El is definitely worth a try., My friends and I had a New Year party at El Baron, and it was an amazing choice! We were really impressed by the mix of classic and modern style. We booked a VIP room for privacy, good conversations, and enjoying jazz music. A bottle of Jack Daniels was perfect for our group. If you love special cigars, you should definitely try them here! The staff was very attentive and professional. They served us well while respecting our privacy—no pushy sales or unnecessary interruptions. With its elegant space, great drinks, delicious food, and romantic live music, this is the perfect place to gather with friends for a special occasion. I’m very satisfied—5 stars for the excellent service!, I'm a tourist and have come here a few times to experience it. I think the restaurant has a beautiful view, delicious food that suits your taste, and most importantly, the attitude of the service staff is professional and enthusiastic.... Thank you, Tam, the restaurant staff is very enthusiastic. professional love! I will come back if I have a chance!
description: El BARón - Whiskey & Cigar Lounge Discover El Barón - A Melodic Journey of Art, Jazz, and Spirits at District 7's finest lounge bar. Experience the perfect blend of art, soulful jazz, and premium spirits in Lounge District 7. Cheers to unforgettable nights!

name: Haidilao
address: 72 Le Thanh Ton L3-08, Vincom Dong Khoi, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Such a long waiting line. We went in pretty late at 9:40 and still had a ticket for 1 hour 30 minutes wait. Called different branches and got the same response. We tried a hot and sour chinese flavor soup broth but it was a little too much tartness and has strange seasonings but i guess it is a personal preference. Service was excellent., Loads of people in HCMC had a birthday on the day we went for lunch so “Happy Birthday” was the song of the day. The restaurant was really full and everyone was having fun, including the 3 of us. We have eaten hotpot before but not like this. 4 different soups to cook the meat and vegetables in (with a choice of others). The food was really fresh and the choice of additions and sauces was extensive. Free nails and free dessert we did not take advantage of but might next time!! Glad they have branches in Melbourne so that we can eat it here as well., At Haidilao, they have different soup bases for customers to choose including the Tomato, the Sichuan Spicy with dried chili and green pepper, the Butter Spicy with butter, Maowen native red pepper and Guizhou pepper, the Mushroom with a lot of mushrooms, of course, and the Three Delicacy with fresh meat concentrated bone and the milky white soup. The special is, you can order up to 4 different kinds within 1 pot. In other words, you can enjoy almost Haidilao soup bases in just one time visiting the restaurant. What’s clearly stored in my memory is the mixed meat between prawn and pork, and the well-known Haidilao noodle dance. When ordered, a waiter did a performance at our table. What could be better than enjoying a hotpot while watching a noodle dance, then eating that noodle? Believe me, it’s the best thing you don’t want to miss out at the restaurant. Furthermore, the noodle is a must-have part to fulfill the excellence of the hotpot. There is also a counter with a variety of condiments to create your own dip. Highly recommended.
description: Such a long waiting line. We went in pretty late at 9:40 and still had a ticket for 1 hour 30 minutes wait. Called different branches and got the same response. We tried a hot and sour chinese flavor soup broth but it was a little too much tartness and has strange seasonings but i guess it is a personal preference. Service was excellent.

name: Bun Rieu Cua Oc
address: 66 Nguyen Thai Binh District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: When my friends from other cities come to visit me, I will always bring them to this delicious crab meat and snails vermicelli for sure. The snails are served separately and it’s quite spicy, but I still love it., A great Vietnamese restaurant snails and crabs soup really really good they are open so don’t let the hours for you., Other than beef pho, this is a must try place where they offer fried fish cakes and marinated snails noodle in crab soup.
description: When my friends from other cities come to visit me, I will always bring them to this delicious crab meat and snails vermicelli for sure. The snails are served separately and it’s quite spicy, but I still love it.

name: Bun Bo Ganh
address: 110 Ly Chinh Thang, Ward 8, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We came here for lunch on a Sunday in early March whilst visiting HCMC for the weekend. Prices here were reasonable and food selection decent. No trouble getting a table - wasn't very busy. Quality was on the average side, and a bit more cleaning would be helpful., Not the same owner anymore and the food quality is ok not as before very disappointing this time. Portion or very smaller than last time I have ate here before many times during the previous year’s every time I travel to Ho Chi Minh City before I leave Vietnam. As you can see in my previous posts, They have some nice authentic looks, di we went in here to try. Looks like there are different corners with different dishes to make. The look is nice too see, food is ok. Not that good, but also not bat. Price is in between.
description: We came here for lunch on a Sunday in early March whilst visiting HCMC for the weekend. Prices here were reasonable and food selection decent. No trouble getting a table - wasn't very busy. Quality was on the average side, and a bit more cleaning would be helpful.

name: Shang Palace - Cantonese Restaurant
address: 1st Floor, 17-19-21 Ly Tu Trong Street, District 1, HCMC, Ho Chi Minh City 848 Vietnam
reviews: Excellent traditional Cantonese cuisine with a slight modern touch. The interior and the customer service brought me back to old-school early 2000s vibe. Highly recommended the stir fry prawn glass noodle. The price is on par with current offerings from other upscale Cantonese restaurant in Ho Chi Minh., Shang Palace serves very authentic cantonese cuisine. Food is very tasty and service is prompt too. Their roast chicken and seafood fried rice with spinach puree are a must-try!, Food was excellent and of great value for money. We really enjoyed the experience. Will defo come back and recommend to friends to try out.
description: Renowned as one of the finest Chinese restaurants in the city, Shang Palace boasts authentic mouth-watering Cantonese and Hong Kong cuisine in a spacious and luxuriously appointed dining space. Exuding understated elegance and style, the Shang Palace is an ideal location for intimate dinners, holding parties, family gatherings and business events - the stylish surroundings are befitting those seeking a fine dining experience. Comprising of 9 private VIP rooms, subtlety and attention to detail provide the perfect environment for meetings and dining with your business partners. The warm welcome of the receptionists and simple, yet beautiful decorations will ensure a great start to the evening. With professionally trained staffs that are conversant in Chinese, English and Vietnamese, tantalizing cuisine and a warm and comfortable atmosphere, Shang Palace Restaurant has proven itself as an ideal setting for those who love Hong Kong and Cantonese cuisine.

name: Ruou1983
address: Số 11 Đường T7, Vinhomes Grand Park, Thành Phố Thủ Đức, Ho Chi Minh City 71350 Vietnam
description: Cửa hàng bia rượu nhập khẩu chất lượng cao nằm tại khu đô thị Vinhomes Grand Park thành phố Thủ Đức.

name: Bamboo Chic
address: 3C Ton Duc Thang Street, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1 Le Meridien Saigon, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We came here to indulge in the atmosphere of the Year end party and watching firework. The food, wine and service are totally excellent. Khoa is the guy made our dinner shining with his humor and great-learning. Surprisingly, he was student from famous université that my son teaching. He distributé very high french standard to us, appreciated. The way he hold the bottle, present the course, reminds us the time dining at high-end Parisien restaurant. Have many stories to share, so talk to him is really enjoyable and interesting. Highly recommended and worth finding if a little off the beaten track. Amy was a great hostess, she is very passionate about her job and a real asset to the business ., Stumbled across this place on our first night in town and what a gem.... amazing staff and great cocktails... The service from the staff was amazing and the Long Island Ice Tea was good :):):) We also had one of the crepes, very tasty.... but that baked Camembert..... was amazing....

name: La Poissonnerie
address: 51 Hai Bà Trưng, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: This establishment offers a narrow facade with a security guard at the entrance. Once you pass the door, you find yourself in front of a stall of fish and shellfish that will whet your appetite. Next is the restaurant room whose walls are covered with blue and white earthenware; it feels like we're in Brittany even if the boss is from the south of France. We have the choice between 3 starters and 3 main courses but there were only 2 starters and 2 main courses left at 2 p.m. Smiling waiter, good food and you can buy your fish, mussels or oysters on the way out. We tried the mussels which were excellent., If you are in the mood for Western-style fish and seafood, this restaurant comes highly recommended (by me). When you enter the premises, there is a large selection of fresh fish and seafood to choose from, including oysters imported from France (along with local ones). Everything is prepared to the highest standards and there is also a variety of delicious side dishes to choose from (e.g., green beans sautéed in butter with garlic, yum, yum). Last but not least, the wine list is quite extensive for such a (smaller) restaurant and very fairly priced. To put my money where my mouth is, so to speak, I have made another reservation for tomorrow night., Definitely one of the best seafood I’ve had. I would like to give it more than 5 stars. Clean, simple yet elegant, authentic taste, great wine pairing, lovely service. Can’t say enough. The oysters heavenly. The lobsters, tiger prawns… cooked to perfection. The price was very reasonable compared to the quality. I paid much more money elsewhere for half the portion and the taste that I experienced in this restaurant. Definitely a place not to be missed. Make sure you make reservations because there aren’t many tables.
description: Seafood shop, restaurant and wine bar. Oysters, Caviar, Seafood platters, Bouillabaisse, French Mediterranean cuisine.

address: 1058, Dai lo Nguyen Van Linh, P. Tan Phong, Quan 7, TP, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: We celebrated CNY dinner in this restaurant. Food was nice and we enjoyed it. Steamed chicken was tasty and tender. Dim sum and chicken feet were yummy. However, they were busy that night so almost the food was sold out at that night., The reason for only a 4 is because on a Christmas Eve the restaurant was packed and overly noisy. It is in the SC Vivo mall and from appearances it looks closer to fast food as opposed to fine dining With that being said the food was delicious and well presented. We had stir fried eggplant and soft shelled crab. Both dishes were very tasty. After finishing these dishes a man came wheeling a cart containing egg tarts. We ordered them and once again they were as good as any that we had in Hong Kong. Several times our wait staff replaced my pot of tea without me having to ask. A nice dinner that I recommend., This restaurant that is located in district 7 of Ho Chi Minh City inside the shopping center is a little bit far from the downtow. address: 12G2 Nguyễn Thị Minh Khai, Phường Đa Kao, Quận1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: After an awesome evening at The Alley Bar and Kitchen the wonderful staff mentioned that the owner Tan had another restaurant, so we booked for the following evening. The restaurant was a bit off the main drag down a little alley but it is definitely worth the effort to find. The restaurant is gorgeous, with beautiful decor and ambience. The kitchen is in full view with island bench seating to take in the full cooking experience. We chose a set menu which included 5 courses and each one was scrumptious. The duck was divine, perfectly cooked with a crisp skin and moist tender breast. The chocolate fondant desert was to die for. Tan the owner and our host was attentive, engaging and informative. After our meal he walked with us around the corner to another of his establishments, a bar called the ATM. That too was a great experience with expertly made cocktails. My partner and I both walked away from the evening with our hearts and bellies full., My husband insists it serves the best duck, so we found ourselves returning three times within our three weeks in Saigon to confirm his claims. Mía Dining offers three different Prix Fixe Menus, and I've tried all three. While the beef and pork were both excellent, the duck still tops them all. I'm pleased to hear that Mía changes its Prix Fixe menu according to the seasons and availability of fresh ingredients but still keeps the duck breast., This was an absolutely outstanding Dinner and food! Such an amazing space, open Kitchen, fantastic staff and lovely ambience. Value for money for that quality of food was exceptional. This is a hidden gem in Ho Chi Min City. They have a cocktail bar above but we did not have a drink in that bar but had a cocktail from there at the table and they were also amazing so next time we are in HCMC we will definitely try the cocktail bar and definitely the restaurant again! Thanks to all the staff as this was exceptional.

name: Vietnamese Pancake Ngoc Son Restaurant
address: 103 Ngo Quyen Street, Ward 11, District 5, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: This was my introduction to Banh Xeo, which is essentially a stuffed Vietnamese pancake… and boy is it STUFFED like a Thanksgiving turkey, or like LeBron on Iguodala. Thank GOD we came with some locals, as I would have had no idea how to eat it ahahha. You essentially rip part of the pancake off while making sure you get some shrimp and meat, roll it up in the lettuce, add some leaves and spices, dip it in the fish sauce, and demolish it. This thing was ENORMOUS too, and for the low price of 65,000 Dong ($2.60 USD) it's crazy bang for your buck. I mean the whole country is but I feel bad about that sometimes, idk. It was delicious. I’ve never tasted anything like it. That’s what's so great about traveling though. You learn so much so fast… If I did have to compare though I’d almost liken it to a crepe as opposed to a pancake… eh but the crepe comparison isn’t that great either. Idk. If you’re in Vietnam you need to try this. IG @jnov_ Tiktok @jnov_reviews, Bahn xeo here was pretty good. Thin and crispy with great veggies to roll in. The Chả Giò was also amazing. Roll that up with the veggies and dip into the nuoc mam for some great flavors. Definitely recommend this place. Family that lives in Saigon recommended it and it did not disappoint!, Came here on a Jeep Street Food Tour with Tour Guide in Saigon and had our first Bánh Xèo which was delicious (and the best we had throughout our Vietnam adventure!)

name: Karaku Japanese Bbq
address: 72-73 Song Hành, P. An Phú, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Karaku Japanese BBQ is a hidden gem in Saigon, offering a delightful culinary journey. Stepping inside, I felt like I was transported to a cozy Izakaya in Tokyo, where the aroma of grilled meats mingles with lively conversations. The atmosphere here isn't just a restaurant; it's a stage where premium Wagyu beef is grilled over charcoal, creating a mesmerizing symphony of flavors. We opted for several signature grilled dishes, including beef tongue, Iberico pork belly, and Wagyu beef short ribs. Each dish was meticulously marinated, retaining its natural tenderness and sweetness when grilled. The beef tongue, in particular, had a delightful crispy texture and tasted heavenly when dipped in the restaurant's special sauce. Beyond the delicious food, the service at Karaku was exceptional. The staff were professional and friendly, always ready to offer recommendations and assistance throughout our meal, making us feel right at home. If you're looking for a dinner spot that offers both delectable cuisine and a warm, inviting ambiance for a gathering with friends, Karaku Japanese BBQ is an excellent choice. Come here to experience this fascinating 'gastronomic journey' for yourself!, We all know that 8th March is the most special day for our female beloved one, right? Me and my girlfriend were having a trip to Vietnam back then, so I pick this place randomly and make a reservation. Everything was nice and the meat quality here really set a standard for the up-coming restaurants that I will visit. One more thing, I ask the manager for any decoration and he gave us a small roses vase and some lights for decoration too. I would rate 9 out of 10, but it was the nice waiter makes it to 10/10 XD, If you're looking for a high-quality Japanese BBQ restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City, especially for special occasions, Karaku Japanese BBQ is a must-try. My family had a fantastic Christmas dinner here. What impressed me most was the quality of the grilled dishes. We ordered a special set called “Hanabi”. It had variety of meat and a beautiful layout. The beef was incredibly fresh, cut into perfect slices, and seasoned with rich flavors. The Wagyu beef ribs, in particular, were melt-in-your-mouth delicious—a truly wonderful experience. The side dishes, such as kimchi and salad, were also fresh and beautifully presented. Also, the The restaurant's atmosphere is also very cozy and sophisticated, suitable for dates or family gatherings. Since it’s Chrismas, the restaurant was decorated to match with the festival atmosphere. Really love this place! 10 out of 10

reviews: We eat regularly in Saigon Craft and overall have had amongst the best tasting food in the city. The wines and beers are very good as well. Amongst our favourite dishes are the chicken nuggets and French Fries - the chicken nuggets have to be the best tasted anywhere, ever!!! The vegetable quesadillas are also the best tasting quesadillas that I have ever eaten and I eat quesadillas everywhere. The corn on the cob is always super tasty and plentiful and all of the food is served piping hot. The only disappointment has been the fried taco chips. Advertised as a vegetable dish we hadn't expected fish sauce to be poured over the fries prior to serving and as we have an aversion to fish sauce we were unable to eat them once we tasted the first few. The salad too was pleasant with a tasty dressing except that I would have preferred the dressing to be a standard French dressing without the raw herbs added to it. That said, such is the excellent taste of all other food eaten there, that I felt this restro bar thoroughly deserves a 5 star rating rather than 4 star. Final mention must be made of the staff who are super friendly, helpful and welcoming. This is a place that we now visit regularly and always eat as well as have a drink there., From the moment you arrive you are greeted with friendly welcoming staff. The selection of beer and food has always exceeded expectations. A beer for every taste and food is just awesome. The owners Ms Thuy and Matthew alway take time to chat with guests and Crete a great social feel. Very casual and certainly worth the stop in PMH, We had a couple quality local craft beers on tap and ate a nice meal at their rooftop terrace. Great selection reasonably priced craft beers, good menu and efficient service!
description: Welcome to Saigon Craft: Bar Tây Ta. We offer a relaxed yet lively place for everyone to come to hang out while enjoying our tasty food and a fresh cold drink. With a wide selection of beers on tap, we also provide a mix of cuisine for both Asian and Western customers. At Saigon Craft Bar Tây Ta, our motto is Customers First. Hence commit to giving you our best customer service possible. All we want for you is to have a great unwinding time at our venue. A side fact: Saigon Craft: Bar Tây Ta is a pioneer in bringing the craft beer culture to District 7, one of Saigon's most diverse residential areas.

name: Amigo Grill Restaurant
address: 55-57 Nguyen Hue Boulevard District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: The breaded sea bass was all but three crispy balls of meat. The beef a few strips. Both had a scattering of small slices of vegetables. The glass of wine was a bit less then adequate. The waiter did come back to bring it up to par. The price, however, wasn't small, a bit more then other local restaurants we experienced., The menu is overpriced for HCM, more than 30€ for any small 200g steak. I had one and was just average meat.. And by the way, the restaurant is also small and dark., Really lovely grilled steaks perfectly cooked. sweet service and a good wine list. They offer US or Australian beef. I chose Aussie beef and it was excellent. my wife had a filet and I had a sirloin. Met our expectations really good quality.
description: Step off the streets into one of Saigon’s most famous steakhouses. Conveniently located on Nguyen Hue Street, Amigo Grill Restaurant features American, Australian, and Wagyu beef, along with freshly imported Norwegian salmon. A fully-stocked bar and international wine list complements any main course. Event hosting is available in the private dining room on the second floor.

name: Ichihana Sushi Vietnam
address: 69A Duong Cao Thang Ward 3, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We had a terrific experience here at Ichihana Sushi. My friend was visitng from Da Nang and we were craving something light, but delicious. Ichihana turned out to be beyond our expectations. The quality of the fish was surprisingly fresh & the crab cake along with egg/octopus dish was fancy & delightful. High recommendation to all sushi lovers & just anyone who is looking for fine & elegant dining!, Very tasty and nice environment! Sushi chef from Japan! Felt very welcome by everyone! Staff is very nice! Food great and fresh!, Creative sushi with good quality. Attentive and friendly staff. A bit of a hidden gem. Don’t expect a fancy environment but a nice selection of reasonably priced fresh sushi.
description: Ichihana Sushi specializes in modern Japanese cuisine & premium omakase sushi buffet. We offer dine in, take out & delivery, and catering service. We are committed to providing our customers with the finest level of hospitality. From the moment you walk through our doors, you will be greeted by our staff and treated warmly, promptly, and graciously throughout your meal. Ichihana Sushi commits to choosing and using clean, quality ingredients and fresh seafood to combine and create the restaurant's unique dishes, but still maintain an affordable price for our customers. We also combine the fusion of traditional with modern Japanese cuisine to keep our menu fresh and unique. By sticking with our slogan "Fine and Fresh", we make sure that you leave our restaurant satisfied and with a smile. We strive to constantly train our staff to ensure customer satisfaction, and this promotes teamwork and a sense of pride and cohesion when working for Ichihana Sushi.

name: Mekong Merchant
address: 23 Thao Dien District 2, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: I came to the Mekong Merchant for breakfast when I was revisiting An Phu Thao Dien after a six-year absence. The atmosphere, character and the food of the establishment is just amazing as it always has been and I will definitely come back to repeat business!! It was so good to be re-acquainted with the Mekong Merchant after six years! I would definitely recommend the English breakfast if you plan to stop by for breakfast as it comes with any coffee and juice!! Thank you so very much and my best compliments to the chef!!!, I had Sunday brunch here today with a local friend who recommended the place. It was highly enjoyable. Totally relaxing leisurely brunch with a huge choice of foods and condiments. Service was friendly, we sat outdoors and enjoyed the balmy atmosphere under the shade of large trees. I will definitely come back here., We visited this restaurant on two occasions during our stay and were very satisfied with its range of food and service . We had a lunch with western style food which was excellent and then came again and had an terrific dinner of tapas selections accompanied by some wonderful wines . Wine list was comprehensive and reasonably priced by Vietnam standards with an excellent sommelier to assist ... We had a table in the courtyard which had a nice ambience about it on a warm evening . .
description: Good location with easy access from street, lovely open and covered setting in the courtyard, children's playroom, one air-conditioned area, professional and attentive staff, kitchen that opens onto the courtyard, good and quick service, good choice of drinks and cocktail specials, excellent prices, good quality locally sourced homemade food.

name: Amun Restaurant & Lounge
address: 3rd Floor, 215-217 Ly Tu Trong St Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: A fantastic spot for dinner and unlike a lot of other Fine Dining restaurants, this one had an elevator that takes you most of the way to the level 3. I had the Lamb Tagine (which is the traditional Moroccan dishes and delicious) and some seafood appetizers (which I was recommended by nice and friendly staffs). Not only the staffs are good but also the manager take care us very careful (always standby anytime). A great view looking down onto the street and even tried my hand at handheld long exposure photography to get the light trails on the motorcycles below. An experience which I can’t forget., Shisha 5/5 quite expensive in the first moment but the taste is intense and really good. Music 5/5 they play relaxing remixes from old and new songs i got after this evening at least 3 new hits for my playlist. Atmosphere 5/5 with near east paintings, designs, flowers and dancing ladys it feels really authentic. In the end this shisha bar has no bad points just go., Literally the best hookah in saigon...can’t go wrong with this place and the food is amazing! Recommend the salmon couscous
description: Amun is a wonderful place to look at least once in your life. It is filled up with the fragrance of Mediterranean Sea spices and has everything you need for a swell time. Bang on!! Our restaurant is popular for delicious Moroccan Traditional Food. If you’re craving something warm and hearty, consider whipping up this Mediterranean stew. The harissa, cumin, coriander and cinnamon create an out-of-this-world flavor that goes deliciously with the kinds of meat and Israeli couscous The collection of varieties wine of many countries is offered to boost up your dining experience. Get the popular homemade signature cocktails and soft drinks like Moroccan mint tea, hot and cold drinks according to your order. For a lot of Shisha lover in the HCMC, there is no better way to wind down than in a cloud of sweet-smelling smoke with a shisha or hookah pipe in hand. Now, combine that with mouth-watering food and superb service — your weekends are sure to be a blast

name: Yakiniku Yazawa Saigon
address: 219 Dien Bien Phu Ward 6, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: The interior is quite luxurious and stylish, so nice that you forget you are in Vietnam. A popular menu item is the Yazawa-yaki, thinly sliced sirloin served with a special egg and yam sauce. Other fresh meat items on the menu include Wagyu Yukke and Meat Sushi. Most of this Wagyu beef is flown in from Japan, not frozen, through a proprietary route. YAZAWA seems to be the only restaurant in Vietnam that offers Wagyu beef in chilled form, and it is wonderful to be able to enjoy such delicious meat in Vietnam., This is my first experience of Yakiniku Omakase. The beef here is of good quality, The flavor is delicious and greasy. When I enjoy it, I can feel the meat melting in my mouth. Salads and dipping sauces are also great, each type of dipping sauce when combined with meat will stimulate the taste buds and make the dish much more delicious. The staff is also very cheerful and cute, and the service is very professional. The restaurant design is beautiful and very luxurious., Really great quality food. We had the chef's omakase - first time anyone from our group has had a beef omakase. We all really enjoyed it, quality of the food and drinks was outstanding. We did add a rice bowl and beef sando though - think without them we might have left feeling a bit hungry. Service was also super. Quite pricey though

YAZAWA seems to be the only restaurant in Vietnam that offers Wagyu beef in chilled form, and it is wonderful to be able to enjoy such delicious meat in Vietnam.

name: PHỞ VIỆT NAM - Bùi Bằng Đoàn
address: S36-1 Bùi Bằng Đoàn, Tân Phong Ward, District 7 Khu Hưng Vượng 2, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant is near my hotel I just walk around and find something to eat sooooo amazing experience, I will comeback again, Great spot for a tasty pho. Made with in house noodles... My wife really liked it so it appears we'll be back next time we're in the area., The Pho is VERY good. The staff is super friendly, and the atmosphere is very welcoming. I highly recommended this restaurant !!! 👍👍👍
description:
This restaurant is near my hotel
I just walk around and find something to eat
sooooo amazing experience, I will comeback again

name: The Wagon Wheel - American Comfort Cuisine
address: 200 Le Thanh Ton District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This was a little diamond. From the outside and even climbing the stairs up to it, I had low expectations. However, as soon as I walked in the door I knew it was a nice place. Cheaper than a regular steak house, it serves good steaks, nice wine (by glass, carafe and bottle) and the service is top. It isnt cheap but it is certainly a nice escape from the hustle and bustle of the streets outside. I enjoyed it a lot and woukd recommend for families, couples and solos., I go regularly to Wagon wheel, usually in the evening, the food is excellent, very tasty and very good value for money. The staff are always very friendly and the place is a hidden gem. Slowly working my way through the menu, and not been disappointed yet. The Meat loaf is very tasty in particular. I am glad I stumbled across this little place and recommend it to anyone., Bit of a hidden gem this one, out the back of Ben Thanh market down an alleyway and up a staircase. Food is very reasonably priced (<$10 for a started such as devilled eggs, around $10 for a cocktail and around $20 for a rack of pork ribs). Food quality was excellent and serving size very generous, would highly recommend if you have a hankering for American food to mix it up during your stay in Saigon.
description: We here at The Wagon Wheel specialize in American style comfort food to give you a feeling and taste of home or perhaps a new experience all together. From authentic American style pork ribs and flamed grilled ribeye to deep fried chicken and juicy burgers, our aim is provide with you with delicious food to fill your belly and warm your soul.

name: Dong Ba Hue Beef Noodle
address: 207B Nguyen Van Thu Da Kao, Didtrict. 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: I had never eaten Bun No Hue before my first trip to Vietnam.Now every time I go,I've eaten here.Foods good, people are great., Since moving to Saigon I've tried a few different places' Bun Bo Hue and this dish by Dong Ba Hue is by far my favourite. The restaurant itself is basic and simple but the food was excellent. Unfortunately, it doesn't have air conditioning but does at least have a dozen fans to keep the air moving., Located in Nguyen Du street, near many tourist destinations and offices, Dong Ba Hue Restaurant has been attracting many tourists, workers from opening to closing. I am not an exception too. As a local, I normally travel here once or twice a week in order to savor the Bun Bo Hue flavor as well as some Hue delicacies. The main reason why is that I do not need to travel to Hue City while I can enjoy the real Bun Bo Hue (the broth is beautiful and you cannot find any places have the “Sate” like here). Strongly recommend it to everyone!
description: Hue beef noodle is a commonly known and served to all Vietnamese and well-accepted through 3 regions North, Middle and South Vietnam. Our restaurant has been in business for more than 20 years and was passed on from my grandmother who was an original Hue-ian coming to Saigon and bringing the dish to the city in the early ages. We are proud to be the restaurant that has been serving different generations of Vietnamese and currently, foreigners too!

name: An's Saigon
address: 5a Tong Huu Dinh Thao Dien Ward, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We decided for it as marked by a well known international guide as “inventive Vietnamese cuisine”. It definitely kept its promise, especially if, as we did, you choose the set menu “Dhong” at Chef’s Table. The present and the past of Vietnam’s elements, habits, traditional food, herbs, and unique ingredients are turning through the hands of Cuong Nguyen at his team , this extraordinary chef, into something really unforgettable . Eat dish has been conceived and is dairy realised with maximum care and additional ingredients than those indicated, so the only chance to enjoy it is not listening or reviewing one’s suggestions , but going there ., Chefs Table! What an absolute treat and stunning environment - I took lots of pictures! . Winning combination of great food, such warm and personalized hospitality and team, and lovely location with garden and gorgeous room and gardens. We have been happily eating at so many great places - but An's Saigon was the STAR of our trip. We very much enjoyed our experience at the Chefs Table. Arrived in a beautiful hidden courtyard - and loved seeing the herb garden, the various fermentations that Chef and his team creates. We are seated at a lovely room and the magic begins - with our own garden at our seat. The short rib and the special fragrant rice was delicious. The squid and dried bamboo dish was creative, the deconstructed shrimp roll was clever. Desserts with the cotton candy spun in front of us enveloping an apricot was so much fun. We want to come back for the a la Carte menu - which has some very delicious looking local favorites too. And their coffee. Must come back. Location is in District 2 - which is quieter and just a short grab/taxi from our hotel villa so it worked out nicely., Wonderful experience, The food & drinks are so good. We can drink coffee in the morning, having luch with a la carte menu and then enjoy a special dinner in private space where called Chef’s Room with set menu.
description: An's Saigon, where our guests become friends and family. An's is a whole concept of Restaurant with progressive Vietnamese cuisine and Boutique Spa. Nestled in dynamic Thao Dien neighborhood, An's is the cozy and serene house in which you will always be welcomed, be at peace and comfort, like being at home.

name: Bun thit nuong
address: 01 Nguyen Trung Truc Street, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: It is a street stall on the corner near Takashimaya, one block from Ben Thanh Market. There is a blue menu card sign, Many plastic containers to take home are stacked on top of each other so you can instantly tell. I ordered the most famous one, the up-spring roll, and no broth of yakiniku. I paid the money (65,000 VND = about 400 yen) on the spot. Your young brother speaks English. I told them I was going to eat on the spot, and they followed me to the sidewalk across the street. They put out tables and chairs and made seats for us. After a while, the food was brought in. It was quite spicy compared to Japan when you tasted Bun sauce When I poured everything over the noodles and mixed them, they tasted just right because they were sweet and spicy. Not only do they make it, but they also have a lot of herbs and nuts underneath the noodles. It was so delicious and filled me up more than I looked., This was one of the best meals I had during my 2 ½ week trip through Vietnam. I know it might be a little intimidating to eat at a place like this if you had not done it before, but just walk up, grab a chair and enjoy. The grilled pork had a yummy smoky flavor and the spring roll was delicious. My boyfriend was hesitant to eat here (as he didn’t want to get sick) but then kept steaking bites of my food because it was so good., This is a street side establishment. We sat on the pedestrian pavement next to a construction site. But this dry vermicelli dish is so simple and delicious. The pork is grilled to perfection. The pork spring roll with sweet sour dipping sauce was so good. Had fresh coconut drink with this dish and it was one of the best breakfast meal we had in Saigon. Only 5 mins walk from Benh Tanh market.

When I poured everything over the noodles and mixed them, they tasted just right because they were sweet and spicy.

It was so delicious and filled me up more than I looked.

name: Choi Go Jip Korean restaurant
address: 161 Ham Nghi, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The food was good but not spectacular. The quality of the meat was good. The side dishes were okay. The dipping sauce with the barbecue was nothing like the one you get in Korea. The girl who was barbecueing our meat overdid just about every piece. They should have left us do it ourselves. The bibimbab was plain and unexciting. The prices are pretty high, especially for the drinks. Would not go back, but it was still a decent dinner., The Korean bbq here is decent although there are similar places all over Saigon. This has been around for a long time and moved around a few locations. They serve manly tourists and locals and you will see few Koreans here. The owner and waitstaff can use a lesson in customer service. The restaurant never felt welcoming and the staff are robotic. There’s not even a greeting from the Korean owner/ manager., Recently visited with 7 work colleagues and had a great meal. Had our own private room which was good to discuss business. Good service and very helpful staff as they cooked the meats for us and served it. Food was delicious and the recommendations were also very good. Also good choice of beers. If you like Korean food fully recommended.

The food was good but not spectacular. The quality of the meat was good. The side dishes were okay. The dipping sauce with the barbecue was nothing like the one you get in Korea. The prices are pretty high, especially for the drinks.
Would not go back, but it was still a decent dinner.

name: Fashionista Café
address: 22B Phùng Khắc Khoan Phường Đa Kao Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 71000 Vietnam
reviews: We found Fashionista via the Michelin guide and wow, we were not disappointed. The services was great, the food exceptionel and the restaurant itself was beautiful. The owner, Quennie, made us feel welcome and presented the food personally. Prices was reasonable and the overall experience was phenomenal. 10/10, I visited Fashionista Cafe March 18th with my best friend for dinner and it was a wonderful experience. Very nice and friendly waiter who meets you at the door and kindly follows you to your table. The service our waiter provided us with was excellent. Good at presenting the dish as well as following up with more wine/water during the course of the evening, and without making it awkward or weird which can happen sometimes. The food was very good, for my starter i got the Quail breast which was cooked to almost perfection, followed up by the pork tenderloin which was cooked to perfection! And ended the evening with the orange caramel creme. the orange and caramel complimented each other very well and you could really taste the high quality ingredients in the dessert as well as the other dishes, which is very important for me when i fine dine. The manager/owner (not sure) also came over to have a chat about the food and experience during the evening which made the experience even more personal which i really liked. He was extremely kind and we ended up chatting for quite some time about various topics. We ended up giving a deserved big tip, as our waiter provided us with great service and nice behavior during the course of the evening. Very worth it for the price! Would recommend it to anyone that wants high quality dishes combined with class and elegant service., This was on of the best restaurants in which I have ever eaten.
