The food, service and ambience were all top notch. I lived many years in Italy and can truthfully say that the pasta ricotta was one of the best pasta dishes I have ever eaten. They are also very accommodating to vegetarians. My husband had the duck breast. He raved about. He said it was perfection. The presentation was beautiful. Easily the best meal experience I have ever had in South East Asia. This is a must do on any gourmand list for Saigon
description: Fashionista Café is a French cuisine restaurant with Vietnamese flavours, honoured to be on the Michelin Selected Vietnam 2023 list of the world-famous Michelin Guide. The restaurant menu serves breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea and dinner, led and inspired by renowned French chef Sakal Phoeung, President of Escoffier Vietnam.

name: Sushi Kobayashi
address: 8A/G7A Thai Van Lung Ben Nghe, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The sushi tasted okay... can never compare to the authentic one. The mast chef assumed that the guests don't understand Japanese and said something very rude about the guests to the waitress. This has ruined the whole experience. I would not recommend this restaurant because it doesn't worth the money at all., The seasoned chef prepares beautiful edo (Tokyo) style sushi. Crafted with elegance and great technique, the sushi is fresh. They prepare two kinds of rice for the nigiris. All fish protein is locally sourced or imported from Japan. Probably the best sushi bar in Saigon. The tamago is to die for. Great sake selection. Pricey, but worth it for sushi connoisseurs., Must-try omakase spot in town. The ambiance was zen, music and lighting were so pleasant. The staff was so helpful preparing a cake for my surprise birthday. Love all the fishes choice and the combination/order was magnificent. Mine was 2500, totally happy and satisfied saturday night. Will keep coming back for more dishes from chef Hiroshi.
description: We have been preparing for this time, and now we are going to open “SUSHI Kobayashi”. I would like to thank you all for your kindness. We are very sorry for your busy schedule, but we would like to invite you to share this precious time with us. It will be a great honor for us to serve you & your friends in our restaurant. When you come, I will gladly tag & mention you in our FACEBOOK page.

name: Chi Hoa Vietnamese Cuisine
address: 97 Hai Ba Trung Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Good location in the very downtown. Firstly I thought it could be served mainly foreigners, however it was a lot of Vietnamese at the lunch time. Friendly service, food was good, the most I liked was deep fried phở. Average cost was 250,000 VND/person, including deserts., Last meal in Ho chi Minh. Before heading home to Aus for 14 days self Isolation. Couldn’t have asked for a better meal. Staff very attentive and helpful and the food divine especially fresh and fried spring roll and the grilled calamari with chilli sauce and dill was to die for. Only shame is we discovered this on our last day. This restaurant also supports the Vietnamese farmers., We have eaten here several times- whenever we are in Ho Chi Minh City, first in 2017 while writing a book on edible flowers - we included them in our book - the food is stunningly beautiful and so very fresh. A must visit.
description: Chi Hoa Vietnamese Cuisine is a unique Vietnamese restaurant with a simple, open kitchen that brings back the warm, intimate family-style meals.Our kitchen is open with traditional Vietnamese designs to help guests enjoy a comfortable, cozy space and bring back the excitement we had when we saw our mom cooking tasty dishes back in those days.

name: Ben Xua
address: 39A Hà Huy Giáp Street, Thanh Loc Ward, District 12, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: I came here sometimes for swimming only but it is really nice place for families with kids because they have a large garden and restaurants. Everytime when i came here, i feel like i was in a airy small town, it was very quiet and nice. If some ones have kids and looking for a place for kids on weekends, just come here and you can spend all day here with them before to start a new busy week., this is very good place to have party with family and friends!!!!\ good food and service!!! this is the place must go!!!, I love Ben Xua because there are beautiful views, delecious food, good service and so on.... I vistit here once and hope come back again
description: I came here sometimes for swimming only but it is really nice place for families with kids because they have a large garden and restaurants. Everytime when i came here, i feel like i was in a airy small town, it was very quiet and nice. If some ones have kids and looking for a place for kids on weekends, just come here and you can spend all day here with them before to start a new busy week.

name: SOHY - Sky Lounge & Dining
address: 72 - 74 Nguyen Thi Minh Khai Street District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I already came here 2 times with my group friends.It's really enjoy and relax time.The ambience and view is so good.Music is increased by hour.Price is average.Staffs are friendly and helpful., Robert is a very good tour guide, he makes sure that we know whats the place we are in and its rich history. He is also approachable and made our tour enjoyable. We recommend this tour to see the beauty of halong bay and enjoy while knowing the beautiful history. :), I went to this place on the Friday night. This place gives you the beautiful view of saigon city. Music and dance performances, both were amazing. In cocktail, I ordered LIIT. It was so good and strong. In starters, there are not that many options in vegetation so just tried garlic bread. Staff was humble and service was quick. In terms of cost, yeah it is little costly. Overall, I had fun on the Friday night.
description: With an unrivalled panoramic view of the city and beyond, SOHY is an alluring lounge and outdoor terrace that offers guests a unique opportunity to experience life at the top. Spanning over four floors, high on top of centec tower in the heart of Saigon, SOHY brings to life the sights, sounds and tastes of the city every night. Surrender yourself to a limitless evening.

name: Pasteur Street Craft Beer - Ly Tu Trong Taproom & Restaurant
address: 110-112 Ly Tu Trong Phường Bến Thành, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: My wife and I stayed in Saigon for 3 nights in August 2024 and we visited Pasteur Street craft beer and taproom in Ly Tu Trong twice! The beers are great and the staff are fun and friendly! If you don’t know your craft beer they will offer tastings and will help you narrow down your choice. But they do more than beer! They also have a great restaurant! They offer a range of western and Asian meals at a decent price and with generous servings! Thanks to everyone for making our stay so much fun!, Wanted to try this place out and had a draft beer - a Double Jasmine IPA. It went down easy and had a wonderful taste. It was so good, I ordered another. Service was attentive and friendly. Also a great place to sit and watch the world go by., Delicious craft beer!!!!! Excellent service! Lovely ambience! Passionfruit beer 😋. Great location :-). Good music!
description: Located at the vibrant corner of Ly Tu Trong & Thu Khoa Huan in District 1, this ground floor space boasts a stunning street view that’s perfect for people-watching featuring 16 taps and cozy elegant seating up to 100 pax.

name: Benaras Heritage
address: 16- 18, Vo Thi Sau, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Truly authentic Indian restaurant. Good location, perfect ambience (indoor and outdoor), food quality excellent and most importantly the staff around to hear and get your needs done. Many thanks to Akshay - Manager, who helped me with my booking, understood my requirements, and went out of the way to get for me Indian Kingfisher beers, which for a change was different for my Vietnamese friends tasting Indian beer. All of my Vietnamese friends, enjoyed the food and appreciates me bringing them to Benaras Heritage for dinner., Great time and great food. This is amazing place for indian street food. My experience was really good, its a huge place so parties can be easily hosted here and the location too is pretty prime., The food is really good, authentic Indian taste, the staff is very polite and supportive, the service was good, the restaurant is very clean and hygiene,must visit place if you are in Vietnam
description: Truly authentic Indian restaurant. Good location, perfect ambience (indoor and outdoor), food quality excellent and most importantly the staff around to hear and get your needs done. Many thanks to Akshay - Manager, who helped me with my booking, understood my requirements, and went out of the way to get for me Indian Kingfisher beers, which for a change was different for my Vietnamese friends tasting Indian beer. All of my Vietnamese friends, enjoyed the food and appreciates me bringing them to Benaras Heritage for dinner.

name: Mitau Restaurant - Traditional Hue Cuisine
address: 30/2 Hai Ba Trung, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Tucked away in a quiet alleyway, this restaurant is worth searching out. It is very well placed in District 1, within walking distance of all the sights. Mrs Oanh is a delightful hostess and her food some of the best we've tasted, in 3 weeks in Vietnam. Don't forget to check out the golf trophies...(and if you're inclined, perhaps fix up a round with Mrs Oanh and her son, he's a handsome young Professional) Oh and do ask her to lead you in a song or two on the guitar... You will have the best night in Ho Chi Minh city, I promise!, you will feel like home with nice and friendly treat here. All Hue cuisine are great! Reasonable price in District 1 and good food. I like Mrs Oanh a lot as her kindness to serve and treat me well when everytime I come., Small restaurant - we arrived at ~ 1800 - no one else there. Split some dishes with my colleague: fresh spring rolls, queen rice with shrimp and crab, and grilled pork and beef with noodles. Add two Saigon Special beers - cost was ~ $15 USD.
description:
Tucked away in a quiet alleyway, this restaurant is worth searching out. It is very well placed in District 1, within walking distance of all the sights. Mrs Oanh is a delightful hostess and her food some of the best we've tasted, in 3 weeks in Vietnam.
 
Don't forget to check out the golf trophies...(and if you're inclined, perhaps fix up a round with Mrs Oanh and her son, he's a handsome young Professional)

Oh and do ask her to lead you in a song or two on the guitar...
You will have the best night in Ho Chi Minh city, I promise!

name: Nàng Gánh Restaurant
address: 115/2 Tran Quoc Thao Street, Ward 7, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 084 Vietnam
reviews: A very beautiful place very well restored. The setting both inside and outside is very pleasant. As for the kitchen it is very good and fine. I recommend the plate of 4 nems is fantastic. And pork and duck. Do not hesitate. I recommend the restaurant., Beautiful restaurant. Vietnamese traditional food is amazing. My girlfriend said that she wanna come here again., Good buffet at the International UEH conference. I hope to be back in future. I love Vietnamese food.
description: Nang Ganh is the first crowd-funding restaurant built by 160 Facebookers. It is really a beautiful story of start-up business. The owner created delivery service named Ganh Hang Rong 4 years ago which is developing day by day and become one of the biggest catering service in Vietnamese traditional foods. The food, the service and the story life of the owner are the key factors to attract guests. The owner is also the main cooker: she puts all her passion in cooking and decorating each dish. She is devoted at doing customer service and so strong in details. She can meet all the difficult requirements provided that it is Vietnamese food. You can enjoy the food on the banana leaf with bamboo tray that is unique vs other places. You also feel comfortable with the ambience of the French antique villa which is attractive with most of people come here. We serve a-la-carte on normal days and buffet on Saturday. We are strong at holding wedding ceremony, birthday parties, events, seminars, meetings, conferences, etc... We supply the A-Z services from F&B and decoration to the specific theme, music band, meeting facilities, MC, entertainment activities. It's our big honor to welcome you in NangGanh Restaurant- the unique Vietnamese cuisine restaurant.

name: San May Vegetarian Restaurant
address: 771 le Hong Phong Street, Ward 12, District 10, Ho Chi Minh City 75000 Vietnam
reviews: Wonderful Vietnamese Vegetarian food. Fresh food and tasty stuff. Good service and courteous staff make this a nice place to Dine out! The greens and lotus stems make the food very healthy., I was staying not far from this restaurant and wanted to check in out. The menu is large and I wanted to try more dishes than I could possibly eat. There are pictures of the dishes on the menu. The staff spoke limited English and I saw no other foreigners when I was there. I had fried abalone mushrooms with tofu and veggies, a large avocado salad with mango and a delicious rice soup with tofu skins. I also tried the banana blossom rolls. I've become very fond of banana blossoms. Really great! I could not eat it all and the price is very, very reasonable. As I finished eating, a Vietnamese monk stopped to say hello to me and asked how I liked it. Turns out that he lives in Colorado. We discussed Buddhist practice and vegetarian food. Interesting and engaging for me., This is the 2nd time I came to this restaurant. The food is nice, tasty and well presented. The sauce is so light and doesn’t have the strong smell of the fermented tofu sauce but you can still taste it and cannot faulted. The only thing that why I cannot give a 5 stars is the lack of air conditioning in Saigon. For local people is ok but for tourist it is like have lunch/dinner in a sauna. Ok I may exaggerate a bit but the heat is unpleasant to fully enjoy the food. But if you don’t mind the heat, this is a restaurant you should not miss.
description: Wonderful Vietnamese Vegetarian food. Fresh food and tasty stuff.  Good service and courteous staff make this a nice place to Dine out! The greens and lotus stems make the food very healthy.

name: Sushi Masa Võ Văn Tần
address: 376A Vo Van Tan, Ward 5, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Pure class! After trying several sushi restaurants in Saigon is Sushi Masa absolutely my most favorite. It is true that the Sushi is for Vietnamese conditions relative expensive but first, trust me, it is really worth its price and second, you find nowhere such a nice service., Finding good Japanese food outside of Japan is never easy but this is the place you want to go to in HCMC. Beautiful fresh sashimi, sushi and hot dishes as well. Staff are attentive and always helpful. You won’t be disappointed!, Such a nice lovely niche place for sashimi. Fresh and delicious. This place is easy to find, it will worth your visit. They master their Japanese cuisine and their staffs are all helpful and lovely.
description: Sushi Masa là chuỗi nhà hàng Nhật Bản với các sản phẩm chất lượng cao, món ăn đa dạng - hấp dẫn, không gian sang trọng, dịch vụ tận tình và giá cả cạnh tranh

name: Brix Wine Bar & Kitchen
address: 42 Pasteur Phuong Ben Nghe, Quan 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We had a nice time with friendly staffs, great services, great food and beer 😘 My favourite place in town 😍 I can recomend this place. ❤️, Great western foods and great service! Had great time as we had both a lunch and dinner here. Great pizza and ribs which we enjoyed very much., The service was great with very good menu with high but not over priced value and a relaxed atmosphere.
description: Brix Wine Bar & Kitchen is located in the heart of Saigons District 1. Our tranquil atmosphere in this old colonial building with exposed brickwork walls and our unique walk in wine cellar enables you to select your favourite wines. Our international Chef and his dedicated Kitchen team are working with only the freshest ingredients as well as imported delicacies from all over the World.

name: Mad Roosta | Burgers & Grill
address: 95 Hai Bà Trưng, Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Thành Phố Hồ Chí Minh Level 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Great burgers reasonably priced. Service was fabulous all staff very friendly. Entrance going up was a little off putting although the restaurant is very stylish, Came here as a group of 3, strange entrance as it is on the 2nd floor and it is a bit grubby to get up to the restaurant but inside is nice, the food was great and staff were very friendly, Quiet space where you can watch motorbikes on the street. The Staff so frendly, The Baron Buger so delicious 🍔🍔🍔🍔🍔🍔
description: MAD ROOSTA located in the center of Ho Chi Minh City and offers burgers and steaks of highest quality

name: Bun Bo Hue Duyen Mai
address: 132 Đ. Bến Vân Đồn Phường 6, Quận 4, Millennium Tower, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We stumbled onto this place because it was near our hotel, and wow, we were lucky! We have never had hot pot before, but the staff did not treat us like idiots, and they welcomed us in, and explained everything well. There was also some other customers next to us who helped out also, so it was very social! What can I say about the food - it was stunning. Beef, pork, fishballs, and loads of fresh veges, which we cooked in the broth in the middle of the table. It was yummy and very healthy. Thanks for your hospitality and we will be back next time we are in Ho Chi Minh City., The bún bò Huế had a light broth that after squeezing in some fresh lime was very well-balanced. I got the thinly sliced Wagyu and it was tender. The appetizer platter with bánh bột lọc lá, chả Huế, and bánh bèo were delicious. The nước mắm or nước chấm it was served with was a bit bland but not bad. Super clean, air conditioned, and took credit card., This is the first time I have enjoyed such delicious beef noodle soup. The broth is traditionally rich and the wagyu beef is tender and delicious. Perhaps this is the best beef noodle shop I have ever enjoyed.
description: We stumbled onto this place because it was near our hotel, and wow, we were lucky!  We have never had hot pot before, but the staff did not treat us like idiots, and they welcomed us in, and explained everything well.  There was also some other customers next to us who helped out also, so it was very social!  What can I say about the food - it was stunning.  Beef, pork, fishballs, and loads of fresh veges, which we cooked in the broth in the middle of the table.  It was yummy and very healthy.  Thanks for your hospitality and we will be back next time we are in Ho Chi Minh City.

name: Ann Quán
address: 66 Ngô Đức Kế Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Restaurant looked beautiful. After reading the story on the menu I thought this will be good. No wine listed on the menu , however the waiter did produce one glass… m not the best. We ordered 2lots of spring roll and rice noodle s 1 chicken and a pork dish.., way way too much food. What a shame the waiter didn’t tell us.. it all went to waste. So disappointing. The spring rolls would have been enough. Wouldn’t come back., Three of us were strolling through Saigon looking for somewhere to have supper. Landed on this restaurant. Very popular with Vietnamese families, couples and groups of workers. We were looked after by a delightfully extravagant waiter called Bao Bao. His English was excellent and he guided us through the extensive menu making helpful suggestions as to what we might enjoy. The food arrived very quickly and when it did it was very good. We chose a fried pork dish, a fish cooked in ginger and a fried rice dish and a boiled rice. This was plenty for three of us., I had pork belly and sticky rice with a basket of various leaves. The pork belly absolutely melted in my mouth and was so juicy and delicious. So I guess that made up for the cold and dried out sticky rice. My husband can't remember the dish he had but says it was delicious. The decor was very interesting!
description: Ann Quan Restaurant is a place reminiscent of Northern villages in the memory of expatriate children, especially those from Nam Dinh, to the South to settle down. Here we and our customers are like a family and share the cuisine and culture of the Northern countryside. Address: 66 Ngo Duc Ke, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, City. Ho Chi Minh City

name: Buffet Cuu Van Long Premium
address: Bitexco Tower Số 19-25 Nguyễn Huệ, Bến Nghé, Q1, Ho Chi Minh City 71000 Vietnam
reviews: STAFF PARTY Amazing seafood & shells buffet, gorgeous variety (sushi, sashimi, crab, oyster, shrimps, octopus, shells, others) Asiatic stand Starters stand with a huge range of greens & salads Grilled meat with garnitures Deserts All food is very fresh Just 2 points must be improved: * Grilled meats, limited, increase choice * Desserts more international (crepes, fruits fritter, choclate mousse, caramel flan) The most important is you have a Good Value for Money Continue the prestation, NO decrease the quality For me the BEST Destination in HCM, Awful location Live hour away in royston UK and had to walk there Day ruined when worker touched me when I didn't ask to be Wouldn't recommend if you don't want to be groped, Delicious and fresh food, luxurious space, very diverse dishes, I really like the dessert line, very beautiful and diverse decoration Enthusiastic service staff
description: International buffet with over 200 cuisines including: Seafood, Sushi & sashimi, Dimsum, Barbecue & Dessert,... with reasonable price from $20/set off buffet.

name: Hoa Tuc Company
address: 17/11 le Thanh Ton Street, Dist, 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: The setting is very pleasant, also quieter because it is located in a small courtyard overlooking the street. Beautiful varied menu, and a nice wine list. The service is efficient and impeccable. Modern decor, with a large terrace. Everything we had was very well cooked, but some dishes were limited in quantity. Correct price level., Very nice discovery on the advice of our guide. Despite our difficulty with language and English our choices were all very good: The squid with a divine coconut sauce the dish list of shrimp and exceptional squid Good value for money, We had lunch here and was recommended by our travel agency. It was a set menu and although we didn't think we were hungry we scoffed the lot - crispy spring rolls, fresh salad, sea bass and dessert downed by a couple of glasses of wine. Looked a popular place in a central location. Service was ok and efficient. Worth visiting.
description:
The setting is very pleasant, also quieter because it is located in a small courtyard overlooking the street. Beautiful varied menu, and a nice wine list. The service is efficient and impeccable. Modern decor, with a large terrace.
Everything we had was very well cooked, but some dishes were limited in quantity.
Correct price level.

name: Banh mi Grandma Lu
reviews: I think the bread here is very tasty, their bread taste is very different from the places I have eaten before. If you have the opportunity to visit, try the banh mi vegetarian sausage, I find it very delicious. The staff here are very enthusiastic and sweet. They also write cute wishes and encouragement on bread bags. The space here is also very cozy. Come visit when you come to Vietnam!, Great ambience, lighting, cheeru background music, tasty banh mi, wide selection of beverage (varieties of tea and coffee to choose from), great conversation with inspirational and friendly owner and founder!!! Agree with her on her philosophy and motivation for starting Grandma Lu!!!, Great Atmosphere with friendly staff and people 👍👍👍. The Bread especially the Fresh bread is fantastic with crunchy top and soft on the inside and great taste. The menu is great for a quick bite with great toppings and with good cold drinks and coffee. Would suggest to add in Hot Drinks into the menu
description: With our real passion for Vietnamese baguette, we have made the most nutritious and healthy fast-food 'banh mi' which is always wrapped in eco-friendly cleaning paper bags. We also serve such special tangerine tea that you can not find anywhere else in Sai Gon.

name: Sóno Grill & Bar
address: 215B37 Nguyễn Văn Hưởng, Thảo Điền, Thành  Thủ Đức, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant is in an off-the-beaten track location in District 2, but is well worth finding. It reminds me of a chic urban restaurant in the US, with an open kitchen, backlit bar, and jazz wafting thru the air. Cocktail were colorful & creative. The dishes were plated with a flourish & even better to eat. We started with a snapper ceviche, served in a lime & cream sauce and bone marrow with mustard seeds & caramalized onions The aged duck breast with Cora dẻ & hot pepper (&!pickled papaya) was wonderful. I was most surprised by the king prawns with homemade pasta (pasta was the dish I most missed during my VN travel!) the pasta was Al dente & excellent! Gracious service. The entire experience was a Foodie’s delight., The service at Sóno was also outstanding. The staff was attentive and knowledgeable, guiding us through the extensive wine list and providing personalized recommendations to enhance our dining experience. We felt genuinely cared for, adding an extra touch of specialness to our night., delicious food in a relatively laid back environment. reasonable value for the money and excellent service
description:
This restaurant is in an off-the-beaten track location in District 2, but is well worth finding. It reminds me of a chic urban restaurant in the US, with an open kitchen, backlit bar, and jazz wafting thru the air. 
Cocktail were colorful & creative. The dishes were plated with a flourish & even better to eat. We started with a snapper ceviche, served in a lime & cream sauce and bone marrow with mustard seeds & caramalized onions
The aged duck breast with Cora dẻ & hot pepper (&!pickled papaya) was wonderful. I was most surprised by the king prawns with homemade pasta (pasta was the dish I most missed during my VN travel!) the pasta was Al dente & excellent! 
Gracious service. The entire experience was a Foodie’s delight.

name: Pink Moment Cafe
address: 258 Hai Ba Trung Street Tan Dinh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Decided to gave this coffee a try while wandering around Tan Dinh Church even though it’s relatively new. When I first came in, I had noticed the AC so strong that immediately gave me a pleasant cool feeling after being under the sun all day, that’s a bonus point. Also, the Café itself has a bright and welcoming atmosphere, rooftop with panoramic church view and very attentive staffs. Last but not least, I like how they presented “Cafe Sua Da” with the pink coffee phin filter, it was very creative and fun, which later my friends asked me a lot about this picturesque cafe when they saw my story. Highly recommended if you’re in town and in need of a chill vibe Café., I hopped into the Pink Moment Cafe purely to take photos of the Tan Dinh Church (pink church) across the street at sunset after my friend and I found out we weren't able to go inside the church (it is under construction). The third floor balcony has a great view of the church! We took a ton of photos from there. The atmosphere is really cute too. Ciders were two for 85,000 so my friend and I each got a cider (get the berry cider if you want a pink drink!). The staff member helping us was very friendly and patient. We arrived a little before 6pm (I believe they are supposed to close at 6) and he came upstairs and told us they were closing at 6:30 (so I think he extended it for us?). They have WiFi and a lot of power outlets. I didn't use the WiFi so I'm not sure how good it is but it seemed like it would be a great place to hang out and work if needed., The staff here were so lovely, really friendly and welcoming. A great relaxed vibe, fantastic views of the pink Church. Would definitely recommend stopping in here to cool off for a while and get some lovely pictures. Can easily recommend this place!
description: Pink Moment Cafe is an Instragammable Cafe just located nearby the famous tourist spot "Pink Church" of HCMC. What we offers to our customers - amazing view of Pink Church - various instagram worthy photo decorations - colourful and tasteful drinks - offer various tourist friendly services including : Vietnam Traditional Cloth Experience, instant photo printing services and power bank rental services. All what we do is to give customers unforgettable memories in HCMC, Vietnam

name: The Posh Duck Kitchen
address: Lot 9, Road 7 District 7, Tan Thuan Dong, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Wow! This place is a bit out of the way if you are staying in District 1 or 3, but well worth the $8 taxi ride. We (party of 4) found it a bit by accident while researching places off the normal tourist maps. It is located on the second floor of the Q Industries building with a small sign out front. Don’t let the location fool you. It is an outstanding restaurant. Service from the time we sat down until we got up to leave was impeccable. The interior decor has a great vibe with seating for around 40 people. They are only open for lunch currently (from 11:00 am until 2:00 pm) with a very nice set (2 or 3 course) a la carte menu with multiple selection options and a daily special menu with 5 dishes that changes every couple weeks. We had one of each of the 5 specials (rib eye steak, soft shell crab, seafood fried rice, Thai curry dusted grilled chicken, and pork/beef satay combination). Add to that 2 bottles of Prosecco, desserts and tea. The chef (Nalinda Prabath Rajasuriya) came to our table to ensure the dishes were satisfactory, and ended up chatting with us for about 5 minutes. I can’t stress what a wonderful experience it was. Make it a “must” the next time you’re in Saigon., Amazing food, not like anything else currently offered in Saigon and so accommodating to food allergies and requirements! Paleo and AIP Paleo friendly options. Super helpful staff. I really loved the salad and herb basket with 3 dips offered instead of the usual bread basket. Highly worth the visit to District 7. Will be back!, So happy the restaurant has reopened after COVID. The set lunch menu is a great help to those who always have difficulty deciding what to order. The choice of cuisine covers both Asian and Western, and the food is well prepared and well presented - good as it has always been. Small things like the sambal chilli paste that comes with the Kway Teow and the cookie that comes with the latte, all made in-house, make for pleasant little surprises that make you want to go back. Looking forward to trying out other cuisines on their ever changing lunch menu.
description: The Posh Duck Kitchen, the culinary showcase of Qindustries. We provide a unique experience to our customers by using premium ingredients and applying modernist cooking techniques, bringing you a new and innovative dining experience.

name: Hủ Tiếu Hồng Phát (hong Phat District 3)
address: 389-391 Vo Van Tan Street, Ward 5, District 3 Quan 3, Ho Chi Minh City L4K 5Y6 Vietnam
reviews: One of the most famous Hu Tieu joints over the past decades, and quite glad that with the new menu, we don't have to just hear from guides what's the origin story of this dish - they actually shared on their first page how the Hu Tieu story started when Vietnamese-Chinese (specifically, ChaoZhao or Teochew) from Cambodia/Khmer returned to Vietnam and made this dish famous in Vietnam. Quite thoughtful to include the origin story - since that's what many other Michelin places do too. As for being well-run/ well-decorated: - Well-run because even their raw vegetable-plates seemed to be individually prepared and packaged (i.e. not exposed to the elements). - You could tell the servers were trained - always ready and attentive, but not obtrusive. - Entire place was well-renovated with air-con, nice decor (even the giant fish tank). Loved that they are family-orientated and displayed huge family portraits as part of the slow-mo videos of their food preparations, taking pride in both. The hanging ladles and transparent bowls as chandeliers were a really nice touch. As for the food itself: - One of the few Hu Tieu places that still has braised blood curds in this dish. Prawns were adequately large and juicy. Sauces in both soup and dry were tasty. - Other than the Hu Tieu, their herbal duck noodles was good too with its nourishing soup... and falling-off-the-bones kinda tender duck confit, with springy egg noodles. - Friends were also impressed that their big pau didn't just have one, but two types of eggs - quail's and salted (duck's)., Great eats, huge portions and reasonable prices. Three things to say that pretty much sums up this restaurant. If you’d like your dishes spaced out, tell the staff otherwise everything arrives all at once. The kitchen is fast. The hu tiu xao has lots of content and delicately flavoured taste. Other dishes are large portions and tasty. So tasty in fact, I’m in a rut about choices. It’s a family run business, service is great., The Bahn Bao (pork) is delicious. It has salted egg, quail egg, pork, mushroom, etc. The bao's filling was a lot and the bao was freshly made. The pig blood texture is like a jelly (quite nice. should try once in your life). The braised duck leg noodle soup is another must try dish.
description: Hủ Tiếu Hồng Phát has been serving for nearly 50 years and has become one of the oldest and most beloved culinary brands in Saigon. With its special recipe, Hong Phat has maintained a strong impression on the people of Saigon through generations of customers. As the culinary service industry continues to develop, Hồng Phát constantly adjusts and improves to meet the high service standards. It not only focuses on the quality of the cuisine, but also creates a comfortable space to ensure that every guest has a sastisfied experiences while dining with us. The year 2023 marked a special milestone for us as we received the Bib Gourmand award from the prestigious culinary magazine The Michelin Guide, organized for the first time in Vietnam. With a firm commitment to development and quality improvement, Hồng Phát aims not only to bring delicious dishes to the Vietnamese community but also to share with international diners.

name: Ut Ca Mau Restaurant
address: 215 Dien Bien Phu Street, Ward 6, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Head upstairs for the ‘local’ seating and enjoy the evening with good food + beer. Staff’s English is limited so with some dishes it is a bit of a guess work. Great for seafood like crab, squids and steamboat., We love the curry/ salted egg-yolk sauced crabs; especially the signature crab hot pot with coconut water. The only thing that I didn't feel comfortable about this restaurant is the thick strings to tie up the crabs; those would make us pay more $ per kg of crag, wouldn't they?, I have been to Ut Ca Mau a dozen times or so and each time the service has been excellent, crabs are always good as is anything else you order. The staff speak English, and I always see other foreigners there. I am from Maryland, the land of steamed crabs, and while I can not compare the crabs here to the crabs in Maryland, they are very tasty and with a lot of meat. Price is really good compared to the other seafood places in Saigon.
description:
Head upstairs for the ‘local’ seating and enjoy the evening with good food + beer. 

Staff’s English is limited so with some dishes it is a bit of a guess work. Great for seafood like crab, squids and steamboat.

name: Bep Vo
address: 90 Đ. Quốc Hương Thảo Điền, Quận 2, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: This is an excellent restaurant in every respect except one: THE PIPED MUSIC. If it were not for the music, I would have given 5 stars for atmosphere. My visits to Bep Vo are marred by having to continually ask for the music to be turned down or, better still, turned off. The music is badly chosen and too loud. Why can't the management understand that the music adds nothing to the ambience and often interferes with conversation? If music has to be played, it should be soft and instrumental (no voices). I will continue eating at Bep Vo but will always ask for the music to be adjusted. Vegetarian options: The veggie baguettes are excellent. So are the veggie skewers., This is the best place to eat in my opinion for the price in Thao Dien. The food is fresh, Vietnamese, delicious and reasonably priced, they update their menu with new food occasionally and the service is fantastic. I can’t say enough good things about this place., Great evening with my love and very happy that I went again. Never disappoint an the staff tries always the best to make you feel good. Couples menu was great, 7 courses to taste Vietnam in a way never done before.
description: Welcome to Bep Vo kitchen - Modern Vietnamese Kitchen! We take great pride in offering you a delightful dining experience with our healthy Vietnamese cuisine. Our dishes are cooked in a modern Vietnamese kitchen, using family recipes that have been passed down for three generations. Our food is free from MSG, and instead, focus on using fresh ingredients and moderate seasoning to bring forth the authentic flavors of Vietnam. At Vo Kitchen, our commitment to providing a memorable dining experience goes beyond just the food. We also feature a cozy and chilling tropical-inspired ambiance, where you can relax and unwind with your loved ones. To complement your dining experience, we offer a selection of classic cocktails and drinks prepared with utmost care and artistry. Visit us and embark on a culinary journey that combines tradition and innovation, all wrapped up in a warm and inviting atmosphere.

name: Du Bar - Perfume Cocktail Bar
address: 36bis Huỳnh Khương Ninh, Phường Đakao, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Du Bar – Here you will witness an extremely beautiful Saigon, slowly enjoying jazz music. But the drinks here are reasonably priced, the cost of a cocktail is nearly $15. Not a spacious bar, Du Bar is cozy and intimate. Make delicious and easy-to-drink cocktails, especially drinks inspired by scents. The manager here is very attentive and understanding, too cute. The music is free, the sound is perfect and the selection of timeless songs is played. Classy, elegant service. The second floor at Du Bar also has a Scentury Concept perfume shop with many niche perfume lines to delight those who are passionate about scents., I've been to this place several times, but today, I'm finally writing a review. Speaking of the ambiance, the bar predominantly embraces a dark color scheme, creating a mysterious and alluring atmosphere. Amidst this, golden lights shimmer, evoking a warm and intimate feel. These two seemingly contrasting colors harmonize beautifully, giving the place a unique charm. In terms of beverages, besides the classic cocktails, what impressed me the most about Du Bar is their cocktails inspired by renowned niche fragrance collections from around the world. Here, you not only get to savor delicious cocktails but also experience the scents that make up those very cocktails. Furthermore, the staff here is incredibly enthusiastic, providing attentive service, and occasionally, you'll encounter the adorable manager. This place is undoubtedly one of my top choices for special occasions or romantic dates., Hidden-place with very creativity businesss, cocktail colabs with perfume. Their signature is amazing tasting and fragance. Place for slow-njoy and forget stress
description: Du Bar redefines the sensory journey, seamlessly blending captivating fragrances with expertly crafted cocktails.

name: La Bettola Saigon
address: 82 Xuan Thuy Thao Dien, District 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This is my favorite Italian place to come with my bf besides Pasta Freska since it's close to our home (other nice place is Carpaccio but it's in the city center so we can't visit very often). My usual time to visit Bettola is during lunch time when it's not busy. Our favorite seat is the one indoor looking out the swimming pool, it's a nice view on a warm sunny day. Food takes time to come but the quality is 100% worth the wait. My favorite is always the homemade pasta with morel mushroom sauce, I LOVE mushroom and they are always generous with the portion and the sauce, which makes me happy every time. My bf on the other hand is a fan of their pizza, he even order delivery from them when I'm busy and he doesn't want to eat out alone. Only two tiny points to improve that I would like to point out: one is the temperature of the tomato sauce paired with complementary bread basket. Sometimes they brought it out when it's still very cold, so even when I know it's not meant to be served hot, I think the sauce should be kept at somewhere closer to room temperature. The second point is background music, sometimes when we arrive they just blasted EDM pop songs at an unnecessary loud volume which doesn't set you on a right mood, so I think a little more gentle music would be great. The service is great: attentive staff always be around with smile on their face so we would definitely come back. P/s: just checked other bad reviews stating about the out of stock and overcrowd issue, so I need to clarify that we always receive top food and service probably because we always come for lunch when it's usually super quiet. I think for better service residents in TD can try going there for lunch and I believe they won't be disappointed., One of best Diavola pizzas I've had, and the toppings are moist and generous without compensating by too much olive oil. Restaurant is aimed at locals and westerners with a Vietnamese buffet outside and a la carte menu in the AC section. Price is about the same as I'd pay in the UK and reasonable for this quality of food. Good pizza chefs, stone fire ovens and fine ingredients don't come cheap. Service was swift and accurate, didn't have to remind them of anything. Would definitely come again., Nice restaurant with an adjacent pool where you play fantasy evenings. Good Italian food accompanied by excellent wines. I will be back soon.
description:
This is my favorite Italian place to come with my bf besides Pasta Freska since it's close to our home (other nice place is Carpaccio but it's in the city center so we can't visit very often). My usual time to visit Bettola is during lunch time when it's not busy. Our favorite seat is the one indoor looking out the swimming pool, it's a nice view on a warm sunny day. Food takes time to come but the quality is 100% worth the wait. My favorite is always the homemade pasta with morel mushroom sauce, I LOVE mushroom and they are always generous with the portion and the sauce, which makes me happy every time. My bf on the other hand is a fan of their pizza, he even order delivery from them when I'm busy and he doesn't want to eat out alone. 

Only two tiny points to improve that I would like to point out: one is the temperature of the tomato sauce paired with complementary bread basket. Sometimes they brought it out when it's still very cold, so even when I know it's not meant to be served hot, I think the sauce should be kept at somewhere closer to room temperature. The second point is background music, sometimes when we arrive they just blasted EDM pop songs at an unnecessary loud volume which doesn't set you on a right mood, so I think a little more gentle music would be great.

The service is great: attentive staff always be around with smile on their face so we would definitely come back.

P/s: just checked other bad reviews stating about the out of stock and overcrowd issue, so I need to clarify that we always receive top food and service probably because we always come for lunch when it's usually super quiet. I think for better service residents in TD can try going there for lunch and I believe they won't be disappointed.

name: Zumwhere Phu Nhuan
address: 117B Nguyen Dinh Chinh Ward 15, Phu Nhuan, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This was my first visit here to the Thao Dien branch although the weather was perfect for Ducks due to the very heavy rain the restaurant and staff were excellent and the food and service was perfect- nothing at all to complain about only compliments- just one small suggestion would be in a top quality restaurant table cloth and napkins are preferred, a very pleasant evening and will definitely return again Many thanks 🙏, The seafood is really fresh, especially oysters, steaks are tasty. Their craft beer is also good taste and good value. Our group really enjoyed our time here, Cool and innovative architecture, excellent food, excellent beer. The music slightly to loud but not disturbing. Perhaps not the cheapest place, but one of the best places for dinner in HCMC. We ordered over ten different things and all was outstanding good.
description: Zumwhere Phu Nhuan isn't just a premier event venue – it's also perfect for casual dining experiences. Whether you're enjoying a meal with friends, family, or colleagues, the lush greenery and spacious indoor-outdoor seating provide a relaxing atmosphere. With a menu that blends modern Japanese cuisine and creative drinks, it's a great spot for everything from casual lunches to lively dinners. The expansive courtyard and serene environment make every dining occasion feel like an escape from the bustling city.

name: 0°C Không Độ C - Korean BBQ Dining Restaurant
address: 95 Đ. Võ Nguyên Giáp Song Hành Xa Lộ Hà Nội, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam

name: Manmaru Japanese Restaurant
address: 71 Mac Dinh Chi Dakao Ward, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Located at a busy street, the venue offers a parking slot for scooters just in front. Great choice of Japanese food of superb quality. Smiley faces of the service staff, fantastic atmosphere! Will definitely go there again if I ever go back to Saigon., Always my safe place for Japanese food. Good flavour although it could have been better if they had some more options, like serving katsudon for dinner in particular., Best sushi I’ve had in years. Absolutely delightful place with an atmosphere and staff to match. Can’t wait to come back here!
description: MANMARU operates with the motto of "Smiles"and "Passion." ✨Wholeheartedly serving delicious food at affordable prices ✨Wholeheartedly providing the best hospitality We hope to bring you energy for a brighter tomorrow！

name: Downtown Steakhouse - Nguyen Hue
address: 42 Nguyen Hue 3rd Floor, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Firstly, location is brilliant. In the cafe apartments, with a great view and a nice vibe. Secondly, we went for lunch and they have an AMAZING set menu. You get 2 starters (from 4 choices), 2 mains (from 8 choices), 1 dessert (from 2 choices), and 2 drinks for 495.000 dong (£15). Starters included soup and salads, and mains include steak, stew, spaghetti, fish, and chicken. Thirdly, our main meals were out of this world. We split a beef stew with noodles and a steak with mash. When you consider it was a 7 ounce (200 gram) steak, the value for money is even better. Everything was so tasty and the service was brilliant. We ended on a brownie for dessert as a sweet treat for finding this place 😁, I went to Saigon for the first time and really want to visit cafe restaurant. I came at night so why not try for dinner too and gladly I saw this steakhouse. I ordered their signature dish the chicken steak and also arrabbiata spaghetti. I asked for a little spicy but not spicy at all but still all good. The view from the outside and good value and good taste of dish was still worth it. Good service too from Mr. Thuayen. Definitely a highly recommended., Great steakhouse in prime location. It’s a bit difficult to find your way in, but at least for us the experience was very good. Style is very ”local” so humble and simple, but the steaks were excellent. And definitely a good value for money with great service!
description: Downtown Steakhouse is located at 42 Nguyen Hue. District 1. Our slogan " There's no such thing tasty as a "juicy" steak".

name: Maison Des Rêves
address: 20/5 Đ. Kỳ Đồng Ward 9, District 3,, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: One of my favourite restaurants in Saigon has recently reopened. If you are a food lover this is a "must try" dining experience. Not only do they serve excellent quality dishes at a very reasonable price but the attention to detail in every part of the service is extraordinary. 4 of us ordered a variety of dishes from the menu and every dish was designed with contrasting and complimentary flavours, textures and colours. There is a well-constructed and reasonably priced wine list and the design and ambience of the restaurant is relaxed bistro to allow you to focus on enjoying the excellent food that you are served. We will be back ...... regularly!, Chef Thao Na has returned to her original location with another French inspired concept - Maison Des Rêves - described as “bistronomy”; a gastronomic, casual fine dining experience styled as a bistro. • For those who loved Atelier des Reves this feels like a reboot, "Reves 2:0" with a stripped back, comfortable décor and a key focus on French techniques & flavours. • Degustation & A la carte menu’s are offered and we opted for the tasting option which has an interesting twist as the guest chooses their dessert option from the main carte. Especially 💜 🦆 Foie Gras Terrine 🐮 Angus Beef with Truffle Sauce 🍍 Pineapple Brulee with Coconut IceCream 🍷 Stephane Ogier Côtes du Rhône Tasting Menu; 1,950,000 Our Wine noted above; 1,500,000, Visit at lunchtime Appetizer and main or main and dessert 550,000 VND The appetizer, main course and dessert were VND 650,000 You could choose from two appetizers, three mains, or a regular dessert. They were all delicious. A glass of wine cost 130,000 VND. I refused the "special tea" which was recommended at the end because I didn't understand the explanation. I could consider writing an explanation on the menu.
description: Bistronomy, French cuisine with a touch of Vietnamese fusion. The word "bistronomy" is an etymological blend of 'bistro' and 'gastronomy', which is defined as, "French casual fine dining: casual decor, quality food".

name: Sugar Town Restaurant
address: Số 2 Đường số 18, Khu Đô Thị Vạn Phúc P. Hiệp Bình Phước, Thủ Đức, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I visited Sugar Town this morning for dinking a cappuccino and getting some donuts. I was quite surprised at the product quality and service style here. Check it out its really nice and relaxing at that location. I have heard that there are delisious Vietnamese, European foods and desserts. Next time I willcome back with my family and have dinner here., Mr. Loi really rocks the service here. He's a great server.We misordered an artichoke tea and he's willing to go through troubles to change for me even though it's my fault. They make excellent teas here. Y'all should come by and try, This place offers one of a kind view overlooking a man-made river tunnel. That's impressive. Furthermore, the service here is friendly, smiley and energetic. For food, my recommendations are Fuji steaks, triple chocolate cake
description: I visited Sugar Town this morning for dinking a cappuccino and getting some donuts. I was quite surprised at the product quality and service style here. Check it out its really nice and relaxing at that location. I have heard that there are delisious Vietnamese, European foods and desserts. Next time I willcome back with my family and have dinner here.

name: Highlands Coffee
address: 28 Vo Van Tan Street, Ward 6, District 3 War Museum, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: This was ok but would not recommend if you are after a GOOD coffee. Typical franchise coffee and assorted drinks - crowded on the day I attend and lack of seating meant that we sat outside in heat., Nice cafes spreading allover the city with some good pastry at decent prices. worths stopping by one of them., after a 3 hrs tour around the war remnants i deserved to have some iced coffee and bread. so just right outside the museum, there's this highland coffee shop . i ordered iced coffee and banana cake for about 52k vnd, thirst quencher and filled my hungry tummy. it was very hot outside but great cold coffee,, io also ordered 3 boxes of highlands coffee take away to bring back home in the philippines
description: This was ok but would not recommend if you are after a GOOD coffee.  Typical franchise coffee and assorted drinks - crowded on the day I attend and lack of seating meant that we sat outside in heat.

name: Wakaba
address: 28 Thai Van Lung, Ben Nghe, Dist. 1 Dist.1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Visit for dinner with an expatriate, and the menu is as numerous as in a Japanese izakaya. Oden, sashimi, salad, tempura, soup roll egg, chicken nanban, etc. A Japanese izakaya restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City, far from Japan., I've been here twice now and both times have had a great experience. The staff are very friendly and attentive and the fitout of the store is nice. Food is very fresh and tasty and the music isn't too loud so you can actually talk to your friends without shouting. It's also great they're open until 2am so perfect for late night snacking and drinks with friends., wakaba open until 2am. there are many friendly staffs. you can enjoy various japanese food. sushi,sasgimi,udon,soba and etc... best choice when you eat midnight.
description: Visit for dinner with an expatriate, and the menu is as numerous as in a Japanese izakaya. Oden, sashimi, salad, tempura, soup roll egg, chicken nanban, etc. A Japanese izakaya restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City, far from Japan.

name: An Vegetarian Restaurant & Coffee
address: 40 Street C Canh Vien 2, Tan Phu, Phu My Hung, District 7, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The food absolutely satisfied a vegetarian-preferred customer like me regarding material, tastes, odour and also price. The service, clealiness, vibe were pleasant. The staff were way better and more friendly than the majority of surrounding stores I had visited. Therefore I would say that my experience here deserve my payment., Good food, good service, reasonable price with variety menu from Asian to Western dishes. My family like to have breakfast here at weekend or dinner on Friday night. This restaurant also has delivery service., we stumbled in here by accident and we very pleased at the selection. Other restaurants nearby were empty but they were very busy.Always a good sign.
description: AN Vegetarian Restaurant & Coffee which stays in central of Phu My Hung residence - the new and peaceful urban area, is rustic, calm and meditated style.

name: Khu 13
address: 175/22 Pham Ngu Lai, Pham Ngu Lao Ward, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We discovered that Khu 13 Saigon is perfect for larger groups - their beer and food combo deals offer excellent value when shared. The music selection kept everyone on their feet, and we couldn't help but join the infectious dance atmosphere. While we came as a couple, we appreciated the lively crowd and group-friendly pricing. The spontaneous dance parties breaking out around us made for an unforgettable night. TIP: Bring friends to make the most of their combo deals!, We were so lucky to be here on Saturday event day! Khu 13 Saigon has everything you need from the club - great music, delicious food, the best service, and reasonable prices. It was really fun to have a special event where the staff were dressed in student suit and offered free popcorn and candy. There was an immediate photo booth so I could leave a special memory. At midnight, the whole club turned into a birthday party. I will definitely visit again next time!, The bar atmosphere is great, blending modern and traditional Vietnamese styles. We tasted several signature cocktails that tasted unique and delicious. Vietnamese snacks are also authentic, with special Recommendations for their spring rolls. The live music was great and the DJs were great. The staff were friendly and patient in explaining it to us despite some language barriers. The only thing that's missing is the slightly higher price, but given the location and overall experience, we think it's worth it. If you want to experience the nightlife of Ho Chi Minh City, Khu 13 Saigon is definitely a great choice. We will definitely be back in Vietnam next time.
description: Underground and industrial design combine with strip lighting and metal grids, KHU 13 is the holy playground for energetic and passionate young souls. More than that, KHU 13 is also a venue where the inspiration for art, lifestyle and fashion.

name: MaâmPho
address: 134 Lê Thánh Tôn Phường Bến Thành, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The reviews looked good so we gave it a try. Easy to find across the road from the market. There is a Vietnamese menu, an English menu and there was a combo deal that looked too good to pass on. I chose the chicken wings and the chicken pho. My wife chose the spring rolls and beef pho. The meal arrived and as you can see it looked exactly as advertised. The flavours were excellent. I tested the green chilli slices and they were hot there were plenty of pho additions - too much for us. The chicken wings were crispy on the outside and juicy in the middle. The chicken in the pho actually tasted like chicken used to taste back home. Service was polite and attentive and the Saigon Special beer in the deal was a bonus. There is also an entire page devoted to explaining pho. Well done folks., Came here per recommendation from our hotel. Was advised that our “Westerner Stomachs” will not be able handle the streets foods stalls. So better play it safe by eating at this restaurant. The place was clean, well lit, and staff spoke limited English. Their prices compared to LA was so inexpensive for what you get. Service was prompt. Thought the food was good. Appears they automatically add a service charge (perhaps a tip) on the check. So pay attention., I’ve spent few days in HCMC and this is the most delicious and Cleanest Pho i had. They use very good quality of beef and the noodles is very delicious and taste so smooth. I recommend it very much. Very easy to find and located in central behind the market. I highly recommend this place for good pho
description: Handmade pho using authentic Vietnamese recipes (North and South) just like your mama's. No MSG and using 100% Australian beef, satisfying homemade 18-hours simmered pho broth.

name: Syunkato
address: 17 Ngo Van Nam Street, District 1, Ben Nghe Ward, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: This high-end Japanese restaurant is located one alley away from Le Thanh Ton Street. This time, we used it for a social gathering with a Japanese expatriate client. On the first floor, there is a kitchen and counter seats on the right side, and on the second floor, there are private rooms with sunken kotatsu tables. We toasted with Black Label draft beer, ordered a course meal, and had sake such as Kaga Tobi and Kenbishi, and shochu such as Akagiri. We had egg tofu topped with salmon roe, sashimi such as medium fatty tuna, sea bream, and squid, roast beef and fried puffer fish, shrimp baguette toast, tuna nigiri and scallop nigiri, tekkamaki and dried gourd rolls, and ice cream for dessert, all accompanied by sake and shochu. It was a very delicious high-end Japanese meal in Ho Chi Minh City., Excellent! Plenty of menu options and service was very good,super friendly staff . Food was delicious, love deep fried Oysters, This intimate and cozy restaurant is locate in the little Tokiyo, at Viet Nam. My faverate food is Tempura. I will come back again
description: We are Japanese Dining in District. 1, Ho Chi Minh City. We have traditional Japanese foods like Suhi, Sashimi, Tempura, Grilled Fish...etc with 7 private rooms. We also can serve Course Meal depending on your budget, for a further information, please contact our staff. *Guests who want to eat SOBA, please come to SYUNKATO SOBA - 9 Le Thanh Ton. SYUNKATO Ngo Van Nam doesn't serve SOBA.

name: Miss Thu Restaurant
address: 65 Le Loi, District 1, Ben Nghe Ward, Ho Chi Minh 24th Floor, Fusion Original Saigon Centre, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: The Missthu Restrictions located inside the Fusion Original Saigon hotel was absolutely 1st class. Breakfast was amazing with so much to choose from. We went for cocktails each night during happy hour and they tasted amazing. The service was outstanding as every staff member was so friendly and very attentive. Our favourite was the young lady who made our cocktails on 24th January she hadnt made them for a long time, and apologised for the wait, but they were worth waiting for. Absolutely delicious. Thank you to everyone at Missthu restaurant, you have been amazing so far., Food 5/5, Service 5/5, Ambience 5/5, City view 5/5. What more do I need to say? I ordered the caviar as a starter and pork as the main both of which were recommended by Thuy ( who is an amazing person ) The chef ( Arnaud - I hope I got that right ) specifically brought the food to my table and furthermore gave me an explanation on the sources of ingredients and what I should pair my meal with The portions are massive and I didn’t have room for dessert. However, the chef made me a complimentary dessert- the tiramisu which was simply superb. The type I have never had before A true 5 star experience. Keep it up guys!, I had the best date once in a while in Miss Thu in this sexy restaurant, this place is a gem in HCMC. The restaurant has some of the best aspects - location is very central, the food is creative and delicious (Michelin style) and the ambience/decoration is top notch. My date and I had a great quiet dinner that we deserved in a very busy season. The portion is just right for us, but if you are a hard core eater who want to go for quantity then this might not be ideal, like I said, it’s perfect for a date or maybe two or three! Will definitely come back!
description: Miss Thu restaurant at Fusion Original Saigon Centre is the city’s newest dining destination with a story to tell.

name: Sol Kitchen & Bar District 7
address: 514B Huỳnh Tấn Phát, Bình Thuận, Quận 7, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: We have been to Sol quite a few times, mainly because of the very good service and beautiful setting. Sitting in a cabana with friends, looking at the gorgeous pool and bar at the far end you genuinely feel that you are in a high end resort. The cocktails and wine are very pleasant and normally I order the Peruvian roast chicken and a garden salad. The chicken is well cooked and delicious although rather small, but the salad is around the size you would expect. Everyone of our group that we have ever gone to Sol with has enjoyed their meal. Disappointed though quite recently when I wanted to book cabanas for 34 people for a special birthday. I was asked to pay a deposit, which was fine because I was told it would be deducted from my bill on the day, but then I was informed that a new policy had just been made where I have to guarantee that everyone would spend at least a million per person. To be honest I didn't feel I could ask my guests to do that as although some would spend around 600- 700 vnd, others would spend a couple of million, so I felt that it would even out. I calculated between us we would pay equivalent to at least 1500 usd and asked the lady taking the booking if she could ask the manager to consider waiving the minimum 1 million spend per person given what I felt was quite an accurate estimate of what we would pay anyway. The lady took my mobile number but no one ever called sadly, as I really had wanted the celebration to take place there. I have been there a few times since, and always there is first class service and a great ambience, but we all go in small groups now to avoid the minimum 1 mill spend and to just order and pay for what we like. But the place itself and the staff etc will not disappoint., If you are in the mood for gourmet, fine dining with maximum portions, delivered straight to your door step for affordable prices check out Sol Kitchen & Bar D7. My partner and I were blown away by the 100k appreciation daily special menu which was a lamb kofta and a truffle cheese burger. Both proteins were cooked to perfection with the perfect amount of relish and fries accompanying them. We love any and all types of dips so wanted to give the Eggplant miso dip a try and it did not disappoint. Incredible amount of flavor and the perfect consistency. All these dishes travelled extremely well and free delivery is applied within district 7 for deliveries which are over 500k. Give them a try for a lockdown lunch treat - you won’t regret it 😍, I visited Sol district 7 for a friends birthday and had the best time. The dishes are like tapas style so we got a few to share. The beef cheeks were so tender, the whipped goats cheese was to die for. Everything we ordered exceeded expectations and just kept getting better with each bite. The restaurant is nothing less than beautiful, with a massive swimming pool, cabanas and a lovely dining area. It feels like a beach club, even though you’re in the city. The perfect place for a birthday or cocktails and tapas. Our server was delightful and so attentive, no one ever had an empty wine glass. The manager and owners were lovely and made sure we were enjoying our meal and experience. Sol d7 is such a unique addition to Saigon and it’s like nothing else in the city. I absolutely can’t wait to go back. 11/10 recommend.
description: Your tropical escape in the heart of District 7, Sol Kitchen and Bar offer a unique dining experience. At Sol we've fused the freshest flavours from around world and designed contemporary cocktails all served to you in a stylish poolside paradise.

name: Đu Đủ Xanh | Tiệm Chay . Vegetarian
address: 178A Hai Bà Trưng Street, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This exquisite meal was satisfying on every level, a physically and spiritually nourishing experience in elegant surroundings. As a vegetarian of 50 years, I put this meal in the top five of my life. I cannot speak highly enough, at the risk of sounding hyperbolic. The detail of attention paid to preparation and presentation revealed inventive and inspired layers as the meal progressed. An oasis of nourishing calm and care., One of the best vegan meals I had in my life. the salad 'goi cu hu dua' was amazing and a must have and a tofu and mushroom preparation called Nam kho was great and the garlic rice was amazing. the ambience was French colonial style with light music and and service was amazing. overall best restaurant so far in Vietnam., The food is this vegetarian restaurant is absolutely superb. Imaginative and cooked to perfection. Without doubt the best meal that we ate during two weeks exploring Vietnam. Give the quality of the food and the setting this should be in the Michelin Guide and a top choice for anyone visiting Saigon.
description: Peaceful greetings from Đu Đủ Xanh . Green Papaya! At the House of Đu Đủ, we love to welcome you to a nostalgic space, filled with pocket of natural light and green plants. We hope that this place and its peaceful aesthetics will touch you at all your senses – so that when you taste, look, hear, smell, at our house, you will entirely feel “filled” (Đủ). Our menu offers delightful vegetarian and vegan dishes, from selected natural ingredients, definitely no MSG and cooked by a team of passionate chefs. The menu is inspired by the diverse culinary base from Vietnam and other wonderful regional places. For we believe, that going vegetarian is a way to feel the peace, mindfulness and calm from inside - to be here and now - and to be “filled” (Đủ). Grow the Green inside You

name: Sông - Seafood & Grill
address: Số 39, Đường 38 Khu Phố 1, Phường Bình An, Quận 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Full selection of seafood at Song. Seafood so fresh and delicious. Hot pot and crab rice super yummy. Highly recommend, with nice view by river, big restaurant with a lot of private room. Big king crab and big lobster. Highly recommend for come and try seafood and vietnamese food at Song., Very nice venue with amazing view, ghe food was delicious and the prices were reasonable. The only problem was that there is no menu in English, only Vitnamese, but the staff is very helpfull and kind. You should try this., I came here last week for valentine day. The staffs are so firendly. The view is amazing. Beautiful aucostic music. The food is great. I will come back!
description: Located in District 2, Sông - Seafood & Grill is the ideal place for a great escape from the hustle and bustle of city life. With the windswept ambiance, the stunning view of Saigon by night and numerous alluring dishes, Sông captures the hearts of local and overseas gastronomes. In addition to serving more than 50 kinds of freshest seafood, the restaurant offers other distinctive menu including a myriad of Vietnamese specialties. A world-class wine list at the open bar ensure dishes have the perfect accompaniment.

name: Lac Thai Restaurant
address: 71/2 Mac Thi buoi St., District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: The food is good but but portions are poor. So at the end for what you eat it is expensive. I used to go there often cause I live nearby. The place is very cute but I said, quality but… probably you will help me find a better thai nearby ))), Located in a small street Good location to spend a good time (family & business) Restaurant with a nice simple decoration Service suitable Frequentation, local & International customers I recommend this restaurant to try Thai food, For those who are unaware of Lac Thai it can be difficult to find. The restaurant is not on the street but rather is located down an alley. The restaurant is attractive with several dining areas. We ordered four dishes all of which were attractively presented and tasty. Service was friendly but empty dishes were not promptly removed from our table. Prices are relatively high. I was not impressed with the toilet facilities.
description: The food is good but but portions are poor. So at the end for what you eat it is expensive. I used to go there often cause I live nearby. The place is very cute but I said, quality but… probably you will help me find a better thai nearby )))

name: The First Steakhouse
address: 69A Cao Thang, Ward 3 District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We enjoyed every part of the experience. The kitchen on the ground floor is open to viewing so you can see the chefs working hard at their crafts. The menu was presented swiftly with beverages and food served promptly. Truly delicious, mouth-watering juicy steak!!! Cooked to perfection, very tender and served beautifully. The staffs were excellent, very attentive and friendly. It was the perfect combination between "Great ingredients", "Great cooking" and "Great Service". We will definitely be back., As someone else wrote, this really is a hidden gem. We have been in Vietnam for 3 months now and have struggled to find restaurants with the ‘wow factor’, I am so glad we came here, left feeling happy and very satisfied. It is more expensive than a bowl of pho on the street, but it’s worth every penny. The quality of the meat is definitely up there with Gaucho and Hawksmoor. The restaurant itself is also very nice, very sleek place, that just screams of good taste. I recommend you try the lamb, OMG it was unreal., Inside an alley on CMT8, very close to the central. Their steak is delicious, ceasar salad is tasty too.
description: The First Steakhouse is the creation of Chef Danny Duy, a young phenomenon in the Vietnamese culinary scene. Chef Danny Duy has been working in the food business for 15 years, with experience of 7 years working in Singapore at Raffles Inn, Pregro Italian Restaurant, Grill-out Steakhouse, Fullerton… His passion to bring authentic European cuisine to the Vietnam inspired him to start The First. With a breadth of knowledge in both Eastern and Western cuisines, he understands and uses an extensive plethora of ingredients, formulating unique flavor combinations across all of the dishes. Therefore, at The First you get the best of both worlds: the bold flavor palette of the East, and the respect of good ingredients of the West. The First brings you fine dining without a fuss, in a casual yet sophisticated dining atmosphere in the heart of downtown Saigon.

name: 1914 Bar
address: 2nd Floor, 196 Lê Thánh Tôn, Phường Bến Thành, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Where do I start? First of all it’s hard to find, but do yourself a favour and look for it. The outdoor balcony overlooks Ben Thanh market. The staff are just the most beautiful people I’ve ever met in a bar. Fluent English. They are very proud of 1914 and the cocktails they serve. The cocktails maybe on the pricey side but let me tell you they are 100% worth it. The cocktail are a representation of Vietnamese food in the form of a drink. For example I had one that was flavour to resemble the Vietnamese pound cake, also one that was like beef noodle??? Sounds weird but they were amazing., Really good location only a few steps across from the Ben Thanh market. Great atmosphere and the balcony was nice for the view and sharing drinks. The management was helpful with suggestions on drinks and also offered some history about the culture of all the drinks they serve. They are adding more decor and music was good as well. I will be sure to make it a stop on another visit., Helpful & friendly staff, usual & delicious drinks, and a view of Ben Thanh market. Perfect spot and such a hidden gem!!!
description: 1914 Bar – a symbol of Saigon’s culture, embodies the openness, harmony, and hospitality of the land of Saigon. It brings together the cultural essence of Vietnam in a modern, vibrant Saigon setting.

name: Vegan Pho Nhu Restaurant
address: 54 Truong Quyen Ward 6, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Delicious food, clean and good service. Diverse menu of delicious healthy drinks highly recommen. I will return when I come to Vietnam in the future, Such a sweet spot. The owners are such kind souls and the food is a-ma-zing! Proper authentic Vietnamese dishes served vegetarian., I travelled to Vietnam 9 years ago and fell in love with the pho dish, I think I had one every day for a month. Now I have returned as a vegetarian & straight away on the trip began searching for vege/vegan pho’s. I did not believe such a thing could exist as the broth especially is prepared and cooked for a huge amount of time using bones from the meat. I tried many different dishes vege restaurants offered, most called vegetarian noodle soup. They were nice but didn’t resemble the pho enough for me to be satisfied such a thing existed until I read the reviews and saw the name of this restaurant. Excitedly visiting this place I was not let down at all! Me and my girlfriend ordered two pho’s which they called pho and not just soup and received two bowls of pho, as a substitute for meat you have some sort of soy bean mix and mushrooms but the broth includes spring onions and all the condiments of pho & the noddles are the same style. The broth is NEXT LEVEL, the whole dish tastes just like an amazing pho and the soy stuff feels a bit like meat but regardless just one of the best tasting pho’s I’ve ever had and no meat! Incredible, had restored my faith that this dish can be made well without meat. If you like pho then come here if you are a vegetarian or not. Atmosphere real great, lots of locals, real local gig with plastic chairs and metal tables, old lady who had set it up 35 years ago Apparantly was lovely and whole meal super cheap 75,000 for two pho’s and some lovely wontons. I want to come back and try more as many more dishes served here.
description: Delicious food, clean and good service. Diverse menu of delicious healthy drinks highly recommen. I will return when I come to Vietnam in the future

name: Sushi Hokkaido Sachi - Thảo Điền
address: 109 Võ Nguyên Giáp, Thảo Điền, Quận 2, Ho Chi Minh City 100000 Vietnam
reviews: Hokkaido Sachj is a delightful Japanese restaurant that offers an authentic dining experience with a modern twist. The menu features a wide variety of options, from fresh sushi and sashimi to hearty ramen and perfectly grilled teppanyaki dishes. The quality of the ingredients is evident in every bite, with an emphasis on freshness and traditional flavors. The ambiance is both elegant and welcoming, making it suitable for casual dinners, business meetings, or special occasions. The attentive and knowledgeable staff add to the overall experience, ensuring every guest feels valued. While slightly on the pricier side, the exceptional quality and presentation make it well worth the visit for lovers of Japanese cuisine., I always eat at Hokkaido Sachi with my family and friends so I'm a relugar at this place since 2019. The sashimi and eggs are good to eat (I ordered a lot of eggs) Hitsumabushi (Rice with a large portion of eel) is what I recommend. Plus, It's also near at the metro station (An Phu platform) so it's pretty convenient., Had lunch with family during the weekday Veey delicious lunch sets. We love the eel sets. Friendly staffs! We will come back :)
