name: Mangetsu Shochu Bar
address: 15/3 Le Thanh Ton Ben Nghe, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Be sure to book in advance as they run three full seatings per night. Fantastic atmosphere in this little piece of Japan. True to the “theme” it’s located in basement with the grill right outside the entrance. Great variety of generally very reasonably priced dishes. Great staff and smoking section at the small bar., an izakaya type of restaurant. located in the heart of expat's zone in ho chi minh city. crowded, studded and noisy, as a restaurant of this type should be. food is good, nothing stand out completely but the service is. they were always so nice and warm welcoming. give the service a high five!, Amazing Japanese experience..... The owner was so friendly with all the guests... The place is underground and more cosy from the others restaurants... Well done..Peter from Greece.
description: Be sure to book in advance as they run three full seatings per night. Fantastic atmosphere in this little piece of Japan. True to the “theme” it’s located in basement with the grill right outside the entrance. Great variety of generally very reasonably priced dishes. Great staff and smoking section at the small bar.

name: Don Chicken
address: 25 Ho Tung Mau Street, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Decided to skid Japanese foods this round in HCMC and tried Korean Fried Chicken. Initially I wanted to try out bb q Chicken Premium but it was closed. Don Chicken was just a few metres along the same stretch, so I decided to give it a try. Upon entering the restaurant I was greeted with a Korean welcome .. staff were young and friendly. Looking through the menu, I realized beside the fried chicken they have other versions like garlic, baked chickens as well. I ordered a Combo 2 set, comprising a 3 pieces of fried chicken, 3 pieces of garlic chicken, fruits salad and a small portion of coleslaw. Three type of sauces accompanied the chicken. The fried chicken and the garlic chicken was great. Would recommend anyone to try it when in HCMC., This is a review of Don Chicken in the Crescent Mall. We were the only people there for dinner but the service was exceedingly slow. I ordered boneless chicken. It was boneless but it was greasy. I did not finish it. Another surprise was that this restaurant does not accept credit cards., I was there for my dinner and I was happy with the service at Don. The staff was really welcoming and detailed-orientated. The dishes were nice. I had Don before but was not impressed, this time I was.

name: Banh Cuon Tay Ho
address: 127 Dinh Tien Hoang, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We were recommended to get here and try the wet spring rolls in Saigon. This place was small but clean. The taste of the spring rolls was good combined with the sweet fish sauce. Everything was ok but the price was quite more expensive than the regular one., Good Food, quick service and the lady that served us (the owner?) was very nice and informative. Beer was cheap and cold., The time I went, the dish I ordered was not available. I had to change the dish, but orders are taking a long time to arrive. I had to call them back several times.
description: We were recommended to get here and try the wet spring rolls in Saigon. This place was small but clean. The taste of the spring rolls was good combined with the sweet fish sauce. Everything was ok but the price was quite more expensive than the regular one.

name: Hoang Yen Buffet Premier
address: 65 Lê Lợi Tầng 05, Saigon Centre, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 720000 Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant is clean with a nice assortment of Asian dishes. My favorite was the Malaysian snapper which was a little spicy. They are many seafood dishes as well as land based selections. I was sorry that several dishes combined pork which I don’t eat. There is a selection of fruits and pastries to wind up the meal. Price was reasonable for the location. Staff was not sufficient to promptly remove used plates from the table, Foods are ok but there are not many kinds of seafood we can choose. I booked by website, then dis 10% for us . Service was ok, friendly staff and clean store., Its Vietnamese foods: the foods are OK but the prices are very high compare with the same quality with other restaurants, its too expesives and unremarkable.

address: 99 Đ. Nguyễn Huệ Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Ngan was our server and she was incredible! This place has a great view of the coffee apartments and I highly recommend!, Great! I really like our steak and squid jerky too. They were decor their space with red latern. Finally the unbelieveble price. The receptionist told me here is the cheapest restaurant on Nguyen Hue walking street., Really nice spot for a drink or some food. Good view of the cafe apartments and street. Rooftop vibes and nice and relaxing. Good price and nice staff.

name: Chill Thái 41 Hồng Hà
address: 41 Hồng Hà, Phường 2, Tân Bình, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Really regret choosing this restaurant. You will have to climb to the 3rd floor. The space is a bit stuffy, the food is below average quality and the price is not cheap (bill 5.5 million for 10 people). When booking, the restaurant said there was a 15% discount on the total bill, but when paying, it only reduced 30% of the lowest item (100k off). The restaurant hooks you with a 20% off coupon for your next visit (sorry there won't be another one) The money spent is not worth the quality and the reviews on tiktok are hired for PR, If you are foreign and only speak English, flee On an order placed using the menu consulted on the mobile 2 errors out of 4 items an orange juice instead of a lemon juice but more serious a steamed fish with a very spicy sauce instead of a lemon sauce therefore refusal to consume it, attempt to bill it anyway but we were successful and I will pass on the two unsatisfied requests to obtain a glass to drink my beer Oh yes I was able to eat my green curry which was very good. So very very low results for this evening, If you are not Asian you will not be treated like others. Very haughty waiters. Meat dishes are not available. Honestly, the taste isn't there. Worst meal in Vietnam and the most expensive too!

name: A.dau Kitchen
address: 70 Hàm Nghi Str. Room No.8, 2nd Floor, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This is truly a hidden gem across the restaurants in Saigon that I've tried. Located inside an old apartment building, which is quite a bold move from the owner, I might add, this place offers mixed cusine, kinda like Vietnamese food but with a twist of Western touch and I must say I am deeply impressed with the creativity and the taste. Totally worth the price and an applaud, Its a cozy restaurant with friendly staffs. I went there on my birthday and they was surprised me with cake and drinks. The stories of each items and the place that they told me was so meaningful and impressive. Food was delicious. Event thought its a bit hard to find the way to the hidden restaurants but after all you will stunning with what you got over there, I stopped by Adau for lunch, the char siu noodles were extremely delicious, everyone, I sat and watched the chefs prepare and then had lunch, in general it was chill, there was music! 100 score. Must visit Adau!
description: A Vietnamese fusion restaurant where a minimalist black and white interior, adorned with imperfect objects, sets the scene for a tale of love's fragility.

name: Ngoc Suong Sai Gon (Suong Nguyet Anh)
address: 106 Suong Nguyet Anh Ben Thanh, Dist 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Had dinner there, great ambiance and great service. The food is traditional with a modern touch and really excellent. It‘s not cheap, you have to expect to pay USD 20 per person for a nice meal, but it‘s worth it., Ngoc Suong's lobster bisque was outstanding! The creamy texture was spot-on, and the rich flavor of the lobster really came through in every spoonful. If you’re a seafood lover, this dish is a must-try, you won't be disappointed., OMG, the food here is incredible, we had the Singapore crab which was the best we have ever eaten. MUST eat here. Staff are awesome, everything just made for a brilliant night out
description: Had dinner there, great ambiance and great service. The food is traditional with a modern touch and really excellent. It‘s not cheap, you have to expect to pay USD 20 per person for a nice meal, but it‘s worth it.

name: Bollywood Indian Cuisine
address: SA 26-2 sky garden 2, floor 2, Phu My Hung, Dist.7 Pham Van Nghi Street, Ho Chi Minh City 401001 Vietnam
reviews: As we were new to the area, I had been exploring the various different Indian restaurants in District 7 and finally came across Bollywood Indian restaurant. As I could see the sign outside but not a way to access it, I called the restaurant and the manager kindly offered to meet me outside as he said it was not easy to find. He met me and was very kind and welcoming. To go to the restaurant we had to walk quite a way through a compound's hot basement with quite a few moto bikes whizzing by and with the scent of strong fumes. Eventually we reached what looked like a small metal fire escape and climbed the stairs into the compound. My heart sank when i saw all the metal steps as no matter how delicious the restaurant turned out to be, my husband is 81 and has difficulty climbing stairs, preferring either a ground floor or a restaurant that can be accessed via an elevator. I asked the manager if we could enter the main gate of the compound and reach the restaurant that way but he said that normal access was reserved for residents only. This turned out to be a great shame as the food was delicious. The poppadums were none greasy, fried to perfection, the pickles extremely tasty. The chicken biryani was amongst the best ever tasted as well as the vindaloo sauce that I asked for. All of the staff were very pleasant and helpful and checked if I was enjoying their food etc. My only regret is the way to the restaurant so that my husband can join me next time as he doesn't really enjoy eating take aways at home, Excellent Indian food in Thao Dien (HCM Vietnam). Staff super friendly and were happy to adjust the spice levels to suit the group. Menu is not big but the food has big flavours. Recommend if you're in the neighbourhood., My "GoTo" restaurant when staying in District 7. The food is tasty and well priced given the area. I have tried most dishes on the menu with the Vindaloo being my favorite. A great casual option !
description: Bollywood Indian cuisine (taste of India) successfully running its first restaurant in Phu my Hung dist.7 for well over 2 years.With its best quality and the most affordable prices amongst all Indian restaurants in Vietnam, it has got all star ratings and positive reviews from customers and is popular with daily diners and regular home delivery customers.. Bollywood Indian Cuisine is determined to introduce Indian food to the majority of local and people with all nationalities and to remove wrong perception that Indian cuisine is very spicy but the fact is that due to vast diversity that Indian country offers ,there are plenty of food options available in Indian food which is from Milder and sweeter taste to spicy and very spicy dishes. Also at Bollywood customers can choose if they need spicy or non spicy while ordering their dishes and we will take care to prepare it just right for you. Indian food spices are good for health and gives natural cure for lots of stomach problems. And so spice up your life with our wide selection of north and south Indian cuisine to suit each and everyone's taste. Hope you will give us the chance to serve you and enjoy the wide range of Indian food selection from special Indian Basmati rice, Mutton curry, naan bread, samosas, griller and Kebabs and very special Indian Chinese fusion menu.

name: Com que Muoi Kho
address: 27 Tran Quoc Thao Ward 6, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: A great little restaurant we spotted on the way to visit the museum across the road. The staff were great, especially as we spoke no Vietnamese and they no English. They laughed, with us, at our attempts to pronounce the names of the dishes. There were three of us and everything we ordered was very tasty with great presentation. The best restaurant we tried while in HCM., this restaurant 's owned by a famous actor. Food tastes good, inspired by Mien Trung Viet Nam. My family loves eating here However, it's a little bit crowded, Very good dishes with authentic Vietnamese flavours. Nice decor and well-mannered staffs. Brought a sense of family gatherings.
description:

The best restaurant we tried while in HCM.

name: L'Usine Thao Dien
address: 24 Thao Dien District 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Love this place. Good food with the best coffee as well. Avocado toast and vanilla coffee for me. Highly recommend this restaurant., Love them They have decaf coffee and nice omelette breakfast. For pretty cheap price Gifts are available, Very good- the salads are excellent. Very fresh and excellent mixtures. Overall very good and very reasonable value for the money
description:
Love this place. Good food with the best coffee as  well. Avocado toast and vanilla coffee for me.
 Highly recommend this restaurant.

name: King Bbq Buffet
address: 100 Hung Vuong Street Hung Vuong Square, Ward 9, District 5, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: The sauce here is delicious, dedicated service, space has a little small, location is easy to find. If you eat on holiday or Saturday, Sunday, you should book in advance, because the restaurant here is crowded every day. The dish is tasty but not diversified compared to other brands sold with the same product, suitable for conversion, This restaurant is a standard Korean BBQ style. The price is not too expensive but foods are fresh and delicious. Various meat and vegetable. High recommend kimchi hot pot., Stumbled upon this place and we enjoyed the meal. Standard Korean BBQ with side dishes supplied and various meats that were grilled for us. They have different set menus available depending on how hungry you are.

name: Ganh Original
address: 58/4 Pham Ngoc Thach, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Nice ambient, authentic viet food. Delicious. Tried the fish salad goi ca mai and hotpot. Hve tried Ganh few places , always return. Recommended., My friend and I went out for dinner looking for another restaurant. So going to Ganh was done purely by chance! Great location near several massage places and bars. We ordered a large plate with an assortment of fillings such as fresh greens, sprouts and some fish cakes and rice noodles, that came with rice-papers for wrapping. The dish was fresh and delicious; enough for a family but too big for two people. The fishcake noodles were good too, with a generous topping of crunchy fresh greens., Visiting Ganh for the first time cuz so many people recommend this place 🤣🤣 Fantastic food. Nice decoration, calming space. The menu has dishes covering different appetites along with fast service. “nem ran” and “nem chua” are all yummy! Later, we ordered another fish dish but it wasn’t fresh and the dipping sauce was kind of spicy.
description: Craving the enticing flavors of Nha Trang's delectable cuisine? Gánh Restaurant, established since 2009, beckons you to savor a delightful journey through Vietnamese gastronomy. Prepare to tantalize your taste buds with our menu of over 100 signature dishes, each carefully crafted with fresh ingredients and a touch of tradition. Discover the iconic Nem Nướng, indulge in the heartwarming flavors of Bánh Canh Chả Cá, and treat yourself to our Gỏi Sứa Đặc Biệt, Gỏi Cá Mai, and Chả Cá Cuốn Bánh Tráng Mắm Nêm. Don't miss our Bún Gánh Đặc Biệt, the sizzling Cá Bò Da Nướng, and the succulent Mực Sữa Chiên Mắm Nhĩ

name: Tung Garden
address: 253 Nguyen Van Troi Street 1st floor, Eastin Grand Hotel Saigon, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: I would like to extend a special thank you to Ms. Linh, Ms. Lien, and Ms. Van Anh for going above and beyond in ensuring our evening was memorable. Their professionalism, attention to detail, and friendly demeanor greatly enhanced our dining experience. They made us feel welcomed and well taken care of throughout the entire evening. The culinary delights served at Tung Garden were exquisite, and the ambiance was delightful. It's evident that your team takes great pride in providing top-notch service and creating a welcoming atmosphere for guests. Thank you for making our dining experience at Eastin Grand Hotel Saigon a memorable one., Good location and good food. Chinese restaurant in town. Highly recommended Suitable with group, family and couple. Ok!, Been here for dimsum lunch buffet .The dimsum here is much better than i expected. Its one of my prefer place for dimsum now. Would come back here again and recommend ppl.
description: Embellished with contemporary Oriental elegance in upscale comfort, Tung Garden – located on the 1st floor of Eastin Grand Hotel Saigon, invites you to indulge in a unique and unforgettable fine dining experience. Let your taste buds luxuriate in the delicacies prepared by our talented chef from Hong Kong with more than 30 years’ experience in Hong Kong, Singapore, China and Vietnam! The restaurant features enticing Chinese cuisine and Dim Sum along with a full lunch and dinner menu. Tung Garden selects the best shark fins, abalones, sea cucumbers & present you the Chinese gastronomy like you have never encountered before. No matter what you’re looking for — whether you’re planning to treat business associates, loved ones or friends to a deserving meal, then there’s no need to search elsewhere - our restaurant with more than 130 seats & 4 private rooms is definitely the perfect choice. At Tung Garden, we believe in offering the highest standards of food and service and to become the “go-to” destination for Chinese cuisine lovers in vibrant Ho Chi Minh City!

name: Robata Dining An
address: 15C Le Thanh Ton District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Quite delicious sushi and sashimi. Very good service and very reasonable value for the money considering the quality of the food, sat at bar and had set meals wirh miso, pickles and salad. i had eel and husband had pork with spring onions and a soft egg. all very tasty,, service very efficient., Nice food and really cool ambiente! We had to wait a bit long for the food but it was really nice and worth it. I can recommend 😊
description: At AN, we have the fresh seafood everyday because We get it everyday from the sea. We carefully choose one by one and wait for you to come to enjoy it. We have many private room ideal for friends or co-workers to come and talk cheerfully with each other.

name: Fresh Catch Vietnam - Mediterranean Seafood Restaurant
address: 4B Phan Ke Binh Dakao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Well off the beaten track and no English but the food was great and google helped. Most shellfish clams etc and very fresh, I had a great Christmas dinner here. All of the food i had were super great and yummy especially, octopus was excellent! Staff are very friendly. If i visit HCMC again, i would definitely visit here again :), Very nice mediterranean restaurant in Ho Chi Minh city. Highly recomend ! People are friendly, foods are fresh
description: Set in beautiful old French house, with a relax atmosphere. Fresh Catch is a Mediterranean Seafood Restaurant, offering a range of the freshest seafood served in a classy family style. From Paella, Squid Ink Risotto, Bacalao served in Basque style to a fish Couscous. As well as a choice of platters: grilled , steamed, iced mixing shellfish. Combining an extensif wine list and craft cocktails

name: The Royal Pavilion
address: 57-69F Dong Khoi The Reverie Saigon, Level 4, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The best chinese fine dining in Vietnam. It deserves a michelin star! I had 2 visits in a week. Recommend xiao long bao, charsiew, bbq pork bun and all other chef recommended items.
description:
The best chinese fine dining in Vietnam. It deserves a michelin star! I had 2 visits in a week.

Recommend xiao long bao, charsiew, bbq pork bun and all other chef recommended items.

name: Bogo BBQ
address: 188 Đ. Nguyễn Văn Linh, Tân Thuận Tây, Quận 7, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Loved the outdoor setting at Bogo BBQ. It created a perfect ambiance for a fun evening with friends. The food was delicious, and the all-you-can-eat option is a great deal. Will definitely come back!, I had dinner at Bogo BBQ and was thoroughly impressed. The food was not only delicious but also beautifully presented. The view from the restaurant was stunning, especially as the sun set, adding a magical touch to the evening. The atmosphere was romantic and cozy, making it a perfect spot for a memorable dinner. Highly recommend for anyone looking for great food and an unforgettable dining experience., It's true that the buffet restaurant is great. I go to eat with my family. It exceeded my expectations. I really like this restaurant. Good price. The food was delicious. I will come back many times
description: Welcome to BogoBBQ, the ultimate Korean-style meat buffet in Vietnam. Enjoy a delightful dining experience with a wide selection of premium meats, fresh vegetables, and delicious side dishes. Perfect for birthdays, weddings, corporate gatherings, and more, BogoBBQ offers a charming outdoor atmosphere with excellent stage and sound facilities for live events. Located in Binh Thanh, a vibrant area popular with college students, our restaurant promises unforgettable moments and mouthwatering flavors. Join us for a unique blend of Korean cuisine and Vietnamese hospitality!

name: Sagar Indian Cuisine
address: 101 Quoc Huong Thao Dien, District 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: So whatever i say about this place is going to be less. The owners are amazing people with so much humbleness. The food is amazing. I ate momos after almost 2 years and was delighted by the taste. The prices are cheap, I believe, because the quantity is so much. The owners were always nice to me and helped me whatever they could. They would always take care of my preferences as I'm a vegetarian. The ambiance of the restaurant is good. It is in a good place. Overall, I loved eating there and will visit them always, good indian food in thao dien ho chi minh city we been to this place so many times all time very good testy food we will back soon, The Staff is very nice. All the food is of very good quality. Better priced than other Indian restaurants in Saigon. Been back several times.
description: Located in Thao Dien, District 2, HCMC, The Grace of Sagar Indian Cuisine is the perfect spot to visit when you need to curb your Indian cravings. Get excited to experience their Indian menu featuring chicken tikka masala and creamy butter chicken. It’s an experience that will keep you coming back! Best dish: butter chicken

name: Din Ky Restaurant
address: 137C Nguyen Trai Street, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: After being ripped off by a neighbouring restaurant in decided to give this one a try. Dim SIM was delivered prompty and they were delicious. Service was polite and efficient. Strongly recommend, This restaurant is opened until 4am, very convenient for person who love party all night. The menu has a lot of good food and the price is reasonable., I really enjoyed the baked pasta and the clam soup , along with fried rice with chicken . Though I would recommend to sit on the second floor since it eally lound on first floor .
description: More than 25 years serving the gourmet of Sai Gon, Din Ky Nguyen Trai (DKNT) - a member of Din Ky Group - has become a familiar destination referring to Saigon Cuisine (Saigon is former name of Ho Chi Minh City) With 24/7 continuous operation service, at any time of the day, DKNT’s customers can freely choose from over 400 TASTY & HEALTHY dishes are cooked elaborately and harmoniously combined style of European-Asian-Vietnamese-Chinese cuisine When persons are talking about DKNT, as mentioned above, gourmet immediately think of fish fillet, hand-pulled noodle or Hong Kong Dimsum in the morning, Vietnamese cuisine at noon and superb delicacies which are made from fresh seafood at night. Operating under the model of the restaurant, but DKNT always imbues with intimacy and its own cozy. When you come here, it is not difficult to meet diners customers of all ages. They can be the old mans, the silver-haired old ladies or the baby babbling. They gather, talk and share food and drink at DKNT as at their own small house. Let's visit Din Ky Nguyen Trai once, you will feel its beauty, its unique and the food of this place where no place can have it. Din Ky Nguyen Trai

name: Sanité
address: 46 Trương Quốc Dung, Phường 10, Quận Phú Nhuận, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: We were a large group of 16 and had very diverse requirements and preferences. Yet, the restaurant stood all tests and no body missed the non vegetarian food they would have liked to order. Our compliments to the chef and the management of Sanite for the great experience, delicious food and patient service staff. Keep up the good work!, “I have eaten at many vegetarian restaurants in Ho Chi Minh City and the dishes I ordered here really surprised me.” Sanite Restaurant is more than just a restaurant; it’s a destination for anyone seeking a high-quality, memorable vegetarian dining experience. I left feeling satisfied, refreshed, and eager to return. Highly recommended!, we found this restaurant by accident, while looking for a vegetarian restaurant, it turned out that there was Sanite next to our hotel. We were so delighted with their cuisine that for the next 5 days we ate there for dinner every day. The food is delicious, the restaurant is lovely with a beautiful smell, the service is charming! We recommend it and we will definitely come back
description: Vegetarian Restaurant

name: The Living Room Wine Bar
address: 57 Le Anh Xuan, Phuong Ben Thanh, Quan 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Service is perfect a huge choice of wines, whiskey, cognac and cocktails Perfect taste on a nice location. The owner is is a real specialist in wines and can you explain a lot. Let him advice you Tapas served by the choice wine you choose, The Living Room is an oasis from the hustle and bustle of Saigon. The atmosphere is laid back and so relaxing. The service is excellent and the staff are friendly and really know their wines and spirits. I highly recommend the cheese platter as an excellent accompaniment to the drinks as well. I love this place. For a great place to kick back, chat and have a drink, The Living Room is where it's at., I went here with my family and this place is a hidden gem ! the staff were really friendly and helpful always there to lend a hand with any enquiries you had . The food was on another level of stunning and delicious and made me want to order more ! On top of that the wine was amazing and very crisp with lots of choices to choose from. Overall an amazing experience !!
description: The Flagship wine bar combines a retail wine shop with the charm of a cozy modern living room. We offer over 40 types of wine by the glass, alongside a carefully curated food menu to ensure every customer enjoys a relaxed and delightful experience. Cheers!

name: Luu Bar
address: 108 Pham Viet Chanh Binh Thanh, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Luu Bar Saigon is nothing short of a hidden gem, delivering an extraordinary experience that seamlessly combines exceptional cocktails with a laid-back atmosphere. The bar's ambiance is captivating, offering a relaxed and welcoming vibe that immediately puts patrons at ease. Whether you're there for a casual catch-up with friends or a more intimate evening, Luu Bar Saigon strikes the perfect balance. The interior design exudes style, with a thoughtful layout that allows for both mingling and cozy corners for those seeking a more private setting. The true star of the show, however, is the impressive cocktail menu. The mixologists at Luu Bar Saigon are clearly masters of their craft, as each concoction is a work of art that tantalizes the taste buds. The attention to detail in both presentation and flavor is commendable, and the diverse selection ensures there's something to please every palate. From classic favorites to innovative creations, the cocktails at Luu Bar Saigon are a testament to the skill and creativity of the bartending team., Visited the area on a whim and walked into this gem of an establishment. It is sexy energy through and through. Dimlit, comfy sofas and intimate seating arrangements, a hecking fairy lights encrusted hammock of your dreams ffs this place is total class. Music is insanely danceable to, and our waiter, nart, was a huge ball of energy and made the experience ten times over amazing. Would highly recommend for a great time. Dj started at 10 for us and the dance floor is looking like an increasingly lit time as i type. 10s across the board., Friendly staffs, makes me feel like the neighborhood. Especially, you can order any kind of customize drink, they certainly not gonna disappoint you. Might comeback in another day
description: Luu Bar is a laid-back yet electrifying hideaway in Saigon, a sanctuary for music enthusiasts and curious souls alike. Its unpretentious ambiance transforms from a chill-out bar into a vibrant mini nightclub during the weekends, pulsating with house, techno, and underground beats spun by local and international DJs. Located just a bridge away from the bustling District 1, Luu Bar offers a concoction of top-notch cocktails, mixology drinks, and an intoxicating blend of good vibes, extraordinary music, and a genuine local experience.

name: Chill Dining - Grill & Seafood Oyster Bar
address: 76A Le Lai Street 27th Floor, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Chill dining restaurant on the 27th floor has an excellent view of district 1. The service is very professional and accommodating. It was like we had our own private waitress. Whether this was because for most of our meal my wife and I were the only patrons I don’t know. Food was excellent and served in the proper order and with proper timing We enjoyed French seafood soup, Miyagi oysters, Canadian lobster and fried rice with seafood. Each dish was top quality and extremely tasty. The cost for dinner was very high, for Vietnam, but it would have been much more costly in the United States. If your budget allows it I highly recommend this restaurant., I got greatest steak ever with vietnamese herb & garnis. Local vegests so fresh, also for flavor of sauces. Beautiful afternoon view from 27th floors. Must try when you guys have a change to Ho Chi Minh city! Its cost you right., Hieu is very cute and nice serving us for the night carefully. Food is good, service is excelent! Highly recommend Great view of the city , good food, and excellent service. We have a decent dinner in the cozy and classy asmosphere.
description: Chill Dining - the ultimate destination for foodies who love the perfect combination of grilled meats and seafood.

name: Le Chateau de Saigon Restaurant
address: 45a Le Quy Don Street, District 3, Ward 7, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Our tour group came here for a nice casual multi-course meal after a busy day of touring. Friendly service., We were brought here for lunch by our private tour guide that day. A lot of the tour operators bring people here for lunch. Lunch was a set, price-fixed menu, but every dish was tasty, and beautifully presented. This place is a nice way to experience the leftover French colonial influence (though the food is Asian)., Great pris fix lunch - we’ll curated variety of tastes and combinations of small dishes that wind up as one big meal. Lovely spot with garden seating - lovely presentation with food sculptures
description: Situated in a small but romantic French villa, Le Chateau De Saigon Restaurant is designed to accommodate any kind of event. Whether it is dinner with family and friends, or a passionate evening with your loved one, Le Chateau De Saigon will provide a sophisticated and memorable dining experience for our guests.

name: Sushi Nhi Restaurant
address: 21 Nguyen Cong Tru Street, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Nice little sushi place with friendly staff. Very populair and busy and definitely not expensive. The sushi was quite good, fresh and tasty, but not the best I've had in Vietnam (which would be Shino Sushi in Hue). Still we had a lovely meal and we enjoyed it. Recommended!, If you’re craving sushi, this is the place to go. It may be a bit out of the way, but the food, the ambiance and the area are definitely worth it. The sushi was really good, freshly made, and just kept arriving as it was ready. We had mostly rolls and some nigiri, all fresh, all delicious. The place was packed (not tourists!) and we waited for a table, but it was definitely worth the wait, and a really good deal too!, Good food and good budget Recommend to order avocado salad and pancake at least It would be better if you book the table before come here For drink, the lemon grass tea is prefered Just US$22 is enought for a couple in a romantic dinner
description:
Nice little sushi place with friendly staff. Very populair and busy and definitely not expensive. 
The sushi was quite good, fresh and tasty, but not the best I've had in Vietnam (which would be Shino Sushi in Hue). 
Still we had a lovely meal and we enjoyed it. Recommended!

name: Tokyo Deli
address: 240 Le Thanh Ton Street District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: I went there 3 days in a row because it was close to where I was staying. The fried chicken, salmon set meal, and chawanmushi salad were all delicious. The rice here was especially delicious! The conversation was only in English, but the waitresses left a good impression. The only person there was a woman in a shirt and skirt, who must have been the manager, and when I ordered takeout, she didn't understand the English for "take out" and even though I changed the wording several times to "to go," she didn't understand. There were other customers at the table, but in the end she started yelling at me as if I was saying something strange, which was scary. By the way, I'm Japanese living in America (lol) I haven't been there since because I had such a bad experience., Average japanese food. Food takes way too long. Staff is trying but wait time is a considerable drawback eventhough it was not crowded when we dined. Used to be one of the better japanese options in the past but quality is going down by the year., If you are a fan of sashimi, Tokyo Deli is not a bad choice. When the first time I came here, I was surprised of the decoration just like in Japan. They decorate with yellow lights that look quite cozy. The seats are divided into two sides, one side is the high chair and the other is the cushion seat. They have diverse menu, I ordered one of the high lights of the restaurant is salad salmon. I felt a little bit scared because I don't know is it fresh or not...... But... I was impressed. It is really delicious. I can not recommened it enough!!!

name: Heli Vegetarian Bistro
address: Hoa Cúc, phường 7, quận Phú Nhuận 92 - 94, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Delicious vegetarian dishes beautifully presented. Especially the brown rice wrapped in lotus leaves, the rolls of all kinds have their own dipping sauce for each type so you don't get bored eating them.. Walking past the kitchen, I saw it was clean and the staff were friendly. Will recommend to friends and relatives to visit. An ideal Vegetarian restaurant for healthy, healthy meetings and gatherings 👍 This restaurant having delicious vegan food, good taste, good services and friendly staff, is a good place to meet friends and family. A must-try vegetarian restaurant in Saigon!, The vegetarian restaurant in the center of Phu Nhuan's bustling dining area has an ideal dating space for chilling and is well worth experiencing! Quesadilla with Tomyum Soup is extremely delicious and also unique in flavor when using only vegetables and fruits 😍 Give the kitchen here 10 points. The atmosphere here also makes me excited in every little corner. Cute and cheerful staff. I will definitely bring my family here to try again 🫶, The cuisine is delicious here. The staff is incredibly friendly. There were several items that astonished me since they were so tasty; Vietnamese cuisine is very fantastic.

name: Cafe Anh
address: Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: came here and it was vibe burger all over again 😂😂,come check this place out, ended getting another burger, but the classic the time, We had a little trouble finding this small place as they have changed name to VIBE BURGER. Managed to notice the place with the photos sent in by previous explorers (yes, the small alley with fairy lightings on the ceiling). It is located on the 2nd floor (known as 1st floor in HCMC), overseeing Ben Thanh market. Food portion is relatively big for us (small eaters), and we ended up ordering a lot! The 3 staff were the best, speaking good simple English and extremely spontaneous to our request to film us doing a mannequin challenge. Overall quiet and cosy. Thank you for the nice food and great videography skills!, I got The Blue medium rare and it was cooked perfectly. Very sweet and juicey. The onion rings were huge and crispy and were great with the dipping sauce provided. My boyfriend got the pulled pork burger and also enjoyed it. The portions are quite large so come with an empty belly!
description: came here and it was vibe burger all over again 😂😂,come check this place out, ended getting another burger, but the classic the time

name: Cherry Restaurant - Vietnamese Cuisine
address: 11b Đường Thái Văn Lung, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I asked for banh seo and fresh spring rolls. Perhaps because they thought I was a beginner, the clerk explained how to eat banh seo. The vegetables were fresh and delicious. It was about 400K, but the amount was just enough to split between the two of us. The air-conditioning was good and it was quiet and cozy., We ordered a hot pot. Taste very good and they give us more than we thought! We are so full after eating 😁 The service is nice too. They kindly answered all the questions., looking for vietnamese cuisine, than surely this is one place to be. serves lovely vietname fod for a relatively moderate pricing in a clean and great ambinence. great customer service too
description: Located in the Sunflower Hotel, downtown, Cherry Restaurant is proud to bring Vietnamese cuisine to you

name: Moira Eatery
address: 204b/14 Nguyễn Văn Hưởng Thảo Điền, Quận 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The food is very delicious for the price, and the drinks are suitable for your taste. Romantic space suitable for dates and meeting friends. Location is deep in Thao Dien with open Rooftop view. It's worth a try and support. Added to the list of familiar shops, From its stylish interior to its superbly curated menu, Moira Bar & Eatery exemplifies the charm of Saigon. The food is a vibrant fusion of traditional Vietnamese flavors and modern cooking techniques, each dish bursting with unique tastes. Coupled with their impressive cocktail list, dining here is a true sensory delight. Highly recommended for anyone looking to experience the local culinary scene!, I had an incredible experience at Moira Bar and Eatery! Last Friday evening, I visited with my best friend, and we were delighted by the scrumptious food and drinks. The staff here provided impeccable service, going above and beyond to ensure our comfort and enjoyment. The ambiance is absolutely stunning, creating a relaxing and stress-free atmosphere. While I often frequent bars and rooftop spots in Ho Chi Minh City, this place stands out, and I'm already planning to bring my friends back here many more times. It's a must-visit destination for anyone looking to chill and unwind.
description: Moira Eatery is an evening dining destination situated on the upper floors of Thao Dien villa area. It offers a private, romantic, and elegant atmosphere along with high-quality dishes and a diverse menu.

reviews: SPACE: quite impressive, too many animals are displayed inside, Japanese comics are spread everywhere, like a bookstore. STAFF: following me is not fun, a little uncomfortable. name: Sushi Nishitsugu
address: Tầng 4 - 108 Pasteur, Phường Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 72914 Vietnam
reviews: Things I love about this restaurant 1. Having a secret door using a password is a very interesting experience 2. The restaurant space is quiet 3. Enthusiastic service 4. The chef is Japanese, very dedicated, friendly, and very sociable (although he doesn't speak much Vietnamese). 5. I highly recommend the dishes here (my set was 3 million VND) Especially the minidon dish (with sea urchin and abalone sauce served with salmon eggs) is delicious The most consistent special dish is hand-rolled sushi. I really like ! (It's so delicious that I don't have a photo) 6. For me, my favorite yuzu ice cream is sour2 sweet2 super sticky!, An Omakase place worth experiencing. Satisfied with the food and service attitude. You will not be lonely because the chef will always chat with you. The food is small but will be served throughout the meal so it's great. The taste was very good and I was introduced to it as the chef's exclusive dish., If people are looking for a quiet, luxurious Omakase experience, Sushi Nishitsugu is a place you should not miss. Ingredients at the restaurant are imported directly from Japan every day to ensure the restaurant's freshness. The ingredients here are very high quality and carefully selected by the chef. Not only can you eat delicious food but you can also watch the chefs work live until the dish comes out 😝 My first experience at omakase Sushi Nishitsugu and it's definitely worth the experience!!! 10/10 must try must go 🦞🦞🦞
description: The Sushi Nishitsugu brand is a sushi restaurant established in 2016 in Tokyo, Japan, now present in Vietnam. With the representative chef, Mr. Nishitsugu, who is known as the "wizard of flavors"

name: Saigon SkyBar
address: 200 Le Lai. St, BenThanh. Ward, Dist 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: I recently visited Saigon Sky Bar and had a truly unforgettable experience. The view of the city from the top is absolutely breathtaking - it's easily one of the most beautiful spots in Saigon. The atmosphere was chic and stylish, and the service was impeccable. The cocktails were creative and expertly crafted, with a great variety to choose from. The bar staff was very friendly and attentive, making for a comfortable and enjoyable evening. I highly recommend visiting Saigon Sky Bar - it's a perfect place for a night out or a special occasion, and the views are truly unbeatable. A must-visit spot in Saigon, We got the combo ticket for 250k vnd which allowed us to use skybar and heineken. Great place for cocktails and pictures of the city., This is one of the greatest places to chill and have great drinks and food, it has one of the most beautiful views of Saigon, at food menu you can find international food and also local specialities, also is a bar with a well settled pool table, the drinks have a good price, my favorites were the jars that makes u feel in the party, also all days they have western dj, so this is a great place to start the party everyday in Saigon...

name: Dau Homemade
address: 6 Hong Ha Tan Binh District, Ho Chi Minh City 700 Vietnam
reviews: 99% people comes here are local. Food was authentic and interesting. Staff can not speak English, just follow the crowded., I ordered stuffed snails for an entree, and although they were tasty (but had 2 pieces of shell grit in 5) they appeared on the table within 2 minutes. My main was fermented pork pieces deep fried. I could not tell what I was eating, as it was not flavourful. It did not taste as if it had meat in it at all. The cucumber and mango slices served on the side were dry as they had been exposed to the air for some time. I would not recommend this restaurant even though the prices were fair., I have been here three times since many years ago and the quality of food here never lets me down. I will come back
description: Dau Homemade includes a chain of diners that specialize in "bún đậu mắm tôm" (fermented shrimp paste with deep fried tofu and rice vermicelli) and other Hanoi's specialty. The word "homemade" not only means the freshness of the dishes, but also aims to bring customer the feeling of authenticity as they are enjoying the meals in the atmosphere and culture of Hanoi - the north of Vietnam, right in Ho Chi Minh City. Dau Homemade wishes to guide customer from daily normal dishes in every northern Vietnamese family to fascinating and surprising light meals and street food in Hanoi, in the most original and authentic ways. Together with the dishes, the space and decoration here also makes customers feel like travelling among the narrow and ancient street of Hanoi. Moreover, if you are lucky enough, you will find surprise as you are enjoying acoustic music or special shows while you are treating yourself here! Come to Dau Homemade, and taste the authentic culture right at your dish!

name: Bay Ho Baguette
address: 23 Huynh Khuong Ninh Street, Da Kao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Small grocery store, located near the city center. This place mainly sells bread, which is served with roasted pork. Bread shaped like French bread, inside will be sandwiched with pork, cucumber, chili and spices. The area of ​​the store is very small, so customers who come to buy have to stand in the street to order. The staff will deliver the goods and collect the money at the waiting location. Good quality roast pork, delicious. Bread costs about 20,000vnd, Very good banh mi. Good choices- well made and delicious ingredients. Very inexpensive considering the quality of food, I've heard for this place on Netflix show Street Food. It's close to the Jade Emperors Tample. And it's by far the best Banh Mi I've had in Vietnam. And I had many, many more. Perfect baguete and pate, every ingridient is fresh and wonderful. If you want to try perfection go there

name: Qua Ngon Restaurant
address: 308 306, Le Van Sy Street Ward 1, District Tan Binh, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Very comfortable restaurant, well decorated in a vegetated way, and arranged in small pleasant rooms with exotic furniture. The service is not very proactive but very reactive: the staff does not see what is missing but everything you ask you have it. On the kitchen side, the menu is incredibly long, which is not a good sign for quality. Indeed, of the 4 dishes ordered, 1 was good, 2 not good and the 4th not eatable. It is unacceptable that these 3 ordered dishes, emblematic dishes of Vietnam like bánh tôm Ho Tây, are as badly cooked to believe as the cook who made it, never ate these dishes. In short, great decor, comfortable room, unprofessional but dedicated service, flat can be good but often bad or even inedible., Good food and fast service. Took a while for the food to be made and assistance in explaining how to eat the more intricate dishes would have been appreciated. Still an interesting experience, just could be improved., We were invited by local host to visit this restaurant. It was located in a high street and indeed the 2nd floor was still a open dining area. I didn't view the manu as our host ordered a series Vinanese food, which were very impressive! I strongly recommend their crispy pork, spring roll, noodle with soup, curry with baguette, and shrimp ball with rice covered. One of their tranditional food with meat, viscera, vegs and a special fish sauce is also an interesting experience. The waitress were very friendly as well. They knew to topup our drinks! I would be very happy to come back although I am not sure about reading manu. lol 當地的朋友招待我們來到這間餐廳，座落在大街上的開放空間，服務生挺友善的，雖然語言不通但是笑容可掬。有幾道菜是相當推薦的，例如烤乳豬、春捲、湯加上麵、咖哩配長棍麵包、以及蝦球! 這幾道亞洲口味應該都蠻喜歡的，另外一道傳統小豬料理，由肉、內臟、蔬菜等加上魚露混合著吃的，印象深刻，口感也蠻特殊的，雖然沒特別喜歡但也挺能接受的，當地朋友說，倘若喜歡上，以後都會上癮! 哈哈。蠻喜歡這家店的食物和服務。
description: Located on a busy street at 306 – 308 Le Van Sy, Ward 1, Tan Binh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Qua Ngon Restaurant is famous for its beautiful scene, elegant decorations, finest cookery with Vietnamese food menu such as seafood, specialties, plentiful folk dishes. With slogan “Fresh food and best products used to make sure the food maintains a high quality, without recycled cooking oil and food coloring”, considerate and honest service, reasonable prices, food and safety hygiene, it attracts local and international guests, especially foreign tourists visiting Ho Chi Minh City.

name: Opus Saigon
address: 12 Phan Ke Binh Street Dakao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Was invited by partner and totally surprised with set up, food and service. Located not too far from the city center in a quite road. After coming, all seting would make you surprise by warm, cozy. Staffs were very attentive., Went along with a friend for a business dinner event and I could not believe there is such an amazing restaurant in the city. All the rooms are private to serve the city's vips. Food is very good and well presented too., The first time came to Opus and had a amazing time here. The service is excellent and food very good. We will be back.
description: Established for those who have a passion for culture and an appreciation for the finer things in life, OPUS offers a private space where discerning individuals meet to connect through food, drink, art and lifestyle. Discover a symphony of flavors at OPUS. Our talented chefs are on hand to cook up the finest of Asian dishes using only best quality ingredients. To deliver a timeless culinary experience, each dish at OPUS is designed to be a work of art in itself and is served individually to our discerning guests. When carefully curated spaces meet with seamless service, a truly unique dining experience is created. OPUS is destined to deliver a unique dining experience.

name: Kingscross
address: 103 Ton Dat Tien District 7, PMH, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We usually visit for late breakfast, since we love their hearty breakfast set with crispy bacons, paired with warm freshly baked bread (favourite: still carrot bread). The kids usually orders their fluffy pancakes with fresh fruits, cream and honey on the side. Decided to drop by for lunch, and discovered they've lunch set menus too! Pleasantly surprised by their beautifully plated dishes, since we thought they were just a very normal Western restaurant. From the frothy creamy soup, to grilled octopus appetizer, to fusion ribs paired with freshly grilled sweet potato chunks, they all looked and tasted pretty good. Though a little on the pricier side, but the well-executed dishes by the chef, good service from the English-speaking manager and relaxing atmosphere by the Crescent lake more than makes up for it., From the friendly welcome to the equally friendly wishing goodbye until the next time, the whole visit was good! The layout, the table setting the easy to read menu, taking the order, delivery; all the service was good! I had the Wagyu Beefburger and it was excellent - the chips and salad were very good! The dessert menu was a little disappointing as I am not a fan of chocolate desserts. So I had the ice cream. I will go back !!!, We celebrated our wedding anniversary here with our daughters. Firstly, the service is exceptional. Very friendly and attentive staff. We had soups for starters and they were nice. My steak and scallop main was beautiful. We were surprised with a desert with"Happy Anniversary" written in chocolate. The choices are varied and we look forward to visiting again to try something else. The Beauty and the Beast cocktail was amazing and added a bit of theater to the night. Order it and you will see.
description:
We usually visit for late breakfast, since we love their hearty breakfast set with crispy bacons, paired with warm freshly baked bread (favourite: still carrot bread). The kids usually orders their fluffy pancakes with fresh fruits, cream and honey on the side.

Decided to drop by for lunch, and discovered they've lunch set menus too! Pleasantly surprised by their beautifully plated dishes, since we thought they were just a very normal Western restaurant. From the frothy creamy soup, to grilled octopus appetizer, to fusion ribs paired with freshly grilled sweet potato chunks, they all looked and tasted pretty good. Though a little on the pricier side, but the well-executed dishes by the chef, good service from the English-speaking manager and relaxing atmosphere by the Crescent lake more than makes up for it.

name: Lau Ca Keo Ba Huyen
address: 10 Nguyen Thong, Ward 7, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: i ate here after a visit to the next door temple. The food was tasty, hot, served quickly and the portions were generous. I ordered from the menu , provided in english or vietnamese. There was lots of choice , veggies, meats, ricey and soups. One waitress spoke good english and was kind, smiled and willing to change the drinks after a misunderstanding over what I ordered. I went at lunch time.There were lots of spaces and seats. If I had gone in the evening I would have had to queue and wait for a seat because this place is popular because it does a first class hot pot or steamboat or cook your own stuff in a big pot . Prices ? not the cheapest, not luxury rip off., Service is quick, foods are stay the same. Love the deep fried squid and deep fried fish with tamarind sauce. Hot pot is perfect and always have extra fish. Authentic flavour. This place has been here for years., I came here with my friend recommend. And i totally upset with the staff here. Because i made the reservation before i came but nobody know and i had to wait 30p for the table. Food is not good. Staff is not friendly. And i won't come back. Not recommend for everybody

name: Sushi Shinkon
address: 15 Nguyen Thiep Phuong Ben Nghe, Quan 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We had one of the most beautiful omakase experience at Shinkon last week. The quality and selection of fish was phenomenal. The dishes are beautifully, meticulously prepared by chef Linh, who are not only very experienced but also a very good host. We also surprised by the exceptional, high quality Sake and also good list of Japanese wine that are very fascinating & well paired with the food. I am certain that anyone who appreciates quality omakase will be blown away by the experience at Shinkon, This omakase restaurant is located in the heart of Saigon. Dishes are very fresh and yummy. Premium ingredients are used in their different omakase sets. Sushi chefs are very friendly and knowledgable in explaining the dishes. I also love the bright interior design of this place., Tried this one out of curiousity from an instagram advert since all the omakase spots in Saigon are no strange places to me, a year living in Japan has made me a seasoned and hard to please Japanese food eater. Surprisingly excellent. Full Japanese-educated team of very talented chefs. I have had food from chef Linh in District 7 before but needless to say he has improved massively at Shinkon. Location and place: 9/10 - central location with valet parking, unfortunately you can’t park here hence the 9. In the middle of bursting Nguyen Hue street, sophisticated interior design. Would have appreciated some more width but you can’t ask for much in district 1 to be darnk. Food: 9/10 - top notch ingredient (trust me on this as I have spent my youth scrouching for fish markets in Tokyo), very risk but well put combination of food - noted my love for the treasure box which is a improvising combination of the chef. Bare in mind tradional sushi eaters should let the chef know otherwise he will get creative (which is more my thing). Food can easily rival with Sushi Rei. My only negative feedback would be the wait some time for the food, but after 3rd visit they have improved. Oh and excellent Sake choices, some very fine Dassai bottles. Staff: 7/10 - all good manners but the staff are quite new and still to be trained (they are still in soft opening I believe) - but nothing majorly bad as in omakase you mainly interact with the chef Price- 7/10 - menus starting from above 2 million to above 4 million have put this restaurant at the very expensive end. With drinks and tax you are looking at 3-4 million Vnd for a fine evening. But with the location and quality and I am happy so far, but would save this for a few special occasions.
description: Sushi Shinkon is a restaurant specializing in Omakase-sfyle Japanese cuisine. Through the motto "Eat with your whole Soul", we hope our customers will feel the essence of each dish - a mixture of passion for work and the Chef's signature uniqueness. In addition to dishes with the finest ingredients in the culinary scene, Shin-kon also serves premium .Japanese wine, whiskey and sake such as Dassai, Hibiki, Chardonnay... Besides, Shin-kon also has a Private Dine room dedicated to serving VIP quests and Organizing a luxurious and cozy party. Contact for more information and reservation Add: 15 Nguyen Thiep, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1 HCM City

name: Saigon Xua va Nay
address: 33 Nguyen Trung Truc Quart 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Unfortunately the photos here do not match the restaurant. At Google you can see authentic pictures. The food is not bad. The staff is happy but determined. The cleanliness of course leaves much to be desired. The mood compensates. The price is very good., Predominantly a seafood restaurant we ate beef with potatoes (chips) and some rice. We are staying at a hotel next door almost and wanted a bite to eat. The boys serving were extra friendly but the older man a bit of a grumpy man. Enjoyed it quite well. If I’m the area would eat here again, I have been to more awesome places in HCM. This place is in central location with some good food. We had the duck tounge with peppercorn, hot pot, steamed prawns and prawn sashimi. Price is expensive but after too much beer, you probably find it acceptable.
description:
Unfortunately the photos here do not match the restaurant. At Google you can see authentic pictures.
The food is not bad. The staff is happy but determined. The cleanliness of course leaves much to be desired. The mood compensates. The price is very good.

name: Restaurant Le Bourgeois
address: Continental Saigon, 132-134 Dong Khoi St, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Happy hour at Le Bourgeois so I enjoyed a drought tiger which is served very cold on a hot day..very refreshing and definitely needed it after a long walk shopping! with only 49,000 VND that is really worth it. The seating outdoor looks beautiful with a garden chair and grass underneath on a busy main road. Looking at a busy road with a cold beer in hand..what else do you need. Will be back before I fly out.. It's a must!, Considering the price of everything on the menu, the food is just ok. We did the set meals and while the appetizer and main course were pretty good, the dessert course was a let down and almost inedible. The mango mousse cake was very hard and seemed old. Service was good, but nothing special even though there were only 3 other tables at the time. For the amount you pay, I would consider going elsewhere. It is mostly for the experience and historical factor., Came for lunch and a cocktail to celebrate Graham Green. Obviously hotel isn’t the best anymore and faded grandure. But standards have slipped. Shown to a table with dirty tablecloth , red stains right through and on bottom one too. Pointed out but not changed. Had to put vase of sort of alive flowers on it. Other tables had wrinkled dirty cloths and not set up despite being a busy day outside. Cleanliness and service are key. Whole place shabby and empty and sad. I was given the wrong order and the waitress made a really angry face at me and stomped off and flared at me the rest of the meal. but my order was seen and confirmed by others and clearly a communication issue on her part despite being pointed out on the menu several times. Staff need a modicum of English or French in a so called high end , certainly expensive, French restaurant such as this. It’s in the heart of Saigon opacité the opera house and should have been buzzing. So I had my onion soup half an hour after everyone else had finished but to be fair it was OK Felt like a ghost
description: Le Bourgeois Restaurant was the most favorite rendezvous of Graham Greene during his stay in Saigon. In the old time, politicians, correspondents and journalists gathered to discuss political issues in "cafe the la hien", a casual name of this restaurant. Nowadays, the former saying "if the walls of the restaurant could talk, they would tell you many secrets" is still the start of all discussion about this restaurant. Le Bourgeois Restaurant today is luxury dining with classic style decoration, that serves western cuisine. The restaurant is located on the ground floor of the hotel, overlooking the Opera House and is conveniently accessible for both in-house and walk-in guests. In the morning, guests can choose either Vietnamese breakfast dishes with variety of noodles or Continental breakfast (bread, butter, jam...). Lunch and dinner is the time for our guests to enjoy Western cuisine along with elegant classic melodies of Piano and Violin.

name: Bagel Brothers - District 2
address: 6 Tống Hữu Định, Thảo Điền, District 2, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: I must say, this place knows how to craft a truly scrumptious bagel! Upon taking my first bite, I couldn't resist devouring it in just 5 minutes - that's how irresistibly delicious it was! The bagel had the perfect combination of flavors, and the texture was spot on, creating a delightful taste experience. From the moment I walked in, the welcoming ambiance and friendly staff made the visit even more enjoyable. The bagel was freshly prepared and served warm, which only enhanced the delectable experience. Whether you're a bagel enthusiast or just looking for a delightful treat, this place is a must-visit! The craving to indulge in another one lingers on even after the last bite. Don't miss the chance to savor their scrumptious bagels; it's a culinary delight that you won't regret! Highly recommended, and I can't wait to return for another delightful bagel experience!, Our family from Australia (travelling with young children) visited Bagel Brothers for lunch. We were very impressed by the high quality and wide selection of delicious bagels and foccacias. Their glazed donuts are the best I've eaten in Vietnam, light and fluffy. Excellent coffee (Melbourne-style lattes) and cold drinks, especially the house brewed non-alcoholic ginger beer. The new shop is cool, clean, light and spacious with a space for the kids that has a gaming console. Excellent customer service. Conveniently located near the main markets and shopping. Definitely recommend for families and those looking for tasty Western food options. Large groups can easily be catered for in the upstairs area which also features a balcony overlooking the playground. Five stars!, If you're looking for fresh breakfast or homemade bagels, this is the place to be! Not to mention their little shop that is full of personality and welcoming staff. My favorite bagel is the BLT or egg bagel with relish sauce :) .
description: Bagel Brothers started when two brothers got hungry... We wanted something quick, easy, delicious and affordable to eat for lunch each day. We came across bagels and start baking fresh each day at our cafe Cheesecake Ngon. From there the menu and demand grew until we realised we needed to start a dedicated bagel shop. We really love good food, if there is any issue with our service or food please let us know.

name: Hải Sản Hoàng Gia Quốc Hương
address: 16 Quốc Hương, Thảo Điền, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I am here with girlfriend windy to enjoy a wonderful seafood lunch. Everything was delicious and good. Beautiful day. Thank you, We came here many times. Ireland crabs are the best crab we have ever had 😇 Fresh seafood from the tank, they will change the food if it is not fresh 😇, a location with always fresh seafood with various choice of crab, shrimp, and other seafoods, definitely recommend for eating their or choose your seafood and get delivered
description: I am here with girlfriend windy to enjoy a wonderful seafood lunch. Everything was delicious and good. Beautiful day. Thank you

name: Banh Khot Co Ba Vung Tau
address: 102 Cao Thang, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Good food, not so expensive and clean place. I loved the vegetable dish, over all it's a very nice place will be back in the future., This restaurant is located in a very convenient location where I can go around for many good attractions, Excellent- better than Malaysia/ Penang etc Halal they got- but the range of GENUINE Malayan/ Malaysian is impeccable Seen very bad reviews- that happens on T.A
description: Good food, not so expensive and clean place. I loved the vegetable dish, over all it's a very nice place will be back in the future.

name: Quan Bui
address: 88 Song Hanh The Estella Place, An Phu Ward, District 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This small, clean and somewhat "upscale" restaurant offers good and fairly authentic Vietnamese cuisine at reasonable prices. The menu is extensive and partially illustrated. We had summer rolls as a starter and chicken with vegetables, peppers and cashews, as well as fried vegetables as a main course. The staff were friendly and attentive, the food was brought quickly and was delicious. Highly recommended., An Authentic Fine Dine Vietnamese Restaurant that is Very Popular and serves Excellent Food. There are 2 Locations of this Restaurant on the same street - one painted Orange and the other White. We went to the one Painted White, as this is the First Location which the locals say is much better than the newer Orange one. The Locals were right too. The Restaurant is Fairly Large, Very Tastefully Decorated with Vietnamese Handicraft Items all over, has an Excellent Bar, an Extensive Menu and offers a Superb Dining Experience. Everything is Freshly Prepared and Served and is Absolutely Delicious too. Although a Fine Dine Restaurant, the rates are quite reasonable and offer good value for money. A Must Visit place whenever you are in the Main District 1 of Ho Chi Minh City., My experience at the restaurant was great. Nvien served very enthusiastically The restaurant space is airy and very cool The food came out very quickly. And the special thing is that the space of the restaurant and the food here are always imbued with traditional Vietnamese values If I have a chance, I will visit this place again and invite you to experience some more dishes here
description: Dining in Saigon is quite easy and it is not a place where you will easily go hungry, regardless of your budget. Some of Vietnamese restaurants which cater to the business community are quite Westernized. If you insist on a crisp, white table cloth, we don't have it. But for those who want to enjoy real Vietnamese & Home made food and contemporary Saigon living, forget about all the tourist restaurants with their white linens and bloated prices, and instead dine where the Vietnamese do. Surely, you'll have a best experience once you try at Quan Bui.

name: Banana Leaf Saigon
address: 46/6 Pham Hong Thai St, Ben Thanh Ward, Dist 1 Located behind the New World Hotel, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant is a divine destination for food lovers, especially for those who love south indian food. There were Idlis, Dosas with different types of Chutneys , the Tikkis and also the small vegetable wrap type . We were full by the time it reached the main course. We politely declined even to taste the Roti Dal etc. We completed our dinner with sweet Gulabjamun and/ or coconut icecream. It was a nice experience to enjoy our local food in a land far from ours. The service was really good.The owner personally verified the service in between. The food was so tempting that one of our friends ordered a take out whose husband refused to take dinner and remained in our hotel. Of course we could take only some of them due to time constraints., Lunched here on the first floor on Dec-27,2023. This restaurant also offers cabbage soup, carrot halwa and serves Indian tour groups. Also offers plenty of mini white cloth towels near the hand wash and restroom area., It’s a very popular Indian restaurant of Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City). It’s located in the City Centre & is frequented by mostly Indian tourists of Vietnam. They serve both South Indian & North Indian vegetarian & non-vegetarian dishes. The food taste is quite authentic.
description: Banana Leaf offers tasty authentic Indian food with traditional southern Indian serving - on a banana leaf. With years of experience in food catering industry, we ensure our customers with qualified food cooked by experienced native chefs. We believe that serving quality food within our homely venue makes it more possible for us to understand ,interact and further innovate. Our Anticipation is real and your feedback and interaction will motivate and enhance our servings for the good. Every ingredient is handpicked and imported here into Vietnam and further inspected by our chef for approval and thus we make careful assessment before we induct into the kitchen space. The spices, flavors and all inputs that we use are collected from specific vendors who promise the quality in a consistent manner . Our former restaurant at 57 Vo Van Tan was closed and our new one is at 46/6 Pham Hong Thai street (opened on 1/7/2019).

name: Banh Mi 24
address: 68 Tran Nhan Ton Ward 2, Dist. 10, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: One of the more popular foods to visitors in Vietnam, Banh Mi is sandwich infused with culture. French influence is very evident in the baguette bread and the liver pate. Local culture can be seen in the different types of meat that make up the sandwich or the banh mi. There is also coriander, cucumber and special sweet and spicy sauce inside the sandwich which adds much zest. I was so used to the 12-in baguette back home, so this 6-8 inch version of Banh Mi 24 is a welcome surprise. Meal is not overly heavy, and with the right amount of crunchiness and softness in the baguette. It’s basically a take away food so enjoy it while walking on the busy streets of Ho Chi Minh. Very good heavy snack or light lunch / dinner. I don’t mind having banh mi every now and then. I, This Banh mi was sublime. The bread was baked on premises and the flavour was incredible. Highly recommend, Crispy fresh baguette straight from the oven madethis my bes4 Vietnamese baguette. Visited as part of our night scooter tour. Worth trying to find
