name: Yunka - Nikkei Cuisine & Cocktails
address: 80 Dong Khoi Street, District 1 Ben Nghe Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I visited yunka,so the food it was a delightful experience from start to finish , I started with sushi and cebiches which one were so delicious and beautiful presentation. For the main course,I opted for the duck Nikkei and lomo salteado which were cooked to perfection ,tender juicy Overall experience junka ,offers an exceptional dinning experience with Nikkei cuisine , even I believe is the Unique kind of cuisine in Vietnam , I would highly recommend it to anyone to looking for memorable meal., We came early before dinner and had a ew cocktails. Happy hour is great value and the place is fitted out very nicely. Service was prompt including cocktails. Next time I’d stay for some dinner too.
description: Welcome to YUNKA, where culinary exploration knows no bounds. Our menu celebrates Nikkei cuisine—a fusion of Peruvian and Japanese traditions. From ceviche with Japanese flair to inventive sushi rolls, each dish embodies cultural exchange and culinary innovation. Designed for sharing, join us on a journey of discovery as we explore the vibrant flavors of Nikkei cuisine. After dinner, dive into the captivating transformation of our restaurant from dinner to late-night, immersing yourself in a whole new vibe. Come for the dinner, stay for the party! At YUNKA, it’s not just a night out – it’s a celebration of life! Start your evening with a unique blend of dining and drinking in an electrifying atmosphere. As the night progresses, watch our restaurant transform into a lively bar and mini club with DJs playing every night until late. Immerse yourself in Saigon’s vibrant nightlife with iconic food, energetic music, and an unforgettable vibe. Your destination to dine, drink, and dance!

name: Sen Vegetarian Restaurant
address: 171 Nguyen Thai Hoc Pham Ngu Lao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Local feel eatery spans three floors. One floor on floor cushion top on table and chairs but with steep steps across floors. Food is OK, decent but Huge Menu! Love the sweet and sour soup asparagus is good too. Noodles w mock meat, Great food. New cuisines great ambience. It’s a must visit at least once if you are in the ho chi min city. It’s quite easily located in district one., Had a pretty decent experience they are helpful and sweet people food is good and service is nice thank you The basil touch to the food is amazing Little high on price but worth it
description: Located in HCMC center, few minutes walking from back packers' area, SEN vegetarian restaurant serves variety of typical Vietnamese vegan food. Established since 2008, SEN vegetarian restaurant has been a preferred & appreciated location by vegetarians, especially for 1st and 15th of every lunar month which is named key 'vegan days' of Vietnamese. With over 100 dish-menu from fresh spring rolls to all kinds of noodles and flavorful & tasty main dishes of Vietnamese, customers will wish to come back SEN to try many others. We look forward to welcome you to SEN vegetarian restaurant so that we have the privilege to serve you local delicious vegan dishes.

name: Pho 2000
address: 226-228 Le Thanh Ton street District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: I've eaten here twice, the first time by myself, the second time with my tour group. The first time I had a bowl of beef tenderloin pho. Adding a few of the leaves and chilli helped it, but it really wasn't to my taste. I'll try one up north. The second time I had some of their pork and shrimp spring rolls. They were very nice. It's a very busy place ., Great food with good flavor definitely nothing to complain about there. The prices was great and you get value for money, the service was fine., Food was very good and couldn’t fault it, but service needs to be improved. No staff smiling or polite when serving or taking your money after the meal, management need to speak with the staff to rectify this because it didn’t look good
description:
I've eaten here twice, the first time by myself, the second time with my tour group. 
The first time I had a bowl of beef tenderloin pho.  Adding a few of the leaves and chilli helped it, but it really wasn't to my taste.  I'll try one up north.
The second time I had some of their pork and shrimp spring rolls.  They were very nice. 
It's a very busy place .

name: Pho Huong Binh
address: 148 Vo Thi Sau District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: It was my first time to have chicken rice noodles, and the taste was better than I expected! The chicken soup was very delicious, the chicken tasted like salt-baked chicken, the meat was very tender, and the chicken skin was very chewy. Compared with beef rice noodles, it had a different taste. If you like rice noodles, you must try this one., If you are craving for steaming chicken pho this place is a must visit. We ordered for one pho and end up having one more. Though we have left Saigon but we still crave for it., We have already tried some Pho Restaurants. But it was clearly the best althoug it was not among the most expensive.
description: It was my first time to have chicken rice noodles, and the taste was better than I expected! The chicken soup was very delicious, the chicken tasted like salt-baked chicken, the meat was very tender, and the chicken skin was very chewy. Compared with beef rice noodles, it had a different taste. If you like rice noodles, you must try this one.

name: Ơ Bistro Nguyen Gia Tri - Steakhouse, Pasta & Bar
address: 157/1A Nguyen Gia Tri Ward 25, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This is a really nice place to eat. Very high quality food at a very reasonable price. Great for set lunch. Awesome for dinner too., A warm & cozy restaurant, even it's quite small. Reasonable price for a reatautant with Easten style. Suitable for couple and family as well., We will be back. Thanks Obistro team very much. Food quality is very good. Served as a close friend, a very close friend
description: This is a really nice place to eat. Very high quality food at a very reasonable price. Great for set lunch. Awesome for dinner too.

name: Jeffrey’s Kitchen - Taiwanese Beef Noodle & Dumpling
address: 137 Cong Quynh Nguyen Cu Trinh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Excellent soup with top notch beef. The restaurant is small though. Very friendly customer service and the price is reasonable in this area., Fantastic noodles and dumplings. Very tasty overall and exceptional value for the money considering the high quality., Customer service 10/10 Cleanliness 10/10 Portions size 10/10 Food quality 10/10 I Would recommend the beef noodle soup to anyone who goes to the restaurant it was delicious and everything was cooked fresh , great experience for my first Taiwanese soup 😋
description: Jeffrey's kitchen restaurant with pure Taiwanese dishes and beef noodles are cooked by a Taiwanese chef. Come to Jeffrey's kitchen, if you're a Chinese or a Taiwanese, you will find your home tastes here. If you're a Western and curious about how Taiwanese home dishes taste like? You won't be disappointed.

name: Le Thanh Ton Sakaba
address: 2 8, Bis Le Thanh Ton District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: I have been to Sakaba many times and the food and service are always excellent. The owners are really friendly and always welcome you a smile and a friendly greeding. I never liked curry rice and my girl friend would order it often and one day she told me I should try it, I had a taste and my feelings for curry rice changed. It was the best and I order it often when I go there. Yakitori is my favorite food, and their yakitori is on par with what I have in Japan., Food is very tasty and the staff are very friendly. The owners are really very nice and always greet you with a friendly welcome. I have about 15 years in Japan and when I first went to Sakaba in Saigon and have my first stick of yakitori I felt I was enjoying it in Japan. I have never been a fan of curry rice but I decided to give their katsu curry a try and I became a big fan of it since. If you want to enjoy some excellent Japanese food, Sakaba is the place to go., I spent a lot of time in Japan, so I know a lot about Japanese food, and Sakaba does it right. Yakitori is my favorite Japanese food and every time I return to Vietnam I head to Sakaba for Yakitori. Cooked over charcoal and cooked perfectly. The owners are really nice people as is their staff. My favorite place to go for Japanese food in Saigon.
description: I have been to Sakaba many times and the food and service are always excellent.  The owners are really friendly and always welcome you a smile and a friendly greeding.     I never liked curry rice and my girl friend would order it often and one day she told me I should try it, I had a taste and my feelings for curry rice changed.  It was the best and I order it often when I go there.   Yakitori is my favorite food, and their yakitori is on par with what I have in Japan.

name: Banh Canh Cua 14
address: 223A Tran Binh Trong Ward 3 District 5, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: On our last night in HCMC, we went on a food trip. Banh Canh was our last stop before heading back to the hotel. We didn’t regret it as it was a good ender to all other small meals. Their specialty is crab noodles. Super tasty and rich so expect to be full at the end of the meal. You need to try their special scallop noodle soup. Aside from scallop, it contains crab, shrimp and cuttlefish in a big bowl of rich soup. Simply delicious. If you’re also on a food trip mission, and don’t want to eat too much, one bowl can be shared by 2 persons. This place is worth a return trip., Done with massage at the other end of the road, so this seems to be a nice place with local crowds. They have menu with photos and staffs that understand English and Mandarin. Thick noodles with tasty soup base and plenty of ingredient. Reasonably priced, don't miss..., Fresh seafood, variery of topping, charm and quick service. I will come again if I visit Hochiminh City in the future…..
description:
On our last night in HCMC, we went on a food trip. Banh Canh was our last stop before heading back to the hotel. We didn’t regret it as it was a good ender to all other small meals. 

Their specialty is crab noodles. Super tasty and rich so expect to be full at the end of the meal. 

You need to try their special scallop noodle soup. Aside from scallop, it contains crab, shrimp and cuttlefish in a big bowl of rich soup. Simply delicious. 

If you’re also on a food trip mission, and don’t want to eat too much, one bowl can be shared by 2 persons. 

This place is worth a return trip.

name: Bornga -Original Korean Taste-
address: 45 Ly Tu Trong, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Cannot recommend this place highly enough. After a long day touring co chi tunnels and delta decided to get a quick bite. This Korean BBQ looked interesting as my wife and I had not done BBQ before so went in. We explained we did not know how it all worked. Alongside the meat to be grilled they set out a cornucopia of kimchi, vegetables and rice (approx 12 items.) When we made mistake of finishing off one dish it would be replaced with more. The hostess also grilled the meat for us and showed how to wrap on lettuce leaves to be eaten. Fantastic first experience of BBQ. We will certainly be back when we are in HCM again., The most popular traditional korean restaurant in hochiminh. All staffs are kind and expert. They speak English and Korean, absolutely Vietnamese. If you don't know about Korean cuisines Just pick the picture on menu. Personally, I recommend "u-sam-keop" combo menu which is made of beef(U means cow and sam-keop mean triple stored meat with fat and meat) They set the table many kinds of vegetables and fresh meat, meat sources., Solid option to scratch the korean bbq itch. Overall tasty; their kimchi fried rice dish over egg was the best part (signature item). Service was prompt.
description: Cannot recommend this place highly enough. After a long day touring co chi tunnels and delta decided to get a quick bite. This Korean BBQ looked interesting as my wife and I had not done BBQ before so went in. We explained we did not know how it all worked. Alongside the meat to be grilled they set out a cornucopia of kimchi, vegetables and rice (approx 12 items.) When we made mistake of finishing off one dish it would be replaced with more. The hostess also grilled the meat for us and showed how to wrap on lettuce leaves to be eaten. Fantastic first experience of BBQ. We will certainly be back when we are in HCM again.

name: Buzza Pizza
address: 5-7-9 Nguyen Trung Truc Street, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, 5-7-9 Nguyễn Trung Trực, P. Bến THành, Q.1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Our Canadian friends were hungry after we spent half a day at Ben Thanh market. We found this Buzza Pizza just metres from our shopping haunt. Don't ask me why...we would've settled for Pho but white folks need their fix after 2 days out of kink....hahaha...just kidding. Service was very good but please be aware that most staff we encountered, if not all, do not communicate in English. Perhaps it's our luck and the planets did not align for us but kudos to the them as they sincerely tried their darnest and kinda understood our 'Google' translated Vietnamese. Our hunger messages got through and voila!...we thoroughly enjoyed the pizza!! Now if our Italian-Canadian friends say the pizzas were great...who are we to argue! Highly recommended!, The food is correct. But it's really too noisy, they should implement isolation panels to avoid the acoustic effect, We ordered some pizza for take away, we had to wait for about 15 mins. The pizza was very good, the staff was nice and helpful.
description: Buzza Pizza Italian restaurant. 5 -7-9 Nguyen Trung Truc Ben Thanh Ward Dist 1 THCMC. Located in the heart of the city, on the side of Ben Thanh market and War Museum HCM. specializes in wood-fired pizza, wine, ...

name: La Sirena Saigon
address: 251 điện biên phủ phường võ thị sáu quận 3, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: We stopped by this highly-rated restaurant for lunch while in the area. The decor and ambiance were lovely, and it seems like a place that likely gets busy in the evenings. The menu features some live seafood and other intriguing dishes. We particularly enjoyed the razor clams and found the black pepper crab quite tasty. The sauce on the cockles was excellent, but unfortunately, about half of them didn’t open, and the rest were a bit dry. Overall, it was an enjoyable experience., Very good food with affordable price that highly recommended for couples, families and business. I have tried couple of dishes and happy with all of them. Also nice decorations for taking pictures. I have experienced both La sirena Sg and Vung Tau, Food 5/5 - Service 5/5 - Price 5/5 - Clean 5/5 Great place! We had a great evening. The dishes are world class. The menu is very large with a lot of choice, but therefore there is something for everyone. The Atmosphere is stylish and modern. Live-Band every friday. Extra shout-out to the staff. Friendly and attentive. Well done. The price is very low. I strongly recommend 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
description: Taste The World Seafood Top 10% Restaurants Worldwide by Tripadvisor 31D Dien Bien Phu, D3, HCMC

name: Mama's Style - Vietnamese Restaurant
address: 77 Nguyễn Thị Minh Khai, Phường Bến Thành, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Everything was really good. The crab moss hotpot was really special, this is a dish that can only be found in Vietnam. The price for the dish is quite cheap, I highly recommend you to choose Mama's Style - Vietnamese Restaurant for a great meal., Mama's Style Restaurant offers a clean and cozy atmosphere that makes you feel right at home. The friendly staff adds to the experience with their warm hospitality. The ot pot is extremely delicious, making it a must-visit destination for hot pot lovers., The restaurant space is airy, spacious, clean, and luxurious. We ordered dried braised pork and braised snakehead fish in clay pot, the food was delicious and tasty. Vietnamese good is great, will definitely recommend
description: Everything was really good. The crab moss hotpot was really special, this is a dish that can only be found in Vietnam. The price for the dish is quite cheap, I highly recommend you to choose Mama's Style - Vietnamese Restaurant for a great meal.

name: Bep Hue
address: 89 Thach Thi Thanh Tan Dinh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Bep Hue Restaurant is a must-visit for anyone looking for authentic, delicious Vietnamese cuisine. The menu offers a wide variety of options, from traditional dishes like Pho and Banh Mi to lesser-known specialties. The staff are friendly and the atmosphere is cozy and inviting. Highly recommended!, A flavorful and truly special culinary experience in the hustle and bustle of HCMC. From the decor to the service, Bep Hue delivers that impressive experience beautifully. The food is a delicious adventure of complex and well balanced flavors that are synonymous with Hue cuisine. An absolute must of a restaurant, for those looking for an authentic food adventure., Very Very good . Extremely reasonable price wise and good testing hue food . I ordered the salad and also had some vermicelli noodles with beef . Hue is famous for its food in Vietnam and this place and another restaurant in Saigon called the Hue House are very good . Highly Recommend! Awesome to be back in Vietnam it's much higher quality than Bali as I was in Bali last month and Sone greedy restaurant owners there charging 60k dong for a coke in Seminyak !
description: A signature restaurant in style where you can enjoy the most beautiful Vietnam food from Hue cuisine with your family, business, and friends.

name: Tori Soba Mutahiro
address: 8A/A1bis Thai Van Lung District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Ho Chi Minh City's Japantown is a lively place after sunset. With so many pubs, clubs and restaurants concentrated in a couple tiny alleys, it is somehow unsurprising to find ramen joints. What makes this small place special is the food quality. Tori Soba Mutahiro is the only choice for chicken tsukemen and it has nailed it. The dipping sauce is flavorful but not excessively salty. Chicken chashu is tender with the aroma of peppercorn. Presentation is loyally Japanese and price pretty reasonable. Excellent post-drink option., We went to try their famous ramen and honestly it was really good. We seated in front of the kitchen and I would say that they should check the cleaning much better. Not really nice to see. Very old equipment and not clean well…. Overall a good ramen with very reasonable prices., Soba was ok & good, broth was excellent, only this is they should give customer Garlic chop instead of Ginger chop, & must have Bean sproud beside as condiment, i like to eat with Bean sproud when earing Ramen
description: Ho Chi Minh City's Japantown is a lively place after sunset. With so many pubs, clubs and restaurants concentrated in a couple tiny alleys, it is somehow unsurprising to find ramen joints. What makes this small place special is the food quality. Tori Soba Mutahiro is the only choice for chicken tsukemen and it has nailed it. The dipping sauce is flavorful but not excessively salty. Chicken chashu is tender with the aroma of peppercorn. Presentation is loyally Japanese and price pretty reasonable. Excellent post-drink option.

name: Bao Bei Chinese Restaurant
address: 285 Cach Mang Thang Tam Floor 2, Viettel Tower, Ward 12, District 10, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We came for dinner for a special occasion and got a table by the window. The decor of the restaurant and presentation of the dishes is very good. The authenticity of some dishes (eg. Gong bao ji ding) has been changed to suit local tastes but that's fine as long as the quality remains. The only disappointment was that all 3 dishes came out warm, not hot. Not sure how long they were sitting in the kitchen before being served but we also noticed the rice bowl was cold to the touch so it's taking the temperature out of the food which was a pity. Use warm dishes and serve hot as Chinese food must be served straight from the wok., I all recommend all the dumplings that they have and congee. As a korean. Their spicy seafood dish wasn’t as spicy as i expected. I like inside of the restaurant, kind of cute decoration., Location at level 3 in the Viettel Building is quite inconspicuous however once there you will see all the decor reminiscent of old Hong Kong. Selection of dim sum and main menu is also good quality and similar to HK at half the price, though it is expensive for the locals, and some of the staff can even speak Cantonese and Mandarin if you wish. Overall, this place is a very pleasant experience.
description: Experience authentic Chinese cuisine with a new taste and style. Bao Bei is a Chinese restaurant located in Viettel tower overlooking the lively Cach Mang Thang 8 street of District 10, HCMC.Stepping inside, the restaurant brings back memories of the vintage 1980s Hong Kong shop: colorful neon signs, constrasting vibrant colors and an open concept kitchen along with tea bar.

name: Banh Mi 74
address: 74/7 Hai Ba Trung, Ben Nghe, D1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: We had several Bahn mi throughout our stay, i mean it is almost expected when visiting Viet nam. This was the most memorable, it wasn’t the cheapest or the most expensive, it wasn’t the fanciest we had not the basic we tried. However I have to say this one hit the spot, fresh ingredients amazing flavours and textures. I almost went back again that’s how good it was. It’s set in a little courtyard off the main road with some other restaurants, but this one was a food truck (a nice one) in the heart of the area. Try it, Please note that there is a kitchen car in the intricate courtyard from Hai Bà Trưng Street, which is hard to find from the street. There are seats outside, but you can also order food and drink inside Vietnam Select Shop, where the air conditioner next door works. Banh mi was delicious, but the outside of the bread is as hard as rice crackers, so be careful if you don't like to chew your teeth weakly. Bánh Mì 362 is better than here if you're after Banh mi with a limited number of meals. Taste, cost and location are good., This restaurant is a small trailer located in a courtyard between a few other restaurants (Hoa Tuc and El Gaucho). They only serve Banh Mi, but boy do they do it well. I had a delicious egg/omelette banh mi which I took to go as I had a flight out. Even though I waited a few hours, the sandwich was still delicious. The bread was fresh, the eggs were fluffy, and the herbs and chilies really made it pop. When I chatted with the owner she said she had been open since October. Any one in the area should definitely visit. Highly recommend!
description:

name: Chickita Flame Grilled Chicken
address: 230 Nguyen Van Huong, Thao Dien, D.2 Chickita Thao Dien, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Having had a somewhat mediocre meal previously at Chickita and having given an average review, I thought it only fair to update my review as my experience there was totally different yesterday when I went back as a friend's insistence to try it again. This time all of the food was piping hot and instead of the previous rubbery skin this time it was super crispy and the actual chicken was melt in your mouth. Remembering that the French fries seasoning was way too salty last time I asked for french fries without Chickita's seasoning and this time the french fries were perfect - piping hot, tasty and flavorsome. The sweet corn had a welcome buttery taste, and the coleslaw was pleasant. My husband said his chicken and sides were delicious and our friend said that her chicken and sides were 'stunning.' I still didn't find a chili sauce there that had the 'wow' factor although we all thought the black pepper and garlic chili sauce was rather nice. But overall our meals were superb. We'll definitely be there again soon., Saturday was super-sexy as this chicken dish 😋 This place had natural and fresh chicken, especially exclusive sauces that were inspired by Asian flavors. The owner made source recipes and it becomes the highlight of the restaurant. You couldn’t find these alike savors in other places. There were 8 types of sauce, each brought a memorable taste, I bet you wouldn’t be able to forget once tasted. The lady who served my table in a friendly great and professional manner. On the table, there was leaflets shared story about the farm where feeds chicken and the history of the Chickita brand. A cozy concept of the restaurant with the yellow lights and the attractive view was a plus point for me. I came to the one at Nguyen Van Huong Street, Thao Dien. It was easy to locate and find. As I know, there are many outlets for you to come and try. It’s cool and I will recommend my friends 👍, GOOD FOOD The food was delicious. The corn was spot on. Perfect for families with children and prices were ok. Felt like the staff was a bit tired this evening but still got ok service.
description: Chickita, the 1st Asian's inspired flame grilled chicken restaurant, is proud to introduce "farm to table" concept in which we use 100% natural brown-rice-fed chicken - our chickens are delivered daily from our own farm. Our unique flame grilled cooking method not only ensures the juicy tender meat and crispy skin, but is also healthy for the customers.

name: Bella Italia
address: 4 My Phu 2C Tan Phu, D7, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: My favourite place for steaks in District 7. They even have an offer of 50% discount for steaks on Saturdays. Besides that they have daily discounts on different food. You can check out their Facebook page for their deals. I normally order the Tendelion steak with pepper sauce and mash potatoes. What is worth mentioning is that even at 50% discount the potion remains the same. The owner Mauro is also present daily to attend to you and take your orders and constantly checking with you on the food and so on, Their staff are just as warm and friendly as he is. Highly recommended if you are looking for a place to chill and relax for a meal as there is also an outdoor area for you to smoke if you want to. It is also pet friendly and they would even offer your pet a bowl of water., Welcoming environment, staff are attentive to customer needs, minimal expectations, and variations to the menu are welcome. We had a great time and Mauro is a very kind host. This was our second time, the first was in 2022. I recommend it to all tastes, even vegetarians and vegans., As the food is so delicious at Bella Italia, I have now eaten there a great many times and the food has been superb, overall. I would have reviewed this restaurant a lot earlier on, but they are a relative newcomer to Trip Advisor so I have not had chance. There are also fantastic daily deals to and so worth looking at their Facebook page, but normally we just order whatever we fancy from the menu. My favourites include the most delicious penne bolognaise - beautifully presented, usually piping hot, lasagne and arabiatta. I normally order a side salad with the pasta and pizza dishes and it always arrives super fresh, tailored according to your requests, and with a wonderful delicate salad dressing made with oil and white wine vinegar. My husband always particularly enjoys the frito misto, the meatballs with spaghetti, the chicken milanese and the Margarita pizza. But as we go there so often, between our choices and those of our friends, we have sampled the greatest part of the menu and have always had a wonderful gastronomic experience. The tenderloin steaks are fantastic too, always cooked to perfection and served on hot crispy asparagus with salad and choice of potatoes and sauces. The pepper sauce is particularly worthy of mention too - none of this indifferent mild tasting pepper sauce that most restaurants offer, and that is reminiscent of British gravy, but a really spice pepper sauce, very similar to a South African Madagascar pepper sauce. Not for the faint hearted and extremely enjoyable. We don't tend to have a starter as they are massive for our appetites, such as a very large amount of mashed avocado with prawns, or bruschetta presented on very large chunks of bread, which though generous, is extremely filling and leaves us without room to completely finish our mains. The desserts are extremely delicious too although the super tasty gelato portions are on the small side but the chocolate coated eclair is massive and a thorough treat from first bite until the last. And although not on the menu, customers can ask Mauro, the owner to make his special Italian bread and butter pudding, which is made from Panettone cake and is quite possible one of the most delicious desserts I have ever eaten anywhere. All this is a very pretty large outdoor courtyard, with lots of fans and a wonderful welcoming owner and staff. There is also live music everyday with a particularly welcoming warm singer called Bin, and which all adds to the great ambience and dining experience.
description: Authentic Italian restaurant and coffee shop in a relaxing, welcoming and comfortable garden setting. Serving, traditional Italian fare; homemade pizza, fresh pasta, and Dolce Vita gelati desserts, cocktails, beers and wine. .

name: 22z10 Bar Saigon
address: 121/12 Le Thi Rieng Phuong Pham Ngu Lao, Quan 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: One of the hidden gems in HCMC, this bar provides excellent service, drinks, and music. Accommodating staff will make sure you have the best experience and the prices are highly competitive in an area dominated by expensive cocktail bars. highly recommend this place, feels like home., My wife and I first found this bar last August so it was a no brainer to bring some of friends here on our next trip. The quality and quantity of drinks has improved, which was difficult to do, the atmosphere is still fantastic but the most amazing thing was the staff remembered us. You feel at home in this gorgeous bar hidden down a hem and they even have pizzas on the menu now, which were very good mind you. One of the bar tenders, Bong, some nights sung for us and even let us join in but I don't think she will again ha ha. Overall if you are looking for a place away from the girly bars in Bui Vien this is the place to go, you can talk to your friends and the staff will answer any questions you have on what to do and where to go whilst in Saigon. A beautifully designed bar with a heritage feel and comfortable stools. Great place., Wonderful service and nice view, such a great place to chill with your friends in your freetime. It has a favorable geographical position in District 1, Ho Chi Minh city. In morning and afternoon, 22z10 serve coffee and tea. In evening to midnight is time for bar with great drinks and great atmosphere. You can order custom cocktails base on your favorite. Every week will have live music at Saturday night.
description:
One of the hidden gems in HCMC, this bar provides excellent service, drinks, and music. Accommodating staff will make sure you have the best experience and the prices are highly competitive in an area dominated by expensive cocktail bars.
highly recommend this place, feels like home.

name: Mam Vegetarian Restaurant
address: Nguyen Van Troi 197/4, Ward 10, Ho Chi Minh City 72218 Vietnam
reviews: Fabulour vegetarian food - will definately be back. This is what a restaurant should be. Good affordable food that is deliciously different and served by attentiveb staff Prices are reasonable. They also have buffet served at talble. Would highly recommend, The food lords smiled on me when I stumbled upon this place. I had no expectations but it was quite possibly my best meal in Vietnam! Extensive and interesting food menu and very innovative (non alcoholic) drinks menu including homemade iced teas from exotic Vietnamese fruits. I had the stewed pepper straw mushrooms - you can see in the photos they even use fresh pepper berries! The food is wholesome and so delicious. The staff were great and you can see they clearly have high standards when it comes to food., Excellent ambience. Awesome vegetarian food. Well mannered staff. Especially Nguyet, lovely lady. Super sweet n warm. She kept feeding us ice cream.
description: Vegan & Vegetarian Food with Cozy Space

name: O Bistro - Steakhouse, Pasta & Bar
address: 141 Thong Nhat Street Binh Tho, Thu Duc District, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Nice place and so delicious food Cozy almosphere,staff friendly Free parking Guabao nice Pesto chickend good Will try steak next time., Great steak for a good price. One of the few restaurants with good steak in district 9. And also great desert, Quality food is 9/10 Dish Presentation 8/10 Service 8/10 Price là 10/10 👆OK I'll come back next time with my family
description: Restaurant style retro, you have too many choice : Beefsteak from US, Japan, Australian, Argentina. Salmon pan seared, more guabao, hamburger, pasta, flaming beef and rice shaking beef from vietnam... Everything so delicious, juicy and very cheap !

name: L' Apella Cafe & Lounge
address: 01 street 16, Thao Dien Ward, Thu Duc City, Ho Chi Minh City 71300 Vietnam
reviews: The shop is so beautiful, from every angle you take beautiful photos. I'm super addicted to salted coffee, and the cocktails are also very delicious in the evening. Overall, lovely, friendly and lovely staff. Will come back many times, I have been to this location. Beautiful space, cool swimming pool, delicious drinks. What I like most are the green trees surrounding the shop's grounds. The staff here are quite cute, especially the waiters. The security guard was also enthusiastic and gentle, guiding the car in and out., This is my favorite place in Ho Chi Minh! ✨Everything is done in an incredible royal style, where I feel like a princess. Very responsive and nice service staff, from the security guard to the waiters. A great place to relax with family or friends, a place for an event or a photo shoot, I highly recommend it ❤️
description: L' Apella is well-known place at the heart of Thao Dien ward, Thu Duc city, HCMC for live music & speak-easy lounge at night. We serve fabulous Jazz live music every Fri & Sat, extraodinary Classic vibes & Wonderful cocktails.

name: Gogi House
address: 189-191 Nguyen Thai Hoc, Ward Pham Ngu Lao, Dist 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We originally visited this location back on our 2015 trip. We had a memorable experience there, so we obviously wanted to go back on this visit. We dined there on December 17th 2019. Unfortunately, this visit was not as memorable as our 2015 visit. As soon as we arrived, we felt that the vibe was off. We ordered a premium sampler plate. All of the proteins we received were about 80% fat. Look, I realize this is a Korean bbq joint, and there is going to be fat on the meat (that's part of the great taste). In this case however, there was just so much fat and little meat, and whatever meat there was, was grisly. The protein was simply not enjoyable. When we came in 2015, the meat/protein was much better quality. We also were introduced to a sesame oil dipping sauce that had rock salt in it. When we asked for this dipping sauce during this visit, they looked oddly at us and brought out a giant bowl of sesame oil and giant bowl of salt. We explained to them in Vietnamese what we were looking for - and again - they had no idea. O'h well.....maybe the restaurant sold or changed management and they no longer have this dipping sauce. It's a shame cause it was awesome. Given the poor experience with the Premium Sampler plate, we order another protein (pork). the pork came but it was nearly frozen. Upon thawing through the cooking process, it utlimately cooked. The taste wasn't as good as our last visit in 2015. Again, I think the overall quality has gone downhill. Or, maybe we got them on an off night - who knows. We probably won't return to this Gogi. We'll either try another location or another restaurant entirely. Given our experience above, use caution, as your experience may vary., I came here to have dinner with you. I also want to rate 5 stars but think again Food has grilled pork dishes, grilled pork chops. Grilled beef. . . . . I also called the mixed rice octopus and vermicelli My total invoice is nearly $ 50 The restaurant is quite crowded, the staff is not very enthusiastic. Fresh and delicious food comes with a water free filter of kimchi. If you want to eat, you should come here, but if you ask for professionalism, don't., This was a chance encounter as we were walking down Nguyen Thai Hoc avenue. This restaurant was full and we thought it could be a good sign. It was. The little barbecue on our table had its ambers replaced regularly by friendly staff. The meats were perfect and so were the drinks. Staff is super young and pro. A nice place to eat in Saigon.
description: GoGi house brings customers to peaceful lanes with its paradise of Korean popular barbeque beef. The food will be served on fire and without smoke. There is a variety of beef types there. Some other Korean authentic food which should not be missed are cold noodle, kimchi soup and hotpot...

name: Gammer Beer
address: 107 Pasteur St, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Large and characteristic room. inside there are various tables designed for large companies. Large and varied menu. The quality of the food is quite good. The service is friendly and quite fast. the place is very crowded and the volume of shouting is high. Let's say that there is a lot of background noise, which sometimes makes it difficult to speak, We dropped in early afternoon and enjoyed a nice draft beer. They make the beer on-site, using old traditional brewing equipment. Only sell dark and "blond" beer; the blond was quite drinkable and a nice bargain at 63K VND for a half liter. Staff didn't manage much English, but were friendly enough., It was on the way back to our hotel from the War Museum. We arrived there around 3PM for a late lunch. As we were very thirsty, we tried all kinds of beer they had and it was the best part of this restaurant. However, the food was on another story. Not so fresh and lack of taste. Service was extremely slow even though there were only four tables during our stay. Average as its best!

name: Cafe 343
address: 343 Nguyen Trai Street, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: This is a nice cafe, lots of greenery and open air. The water fountain and waterfalls were relaxing. Compared to other restaurants, the menu is reasonably priced with most items under 130K Dong. The only negative I have is the service is very slow, expect a hour or more for your choice of dinner to arrive. The food is tasty for a cafe but average for a good restaurant. Al in all the atmosphere carries this cafe, definitely worth visiting👍., This is a popular spot for morning coffee, with newspaper reading and discussion. There are many seating options, including inside and out. The menu is very well-presented. One negative: still using plastic straws., Visited recently whilst in Vietnam, exceptional food, drinks, ice cream and staff had excellent customer service. Would highly recommend!
description: This is a nice cafe, lots of greenery and open air. The water fountain and waterfalls were relaxing. Compared to other restaurants, the menu is reasonably priced with most items under 130K Dong. The only negative I have is the service is very slow, expect a hour or more for your choice of dinner to arrive. The food is tasty for a cafe but average for a good restaurant. Al in all the atmosphere carries this cafe, definitely worth visiting👍.

name: The Joi Factory at Christina's
address: 212/2B Nguyen Trai, Nguyen Cu Trinh ward, district 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This is a quirky little cafe in a quiet (for HCMC) side street. The laid- back casual vibe would provide a relaxing venue for a quiet coffee, but actually delivers some seriously tasty food. Our servers were clearly being trained, but were efficient and attentive without being over the top. We had two very tasty and filling dishes and my iced coconut coffee was delicious and refreshing. I feel like its a genuine shame that our travel plans mean we probably won't be able to go back, but a definite must visit if you're in the area., While staying at Christina's, having this gem downstairs made my stay even more wonderful. The food was delicious, and everything was so fresh and flavorful. I had quite a few things on the menu, but by far my favorite was the Vegan Banh Mi. It was such a nice meal to have before heading out for the day. I really enjoyed having the café where I was staying because, with everything being so good, I didn't really need to leave the building. One of the more special things about this place was that there was live music during my stay, and that really sealed the deal for me. I love having a nice meal in a nice lively and relaxing environment. I'd rate this place higher if I could, but I suppose the 5/5 will have to do., This place is absolute GOLD. Coming from a person who eats ONLY vegetarian food, this place has great options to choose from for food and beverages. The space and atmosphere to hangout either for few drinks or just getting work done, is pretty clean and Instagrammable. They have open areas where natural light is entering the entire premise which makes it even more lively. I can't do justice to how positive this place feels. Can't wait to visit again.
description: The Joi Factory is Vietnamese vegetarian café restaurant located at Christina's Hotel in District 1, Ho Chi Minh City.

name: Nha Hang Rung Xanh Crocodile Farm and Restaurant
address: 2 130, Kha Van Can P. Hiep Binh Chanh Q. Thu Duc, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: never it crocodile ever before and never think i can do it . the flavour is smilar like chicken , good to have a try to see how vietnamese people can do " local people said everything move you can try and everything do not move you also can try " that is vietnam, The farm is a fascinating look at crocodile farming. Then we ate at the restaurant which was awesome. Relaxing, delicious with great service. Highly recommend a visit!, Well worth a visit to the Crocodile farm near Ho Chi Minh City. Here crocodiles are reared for their meat and other products. The farm has crocodiles of different sizes and a restaurant in the facility where crocodile meat can be tried.

name: Tăng 1 Quán
address: 227 Lê Hồng Phong, Phường 4, Quận 5, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Suitable for gathering to eat and drink with friends. I can comfortably go in a group of 5 or 6 people. When we arrived, the tables were full, but the staff quickly cleared out a new table. Delicious, cheap, quality food. Will come back next time, Accidentally found this place and came here for dinner. The food was great. The price is what you can't beat., Delicious food, reasonable prices, good service staff, beautifully decorated restaurant. Suitable for couples, or important occasions
description: Suitable for gathering to eat and drink with friends. I can comfortably go in a group of 5 or 6 people. When we arrived, the tables were full, but the staff quickly cleared out a new table. Delicious, cheap, quality food. Will come back next time

name: Basta Hiro - Vincom Center Dong Khoi
address: 72 Le Thanh Ton, district 1, HCMC B3-06 Vincom Center Dong Khoi, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Are you looking for an Italian taste in Vietnam? This is the place! They mix it so well the Italian cuisine with an Asian touch that makes it one of the best experiences for Pasta in Ho Chi Minh City! Check it out!, Couldn't believe that I made a right choice to stop by this restaurant for dinner. At first, the staff were polite to request diners to follow distancing rules due to the covid-19 spread, they were hygiene and careful to serve food and certainly I didn't wait for so long for my order dishes. The restaurant were generous to provide some free mini bread with butter for me as well as others and I really appreciated 👍 Couldn’t believe that there are many kinds of Italian-taste Japanese-style choices here and I lost my mind for seconds on which I should get, however, I picked green salad and ontama bolognese spaghetti then. So fresh and Italian tasty! I wish to come back with friends next time so that I can enjoy more and more food in this restaurant., Food fresh and amazing 🥳 staff very attentive and polite. We had, pizza and pasta dishes, we visited twice. All the kitchen staff wearing face masks, dining areas very clean too. There was so much choice at the shopping centre, we were drawn to this restaurant as the food looked delicious as we walked past, we were not disappointed 🥳
description: Basta Hiro brand name was first launched in 2013 by Hiromi Yamada, who is considered as one of the "Legendary" chefs who innovated and popularized Italian Cuisine in Japan, identified his enthusiasm to bring the culinary art to the whole world.

name: Noriboi - Omakase Japanese Restaurant
address: 31 Pho Duc Chinh, Nguyen Thai Binh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Very fortunate that we chose NORIBOI to celebrate our anniversary of all the millions of great places in the city. A+ service. Atmosphere is very zen and pristine. Most importantly, the food was exceptional. All the ingredients were so fresh and unique. The dinning experience feels much more elevated due to Chef Công’s extensive knowledge of the ingredients in his dishes. The stories and planned activities are a nice break in between bites that kept the meal engaged rather than the normal dining experience. Overall, had an absolute blast here, and I would highly recommend NORIBOI to anyone who is familiar with the Omakase dining experience but wants a more Vietnamese inspired flavors., Noriboi Omakase のり坊い has moved to a stunning new location in D1 on 31 Pho Duc Chinh. The ambiance and décor is delightful and is inspired by the Japanese life nurturing concept of water and in reality feels like you could be on the set of the movie Dune 2. The Vietnamese chefs are talented & engaging while the service is white gloved, attentive with a light touch. The drinks list is comprehensive with a wide range of sake and Japanese tea. The stars of the show are ingredients that showcase world class proteins prepared by the chef’s to accentuate the flavours of the freshly flown in fish. Noriboi is owned by SOKO Cake Bake & Brunch Group so expect “surprise & delight” with the desserts., The food, presentation and service were great. My wife and daughter had a great meal and overall experience. It’s awesome to have this dining experience in our Thao Dien community.
description: Noriboi– named after NORI のり (seaweed), the essential ingredient in sushi rolls, embodies the values of harmony, elegance, and enclosure in Japanese cuisine. At NORIBOI, we are proud to provide our customers with a modern experience and traditional taste. Noriboi proudly pioneers the exquisite Japanese omakase art in Vietnam, showcasing the talents of our exceptional chefs. Inspired by nature’s beauty, Noriboi offers a refined culinary journey with premium ingredients from Japan’s renowned fish markets. The architecture of Noriboi Omakase reflects the Japanese philosophy of respecting nature. Water, as a central source of inspiration, is integrated into the restaurant's space in various refined forms, engaging all the senses and creating a multi-dimensional, immersive experience for guests.

name: Sushi Ko
address: 122/37/15 Vinh Khanh Phuong 16 quan 4, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: This place cost about AUD$70 in total for three of us and we ate a truckload, had about six or seven beers some other drinks some saki. And probably ordered 10 different dishes. In Melbourne it would be like spending $250-300 at a suburban sushi place, in terms of comparing quantity versus cost. Everything was fresh, no sickness or anything so it will be the same quantity and hygiene as something in Australia. So all good, go and enjoy. The ice in drinks etc is all okay for Aussies to have. Cheers Mong, My all time favourite place for sushi. The salmon sashimi is great, you can request the salmon belly for the same price. The salmon hotpot is also a must try. Sea urchin is fresh, This restaurant is the best value for money when it comes to sushi in Saigon! The restaurant itself is not fancy and more of a 'street' restaurant but the sushi is delicious, good quality and always fresh!! It's a great place for a group of friends to have some beers as it's on a busy food street and there's always a good buzz around!

name: Taj Mahal Restaurant
address: 31 Bui Vien District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: While searching for an Indian Restaurant in the vicinity, we ended up at this restaurant. We were pleasantly surprised to enter and hear Hindi from this smiling Vietnamese lady - Ms Shofia. The food was tasty and cost friendly compared to other places we tried in Ho Chi Min City. The lady was friendly and in the conversation she told me that she used to work for an Indian Restaurant for 17 years and then opened up her own restaurant. She has never been to India but still speaks fluent Hindi. The place is definitely worth visiting., Grab a dish of chicken pakoda. It just melts in my mouth since it is so soft. Due to an unpleasant morning encounter, I skipped lunch. However, after eating the pakoda, the waiter—the lady owner's son—told me not to buy a half since it would be too heavy for me, so I got a quarter of chicken tandoor and a Saigon beer instead. Wow, that's even better. It only need to marinate longer. I therefore have a pretty great meal that doubles as snacks. Because of the owners' kind demeanor, I plan to return., Authentic Indian + Pakistani cuisine, mini-restaurant in one of the old town streets of Bien Vien. You need patience because it takes a while until all the dishes are on the table (we had 6 dishes + naan bread) but we both smile, full and happy, that's soul food. Thank you, we'll be back!

She has never been to India but still speaks fluent Hindi. The place is definitely worth visiting.

name: Jamaica Jamaica
address: 359/67- D Le Van Sy Ward 12, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Had the best Jerk Chicken of my life. Well recomendable. The curry goat was also awesome along with the fried dumplings. This is truly authentic Caribbean Taste!, Very tasty jerk chicken and great foods with reggae BGM! Start up restaurant so better to contact owner/chef before you go. It doesn't have signboard outside and little bit hard to find but it's nice and cozy restaurant and friendly staff! It is in the small alley behind Screc tower with Coop mart. They don't have their own drink for now and we will order from neighbor Vietnamese restaurant :-), Been here usually for our dinner then I would love to say that this is the best chicken with specially red chilli sauce. The owner is friendly and kind. Highly recommend!
description: Welcome to Saigon's only Jamaican eatery. We grow our own scotch bonnet peppers, and prepare all of our meals fresh daily. come and visit our humble little place for a true taste of the Caribbean.

name: Banh Mi Hanoi
address: 83 - 85 Nguyen Thien Thuat Street, Ward 2, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Street food with a bit of a grocery store behind it, this place has several different types of Bahn mi and they're all amazing. Try their coconut jello for dessert it's incredible (forget the name but it's in the fridge and comes in a coconut)., Hands down the best banh mi I had in Vietnam. I was lucky enough to be introduced to this shop by my family, otherwise I would have not come across this on my own. The bread is super fresh, pate if plentiful, and the cheese is magnifique!, This place is basically a bakery that serves banh mis to take away. The banh mis are served overflowing with perfectly roasted meat and classic Vietnamese sandwich vegetables. More expensive than your usual banh mi but so worth it. If you want high quality service that speaks English, go somewhere else but you won't get better!
description: Street food with a bit of a grocery store behind it, this place has several different types of Bahn mi and they're all amazing. Try their coconut jello for dessert it's incredible (forget the name but it's in the fridge and comes in a coconut).

name: Nhà Hàng Chay Bà Xã
address: 245/5 Nguyen Trai, Ho Chi Minh City 71014 Vietnam
reviews: Visited with a family of 5. Vegan curry was delicious and reasonably priced at 70. The portion size was exceptionally generous. The pad thai and pineapple flavoured fried rice was great quality. All Vegan. We'll definitely be visiting again, We went to the second outlet at 107K Truong Dinh Phuong 6, Quan 3. The restaurant is pleasant and air conditioned and the staff are lovely. The food is well priced (we paid 650,000 dong for 7 dishes, extra rice and 4 drinks (no alcohol)). Great vegan food including tasty salads and a really good green curry. Happy to be able to pay with credit card and no hidden taxes or sevice fees., Very good vegetarian restaurant in D3 I eat here often when I stay in HCMC and their food is excellent with many choices to choose.
description: Today vegetarianism is gradually becoming a trend in modern life in developed countries. In the midst of busy life and hustle, people like to go to vegetarian meals to find their moments of peace. Not only do religious followers of the full moon or the anniversary of death die, but everyone regardless of age or gender can opt for vegetarianism. As one of the famous vegetarian restaurants in Saigon, Ba Xa vegan gives you the opportunity to enjoy the most authentic vegetarian dishes. Vegetarian Vegan Nguyen Trai - The taste of vegetarian sweet, pure In modern life, fast food has become so familiar that under the potential risk of vegetarianism as a means of preventing illness, keeping fit, prolonging longevity is of great concern and apply. With its varied menu and varied menu, vegetarian dishes Ba Xa Vegan not only delicious but also decorated beautifully attractive. Raw veggies from vegetables, mushrooms, tofu, eggplant, ... restaurant that any customer tasted passionate but remember

reviews: I today came back to the Russian Dumpling place Fat Pie in Cresent Mall D7. I this time enjoyed their marvelous Tomato soup with cheese and fried chicken dumplings. The taste was just splended! Can really recomend., Dinner with colleagues, quiet place and good tastes. Russian food was for me new, I've a good surprise finding good plates and good drinking. address: 63/18 Pasteur District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The food is delicious with reasonable price. The staffs are nice. The air con was a bit hot for us since we ate spicy food for lunch. Coconut ice cream was so tasty., First of all, this place is real cool. Cozy, great ambience. We ordered about 6 dishes: Pad thai, tom yum, salad, fried rice with egg, grilled pork and deep fried pork. My fav is pad thai with shrimp, this one was just perfect. The portion is quite small, so you can try a lot of different dishes. The staff were very attentive and friendly. All in all, I really like this place. Definitely will be back., Enjoy with tiny corner made from Thailand, multi dishes. Not too much spicy 'cause they made suitable for Vietnamese. Great experience, will be back next time.
description: An Com Uong Nuoc - Kin Khao Kin Nam is a beautiful bistro and coffee that serves a generous selection of authentic and unique Thai dishes.

name: Pasta Fresca
address: 28 Thao Dien District 2, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: I Remember the two guys from when they were standing on the sidewalk. Now they've moved into a more restaurant-like setup. The food is still good value for money and fast, but the seats are perhaps a bit rustic and low. The gravel doesn't help much with that; it's a bit hard on my long legs. One easy improvement that would make this a 5 out of 5 Install a suction fan in the kitchen. Perhaps you have one, but it's not on? Or it's missing. The smoke from the kitchen makes most seats a bad pick and is clearly an issue. Fans are $50; have one installed to improve airflow out the side. It's a 10-minute job. Guys, please, please sort this out, We stumbled across this restaurant as we had originally gone to a Japanese restaurant nearby which was unfortunately closed. The serving lady recommended green spinach linguine which we had with meatballs and a ham mushroom pizza. The seating is out under the sky and since this is December it was pleasant. The lingiune was very good but I felt the meatball could be better infused with the tomato sauce. The pizza too was good and did not disappoint. Last but not the least was chocolate digestif was much appreciated. Am coming back., I've been to Pasta Fresca twice, once with a friend and once with many friends. The pizza is divine, in Saigon I haven't eaten anything so good, the place is simple and the service excellent, the owner is friendly and so is the whole environment and the price is correct. Try it, then Thao Dien is a neighborhood that also offers after lunch or dinner.

The staff is extremely friendly and knowledgeable, they are willing to recommend beers that suit your taste. The food is also very delicious, especially the deep-fried chicken wings and bacon burgers. This is definitely a great place to relax with friends after a long day. I will definitely come back!, Good beer, good desserts and yummmy meals bring the best moments with buddies. Have fun with friends when catching up with them! Yayyyyuy, Great spot for beers in Ho Chi Mihn City. Friendly staff and good beers for a good price. Nice spot for people watching and chilling

address: 86 Nguyen Hue 1st Floor, Dist.1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: It was nice to find a vegetarian version of a traditional Dish! The Mushroom pho was very nice and a good portion. My friend had the Tofu and rice. Mushrooms were really tasted but the tofu could of been more flavoursome. We also had summer rolls (18k VND) Our total bill came to 190k VND (just under £8. The restaurant is upstairs through another restaurant so a little tricky to find. It does also close early than most places at 9pm., Great vegan restaurant in town. These foods are not too spicy, I love "Bun Rieu" & "Bun Thang" so much. The place is not really easy to find, you have to find Maycha then go upstair, Mang is in the 1st floor., Location is hidden (see texts before this) but nice and clean. Food is good but served from the saddest girl. Maybe only a bad day, but.... Hidden room on the first floor. Great food and inexpensive, but served by the saddest girl in the world. Maybe just a bad day but...
description: A small and cozy Vegetarian Restaurant in the center of Saigon. Vietnamese vegan cuisine, home-made Tofu, daily cold_press juice, home-made nuts milk.

name: Tenku - Japanese Modern Kaiseki & Bar
address: 720A Điện Biên Phủ Tòa Nhà Landmark 81, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Was introduced to the 67th floor of the Landmark building by a colleague. Very impressed that there is such a beautiful restaurant in Saigon ~. My wife and I use the Kaseki Wagyu Lover set. Enjoying wine while listening to live music and watching the sunset is truly wonderful. Will come back here one day soon!!, Good service, good food & drink, friendly & professional staff. Must try when you visit Landmark 81. Incredible view. You also can see the firework there, Honestly, this restaurant is great, I really like the food here and the staff are very enthusiastic and attentive.

name: Yummy Chicken
address: 16-18-20 Thu Khoa Huan Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: These guys know Australian beef. I had delicious tenderloin with Chilean Shiraz. Sides and salad also delicious, Wow, OMG, need I say more. They have a sign out side saying 50%, yeah right heard that before, BUT no it’s true, wend in had the most amazing Rib ever, with a 200g filet, to say stunning doesn’t go any way near how good this was, service was excellent and delightful, when in hcmc, you have to come here, less than £20.00 for an awesome meal,, This is a nice, clean restaurant to take a break from market shopping. The staff are friendly and cheerful. Enjoyed my meal here.
description: A Portuguese eatery that serve all kind of grilled and rotisserie chicken dishes. Even though, Yummy Chicken specializes in chicken, the restaurant is also offering a wide range of salads and healthy juices.

name: Rbar
address: 8-15 Ton Duc Thang Street, District 1 Renaissance Riverside Hotel Saigon, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I was very impressed with the space of the hotel from the moment I entered the restaurant. The space is very luxurious but does not lose the feeling of being at home. About the room, the view of the hotel is quite nice, you can see most of the city at night. I am also impressed with many places where the staff advises me, especially My and Son, they serve very enthusiastically and also advise me on many restaurants in the hotel such as Liquid Sky Pub, I have not had the opportunity to go this time, but next time I will definitely try., We just had a great evening at RBar with the music and fortunately there was a fireworks so Nat actively offered us a stunning view to watch the show with warm heart. She took her time to carry our drink to the rooftop and gave us more information about the show. Surprisingly, the service & drink is very worthy with the reasonable price. Highly recommend 👍, Was here for coffees and cakes with the kids on a Sunday morning. The kids were so active and making a mess at the table. Chau was so kind, nice and friendly to offer assistance to clean up, she also played with the kids. Liked the atmosphere at the bar too, it is relaxing to look out the windows to watch the world goes by in a relaxed space. The manager also very informative when we asked questions about the hotel and places to go around town. Thank you very much for a good morning.
description: RRbar is a trendy and stylish lobby bar and lounge; inspired by the look and feel of a European street-side café. Much more than just a lounge bar, Rbar offers a wide variety of culinary options throughout the day. From delicious breakfast pastries in the morning to delicious éclairs and other snacks to leisurely afternoon teas, the innovative menu is designed for comfort and convenience – whether joining us for a meal or grabbing a quick bite to take away. Whether our guests feel like a world-class international wine or award-winning Pasteur Street Brewery craft beer, the drink selection will surprise and delight even veteran bar explorers. Ideal for both casual drinks after a long day of business meetings or an overdue catch-up with friends, Rbar sets a new standard for lounge bars in Saigon.

name: Food Village Cu Lao Xanh
address: 9A Trần Văn Trà Phường Tân Phong, Quận 7, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: It's an interesting place with a memorable experience of taking q boat across the river, which is quite special in SaiGon. You must try the "Mangosteen chicken salad" which is "Gỏi gà tre măng cụt" in vietnamese, This is a short hop on a boat just opposite Starbucks at Panorama. We love going here with our toddler as there is a playground so she can play while we eat. Tanks full of fish and extensive menu. Staff have limited English but the menu is in English so you can just point. Always a good evening, We had a nice lunch here the other day, nice short ride across the river to the restaurant, a seafood place we had clams, fried rice, fried squid for me, soup, and a salad that I'm not sure what it was called, but it had pig ears in it. I usually have squid, shrimp or clams as the fish in most of the restaurants, and whatever is in the river. We had a nice quiet lunch with friends and family it rained while we were there and we just moved our table back into the restaurant, it was an enjoyable afternoon and the short ride to and from the restaurant was fun.
description: Cu Lao Xanh Cuisine - the only islet in the middle of Ho Chi Minh City - has a modern architecture with Vietnam's village style with green palm trees creating soft and cozy atmosphere. Seafood dishes and specialties countryside brings a Vietnamese culinary experience for you and leisurely meals

name: Ronin - Best Rooftop Izakaya, Yakitori & Sushi
address: 13 Pasteur, Ho Chi Minh City 7000 Vietnam
reviews: The skewers are smoky little miracles on sticks, and the miso soup tastes like someone’s grandmother still works the stove!, Amazing vibe. Friendly staff. Great food. Highly recommend for a special occasion or just a meet up with some friends. As for the Japanese whiskey. 😊
description: Rooftop Japanese Restaurant | Izakaya - Grill & Sushi | 360° Panoramic View - Eatery & Bar A must-visit destination for Yakitori, Sushi, and handcrafted Sakee & Beer. Discover a hidden Japanese bar perched above the bustling streets, offering a stunning cinematic view of the historic district.

name: Nous
address: 123 Lê Lợi 5th Floor, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The entry immediately asks: is this the right address? It looks like a building entrance with its scooter parking lot and its two guards dozing in front of a rose-tinted Vietnamese TV series. Well, yes, it's there at 42 Lý Tự Trọng Street, on the first floor. We feel a little reassured when entering the restaurant with its minimalist decoration, passing through an original “pivoting wine cellar” door. Don't be surprised, there are only 10 places and it is very possible that you will find yourself with other guests. We were 8 participants and were lucky enough to have the restaurant "privatized" And from there: Showtime! The show is as good in the ballet of dressage with 2, 4 or 6 hands as in the service, but especially in the plates. An explosion of flavors and dishes straight from the history of chefs. An opera in 6 courses that is worth the detour. Book in advance and do not hesitate to communicate by email with the team before your visit in order to prepare it as best as possible. For us it was a birthday and the kitchen team had prepared us a cute little cake with a candle.... I have read several reviews, but I have also experienced quite a few so-called gourmet restaurants and I have never had such an experience. Thank you to the Nous Dine team for this journey into your flavor capsule., To dine at Nous, booking is mandatory. I was told that 500,000VND deposit is required, as their kitchen prepares food daily based on the bookings and the seats are limited at 10. Fair enough. You'll start to be served the same time with all other patrons so being on time will be recommended. Welcome drink and welcome canape provided off the menu while waiting the service to be kicked off. Each course of the menu, you will be able to see how the chefs making and plating it in front of your eyes, then the host will introduce and explain the story behind it. It's interesting that they really take Vietnamese cuisine as the root and modernise the food in a more Western way and the food is really delicious and honest. Wine list is quite short tho. The Chef later will come to talk to each group of patrons and is keen to answer all of my questions. The service is very friendly and the atmosphere is cozy, "fine dining" feeling but warm hospitality. Highly recommended., One of my top choices for fine dining in Saigon is this exclusive restaurant, limited to just 10 guests per night. With that said, reservations and a deposit is a requirement. Its open kitchen setup provides diners with a captivating view of the meal preparation process, and each course comes with an entertaining story behind it. The Prix Fixe menu is exceptionally creative, it changes only once every three months.
description: Nous is Vietnam's very first Capsule restaurant. Our capsule restaurant is cozy and intimate and allows us to deliver an exceptional experience not only with our carefully crafted dishes, but also with our highly personal approach to cooking. With limited seats, our dream is to have each guest feel like they are a part of our story and engage with us as we bring local ingredients to life in a unique and compelling way while still remaining true to the flavors and places they came from. We are overwhelmed with joy and gratitude to be recognized as a Michelin-Selected Restaurant by the .

name: Ambrosia Café Bistro
address: 149 Nguyen Du, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We had the pleasure of visiting the restaurant during our round trip, and we loved it all. The atmosphere was cozy and welcoming, perfect for a special occasion. The food was an absolute treat, both taste and visually a highlight. The quality of the ingredients was noticeable, and the attention to detail was evident in every bite. The service was friendly and accommodating !, Evening meal with our touring group . We enjoyed the set meal. Food was of great quality and it kept coming. Beef rolls were especially good. Service was friendly and efficient. A great evening., The food is amazing. Great price for really great food. The atmosphere was also nice and calming with some nice relaxing jazz music. The tables were fancy but not too fancy. The portion sizes were also well though out.
description: Ambrosia is a fusion cafe and bistro in the heart of Saigon, offers you hot coffee, refreshing drinks, daily baked pastries and all day menu.

name: Bac Kim Thang Steamed Hotpot - Crescent Mall
address: 101 Ton Dat Tien Street 5F-53 5th Floor, Crescent Mall, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: It's close to home so I should try it. The first time I tried steamed food, I was very surprised. The dishes with chug and sauce are very rich, especially the lean and crispy pork is very fatty and delicious, the seafood fried rice is also very delicious. Phuc Customer service and enthusiasm will lead to long-term support❤️, Friendly staff from the door: plus mark Delicious food, drinks are mostly home made, frugal: plus mark Consultant creates member to receive 10% discount on bill: 2 plus points :)))) Nice space but the number of tables is still modest, the wait is a bit long: Slight minus (because it's a weekend), The restaurant space is airy, the staff is friendly and enthusiastic, the dishes are fresh, delicious and unique ♡ This is a restaurant worth experiencing 🫶🏻

name: Baozi
address: 165 Nguyen Thai Hoc Street District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Short Menu but tasty food! We ordered a bunch of Baos and Noodles. There is not much choice in terms of dishes but they were all good. Baos are small so order more than one per person., The soft shell craft i had was amazing. But the poached egg with bacon having with honey sauce was a little bit sweet for me. The ambience was perfect. All in all, everything was good., Great food and atmosphere. Craft beers available. Cocktails were well made. We ordered too much food and therefore found the price a little high. The portions are large. I’d suggest you order only one or two dishes at a time, regardless of whether they are shown as starters or mains on the menu. We saw quite a few people taking the food they could not finish away. I’d describe the food as Asian fusion. It’s delicious, but not traditional Vietnamese nor Bao. Be aware that you may have to pay a 10% service fee. We asked local Vietnamese customers about the service fee and they said they also paid the service fee.
description: Taiwanese and British cuisine with abit of swagger.

name: Chivago Chicken Vietnam - Fried Chicken & Beer
address: 161 Nguyen Thai Hoc Pham Ngu Lao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We popped in here for a meal purely by chance while walking past. There is a variety of Korean influenced fried chicken dishes and beers to select from. We selected a chicken curry dish - similar to a chicken katsu, and chili boneless chicken pieces with chips. The dishes came with a selection of Korean condiments including a delicious kimchi. The food was on the whole tasty and reasonably priced., Got their lovely fried chicken delivery for dinner. Taste was beautiful. Plates were big. Price were okay., Got there and was surprised it was empty, i guess not so well known yet, but from the start the staff was really helpful and nice we ordered 3 half portions and that was to much seams expensive when you look atcthe price but its REALLY NOT! One hald portion a person will mostly do we ended up the meal super full, the chicken it self was amazing, very well seasoned and very well fried the garlic soy sauce chicken wings are amazing, i would go back just for those!! the standard beer selection is pretty good catering to all kinds of tastes and the craft beers are great!!
description:
We popped in here for a meal purely by chance while walking past.

There is a variety of Korean influenced fried chicken dishes and beers to select from. We selected a chicken curry dish - similar to a chicken katsu, and chili boneless chicken pieces with chips. The dishes came with a selection of Korean condiments including a delicious kimchi. 

The food was on the whole tasty and reasonably priced.

name: Le Bacoulos
address: 13 Tong Huu Dinh Thao Dien, D.2, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Discovery above all curiosity. Impeccable welcome, support and accompaniment to a table, I had made a reservation but it does not seem necessary, we find the reflexes and scents of France. Study of the menu, very French cuisine, my Vietnamese family is pleasantly surprised, order and service, fast and very correct. The portions are correct and of very good quality. Some staff speak French and/or English, which simplifies things considerably. Thank you for the welcoming, Excellent value for money with a good variety of classic French cuisine dishes. There are starters, main courses and desserts with set menus. The establishment offers a bar as well as a restaurant with an indoor and outdoor section., Surprise in Thao Dien. Food is well served and well presented. One of my #3 french restaurant in HCMC. Lucnh formule is very honest. Will comeback again !!!

name: Hu Tieu Nam Vang Thanh Dat
address: 34 Co Bac Cau Ong Lanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: フーティウはベトナム南部発祥の細麺を使った汁麺です。日本で有名なフォーは実は北部発祥で、ホーチミンではあまり食べられていないとか。 こちらはフーティウの有名店ですが、店内は現地の方でいっぱいでローカルな雰囲気を楽しめます。味も評判通りの美味しさで、海老やレバー、豚肉、野菜等さまざまな具がはいって6万ドン弱でした。なお、英語メニューはなく話せる方もいないため、注文はやや大変でしたが店員さんも根気よく付き合ってくれました。 "Hu Tiu", one of the local cuisines in southern Vietnam, has thinner noodles than "Pho". *Actually, "Pho" originated in northern Vietnam. This restaurant is full of local people at lunchtime, so you can feel local lively atmosphere. And the taste is very good. It lives up to its reputation. They didn't have an English menu, but they helped me to order kindly., One of the best Hu Tieu I’ve tried in Saigon. The broth was super favorable and well balanced and a touch on the sweet side. The night we went they were out of egg noodles, but that didn’t change my experience. Super crowded, but super fast service. Highly recommended., Another kind of noodle besides Pho, this food is really really delicious. I recommend the dry noodle.

name: Arirang BBQ
address: 3rd Floor, 2 Dong Khoi Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Bad English but very good welcome Large choices of dishes (meat and fish) Nice view on the Saigon river Close to city center, Excellent Korean food! The location has a great view overlooking a bustling street and the river. The staff are friendly and attentive, and the food was fantastic! Highly recommended., The food was delicious! We got a private room to eat. The service was good, there was a language barrière but the staff really tried to help us. Good experience!

Large choices of dishes (meat and fish)
Nice view on the Saigon river
