name: Song Saigon Home Cuisine
address: 212 Nguyễn Văn Hưởng, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: The food is great, my favorite is Saigon bread, super delicious. The restaurant space is very cool and cozy, like dining at home and the staff is very enthusiastic, cheerful, and attentive. I will definitely come many more times., A Vietnamese restaurant in the Tao Dien district. The menu is written in English, so you can understand it to some extent. However, there are so many items on the menu that it was hard to decide what to order, so I ended up ordering two: "fresh spring rolls and spring rolls". I didn't know how to eat the fresh spring rolls, so I asked the staff, who kindly taught me, and I enjoyed eating them. The spring rolls were fried in rice paper and had a firm filling, so they were also very satisfying! This is a restaurant you should definitely visit when you visit Ho Chi Minh City!, I visited this restaurant after a friend recommended it to me. The staff were very friendly and I had a warm and welcoming meal. When I didn't know how to eat the food, they carefully explained how to eat the spring rolls. It's a perfect share for two people. It contains a variety of herbs, and the flavor can only be enjoyed at a local restaurant. I recommend you try the delicious local food eaten with your hands.
description: The food is great, my favorite is Saigon bread, super delicious. The restaurant space is very cool and cozy, like dining at home and the staff is very enthusiastic, cheerful, and attentive. I will definitely come many more times.

name: KOTO Saigon
address: 39 Le Duan 3rd Floor, Kumho Asiana Plaza, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: My kids aren't adventurous eaters so this restaurant was perfect for the adults to enjoy authentic Vietnamese food while the kids could choose from a western kids menu. The food was delicious, a bit different to a standard Vietnamese menus at home so I could try some new things. The concept behind the restaurant is great, helping street kids learn a trade and english and get work experience. We ate there twice in the 4 night we were in HCM City., This restaurant is not-for-profit and helps underprivileged kids learn important useful skills to help them get a leg up in life. The food was delicious and the waiters and waitresses very attentive. For westerners the price seemed unbelievably cheap (as is common here). But it felt so good to be supporting such a great cause. Highly recommend it., Honestly one of the best restaurants I have ever been too. Not just the food was good but the staff were friendly and kind but most off all the resoning behind the amazing organisation amazed us to the core. Not only do you just eat the incredible food you also get a visit at the end of your meal from the head chef, who tells you more about the organisation. I would like to thank Quyen (head chef at Saigon koto) for his wonderful food and for informing us about the organisation he works for. I truly believe that koto is the future.
description: KOTO Kumho - a KOTO Training Restaurant is one of the most unique experiences for visitors to Ho Chi Minh City. KOTO Kumho is part of KOTO, which means "Know one, teach one". It is a not-for-profit social enterprise training programme, which works with at-risk and disadvantaged youth in Vietnam and empowers them with to learn and strive in their lives. KOTO is a unique not-for-profit social enterprise that started in 1999 in Hanoi. The program targets at-risk and disadvantaged youth—aged 16 to 22—with a 24-month-long training program in vocational hospitality, life skills and English. KOTO’s Vision Positive permanent change for at-risk and disadvantaged youth through the transformative power of social enterprise. KOTO’s Mission We believe at-risk and disadvantaged youth should have access to a holistic program that provides career training and life skills in a nurturing environment, where each builds self confidence and exercises their right to live a life of dignity.

name: Hai Ky Mi Gia
address: 349 - 351 Nguyen Trai Street, Ward 7, District 5, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: If you like duck noodle soup and wonton, its the place to eat!! Better than here in California , will definitely be back on next trip, Ordered the duck noodles with mushroom & the wonton soup. Loved both of them! They basically served a huge portion of duck, but the duck was wonderfully tender (not dry, like I expected it to be). They make the noodles themselves too, and I enjoyed the texture very much. The broth was also tastefully done. Definitely recommend a trip here if you’re in the cholon area!, While in Saigon I had visited this restaurant twice. The bowl may look small but the duck thigh was huge, the price was high but it's worth. Definitely comeback here in the future
description: If you like duck noodle soup and wonton, its the place to eat!! Better than here in California , will definitely be back on next trip

name: A Mà Kitchen
address: 62 Vo Van Tan, Ward 6, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Amazing Food & Outstanding Service – Highly Recommended! My husband and I came here after our friend Danh recommended Ma Kitchen, and we’re so glad we did! We tried the truffle rice with abalone, various drinks, and several other dishes, and everything was delicious. The food was so good that we came back the next day to try even more, and once again, it did not disappoint! The service was exceptional—staff were friendly, helpful, and welcoming. The restaurant is very clean, beautifully decorated, and creates a warm, inviting atmosphere. We will definitely return before we head home and highly recommend this restaurant to everyone. You can truly feel the passion and heart they put into their food and service, ensuring every customer has a fantastic dining experience. If they ever plan to expand to the U.S., I’d love to be a part of helping them grow—this level of quality and care deserves to be shared!, Purposely came here for their dimsum. A fine selection of dimsum, must say: delicate, bursting and good size. The charsiew was flavourful and the fried rice was delicious. Service was friendly, efficient and subtle too. To be more precise, the service was second to none and the food was served with poise and speed. The evening was a delight. No faults at all. From start to finish, it was a great meal and evening. Definitely worth the price and for celebratory occasions. Book well in advance as they fill up quick., Delicous food, Warmth vibes, fast service. My family order a lot of Food, After 10 minutes food came, we really enjoy. Will come back when I go to HCM City Must try restaurant
description: Hongkong style restaurant

name: The Gangs - Grill & Beer
address: 131 Nguyen Phuc Nguyen Ward 10, Dist.3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: They have some food combo so big but food just so so, a lar carte food is better. Staff friendly, Bbq food full selection at here., We found this place by chance, it’s close to the railway station. All the dishes we chose were based around an amazing garlic sauce. We had the ribs, tender and delicious, the eggplant and okra, pork with garlic sauce and the garlic fried rice. The ribs came with a knob of delicious roasted garlic, salad and best kimchi we have ever eaten. The price was reasonable and the service was great., I visit their new location at 32 Mac Dinh Chi, district 1. It is better than what other review said about the different location. The food is pretty good. Seafood is fresh, especially oyster. Boneless beef ribs is so tasty. They have good selection of light beer and cider. I got ginger beer (I think they should put it in cider group in stead of beer), rooster, and hoegaarden (which has orange aroma and light as Budweiser). Most of beer has average of 4-5% alcohol. Just one downside is their design pretty weird with the lights around. They are hot and too bright.
description: They have some food combo so big but food just so so, a lar carte food is better. Staff friendly, Bbq food full selection at here.

name: Bistro Tony
address: 30A Nguyễn Ư Dĩ, quận 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Restaurant offering very good quality French dishes with a touch of Vietnamese flavors, all with nice portions. The manager, Tony, is friendly and will be able to advise you on the menu while chatting with you in a very friendly manner. Many dishes are available (starters, main courses, desserts) and the restaurant also has an open kitchen where you can see the cooks working on the dishes., Tony Bistro is a nice French fusion restaurant known for its cozy ambiance and delicious food. They use fresh ingredients in every dish, ensuring a burst of flavor with each bite. Despite the high quality, their prices remain reasonable, making it a popular choice for both locals and visitors. Whether you're craving classic French dishes or innovative fusion creations, Tony Bistro promises a memorable dining experience that will leave you wanting more., A real surprise and a real pleasure to discover this restaurant, with a cozy atmosphere that changes the deafening noise that is quite often found in restaurants in Vietnam. The cuisine is refined, sought after, based on French cuisine with a twist of originality from chef Tony, who warmly welcomed us. The service is neat, the staff very attentive and well trained. Excellent quality/price with a wide selection of wines. A good address to remember in Saigon.

Restaurant offering very good quality French dishes with a touch of Vietnamese flavors, all with nice portions. 

The manager, Tony, is friendly and will be able to advise you on the menu while chatting with you in a very friendly manner. 

Many dishes are available (starters, main courses, desserts) and the restaurant also has an open kitchen where you can see the cooks working on the dishes.

name: River View Restaurant And Coffee
address: 8/11 Street 49B Thao Dien, District 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I had lunch here today for the first time. The owner came out to greet us - a very friendly chap from Upper Egypt. We ordered a range of vegetarian dishes, all of which were tasty: babaganoush, humus, felafel, okra and beans. Together with Arabic bread. An excellent meal and cheap too: 370,000 VND for everything. The only downside was the pong from the adjacent river, so perhaps sitting inside is advisable., This evening I just want to go around to buy some stuffs but accidentally I passed by this restaurant in order to enjoy good food with nice soft drink . They have shisha to chill too but I actually like their view because outside so hustle and bustle to observ all people’s activities, I have passed it many times but today I tried to stop by to taste it that is perfect tasting food with good price for Vietnamese or foreigners too . I honestly recommend this restaurant for all like Egypt food or trying a new taste.

name: Naked Sushi & Sashimi
address: 39 Truong Dinh Ward 6, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Best restaurant around the city. Welcoming, fresh amazing food and best service. Wish you also had a restaurant in Australia, We go here at least once a month. Excellent food, timely service and quite relaxing atmosphere. The staff are great, very attentive, without being intrusive, very friendly and professional., Third visit and every dish a winner. Sashimi is really fresh and perfect temperature Duck, prawn and salads all great. Service is friendly and efficient.
description: Best restaurant around the city. Welcoming, fresh amazing food and best service. Wish you also had a restaurant in Australia

name: Viet Village Restaurant
address: 15 Dinh Tien Hoang st, Da Kao Ward, Ho Chi Minh City 848 Vietnam
reviews: I visited here with a tour group I was with on a 12 day tour of Vietnam. From my perspective, this appears to be a restaurant which currently caters to tour groups and serves the food family style to tables between six and 12 people. The food was decent but it took almost two hours to serve the 4-5 separate dishes. Nothing special., This was the place for dinner tonight for our Gate 1 group. Nothing wrong with it, it’s just OK. The other restaurants where we had dined, as a large group, were much better. The rice was dry, the chicken not so appetizing but other things were just fine. As a group activity it’s acceptable but if I were making a choice to go out for dinner it wouldn’t be here., We asked our local tour guide to recommend an authentic Vietnamese restaurant. He took us to Vietnam Village. We were to only ones there for dinner. The restaurant was very clean. We were told they just recently opened. The wait staff was friendly and the service fast. We finished a 5 course meal in less than an hour. We did not feel rushed. The food was better than some of the other places on the tour, but just average. We were told that Pho was a traditional dish, but was not served any type of noodles.
description: Born in a French Colonial style in conjunction with completely modern facilities as well as an experienced, well-trained and highly professional catering team, Viet Village are pleased to cater a complete selection of all iconic dishes from North, Mid to South Vietnam. Viet Village was also launched with the ambition to become one of the best traditional restaurant in catering for international guest and travelers in Ho Chi Minh city.

name: Beef 7 Items Restaurant
address: 320 Binh Quoi Street, Ward 28, Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: I took my family to dinner and I enjoyed the atmosphere and really enjoyed the food. I was also impressed on how the waiter was on point., A great little restaurant just near Saigon Domaine apartments, with amazing food and service. We couldn't understand the menu as it was in Vietnamese, but one of the lovely staff members explained it to us in beautiful English. A delicious meal in a lovely relaxed setting
description: I took my family to dinner and I enjoyed the atmosphere and really enjoyed the food. I was also impressed on how the waiter was on point.

name: Matsuri Japanese Restaurant - Nguyen Hue
address: 3-5-7 Nguyen Hue, Ben Nghe, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Had a fantastic birthday celebration at Matsuri! The festive decor, great view, and cozy ambiance set the perfect mood. The food was amazing—fresh sashimi, sushi, vibrant salad, and flavorful grilled eel, all beautifully presented. Attentive service and authentic Japanese flavors made it an unforgettable experience. Highly recommended!, A great place to enjoy Japanese cusine with friends and family. Delicious food, fresh sashimi, cozy Chistmas decoration. Niceee!!, Came up the stairs with concern. WOW a surprise, beautiful decor, amazing food and friendly and obliging staff. The best Japanese ever and great views as well.
description: A miniature Japanese cuisine universe In Japanese language, Matsuri is the word for festive. This is the principle of our restaurant, bringing festival atmosphere to our guests. Especially, Matsuri Japanese Restaurant is a culinary address, unique in serving traditional Japanese cuisine “Washoku” blended with fusion dishes representing Japanized forms of European dishes “Yoshoku”, aka Western food reinvented the Japanese way. By introducing Japan’s two main categories of food, Matsuri Japanese Restaurant confidently delivering our dear guests extraordinary and satisfying dining experience.

name: Quan 94
address: 94 Dinh Tien Hoang Dakao Ward, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: There is a similar restaurant next door, but the quality of the Ca Mau crabs they use and the dishes are completely different. Be careful, as guidebooks for Japanese tourists seem to be written by people with no taste. I recommend the crab soup that comes with crab fried rice, deep fried spring rolls and bun cha. Foreigners can ask to sit on the second floor where it is air-conditioned. Even if you eat to your heart's content, it's super cheap at less than 2,000 yen per person, and it has a good reputation among locals., Only locals spotted today, even though they are listed in my guide book. They have a good reputation for their crab dishes, such as crab nem, or the crab wings in tamarind sauce., Great food. Value for money. Easy to get there. Good services and friendly staff. Recommend others to visit.

name: Com Tam Nguyen Van Cu
address: 167 Nguyen Van Cu, P.2, Q.5, TP. Hcm, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant has been famous in Saigon for decades, so I decided to give it a try. My friend and I ordered the pork chop with pork pie and shredded pork skin, and a bowl of veggie soup. The prices here are on the higher side compared to other places, with just the pork chop dish costing 170vnd and the soup 50vnd. The pork chop was too huge to me, and the shredded pork skin was thinly sliced, with thick slices of meat beautifully arranged on top. Pork pie is not good, i dont like it. The pork chop was marinated well, and the fish sauce that came with it was perfectly balanced. The soup was hearty, with lots of vegetables and tender ribs, and it tasted okay. However, the space was quite hot and smoky, and the food took a long time to arrive even though the restaurant wasn’t busy. When I ordered a takeaway portion, they didn’t include pickled vegetables, only fish sauce, which was a bit disappointing., One of the best com tam I'd tried in Saigon, with soft and tender pork chop, very soft and moist rice, chã is one the best I tried so far and sauces is well taste. Pricing at 140k dong ($9 aud), for pork chop with chã and rice relatively expensive for Vietnamese people. However beware of the pricing charge, no menu with price on it (no transparent), offering tea but might include in the charges, even customers don't drink or ask for it. Like many restaurant in Saigon, restaurant leave wet wipe on the table and when customers don't use it they still get charges, which I found very shifty. I happy to provide tips but dishonest business should be prohibited! Three star rating for the food but no star for service and no star for the pricing transparency., I give this restaurant 4 stars because of their location is too small and my family had to sit in the same table with other family during lunch. And foods served slow.

This restaurant has been famous in Saigon for decades, so I decided to give it a try. My friend and I ordered the pork chop with pork pie and shredded pork skin, and a bowl of veggie soup. The pork chop was too huge to me, and the shredded pork skin was thinly sliced, with thick slices of meat beautifully arranged on top. Pork pie is not good, i dont like it. However, the space was quite hot and smoky, and the food took a long time to arrive even though the restaurant wasn’t busy. When I ordered a takeaway portion, they didn’t include pickled vegetables, only fish sauce, which was a bit disappointing.

name: Sakura Yakiniku Pasteur
address: 182 Pasteur Ben Nghe, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: If you love Japanese food, or even if you’ve never tried it before -you are in for a treat. Plenty of Wagyu beef /meat platter options for teppanyaki. We also had the salad cá hoi tuoi which was really refreshing. The Korean pancakes were a revelation-never tried those before and loved them. It’s a shame we only discovered this restaurant on our last night in Saigon as we would have loved to eat here again., The food was delicious and the service was amazing! The waitress were very polite and kind! I totally recommend this restaurant!, Amazing. We are from spain and we ate so well. The meat is incredible and the other things too. I really recommended. The service is excellent
description: Inspired by Sakura, Japan's national flower, Sakura Yakiniku offers a culinary journey to the heart of Japan through the art of Yakiniku. Since 2008, our restaurant has been an authentic and original destination for those seeking traditional Japanese barbecue in Vietnam.

name: Pho Dinh Restaurant 5
address: 73 Hoang Van Thai Tan Phu Ward, District 7, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: This is a part of well known BBQ franchise called Uraetei. As often happens to successful franchise, the quality of food and service went down quickly, while prices gradually go up. Unfortunately this has dropped out of my restaurant list. There are many better BBQ restaurant choices in District 7 around so called Korean Town., Knowing how much the Vietnamese love their Bbq we went to Pho Dinh Restaurant at the recommendation of a friend. Disappointment on arrival to discover it wasn't a Vietnamese Bbq however thought we would give it a go anyway. Once we got someone's attention to order - the food arrived quite promptly. The seating is in booths, service was friendly, the food OK, no wine by the glass so had beers. Note this is NOT a complaint - seemed like we were in Japan not Saigon, and missed that jovial noisy casual atmosphere. Yes I know we could have gone somewhere else - this may help someone else ..., I was at next door Ibis so went a couple of times to this restaurant. The staff is very kind and food great. They don’t have wine by the glass so if you are alone it is difficult that you have a full bottle.
description: This is a part of well known BBQ franchise called Uraetei. As often happens to successful franchise, the quality of food and service went down quickly, while prices gradually go up. Unfortunately this has dropped out of my restaurant list. There are many better BBQ restaurant choices in District 7 around so called Korean Town.

name: The BEM Saigon - Craft Beer & Food
address: 2F - 120 Cong Quynh District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: As a fan of craft beers, I do love to explore more amazing beers. BEM has wide range of craft beers which are very tasty and awesome. In my opinion, local craft beers such as pasteur street or rooster beers are so so good! especially pairing with BEM food. Dont forget to try their new dish: bone marrow, so juicy & tender!!! My favorite spot is out side, where can enjoy the view of Bui Vien street. Definitely come back again with my friends! Recommended, we accidentally found this place on our trip to saigon last time. it was located on 2nd floor of an old building. you can choose wide range of craft beers here along with other spirits. we did ordered local craft beers from Pasteur street brewery & Belgo brewery which were awesome. Highly recommended for those who really want a speakeasy place., Been here every day of our trip. Delicious beer in chilled glasses and occasionally some peanuts on the side. Great spot and variety of beers.
description: The BEM Saigon is a unique and vintage craft beer & snack bar located on one of the most bustle streets in town created for young people Bui Vien. This is a place where you can be wild with your friends or fellows after a hard working day or just chill at night. The BEM Saigon welcomes and treats you well with a variety of craft beer & finger food. The vintage-inspired interior and soundtrack chose by its jazz-loving owners, enhance the bar unique and retro feel. Coming to The BEM to break down all barriers, rules and for endless fun, pleasure & freedom. Address: 2F- 120 Cong Quynh, Dist. 1, HCMC

name: Nephele Restaurant
address: 125/12 Nguyen Cuu Van Street, Ward 17 Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Excellent discovery this gem opened only 6 months ago , very innovative fusion cuisine dégustation menu is a must. , perfect wine pairing , the pigeon was cooked to perfection, from the amuse bouche to the dessert everything is a festival of savour, attentive service , nice cozy atmosphere Reservation recommended. A bit pricy but with every dong. I will go back for sure
description: Nestled in the vibrant heart of Ho Chi Minh City, Nephele offers a distinctive culinary experience, where locally sourced and seasonal ingredients are celebrated through the mastery of Chef-Patron Francis Thuan’s wood-fired cooking.

name: Lau De Truong Dinh
address: 105 Truong Dinh St., Dist.3, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Excellent food. I've tried goat in the UK in either Indian or Carribbean food and not particularly enjoyed it however this was a completely different experience. We shared goat curry, goat fillet with lime sauce and vegetables with noodles. We ordered the smaller portion of each - there was a lot of food! It was our first time trying fresh lemon soda with salt - highly recommended. We also inadvertently got involved in a young boys birthday party 🎈🎈🎈and were made to feel very welcome. Staff were very friendly and helpful., Fell upon this corner joint Saturday afternoon. We had some beers and grilled spinach with goat meat amd garlic -yum! We were definitely the only tourists in there but they were helpful and friendly. Six beers and what was a meal later…..$12😉 wish we would have ordered the brains just to say we did., We had both the goat grill and hotpot. Very local cuisine and wonderful experience. Servers number 10 & 18 were excellent. Even though they don't speak English but using the art of sign language and Google translate all was well. Ha ha! They taught us how to eat the bbq meat. It was delicious and fun.

name: 7Fuku Izakaya
address: 212 De Tham Street, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: The menu boasts a delightful array of Japanese izakaya dishes, each crafted with precision and bursting with flavors. The sashimi was incredibly fresh, and the takoyaki was a savory delight. What impressed me the most was the attention to detail in each dish – a true testament to the chef's dedication to quality. The service was impeccable. The staff was attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable about the menu. They offered excellent recommendations and made sure every aspect of our dining experience was enjoyable., Great japanese resturant with many staple dishes from Sushi to Okonomiyaki! Great service, beautiful building and spaceious place, with three levels! The food was fresh, delicious and not to pricey!, Really good service, great cold beer, food really tasty and would recommend to others We sat outside and relaxing to watch the world go by!
description:
The menu boasts a delightful array of Japanese izakaya dishes, each crafted with precision and bursting with flavors. The sashimi was incredibly fresh, and the takoyaki was a savory delight. The service was impeccable. The staff was attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable about the menu. They offered excellent recommendations and made sure every aspect of our dining experience was enjoyable.

name: Casablanca Restolounge’n Bar
address: 54 Le Thanh Ton District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We intended to head for a Thai place given my wife’s fatigue with veg options at a standard Pho place. While in cab we just happened to see this place and decided to stop by for lunch on our first day at HCM. Casablanca as name suggests serves Moroccan cuisine. Very nicely done up (ref pictures). The menu is pricey given its location and decor. Food is a mixed bag. Some good dishes offset by some not so good ones. We ordered a couple of dishes. Good & great Chicken Skewer, Hummus & Veg Tajines. Not so great - Seafood Paella, lacked flavour probably no saffron. Needs real improvement - Casablanca Delight. Terribly sweet and was very ordinary. Wouldn’t recommend at all. Drinks - Beer on tap is pricey and best avoided.. Service is excellent. Def worth a visit if you are looking for options in HCM / Vietnam., We went with 9 friends to this place and had a mixed experience. The owner is nice and friendly but has to work on the service level of his staff. The food was very good for sure reason to go. Wine is in line with the price but no very good wines on the menu. But recommend to try it out., Casablanca serves amazing Moroccan dishes. The mezzes, tajine and couscous we tried were all absolutely gorgeous. It’s clear everything is made with fresh ingredients and by a passionate chef. The staff was great and went out of their way to make my birthday party unforgettable. Have a look at the recently renovated bar upstairs too! Good vibes and delicious cocktails. Highly recommended!
description: Our story is as old as it is new - embrace a cuisine influenced by ancient Arabic and Mediterranean cultures and create fresh, new flavor profiles. Ras el hanout is an essential ingredient and we use over 20 different spices to create our own blend. It gives foods fragrant, aromatic and warmly spiced flavors that Moroccan dishes are renown for. Breakfast, lunch or dinner, it's a great place for chilling out with a pot of Moroccan mint or selection of fruit teas and coffees. A chill bar that offers up our signature cocktails like the dusty camel, Rick’s Cafe Americain and Ilsa’s Choice. Casablanca never had it so good. We welcome you to discover classic and contemporary fare. We hope you enjoy our take on a timeless cuisine. It’s the beginning of a beautiful friendship.

name: Zen Saigon Japanese Yakitori Restaurant
address: Saigon Sky Garden, 20 Le Thanh Ton Street, Distric 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant comes across as having been around for a long time and is a popular haunt by locals. We had a late lunch and as a result, grilled dishes were not available. We ordered a set lunch which included an assortment of sashimi, assortment of tempura, rice, soup, and we added chawanmushi, deep fried squid head and lime tea. It’s odd that a Japanese restaurant did not offer green tea or roasted barley tea on its beverage menu. The serving was generous and food tasted good. But the tempura did not appear like tempura. Rather, it looked like they used the wrong batter. Price is reasonable and taste is good. But not very authentic Japanese looking food, if you asked me. Although, I understand the owner is a Japanese!, Japanese food is aplenty in Saigon but Zen is more than a household name. Though its my first time having lunch there, I can certainly appreciate why it is one of my Viet friend's favourite haunt. The sashimi is super fresh and the yakitori sticks are perfectly grilled without being charred. The side dishes of cold somen and miso soup were exceptionally tasty without the usual heavy saltiness of soy and miso. Delicious and unpretentious traditional Japanese food coupled with the warm ambience and friendly service makes it a worthwhile Japanese food choice when visiting Saigon., This place serves up very generous potions at a reasonable price. Its not a place with exceptional décor, but a standard industrial eatery very common in Japan.

name: Pizza Reale
address: 27-29 Nguyen Dang Giai Thao Dien Ward, District 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: As this is in lockdown was unable to visit the restaurant.Tried to order online but was confusing so phoned direct and ordered so much more easy . When I ordered they said will be there in 20 minutes thought they were kidding cause even dominos takes almost 30 minutes. But sure enough in 20 minutes they were delivering and the pizza was like hot right out of oven . The pizza is very authentic Italian style using high quality ingredients and is cooked in a wood fire oven . There was a promotion that day buy a pizza get a margarita pizza free so with already reasonable prices the value was incredible Overall incredible fast friendly service ,incredible taste ,incredible value . I have eaten many of the top pizzas in Saigon and we are lucky to have so many great pizza restaurants I consider REALE right up there with the best, First visit to Pizza Reale with a friend and we had such a pleasant surprise. The staff were very welcoming and attentive and overall the food was delightful. The wine was pleasant enough. We shared both a pizza and a pasta dish. The pizza was exceptionally nice, with a tasty tomato and cheese base, capers, black olives , hame and we asked if we could change the mushrooms for pineapple which they agreed to straightaway. The french fries were tasty and piping hot, as was the pizza. The pasts dish arrived soon after but was luke warm. When it was returned somewhat warmer the taste could be appreciated a lot more. The meatballs were so well cooked and melt in your mouth, the rigatoni to the right al dente and the tomato sauce was also very good. The food was served with a generous portion of Parmesan cheese as a side dish and the home made tartar sauce that accompanied the french fries was lovely. My friend had the Tiramisu for desert and said it was beautiful. I has the Dolce Vita vanilla ice cream which had a standard vanilla flavour, with a tasty espresso to pour over it. It was very quiet there but it was very early evening so next time we will go a lot later. But a very pleasant find indeed and very close to our homes., Ordered a bruschetta which was tasty and original presentation. The pizza reale was crunchy with thin paste (many Italian can't do it like that) with superb topping dry meat. The chitarra seafood. pasta was well cooked and I recommend to add a bit more seafood. Red wine bottle was very nice even if from 2019. Service was good and efficient.
description: Simple original Italian food, our specialties are Pizzas cooked in the wood oven, arrived directly from Italy... Our Pizza dough have 30 hours of maturation

name: The First Restaurant & Bar
address: 23 Huynh Thuc Khang St., Ben Nghe Ward, Dist 1, Ho Chi Minh City 840000 Vietnam
reviews: I went there for a drink before bed on the recommendation of the owner of a nearby Japanese restaurant. I was tired of the women filling the streets around me, so when I stepped inside the bar, I was relieved by the quiet atmosphere and the appearance of a real bar. The sign and door are so inconspicuous that you wouldn't notice it unless someone told you, so I had to look carefully for it., Great food (highly recommend all the sashimi menu) and drinks. I enjoy most drinks its offer, but the plum liquor/umeshu is beyond excellent, a must-have. Friendly staff and owner. Great location as well., Seek this Restaurant out and enjoy everything the have to offer!.Weather your traveling solo or have a large group this place can accommodate all your needs from a night out on a date or a large group doing business this location is here to serve and they have proven to do everything just right very detail oriented and extremely friendly staff.Super happy to have found this just by exploring the area that was nearby my hotel.⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
description: Japanese style restaurant & bar

name: Mr Lucky Club
address: 102- 104- 106 Lê Thị Hồng Gấm phường Nguyễn Thái Bình, quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Located in the 9th floor of Lotus hotel righ in the center of D1 so the view is magnificent, ngl. The staffs are very friendly, attentive and make great recommendation. Thus, there are wide variety of food and beverages which are outstandingly delicious. The price are suprisingly affordable compare to other bars in the same area. It's an absolutely great experience and can't wait to return ASAP. Highly recommended., Minh rat thich quan. Thoang mat, city view, nhan vien rat de thuong dac biet la ban Huy, Duy va Tran. Luc dau minh order Long Island, con Old Fashion minh quen chup roi, Had a fun night with great music, delicious drinks and an amazing view over Saigon. Highly recommend
description: At the Lotus Central Hotel rooftop you find the beautiful Mr. Lucky Club. From the indoor 8th level restaurant, a couple of stairs leads up to the 9th floor rooftop bar and terrace, offering breathtaking views of the Saigon skyline. With a unique and luxurious setting, lots of wooden details, the terrace really has the feeling of a very natural and clean oasis right in the buzzing city. Enjoy well crafted and fine looking cocktails and light snacks in a great atmosphere.

name: Al Fresco's
address: 16, Nguyen Thi Nghia Street, District 1 Located just behind the New World Hotel and across the street from the giant Starbucks., Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Even when you travel in another country sampling, all the great native foods, every now, and then you just feel like having something that reminds you of home. This was the case of us last night when we spoke to our wink hotel local guide, saying that we were in the mood for something Italian. We were directed to Al frescoes. A quick grab ride. We were greeted at the door by a lady who had the biggest smile, and we were directed to our seat. The menu had a good range from salads to pasta to pizza,some Korean items, but what caught us was the good old Aussie pub favourites, the chicken, parmi, and the humble cheeseburger. I was even asked how I would look how I would like the cheeseburger patties cooked - medium or well done, I went with medium rare. While we were waiting for our food to be cooked, we took part in a jug (very aussie ) of Sangria. The food arrived hot, my partners parmigiana was the thickest I've seen in a long time but it was perfectly cooked. The cheeseburger was so tasty, the juices dripping onto the plate. The tastes took us back home just for that evening. We finished off with a huge apple crumble and ice cream for her and a chocolate pudding for me. Did we overdo it?- Definitely. Did we enjoy it ? Yes. Would we go back again? - of course. Now, it's not the cheapest meal we have done while here but was very nice. If you are after candlelight and romance, then this is not the place for you, but it you are into pizza and pasta plus more, done nicely and quickly. This just might be the place., If you are tired of Vietnamese food, that is the best place to eat European food. Pizza is awesome! Al Fresco’s salad is much better than any Vietnamese one! Tasty nachos and mango juice. We were really happy and satisfied with all the dishes, but I would say that prices are high. They have sofas ( not chairs) and tissues on tables, that make you feel like in Europe 😂 Nice place for foreigners! I highly recommend it., Family was tired of Pho, noodles and rice. Wanted something different, walked around hotel area, found this place. Kids said okay to pizza even if its not from our local place at home. Went on tues afternoon, ordered a peperoni pizza and come to find out it, it was 2 for 1 day. So, got a BBQ chicken pizza to boot. Price for XL was about 300k dong, but for 2, all the more better. Waited 20 mins for them to cook it, walked it back to hotel, family chowed down. We enjoyed it, asked staff for plastic plates and napkins, was all good. Would recommend.

reviews: The food here is absolutely delicious! Every dish is well-prepared, flavorful, and beautifully presented. My group truly enjoys the variety of flavors and the freshness of the ingredients. Everyone is extremely satisfied and appreciates the wonderful dining experience., The ambiance upon entering is wonderful, and the venue is well-maintained. The seating arrangement is comfortable, and we enjoyed a lunch buffet that was absolutely delicious—honestly, even better than in India! Both the vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes were outstanding and exceeded expectations. It's a must-visit spot for a meal if you're coming to the Cu Chi Tunnels, just a 4-minute drive from the sightseeing area. A special thanks to Rohit and Ritesh for their exceptional service!, Very nice homely food. Very good service as well. reviews: The restaurant's space is extremely cozy, suitable for family meals or dates. The food is excellent, very satisfying and the portions are large, suitable for the price. The dish has a delicious taste and beautiful decoration, a must try when coming to Saigon!!, I came Thao Dien with My friend and i found this new restaurant, they opened in the end of Sep I heard that the Founder is Korean and who joined master chef , i didnt come Japan before but for my taste the food is so good I love maze noodle and omurice If you come there please add extra tonkatsu also

name: Pasteur Street Craft Beer - Thao Dien Taproom
address: 120 Xuan Thuy, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Excellent craft beer in a contemporary setting. Solid core beers with a good range of seasonal crafts to keep things interesting. Traditional craft beer with a Vietnamese twist. The burgers are outstanding, especially the holy guacamole and the Nashville style chicken burger. Special mention to Ti and Kurt, super friendly and attentive bar staff., This is an amazing little bar in Pasteur Street. Loads of different craft beers plus a really interesting menu - some great snack options. Most of all the staff are incredible - so friendly and accommodating. Definitely recommend a visit, Undoubtedly the best part of Pasteur street is the craft beer, wide variety of choices to suit your taste. The food is not bad, it is worth it for the price. It’s also super fun to have the option to play table football with friends or family. However, the service was the only thing holding me back from giving the restaurant 5 stars. Although staff were nice, they seemed to be always distracted and were not very attentive. It took my family and I quite a few times to get their attention for them to take our order or get the bill. Which, isn’t great considering we were the only ones sitting inside of the actual restaurant. Will be back soon to see if things have improved!
description: Located in the crowded Thao Dien area, Thao Dien Taproom offers you a spacious venue with up to 115 seats for your events and private parties.

name: Vicolo1
address: 232 Bui Vien Pham Ngu Lao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Some very nice people who care about their food and their customers. It is refreshing stopping in once or twice a week for a piece of fresh pizza, also one of the few places you can get good pizza by the slice, so you dont have to buy a whole Pizza if you dont need a whole pizza. Good for grabbing a slice on the run as well! Perhaps my favorite point about this place is the atmosphere. The owners, staff and customers are all respectful & positive, the mood is special there., Love this bar. Great owner and beer selection. The girl who works here is super cheery and always makes my day to see her so happy. Pizza is delicious, good music and super laid back atmosphere., Awesome place to start with hmmmm... like everything is alive there, serves good food and beverages plus their staff gives great service. Love how the place is decorated. Trust me this is the best choice. I'm gonna come again ofc.
description: Vicolo1 was established in 2015 by a group of dynamic & passionate professional people, these people happened to be friends, and colleagues in their previous experiences gathered throughout many years of travelling and working in the hospitality business. Our mission is to bring a new unique food experience with attentiveness to the world's trends always being mindful of what people are looking for now days: hearty, modern, innovative & well priced offers !

Both were fine, +/- 100k dong per dish, 29k per beer and 2k if you use the packaged wet towel left on the table with your order. Quick service from friendly young people, nothing to complain about., Amazing Vietnamese food at very affordable prices. Great friendly service. Street seating to enjoy the local ambiance, and also indoor seating with air conditioning. Highly recommended 5*

reviews: We came here for the meat. We had a pleasant time. The meat is more than perfect and the cooking is well mastered. We took the dish to share for 2 with 3 different meats, the special. Top for our last meal in Vietnam, the team is very professional and classy., This is a very good option, it is a nice ambiance and the food is good. It is not the first time have been there and definitely worth trying., This is one the best restaurants we have been to. From the time we arrived, we were welcomed by staff and the owner. Chow !!! We ordered our meal and drinks and our first delight arrived at our table served in a glass case. Not only delicious, it was lovely and elegant to look at. This was followed by our entrée of sashimi. So tasteful, it melted in your mouth. My husband is not into raw fish but he ate this without any problem at all. Being true blue Kiwi, he had the steak from New Zealand while I had the hamburger. Honestly, both dishes were tender and so tasty. Once we finished, we headed down stairs to pay. The owner came to farewell us sending us on our way with a small gift. A fantastic experience with great food and great hospitality. We hope to return before we leave Ho Chi MInh City.

name: Yu Shang Lou - Fine Chinese Cuisine
address: 975 Tran Hung Dao Ward 5, District 5, Ho Chi Minh City 72720 Vietnam
reviews: Just a cut above the stantard Chinese and Vietnamese restaurants. Nice atmosphere... Beautiful food so fresh and very tasty. Quality is good. Service is good. Yes a little bit more expensive than other restaurants but I have becoming to this restaurant for over two years and it is still presenting quality food and we love it.. So yes worth a vist..., I have had a very nice dinner at this restaurant yesterday. It’s a good change from the usual Vietnamese food. In fact the Cantonese cuisine in the menu were so tempting. As single traveller I’ve picked 3 small dishes to savor. The service was exceptionally good with the waiter trying to communicate with their best effect. Finally the waiter spoke in Mandarin and the rest was so easy. The dishes were very delicious, especially the cracking roast pork, so crispy on the skin and yet juicy as you bite it in your mouth. After dinner, I was given free tasting of their moon cake as it was near the festival. The moon cake was very tasty. I ended up purchasing 1 box of 4 pieces to take home. Will definitely visit this restaurant again in my next visit to HCMC. The attentive waiter has made a difference for my first experience in this restaurant., Nice Chinese Cuisine,n good service in Ho Chi Ming City (Vietnam),i have try it with my Friend already .is Nice,
description: Experience the art of Chinese cuisine at YU SHANG LOU restaurant, as our expert chefs take you on a journey of discovery based on excellent food, impeccable service, and an elegant atmosphere. Enjoy a new take on familiar flavors, where we blend eastern and western cooking techniques with a modern, sophisticated flair that will give you a fresh taste of traditional Chinese food.

name: Quán Bụi Garden 2
address: 3 Tran Ngoc Dien, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Have come here several times for dinner with my family. The canh chua is great. The appetizer variety platter is also exceptional. Dining upstairs is peaceful and air conditioned. Waitstaff are exceptionally attentive and prices are very reasonable for the quality of food and service. Truly a top notch restaurant in a sea of many choices., Cuisine at Quan Bui Thao Dien is a perfect symphony between traditional flavors and modern creativity. I have tried many dishes, from familiar dishes such as spring rolls, Hanoi vermicelli, beef pho,... to specialties from 3 different regions. Each dish has its own unique flavor, is made from fresh ingredients and ensures food hygiene and safety. Besides the delicious food, the service at Quan Bui Thao Dien also makes me extremely satisfied. Friendly, enthusiastic staff, always ready to advise and support customers. Everything was done professionally and quickly, giving me a great experience., The newest quan bui branch in thao dien. We had our usual family favourites such as fried spring rolls, beef fried noodles, morning glory garlic style and fried sea bass in tamarind sauce. The quality of food is similar to all their other branches, clean and fast service. Walk ins are most welcome with plenty of tables inside and out.

Waitstaff are exceptionally attentive and prices are very reasonable for the quality of food and service. Truly a top notch restaurant in a sea of many choices.

name: Ippudo Ramen Le Thanh Ton - Japanese Restaurant
address: 17/5 Đ. Lê Thánh Tôn, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: One of the best Japanese noodle.... Slow cooked, cleanly serving, very polite staff and great service...one of the fastest serving Japanese food restaurant in Saigon....must try is naban, buns, etc, Had delicious tonkotsu ramen with my mum I had seen the menu from outside. They have upstairs seating too and the food took 5 minutes to come out. Super fast food and I had a delicious mojito ale to accompany my meal. Absolutely insane broth flavour and I would love to go again. Can choose the saltiness of the broth and how hard you want your noodles. Amazing!
description: IPPUDO was first established in 1985 in Hakata, Fukuoka. Now, we have stores in not only Japan, but also London, Paris, Singapore, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Sydney, etc. We innovate and build the "global standard of ramen shops" all over the world by ensuring not only our delicious tasting ramen but also our service

name: Som Tum Thai - Nguyen Tri Phương
address: 463A Nguyễn Tri Phương, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: So many choices of Thai foods. Out of my expectation, every dishes is super delicious. Not high but also not low price, they have a good service. But the potion is kinda small. Anyway, still love it. Will comeback.

name: Hao Yu Grilled Fish
address: 17-19 Ho Xuan Huong Ward 6, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: First time eating at Hao Yu, I am really impressed by dishes of HY Flavor is Excellent! The price is affordable. The place is suitable for reunion!, I have come here 2 times and would love to come back again and again ❤️❤️ The place is so Chinese, so beautiful. The fish is delicious and big, so that I recommend you’d better go more than 2 people to try more food., Had a craving for this grilled fish for quite some time ever since I tried it in China. So glad Hao Yu opened here in HCMC, and also an outlet in Phu My Hung in District 7. The restaurant's deco is pretty, a clever touch of the classic Chinese royal blue wall tiles shaped to look like fish scales and red wooden beams... pretty instagrammable. Their Sichuan-flavoured fish was pretty on point, a good kind of spicy that keeps you wanting more with each bite. The tender fish definitely added to the addictive nature of this dish. If you prefer non-spicy versions, their tau xi flavour was pretty good too. Once, I ordered this dish to-go for a party, and was rather pleased with their packaging. The sauce, peppers, grilled fish and sides were all packed separately and neatly, making it easy to assemble the dish later on. Pretty reasonable price of about 500,000vnd for a unique cuisine and rather large fish that stuffed four of us to the brim.
description: The first brand brings Sichuan grilled fish to Vietnam customers, such as unique experiences in Chinese cuisine. New taste, new experience.

name: Hải Sản Hoàng Gia
address: 180 Đ. Trần Hưng Đạo, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This seafood restaurant is really impressive. Diverse menu with many fresh seafood options. The service staff is friendly and professional. In particular, the dishes are delicately prepared and attractive in both flavor and presentation. Definitely a memorable culinary experience. You should go in the evening, there are tables and chairs outside in the yard, which is very cool., This Hoang Gia seafood restaurant location is suitable for dinner with the family and offers many attractive gifts, Fresh seafood, hand picked and picked up at the lake. Open, comfortable space. Diverse and fresh prepared food. Friendly employee.
description: This seafood restaurant is really impressive. Diverse menu with many fresh seafood options. The service staff is friendly and professional. In particular, the dishes are delicately prepared and attractive in both flavor and presentation. Definitely a memorable culinary experience. You should go in the evening, there are tables and chairs outside in the yard, which is very cool.

name: Ruth's House
address: Truong Dinh, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: A wide menu of Vietnamese foods. Good service, reasonable portions, my choices delicious! Ruth herself is special, welcoming and caring for each customer and with explanations of the dishes, if necessary. Her English is very good. We ate there twice (second time because the first experience was so good), enjoying pork ball soup with vermicelli and the pho with brisket. Broth as hot and tasty and the accompaniments sufficient to garnish to my taste. Condiments (especially crushed chili “paste”) were available. But there are plenty of other types of dishes on the menu. A companion enjoyed the “special broken rice dish”. Can get crowded; you might wait (briefly) or share a table. Highly recommend; wish I had eaten there instead of walking by years ago. A short walk to co Ben Thanh and a Legends coffee., Delicious, fresh, clean and the perfect local dining experience. A simple menu featuring the staples that you want to try while you are in Vietnam. We ordered Garlic Fried Chicken, Pho, Pork bowls, fresh and fried spring rolls and every plate was empty! The beer is cold, the service is great and the only warning i can offer is to beware if the fresh chillies… delicious but they are HOT!! 😂, What’s not to like? The staff here are so lovely, and the food is really good- freshly made with quality ingredients. So very tasty. They cater for vegetarians as well, which may not be everyone’s cup of tea but it’s an interesting alternative to meat. All in all, I loved it!

Highly recommend; wish I had eaten there instead of walking by years ago. A short walk to co Ben Thanh and a Legends coffee.

name: Rose Business Lounge
address: Tan Son Nhat International Airport, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Nice enough for short stays: Considering that it has both cushioned booth and low sofa seats sections - and with a full floor-to-ceiling view of the runway, it's nice enough for relaxing a little, away from the rest of the crowd at the public areas of the airport. ...but it gets crowded quickly: Was relatively empty at 8am, but almost at capacity by the time I left at 9am. Servers didn't quite have enough time to clear all tables at this fast turnover. Average food: Rather short buffet line of potatoes, some meats, Vietnamese noodles and fruits. Teas were either pot or bags from Phuc Long, a big local brand. Food might not be as good as those freshly cooked at the food court upstairs on level two. If you just need a quiet place to rest and not really here for their food, most guests just rest at the low sofa seats with a cuppa tea/coffee/beer/mineral water anyways., The bullet Ho Chi Minh City trip ended very quickly Take a taxi to Tan Son Nhat International Airport. If you go through immigration four hours before your late-night flight Go straight to the lounge in the international departure area. I drank a lot before returning to Nagoya. It's buffet style, it's various, it's normally delicious. The beer was canned beer, but I drank it hard. We also had wine, so we really enjoyed it. It was crowded with foreigners, but comfortable. It was good enough to last for hours. Thanks for the food., Clean, Hygienic, and Calm – A Solid Lounge Experience We had a domestic flight to Hanoi and were able to access Rose Business Lounge—and we were pleasantly surprised by how clean and well-maintained everything was. The food selection was decent—not outstanding, but not bad either. What stood out most was the hygiene. Every dish, utensil, chopstick, spoon, and fork was properly cleaned and neatly arranged, which made the dining experience feel safe and pleasant. Compared to Le Saigonnais - SASCO Business Lounge, Rose Lounge is miles ahead in cleanliness, food handling, and customer service. The environment here is calm and organized, and staff seem to care more about maintaining a good standard for travelers. Highly recommend using this lounge if you want a cleaner, more professional experience before your flight.

If you just need a quiet place to rest and not really here for their food, most guests just rest at the low sofa seats with a cuppa tea/coffee/beer/mineral water anyways.

name: Pasteur Street Craft Beer
address: 23A Ngô Thời Nhiệm Phường 6, Quận 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: My husband and I stumbled upon this cozy corner as the weather was super hot outside. We just needed a cold beer. Stopped by here for a few drinks and loved every minute. Nitro Irish stout is always a lovely way to start with. But, well but, to my surprise, Cyclo Choc stout killed it. Gotta come back for more. Staff members were super professional and attentive. It’s a nice way to beat the heat., Found this location at Google maps staying in Hotel La Vela, the reviews were promising. And that was right. The beers are outstanding and the food as well. The waiters gave very good advice. Will is a very nice host also gave good advice for tourists. We will for sure come back when we visit HCMC again., Great IPA beer , excellent service from Will who helped us out greatly . We loved the live music . This is our second time in the Pasteur street pub chain , the first pub being the original one .. Keep up the good work Dave C and friends - the UK 🇬🇧 👍
description: Located on Ngo Thoi Nhiem street with a brewhouse and an open space that can hold up to 150 seats for customers.

name: Forest Therapy Kitchen & Bar
address: 76 Đ. Nguyễn Thái Bình Phường Nguyễn Thái Bình, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: What a wonderful little find! Spent a long day walking around Saigon, and then stumbled on this place while looking for an early evening cocktail. Incredible creative drinks, as well as delicious fusion Asian tapas. Extraordinary atmosphere and decor, featuring a “living wall” of plants and rock, I love everything about this place, It smoothed my soul in a rainy day, just sitting here help me recharging my energy. Food & drinks are special & tasty though, a must try place for dating or hanging out with friends., Very chill and relax. An amazing space for tasting food and drink. I will come back soon. Nice staffs.
description: Deeply relax in a closed green space right in the heart of the city. Discover the diversity & uniqueness of Vietnam’s nature through our modern fusion Vietnamese cuisine & mixology.

name: Olivia Dining
address: 31a Le Van Mien, Thao Dien, District 2, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: What an exceptional fine dining experience at Olivia Dining! The menu is extremely well designed to take you to the next level of fine dining. Everything is hand-crafted from the smallest details with ingredients are unique, rare, of high quality and highly sourced. From the first dish to the last dish, the chef takes you to the journey of different flavours and countries. The flavour on each dish and ingredients blends together so well that you can’t say anything other than “WOW” when you start trying each dish. Great job to the Head chef on creating such an amazing tasting menu for us to try. The atmosphere is formal fine dining setting but still romantic, warm and cozy. Staff is very knowledgeable and explained each dish really well how it was made and the special ingredient in each dish to us. We will definitely be back again!, the food is very, very good-- and the service and atmosphere superb. Lovely place! Not giving it 5 starts because it is getting so tiring to go to restaurants that feel compelled to add "gold leaf" (in this case to a dessert) to food in an effort to comply with some misplaced sense of sophistication or elegance. Wish this would stop! Otherwise a fantastic place., A great find in Ho Chi Minh for quality dining and exceptional service along with a knowledgeable sommelier. A must do for dining. Australians will appreciate the fact the chef has worked in one of Victorias best restaurants before opening here
description: Creative Fine Dining set in an intimate and contemporary atmosphere

name: Banh Xeo Em Oi!
address: 26 Thu Khoa Huan A17 - 18, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant specialises in this dish: Banh Xeo. It is crispy and tasty, and so their grilled meat skewer. It is very authentic and delicious. Highly recommended!, The vegan mushroom Banh Xeo here is AMAZING, it tastes so good! We ordered it between two people with veggie spring rolls (also really great) and it was plenty of food for us to share. I’d definitely recommend this as a good vegetarian/vegan option within the street food market., I had banh khot with shrimp and squit in this place. It was very tasty and the staff was very helpful.
description: An authentic Vietnamese street food stall inside the Ben Thanh Street Food Market. We are specialized in making Banh Xeo, a Vietnamese pancake that is consisted of rice flour, beansprouts, mung bean, pork and shrimp.

name: Dynasty House Dong Khoi
address: 02 Dong Khoi, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Was tempted by the hotpot’s and dumplings. Both were correct but the choice is complicated because some dishes are available during the day other only the evening and so on. Ingredients for the hotpots are quite expensive, and service is so so, especially because they close very early and are in a hurry to see you out if you show up a bit late. Not bad but should be better., A quite fancy place to go out for dinner, but for my taste unfortunately, there is a mismatch between the Location/Deco and the taste of the dishes., We had a wonderful lunch here. The staff were very helpful as we didn't really understand the hotpot concept and they even cooked and peeled our prawns. We had delicious dumplings to start and then chose the hotpot with Seafood. It did take some time but we were not in a hurry and thoroughly enjoyed the whole experience. The restaurant is very comfortable and I would love to visit again....
description: Enjoy a multi-flavored Chinese dim sum & hotpot at Dynasty House. The captivating features of our diners come from the variety of handmade dim sum, made fresh every day, and the unique hotpot flavors, bringing an engaging Chinese hotpot cultural experience. We always focus on selecting quality, fresh ingredients, ensuring quality to bring the best experiences to our diners.

name: Café Central An Dong
address: 18 An Duong Vuong, District 5 The Windsor Plaza Hotel, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Just came to have buffet dinner yesterday, it was the Thailand cuisine so a lot of Thai food. I love Thai salad but couldn't see the Thai salad stood until I was nearly full, so I can eat much, that's a pity. Anyways, lobster was good, food is ok, not too excellent but it's ok for the buffet like this in city. Spacious and clean room is another plus. will come back if be invited :), Meal: - Lobster was definitely the highlight; all you can eat, just order through your waiter. - Oysters fresh and large or baked in cheese . - Crabs are excellent. - Sashimi and sushi are excellent, very fresh. - BBQ prawns, pork, beef and others are nice. - Lots of desserts available and the ice creams are very good. - Thai foods are very delicious. - Dont try cheese, not good. The service is good. They talk well, behave politely and very helpful. Really pleased with everything that we tried including the desserts. The free one beer was nice., We enjoyed our time here between our small group of friends. Really nice and cozy atmosphere, friensly staff and great selection of beverages available. Will definitely be back!
description: Located on the 4th floor of Windsor Plaza Hotel, Café Central An Dong is designed in a luxurious and cozy space where offers the diversity of typical cuisine featuring all-time favourites as well as new flavours created by the team of experienced chefs, bringing exciting culinary experiences for guests. The restaurant serves an extensive a la carte menu for breakfast, lunch and dinner daily with a variety of international and Vietnamese dishes combined to attractive monthly promotions. In particular, on the 1st and 15th of the lunar month, Vegetarian Dinner Buffet will open with more than 80 delicious Asian and European dishes prepared in beautiful presentations, priced only 330,000 ++ VND per guest. It’s our honour to welcome you!

name: Jimmy's New York Pizza - Saigon
address: 7B Đường 1, KP4 An Phú, Quận 2, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: I visited the Jimmy's location in District 1, not far from Ben Thanh Market. I had the individual peperoni pizza with extra cheese. Being from New York, I am very critical of pizza, especially those advertised as "New York" pizza. I was favorably impressed. I tend to avoid Pizza in Asia, since most Asian cultures don't understand or appreciate cheese. A friend took me to a "Western style" restaurant up near Chu Lai. I ordered the sausage pizza, and discovered that they didn't think pizza needed any tomato sauce, and their idea of "sausage" was sliced hot dog. So, at Jimmy's, Sauce 10/10; Cheese Quality 10/10; Peperoni 10/10; Crust 9/10. A nice surprise in Saigon., First night Saigon at my hotel and checked out pizza on Grab which I often use at night in Thailand. Being an Italian American from Boston I know a thing or two about pizza. I made my decision based on reviews but also the photo provided which looked more like an actual pizza I might see in Boston or Providence. Grab delivered the pizza in under 45 minutes and honestly it was an excellent pizza especially the crust; firm/little or no flop, generous toppings completely covering the pizza in layers; fresh and delicious. I would be happy to pay 12 bucks for this at home. In Saigon I would order here again., My partner and I were drinking in a bar next door to Jimmy's and decided to order Pizza from Jimmy's. The Pizzas we had were very good and the garlic bread with cheese was delicious. The additives accompanying the Pizzas were just what was needed for my chilly loving partner. Thanks Jimmy from Boston we will be back.
description: Bring a slice of New York to Vietnam. All of our pizzas are made with Jimmy's homemade family sauce, imported cheeses and tomatoes and fresh meat, seafood and veggie toppings. Our dough is made daily from scratch and hand tossed.

name: Fang Pub
address: 13 Ho Xuan Huong Ward 6, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We searched bars with live music and found that this place was suggested. When we turned up on the street, we couldn’t hear much and were suspicious, however as soon as we entered we were met by a crowd of people having the time of their lives! We stayed to see two bands. The first were great and everyone was singing along. The second were fantastic too, and performed current English songs and Vietnamese songs (which were catchy despite us not knowing what was going on!). The second band had a beat boxer who was incredible! You get your drinks at the bar, and then stand and join in the fun - either dance your socks off or stand with your drink and giving it laldi with a head nod or two. One thing that really struck me was the crowd. People were obviously drinking lots and letting loose, but they were so friendly. Whenever anyone bumped into us by mistake, they were so quick to apologise! This is surprising as most of the time drunk people don’t realise! We were also greeted warmly by strangers and welcomed to the place. This is a great place, and hidden gem for the locals. We were delighted to stumble across it and had such a good Saturday night! If you want to find somewhere with live music then go for it. Lots of stuff to sing along too, and they mash up songs as well., The space is small but I love it. The music is good. The bands are cool. A super exciting place to go with a medium/large group of friends. My group of 20 people came here and it was the craziest night ever! Budweiser seems to be the beer with the best price here and I really love the taste. However it's necessary to make reservations. The tables are often fully booked., Nice beer towers for 4 of us. But the only thing I like is beer. I reserved a table before coming, but when we showed up, nobody checked whether we booked or not and got a table for us. Could we get a spot if we came late, and without any "reserved sign"? While we were enjoying the music (not really good voice, but acceptable with my fav songs from 10 years ago), police came and took fun away in around 50mins. What the hell is that???

name: Sabor Restaurant & Bar
address: 114/1 Yersin Phường Nguyễn Thái Bình, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Amazing dinner! This gem was just around the corner from our Airbnb, so we decided to try it, and so glad we did! We arrived late (shortly after 9:00 pm), so the restaurant was almost empty, but decided to stay based on reviews, and it did NOT disappoint. After traveling in Vietnam for 2.5 weeks, we were craving something different. We had an amazing meal of tapas and absolutely delicious white sangria! The price was reasonable for 3 sangrias, and 5 tapas plates, it was about 1.2 MM VND, that also includes the VAT and service charge. The service was impeccable as well. Would highly recommended this amazing restaurant!, We needed a night off Vietnamese food and this restaurant was only 4 minutes from our hotel. Was an absolute gem! The food was really good. We had the burrata salad and added Spanish ham, meatballs, steak on toast and honestly it was so much food. The wine was good and the service great. Definitely recommend!, Fabulous! After a long drive from Nha Trang to here I was famished. I grabbed a grab over to Sabor based on the reviews and I was not disappointed. From the moment I walked-in until I left I was thrilled with the service and the food was delicious. This is a comfy and warm space with an open widow to sit and watch the world go by. I sat down and enjoyed a glass of the sangria very much especially since it was packed with fresh fruit that had been marinating in the alcohol. I began with the pumpkin soup. It was hot, light and nicely balanced and the toasted fresh bread was sprinkled with fresh rosemary and it complimented the pumpkin soup perfectly. Next I had the slow-cooked beef in red wine on semolina and was topped with beet chips and it was absolutely delicious. The beef was tender and each bite coupled with the mild flavor and textures of the semolina and chips was fabulous. I left stuffed and happy and I defiantly recommend enjoying a fabulous meal here.
description: Sabor serves tasty tapas and paella, wine and beers with upbeat music, Sports TV and a breezy rooftop in the center of District 1. Southwestern European dining menu available by end of December 2022.

name: Pho Hien
address: 269 Nguyen Trai Street, Ward 1, District 5, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: This trip was to try out new foods joint, instead of Pho Hung or Pho Vietnam, Mr friend recommended me Pho Hien 1985. When I was there, I didn’t see any foreigner except me. I had the beef pho, it was great comparable to Pho Hung but slightly tastier. I also have an egg in beef broth, to be eaten in one go was delicious. Pho Hung has more beef varieties. Definitely, can come back again, The big sign on the entrance claims longevity. The professional photos on the interior wall show care about the menu offerings. The food is good. The price is right., It is yummy pho.good location,nice and clean places.the soup quite sweet from the sugar.if they can add more bone and reduce sugar.their soup will be high standard

name: Dot Drinkery & Kitchen
address: 75 Hai Bà Trưng Lầu 3, Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: At Dot drinkery, the staff's warmth and attentive service set the stage for an unforgettable experience. The drinks at here are top-notch, with expertly crafted cocktails and inventive creations that cater to every taste. Each sip is a testament to the bartenders' skill and dedication. This bar excels in providing a friendly environment, great drinks, and welcoming ambiance, making it a must-visit destination for anyone seeking an exceptional bar experience., Tasty cocktails with a buzzing atmosphere and dj playing the best rnb songs from 90s were great. But what the highlight is the bartenders - very nice people with great conversation which made our wedding anniversary such a great night. Especially Kir is a great bartender with a huge smile on her face. Overall, a great experience!, Exceptional personal service! Ambience, music and band were all great! Talented and friendly mixologists! The owner made us feel very welcome and certainly made my birthday one to remember. Thank you! Fabulous bar, we will be back!

name: Le Café Des Stagiaires - Saigon
address: So 8, 10 duong so 54 Thảo Điền, Quận 2, Ho Chi Minh City 711000 Vietnam
reviews: Great venue, the perfect place to see the sunset, and a cozy interior. Very friendly staff and fun parties. The selection of beers is awesome and food is really tasty - the chicken Karaage is perfect for sharing with friends. Definitely recommend!, Been at Le Café des Stagiaires a couple of times since the opening, every occasion was just great. Food is really nice, I tried the hamburger and some starters, the shrimp croquettes and cold cuts platter, all super. The range of beers is pretty awesome too. The views are incomparable, probably the best in town and the decoration indoors, very classy and cool. This is def one of my new places to go!, This rooftop bar had a great vibe (DJ playing some tunes - although more background music which was perfect). Great variety of cocktails (and strong). Everyone super friendly. More in the exoat area of Ho Chi Minh - but easy to get too. Would recommend.
description: Le Café des Stagiaires, with a rooftop over the Saigon River, is the first bar in Vietnam to serve Duvel Moortgat Brewery's portfolio, the iconic Belgian beer company. Good drinks and great food is always the best match! We offer a full European menu, emphasizing the tradition of sharing food - with a French and Belgian focus. At night, the tables make way for a dance floor – while leaving the lounge sofa in the corner for those who prefer to chill. Part of the wall retracts to reveal the hidden DJ space behind it, which hosts both top local DJs and open deck nights.

name: Ollin Café
address: 300 Nguyen Thi Thap Tan Quy Ward, District 7, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I tried Ollin Café on a weekend. The place is quite large and divided into 3 different spaces including one covered outdoor terrace for smokers. Coffee is good (I tried the signature coffee with coconut). Minus point : the plastic use for cup cover, straw and spoon. This could be avoided., Real nice coffee place in D7, I go there on a regular base, was never disappointed! Great and helpful stuff. Excellent service and good for working and pleasure. I can highly recommend it., Excellent coffee, nice cafe. Hipster, concrete cube with a vibe. One odd thing though - they don’t have macchiato on the menu, but will make it if you ask for it. My place for weekend coffee!
description: I tried Ollin Café on a weekend. The place is quite large and divided into 3 different spaces including one covered outdoor terrace for smokers. Coffee is good (I tried the signature coffee with coconut). Minus point : the plastic use for cup cover, straw and spoon. This could be avoided.

name: BBQ & Beer De Salita
address: 29 Le Thanh Ton, district 1 District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This place was close to our hotel and we popped in late afternoon one day, we sat outside but it was spoiled by a party going on over the road on a pavement which include loud music and singing. Despite that we had a few beers and some chilli prawns, as long as the street is not having a pavement party it is worth a look as the food was good., A lot of complaints about the wait time. I agree but IHMO that is why the food is always so good. They cook to order - perhaps a few pieces ahead but not a stack of pre-cooked barbequed meat dumped into a bain marie in the corner. Best Com Ga I have ever had - chicken was succulent and perfectly cooked, the broken rice well spiced and the salsa to die for. Do Not Go if you are in a rush. If you have time, one of the tastiest, juiciest and friendly places around, Just be warned that it IS popular and the food is barbecued to order. There is a McDonald's not far away if you need fast food. Otherwise, kick back and watch the street life and savor the delicious smells - worth the wait!, Thank you to the guys in this restaurant who made us feel very welcome and were very attentive. My husband is not a massive steak fan but he fancied one tonight and for him to finish itis fabulous and shows the quality. From the moment we arrived the staff couldn't be attentive enough. Food served quickly and was fabulous. Thank you. Great team!
