name: Sake Central Saigon
address: 59 Dong Du Ben Nghe, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: what a great spot. The sake was spot on-- the menu very limited but everything was delicious especially paired with great sake. fantastic service, Great ambiance, outstanding foods, quality sake . This is a must try if you had chance to visiting saigon. I had Masamune Katana sake it was a perfection . The omakase set was great but it was kinda too much for me haha. YOU MUST COME TO SAKE CENTRAL SAIGON, I am US based but in Vietnam almost monthly for business. As an enthusiastic but unsophisticated sake aficionado, I booked a table right away after hearing about this relatively new restaurant from my hotel's management. When I got there, I realized that I'd been to the tiny 2nd story location before, when it was a weird little bar in the heart of Saigon's District 1. Having seen the location before, the architectural transformation of what is a very small and unusual floor plan was nothing less than amazing. The tiny stairwell which leads you from the street level entry door to the restaurant has been converted from a creepy winding hallway into a dark, soothing, and inviting start to your sake adventure. It reminded me of the stunning Aronia de Takazawa in Tokyo, one of my top 2 favorite restaurants on the planet: in each case, an elusive, unassuming street entrance turns into a intriguing prequel of the amazing experience which lies just up the staircase. Once inside Sake Central, I immediately appreciated the time, thought, and effort it must have taken to convert the small area into what is a stunningly beautiful room which is inviting, intimate, yet comfortable. The large communal table set up maximizes capacity for the owners, but somehow does so effortlessly. I am not a big fan of shared tables but here, it was not an issue...it just works. The sake selection: SUPERB and better than any I’ve found in this part of the world (outside of Japan, obviously). As I've said, I'm no expert but I know what I like and with sake, it’s a love/hate thing: I am passionate about certain styles while others - solid, award-winning varieties - taste absolutely undrinkable to me. I explained that to Thanh, our server, and he immediately launched into his recommendations based on my preferences. Thanh was simply FANTASTIC in going over the sake list in detail with me; I was there for an early dinner so it wasn't crowded, and I'd say he spent more than a half hour explaining and elaborating as I peppered him with endless questions (while my poor dining companion suffered through my Sake Nerd Session patiently LOL). I tried 3, all were spot on recommendations. Later, I was given the gift of a small paper handbook prepared by Sake Central’s owners. (I didn’t open it till this morning; what I expected to be a promotional booklet is actually a wonderfully written, succinct crash course on Sake, complete with a section for tasting notes on the back. A keeper for sure.) Food: we opted against the Omikase dinner combination and instead went a la carte with appetizers. The food was excellent, small sharing portions, delivered one at a time to maximize the experience. I can’t remember the name of the Japanese oysters of the day, but they were HUGE, fresh, and delicious, served on ice with a kumquat mignonette. Sadly, they were out of the raw Yellowfin tuna appetizer, but the other big standout was double-miso Black Cod...superb. Every bit as perfect as Joel Robuchon’s legendary “Le Black Cod”. Really. I asked about ownership and Thanh mentioned there were multiple partners; in the booklet, I saw the Pizza 4ps is involved. Pizza 4ps has the absolute best pizza in this part of the world and, best of all, they make their own artisan cheeses. One of the events they have is a sake/home made cheese pairing...VERY original and VERY cool. My two constructive suggestions to Sake Central’s otherwise masterful execution are the following: first of all, create several sake flights which let someone like me experience 6-7 small tastings at one time. All three of the sakes I had were excellent, and one was a very expensive rare brand. I would have liked to have tasted more. Second – and for all I know they may be already doing this – is create once or twice a week themed events (like their sake + cheese night) on their slow nights to fill the restaurant and create a recurring crowd of fans. Their concept is unique in this amazing food city and news will spread quickly. In a few weeks, tables will be pre-booked a week in advance, I’m certain. Thanh is perfectly capable of leading the shared table to understand each progressive sake step in the flight and the young chef who delivered the Miso Cod was equally eloquent and enthusiastic. Sake Central is just a lovely place, the product of much thinking, serious expertise, and passionate execution. It shows in the way the place is built, in the sake selection, in the execution of the food and, as a restaurant owner myself, most importantly in the way its young staff has been not only trained but EDUCATED on the beautiful nuances of sake culture. I’ll be back every time!
description: Sake Central Saigon is a celebration of Japanese culture through food and beverage, with a primary focus on sake. Created by an international team from Japan, Europe, and North America, the concept behind Sake Central Saigon is rooted in promoting the sake industry and Japanese culture on a global scale.

name: Dim Tu Tac Cobi Tower
address: 69 Hoàng Văn Thái, Quận 7, Ho Chi Minh City 7000000 Vietnam
reviews: What a great addition to HCMC D7! The food is absolutely exquisite. Better quality and environment than in D1. Excellent location for relaxed / business meals., Delicious food, friendly staff, served fast, beautiful luxurious spacious space. I recommend Hong Kong milk tea, peking duck and kungfu soup
description:
What a great addition to HCMC D7!
The food is absolutely exquisite.
Better quality and environment than in D1.
Excellent location for relaxed / business meals.

name: Busshari - Modern Japanese Eatery
address: 275 Vo Nguyen Giap Street West Office Building, Lumiere Riverside, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We have visited many Michigan star ⭐️ restaurants around the world and this New 1 month old Japanese restaurant in HCMC Was up there with the best of them even though they are not Michigan ⭐️ We ordered 4 different cocktails which were all very tasty and refreshing just like a good cocktail should be!! The food is soo fresh and well presented and prepared… I ordered loads of different food dishes from all over the menu and the chefs sent it out all in the right order and at the right time!!! They were amazing. The staff are soo friendly and are always there when you need them, my family and I can’t wait to go back… We are staying here for 6 nights and I am already dreaming about the next dishes I will order tomorrow…. So do your self a favor and book a table tonight! You will not be disappointed!!…, Very tasty place with wonderful food and pleasant atmosphere! The staff is amazing and helpful! Highly recommended this restaurant with delicious seafood., The food was fantastic, freshly prepared and also visually beautiful. The service staff was very friendly and attentive. I can highly recommend the restaurant and go safely back there.
description: A Japanese restaurant that seamlessly blends traditional Japanese flavors with innovative modern culinary techniques

name: Kiba Saigon
address: 31 Pho Duc Chinh Nguyen Thai Binh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Really awesome place to eat !! The food is incredibly tasty, sophisticated and has a great balance of Asian cuisine with a Spanish touch (very well presented as well). Service is very tentative, the decor is lovely and the overall ambience is great (I personally really enjoyed the soundtrack and the space is well air conditioned so it’s a great break from the sweltering heat). Me and my wife ordered a number of tapas dishes , a salad and a main which was plenty to make us full and happy. The owners/management are very nice to talk to (if you feel like talking, they are not over engaging if you simply feel like eating in peace) and seem to know a lot about food. The ingredients are of top quality and you can taste the fresheners in the food (the restaurant has its own herb garden which is really cute). The prices are very reasonable and there is an overall great value for what you pay so I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone who is looking for a great meal in Ho Chi Minh City, The restaurant is very beautiful, the rooftop looks amazing, definitely is a perfect choice for a couple or someone who wants to enjoy good food and a little heaven inside busy Saigon. The music is nice, the owner and all the staff are very helpful and kind. Price is affordable. All the best to the owners!, We wanted something unique in Saigon and Kiba didn't come short. The food was outstanding. Highly recommend the ibérica pork and the duck confit. The restaurant is super central but the decor is super chilled and relaxing.
description: At Kiba, we pay homage to Saigon in the best (and only) way we know how - with food. Here, we marry traditional Spanish flavours and technique reminiscent of our nostalgic Spanish days growing up with our love affair with the city’s vibrant spirit and pulse. Like Saigon, Kiba’s cuisine is ever changing, unique and bursting with gourmet flavours and innovation. Think moreish good food using the freshest ingredients sourced directly from our hydroponics rooftop garden, playful cocktails and a promised good time with our charismatic team.

name: Chandni Chowk Indian Restaurant
address: 266, Bui Vien St. Pham Ngu Lao, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: My cousins and I had the pleasure of dining at Chandni Chowk during our stay in Ho Chi Minh City, and it turned out to be the culinary highlight of our Vietnam trip. This gem of an Indian restaurant exceeded our expectations in every way. The flavors in every dish were exquisite, delivering an authentic taste of India that left us craving more. What made the experience even better was the reasonable pricing, especially compared to other restaurants in the area. From lunch to dinner, every meal was a delightful experience, and I can confidently say that Chandni Chowk is a must-visit for anyone seeking exceptional Indian cuisine in Vietnam. I wholeheartedly recommend this restaurant to fellow travelers and food enthusiasts alike., I have been to many Indian restaurants abroad but the food here is really delicious and it makes me feel that I am in Chandni Chowk only. Keshav the owner was really polite. Highly recommended to all Indians food lovers., We came quite late at night and they were still open, the food arrived quickly with good service and was great indian food. If you go for a classic curry/naan/rice per person it can get more expensive than a lot of local restaurants but it is not a ridiculous price for the quality and a nice restaurant you can sit inside
description: "A well maintained and hygienic place for everyone to enjoy authentic Indian food. All dishes are prepared by Indian Chefs and made with proper hygiene."

name: Hu Tieu Mi Thap Cam
address: 62 Truong Dinh Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Hủ tíu mì Cật in Ho Chi Minh City Copy and paste the name of the restaurant into the taxi app Grab I've been there since 6 a.m. The Vietnamese noodles are not just pho. Egg noodles are also popular, and pork and liver soupless noodles are It's full of umami and very delicious!! At the end, it was great to eat it with soup., We had the soup and the dry version which includes a small bowl of soup. Simple nice flavour, soup is tasty. 50k a bowl. Coffee is costly in a small cup. Best option around 7am, simple comfort food., Simple, gorgeous, flavorful, beautiful bowl of delicious pork noodles with fried pork fats and just oozing umami!!!! And the price? 2,200 VND. It screams you are crazy not to have this. If you like noodles, you will like this.

name: Yen Sushi Premium
address: 123 Ba Huyen Thanh Quan St Dist 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: A beautiful restaurant (the branch in district 3) with good food. The staff Ms. Ha Trang and Ms. My Phuong were both very helpful. Thank you,, Beautifully prepared and presented food, very fresh sashimi. Cosy private room suitable for family dinner with kids. Highly recommended for authentic premium Japanese cuisine, Yen Sushi Premium is extremely atmospheric, complete with a kimono wearing attendant who will sit outside your private room. Is it (relatively) expensive? Yes. It was not difficult to spend 3 million VND here between two people, but if that price does not scare you, you will have a very memorable meal with some unusual and delicious cuts of fish. You could eat here more cheaply, ordering items from their barbeque menu and some of their cheaper sushi offerings.
description: YEN SUSHI PREMIUM is offering fresh ingredients, also we pay particular attention to sashimi and others. We are introducing the equipment used in Japan as it is to keep freshness with the best condition. YEN SUSHI PREMIUM will serve "safe and secure" Japanese food at its best condition. We are waiting for your visit from the bottom of our heart.

name: Ca Phe Do Phu - Com Tam Dai Han
address: 113A Dang Dung Tan Dinh, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Cute little place with old furnitures and steep stairs. Sitting in the balcony can be an experience while the local go by. Their signature dish, the first on the menu is worth a try. We also tried their butter coffee ( filter coffee with butter in it) - It was unique and has given me some ideas to try when I am back home. Use google translator for a better experience, they are nice people. Just need to know what you are after :), Cà phê Đỗ-Phủ is a little way from the more touristy parts of Saigon, but still just a quick ride in a Grab. Their specialty is broken rice with kimchi (delicious), which was originally served at the request of the Korean soldiers stationed nearby – you can read more about the interesting history of the cafe by searching "The war-time secret behind Saigon eatery". Highly recommended., We stop off at this café to see the history. Food was tasty and the many items from the war period shown on display.

We also tried their butter coffee ( filter coffee with butter in it) - It was unique and has given me some ideas to try when I am back home. Use google translator for a better experience, they are nice people. Just need to know what you are after :)

name: Pizza 4P S Le Dai Hanh
reviews: We have visited a number of the Pizza 4P restaurants in Vietnam. This was our first to this location and everything was of the high standard we have come to expect. We were placed at a table of our choice quickly and the Pizzas were perfect - and consistent with all of the franchise venues. It is also key to note that the price is very reasonable for such high quality foods. A special shoutout to Miss Thảo who was managing the staff with professional excellence, whilst seamlessly taking time to also meet and greet the customers, making us all feel most comfortable and welcome., I visited different 4Ps in many places in and out Saigon. I love their food, the way they build their business and of course with their services too. Yesterday, we choose to try 4Ps in Le Dai Hanh, I was there with my partner and one of our guests from US. I glad that I booked the table in advance. at around 7:30pm, they were super busy and many ppl waiting for the table. We have the table in the front restaurant. Beautiful views. Not wait too long for the food at all, hot - delicious pizzas came directly from the wooden oven to our table. Our guests from US super impressed with the whole experience, good the service, reasonable price, delicious food. It is an excellent choice to come here with friends/business to have good meals and talk. We glad that we made the decision to come here. Wonderful night for us. Thanks everyone for a great service and hard work., There is no complain about the food cause taste still remain the same. By the way service is going down day by day clearly. Come for a lunch at 11am. After opening the door. All the staffs were standing at the bar. They turned over and saw us. Then back to chit chat with no attention and welcoming. As coming from a long distance we quickly take a table instead of choosing another place. Waitress came w a menu and go did not come back to ask if we ready to order or not. Restaurant status were not busy. I can see a lot of staff just hang around just to chit chat to each others,fixing the hair blah blah. After calling for few times. A waitress came to out table to take order. We request salad served the same time with main course. After reconfirming w us. Food still being served separately . LOL I can pay understanding for a busy restaurant with busy staff but not for this case. Restaurant under Japanese management but the grooming of the staff should be reviewed. Aprons so creasy. Hair is not tidy as well
description:
We have visited a number of the Pizza 4P restaurants in Vietnam. 

This was our first to this location and everything was of the high standard we have come to expect. 

We were placed at a table of our choice quickly and the Pizzas were perfect - and consistent with all of the franchise venues. 

It is also key to note that the price is very reasonable for such high quality foods. 

A special shoutout to Miss Thảo who was managing the staff with professional excellence, whilst seamlessly taking time to also meet and greet the customers, making us all feel most comfortable and welcome.

name: On Tap Cafe & Restaurant - Halal Food
address: 41-43 Nguyễn Thị Thập Tân Phú, Quận 7, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I had a delicious dinner with my friend at On Tap Kombucha restautant where I really have made impression on quality of dishes and service. In term of food and drink, it’s undeniable that it's really worth experiencing meals at this restaurant. Once you come, you will definitely wanna go back again to enjoy more and more. Rest assured because you will be suggested to order the most delicious dishes that suit your mood by a very sweet person. In regard to the service of the restaurant, this especially makes a very unique feature in here, which I have never felt before in anywhere else. Thank you for taking care of us during our dining time at the restaurant. Everything's really nice! Oh, I also wanna give praise for the atmosphere, we were overwhelmed by the feeling of warmth with natural light and soft music, which was absolutely perfect for us to talk together. Sum up, the taste, people, space and emotions here make me feel relax and comfortable a lot!, The space is different from the bustle that you often encounter in HCMC. The food is unique and has its own flavor that you cannot find anywhere else. The signature drink is kombucha which is delicious and healthy. A month living here, I can't help but drink kombucha every day. and the amazing thing is that despite eating a lot of delicious food here, my weight has not changed thanks to kombucha. I miss this taste so much. Besides, the restaurant owner and staff are very friendly, you can chat and play pool with them when they have time. Sometimes the owner even surprises you because the dishes she creates are not on the menu. I will definitely come back here., On Tap Cafe and Resturant was so convenient for us when we stayed at Sonata Residence. For 2 weeks we had many of our meals there. One of our friends loved the breakfasts. Those who didn’t rise so early enjoyed the hamburgers, the variety of curries and other food on the menu. We had a group meal one evening with friends, a lovely atmosphere to get together for great food. During my stay I particularly loved the iced chocolate frappe when it was so hot outside. Sejh and Linh dining room service was always delivered with a smile. . We were delighted with Mr Lam and his team, they become like friends in a new country. Well done Thoroughly recommend this place.
description: On Tap restaurant serves diverse Halal dishes with refreshing flavor and high-quality standards. On Tap has unique and appetizing Halal Food & drinks for those in need. We are open from 7 am to 10:00 pm every day, so customers can order throughout the day for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, anything that suits their needs

name: Alley Cat Restaurant
address: 241/10 Pham Ngu Lao District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I dropped by this place casually because it was close to where I was staying, and I really liked it. It's a small local restaurant, but it was delicious and reasonably priced! I recommend the Banh Xeo! They also serve fresh spring rolls and alcohol, so I was able to eat there any time I wanted, and it was a casual and enjoyable stay. And the staff's customer service was great. But the owner is like a cat!, We found this restaurant close to our hotel. We started with a tea time snack, then went back for dinner. The menu was excellent, and the family who ran the restaurant were great. The food was very reasonably priced too would definately recommend., We found this little restaurant by chance in a little street just behind the most chaotic area of Ho Chi Minh, a few steps from our guesthouse. Lovely hosts and fabulous food, fresh and well cooked! Highly recommended!
description: I dropped by this place casually because it was close to where I was staying, and I really liked it. It's a small local restaurant, but it was delicious and reasonably priced! I recommend the Banh Xeo! They also serve fresh spring rolls and alcohol, so I was able to eat there any time I wanted, and it was a casual and enjoyable stay. And the staff's customer service was great. But the owner is like a cat!

name: Drinking & Healing
address: 2nd Floor, 25 Ho Tung Mau District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This place is absolutely awesome! I love Speakeasies and I guess this could be considered one just because of the entrance and the way it's set. Drinking & Healing is the epitome of cool: drinks, bartenders, food, music, the place itself... I've been several times -by myself and with friends, and have also enjoy guest bartenders that offer new and original concoctions but the ones from the house are the best. In addition to this you can find all kinds of great choices of liquor. Definitely a must visit if you are in the area, Stopped in with a friend for a cocktail. Really nice place, entry sequence, bathrooms. The bar is very well designed. Great concept for staff as Healers are the wait staff and you of course are the drinkers. Great atmosphere, but a bit dark to see. Music a bit loud to have a conversation. Good music., The staff really friendly. Good music ,good atmosphere, there must be some magic in the cocktails here where you cant stop with one. Will back again for sure
description: Intimate and friendly, Drinking & Healing is a cannot-be-missed place for you to enjoy the inspirational cocktails and relax with the most simple and authentic realities.

name: Hanabi Japanese Cuisine
address: 18 Street 41 Thao Dien, District 2, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Very good tempura- if you like tempura this is the place. The rest is pretty average. Overall good service. Expensive but reasonable, This place will never let you down! Changes menu each month which includes Japanese seasonal foods and atmosphere. You will never be tired of going there to try new menu. Quality of tempura and other Japanese food here is simply amazing! And personally chef's post on fb and instagram is hilarious (only in Japanese). You need to book in advance., Can you imagine being served one tempura at a time? This is what you get here and every single morsel is lovingly presented and delicious. The location of the restaurant and the decor is modest but the food is good. It is different and not your standard Japanese fare and dare I say nouvelle in nature. Chef Taka used to be the chef for the Japanese consulate in Ho Chi Minh City and is to be commended for his efforts and bringing good Japanese cuisine and service to a city that is already teeming with standard fare Japanese food! Kudos!!
description: Very good tempura- if you like tempura this is the place.  The rest is pretty average.  Overall good service. Expensive but reasonable

name: Magnolia Kitchen & Cafe
address: 190 - 192 Đe Tham Street, Cau Ong Lanh Ward, District1 Crossroads De Tham street with Tran Hung Dao street, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I really really miss the experiences in Magnolia, it always the best choice when I take my foreigner guests to try Vietnamese food. Now I have to bang my head every time to find the replacement, please reopen the restaurant, please please, Food and drink here are so good and healthy. This place offers diverse meeting purposes, such as friend gathering, couple time, foreigner treats or business meeting (10+ people). The staff are nice and very professional. I hope the restaurant will be open soon so that we can come back. Will miss this place, My wife and I took a trip to South Asia for 35 days. A long way from Brazil. Besides Vietnam, we have been to Thailand (including beaches and islands), Cambodia and Myanmar. We tried all kinds of food, from fancy resort restaurants to a variety of street food. Magnolia was our BEST food experience by a long shot. The staff is very supportive, they would go out of their way to help us in all kinds of occasions. The first time we went there (by the suggestion of the front desk hotel staff), we suddenly found ourselves late for our afternoon tour due to bad scheduling. We asked them to haste as much as possible, and we thought of swallowing the food and leaving. We also had no idea of what Vietnamese food was like, so we just took the suggestions of the server. When our dishes came though... They were superb. Even having to eat fast, it tasted just so good we could not stop remarking it every time. We decided to go back there with more time. The following day, we went there and asked details of the dishes we would order (in spite of everyone’s English, ours included, and the natural difficulty of food names translation). Also I had pictures I had taken the day before of dishes served to other guests, the presentation of which had made an impression on me. I usually don’t care much about food presentation, but they do it in beautifully, to the point of calling my attention. Once again, food was superb. Food presentation often comes with high prices, which is just not the case. Magnolias have dishes for very reasonable prices, in spite of the beautiful presentation and wonderful food taste. On our last day of our stay in Saigon, we lost our credit card. We thought we had forgotten it at Magnolia, but we passed by and they said it wasn’t there, after searching everything. When we got back to our hotel room, we found out the credit card had been there all day long. We went to the front desk of the hotel and asked the receptionist to call the restaurant saying we had found the card, and also to say, in good Vietnamese, they had the best food we had tried in all Asia thus far. We had then about 15 days travelling. After all the 35 days, we still hold the same opinion. I do hope someone of the restaurant reads this. If you are going to Saigon and plans to visit Bui Vien Walking Street, please do yourself a favor. Take Đường Đề Thám down, cross Đường Trần Hưng Đạo and keep walking a few meters. It is just the next block down on the left, less than 10 minutes from Bui Vien. Then ask for the crunchy rice. You won’t regret it. I certainly won’t forget!
description: The Magnolia Kitchen & Cafe is where to experience home cooked Vietnamese food in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City. Our unique and traditional meals from all corners of Vietnam will inspire you to experience something new and delicious, and our location downtown cannot be beat. Relax in our cozy and private concept rooms or have a cool drink on the rooftop cafe.

name: L'Usine Thiso Mall
address: 13 Hoang The Thien Thu Thiem, District 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Really enjoy the food here. The grilled vegetable salad is quite hearty. The service has been great but my wife didn't have good service at one of their other locations. They can get busy. The atmosphere is nice and it is pretty cool to have the open kitchen where you can see them plating the food. Expect western prices., Visited Lusine restaurant upstairs on Don Khoi Street. Good place to meet friends for brunch . Had a great western breakfast with good bakery items. You are surrounded with antiques and the place has a warehouse feel , hence the name, highly recommended!, Was recommended to us by a friend who had previously travelled to Hi Chi Minh City (Saigon). A little hard to find, down an arcade, turn right, up stairs but was worth it. Prices were good, nice variety and convenient location.
description: Really enjoy the food here. The grilled vegetable salad is quite hearty. The service has been great but my wife didn't have good service at one of their other locations. They can get busy. The atmosphere is nice and it is pretty cool to have the open kitchen where you can see them plating the food. Expect western prices.

name: Bep Oc Sai Gon
address: 74/7 Hai Ba Trung, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: One of my favorite meals in Saigon, which says a lot because I believe that this is one of the food capitals of the world. Highly recommend getting there earlier because some dishes will sell out. Our order: salted egg chicken feet, salted egg cartilage, snails in coconut sauce. You can’t really go wrong with any snail and any sauce combo. Wasn’t a big fan of the Cajun-style boil or the scallops, but everything else was so good. A must-try when you’re in Saigon., Found this place hidden in District 1 and absolutely loved it. They were still closed when we showed up, but the staff was so welcoming and told us they can serve us early anyway. The food was great - we tried many dishes and loved them all. Food is all very rich and perfect level of spice. Spent 2 weeks in Vietnam and this might have been our favorite meal from the entire trip., Great little seafood restaurant popular with locals tucked away in a quiet lane. The place was buzzing with regulars served the freshest seafood. Mostly shellfish, clams and snails. The seafood bowl in the house spicy sauce was incredible.

Highly recommend getting there earlier because some dishes will sell out. Our order: salted egg chicken feet, salted egg cartilage, snails in coconut sauce. You can’t really go wrong with any snail and any sauce combo. Wasn’t a big fan of the Cajun-style boil or the scallops, but everything else was so good. A must-try when you’re in Saigon.

name: Pho Hai Thien
address: 14 Bui Vien, Quan 1 T&vi chu Tam, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: I have eaten for 5 times and the taste has never changed!!! Clean, different and good staffs. More about food: beef noodle is the most famous bowl in Saigon, normally noodle is made from rice, in Hai Thien after made from rice, noodle is mixing with color of vegatable to make colorful noodle. It’s pretty good for your health and your taste!, Way better than I expected it to be. Had the "Fried Pho With Beef" (75,000 VND) and the "Pork Deep Fried Spring Rolls" (49,000 VND). Portions were ample and flavors were bold and totally spot on. Noodles, freshly made, were actually deep fried until gnarled and delicious, then topped with the tastiest beef-veggie stir-fry imaginable. Spring rolls were stuffed with sausage. I made a slurry of fish sauce and garlic-chili mush for dipping. The way to go. Ingredients used were top-notch - they went a long way towards making the meal excellent. Really can't recommend this place highly enough. You do pay more here but you get way better food and more of it, and air-conditioned confines, too. Can't go wrong. I only cry in my beer that I didn't try this place months ago as I've been walking past it for the longest time. This joint will enable you to understand why VN food is much-loved and sought-after., Since I am a flexitarian I appreciate good vegetarian food when I travel. The noodles in this restaurant are colored with vegetable dyes, thus a plate of vegetarian rolls could be very colorful. I also like their many fresh juices. I have dined here before and I will return.

I have eaten for 5 times and the taste has never changed!!! Clean, different and good staffs.
More about food: beef noodle is the most famous bowl in Saigon, normally noodle is made from rice, in Hai Thien after made from rice, noodle is mixing with color of vegatable to make colorful noodle. It’s pretty good for your health and your taste!

name: Roast & Smoke Thao Dien
address: 188be14 Nguyen Van Huong, Thao Dien, District 2, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: This is a beautiful pet friendly bbq cafe is the place for all meat lovers, where you can try the finest smoked meats, slow-cooked to juicy tenderness. There are lots of dishes to choose from and we couldn't get enough of their brisket, which is barbecued to perfection for 12 hours and melts right in your fork. We ordered the brisket and pork ribs platter which was absolutely heavenly. We also tried their spaghetti carbonara. The owner and chef are really sweet and friendly and it is evident that the place is a hot favorite among expats and pet lovers! Definitely one of my favorite places to eat in HCM., This place is highly recommended by my friend Rebekka, she suggested to me to try the Smoke beef brisket Pho and their coconut coffee,and guess what, I Love It!!! Definitely a must try. The ambiance of the place is cozy, with free wi-fi,courteous staff that can converse in English. PS. Smoked beef brisket Pho is available only from Mon-Sat., This is a nice quiet nook in suburban Ho Chi Minh City. The garden is lovely and welcoming. The menu is perfectly expansive. The food is served with a definite pride and attention to care. The cafe is a bit out of the way but worth the trouble.
description: Coffee Roasters & BBQ Smoke House

name: Okra Foodbar
address: 02 Lê Văn Miến Street Thảo Điền, Quận 2, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: A small restaurant located in Thao Dien area but always busy, so book a table before coming. All dishes are delicious and beautiful. I can't eat much raw food, but the oyster dish here is very delicious, fragrant, unique and not at all fishy, so I recommend you try this dish. Staff are very friendly and cheerful. I have eaten here many times, and will continue to visit to enjoy the delicious food., We loved our visit here. The food was superb (though our most disappointing dish was the pigs ear ) and the service and ambience was excellent. Our food came out fish by fish so we were never overwhelmed by dishes. Our server and OK thế were excellent!, We decided to try Okra after a few recommendations from friends. The food was outstanding and definitely some of the best we’ve had in Saigon which is very high praise. We opted for the set menu (1M for two people) and upgraded to the duck breast main for an extra 200k. This provided us with 7 courses in total. Each dish was brimming with flavour and had very creative combinations. The lamb and clam cassoulet was a definite highlight! The food draws culinary influences from every corner of the world but had a definite Japanese / Mediterranean fusion feel overall. Okra is a small venue which means you have an intimate experience and can sit up on the bar and watch the chefs at work. The staff are very attentive and the head chef clearly loves what he does which sets the tone for the whole experience. Best to book ahead!
description: OKRA FoodBar is a casual yet vibrant space where Chef Jamie Celaya and his passionate team craft innovative comfort food and craft cocktails. Our focus is on creating a dining experience that honors sustainability, accessibility, and local ingredients. We delight in sharing big, bold flavors that break away from tradition, incorporating international techniques to craft a menu that is truly unique. Our unorthodox style of hospitality reflects the diverse community we are proud to serve. Join us for a chef-driven dining journey with globally inspired cuisine and innovative cocktails that celebrate culture and creativity.

name: Am Thuc Sinh Thai Sen Nam Bo
address: Vo Chi Cong Street Cau Kenh Mot Tan, Phu Huu Ward, District 9, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This place is surely a great place for an outing for lunch or dinner.Indeed very unique and a good experience. kind of floating lotus restaurant. Merely simple vietnamese cuisine. Located in District 2 and probably will take you about 30 minutes, We had a fantastic group brunch in this open air restaurant featuring various types of Vietnamese dishes ranging as fried fish, drilled chicken, seafood, spring rolls, vegestables, soup, desserts etc... Ambience was nice and weather was cool in Nov.
description: This place is surely a great place for an outing for lunch or dinner.Indeed very unique and a good experience. kind of floating lotus restaurant. Merely simple  vietnamese cuisine. Located in District 2 and probably will take you about 30 minutes

name: Zeroism - Vegan Café & Store
address: 50 Nguyễn Cừ, Thao Dien, District 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Nice atmosphere, this vegan could be found anywhere in the world: Munich, New York or Paris as the Vietnamese note is absent. Enough card provided for breakfast, lunch or dinner prices are correct although rather fixed for expats or Vietnamese upper middle class. It is tasty, fresh but a little too trendy: the burger rubs shoulders with fucacia. Good desserts not too sweet this vegan rivals those in this district of Thao Dien with less authenticity. Discover, Entirely vegan café and brunch-style restaurant which offers a huge range of mains - including plant-based pizzas. The menu is 🇵🇸clear on ingredients - labelling each item and marking those that contain gluten - and providing additional information too. 🇿🇦🇵🇸The desserts can be low in sugar. I’ve had the sweet potato chocolate brownie, and that certainly will control your glycemic reaction. 🕊️⚖️🌏⚖️ Out of the centre of HCMC and halfway down a pleasantly quiet street. Welcoming to all🇵🇸⚖️!, I'd rate this a solid 99.8. First off, it's a charming little restaurant, beautifully and tastefully decorated, with soft, unobtrusive, mellow jazz to accompany the best vegan food I've found anywhere in Asia. Started with a salted, sweetened lemonade with many other ingredients, all of which added up to a taste I've never encountered, but it was incredible. Then ordered a mushroom/cheese sandwich whose bread was soft, sweet, and just the right size to carry the tasty sandwich. The cheeses (yes, at least 2) were, like everything, made onsite, and I'm guessing were a nut base, but not sure. I am sure how they tasted though: excellent. Some sort of vegan paté and homemade mayo capped the masterpiece. As if the sandwich weren't adequate, a small salad accompanied, with a softly sweet dressing. I topped the meal with superb cheesecake, topped with strawberry jam, in just the right proportions. All in all, an EXCELLENT meal, and for a very reasonable price. My partner had similar order to mine, and the bill came to less than 500K. And the best part was the people. We met the manager who spent time explaining the restaurant's origin and owners. She was delightful, as were the other people working there. This place is new, and I am sure it will draw a faithful audience. I'm at the top of that list.

Enough card provided for breakfast, lunch or dinner prices are correct although rather fixed for expats or Vietnamese upper middle class. It is tasty, fresh but a little too trendy: the burger rubs shoulders with fucacia. Good desserts not too sweet this vegan rivals those in this district of Thao Dien with less authenticity. Discover

name: Agavesaigon
address: 13 Pasteur Q1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Absolutely delicious!! We stumbled upon this place, we’re huge fans of the cuisine & absolutely loved it!! Recommend soft shell crab tortillas with a cold Corona! Fresh & so full of flavour, the guacamole was just perfect. Could be up there with the best Mexican I’ve had!, Wonderful fooddddd! I was so in love with all the dishes from Carlos. He is the best Mexican Chef. Cozy restaurant on 2nd floor, quiet hidden but you will feel very comfortable with theme music, chit chat with friends. The service quiet good and friendly. If you are looking for a place to enjoy with friends and chill out on weekend, this is it. A reservation is recommended as they are usually full house. They close on Monday as well!, Great place to have a few tacos, cocktails and cold beers. Can highly recommend the monster burrito, corn and the fajitas. Everything we had was awesome and the owner Abel and the staff are great. Great night out
description: Agave is the first Contemporary Mexican Bistro in Vietnam created by Mexican owner of Macho Taco Ricardo and Mexican Chef Carlos Bravo well know for his great cuisine while being the Chef at Marriot Phu Quoc.

name: Kitchen By The River
address: No 2-4, Street 10, An Phu Ward Mia Saigon Luxury Boutique Hotel, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: What a delight to be greeted with warmth, with emotional connections like if they know you, like if they care about you. They DID care about us for the whole afternoon and evening.. It was my husband 60th Birthday: we arrived by boat (astonishing trip from D1 to the restaurant). Another way to travel in Ho Chi Minh City. A complimentary flute of Prosecco, a yummy beautiful red velvet cake... We had dinner on the pontoon, by ourself, with the view on the river and the city. Golden time was magical. The food could have been officially a Michelin food. Light, well presented, and truly delicious. We had Hokkaido scallops, NZ mussels, tuna with pickled quail eggs...We will come back with our friends to showcase the view, the food and the warmth of the excellent caring service. Thanks Atila and team. Thank you, This restaurant is in the 5* Mia boutique hotel. The outdoor seating is on the River & the busy city seems far away. We started with a tasty pumpkin soup, then a beef salad w/lemongrass. We then had a tasty chicken w/bamboo & spicy side. The dessert of dark chocolate with raspberry sauce was great. Our waitress (I think her name was Tam) was polite & thorough, We had a memorable experience celebrating my friend's birthday at this scenic restaurant by the river. I only communicated for the preparations via WhatsApp with the restaurant while I was in a different country, and all my requests were provided. We especially appreciated the very courteous and excellent service of Phuong, too bad his shift ended before we finished our meal and we missed to express our appreciation. The food from appetizer to dessert was also great.
description: Where Asia and Europe Meet. Surrounded by simmering sauces, sizzling meats and chopped salads, most families gravitate towards the kitchen when gathering. Dining at Mia Saigon offers a gastronomic journey through time and space for a truly unique culinary experience.

name: Ming Court Restaurant
address: 235 Nguyen Van Cu Street, District 1 Hotel Nikko, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Had my first visit to the Ming Court as the Japanese Restaurant is now closed. It was great and the All You Can Eat Dim Sum is Wonderful. Huge choice of food all freshly prepared and the quality is very good and you can eat, eat and eat. Good Service as well in a spacious restaurant. I also had Tiger Beer on draught. Fully Recommended, The Peking duck was authentic prepared in 3 dishes separately for the skin, meat and bone. We went again for the second evening and the porridge was excellent as well. Really great food and service from Ming Court restaurant in Hotel Nikko Saigon., Food: mediocre dim sum Services: Fair Price: High Value: Average Ambiance: Fine dining Decor: Plain Location: 3rd Floor of Hotel Nikko Saigon Favorite Dish(es): stewed beef shank, crispy shrimp, sesame crisp dessert
description: Ming Court features classic Chinese cuisine with a Taiwanese touch, traditional dishes prepared with a modern Chinese approach. Guests can enjoy delicious dim sum lunches, a la carte or set menu with a wide selection of Chinese and Taiwanese teas, wines and rice wine.

name: Aex Cocktail Bar
address: 128G NGUYEN DINH CHINH, Ward 8, Phu Nhuan District, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Absolutely loved the cozy ambiance of AEX Cocktail Bar! The warm orange tones create a welcoming atmosphere, making it a perfect spot for both friends and couples. The drinks were exceptional, each sip was a burst of flavors that left a lasting impression. The bartender was not only skilled but also incredibly friendly, adding a personal touch to the overall experience. The cave-themed concept added a unique charm to the place, making it a great choice for a casual hangout with friends or a romantic date night. Definitely a must-visit for anyone looking for a great atmosphere, delicious drinks, and friendly service. Can't wait to go back!, I went with my lover on Christmas day. The restaurant's space is cozy with orange tones. Cocktails cost from 149k - 219k (quite reasonable price) There is private parking for motorbikes and cars Friendly and enthusiastic staff The drinks are very delicious, Nice view and concept!Menu from classic to signature drinks. I took a drink from the seasonal menu.: Typical vietnamese sweet dish inspired cocktail! We took a taxi 7 mins from downtown. Suitable for big groups. If you want it private choose the second floor!
description: Famous cocktail bar in Ho Chi Minh City. Inspired by the nature, this cocktail bar has a cave concept with an orange yellow color palette, offering a nice ambient. Table for private talk or big tables for any events are available. Every Saturday from 10pm to 1am DJ Richie is in the house. Many infused cocktails are offered. (inspired by vietnamese ingredients)

name: Country Houses Cafe
address: 18C Phan Van Tri Street, Ward 10, Go Vap District, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: This spacious coffee shop boasts a fountain and a garden in the middle of the compound. Even some of the tables for coffee are housed inside a wooden cabin for the countryside feel. The prices of coffee and meals are affordable. You can definitely spend as much time as you want in this place and just relax. Great for catching up with friends., If you're close by, it's worth a visit. The setting is nice and food was good and cheap. They don't give you much when it comes to drinks though. A few sips and it's gone., A decent big cafe with countryside theme. The menu does not only have coffee but there are also finger food and main meals you can ordered. We took a taxi there from the city. Seems like a long ride due to the traffice. Service was ok.
description:
This spacious coffee shop boasts a fountain and a garden in the middle of the compound. Even some of the tables for coffee are housed inside a wooden cabin for the countryside feel.

The prices of coffee and meals are affordable. You can definitely spend as much time as you want in this place and just relax. Great for catching up with friends.

name: Hidden House - Vietnamese Restaurant & Drinks
address: 55/1-3 Lê Thị Hồng Gấm, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Just around the corner from our hotel and very convenient. We chose an early dinner as it was our final night in Saigon, and the final night of a two week tour from Hanoi. We chose deep fried spring rolls and they were better than most. The soft shell crab with salted egg sauce was an absolute winner, especially with some chilli. A simple beef with noodles gave us a good meal for about $A35 and that included a couple of beers. Nice staff. The waitress was very attentive and deserves a thank you. Highly recommended as other members of our group also ate here and loved it., Lien and Kha were very attentive. Served us with a smile and helped us with the menu. The setting is very relaxing, air conditioned. With chilling music. The food. We had the pork char Sui ribs (fabulous) Mushroom glass noodle stir fry. Egg vinegar salad. After a long day out on the Cuchi tunnels it was perfect along with a couple of G&Ts. Will be back. Highly recommended, The restaurant seating and atmosphere were very calm and presentable. My favorite dish was the garlic fried rice because there was soon much garlic, and the flavor was excellent. The shrimp were also AMAZING and really juicy. The service was also really nice and fun. Overall I would rate the experience a 9/10.
description: Located in a small alley on Le Thi Hong Gam Street, the center of District 1 is always bustling and bustling. Hidden House brings a nostalgic, cozy space, diverse menu, will be the ideal meeting place for groups of friends and family after work.

name: Cơm Niêu Cà Pháo
address: Tầng 1-2 Số 68 Ngô Đức Kế, Phường Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Very early dinner at 5pm, they were still clearing up after a busy Sunday lunch service by the look of it but very accommodating. Friendly staff, varied menu, good food. 3 dishes and 2 soft drinks for £15., This place was such a pleasant surprise. Stumbled upon this place while taking a stroll in the city center. Food will make you melt. The service is great. I recommend with closed eyes.
description: Very early dinner at 5pm, they were still clearing up after a busy Sunday lunch service by the look of it but very accommodating. Friendly staff, varied menu, good food. 3 dishes and 2 soft drinks for £15.

name: Manmaru Japanese Restaurant
address: 192A, Ly Tu Trong Street, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: We came here this lunch and it was a missed for us. Maybe we chose the wrong plate or we came on a bad day. The restaurant looks okay outside but it was a mess inside. The food was same as the menu but the taste was average. My California rolls was not fresh. Staff was young and nice., Nice atmosphere, attentive staff, good menu options, even for small bites. Very affordable prices. Personally I liked it very much, open kitchen, quick service, The place is wonderful because of the food and the service, but (and this “but” makes the whole impression of the restaurant) it’s very noisy in there, the staff greets you saying “welcome” in Japanese and its okay when you enter the place, but when you are sitting and enjoying your food (and the food is really great and fresh) it irritates so much that you don’t want to be there.
description:
We came here this lunch and it was a missed for us. Maybe we chose the wrong plate or we came on a bad day.
The restaurant looks okay outside but it was a mess inside. The food was same as the menu but the taste was average. My California rolls was not fresh.
Staff was young and nice.

name: Marcel - Thao Dien
address: 19a Ngo Quang Huy, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Marcel Gourmet Burger is a total gem, blending amazing food with a super welcoming vibe. From the moment you walk in, it feels stylish yet comfy—great for a relaxed meal or a nice casual dinner. The food's incredible. Each burger is perfectly made with top-notch ingredients that make classic flavors amazing. Whether it's their signature burger with that awesome raclette cheese or the spicy chicken burger, every bite is seriously good. The service is fantastic too—friendly, helpful, and fast, making the whole experience smooth. With its great food, fair prices, and effortlessly cool atmosphere, Marcel Gourmet Burger is a must-try for anyone who loves a really great burger., Good burgers and efficient service, also for large groups, although we may have to wait longer than usual. We will come back, I really like Marcel restaurant, i usually have dinner in Marcel in D1, and sometime in Thao Dien. Last week, i and my son went there, at that time no customer at all, staffs just gather to talk with a grab food service. We was sitting there nearly 15 minutes but no one come to ask us. I tried to look at them to see if they look as us or not, but they didnt. We stand up and left the restaurant but none of them ask us why we left. I never want to come back this restaurant.
description: At Marcel Gourmet Burger, we like our burgers the French way! We propose unique recipes with a creative twist, using only the finest ingredients to bring burgers to a gourmet level. We use a large majority of fresh and good quality products, sourced locally whenever possible. When we can’t find the good stuff, we make it!

name: Mẹ Ỉn Noodles
address: 136/7 Lê Thánh Tôn, phường Bến Thành, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Our family of four ( 2 teenage boys) ate here three times (lunch and dinner) over 7 days. Food is consistent, very tasty, fresh and great servings. Staff were friendly, happy to demonstrate how to eat certain dishes. Lovely clean premises and ambience. Great food at great prices. Independent Ice cream vendor at entrance - buy a few scoops and enjoy at your table. Around $50 AUD Michelin 2023 & 2024., Spring roll was a fail. A few mins after ordering it already came out but the pho took 10mins. Anyway, the spring roll was all veggies even if the receipt says it has grilled meat. We asked them about it and they said there is no price difference 😩 Anyway pho is worth it., Food here is amazing, as is the servce. Several servers stopped by, but Nolan was the one who helped me decide what to order and his recommendation was perfect for me. Had the clear noodles with crabmeat. It was so full of flavor, crab and vegetables that I highly recommend it. There is a small wait but well worth it while they cook it to order. Highly recommend this place for lunch or dinner on your next visit to Hanoi.
description: Our family of four ( 2 teenage boys) ate here three times (lunch and dinner) over 7 days. Food is consistent, very tasty, fresh and great servings. Staff were friendly, happy to demonstrate how to eat certain dishes. Lovely clean premises and ambience. Great food at great prices. Independent Ice cream vendor at entrance - buy a few scoops and enjoy at your table. Around $50 AUD Michelin 2023 & 2024.

name: Pho Ngoc
address: Alley 1, Ho Hao Hon Co Giang, Dist 1, Opposite Number 27, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: This super tasty joint was around the corner from our hotel. It is only open for breakfast but it is worth skipping the hotel breakfast for. This is proper streetfood with makeshift tables and roof but the broth was incredibly beefy and meat generous servings and much better than the no1 place for pho in HCM. If you are in the neighborhood one not to miss! A hidden gem for sure!, Ok I know it’s totally subjective but this was the best pho I’ve personally ever eaten and I’ve tried it all over Vietnam. Our family of six plus one friend enjoyed every bite. The staff was super attentive and kind taking care of every single need. I’ll go back here without a doubt., E went here on the r commendation of Luke Nguyen (Australian celebrity chef) and loved the food and atmosphere. The only thing I would suggest is that if you don’t like your meat a bit fatty then let them know and they will remove it for you. Most locals like the extra bit of fat since they don’t eat a lot of meat, but personally I like the fat removed. The staff were lovely and happy for us to take a fe20' Core Fit. touristy photos of the place.
description: This super tasty joint was around the corner from our hotel. It is only open for breakfast but it is worth skipping the hotel breakfast for. This is proper streetfood with makeshift tables and roof but the broth was incredibly beefy and meat generous servings and much better than the no1 place for pho in HCM. If you are in the neighborhood one not to miss! A hidden gem for sure!

name: The Gin House
address: 28/3A Ton That Tung Street, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Couldn't understand why this place was so underrated! The drinks was damn good and service was attentive. The most important thing was a live music from 10PM. On the night we came, they played most of Maroon 5 songs which was great, at least for me. I and my party drunk total 9 glass of cocktail, 1 cheese stick and the bill came out as around $150. So cheap!, Absolutely fantastic unexpected find in a small alley in ho chi min city . Large gin collection with great live music and exceptional staff ! Big shout out to the captain - Vi ! We will be back !, Beautiful little Gin bar in HCM, great choices, lovely atmosphere Will go again when next back in HCM
description: A small Speak Easy bar, in a small alley, will make you surprise with a biggest Gin collection in Vietnam together with 24 kinds of House Gin Infusion (Our home made gin). Also with the craft cocktails from our mixologist will satisfied you! Come on, get your G&T!! #theginhousesaigon #fromginhousewithlove

name: Cuu Non Hy Lap
address: 395 Hoang Sa District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Cuu Non Hy Lap, with its tasty and authentic Greek delicacies and casual outdoor dining, is a unique and memorable Saigon experience, matched only by the unique and memorable character of its owner/chef. District 3’s roadside Greek restaurant across from the river has a story with a unique and amazing twist: restaurant owner and chef Duc is Vietnamese . . . and then became Greek. How? you might ask. Duc's story is a tale of courage, resilience and triumph. He was a teenage refugee who crossed stormy seas to reach Malaysia. Soon he was on a plane with other Vietnamese refugees and landed in a place he never imagined he’d visit: Athens, Greece. His education - learning a new language and learning about life and survival in a foreign land - came through work. He started out in restaurant kitchens working long hours as a dish hand and cleaner. He made Greek friends quickly through his work ethic and quick wit, learned the language fluently, and progressed in the restaurant industry to eventually become a chef. He worked hard and did well, but when the global financial crisis hit in 2008 he realised that he had one more calling: to return to his original home, Vietnam. Duc started over in the country of his birth, and before long was back in business, opening his own restaurant, Cuu Non Hy Lap (Greek Lamb). It is a restaurant that offers a variety of cuisines, but what makes it special are the Greek dishes cooked 7 days a week by Duc himself. Try any of his signature dishes - moussaka, meat barbecued Greek-style on the grill, tasty and authentic dips, delicious cheese pies (tiropitakia) made with filo pastry - and you will know that these are meals cooked with love and skill. Duc is a proud Vietnamese man. And he is also a proud Greek citizen. He is an extraordinary man who is only too happy to share his food and his story (in English, Vietnamese or Greek!) with his loyal and satisfied customers. Tell him Milton says hello when you go there., This restaurant was favourably reviewed in a Saigon magazine, so we went there at sunset. What a surprise! The tables and chairs were well placed for views of the river and bridge. The service was excellent. The beer was chilled. The Greek food was delicious. Greek salad, moussaka, lamb kebab, garlic bread. A huge meal for 2 people, including 6 beers, for 444,000 VND (= $18). Will definitely visit this place again and again.

Duc is a proud Vietnamese man. And he is also a proud Greek citizen. He is an extraordinary man who is only too happy to share his food and his story (in English, Vietnamese or Greek!) with his loyal and satisfied customers. Tell him Milton says hello when you go there.

name: Prem Bistro & Café
address: 87/15 Dien Bien Phu, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The 🇵🇸🧕🏼 café attached to the bistro is called Kafka Café ⚖️🔻 and is located on the ground floor, although the fair-sized restrooms themselves are up on the 3rd floor, above a yoga boutique I believe 🕌 . The café itself is located down a short cul-de-sac, close to a corner of a standard block. It's a 🇿🇦 great and 🇵🇸 friendly choice for doing a bit of working, or studying of a Middle Eastern language - whether an 🇱🇧Arabic dialect or 🇮🇷 Persian. There's a long bench further back on the ground floor, which affords a great view of chefs prepping food and stock checking. If you're cruelty-free, you'll be elated to know that there is an option for 🌳 oat milk with your drinks order, and you're also able to specify the number of espresso shots you'd like. There don't seem to be many - if any - options (food-wise) in the café. If you do calves' milk there's stuff., This place has a lovely setting. The roof terrace is a particularly pleasing place to drink a few sundowners and have a bite to eat. The service is excellent and the food was tasty. My one criticism would be that some of the dishes we ordered were a little small for the price. However, the atmosphere and service go someway to make up for that., I was invited by my close friend for dinner at this restaurant. When I first came there, he chose a floor-seating table and we sat down on cushions. That made me feel like somewhere like home but special. He ordered some signature dishes which are culinary combinations of the East and the Western ingredients. The foods took me to several levels of taste like I was traveling to Italia when it came to burrata cheese then I moved to one tropical country for a bite of sour sweet orange. I would love to try more in the next times.

address: 57 Hai Bà Trưng Phường Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Since our hotel was nearby, we saw this restaurant. It gave us a traditional impression and we decided to eat there for dinner. The food came quickly and was tasty. The staff don't speak English and serve in silence but with a smile. The menu is also in English and has photos of the different dishes. Therefore, choosing and ordering is easy. The prices are reasonable. We went there twice for dinner and were satisfied., The menu is extensive and authentic. The ingredients fresh and flavoursome, what could go wrong. We had the Bun Char and Pho Tai Lan, both excellent. The drinks list includes beers and fresh juices. Highly recommended., Excellent Vietnamese food. Really good flavours and the broken rice was great. The soup was good too and the sauce was amazing. Reasonably priced too. Good stuff!
description: Vietnamese Casual Dining - Come to Taste Traditional Recipes - Kind Staff Ready to Serve - Explicit & Fair Price. We serve typical dishes of Vietnam like Pho, Broken Rice, vietnam's noodles,... Discover the Go-To Vietnamese Restaurant in Hồ Chí Minh. Come and Eat with Us Today.

name: Catinat Lounge
address: 1 Dong Khoi, District 1 Hotel Majestic Saigon, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Great place for an afternoon cocktail after a long day of sightseeing in Saigon. Located in the Majestic Hotel Saigon in the lobby. A touch of old world charm on the Saigon River. Great views of river and the hustle and bustle of the city. Cocktail menu quite extensive and delicious. Sitting area is relaxing and a piano player makes it perfect. Worth a visit!, This lounge is good for lunch or afternoon tea/coffee if you want an oasis from the hustle and bustle of one of the busiest streets in HCM. Since staying at the Majestic on several occasions over the last few years, I have taken advantage of this lounge four or five times. There is nothing hip or even authentic? about it but is is a nice quiet atmosphere to sit for a while and watch the world go by outside the windows while you are planning your next foray into the fray. It would be a good place for a informal business meeting or a meet up with friends., Quite expensive bistro given that it is located within the Majestic Hotel. We had a tea time love with several little things on it... everything was bad, poorly cooked and of more than mediocre quality! At this price it is better to go to the roof top of the hotel

Great views of river and the hustle and bustle of the city.  Cocktail menu quite extensive and delicious.  Sitting area is relaxing and a piano player makes it perfect.   Worth a visit!

name: Bo Kho Co Mai - Since 1984 - Nguyen Thi Miinh Khai
address: 17C Nguyen Thi Minh Khai Street Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Specialty restaurant. Very good!! We went with friends and we liked it a lot. We recommend. I'm dissapointed

With a time-honored family recipe, the beef stew offers a unique and unforgettable flavor experience. Come and indulge in the rich and flavorful beef stew at Bo Kho Co Mai!

name: Mindfulness House
address: 21/20 Xuan Thuy, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: The tea gong ceremony brought tradition to life in the most elegant way. Watching the host prepare the tea with such grace and skill was as delightful as drinking the tea itself. Each variety was rich in character, paired with artisanal sweets that complemented the flavors perfectly. The atmosphere felt sacred yet welcoming, making it an experience I’d recommend to anyone seeking serenity., Visiting this tea house was a serene experience. The ambiance is peaceful, with a minimalist yet sophisticated design that immediately makes you feel relaxed. I came for their Tea Omakase and was blown away by the meticulous presentation and the depth of flavors in every cup. Each tea was paired thoughtfully with small bites that enhanced the tasting experience. The Tea Bell ceremony added a spiritual touch, allowing me to truly connect with the essence of tea. A must-visit for tea enthusiasts looking for a unique and memorable experience!, The Tea Omakase experience was beyond extraordinary. From the moment the first tea was poured, it was clear this was not just a tasting but a journey through tradition, artistry, and flavor. Each tea was presented with care, accompanied by a brief yet captivating explanation of its history and origin. The pairing with light, handcrafted bites elevated the entire experience. The balance of flavors, textures, and aromas left me feeling both invigorated and at peace. This is a must-try for anyone seeking a deeper connection with tea.
description: The tea gong ceremony brought tradition to life in the most elegant way. Watching the host prepare the tea with such grace and skill was as delightful as drinking the tea itself. reviews: This Resteraunt is in the financial tower. It was near our hotel. The drinks were amazing. The food was good. In addition, Cafe Terrace is also a place where customers can find food and drinks from other cultures in the world, creative variations that keep pace with the trend. Lost the traditional characteristics.

Overall, I highly recommend this restaurant if it's in your budget.

name: Pizza 4P's Vo Van Kiet
address: 608 Vo Van Kiet Cau Kho Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Pizza 4P’s Vo Van Kiet is a true hidden gem. While I've enjoyed their Ben Thanh branch, this location is truly special. The atmosphere is incredibly relaxing and perfect for a casual meal with friends, family, or a romantic date. The restaurant is spotless, and the staff is incredibly attentive and friendly, going above and beyond to ensure a pleasant dining experience. They even helped me with a surprise for my husband on our anniversary, adding a sweet message to our dessert plate. It was a lovely touch! The food is delicious and surprisingly affordable. While the dishes themselves are generally on the milder side, they provide a selection of condiments to customize your meal to your liking. I particularly enjoyed the crab pasta, which was even better with a dash of chili oil. While there were a few flies buzzing around, it didn't detract too much from the overall experience. Overall, Pizza 4P’s Vo Van Thanh is a great option for a delicious and affordable meal in a relaxing setting. I highly recommend it, especially for those looking for a personalized touch and the option to customize their dishes., Food was delicious! Service was fantastic! Do yourself a favour and eat here. We stayed in the apartments above this place and were a bit hesitant until we saw they were always very busy. First night we ordered take away and loved it so much we had dine in another night. We did not regret trying it. Fresh dough pizzas (even the cheese was amazing!). Everything we had (and we had ALOT) pizzas, pastas and mains were all worth walking through pouring rain to get there. I would definitely recommend 👍🏽 Thumbs up all around. Carbonara was a bit heavy and nothing to write home about, but otherwise we ate our way through the menu and everything was top notch., Pizza 4P is a full service Italian restaurant with an extensive menu but without the pretentiousness or unreasonable pricing of some of these places. I'd recommend prioritizing the Pizza and the fondue over the starters or Pasta! Service is prompt and the Pizzas are made fresh right in front of you at their oven which makes sure a great aroma fills the restaurant. They also have a decent wine menu with offerings from as far as Chile! Expect to pay around 300,000 VND pp without drinks.
description: An Earth to People restaurant on a mission to make the world smile for peace, one pizza at a time. Earth to People is our commitment to serve safe and fresh foods directly from Mother Earth to you. Located in Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Danang and Nha Trang.

address: 8 Nguyễn Thị Nghĩa Phường Phạm Ngũ Lão, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The banh Mi is really fresh and you can easy say what ingredients you want and what not. For those who haven’t known before, you can take a sit at 2nd floor to savor your meal while talking with your besties., we went there for a quick fix up and the banh mi there was just yum! reviews: The Tipsy Cow is a nice place to come with friends or not, it still warm your heart with cocktails, music night and people come here. Good service with good cocktails with price not too high. I highly recommend visiting., We were staying at fusion hotel for a few weeks and finally made it to the tipsy cow on our last night, I wish we had gone sooner. Really smart bar, modern and really nice cocktails. Reasonably priced old fashioned which is always a bonus. The fact it took him 10 mins to make, you know it’s done properly., Great place to relax and enjoy some good cocktails. Great service and music is on point. I definitely recommend this place for anyone looking for a place to relax without any hustle getting on your nerves. I like this place.
description: Introducing a new spot in District 1 with an intimate and cozy setting. Specializing in flavorful cocktails with fresh ingredients. Good vibes only! Come to chill and let’s get tipsy.

The food is excellent. I had the eggs Benedict, kombucha and a kefir smoothie. Laid back atmosphere and I would love to come back., Coming here without any expectation. This place is really interesting and surprised me a lot. They have fresh sourdough bread everyday. The food is delicious. Should have a cup of coffee then you're ready for working. The atsmophere and space make me comfortable. The staff is really helpful . Suitable for any kind of repast. They serve from 7am-10pm <3

name: Le Padam - Cheese Bar
address: 140 Pasteur street District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Best place in town for cheese and cold cuts. Great selction of wine by the glass. For cheese lovers. French atmosphere with musical background playing famous French artists. And nice painting and decoration including “Les Tontons flingueurs”; “la traversee de Paris”.... go check and enjoy this French paradise in the middle of Saigon..., A nice bar that has a huge selection of cheeses and some delicious ham and cold cuts to eat at the bar or at the Table and served with great French bread. Wines by the bottle and the glass and a few craft beers. A nice place to stop on Pasteur Street, Best cheese and service in HCMC. Fresh cheese imported regularly. The know best wine pairings. Laid back atmosphere.
description: Le Padam - Cheese Bar is a French wine bar that proposes nice cheese platters. All of the best cheese are selected and imported from France. You will be able to see the best quality of the raw milk cheese which is made by one of the best French Artisans. Located at 230 Nguyen Van Huong street, dist 2, Le Padam is where you can come with your friends, your family to enjoy our cheese, with homemade bread, and homemade Rillettes, or a Camembert Roti, ... Feel free to entertain yourself while waiting for your food with some of the activities we have to offer such as Apero (French custom of having a beverage around 7pm), a game of pool table, board games, or you can read a book, and much more. We will make you feel like home away from home, or just someone who is missing a corner in Paris, or a small bar in a small alley in France, or just a feeling of walking down the street with a baguette in your hand and eating a piece of cheese.

name: Bongensai Japanese Vegan Restaurant
address: 49 Nguyễn Đăng Giai, P. Thảo Điền Phường Thảo Điền, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: I went out to eat with my family in the evening, the space was quiet, comfortable, suitable for meditating over tea, the food was quite rich and the decoration looked very nice. The staff is polite and very happy and considerate. Please come and experience it, Outstanding dish for both vegetarian and non-vegetarian diners. We are not vegetarians and only came across the restaurant by chance, but they made us completely ignore the salty dishes. We both ordered soups as appetizers, a Lion's Mane Soup and a Cypress Two Soup. Each soup is fresh and delicate. We had a few dishes including red fish rice rolls with spicy sauce which had a delicious and unique flavor just like the savory dish. The sashimi combo is amazing. The staff is very nice, quick service response. I will give them 5 stars for the quality of food and service. I will definitely come back many more times., Bongensai- Phamnghiemtrai is a Buddhist cultural centre rather than a restaurant. They serve great Japanese Vegan dishes, and also Vietnamese vegan. I love the vegan Phở here alot. There is a Vietnamese Buddhist Museum on second floor, and also a Buddhist shop inside the building. You must try this place if you want to know more about Buddhist culture, especially Vietnamese Buddhism. They also have second place in Dist 1 with Mahayana Buddhist gallery and great TeaLounge
description: Bongensai is a Japanese vegan restaurant and Tea lounge, belong to Pham Nghiem Trai group with the style of Japanese architecture combined with Buddhist decoration. Bongensai serves 100% vegan foods, premium tea, Buddhist art museum and Buddhist boutique.

name: Pho Dinh Japanese Restaurant
address: 69 Nam Ky Khoi Nghia Ben Thanh, Quan 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: good food and good experience their grilled beef and fried rice special is good. staff and quality is always consistent and I have eaten here many times., By chance found this place while walking around Saigon. They have a very interesting menu from basic to very exclusive (and expensive) dishes on offer. We opted for the prime rib which came thinly sliced which you then cook on a grid over a charcoal fire on your table. The meat was tender and the served with a variety of side dishes and a salad. Ice cold beer and a very reasonable price made for a very good lunch experience., It is located next to Saigon Square so it is easily be accessible by walk or car if you are in the city center. I went there for lunch on 23 February 2019. We ordered 2 lunch sets, 1 beef chop, 1 chicken fillet and 1 assorted vegetables. The beef chop and the chicken fillet were delicious. The environment there was average, to me it was a bit noisy on the day I visited. The service there was so so, the waiters and waitress were not as efficient as what I had expected but the price was reasonable. The total of my bill was around 35 dollars. Just to the conclusion, I would like to recommend it to those who likes BBQ food. It is because of its location, price and food.
description:
good food and good experience

their grilled beef and fried rice special is good.  

staff and quality is always consistent and I have eaten here many times.

name: Malt
address: 46-48 Mac Thi Buoi District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Great choice of tropical and traditional craft beers, nicely curated by the friendly bar staff. Food was by no means secondary to the beer, and after five days in Saigon it was a refreshing contrast to the generic Vietnamese cuisine. Bit quiet during the day time, but feels like it would be very alive and vibrant at the night time. The meal was soundtracked by bouncing, atmospheric tunes, making the experience all the more enjoyable. Massively recommended!! 👍🏻, I wanted to write a review of Malt South in District 7 but unfortunately I cannot find it listed in Trip Advisor. Knowing that Malt is a sister restaurant of Malt South, in D1, I decided to write the review here. Malt South is a place to which we go regularly, with super friendly, welcoming staff and it is usually at least half full each night which gives it a great vibe. We very much enjoy the pork ribs, especially with the corn on the cob, salad and the coleslaw. I must say that the coleslaw is the best tasted anywhere. Malt South also makes a delicious spicy cauliflower dish as well. In addition, my husband loves the prawns in chili and garlic sauce which he says are wonderful. Finally, another favourite of mine is the chili con carne on fries. There is a slight sweetness to the meat which I don't particularly like but a few extra chilis and generously added salt soon takes care of that. The fries are crisp and tasty. The only concern I have had is sometimes in the past this dish has been a little warm as opposed to hot, or the French fries have been hot but the meat just warm. However over time of asking if the waitress can ask the chef to send the whole dish out piping hot, it is now to a supper hot temperature on a regular basis. The wines there are very good, especially the Italian and the frozen Bellinis are the best in town. It is a treat to pop into Malt South from time to time., We loved coming to Malt. The staff are really friendly and always smiling. They have a great selection of beers, our favourite was the Jasmine IPA. We had the Beer Fries, which are delicious. The Chicken wings are SO good and we enjoyed the meatball sandwich with tomato soup too. It's very relaxed at Malt, and the front patio is a good place to sit and watch the world go by.
description: Malt Saigon started as a dream of creating a cozy hangout for friends to enjoy good beer and great company. Today, we're a vibrant neighborhood bar, offering a curated selection of craft beers, an eclectic menu of Asian and Western small plates, and a fun-filled atmosphere. Whether you're looking to catch up with friends, unwind after a long day, or try something new, Malt Saigon is the perfect place to be.

name: Little Bear
