reviews: Definitely worth a visit! The ambiance is perfect for a date or a small gathering with close friends to chat and sip some wine. The food is delicious, flavorful, and unique. The staff is adorable and friendly—100 points ❤️❤️❤️, Just spot this new place in the neighborhood - Thao Dien, D2, HCMC. Kinda surprised with this concept. I decided only to drink with my friends but they served me some really good free snacks. The food matches well with the wine I ordered although it’s looks so strange at first 😆 cant guess what it is. Space is not too loud but gives high energy, relaxing to talk. Will be back for sure!
description: Vibrant vibe - Tasty food - Dynamic wine Set menu / A la carte menu available Little Bear is an intimate place A gathering place for all friends to enjoy music, delightful food, and fresh wine. Come to Little Bear for a unique blend of contemporary cuisine and diverse local ingredients. We are very excited to provide you the finest experience here with the addition of many more glasses of wine!

name: Red Bison Grill
address: 56 Pho Duc Chinh, Nguyen Thai Binh Ward, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: HCMC- RED BISON GRILL Restaurant- 12/03/25 dinner Great rating & food on offer drew us into booking a table at the venue. Greeted at door with a friendly welcome. Table had plenty of room. The ambiance was lovely & decor was dark, but worked adding to the atmosphere. The pan seared scollops & creamy mushroom croquettes for starters didn’t disappoint Main course - both steaks ordered (Grilled Picanha & NY strip) were perfectly cooked to our order of medium rare, super succulent & juicy. Accompanied by (their version of) Mac & cheese & green salad, while enjoying a mocktail, of which I would recommend tasting. All round great experience! Waitress was brilliant., Fantastic restaurant. We wanted something other than Vietnamese food and stumbled upon the Red Bison. The menu choices were great for all dietary requirements. Can highly recommend the butternut squash cannelloni, the beef spaghetti bolognaise and the bison burger. Restaurant was cool & comfortable, the prices were reasonable and the service was friendly & excellent. Met the chef/owner who was really friendly. Can’t rate this restaurant highly enough. Thank you for a great evening., We had a delicious dinner here. The Red Bison Burger was sooo good. I didn’t feel like fries so swapped them over for mashed potatoes which were so yummy! You can also get great steaks here as well. If you want a good burger I highly recommend!!
description: Red Bison Grill focuses on a more modern approach to American Cuisine, all while still staying true to our roots of good, honest food in a comfortable setting. Our menus draws inspiration from the flavorful fare of Southwestern and Southern American cooking along with some global favorites of ours and of course… fresh, local ingredients. The end result is American Cuisine done in a contemporary style that we hope creates a unique culinary experience for our customers. Come to Red Bison Grill, you can enjoy a wide range of dishes from Steaks and Burgers to Pastas and Pizzas all in the comfort of our warm and wonderful dining atmosphere!

name: Thap Nga Restaurant
address: 168, Nguyen Huu Tho Street, Phuoc Kieng , Nha Be, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Thap Nga -Binh Xuyen 2 is a restaurant that is off the beaten path. Locals who know good food make up the majority of patrons. After parking outside the restaurant there are a number of sculptures which provide good picture taking opportunities. Upon entering I was overwhelmed by the size. We walked quite a distance before we arrived at our table which was right on the river. Watching it grow dark was a pleasant experience. There were no insects to bother us. As I said the restaurant is huge. It easily could accommodate hundreds of diners but our table was in a quiet location on a Friday evening. The menu is extensive. Only one copy was provided to my Vietnamese companion. i requested my own copy and quickly saw that it is entirely written in Vietnamese. However there are many pictures. The restaurant is so large that the servers use bicycles and roller skates to travel up and back the wide aisles. Portions are enormous. Snails, which I don't eat, were plentiful and plumb. i was told they were delicious. I ordered a chicken dish which was ample enough for 3 or 4 people to share. The chicken came whole and was cut up by our server at an adjacent serving station. An excellent choice. Local beer was a fine and inexpensive accompanyment to our meal. We enjoyed Saigon Gold which is a limited edition brew that i had never seen before. Service was friendly and efficient. There are enough young servers so that you will be able to find someone who can speak English., Very good for family weekend. You can come here for fishing, dining... Larger space, but there are many small "cottages" for private groups from 5-10 people. Food is really local., We were looking for an ordinary outing and stumbelled on this extraordinary restaurant. If you live to go fishing and are looking to go out for dinner with the family, this is the place for you. The setting is lavish and extensive. It looks like it is designed to accommodate large business groups and weddings, but a section is devoted to smaller tables. They had no problem accommodating our group of 12. In fact they did really well with our mostly 6-12 aged children, while the dads went fishing. There was something for everyone and the serving sizes are large. They were kind enough to down scale our order, knowing it was going to be too much food. The price was reasonable considering the quality of the setting and service. The waiters actually wore roller skates to speed up service over this extensive restaurant. The fishing was really inexpensive at 10k a rod, and it came with bait. The foyer aquarium showed an extensive selection of fish, but they came at a premium price. A great outing for the family and a great venue fir large groups.

name: Shun Yi Stone Pot Cuisine
address: 65 Lê Lợi, Bến Nghé, Quận 1 Tầng 5 Saigon Centre, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We were looking for some plain congee at Saigon Centre. for our friend who was feeling unwell. The restaurant actually only had seafood or pork congee on their menu but the lady at the restaurant was so super kind. She got her kitchen to specially make a small portion of plain congee for us! Soooo super kind of her! Thank u and I’m sorry I forgot to ask for your name. Think u are a restaurant Manager. From the bottom of our hearts, THANK YOU!, The staff attentively recommends a variety of delectable foods. My impression is that 'Seafood Platter in Shun Yi Sauce' dish is served in a large bowl. I love the mild spicy mixed a little fat from peanuts blended of sauce. Furthermore, there is another dish that I would like to recommend to everyone 'Spare Ribs with Plum Sauce' with tender ribs combined sweet and sour sauce that makes I want to get more. I will return with my family the next time., The food is so delicious, and at an amazing price point. The staff was lovely, fun and sassy. They were extremely kind people. We had Double Boiled Watercress Soup with Pork Rib, Starter Set, and Stewed Beef Tendons & Oxtail with Kimchi. Excellent service and tasty food, a wonderful dinner.
description: From smokey sizzling hot Stone Pot to irresistible aromas and undeniable flavours, we want to stimulate your senses through a different height of culinary.

name: Mo Mo Paradise
address: 96 Nguyen Thi Minh Khai, Ward 6, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: All you can eat at a reasonable price. Your soup bowl will be boiling at the center of the table while you add ingredients., For meat lover, it’s not really idea place under buffet style. The restaurant provides only 2 types of meat: 1 for beef, another for pork. Meat quality is OK. 400.000VND/person is not chip. We came at a holiday so it was crowded, we had to wait 45 min for a cup of hot tea!, Went here for dinner for two. Good atmosphere and music, had sukiyaki and shabu shabu hot pot. The food was nice and the staff was very helpful and professional. We were well greeted and served. Enjoyed our meal. Good value all you can eat buffet, icecream also available as dessert. Would be nicer if there was more than just two types of meat (beef and pork belly). Was a nice experience overall.
description: Mo-Mo-Paradise, otherwise known as "MoPara", is an All-you-can-eat restaurant established in 1992 that specializes in shabu-shabu/sukiyaki. Enjoy our selection of beef, pork and fresh vegetables delivered straight from the market in your favorite soup. We currently have branches in and around Tokyo and are growing as a global brand with branches in Taiwan, Thailand, China and Vietnam.

name: Xoi Che Bui Thi Xuan
address: 33 Din Tien Hoang, Quan Binh Thanh, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: This place is both engaging and entertaining. Serving a large range of mainly sticky rice dishes and local beverages, it’s a real eye-opener for a traveler. The sticky rice dishes, though seemingly small in size, are very tasty, quite filling and amazing value. Their banh flan is extraordinary, served with coffee and ice. Nice staff too with super quick service. A favourite in Saigon., Cheap and cheerful sticky rice in HCMC. I had the shrimp sticky rice which was really tasty. My friend tried the pork and mung bean sticky rice which wasn’t quite as nice but both very cheap and lots of other options on the menu, I always like to take the sticky rice mixed with special combination of topping (dried shrimp, braised pork, Vietnamese ham) as the never-missed Vietnamese plate. It only costs more than 1 bucks (25,000 vndong) for each serving. However, I think this eatery needs to improve their customer service, the staff need to show more friendliness to customers.

name: Calmo - The Tonic Bar Tan Cang
address: 85/7 Pham Viet Chanh Ward 19, Binh Thanh, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Great cocktail selection, excellently executed. High quality spirits and ingredients used with very knowledgeable bar team. A great spot in a lively district!, My husband and I stumbled across this cool little bar=restaurant. We had a delicious Veg Curry with hot nam bread really tasty, compliments the the Chef. We also had some beers. We enjoyed it so much we went back and it was gin Tuesday happy days lots of choices on the menu. We had a great night here. Music great and staff friendly and helpful. I would 100% recommend this cool bar., Nice balance of good food, great music and a considerable cocktail, owner and bartenders are super friendly. Definitely will be back
description: Tucked away in a small alley down Pham Viet Chanh street, Calmo is a gem hidden away from broad vision of majority. Whether it’s a quiet drink or a night out with friends, whether it’s your first time here or your home away from home, we hope to surround you with joy and laughter as well as to keep you inspired by the passion of mixology. Calmo is always our premier after hours place to be.

name: Lebanhmi
address: 17.11 Lê Thánh Tôn Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The location is located in the Japanese Town area with cheaper prices than other restaurants in the same area. The only restaurant with Vietnamese food on Le Thanh Ton Street. Delicious food like Pho Banh Mi and delicious Hanoi Bia Hoi, This is a small Vietnamese restaurant where you can get local cuisine for little money. My rice dish with meat (very small) and greens was fine, but the greens were a bit too much for me. However, the service has been very friendly. The ambience is more type snack bar, but can sit nicely outside and watch the hustle and bustle on the street., I had coffee and banh mi a couple of times while staying nearby. Efficient service in English. The place looked clean, the coffee (espresso) and sandwich were nice.
description: The location is located in the Japanese Town area with cheaper prices than other restaurants in the same area. The only restaurant with Vietnamese food on Le Thanh Ton Street. Delicious food like Pho Banh Mi and delicious Hanoi Bia Hoi

name: Quán Oc Khanh
address: 5 25, Nguyen Binh Khiem, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We were staying in Somerset Ho Chi Minh and this restaurant was within the walking distance to where we stayed. "This is where we get to eat good and cheap seafood, Vietnamese style.. and also the way they eat" said my bro-in-law after a long day sight-seeing around the city area. We stopped by the main road and had to walk through a small alley to reach this restaurant. It was packed and we had no choice but to sit right outside the main entrance along the pedestrian walkway (kaki lima in Malay) - same like everyone else, low plastic tables and chairs. The modus operandi was to walk to where they display the seafoods, take your pick and let them cook before serving it to you while waiting with, say, few bottles of cold Saigon Export beer. We started with Vietnamese baguette (similar to French because they were colonised by the French in the past).. crispy outer layer and fluffy on the inside. Needless to say, the eggs, baby squid, mussels, bamboo clam, grilled squid, grilled snail (edible ones of course), blanched cockles and their stir fried mee topped generously with water spinach and mushrooms were the highlights - in fact the mee finished in the fastest time. For me, I love each and every dish that we'd ordered. This is the authentic way to enjoy food the Vietnamese style - I remember my first trip to HCM City not long ago (business trip) and we were also sitting like this by the main road while having seafood in District 5. It was also a good exercise to walk a short distance back to the hotel, Other food is okay but So Duong is magnificient with so many scallion as topping. The owner is also nice and friendly., If you like street food, you should try this local restaurant. They have a lot of seafood dishes with good price.

name: Station Sports Bar & Restaurant
address: 135 Bùi Viện, Phạm Ngũ Lão Quận 1, Saigon, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Station Live Music & Sports Bar in Saigon is a vibrant spot for those who love a mix of live entertainment and sports. The venue offers an electric atmosphere with live music performances featuring talented local and international bands. Its well-placed screens make it easy to catch your favorite sports games without missing a beat. The menu offers a good selection of drinks and pub-style food, all reasonably priced. The friendly staff and lively crowd make it a great place to unwind with friends. Perfect for music lovers and sports enthusiasts alike!, It was a beautiful place with great ambience got to celebrate by wife’s bday here. The staff here were very friendly and suggestive, food Was amazing and tasty just how we wanted, service was fast would over all rate this place a 5🌟 rating. The best part is got to surprise my wife here for her bday would love and thank for the below mention not 😬 people who really went out of the box for organising a beautiful memorial setup for my wife to up-bring her beautiful start of her day. Lam Huy Triue Tam Bao Hakan(manager) Thank you team great hospitality and keep up the good work you guys rock and have a long way to go. Keep creating such beautiful memories for People. Cheers ! Warm regards, Pranav Deepak, The food here is delicious and satisfies me. I enjoyed it with a cold cocktail and listened to the rock band, which gave me an extremely memorable experience. The sports space is lively with many large LED screens. It suits everyone, especially those who love sports and Rock music.
description: Step into the heart of Bui Vien & Discover the joys of Sports, Music, and Delicious Bites at Station Sports Bar. This is a lively and vibrant place to hang out with friends and watch your favorite sports games. With an extensive selection of refreshing drinks, delicious food options, and an energetic atmosphere, you're sure to have a great time.

name: K Cafe
address: 74A4, Hai Ba Trung, P.Ben Nghe, Q.1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We had a wonderful experience in K Café with high quality sushi and excellent service. The owner of the restaurant was very friendly and interesting to talk to. He made us feel most welcome in his restaurant. We would highly recommend this restaurant for sushi lovers!, We stumbled across this place outside our hotel on our final day and wish we knew about it sooner. It’s small, authentic, fresh and absolutely fantastic. Excellent sushi with fish either local or from Japan., Excellent sushi and service. Highly recommend this place. Email to book. The cuttlefish was delicious. Great prices compared to the UK.
description: We had a wonderful experience in K Café with high quality sushi and excellent service. The owner of the restaurant was very friendly and interesting to talk to. He made us feel most welcome in his restaurant. We would highly recommend this restaurant for sushi lovers!

name: Spice Temple Restaurant
address: 81 Mac Thi Buoi Ben nghe Ward, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We were at Saigon Center and decided to try Spice Temple there. Ordered the deep fried soft shell crab In pepper sauce, steamed squid and a salad. Everything was delicious. The squid was perfectly cooked, the soft shell crab exceeded expectations and salad was quite good. Price was very reasonable and service was good. Will definitely be back to the restaurant, We wanted something light and tasty; we got it. Gorgeous Thai food in manageable portions at a very reasonable price, great smoothies and the best espresso since we left Australia a month ago. We had a “bite sized starter” that looked like a favourite and loved it - it had RAD chillies (Red And Deadly) that were east to pick out after the first piece 🤣 - tasty but hotter than most food in Vietnam. Loved it., I visited this restaurant in Estella Place with my family. The view is not great, but it´s not the fault of the restaurant because it´s located in a shopping mall. It takes a bit long time to have the food served, but worth it. Delicious Thai Food (not original Thai but fusion)
description: Spice Temple - Fresh interpretation on Thai cuisine! Thai cuisine! It's located at a busy Mac Thi Buoi street, District 1, in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City, Spice Temple is a contemporary casual dining restaurant offering Thai inspired dishes. Step into Spice Temple, customers will enjoy modern bistro-style interior and cosmopolitan dishes at affordable prices.

name: Sky Garden
address: 624 Lac Long Quan Street Ward 5, District 11, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: 1. Seafood is fine, fresh. 2. Too salty lobster with cheese and not warm enough. Fried rice is not warm enough. 3. Serving is good and fast. 4. Parking fee for a car: 30.000VND - on a side street is a big failure. Not recommend - never come back again., Sky Garden BBQ falsely adv. their King Crabs & lobster. They advertise online $1 000 000 dong / 1 king crab. When you get there, the price is actually around $7 000 000 / 1 King Crab. They also mislead you about the price of their lobsters. Don't waste your time. Go elsewhere. The food is bland and not very tasty., If price is not one your criteria than this place is the place to eat American lobsters and Alaskan King Crab! Service is top notched, everything is served and cut up for you so your hands don’t get dirty!
description: Our barbecue is familiar and still unlike any barbecue you have ever had. We pay homage to the many great pit masters who have gone before us and put our own kiss on every meal we serve. Sky Garden BBQ is a best place to enjoy Vietnamese tradition BBQ, Beer.

name: Shamoji Robata Yaki
address: 68 Lê Lợi Phường Bến Thành, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Great place for drinks with coleagues especially the rain evening afterwork. We ussually sit from 6pm to late and drinks from bottle to bottle, Authentic Japanese food, great service, great proce. Right next to the river in district 1. Food was very tasty, sake nice and hot., Had a great evening here experiencing Japanese Robata, having tried some great places in Japan prior, I had some high expectations and this place did not disappoint especially for such a new venue. This place will only get better from a service perspective but the food and atmosphere is amazing.
description: Elevate your dining experience at the rustic, yet defined Shamoji Robatayaki, where you will enjoy Robatayaki – the art of Japanese-style grilling.

name: Kohaku Sashimi & Yakiniku
address: 208 Nguyen Huu Canh Floor B1-29.30, Landmark 81, Ward 22, Binh Thanh, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: One of the Yakiniku & Sashimi location that i love, top 5 in my favorite-spot-list. Food is good and not pricey. I would recommend to try the Yakiniku, sashimi set, "Don" - salmon rice in Japanese style, and hot soup. They make amazing combo., Okonomiyaki here was much bigger than I thought and so differently delicious than other restaurants usually make. The top of this Japanese pancake was added with tempura flakes so it was crunchy when eaten each bite in the mouth. Seafood and vege ingredients were certainly fresh. I loved the salmon skin salad, too. Its worth the money!!!, Tucked into the Vincom Center of Ho Chi Minh City, Kohaku offers a great selection of rolls that come beautifully presented, made with fresh vegetables, fish and sauces. Order the ice cream at the end of your meal for a refreshing and tasty finish. It is at once elegant, tastefully decorated, and laid back. Highly recommend it.
description: The restaurant is designed in the traditional architectural style combined with modernity, bringing a unique and luxurious space. Besides, coming to KOHAKU, you will be hard to resist with Japanese cuisine with skillful and subtle blend of color, elegant and gentle taste.

name: Jatujak Retro Bar
address: 97 Lam Son, Ward 2, Tan Binh District, City., Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We were staying at the nearby Ibis Airport hotel before a morning flight to Singapore when we decided to explore the local neighborhood for dinner. This restaurant was just over 5 minutes walk away and we were drawn in by the very authentic Thai menu and the dinners already enjoying their meals. My partner ordered a cocktail as we selected a variety of dishes to share. The food was very tasty, with just enough chili heat for flavour, yet comfortable enough to eat. The service also was spot on and super friendly, with the two people serving us speaking a bit of English. We ate till we were completely full and even with a cocktail order, the total price was super reasonable, coming to just over 700k VND. This is a fraction of what the same meal would cost back in Singapore. Well worth trying if you are near Saigon airport., I travel extensively and I always stay near the HCMC Airport, at Victory Airport Hotel. Several years ago I discovered a Thai Restaurant two blocks from the hotel and it has become my go to place. JATIJAK Retro Bar and restaurant. The food is Rhai and cagey always,accommodate my request fir "khong cai" or "not spicy". Though I like chilli, my system does not tolerate it well. So, on my way to Indonesia and after a much needed nap, I headed over. My last time was mid November, on my way back from Croatia. I was surprised by all the new faces, though it is Tuesday and I am usually here on weekends. The menu also changed. The fabulous fried prawns,with onion rings, were not on the menu. Nonetheless, the fried chicken was fabulous. Tender boneles pieces iof crunchy outside and juicy inside, were so good I had to order seconds. The French fries needed salt, which was easily solved. The fried peanuts were hot and tasty, after I removed the slices of hot chilli. Their gin and tonic is the best I have had in Vietnam, very consistently excellent.The coconut ice cream with coconut gelatin, shaved coconut and peanuts was very flavorful. (I have had some with zero taste of coconut ) Some of the staff I knew, who were not here, spoke relatively good English. That knowledge was absent tonight. My only criticism is that every member of the staff walked around chewing food of some kind. I appreciate their right to feed themselves; but pretty much international standards are that eating or drinking while waiting on tables or in front of customers is in bad taste. I hope next time that mistake is not repeated., The food is delicious, it’s 100% Thai, the taste is The Best, the restaurant is beautifully decorated and the service is just a stone’s throw away from Tan Son Nhat airport. #The Thai restaurant in Ho Chi Minh.

My favourite dishes are the iskender kebab and sapanakopita! Worth a visit!!, My wife and I came here for our anniversary. It was a great place for a special occasion. Great service and atmosphere, and lots of options. We would highly recommend this restaurant as everything from starters to the main courses were delicious (we had eggplant dip, chicken souvlaki, lamb meatball dish and rice pudding - amazing!), Food is really good! Authentically Turkish and Greek! The owner/chef and staff are also very friendly and accommodating! Turkish coffee is a winner!
description: Taverna Greek - Turkish Restaurant welcome you to loosen your ties for an unforgetable lunch and dinner experience with authentic Greek & Turkish cuisines.

Love it all the way

name: Dtwo Sports Pub
address: 55 Thao Dien, District 2, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Well, i jump inside this pub to run away from the scarching heat of Ho Chi Minh City and have a nice beer. First impression i had was the surprise to see a place so clean and in order, elegant and well done. The draft beer i order was really cold , just what i needed, i did eat a banger and mash wich was well presented and tasting good plus i doubled with a cheeseburger which was very satisfactory. I reccomend this place if you really need a cold beer. Good place to have a couple of game of pool, they have 2 tables., Went to go watch the UFC and boxing. Was a nice atmosphere and the staff always checked on me. Beer was a good price and no extra fees/ charges when I went to check the bill, Was looking for somewhere to watch the MotoGP. Found this place, comfortable sports bar with plenty screens showing variety of sports. Was able to see the MotoGP and with English commentary. Reasonable drinks prices, would come again.
description: Dtwo was established to fill a need for a “Pub” in District 2, HCMC, that not only satisfies all of your sporting viewing pleasure, but satisfies your tastebuds too. With multiple satellite and streaming options available on 9 TV’s around the Pub, rest assured that we are covering most of the bases at Dtwo.

name: Mama Masala Indian Cuisine
address: 83 Đ. Nguyễn Cư Trinh, Street, Quận 1, Thành Phố Hồ Chí Minh, Vietnam, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Veera, the manager and his excellent team deliver a great customer service experience from the moment we entered to the moment we left. The food was relatively inexpensive and tasty - my partner is not well acquainted with Indian 🇮🇳 food - he is from Laos 🇱🇦 but he loved it! We will be back! reviews: When you decide to stay at 5 star hotel, a good service would be one of your expectations. As well dining in one of their restaurant. I found that apart of good chinese food; amazing sevice provided by staff is most important. And Orentica is accommodating this two. Compliment for a young manager who addressed my health issue and solved it in perfectly way; a hot tea offered that shown his care; it is how we say "personal touch" and the 5 star neighbours should follow. Highly recommend this restaurant, worth your stay., Has both a selection of Vietnamese and european style food. comfortable and with pleasant service. We enjoyed it., We were greeted by friendly servers. I ordered a juice and after trying it, I realized they have added sugar in it. Only a question of “is there sugar in this? I don’t like it sweet.” The manager took it back and exchange it with a new no sugar added juice. Food is really good! We had 2 types of clay pot dishes and a vegetable. Servers are always asking if we find the food good and if we need anything else. Good place to go for any occasions!
description: Go ahead…indulge your five senses at the new Orientica Seafood Restaurant & Bar. Located at the 2nd floor of the hotel. Touch the unique seafood brought live to you from Tuesday to Sunday. Enjoy the sights, sounds and smell of seafood as it is being prepared before you with FIRE, STEAM or ICE. It’s seafood that’s truly sense-sational The restaurant was reviewed by Gourmet Vietnam and was selected as Vietnam’s top 100 restaurants by the publication.

name: Tomidaya
address: 8a/1C1 Thai van Lung, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We went three times over the course of four days. And I've tasted quite a few different places in my life. Might not be the best in the world, but certainly a very good option in SEA., This ramen shop just relocated again, moved to a new place within the Japanese zone. The ramen serves here is shoyu (soy sauce base) ramen. In term of ramen broth, I prefer miso and tonkotsu more. The shoyu broth here taste quite good though. The best thing about ramen here is the chashu; it's excellent, probably the best chashu in town. The chashu melts in your mouth, so tender, juicy and tasty. Five stars for chashu, 3 to 4 stars for everything else. The seasoned boiled egg is a bit salty, probably over seasoning. For a light version of ramen (shoyu and shio), this place is a good choice., This is the best ramen place in Hochiminh city. As a fan of Japanese cuisine and particularly ramen, I’ve been to many ramen stores but this is by far still the best in my opinion. It’s a quaint little establishment situated in the catacomb of small alley ways connecting Le Thanh Ton street and Thai Van Lung street, it’s like a little Jap town there with myriad of restaurant, massage parlour, bar and shop there. The noodle here is handmade by the chef, he made a fixed amount everyday so sometimes they might ran out of noodle and will close up shop early. It’s one of the best noodle i’ve had, soft yet firm to the bite, smooth and slippery so you can slurp it up, which is the right way to eat Jap ramen, it’s a compliment to the chef to make slurping sounds. The broth is hearty and fulfilling, you can really taste the bone flavor, not the MSG additives like the broth in many places in Vietnam. There’s only 2 kind of broth, one soy sauce flavor and one tsukemen (dipped ramen with a touch of vinegar in the broth). You can choose the compliment ingredients to go with ramen such as eggs, pork belly meat, bamboo shoot, nori seaweed..... The only downside of this place is that it’s very small, only enough counter seats for 8-9 people, so you often have to queue til your turn. And it’s not a place for gathering and chit chat, you just go in, eat and then leave. But that’s the way it is, it’s exactly like some ramen store in Japan where they serve ramen for mostly office workers. It’s very space efficient, the whole store is like only 20m2 and they manage to have 8-9 counter seat plus a kitchen for 3 chef/chef de commis. This is defo a place to frequent if you are a Japanese cuisine lover!
description: We went three times over the course of four days. And I've tasted quite a few different places in my life. Might not be the best in the world, but certainly a very good option in SEA.

reviews: This takeaway place was close to my hotel. Ate here twice during my stay. Tasty chicken kebab with fresh salad straight from a fridge. Slightly dearer than neighboring places but still fairly priced. Friendly staff., This place is a great German style kabob place in Vietnam. Had the chicken with veggies and garlic sauce a couple times last week. Really good. Super affordable. Like many places near the street, they have no seating., Here on business we are rushed! Walked past this place and decided it looked appealing so we'd try. We have come back each day!!!! It is so amazing. I was truly shocked how decadent the food is and TASTY! I keep clinging to my new found go to for the remainder of this work trip. The food is delicious, beautiful, and the only thing I wish was I could take this place home with me. It's sooooooo wonderful. Don't take my word for it...eat there! Today! Thank me later ;)
description: This takeaway place was close to my hotel. Ate here twice during my stay. Tasty chicken kebab with fresh salad straight from a fridge. Slightly dearer than neighboring places but still fairly priced.   Friendly staff.

name: Le Cafe Restaurant & Bar
address: 192 Nam Ky Khoi Nghia District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I recently had the pleasure of dining at Le Cafe Restaurant and it was an unforgettable experience. The evening was made even more special by the exceptional service provided by Mr. Cuong and Mr. Quang. Their attentiveness and professionalism truly stood out. The food was nothing short of spectacular. Each dish was a delightful blend of flavors, beautifully presented, and cooked to perfection., Le Café has a wide array of international dishes and also serves some Vietnamese standards. In my experience, everything is delicous and high quality, with very friendly, efficient, and multilingual service. The staff speak excellent English. The menu is also in Chinese, Japanese, and Korean (see photo). Especially the breakfast (Monday–Friday 06:30–10:30 am, weekend 06:30–11:00 am) is great value at VND 350k++. Apart from the breakfast buffet, this includes as many hot drinks (Espresso, Americano, Caffè latte, Cappuccino, hoto chocolate etc.) and as many up plates as you would like from the breakfast menu. The breakfast buffet changes daily so you won't get bored. You can sign up for their membership free of charge and get a discount right away. The restaurant is located inside Sherwood Suites hotel but open to outside guests as well., Quynh and Anh provided excellent service, especially pointing out the different options for our breakfast. The food was great and they made us feel extremely welcome. The kids especially loved being able to select everything and anything from the all you can eat buffet.
description: The elegant dining space of Sherwood Suites’s Le Cafe Restaurant & Bar is open to the public as well as hotel guests, and serves up the finest Mediterranean and Asian cuisine, including Vietnamese classics, prepared by the chefs at work in the open kitchen. Located on the ground floor and open from 6:30 am to 10:00 pm, Le Cafe also offers a range of creative cocktails, coffees, specialty teas and other drinks.

name: Red&Round
address: 15 Hung Gia 3, Tan Phong Ward, District 7, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Oct 12 2024. Red&Round in D7 was recommended by a local friend. (Italian food is never my first choice in HCMC, like P4P's). However, Red&Round was excellent. Best in City! Food as good as promo photos. Worth the time. Pizza - great crispy crust and fresh cheese; beef high quality and properly prepared; Salad fresh great dressing. Even the bread was toasted (with salad's avocado made adequate AvoToast) Truly as good as Italia or USA. Food as good as promotional photos - J, Quiet little restaurant with amazingly good fresh Italian food. Pizzas world class, pasta world class… it’s one of the best Italian restaurants in Ho Chi Minh City for authentic Italian food. I have been quite a few times now and the food has been fantastic each time. It is quiet in the week so no need to book. Not sure about the weekend. The owner is Italian with a passion from what I see. There are about 8 different pasta choices, maybe 10 different pizzas and then some other mains., I came to this cozy little restaurant with my girlfriend for a lovely dinner and I must say we had a really nice time there. First they asked us if we wanted something to drink and when we heard "spritz" we had no doubt: we did well because it was really well done. The menu is wide but above all it differs from the other restaurants in the area: there are so many interesting dishes that we didn't know what to choose. In the end we ordered a carpaccio, a plate of mussels, a pizza with burrata to share and a tiramisu as dessert. All was really good and abundant. The staff with the right approach: kind and friendly but still very professional. I must confess that it was a really nice discovery and I think it's one of the best options to eat really well, feel full without spending too much that you can find in the D7. Highly recommended
description: An authentic Italian Bistro where you find fresh, delicious yet affordable foods. An Aperitivo Bar where you can grab some drinks & chill, also a stopover if you need a place to switch yourself from a working mode to relaxing mode after a long day.

name: Sushi Tei
address: 41-47 Dong Du Ben Nghe, Quan 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: My family and I visited this restaurant in October 22. We hadn’t eaten all day and was super hungry. The food took forever and came 1 little dish at a time with 20-30 min in between. I didn’t get my drink until at least 15 min after ordering but the rest of my family got theirs… when it finally arrived it wasn’t even what I ordered. We had to try and get the waitress’s attention, if we needed anything, which was almost impossible to make eye contact. We ended up leaving to get food another place because we were waiting way too long. But not until we got one last surprise: we had to pay for our wet wipes (!!!) no one had told us, and no other napkins was offered for us. The worst experience I’ve ever had eating at a restaurant. The absolute ONLY reason I give it 3 stars is because the food was pretty good - too bad we had to wait a lifetime to get our orders :(, We were a group of 3 couples and we all ordered the special of the evening. The food was terrific- and way more than we could finish. Our waitress did not speak English and we spoke no Vietnamese- but we muddled through and had fun doing it. I recommend this place if your looking for a good sushi dinner while in HMC., Had lunch here with a co-worker on a rainy Sunday. We arrived at the restaurant wet, walked in the air-con restaurant and non of the staff come greet us nor offer dry tissue. I ordered some ordinary food: 2 sets of sashimi, some nigiris, some rolls and finish with a bowl of udon. The fish doesn't appear fresh. Then I ordered seaweed when I realised that I need some more. But by the time they brought the seaweed to our table, we had almost finished eating. Would happy to pay the same for a better service and food.

name: Lumiere Texas Bbq & Craft Beer
address: 18E Cong Hoa, Phuong 4, Quan Tan Binh Republic Plaza, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Very good service from Tuyet. Great Shíwù. We would return. Very helpful service. Presentation was excellent. Good location, Service was excellent and food was delicious! We had the Texas BBQ chicken burgers and it came with a salad and fries. Very tasty, Staff was helpful and friendly however teo comments which I hope management will consider to improve. 1. Happy hours should cover non-alcoholic drinks or mocktails as not everyone drinks alcohol. 2. The steak should never be served together with the soup. I had to ask them to take the steak back while I finished my soup. By the steak was back (which was about 3mins later, I had to rush finishing my soup), the steak was already lukewarm so that wasn’t good. On the plus side, the doneness (I asked for medium rare) was spot on so kudos to the chef. The soup was more like a pumpkin soup than a real crab bisque so suggest they change it to vegetable cream soup with some crab meat.
description: * BBQ - Craft Beer - Wine * Located in Sai Gon * Where you can find food food, good beer & good fun

name: Kashew Cheese
address: 14 Tran Ngoc Dien Thao Dien, District 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: dips, coffee options & all the way to their desserts; there is a lot to be enjoyed! Even their breads are baked in house, are light and fluffy, not full of heavy dough, and very flavorful. Another addition that makes us such a great experience, is the conscious level of the owner and creator. She created the menu and her dishes in mind of being not just plant-based, but healthy! She uses organic products and produce, no additives, preservatives, or refined sugars, so she is not making something that is delicious and enjoyable, but absolutely healthy for the human body and good for the environment as well. This is a must for all not just Plantbased individuals, but people that enjoy & appreciate enjoy good quality and delicious food, with an appreciation of great culinary creations!!, Everything we ordered was delicious - nut cheese sandwich with pickles, spaghetti with eggplants, goulash with pita, sourdough pizza - never knew vegan food could be so delicious. Warning though - well so our kiddos were used to processed cheese so... nuts cheese could taste a little weird to them... or to anyone who don't really like the nuts and oils combo. Liked the space too - tucked at the back of Ascentia condo, facing a small park and villas - pretty relaxing., I've been vegan for well over a decade, and the sandwiches at Kashew are some of the best in the world. If you didn't know you were eating it in Vietnam, you'd swear you were at one of the finest vegan shops in Paris. Though we never stay in District 2, it's worth a Grab or taxi ride over just to dine at Kashew! I generally prefer to eat Vietnamese food while I'm in Vietnam, but I make an exception for Kashew....it's absolutely outstanding. And their mango lassi is to die for! My highest recommendation!
description: Kashew Cheese is a plant-based artisan cheese made from Vietnamese cashew nuts. We combine traditional cheesemaking methods with bold new flavours. At the Kashew Cheese Deli we sell a range of plant-based cheeses including aged cheese, cream cheese, feta, mozzarella, ricotta, camembert, Kashew milk and more. We also make Mediterranean-style sandwiches using our cheese.

name: Brick & Barrel
reviews: I moved to Vietnam from the States 3 years ago and typically just eat local food on a local budget, but when I’m craving western food, Brick & Barrel is one of my places of choice. Everything I’ve tried is delicious and the portions are generous (western-sized portions, often resulting in enough leftovers for lunch the next day). I’ve tried the chicken sandwich, the pizza, the wings, and the jalapeño poppers and everything is ON-POINT. The price is right and the service is great. I recommend the house sauce with the chicken sandwhich. I even get extra for my fries. No lie, I always cut the chicken in half and save the other half for lunch the next day. Yes, it’s that big! My favorite pizza is the Tropical. If pineapple on pizza isn’t your thing then try the Diablo. And if spice isn’t your thing (the Diablo is REALLY hot) then just try your pizza of choice. The crust and cheese is what you’d expect from a proper pizza. Oh, but if you like the cheeseburger pizza from Whole Foods, then the one here isn’t the same; you’d need to add ketchup. Still pretty good, just not the same. The buffalo and bbq wings are my favorite. If you like spice, they have a spicy version of both. I’ve tried nearly all the other flavors and they’re alright too, but buffalo and bbq are my go-tos. Also comes with a side included in the price. I like the wedges but my fiancé prefers the fries. Can’t go wrong either way. I don’t order wings from anywhere else. The poppers are phenomenal… but a lil on the pricier side. It’s not something I get every time, but when I do it’s definitely worth the splurge. I typically order delivery because I live on the other side of the city, but the few times I’ve been there, the staff was friendly and attentive and have no issues communicating in English. Highly recommend Brick & Barrel., We went here on the strongest recommendation from another couple of travellers in our party and were not disappointed. Really good burgers, choice of fries (thin, fat or wedges) amazing onion rings and scrumptious chicken strips along side perfect pizza cooked in an authentic pizza oven. The cocktails were delicious; beers were chilled and staff attentive. A special shout out to Anh who was so helpful booking us a cab when the heavens opened. Defo’ above and beyond commitment to her job that she was obviously passionate about. It’s people like her that add to the unique offer at Brick and Barrel. One piece of advice: this venue is on the second floor so is accessed via a very narrow doorway that we missed - twice! Persevere! It’s well worth the effort to find this gem! So much so, our buddies went the following evening too., I just came back from there, I can eat spicy so I decided to order EL DIABLO pizza, it was the best spicy pizza of my life, it is not for amateur of chilli. I also ordered some nuggets with sauce called « fire in the hole » , it was really good, tenderness of chicken, crispy, with perfect fries. Eating there with Ben Thanh market in view, very kind waitress, average price , so don’t waste your time and money at all other places, 4 minutes walking from Ben Thanh market.

name: The Vagabond Pâtisserie & Café

reviews: 64 items on the menu unavailable. Adults playing video games on phone with volume, couple on a call on speaker really made for a shopping mall atmosphere. Cake was good but at a price it should be., Pretty coffee shop with decent selection of beverages. Scope of including some chocolate desserts on their menu, I’ve never been to this place nor eating any cake here, but I’ve been ordering cakes for special occasions. Last October, I ordered 2 cakes and 1kg of beef ball, they forgot my beef ball and I have to complain with the customer service rep. Last month, I ordered a cake for my mom’s birthday, this time both of my mom and dad was disappointed at the cake as it wasn’t good. Like they said, the cake was tasteless and didn’t stand well. For the price I paid, this is totally not worth it. Save yourself and your money, stay away from this place as they don’t give a f*ck about their customers!

name: Sen Vegan House
address: 93-95 Pho Duc Chinh Nguyen Thai Binh ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We were here for lunch last week. The restaurant was so crowded during lunch so service was a bit slower than expected. The food, however, was amazing to us! We ordered mushroom salad, fresh summer rolls, sweet and sour soup, fried rice packed in lotus leaf. All of them was tasty and well seasoned., Meal is good and good for solo/couple/family or group dining. Service is fast cleanliness is fine. Free WiFi provided. Price is a bit expensive however with lots of choice from menu you can have., We were looking for a good vegetarian place to eat on our night in Ho Chi Minh when we discovered the Sen Vegan House in the heart of the city. I can not recommend this place enough. Whether you are vegan/ vegetarian or not - the food here was incredible. If we had not been so full, we would have ordered more! The spring rolls were a particular favourite. So fresh! The service was ok. Not bad but not super great but the food was worth every moment. Highly recommend! We will definitely visit them again.
description: Located in the center of Distric 1, HCMC - only 5 minutes walking from Ben Thanh market, Sen Vegan House is the 2nd branch of SEN vegetarian restaurant which has been established for more than 10 years. Sen Vegan House serves wide variety of Vietnamese typical vegan food with more than 150 choices. Famous for its great taste, Sen Vegan House brings you to an elegant and peaceful place with lotus element decoration like its name - SEN.

name: The Shamrock Irish Pub
address: 139 Bui Vien Pham Ngu Lao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Has to be said this place is really really expensive, but after days of eating different foods I wanted something normal and like a sad uk tourist got an English breakfast which although way over priced was well cooked and tasty., Here is a great bar to come and chat with friends. They are different to all the other bars as they have nice live music, the atmosphere is really chilled. They have a great menu with western and Vietnamese food. Really good quality and not too expensive! The cocktails are delicious and they have a happy hour which makes it even better! The staff are all friendly and will try to make sure you enjoy your time in the bar by putting on any sport you want., Here is a great Irish bar in the middle of the city. They have on live music everyday which is such a nice change from the techno music in all the bars in the tourist area. The atmosphere here is really chilled out, they have great food and drinks. The staff are all super friendly and really make the experience. They always have some sports on, and they are happy to find any sort of sport that you want and put that on the big screen. They are very welcoming and will do anything they can to make sure you enjoy your time in the bar.
description: Established in 2019, The Shamrock lies in the heart of Bui Vien Walking Street, HCM City. Offering live music every night, a wide range of beers on tap, a selection of single malts, whiskeys, a drink for the spirit with a Guinness & hearty fare. The Shamrock’s exciting atmosphere has become a favorite among locals and a destination for newcomers. Come for the Guinness, stay for the Craic. Slainte!

name: Yoshino Japanese Restaurant

reviews: Food is just ok and prices quite high. Service is good but it’s simply difficult to argue it is good value for money, Took customer & supplier to this fancy place at the Lotte Hotel. How was it? Service CAN be better but food was very good but not cheap compare with many smaller establishments. name: La Fiesta Phu My Hung
address: 1-1A Ha Huy Tap District 7, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This was a revelation. Tucked away discretely on a side street of Phu My Hung (District 7 aka 'South Saigon', this Tex-Mex restaurant serves hearty portions of extremely good Tex-Mex food from an extensive menu. Also excellent cocktail list and 6 craft beers available on draft from three Vietnamese microbreweries. Tiny thing is that the first beer came out with a large foamy head but that was quickly rectified on the second pour without any fuss at all so no worries (craft beer head should never be more than 5% of the total liquid volume). The food was amazing, service quick and friendly and also some lovely Mexican music playing. The owner came over for a chat and asked us how we were getting along. All in all a superb occasion and free of tourists:))))))) Particularly recommend the burritos- excellent., Delicious Mexican food, We had Nachos, Tacos and Burrito.... Friendly staff, Good Service... Keep it up......:), La Fiesta has the best Tex-Mex in Saigon. Their D7 location is just a good as their D1 location. I love their tacos and enchiladas. This is where I go to get my Mexican food fix. Their rice and beans are especially good.
description: La Fiesta Phu My Hung serves tasty Tex-Mex food and drink on the quiet side of Phu My Hung.

A couple different vegetarian options are available and they're great. Several delivery drivers were picking up during our last visit, so they're apparently on the usual such apps. Highly recommended., Bánh mì rất ngon ❤️❤️ Banh mi so good for foreign . Delicious , fresh, clean. Come back again. I like banh mi Vietnam very much, friendly, english speaking staff and very delicious Banh Mi. They We were there twice and had the tofu Banh Mi and the one with eggs. We had a lot of Banh Mis before and can totally recommend it!

Been here multiple times on this visit.  Service is fast and friendly. Price is low, quality is high. Very tasty and fresh.

A couple different vegetarian options are available and they're great.

Several delivery drivers were picking up during our last visit, so they're apparently on the usual such apps.

Highly recommended.

name: Relax Garden
address: 15B Nguyen Huu Tho Phuoc Kien, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Peter saved us when our other accommodation cancelled our booking when we got there. He has gone above and beyond everyday to make sure our stay here was nothing but exceptional. Beautiful rooms, great pool and the BEST service. I would recommend to everyone!, It is too bad that a tourist won’t be able to find this restaurant because the food and surroundings are tremendous. Also the name relax garden only appears on your receipt. Walking down a dirt road, prior to any signage, you reach the restaurant. It is on the river. Walking across a series of wooden piers you reach your table. Overhead is a straw covering with tropical foliage surrounding you. For lunch we ordered fish soup, bahn xeo hai san(with seafood), and bahn xeo mien tua with a crispy rice pancake and fish that is spread on the pancake. We also had peach tea with chia seeds. All of these dishes were absolutely delicious. Service was friendly and accommodating and the cost was reasonable extremely reasonable., Located on the outskirts of the city (raft house), but not too far away, it is easy to find. This is an ideal place for those who like quiet space. The dish is diverse but inclined to rustic, the price is also very reasonable. Very suitable for family, friends meeting.
description: Mekong style garden restaurant located in 12,000m2 greeny area, serving Vietnamese food, some basic western dishes, beer, wine, juices, dessert. Fishing equipment, hammock, swing available. Live fish and cookeries display. Good view, good food, good sense.

name: 5Ku Quan Restaurant
address: 293 Dien Bien Phu Street, Ward 7, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: This place is on a street corner and open on both sides, it is cavernous and looks like a cattle shed with corrugated roofing. But what had attracted me was the large area of fishtanks where the live seafood was kept. There were long rows of tables and chairs all lined up as if for some giant feast, I was very early and so there was only one other group of diners at the start. The staff were very apologetic explaining that as it was so early the BBQ was not yet fired up, so some of the menu was unavailable. However I settled for grilled tiger prawns, and beef with chili and lemongrass, along with several bottles of Larue, the local beer. Despite the inauspicious start and no frills appearance, this was a really delicious dinner and excellent value at just 288,000 Dong including drinks. If I was in the city for longer I would have been back for more., We visited twice during our stay in Ho Chi Minh City. Nice fresh food that you can cook yourself. Even with several bottles of Chang beer the total bill was less than 500,000 vnd (about £16). Lots of locals eating there so always a good sign., Been walking past several times bcs located ’my backyard’. Wondering now why not getting in before. Tasty food with comfortable price. Great to see this kind of hiphop style places.

address: 30 Thủ Khoa Huân, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: This place is a whole vibe!! As soon as you approach the place, you instantly see all the vibrant lights and decor, it’s so pretty! My friends and I came here Thursday evening—had reservations for a table of 10–we got seated at a high-top right by the stage. At the night went on, this place got packed! They have lots of food items aside from the alcohol. We tried some mixed cocktails that came in a high tower—one was super sweet, one was super sour—they were poured as shots for the table. Also got a liquor bottle and some beer—prices are reasonable. The DJ played really good upbeat music and later in the evening there was a short entertaining dancing show. Service was excellent—very attentive. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking to have fun—good music and great ambiance for a drinking night!

name: Gangnam BBQ
address: R2-48 Phan Khiem Ich, Hung Gia 2, Tan Phong Ward, District 7, Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Good quality Korean food. I especially enjoyed the BBQ ribs. The staff is attentive and friendly. If you are in district 7, it’s worth a visit., I really enjoyd dinner here. Good food and very joyfull service. You wwill not disapoint if you try BBQ., We enjoyed the beef bbq ordered 4 plates. They are all good The hot pot was not so yummy may be we were full. It a bit pricey when considering what included in the pot. They gave us two dishes on the house. Was good. Steam rice was free of charge We also enjoy the rice wine The staff who serving us was super quick and friendly her name starts with Kim. We had a good joke about Kim Korea family name Overall not perfect but highly recommended
description: Good quality Korean food. I especially enjoyed the BBQ ribs. The staff is attentive and friendly. If you are in district 7, it’s worth a visit.

name: Pho Hung Vietnamese Beef Noodle Soup
address: 87 Ly Tu Trong Street, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Being our first day in Ho Chi Minh we had already settled into our hotel, gone to a local coffee house and got our caffeine fix and had a stroll around the streets close to our hotel and we're getting a little hungry as it was just after midday. Suggestions were made of what to eat, mainly western takeaway but we decided to try some local cuisine being of course the pho. Not far from a hotel on our walk earlier we noticed this eatery and came back to try it out. Upon entering we were greeted by a young server who spoke a little English and directed us to our table near the window which was great for looking out and watching the street traffic go by. We ordered our drinks and pho or soup, my wife going for the plain chicken, my daughter the vegetable and my son and I had beef and pork. They came out soon after and you could see that they were very hot from the steam coming off the top as we waited a little for them to cool down we could smell the fresh herbs and spices that were used, they were fresh tasting and quite a good size, the noodles were nicely cooked not mushy, just right. The price for our overall meal was also quite cheap and for our first local cuisine experience this place gets a thumb's up from me and my family., One of the best beef noodle soup in the city, and its well known among locals and tourists. Truly worth the effort to go, and try it out. Do expect to queue a little and sharing table style seating., Freshly cooked pho. Generous portions, and fresh greens with every bowl of noodles. Simple and visited by locals too. Was there early for breakfast.

address: 92 Nguyen Thai Binh Street Nguyen Thai Binh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I don’t often write reviews, but I absolutely loved the Hu Tieu here. If you ever have the chance to visit Vietnam, make sure to try the Hu Tieu Sate at this spot – it’s a must-try! This dish is truly unique, with a rich, slightly spicy broth and tender, fresh beef that melts in your mouth. I also tried the refreshing Basil Seed Herbal Tea here, which was delicious and incredibly cooling, We randomly stopped by this restaurant in District 1 while looking for a place to have lunch. It’s a lovely little restaurant with charming decor. The shrimp and squid were very fresh, and the broth was rich in flavor. A great choice for a light lunch in Saigon., Clean, good service, good food, good location, good price, and have a lot of choices. Good place to have a quick authentic Vietnamese meal

address: 417 Hoang Van Thu Ward 2, Tan Binh, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Basically, seafood, meat, vegetables are fresh I picked out Thai soup Hotpot and Collagen soup Hotpot. All of them are perfect. The staff served us quickly and thoughtful, even at that time, the restaurant was so crowded. There are various kind of dessert and drinks. I could get it without inhibition. Overall, everything here is good., One of the best hotpot restaurant in town. Suitable for fine dining with family and business. Free to order the beef, cow, pork in buffet menu. Some of deluxe Wagyu beef in another A la carte menu. Love the beef and the sauce here. Dessert is also good., You all should try this place at least one when you come to Saigon. It's in the center, very easy to find. Good food, sservice and drinks

name: Gogi House
address: 254-256 Le Van Sy, Phuong 14, Quan 3, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: For a party of 4, with a Soju bottle, a shared desert, and plenty of BBQ meat, the final bill was about 1.2M which at the rate of 23,200 / us$, is about US$50. That's very reasonable, with good service and nice air-conditioned ambience. The wait staffs replaced the bbq grill many times (4+) during our dinning time there. The foods were good. They did run out of some vegetables (plenty of lettuce) to roll with the bbq., Food is great and delicious. A good menu variety. Try the fruit juices, they are fresh and delicious! Prices are reasonable. Unfortunately, the service is quite poor. Dishes came out at different times. By the time I was finished eating, my mother's dish had not arrived. Asked a waitress to check in the order and still had to wait another 10 minutes., Fun, hearty, tasty, and great for a party of 2-6 people! Korean BBQ done at your table on a small grill with coals. We had 3 different meats and a big hot pot soup - all were wonderful. They bring out an assortment of small sides, and meat trimmings, including lettuce to make wraps. I also highly suggest their "sparkler" drinks and both of the fruit drinks listed below them (the name eludes me). Enjoy!
description: GoGi house brings customers to peaceful lanes with its paradise of Korean popular barbeque beef. The food will be served on fire and without smoke. There is a variety of beef types there. Some other Korean authentic food which should not be missed are cold noodle, kimchi soup and hotpot...

address: 149 Bùi Thi Điệt ,Củ Chi, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Join cu chi tunnel tour and got lunch here. I dont eat pork so i got extra chicken, it had various menu, rice, vegetable soup and fruits at the end. I ordered coconut water, it really fresh and the coconut meat was soft. The restaurant dont have AC but it open space, good airflow. The toilet also clean.

name: Sol Butcherant
address: 57 Nguyen Duc Canh My Khanh 4, Phu My Hung, District 7, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Pros: Decor is acceptable. Tasty crystal ice salad. Japan beef steak medium rare is salt enough, the meat is soft and moisture enough. Grilled Atlantic black cod is so soft and smooth. Cons: High price. >2milVND for a meal with 4 dishes, 2 glasses of wine, 1 dessert. Small area., I've been coming here since shortly after they opened, sometimes once or twice a week, sometimes less frequently, and it's great. Food, service, price... There are many reasons I come as often as I do. Don't get me wrong, it's great for dinner, too, just a lot pricier. But the food is even better, as there's a far larger array of dishes to choose from and some very creative recipes. I've even started buying the occasional steak here, as their prices are fairly reasonable for the quality of the meat they sell., Best steak in town. Good selection of wine. Friendly staff with knowledge. Small but cozy space. Suitable for couples, friends, and business. Highly recommended!
description: SOL Butcherant brings Modern Art Cuisine to customer, Our restaurants are a place where friends and family can gather to enjoy an authentic grill room dining experience with gourmet food, exceptional service and comfortably refined ambience.

name: Bistro 48 SaiGon
address: 48 Le Thi Rieng District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Seemed like a pretty new restaurant. No one knew English more. 3 people got to discuss what we meant by a question if the dish was ”spicy”. Needs improvement. The food we ordered and got was very good. When we had to pay, they had put on 5000Dong for 2 wipes that they threw on the table before we got the food. No big money but everywhere else you got the wet wipe! Seems very petty., I think it is a quite good place for dinner with your partner or family members. Nice decoration and friendly staff.I saw there are lots of dishes in the menu, so you can choose your favourites. I had beefsteak but it was just so so, not really tasty., We came upon this restaurant when out walking so we decided to eat here . The staff were ok not much English but got by however the portions were tiny the vegetables were cold and we left needing a snack lol I personally would not recommend this restaurant

name: Boudoir Lounge
address: 17 Le Duan Boulevard Sofitel Saigon Plaza, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: It was amazing that there was a place where I could have such a pleasant coffe time. The dessert was so pretty and delicious and all staffs were all kind and nice. I and my husband were so happy to know this place :), Been here a few times for drinks, for cocktails, for meetings and a coffee or three. Really niche little lounge with character and plenty of versatility. Worth a visit, I stayed at Sofitel Saigon for a night and came here for Accor members welcome drinks that includes wine and beer. Love the decor and ambience especially the inner section with more privacy. Will return again.
description: Get ready to immerse yourself in the refined atmosphere as you savor delicate French pastries, relish a serene afternoon tea, or unwind with classic cocktails beneath the gentle embrace of the night!

name: Binh Xuyen
address: c3/16 Duong Pham Hung, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: We came here for the first time and shall not be the last !! It’s HUGE RESTAURANT ... the waiters had to go by roller skates ！ DO NOT ORDER PIGEONS ..Not that tasty ! Do book the table in advance so you can have the good table near all THE PONDS ! You can fish your old fish too ! Good place for children and big families gatherings !! The service is good and the toilets are VERY CLEAN ! SHALL BE BACK ! 👍👍👌👌, This is a good place for groups and families have childredn, there aredifferent sections and playground for children. Actually it could not be a place for business meal. it is too noisy. music and sound are loudly always There is live seafood, kinds of fiish and huge river prawns. But because of huge place and huge guess at the weekend, some meail will not be servered if you do not do reservation in advance It is ok if their targeting customer is vietnamnese of who know vietnamese. but it would be great if they can serve more foreiner and tourist, becuase their menu is so vietnamese specail. they should improve their serviec as well, the waiter/ waitress argue/ agaist their guess some time., Had a hard time ordering our food. Had high hopes for this place after hearing much about it. So we endured the 1 hr cab ride from district 1.. only to feel a little disappointed. Couldnt understand the menu, theres no english menu, guess probably majority of their guest are still their local people. Food and drinks came fast though. A plus point. Average food. But it was quite an experience.. liked the pancake looking rice. But i must agree that i didnt really like some of their staffs who seemed to be jeering when we couldnt understand and asked for help.

address: 52/3 Đông Du Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Im in love with the vibe here. Excellent jazz band. Professional service and the cocktails taste really good. Highly recommend when you came to Saigon, nice atmosphere, nice cocktails, amazing live band, friendly and supportive staff, will definitely swing by more often, Wow. Talking abut owning your profession. These cocktails were outstanding. Kind of cray entrance as it's down a tiny alley and then you need to go upstairs. When you get seated, let the experience begin. Just tell them what spirits you like, then be captivated by the show they will put on. Make this a must stop for a drink when you're in Saigon
description: an Izakaya concept by 523 DRINKs, FOODs and FUN

name: The Lounge
address: 235 Nguyen Van Cu Street, District 1 1F Hotel Nikko Saigon, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: This is situated in Hotel Nixon. It is a tea bar in the morning and in the evening it turns out to be a bar. They have some amazing cup cakes. Drinks are slightly expensive but its ok for the ambiance they are providing., The lounge was spacious and stylist, luxury but not too old, elegant and charming. Good smell and soft music. Cake and drink were excellent! Staff was polite. A little bit expensive but worth the service., The Lounge is the spacious hotel bar of Hotel Nikko Saigon. In the afternoon it functions as a meeting place and tea room for guests of the hotel. In the evening it changes into a cocktail bar, where guests can have a drink before heading out or going to bed. The elegant design and the formal style of the staff doesn't make it a very lively bar though.
description: This is situated in Hotel Nixon. It is a tea bar in the morning and in the evening it turns out to be a bar. They have some amazing cup cakes. Drinks are slightly expensive but its ok for the ambiance they are providing.

name: Hoang Ty Restaurant
address: 256 Binh Quoi, Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Never been to this type of Vietnamese food restaurant. Our friend from HO Chi Minh city took us here for dinner. We ordered whole bunch of sliced meats like pig feet, beef, and grape leave wrapped beef( bolalat). Then we wrapped the meat in a special kind of rice paper( used steam to make the rice paper I was told) with different organic green leafy vegetables. After dipping in fish source, it tasted like fresh spring egg roll. Apparently this type of food is very popular here in Saigon. We also ordered their famous bbq black fish. Very tasty with different types of herds including lemon grass. Quite a different experience., Our apartment was just opposite this restaurant. We visited for lunch on the last day of our holiday and it was buzzing with people enjoying the delicious food. A big plate of fresh assorted leaves, wraps, crispy vegetables, spring rolls and much more. We enjoyed being in a place rated so highly by the real Vietnamese people, who made us feel so welcome., This is the 3rd time we’ve returned to this restaurant. Food was good. Great servive and quick staff. Highly recommend

address: 18A/67 Nguyen Thi Minh Khai Da Kao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: After seeing a post on a Facebook Foodies Group about good value set lunches in Saigon. My Canadian friend and I visited their outlet in Da Kao ward on D1. Down a hem on busy Nguyen Thi Minh Khai we located their cute little restaurant. Very impressed by the professional waiter service and the food couldnt be faulted. We will now become regulars., A simple but fresh n clean place for a dinner out not too vheap n not too expendivr. Great good n nice service . Away from the main street but still great atmosphere, The price about USD10 (vnd 200000) for one disk too high but taste is very good. Vintage style and the address is easy to find on maps.
description: Cocotte Da Kao is located in a charming traditional alley Vietnamese walking distance for the city center. The restaurant is located between one of the Thao Cam Vien Zoo and Consulate-General of France. Discover our small French Bistro with authentic food for everyone, with great value, warm and friendly service. Indulge in our carefully selected wine selection. Cocotte is the address for French Bistro food and wines in Ho Chi Minh City.

name: Saigon Bagel
address: 38 Nguyễn Cừ Thảo Điền, Quận 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: On arrival it looks like a third rate place. But you must go upstairs to eat where it looks like a nice quaint cafe. The people are friendly. My wife had a smoked salmon bagel and I ordered a prosciutto bagel (my bagel they stuffed up and gave me a breakfast bagel which they were going to change but I said not to worry). Both were very nice. My wife’s probably the better. My kids just had a buttered bagel. Still cheap but pricey for a Vietnamese feed. Still it was only $28 AUD. If you want a change from Asian breakfast or snack come here., My favourite spot in Ho Chi Minh. I was sceptical at first when reading ‘best bagels I’ve ever had’ but they really are that good. Was almost scared off by the shop front downstairs thinking it was being renovated however upstairs was really nice. The prosciutto bagel was 10/10. The honey rocket was also very good but was disappointed to see this one served as a filled bagel as a pose to two separate halves with filling on each half. The banana and coffee shake was great just lacked a little flavour, probably just due to having to much ice in it., I had a whole wheat bagel with avocado and onion and a banana and coffee smoothie. Never had a banana and coffee smoothie very interested to see how this comes out and I’m happy to have whole wheat bagel. It’s a nice location upstairs clean and happy staff a hidden gem on the river of Saigon. Everything is delicious bagel nation toasted fresh avocado and the coffee banana shake is outstanding
description: Saigon Bagel serves plain, poppy, sesame, cinnamon raisin, onion and everything bagels - all made the traditional way, boiled and baked. Our cream cheese schmears are: smoked salmon, strawberry, pineapple, chives & bacon, sundried tomato & basil and chives. We also offer high quality smoked salmon and our homemade gravlox and pickled herring. Choose from our menu of bagel sandwiches, such as our egg and bacon breakfast bagel, or make your own a la carte.

name: The Loop
address: 49 Thao Dien Road Thao Dien Ward, District 2, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: I have only sampled two different dishes in The Loop, mainly because the beef lasagne is so delicious that I tend to just order this time and time again. Unlike the tomato type lasagne with an over abundance of fresh tomato sauce in many other restaurants, the Loop's beef lasagne is a cheesy, meaty version which is really hearty and extremely delicious. I usually order French fries with the lasagne for a bit of self - indulgence, and not really liking their mixture of large and thin French fries, the staff, when asked, are very happy just to make thin French fries instead. The French fries are quite pleasant and the two dipping sauces which come with them are super tasty and quite addictive! I have only been to the restaurant once and that's when I decided to try something different. I ordered the Tagliolini which consisted of parma ham, mushrooms and a mushroom sauce. It was quite pleasant but I think the taste wasn't really for me. There was absolutely nothing wrong with the dish but it just wasn't my type of flavour. However, it was disappointing that it was only barely luke warm and even after being heated again it was only a little warmer. This surprised me as even after travelling quite some distance, the many lasagnes I have had delivered are still hot on arrival. But I put it down to a glitch on the day. But for now I will continue with the tried and tested best-in-town lasagnes. Special mention must be made to the staff, whether on the phone or in person, they are amongst the warmest , most helpful and welcoming staff anywhere. The Loop, along with one other western restaurant (and every single Indian restaurant) was one of the few that we approached who agreed to deliver to the other side of District 2, to Thanh My Loi, during the Covid restricted working period. Most restaurants said that that part of District 2 was too far and refused. As there is very little in the way of restaurants and deliveries in Thanh My Loi, me and my team were extremely appreciative of The Loop and a handful of others who were prepared to make the trip. In return, we will continue to support The Loop although that's no hardship due to their tasty food and friendly team. Looking forward to my next trip to Thao Dien to sample their food again., Nice place and it was quite in the late evening to have dinner with my family. Best time to have a quality time chit chat with my daughters. My daughters like Lasagna and I just have a hot tea and Chocolate Brownies. All good, thank you!, Great place- wonderful breakfast in a very nice location and atmosphere. Overall very reasonable value for the money.
description: Bistro Restaurant focussing on Home cooked and authentic taste

name: Uchi Sushi
address: 14, 45 Street Ward 6, Dist 4, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Fantastic.... I wanted to eat something good and different.... Congratulations on the service and the wide range of choices.... Really excellent.... GRAZIE...., Arrived after travelling all day. Staff were very friendly and helpful. Service was super quick. Prices were super reasonable for really fresh sushi. Really enjoyed it!, They offer a buffet on their website. We called and they said sashimi was included, so we went there. It's not. They have literally no clue what they offer. They had to go back and forth and discuss things with each other and they literally kept changing the deal in the 20 minutes we waited there for them to figure thing out. The price went up while we there from 40.000 to about 550000, even though it stated another price on the menu. They tried to charge extra for all the other options of the menu. This is not a buffet option. You only have the option to pick 3 dishes max and you can only rotate between those. For the rest you have to pay extra. Whole staff combined speaks 3 words of English. Completely useless if you don't speak Vietnamese.
description: At Uchi Sushi, we pride ourselves in delivering modern and contemporary Japanese cuisine right in the heart of Ho Chi Minh city with the best quality and prices.

name: Hoang Yen Vietnamese Cuisine - Hai Ba Trung
address: 148 Hai Ba Trung Street, Dist1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: What a nice place. Atmosphere was nice, food tasty with a good selection available, service was speedy, staff was friendly and prices extremely reasonable. Why isn't every restaurant like this? Highly recommend, very average food. unusual for vietnam that it was so mediocre but it was acceptable quality and reasonable service and value, This is a chain Vietnamese food restaurant Near Novotel hotel, is a good economic alternative than hotel restaurant Decor is decent, food taste is average, staff is friendly Maybe I should try the crab...
