Highly recommend

name: Leaf Lounge
address: 2 Phó Đức Chính Phường Nguyễn Thái Bình, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We love to go to this place. City view is perfect especially in dark. The best cocktail we tried was created by manager. I recommended this bar for all my friends.
description: Wine, whisky, cigar, specialty coffee – a refined lounge and social club for connoisseurs to indulge and connect

name: Nén Light Restaurant
address: 122/2 Tran Dinh Xu, Nguyen Cu Trinh Ward, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: A very interesting gourmet experience I must admit - reading some of the reviews after my booking, I got a little worried. But going there it all worked out really nicely The cuisine is definitely experimenting, the flavors are “new” and selected carefully - in my opinion the fit the meat & vegetables very well The presentation of the food was also very exceptional - nicely put on the plate followed by a clear and easy to understand presentation in English One advice - change the wine pairing to also be local Vietnamese “drinks”…… then the pairing also would be exceptional 😉 I will admit - the wine from Chech Republic was experimental, but it suited the dish very well, very good place. quite unique. lovely stories in a very different setting. service was excellent. Overall worthwhile, Amazing birthday treat with my wife. Tucked away in an oasis of calm found delicious found served with a story. As Westerners with limited insight into the local ingredients we were talked through some of the key ones. A highlight was fish cooked in hot beeswax at our table. It was poured at our table early on giving it time to cook and cool before being taken away for presentation later. Great stories and superb food. We also had the wine flight with 3 absolutely delicious sakes. Only downside was a couple wines which while we were assured to be right tasted sour.
description: Creative, storytelling tasting menus with a focus on hyper-local Vietnamese ingredients. Michelin Selected 2023 ✳️Sister of Nén Danang Restaurant

name: Com Ga Hai Nam Eat Lah District 4
address: 67 Nguyen Truong To, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Been to many Singapore Hainanese Chicken Rice shop in Ho Chi Minh however Eat Lah Vietnam exceeded all my expectations with its unbeatable combination of quality, authenticity, and exceptional service. The chicken rice here is nothing short of perfection, with each component thoughtfully prepared to capture the true essence of this beloved dish. The attentive staff made me feel right at home, providing recommendations and ensuring that every need was met. I was particularly impressed by the unique design atmosphere, which beautifully blends elements of Singaporean culture with Vietnamese charm. A true culinary oasis in the heart of Vietnam!, 5 stars! The atmosphere at Eat Lah is warm and welcoming, just like the friendly staff. Must-try dish: The sambal fishball is pure magic! Fried fishballs ladle with chilli thats savory and spicy. Please don't try this if you can't take spicy. If you're looking for an authentic taste of Singapore without leaving Saigon, Eat Lah is your answer., Recently visited Eat Lah, my favorite Singaporean spot in Ho Chi Minh City, and I’m thrilled to share my experience! The recent renovation at Eat Lah caught my eye, the place looks fantastic. As a Singaporean, this is my go-to place, and it never disappoints. My friend and I ordered the steamed chicken and onion omelette. The flavors really tasted like home, 10/10. The revamped ambiance adds a delightful touch to the overall experience. Highly recommended for those craving authentic Singaporean goodness in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City.

I was particularly impressed by the unique design atmosphere, which beautifully blends elements of Singaporean culture with Vietnamese charm. A true culinary oasis in the heart of Vietnam!

name: Legato
address: 126 Pham Viet Chanh, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Excellent cocktail bar. Very expensive but worth it. Do ask for the price of the whiskey 🥃 pours to avoid sticker shock at the end of the night. Easily the best and most expensive bar in Vietnam 🇻🇳. Two drinks and one whiskey pour was 85 US. Yep, that is correct. More expensive than similar bars in the US. But, it was a beautiful night., One of my friend introduced me to this bar, hidden inside the streets of Vui Bien, and I was shocked how the atmosphere is completely different compared to other bars on the main streets. It was quiet, cozy and comfortable with retro style decorations inside. The bartenders and staffs were kind and engaging as well as the owner. They asked me what I like to drink(I was going for gin that day) and recommended one of their signature cocktail - 'Apple of my Eyes'. Personally, I don't like too sweet cocktails but this one was on the spot! Also, they had whole collections of whiskys and wines other than cocktails. I'm not a big fan of whiskys that I didn't try that day, but the owner seemed very knowledgeable about them. So if you're a whisky lover, this is the place you should visit., They actually have changed their name into Legato, the place is sandwiched between two massage parlor, it's quite bustling outside but once I set foot in, a completely different atmosphere! Super super super cozy, they play chill music when I was there. Reasonable price, friendly staff and good drinks, I highly recommend any cocktail from the signature. This place made my night!
description: The hidden gem in backpacker's street (Bui Vien) center of Ho Chi Minh City. Cozy atmosphere Seoul Night gallery & Bar has Authentic cocktails, Draft Beer, Wine, Whisky, Single malt. Every month you will be surprised by good exhibitions! and opening day of a new exhibition, one drink is FREE. Enjoy the atmosphere of Bui Vien, and go to Seoul Night gallery & Bar to have conversations. Song-writer curate the song.

name: Gyu Shige Nguu Phon
address: 6A Tran Hung Dao Pham Ngu Lao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I must say this is the most delicious restaurant I have ever eaten at. Grilled beef or seafood dishes are all fresh. The accompanying sauce is also very special. The decoration style in the restaurant is also very cozy, the staff is very friendly and cute. The food comes out quickly, the price is also suitable for the budget. Everyone should come and experience it! It would be a wonderful thing!, This is one of my best experiences of a good restaurant. The taste of the food is incredible, the food was served within a reasonable time .All the time waiter were asking us if everything ok and they made up what we complained, they were so helpful. The atmosphere of the restaurant was excellent, the waiting time was pleasant and the attention was incredible. Especially the prices are affordable. Definitely I gonna there next time., Decide to eat here because the menu looked good. Had the salad with salmon, grilled squid, pork bone soup and seafood soup. Everything was good but the real standout was the salmon salad. Be definitely be back for that again. Service and price was good

name: Grandma Lu
address: 18 Thái Văn Lung, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We were staying in district one and the hotel we stayed at recommended Grandma Lu’s for a meal. It was a great recommendation, we ended up having breakfast there four times and tried a beef hot pot for dinner as well. The meals were all great value served with top quality coffee. The staff were friendly, with the lady speaking very good English that helped us, not only with ordering but also other tourist information., Everyone should come here to eat fresh bread, delicious, hot bread to blow and eat. Baked in a brick oven, very interesting and strange. Everyone who comes here should eat the shredded chicken sandwich, it's delicious. The staff are also cute and friendly. There are also lucky money envelopes and gifts made from recycled materials, which are very environmentally friendly. Should come hen, I ordered the famous Vietnamese egg coffee, Thai milk tea, beef stew and chicken banh mi. It was delicious. This is my second time coming to this simple and humble Vietnamese restaurant. The staff are polite and able to converse in English. All in all, I would recommend this place to those who are living in District 1. Give “Grandma Lu” a try for authentic Vietnamese cuisine. Thank you and see you soon Vietnam (HCM) !

name: ICHIBAN Japanese Hotpot Buffet
address: 14A Phan Dinh Giot Street, Ward 2, Tan BInh District, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I have been here twice and will surely visit the restaurant again! Excellent service, tasty food, spacious and lovely restaurant setting for surprisingly very very reasonable prices!, All of the taste of seafood, beef, pork... is very fresh and delicious. I like all types of food here, from sushi to salad, and there are so many vegetable for the hotpot, too. Free water and coke. The staffs are very friendly and always fill food on the bar for customer to enjoy. The decoration is in Japanese style and the space is very wide. I'll go here next time with my family and friends.
description: I have been here twice and will surely visit the restaurant again! Excellent service, tasty food, spacious and lovely restaurant setting for surprisingly very very reasonable prices!

name: Gánh Chả
address: 90 Hồ Tùng Mậu, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: I’ve eaten Bun Cha in many places since I traveled to Vietnam, but I personally liked this restaurant the best in HCM city. The restaurant staff were friendly, the food served was hygienic and clean, and it was even better because it had a local Vietnamese atmosphere. The service was a little show, but it didn’t affect the meal that much, and it was good overall, so I recommend it., I was stopped by their floor tiles: one is identical and one looks similar from my great granduncle’s Chee Hsin Tiles company in China. This is the second restaurant that I saw Chee Hsin tiles. Although my belly was full from lunch and looking forward to dinner at Li Bai, but I went in and ordered the spring rolls anyway. It was yummy … I thought was the most delicious spring rolls - how much it was influenced by the tile is incalculable -:) Happy holidays, If around district 1 and looking for some authentic Vietnamese food, would recommend to drop by and try out each little things!
description:
I’ve eaten Bun Cha in many places since I traveled to Vietnam, but I personally liked this restaurant the best in HCM city. 
 The restaurant staff were friendly, the food served was hygienic and clean, and it was even better because it had a local Vietnamese atmosphere. The service was a little show, but it didn’t  affect the meal that much, and it was good overall, so I recommend it.

name: Shang Garden
address: 23 Nguyen Khac Vien District 7, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Whilst walking around looking for somewhere to eat on our first night we came across their restaurant. What a find, lovely staff and amazing food. A little on the pricey side, mainly the wine, approx £25/30 for a brittle but this was quality Chilean Sauvignon . Had a amzing prawns , spinach rice with scallops and green beans to die for. It was so good we went again on our last night. 100% recommend!, The Chinese Authentic Cuisine is excellent. We had Dim Sum and several signature dishes. The peking duck with pancakes was exceptionally delicious. Highly recommended and ambiance.. service was excellent. The price is value for money. What's more we were invited to join the VIP membership with special benefits., Great food and the ambiance is fantastic. Great value. Highly recommended. The Dim Sum.. Pekingese Duck.. Barbecue Pork ribs.. suckling pig are our favourite.

name: Saigon Hot Wings
address: 32H Ho Hao Hon Co Giang Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I was born in Buffalo, so I feel like the wing life is imprinted on my DNA. Having grown up with wings as my personal staple food, I can say with 100% confidence that this restaurant has the best wings on this side of the Pacific. I go here every time I'm in Saigon, and crave it when I'm not in town. Namesake food aside, the rest of the food here is really, really good. The burger is one of the best in HCMC, the chicken sandwich (which can even be ordered with the Saigon Kiss sauce, recommended), the Philly cheesesteak with in-house made cheese sauce... seriously, in a week-long visit to Saigon, I go to this place 3 or 4 times., The Cong Quynh location is no longer. New location, same owner, same staff, re-opening soon less than 1km away, at 35 Ho Hao Hon Street. Estimated to be open late Sept / early Oct 2018., Was recommended by a friend, she's an even better friend now for that, not full of eejits like most places, mind you they mibis thought I was as they will play any music videos you request, and I virtually took the place over with my suggestions, food good, atmosphere magic, bit hard to find, which makes it a wee gem of a place,Highly recommend,

name: Cari Cua 63
address: 63 Nguyen Truong To Ward 12, Dist. 4, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Just walked around to find an place to eat. I saw many people sitting there and take the last table.The waitres gave me an smartphone with pictures as the Menue is only in Vietnamese. I was hungry and on the pictures the portions looked smal, big mistake ;). The Scalops was perfect tasty. The Prawns in Cury just perfect. The beef with noodles great to. Tipical Saigon Restaurant. Do not expect an great service its an authentic place where locals, expads and tourist enjoy an good cheap food. Only at the end i notice i m not in the Restaurant, its on the other side of the street. The main Restaurant is so full that they rent at night time an coffe shop to have more seats. 20$ all in just great, Our friend invited us to this restaurant and he highly recommend us to try curry crabs so we did order two crabs. They have two kinds of crabs 1) with string the price is a lot cheaper, but you end up paying more because the fabric they use to tie the crabs is pretty heavy due to water retention. 2) craby without string is about $300k vnd more than with string. The curry crabs flavors is really good and other snail dishes too. We went back here the next day without our friend and they don’t treat us the same because we are not locals. They know we are visitors so they give us not so good quality crabs. We complain to the waitress and she told us that the crab are not good today. They should have told us that when we place the order not wait until We complain about it. So if you are foreigner or not the locals make sure to ask if the crabs are good or not. If they tell you it’s good then tell them if the crabs comes out bad you will return it. This way they won’t dare to give you bad ones. Enjoy 😉, Great local spot serving nice crab curry. Mid range priced. Make sure you get one that of bread to mop up the sauce afterwards

address: 38 Ly Tu Trong Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I like this place; I found the staff to be very friendly and helpful ordering food and drinks. Had some appetizers, the chicken wings came with a dipping sauce that was super Asian good, full of lemongrass and garlic. The potato was so creamy and had a nice crunch to it. The spring rolls were also worth ordering. Bartenders are good at mixing the drinks, so all is good here. Recommend to visit., Went on a friend's recommendation. Location quite easy to find as nearby tourist attractions. Food was surprising good. What stand out for me was the friendly service and the ambient of the place. They had a wide range of drinks, especially enjoyed the cocktails! Generally a gerat place to chill out! Would visit again when back to Ho Chi Minh., friendly staff, delicious food. Highly recommended. We had sea food spaghetti with pesto , it is delicious ly was lovely.
description: THE VAULT Bar & Lounge locates in the heart of Saigon. Asian Fusion Dinning & Cocktails. Entertainment & Live Music.

name: OnTop Bar
address: 167 Hai Ba Trung Street, Vo Thi Sau Ward, District 3 Novotel Saigon Centre, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I was so happy to have a couple of Negronis tonight breaking my self enforced sobriety spell at this lovely bar on the 20th floor of the Novotel Saigon Centre. If I am only going to have a couple of drinks every now and then, then it needs to be in style. This venue oozes a laid back cool style with fabulous night views of the Saigon skyline, and great laid back, chill music that all combine with their heavenly drinks to make you appreciate all the good things in life. The service is friendly, yet still very professional, I do love that combination. The bar is well stocked, there is also food available. From me, top marks to their mixologist, both Negronis were perfect! This was my first visit to OnTop, it certainly will not be my last. Next time I will bring a couple of friends with me. Tonight it was just two drinks before dinner. Thank you!, This is a great spot to finish the day with partners or friends with a magnificent view across the lights of Ho Chi Min City. Only open at night but a good variety of drinks and snacks. Worth a look., Excellent Bar with a great view over the city - beautiful seeing all the lights come on after sunset. Nice selection of drinks and yummy things to eat. Looking forward to coming again.
description: The OnTop Bar, a stylish rooftop bar located on the 20th floor at Novotel Saigon Centre, provides stunning views of the Saigon skyline from the outdoor terrace. Come and chill out with friends or business associates at a relaxing and casual ambiance.

reviews: We tried borscht soup and red caviar bliny, which is super delicious. Team is nice and super friendly. Located on second floor. And it’s open 24 hours ), Come and enjoy the delicious taste of Tacos, pleassss. Why ? I dunno but I tried it once and now it is my favorite dish, This place is so cool, guyss you gotta try the Oliver Salad, its so tastyyyyy, The desserts amazing
description: Eatery & wine Bar in heart of Thao Dien , Ho Chi Minh City

name: Nasi Padang Restaurant
address: 22 Pham Hong Thai District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Nasi Padang, which comprises rice with side dishes, originated in the West Sumatran city of Padang. Hence its name. But it is also becoming a big part of the Vietnamese food scene. Just walk in and get a plate of rice and choose any dishes or food. There are different sorts of mouth-watering dishes on display. The difficulty is in choosing what to leave out rather than what to order. You will be charged on the amount of food on your plate. The price is reasonable & the restaurant is very clean. Open daily and be there early to avoid the rush hour. Beef Rendang and Black Ink Squid was delicious!
description: Serving Authentic Nasi Padang Cuisine

name: Pizza 4P's Thiso Mall
address: 5 Hoàng Thế Thiện 5 Hoàng Thế Thiện, An Lợi Đông, Thu Duc, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Pizza 4p’s is my favourite pizza restaurant chain in Vietnam. I came to this particular restaurant for the first time this visit to Saigon and ended up eating here twice in one week: once with a friend and the second time with my partner as the food was so nice. Highly recommend booking as this is a very popular restaurant situated in Thiso Mall. Especially at peak times you will need to line up if you have not booked and booking online is super easy and quick. There is a wide variety of food to choose from aside from Pizza, but they do Pizza incredibly well and with a very unique selection of flavours & toppings. Other mentions are the German potato fondue with Raclette cheese, the crab spaghetti and OMG … the desserts especially the Cacao Terrine are delicious. They also have a house beer - Yuzu Wheat. which pairs particularly well with the pizzas. Slightly bitter first taste with a smooth finish. I really like the Yuzu beer. Service is especially worth mentioning. Super friendly and professional staff that are constantly on the go., Very nice environment in Thiso Mall entrance. Nice ambience, very professional staff, nice menu. Pizza, spaghetti, salad, really enjoyed all dishes, recommended.

name: Miya Sushi & BBQ
address: 150/26 Nguyen Trai, Quan 1, TP HCM, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Fantastic, well presented delicious food. Reasonable prices. Good, friendly, efficient staff. Good service. The restaurant looks very clean and pretty. We got lost, but they were patient and held our booking for us. Really good value for money, The atmosphere is not very good but the food is amazing. I've been here multiple times on my own as well as with my friend. Highly recommend the Katsudon., Food was good. Staff was attentive and nice. The only thing I didn't really like was the ambience. Building infrastructure needs some TLC. The price is not cheap considering the location (in an alley) and the facility. But anyway, the taste is good.

name: Saigon Grill
address: 91 Pasteur Street Saigon Royal Building, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: This rooftop restaurant is large and can accommodate a lot of people and has great views over the city. We came here on a Friday night and the place was packed with locals, which is always a good sign. There was a good range of food and drink options. We thought it was so good we came back again on Saturday night., Made a reservation in advance so we're given a great table on the rooftop with amazing views of the city. Menu was very extensive but the staff helped to explain it and give recommendations. Food was amazing, we had frog in chilli and salt, beef in pepper sauce, seafood fried rice and crab spring rolls. Would definitely recommend., If you like barbecue and nice view then you chose rooftop grill. Veggie, meat 🍖, fish 🐠, sea food, vegetarian 🌱 on grill. If I do not use the map I would not find it quick. Food was great 👍
description: Indulging yourselves in a fantastic experience of table-charcoal grill restaurant and admiring the stunning beauty of the heart of Saigon. Our first standards are made from the combination of our fresh and high quality ingredients with modern and traditional styles of cooking that creates the authentic cuisines to the satisfaction of your utmost taste.

name: Lai Restaurant
address: 92-94 Nam Kỳ Khởi Nghĩa Tầng 28 Sedona Suites, 28th Floor, Ward, Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Lai Cantonese Restaurant delivers an authentic taste of Cantonese cuisine with a modern twist, offering a dining experience that is both comforting and refined. Located in a stylish yet welcoming setting, the restaurant strikes a balance between traditional Chinese aesthetics and contemporary design. Service at Lai is attentive and efficient, with staff knowledgeable about the menu and happy to offer recommendations. DUY KHANG was our server, he is very professional. Dishes are served promptly, and the staff’s warmth adds a personal touch to the overall dining experience., The space here is very beautiful and quiet in the morning, chatting and working very reasonably in the VIP room. Delicious food and delicious dishes are very attractive. Mr. Son, the waiter, is very happy and explains each dish in detail. Very satisfied here and will come back., Lai Restaurant, centrally located in HCMC, opens its doors to an extraordinary culinary experience. With a unique view over the entire city, the atmosphere is almost magical. The food, characterized by high Chinese and Japanese quality, turns the meal into a taste journey. The service reaches world-class standards and helps to make the visit extraordinary. The super extravagant and cozy decor adds a touch of luxury to the overall experience. Lai Restaurant is a must-visit for those seeking a perfect combination of sublime flavors, first-class service and an atmosphere of exquisite comfort in the heart of HCMC's vibrant heart.
description: Lai is a new exploration of Modern Cantonese cuisine offering a unique culinary experience. Through a distinctive menu, a dim sum bar selection, and a display of rich sashimi choices, our menu lets the ingredients take the lead. Fresh and imaginative, it invigorates traditional recipes for a modern audience. Our Chefs combine age-old techniques and meaningful flavors with imagination and refinement—the result is flavorful, unexpected, and elegantly executed dishes. Set over two floors, it contains a variety of dining areas, private dining rooms, and an opulent terrace. The decoration playfully fuses the traditional with the boldly modern, creating open yet connected spaces.

name: The Cloud
address: 720A Dien Bien Phu, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Cloud Restaurant truly lives up to its name. Located high above the bustling streets of Ho Chi Minh City, it offers breathtaking views of the city’s skyline, making it an ideal spot for a romantic dinner, a special celebration, or simply an evening to indulge in something extraordinary. The restaurant is a perfect blend of modern elegance and relaxation, creating an exclusive yet welcoming atmosphere. The staff is attentive, friendly, and professional, always ready to provide recommendations or adjust details to ensure a flawless dining experience. The menu is a harmonious mix of Vietnamese classics and international dishes, all crafted with fresh, high-quality ingredients. The flavors are outstanding, and the presentation is a work of art. I particularly recommend their signature seafood dish and the dessert, which combines tropical fruits with delicate chocolate in a delightful way. The drink selection is equally impressive, featuring a wide range of wines and creative cocktails that perfectly complement the food. I tried a refreshing cocktail that was the perfect match for the warm Vietnamese evening., Very accommodating service from Lance and the food was delicious and very appealing served. We had the squid and the salmon rolls. The cocktail without alcohol was also very good. The view was magnificent. It was very special for our last evening in Vietnam, OH.MY.GOD! One of the best experiences I've ever had! The service is impeccable! Tháo & Daria served me well, from the start until finish. The grilled octopus with pumpkin purée sauce & kaffir lime leaves was SOOO gorgeously delicious that I ordered 2 servings of it! I felt like I was in Spain & on cloud (pun intended) nine! The calamari with the mayonnaise sauce was also out of this world! Maybe the ambience of the restaurant being at the 48th floor, with some alfresco seats, which was so windy & breezy, made everything so fantabulous! The hot chocolate & decaf mocha latte were too delicious! Served with their in-house Vietnamese-made dark chocolate,it was so smooth to savour! The views are so expanse & made me wonder why I did not visit this place earlier! Kudos to the chefs, sous chefs, commis cooks & all the crew at this fabulous restaurant! A must-visit the next time you visit Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam! Truly no regrets!
description: Day time discovery of local coffee’s and single origin crafted chocolates and delicacies. Night time place to hang out with friends and experience one or two of the wide range of biodynamic, organic and natural wines. Collaborations with Vietnamese craftsmen contribute a gentle vibrancy to the entire aesthetic. A confluence of tradition and modernity appears in The Cloud lobby lounge in the form of local Lacaph coffee and Marou chocolate and staff clad in modern ao dai.

name: Buffet NINETEEN
address: Ground Floor - 19 Lam Son Square, Dis 1 Caravelle Saigon, Ho Chi Minh City 848 Vietnam
reviews: The seafood restaurant buffet was excellent, most of the seafood and other meat dishes and a big range of desserts. Restaurant waiter and waitress Hiêu, Nhi, Thao has been very friendly and supportive to make the experience enjoyable. All food served was top class including the drinks and wonderful Vietnamese coffee. Full marks to the cuisine team 👍., Now I'm back at Nineteen buffet because I saw a recommendation from Hieu's call that there were Japanese dishes, but to my surprise, yesterday when I went there were all Thai dishes, mango sticky rice, Thai hot pot... But my favorite dish is pumpkin soup. Yesterday was very disappointing. The pumpkin soup was cooked without seasoning, not sugar-sweet, very strangely brackish sweet. After reporting it, Hieu received the information and reported it to the kitchen. Cooked it again, then Nhi came directly to receive feedback and noted that the soup had been adjusted, although not as delicious as before, but it was very remarkable for your enthusiastic customer care. The quality of seafood is no longer the same as before, the crab looks like it has a whole piece of meat, but it looks bad, some are good and some are not so good, hopefully the restaurant will adjust the seafood input and have a richer taste. Dessert: Personalized cakes should be pre-cut so that guests don't get messy when picking them up Plus points: the flan still maintains the same quality, the sushi is very delicious and we cannot help but acknowledge the enthusiastic care of the staff and the restaurant manager., Hieu's service is very good and the food is delicious. I will come again next time I come to Vietnam. It is highly recommended. You can order unlimited lobsters and crabs for fresh cooking. The seafood is very fresh, the desserts are delicious, the ice cream is also delicious, and the drinks and juices are also very good. Drink, and the gratin dishes are also delicious. Children love them very much. It’s suitable for the whole family to come together. It’s great.
description: Our flagship restaurant Nineteen, named after our address at 19 Lam Son Square, has grown a reputation in Saigon for its unparalleled seafood buffet and five-star dining experience. The seafood is caught fresh from Vietnam’s waters in the East Sea and off the tropical holiday island of Phu Quoc in the southwest. But Nineteen isn’t just about the seafood buffet. Everyday there are breakfast and lunch buffets that include the freshest and best quality produce that can be sourced in Vietnam and from abroad, including mouthwatering roasts, ribs, vegetables and salads. Whether you prefer soup or sushi, pho or pancakes, both Asian and Western options are available for the most discerning eaters to mix things up a bit, all of course, topped off with an indulgent spread of delicious desserts.

name: Bánh Xèo 46A
address: 46A Đinh Công Tráng, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Found this place by browsing, because actually i check the michelin and dont want to eat carbs. Come before 9pm, still crowd especially with foreigner. Because i come alone, easy for me to get seated. The staff can not speak english, but the madam owner took my order politely and kind, love. There is different menu with english for foreigner. Order vietnamese crepe small size with small shrimps and without pork and summer rolls without pork but the madam allow me to order only 3 because i was alone and tea for the drink. The crepe really big, even i ordered the small one and everytime i eat at vietnam, they also provide condiment vegetables. The crepe tasty, many shrimps and the shrimps taste sweet and fresh, and many bean sprouts inside. The summer rolls taste better than i eat at pho restaurant, i love their sauce and i can refill it. I am very full here. Only accepted cash payment and they had grey doggies. Better come before 9.30 pm because they prepare to close before 10pm. Thankyou madam for your hospitality., Bánh Xèo 46A is a must-try for anyone craving crispy, savory Vietnamese pancakes! The bánh xèo here is perfectly golden and filled with shrimp, pork, and bean sprouts. It’s served with fresh herbs and dipping sauce, making every bite flavorful and refreshing. The atmosphere is casual and cozy, and the service is friendly and quick. If you're in Hanoi, this place is definitely worth a visit for a delicious and authentic meal!, You can eat really good banhseo! It was the first time the whole family had eaten a dish called banh seo, but it was delicious and I ate it very quickly. The fresh spring rolls I ordered with them were also delicious and full of sauce, which was very satisfying. I think there were many locals. If you can go to Ho Chi Minh City again, this is the place to visit. The restaurant was full of tables outside, so I was lucky to be shown to a seat with indoor air conditioning.
description:
Found this place by browsing, because actually i check the michelin and dont want to eat carbs. Come before 9pm, still crowd especially with foreigner. Because i come alone, easy for me to get seated. The staff can not speak english, but the madam owner took my order politely and kind, love. There is different menu with english for foreigner. Order vietnamese crepe small size with small shrimps and without pork and summer rolls without pork but the madam allow me to order only 3 because i was alone and tea for the drink. The crepe really big, even i ordered the small one and everytime i eat at vietnam, they also provide condiment vegetables.

The crepe tasty, many shrimps and the shrimps taste sweet and fresh, and many bean sprouts inside. The summer rolls taste better than i eat at pho restaurant, i love their sauce and i can refill it. I am very full here. Only accepted cash payment and they had grey doggies. Better come before 9.30 pm because they prepare to close before 10pm. Thankyou madam for your hospitality.

name: Pizza 4P's Ben Thanh
address: 8 Thu Khoa Huan Street District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Pizza 4P's is undoubtedly one of the standout dining experiences in Hanoi, offering not only the best pizza in Vietnam but also amazing service that elevates every meal into a memorable occasion. The staff at Pizza 4P's are incredibly attentive and knowledgeable. They provide personalized recommendations, ensuring that every guest feels valued and well taken care of. Their professionalism is evident in how they manage orders efficiently using modern technology like iPads for ordering5. The pizzas here are truly exceptional. Made with fresh, locally sourced ingredients and house-made artisanal cheese, each bite is a delight. Options range from classic margherita to more adventurous combinations like seafood or Japanese-inspired pizzas. The half-and-half option allows you to try two different flavors on one pizza, which we found particularly enjoyable. The restaurant boasts a modern design with a welcoming atmosphere that makes it perfect for both casual gatherings and special occasions. Whether you're dining alone or with friends, the ambiance ensures an enjoyable experience. If you're looking for authentic Italian-style pizza in Ho Chi Minh City with outstanding service, Pizza 4P's should be at the top of your list. Their commitment to quality ingredients and customer satisfaction makes them stand out from other pizzerias. Don't miss trying their homemade burrata pizzas or exploring their diverse pasta options — both are highly recommended!, I've tried Pizza 4P's at many different locations, but this one is truly the best and my favorite place to dine. Not only is the food consistently delicious, but the ambiance is also warm and inviting, making every visit enjoyable. What stands out the most is the exceptional service—the staff are always enthusiastic, attentive, and ready to assist with a smile. Every meal here is a wonderful experience, and I’ll definitely keep coming back to enjoy my favorite dishes again and again!, The atmosphere is casual and welcoming, making it a great place to relax and enjoy a meal with friends or family. The service is attentive and friendly, adding to the overall positive experience. While it might be a bit pricier than typical pizza joints, the quality and taste are well worth it. I often order these dishes when come here.
description: An Earth to People restaurant on a mission to make the world smile for peace, one pizza at a time. Earth to People is our commitment to serve safe and fresh foods directly from Mother Earth to you. Located in Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Danang and Nha Trang.

name: Poke Saigon Ly Tu Trong
address: 42 Bis Ly Tu Trong First Floor, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Hawaiian food, fresh and delicious. When I went around noon, it was a bit crowded, but the waiters were still enthusiastic and helped me quickly so I could eat in time. The price is a bit high but in return the quality of the food is fresh and delicious Spicy salmon for everyone, If you’re looking for a healthy dining spot, Poke is a fantastic choice. This cozy restaurant focuses on nutritious, organic ingredients and caters to various dietary needs including vegan, gluten-free, and keto. Their quinoa bowls, fresh smoothies, and grilled salmon are both delicious and guilt-free. The ambiance is calm and welcoming, perfect for a relaxing meal. Staff are knowledgeable about the menu and happy to help with customizations. With a strong commitment to sustainability and wellness, Poke offers a wholesome dining experience that doesn’t compromise on taste. It’s ideal for anyone seeking balance between health and flavor., Nothing can beat Poke Saigon when you are looking for fresh and quality ingredients! Hidden in an old few floors building, this little cute restaurant with friendly staffs is the best place to go when you want variety of taste, healthy food, for a very competitive price! You never can be disappointed by a poke bowl for lunch or dinner!
description: Second outlet of Poke Saigon. We serve modern hawaiian poke.

name: Lua Dai Viet Restaurant
address: 189 - 191 - 193 De Tham Phuong Pham Ngu Lao, Quan 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We just happen to see this Seafood Restaurant while walking around Saigon and we're so pleased with the food and service. They cook the food infront of you My, our server is so friendly and knowledgeable on the food she's serving Highly recommended!!, The Dai Viet serves a wide variety of dishes, including spring rolls, fresh seafood and even pizza. The restaurant has a bright and airy atmosphere, with colorful décor and comfortable seating. The service is friendly and efficient, and the staff is always willing to help with any questions. Rose is amazing and helpful. She looks after us really well. I'm impressed with the quality and freshness of the food. Everything is made fresh, and flavourful. ., Good Food and Service is Superb. I had fried shrimp rolls and omelette with veggies , pork and shrimp and sweet and sour sauce. Definitely a good dinning experience and value for money
description: Located at Welcome Gate of Bui Vien Walking street (the crossroads of De Tham street and Bui Vien street), Lua Dai Viet restaurant is an ideal place to enjoy Vietnamese fresh seafood and admire the busiest tourist street of Saigon

name: Baba's Kitchen Bui Vien
address: 274 Bui Vien Pham Ngu Lao, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Baba's Kitchen on Bui Vien Street in Ho Chi Minh City offers authentic Indian cuisine in a welcoming atmosphere. Diners praise its flavorful dishes, generous portions, and attentive service. Popular menu items include butter chicken, various naans, and dal makhani. The restaurant is open daily from 11:00 AM to 10:30 PM., I have been a devoted customer of Baba's Kitchen for more than five years, and I can confidently say that it is an exceptional Indian restaurant. The consistent quality of their food, combined with their warm and welcoming ambiance, has kept me coming back time and time again. The flavors at Baba's Kitchen are truly remarkable. From their aromatic curries to their mouthwatering tandoori dishes, each bite is a delightful explosion of authentic Indian taste. The chef at Baba's Kitchen have perfected their craft, ensuring that every dish is prepared with care and precision. I have never been disappointed with the exceptional flavors that emanate from their kitchen. What sets Baba's Kitchen apart is their commitment to providing great value for money. Despite the high quality of their food, their prices remain affordable, making it an excellent choice for both casual dining and special occasions. I have always felt that I receive excellent value for the delicious meals I enjoy at Baba's Kitchen. The service at Baba's Kitchen is also worth mentioning. The staff members are attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable. They go above and beyond to cater to their customers' needs, ensuring a memorable dining experience. The welcoming atmosphere and the excellent service contribute to the overall enjoyment of each visit. As a loyal patron of Baba's Kitchen, I can confidently say that it is a restaurant deserving of high praise. The consistent quality of their food, combined with their reasonable prices and exceptional service, have made it a favorite dining destination for me. If you are seeking an outstanding Indian dining experience, I wholeheartedly recommend giving Baba's Kitchen a try., This is an excellent Indian restaurant in Vietnam. Something different. Very popular as there was a mixed crowd when we were there. The food was great and the staff were very attentive. You also get free water, a little starter and a small desert to finish off with all free of charge and it is not expensive.
description: Baba's Kitchen Indian Restaurant Conveniently located in District 1 of Ho Chi Minh City. We can also handle large groups. We are at the entrances of the Bui Vien Walking Street. Discover OurFlavourful Journey with a passion for flavors and a vision to create unforgettable dining experiences.

name: B3 Steakhouse & Craft Beer
address: 14 Nguyễn Huệ, Bến Nghé Level 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: The cozy atmosphere made it perfect for a romantic dinner, and the beautiful presentation of dishes added to the charm. The steaks were cooked to perfection, though the prices leaned on the higher side. What stood out were the knowledgeable servers, who guided us expertly through the craft beer selection. While it’s not a budget-friendly spot, it’s a great choice for couples looking for a special night out., The appetizers are varied and delicious, especially the fried squid ring, which is crisp and delicious! The staff were very friendly and patiently recommended dishes even though we had some difficulty communicating in Chinese. What surprised us the most was the value for money, such a good steak and craft beer pairing at such a reasonable price!, We stumbled upon B3 after a grueling day of meetings in HCMC's February heat. What a find! The air-conditioned sanctuary offered perfectly seasoned ribeyes that didn't break our expense account. The knowledgeable servers guided us through their impressive craft beer selection, suggesting ideal pairings for each cut. Great value considering the quality—our team was thoroughly impressed. The vibrant evening atmosphere perfectly captured the city's energetic pulse while providing enough quiet for important conversations. Definitely our new go-to spot for impressing clients in Ho Chi Minh City!
description: Located in the very center of Ho Chi Minh city, B3 Steakhouse is an ideal place for both locals and tourists to stop by for a decent steak and a cold glass of beer with an amazing view from our wide terrace. We are proud to have the biggest selection of craft beer in town with all the famous brands from local such as Pasteur Street Brewery, Te Te to the international ones such as Hoegaarden.

name: La Fiesta
address: 128 Ly Tu Trong Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The food is AMAZING. So many choices of Mexican, western, salads and different sides. The portions they give you are very generous and the staff are so lovely. One of the best restaurants we’ve been to in vietnam. They also give you some free crisps/dips at the start of your meal and a free shot at the end of the meal!, The first time I went to La Fiesta I didn't really do the food justice as I was on a diet and so only ate the chicken salad. But the salad was refreshing and the dressing was enjoyable. The chicken was very more-ish too. And the frozen jalapeno Margarita was one of the best, most enjoyable Margaritas tasted anywhere. The next two times I had a delivery of chili con carne which came with french fries, so I made my own basmati rice to go with the chili as rice is my preference and also enjoyed the shoestring fries. I had a side of salad too which was just as fresh and tasty as I remembered. The chili con carne was too much on the mild side for me, although still a delicious flavour, but a couple of sliced red chilis added to the chili soon remedied that and brought it up to the level of spiciness I'm used to. The whole experience was very satisfying and I.m now looking forward to trying many of the other dishes at La Fiesta as well., I had burrito plate which included taco salad that was tasty and fresh, tofu burrito which was tasty and two sides including refried beans that were really good, rice that was bland, and for dessert a brownie that was very fresh. I had fresh watermelon juice and it tasted like it was just made. It was 2pm and there were 2 other tables, and lots of Grab delivery guys picking up. Servers are so nice and attentive.
description: Hola Amigos! This is OUR Tex-Mexican Restaurant in HCMC, Vietnam. I'm (Scott) from Maine, USA & my wife and better half (Duc) is from here in Saigon. What we are trying to do here at La Fiesta is to make some tasty and fairly authentic Tex-Mexican food, served with a smile in a welcoming setting. We make all of our sauces and tortillas onsite, and also use Saigon Tacos locally made Corn Tortillas & Salsa Verde. We take great pride in our work, and strive to do our best to pay attention to detail every single day. It's the little things that count, and that gets lost sometimes. We will all work hard every day to stay on top of our game, and keep you wanting to come back to La Fiesta. Serving tasty Tex-Mex food and drink in the heart of Saigon.

name: Nhà Hàng Bê Vàng
address: 261 -263 An Duong Vuong, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The food is quite diverse, very delicious. Luxurious space, enthusiastic service, very suitable for gathering with family and friends. You can come and try the cherry soda, I feel it is very delicious and suits my taste, Where to begin?! I’ve been to Be Vang before and after their remodel and the food has always been consistently top notch. The restaurant interior is very clean, comfortable, and their staff is welcoming and kind. This is more of a fine dining establishment and both the menu items and impeccable service reflect this type of experience. Plus they are great with kids which is so very appreciated! They took great care to provide us a high chair, and were attentive to their needs such as giving us plastic cups and kids utensils. As for the food, I am incredibly impressed by the selection ranging from seafood and sushi to Western and Vietnamese delicacies. I live in a huge metropolis in the US where we have access to the best chefs and restaurants in the world. But I always look forward to Be Vang when we come to this area. We have sampled most of their offerings and everything is just fresh and well prepared. On our most recent visit we did a surf n turf with a deluxe sushi boat and steak - it was amazingly good and the owner even mentioned the fish gets imported from Japan. My kids devoured the sashimi. The steak was cooked to a perfect medium rare and melted in your mouth…I am still thinking about it days later. I see that the restaurant has lots of local Vietnamese patronizing them in addition to foreigners which is a great sign that they do a good job of accommodating all kinds of people. It seems to be somewhat of a hidden gem but I think they rival even the best Michelin restaurants out there! Will keep coming back every time we visit Saigon., Today my family is having a birthday party at Be Vang. Delicious food, cozy private room space. Recommend everyone to try the fried quail, stir-fried noodles, and lobster with passion fruit sauce. The kitchen makes it delicious and delicious :))
description: "Great People Love Great Food" | A Hidden gem famous to the Native Vietnamese, from north to south. Led by owner & Master Chef Quan Diec with over 45 years experience in Traditional Hong Kong style Chinese cuisine & 35 years of Japanese Sushi & Sashimi, located in Saigon's China Town. Our journey began as an outside restaurant since 1999. Yes, outdoor only seating with the little red plastic stools, and the aroma of spit roasted whole cows (Bê Vàng) wafting to the street. Now, transformed and earning a distinguished place in Saigon's social and culinary landscape. We are so proud to offer this unique experience, that showcases our roots deep in the art of traditional Hong Kong Chinese cuisine and Sushi & Sashimi creations that deliver the freshest flavors from the sea. Thriving by staying consistent with what we know. With a menu of over 100 recipes tested over decades, everyone is sure to find something and love what they find. Walk-in’s are available, come see us today!

name: The Indian House
address: 30 Ton That Thiep, Ben Nghe ward, District 1, HCMC, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Authentic Indian food at an extremely reasonable price and a highly hospitable service and great interaction with the staff. The food is sits great on the Indian tongue and provides flourishing flavours to the mouth. Definitely recommend to have a nice and calm dinner with nostalgic Bollywood music., It was our first time eating Indian in a restaurant. The waiter was really nice and helped us choosing our dish and also told us how they would eat it after we asked. The food was really good :-) Would recommend to try., Had snacks cheesy Nan bread with chicken in sauce really really nice. Vegetable samosas really nice with sauce And a bottle of room temp water very pleasant staff the food albeit I only had snack was good they also have a veranda you can sit out on would be nice in the cool night air. Would def recommend Steve Fm Blackburn Lance
description: The Indian House, an Indian restaurant, located in the heart of Saigon city on Ton That Thiep street in District 1. Walking street views, live kitchen & delicious Indian food. Cozy & inviting, ideal for small groups. 50 seats. Enjoy a casual Indian escape!

name: My Banh Mi
address: 57 Nguyễn Du Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Two of us stumbled upon this great place, my wife had wanted a Ban Mih, but not from a roadside stall. It was great and the staff were very friendly. In GBP cost was around £16 for two Ban Mih, one vegan and one fish, a coke, a water and some fries. Note, it’s not a big place so they save the larger tables for the bigger parties., Last time (2022) I rated it 4/5 like this time…and previously I acknowledged the price and quality…I get all that, but AUD (150k dong) AUD$9 per Banh Mi is more than in Australia prices. My review 2 years ago defended the pricing…but actually now, it is not worth the money. You get just as good Banh Mi for 150k dong pretty much anywhere you regardless what the owner says in response to this (or any other pricing based feedback). So I have still rated it 4/5 for the paranoid eaters…but if you are normal…save 90% of the cost and go elsewhere. PS: service in previous visits, this time somewhere between sub-par and disinterested., This is a high quality banh mi sit down restaurant in the heart of Saigon. The staff was very helpful and asked us if we had any allergies to the ingredients that were named as the normal toppings for the banh mi. The music played was US oldies, which were a great part of the dining experience. It’s a great place to have a high quality banh mi sandwich.
description: Special authentic Vietnamese Home Cooking restaurant in Vietnam. It is a Vietnamese Bistro, not a street stall. Our Banh Mi mirrors the taste and quality of the original 19th Century Banh Mi introduced to Saigon by French and local culinary Masters. Our specialty is charcoal grilled meat fillings featuring USDA Choice Steaks, Pork, and Chicken. A one-page menu limited to a few classic Vietnamese Home Cooked Vegan & Non-Vegan favorites: Gluten-free Noodles, Meats, and Vegetarian Items. MBM culinary excellence is recognized on TV, BBC, Moya Moya Japan, etc. Tour sponsor recognition includes: Ctrip Gourmet PRC, Rurubu, Vinadaytravel, Tripzilla, Coconuts, etc. AMBIANCE: Air-conditioned - English-speaking table service. AUTHENTIC MEALS: delicate flavors combining local herbs and spices. HYGIENE SAFETY: Healthy meals are excellent value for money. Five-star quality moderately priced.

name: Benaras Indian Bistro
address: 21B D. Ton Duc Thang Ben Nghe, Quan 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: The food was excellent and is worthy of 5 stars. The reason I only gave 4 stars was because the person who took our order didn’t write down what we ordered but tried to do it by memory. As a result, when the food arrived at our table, my chicken curry ended up being mutton curry. I was ok with mutton curry so didn’t send the order back. However, rather than apologizing, the server argued that I had ordered the mutton even though, right after ordering, he had asked me to verify that I wanted the chicken curry, opened the menu to the correct page and pointed to the chicken curry, to which I said yes. I also had to remind our server that I had ordered a mango lassi as he served my spouse her drink but forgot mine. My wife had chicken tikka masala and we shared an order of naan and palak paneer (often referred to as saag paneer). As I said above, the food was excellent., Banaras Indian restaurant has a delicious food selection! I stopped by after hearing a lot of good things about this place and I was not disappointed! Friendly service, cozy ambiance, and scrumptiously excellent food. I eat gluten free food as a preference and this is one of the most unique Indian restaurants that was able to satisfy my cravings for Indian style bread / rotis and appetizer selection! They have a dedicated Millet menu which serves very good options for all gluten free customers. I am not sure about the cross contamination factor for those with “Celiac”…but if it’s a pure preference, than this is the place!!!! Sweet, savory, spicy and flavor-packed. Delicious! Very authentic and elegant serving dishes - nice touch 👍 I am fully impressed with their overall quality, interior decor, cleanliness and presentation with great hospitality! Special shout out to their amazing team of staff - Shritel, Ritesh and the Chef Lokendrq! Try the Banaras Indian Bistro, it's one of the best I had in Vietnam!, The restaurant has delicious dishes, with many characteristics of Indian cuisine. The serving time of the dishes is quick. The service attitude of the staff is very friendly and attentive, especially the cashier on the evening shift (Thao Van) is very cute and professional. If I have the chance, I will come back to enjoy delicious dishes with my friends!
description: BENARAS Indian Bistro is a modern, up and coming restaurant located in Ho Chi Minh City. From authentic Indian street foods to marvelous Indian sweet delicacies, we serve it all, made by hotel experienced Chefs all the way from Northern India. BENARAS has an ambience like no other and welcomes all to taste the unique flavors of India and reward their palates. The restaurant offers premier Customer Service accompanied by a plethora of amenities including buffets, set menus and catering options. We look forward to serve you at Benaras!

name: Quán Bụi Original
address: 19 Ngo Van Nam Ben Nghe Ward 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Today the weather is quite cool. I invited my friends to a famous restaurant located in the heart of Saigon. What I'm interested in is that the restaurant has a lot of foreign customers and I can't say "oh wow" because of the Vietnamese food, but there are a lot of tourists coming. I'm sure the restaurant was built a long time ago. After asking the staff, they learned that the restaurant has many branches in District 1 & 2. I tried the dish at Bui Original branch and it was delicious. I plan to enjoy it at the Bui Garden branch restaurant next time because my family has young children who need space to play. The staff was quite thoughtful in giving instructions on how to eat for guests when I accidentally saw that there were also foreign guests next to them eating dishes like spring rolls, hot pot... Eating here is much more economical than other Vietnamese restaurants I went to a few days ago. The feeling of enjoying it is truly Vietnamese but in a foreign space which is quite interesting. A place worth exploring and giving your family more peace of mind. Will introduce foreign guests to support Quan Bui., Delicious dishes and a wide selection of specialities, quality is at the rendezvous. Moreover a very pleasant setting. We ate a crispy pancake with seafood inside Banh Xeo Hai san, a mango and shrimp salad, and a delicious tomato soup, with a whole bunch of herbs and shrimp The waiters are kind and show how to eat dishes and sauces The service manager speaks English very well and kindly agreed to call us a taxi to drive us to the hotel We were delighted with our dinner, no wonder the cook was MasterChef of Vietnam. Good job! We highly recommend this restaurant, My wife and I had lunch here yesterday. Great spot for delicious Vietnames food. Drinks are ice cold and the serves of food are reasonbly large. Beware of ordering the rolls or wraps as an entree, as the serves are large and may well impede you finishing your main meal. Prices are good, not market cheap but this is quality restaurant food. I can highly recommend TÔM SÚ XÀO SA TẾ (Sautéed Prawns with Satay sauce, Bell pepper, Onions). There is at least a dozen prawns and the Bell Pepper (capsicums) are fresh and crisp. We will definitely be returning before flying home. Keep up the good work guys.
description: Dining in Saigon is quite easy and it is not a place where you will easily go hungry, regardless of your budget. Some of Vietnamese restaurants which cater to the business community are quite Westernized. If you insist on a crisp, white table cloth, we don't have it. But for those who want to enjoy real Vietnamese & Home made food and contemporary Saigon living, forget about all the tourist restaurants with their white linens and bloated prices, and instead dine where the Vietnamese do. Surely, you'll have a best experience once you try at Quan Bui.

name: Papaya Papa
address: 147 Hai Ba Trung 13th Floor, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Papaya Restaurant in Saigon exceeded all my expectations and quickly became one of my favorite dining experiences in Vietnam. From the moment I walked in, the cozy and welcoming ambiance set the tone for an incredible meal. The menu offers a delightful mix of traditional Vietnamese flavors with a modern twist. Every dish I tried was thoughtfully prepared, beautifully presented, and bursting with authentic taste. The portions were generous, and the use of fresh, local ingredients was evident in every bite. The service was equally impressive. The staff were warm, attentive, and happy to offer recommendations, which truly enhanced the overall experience. Their knowledge of the menu and enthusiasm for Vietnamese cuisine made me feel like I was dining among friends. The atmosphere of Papaya is intimate yet lively, making it an ideal spot for both a relaxed meal and a special occasion. Despite its high quality, the prices were very reasonable, offering exceptional value for money. If you're in Saigon and looking for a restaurant that captures the heart and soul of Vietnamese cuisine while offering a memorable dining experience, Papaya is an absolute must-visit. I can't wait to return!, I had an incredible experience at "Papaya Papa"! The atmosphere was vibrant with a great mix of music that kept us dancing and enjoying the evening. The service was attentive and friendly, making us feel right at home. The food was absolutely delicious, with a variety of options to please all palates. The drinks were also great, with a good selection of cocktails and other beverages. My friends and I had a fantastic time here and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a great night out with great food, drinks and music!, Have to say this is a great place to have a dinner with your family, the food is tasty and unique. We love the signature cocktail at Papaya, especially "cordial patron". And thank you for all staff at Papaya for good experience. I definitely come back at next month,
description:
Papaya Restaurant in Saigon exceeded all my expectations and quickly became one of my favorite dining experiences in Vietnam. From the moment I walked in, the cozy and welcoming ambiance set the tone for an incredible meal.

The menu offers a delightful mix of traditional Vietnamese flavors with a modern twist. Every dish I tried was thoughtfully prepared, beautifully presented, and bursting with authentic taste. The portions were generous, and the use of fresh, local ingredients was evident in every bite.

The service was equally impressive. The staff were warm, attentive, and happy to offer recommendations, which truly enhanced the overall experience. Their knowledge of the menu and enthusiasm for Vietnamese cuisine made me feel like I was dining among friends.

The atmosphere of Papaya is intimate yet lively, making it an ideal spot for both a relaxed meal and a special occasion. Despite its high quality, the prices were very reasonable, offering exceptional value for money.

If you're in Saigon and looking for a restaurant that captures the heart and soul of Vietnamese cuisine while offering a memorable dining experience, Papaya is an absolute must-visit. I can't wait to return!

name: Benthanh Princess - Luxurious Dining Cruise
address: 05 Nguyen Tat Thanh Street Saigon Port, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Great evening. Food was spectacular, entertainment great including a magician which performed at our table. Service was also exceptional. Would highly recommend to anyone when visiting Ho Chi Minh City., Such a great night!! Beautiful boat and views, wonderful service ❤️ great food and music. Best steak ever literally. Even had a magician who came to our table and a band who were great. Good selection of drinks, even fresh juices and smoothies. Defo recommended, Had a great dinner cruise with this company. Excellent service with Lamnie taking good care of us. Food was excellent given we were on a boat. Lovely music and magic to add to the night. Plus you get to see Hi Chi Minh from the river.
description: Benthanh Princess is a luxurious dining cruise offering unique culinary and sightseeing experiences. It is also recognized as the ideal venue for the most upscale and elegant events on the Saigon River. Featuring a modern tropical architectural style with a capacity of up to 350 guests, the cruise boasts 18 private VIP rooms and a sophisticated lounge. Notably, its expansive rooftop spans up to 700 square meters and provides a 360-degree sky-view, paired with the most scenic cruising route along the Saigon River. Benthanh Princess promises to deliver extraordinary experiences, combining a high-class ambiance with luxurious service and memorable moments.

name: TukTuk Thai Bistro 2
address: 38 Ly Tu Trong St. District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Small restaurant unpretentious decoration but the dishes served are succulent and worthy of those found in Bangkok. The service is fast and considerate and the prices very very sweet. Papaya salad and Pat Thai really very Thai. Well, nothing but positive. Not far from the restaurant “Secret Garden” in Pasteur Street. Finally very easy to find., There are any number of restaurants in this city plus all the street food! To offer such good food in such a nice environment with such good prices is a diet! The staff seem to enjoy their jobs! They are happy and service oriented! The chef cooks very good food and spices it with love and the drinks are also super good and healthy! Thanks! Heard there is a TukTuk in Hanoi! We will definitely try it too!, The food arrived fast, I was craving for pad thai and it was just what I imagined it would be. We also ordered chicken with curry, coconut soup and papaya salad. They were great, the salads were very spicy but delicious.
description: Small restaurant unpretentious decoration but the dishes served are succulent and worthy of those found in Bangkok. The service is fast and considerate and the prices very very sweet. Papaya salad and Pat Thai really very Thai. Well, nothing but positive. Not far from the restaurant “Secret Garden” in Pasteur Street. Finally very easy to find.

name: La Villa French Restaurant by Thierry Mounon
address: 14 Ngo Quang Huy Thao Dien Ward, Ho Chi Minh City 0084 Vietnam
reviews: This is an amazing dining experience. The location is a quiet street in district 2. The restaurant was previously a villa , hence the name. It is the epitome of fine dining. Exactly as you would expect, fresh white table cloths, sparkling cutlery and glasses. The staff are very friendly, attentive and helpful. But the reason to come here is the food. A taste of heaven in every morsel. On the evening we were there, there was a choice of 3 set menus or a la carte. We opted for one of the set menus which comprised several courses. There is an option to also add a wine pairing with each course. My wife doesn't drink so we did not try this. The food is simply amazing ! Beautifully presented and every mouthful is absolutely delicious. I have had the opportunity to eat in several gourmet restaurants in different parts of the world, La Villa is far and away the most delicious food I have ever eaten. Yes, it is a little more expensive than a typical restaurant but the entire experience of location, service, the food and meeting the chef at the end of the meal is more than worth the cost. If you are looking for the ultimate dining experience then you owe it to yourself to try this place. You will not be disappointed., The environment of the restaurant is very classy French decorative. The service was good; waitresses are very aware of guest’s need and willing to satisfy you in any requests. The chef also came out to each table for a little introduction and it was also nice to know the chef. Although the food was good but missing wow factor which I believe needed a step up to get it first star. In deed the chef was very generous with food portion. Caviar / Foie gras especially., As soon as you walk into the restaurant the tone is set for a terrific evening. The ambience tells you that you are in for a special dinner. The service is top notch; the food was great; and, they accommodated our preference to avoid beef. We ordered the wine pairing with our dinner, and each course was accompanied by the perfect wine selection. After 3 hours, yes the dinner lasts that long, the chef came out to introduce himself and inquire about our meal. If you are looking for a splurge, this is the restaurant to dine in.
description: A French Chef Thierry Mounon and his wife Tina are welcoming you in that elegant colonial style Villa. In Saigon's District 2, enjoy traditional or not so traditional French cuisine straight from Provence. Have lunch or dinner in the serene courtyard or refined interior, both bolstered by experienced and personable waitstaff. La Villa French Restaurant is located on a quiet side street off Thao Dien, a short taxi ride from the city center. La Villa French Restaurant features authentic French cuisine with true love of top products.Lunch Menu available, Dinner, a la carte and set menus are available for your dining pleasure. For the connoisseur a broad selection of French wines is on offer.La Villa is closed Sundays. Local Insight: The Lobster Menu is a must! Lunch Menu available Bringing due diligence to dessert, each pastry is delicate, delicious and just a touch decadent.

name: El Gaucho | Hai Ba Trung
address: 74/1 Hai Ba Trung Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: You cannot rate this place five out of five because it’s 10 out of five we went for lunch on the recommendations of the team at the Sofitel the restaurant is well located just near a major shopping center so very easy to get to, on the day we went we were located on the first floor looking out onto the street and as usual in Vietnam the street was packed Coming from Australia we think we’ve got a pretty good beef in this country the meat that I had on that day l will remember for a long time it’s been unbelievably good Look by Vietnamese standards it is reasonably expensive but again as I say whenever you go to the top class restaurant even though you might pay a lot of money you don’t think about the cost you think about how good service the food and the environment. We also purchased a bottle of the spirit that they make which you keep in the freezer at home it will knock your socks off but it really is wonderful we are going back in November 2024 and will definitely be going to the restaurant again I’m looking forward to it, If you’re in Vietnam, are craving for steaks, and don’t mind paying a high price, this is a good place. The steaks are not nearly as succulent as at temples like Morton’s or Bistecca Fiorentina, but are good enough. Compared to locally-operated steakhouses, this is better, but prices are at least double. Customers are mainly Caucasian expats., We were looking for a high end meal in Ho Chi Minh and it was a little late so we decided on El Gaucho. There was a bit of a wait but we got a table and were very pleased with both the food and the service. The drink .. a moscow mule; not so much and they tried 2x. After a few weeks in SE Asia I just came to the determination that mixed drinks is just not something they do well; and that's ok. The meal here was great from the Empanada starter to the lamb chops (me) and Wagyu Rib Eye (guest) with truffle mac and cheese and sauteed mushrooms for sides. YES! I left full and fulfilled. Sooo happy we decided to stop in and get a table. I can tell this is a key local spot because I saw a business dinner, friends out and date night all happening on the second floor and the waiters were hustling all night. I'm not rating this as a good value only because it's a steakhouse, you are not doing a value meal it's going to be pricey, as you would expect a steakhouse to be anywhere. Well worth a visit.
description: Food is our passion and it is our aim to establish the benchmark in Southeast Asia and beyond for a contemporary, specialised steakhouse concept. We are proud to serve you the finest steakhouse-style food, using only the best available meat products sourced from selected farms in Victoria, New South Wales and individual farmers and ranchers in the United States.

name: Marcel - Calmette
address: 115 Calmette Phường Nguyễn Thái Bình, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: If you find yourself in Ho Chi Min just wanting a good ole burger then you can’t miss Marcel - Calmette Burger. In fact, you just shouldn’t miss this place period. It’s just THAT GOOD. You can get a great smash burger or there are quite a number of options with a gourmet French twist. I love my burgers and this place is high up on my list of great burger restaurants. They also served great French fries and delicious desserts like creme brûlée, creamy cheesecake with raspberry sauce and brownies. The place itself is very cute and inviting. The hostess and cashier girls were so welcoming and helpful they made the whole experience that much more enjoyable. My family and I ate here twice and If I lived in Ho Chi Minh, I would be a regular here., Came here after doing a quick Google search. Was craving a really good burger after eating Pho for almost a month. And this is a really good burger, the bread was one of the best I've tasted, although the meat could have been a little more seasoned. Fries were also very good and the homemade chili mayo that you get for free was the icing on the cake., Marcel the price of the cake combo includes 1 side dish and 1 water and the cheapest is about 220k, the price of the cake is about 180 in the picture, I ate 2 people with soft, delicious meat cake, the crust is very soft. But since it seems that people order a lot with the order of which one is to be grilled, the wait is a bit long. If you go hungry, you will cry :))
description: Marcel is a French Gourmet Burger Joint, right in the center of Saigon. At Marcel, we like our burgers the French way : unique recipes with a creative twist, using only the finest ingredients to bring burgers to a gourmet level. Our juicy patties are a secret blend of 100% Australian grass-fed beef, cooked medium rare. Our very own soft and fresh buns are home-baked twice a day. All of our sides, sauces, salads and desserts are prepared in-house. Because at the the end, Marcel is all about making sure you enjoy the best gourmet experience.

name: Moo Beef Steak - Prime
address: 35-37 Ngo Duc Ke, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I've been to Moo's dozens upon dozens of times, so I know it well. The service is quite good considering it is Vietnam (Vietnam is not used to the service seen in high-end western restaurants). Steaks are always cooked to perfection, so hats off to the kitchen crew! Their sides and salads are also quite good. Management is excellent. Whenever I have had any issues (which is rare) the management has always taken care of it. Their Monday 50% off steaks special cannot be beat. It's a great value., Now is my favorite restaurant in Ho Chi Minh. I have visited the city multiple times in the last one year, tried the best or highly rated Vietnamese, Japanese, seafood, Chinese or fusion food and nothing comes close to the quality, service, ambience and value for money as a high end steakhouse., If you write a review, you will get a 50% discount on Monday. I ordered the ribs medium-rare, and it was cooked to my liking, tender and delicious. The sauce isn't too much either. However, the salad is a little saltier than expected, so be careful when ordering.
description: Welcome to Moo Beef Steak The pristine and unbounded beauty of the American Far West has long been a symbolic picture admired worldwide. It also inspires our conception of Moo Beef Steak restaurant chain with our wishes to convey some quintessential characteristics of the local foods to Vietnamese people, thus instilling cozy moments of sharing and reunions.

name: Dong Duong Restaurant
address: 26 Truong Dinh, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: When we arrived there was a live piano playing. We ordered 5 dishes between 3 of us which came to about a total cost of 1.8 million. The food was very good and the service was excellent. We would recommend for a fancy restaurant., As i said above. Good food great service just to be really picky wish we had a menu each instead of having to share, Since the temperature in Saigon is very high and the wish of eating outside are not compatible it was nice to find this outdoor restaurant where the temperature is held artificially down. We had a good experience with a set menu consisting of 6 really tasty servings. A nice cooled white wine. Fair prices. The staff friendly and professional despite a fully booked restaurant
description: A sense of Indochina located in the heart of the city Inspired by the movie “Indochine” by director Regis Wargnier, the Indochine Restaurant was opened right in the heart of a bustling street, yet still remains its isolated nature. Leaving behind any daily worries, customers will go on a pleasant journey as soon as he or she step into the grandiose old 19th century villa – where Indochine Saigon is located. Following the unique and excellent design, the Indochine Restaurant is skillfully divided into different room sections, from the separate cozy dining rooms to spacious and elegant ones, as if to bring customers back to the old Saigon. The beautiful garden adorned with a “cloud-shape” lake which is skillfully made by master craftsmen is eminently suitable for any outdoor parties or events. A beautiful and elegant designed public bar with dozens of types of drinks made from Vietnamese traditional fruit would bring great joy to any customer. With a wealth of experience and passion in their expertise, chefs in Indochine Restaurant have spent an adequate time to visit any corner of this country to discover, experience and, literally cook with regional inhabitants. From what they have experienced, chefs in Indochine Restaurant will capture the very essence of every meal they have tried and create such an extensive and colorful menu that we currently have. Customers can detect distinguishing smell and taste of different unique meals which could only be found in this restaurant. With the above special features, Indochine Restaurant would present the perfect choice to anyone who has a savor in Vietnamese cuisine

name: Laang Restaurant
address: 22 Dang Huu Pho Thao Dien, District 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We found this restaurant on trip advisor and we're able to get a table on fairly short notice. The menu is some 60 pages long. We chose three chef special items to share and it was plenty of food for two. We also ordered two desserts. The presentation is impressive and everything tasted good. Prices are quite reasonable., My friends from the US were visiting Saigon for the first time - as they are vegetarian with sensitive stomachs and extremely wary of the tap water in Vietnam, I knew I had to bring them to this hidden gem in Thao Dien. In addition to the amazing and relaxing ambience, Laang has a great vegetarian option on its extensive menu. We ordered several dishes off the menu, including the stewed king oyster mushroom, grilled eggplant stuffed with shitake mushrooms, and stir-fried flat noodles with mixed mushrooms. Everything was delicious and my friends were very happy with the food. The pricing is extremely reasonable (6-15 USD / dish) given the ambience and service. If you visit, be sure to ask for Lukas who is the GM and he'll be sure to take care of you. He has deep experience working in F&B and originally worked in a Michelin rated restaurant in Europe. He's extremely knowledgeable about wines so can provide great recommendations if you're a newbie like me. Overall great restaurant with great service and great people. Couldn't recommend more highly., Nice restaurant with romance view, nice food and perfect service. I got 110% support from staff to setup a dinner for 19 people, 1 of our guest need to use Halal food and restaurant could support me to bringing the Halal food which delivered from another restaurant. I need to deposit 6 M VND for our dinner and could get it back from restaurant within 15hours, very high prestige. 5 stars and high recommended to visit.
description: Laang is an Asian-inspired, vegetarian-friendly restaurant in Saigon. We provide progressive urbanites an all-day healthy dining experience using fresh ingredients sourced locally. We want to build a lifestyle and a brand that emphasize on high-quality, advocates for local ingredients and celebrates authentic human connection.

name: IBiero Craft Beer Station
address: 65 Xuân Thuỷ, P. Thảo Điền, Tp. Thủ Đức, Ho Chi Minh City 713000 Vietnam
