reviews: Excellent staf, nice beers from own brewery. Nick the manager talked to us and gave us good advice about the city, atm, food, beers and Saigon in general. Relaxed environment and very good food!! Absolutely recommand this place!, I recently visited ibero, and I had a fantastic experience! Their IPA was bold and flavorful, and the lager was refreshing and smooth. I didn’t try anything else, but the selection looked impressive. The atmosphere was great, and the staff were friendly and welcoming. I'll definitely be back to explore more of their offerings! Highly recommend for all beer lovers!, The place has great beer, great service, and nice facilities. I totally recommend you check them out if you’re in town!!
description: Excellent staf, nice beers from own brewery. Nick the manager talked to us and gave us good advice about the city, atm, food, beers and Saigon in general. Relaxed environment and very good food!! Absolutely recommand this place!

name: Beirut - Mediterranean Kitchen & Lounge
address: 21 Ngo Duc Ke District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I had dinner the other night at the new location in D2. The villa is beautiful and the outdoor area is nicely laid out. There's a big screen showing random videos and a belly dancer came out twice during my time there. I had the moussaka and the shawarma. Both were delicious although I don't pretend to be an expert on cuisine from this region. Go during happy hour for 2 for 1. The menu is extensive and there are plenty of vegetarian options. English is spoken, so no issues there. It's a nice change. Definitely recommend you eat here., I came here and ordered the hummus and lamb mashi. Both dishes were excellent and the service staff was fantastic as well. They did not hover around like a lot of staff and only came when called upon, but were always attentive to us. Only complaint I have is that the dishes are quite expensive, but this is an ideal special occasion place. The decor is beautiful and a bit on the weird side, but in a good way. I have not been here to see the performances or smoke shishah so this review is only about the dining experience. I will come again., We visited the new location in Thao Dien with my husband and we loved it. The food is really good and the portions are generous. I loved the outside are which has a really good vibe and luxury feeling with music and exotic dancers coming to your table! A special thank you to our waitress Gabriela for making our evening so special. We will come back!
description: Beirut brings Mediterranean flavours to diners in a gorgeous funky Mediterranean- inspired modern space. Beirut is the only the restaurant & lounge of its kind to offer the full Arabian dining experience with Shisha and Belly Dancing in Ho Chi Minh City.

name: Terraviva Pizza & Italian Cuisine
address: 2C Đặng Tiến Đông An Phú Tp Thủ Đức, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Finally an excellent Italian restaurant abroad, where you really eat Italian! Run by an Italian! Carmine, very kind, welcoming and not intrusive! Nice and knowledgeable staff. All right, no criticism, but an applause to the place that has a beautiful open-air terrace over the city center. Lush and well-kept plants carefully frame the whole room, giving it a pleasant feeling of freedom and grace. Nice idea of baskets on the floor in which to put bags or backpacks. Good! The heart-shaped glasses also impressed us positively. We ate a very very tasty and well made fresh pasta first course, and a plate of bresaola with parmesan and salad, really good and plentiful. Excellent raw materials. Nice display case of cold cuts and wood oven. A note for those who want to go there, the place is on the third floor of a building, on the street there is a round illuminated sign but do not look for a window, just the entrance of a small alley. It's worth it!, This a great restaurant at the heart of Ho Chi Min city, serving the best Italian pizza you could have on Vietnam. We had a lonely evening here and had the privilege to meet and chat with the manager of the restaurant. He makes sure that you have the best dining experience. Thank you! The location is quite special too, it is located at the top floor of a beautiful, old building and feels very cosy. One tiny suggestion for this restaurant is this: they should consider getting some proper Grappa glasses to enable the full Italian experience. I loved everting about this restaurant. Highly recommended., A bit outskirt from centre but in quiet area. Even location is good for a real Italian type trattoria. A friendly casual atmosphere where you may enjoy real Italian food with mostly italian ingredients prepared by the Italian chef Giorgio. He and his wife Anita Ng (import food manager) will welcome you and make you feel home. To try the real italian pizzas, with imported burrate, parma ham and parnesan cheese to mention few. And before dinner a very Italian SPRITZ.
description: Terra means “Earth”, Viva means “praise of life”. Terraviva is a living breathing earth, breathing the breath of life into all its creatures in perfect harmony and fertility. The name Terraviva means “innocent and fresh spirit”. Terraviva also reminds us that keeping the connection between us as humans and all other beings on this fragile planet. We consider food as a gift from Mother Nature and not only is fresh food an essential part of living healthy, but it can also be a delicious meal to enjoy our daily life. It’s moment when we sit together as friends and family to share a meal, that’s when we can appreciate life a whole lot more. We at Terraviva have respect for our fragile wonderful earth and it’s gifts ,we believe life is about always doing what we can in limiting waste in business and daily life, whether that’s shopping locally,planting more trees, reuse, reduce or recycling or simply cherishing the food we consume. And pulling together as a community We invite you to visit Terraviva, to enjoy delicious dishes made from traditional Italian cuisine- baked to perfection by an 20-year experience Italian chef and the delightful flavors from Mother Earth in a cozy, friendly atmosphere with exceptional service. Terraviva Pizza & Italian Cuisine - flavors from the Earth

name: Today With You
address: 99 Thao Dien Street, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: I had an amazing experience at Today With You! Their pizza is absolutely top-notch—crispy, flavorful crust, fresh and high-quality ingredients, and the perfect balance of toppings. Every bite was delicious! The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, making it a great spot to relax and enjoy a meal. The staff was also incredibly friendly and attentive, ensuring a fantastic dining experience. Whether you’re a pizza lover or just looking for a great place to eat, Today With You is a must-visit. Highly recommend!, Review your second visit with friends: Thanks to the lighting, the atmosphere is cozy and romantic, which seems to be a special advantage of the restaurant, especially because the background music that day was well chosen as the Big Bang Playlist, so we had a great time eating and chatting! I ordered gorjongola pizza and baking cream pasta, and my staff recommended me to google a review, so I was able to get a butter-eating service. My friend said that the cheesecake was delicious and I tried it because I wanted the baking cream paste to be delicious, but it was too much! :) That's the combination of cream sauce and spicy bacon, and it's better than I thought. The restaurant has plenty of fun and beautiful photos! I was trying to take pictures of my life to leave my friends with memories, but the camera broke down and I couldn't... Among the menus I have eaten so far, a menu that I recommend, Pasta: Bungalow (1st) / Baking Cream (2nd) / Meshroom Cream (3rd) Pizza: Chicken BBQ (1st class) / Gorzongola (2nd class) / Chicken pizza (3rd class) Next time, I'm going to try an orange pasta and margarita pizza :), Pros: Delicious food: The pasta dishes are made with fresh ingredients and have amazing flavors. Enthusiastic staff: The staff is attentive and always ready to assist and answer customers' questions. Good air conditioning: Creates a comfortable dining experience. Clean restroom: Maintaining good hygiene is a big plus. Fresh salad: The salad uses fresh ingredients and is combined with a special sauce to create a harmonious flavor. Reasonable price: The price is reasonable for the quality of service and food served. Cons: Small space: The restaurant is small and can feel crowded when it's busy. Overall impression: Today, With You is a pasta restaurant worth trying if you are looking for a place to enjoy delicious food, attentive service at a reasonable price. Recommendations: Make a reservation before you go, especially during peak hours. Try the salad with the restaurant's special sauce. Suitable for family meals, friends or dates.
description: Today With You is a Korean-style pasta restaurant located in the heart of Thao Dien, Ho Chi Minh City. Known for its romantic atmosphere and unique fusion flavors, the restaurant has been featured in several popular Korean media outlets: ✔ Featured on TVN’s “Dokbak Tour” – Ho Chi Minh Episode ✔ Featured on YouTube channels “Vietnam Ttubuck-i” and “Hoonbine” With its deep green color palette, warm wood accents, and charming pink highlights, Today With You offers a cozy and aesthetic dining experience perfect for couples. Our signature dishes reinterpret traditional Italian pasta and pizza recipes with a Korean twist—bringing a taste of Korea to Vietnam. Dishes are beautifully plated on vintage European tableware, and the romantic ambiance is enhanced by a curated selection of Korean drama soundtracks. Whether you’re on a date or looking for a memorable culinary moment, this is the spot for you. Free Wi-Fi Outdoor terrace seating Reservations accepted English and Vietnamese speak

name: King Of Crab
address: 42 Hai Bà Trưng Phường 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I have a great dinner at Vua Cua. The food is so delicious. The staff is so nice. I will return some day, Spent my diner with my friends here and we had lots of fun. Nice are, friendly staff, the food was good., Good service, delicious, good price, good crab. Hahahahah. Will come back soon with my family and friends.
description: DELICIOUS WITH FRESH CRAB - is the core message that King of Crab would like to bring our valuable customers, we keep researching and bring our appetizing processed food but still retains fresh and sweet tastes from sea crab meat freshly!

name: Smith's Kitchen & Bar
address: 14-16 Le Lai Street, Ben Thanh Ward, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I had a fantastic experience dining at Smith's Bar for my friend's birthday! From the moment we walked in, the staff was incredibly accommodating and helped fulfill all our requests, making the celebration truly memorable. Our server, Benjamin, was outstanding—he ensured we were enjoying every part of our meal and offered excellent food recommendations that we absolutely loved. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the service was top-notch. I will definitely be returning for another great meal. Highly recommend!, We hosted our intimate wedding ceremony here on July 14th and it was absolutely perfect! Despite being the restaurant's first wedding, their professionalism was outstanding. *SPACE The restaurant's unique design and breathtaking bird's-eye view of District 1 are breathtaking. I love the way the restaurant used golden evening light, creating not only a cozy but also an unforgettable atmosphere for our guests. *FOOD The food was a major highlight of the evening. Every dish was delicious and the portions were generous. Our guests raved about the flavors and presentation. It's clear that the restaurant takes pride in its culinary offerings. *SERVICE The staff was exceptional. They were professional, friendly, and went above and beyond to ensure our wedding day was perfect. Their attention to detail and willingness to accommodate our requests were truly appreciated. We felt incredibly well taken care of. Overall We cannot recommend this restaurant enough! If you're planning an event or simply looking for a memorable dining experience, this is the place to be. We are incredibly grateful to Ms. Thuy Dan and the entire team for going out of their way to make us feel welcome and to help create a truly special wedding ceremony., * I like Smith's impressive design, this place has a top city view, overlooking the Ben Thanh intersection. * Regarding the food, although the menu is not as rich as it is, it is very delicious and unique. The highlight is probably the Pho cocktail, I recommend the mojito everyone should try. * Staff is also ok, well-dressed and professional. My friend complimented him, his name was Vuong, he was quick and understood the customer's wishes. Hope everyone has a fun dining experience here!
description: Nestled on the top floor, Smith's Kitchen & Bar offers a unique city view and a cozy ambiance akin to home kitchens.

name: Coco Dining
address: 143 Nam Ky Khoi Nghia, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: When I first learned about CoCo because I passed by it a few times, the layout design at CoCo is very impressive and luxurious. I used a 12-course set menu for my husband and my wife. The waiters introduced each dish in detail, including allergies. I am very satisfied with the service here. I will come back, but I think I should promote advertising, because I told my friends that they don't know much about CoCo., Very good dinner. We ordered the short menu and were embarrassed to order the long one. The dishes are original, with detailed haute cuisine preparation and very tasty. The service is exceptional, the staff is attentive to any need and they even gave us a dessert for our daughter. Keep in mind that wine prices are quite high, although it is general in Vietnam. In short, we loved the experience, Coco Grill welcomes you with a beautiful entrance and warm greeting. We were ushered into a secluded corner. Our waiter was warm, friendly, and patient with our lack of language skills. The foie Gras was superb and paired with delicious mashed potatoes. The tooth fish was fresh, tasty, and perfectly cooked. When the waiter learned we were on our honeymoon the kitchen prepared a creamy tiramisu for us. Wonderful evening.
description: Vietnamese Contemporary Dining Michelin Selected 2024 & 2023 - Latest Tasting Experience: 'Ra Khơi' CoCo Complex: CoCo Grill - Fire Dining Experience (A la Carte) CoCo Whisky Bar - 'New York & Indochine Blended' inspired Contemporary Bar

name: Com Tam Ba Ghien
address: 84 Dang Van Ngu Phường 10, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: If you’re a fan of Vietnamese broken rice, Cơm Tấm Ba Ghiền is a must-visit! This place truly lives up to its reputation, and it’s no surprise that it’s Michelin-selected. The highlight of the meal was the grilled pork chop (sườn)—massive (about 400-500g before grilling), juicy, tender, and packed with flavor. The portion was so generous that I struggled to finish it! *Note: a bigger size of the grilled pork chop is available upon request. My husband and I ordered the combination plate “thập cẩm” and the grilled pork chop, shredded pork & skin pork, steamed egg cake “sườn bì chả” plate, along with a bowl of soup. Every bite was delicious and satisfying. Our meal cost 306,000 VND, which was well worth it for the quality and portion sizes. Service was super fast and efficient, even though the place was packed by 6 PM. Be prepared for a crowd, as they don’t take reservations. If you’re riding a motorcycle, there’s free parking, but note that car parking is not available before 6 PM. Overall, an amazing local food experience with authentic flavors and great value. Highly recommend!, I came here for a late lunch with a Saigonese friend who eats here regularly. This was my first experience of Cơm Tấm Ba Ghiền. Incredibly tasty pork & chicken dishes served up with broken rice. This place from the outside just looks like one of tens of thousands of local kerb side restaurants dotted around Saigon’s districts. This one has been serving the same recipe for over 30 years and is now Michelin listed. The marinade sauce is the secret ... delicious savoury/sweetness, simply wow! Side note, the servings are large! We both had difficulty finishing even though the food was incredibly tasty. Our huge lunch for two including two drinks … came to a nominal total cost only 296k VND = $17.50 Australian!!! Good luck at eating such a delicious, Michelin rated lunch for that amount of money for two anywhere else in the world! If you are visiting tourists well worth leaving the comfort of your 5 star District 1 hotel and hopping into a Grab car and heading over for a late lunch. Be warned, no such thing as bookings; cash only payments; and after 5pm it is absolutely packed I am told., We accidentally stumbled upon Com Tam Ba Ghien. We got a Grab to a steakhouse that had been recommended to us, but when we got there we were told the steakhouse had been closed! We were both hangry and went into the first restaurant we saw, and boy are we grateful that we did. From the outside it looks like a typical Vietnamese restaurant you’ve seen 1,000 times in HCMC. But when you sit down and try the food, everything changes. The menu is rather small. It pretty much only sells pork with rice and chicken with rice, in different variations. We ordered one pork rib and one chicken. It was simply one of the best meals I’ve had in Vietnam. It’s no wonder it’s Michelin rated. The portions were big but the food is so good that you don’t want to stop eating. It’s also ridiculously cheap. I think we paid 180.000 dong for two meals and two drinks (about £6). PLEASE take a Grab, leave district 1, and try this place. You won’t regret it.
description:
If you’re a fan of Vietnamese broken rice, Cơm Tấm Ba Ghiền is a must-visit! This place truly lives up to its reputation, and it’s no surprise that it’s Michelin-selected.

The highlight of the meal was the grilled pork chop (sườn)—massive (about 400-500g before grilling), juicy, tender, and packed with flavor. The portion was so generous that I struggled to finish it! 
*Note: a bigger size of the grilled pork chop is available upon request.

My husband and I ordered the combination plate “thập cẩm” and the grilled pork chop, shredded pork & skin pork, steamed egg cake “sườn bì chả” plate, along with a bowl of soup. Every bite was delicious and satisfying. Our meal cost 306,000 VND, which was well worth it for the quality and portion sizes.

Service was super fast and efficient, even though the place was packed by 6 PM. Be prepared for a crowd, as they don’t take reservations. If you’re riding a motorcycle, there’s free parking, but note that car parking is not available before 6 PM.

Overall, an amazing local food experience with authentic flavors and great value. Highly recommend!

name: Pandan Leaf Saigon Restaurant & Rooftop Bar
address: 107 Pham Ngu Lao Street Pham Ngu Lao Ward, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant has 3 floors plus a roofed terrace with nice city views. The service was very good, the same as the dishes we ordered. Curried duck, mushroom chicken and some cheese balls and starter meat. With a coke and a beer and two Vietnamese coffees for dessert, it cost about 35 usd. Something expensive for Vietnam but equally accessible., Wonderful service, excellent food provided with courtesy and attention to detail by the manager and our table waiter, Jacques. I was part of a very large party with several people who had specific dietary requirements. We were catered for with special dishes and given a very full meal of many courses. The presentation was beautiful and each plate had fresh, healthy, tasty ingredients. A great experience!, Fab food, friendly service we enjoyed a lovely dinner in the rooftop section of this busy four-storey restaurant (NB no elevator), with a great view of the street, the park and the huge (seasonal, I expect, for the imminent lunar new year (Tet)) flower market We both chose from the house specials menu: grilled chicken with pandan rice, shrimp in coconut, plus bok choi fried in garlic to accompany / all very tasty. They have a selection of Toucan (Vietnamese) beers as well as Saigon. Service friendly and generally prompt.
description: Tastes of Vietnam, Wrapped in Pandan Aroma! At Pandan Leaf Saigon, we pride ourselves on serving up traditional Vietnamese dishes crafted with love and care, with a special focus on our signature rice made from fragrant pandan leaves. Beyond its delightful aroma and unique flavor, pandan leaves bring with them a plethora of nutritious benefits, making every meal not just a culinary delight but also a nourishing experience for your body and soul.

name: East By Ngô Thanh Hòa
address: 73 Ba Huyen Thanh Quan, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Absolutely delightful experience dining at East. Can't recommend it highly enough! As someone with an eating disorder, I am frequently very anxious about eating at fine dining establishments, as it can be very embarrassing listing all my 'unsafe' foods and feeling like I'm an inconvenience. However this was not the case at East. My friend and I had a lovely chat with the chef, he made a recommendation based on what I can and can't eat and I enjoyed a beautiful meal and never once felt like an imposition. And the cocktails were divine!, Managed to get a last minute booking for dinner with my wife whilst in HCM City. Sat in the bar area and had the 6 course taster menu with wine. Really nice atmosphere near the chef's kitchen. The food was excellent and each course looked and tasted fabulous. In addition Harold (as I believe he is affectionately known) talked to us for quite some time about his life, his family and his ambitions. Lovely man. His staff were first class with excellent English spoken. A special night and I would encourage you to try it if you are visiting Saigon/HCM any time soon. Thank you for a wonderful evening Harold and team!, I must be honest, I know Harold from his time when he lived in Sydney. But I knew him then as a barista - a very good barista. But now, after not seeing him for a dozen or so years, I now can say I know him a a very very good chef!! He may have been Vietnam’s inaugural MasterChef winner, but since that acclaim he has obviously studied and refined his style and techniques thereby establishing himself as a leading chef and restaurateur in Saigon. His modern approach to Vietnamese cuisine while always using fresh local produce accompanied often with Australian and other Pacific Rim protein shows both his Heritage and his understanding of modern Australian cooking. I thoroughly enjoyed his degustation menu interpretations finding all his cooking techniques, flavours and textures to be world class. I enjoyed seeing him again ‘working the kitchen pass’ and obviously revelling in his new role as chef/owner of his own restaurant. Mark S
description: Viet Contemporary+ by MasterChef Ngo Thanh Hoa

name: BIG PIG Bar - BBQ - Beer
address: 84 Ngo Duc Ke Ben Nghe, Quan 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We had an amazing meal with entrees and main, the meals were very large serving and so tasty, the staff were amazing the drinks were cold the aircon was on and it was just a great experience. Highly recomend the pork belly bites, the ribs the steak and the garlic bread all the foods we had. Yum, We’re in Saigon on a school trip from the UK, two teachers with ten teenagers. The students asked for a mix of western and Vietnamese foods for dinner and we stumbled across The Big Pig which beat our expectations. Being such a big group we managed to reserve a table a couple of hours earlier. We had a warm welcome on arrival and we’re quickly offered food and drink menus. There was a great choice of food to keep everyone happy. The students told us the Smoothies were the best yet (and they’ve had several from across the city!). The food was tasty with generous portions all came out fresh and hot from the kitchen. We had burgers, pizzas with a lot of side dishes and left with many clean plates - a huge sign of happy teenagers! Fab place for tasty food to please all tastes, and really well located right by the Siagon Skydeck, making our evening even easier. The staff were excellent always on hand to help and serve us quickly. Brilliant work., Really professional friendly service, welcoming and polite showing my wife and I the full food menu and drinks menu before we were seated by Lewis who was brilliant 🤩 Our waiter this evening was Le Nhu Y who was exceptional in his service. A friendly smile and a very warming personality who makes guests feel so welcoming. The restaurant is very spacious with a few levels. The beer was ice cold and the cheeseburger & fries was really nice reminding me of a good burger from back home,many thanks for your service 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
description: Drop into Big Pig for delicious American style BBQ Ribs, Awesome Burgers, Steak & Pizza, along with yummy Vietnamese favorites like grilled seafood, rice & noodles, Big Pig also has a big selection of ice cold beers, cool cocktails, wine list and excellent western and Vietnamese coffee. Open for breakfast, fantastic lunch specials (from 99k+), hearty meals and late night drinks & snacks, the team at BIG PIG District 1 is ready to welcome you. Daily Happy Hour from 3-7pm! Our team speaks English well, and look forward to seeing you soon!

name: Stoker Woodfired Grill & Bar
address: 44 Mac thi Buoi, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: It was by far the best 3 courses of meals I have had in my life. We were having a hard time choosing a place for our final dinner of Ho Chi Minh so we opted for the Michelin filter and moved forward. A bad stomach flu from local food led us to this steakhouse. The bone marrow and tartar as startera were great. I am a fan of beef tartar and it was very likely the best I have had, anywhere. Main course duck breast was amazing and the portion was big (2 breasts opposed to the 1 we get in Europe normally), but the star was the Wagyu beef. Paired with the chimicurri sauce and pinches of salt it was like an explosion of flavour and texture in my mouth. It was by far the most unbelieveable piece of beef I have eaten. The recommended sides of potato puree and asparagus were spot on. The cheesecake and meringue dessert were amazing. The recommended wine pairings by the server for each course were absolutely spot on. For the prices you get absolutely top notch quality in the food, the atmosphere and the serving. We came in as walk-ins at 6.30 and were gladly seated, the restaurant filled to full over time., The food was fantastic but definitely on the high side in regards to pricing. Service was good but not the level you would expect for a fine steakhouse in that price range. We will go back to give it another shot at some point and hopefully I’ll want to write a review to match the quality of the steak. Note there are very limited options if you have anybody in your party who is not into a great steak (2 options). Bone marrow app was the highlight., I decided to spend my nighttime here and it couldn’t be a better decision. I ordered a caprese salad, an ash cured salmon pastrami and a creamy potato puree. The food was tasty and the drink was another plus. And did I mention the staff was extremely hospitable? They absolutely made me comfortable. The atmosphere, music, etc. were just right.
description: More than a grill, more than a steakhouse, Stoker is a unique fixture on Vietnam’s dining scene for those that like meats well prepared and expertly cooked

name: Home Saigon Restaurant
address: 185/28 Phạm Ngũ Lão, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: My wife and I have had lunch here for 3 days in a row. The Vietnamese food portion of the menu is authentic, well cooked and presented and very reasonably priced. Staff are very attentive and friendly. Waiting time for meals is good but if busy and you have ordered a particular dish, staff will let you know when ordering, that the meal may take a little extra time - very courteous and diner friendly. I suggest booking for lunch, as the restaurant gets very busy, especially with tour groups who come for the "set menu". With another 20 days left in Ho Chi Minh, we will certainly be having lunch there again. Well done guys, keep up the great work., We went there for dinner once and returned twice, always very well received with a small personalized sign with my first name on the table (remember to reserve, otherwise not sure that you will be able to dine). The photos on the walls are fantastic. As for the dishes, I recommend the flambé filet (quite a spectacle) and the equally flambé bananas. The icing on the cake, the view of the neighbor opposite is quite spectacular, I'll let you discover it., Home Saigon Restaurant offers a cozy atmosphere with a solid selection of Vietnamese dishes. The pho is a standout, with a rich, flavorful broth and tender slices of beef. The banh xeo (Vietnamese pancakes) is crispy and filled with fresh ingredients, while the spring rolls are a perfect appetizer, light and packed with flavor. Service is friendly, making it a great spot for casual dining. Overall, it’s a great place to enjoy authentic Vietnamese food at reasonable prices.
description: Welcome to Home Saigon Restaurant! It is a second home away from home for you. Located in the alley way, great place to hide a way from the hustle and bustle of the most hectic city. The restaurant reflect the life style of the vantage Saigon - pre 1975. Our ambition to bring back the cultural cuisine from the old time to the contemporary.

name: The Alley Cocktail Bar & Kitchen Restaurant
address: 63/8 Pasteur Street, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1 Next to Liberty Central Point, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Down a narrow alley behind black curtains lies this gorgeous cocktail bar. We had four great cocktails which were very reasonably priced including the Mekong Delta featuring a huge ice cube and two others which were set on fire before drinking. Atmosphere was great and service perfect, we had 8 oysters which were huge, delicious and very cheap at $2.50 each. Cocktails ranged from $10-$13. Some of the best cocktails we’ve ever had!, You won’t find this bar by accident, but it is well worth looking for. They offer classic and signature cocktails expertly mixed by a friendly barman. It’s a sophisticated classic bar and plays gentle jazz rather than pop music. We enjoyed the tapas snacks which are freshly prepared to order. Apparently it used to be busy every night before COVID but now it’s quiet on weekdays especially before 8pm when they have half price happy hours. They also have a great selection of spirits from around the world., Can easily miss this place down a small alley. Well worth the effort. The bar staff definitely know their stuff. Expertly crafted cocktails which look and taste stunning. Not at all pretentious, all the staff very welcoming and friendly even offering to adjust cocktails if they weren’t to our taste. This was never necessary! Many cocktails and some food and wine at half price between 5 and 8 so pays to go early. Quiet jazz played, with live music later on.
description:
Down a narrow alley behind black curtains lies this gorgeous cocktail bar.
We had four great cocktails which were very reasonably priced including the Mekong Delta featuring a huge ice cube and two others which were set on fire before drinking.
Atmosphere was great and service perfect, we had 8 oysters which were huge, delicious and very cheap at $2.50 each.
Cocktails ranged from $10-$13.
Some of the best cocktails we’ve ever had!

name: Jin Din Rou - Saigon Centre HCM
address: 67 Lê Lợi, Phường Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: We found this place by accident while we were shopping in the mall and I usually don’t go to the restaurants in the shopping mall but this one was an exception the food is so great and so fresh we never had anything like this service waswonderful. as well I will highly recommend this place. If you are in the area, you won’t be disappointed., The food is delicious, tasty. The restaurant heard the customer’s review since the first time I went here, I left a recommendation that they should add white rice into the menu, now they did. The flavour of the xiao long bao is now clearly better than the grand opening period., Jin Din Rou at Takashimaya is a must-visit for dim sum lovers. The quality of the dim sum is consistently excellent, with delicate dumplings filled with flavorful ingredients. The service is efficient and friendly, even during peak hours. While the prices are on the higher side, the experience is worth it. The elegant ambiance of Takashimaya adds to the overall dining experience.
description:
We found this place by accident while we were shopping in the mall and I usually don’t go to the restaurants in the shopping mall but this one was an exception the food is so great and so fresh we never had anything like this service waswonderful. as well

I will highly recommend this place. If you are in the area, you won’t  be disappointed.

name: The Park Rooftop & Lounge
address: 20 Đỗ Quang Đẩu Phường Phạm Ngũ Lão, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: This sophisticated rooftop bar offers a refined atmosphere, delicious cocktails, and a charming city view. The drinks are expertly crafted, the service is excellent, and the staff is warm and attentive. Perfect for a romantic or upscale night out!, It’s brilliant having a spot for a cocktail right in the middle of all the hustle and bustle. The view looks out over Ho Chi Minh’s uniquely urban nightscape. The décor and music really show the vibe the place is going for, and it’s such a stark contrast to the busy street downstairs. Perfect little bar for a date or a good chat. 和一樓大街有強烈對比的酒吧，在這裡可以喝到有質感的調酒，配上胡志明城市夜景與舒服氛圍，是適合放鬆的好地方。, I was walking along this street to look for a glass of wine. I stoped by a coffee shop named La Cà Phê, then the staff introduce me about the cocktail & rooftop bar. They have a very nice vibe, good cocktail. Thank you!
description: The Park Lounge là điểm đến không thể bỏ qua. Quán nằm gần khu vực Bùi Viện nhưng hoàn toàn tách biệt khỏi sự ồn ào náo nhiệt, mang đến một không gian yên tĩnh và đầy phong cách.

name: Saigon Saigon Rooftop Bar
address: 19-23 Lam Son Square, District 1 Rooftop via 9th Floor, Caravelle Saigon, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: If you’re looking for a chic spot to unwind, head to this rooftop bar called Saigon Saigon perched atop the iconic Caravelle Hotel. The sweeping views of the city’s bustling heart are simply spectacular, offering the perfect backdrop for a relaxing evening. The cocktails were crafted to perfection, and the excellent service added a touch of sophistication to the experience. The live music set the mood beautifully, creating an ambiance that was both lively and intimate. Whether you’re a local or a visitor, this is a good place to soak in the city vibes while sipping on a great drink., In the five star Caravelle Hotel in Ho Chi Minh City I relaxed and relaxed at the rooftop bar. A historic rooftop bar founded in 1959 The classic atmosphere and comfortable terrace seating are the best. Happy hour until 19:00 with half price drinks while enjoying the night view of Ho Chi Minh City with cocktails I had a very nice time. The recommended Miss Saigon was also delicious. ◇ Carlsberg ◇ Miss Saigon, We often go to Saigon Saigon Rooftop Bar during happy hour. During this time frame, drinks are 50% off. Cocktails here are very delicious. We drank Passion Fruit Sour and Miss Saigon. Watching the sunset is beautiful
description: Ten floors above the heart of the city, Saigon Saigon Rooftop Bar is an iconic, inviting space to share a drink, soak up sunset views, or unwind with live music and good company. Since 1959, the bar has drawn people from all over the world to its open-air tables and breezy verandah. Saigon Saigon played a prominent role as a haven for wartime journalists in the 1960s. The heritage wall along the staircase leading to the entrance highlights pivotal moments in Caravelle history.

name: Sushi Sun
address: 46 Nguyen Cu Trinh Street Pham Ngu Lao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We found this restaurant based on reviews and next to the hotel, the food is incredibly delicious! You just need to turn a little away from the noisy tourist street, everything is in the center, nearby. It’s very cozy inside, as I understand it’s a family business, the owner and his wife are very conscientious, they work, they’re polite and responsive. As for the food: we took 4 dishes and a drink each, beer and lemonade (very interesting lemon with salt) We took the sushi set, it was incredibly delicious! The sashimi set was also excellent and my husband ate rice with beef, he said it was super, very filling and a set of rolls We recommend this establishment There is pleasant music inside, otherwise there is usually a buzzing sound in the center, it’s impossible to eat Everything is great here 👍🏼, We orderd three different types of sushi rolls, gyoza and two lemon juices. The sushi and the gyoza was in my opinion perfect. The raw salmon tasted super fresh an the fried shrimps were also perfect. The gyoza was roasted from one side (also perfect). It’s definitely not the cheapest sushi restaurant but it‘s worth the money If you are not far away, we do reccomend to come to sushi sun., The sushi at this restaurant is outstanding—fresh, beautifully crafted, and bursting with flavor. The staff is friendly, the ambiance is inviting, and the presentation of each dish is a work of art. A must-visit for sushi lovers and Japanese cuisine enthusiasts
description: Authentic Japanese dishes in the heart of Saigon. We provide fresh & delicious food, cozy atmosphere with good service. Ideal for either private dining or family gathering experience.

name: Ola Hale - Restaurant & Bar
address: 270 Hai Ba Trung street, Tan Dinh ward, district 1 Tan Đinh ward, district 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We were drawn to the sophisticated design and stayed for the gourmet cuisine. The artistic plating of each dish showed real creativity. While prices are on the higher side, the quality of ingredients and impeccable service justify the cost. The extensive wine list perfectly complemented our meal., We spent our anniversary dinner at Ola Hale and were blown away by the stunning views of the city skyline. The outdoor patio created such a romantic atmosphere as the sun set. The service was attentive without being intrusive, and the fusion dishes exceeded our expectations. A perfect spot for special occasions!, We absolutely loved the romantic lighting and intimate setting at Ola Hale! The soft amber glow created the perfect atmosphere for our anniversary dinner. The creative cocktails were spectacular, especially their signature lemongrass martini. Every dish was beautifully presented, and the service made us feel extra special.
description:
Step into an elevated dining experience at Ola Hale, where modern European cuisine meets French refinement in the heart of Saigon. Under the creative direction of Chef Jonathan Koh, our menu celebrates seasonal ingredients, delicate techniques, and a love for craftsmanship.

Enjoy beautifully plated à la carte dishes, thoughtful wine pairings, and a surprise French dessert tray to end your meal on a memorable sweet note.

name: Huong Lai Restaurant
address: Floor2,  60 Cach MangThang8 (corner of VoVanTan) Vo Thi Sau Ward, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: First visit after renewal. The steps from the entrance to the building to the shop were a little uneasy, but it's good to have Vietnameseness. The staff was attentive to the food as before, and I was able to enjoy the meal comfortably. I recommend coconut-flavored salad, chicken sour soup, beef rolled in lemongrass and pudding. Purple potato soup is a taste from before. I think you should make a reservation., We dined here on New Years Eve and we weren’t disappointed. The restaurant is low key from the outside, then as you make your way up the stairs (definitely not recommended for the elderly or infirm) you enter a quaint dining room. The staff greeting us on arrival were so friendly, with impeccable manners, it would be hard not to be impressed. The concept of the restaurant is beautiful too, in that it trains and employs orphans and those from disadvantaged backgrounds. We elected to order the Seafood Set Menu ($280,000 VND pp) and whilst the food was very good, it’s the staff that truly make the experience. We were served by a number of wait staff and nothing was too much trouble. I’d like to single out Hoa for her beautiful service and thank all of the staff present on New Years Eve for a wonderful evening. All the best for the New Year and may all your dreams come true in 2020 ❤️, Huong Lai is a little hard to find. It's on the first floor of a nondescript building and you probably will miss it if you aren't looking for. That's a pity for the food was the best I tasted in HCMC, and the price was amongst the cheapest. The wait staff are all street kids who clearly appreciate the opportunity the restaurant is providing them and are cheerful and helpful. All were relatively fluent in English. The restaurant itself is nothing special in terms of décor and the elderly air con will no doubt struggle with summer temperatures but the food and fast service make up for this. Recommended..
description:
First visit after renewal.
The steps from the entrance to the building to the shop were a little uneasy, but it's good to have Vietnameseness.
The staff was attentive to the food as before, and I was able to enjoy the meal comfortably.
I recommend coconut-flavored salad, chicken sour soup, beef rolled in lemongrass and pudding.
Purple potato soup is a taste from before.
I think you should make a reservation.

name: Madame Lam - Vietnamese Contemporary Cuisine
address: No. 10 Tran Ngoc Dien Street, Thao Dien, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: A worthy selection for Michelin, as they don’t have a star but still on the list of great honour. A Vietnamese fine dine restaurant with a very soothing ambience and limited seating. The food was delicious specially clams and chicken. Overall a decent presentation and good taste. The service may be better and a little more mature as it took them long enough to serve wine., I thought it might be better to make a reservation, but I had a lot of plans during my stay and I wasn't sure when I could go, so I went without an appointment on the last day. I had been eating at a popular restaurant for about a week, so I was nervous every time I ordered a dish because the number of zeros was different, but when I finally calculated it, it came to less than 10,000 yen for dinner for two people, so I regret not being afraid and eating more (lol) I'm glad I went. I have a common palate, so when I go to a high-class restaurant abroad, I often expect too much and end up being left unsatisfied with the taste, but I'm really glad I went here! The seasoning is not strong and sharp like the common palate would like, but rather elegant and slightly light, which is really exquisite. The seasoning doesn't kill the ingredients, you can feel the harmony with the other flavors, and it doesn't make you feel full after just one dish, so the joy of feeling satisfied and moderately full at the same time makes it a restaurant that I'm really glad I went to. I'd like to visit at lunchtime next time., Today I went to a restaurant for dinner. I ordered 4 dishes for 2 people and my stomach was full. The most impressive dish is the mango shaking beef dish that everyone should try. The servers are very attentive to the customers and often ask me how the food is. I also try new drink, it’s so good
description: Madame Lam is a casual restaurant specializing in Vietnamese contemporary cuisine. All dishes are carefully selected from the best local ingredients and homemade by Chef Cuong to keep the richest flavors in every bite.

name: The Jackaroo Bar And Grill
address: 41 Nguyen An Minh, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Awesome pub! The owner is always there and easy to talk to, and the staff are incredibly sweet and polite! They are always happy to have a chat with great recommendations of places to see/do around. They are very on top of getting you food and drinks ASAP. The atmosphere is great! It’s well air conditioned with vaping allowed inside and a smoking area on the balcony. There’s surround sound speakers with great volume playing the AFL/NRL. The food is AMAZING! The chef is Italian and nails every dish with very good value for money. We’ve been back here countless times, you can’t give this one a miss! Very clean too. But be aware there are stairs to get up to this bar if youre a little older., Great bar owned by an Aussie expat couple . He is up for a chat on any questions you have about Vietnam , he also has all the do’s and dont’s if it’s your first time in Vietnam. We visited for lunch myself my wife and our 2 kids , food was great 👍, beer and cocktails were cold and at a reasonable price , great Aussie music too , this is a must place to grab a bite and cold beer when in district 1 🤙, We enjoyed it so much we came twice! Great fun atmosphere where you can enjoy drinks and food in a nicely air conditioned location. They also accommodate those who smoke on the patio, so the rest of the patrons in the bar have a smoke feee area. The staff provide excellent service, they have a large assortment to of drink choices. The prices are good and the food we order ordered was tasty and delicious. Can very much recommend.
description: Outback Pub, Sports Bar & Grill : Great Pub Grub, Ice-Cold Beers, Cocktails, Good Selection of Spirits, Live Sports, Very Friendly Team, Family Enviroment, Australian & Vietnamese Husband & Wife Owned & Managed, Come Say G’day!

name: Wine Bar at Level 23
address: 88 Dong Khoi Street Sheraton Saigon Grand Opera Hotel, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant offers several dishes including exotic desserts.The price are reasonable and the foods are served quickly I like the spacious, serene environment, serves and tasty food. Especailly, ms.Nguyen, she helped us to choose tasty food. Thank you for your advice, My friends and I went to dinner to celebrate the year-end party. The food we're very delicious, especially the butter aged tenderloin and thanks to Mr. Huy who served our table He was very professional in the service. His attitude was out of our expectations when we were enjoying dining. If we have another time, we should choose him for our server, we love the way he shows his serving in our experience. Once again, thanks so much that the Level 23 Signature Restaurant welcomes us on a special occasion., I just love everything of this restaurant. Warm welcoming, cozy atmosphere and excellent service got me feeling like being at home. Thanks to Thang, I enjoyed every moment of it. He kept asking how good/bad the food was and thoughtfully took care of us. Thank you, Thang! Hope to see you again when I come back. And the food was amazingly stunning. The appetizer and main dish were freshly prepared and perfectly cooked. But that's nothing compared to the dessert. It's the best!!! Really highly recommend this place to those who look for great experience and professional customer service.
description: Boasting a breezy rooftop atmosphere with lush greenery from the 23rd floor, the Wine Bar is among the top spots for watching the sun set and immersing yourself in the scenic central landscapes of notable landmarks, namely Bitexco and Nguyen Hue walking street while sipping on exotic cocktails.

name: Skewers
address: 9A Thai Van Lung Street, District 1 9A Thái Văn Lung, Q.1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: This is a favourite restaurant in HCMC, conveniently located in District 1. Skewers serves excellent Mediterranean food-I had Greek sausages-in a pleasant ambiance with very courteous waiting staff. And it won't set you back huge amounts wither. Recommended., Having had a few days of Vietnamese food, it was good to have a different type of meal. Had a dip with lots of different breads to share. Had a main course each,one of which is the seafood pasta under chefs recommended. All very delicious. Service was good and quick. Closes at 22.00 and we were advised 15 minutes early that it was time for last orders. Lots of places within a few minutes walking distance to have a drink afterwards, Love this place. This was my third time visiting. The wine is very cheap and I love the greek sausage and marinara sauce over the mashed potatoes and peas. I think I've ordered the same thing everytime I've visited. I'd try more of the menu but I just love the way they do that dish way too much. Great food.
description: Located near the Opera House, Caravelle and The Park Hyatt Hotel (5 minutes walk). Skewers has been open since July of 2000. The restaurant has 2 level, ground floor with 30+ seating, bar area and open kitchen. 1st floor with 12 tables, plus a cigar/smoking lounge. Skewers is open for lunch and dinner only. From 11:30 to 2pm and 6pm to 11pm. The kitchen last order is at 10:30pm. The restaurant is good for groups, wine tasting, lunch, special dinner, entertaining clients, romance, delivery and reservation.

name: ANH TUKK
address: 74/7 Hai Ba Trung Street, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The taste of the food itself was excellent, nothing that is noteworthy. The decor and ambient screens fine dining. Most of the dishes comes in small portions to share. Had a relaxing dining experience. The total came out to be $140 for 5 person, definitely not cheap, but acceptable considering the location and design of the restaurant itself., A nice location with proper AC inside and a bit offside the road. Therefore less noise polluted. The food was a nice mixture of Southern Asian cooking styles with decent variance. Te service was good, the pricing ok. In all, a quite decent and trendy location., Quality food, with several interesting variations on traditional Thai food. An improvement in pacing and delivery of meals would make it even more palatable. A great host too in Mr Valerie. Fair value.
description: ANH TUKK Modern Thai Cuisine Ideal for high class events, business meetings, or just simply a perfect place to relax in the hustle beat of modern life. Not long since its launching, the restaurant has left a special impression in the heart of local as well as foreign customers by introducing the unique creativity into its cuisines: keep the original taste of Thai dishes, in the other hand, innovate that authentic by applying sophisticated, meticulous, modern and luxurious styles of presentation.

name: Banh Mi 37 Nguyen Trai
address: 37 Nguyen Trai, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Tasty and filling banh mi but underwhelming bread. I live in France and I normally find the bread in Vietnam is of an equally high standard, but today's, although visually appealing, lacked in structure and freshness. The filling, on the other hand, was exceptional, and I quickly realised why there was such a long line (of mostly Vietnamese) to obtain such tasty morsels. The homemade freshly grilled pork patties are flavoursome, but once coupled with the shredded daikon and carrot, salad leaves, cucumber wedge, chilli seeds and special sauce become more than their sum of parts. The sauce brings everything together. It is kind of like a barbecue sauce, I suspect made with a soy sauce base, but it has a ketchup sweetness and consistency that made me think of tamarind and dates. The cart is old and beaten up, it is probably the original from when the stand first opened in 1980. The old lady assembling the banh mi works dexterously with expert hands. The bread rolls were opened with scissor, before she placed five pork patties in each along with the affor mentioned accompaniments. A steal at 28,000 dong, which is €1.13 at today's exchange rate. A small motorcycle delivered a fresh basket of rolls moments after mine was made, so I will give Banh Mi 37 another go tomorrow and hopefully get a fresher roll. All in all, it was a cheap and satisfying meal and worth the hourlong walk from where I am staying in Japantown area of District 1. Don't be put off by the wait, your taste buds will thank you for it., Bánh Mì 37 Nguyễn Trãi is a must-visit spot for anyone craving a great Bánh Mì. The sandwiches here are packed with flavor, thanks to the crispy, freshly baked baguette and tasty fillings. The pork is tender and perfectly grilled, and the pickled veggies and herbs add the right amount of crunch and freshness. The shop is small and casual, but it's always lively. It’s perfect for a quick bite on the go, and the prices are really good for the quality you get. The service is quick and friendly, even when it's busy. They also offer chili and sauces if you like a bit of heat. If you're in the area and want a tasty, filling meal that won’t break the bank, Bánh Mì 37 Nguyễn Trãi is the place to go. Highly recommended!, This was a cheap eat, priced very well for a good banh mi. They were 28,000 Vietnamese dong each. The banh mi has grilled pork, chilli, herbs, cucumber. There is no pate or cold cuts in this version, so we are calling it the ‘healthier’ banh mi. We liked that the two women grill the pork on the grill and the queue moves quickly. We would recommend, however we preferred the ‘unhealthy’ banh mi from Huynh hoa which contained cold cuts and a ridiculous amount of pate. It depends what you prefer.
