name: Cocoon Rooftop
address: 105 Cô GiangPhường Cô Giang, Quận 1, Thành phố Hồ 8th Floor, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: This bar not only has a magnificent view, but is decorated with very nice velvet chairs, lounge corners, plants and other cozy decor. The cocktails are relatively expensive, but this is due to the high standard - including the delicious cocktails and the friendly, even English-speaking staff. Thanks to Tim for the good hospitality ☺️, Cocoon Rooftop Bar offers a vibrant atmosphere with stunning views of the city center. The contemporary design and comfortable seating create a relaxing environment for guests to enjoy cocktails and small bites. The service is attentive, and the drink menu offers a variety of creative concoctions, making it a popular spot for locals and tourists alike. However, it can get crowded during peak hours, so reservations are recommended for a seamless experience. Overall, Cocoon Rooftop Bar is a must-visit destination for anyone looking to elevate their nightlife experience in the city center., Caccoon rooftop is a spot in Saigon where you can enjoy great, view good drinks and staff that are very friendly. The owners really know how to entertain with surprises and snacks. Definitely going to join again .
description: Nestled in Saigon, the Cocoon rooftop bar is a haven where the city's buzz meets the sky's tranquility, offers a delightful blend of fantastic views, original events, creative cocktails, and delicious Pizza. Whether you're a fan of classic favorites or unique creations like the Cocoon Mule or Sassy Sky, you'll find a paradise of mixology. And the Pizza? Made by the famous team of OLIVER'S PIZZA, a pizza 100% homemade "Al Taglio" style (by the slice), a speciality from Roma. Spacious Rooftop: Enjoy the breathtaking Saigon skyline with plenty of seating. Group Reservations: Secure a dedicated space for your party. Custom Packages: Tailor your event with unique food and drink options. Special Occasions: Make birthdays, anniversaries, and milestones extra special with personalized touches. Corporate Events: The Cocoon rooftop is perfect for business events, from cocktail parties to client meet.

name: Barbecue Garden Restaurant
address: 96B Le Thanh Ton Phường Bến Thành, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The service attitude is very good, and many of the waiters can speak English. However, the quality of the beef I ordered was mediocre. It might be better to order other meat or seafood. In addition, it is paired with a green Vietnamese sauce that is very flavorful, but you have to ask for it., Two of us came back to the Barbecue Garden with friends we are traveling with, 10 years after our previous visit. The food was lovely but I would like to caution anyone going for first time about choosing from the menu. It isn’t entirely clear from pictures/descriptions on menu, what meat comes as skewers and what as a plate of marinated meat. So do ask for specific clarification. We over ordered! We also were keen to do our own cooking but staff seemed to come and turn meat immediately after we had, and did not seem to understand that we were happy to cook ourselves. Also, probably should have more than one set of tongs, in this day and age, to prevent cross contamination between seafood, beef and chicken. Surprisingly, in this location, and with a lot of tourists, staff were not strong with English but they were friendly and when we needed to cancel some of the order, were accommodating. Do order a Mocktail for the sheer experience. They came in huge glasses and were superb! (I’m presuming the cocktails do also.) Overall, an enjoyable meal but some work on the menu or explanation of how to order, by the staff, would be a suggestion to management., Food was good when it came but service was terrible. Ordered a beer tower and had to ask for some glasses so we could drink it. Food came out at different times, servers didn’t smile as if they didn’t want our money. Management needs to speak to staff and sort this because it’s not appealing to tourists with staff with that attitude. 2 people’s pork came part cooked so had to send back for re cooking
description: Located right in the city centre, Barbecue Garden is a family style restaurant where guests share modern BBQ dishes in a natural environment. Escaping the noise and bustle of the big city, guests can enjoy a getaway with friends and family, while sharing and socializing, cooking delicious food right at the table. We are passionate about creating a unique BARBECUE EXPERIENCE for each and every customer... And let them forget everything else for a couple of hours. When you dig into our delicious Barbecue Garden grub, we are sure you will give us two finger-lickin' thumbs up!

name: Å by TUNG
address: 31-33 Dang Dung, Tan Dinh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: This is the place that I would love to splurge my money on haha, how they came up with every dishes still astonished me 🤯 the creativity is insane, it’s kind of hard to find this kind of fine dining experience in HCMC so I’m very happy to have a place I can be “boogie” sometimes 🤣. But seriously, the value given from its price ~USD 100 is beyond reasonable and worth every single penny. I like how this fine restaurant is very approachable, like it’s not crazy formal or serious but chill, young and artistic, like really relaxing vibe, but still offers high standard food and attentive service., Contrasting the busy streets of Saigon, Å by T.U.N.G boasts a modern and serene setting that celebrates the art of fine dining. The Chef elevates Vietnamese cuisine and brings his own touch of sophistication on local flavours. The signature “Pho” course with fermented green chili, torched A5 Kagoshima Wagyu, consommé gelée, assorted herbs and a side of hot pho broth was invigorating and effortlessly melting in the mouth. Other honourable mentions include toothfish served with curry and roasted pigeon with its jus and homemade oyster sauce. Hoang Tung’s focus on his craft and sauce making is perhaps what makes his establishment stand out from the rest of the dining scene in Saigon. Service was attentive during both of my visits. Every dish was well-explained. Smart and concise wine list with bubble options such as Billecart-Salmon and Taittinger. Or there’s a very reasonable corkage fee of 25 USD should you prefer to bring your own bottle., I just had an amazing dining experience at A by Tung in Ho Chi Minh City, and I can’t stop thinking about it! The decor is absolutely stunning—modern and chic, yet warm and inviting. You really feel like you’re in a special place as soon as you walk in. Now, let’s talk about the 15-course tasting menu. Wow! Each dish was a little work of art. The Iberico pork was hands down one of my favorites—so tender and flavorful. And the deconstructed pho? Just brilliant! It was a fantastic twist on a classic, and every bite was packed with deliciousness. The service was also top-notch. The staff was friendly and attentive, making sure I had everything we needed without being overbearing. You could really feel their passion for the food. One thing I hope they consider is adding an à la carte menu in the future. While the tasting menu is incredible, I’d love the chance to revisit and enjoy my favorite dishes again at my own pace. If you’re in HCMC, do yourself a favor and check out A by Tung. It’s a dining experience you won’t want to miss!
description: At Å by TUNG, savor every moment of the night with Nordic-chic vibes, aurora sky and a sensational dining experience, making the first-of-its-kind debut at the heart of Ho Chi Minh City by the celebrated Head Chef Hoang Tung, the youngest Vietnamese Chef to rank in the TOP 100 of THE ASIA’S 50 BEST RESTAURANTS list at the age of 28. In 2022, Hoang Tung joined FORBES UNDER 30, 2022, as the fearless pioneer of tasting menu in Vietnam, who set a cornerstone for the new era’s Vietnamese fine dining. A tribute to Northern Europe where Chef Tung’s passion for fine culinary blossomed, the restaurant offers bespoke guests a frontrow view of immersive Nordic interiors and a celebration of flavours, seasonality and aesthetics, across its signature 20-course tasting menu. Constantly innovative and occasionally rebellious, beyond introducing signature dishes, Hoang Tung and his team is passionate to invoke a sense of wonders in each and every guest and deliver an original, authentic experience

name: Elisa Floating Restaurant
address: 05 Nguyen Tat Thanh, Ward 12, District 4, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We initially went to take pictures of the boat, since we saw it from far away and looked beautiful. We then asked if we could have a drink and they were happy to have us on board, so we entered the ship. It looks fantastic, we ordered a drink and meanwhile we had a walk on the sun deck. The ship is just beautiful and very well located in a way that you see most of Saigon from the boat, simply stunning views. When the drinks arrived, we asked if we could have a look at the food menu, we saw it and everything looked delicious, so we decided to have dinner even though it was a bit early for us 18:30. This was the best decision that we made. We had soup, spring rolls (shrimp ones), goose and beef tenderloin with mashed potatoes. I cannot describe in words how f***** amazing the food was, just speechless. Regarding the service, they were very attentive and professional. I asked the waiter to let the cook know that we were amazed by the quality of the food. Then the manager came to ask us about the experience and about our holiday trip. Regarding the price, it obviously is not comparable to street food or a cheap restaurant, but quality/price. It’s definitely a 10/10. A must try if you ever go to Saigon. An unfortunate experience., Beautiful setting for a great meal in HCMC, located right on the river. Staff were very friendly and helpful with meal choices. Food was so well presented, and tasted really good. We had the crab spring rolls for starters…so good! Then pan seared cod and beef in peppered sauce, both really good. We ended with coconut ice cream, served in half a coconut…a great way to end a beautiful evening. We’d recommend a visit to Elisa, We were lucky enough to be seated at an outside table with a view of the harbor and the ships passing by. Although it had been a hot day the sun was down and there was a nice breeze. We were with another couple and got two bottles of wine, small but adequate selection and prices were good (we are from the US so the exchange rate helped some). The food was very good and the service was excellent.
description: Elisa Floating Restaurant was awarded as No.1 in Top 5 Restaurant in Ho Chi Minh city . Where its a 3 deck floating boat with beautiful amenities along with lift facility . The first 2 floors with beautiful structures with party and beautiful 3 VIP rooms on each floor. Then the sky-deck is really awesome along with beautiful awesome views on night time with night music along with musical fountain along with best sea foods , western & Chinese foods with reasonable price and there number of choice of different kinds of seafood's which it makes you feel surprise the there are large variety of wines and spirits which its make you choose your best choice. Come and feel the difference. Because we are ready you with Heart and Smile.

name: Residence Eleven
address: 11 Công Trường Mê Linh, Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Wonderful service from Long and Yen at dinner service! They were extremely attentive, never let our tea cups go empty or tea go cold, sauces never ran low and plates were always cleared really swiftly. We got the half salt and pepper tofu, Peking duck, beef hor fun and duck fries rice- everything was delicious and well prepared. The restaurant was very beautiful and every staff member we spoke to was great., I had an exceptional lunch experience at Residence Eleven in Ho Chi Minh City, thanks to the fantastic service from Yen and Long, who were both friendly and attentive. The food was outstanding, especially the Hong Kong-style steamed red grouper, which was perfectly cooked with bold, savory flavors. Their excellent service, paired with these delicious dishes, made for a memorable meal, and I’ll definitely be back!, Hilton Saigon opened a new Cantonese restaurant with a great view. Although they are in a soft opening period with limited menu, it is enough to enjoy the night with nice dishes. Nice modern dining area and attentive staff, thanks to Dylan, Tyhi and Sy, also help to enjoy food. I am looking forward visiting again in October with full menu with more dishes to choose.
description: Entering the main dining space, guests are welcomed by a feature duck oven with carving station. Interesting table mix to break up the space and clever use of bold colors and materials to reflect modernity. Each private dining room has its distinct Chinese design elements and offers exclusivity and privacy.

name: The Refinery
address: 74 Hai Ba Trung, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: It's a beautiful restaurant (very instagramable) set in a building/courtyard with a rich and interesting history. Skip the common tourist souvenirs and ask them about their dish towels and bread plates (opium manufacturing from 1881. We had the set lunch (sea bass), beef tongue, and ratatouille. The food was SO delicious and unique. And as a former Los Angeleno, we found it comparatively very inexpensive for the quality, service, and ambiance. We currently live in Hawaii so unfortunately, we will never get something this amazing in Hawaii. iIt's so good I've gone more than once. I think if you are visiting Vietnam, it's good to try Vietnamese food, but I think everyone should try French as well while in Vietnam. As an American who is used to live in Los Angeles and currently resides in Hawaii, this place is comparatively really inexpensive. No way you could get this kind of delicious French food in a beautiful historic setting with well trained staff for the same price., We stumbled upon The Refinery while looking for a late lunch, and everything about the meal was fantastic! The bread used for our sandwiches were made in-house, and perfectly reminiscent of what I’ve had in Paris. My favorite drink is a passion fruit martini, and they can be difficult to find. But it so happened that The Refinery’s specialty was in fact a passion fruit martini, and it did not disappoint! It was a perfect balance of sweet and refreshing. We also enjoyed learning about the historical setting of the building, and they did a good job of leaning into it with tasteful decor accenting the story of the old opium refinery. Finally, the pricing was extremely affordable by western standards. We had two entrees complete with sides, an alcoholic drink, and coffee and the total bill was $30 USD! Overall, if you’re looking for a break from the hustle and bustle of the city, and enjoy history and classic French food, The Refinery is a must visit!, The food was great, considering the price, but the service was not so great. I waited for more than 20 minutes to order. There were not many people at that time. Later they brought me butter saying that bread would be served soon, but it didn’t come until main dish is served. After I finished half of the main dish, I asked waiter about bread, which made him totally surprised because he thought bread was served already.
description: Opened in 2006 and making use of an iconic location, Saigon’s old “Manufacture d’Opium” (built 1881), The Refinery was designed and decorated in the greatest Paris bistro tradition. A French Brasserie and Wine Bar tucked away in a secluded courtyard in the heart of the city, The Refinery offers a terrace with comfy armchairs and a beautiful interior with many original architectural features. While the restaurant serves top quality food, the wine selection is superb with 17 wines served by the glass.

name: Chit Chat at the Café
address: 242 Tran Binh Trong Steet, District 5 Hotel Equatorial Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews:
Just had a delicious dim sum made-to-order buffet lunch at Chit Chat Cafe in the Equatorial Hotel. We called yesterday to book and asked if they were offering any discounts, and they said they would give us a 15% discount, so it was about 500k/pp ($20 USD), including VAT, service charge, and hot/iced tea, which is a pretty good deal for a luxury hotel. The dim sum did not disappoint. Stand-outs were the abalone siu mai, shrimp rolls, taro balls, fried rice, and custard egg tart. Everything was tasty, exept for the seafood soup, which would have been good had it not been so salty. Ice cream was also not great, it tasted like a local brand, which is more like ice milk rather than ic cream. It'd be better to go with the interesting local desserts. Excellent and quick service was provided by Sandy and other service staff. Within ten minutes of ordering, the food came out nice and hot, and nothing was missed. We will definitely be back!, The restaurant has a quiet space so it is suitable for meeting family and friends in the evening and having lunch with partners is very reasonable. The staff brought me and my friends a very lucky New Year's dinner. Dishes are replenished almost continuously by the kitchen, making it impossible for me to stop eating. The evening space is cozy and hardly disturbed by traffic noise, so our dinners are great. Thank you for providing this wonderful experience., Good service and food ! The food quality is in line with that of a five-star hotel. It is an all-you-can-eat restaurant, but it adopts a single-point model. The portion size will be adjusted according to the number of people, and the food will be served quickly, so you don't have to worry about the food being served too slowly or getting cold. The service staff are attentive. Although they are quite busy, if the service staff don't notice you, you can notify them at any time and they will come right away. Five-star food and five-star service Chit Chat at the Café earns rave reviews for its extensive buffet that tempts with fresh seafood and delightful dim sum, earning it high marks for both variety and taste. Guests often note the value for money, thanks to the delicious dishes and attentive service.

The friendly staff and their eagerness to assist add to the dining experience, which many reviewers find enhances the restaurant's elegant yet comfortable atmosphere, making it an inviting spot for various gatherings.
description: Chit Chat at the Café offers you a succulent culinary spread that is carefully selected to ensure the best dining experience possible. It showcases a remarkable range of food and beverages both for ala carte and buffet. Indulge in the international buffet with action stations for a virtual culinary tour through a variety of flavours.

name: Link Bistro Cafe & Restaurant
address: 47 - 51 Le Anh Xuan Street, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Link Bistro Cafe & Restaurant is new and quite modern. It is part of the La Siesta Premium Saigon Central hotel and is open to the hotel guests and the general public. The ambience in this restaurant is very pleasant and welcoming. As guests, this is where we had our daily breakfast. The supervisor of the restaurant, Thoa Nguyen, fully guided us with the food selection due to our vegetarian diet. The other staff were equally supportive and very friendly. We were overjoyed with how Thoa, Mindy, Kim, Olivia, Duc and others got to know our breakfast routine and served up our individual preferences as soon as we were seated. The food was freshly cooked, served hot, and it was consistently delicious. We thoroughly enjoyed our meals at this restaurant. The service was superb! Earlier, we had casually mentioned to Thoa of our son's birthday in the coming days. On his actual birthday soon after breakfast, about a dozen staff members led by Hai Le, the hotel manager, orchestrated the occasion with a birthday song, a delicious chocolate cake, a candle and a party hat! Thanks to Thoa for arranging all this. We were truly touched by this gesture. Here we were in a totally foreign country, but the genuinely warm and friendly staff made us feel very much at home with their gracious hospitality. We would definitely revisit this location., We very much enjoyed our dinner at this bistro. We were staying at the hotel in which the bistro is located. Rather than look for a restaurant after a long day of sightseeing, we decided to eat here since it was in the hotel. It did not disappoint. The food was delicious and much care was given to the preparation and presentation of our dishes. The wait staff was particularly attentive, working hard to ensure that our experience was a great one and we appreciated their efforts. Our waitress, Phuong Phan, was especially kind to my mother which I appreciated very much. Thank you for making our dinner a special one!, I had the pleasure of enjoying Vietnamese cuisine at a restaurant inside a new brilliant hotel in Ho Chi Minh City with my friends. First, the presentation of the dishes was stunning! Each plate was carefully arranged, providing a visually delightful experience. Every dish was incredibly delicious, and the delicate flavors unique to Vietnamese cuisine stood out beautifully. The rice paired perfectly with every dish! The salad was fresh, with a crisp and savory kick from the ingredients. The fluffy egg dish had just the right amount of salt, making it a great complement to any other dish. The traditional sweet and savory braised dish from Southern Vietnam had a rich, deep flavor that was truly addictive. The stir-fried shrimp was plump and juicy, with a satisfying crunch from the peppers and onions. The gentle taste of the soup also elevated the entire meal. The staff was extremely friendly and took the time to explain the background and ingredients of each dish, which allowed me to enjoy Vietnamese cuisine on a deeper level. Each dish had a warm, homey feel while showcasing professional culinary skills. With Instagram-worthy dishes and a lovely ambiance, I can't wait to visit again. This is an excellent place to truly experience the charm of Vietnamese cuisine! I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone who loves Vietnamese food or is trying it for the first time. I look forward to bringing my family here next time!
description: Nestled on the ground floor of the La Siesta Premium Saigon Central Hotel, Link Bistro Café is a vibrant culinary destination that offers a unique blend of modernity and tradition. Located in the bustling District 1, right at the heart of Ho Chi Minh City, this stylish café is a perfect retreat for both locals and travelers seeking a refined dining experience. At Link Bistro Café, the menu is a delightful fusion of international flavors and local culinary traditions. The chefs take great pride in using the freshest ingredients to craft dishes that are not only visually stunning but also bursting with flavor. Whether you’re in the mood for a light breakfast, a leisurely lunch, or a sumptuous dinner, the menu offers a wide range of options that cater to all tastes. In the heart of Saigon’s vibrant District 1, Link Bistro Café is more than just a place to eat—it’s a destination where food and style come together. Whether you’re a local resident or a visitor to the city, a meal at Link

name: Mandarine Restaurant
address: 11A Ngo Van Nam Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Mandarine is one of our favorite restaurants anywhere. It has really, really good Vietnamese food and great service! We dined here six times during our 2024 stay in Ho Chi Minh City and many more times during our previous visits. Our favorite appetizer was the Mandarine Spring Rolls. You have to try those! The hot pot was exceptionally good and cooked at our table; we also enjoyed other dinners as well. Tran van Tuan, the restaurant manager, puts on a spectacular show as he prepares flaming bananas and mango for desert. The service as we said is excellent. Thanks to waiters, waitresses and captains Anh Thu, Kim Chi, Hoang Kwang, Kim Phuong and all of the others who made our dinners so wonderful. We really like this restaurant!!, A long-established restaurant that represents Ho Chi Minh City. This is my third visit in eight years. I think the taste and quality are the same as before, but I'm not impressed anymore, perhaps because I went to the Michelin restaurant anan the night before? All three appetizers were delicious, but the second half, especially the seafood, was a bit lacking. The atmosphere and service are top class in Ho Chi Minh City, so it's good for entertaining guests, but the wine list is completely devoid of the wines I wanted to order, which also lowers my rating. For a restaurant of this class, I would like them to have more wines in the 10,000 yen range., Mandarine Saigon really impressed me. The food selections were delicious and well presented. From the extensive menu we ordered prawns with vegetables, a vegetarian soup, tofu and roasted duck. All were tasty and I truly enjoyed each of them. The staff was friendly, helpful and all spoke English quite well. We were seated quickly on the top floor which was quiet and a beautiful setting. A large tour group was seated on the second floor but this had no effect on our experience. The only issue was that the air conditioning was too strong. Prices for our dishes was reasonable considering that we were in the tourist portion of district one.
description: Mandarine Restaurant is an old time favorite of companies entertaining guests as well as travelers visiting Ho Chi Minh City. It's a fine dining restaurant serving Vietnamese cuisine tailored for non-Vietnamese nationals. What is unique is that the dipping sauces are homemade mostly from beans which give flavor acceptable to foreigners. The food is created with a story itself of Vietnam being a destination which can be reflected in the traditional decorations served together on the plates. Mandarine is known for its taste and beauty on the dish.

name: Sushi Hokkaido Sachi
address: 40 - 42 Đong Du, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1 L5 - 17, 65 Le Loi,Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: From the Yucatan of the female attendants to the Japanese greetings to the extensive menu and drinks selection all the way down to the presentation, this restaurant is a fine example of how to really give the customer a small piece of culture from another country. The menu is large and has plenty of options available from sashimi plates to the casual Katsudon bowl, there'll be something on the menu for even the fussiest of eaters. The drinks menu was also brilliantly presented with a wide range of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages with Sake and Japanese beer alike. The food portion sizes were a little small but to be honest, it's the same portion size you'd get in Japan, so well presented. The sashimi was delicate and tasteful, an amazing representation of Japan. We also got the wagyu tataki, tempura plate, salmon skin salad and grilled fish. Nothing bad can be said as we were all smiles and our taste buds were having a feast. Prices aren't cheap and you'll be looking to spend around the $100 USD mark for dinner if you go with at least 3 or 4 people so budget accordingly. This isn't your run of the mill Vietnamese restaurant. Overall, for the price you pay you get twice more with the service, menu and taste. Definitely worth a visit if you want a small break from Vietnamese cuisine., Review of Sushi Hokkaido Sachi Sushi Hokkaido Sachi is an exceptional sushi restaurant that offers a delightful dining experience. Located in the heart of the city, this restaurant stands out for its authentic Japanese cuisine and impeccable service. First and foremost, the quality of the sushi at Sushi Hokkaido Sachi is unparalleled. The fish is incredibly fresh and the sushi chefs skillfully prepare each piece with precision. From the classic tuna and salmon rolls to more unique options such as sea urchin and eel, every bite bursts with flavor and melts in your mouth. The presentation of the sushi is also commendable, with each dish beautifully arranged and garnished. In addition to sushi, Sushi Hokkaido Sachi offers a variety of other Japanese dishes that are equally delicious. The miso soup is rich and flavorful, and the tempura is perfectly crispy. They also have a range of hot and cold appetizers, such as edamame and gyoza, which are great for sharing. The ambiance of the restaurant is cozy and inviting, with traditional Japanese decor and soft lighting. The staff are friendly and attentive, always ensuring that you have everything you need for a pleasant dining experience. The waiters are knowledgeable about the menu and offer helpful recommendations, making the ordering process seamless. One of the highlights of dining at Sushi Hokkaido Sachi is the Omakase experience. This is a chef's tasting menu where the, Today I had the experience of dining with my family at Sushi Hokkaido Sachi restaurant, Dong Du branch. I feel that the space here is decorated very cozy, with a Japanese-style design. Regarding the food, I feel that the beautifully decorated dishes are a big plus, the dishes are very delicious from hot to cold dishes. Sashimi is always guaranteed to be the freshest to bring to diners. Enthusiastic and happy staff always bring out the dishes as quickly as possible for customers to eat. I really like the restaurant's way of working and really like the restaurant's food, so my family and I will come back another time to enjoy more delicious dishes.
description: Our supreme seafood is imported swiftly from Shinjo wholesale market, Sapporo, Hokkaido, a northern island district of Japan, famous for its abundant fresh and delicious seafood. Together with high quality fresh local ingredients, selected and cooked by 30 years experience chefs from Hokkaido, we will always guarantee to serve you the best quality and taste with reasonable prices.

name: Nhà hàng The Canvas
address: Tầng G, Khách sạn Lotte 2a-4a Tôn Đức Thắng, Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: I went to The Canvas restaurant to enjoy buffet lunch at the restaurant. The food here is quite diverse, including many Asian and European dishes, but is prepared very well to my taste. Especially the vermicelli here, the broth is delicious and flavorful. I really like the space here, the view is airy and comfortable for a luxurious lunch. The staff here are very enthusiastic and attentive, especially Nina. She took care of me throughout the process of enjoying my food, asking about my taste and getting drinks for me and my friends. She also enthusiastically introduced me to the hotel's monthly promotions. I feel the service and food at the restaurant are excellent. I will recommend to friends and I will come back to enjoy in the future., Employees don't have to ask, come first and get what you need when you need it! I was also impressed by the delicate kindness that kept me reasonably away without burdensome. Make a note of each employee's name and leave it here for review! Quan, Loan, Ngan, Khai, Tuan Anh, Lan, Han, Oanh, Linh, Hao. Adding kindness to delicious food, it was a really comfortable, more satisfying time. Thank you so much for making the last Sunday of 2024 warmer. Thank you to the Lotte staff who worked hard, even if the name was not right., I had a wonderful experience at The Canvas with my family. Breakfast buffet has a variety of Asian and European dishes. I ate here for many days and Nina especially understood and brought drinks for my family. Nina is friendly and thoughtful with my children. She asked for hot chocolate for them and talked happily with them. Not only food and drinks here, but also a perfect service for children. Thank you for providing an enjoyable experience.
description: I went to The Canvas restaurant to enjoy buffet lunch at the restaurant. The food here is quite diverse, including many Asian and European dishes, but is prepared very well to my taste. Especially the vermicelli here, the broth is delicious and flavorful. I really like the space here, the view is airy and comfortable for a luxurious lunch. The staff here are very enthusiastic and attentive, especially Nina. She took care of me throughout the process of enjoying my food, asking about my taste and getting drinks for me and my friends. She also enthusiastically introduced me to the hotel's monthly promotions. I feel the service and food at the restaurant are excellent. I will recommend to friends and I will come back to enjoy in the future.

name: Heart Of Darkness Craft Brewery Saigon
address: 31D Ly Tu Trong, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We had a couple of fantastic craft beers at the Heart of Darkness, both with a fruity twist. Unusual and very drinkable. We also had their two for one burger offer and I was delighted that every burger they did could be done for a vegetarian. It made a nice change during our trip. The service was impeccable. I thought I had lost my purse at the bar and was flying to Haiphong early the next day. I decided to try to contact the bar on linked in and got an instant response and the person went out of their way to contact staff at the bar to see if they could find it. Amazing service and kindness so 5 stars all round. Would definitely go back., We found the restaurant by chance. The different beers are a dream. You can order 6 different small beers to try, not for free of course. If you don't find anything here, it's your own fault. The menu also has great little things such as 4 small burgers, or just fries but also with toppings such as brisket. The ribs alone are also a dream. On various days there are highlights such as burgers buy one get one free. Tomahawk almost half price. Cocktails buy one get one free etc. The staff are very friendly and make you feel welcome here. We would come back again and again, it's worth it., We stumbled on The Heart of Darkness while sight seeing the streets at night. We were impressed by the almost 20 beers on tap and the American styled food menu. Our black and bleu burger and truffle fries went down well with the fruit IPA's. The servers were friendly, helpful and efficient. Prices were very reasonable - eg.burger and fries 240,000 dong (about £8 or US$9.50)
description: Drop by Heart of Darkness Saigon for uncompromising BBQ, burgers & tacos, award-winning craft beer, great service and good times!

name: Bếp Mẹ Ỉn - Nguyễn Thái Bình
address: 165/50 Nguyen Thai Binh, District 1 Phường Nguyễn Thái Bình, Quận 1, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh 71010, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Nice little typical restaurant located at the end of an alley! Delicious local dish served in Vietnamese baskets, with plenty of greenery and fresh mint! Inexpensive and traditional, don’t hesitate to add a few starters like their famous beef dim sum, served with sauce! Everything is delicious! Correct service and local comfort!, We spent three weeks in Vietnam and Cambodia. All of our meals were either good or excellent not a single bad meal. We flew in and out of Ho Chi Mihn, this was the place my wife wanted to revisit as they served the tastiest meatballs she has ever had. Its not fancy at all and we sat on stools but food, drink and staff all good. Also only two choices of cake for dessert if you want a piece order immediately, they quickly go., Very friendly and attentive staff, especially Zizi who is very nice and speaks English very well. We ordered a pizza with a rice base and a beef pancake with mushrooms, both delicious. We will return without a doubt. Very good place to have dinner in Vietnam
description: Come to Bep Me In (Mama's kitchen) and be transported back to Saigon in the 80s. Just imagine the owner of the restaurant is a woman from the North who moved to Saigon at a very young age. Her key childhood memories are her childhood Vietnamese meals, the fierce and strict mothers who raise their children with discipline , the stuffy ao dai fashion stores, the old 80s gadgets..all you can experience in the cozy area of Bep Me In. Here, visitors will enjoy authentic iconic vietnamese food all over the country.

name: Pizza 4P's Hai Ba Trung
address: 151B Hai Ba Trung Ward 6, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I came for dinner here with a good friend last night. We had booked and luckily so, when we arrived there was huge queue . Due to booking, we only needed to wait 5 minutes while they prepared our table and we jumped ahead of the queue. This particular 4Ps is huge, over two levels and it was packed totally on a Thursday night. Testimony to how popular they have become. They are definitely the best Pizza restaurant chain in Vietnam. Their salads and pasta dishes are good too. Definitely try the spaghetti with crab if you get a chance, simply delicious. Service is pretty good, ordering is by scanning a QR code to bring up the menu on your smart phone and ordering directly. Considering how crowded they were last night, the wait was totally reasonable and not long, the food was delicious. For tourists, please note: it is not easy to find at first. There is only a small sign for Pizza 4P at the top of the laneway. The laneway has a Japanese Sake Pub at the corner. Walk down the laneway, past all the parked bikes till you get to the end and to your left is the entrance… you can’t miss it when you walk down to the end of the laneway., Had very high expectations on the pizza. Tried the four cheese and salmon miso which was possibly my mistake, however the salmon came recommended. The pizza ingredients are definitely top notch. I take issue, and yea i am being pedantic, with the base. Slight soggy and chewy, not aure whether it’s a question of having it rise more, or cooking longer. That being said, perfectly passable. The venue itself, this branch anyway, outstanding. Elegant, spacious, in a courtyard which is very thoughtfully decorated. Service exceptional. The burrata served with watermelon, mango, dragon fruit and prosciutto strangely works. The dessert is had was ricotta ice cream with passion fruit and i almost ordered a second one. Delicious indeed. Will come back to try the pasta for sure. Overall very satisfied and rooting for this place to make some slight improvements on the pizza front., Going on the weekend will be crowded, so you should book a table in advance. It took me 30 minutes to save the code and be called, but the service here worth waiting. The waiting room is chill like a coffee shop, the space is large on 2 floors with many trees, and the staff is very nicr and attentive. I ordered crab spaghetti, pizza 3 cheese with honey and burrata fruits salad. All good
description: An Earth to People restaurant on a mission to make the world smile for peace, one pizza at a time. Earth to People is our commitment to serve safe and fresh foods directly from Mother Earth to you. Located in Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Danang and Nha Trang.

name: Shamballa Vegetarian, Restaurant & Tea House
address: 17-19 Trịnh Văn Cấn Cầu Ông Lãnh, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant has beautiful vegetarian food if you are a vegetarian or would just like to try some authentic vegetarian food this is a must visit!! I decided to try the banana curry as I have never had one before it is one of the best curries I have ever tasted ! I also tried the Vietnamese crepe as again I have never experienced one. Please don’t be shy to ask your waitress or waiter on how to go about eating this I had to lol 😊 I also had the mango/strawberry smoothie and it aimed to please 😊 yes I highly recommend this place I would definitely visit again😀, Amazing restaurant with good gluten free options, as well as vegan options for those with dietary restrictions in Da Nang. Tien, our server, was incredibly attentive and helped us navigate the GF options on the menu. 100% would recommend this restaurant for anyone looking for delicious food in Da Nang., As you walk in the restaurant, you have a positive and calm vibe around. We got seated in a good outdoor area and Truing Thinh had served us while we were there. He heard us well to know our interests and appetite, then suggested us what is best to order and to our surprise; everything he suggested was good. They are genuine people offering good quality food with good ambience
description: Shamballa -- the kingdom for pure spirits; the haven of peace, tranquility and eternal happiness; the mysterious capital between reality and fantasy; the medium between Earth and the Spiritual. We at Shamballa wish to share our peace & mother nature’s delights with everyone. Our menu is MSG-free, with strong flavours stemming from fresh vegetables, fruits, nuts, and wheats. Each ingredient is carefully selected to form a menu that is filling, nutritious, and tasteful. Our creative & meticulous presentation of each dish satiates your visual senses before your palate. We are the place for friends to unwind, for families to reunite, and where a sense of peace can be found within the liveliness of Saigon..

name: Market 39
address: Corner Hai Ba Trung st. and Le Duan blv. Lobby Level Of Jw Marriott Hotel & Suites, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Only tried it for lunch buffet; yet, I would go anytime: lunch, dinner, brunch! The service was impeccable: the staff knew what I wanted even before asking for it. They were observant, fast, smiling, and mostly kind. The food was rish, the pasta homemade, they carved the tuna in front of us: its taste was so fresh. The desert was refined with great quality chocolate and well decorated cakes. Everything had a personal touch that tremendously added to the whole experience. Ms. Linh Nguyen (director of restaurant and bar) went out of her way to make sure all was perfect and indeed it all was. Kudos to all the staff! Will definitely come again., My breakfast was amazing. The restaurant has a variety of dishes. There is a full range of food. The staff was friendly, enthusiastic and very supportive of me. Clean, large space, beautiful view. Fast service speed, tea and coffee are delicious. There is Iced Vietnamese Black Coffee with condensed milk which is very delicious, I was suggested by the staff to try that. If there is a next time, I will definitely still choose the Intercontinental SaiGon hotel in, Great buffet breakfast selection with EXCELLENT service. Wide range of food options from many different countries. Great live cooking stations (eggs, waffles, pancakes, pho) where you provide your table number and your order is delivered to table (no waiting around!). Fabulous staff who are very friendly and attentive and take barista coffee orders from your table and offer multiple times if you’d like more coffee if they see you’ve finished. We would comment each morning how great the food was and how great the staff were. Would recommend 10/10.
description: Combining the essence of JW Marriott's hospitality and profound passion for culinary delights, Market 39 offers a warm, inviting destination where guests can go beyond savoring the cuisines, to be inspired, elevated and connect in one of our sumptuous buffets.

name: L'Usine Saigon Centre
address: 65 Le Loi District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Dined at this restaurant as the outside presentation looked quite appealing. We were greeted by friendly staff who seated us promptly. The meal i was given was absolutely sensational and one of the best lunch meals on our trip. Staff were attentive and helpful. Meal was prepared and service in quick time. The price of my meal was excellent for the quality. Highly recommend you try!, We visited L’Usine the last time we were in Ho Chi Minh and it was really good, this time I think it was even better! We ordered the Croque Monsieur, Eggs Benedict, ice coffees and fries and all as delicious. There is also a gift shop, we purchased some shorts for my son which were very reasonably priced. Great respite from the heat!, After thee weeks Vietnam and Cambodia we were looking for a lunch location with Western food options. We had the clubsandwiches, muesli bowls and egg plant sandwich. All food was fresh and tasteful. The juices were also good (but they are almost everywhere good in Vietnam and Cambodia with all the fresh fruit available!). This place can be found at the top floor of the Saigon shopping centre. Great place for having lunch.
description: More than just a fashion boutique, café and evening bistro, L'Usine is a contemporary Vietnamese experience. Inspired by the timeless elegance and enterprising industry of the Indochina era, L'Usine's founders have designed a space that not only showcases global fashion but celebrates modern Vietnamese creativity.

name: CCCP Saigon Cafe & Restaurant
address: 48A Nguyen Binh Khiem, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: My good Aussie friend had spent a week in ICU then a week at home resting and was going crazy and needed a pick me up. So I suggested we visit the Russian Restaurant not too far from where we both live in District Binh Thanh in Saigon. Well it was just what the Dr ordered and got him out of the doldrums. He absolutely loved the food and it turned out when he was young a Russian friend of his mum taught her to make Borscht Soup and so for him it was like comfort food from his childhood days. For entree we had what looked like a pasty with lamb in one and pork in the other. We cut them in half so we could experience both without over stuffing ourselves. Next Chris had the Borsch soup followed by the Goulash stew. I instead went for the Pork Kotleta which looked like a hamburger Pattie but was the texture of soft meatloaf. Unbelievably tasty. We both ordered the potato Dranhiki which is very similar to Scottish Tatties. Very addictive. Through all of this we shared a jug of their fruit Kompot. For desserts I chose the Blinchiki and Chris went for the Syrniki. It turned out his was the better choice of the two desserts available as mine was a little disappointing as it was very dry in the middle and the crepe was too dry also. But the Syrniki was delicious. Chris was very grateful I got him out of his apartment and even reckoned it was the best meal he has had in Saigon so that's saying something., If you are looking for something other than oriental/fusion cuisine this is the place. Short of traveling to Russia it would be hard to find this menu anywhere else. The menu is legitimately Russian and the food went down nicely with a bottle of Beluga Vodka!, We lived around the corner, literally a 3-minute walk away from CCCP but never went there. Now that we live 8 km away, we decided to dine here.....ironic. Better late than never just to find out how good the food is. It's a Friday night and this place was packed, something totally unexpected. But still, the owner found us a place in the corner in under 3-minutes while still smiling and being chatty under all that stress. My compliments! We were hungry, so the idea was to order as quickly as possible.The first thing my wife set eyes on was the salad, women huh. The Mimosa salad is their signature salad dish, but was sold out (at 730pm???), and the recommendation was to try the Shuba salad. I only know there was some chopped smoked herring located between layers of other chopped veggies, but this tasted so damn good. Other dishes ordered included the black Russian caviar, the goulash, russian pork dumplings and to finish off with a Napoleon cake. My favourite was the salad and the Napoleon cake, but the other dishes were also awesome in their own right. Overall, I highly recommend you give this place a chance, and it's almost guaranteed that you'll be making a return trip in short order.
description: Cafe CCCP offers comfort food from the days of the Soviet Union. Visitors can look forward to a hearty meal at very reasonable prices. The cafe's interior is cozy and comfortable, looking a bit like a family living room converted into a restaurant.

name: Nha Tu Restaurant
address: 129/4 Vo Van Tan Street Ward 6, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Our home stay recommended this place for our last lunch on the day we were leaving Vietnam to travel home to Australia, we caught a grab and extremely happy we went there. The restaurant is beautiful, tucked up a laneway, the food was the best food we have eaten in Vietnam on our 3 week trip. Loved everything! Tu the owner and her staff are fantastic! Won’t forget this meal and would fly back especially to eat there again!!, Simple but fantastic lunch. I started with the fried spring rolls, then moved on to what I had come for, the baby clams and morning glory broth. Clean, vibrant tastes, further bolstered by a selection of fresh herbs and raw chopped chillies. Sad that I didn't discover this restaurant sooner, as now near the end of my 60 days in Saigon. Didn't know about their Michelin Bib Gourmand status prior to taking my seat in the restaurant, but now that I have eaten there, I'm not at all surprised., Quaint delightful find in an alley way Plenty of locals enjoying unpretentious tasty food Recommend Vietnamese pancake Ribs , stir fried beef , morning glory, snake head fish, spring rolls Every dish was unique and tasty Very reasonably priced Service In English is spotty but staff are very friendly Highly recommend
description: Hidden in an alley on Vo Van Tan, Nha Tu Vietnamese Bistro is a 3-level house with both indoor and outdoor terrace seatings, fully decorated with basic and authentic items collected from different regions of Vietnam. We mainly serve authentic Vietnamese food from the South-Central of Vietnam, with fresh ingredients from vegetables to fish and meat directly imported from Phan Rang.

name: Bún Chả 145
address: 145 Bui Vien Phường Phạm Ngũ Lão, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We had a great Bun Cha in a very nice little place in the heart of Saigon's busiest street. They bring vegetables, rice noodles, garlic and chili aside so you can decide how to mix them. We also took the pork skewers and the grilled ochre. Portions right and well cooked. A bun cha cost 60,000 dong. To return., Buncha 145 in Vietnam offers a delicious and authentic experience for those craving traditional Vietnamese dishes. The signature bun cha, with its tender grilled pork, flavorful broth, and fresh herbs, is a standout. The atmosphere is casual and welcoming, perfect for a quick and satisfying meal. The service is friendly and efficient, making it a great spot for anyone looking to enjoy a tasty, no-frills Vietnamese meal. Highly recommended for both locals and tourists!, I love the bun cha here. It is good and the place is clean. It's the second time I've eaten there. Hostesses are not oppressive and let them choose. We make crosses to choose the dishes ordered on a stretched sheet. It avoids misunderstandings.
description: We warmly invite you to come and savor our delicious bún chả! Pair it with a refreshing beer and enjoy the cozy atmosphere, away from the city's hustle and bustle. Perfect for a relaxing meal any time of day! This isn’t mere marketing; I sincerely hope you experience the delightful taste of bún chả. Among countless others, you are the lucky one with this special invitation. Whether you choose to come or not, I wish you all the best!

name: Quince Eatery
address: 37bis Ky Con District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: My spouse and I had the pleasure of dining around the world, and Quince/Madam Kew belongs in the top tier. We walked in without a reservation to a full main dining room, but the staff had some room upstairs. Initially, we thought this would be “less than”, but the decor was that of an upscale, modern lounge with a great vibe. Then came the menu… a Tomahawk in Ho Chi Minh City… YES!!!! We started with oysters which were presented and served uniquely and beautifully, and then dug into our Tommy with sides of some of the best “Not so Mashed Potatoes” and roasted cauliflower with whipped cheese. You could tell there was a French influence throughout the service, and we were thrilled to see it. The flavour, presentation, and service were excellent throughout the night. We enjoyed every bite. Probably too many bites, ha. I suppose the Michelin Guide was right to feature this restaurant, but maybe they will get a star before too long., Recommended to us we went on our first night to Vietnam and we were not disappointed. The food was superb and the ambiance relaxed, confident and keen to please. Sitting at the kitchen side was an education to watch the love and attention put into cooking and presenting the delicious fayre. The home made sweets were masterpieces and the staff were pleasant and helpful with our menu choices. More expensive than the normal Vietnamese food, more on a pair with UK prices but if you can push the boat out a little you wont be disappointed., Its a little spendy esecially considering where you are, but the quality of the ingredients, quality of service, and the ambience of the place make it well worth it in my opinion. We have been multiple times since they opened. Last night for one of my daughters Birthdays we had aged duck breast, a wagyu sirloin bavette, scallops, bbq octopus, ceasar salad, bread with kombucha butter and various deserts, one of which is a new addition. The food was great as was the wine and service was phenomenal. Cassie's crew excellent job
description:
My spouse and I had the pleasure of dining around the world, and Quince/Madam Kew belongs in the top tier.

We walked in without a reservation to a full main dining room, but the staff had some room upstairs. Initially, we thought this would be “less than”, but the decor was that of an upscale, modern lounge with a great vibe.

Then came the menu… a Tomahawk in Ho Chi Minh City… YES!!!! We started with oysters which were presented and served uniquely and beautifully, and then dug into our Tommy with sides of some of the best “Not so Mashed Potatoes” and roasted cauliflower with whipped cheese.

You could tell there was a French influence throughout the service, and we were thrilled to see it.

The flavour, presentation, and service were excellent throughout the night. We enjoyed every bite. Probably too many bites, ha.

I suppose the Michelin Guide was right to feature this restaurant, but maybe they will get a star before too long.

name: Du Mien Garden Cafe
address: 7 Phan Van Tri Phuong 10, Quan Go Vap, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Coffee Gardens tend to be large scale here in Saigon, and this one is quite the daddy. Largely but not totally outdoors amid land and waterscaped gardens with beautiful flowers. The staff are reasonably attentive and the drinks arrive promptly. A great place to unwind over a coffee., Wow!! Once my wife Nga & I walked in we were amazed at the size of the café inside, amazing! Beautiful lights, Têt Luna New Year decorations, waterfalls & gardens. We had watermelon & sugar apple smoothie which was nice, I was expecting more flavor maybe. Café sua nong (hot w/milk) was great, I do love the smaller cups of Vietnamese coffee with great strong taste! I highly recommend Du Miên Garden Café to any café lovers whilst in Saigon as it's an experience in itself. They also had a great menue of food, & we saw many families eating, as was our's before they flew home to Hue. Càm òn rât nhiêu! :), Enjoy our time at the Cafe. Place is beautiful and tranquil in the middle of the Urban Jungle. Staff was helpful and friendly.
description: Coffee Gardens tend to be large scale here in Saigon, and this one is quite the daddy. Largely but not totally outdoors amid land and waterscaped gardens with beautiful flowers. The staff are reasonably attentive and the drinks arrive promptly. A great place to unwind over a coffee.

name: The Gangs
address: 32 Mac Dinh Chi Da Kao, Dist.1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant offers a diverse menu that blends traditional Vietnamese flavors with modern twists. The atmosphere is lively and upbeat, making it a great place for social gatherings or a fun night out. I have been here many times but almost at the weekend, especially on Saturday cuz they always organize surprise events. The staff is generally attentive and friendly, though service can sometimes be a bit slow during busy periods., This is a fun spot! We went on a Sunday night and discovered it as it’s just across from our hotel. The night time dinner vibe is loud and fun! Mostly big groups, lots of mini beer kegs on the tables, wine by the bottle only ( but reasonably priced and you can take bottle home with you). The food ( we shared one dish) was very tasty and served quickly. Steak on a hot stone. Maybe because it was crazy busy and loud we did not have a great server. He was very disinterested and ignored us. However…we really enjoyed the overall energy! I would recommend more for a party eve and not a quiet couples meal. I am not sure if it’s always like this. We enjoyed the music and food!, We stumbled upon The Urban Gangs in Ho Chi Minh and ended up going back the very next night—yep, it was that good! The vibe really picks up after 9 PM—it's electric and super contagious. The bartenders not only serve drinks but also dance and pull off fun tricks right on the main floor. It’s like dinner and a show rolled into one. We loved how the cocktails and beers come in towers—great for sharing and keeping the party going. The food was amazing too. We ordered the kimchi soup, chicken cartilage, and a big sharing platter. Everything was packed with flavor and perfect for the setting. If you're looking for a place with great music, high energy, awesome drinks, and tasty bites, The Urban Gangs is the spot. Highly recommend it for a fun night out in Ho Chi Minh City!
description: The restaurant offers a diverse menu that blends traditional Vietnamese flavors with modern twists. The atmosphere is lively and upbeat, making it a great place for social gatherings or a fun night out. I have been here many times but almost at the weekend, especially on Saturday cuz they always organize surprise events. The staff is generally attentive and friendly, though service can sometimes be a bit slow during busy periods.

name: Eddie's D1 New York Diner & Deli
address: 73 Pasteur Street, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: I stayed at this restaurant with friends because we felt like a nice hamburger after days of local cuisine. The place is faithfully reminiscent of the American ones, the staff is welcoming and friendly. We tasted the classic burgers (very good) with chips and coke (you can refill the drink for free once you finish). We spent about 10/15 € each, including two desserts that surprised us particularly, given the loyalty with those eaten in America., We looked up restaurants close by and Eddie's came on the scope. So we popped in for dinner and tried some burgers, what sensational burgers absolutely top class and the staff were attentive to our needs and happy to engage in friendly chat. We will definitely be back for more. Also the apple pie was the best. Our main man Tai who served us was the best., Eddie’s is the real deal! Started by an American ex-patriot from Minnesota, it serves up fresh, authentic diner food in a casual atmosphere. Where else can you get a tuna melt in Saigon? Eddie’s serves breakfast all day, along with burgers, cheese steaks, fries, onion rings and even chicken parm! Yes, they make their own ice cream, too. Servers are fluent in English, so there’s no menu-pointing required to order your favorites. When you’re half a world away from Katz’s and craving a corned beef Reuben, Eddie’s is the place.
description: With 3 convenient, tasty & fun locations in D1, D2 & D7 Eddie’s Deli & Diner is Saigon's Favorite Authentically American Dining Experience since 2018. We pride ourselves on our Good Food, Warm & Friendly Service, Awesome Shakes, 1950’s Diner Vibe & Huge American Menu with something for everyone! All of our cuisine is made in house using the finest ingredients for that Real- American taste. So what’s on the Menu? All-day breakfast, mouthwatering burgers, hotdogs, and deli sandwiches including our famous Reuben, juicy steaks & chicken, salads, soup, apps, full vegetarian menu & even an American Chinese Menu. We bake our own cinnamon buns and pies too. Kid’s love Eddie’s and we have a full menu for the little ones. Our Satisfaction Guarantee makes Eddie's the perfect place to enjoy a little taste of home. Please Visit us at 73 Pasteur in D1 71 Thao Dien in D2 408 Pham Thai Buong in D7. Eddie hopes to see you soon!

name: San Fu Lou Cantonese Kitchen Ho Chi Minh
address: 76A Le Lai Street, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Sanfulou chain of Hong Kong-style tea restaurants is located next to the First Bank in District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, and also close to Pham Ngu Lao Street. The dining environment is not bad and the decoration is antique. I ordered shrimp rice rolls, shumai with shiitake mushrooms, fried bean curd sticks, ribs with black bean sauce, braised Yi noodles with shredded black pepper and duck, and pearl milk tea (only after I ordered did I realize that the milk tea is Thai milk tea). The taste was acceptable and quite similar to Taiwan. . The price is on the high side. 10% VAT will be added to the menu price bill., I went to eat at San Fu Lou District 2, ordered dumplings, shrimp rolls, XO rolls, Chinese chicken feet, braised rib noodles. The dishes are seasoned just right, filled with shrimp and scallops in fresh dumplings. Service staff is fast and attentive., I got a delicious Dimsum, steamed cake and specialy is a milk tea with HongKong style. Service is reall good, staffs are friend, serve food quickly. San Fu Lou is one of Cantose restaurant that I like the most in HCM. Highly reccommended
description: San Fu Lou_ The house of three blessings. At our restaurant, we provide great tasty food, healthy cooking techniques and hygiene. At SFL, we take the traditional concept of a Chinese kitchen and bring it to a new level of sophistication with a contemporary Oriental ambience replete with the colours and material of a traditional Chinese "house". Our show kitchen, which is a first in Vietnam for a Chinese restaurant, allows diners to take in a visual feast before the food is served. This kitchen shows the guests the extensive Chinese influences which can be found in the Vietnamese culinary heritage today.These include the use of bean curd, stir-frying food, the use of chop-stick and wok, and so much more. SFL is a place to enjoy Chinese classics with handpicked teas and allows all guests to appreciate nostalgic tastes in these modern times.

name: Em Mời - Flavors Of Vietnam
address: 51 Lê Thị Hồng Gấm, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: I ordered the Spring Rolls Platter, and every bite was fresh and flavorful. My favorite? Pho Rolls with Beef—so light yet full of umami! I sat upstairs with a great view of the bustling streets, enjoying the relaxed atmosphere. Definitely coming back!, Tried the Minced Crab Hotpot, and it blew me away! The broth was slightly sour, rich with crab flavor, and paired perfectly with beef and fresh veggies. The open-air seating made the experience even better, and the staff was incredibly welcoming, always checking if I needed anything., I’ve tried a lot of Vietnamese food, but this place really stands out. Bánh Xèo, Cơm Tấm, and Minced Crab Hotpot—every dish had a unique taste, showcasing different regions of Vietnam. The staff made sure I understood how to eat everything properly, which I really appreciated as a foreigner!
description: ̛̀ Have you ever longed to savor crispy Bánh Xèo, refreshing Spring Rolls, or fragrant Nem Nướng all in one delightful meal? Join us at Em Mời for a heartfelt culinary journey that captures the essence of Vietnam's diverse regions: North, Central, and South. From the humble Cơm Tấm of Saigon, the savory Nem Cua Bể of Hai Phong, to the renowned Nem Nướng of Nha Trang, each dish is lovingly prepared with the freshest ingredients, embodying the true spirit of Vietnamese culture.

name: Pho Le
address: 415 Nguyen Trai, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: It's a legendary pho restaurant. The taste is addictive and makes you want more. Most of the people who eat here are not tourists but locals. Plus the portions are also big. If I may suggest, order the Thap Cam variant. Oh yes, the beef meatballs are also delicious, the beef is really tasty. At each table, serve 1 large plate filled with fresh vegetables, coriander leaves, bean sprouts, and lime. So if you are a vegetable lover, Vietnam is the right country. No wonder this restaurant won the Michelin award because the taste is delicious., It was a Vietnamese friend 🇻🇳 who lives in HCM who introduced us to this restaurant fifteen years ago. Located in District 5 on Nguyễn Trãi, a real neighborhood of life in HCM you can order the best Phở in the city. A fantastic broth, meat, perfect rice noodles you have on the table a mountain of herbs and soy, limes, sauces and chili peppers 🌶️ to customize your Pho 🍲 Very reasonable prices, and menu in English for those who don't read Vietnamese. Friendly and efficient service. Go and enjoy this iconic dish of Vietnamese cuisine at Phở Lệ, you will not be disappointed., Jinli is also a famous Vietnamese pho restaurant, but I feel that it may be a bit of a bully. This time in Ho Chi Minh City, I ate so many Michelin-recommended (2023) Vietnamese pho restaurants, and this is the only one that temporarily increased the price because of the Spring Festival. The taste is okay, but to be honest, it is quite difficult to make Vietnamese pho taste bad.

At each table, serve 1 large plate filled with fresh vegetables, coriander leaves, bean sprouts, and lime. So if you are a vegetable lover, Vietnam is the right country. No wonder this restaurant won the Michelin award because the taste is delicious.

name: Oc Đao
address: 212/C79 Nguyen Trai Street Nguyen Cu Trinh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: A street food Michelin Star restaurant. What a gem we found searching for the best Snail place in Ho Chi Minh. Oc Dao was so delicious that we wanted to order everything. The staff were very fast and attentive. They also have an inside sitting area so you don’t have to sit In the street to enjoy the food., It is one of the most popular snails seafood in saigon. Perhaps they take it for granted and do not care about service. It is super noisy place that you barely have a conversation with your friend. Its a shame as food is very tasty For vietnam living cost, price is quite pricey, What an experience. Was first time for us. Little overwhelmed but it was an amazing first time experience. Must try when you visit Ho Chi Minh city
description: A street food Michelin Star restaurant. What a gem we found searching for the best Snail place in Ho Chi Minh. Oc Dao was so delicious that we wanted to order everything. The staff were very fast and attentive. They also have an inside sitting area so you don’t have to sit In the street to enjoy the food.

name: Shoku
address: 22 Ngo Van Nam Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Very nice place that offers dishes of Japanese cuisine and more. They range from sashimi to sushi, including skewers and cooked meat. It has several tables some of which are located at the counter where they prepare dishes. We had dinner there, beautiful to see the care with which they prepare the dishes. Prices a little above average but definitely worth it. Friendly and professional staff. Bravo!! 👏🏻, The sound space is suitable for sitting, eating and chatting with friends I ordered many dishes but my favorite is this delicious fresh oyster dish, eaten with all 3 types of sauce Service is rated 9/10, there is Hong Nhung who talks charmingly and understands customers' wishes quite well, service is fast and fresh., The food is delicious, the ramen tastes just right to my taste. The fish is very fresh. If I have a chance, I will come back. Ms. Nhung and Mr. Khang served me very well and enthusiastically, always caring about the customer's experience. Really like the customer service here
description: Nestled in Ho Chi Minh City's bustling District 1, SHOKU elevates Japanese cuisine with fresh, imported ingredients, transformed by skilled chefs into delectable plates. The vibrant and cozy atmosphere fosters a dynamic dining experience, perfect for both intimate gatherings and lively encounters.

name: Phatty's Sports Bar & Grill
address: 46-48 Ton That Thiep Street District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: We went here for beers at lunchtime, lovely bar with air con and great staff. We decided to come back for dinner, Wednesday was steak night and as we’d eaten lots of Vietnamese food we fancied a change. Doug and Nathan are so welcoming, nothing is too much trouble and they were so accommodating to our needs (both dietary and our fussiness about wine). The steaks were incredible, some of the best we’ve ever tasted (great price too). This is such a friendly place, you won’t be disappointed., Great hospitality by Nicholas and his team. Highly recommend this bar for the expansive menu and drink selection, not to mention the service which was terrific! We experienced Phatty’s while watching the State of Origin where Nicholas put on a sausage sizzle for the patrons. A must to visit!, Phatty's Sports Bar & Grill is truly an ideal place to relax after a long day. The restaurant space is designed to be modern and cozy, creating a comfortable atmosphere for customers. Another big plus is the food menu here. Each dish is meticulously cared for and suitable for taste.
description: We went here for beers at lunchtime, lovely bar with air con and great staff. We decided to come back for dinner, Wednesday was steak night and as we’d eaten lots of Vietnamese food we fancied a change. Doug and Nathan are so welcoming, nothing is too much trouble and they were so accommodating to our needs (both dietary and our fussiness about wine). The steaks were incredible, some of the best we’ve ever tasted (great price too). This is such a friendly place, you won’t be disappointed.

name: House of Merlin - Cocktail Bar & Eatery
address: 178/1 Pasteur, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Cozy and inviting, it’s perfect for a quiet evening or catching up with friends. Vintage vibes with plush sofas and antique lamps make this whiskey bar feel like stepping back in time. Friendly and swift service adds to the welcoming atmosphere. Their Daiquiri is a must-try, perfectly blending rum, lime, and sugar. The Thai fish cakes were aromatic and well-spiced, a delightful pairing. The bartenders are true experts, ensuring each drink is crafted to perfection. Enjoyed a Thursday evening with their live jazz, which added to the warm, nostalgic ambiance. A spot to visit if you appreciate good whiskey and a warm atmosphere., get here on Tuesday evening and loved the lively atmosphere. The Negroni was expertly crafted, with a delightful balance of bitter and sweet. The fish and chips were crispy and flavorful, ideal with the drink. The bar's retro vibe, complete with Edison bulbs and exposed brick, adds to its charm. Live jazz performances on Tuesdays and Thursdays are a definite highlight. Perfect spot for a fun night out with friends., House of Merlin’s signature menu, designed like an ancient magic book, added a whimsical touch to my evening. I ordered a Whiskey Sour, which was tangy and refreshing. The bartenders also recommended some snacks, and the truffle fries were absolutely delicious. The combination of great cocktails and tasty snacks made for a perfect night out in Ho Chi Minh City.
description: an unique cocktail bar, inspired by the world of 19th-century industrial aesthetics, located in the Heart of Saigon. --Find us at: 178/1 Pasteur St., Dist 1, Ho Chi Minh City

name: Sorae
address: 36 Ho Tung Mau Street Level 51, Bitexco Financial Tower, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Super nice view. Make sure you're on the right side! Keep going! It's obviously more expensive than on the street, but it's worth it. The sushi lunch was great with starter and dessert included. You also save on the entrance fee for the viewing platform;), Overall, my shop gives it a 9/10 overall. The view of the restaurant is beautiful and has an overview of the city, especially at night I quite like the atmosphere and complete separation from the bustling city below. There is no need to discuss space when the date takes place here. Music is indispensable, here I was impressed that the music was quite good, especially the violin performed quite attractively. Regarding the food, I have known Chef Tuan Anh's skills for quite a long time, so I am always satisfied with the dishes at the restaurant, the eye-catching presentation makes the meal easier to conquer diners, to work with Chef Tuan Anh and the kitchen staff are also quite meticulous in each step of dish preparation. The staff's service is quite good, tables, chairs and tableware are always complete and neat. I highly recommend everyone to dine here, especially on important occasions such as dates, meetings with important partners, intimate family parties... experiencing delicious food on a high floor in the heart of the city. With delicious cuisine, eye-catching decoration and good service, attention to all the diners' senses is quite enjoyable., Recently I went to Sorae for lunch - the feeling was "WOW" - The restaurant has a super diverse set lunch - bento menu. Eating while enjoying the view of the entire city at such an office price is a great deal. The Faculty staff provided very good service. very enthusiastic and thoughtful. Will come back here many more times.
description: “SORAE” – Phía trên bầu trời, giống như chính tên gọi của mình, SORAE là một trong những nhà hàng Nhật Bản có tầm nhìn ngoạn mục nhất và cũng là điểm đến lý tưởng nằm ngay giữa trung tâm Sài Gòn. SORAE là một trong những nhà hàng Nhật Bản với phong cách ẩm thực sành điệu bậc nhất và là điểm đến nhất định phải biết của dân sành ăn ở trung tâm của thành phố. Nơi đây sẽ là địa điểm lý tưởng cho những vị thực khách muốn tận hưởng những trải nghiệm ẩm thực độc đáo của Nhật Bản và đắm mình trong nét đẹp văn hóa của Tokyo ngay tại Sài Gòn hoa lệ.

name: Hoi An Sense - Central Vietnamese Cuisine
address: 12 Phan Ke Binh, Dakao Ward, District 1 Rooftop, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The Viking cruise 61 passengers dined in this beautiful restaurant with an indoor koi pond and live music provided by 3 Vietnamese musicians. We had a set menu served family style. On the menu was Rice pancakes with scallops Fried spring rolls with crab & pork Sautéed prawns Sautéed beef Wilted bright green spinach Steamed rice Coconut & chocolate ice cream, Very nice place with a very stylish welcome! When you arrive you will pass a large fish pond with a typical Vietnamese music orchestra! Frequented by the local bourgeoisie, the cuisine is good, without frills! It is not very modern but nicely presented to tastes made for all palates. Large wine list. Don’t come too late because after 8:30 p.m. the room is almost empty, the orchestra has finished a long time ago and you can hear the disturbing noises from tidying up at the end of the evening! Come around 7:00 p.m. to enjoy the atmosphere!, Took the family here on our last night in HCMC. Made a reservation in advance - this was towards end of the Lunar Year Holiday - expected it to be busy but ended up having the entire place to ourselves. At first a bit awkward but the staff were wonderful and soon we were enjoying ourselves immensely. The menu was wonderful and the entertainment was fabulous also. Not sure why they aren't getting more traffic as I noticed others have had same experience but this place was great and highly recommend.
description: In the past 21 years, Hội An Sense (previous named as Hội An Restaurant) has always been recognized worldwide for its culinary excellence and extraordinary interior. Drawing influences from vibrant flavours of Vietnam’s central region, Hội An Sense is a new exploration of gourmet Vietnamese cuisine in a restaurant that exhales both exquisite and lavish.

name: Hello SaiGon Vietnamese Fusion Food
address: Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Thank you to our server Vivian and hello Saigon for a lovely meal! Really varied vegetarian options (especially the vegan lemongrass ribs which were really unique and tasty) and reasonable prices . Also Vivian was so helpful explaining all the dishes to us and giving us recommendations. Thanks again!!, Lovely little place out of the way down a picturesque lane way. Vivian served us and she was really lovely - making recommendations and even talking a bit about the history of chopsticks as our kids worked towards being able to competently use them 😊 A lovely meal in a great setting - recommend 😊, Everything was great: the food, the welcome, the atmosphere and the music (you would have thought my music playlist: English pop rock). Thanks to Henry for his welcome and for advising us on the house's flagship dish. Very good ! Everything was very good. We had: pineapple shrimp, grilled squid, garlic bread, pineapple ribs. This is the right address in Saigon: good home-cooked meals at very affordable prices. Ice cubes are safe (with drinking water): we saw an ice cube delivery man passing by.
description: Thank you to our server Vivian and hello Saigon for a lovely meal! Really varied vegetarian options (especially the vegan lemongrass ribs which were really unique and tasty) and reasonable prices . Also Vivian was so helpful explaining all the dishes to us and giving us recommendations. Thanks again!!

name: Bếp Chú Tễu
address: 22 Trần Quốc Toản Phường Võ Thị Sáu, Quận 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700901 Vietnam
reviews: A restaurant with a very Vietnamese folk style and colors. The airy restaurant brings a very close feeling to family dishes. The friendly staff is very enthusiastic to support customers. The menu and every corner of the restaurant are very neat. The important thing is that the food is very suitable for general taste as well as reasonable price, Very nice and friendly staff that made us feel welcome right away. Food was delicious and came with both smile and extra explanation. Can recommend., Delicious , traditional Viet Nam food , comfortable space good serve and warm free fruit for desert i love it ❤️❤️ will come again
