name: Quán Bụi
address: 222 - 224 Le Thanh Ton, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews:
Were here for dinner together. Excellent interior, there is a special shelf with original ceramics - you can not only eat deliciously ) choice of dishes very large , pleased very detailed menu with pictures - so choose more convenient and easier ) excellent service / quickly, unobtrusive and clear. Everything was delicious, the food was fresh. The cost of dinner was a pleasant pleasure. I recommend, This place is like a high end but very relaxed restaurant. It is a lot better than the average Vietnamese restaurant. huge selection of properly looked after wine. We had two seafood entrees two main courses, 4 Tiger draft beers, 3 sodas, and a desert and it cost VND1.2million which is the equivalent of AUD$72. I’ve been to Saigon six times over the last 10 years, and for its price this is probably the best restaurant if you want something a little bit more classy, with proper service, without the standard attitude. Highly recommend. And actually clean toilets to boot! we will be back, probably in two days…, Great food in the heart of Ho Chi Minh District 1. Located 200mt from the Ben Thanh market, this place has a wonderful atmosphere, beautiful ambience and a wide range of authentic Vietnamese dishes. Here food is prepared with care, ingredients are fresh, service is attentive and our waiter Honee advised us on how to consume each dish according to the Vietnamese traditions. Prices are very honest. We loved this restaurant and will definitely be back! Quán Bụi earns rave reviews for its attentive service, with many diners commending the staff's promptness and courtesy. The restaurant's ambiance is a hit among guests, who appreciate the blend of elegance and traditional Vietnamese culture in its decor.

While the diverse menu of authentic Vietnamese dishes is celebrated by patrons, one did find the spring rolls chewy. However, the overall value is lauded, with most reviewers finding the quality of the cuisine to be well worth the cost.
description: Nowhere else in Southeast Asia but VietNam, the cultural mix between East and West seems to be so apparent, especially in its architecture. Welcome to Quán Bụi, another Vietnamese restaurant concept brought to you by Quán Bụi Group, one of the most renowned and beloved restaurants in Vietnam. Drawing inspiration from the traditional flavors and cultural heritage of the ancient town of Hội An, our restaurant aims to capture the essence of Vietnamese cuisine in a contemporary and inviting setting. At Quán Bụi, we celebrate the rich tapestry of Vietnamese flavors, carefully preserving the authenticity of each. Our menu showcases a wide range of culinary delights, from classic street food favorites to regional specialties. Every dish at Quán Bụi is thoughtfully crafted using the freshest local ingredients and traditional cooking techniques, ensuring an unforgettable dining experience.

name: Di Mai Ben Thanh - Vietnamese Restaurant
address: 136-138 Đ. Lê Thị Hồng Gấm, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I came to the restaurant while it is not really busy but it took them a minute to welcome and take us to the table. The food came after 20 mins after placing order, however, the food seem okay with my own taste. The deserts here The service here is really good. I would rate 3/5 for food, service 5/5., We arrived late afternoon in HCM and wanted a place to have an early dinner. The concierge recommended Di Mai as it is located in the mall just next to our Hotel. Located on the 2nd floor, Di Mai ( which means "Aunty Mai") serves great Vietnamese food that is wholesome and packed full of the use of local spices that tantalise the taste buds. We ordered their signature dishes such as prawns with Coconut bits, fried siew mai and fish in tangy sweet & sour sauce. Paired with just a simple bowl of steamed white rice, we had an amazing dinner. The service staff were very attentive and made sure our every need was attended to. The restaurant's ambience also added to make our dining experience an unforgettable one., Very nice clean restaurant inside a mall serving various Vietnamese dishes. Our waitress is a very nice young lady patiently helped us chosing the foods. Foods are great. We will come again third time.
description: From the deep notion of Vietnamese, their cuisine is invariably attached to the image of rustic countryside food. Paying Di Mai a visit; However, diners would be astonished by the subtle and distinctive architecture language between the Vietnamese countryside and Indo-Chinese, reminiscent of the good old Saigon streets.

name: Dong Pho
address: 57 Ho Xuan Huong District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Lovely food and nice place! Had the tasting menu and got to taste the most delicious dishes! If you want to try the different authentic Vietnamese dishes I recommend it! The dessert in particular was festive and very tasty, with surprising textures/tastes - and not something I would order myself. They also had good wine (new zealand chardonnay)., The owner went to a premier cooking school in France, so in addition to specialising in Huế cuisine, it has some French dishes! There are more authentic Huế restaurants in Saigon, but this is by far the most upmarket one, and it’s pretty good, so it’s extremely popular with expats and rich overseas Vietnamese. Service is good, but certainly not what you should expect at this price level in Vietnam., We stumbled upon this place through the place we planned to eat from the Michelin app being fully booked - so glad we did ! We ordered a couple of appies which were shrink and pork spring rolls (awesome) and shrimp on toast (amazing) the. I had seafood fried rice which was possibly the best fried rice I have ever had - honestly amazing Well worthy of its Michelin listing and so glad we found it - and then gelato next door - boom mind blown Rob
description: Delicious Vietnamese food from Hue and Central Vietnam

name: Cyclo Resto
address: 133 Nguyen Du, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: I had the pleasure of attending a private cooking class for a corporate event, and it was an unforgettable experience. I was picked up on a bicycle and rode through the vibrant streets of the city to the market, to learn more about the ingredients used in Vietnamese cooking. The market tour was an eye-opening experience … with some rats running around!! Afterward, I headed to the kitchen, where I got hands-on preparing delicious chicken noodle soup and crispy Vietnamese pancakes. The it was time to taste the dishes I had just crafted, all while learning the techniques behind each recipe. It was a thrilling, educational, and truly memorable adventure., This is a family-run restaurant in Saigon. Young respectful lady serving. The menu is not extensive but the food is tasty. We ordered the daily meal for about 250k dong per person, which included, chicken, seafood, and pork dishes from around the country. The quantity was a bit on the low side, but the food was good, and the meal concludes with a decent egg coffee. The seating area is nice and the restaurant allows the customers to write on their wall, so I did (check the photo). Recommended!, We had the family meal, everything was delicious. I don’t eat seafood so the friendly staff altered the menu so I was able to eat the same food as my husband without any hassle, very accommodating. While everything we had was amazing the surprise was the pancakes and the coconut ice-cream, my first time eating Vietnamese pancake and wow so much flavour !
description: Cyclo Resto is an origional Vietnamese cuisine restaurant. We serve you the real taste of Vietnamese food.

name: Sushi Taka
address: 8A/A22 Thai van lung, Ben nghe wards, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 00700 Vietnam
reviews: Cozy hidden restaurant, located on the upper floor. Must walk thru another izakaya, up a narrow staircase. Authentic. Fresh seafood flown in from Japan daily. Must try, very good sushi when i came back 1 more time, it’s white valantine , many people but all thing serve well, exited all the time i come back, looking forwards for next trip, i went to sushi taka omakase restaurant with my group of friend, it's was an amazing dinner expirient at there, the quality of sushi is so good, most of the fish is imported from japan, & the chef is ver nice to talking with him, will be back next time again
description:
Cozy hidden restaurant, located on the upper floor. Must walk thru another izakaya, up a narrow staircase.
Authentic. Fresh seafood flown in from Japan daily.
Must try

name: Ocean Palace
address: Le Duan 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Walking inside you notice a large restaurant basically in white with high ceilings. Very attractive space. For entrees we had diced chicken with chili. It was unlike the picture as it contains many different vegetables. The noodles with seafood contained many items of seafood. My wife had birds nest soup that she really enjoyed. Service was professional and attentive making sure our teacups remained full and replacing our napkins and dirty plates. Prices, except for the birds nest soup were high but reasonable considering the quality of the cuisine., Excellent as usual. And very suprised with the new drink which not on the menu yet. Hong Kong milktea. Impressive with the cute milktea bear. 🥰, Cosy ambient and good food. All the cantonese food you crave is found here. Their crew speaks fluent cantonese.

name: S79 - Japanese Teppanyaki
address: 772 Đ. Điện Biên Phủ Phường 22, Bình Thạnh, Toà Nhà Landmark, Ho Chi Minh City 55577 Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant has a cozy, romantic, and quiet space. The dishes are attentively by Chef little by little, in terms of quality, it must be said to be the best, very suitable. Try once to experience and feel impressed and will forever remember the moment in this place. Thank you to the staff here for showing me that outside the space has a view of the whole city, not only for the quality of the food, but also for the way you welcome guests hospitably and cherish every moment of your guests. How is the item. Will definitely come back here someday., This was an absolutely amazing experience. The food was mind blowing and unique. The staff was attentive, kind and very professional. THE FOOD WAS ONE OF A KIND! The chef would come and explain each dish individually and how meticulous the preparation was for each. Highly recommend coming and participating in the 7 course meal., I went here with my friends as a group of 5 and picked set menu with 7 dishes. I like how beautiful Saigon looks at night from floor 79 of the building. Stunning view! Food is really well done with fresh ingredients and fine techniques. The presentation of the dishes was good. The dessert was presented by the chef introducing the cooking techniques. We had a fun and yummy dining experience here.
description: S°79 - a restaurant located on the 79th floor of the Landmark Building with a fine-dining style. Like culture and society, food is always adapting and evolving. It is that development and creativity motivate Tommy to establish Sº79 - a stage for him and his team to pursue contemporary Asian cuisine in order to bring the magic of food closer to diners. In every simplicity, there is always a hidden beauty. That philosophy is what Sº79 - Skyline Dining delivers through space, sophisticated dishes, and fine dining services.

name: SENS - Dine & Wine
address: 36 Đ. Hồ Tùng Mậu 52nd Floor, Bitexco Financial Tower, Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: An ideal place for couples, extremely beautiful view. There is also a private space, VIP room for guests who book parties, guests on tours... The price is quite stable, the food is delicious and suits my taste very well. Going at night is so beautiful, you can freely live virtual life in every corner of NH. A recommended place for people to go this Tet if they don't know where to go.^^, If you are a fan of French cuisine and looking for a place in the center of SG because you are afraid to go far but still want to find a luxurious space without being disturbed or street noise, this is the right place for you. . I experienced it here and I really liked it Afternoon and evening are the two times I recommend you to visit here, Reasonable date place, nice view + quiet. Rcm tried the restaurant's Beef Tartare and Duck Breast, very delicious. Quality food goes hand in hand with price.
description: At SENS - Dine & Wine, our culinary philosophy is centered around delivering dishes that are nothing short of perfection. Each creation is meticulously prepared with the freshest, finest ingredients, reflecting the passionate, creative touch of our chefs. From preparation to presentation, every detail is handled with utmost care and sophistication. At SENS, we often prioritize the on-site dining experience, placing value on the presentation and ambiance of the restaurant. We focus on creating a cheerful and intimate atmosphere for our guests, allowing them to fully immerse themselves in the culinary art and culture. Therefore, we only provide dine-in service and do not offer takeout. This ensures that every aspect of the dining experience is meticulously curated, from the exquisite dishes to the attentive service.

name: Cơm Niêu Sài Gòn
address: 27 Tú Xương, Phường Võ Thị Sáu Quận 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Situated near downtown Ho Chi Minh, is this enchanting colonial Vitenamese house turned into a restaurant serving Vitenamese cuisine. Popular with locals as well as tourist. They had a dish where the rice in a claypot was broken purposely and thrown in the air where another server catches the flying cooked rice to be served at the table. Its all show! The highlight was their stir fried pumpkin flower, deep fried soft shell crab. Other food was acceptable but no wow factor! Price was on the higher plain but service was good. A memorable dinner., G4Fun selected our first group dinner at Com Nieu Sai Gon to try out Vietnamese cuisine. We selected the non AC part of the restaurant and had our seats right in front of the live band. The restaurant has a very wide selection of basic food and high end entities. There were a number of pre-order items like wild boar. Other exotic dishes included special blood cockles, pond snails and clams. Our group were subdivided into smaller groups of six. My group of six ordered the basic foods. 6 We had their signature clayport rice where one staff member will "throw" the cooked rice in the cooked pot from one end of the room for another member to "catch" the rice intact. The order taker recommended a special belly fish cooked with a unique sauce. This fish is very fresh and tasty. Also ate two kinds of vegetables and a chicken dish. We also selected seafood soup. All the dishes were satisfactory. We also took the occasion to celebrate a member's birthday. This has been one tradition the G4Fun group has been practising for many years now, a legacy to cherish., Nothing was BAD here. Just nothing was memorable. The crock rice makes for a nice show, but honestly, it was kinda lackluster and the actual eating wasn't great. I came here because of Bourdain, but to be honest, in rewatching the episode, I'm not sure he liked it, but was just too polite to say so. It felt like the Vietnamese version of the Olive Garden.
description: Situated near downtown Ho Chi Minh, is  this enchanting colonial Vitenamese house turned into a restaurant serving Vitenamese cuisine. Popular with locals as well as tourist. They had a dish where the rice in a claypot was broken purposely and thrown in the air where another server catches the flying cooked rice to be served at the table. Its all show! The highlight was their stir fried pumpkin flower, deep fried soft shell crab. Other food was acceptable but no wow factor! Price was on the higher plain but service was good. A memorable dinner.

name: The Vintage Emporium Đa Kao
address: 95B Nguyen Van Thu, Da Kao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Had a delightful evening at Vintage Emporium! The ambiance was charming with a perfect blend of vintage decor and modern comfort. The food was exceptional, with fresh, flavorful dishes that showcased the best of both Vietnamese and Australian cuisine. The service was friendly and attentive, making our dining experience even more enjoyable. Highly recommend it for a unique and memorable meal in Ho Chi Minh City!, The food was amazing, the service was excellent - I had a hearty breakfast which was delicious - I really enjoyed it here and would recommend this place to anyone everyone. I sat outside and watched the world go by. Lots of plants outside and the, A quiet and peaceful place to have brunch! The food was also really decent - I had the soufflé omelette with mushrooms, paired with a glass of iced vietnamese coffee (while my partner had a sandwich) and it was very enjoyable. Will definitely recommend TVE to others that are coming to HCM :)
description: With an eclectic mix of vintage chic French decor fused with Indochina flavor the Vintage Emporium aims to be the only venue for a tranquil retreat in the frenetic city of Saigon. Serving proven classics with an emphasis on quality ingredients, food & beverage, and impeccable service we aim to be the first choice for those both Vietnamese and from abroad.

name: SH Garden
address: 26 Dong Khoi, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: We got some really delicious food. Some small different spring rolls to share and two different main courses. Their fried rice with prawns was absolutely fantastic with just the right amount of crisp and soft and a good taste. Good space around the tables and even though it was full, it was a nice sound level and a staff that was ready with good service all the time. The only downside is that not everyone is that good at English, but then they quickly found a colleague. Can only be recommended., We walked over to the restaurant after watching the AO Lune show at the opera house. The coconut salad and spring roll assortment were very good. The rest (chicken, pork belly and stir fried morning glory) were above average but nothing exceptional. Service was attentive, the place was buzzing and vibes were pleasant with live piano music and a view over a busy street. All in all, a good restaurant in a central location for delicious Vietnamese food., First tip: Book! It’s the only restaurant we’ve arrived at in Vietnam this trip not to be able to fit us in. That alone says a lot. Great food, great drinks, but what really stood out was just how good the mostly quite young staff were. This, to me, is the key sign of excellent management. Each table was cleaned perfectly after guests left, each chair was placed perfectly - in perfectly alternating colours of course! And we sat next to the guitarist playing popular songs on a classical guitar. Lovely! Hats off to our waiter Minh Khang!
description:
We got some really delicious food. Some small different spring rolls to share and two different main courses. Their fried rice with prawns was absolutely fantastic with just the right amount of crisp and soft and a good taste.
Good space around the tables and even though it was full, it was a nice sound level and a staff that was ready with good service all the time. The only downside is that not everyone is that good at English, but then they quickly found a colleague. Can only be recommended.

name: El Gaucho | Phu My Hung
address: 103 Ton Dat Tien Unit Cr1-U3, The Crescent, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: El Gaucho is THE place to eat if you want to experience perfect steak. It’s all about the meat here, no unnecessary extras. Just perfectly cooked steak. I chose the New York Strip with side of fries and thick pepper sauce. Cooked to perfection. (Medium plus) and my wife had sirloin. Toffee vodka shot (complimentary) was a nice way to end meal. Not the cheapest of places to eat but certainly worth it for a special ‘treat’ and it restored our faith in finding the perfect steak. Probably the best steak I’ve eaten anywhere! You have to pay for quality sometimes., El Gaucho - El Fantastico - El expensivo!!! But worth it. The service is excellent thanks Mr Trung (Tom from Tom and Jerry) and the steaks USDA are to die for. We had the Chateaubriand and the Lambchops to share among 4. The chicken liver was a bit soft for us and the chef swapped it for some unbelievable prawns at no Cost. Try their Caramel Liquer which is in-house made and we had a chocolate cake for dessert to top up our Vietnam holiday !!, Really, everything perfect - including that entrecote so tender that I can cut it with a finger. perfect - the caesar salad, the garlic, burrata, the caramel vodca...And if there is one single thing I can criticise is the chorizo served with the provoleta, a bit strange consistence, but still with great flavour. Gorgeous steak, spicy prices, Stanley Tucci heading a team that presents a great dinner in this steakhouse.
description: Food is our passion and it is our aim to establish the benchmark in Southeast Asia and beyond for a contemporary, specialised steakhouse concept. We are proud to serve you the finest steakhouse-style food, using only the best available meat products sourced from selected farms in Victoria, New South Wales and individual farmers and ranchers in the United States.

name: Soul Ben Thanh Restaurant & Bar
address: 7 Thu Khoa Huan Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We stumbled onto this place on our last night and left satisfied. We ordered spring rolls, fish dish, beef rice, beef salad, mushroom dish and two watermelon juices. Drinks arrived promptly. Our mushroom and rice arrived first, we waited 5 min for the salad then a few minutes the spring rolls and fish arrived. The spring rolls were oily, and we've eaten a lot in Ho Chi Minh, so was a little disappointing. Because everywhere else had been amazing. As for the rest of our meal we were very satisfied and our waiter Thanh was very nice and courteous. Everyone's experiences are different, the restaurant was not overly busy, only half of the upper level was occupied. But all in all we were happy., Hannah who served us was beyond friendly - she was so lovely to talk to and she actually took the time to explain a little about her life. Which we found extremely charming and considerate, especially in a busy restaurant. We had the beef (350g) enough for two with vege fried rice and morning glory. All in all a great place to escape the heat of a nearby market. 10/10, Soul Ben Thanh Rest & Bar, Ho Chi Minh 7 Thu Khoa Huan Phurong Ben The restaurant is up the stairs one flight. The two of us shared the fresh shrimp spring rolls and the huge seafood pancake (think crepe with seafood). All good. Would return.
description: Level 1 & 2 offers a full day dining experience as it opens its doors from 08:00 Am for breakfast/ Coffee and continues on for lunch and entertains last order for dinner at 02.00 Am. Diners have the option to dine in non-smoking airconditioned area and an outdoor alfresco at level 1 and a balcony view on level 2 that has a view like no other. The surprise comes after 10.30pm when levels 1 & 2 transform into a music bar that feeds your soul with songs from the 70’s - 80’s that plays in the background as you enjoy conversations or choose to sing and dance along to your favorite songs. Level 3 is a Rooftop bar which opens at 4 pm for Happy Hour till 6pm. Place for those who want to impress or be impressed. Reservations are recommended to avoid disappointment.

name: Quan Ut Ut - Vo Van Kiet
address: 168 Vo Van Kiet Phuong Cau Ong Lanh, Q.1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Come back after 6 years and the restaurant still retains the old flavor. Ordering the bbq grilled pork rib combo is very suitable for a large group, it comes with grilled vegetables and fries. But the most captivates me is the crispy fried chicken skin, I just want to order it again and again, and gain. There are also soft drink refills and chilling music. Cute friendly staff. Reasonable prices, free parking. Lovely place., The ribs were excellent as well as the Mac and Cheese. The service is a little slow and other guests in our party said the chicken was a little dry. So if you come to enjoy, I recommend what they are known for. Eat those ribs!, Would have got a rack of traditional, but was with a VN friend and thought she might prefer the other flavors, so I ordered the 4 flavor combo. Tried all except dry rub. Even my VN friend agreed, traditional was by far the best. If they sold them in St. Louis, they'd still be good. 'Sweet and spicy' Korean style wad ok but would be better with more spice and less sweet. Other two were ok. I would give them 5 stars BUT how can you claim to be a Western style restaurant and not have salt and pepper on the table? I've been here a few times and always seem to have the same interaction with the waitress. I ask for salt, her English isn't too good so she thinks I said 'sausce' and tells me it's already on the table. Then I have to break out google translate. She gives me a weird look like 'why do u need salt?' but says 'ok.' But then she forgets and I have to remind her when she brings my food. Now I have to sit there and stare at my food for two minutes while I wait for her to bring it. Those will most likely be the longest 2 minutes of my day. Owners, please, spare your customers this hassle. Just put salt and pepper on the table. It inot that hard to do.
description: Fast food it ain't. At Quán Ụt Ụt we are serious about pig, so we take our time to slowly barbecue it to perfection. Pure smoked SLOW perfection. And there's nothing quite like a freshly brewed Pale Ale to get those juices flowing.But hey, 'nuff said. We had you at 'oink'.

name: Bep Nha Xu Quang
address: 16 Tran Cao Van Dakao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Wonderful traditional Vietnamese food from the middle of Vietnam. I love their mi quang and chicken wings fried with fish sauce coming along with pandan sticky rice. So yummy. Service here is also great. I had a very good dinner with my family., Very tasty, innovative restaurant with great, authentic south vietnamese dishes. The interior design is very elegant and the service was friendly ... the only thing that bothered us was the choice of music, Not the type of review you expect but I want to share my experience about this great place. I was walking near this restaurant when suddenly very, very heavy rain started. I did not have an umbrella so raced under the awning of this restaurant. The rain continued so I decided to sit on one of their comfortable chairs and wait till the rain eased. After 10 minutes it was still raining when a waiter came out to me and gave me a glass of tea. I said that I had not ordered anything then he told me it was compliments from the manager. Wow, what a welcoming experience. I love how friendly the people of Vietnam are......he could have easily asked me to move away so I presume the food service is just as inviting.
description: Located in the heart of Saigon, Bep Nha Xu Quang is an authentic Vietnamese restaurant that will take you onto an adventure of discovering the culture of Vietnam, through the many delicious dishes from all over the country and the cozy, home-like yet sophisticated atmosphere.

name: Nhà Hàng Chay Tuệ
address: 76 Đ. Mai Thị Lựu Đa Kao, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Vegetarian restaurant with many delicious, strange, beautiful and unique dishes. It can be said that this is the art of vegetarianism. Beautiful, quiet space, ordering food is quick, enthusiastic and attentive staff. The owner of this restaurant has definitely invested a lot of effort into Tue vegetarian restaurant, so every experience is very good. I am very confident in inviting my partners and family to vegetarian Tue. We hope that Tue vegetarian will open more branches so that we can invite partners to dine in. Every district has a Tue vegetarian restaurant to enjoy., The restaurant space is very beautiful, the 3rd floor at Tran Hung Dao branch has a very solemn Buddha statue. The service staff enthusiastically advises customers. The food is very delicious, especially the mango sticky rice with young coconut butter sweet soup., The restaurant's space is a meditation style, very suitable for everyone. Anyone who is stressed due to all aspects of life can come here and talk together, slowly enjoying wonderful Asian and European dishes, which makes me happy. What I really like about this restaurant is that it has a main hall with a statue of the Medicine Buddha as if healing an internal wound. This is a place worth visiting.
description: Tue's Vegetarian Restaurant has a variety of regional courses: - Bringing customers quality vegetarian meals - Diverse experiences in taste, unique layout and most especially physical health as well as mental health - Spirituality Space with Buddhism inspiration - Located in the center of District 1, Chay Tue is an oasis of serenity amidst the bustling city. - Tue's Vegetarian Restaurant has a capacity of more than 300 diners with 4 spiritual spaces (ground floor and 3 floors) invested in luxurious and delicate display with Buddha image with deep spiritual meaning. - At the same time, the restaurant has a shared and private space arrangement for the most complete experience.

name: Haidilao
address: 2 Hai Trieu 2nd Floor. Bitexco Tower, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Haidilao Hot Pot is a well-known Chinese chain that has gained popularity worldwide. Let’s break down the key aspects of our visit: Fresh Ingredients and Flavorful Broth: The food at Haidilao lives up to its reputation. The tomato and chicken soup base are particularly delicious. Don’t miss out on the prawn paste, which adds a delightful twist to your hot pot experience. Service Excellence: Haidilao is renowned for its exceptional service. From providing manicures to offering aprons and handphone plastic covers, they go the extra mile. The attentive wait staff also prepare your food tableside. It’s a great place to enjoy a meal with friends or family. Hidden Costs and Price Value: While the overall experience is positive, it’s essential to note that Haidilao isn’t cheap. Expect to spend at least $35 per person. The soup base alone costs $20! Additionally, there are hidden costs such as sauces ($4) and drinks ($3 per person), so factor those into your bill. In summary, Haidilao Hot Pot offers a flavorful journey, excellent service, and a cozy ambiance. If you’re willing to splurge a bit, it’s worth a visit., Hadilao is a standout for its exceptional customer service. Although there is often a long wait time, customers don’t mind thanks to the various amenities offered while waiting, such as snacks, tea, ice cream, free nail services, and photo printing. I’ve visited all the branches in Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, and Guangzhou, China, and have consistently received excellent service. While the food is generally well-prepared, adding a bit more pork to the menu would make it even better. The ginseng hot pot broth is truly fantastic., We went here twice with family and had a blast. It’s Hot Pot dining at its best Free ice cream, toys, while waiting and ladies can have their nails done while waiting! Impeccably clean and excellent service The choice of broths and items to put in the hot pot at each table was endless Fun fun fun!
description:
Haidilao Hot Pot is a well-known Chinese chain that has gained popularity worldwide. Let’s break down the key aspects of our visit:

Fresh Ingredients and Flavorful Broth: The food at Haidilao lives up to its reputation. The tomato and chicken soup base are particularly delicious. Don’t miss out on the prawn paste, which adds a delightful twist to your hot pot experience.
Service Excellence: Haidilao is renowned for its exceptional service. From providing manicures to offering aprons and handphone plastic covers, they go the extra mile. The attentive wait staff also prepare your food tableside. It’s a great place to enjoy a meal with friends or family.
Hidden Costs and Price Value: While the overall experience is positive, it’s essential to note that Haidilao isn’t cheap. Expect to spend at least $35 per person. The soup base alone costs $20! Additionally, there are hidden costs such as sauces ($4) and drinks ($3 per person), so factor those into your bill.
In summary, Haidilao Hot Pot offers a flavorful journey, excellent service, and a cozy ambiance. If you’re willing to splurge a bit, it’s worth a visit.

name: Shanti Indian Cuisine
address: 26 Nguyen Cu Trinh Street Pham Ngu Lao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: While shopping, I accidentally saw many stalls here so I went in to try Indian food. Unusual dishes you should try, very easy to eat, very reasonable price. I tried butter chicken and I will come back to try more dishes, I’m among the lucky ones to found this place. The food is delicious at very reasonable price, especially for district 1. I and my friends both love the foods. We tried only a few starter disks and a couple of curry disks with naan and everything is tasty. Have to mention a bout the host hospitality. She have a big love for Indian food and people. Don’t shy to ask for her recommendation when you not sure what to order. It was a memorable night out when we finished our food it was raining out side and she offer to take our motorbike overnight and lend us a umbrella., While on a cruise staying in HCMC some of the cruise staff invited us out with them for an Indian! I was greatly suprised to find this excellent restaurant, they had been before so it came with no suprise we had a great service, food was excellent. I consider myself to have good knowledge of Indian food, this was v very good. Curries excellent. Was not the cheapest meal but it was one of the best over the four day stay we had.
description: Shanti restaurant's style are Indian cuisine with all chefs from India. Our restaurant serves mainly Moslem, people follow Islam,as well as foreigners want to try Indian food. Restaurant have wide space with 2 floors. In floor one,we have a V.I.P room for tourist group,can handle for 40 peoples.

name: The Long @ Times Square
address: 22-36 Nguyen Hue Boulevard, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: I visited at the Long @ Time square several times during the lunch time, but also at dinner time. (great escape for rainy day) Their food (drinks also) are very good value for the money. For example their midweek lunch 3 courses set menu deal 228000VND (9$) is very good. As it’s their Happy Hour deals (midweek 4pm-7pm) drinks are “buy one get one free” and weekend (11am-7pm) food and drinks are “buy one get one free”. And prices are very good, to consider that the long is part of the 6* hotel. Their menu has wide range of something to everybody..local food, asian food, italia food, salads, small snacks etc. not forgetting their 16 different flavors gelato bar. All my visits i was well take care of Ms. Ngoc and the other great staff that works there I highly recommend to visit at the Long, if you are around city center of Ho Chi Minh., We were lucky to dine in the outside terrace area of this restaurant on the night that the Vietnam National Football team played in the Asean Cup final and won. The atmosphere was electric but what really blew me away was the incredible and attentive service of the staff. Our food, which was delicious, came at a steady pace throughout the night and they constantly ensured we had drinks. Every time we ordered a new round of drinks, it came very quickly. The staff also ensured we got into the spirit of the game by giving us a flag and little flag stickers to put on our faces. The staff were incredibly friendly. At the end of the night when we were leaving, our waitress even hugged me. I cannot recommend this restaurant highly enough for it's food, location but most importantly for the beautiful staff., I invited you to have lunch here because it's close to the company, but I didn't expect a restaurant located in District 1, in a 5-star hotel, but the price is extremely suitable for office workers. The food is delicious, many options, the staff is very attentive and enthusiastic from the time of booking to experiencing the meal at the restaurant, there is nothing to complain about other than the atmosphere being a bit hot at noon. Thank you Ngan and Trang for being so cheerful and enthusiastic with us.
description: Drawing inspiration from Italian sidewalk cafes, take a break and enjoy signature refreshments at one of the most sought-after destinations in the city.

name: Sen Đại Việt Restaurant
address: 226 - 228 Đ. Bùi Viện Phường Phạm Ngũ Lão, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We were on the hunt for another top-notch live seafood spot and came across this highly-rated gem in the area. The selection of fresh, live seafood was impressive, offering plenty of options to satisfy any craving. The service was attentive and friendly, and every dish we tried was bursting with flavor. A truly delightful dining experience that left us wanting more, This is a fantastic seafood restaurant located on Bui Vien street. The food is as fresh as you can get with a huge choice, whether it be traditional Vietnamese food or home comfort dishes. You can choose the seafood you want fresh from the tanks and watch it being cooked right in front of you. The staff are very polite and highly attentive. I’d happily go here again and would recommend if you are in the area., This fresh fish and shrimp was really good and filled with locals which is a great way to locate best food. If I can I’ll post my video of the fish and shrimp and various snails and shellfish. You will not regret this meal.
description: Sen Dai Viet Restaurant - Seafood - Vietnamese Pho with more than 300 unique Vietnamese dishes and European - Asian dishes

name: Be An Vegetarian Bistro
address: 99 Nguyen Hue Saigon Garden, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We have eaten at many vegetarian/vegan restaurants across US, Asia and Europe, and this delightful place in Saigon is one of our top 10 favorites! There are two locations in Saigon, we ate at the one located on busy Nguyễn Huệ street, tucked away inside an alley underneath this fancy building. Cozy atmosphere, chic dining room with bamboo wood, live plants, flowers, and comfortable seats. The young, good-looking waitstaff were extremely professional yet friendly and helpful. We ordered a variety of dishes to share, all were delicious! But the hot pot dish was stunning, beyond our imagination! A huge plate filled with fresh vegetables including different mushroom varieties, zucchini flowers, taro root, crunchy greens, red noodles, and tofu wedges, all to be cooked inside this boiling pot of mouthwatering broth infused with lemongrass, coconut milk, and turmeric. The broth alone was incredible, so tasty and smelled heavenly! It was a fun experience to cook all the vegetables right at the table! Oh, we also loved the variety of eclectic, creative, non-alcoholic, healthy, cool drinks. Definitely a gourmet vegetarian place, we highly recommend., Superb, stylish, modern and tasty. Fantastic place to eat dinner, though we did struggle to find it. If you do...don't quit its worth it. We had quit a mix of dishes, sexton, tofu, mushroom etc in various sauces and the obligatory sticky rice. 4 beers... 750.000 vnd = £22.66 Pros: Modern, Great price for top food, Tasty Cons: Fairly small bowl of sticky rice,, Amazing vegan Vietnamese food in a cozy air-con atmosphere, hidden inside Saigon Garden mini-mall, facing Nguyen Hue St. In the evenings, this busy road is closed to vehicles and temporarily becomes a charming pedestrian area. Our lovely server Nga was knowledgeable and attentive. My family of five enjoyed the dinner very much.
description: Be An Bistro is a Vegetarian restaurant with an emphasis on good health and well being. Located right in the heart of Saigon, Ground Floor Saigon Garden, 99 Nguyen Hue, District 1, Be An hopes to amplify Vegetarian cuisine, elevate it become a lifestyle.

name: Pendolasco
address: 30 Tong Huu Dinh St Thao Dien District 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Been craving a pizza place like home back in the US and this place got pretty close to it. Oven bake pizza at a affordable cost. Pizza 10/10 Seafood Spaghetti I would be coming back if I ever visit Hcmc again., Great Christmas lunch during our holiday in Vietnam! For the occasion, we wanted to rediscover the flavors and colors of our cuisine and we really succeeded. The restaurant enjoys a beautiful space that is divided between an internal room and a dehors with outdoor tables or on the air-conditioned veranda. The menu is full of dishes, from the selection of starters, first and second courses, even to pizzas, cooked in the scenic station at the entrance to the restaurant. Although the clientele was predominantly Asian, the restaurant maintains a menu faithful to the tradition of Italian cuisine. The Italian dining manager welcomed us upon our arrival and made sure everything was going well during lunch, as were the rest of the staff, kind and attentive service. We selected some dishes from the special Christmas menu and others from the menu, all truly delicious! A note of praise for the tagliatelle with meat sauce and the risotto, cooked perfectly. In summary, a beautiful lunch, which allowed us to find a bit of Italy in Vietnam! Highly recommended!, I went there with friends on recommendation. It was worth the visit. The Garlic bread, Burrata, Pizza and Pasta all were very well prepared. One must visit this place if they are looking for authentic Italian food.
description: Our fully air-conditioned dining room, resembles a large italian authentic "trattoria". A large list of Italian wines available as well as a selection of other international lables " Our staff will be ready to help You with the right choice ". Following the great success in the heart of the city, the Pendolasco family has opened a new branch, for all the people living in the many residential areas located around district 2. What was once an old villa has been brought back to a beautiful restaurant that with its decorations. As the original Pendolasco, the new restaurant offers authentic Italian dishes such as the traditional : " Wood fire oven Pizza " Looking for a good meal delivered to their door steps ? Try Our great delivery team !

name: East West Brewing - Sai Gon
address: 181-185 Ly Tu Trong St District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Review Highlights: Food and Beer: I visited East West Brewing for lunch, and I must say, both the food and beer were outstanding. The craft brews are top-notch, and the variety of flavors impressed me. Whether you’re a beer enthusiast or a casual drinker, you’ll find something to enjoy here. Friendly Service: The staff were friendly and attentive. Their warm hospitality added to the overall experience. It’s always a pleasure when service matches the quality of the food and drinks. Price Value: While the lunch prices might be slightly higher than other places, the value is still good considering the quality. Keep in mind that there’s a 10% VAT added to the bill. Overall Verdict: East West Brewing Co. is a must-visit for beer lovers and foodies alike. The modern ambiance, great service, and delicious offerings make it a memorable spot in Ho Chi Minh City. 🍻🌟, Probably our favourite spot for lunch/dinner/drinks - we came here a couple of times during our week in Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon). Food is great! Service is great! Beers are great! A very extensive and interesting menu - everything freshly prepared and well presented. Beautiful food! LOVED the buffalo jerky! And their beef quesadillas - YUM! Trendy, amazing decor, awesome atmosphere, always packed with beautiful people wearing beautiful clothes. Absolutely buzzing! Fantastic people watching. We just LOVED it!, Tasty brews and good pub grub. Tried 2 brews - the Far East IPA, might good - and an American Pale Ale, good but not as good as the IPA. Dinner was a crispy fried soft-shelled crab burger with fries. It as a perfect sandwich. There were lots of other items on their pub grub menu. I sat up in the bar area in front. The place is cavernous and that means it was noisy with all the hard surfaces everywhere. Guess that part of eating in a microbrewery. I'd certainly go back.
description: East West Brewing Co. was birthed from a dream to provide world-class craft beer to our Vietnamese community, while using inspiration from the East (Saigon, Vietnam) to the West (San Diego, California) in hopes of creating a unique experience for both locals and tourists alike. While we’re proud to be one of Vietnam’s first microbreweries with award winning craft beers, we're always doing our best to provide our community with fresh new tastes. Whether it be our core beers, batches of seasonals or even sours, we continue to push ourselves to create a wide variety of beers made up of both global and local ingredients. We pride ourselves on connecting cultures through craft beer and welcome you to try out the East West experience!

name: Belgo Belgian Craft Beer Brewery - Ton That Thiep
address: 29 - 31 Ton That Thiep Street, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: We came as a couple on a sat night and loved this bar!! We are a huge fan of Belgian beers and felt like the bar had a great Belgian feel with the decor and vibe. The cherry beer on tap was great, we only sampled a few small tapas style dishes but can highly recommend the chicken croquettes and the extra cheesy fries, so tasty!, If you're looking for a good beer and food place, this is the perfect spot. There are a lot of craft beer pubs around Saigon, but for me Belgo is the best in terms of quality, service and experience. The food is Belgian style and a lot of dishes are cooked with Belgo beer, which makes it even more unique. On top of that the beer is truly Belgian style, with a deep and complex taste. The location alone is beautiful, old colonial style building, a little gem in the busiest neighbourhood of Saigon. Highly recommend !, Belgo at Ton That Thiep is a true gem in Saigon's culinary scene. It's a historic building, with its captivating charm and rich heritage. With its authentic Belgian cuisine, curated craft beer selection, and impeccable service, Belgo Ton That Thiep is a must-visit destination for those seeking a remarkable blend of history, culinary excellence, and unforgettable moments in Saigon.
description: We came as a couple on a sat night and loved this bar!! We are a huge fan of Belgian beers and felt like the bar had a great Belgian feel with the decor and vibe. The cherry beer on tap was great, we only sampled a few small tapas style dishes but can highly recommend the chicken croquettes and the extra cheesy fries, so tasty!

name: La Cuisine
address: 52 Le Thanh Ton District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: We thoroughly enjoyed both the delicious French food and the attentive service of the waiter. We especially appreciated his photographic skills that ensured we have plenty of lovely memories. We highly recommend La Cuisine and hope to return soon!, We stumbled across this gem while looking for a local restaurant to go to last night. Not having had a Frenchmeal for a while we couldn’t resist and I’m so glad we didn’t! The service was perfect from the moment we walked in. Steak tartare was beautiful with just a hint more zing than you would have got in Europe but it was perfect. The foie-gras had my wife asking if we could get the chef to export it to Australia! The duck breast was cooked to perfection as was the sea bass. Topped off with a bottle of Chablis. Worth coming back to Saigon just for the meal., It has been manny years since we have been able to enjoy this wonderful restaurant. After recently returning to this vibrant city, we chose La Cuisine for an intimate dinner on Valentine’s Day. The restaurant is only a short walk, along the vibrant sidewalks, bustling with street food and traders, from the hotels surrounding the Opera House. As expected of such a popular place, it was buzzing with couples filling the restaurant. There was a set menu in addition to the a le carte. We chose from the menu and were rewarded with the same thoughtfully prepared fare that we had come to know and love. The staff were attentive from the moment we arrived, until we settled the account hours later - an amazing achievement given the number of diners enjoying the experience. The food is quintessentially French, beautifully presented and real value for money. The wine list is more compact than usual given the restrictions that still affect us all, again with a eye towards regional and varietal character rather than profit. We simply love this place!
description: La Cuisine is a French restaurant located in the heart of Ho Chi Minh city, designed to make you feel as if you were at home. The open kitchen gives you the opportunity to see the Chef and his team pamper you with a selection of mouth-watering dishes. Having worked in France, London, and São Paulo, Chef Erwann Serene decided to settle in Vietnam where he worked in La Camargue for the past 8 years. In 2009, he decides to open his own restaurant, and works on the La Cuisine concept, which is a mix of a home designed kitchen and trendy restaurant serving refined Mediterranean Cuisine. “Visit La Cuisine for a fantastic, reasonably priced lunch set or for a sumptuous dinner, be sure to make a reservation as word about this wonderful eatery has spread like wildfire”. Gourmet Vietnam Magazine 2010-2011

name: Banh Mi Hong Hoa
address: 62 Nguyen Van Trang, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: This is the best Banh Mi I've eaten! Better than the competitor around the corner where you stand in line for 2 hours because he gets so hyped. This was fantastic! The sandwiches were super fresh (were made and baked behind us) the ingredients full of flavor and fresh and they had lovely chairs, Yea the best succulent Roast pork version we ate on our tours . Bread baked on the site , spliced to perfection and served with a smile . Chicken and Tuna versions equally good . The iced drinks selection baffles one with such a choice . Kumquat tea is recommended. So good we made a detour for a second visit , equally brilliant, food quality, price , service .. what a package, We travel to Vietnam from Thailand with friends and had done some research on where to get the best banh mi in Ho Chi Minh City and this place was mentioned as the best very often. We were there for three nights and I had four of these the roast pork and the mixed meat varieties were absolutely spectacular. This particular location bakes their own bread on site it was unbelievably fresh. If you get the Ho Chi Minh City you must make time to visit this place it's located in district 1 not far from the walking street entertainment area.
description:
This is the best Banh Mi I've eaten! Better than the competitor around the corner where you stand in line for 2 hours because he gets so hyped.
This was fantastic! The sandwiches were super fresh (were made and baked behind us) the ingredients full of flavor and fresh and they had lovely chairs

name: Taco Del Sol
address: 110 - 112 Ly Tu Trong, Ben Thanh Ward, D1 Ben Thanh D1, Ho Chi Minh City 10000 Vietnam
reviews: Fun and colourful Mexican restaurant on 4th floor, reached by elevator. Part a/c and part open sided. We had a corner table with great lit views down the crossroads to the market and lively street life. Food was tasty, good Mexican food at a reasonable price, and we were served by a very engaging young waiter whose American name was Troy., Small and cosy little piece of Mexico within Ho Chi Minh. Food was higher than average but it is a specially cuisine. Portion sizes were good and the food range was vast. My friend and I opted for the Carne Burritto, corn ribs and tacos which was amazing. We were there at 11am which was their opening time so it was relatively quiet though as lunchtime drew closer the numbers increased and is definitely a hotspot for foreigners looking for a bit of western comfort food. Location is District 1 about a 2 minute walk from Cho Ben Tanh and Takashimaya mall. Service was great and if you're not versed in Vietnamese don't fret as all the attendants speak English. Highly recommend this place!, Tacos Del Sol has the most delicious Mexican food in all of Saigon. Their menu is vast with many great classic dishes as well as some of their own savory creations. The birria tacos and birria ramen were both exploding with flavor with very generous portions. If you want authentic Mexican food then this is the place for you! Highly recommend this quality restaurant!
description:
Fun and colourful Mexican restaurant on 4th floor, reached by elevator. Part a/c and part open sided. We had a corner table with great lit views down the crossroads to the market and lively street life.

Food was tasty, good Mexican food at a reasonable price, and we were served by a very engaging young waiter whose American name was Troy.

name: La Moi plant-based Restaurant
address: 84 Đ. Nguyễn Du, Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: We were lucky to come across La Moi Plant Based Restaurant while in Ho Chi Minh City. The food was so good and we enjoyed it very much! We liked it so much that we came back a second time the following evening and enjoyed one of their combo dinners. The wait staff was so helpful in our ordering the food. We were surprised when they brought out 5 different dishes for us to share. Each dish was awesome and we were so pleased that we had happened upon this restaurant. I definitely recommend La Moi to anyone who is looking for a delicious meal that is very reasonably priced., I went to lunch with a friend. Vegetarian food was delicious. The first time I ate vegetarian food in Ho Chi Minh City, I was really impressed by the presentation of the food and the kindness of the staff. I really liked pottery and pineapple fries. My friends come here to eat often, and I will come more often., I had the chance to enjoy breakfast at La Moi vegetarian restaurant, and I was completely satisfied. The dishes were exquisitely prepared, both delicious and beautifully presented. The rich flavors and elegant presentation left a lasting impression. The restaurant’s atmosphere is serene and cozy, making it a perfect place to unwind after a busy day. The staff were attentive, friendly, and always ready to assist, especially Ms. Nhu. This is definitely an ideal spot for anyone who loves vegetarian cuisine or wants to explore a refreshing and inspiring dining experience. I’ll definitely be coming back for more!
description: We were lucky to come across La Moi Plant Based Restaurant while in Ho Chi Minh City.  The food was so good and we enjoyed it very much!  We liked it so much that we came back a second time the following evening and enjoyed one of their combo dinners.  The wait staff was so helpful in our ordering the food.  We were surprised when they brought out 5 different dishes for us to share.  Each dish was awesome and we were so pleased that we had happened upon this restaurant.  I definitely recommend La Moi to anyone who is looking for a delicious meal that is very reasonably priced.

name: Square One
address: 2 Lam Son Square, District 1 Park Hyatt Saigon, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We had a wonderful dining experiencing at Square One. In the Park Hyatt, very close to the opera house, the food was creative and abundant. Service was attentive and informed. Excellent attention was paid to those in our party with severe food allergies. The best decision was getting the 3 flight blind wine tasting. Wow! No box wine here. Outstanding, premium choices were presented, well paired with the food. We enjoyed our meal at Le Beaulieu at the Metropole in Hanoi, but this meal was far better and much cheaper. Bravo., Square One, located on the 2nd floor of Park Hyatt Saigon, offers a $100 dinner credit. This time, as a Michelin recommended restaurant, Square One offers a Michelin-quality dining experience, from service to meals. The staff is attentive and the contents of the dishes are explained thoroughly. Vietnamese and French dishes are well executed, with unique specialties. Square One is ideal for gatherings and to safely experience the fusion of Vietnamese and French cuisines., Square One, long one of our favorite restaurants in Ho Chi Minh City, is now even better! We dined here six evenings during our three-week stay. Chef de Cuisine Ninh Le Trung Hau is superb! Everything was delicious. One evening we asked him what to order for dinner and had the best fish we’ve ever had! His Sous Chef Phuc also is excellent. A new addition is Chef de Cuisine Arnaud Schuttrumpf, a French chef. His Lobster Bisque was very good as was his delightful soufflé. The service here is very good. Restaurant Manager Tran Thanh Tri is an excellent hands-on manager and very good at making sure customers are well served and pleased with their meals. Tran, Man and others were very good waitresses and waiters. The wine selection and sommelier service also is very good. Thanks Trane.
description: Celebrated for its innovative dual-cuisine concept, the signature restaurant of Park Hyatt Saigon, Square One, seamlessly unites the refinement and finesse of French culinary artistry with the vibrant and authentic flavours of Vietnamese gastronomy. At the heart of Square One are two remarkable chefs: Chef Arnaud Schuttrumpf – a master of French culinary arts and Chef Trung Hau – an artisan of Vietnamese flavours. Their commitment to using only the highest quality produce sourced from responsible local farmers ensures that every dish supports a sustainable future.

name: Shamballa Vegetarian, Restaurant & Lounge - Sai Gon
address: 31 Ly Tu Trong St, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: What an amazing discovery amidst a City with so much to offer. We went for dinner and immediately appreciated the design before being led to our table. We were seated in the courtyard, and the thoughtful staff put a fan at the base of our table (they did it for all the outside tables) which made the whole experience much better; wind to keep the bugs away and also cool is down as we ate the deliciously spiced food. The staff were really outstanding throughout. The food was exceptional. So good we went back for lunch the next day. If I had the chance, I would go again; just thinking about it makes me hungry., Very nice and quiet places the staff, all young, is very prepared was the first time I was asked if I have allergies, this means a special attention to customers, and a nice cloth napkin with cutlery, are not the sticks. There or excellent and cared for in the presentation. I stayed 10 days in Ho Ci Minh and almost every night I went to dinner with them, Absolutely beautiful aesthetics. Right when you walk in, there's a pond with fish and another in the back. There's just the right amount of space if you happen to come with a large party. We came on 9/3/2024 and received extremely excellent service from Thanh Bac. She was very polite and incredibly attentive. When she noticed that I was having difficulty drinking my macadamia and brown rice latte she immediately came over with a tray of bigger straws and asked if I wanted to switch it out. She came several times to check in on us without being pushy and always greeted us with a smile. Sadly this was the best service we've received from a restaurant during our trip to Vietnam. As for the food: - Macadamia Brown Rice Latte (5/5) - lite and refreshing with just the right amount of sweetness - Fresh Passion Fruit and Orange Juice (5/5) - a little sour but 100% fresh. It came in its own little bottle that we pour out to a cup with some liquid sugar - you can adjust the sweetness/tang to your liking - Nam Rac Muoi Xanh [Green Salted Crispy Mushrooms] (5/5) - - Mien Xao Noi Dat [Clay Pot Glass Noodles] (4.5/5) - aside from some of the noodles drying out because they were left at the end of the pot instead of properly being placed inside, this hit the spot if you're craving glass noodles - Banh Hoi Nem Lui [Woven Noodles & Grilled Nem] (5/5) - you wouldn't believe this wasn't meat. had all the right flavors of nem. perfectly cooked and succulent (normally this can be slightly dry if cooked improperly) but it was excellent Overall, excellent spot for vegans/vegetarians traveling to Vietnam. Would 100% recommend and give a shoutout to Thanh Bac for us!
description: The mind is a wondrous place. It contains our memories, talents, and perceptions, but we can sometimes get lost in the the complications life brings. In Buddhism, every sentient being has a mind of its own and there exists a pure primordial energy in each of us; this state of purity is what Buddhist practitioners seek to reach through meditation. At Shamballa, we are inspired by Tibetan Buddhism and the teachings about the mind. We wanted to create a space where the mind can unwind in a serene atmosphere. Our vegetarian cuisine accommodates the experience by providing delicate flavour combinations for the palate. We organically produce some of our own vegetables, and we carefully select others to ensure you dine on the finest ingredients. We hope you enjoy your meal with us, and we hope you leave our new wondrous home, located in the heart of Saigon, feeling brighter than before.

name: 5 Senses
address: Nikko Hotel, Ground Floor Valet Parking Available, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: This is second time I am visiting this restaurant And I am surprised that the level of food quality has been develope further I am confident that this place will be getting Michelin star soon Also I would like to say special thanks to manager Chef which is expert in his field Great job amazing creative food, The culinary expertise of the Master Chef Burc Tuncel was evident in every dish served. The high standards and attention to detail of Manager Sherif , were evident when you walked into the tasteful surroundings of the restaurant situated in Hotel Nikko Saigon . The staff were exceptional and the service complimented the food. The taste , the flavours , the fresh ingredients were outstanding! It’s hard to believe they are only open 3 weeks and have gotten everything right. The price was reasonable and I would highly recommend this restaurant. They are hoping to open in Dubai and Miami and we will definitely visit one of these locations for our anniversary !! #fabulous, It is one of the most amazing experiences to visit the 5 senses. As the name suggests , this finely crafted gourmet experience appeals to all your senses of touch, taste, nose , sight and sound ( yes there is dish there that does this so well that you go down memory lane). The take on ‘modern Japanese cuisine’ is so well thought through that the experience leaves you wanting to come back. The food is to die for. The bartender makes very good cocktails and there is a curated list of Sake and Champagne that beautifully compliments the food. If you are in Saigon and haven’t been to 5 senses , for sure you missing out on something amazing. I highly recommend this one.
description: If you are looking for a unique and memorable dining experience, then you must try the 5 Senses Modern Japanese restaurant. This fine-dining restaurant is located in the Nikko hotel and offers a fusion of Japanese cuisine with a modern twist. The restaurant is famed for its creative dishes that are not only visually stunning but also tantalizing to the taste buds. The team of chefs here use only the freshest and finest ingredients to create their masterpieces. In addition to the impeccable food, the restaurant also offers a wide range of sake and wine that has been carefully selected to complement the dishes. The 5 Senses Modern Japanese restaurant is an experience that you will not forget any time soon.

name: M. Bar
address: 1 Dong Khoi District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Located at the Rooftop of Hotel Majestic, the M Bar serves food, beverages and wines. One could sit back and enjoy the magnificent view while having a drink or two. Its indeed a great place to chill out., This review is mainly for the service offered by Manager Hoang. Although the M Bar was extremely busy on Saturday & Sunday evenings 25 & 26 February 2023 entertaining cruise passengers with their traditional Vietnamese dancing and musical performances for an hour, we as in-house guests were still lucky enough to get excellent service offered by the Manager Hoang himself. For some other hotels and restaurants, Managers mostly watch from a distance supervising, but rarely are to be found with hands on deck. Hoang has set a very good example for his team to follow, he was extremely service orientated and needs to be congratulated., I highly recommend taking a pre-dinner cocktail here; we did on two out of our three nights! From the rooftop bar of the historic Hotel Majestic, you get a great view of the city and, more particularly, the river. Service is exemplary and we were made to feel incredibly welcome when we returned for a second evening. The cocktails are reasonably priced by western levels, although a little pricy by Vietnamese standards but you're paying for something special. With their signature cocktail, Majestic 1925, the barman prepares the drink in front of you with a little 'theatre' and, whilst it's quite expensive at £15, it is in my opinion worth it for the 'special moment'. Normally cocktails are circa £8 each and they do have a limited 2 for 1 selection before 7.00pm. I would highly recommend.
description: Located at the Rooftop of Hotel Majestic, the M Bar serves food, beverages and wines. One could sit back and enjoy the magnificent view while having a drink or two. Its indeed a great place to chill out.

name: Trois Gourmands
address: 39 Tran Ngoc Dien Street Thao Dien Ward - District 2, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Trois Gourmands is still my family's favorite fine dining restaurant for more than a decade ❤️ Delicious truffle scrambled eggs are nowhere to be found but here. We ordered their tasty unique foie gras spring rolls as always. We also enjoyed the thinly sliced ​​fresh scallops blended with a layer of olive oil with a sweet vanilla scent. The truffle sole was just delicious, so I didn't need to add its red wine sauce… We were so full that they packed the cheese for us to take home. Then we ate some ice cream desserts to refresh our palate. Such a delicious menu is only $65 for 1 adult & 1 child, because if you just eat alone, taking the $55 menu is enough., Superbly traditional French cooking, with a nod to local traditions. The menu is broad and everything is prepared and presented with the utmost elegance. The beef options must form part of the meal - the Rossini was magnificent on its own, but when it is joined by the truffle sauce you get absolute culinary perfection. The wine list is resolutely French, and includes some classics, including a suite of Grand Cru reds and a couple of d'Yquem sauternes. Add the ambience and staff who are passionate and well informed about their work and you have the perfect meal., Trois Gourmands is a famous French restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City. The restaurant is a big villa with a swimming pool. Its green walls make it very distinctive in the residential zone. There are outdoor tables and a big grill in the garden area. The interior is beautifully decorated with fresh orchids, fancy curtains and colourful paintings. Ambience is great! The main dining room and private rooms are spacious, bright and well furnished with carpets, air conditioning, and comfortable chairs. Servers and chefs are all very friendly and accommodating. They even accept new US dollar bills. Depending on your choice of entrées, set lunch can cost around VND 1,046,000 (or USD 45) to VND 2,379,000 (or USD 103), which is quite expensive in Vietnamese standards. Highly recommend the flavorful “Nem de Foie Gras” (Goose Liver Spring Roll), the refreshing “Tartare de crab” (Crab Tartare), and “Profiteroles au Chocolat” (Chocolate "Profiteroles" with Vanilla ice cream). One thing that needs improvement though is the slow serving speed; taking more than 3 hours to enjoy a 5-course French lunch is a bit too long.
description: Trois Gourmands is regarded as one of the finest French Restaurants in Ho Chi Minh City. Opened in 2004 and previously named Le Toit Gourmand, this fine French dining restaurant is the creation of Gils, a south east of France native who has dedicated himself to excellence in French culinary art with a particular dedication for natural products such as his mouthwatering homemade cheeses and to ‘’work’’ noble ingredients such as Goose Liver and Truffles.

name: Gyu Shige - Ngưu Phồn
address: 48-50 Đông Du, Phường Bến Nghé, Quận 1, TP.HCM. P. Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Crispy and fragrant seaweed fried rice Spicy and delicious kimchi rice Seafood rice is delicious, rich and delicious The space of the restaurant has a private room to chat with the dedicated and quiet service staff. It's worth going to many occasions to gather with family and friends. It's always reasonable ^^^, Everything is very fresh and delicious, but maybe because the restaurant was too crowded, the service staff didn’t care about us. Many times I had to ask for more cups, spoons, plates on my own. Overall, the restaurant is nice, just need to take better care of customers., One of the places I often recommend to friends with families (especially children) to eat, because the private room is very comfortable. The waiter prepared the food quite quickly, I rarely had to wait long. Regarding grilled food, Gyu Shige is always my number 1 choice, unless I can't book a table then I refrain. Fresh beef, delicious marinade, the best dipping sauce with fresh vegetables is terrible, after finishing the tray of vegetables, I have to order another tray to eat. Private room is comfortable, private, going alone with your husband - going with a family with grandparents - or going with your partner is all suitable. When going east, there are combos to order, reasonable. The banh xeo at Gyu Shige is so delicious, every time I come here I have to order 2 servings. 100 points no buts.
description:
Crispy and fragrant seaweed fried rice
Spicy and delicious kimchi rice
Seafood rice is delicious, rich and delicious
The space of the restaurant has a private room to chat with the dedicated and quiet service staff. It's worth going to many occasions to gather with family and friends. It's always reasonable ^^^

name: Pho Muslim
address: 505 Tran Hung Dao Street, TK:25/18 District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Super authentic and delicious Vietnam. The best part it’s 100% halal as it’s run by a local Vietnamese Muslim family. I would recommend the Pho and always order the Beef and Banh bread as well, it’s a new flavour unlike any you’ve tried before. I finished the food before I took any picture., The essence of Vietnamese street food. Thick flavoursome broth for the pho. Pair that with banh mi. Most importantly, opportunity for Muslims to savour as food served are all Halal. The owner, Zaki is very friendly and attentive to his customers! Definitely will come again!, Don't take our word for it, but by far it's the tastiest pho we tried in HCMC!! I recommend visiting the establishment on a rainy night to maximize the experience!
description: Super authentic and delicious Vietnam. The best part it’s 100% halal as it’s run by a local Vietnamese Muslim family. I would recommend the Pho and always order the Beef and Banh bread as well, it’s a new flavour unlike any you’ve tried before. I finished the food before I took any picture.

name: Xu Restaurant Lounge
address: 71-75 Hai Ba Trung Street, District 1 Near Hyatt, Caravelle, Sheraton & Intercontinental Hotels, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Enjoyed a wonderful birthday dinner and later in the week an excellent lunch. Both experiences were fantastic. The food is modern Vietnamese, very tasty and creative. Service was exceptional, wait staff made awesome recommendations. Food is served family style so that we could all taste a variety of dishes. Everything was soooo tasty and also healthy. As with most things in Vietnam, relatively inexpensive., Our favourite restaurant in HMC. Found it whilst walking past. Downstairs bar has a great atmosphere and the wine was very well priced. The upstairs restaurant had a choice of Al a carte or set menu. We did Al a carte. The serving sizes were very good and the quality of ingredients and flavours were outstanding. Prices excellent. Service was fastidious., What a fun night this turned out to be at Xu restaurant! The menu had many choices and the food was delicious - we opted for the a la carte menu rather than the set dinner menus. I highly recommend the scallops. Our server was so attentive, there were a couple of mix-ups in the order but once we communicated them, the issues were fixed. They even took my husband up the elevator to the restaurant as he has trouble climbing stairs. Put this restaurant on your list when you are in Saigon!
description: Enjoyed a wonderful birthday dinner and later in the week an excellent lunch.  Both experiences were fantastic.  The food is modern Vietnamese, very tasty and creative.  Service was exceptional, wait staff made awesome recommendations.  Food is served family style so that we could all taste a variety of dishes.  Everything was soooo tasty and also healthy.  As with most things in Vietnam, relatively inexpensive.

name: Elgin
address: 27 Mạc Đĩnh Chi, Đakao, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Warm and welcoming staff greeted us and guided us through the menu. Three of us shared three small plates and 2 main plates, plus 2 desserts and we were very happy. All the dishes were creatively presented and tasted amazing, bright spices and herbs flavored the very fresh food. hamachi crudo was excelente as was the barramundi filet. We found the wine list unusual and intriguing, and found that the Viognier and Rosé went perfectly with our choices. You must go!, We had an absolutely fantastic dining experience at Elgin in Ho Chi Minh City! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was chic and inviting, setting the perfect tone for an amazing meal. One of the things we loved most was their shared plates style—it allowed us to try a variety of incredible dishes, and every single one was outstanding. We had the chutoro toast, chicken ayam taliwang, lamb gnocchi, tropical granita, and sticky toffee pudding. Everything was so good that we couldn’t even pick a favorite! A special shout-out to Doug, who went above and beyond to make our night extra special. His friendly service made us feel truly welcomed, and to top it off, he even surprised us with a free dessert! It’s rare to find such great hospitality these days, and Doug absolutely nailed it. Five stars all around! If you’re in Saigon, love food, and are looking for a top-notch dining experience, Elgin is the place to go., My wife and I went here to celebrate our anniversary and as a final treat for our four week vacation in Vietnam. We read on many websites that the dining experience was great here. We were welcomed by a very friendly staf, that spoke excellent English and was very knowledgeable about all the dishes. The atmosphere was excellent: relaxed and modern, but not too fancy. The food was exquisite. They have a sharing concept and a lot of choice. We had four small(ish) starters, one main (the lamb gnocchi) and desert, coupled with a good wine. Every dish was very outspoken and tasted excellent, especially the duck roti and the lamb gnocchi were to die for. If you are a food-enthousiast and want to have a fine-dining experience in Ho Chi Minh City, I couldn’t recommend this place more. The prices are more on an European level than a Vietnamese level, but due to the excellent food and great experience, we think it is certainly worth it.
description: Discover Elgin: a casual dining restaurant and wine bar in Saigon Elgin is a casual dining restaurant and wine bar in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City, offering delicious sharing plates inspired by modern fusion flavors. Our seasonal rotating menu showcases the best of local and fresh produce. Whether you're looking for a cozy dinner with friends or the perfect wine pairing, Elgin is the go-to spot in Saigon. Join us and explore a new level of creative cuisine in a vibrant atmosphere.

name: Pizza 4P's Saigon Centre
address: 65 Le Loi Street 01-02 Level 6 , Saigon Centre, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I've been to 4 different 4P's locations here in HCM but this is by far the friendliest place. Located at the top of Saigon Centre, the atmosphere is quiet and peaceful with a smoking section outside. Menu is the same as every other 4P's but if you've never been then you'll find a whole range of gourmet pizza available along with delectable appetisers such as your casual fried chicken to your more fancier prosciutto wrapped mango salads. My friends and I chose two half and half pizza, a pepperoni chorizo / spicy kebab and mushroom cheese / ham prosciutto. Prices are more than your average restaurant but still very affordable. For 4 people, we got 2 half and half pizzas, 3 entrees, 1 pasta and 5 drinks which cost $80USD. Ordering was done via QR code and very user friendly with pictures so you know what you're getting. Service staff were amazing and very friendly too. Definitely worth a visit., Delicious taste of 4P’s thin crust pizza with innovative ingredients choice , an enthusiastic and friendly service 😀. A surprise and unexpected “wow” whisper from my mouth, when watching your staff cut the white bubble cheese on the thin crust pizza , an amazing motivation at this moment. Later a plate of creamy crab meat cheese pasta was serve in front of us , the attractive orange colour of crab cover decorated on the top of the cheese paste. 😛😛😛 Should you want to know any available seats , making a reservations in advance to avoid any longer waiting times to be seated. Thanks for chiefs have prepared such an outstanding and memorable dinner for us ., Very good pizzas., better than in some pizza restaurants in France or elsewhere. The work is very conscientious. From the table where we were settled, we had a beautiful view of the pizzaiolo who were committed to making us the most beautiful and best pizzas...Our pizzas were delicious and very generously garnished.. the welcome was perfect, the staff is smiling and well organized. The setting is super beautiful, industrial style seen and it is very clean. It was good to change a little food because we've been in Vietnam for a long time
description: An Earth to People restaurant on a mission to make the world smile for peace, one pizza at a time. Earth to People is our commitment to serve safe and fresh foods directly from Mother Earth to you. Located in Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Danang and Nha Trang.

name: Luli's Kitchen
address: 182a Pasteur Street, Bén Nghé Ward,district 1, Tp Hô Chi Minh, Vietnam, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: We followed the good reviews and were not disappointed. The really small restaurant is run by Timothey, a Frenchman living in HCM City, his very charming Vietnamese wife and her mother.
