The name "Luli" is composed of the initial letters of the names of the two children of the couple. Luli's wants to bring honest Vietnamese cuisine to the plates and it succeeds. The food was delicious and the price absolutely fine. For dessert we had fantastic crepes based on a Breton recipe. Interesting insights into life in Vietnam were available for free. Très sympa. Good luck and success with the business., If you're looking for a place to eat delicious home-cooked meals in a great family atmosphere, you've come to the right place! You'll find an excellent mix of French cuisine (crêpes) and Vietnamese cuisine (excellent Bo Kho). The place is very nicely decorated, good atmosphere, very friendly and attentive owners. The prices are very reasonable for the area... I recommend it!, Here is an excellent discovery of this family restaurant where we met the boss Timothy and his wife and where we discussed at length around several Vietnamese specialties that were all worthy of a very large restaurant! You can go there with your eyes closed you will not be disappointed with the trip! Thank you again for this very good time spent together and will soon.
description: We followed the good reviews and were not disappointed. The really small restaurant is run by Timothey, a Frenchman living in HCM City, his very charming Vietnamese wife and her mother. The name "Luli" is composed of the initial letters of the names of the two children of the couple. Luli's wants to bring honest Vietnamese cuisine to the plates and it succeeds. The food was delicious and the price absolutely fine. For dessert we had fantastic crepes based on a Breton recipe. Interesting insights into life in Vietnam were available for free. Très sympa. Good luck and success with the business.

name: Black Vinegar
address: 76 Le Lai 1st Floor, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Black Vinegar is a great choice for Cantonese Lunch, especially to enjoy variety of dim sums and dishes at the same time with cost competitiveness and quality food. Their weekday lunch special is a great jewel and their weekend all you can eat dim sum can also be recommended. Thank to great staff with quality service including Ai, Duyen, Linh, who is always help me to have great experience at Black Vinegar, and Truc, who always serves with care., The weekend lunch buffet menu is very cost-effective, the dim sum is very delicious and there are many varieties. The waiter Linh is also very friendly and responsive. It is a good dining experience. Xiaolongbao and corn soup are recommended., We were in search for a lighter dinner and ended up in this restaurant (in 5* New World Hotel) to eat dumplings and was amazed by the quality, presentation and service. We had pumpkin flower salad as greens, 3 salty type of dumplings and a one off-sweet as dessert. All were very fresh, dumplings had a great texture and taste inside & outside. The waiter, who was very well informed, truly polite gave us many insights and hints about the dumplings and which souces to match. Lastly the setting was very adequate & welcoming with different dining areas. Highly recommended. p.s. We just asked ourselves why there were almost no one in such a nice and spacious eatery. It's a pity especially taken into account that the prices were quite affordable for such a high quality.
description: Black Vinegar is a great choice for Cantonese Lunch, especially to enjoy variety of dim sums and dishes at the same time with cost competitiveness and quality food. Their weekday lunch special is a great jewel and their weekend all you can eat dim sum can also be recommended. Thank to great staff with quality service including Ai, Duyen, Linh, who is always help me to have great experience at Black Vinegar, and Truc, who always serves with care.

name: Tartine Saigon - 215 Ly Tu Trong, Q1
address: 215 Lý Tự Trọng, Bến Thành District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: A Review of Tartine Saigon, in the Manner of Charles Dickens Upon my arrival at Tartine Saigon, I found myself greeted with the kindest of courtesies from a most amiable staff, whose manners shone with such warmth as to make the place seem not a mere café but a refuge from the world’s cares. Their attentions were neither officious nor reluctant, but bestowed with that rare balance which leaves a man feeling both welcome and at ease. The pineapple juice, as bright and golden as a morning sunbeam, was a refreshing delight, sweet yet tart, and most invigorating to the senses. The latte, brewed with the sort of diligence that bespeaks a craftsman’s hand, possessed a velvety richness that both awakened and comforted the spirit. And as for the ham and cheese bagel—ah!—it was warm and hearty, the ham tender and the cheese melting just so, as if each had conspired with the other to delight the palate. The view, like a vivid picture framed by nature’s own hand, added to the charm of the establishment. There, one could sit in contemplation, the world bustling by, while finding, within those walls, a quiet moment of repose. Indeed, such was the peace of the place that time seemed to slow, inviting the guest to linger a little longer than intended. In sum, Tartine Saigon offers not merely sustenance, but an experience of quiet pleasure and simple elegance, where one’s soul may find solace in the company of fine food and kinder company still., This place is fantastic for breakfast! After two days, I’m certain it serves one of the best full English breakfasts I’ve had in Southeast Asia. The soul bread is exceptional, and every dish is cooked to perfection. The staff are incredibly friendly and truly an asset to the restaurant, offering top-notch customer service—10/10., I really missed the sourdough bread during our stay in Vietnam, so we decided to check this place. Their bread was delicious I chose the pesto cheese one, my husband had a sallmon bagel. Come to this place if you miss the bread 😉
description: We are bakery-café-restaurants with a focus on naturally leavened bread (#sourdough), run by passionate #artisan bakers keen to bring #realbread to #sunny #saigon. We serve good coffee, #cool drinks, and #healthy #vegan and non-vegan food main with premium ingredients: #tartines, #snacks, #salads, #sandwiches, delicious #mains and #desserts. Come visit us at any of our many locations across the city! Dine-in, pick up or delivery. www.tartine.vn

name: Ministry Social Club Saigon
address: 17 Le Duan 3rd Floor, Sofitel Saigon Plaza, Ho Chi Minh City 710545 Vietnam
reviews: Had the best time at Ministry Social Club Hanoi. the restaurant has a wonderful server and is very kind, attentive and helpful. He deserves 10 stars. The staff is very polite and courteous, the food is delicious, the western decoration is very eye-catching, especially the bartenders are very skilled. Great customer service Will be back soon, The Ministry Social Club is a must-visit for a stylish night out in Saigon. Hidden away in the heart of the city, this club boasts a unique ambiance with plush furnishings and intriguing nooks. The friendly, English-speaking staff provide excellent drink recommendations, and I highly recommend their wines and cocktails., We love a great secret hidden cocktail bar and this doesn’t disappoint. Tucked away on the 3rd floor of the Sofitel this is an absolute gem for a spectacular immersive and interactive cocktail experience. Staff welcomed us (in particular Zane who was a master alchemist) A cozy bar with chesterfield seats around three tables in the main bar and a members private VIP area to the side. Drinks explained on an I-Pad give you the details of each cocktail and then sit back to watch them being prepared and with spectacular theatrical flair they are delivered to you. This bar has to rate up there with the top cocktail bars we’ve ever visited.
description: Ministry Social Club is themed to honour prominent people from the past, through extraordinary cocktails that were curated to trigger all your senses. Be it men or women, the most influential people in humanity's history are commemorated on our walls, and in our drinks.

name: Lüne Restaurant & Bar
address: 17/14 Lê Thánh Tôn, Phường Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We completely agree with the other 5 star ratings. I would also give it a Michelin 1 star, if not two, and we have eaten at a lot of Michelin-starred restaurants, especially in France. The food was creative, presentation was beautiful, waiters were cordial and attentive without being over-bearing. We ordered one of their 4 course meals, one of the 5 course ones, and split or shared everything. It wasn't cheap, by Asian standards, but a real bargain for the quality by Boston prices. Certainly worth the price., Our experience at Lüne in Saigon was truly exceptional, thanks to Chef Adrien and his remarkable culinary skills. From the moment we stepped into the restaurant, we were greeted with warm hospitality and an elegant ambiance that set the stage for a perfect evening. Chef Adrien's creations were nothing short of culinary masterpieces. Each dish was beautifully presented and bursting with flavors that danced on our palates. The attention to detail in Chef Adrien's dishes was remarkable. Every element on the plate had a purpose and contributed to the overall harmony of flavors.We were particularly impressed with the way Chef Adrien incorporated local Vietnamese ingredients into his French-inspired dishes, creating a delightful fusion of flavors. The sommelier at Lüne expertly paired each course with the perfect wine, elevating the dining experience to new heights. One standout dish was the perfectly cooked monk fish, accompanied by a heavenly truffle sauce that left us craving for more. Chef Adrien's passion for his craft was evident in every bite. His dedication to sourcing the finest ingredients and his creative approach to cooking truly shone through in his dishes. The service at Lüne was impeccable. The staff was knowledgeable, attentive, and ensured that every aspect of our dining experience was flawless. As a couple, we couldn't have asked for a more romantic and memorable evening. Lüne, with its enchanting atmosphere and Chef Adrien's culinary genius, exceeded all our expectations and left us with unforgettable memories. Overall, our dining experience at Lüne with Chef Adrien was nothing short of extraordinary. It is a true gem in Saigon's culinary scene, and we highly recommend it to anyone seeking a fantastic French dining experience., The decor was beautifully done, with soft lighting. The service was friendly, and ensured that we felt comfortable and well taken care of throughout the meal. The food was absolutely delicious! Every dish we tried showcased authentic flavors and careful attention to detail. This is a place worth experiencing
description: Chef Adrien Guenzi's new venture, combining a stylish lounge and a modern French fine dining restaurant.

name: Chuck's Burgers
address: 46 Pham viet chanh, phuong 19, binh thanh Phường 19, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: A thoroughly enjoyable and delicious night out! My friends and I enjoyed the pulled pork burger, a regular cheeseburger, and I had the Sriracha burger with a side of crispy zucchini fries. Absolutely delicious! At the end of our meal, the owner came around to greet us and see how we enjoyed our evening. He mentioned that they will soon be a breakfast burrito offering so we will definitely be back!, The thing about Chuck's Burgers is their consistency in providing a quality product every time I visit. This is brought about by the way the owner trains his staff in good customer service. Tonight was no exception. The burgers were great and easy to manage while eating them. There's nothing worse than a burger falling apart in your hands while you try to consume the contents. My wife finds Western sized burgers too much to eat in one serve so she always asks them to cut hers in half which pleases me no end because I get to eat her 2nd half although I would probably pass up on eating a whole 2nd burger. Win win all round. Now that they've opened a 2nd outlet in my district I don't get to eat in the Pasteur Street Diner as much as before but tonight with a function on in D1 we took advantage of the opportunity to eat there again. Yep still the best American style burger in Saigon in my humble Kiwi/Aussie opinion., Omg the burgers were AMAZING probably the best burger I’ve ever had. Service was great. Came out fast and hot. Ordering system quite unique too. It was a fab experience will def be back every time I visit Vietnam. We need more chucks burgers. It’s a must try
description: We are a simple burger joint. Serving good quality Classic American burgers in Ho Chi Minh City. Established July 2013

name: Halal Saigon
address: 31 Dong Du, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 12345 Vietnam
reviews: Atmosphere and place was nice and comfortable. However the waiting time was longer than expected. Close to half an hour to be precise. Food tasted alright, nothing too fancy. The tables next to us was vacant, however it took them a long time to clear the used plates and left over food. So we were sitting beside a table full of stacked plates and leftover foods from previous customers through out the whole time we were having lunch. And that wasn't even at their busiest period. Overall it was average, but service and time for meals to be prepped could be greatly improved., This place is opposite a beautiful mosque so decided to go in. The service was great from the off and the coconut water I had was excellent. However the food I had was a little salty and didn’t really have much to it. I think I didn’t order well and was underwhelmed with my choice. I wouldn’t be rushing back., What we love: - The halal friendly food; good value - Good ambience, wheelchair friendly but also have upstairs seating upon availability - Location (opposite mosque and walking distance to other spectacles such as Apartment Cafe, Opera House etc. Even Better Ifs: - Waiting time for food can be better
description: Atmosphere and place was nice and comfortable. However the waiting time was longer than expected. Close to half an hour to be precise. Food tasted alright, nothing too fancy. The tables next to us was vacant, however it took them a long time to clear the used plates and left over food. So we were sitting beside a table full of stacked plates and leftover foods from previous customers through out the whole time we were having lunch. And that wasn't even at their busiest period. Overall it was average, but service and time for meals to be prepped could be greatly improved.

name: Quan Bui Central
address: 1B Ngô Văn Năm Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This cozy restaurant is just around the corner from where we stayed. One among many restaurants in this area that are worth visiting. We got a nice table upstairs. As we ordered the waiter said “that’s too much food “ very nice of her as we would have ended up leaving half of it uneaten. Many good dishes to choose from. We had a great dinner and could leave satisfied., In my past four days in HCMC I visited it two times, and I am going to do it again tonight! It is a no-nonsense vietnamese restaurant with a good array of home cooking food. Like its beautiful simple but delightful decoration and environment. So fell in love with its fish soup. So good that despite I come from Hong Kong with all kinds of tasteful cusines that it really hits my tongue! Tomato with pineapple and some local vegetables really made this soup stand out. Also like their jasmine tea accompanied by a small bowl of dried coconut and ginger. So thoughtful of them! Service is very efficient and courteous. The few young men serving us were always with a big smile. Pricewise it is very inexpensive, in particular considering it is inside the hustle tourist district surrounded by overpriced eateries., During previous stays we had discovered and appreciated the Quan Bui Original and Garden. Le Central offers the same quality of service and freshness of products. A little away from the hustle and bustle, it seemed calmer and less crowded, at least when we came. The ground floor room is well ventilated. The cooks enhance the passion fruit with a sauce to accompany the Seabas fillet and the essential Panacotta.
description: Dining in Saigon is quite easy and it is not a place where you will easily go hungry, regardless of your budget. Some of Vietnamese restaurants which cater to the business community are quite Westernized. If you insist on a crisp, white table cloth, we don't have it. But for those who want to enjoy real Vietnamese & Home made food and contemporary Saigon living, forget about all the tourist restaurants with their white linens and bloated prices, and instead dine where the Vietnamese do. Surely, you'll have a best experience once you try at Quan Bui.

name: Bambino
address: 29-31 Tôn Thất Thiệp Lầu 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: A vibe dining experience Saigon has been missing. Great modern Italian cuisine served meticulously in a fun environment. Great terrace and private dining area as well. On weekends the party vibe comes late and it transforms to a lounge/club feel., Delicious restaurant, great service. In RCM food, everyone eats beef potatoes. Anyone who wants to eat vodka macaroni but doesn't like the strong tomato flavor should try other dishes... (ykr) 🤍 Ms. Lam is so cute, love, The vibe and concept here are very good, but most of all the food is delicious, the staff is enthusiastic and polite, very suitable for dates or going out with friends. I'm not the type of person who takes pictures while eating so I don't have any pictures 🤣 anyway good food, good vibe, good service. Not exceeding expectations but enough to impress with the very good vibe 👍
description: A vibe dining experience Saigon has been missing. Great modern Italian cuisine served meticulously in a fun environment. Great terrace and private dining area as well. On weekends the party vibe comes late and it transforms to a lounge/club feel.

name: Bo Ne Thanh Tuyen
address: 20/6-7 Nguyen Truong To Ward 12, District 4, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This is an absolute must do for breakfast. Sizzling hot beef, egg and pâté finished off with a Banh Mi. This place was fantastic, 10/10. The staff are friendly, the atmosphere buzzing and the meal was off the charts. Meal for 2 cost $7.50 AUD Enjoy 👍🏽, Best breakfast ever! I think this is the best breakfast I’ve ever had in my life. The quality and taste is just unmatched with very reasonable price., This is a must visit! Super friendly staff and the food was delicious. Would come on the daily if I wasn’t a tourist. We got the Beef egg and pate which seems to be the specialty.
description:
This is an absolute must do for breakfast. Sizzling hot beef, egg and pâté finished off with a Banh Mi.

This place was fantastic, 10/10. The staff are friendly, the atmosphere buzzing and the meal was off the charts.

Meal for 2 cost $7.50 AUD

Enjoy 👍🏽

name: Au Parc
address: 23 Han Thuyen District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Having eaten here the last time I was in Vietnam, I was looking forward to the sea bass, and I was once again impressed! It was delicious! The server was knowledgeable about gluten allergies, and assured me everything on my plate was gluten-free. My friend had the halloumi salad, and it was loaded with halloumi, and so delicious! We arrived during Happy Hour, where cocktails were 100,000 vnd each, and wine was 30% off. I had a glass of wine, and also ordered the best cocktail ever - "Say Captian, Say Basil" - so refreshing! The menu is pricey by Vietnamese standards, but a good deal when compared to western restaurants. The bathroom was spotless, which is always a welcome sign. I love this place!, This was a restaurant that we frequented about 1-2 times weekly when we used to live a 15 minute walk away, but no longer. Our patronage intervals of this place has dropped to a miserable 2-3 times annually, since we moved further out of time. Tonight, we were ashamedly stuck for a place to eat so what better than to re-visit our old flame. Au Parc is a Mediterranean restaurant with a loyal bevy of fans. For a rainy Saturday night, these fans were either no longer with them, or just absent, leaving us as the only customers in the restaurant at 7pm on a Saturday evening. The waiters are extremely pleasant as always, refreshing to see a pleasant face when you are tired and hungry. I ordered the hummus as a shared starter, my wife had a grilled salmon and I had the grilled chicken breast. Almost immediately after our orders were taken, the waiter plonked a bread basket onto out table followed by our hummus started a few minutes later. The main courses arrived no more than 10 minutes after. As usual, food standards are extremely high at this place, from the quality of the complimentary bread, then the hummus starter and the main courses. I must also mention that they do fabulous starters here. Prices are reasonable for the quality if food that you get. Highly recommended obviously!, The food is great and large portions - so make sure you are hungry. I had a mojito cocktail which was amazing. The owner is french and she has done a great job making the interior really relaxing and welcoming.
description: We are serious about the term Mediterranean here. We don’t just mean Italian & Greek delicacies, we mean Mediterranean in the wide sense; Turkey, Cyprus, Lebanon, Syria, Israel, Egypt, Algeria, Morocco, Spain, etc. We selected wines in harmony with our food and snack menus. Our charming colonial building with no frills, original cement tiles, bare brick walls and old window frames is ideally located half way between the Reunification Palace and Notre-Dame. The space has a peaceful, relaxed feel to it and is a perfect stop on a busy day around the city with a small but extremely popular terrace on Saigon’s most prestigious tree lined street. We are opened for breakfast, lunch and dinner. A super popular brunch is served from 11 to 4 Saturday and Sunday (bookings highly recommended). As demonstrated by our bikes zipping around the city, our delivery service is the most efficient and most popular in the city, amongst expats and locals alike. Au Parc opened in February 2003.

name: Runam d'Or
address: 3 Cong Xa Paris Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: During our short stay in HoChi Minh City we had an excellent dinner at the restaurant. The combination of French and Vietnamese cuisine was really outstanding. The manager of the restaurant, Mr. Rousselin, was very charming and gave us good recommendations. We can highly recommend this restaurant if one is looking for a high quality ( not cheap) dinner in a great atmosphere!, My husband brought me to Runam d'Or for my birthday dinner after having gone there with clients earlier in the day and being impressed by it. It was delightful. We were warmly greeted by the French Maitre D' and were treated very attentively by the staff. The food was delicious and the French colonial decor was lovely with lots of potted greenery outside. I agree with the review below that it is an oasis from the city's hustle and bustle. I highly recommend it., Close to two tourist sites: the cathedral and the old post office. The restaurant is open in an old traditional house, there is a shaded terrace. The varied menu offers very fine and tasty dishes, accompanied by wines of extreme delicacy. We recommend this restaurant.
description: RuNam d’Or is a premium restaurant - bar in center of Sai Gon. This is a new look of a historical structure where we bring all the best of cafe RuNam with our professional and international standard services to people who love perfection and beauty.

name: Truffle Restaurant
address: 208 Nguyen Huu Canh Level 73, Vincom Landmark 81, Vinhomes Central Park, Ward 22, Binh Thanh, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The overall experience was wonderful! It makes the price seem cheap compared to the excellent quality of service and food here! The staffs are all really nice and they make your dininng time feel heartwarm. In particular, Alex was hearty in showing the way, Kayla is an excellent bartender who caters for her guests in a very active, friendly way. I am also especially impressed at Francis for his food knowledge, his friendliness and engagement when serving his customers. As for the food, gotta say Chef Pierrick has both a great sense of arts and excellent cooking level! Our food was both gorgeous to look at and exquisite to dine! Totally deserving of the Michelin stars he got! Made our anniversary an unforgettable memory!, The view and amazing service captivated me, not to mention the stellar, well thought out dishes. A perfect combination of elegance, atmosphere, and thought provoking food created an amazing experience. will come again, Good food; nice staff and a really nice view over Saigon. The restaurant to get away from the traffic and in a distance really enjoy the atmosphere of the town. If you’re planning to eat it could be a good idea to book a seat the evening before, , but cozy.The view is great, the staff are super friendly and the food is delicious! Highly recommend!
description: Truffle Restaurant in Landmark 81 offers an exquisite dining experience overlooking the beautiful skyline of Ho Chi Minh City. The restaurant serves set menus with a focus on French cuisine, using the freshest and highest-quality ingredients. The relaxed and elegant atmosphere, accompanied by knowledgeable and attentive staff, ensures a memorable dining experience. The menu also features a selection of fine wines and spirits to complement the delicious meal. For those seeking a luxurious and indulgent dining experience, Truffle Restaurant in Landmark 81 is definitely worth a visit.

name: Yuzu Omakase Vietnam
address: 34 Thu Khoa Huan Street, District 1 Level 3, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Excellent lunch omakase experience, very friendly and knowledgable chef. Staff recommended a nice sake bottle to pair very well with the entire set menu, plus a complimentary glass for trying a different bottle from the same producer. Overall an unforgettable dining experience, I watched a lot of review clips on Tiktok, I really liked it, but looking at the price, I was a bit shocked. But in the end, I still decided to experience it with two friends. We used the set for 4 million/person, with about 18 dishes, including dessert. You really get what you pay for, all the dishes are delicious. My favorite dish is Bafun Uni Sushi. It's soft and fatty. The chef also adds a lot of Uni. I'm so addicted. We ate 18 dishes in 2 hours but the chef served the dishes in a very timely manner so we didn't feel overwhelmed or overwhelmed. The chef also takes care and we often ask if we need to adjust the amount of rice or wasabi to get the best taste. Looking at the picture, I thought each dish was very small, but after eating that set, I was very full. After eating, you will also receive a free cake to take home. The restaurant space is luxurious but quite small, so the waiting area is not comfortable. The day we went, we had to wait about 10 minutes (even though we booked a table in advance) because it was a bit crowded., I've known about this Yuzu Omakase restaurant for a long time, but only now have I had the chance to experience it. I booked a table for 2 people and chose the 6.5 million course, plus VAT and drinks, so the bill was about nearly 16 million. This price is the most expensive compared to other Omakase NHs. The food is very fresh and delicious, there are unique performances by the chef throughout the meal to help keep the dinner from being boring and customers can also interact and chat with the chef. What I like about the restaurant is that there is a Sommelier who advises and recommends wine to customers because I am someone who likes to drink wine on special occasions or on dates, but I don't know much about wine, so I really need Sommeliers who can. Advise and help me choose a bottle of wine that is delicious and suitable for me. Overall, I feel that spending a large amount of money on a date dinner for 16 million is quite satisfying, the food is delicious, the chef and service are both very cute and enthusiastic. I rate 8/10 for food and service. The remaining 2 minus points for the restaurant location are quite difficult to find because it is a one-way street and if you overtake, you have to turn around quite far. The next minus point is that even though I spent more than tens of millions of money, I still have to sit with friends. Other guests and the chef served not only the 2 of us but also 3 other guests. When we came to eat, the room was full so it was quite noisy, for guests who need privacy and don't like crowded noisy places. You should not book the main room but can choose a private room.
description: Yuzu Omakase Vietnam - Revolutionizing Omakase with a Modern Culinary Twist to Elevate Your Experience

name: Soul Burger
address: 35 Vo Truong Toan Street Thao Dien Ward, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: First of all I walked here so I did not have to worry about parking or a motorbike but in Vietnam you can always find parking for your motorbike let me just say. I came on Wednesday night for the cheeseburger special for 99,000 it is a good hamburger quality meat good cheese and a nice bun. A little on the smaller side for hamburger standards but I enjoyed everything. A 4 star restaurant friendly staff and great music and happy hour beers for 30,000 tiger draft., The perfect burger for me has tasty meat, crispy bacon, thick cheddar and most importantly a bun that doesn't disintegrate as you eat the burger. This place has awesome burger bun bread and all the above. Comes with fries that are home made style and really good. Also the pulled pork burger was excellent as was the corn on the cob with parmesan which tasted great. Awesome food and highly recommended!, Great hidden gem featuring western style burgers and quality bar appetizers, right next to one of the biggest markets overlooking street vendors. Chill late night atmosphere and very friendly staff. Delicious!
description: Casual restaurant with international beer list, a few wines, and a full bar program.

name: La Crêperie Ho Chi Minh City
address: N 16, Street 43 Thao Dien, District 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Looking for a place to celebrate Valentine's Day with my lovely wife and spotted a post in a Foodies Group for Saigon by La Creperies outlining their special menu for Valentine's Day. (Normally closed Monday nights) After reading it I knew this was the place to be tonight. Booked a table for 6pm but unfortunately my Vietnamese wife is a French chef and she got a little tied up with her private client and we didn't arrive till 6.30pm. I messaged the restaurant that we would be running late. I'm so glad they decided to open for Valentine's Day else I probably never would've found this delightful bistro. We started with a shared entree of Smoked Salmon Blinis. They quickly disappeared in no time. Lol. I ordered the French Lamb Cutlets from NZ which were unbelievably tender. Kim ordered the Prawns & Mango Crepe. Excellent choice. Kim ordered the Caramelised Apple Crepes while I chose the ultimate Valentine's Day dessert of Crepes Suzette. All in all a superb meal in a friendly atmosphere with even the owner coming to visit the guests at their tables for a nice chat. Now that we have found this little bistro I look forward to future visits to try other dishes on their menu., Cool restaurant with a variety of delicious dishes. Lamb Rack is very delicious, the meat is tender, the sauce is just right, and the mashed potatoes are wonderfully soft. La Sexy Suzette cake with orange sauce and mango ice cream was delicious along with the top-notch wine burning., This restaurant was recommended by some French friends, so we went with high hopes. This place is excellent! A bit small with indoor and outdoor seating and also a small bar, but being Sunday lunch time, we did not partake. The savory and sweet crepes were really excellent quality. The service friendly and helpful. There is nothing we could find bad here. In the taxi home our 5 year old daughter said it was her favourite restaurant ever. Highly recommended and we will be back for sure!
description: La Crêperie is a casual French bistro, already famous in various big cities in Asia. Besides some traditional French dishes, you will find here the most authentic French savory and sweet crêpes. Wether you have a sweet tooth or not, with so many options in the menu, you will for sure find your favorite. In addition, specifically in Ho Chi Minh City, our Chef proposes some great Pizza, with a wonderful bread made thin and crispy, to let you enjoy our great selection of toppings. La Crêperie is not only a place serving great food. It is a place you may also enjoy for its atmosphere, thanks to a nice decoration and an attentive team, managed by Patrice, the owner of the place, who will warmly welcome you!

name: Bar 5 Saigon
address: 44-46 Pasteur Ben Nghe, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Number 5 Bar is owned by a European gentleman, and it shows in the dinner menu. The food here is EXCELLENT. This is a hostess bar with a pool table and darts. The ladies are fun and like to keep the guests entertained. The bar is well stocked. The hostesses share bartending duties; ask for Hahn to make the best margarita in town. This place draws a large number of expats, which on most nights outnumber the locals. There is live music three or four nights a week. The wine bar next door is the same ownership and management; that section is non-smoking., This Is The Best Restaurant In Japan town In Saigon Vietnam Hands Down. The Cauliflower Onion, And Garlic Stir Fry Is Awesome. Keep Up The Good Work Satisfied Customer Alfred Schlegl From Calgary Alberta., Is this a brass house??? Left unsure the staff were extremely friendly 🥰😳………………………..beer was cold staff dressed like Britney Spears
description: Bar 5 Saigon is a great place where Tourists , Expatriates and Locals meet to have a drink and eat ! Our menu contains some delicious , Swiss , German,Vietnamese and other famous international dishes . Bar 5 Saigon opened since 1998 (oldest Bar in Saigon )and is a widely known pub with Live music on Sunday's, Tuesday and Wednesday . Also Bar 5 is well known as a Sports bar as we show all Sports event on big TV's , we have free Pool table and we organize regular Golf events. Bar 5 offers the best HAPPY HOUR in Vietnam ! Everyday from 3pm until 8.30pm. Draught Beer all you can drink ! For only 170'000vnd(6.5usd). Welcome to Bar 5 Saigon !

name: Com Tam Moc
address: 85 Ly Tu Trong District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Very nice and clean place. I got a plate with grilled pork, rice, vegetables and tamarind juice. It remains a puzzle why they made me pay extra for asking for a napkin – total lunch 152,000 Dong, Not much on the ambience, but the selections made up for it. It seems like they must have literally dozens upon dozens of menu items and the prices I think are pretty much reasonable for what you’re getting. The menu is impressive with many offerings like pho, soup, broken rice com tam. The com tam is outstanding The restaurant is rather austere but certainly not unpleasant in any way. We left feeling we had had just the right amount of food., I ate well in this small restaurant in Saigon where there are relatively many staff so that, from the moment you sit down to the moment the dish arrives on the table, just a few minutes pass. Not all of the staff at the tables found the time and desire to smile. In the considerable comings and goings of customers, little time was dedicated to courtesies. Seeing none on the table, I asked for paper towels or napkins (no tablecloth covered the table) but was told there were none. In fact, there were no tablecloths or napkins on any of the tables. I then solved the cleaning of my hands and lips in the toilet which I found clean but without anything to dry my hands.
description: Homecooked Vietnamese restauranted located in the central of city. We are established more than 10 years. Our signature is Saigon broken rice with many kinds of BBQ (pork, chicken, etc,..) Now we have 2 branchese -• Com tam Moc Ly Tu Trong 85 Ly Tu Trong, District 1 near HCMC museum -• Com tam Moc Bitexco Icon 68 Bitexco Finacial tower

name: Miyama Cafe
address: 65 Le Loi Street, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1 L3-01, Saigon Centre, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: There was good service with good food. It had a nice atmosphere and I had an amazing time. I would definitely recommend going there in the future if you can. I know that I will probably again!, Good service, cozy and warm atmosphere . I tried almond milk matcha latte, very awesome drink 👍🏻👍🏻, My sister recommended us to go to Miyama Cafe to celebrate my birthday. We had a really good time with delicious cakes, drinks and good service. We will be back.
description: Miyama is the first truly modern Tokyo Cafe & Restaurant in the midst of bustling Saigon. From our grand desserts, our inspired food, our service, our minimalist space, to the urban views through the glass windows, the whole concept of Miyama Cafe is designed to make you feel as if you’re sitting in Tokyo, watching the busy streets of Shibuya….

name: Dalcheeni HCMC
address: 2A Ngo Van Nam Ben Nghe , District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 710000 Vietnam
reviews: This is another authentic Indian restaurant which has good ambience and a very friendly staff. The food here is excellent with a choice of veg and non veg options. The tandoori preparations are really good. We enjoyed our meal though the service was a tad slow due to the rush (they actually have a waiting if you don't reserve in advance). A bit pricey than Makhan Bhog located 200 yards away, this restaurant is located right across the waterfront, At Dalchini, you will feel like you are invited into their home. Their friendly, warm and high quality hospitality and food make this restaurant the best restaurant in Vietnam and the best Indian restaurant. Customers also seem to enjoy a good time with their close friends and family. Madame will teach you about the precious food culture and manners of India. Please enjoy the beautiful aroma of ginger and cardamom after the meal with Indian tea. Dalchini is highly recommended for those who live in Ho Chi Minh City and those who are visiting on a trip!, The restaurant space is very luxurious, the dishes at the restaurant are mainly Northern Indian dishes, although strange, they are very delicious and suitable for Vietnamese tastes. The staff is very dedicated and recommends dishes suitable for Vietnamese people. If you want to learn about Indian food, you should visit the restaurant to try it! Will come back again and again to try other dishes.
description: At Dalcheeni we serve you a part of our culture ,soaked in our heritage ,made with heart and served with passion . Dalcheeni is not only a place to dine , It is place to experience Indian Culinary lineage . The Culinary journey at Dalcheeni starts with dishes cooked in Tandoor and Charcoal Fire . This Technique was inherited by the Mauryan Dynasty ( 300BC) and Perfected over centuries. The main course have been selected to give you a gastronomic panorama of Indian cuisine . The Royal kings were the main patrons, connoisseur of food . Each dish has a story to tell. We at Dalcheeni serve Vegeterian and 100 % HALAL food .

name: Stoker Woodfired Grill & Bar - Thao Dien
address: 02 Dang Huu Pho Thao Dien, District 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We discovered this restaurant in 2020 and couldn't wait to return there during this stay; for its location in a quiet street in Thao Dien, its large, bright room, well air-conditioned without excess, the comfort of its armchairs. You feel at ease upon entering with discreet and attentive servers and its large kitchen open to the room. We see the cooks preparing the dishes, in sauce, grilled or smoked with great care and the result is guaranteed; the plates are well presented and tasty. Possibility to choose between a menu or a la carte. A lunch that satisfied our taste buds., The restaurant’s cozy and stylish atmosphere provided the perfect setting for a relaxed midday meal. The menu had a great variety, but I was particularly drawn to the wood-fired dishes. I chose the steak, which was cooked to absolute perfection – tender, juicy, and packed with that distinct smoky flavor that only a wood-fired grill can achieve. The sides were just as delicious, fresh, and thoughtfully paired to complement the main course. The staff were warm and welcoming, with a keen attention to detail that made my lunch even more enjoyable. They were attentive without being intrusive, ensuring everything was perfect throughout my visit., This restaurant is fancy, this reflects on their pricing but trust me, it is absolutely worthy of being called fancy. Well-personalized details, from the smiles down to their greetings. Wagyu steaks are must-trys, they also have such delicious sides to top it up lols (in my opinions, their sides are even better than some main dishes). This detail shows me that they care about your dining experience. Well-played Conclusions, MUST GO AND TRY
description: More than a grill, more than a steakhouse, Stoker is a unique fixture on Vietnam’s dining scene for those that like meats well prepared and expertly cooked

name: Nha Hang Asian Kitchen
address: 185/6-8 Pham Ngu Lao Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: We went there for lunch. The menu was extensive and the prices were reasonable, so we were able to enjoy a casual meal. They are open from 7am to 10:30pm, so you can enjoy breakfast, dinner, and alcohol. We also had beer and Dalat Wine White., We found this restaurant down an alley near our hotel, these alleyways are full,of lovely little restaurants serving good food at very reasonable prices. Most, like this one, are family run and you receive a warm welcome and they want to create a good impression. We have bee here a few times and food and service are excellent. The prices are very reasonable and we will be going back again! Highly recommended., Guys have eaten at Asian Kitchen many many times everytime food excellant service excellant. I have got to knoe the owners and staff very well and all my meals are the best. Menu has anything you want Vietnamese food, vegetarian and many many western dishes. I am in Viet Nam for 45 dsys will eat 75% ofvmy meals there. For me quality of food always the same excellant. Great location good people best food. And for you penny pinchers always get your moneys worth never walk away hungry. Also good selection of cold beers, wine and mixed drinks.
description: We went there for lunch. The menu was extensive and the prices were reasonable, so we were able to enjoy a casual meal. They are open from 7am to 10:30pm, so you can enjoy breakfast, dinner, and alcohol. We also had beer and Dalat Wine White.

name: Chang Kang Kung
address: 1058 Nguyen Van Linh Level 3, Vivo City Mall, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We were taken by our family to this lovely place. Absolute perfection. It was just a pure joy to savour that standard of steamed vegetables, fish and other healthy options of dishes. The ingredients tasted fresh and the service was friendly and attentive., All dishes were cooked via steam in a central submersed hot pot. All of us had a conversation while waiting for steaming food. All fresh and tasty. Highly recommended! * should book table in advance., It's not often you try a new cuisine, much less a new cuisine cooked in a style never seen before. You order a bunch of dishes, and each dish is steamed in front of you in this innovative steamer pot. But the real trick is the rice that's sitting below the steamer, absorbing all the food's juices and steam. At the end of the meal, you have an insanely rich porridge to cap off your meal that contains all the meat, seafood, and veggie sweetness and essence. Amazing!
description: We were taken by our family to this lovely place. Absolute perfection. It was just a pure joy to savour that standard of steamed vegetables, fish and other healthy options of dishes. The ingredients tasted fresh and the service was friendly and attentive.

name: Oedo Alley - Japanese Food Village
address: 65 Le Loi L5-09, Saigon Centre, Ben Nghe, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant has a wide variety of food options and has decent ambience. The age dashi was of acceptable quality 8/10 and the highlight was the fried chicken with mentaiko sauce. 8/10 which was billed as the best seller. The teppanyaki prawns scored a 8/10. It was devoid of customers for some reason but it may be due to other factors. The Fruit Parfait looks fantastic and the taste is outstanding. 8/10 One fault has to be the amount of time spent waiting for the food to be served. There was only 4 tables occupied so a waiting time of 15mins is inexcusable. 5/10, This is a great restaurant if you want to try various types of Japanese cuisines. The atmosphere is calm, but lively during dinner time. Great staff! Amazing food! Highly recommended for those who wanted to try Japanese for the first time., A village full of Japanese food. You can easily find everything here: udon, ramen, sashimi, matcha... Everything reminds you of Japanese cuisine and culture. The staff are very nice. I really want to come back often although the price is quite expensive.
description: Oedo Alley consist of six restaurants about the japanese Cuisine. That is: Tamoya Udon, Bankara Ramen, Sushisen, Tokyo Sundubu, Botejyu Okonomiyaki, Gourmet Yatai.

name: PHO 2000
address: 208-210 Le Thanh Ton Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Welp... It was kinda affordable for me, but I would say it a bit too "heavy" for me in the morning since there're a lot of meat and the broth maybe a bit too much meat juice for me I think. However, my girlfriend really likes it so... I think it worth to give it a try tho, Pho so-so. If you've eaten good Pho, this is not the place for you. Overpriced cold coffee 69,000 I've never had it so expensive. In pho-bo, vegetable oil is added to the broth to add richness; this can be seen immediately. I don't recommend this establishment. Before Covid there was delicious soup. This is a pink place to visit., The soup is the best I have ever tasted. It is not an ordinary soup base. It feels thick and fragrant. The meat quality is also good, but the powder is not very good. The soup is not that hot. The spring rolls taste crunchy. , smells like lard, but the staff is too lazy and chatting all the time. It may be a cultural problem~ So far, it is considered a good place to eat in Ho Chi Minh and worth a try
description: Will forever be remembered as the place where former President Bill Clinton enjoyed his first bowl of pho in Vietnam during his visit in 2000. Savor the delicious broth, slurp the noodles and bite into the succulent beef. You'll soon understand why Pho2000 continues to live on its legacy till today. Come visit us across the Iconic Ben Thanh Market.

name: Cha Ca La Vong Restaurant
address: No 3-5 Ho Xuan Huong Street, Ward 6, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Love the chả cá here!!! Just note, this place only serves this specific dish here. The cá (fish) is well flavored and even better once the dill/onions cook more with it—the smell is amazing. The purple dipping sauce has quite a distinct smell, so it could take some getting used to it before you can fully enjoy it—but once you do, it’s delicious with the fish and noodles!, Had our very first meal in Saigon at this restaurant. Service was friendly, fast and efficient. The cat fish cooked in tumeric with all the fresh herbs was so so good. This meal is originally from North Vietnam. Must try local cuisine. Price was average. Restaurant was clean and comfy. Payment in cash only., We visited with Vietnamese friends, a group of 5. Delicious cha ca la vong fish dish with dill, onions and greens. It was served with noodles and a sauce that was flavorful. We were told a bit of history of the man (since passed) that started and owned this restaurant over 100 years ago. They only serve the one dish. But, ending on a sweet note, we had the best creme brule we have ever had.
description: Love the chả cá here!!!  Just note, this place only serves this specific dish here.  The cá (fish) is well flavored and even better once the dill/onions cook more with it—the smell is amazing.  The purple dipping sauce has quite a distinct smell, so it could take some getting used to it before you can fully enjoy it—but once you do, it’s delicious with the fish and noodles!

name: Mr.T-Bone Steak & BBQ Saigon
address: 70-72 Tôn Thất Đạm Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: The boss is very enthusiastic. The pasta is seasoned with a little Vietnamese tomato sauce, which is delicious! When ordering, he reminded us how much we should order. The service is very good. There is a hot stone plate to heat up the T-bone to avoid it getting cold., Not cheap but quality of steak was good. Service was good albeit the food took a while to come even though the restaurant was not busy when we came. Sides accompanying steaks could be bigger given the cost. Overall a very pleasant change after 9 days straight of vietnamese food. Staff very nice., Best beer we have found in Vietnam!!! Been missing the hole comforts of tap beer and this fixed it (Saigon on tap). We only had appetisers but these were amazing. Hidden spot here as only found it as we were searching streets for a decent beer. We ended up with a surprise 30% discount on arrival and extra free nibbles. Staff were amazingly friendly and speak very good English. Definitely a spot to check out if you are in the area, even just for a beer!!!!!!!!!!!
description: TEX-MEX-STEAK cuisine- Best in town in low price for special steaks especially T-bone on hot stone is alway Best seller. Waiting you guys to come enjoy beers and steaks.

name: Saigon Kitchen Restaurant
address: 78 76 Nguyen Thi Minh Khai Street 2nd Floor, Hôtel des arts Saigon, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The breakfast is very modern. The juice is gold pressed. You can choose a salad with grains, and the egg dishes are cooked to perfection. It's healthy, cozy, very delicious, and very satisfying. It's also perfect for lazing around in the morning. But the taxi on the way back to the hotel was the worst. The hotel staff seemed to know me, but it was a rip-off. There was a familiar lettering like VANSAN written on the body, so I got in, but there was no meter. By the time I thought it was bad, the taxi was still running, so I just left it. The taxi on the way there was 20,000 VND, so I paid 25,000 VND, and suddenly the screen on my smartphone showed 36,000 VND. It's not a big deal in terms of the amount, but it makes me feel bad, so I recommend that you visit the hotel with the intention of calling a Grab yourself on the way back. Anyway, the breakfast is great❗️, Had a wonderful seafood buffet. There were plenty of delicious food and as we luckily booked earlier on the same day, we were even given 2 bottles of complimentary wine! The kind and professional team facilitated an exceptionally enjoyable evening, especially the attentiveness and friendliness of one of the staff members, Mr THÂNH NAM. He ensured that all our needs were met while his warm hospitality added an extra layer of enjoyment to our dining experience. His presence made us feel valued and well taken care of throughout the evening. We truly appreciate his exceptional dedication and professionalism., It is a while since we ate in Saigon Kitchen and yet I remember the food vividly, as well as the first class service and warm welcome. I went to see the restaurant shortly before Christmas as we were considering dining there on Christmas Day. The restaurant's décor and ambience has the wow factor upon entering and the Events Manager couldn't have been more welcoming or helpful , inviting me to look at the dishes under the tureens and asking me where I would like to sit on Christmas Day. Unfortunately I was too late to book for Christmas Day lunchtime and had to settle for the evening buffet, but minus the turkey. I would have loved it if the hotel could have offered turkey at both sittings on Christmas Day. We compensated for this by having a massive Christmas turkey dinner elsewhere on Christmas Eve and just came to the Saigon Kitchen Christmas Day evening buffet to enjoy whatever was there. Again, we received a wonderful welcome, not just from the Events Manager but by every member of staff we saw there. It was a sheer pleasure to eat in that venue. The staff were also very attentive, clearing away plates and regularly topping up sparkling wine etc. The food was generally to a very good standard, there was a very good range of salads, roast meat, bread and cheeses etc., as well as lots of other things like sea food and dessert. I was slightly disappointed that there was no Thousand Island dressing for the salad, as that, along with French dressing, is my favourite. Nor was there any Mustard and Honey dressing or something similar, but it was not a big issue. Nor was the cold brandy sauce that was next to a most delicious hot Christmas pudding. A polite request to the server at the stand as to whether I could have hot brandy sauce, resulted in a very generous amount being whisked away to the kitchen and returned a very short while, steaming hot. It was delightful, as were their other desserts, but particularly the Christmas pud. The staff are ultra helpful, the server made a point of saying that if I needed any more hot brandy sauce, to just ask anyone I could see, who would all help. There was a pianist in the background and the volume was at a non intrusive level which added to the pleasant experience and was welcome as some enjoyable background music. We will definitely return to this restaurant in the near future and we will definitely book extra early at the end of the year for the Christmas turkey lunch!
description: Located on the 2nd floor of Hotel des Arts Saigon, Saigon Kitchen offers a vibrant dining experience blending Asian flavors with Western cuisine. The restaurant features an open-kitchen concept, inspired by the Asian street food markets. With its warm atmosphere, it is the perfect place to enjoy a variety of culinary delights. Guests can indulge in a Chic Buffet Lunch daily or savor an exquisite Surf & Turf buffet dinner from Friday to Sunday evenings.

name: Jumbo Seafood Đồng Khởi
address: 2 Dong Khoi Little Saigon Tower, 1st Floor, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Jumbo just has the best fat and juicy Sri Lankan chilli crabs in Singapore... so we're here for our crab-fix again. Trying the Thai-style claypot rice vermicilli with crab this time and it was still as good. The Garoupa fish we ordered was so succulent and fresh. Our kids went crazy for the Mentaiko shrimps that they went for seconds. Mango Pomelo desserts made a sweet chill ending of the meal. We loved the view of the main Saigon pier and river from our table, and also loved that they're not crowded at all on a weekend afternoon. They're probably more crowded at night since most prefer their sumptuous seafood meals in the evenings!, This Singapore-based upscale chain (2-3 locations in Sai Gòn) serves crab prepared in different ways. The most famous & tastiest is also the messiest, chili (sauce) crab! Delicious! This main Jumbos on Dong Khoi is quite fancy. Prices are not cheap. But it’s a treat for “a night out on the town.”, Chosen for its reputation and the comments read, I was not disappointed. The setting, both refined and chic, is a beautiful invitation to appreciate what follows. The service is impeccable at the level of this type of restaurant. The dishes are tasty and the chili crab has no equal in other sea food restaurants in Ho Chi Minh: it’s the best. The prices are correct given the category of the establishment. I wanted it to be a good moment for a very special occasion, it was.
description:
Jumbo just has the best fat and juicy Sri Lankan chilli crabs in Singapore... so we're here for our crab-fix again. Trying the Thai-style claypot rice vermicilli with crab this time and it was still as good. The Garoupa fish we ordered was so succulent and fresh. Our kids went crazy for the Mentaiko shrimps that they went for seconds. Mango Pomelo desserts made a sweet chill ending of the meal.

We loved the view of the main Saigon pier and river from our table, and also loved that they're not crowded at all on a weekend afternoon. They're probably more crowded at night since most prefer their sumptuous seafood meals in the evenings!

name: Quan Bui Garden Restaurant
address: 55 Ngo Quang Huy street Thao Dien Ward, District 2, The street right in front of PB Compound, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Beautiful place. The garden tables are surrounded by well-maintained exotic plants. The food is exquisite, refined and tasty and the prices match the freshness of the products. The only downside is the service, not due to poor staff but insufficient numbers: in the garden with 17 to 18 tables of 4 only two waitresses. We wait, they run in all directions. I think that in Vietnam taking 1 or 2 more people will not cost the boss that much, taking into account the additions. Hats off to the waitresses and the chef. Address to discover, They also visited their families (three children, ages 2, 4 and 6) and their local friends. They reserved sofa seats, so there was quite a lot of space and I could relax. There are also chairs for children, and they cut them for children, such as spring rolls, to make them easier to eat with scissors. The vegetables were delicious - mango salad, spring rolls I made myself - and the drinks, watermelon and orange, were very fresh, especially the smoothies. No matter what I ate, it was really delicious!, The food is really nice here. I’m from Hanoi and HCMC food is not my type but this restaurant’s food is very delicious. My recommendation is that you go with a large group of friends so that you get to try lots of dishes. I took my foreign friends here, young to old and they all really like the food here. This place is also foreigners-friendly as all the staff here know english. However make sure you tell the staff if you are allergic to anything in advance so they can tell you which dish to avoid.
description: If there is anything to conclude about Vietnamese food, it can only be the "unpredictable diversity". Each region- North, Central and South has something to be proud of. The influence of Chinese and French culture during colonial time adds more to the vibrant scenes of gastronomy. It is hard to describe and compare the specific features of cuisines from each region as there is more than a capital of food in Vietnam. While Hanoi offers some authentic and original food experience, Hue boasts about its royal trait and Ho Chi Minh City is proud that it is the most inclusive place when it comes to dining. You will have to discover it yourself, visit Quan Bui restaurants and decide which one you like the most!

name: Tib Hue Restaurant
address: 187 Hai Ba Trung Street District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Nice place nice food. But the location is not very good. Not easy to find. Waitress services is very good. Will come back again, If you're craving authentic Hue cuisine, this restaurant delivers. The food is fresh and flavorful, with standouts like Goi mit and Bun hen. Service is friendly and attentive, making the dining experience even better. A must-visit for a genuine taste of central Vietnam!, An amazing gem tucked away just outside of the main tourist area. For anyone wanting to experience really amazing Vietnamese food and service, then look no further. I’ve been coming to Vietnam for over 15years and this restaurant tops the list. A faultless experience where the food and environment reflects the traditional Vietnamese hospitality.
description: Nice place nice food. But the location is not very good. Not easy to find. Waitress services is very good.  Will come back again

name: Xoi Ga Number One
address: 15 Nguyen Trung Truc Street, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: When we sat down the host offered us some rolls and other things that I can't define. In any case, beyond his kindness, in his "basic model" restaurant (metal table, plastic plate, no glass), we were served quickly and ate well for just a few euros. Also, very useful and rare to find in popular Vietnamese restaurants, cleaning wipes., Corner small restaurant selling very good sticky rice . We order sticky rice with chicken drumsticks. It contains some crispy shallot but Chili super Spicy but was good. We enjoy very much, After our dinner and shopping at the nearby Takashimaya, we came by here for supper. Since we have had a heavy dinner, we decided to go for something light and thus ordered the Vietnamese Spring rolls (10,000 dong each). This was not the first time we came here as we visited the restaurant in our last visit to HCMC in December 2018. It is just located next to Papaya Hotel. The spring rolls were nice and fresh and what made them perfect was the peanut sauce that came with them. It was very fragrant and a little spicy but was extremely tasty and yummy! (in our previous visit, we tried the sticky rice and that was also very nice) Staff were friendly and though they do not really speak English, we could still communicate with them, with the help of the price labeled menu that is in both Vietnamese and English language.
description: When we sat down the host offered us some rolls and other things that I can't define. In any case, beyond his kindness, in his "basic model" restaurant (metal table, plastic plate, no glass), we were served quickly and ate well for just a few euros. Also, very useful and rare to find in popular Vietnamese restaurants, cleaning wipes.

name: Blanc de Blancs
address: 83-85 Nguyen Hue, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Extremely friendly and attentive staff. Great choice in dishes and drinks. We chose Meaty Meaty, a board with chicken, pork and beef, for two people. The house wine was a nice Cabernet Sauvignon. One detail: we had ordered fries with our main course, we got them first and when the main course arrived 20 minutes later, the fries were gone. But notwithstanding that: a perfect evening, we enjoyed it., An absolute must-visit! The cocktails are expertly crafted, and the atmosphere is unbeatable. Its location near Nguyen Hue Walking Street makes it super convenient for a fun and memorable night out in the city., The attention to detail here is on another level. From the perfectly crafted drinks to the mood-setting lighting, everything feels thoughtfully curated to create an unforgettable experience.
description: Premium Innovative Concept Lounge Offering Multisensorial Experiences & Exceptional Cultural Drinks

name: Parkhaus
address: 152 Le Lai, Distr. 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Cosy - My family & I went in very late in the afternoon but still got to enjoy delicious ice cold German beers & tasty German snack bites… A good variety of German beers… A decent menu with a good spread… Friendly, courteous & attentive… Ideal location…, Descent bar and restaurant for good selection of German imported beer(very important) and food menu looks excellent too but did not eat this time. Comfortable inside area with a seated bar area at the back, music playing in the background which allows one to one conversions. To be honest why drink Heineken or Tiger when you have imported German Arco Weizen and Arco Urfass on draught and bottled Hofbrau Munchner in bottles also imported from Germany. Always worth paying more for quality beer. I am actually drinking Veldensteiner Schwarzbier black lager which is excellent as I have never drunk this beer before and does not disappoint when it enters my mouth. Location of Parkhaus is only a slow 20 minute walk away from the river and Don Khoi Street. This drinking and eating establishment is located in the so called backpackers area of Ho Chi Minh (Saigon) Bui Vien Streetwere where there is a gold mine of cheap hotels and restaurants. Undoubtedly after cycling in the city in 34c temperatures one does get thursty but not for water. Thankfully inside Parkhaus the inside temperature is very sensible as their air conditioning is set to a healthy condition. There is nothing worse then being outside in 34-37c temperatures and going into a place of very cold, ice box air conditioning, for me it is very uncomfortable but here it was very comfortable. Have to recommend Parkhaus on the beer and obviously will have to return to try the food., Mega!!! Food is super delicious! After two weeks of Vietnamese food we were very happy to enjoy our German food 😄 Also recommended for families with children. Super friendly owner! Thanks for the delicious food!
description: Parkhaus brings the true flavors of traditional German cuisine to the heart of Saigon, offering a diverse selection of regional dishes from across Germany. Alongside our iconic sausages, schnitzels, and the famous pork knuckle, there’s something for every craving. Whether you're in the mood for a hearty meal or a classic German feast, Parkhaus delivers an authentic German dining experience in the bustling city of Saigon.

name: Pho Quynh
address: 323 Pham Ngu Lao, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Dinner out with local friends. Great tasting combination pho in a town with plenty of competition. Thankful it didn’t rain. 80,000 a bowl and it is a big serve - too big for me and the outdoor ground level seating is a good viewing platform, Every time I come to HCMC D1, I always come here for one-of-the-best Pho in HCMC. I always order stewed beef pho and beef blood soup with egg (can't find this dish outside HCMC). Both dishes for 109k VND in total, very cheap. The restaurant is a bit squeezy, and the staff dont allow me (solo) to go to L2 to eat. I don't like their service attitude but for their food and price, I still return again and again. LOL!, The Pho tastes delicious and many tourists eat here Wet tissue costs 2000 dong. Taste the original taste before adding additional spices. Like soy sauce, chili sauce
description: Dinner out with local friends. Great tasting combination pho in a town with plenty of competition. Thankful it didn’t rain. 80,000 a bowl and it is a big serve - too big for me and the outdoor ground level seating is a good viewing platform

name: Belgo Belgian Craft Beer Brewery - Da Kao
address: 159A Nguyen Van Thu, Da Kao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Super good service always. We were celebrating a birthday and didn't buy plates or spoons, so we just asked for spoons. They counted the number of people and brought out the right amount. Also, when they saw us bringing in a cake, they even suggested keeping the cake cold. As a bonus, when you take out the cake and blow out the candles, you also pay attention to playing the music "Happy birthday". Nchung is extremely impressive. 5 stars is not available but ^^, Excellent Belgian-style beer served up in a trendy atmosphere. They also serve usual bar food; we had The staff were very friendly and helpful. The provide interesting complimentary snacks of spicy roasted malt and Belgian chocolates! Location is a bit out of the way, but worth seeking out. Beer was 165K VND for a half liter., Sitting in this restaurant, we felt like we were back in Brussels, or it could be any major city worldwide for that matter. The ambiance, atmosphere, service, and food/beer were fantastic. There was even a French singer at one point in the night. A great all-around atmosphere. The steamed mussels were great, and the Belgian style frites were almost too good. Great options off the menu. The beer selections were outstanding too as there's something for everyone with all manner of traditional Belgian style beers. They were pretty busy on the weekend, but our server was very attentive and even brought us complimentary waffles after a slight order mix-up. Wasn't a big deal with the mix-up, but it was evident that staff here care deeply about the level of service. Great job. Our group's only regret was not coming sooner. Highly recommend.
description: A Belgian pub specialized in Belgian beers and foods.

name: Ngan Dinh Saigon Restaurant
address: 52-54-56 Dong Khoi Street, Ben nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: We went to Ngan Dinh when I was 4 weeks pregnant and dealing with the worst morning sickness. It was hard to find a restaurant where I could eat without feeling nauseous, but Ngan Dinh saved me from starvation. Lol The food was so delicious that I was able to devour it without any issues. The flavors were fresh and comforting, making it the perfect spot for a sensitive palate. Highly recommend!, We went to Ngan Dinh when I was 4 weeks pregnant and dealing with the worst morning sickness. It was hard to find a restaurant where I could eat without feeling nauseous, but was so thankful we found Ngan Dinh. The food was so good that I was able to devour it without any problems. Highly recommend!, Fancied some chinese food and saw they had western sweet and sour pork....so went in very keen. Also ordered the pork belly, steamed rice and broccli with garlic. Was all very, very good. A varied menu, so maybe have the duck next time.... Nice surroundings, friendly and professional staff.
description: Ngan Dinh Saigon presents authentic Cantonese recipes at the heart of Saigon

name: Vintage Taste Deli Cafe
address: Số 28, Đường D9, khu phố Phước Thiện, Phường Long Binh, thành phố Thủ Đức, thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, Ho Chi Minh City 71217 Vietnam
reviews: Vintage cafe has a green space, many beautiful trees, the space of the shop is decorated with very beautiful Vintage style items, from hanging paintings to decorative items, all are very meticulous, with a unique style. The shop has a variety of drinks, including light snacks such as cream cakes, croissants... Drinks from tea to traditional coffees and Italian coffees are all very typical. In particular, there is a very typical Hai Phong chrysanthemum tea. I really like this shop. 5 star rating, The restaurant just opened and many people were talking about it, so I came to try it out and see what it was like. The restaurant is beautiful and spacious. I drank salted coffee and my friend drank kumquat tea, extremely delicious and cool drinks, Seeing a new coffee shop open, our group came to experience and share with the whole family. We had iced milk coffee, kumquat tea and chocolate Tiramisu cake. Delicious drinks, extremely high quality cakes, beautiful space, very good staff. Next time I will come back to experience more, the coffee shop is impressive.
description: Vintage cafe has a green space, many beautiful trees, the space of the shop is decorated with very beautiful Vintage style items, from hanging paintings to decorative items, all are very meticulous, with a unique style. The shop has a variety of drinks, including light snacks such as cream cakes, croissants... Drinks from tea to traditional coffees and Italian coffees are all very typical. In particular, there is a very typical Hai Phong chrysanthemum tea. I really like this shop. 5 star rating

name: Dodo Pizza Tran Hung Dao
address: Trần Hưng Đạo, Phường Cầu Ông Lãnh, Quận 1 147A, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant is clean and bright. Food to suit your taste. Enthusiastic service staff, dedicated customer care. Highly recomment must try pizza Seafood Pesto, 4 Cheese and Seafood Dodo., The restaurant is spacious, airy, the staff is enthusiastic, the food is quick and attractive, the base is not too thick and not too thin. I enjoyed it the first time and will come back many more times. Give the restaurant 10 points, no buts☺️, Visiting Dodo Pizza in Ho Chi Minh City was an absolute delight! From the moment I walked in, I was greeted by a warm and inviting atmosphere. The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, making sure every detail of my experience was perfect!
description: The restaurant is clean and bright. Food to suit your taste. Enthusiastic service staff, dedicated customer care. Highly recomment must try pizza Seafood Pesto, 4 Cheese and Seafood Dodo.

name: Pho Phu Vuong
address: 339 Le Van Sy, P.1, Q. Tan Binh, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: This is one of those places specialized in Pho. It serves a hybrid between north and south Pho, and comes in medium, large, or extra large formats. The medium one can have 2 components, the large 3, and the extra 4 components. Unfortunately, they had run out of the meatballs and one type of fatty meat, so we ended it up trying it with tripes and other meat types. The taste is great! We also had coconut drinks which were very sweet and full of water. Highly recommended, but try going early before they run out of ingredients., Hard to make more authentic: recommended by the receptionist of the Continental Hotel as the Phó par excellence, well it is... excellent! Only beef (different pieces to choose from), perfectly accompanied by vegetables and condiments. Very simple setting and very attractive prices., I visited the second location, 120 Nguyen Thai Binh. I went because a local food blog had suggested it might be in the top 5 place for Pho. With these expectations I was a little disappointed. First surprise was that they don’t use pho noodle, but use bun. No effect on the taste but very non traditional in my understanding. And to my experience the noodles were over cooked. Supposedly top pho broth is very clear, this one a bit cloudy. Overall it was no better, perhaps not as good as the place local to my apartment who only charges about half as much. I think Phu Vuong suffers some from operating like a production line. If you are close to a more traditional place I wouldn’t suggest making a journey.
description:
This is one of those places specialized in Pho. It serves a hybrid between north and south Pho, and comes in medium, large, or extra large formats. The medium one can have 2 components, the large 3, and the extra 4 components.

Unfortunately, they had run out of the meatballs and one type of fatty meat, so we ended it up trying it with tripes and other meat types.

The taste is great! We also had coconut drinks which were very sweet and full of water.

Highly recommended, but try going early before they run out of ingredients.

name: Pho Bo Phu Gia
address: 146E Ly Chinh Thang Ward 7, Dist.3, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: An iconic place after it was mentioned in an episode of somebody feed phill. The pho is with a crispy twist which was very unique. The food is good and ambiance is basic. Musty try for ho chi min, Obviously don't have a lot of experience with Pho. But hands down the best Pho I've had. The meat is stir fried in fat which it makes really yummy. Ordered the Pho Tai lan., Thanks 'Somebody feed Phil' and Netflix! This place was slightly out the way and hard to find, but definitely worth it. The best Pho I've ever had, so tasty. If you're in Saigon, get yourself here! Stir fried beef Pho is my recommendation. Judge for yourself, but it looks like the locals are impressed too
description: An iconic place after it was mentioned in an episode of somebody feed phill. The pho is with a crispy twist which was very unique. The food is good and ambiance is basic. Musty try for ho chi min

name: Sushi Hokkaido Sachi Pasteur
address: 180-180A Pasteur Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Sashimi is fresh and delicious :)) A place worth trying for Japanese food. Love the service here, the staff are all cute and enthusiastic. Provide adequate backup for customers, especially staff who find themselves leaving backpacks on the ground, so they automatically bring and order backpacks immediately :D Free genka, fresh salmon sashimi, nice decor with the perfect location in Dis 1. Must try Zuwaikani miso yaki., If you are looking for a sushi restaurant that offers quality, variety and service, look no further than Hokkaido Sachi. This place has it all: fresh fish, creative rolls, friendly staff and reasonable prices. I have been here several times and I always leave satisfied and impressed. The sushi chefs are skilled and attentive, and they can accommodate any special requests or dietary restrictions. The waiters are helpful, and they always refill your drinks and clear your plates promptly. The restaurant is clean and cozy, with a relaxing atmosphere. Whether you want to enjoy a romantic dinner, a family outing or a business meeting, Hokkaido Sachi is the perfect choice. I highly recommend this place to anyone who loves sushi or wants to try something new. You won't regret it!, I find the restaurant staff very friendly, the food consultants are very professional, they are very happy and enthusiastic, the food is very fresh and delicious. I went with my family on the weekend but the food came out very quickly, fresh sashimi, grilled oysters with miso sauce, very fragrant and attractive, the restaurant's best-selling dish is grilled crab shell, very greasy, very fresh and delicious salad. .. There are so many great things about this restaurant and I will come back in the future
description: We are committed to using only the finest fresh ingredients imported directly from the famous Japanese seafood island of Hokkaido, combined with the ingredients to meet the standards of food hygiene and safety.

name: ORYZ Saigon Restaurant
address: 51 Tran Nhat Duat, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: On our holiday, we had our last dinner at this incredible restaurant, which offers a set menu showcasing the best dishes from the top to the bottom of Vietnam. The 12-course experience was thoughtfully curated, with a little menu book detailing the traditional version of the dish that inspired each course. The explanations were clear and insightful, enhancing our understanding and enjoyment of each course. Our party of six opted for the full 12-course menu, and the restaurant was very accommodating when three of us wanted to try two additional dishes. The staff were not only professional and friendly but also had a fantastic sense of humor, making the experience even more enjoyable. Having opened in October 2023, this place is a hidden gem that deserves a Michelin star and should be ranked number one. As we were leaving, we had the pleasure of meeting the chef, who was just as warm and welcoming as the rest of the team. Highly recommended!, Very interesting experience. In Saigon a lot of restaurants lately aim for fine dining experience but all offering similar style and products. Oryz is the exception and stands out from the other by offering an Asian approach. Had a tasting menu which was made of 10 small portion but more than enough food. The service was really good with great explanation of all dishes and ingredients from the waitress Ms Thu. We will definitely come back when they change the menu, which I was told changed every 5 to 6 weeks. They even offer non alcoholic pairing .., We had the 8 course, ambience was great, pricing was very reasonable (50usd around) For this price , it is very great for value!
