The dishes, service, ingredients were great. Wine pairing was decent (not stunning) The clay pot rice was the best, the others were basically good ingredients, well plated and good (not stunning, but for this price, very good value) I would come back again! You can tell the chef and staff placed a lot of effort!
description: Nhà hàng finedining modern Asian concept

name: Jalsa - Indian Restaurant
reviews: I had a wonderful experience here. The food was delicious, the ambiance was inviting, and the service was top-notch. Our waiter, Parvez, was exceptionally friendly and helpful, making sure we had everything we needed and offering great recommendations. His warm and attentive service truly enhanced our dining experience. I highly recommend this place and will definitely be coming back!, After being in Vietnam for 8 days and eating Vietnamese 3 meals a day, we were So Happy to have found Jalsa in Ho Chi Minh City for Excellent Indian Cuisine. It was busy when we arrived but Naveen got us a great table and offered some great recommendations. The food was outstanding. The service was great. The beer was cold and crisp. The menu was big, and the chef controlled the spiciness for Laura’s Korma so it was flavorful but not too spicy for her Irish American palate! The naan was so delicious that we ordered a second serving. Naveen also recommended the cumin basmati as opposed to the plain white which we were going to order, and that was great. Try Jalsa. You’ll Love the experience!, I should definitely call this out... Wonderful gesture, awesome food, its all about Jalsa restaurant in Vietnam... We were there for 7 days and our last day was as Ho Chi Minh beautiful city where we started missing Indian food... Luckily our guide spotted Jalsa.. Excellent ambience and mindblowing food... I would give a rating of 10/10 for the Chef.. He was so kind and polite and according to our taste the food was served with a home care.. Kids, my friend and ofcourse me we all enjoyed the food Dosa, and its varities and Chicken fried rice and chicken biriyani was the top most... Everyone who visit this city should give a try in this restaurant and I bet you will find time to provide review here :)
description: JALSA is an Indian restaurant and bar located in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, that offers an exceptional culinary experience with authentic Indian dishes made with fresh ingredients. The restaurant has a warm and inviting atmosphere that is perfect for any occasion, and a team of highly skilled chefs. It also offers an extensive list of signature cocktails, beers, and wines to complement the dishes perfectly.

name: Spice Viet Restaurant
address: 157 Pasteur District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We have stayed at Emm Saigon hotel several times, and each visit is marked by our excitement to enjoy lunch or dinner at Spice Viet. The highlight of every meal here is undoubdly their signature Saigon-style pork chop rice, which has become my absolute favorite. The food is consistently delicious and the service is exceptional professional, warm and attentive. The team goes above and beyond to make every dining experience memorable. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a taste of authentic Vietnamese cuisine at Spice Viet for your wonderful food and hospitality., Really really good restaurant. We went early on a Sunday evening so it was quiet but the food was excellent. The focus is on healthy variations of Vietnamese cuisine and our Waitress had lots of knowledge on what and how to eat to get the best taste. Really good value as well so well worth a visit, I had dinner with my family, the staff was very friendly and the atmosphere was so relaxing. The dishes here were well cooked and decorated, especially Bun cha, which is a new favorite of my family. I highly recommend this place if you want to find a restaurant with stable prices and fresh food.
description: Located in vibrant District 3, just minutes from Saigon’s city centre, Spice Viet Saigon creates a uniquely unforgettable experience for our diners through appetising dishes, warm hospitality, and an elegant setting. Prepare for your taste buds to be tantalised with a finely curated selection of superb Vietnamese favourites made from the freshest, finest, and healthiest ingredients available. Looking for a space to host your special event? Spice Viet Saigon’s open concept restaurant is ideal for large groups and is easily partitioned for more intimate celebrations. Our extensive, competitively-priced menu is sure to please a range of discerning palates and preferences.

name: SOKO Cake Bake & Brunch
address: 27a Nguyen Trung Truc Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We tried two smoothies and one juice which were delicious and looked gorgeous!! We hadn’t seen these in other shops before. They also had special croissants, rolls and 3D cube croissants. While the croissants unfortunately don’t look particularly good (I’m French) - although they are very big! - we tried the chocolate smore cube croissant, which they baked on the go (so we had to wait around 15min) but it was worth it! It was really good for the paste, crunchy outside and soft inside. It had a chocolate mousse inside. The mousse was good but there was a bit too much. Still great! Highly recommend., I have never seen such aesthetic food that tastes so good I was genuinly in shock at how amazing the food looked. The portions are perfect I reccomend the smoothies and the bagel and salmon eggs Benedict rosti. Please visit the staff are so sweet and the croissant was genuinly the best croissant I ahve ever had and huge. I had the almond croissant still warm and filled with almond paste. Honestly incredible!, Famous restaurant for brunch, beautifully decorated Christmas space. Drinks and sweets are beautifully decorated, pleasing to the taste, and moderately sweet. Sweets with many different types and flavors look very eye-catching.
description: SOKO Cake Bake Brunch, the first “member” of SOKOGROUP, an all-day dining establishment that leans into casual daytime refreshments, which translates to brunch. We serve you European brunch classics with a modern and Asian twist. In Japanese, “Soko” translates to “that place/there.”. Soko is named in the hope of being that special “place” for our customers to choose from, whether that be a quick pick-me-up drink or to enjoy a relaxing weekend brunch with their loved ones.

name: La Brasserie
address: 235 Nguyen Van Cu Hotel Nikko Saigon, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Visit to La Brasserie at Nikko Hotel – December 8th We dined at La Brasserie on the evening of December 8th, having wisely made a reservation in advance, as securing a table without one can be quite challenging. Arriving early, we were seated promptly as the restaurant opened. I had heard glowing reviews of this seafood buffet from friends, as well as from online platforms and YouTube. My experience did not disappoint. The buffet featured an extensive array of seafood, including lobster, clams, oysters, and more. The dessert station offered a mix of Vietnamese specialties, fresh fruits, and classic Western desserts, all complemented by free-flowing wine and beer. The staff were attentive and service-oriented, adding to the dining experience. Although the table-ordered lobster could have been served more quickly, considering the large number of diners, it was acceptable. Overall, this is a 5-star buffet experience, though there is still room for improvement in certain areas. Pros: Extensive seafood stations featuring lobster, shrimp, oysters, and more. Traditional Vietnamese dishes like bánh xèo. Attentive and courteous staff. Suitable for romantic dinners, special occasions, or even casual gatherings. Cons: Reservations are essential due to high demand. Prices are subject to additional taxes and service charges. The dessert selection is decent but could be enhanced for a buffet of this caliber., Overall dining environment and food quality are top-notch. The lobster, shrimp, oyster, steak etc are all very fresh. But experience-wise, two improvements: 1) we arrived very early at around 6pm and there were lots of spare seats, but we were arranged to sit at a small table at a corner. When we asked staff to change to other tables, they insisted that all others were already reserved. I don’t think when making bookings, people tell them exactly which table they want to 2) We didnt order many lobsters every time (around 4 pieces each round), but for every round only 1-2 lobsters were served, and sometimes at wrong flavors. So we had to check with staff again and again., We do not normally eat in buffet restaurants but we were recommended and we were not disappointed, the beer and wine is all inclusive, the beer Sapporo or Blanc 1996- both great, the white is ok , drinkable but not great. The amount and range of food available is staggering, lobster is cooked in different sauces and ordered from the table, vast amount of shellfish available , which the adjacent table enjoyed.Wagyu beef etc the list is endless. We loved it- the service is very attentive, topping wine up - without asking . Cost in sterling £60 per head - crazy - just do it!
description: The restaurant offers wide excellent international buffet stations for breakfast and dinner. A la carte menu and set lunch menus also offer Asian cuisine and International selection. La Brasserie is also available for private events where you can entertain your guests in a homey atmosphere while enjoying the bustle of the city. Guests will feel welcomed with a contemporary, spacious, and cozy atmosphere when joining us for a quick bite or at leisure, relaxing breakfast, lunch or dinner. Various menus balances healthy eating with tasty global-inspired dishes, incorporating fresh, locally farmed ingredients on a menu that updates regularly with daily chef specials.

name: Tre Dining
address: 35 Xuan Thuy, Thao Dien, District 2 3rd Floor, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We had a fantastic night at Tre Dining in Thao Dien, District 2. With the top of the view, we really loved and enjoyed the beautiful and dazzling view to Landmark 81. The atmosphere there was very great. High food quality, professional staffs who are always attentive to the details. Opened Kitchen with talented Chefs. The dishes were decorated nicely, well presented. You will have a staff to be ready at your service at the table and present for each dishes. Bar prices cheap, snack food prices cheap. Great night out for not a lot of money. Well worth a visit. Would definetly go back here again., I am quite blessed on the food front. I have extensive experience. Tre is the most memorable dining event I can recall. The combination of exquisite flavors, the presentation, and the beautiful Vietnamese cultural story that is integrated with each course make it a worldwide phenomenon. I can't wait to have another of Chef Dong's creations. Bravo!, This is a nice and cozy place and the staff is really dedicated. The food is delicious. They are also very thoughtful to recognize that it's a special day for us and prepared a surprise gift. We will definitely come back, strongly recommend.
description: MICHELIN SELECTED 2023 A harmonious incorporation of tradition and modern elements into our space, sips, and dine to create the quintessential outing experience. Stories will be made. Experience will be shared. Memories will be forged.

name: BiaCraft Artisan Ales - Le Ngo Cat
address: 1 Le Ngo Cat Street, District 3 Intersection with Ngo Thoi Nhiem, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We stopped by this burger/beer spot. We ordered double bacon cheeseburger, fish and chíp, wings, and black beer. The black beer was amazing. Burger right up there. Fish and chips solid. All in all a great experience. The waitstaff was friendly and helpful. We will return., Good beer with a wide range of selection. Fun vibe. Friendly and helpful staff. Nice surroundings with both locals and tourists 🤩, Huge selection of craft beer. Couldn't even count. They have a great variety of food options as well. On the more expensive side for Saigon but totally worth it.
description: Vietnam's most extensive collection of artisan craft beers and great gastropub food.

name: Bom - Kitchen & Wine Bar
address: 24 Nguyen Thi Nghia Street, Ward Ben Thanh, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: For my last day in Ho Chi Minh City I decided to search for a treat and this place seemed to tick the boxes. It looked nice, a good menu, and popular cocktails. I predicted that I would have a nice meal, but ‘nice’ doesn’t do it anywhere near enough justice! This was a PHENOMENAL visit! The staff are all incredibly kind and polite, and the bartender even managed to pull out a Frangelico Sour just for me (I never get these in bars!). All of the food looked amazing and I wanted to taste as much as I could, so I went for one of the set menus which was 5 courses, and each one was just incredible. The chef(s) have clearly put a lot of thought into each dish and the combinations work wonderfully, I didn’t want it to end. Every bite was delicious. And to top all of this off, it was remarkably well priced! For 5 courses and 2 cocktails I paid 1,300,000 - which equates to £40. If I had this in Europe, I would easily be paying 4x that amount! I implore you to check this out! Both you and your tastebuds will thank me for it., What a place to be with great menu and mega great service. The Seasonal Menue was a fireworks display of flavours and products and showcases the perfect craftsmanship of the kitchen. The wine list leaves nothing to be desired. Thanks for the great evening, the beautiful table and the surprise for your birthday. A highlight of our 4 week trip., What an absolutely genius place. The burger that tastes of pho. The incredible mackerel and tomato. The awesome chicken risotto with corn. Salmon and shrimp dumpling in a bisque. Duck spring rolls were good and the ordinary part of the meal. Puddings of sticky rice and bean not my favourite but probs just me Gorgeous gorgeous and delicious service and awesome cocktail with a huge shout out to Hieu the restaurant manager and all his staff.
description: BỜM wants to remove the barriers to dining formality by creating a casual hangout and relaxing dining experience for locals and visitors to connect. Here, we aim to create a funky eatery that features our cheerful approach to cooking which criss-crosses over Vietnamese and other cuisines.

name: Yu Chu
address: Corner of Hai Ba Trung St & Le Duan Blvd, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1 First Floor Of Jw Marriott Hotel & Suites Saigon, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Came here to try the autumn crab feast and the dishes were awesome. Service is also excellent and value for money. However, it would be nice if they offer bigger crabs at a proportionally hgher price., This is my second time dining at this restaurant. And this time was a bit different, each of us was served a complimentary appetizer which was a deep-fried oyster with some kind of sauce. Moreover, they have just updated a brand new menu. My family ordered a 5-course appetizer, in which cherry tomato salad was the one that impressed me the most because its taste was quite new and delicious. Recommend the shrimp in spicy vinaigrette sauce, the taste is amazing to me, and my whole family like it 🤤(too focused on eating and forgot to take pictures😂). Oh! And the staff here are really friendly, supportive and attentive. Will definitely be back to try other dishes♥️., The restaurant is very good. We went on our first night in Saigon, when we were still adapting to the city and decided to have dinner at the hotel. We were very well served, but communication didn't flow so well, and the dishes weren't familiar to us. Until now we don't know what we asked for, nor what came, but in the end everything worked out. The price is what you should expect in a hotel restaurant of this level. Everything is OK.
description: Translated as “Emperor Kitchen,” Yu Chu is InterContinental Saigon’s signature restaurant located on the first floor. The restaurant marries contemporary style, polished surroundings and culinary spectacle with authentic Cantonese and Peking cuisine. As diners look on, our skillful chefs prepare hand-pulled noodles, fresh Dim Sum and hot wok dishes within the open, impeccably designed show kitchen.

name: Vincom Center Food Court
address: 72 Le Thanh Ton,Dist1 Vincom Center 5F, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: We have visited several times during our month long stay in Ho Chi Minh City. There several good restaurants as well as buffet places that have good food selections, quality, good services and great price points. We love Hoàng Yến, kichi kichi, GoGi House Korean BBQ. If you looking for good quality food, definitely check out the food court on the fifth floor., First visit to the new Street Food Court. Settled on the Wraps and roast Potatoes. Highly recommended. Reasonable prices., Mist of the joints were viet hot pot and bar be que and had waiting lines from locals and tourist on weekend. There was koren barbeque also. A little pricer court
description: We have visited several times during our month long stay in Ho Chi Minh City. There several good restaurants as well as buffet places that have good food selections, quality, good services and great price points. We love Hoàng Yến, kichi kichi, GoGi House Korean BBQ. If you looking for good quality food, definitely check out the food court on the fifth floor.

name: Chay Garden - Vegetarian Restaurant & Coffee
address: 52 Vo Van Tan Vo Thi Sau Ward, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Wonderful place, not crowded and not caothic, as you have to walk down an alley to reach it. very good menu with sooo many veg dishes. aldo the drinks are delicious. we had 2 dishes each and it was definitly too much as everything is "sharing size", This restaurant offers an extensive menu with a well-curated mix of Vietnamese and global dishes, perfect for vegetarians looking for variety. The food was delicious—one of the best meals we had in Vietnam for strict vegetarians—and the drinks complemented the meal nicely. The staff was incredibly polite and attentive, ensuring our dietary requirements were met. A few things to note: For Indian vegetarians, it might be surprising to see some items contain egg, as "vegetarian" here doesn’t exclude it. Additionally, some items with eggs aren't clearly marked on the menu, such as noodles, so it’s best to confirm with the staff, especially if you have allergies. Portion sizes can also be inconsistent; for example, my salad was very large, but the rice portion was quite small, so asking for guidance can help avoid over-ordering. Overall, it was a great experience, and I’d recommend it to fellow Indians visiting Ho Chi Minh City!, Chay Garden serves only vegetarian food, and it's expertly prepared - from the fried taro bowl with veggies to the pineapple fried rice, the food here is amazing! Don't miss the tofu. The green curry was delicious as well. Service is exceptional - if you drop a chopstick, or need more bread, the staff will bring it to you before you're even able to ask.
description: Welcome to Chay Garden - Vegetarian Restaurant & Coffee, A small garden with cool spaces bring you back to the silence in the soul!

name: Akuna Restaurant
address: 3C Ton Duc Thang Street 9th Floor, Le Méridien Saigon, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I just had a very delicious and interesting experience at Akuna. The space is very luxurious and cozy, with tables and chairs arranged far enough apart for privacy. There is a very large open table in the middle to observe the chefs preparing food. I tried the 4-course dinner, which did not include petit four appetizers, bread, and petit four dessert. Every dish is very meticulous, combining many fresh and unique ingredients but very suitable for my taste. I really like the steamed eggs here, they melt in my mouth. The same goes for the tuna belly sashimi, greasy. This was also the first time I tried porcupine meat, the meat was soft and succulent. The staff are very nice, taking care of your table quite thoughtfully. Worthy of a 10/10 experience!, A True culinary art in Saigon. 1. Atmosphere cozy and welcoming. 2. Staff are very well disciplined and well trained. Everyone is on point on all their duty. 3. Wine paring perfectly to each course. 4. Each course is perfectly presented, each are presented with its own utensil, to cleansing on tasting of each course. 5. Chef Sam.. Michelin star chef level experience. I have a chance to dine at Chef table. I get to see all dish come together. Every sous chef, are on point. Clean, respond clearly to head chef command. Each course have its unique tasting. Where I get to experience and tasted each component of each dish are presented to be tasting., This was one of the most memorable meals we've had. Some was due to the amazing and varied food and drink with a great non-alcoholic pairing, some because of the brilliant service and the rest as they handled my gluten free request in an exceptional way. Thanks for making it such a special evening
description: Akuna, located at the Le Méridien Saigon, sits in full view of the Saigon River and is led by Chef Sam Aisbett and hospitality veteran Desiderio Bevilaqua. Bringing his rule-breaking nature to the kitchen, Sam actively decides against limiting the menus to the boundaries of a region or style. With a nod to the people and produce of Vietnam, guests can expect indigenous ingredients, local herbs and spices, rare flavours and nuances — many of which find their way to a fine dining menu for the very first time. The dining experience is further enhanced by a wine list that features a variety of natural, organic and iconic wine bottles; and a cocktail menu of reinvented classics.

name: Meat & Meet Korean BBQ Container Restaurant
address: 08 Le Thi Rieng Street, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: No complaints, the food was outstanding, the veggies meat and everything about it was quality, The service was very attentive, and not intrusive, I choose the middle price selection, of the set menus, and could not finish all the options that came. The only drawback was as a solo traveler, I firstly had to convince the receptionist that I would pay for 2 people, who after radioing upstairs was glad to admit me, this maybe why I struggled to finish the food, as they may have sent out for 2 people. Strangely at the end when the bill was presented I was asked if they were to charge for 1 or 2 people, having indicated that I agreed to pay for 2 the bill including 3 beers came to less than £22.60, and really it would have feed 3 or 4. Have tried Korean BBQ, before and have been let down, this will give some of the higher cost ones a true run of the money, We accidentally found this restaurant just walking around the city. You need to take an elevator up to enter. It’s definitely a spot for locals to go and have fun. We ordered the basic meal ($9.50 per person) and when we were done, the waiter asked us if we wanted more because it was all you could eat! We were full and had to catch a plane so we declined. It was a healthy meal at a great price in a great city. I would recommend it to anyone., This is a great spot for couples and groups, but not if you are looking for a quiet romantic time. Second time for us and enjoyed it just as much. There was much consternation among staff and patrons when the power went out for about 5 or 10 minutes but everyone was patient waiting for the electrician and staff were considerate so no issue. The food is fantastic, service is great with staff willing to explain and help and the Korean rice wine is fantastic(trying to find it here in Australia). And the kimchi- to die for. We will be back on our next visit to HCMC.
description: Wellcome to Meat&Meet Korean BBQ Container. You can enjoy the BBQ with Korean Taste Style inside exciting interior like a container in Saigon city.

name: The Crab Shack
address: 61B Tu Xuong Ward Vo Thi Sau, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Could not find the place. Probably closed down but not updated in trioadvoisr. Kinda of wasted time travelling there. There should be a system of updating, I have pigged out at this place twice. The prices are very expensive for VN standards and the sauce is very oily compared to what I get back in the US. Overall, it is still very good and spicy but some oil reduction could go a long way in improving the sauce., Went for dinner with friends and received great friendly service from wait staff that topped our drinks up for us as our hands were quite saucy. Good selection of seafood options and would recommend the pesto pasta. Garlic sauce that we had in our mixed combo was delicious. The only downside for me was the the gumbo we ordered came in the heavy industrial plastic bag that you see in photos. This made it a bit hard to scoop out all crawfish and I will ask for it to be placed in a bowl next time I go there.
description: Could not find the place. Probably closed down but not updated in trioadvoisr. Kinda of wasted time travelling there. There should be a system of updating

name: Pho Hung
address: 241, Nguyen Trai Rd, Nguyen Cu Trinh Ward, District 1 288 Nguyen Tri Phuong Rd, Ward 4, Dist. 10 and 23 D1 Rd Him Lam Residense,Tân Hưng ward, dist 7, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This noodle shop has been a must-eat for me when I live near Pham Ngu Lao Street for at least 5 years. Choose a large bowl of full ingredients, beef clear soup, delicious taste, and plenty of meat. It is definitely the right way to start a good day., By far one of the better beef pho I have eaten in Ho Chi Minh. Raw beef pho. Generous beef quantity and good flavour. Like most Vietnamese specialty restaurants service is quick and almost instantaneously have food in front of you. Worth the visit., Was coming to the end of our HCM trip and couldn't not have Pho. So popped in here at around 1.30am post some cocktails. Was still fairly busy with locals - there was even a wedding party on their way home. Simply delicious and loved the copious amount of herbs left on every table.
description: Pho Hung was established in 2006 , for the beginning it 's only a small noodle shop as the others noodle shop in Dist 1 , H CM city with an orientation of bringing Vietnamese noodle up to a new level which is quality and service to make a satisfaction and sanitary when enjoying Pho Hung Due to this orientation , we re always maintaining the family traditional flavor of Pho Hung and the high quality service to our customers as well , with the category of quick service , sanitary and quality standard to satisfied the customers enjoying Pho Hung Quality and Pho Hung's taste is always delicious, so we cook according to traditional recipe from our family, the calming flavor of Beef broach , gracious Cow's smell gently stimulate appetite, to ensure stable quality from the selection of materials to the beef broach and cooking Pho soups We're looking forward to welcome and appreciate all the new customers and the traditional customers of Pho Hung as well, Pho Hung will have be seen as a meeting place , a destination of families and friends regularly, on weekends and holidays We sincerely thanks for the kind support from our customers to Pho Hung's staff in recent time to do their good job and always bring to you the satisfaction and trust .. Currently, due to the many noodle shops was named "Pho Hung" which scattered throughout the city, and somewhere in South province , in order to avoid confusion for customers, we ll advise you how to distinguish the Pho Hung tradition name,we'd propose you, and customer to pay attention on the differences below: PHO HUNG we have 0nly 02 shops in Ho Chi M i n h city We honorably welcome to all customers !

name: Mít Rooftop Bistro
address: 7th floor, 35 Dong Khoi, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Chose this restaurant for its rooftop with views and breeze over the Saigon River. We were early for a pre-dinner drink. The drinks were half price and a couple of frozen Daiquiris hit the spot after a hot day. The decor was fairly standard but seats comfortable, the service attentive and prices very reasonable. The food menu had a good range of Vietnamese dishes and we chose Pork Hotpot and Beef and Tonkin Creeper. Both were hot, fresh and tasty. A nice early evening spent in a pleasant environment with good service and food., Small but lively rooftop bar and restaurant on the 7th floor of a block near the river. Street views all round, but what really impresses is the food (all the menu with English translations) and the friendly, efficient service. There’s a happy hour for drinks til 8pm (I think) and decent wine available such as Chilean Sauvignon Blanc, plus beer and cocktails. Prices are not the cheapest in Saigon but represent excellent value and certainly as western visitors we found it to be a modest bill. Highly recommended., This rooftop restaurant has great views and the food is not bad. The service could have been better, and the very high, uncomfortable bar-type stools make the experience crowded and less enjoyable. Overall not bad, maybe if I were a little bit younger lol!
description:
Chose this restaurant for its rooftop with views and breeze over the Saigon River. We were early for a pre-dinner drink. The drinks were half price and a couple of frozen Daiquiris hit the spot after a hot day. The decor was fairly standard but seats comfortable, the service attentive and prices very reasonable.

The food menu had a good range of Vietnamese dishes and we chose Pork Hotpot and Beef and Tonkin Creeper. Both were hot, fresh and tasty. 

A nice early evening spent in a pleasant environment with good service and food.

name: Banh Mi Hoa Ma
address: 53 Cao Thang, phuong 3, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: If you’re in Saigon and looking for an authentic Vietnamese breakfast experience, Bánh Mì Hòa Mã is a must-visit! This hidden gem serves up a delicious take on the classic bánh mì ốp la (baguette with eggs), complete with sizzling skillets of fried eggs, assorted meats, and pâté. The baguette is fresh and crispy, perfect for dipping into the rich yolk and savory sauces. Service is quick, the food is flavorful, and the experience is unforgettable. Highly recommend visiting early to avoid the crowds. Definitely one of the best breakfast spots in the city!, Walked here from our District 1 hotel and it was worth it. This is right on a busy street so you are sitting on a busy pavement with traffic going by. Motorbikes constantly stop for locals to pick up take-away. Foreigners like us were made very welcome, immediately seated and shown a menu which featured the "cooked breakfast" banh-mi we had gone for. The thing is that you may be eating fried processed pork (well what else is a sausage anywhere I suppose?) but the quality of bread, the pickles on the side, the iced very strong sweet Vietnamese coffee and the freshly cooked eggs just make this all totally delicious. Will definitely return next time in HCMC., This was the best breakfast experience we had in Saigon. Sitting in tiny chairs on a small side street. The eggs n meat were served in a hot skillet. The banh mi is to die for. So crunchy outside, so soft inside. You can always order extra banh mi in the side. So good! You make your own breakfast sandwich. Must try and super recommended. Pair with iced Vietnamese milk coffee and the experience is complete. So yummy!

The baguette is fresh and crispy, perfect for dipping into the rich yolk and savory sauces.

Service is quick, the food is flavorful, and the experience is unforgettable. Highly recommend visiting early to avoid the crowds. Definitely one of the best breakfast spots in the city!

name: Big Pig Bar - BBQ - Beer (46 Truong Son, Tan Binh)
address: 46 Truong Son Ward 2, Tan Binh, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: We got 3 courses of food, two large beers and two glasses of good white wine for 780,000 VD. It was our most expensive meal on a 15-day trip in Vietnam, but it tasted good, the service was top notch and we enjoyed ourselves there. We got to play pool and have a few good hours there. Highly recommended, after many days of local tasty food., Absolutely fantastic food and service! Here in Ho Chi Minh for the afternoon in the stifling heat however Big Pig had a lovely air conditioned restaurant cold beer and excellent noodles! Thoroughly recommend!, We were in Ho Chi Minh for 6 days travelling with two children so this place was a fantastic find for them. Specialising in more American style cuisine - our son loved the belly pork and our daughter gorged on the creamy garlic spaghetti - both were cooked perfectly with big flavour! The servers were so friendly and attentively throughout both our dinners. Thank you!
description: Offering the best in American style Ribs, Pizzas, Steaks & Burgers, along with Vietnamese favorites like hot-pot and grilled seafood, Big Pig BBQ & Beer also has the largest selection of craft beers in Tan Binh District. Open early for breakfast, with fantastic lunch specials, hearty meals and late night snacks, the team at Big Pig BBQ & Beer is ready to welcome you.

name: D'Maris Premier Buffet Phu My Hung
address: 469 Nguyen Huu Tho 3rd Floor Lotte Mart, Tan Hung, Dist.7, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: There are so many choices of food here: Vietnamese, Korean, Japanese, pasta and pizza. I love the seafood here. They are tasty and have so many options. They also have many fresh fruits and various well presented and tasty desserts, coffee and tea. Recommend it if you love seafood and premium buffet. The service staff is very friendly and attentive., Finally reopen ! There has more than 250 different kinds of food for you to choose and this is quite a spacious restaurant ! Feel this is the best buffet restaurant in district 7 ! Waiters and waitress also giving you a warm service !, Other than one friend we were the only foreigners in this restaurant. That is a good sign The restaurant contains many different serving areas including Chinese, Japanese, Korean, seafood, barbecue, pasta and pizza, steak and a large dessert area. The selection was huge and it was difficult to find everything even on my 3rd trip through the buffet lines Whatever your tastes I am sure that you will find more than enough items to enjoy. The restaurant is on the 6th floor of a building but once inside it is easy to find.
description: Biggest Buffet In The World. Premier Buffet Restaurant D'Maris.

name: Ben Nay Restaurant
address: 07 Phu Thuan Phu Hoa Dong, Cu Chi, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I stopped here for a set menu lunch as part of a cruise ship excursion to the Cu Chi Tunnels, which are a short drive away from the restaurant. The restaurant is located in a delightfully pretty position by a river. There was a large number of tables laid out in a covered outside dining area and we were shown to a couple of tables for our tour group. The lunch was a set menu, with papaya salad with prawns, fried basa fillet, grilled chicken and sticky rice, water spinach with garlic, seafood fried rice and fresh fruit to finish. They brought out all the food in two servings, so we all had a choice of dishes to choose from. The meal included a drink and I chose the local Bia Saigon beer, which was nice. The grounds were pretty, the service was efficient, and the toilets were clean. Would certainly recommend, based on my experience this time., 80 of us stopped here for lunch in our way to meet up with the Viking river cruise. We were seated at lovely covered patios by the river. The food was delivered as family style servings and included seafood, pork, chicken and sides as well as dessert at the end. Service was good and the food was good too. The facilities are also nice. It was a fun stop on way to our adventure. We never saw a menu so it must have been pre-arranged. They were also able to help with some food intolerances. Lovely surroundings, we would recommend., We stopped here with our tour bus after visiting the Cu Chi Tunnels. They had a pre-set menu for all the bus tours that arrived here. The food was very good with a nice variety of local dishes. It was a very pretty area with lush greenery and along a fast moving river.

There was a large number of tables laid out in a covered outside dining area and we were shown to a couple of tables for our tour group. name: Liquid Sky Bar
address: 8-15 Ton Duc Thang, District 1 Renaissance Riverside Hotel Saigon, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: I absolutely loved this bar. We arrived and were immediately ushered to the Sky Bar for drinks before eating lunch at VietKitchen, which is located inside the hotel. The location, service, and views are spectacular. Keith, in particular, was very helpful in recommending several sites and activities in HCM City., Today I had a meeting with my friends at Liquid Skybar and I felt very satisfied with the drinks and service style of the staff here. Especially Ms. Min, she is very friendly and enthusiastic with us. If I have the chance, I will come back and experience it., Poolside at Renaissance Riverside in Saigon, Vietnam. Keith was the bartender this afternoon and he was very helpful with recommendations on the cocktail menu. We tried a variety of four different drinks and they were all very good and similar to what he explained to us. Good service and very nice people.
description: The Liquid Sky Bar is a casual destination to escape and unwind in the sun. In the evening, space transforms into a rooftop lounge where guests and locals will come to socialize, dance, or just let loose. On the mezzanine level, comfortable lounges and a flow of cocktails create a casual and fun atmosphere. It is the perfect spot to watch the sunset over the horizon. It’s a perfect venue for private events and cocktail receptions.

name: HCM Villages Restaurant
address: 107 Tran Van Cham ,Phuoc Vinh An ,Cu Chi, Ho Chi Minh City 84 Vietnam
reviews: Wonderful experience, from learning about the various herbs, mushrooms etc, picking everything fresh from the farm garden, to getting step by step guidance in cooking the most delicious, flavorful 3 course meal. The chef is not only very knowledgeable, but absolutely passionate about what he does. The numerous young trainee chefs and helpers were so friendly and helpful. To top it all off, we left with a bag full of gifts, including a recipe book, an apron, herbs etc. would definitely recommend this even to non-foodies., We signed up for a half day cooking class - the restaurant picked us up from our hotel and brought us out to the cooking school. Our instructor Minh was very knowledgeable and took us through the garden firstly to gather ingredients prior to cooking. We made prawn spring rolls, coconut chicken, bbq pork noodle salad and banana spring rolls. Minh's instructors were very easy to follow and the food we made was delicious. Would recommend highly if you'd like to learn a few Vietnamese dishes and have some fun while you are in Ho Chi Minh City., We went there yesterday as a family, it was a real treat, we were able to taste 7 dishes (dessert included). They were all really good. The welcome was really very pleasant. A good address when returning from Cu Chi
description: HCM Villages Restaurant is unique restaurant with 98% ingredients from organic farm. We do serve for all kinds of cuisines specially, Vietnamese cuisine, Indian Cuisine Asian cuisine, fusion food, all food Allergic accept such as gluten, lactose, coeliac, Halal, Vegan etc...

name: Bep Nha Luc Tinh
address: 37 Nam Ky Khoi Nghia Nguyen Thai Binh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: My department had a lunch at this restaurant while on our overseas trip to Vietnam. There were 32 persons in total. The food was good and serving portions were generous. The restaurant serves only a few vegetarian dishes and does not prepare Halal dishes. However, the restaurant permits catering of outside food for special dietary needs. The restaurant is spacious and able to accommodate many patrons. It is set in rustic ambience and even has a pond in the middle. While we were there, it was decorated with lanterns for the Mooncake festival. The reason for a low score is due to the ruining of the entire experience when it comes to payment. They were aware that we are foreigners but refused to accept payment by credit card. They only accept cash or bank transfer. When we attempted to make a bank transfer, a female staff presented a local bank QR code for us to scan to make the transfer. And because none of them are able to speak English, it took some effort to make her understand that the QR code doesn’t work for foreign banks. The female staff got impatient and showed her frustrations while I was setting up the details necessary for the bank transfer. She even tried to take my phone so that she is able to enter the details. I had to stop her because it is classified information. My personal bank account details could have been compromised. That ruined the entire experience for me. Otherwise, it was a good lunch for my colleagues and I. One more thing, AC is weak in the restaurant. Possibly due to it being an old structure., Cosy restaurant with local dishes. The hot pot took us enough time to wait however other dishes were served well during a festive season. Good taste to come back., Bep Nha Luc Tinh Is a traditional Vietnamese restaurant featuring an authentic Vietnamese cuisine. The ambience is fantastic, open and enjoyable. We ordered many items from the menu and were satisfied with all of our dishes. If you’re in the mood for traditional Vietnamese food come here, relax and enjoy great traditional Vietnamese food in a very clean, fun atmosphere.
