name: Vị Sài Gòn Restaurant & Café
address: 254 Bis Nguyễn Đình Chiểu, Phường Võ Thị Sáu, Quận 3, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Interesting menu. Food really tasty. Friendly service. We arrived early evening to an empty restaurant but staff said they thought they could fit us in! We were the only people for the first 30 minutes but then the tour parties started arriving and by the time we left there were at least another 100 diners. Clearly a favourite so suggest you check if booking needed., I recently dined at Vi Sài Gòn, a newly opened gem in HCMC, and it truly exceeded expectations. The ambiance is a harmonious blend of Vietnamese elegance, with open seating areas perfect for group gatherings, alongside private dining options for a more intimate experience. The soothing instrumental music adds a relaxed vibe, making it an ideal spot to unwind. As someone with celiac, dining out can often be a challenge, but Luna, our server, was incredibly helpful and knowledgeable about gluten-free options, which made the experience stress-free. I started with their vegetable soup, which was flavorful and comforting, paired with a refreshing peach tea. My boyfriend ordered the Northwest grilled chicken, served beautifully with rice in bamboo—both the presentation and taste were outstanding. The hospitality at Vi Sài Gòn was exceptional, and their selection of fresh, health-focused drinks was a highlight. It’s clear they prioritize both quality and guest experience. Whether you’re a local or a visitor, Vi Sài Gòn is a must-try for anyone looking to enjoy authentic Vietnamese flavors in a welcoming atmosphere., Really really good cooking here, with excellent options for vegetarians. Not far off fine dining. We had the vegetarian pumpkin with rice, Red Tilapia fish with tamarind sauce, and potato wedges. All superb. The vibe of the restaurant is great, lovely decor and good music. The staff were very upbeat and friendly, and apologetic for some slight problems we had during our meal. We came at a strange time, when they were waiting for several large table bookings. As a result, they were out of quite a few options on the menu, which they didn’t tell us, and several other diners, until after we went to order/had already ordered! This meant there was a delay in timings with the food, and the staff were a bit distracted (from the other/smaller tables) waiting for their arrival, but this is not a major problem and the taste of the food more than made up for it. All in all, a good restaurant with good cooking.
description: Delicate Vietnamese fusion food - Charming craft drinks - Fine wine! Overflowing hospitality! “Vị Sài Gòn” – a warm house that harmonizes many nuances of flavors and emotions, gathering the essence of Vietnamese ingredients combined with new experiences from the flow of diverse cultural intersections on this land. At “Vị Sài Gòn”, each dish echoes the whispers of the long-standing culinary heritage and carries its own story told through flavors. From the harmonious tastes of the North to the rich and bold flavors of the Central region, along with the delicate flavors of Southern cuisine to the modern culinary techniques of international cuisine – all are meticulously and perfectly blended! We believe that cuisine is not only a passion but also a bridge connecting people. With the mission of creating unique culinary experiences, “Vị Saigon” is an unmissable destination for those who are passionate about exploring and experiencing culinary culture in Saigon!

name: Rau Oi Vegetarian Restaurant
address: 55/15 Le Thi Hong Gam, District 1 Cute Allyway Between Le Thi Hong Gam & Nguyen Thai Binh, Ho Chi Minh City 000000 Vietnam
reviews: Hidden away in an alleyway with an interesting, creative menu & lots to choose from. Each item described in detail which was fortunate as the server we had wasn’t particularly over-informative. Especially enjoyed one of the specials with aubergine, mushrooms & glass noodles Great depth of flavour. Met one of the owners who was passionate about the healthy, vibrant food they create & a pleasure to meet. Reasonable prices. Highly recommended., Some of the best vegetarian food I have eaten. Period. Delicious and fresh takes on classic Vietnamese and Thai dishes, all with a twist. Perfect for lunch after a visit to the Fine Arts Museum, The best place ever. The vegetarian food is exceptional and the team so wonderful. I was there with my family and everybody loved it. Viola welcomed us warmly and you can feel that making good healthy food makes her happy. 5 stars!!! You can also pay for a good and cheap lunch for people that need it!
description: A cozy and vibrant plant-based eatery offering fresh, colorful, and delicious vegan dishes made from locally sourced ingredients. A must-visit for a traditional home-styled and innovative feast!

name: Basilico
address: Corner Le Van Huu Street and Nguyen Du Street Lobby Level Of Suites' Tower Of Jw Marriott Hotel & Suites, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Food was quite good even though my veal was quite chewy. Rest of the food tasted very good. That being said, the service left a lot to be desired. We got our sides served well ahead of the mains so by the time the food arrived the sides were all cold. It was always hard to get the attention of waiting staff. Given this is not a cheap restaurant I think the service standards need to be improved, I decided to treat myself on the last day of 2022 and fancied a nice simple but healthy breakfast. The restaurant was quiet which I was grateful for and a world away from the chaotic streets outside. Nice breakfast menu from eggs to Vietnamese dishes, fresh juices and more. Very reasonably priced too. Surprisingly quiet considering the location inside the Intercontinental Saigon. I went for the scrambled eggs, with smoked salmon and grilled asparagus. To drink I had an iced black americano. They have like an option where you can choose how you want your eggs including an omelette and then three side dishes. I just went for two side dishes which was enough. Although smoked salmon was not included as a side, they were nice to let me have it without any extra cost. There is a good selection of side dishes. It also includes toast which I decided not to have after eating too much carbs recently plus tea or coffee! The breakfast was perfect! Well presented and freshly made. Good portion size. Loved it. The iced americano was perfect too. Very clean restaurant. Big. Staff were really pleasant and friendly. They accept AMEX. Just one thing, if you have any dietary restrictions or allergies then make it very clear or repeat yourself to make sure the staff understand. Highly recommend otherwise. Tempted to go back for lunch or dinner. Italian restaurant., Magnificent experience in every way - food, wine and service. Not cheap by any means - but then you pay for good value, and this was exceptional. From the moment we arrived the head waiter looked after us faultlessly - offering us multiple table locations. I had a Carafe of Vermentino followed by the Scallop Risotto, whilst my wife had the Lasagne. Normally we share our food, but not on this occasion, as it was just too good. The Lasagne was as good (if not better) as my wife makes. We then both had the banana bread with nuts ice cream and espresso poured over. Excellent from start to finish. A great find in Ho Chi Minh City. Many thanks for a great experience.
description: Located in the heart of Saigon, Basilico provides a contemporary-casual eatery specialising in authentic Italian dishes and homemade desserts. Here you can find and pair artisanal pizzas, homemade pasta, premium cuts of meat, dry or wet-aged and good cheeses with a wide selection of fine wines and a welcoming ambience.

name: La Casa Del Habano Ho Chi Minh
address: 74B Hai Ba Trung Street, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Came here back to back days recently because we enjoyed this place a lot! Inside decor is nice and has a fancy feel. The “lounge floor” is strictly for cigar smoking only—a bit disappointing if you only vape, they don’t allow that. The top floor which is the “restaurant floor”, is where you can smoke whatever you please there, and offers food! While the lounge is more of a classy feel, I liked the restaurant better with their glass windows with nice chandelier and greenery decor—they also have live music at night! Their ventilation system is pretty great too (both floors). Drinks were good, lots of bourbon/whiskey to choose from, and select vodka/gin options. The Ultimate Caviar & Salmon dish was AMAZING!!! Cigar wise, they sell Cubans, so this place is great for cigar lovers!, Biggest selection of Cuban cigars I have ever seen being seen for sale at a store! 2 stories of madness! So much accessories and a liquor store next door with many nice bottles. They even had 2 boxes of my favorite cigar, Behike 52!!! But, you needed to first buy $2500 USD worth of goods before being able to buy a box for $2500 USD!!!! I left with a few cigars, a new 3 cigar case, a man purse and spent over 1k USD! I went upstairs to the lounge to enjoy a nice relaxing smoke and drink at this beautiful lounge. Service and sales were top notch exceptional! I will definitely be back to visit the next time I'm in town!, Had the opportunity to be invited here for dinner by a partner, for the first time I just think here’s just a Cigar Lounge and Boutique but there was a cozy Restaurant on rooftop . The atmosphere of the restaurant is very cozy and luxurious. The price is not too high compared to the model and the quality of the project and the service. There's also live music, my favorite is the Tenderloin Steak, the meat is tender and delicious not too chewy and all the limited whiskeys are excellent.
description: The First Official House of Cuban Cigars in Vietnam is located in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City. Come and enjoy a warming, luxurious atmosphere, rare & collectable whiskies together with Fine Dining from Chef Brian, Executive Floor, Lounge, and Terazza Cuabana with Live Music every Night only at La Casa Del Habano Vietnam.

name: Bò Kho Ông Bà Già - Vietnamese Beef Stew - Local Bistro
address: 70 Truc Duong, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This small restaurant serves mouthwatering Vietnamese beef stew in a cozy setting. The stew is rich and flavorful, with tender beef and aromatic spices. Service is attentive and prices are reasonable. A must-visit for lovers of Vietnamese cuisine!, Best beef stew in town, small store, located in district 1. They also serve the best homemade milk tea! I ordered beef stew with “banh mi”. Really enjoy my lunch here! Highly recommended!, I search on google for beef stew and they pop up first and they got all 5 stars so I gave them a try. And wow this is such a amazing hidden gem in Saigon. Didn’t expect the space is that cool and cozy. I tried their Beef stew with instant noodle and it is amazing. Must give them a 5 stars. Will come back for sure.
description: BÒ KHO ÔNG BÀ GIÀ - a hidden gem in the heart of Saigon, district 1, specializing in Vietnamese Local Beef Stew. Join us for happy hours, breakfast, brunch, dinner, and let our friendly staff make you feel right at home. Come and taste the difference at BÒ KHO ÔNG BÀ GIÀ – where every meal is a celebration of flavor and hospitality.

name: Gringo Tacos y Cantina
address: 28 Mê Linh Ward 19 Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Authentic Mexican food in Vietnam, is that even possible, how good could it actually be? Well it’s authentic for sure, right down to the simplest detail of ordering a Corona beer or the large selections of Tequila for you. No matter what you order, you can’t go wrong. You could close you eyes with every bite, and it will send you to Mexico. Carnitas was slow cooked to perfection, the guacamole with chips is a MUST!!! I will have dreams about how smooth and delicious that guacamole. Staff was friendly, the place immaculate, great decor, and plenty of seating. If you are looking for a break from the local food, or just want to try some of the best Mexican food, then this place is a must on your visit to the city., After travelling Vietnam for a while we thought we'd not have Vietnamese one night. We picked Gringos and although it was slightly out the way on foot from the main area of Ho Chi Minh it was easy to get there with Grab. The food was amazing and probably was one of the best Mexicans we have ever eaten at. They catered for gluten free and the staff were really friend and attentive. This is a must try for anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh., Excellent margaritas and White Russian Horchata (50% off in happy hour 5pm to 7.30pm so around 70VND each!). The batter on the shrimp and fish tacos was crunchy, and the salad crisp and fresh. I’d choose the standard carnitas over the michoacan version as I’m a bit picky and the fatty bits not to my liking. The quesadilla was fantastic and the juiciest I think I’ve ever had 😊 The others enjoyed their carnitas chimichangas too - one was customised to leave out the rice. The restaurant was clean and tidy and the best small restaurant bathroom I’ve been to so far. Will be back next time we’re in HCMC! Was so keen to eat I forgot to take photos of the food 😂
description: We are a Mexican restaurant, serving homemade Mexican tacos, burritos, tostadas and quesadillas. At Gringo Tacos y Cantina we make our own fresh corn tortillas and queso fresco daily. If you're looking for a taste of Mexico come to Gringo Tacos where we keep it simple and focus on the quality of our ingredients. "It's all about the meat!

name: BAR SON
address: 3C Đ. Tôn Đức Thắng Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I visited Barson on the Lady night. The crew is very welcoming, especially Julian and Huyen Anh, who gave me outstanding service and high-quality food and drinks on a special night when I was there. I appreciate you all and will be returning soon "with the whisky bottle", I came to Barson Saigon for lunch and was really amazed by yummy food and the service they gave me there was also impressive. Nora remembered my allergy when I had meal with my friends although at the previous time there were a lot of guests in the restaurant. The other staffs was friendly too. I’ll be back soon., A decent bar on the first floor of Le Meridien Hotel. It was renovated last year and has a relaxed atmosphere. They don't serve much food, but they have a full range of alcoholic drinks. There is outdoor seating as well. Depending on the time of year, it can become like a small club at night, but it doesn't feel unnecessarily noisy. All the staff were very polite.
description: BARSON, a vibe-dining bar set in the foothills of the Ba Son Bridge and on the banks of the Saigon River, District 1, designed to elevate guest experience who stay and visit Le Méridien Saigon.

name: Au Lac Do Brazil Pasteur
address: 238 Pasteur District 3, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Please please please whatever you do you must not miss out on this place. Wandered around for an hour before stumbling upon this place. Selected the buffet and the food just came coming steak, ham, lamb it was like xmas. Staff were amazing draught beer sublime i think I’m in heaven Kenny meat lover from the UK Sorry there were no photos just couldn’t wait to tuck in The young man just kept bringing more meat 😘😍🥰😘😛, C ( 24.03.11 ) My friends and I visited this restaurant for dinner. It's a barbeque dish that is baked right away and served, and we were satisfied with the variety of menus. The price is a little bit expensive, but the atmosphere is good, and the service is excellent. It's a good restaurant to enjoy with beer slowly., It was my first time trying Churrasco aka Brazilian BBQ feast and it turned out fantastic beyond my expectation. I was very satisfied with the meat quality plus some side dishes were very well cooked. All meat lovers will love this restaurant for sure!
description: Vietnam's best Churrasco menu with a wide variety of meat. Serving Saigon for more than 10 years, AU LAC DO BRAZIL is the very first authentic Brazilian Churrascaria in Vietnam, bringing along with it a new dining concept - an "All You Can Eat" Brazilian style BBQ, where meat is brought to your table on a skewer by a professional passador and served to your heart's content, paired with an extensive selection of fine wines.

name: Dim Tu Tac
address: 05 Nguyen Tat Thanh Ward 12, Distric 4, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: We dined at Dim Tu Tác in District 2 last night. Not having reservations we had to wait approximately 20 minutes for a table. The Cantonese menu is very large and all inclusive. I enjoyed the seafood, hot and sour soup, half of a Peking duck (served on “crepes”) and a hot soup for dessert. All were cooked well and were very tasty. The duck was placed on the crepes in a different manner than I have experienced in the United States. We were also presented with a plate full with the balance of the duck. Service was attentive without being overbearing. Prices were reasonable., The food in here was superb I had the three meats and the duck was to die for, stunning. The sweet and sour pork has a unique delicious flavour, slightly burnt taste but again delicious. The best was the hot and sour soup. Ive eaten this all over the world and this was the best, I wish I could replicate it., My friends and I had been traveling around Vietnam and wanted dimsum. Being from Vancouver, Canada, we all agreed this restaurant’s dimsum was one of the best we’ve had. The quality of the ingredients and flavor was very traditional. We especially loved their egg tart (flakey crust) and their Shanghai dumplings (thin-skinned and juicy)! We liked the egg tart so much that my friend wanted to buy some home. The restaurant is clean and provides a nice Chinese ambience. Definitely Michelin worthy! Would absolutely come back again!
description:
We dined at Dim Tu Tác in District 2 last night. 

Not having reservations we had to wait approximately 20 minutes for a table.

The Cantonese menu is very large and all inclusive.

I enjoyed the seafood, hot and sour soup, half of a Peking duck (served on “crepes”) and a hot soup for dessert. All were cooked well and were very tasty. 

The duck was placed on the crepes in a different manner than  I have experienced in the United States. We were also presented with a plate full with the balance  of the duck. 

Service was attentive without being overbearing. Prices were reasonable.

name: Pasteur Street Craft Beer - Lê Thánh Tôn Taproom
address: 26A Le Thanh Ton Ben Nghe, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Great variety of craft beers,massive selection of great foods, traditional, pizzas, burgers, fries and desserts. Nice location to sit on edge of the path and people watch. All the staff were extremely lovely and very efficient in service. Definitely a place to come and very children friendly and all round great vibe., So glad we discovered this during our stay in Hu Chi Minh! Everything was great!! The delicious beer, especially Passion Fruit Weat Ale and Irish Stout! The food: never had such a delicious beef burger! Cheese stuffed beef rolls....yummy!! And the chicken skewers with satay sauce, fantastically tender. We ended the day here on three evenings with a beer. The staff knows what they are doing, great! The music was not always our choice, but we were happy to accept it. The toilet was clean and smelled nice. All in all great, a nice looking ambiance with the copper work!, Went for a nice refreshing chanh muoi beer. The taste was great and really refreshing. I opted for the burger, which tasted good, but it was a quite small sized burger and not many fries. Afterwards I was still hungry.
description: Just around the corner of Le Thanh Ton, or Thai Van Lung Street on the other side, you can find our taproom located in the centre of the busy district 1.

name: The Arth Saigon
address: Floor 1, 222 Nguyen Cong Tru Street Nguyen Thai Binh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Top hole drinking spot in the crowded Saigon scene, Arth is in a niche in itself. Inconspicuously hidden in an old shophouse, the ambience of the place is modern, elegant and cozy. Prices may be steeper than your average Saigon cocktail bar, but I do think you get what you pay for! It's definitely one of those places you should visit in Saigon for a classy night out - the drinks are created with so much passion and creativity, while the hospitality and service at the bar is pretty world-class., Gotta say this is the best bar to hang out. Really give you a luxurious vibe with all of the decorations and scenes of wood and tobacco. The food and drinks were great as well, staffs were friendly, especially the bartenders. Really brighten my mood. Bet I’ll come back again with the lads to hang out., What an incredible find! The Arth truly lives up to its tagline of "Where Spirits and Stories Blend." From the moment I stepped in, I was greeted by a warm and inviting atmosphere that effortlessly combines rustic charm with modern comfort.
description: The Arth Cusine Mixology is a Dining - Cigar Lounge concept in Saigon. Join us for your great evening!

name: Tuan & Tu Restaurant
address: 06 Thai Van Lung Street, District 1 Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Fried spring rolls and hot pots are found in most Vietnamese restaurants in Saigon. However, Tuan & Tu has elevated it to a higher level. Before I go any further I must mention that the restaurant offers a varied and interesting menu. The starters of minced snail and pork wrapped in betel leaf, the special fried crab spring roll and fried minced squid and dill are by far the best that I've eaten beside the home made ones by my Viet friend's mum. The skin of the spring rolls were paper thin and crackling, and the packed filling was moist and additive to eat. The hotpot of river crab, pork rib and beef was exceptional. The soup base was flavoursome and less salty and murky then the usual southern version. Highly recommended if you are a fan of hotpot. Overall value for money., I was taken here by a Vietnamese customer and enjoyed the local Vietnamese delicacies that were available. The food is freshly prepared and tasted very good. The prices are high but it is a fine dining restaurant. The service was good., Nice restaurant to savour local delicacies - must try the worm cake and snails; pork belly is also excellent
description: Fried spring rolls and hot pots are found in most Vietnamese restaurants in Saigon. However,  Tuan & Tu has elevated it to a higher level. Before I go any further I must mention that the restaurant offers a varied and interesting menu. The starters of minced snail and pork wrapped in betel leaf, the special fried crab spring roll and fried minced squid and dill are by far the best that I've eaten beside the home made ones by my Viet friend's mum. The skin of the spring rolls were paper thin and crackling, and the packed filling was moist and additive to eat. The hotpot of river crab, pork rib and beef was exceptional. The soup base was flavoursome and less salty and murky then the usual southern version. Highly recommended if you are a fan of hotpot. Overall value for money.

name: Kobe Teppanyaki Restaurant
address: 13A Tu Xuong, Ward Vo Thi Sau, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 08 Vietnam
reviews: We were passing through HCMC and decided it was a great opportunity to experience a world famous Kobe beef steak. On arrival we were escorted to our room and allocated a dedicated server who took our order. We opted for a Kobe set menu and a Foie Gras set menu. In the UK this would be called a fine dining tasting menu Our allocated chef appeared and set up to prepare the meal on the hot plate in front of us. The Foie Gras menu included courses of prawns, scallops, salmon, foie gras and Australian rib eye. See photos. The skill and hand speed of our chef was phenomenal as she cooked and prepared the various courses. The Kobe was melt in the mouth special. The textures, flavours and presentation of all the dishes are up there with some Michelin starred restaurants I have visited. Sitting at a table with a chef preparing food at the table may not suit anyone looking for a quiet intimate experience. But we found it to be a fantastic gastronomic experience. Fabulous., I had my birthday celebration dinner with my family at this restaurant. We all enjoyed the food and experienced a great cooking show by the chef. Lobster, kobe beef, seafood are all fresh. Staffs are friendly and cozy atmosphere restaurant. The only cons is that the bill is a bit heavy. 😉 Anyway it’s worth for a birthday dinner! 5 stars ⭐️!, We had a very romantic dinner. When you enter Kobe restaurant you feel just like in Paris. Beautiful restaurant. Amazing food. Tasty wine and utmost friendly staff. I can recommend this restaurant from the bottom of my heart. Thank you Peter for taking care of us during the exquisit dinner. We will be definitely be back. Thank you to the whole team.
description: The chain restaurant Kobe Teppanyaki has finally arrived in Vietnam for the first time with the best of Japanese Teppanyaki cuisine. With 10 VIP rooms have been specially designed by our Japanese designers. You can enjoy our premium Kobe beef, fresh seafoods and full range of sushi and sashimi in a luxury and cozy atmosphere.

name: Nam Mê Kitchen & Bar
address: 7, Đường số 44, Phường Thảo Điền,Thành phố Thủ Đức, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Honestly, this place knows how to do good business. They give really good values to the surrounding community by providing such good concepts of F&B, great service for such a reasonable price. Not a lot of place can be reasonable in term of pricing. Hands down good job ❤️, This place is truly a hidden gem. Location was a bit hard to navigate. Thanks to our Grab driver, we found it easily. Staff was really nice and helpful. Food was well prepared and came in decent portions. Love the authentic Vietnamese taste!, You will definitely be surprised by how affordable this place is compared to all the restaurants in Thao Dien area, which is a really high price area to dine in. We had 5 people but the bill came out just about $20 each, including one drink and water for each of us. In Thao Dien, a normal restaurant meal would easily cost somewhere between $30 and 40 each. Much more for more fine dining places (probably $50-200 each). So this place is highly recommended, not only for good and reasonable price food, but also for service and their nicely decorated venue.
description: Nam Mê is a Vietnamese restaurant in Thao Dien that utilizes a creative firewood grilling technique to elevate the traditional Mekong cuisine. Drawing inspiration from the early morning market journeys, Nam Mê's dishes are skillfully crafted from fresh and delicious ingredients, carrying the story of a bountiful season of shrimp, fish, rice, and agricultural produce through the tales of explorers – an allegory for the team and spirit of Nam Mê

name: Kyung Bok Gung Korean Restaurant
address: 52 Hai Ba Trung Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: We travel a lot and always try and eat Korean food at least 1 time in each location. we stumbled upon this gem which was a 5-10 minute walk from our Hotel (Park Hyatt). We way over ordered as we were so hungry but very happy with our selections. We ordered the seafood Pancake, Spicy pork, Short Beef Rib and Bean Paste Beef Soup. We would have been fine food quantity wise if we had omitted one of the items but we were very glad we got to taste it all. The side dishes (bon chon's) were plentiful. The Kim chee wasn't as ripe as I would have liked and I thought it odd I had to ask for a bowl of rice but maybe that's why every one is Vietnam is so skinny? :-) . Don't miss this Gem if you are looking for some different variety while visiting here. Our bill with a beer and food came to $65USD. A yummy experience that didn't break the bank. On a last note, we were surrounded by other Koreans so you know we were in the right place!, Get there early as it's very popular with Saigon Korean residents / tourists. Seems to be on about 5-6 floors, a veritable rabbit Warren of staff rushing about with plates of food. Vietnamese staff highly trained in Korean traditional manners. Lots of bowing and no small talk, and very attentive. The menu can be confusing unless you are conversant with Korean food, though plenty of pictures and part written in English. My companion ( Vietnamese) thought she had ordered 2 dishes, but I counted 21!!!! (Albeit small tasters) The food was healthy, fresh, varied and one had to adapt chopsticks handling skills to metal ones (more difficult). All in all a good meal at 550,000 dong which is reasonable for two. As we left, queuing already in the tight entrance foyer. Suitably replete, we stepped forth into the Saigon traffic and noise., We had excellent korean barbecue. There are so much food even if you order one or two dishes for bbq. Real taste of Korea.
description: We travel a lot and always try and eat Korean food at least 1 time in each location.  we stumbled upon this gem which was a 5-10 minute walk from our Hotel (Park Hyatt).  We way over ordered as we were so hungry but very happy with our selections.  We ordered the seafood Pancake, Spicy pork, Short Beef Rib and Bean Paste Beef Soup. We would have been fine food quantity wise if we had omitted one of the items but we were very glad we got to taste it all.  The side dishes (bon chon's) were plentiful.  The Kim chee wasn't as ripe as I would have liked and I thought it odd I had to ask for a bowl of rice but maybe that's why every one is Vietnam is so skinny?  :-) . Don't miss this Gem if you are looking for some different variety while visiting here.  Our bill with a beer and food came to $65USD. A yummy experience that didn't break the bank.  On a last note, we were surrounded by other Koreans so you know we were in the right place!

name: Bun Thit Nuong Kieu Bao
address: 139 De Tham Co Giang Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The rice noodle is accompanied by your choices of sides, typically grilled pork and fresh aromatic greens. We also had the deep fried spring roll. Everything was delicious, especially the sauces. Typical no nonsense dining room., This was a stop on our walking tour. Quick service, delicious food. Since we were part of a tour it was great seeing people from other countries try the dish and be thoroughly enjoying it. Sort of made me proud. Great spot to be introduced to this dish. Really tasty. Also....super cheap., The bun cha here is amazing. This place is also a favorite stop for local food tours. During our stay in Saigon, we visited twice. The food is very affordable at $2 per person.
description: The rice noodle is accompanied by  your choices of sides, typically grilled pork and fresh aromatic greens. We also had the deep fried spring roll. Everything was delicious, especially the sauces. Typical no nonsense dining room.

name: Hoàng Ty
address: 74 Truong Quoc Dung, Ward 10, Phu Nhuan District, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: This place like a mini food court which has many different stalls. You can do the wrap & rolls yourself. They have a good food hygiene. We visited the restaurant in Truong Quoc Dung, Phu Nhuan. You can decide to dine upstairs which has aircon or downstairs like “free air” - no aircon. Service is quick and friendly., This is a fairly casual restaurant that offers traditional VN food. We shared the meal in which we made our rolls from rice paper, a lot of different lettuce & greens, putting the meet inside, and dipping., We were brought to this branch of Hoang Ty. Very tasty and local Vietnamese food, with specialty rice paper, and really fresh own planted vegetable!
description:
This place like a mini food court which has many different stalls. You can do the wrap & rolls yourself. They have a good food hygiene. We visited the restaurant in Truong Quoc Dung, Phu Nhuan. You can decide to dine upstairs which has aircon or downstairs like “free air” - no aircon.
Service is quick and friendly.

name: Go2 Wine Bar Eatery
address: 187 De Tham Pham Ngu Lao, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: I don't get all the bad reviews. Maybe the management has changed recently, but I've never had anything but great experience here. The staff is really friendly (hi Phi), the pizza is pretty good and drinks actually pack a punch unlike many other places in the area. And the prices are pretty decent (by Bui Vien standards) and their happy hour offers are actually legit., I had a great experience thanks to Tin, the bartender. He was incredibly friendly and full of positive energy. I really appreciated how he enthusiastically recommended drinks and made sure everything suited my tastes. His warm attitude and cheerful service definitely made my day more enjoyable, Lovely casual place to sit and watch the world go by. Made some really good friends for life right here. The boss nghia is very friendly and welcoming. His hospitality is fantastic. Ever aiming to please. Look out for Seth the server. Speaks proper english and also a great guy. They have Happy hours monday to friday from 10 am to 8 pm. Go here for their wood fired pizzas which are excellent. My favourite was the Saigon beer in tap and local wines. Overall a good place to visit before getting into walking street.
description: GO2 Wine Bar Eatery is a popular nightspot located in the Pham Ngu Lao (backpackers) area. GO2 Wine Bar Eatery - GO2 Club

name: Sushi Tei Vietnam
address: 200A Ly Tu Trong Street, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, HCMC, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: My friends and I went to this restaurant on Saturday evening and reservations were fully booked. Despite of bunches of orders from other customers, we were serviced quite fast and instantly. Foods were well prepared and served in a short amount of time. Tastes, flavours and freshness were undoubtedly great since Sushi Tei is well known as its art of international sushi cuisines. In addition, prices were so much acceptable and reasonable that we hardly resisted ordering more sushi while dining :))), We (family of 4) visited twice within the few days we had in Ho Chi Minh. First time we ordered quick and didn't need drinks. Sashimi and sushi fresh, tasty and beautifully presented. They didn't have tuna and a couple of other things though. We decided to go again and service was terrible. It was not busy, only 2 tables with lots of staff. We are friendly and smiley Australian's. They did not crack a single smile and if the weren't so disengaged anyway, I'd descibe them as rude. It took 20mins to order drinks then, took 15mins for 2 drinks come, then another 45mins to get the other 2 (a simple lemonade and warm local beer). The sashimi was lovely and beautifully presented, as was the sushi rolls ordered by my older teens. Tempura and sauce was tasteless. I usually give good reviews or don't bother, but this was worth the mention...., Sushi Tei is a large chain that has several branches in HCMC. This one was very close to our hotel. There are various Japanese restaurants in the area and we decided on this restaurant. The restaurant is on two floors and we got a table on the second floor. We ordered sushi and sashimi. The food tasted good and the price for sushi/sashimi was more than OK. The service was OK and the waiting time was OK.
description: My friends and I went to this restaurant on Saturday  evening and reservations were fully booked. Despite of bunches of orders from other customers, we were serviced quite fast and instantly. Foods were well prepared and served in a short amount of time. Tastes, flavours and freshness were undoubtedly great since Sushi Tei is well known as its art of international sushi cuisines. In addition, prices were so much acceptable and reasonable that we hardly resisted ordering more sushi while dining :)))

name: The Brix - Eatery & Bar Lounge
address: 26 Tran Ngoc Dien, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: I first went to the Brix quite a while ago and was bowled over with the delicious dishes at a friend's birthday buffet. The setting was very beautiful too - similar to an upmarket holiday resort with an attractive pool, trendy chic furniture and decor etc. It also has very effective ceiling fans. When I returned with another set of friends I was disappointed to discover that the food I had eaten previously wasn't on the menu as it was part of a personalised party package. However the menu still had a lot of delicious sounding things to offer, mainly the more gourmet style of international cuisine. The food is rather more expensive than normal but still affordable, and worth it for the lovely surroundings. I shared a cold cut and cheese platter with a friend, french fries with truffle sauce and a mixed salad. Each dish was very pleasant. The staff were professional, efficient and friendly. The drinks too were rather good. Friends enjoyed their cocktail and wine a lot whereas I thought my Sangria, both a red and white wine Sangria were enjoyable. A beautiful place to relax and chill with friends., Brix is located in a quiet area of Thao Dien separated from the street by a high brick wall and surrounded by large and beautiful palm trees. The armchairs are comfortable. The servers take great care of customers and professionals. The cuisine is refined, the plates are beautifully presented. The establishment has a lovely swimming pool and comfortable deckchairs. Very nice place to spend a few hours relaxing to the sounds of a pleasant musical atmosphere., Excellent! Awesome!! It makes you forget that you are in Vietnam. The food is outstanding!! Seafood, meat, dessert, whatever you eat, it all tastes elegant. And cocktails are just fabulous. finally a very different place in Ho Chi Minh
description: Located in Saigon, THE BRIX restaurant and bar lounge offers a slice of paradise mere minutes away from the heart of the city. This small oasis is in an outdoor environment and combines a swimming pool, restaurant and bar – all surrounded by an extensive tropical garden. During the day, it is a peaceful hideaway where you can swim, eat, sip and relax on a daybed under the shade of swaying palms. Over the evening, the venue transforms into an enchanting and intimate restaurant for dinner. On the weekends you can enjoy the vibrant late night atmosphere accompanied with music curated by our DJs or live bands. Whether it’s – a chilled bottle of wine, bespoke cocktails, fresh seafood, or anything else from Chef Phong’s inventive Western fusion menu, THE BRIX has you covered. Escape the mundane and step into our tropical oasis.

name: Crystal Jade Palace
address: Lotte Legend Hotel Saigon 2A-4A Ton Duc Thang Street District 1, Lotte Hotel, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Good place and trained staff with good English understanding. Breakfast was limited but you can order Chinese noodles which is just mouth melting, 5Stars 💯, The food is delicious, seasoned with authentic Cantonese flavors. The waitresses are funny and can speak Chinese. My mother is originally from Quang, not fluent in Vietnamese. When she came here, the girls chatted like family, so she was very happy. Roasted pigeon dish is worth trying. Succulent meat and crispy skin, my 2 children loved it., SO glad Crystal Jade Palace is open again, and with the same awesome menu and experience as before. They make you feel welcome and really loom after you (they seem to have the ability to predict when my cup of tea will be empty, as sip... here's a refill!) Highly recommend the fried rice noodles in XO sauce, the shrimp dumplings, the rice in lotus leaf... and everything is great. Please note I'm reviewing the Crystal Jade Palace in the Lotte Legend Saigon Hotel. I cant confirm regarding other branches in HCMC or elsewhere.
description: Stalwart Chinese culinary group with Michelin One Star and multiple Michelin Bib Gourmand Awards, with over 100 outlets across 25 major cities.

name: ASA Bistro - Cafe & Restaurant
address: 208 Nguyen Huu Canh Street SH11 - Park 1, Vinhomes Central Park, Ward 22, District Binh Thanh, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: Such a lovely, charming place! We loved all the waitstaff, especially the sweet, helpful young waitress at our table. We ordered phở bò (which came in a boiling pot of broth and we added noodles, raw slices of beef, onions and other items to the hot broth to cook), beef bò lúc lắc with fries, and egg noodles with seafood. Everything was so delicious! Also had red sangria and a very tasty, unique jasmine calamansi ice tea for drinks. Highly recommend., Great everything 👌 The truth is spectacular and very healthy, we ate a local soup, seafood noodles and salmon platter, all fabulous. Definitely a recommended place and we will come back next time we visit District 1 in Saigon, I happen to live in the area and I come here quite a lot. Not only they provide such good food for a really affordable price, they also have nice warm and friendly staff. Serving is also quick. 10-15’ and voila 😍
description: ASA Bistro Cafe & Restaurant located in the heart of a residence area - Vinhomes Central Park brings the exquisite vibe and little twist of Asian Fusion.

name: Rico Taco
address: 74/7 Hai Ba Trung Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Just the Facts: Rico Taco, an authentic Mexican-owned HCM (D1) restaurant, features a reasonably priced diverse meat and vegetarian menu, a quaint and friendly atmosphere, and fast and friendly service, ensuring a satisfying dining experience for all. The Rest of the Story: Nestled in a charming courtyard among coffee and tea shops in HCM (D1), Rico Taco stands out with its authentic, fresh, and attractive dishes. The service is efficient, friendly, and fast, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. One notable aspect is the inclusive menu, catering to both meat and vegetarian diners with a variety of options for each dish. An added bonus is the personal touch from owner David Torres, who goes out of his way to interact with each table, ensuring excellent dining service. Whether you're dining alone for a quick meal or gathering with friends, family, or colleagues, Rico Taco is a winner., This was a fun place in a great location right next to the Opera House and the Park Hyatt. They have outdoor seating on the upper level. My family and I went and we tried many different foods. We started with quesadillas and chips. It wasn't what I was accustomed too, but it was pretty good. They were stingy on the amount of chips. The steak fajita was served and looked more like a quesadilla, but it was tasty. The steak burrito was good and a nice sized portion. I was surprised that they offered American IPA beer from New England which was very good. Unfortunately, I didn't try the margarita's. I know it was sacrilegious not to order one. It was overall a good restaurant., Well I happen to show up on Tuesday and yes it is taco Tuesday for 30,000 a taco I might as well try all of them. The vegetarian. If you want an honest review you eat all the tacos. HeHe. So I’m from Los Angeles California trust me I have the best tacos in the world yes I’m close to Mexico. Well if you come on a Tuesday it is well worth every penny. This is a 4 star experience six days a week for taco Tuesday it turns into a five-star experience the tacos are good not great but definitely worth a visit. They do give you plenty of meat inside your taco even on taco Tuesday. . They have a decent selection of craft beer good air-conditioning rooftop view it’s a very nice place.
description: Authentic Mexican cuisine by Chef Alejandro Torres in an al fresco setting inspired by late architect Ricardo Legoretta.

name: Une Journee a Paris
address: 17 Tran Quoc Toan St Ward 8, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Une Journée à Paris deserves its name, as the place transports patrons to Paris, maybe not for a day as its name suggests, but certainly for the time they are there. While the pastries beckon those with a sweet tooth from the street, the salads and sandwiches are also quite tasty. We were there shortly after the new year, and were able to sample, or rather devour, a whole king’s cake for two. Traditionally called la galette des rois in French, it resembles a pie made of flaky dough (pâte feuilletée), stuffed with marzipan. Traditionally, there is a small object in it, which, when found by one of the individuals eating the cake, will designate him or her as the king or queen. This galette achieved a perfect equilibrium between flakiness and the density of the marzipan, all the while hitting the right amount of sweetness., Party of two. Ordered apple tart and clam chowder. Both excellent. Service was good and was informed in advance that the clam chowder would take 15 minutes. Well worth the wait. We will return for breakfast. The owner was pleasant and went out of his way to insure all was ok. Upon receiving the check we were served gratis two small pastries. A very nice touch. Will be returning for breakfast as I am sure it will be exceptional. Prices were more than fair., Was here after food so only ordered their chocolate banana tart and iced chocolate. Both were great. The tart was crispy and the fillong was well balanced. A layer of dark chocolate with mashed banana beneath. Nothing too sweet. Iced chocolate was dark as promised as it was 'au lait' as per the menu. If you love pastry, give this a try.
description: Une Journée à Paris is a traditional French bakery and patisserie, proudly French owned and operated. Neighboring the iconic Ben Thanh market, our bakery attracts both local and international foodies alike. We are passionate about offering all of our visitors an authentic taste of Paris. We believe that Paris has not passed your lips until you’ve had a bite of one of our croissants, chouquettes, or religieuses. Our macarons are adored far and wide, with orders coming in from Singapore, Malaysia and Hong Kong. For an original recipe, our mango pies, rum babas, or edelweiss are for you. All of our pastries, cakes and bites in-between are made with quality goods. We use European imported ingredients to give you an experience that ticks the boxes of quality, taste, and authenticity. As French we stay true to tradition, and prefer to use the recipes found in our grandmothers kitchens. We look forward to sharing these with you!

name: Khap Khap Thai Bistro - Võ Văn Tần
address: 46ter Võ Văn Tần, Phường Võ Thị Sáu, Quận 3, Thành Phố Hồ Chí Minh, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: We just enjoyed a delicious meal at khap khap Thai bistro. They have two addresses. We ate at 40 -42 Bui Thi Xuan Street District 1. We ordered a starter of fried chicken wrapped in pandan leaves and the masaman chicken curry. Together with 2 local beers total cost was less than AUD 20 and we couldn't eat anymore. Food was delicious and service very attentive. We would come back again., We had an absolutely amazing evening tonight at Khap Khap Thai Bistro. First of all, we sat outside, and the ambience of the old style Indochine courtyard was perfect for the evening we were having. The staff did an amazing job of taking care of us, and we felt so relaxed amongst the hustle and bustle of Ho Chi Minh City. The food was out of this world and was some of the best, if not the best, Thai food we have ever had. All of us, the kids included, couldn't stop eating and left very content and happy. Thank you, everyone, at Khap Khap Thai Bistro Võ Văn Tần., We sat on the cozy courtyard and enjoyed the freshly prepared treats. Nice and spicy tom yum with prawns without gut. Then Seafood pineapple fried rice. It all worked out. Highly recommended 🫶
description: We just enjoyed a delicious meal at khap khap Thai bistro.  They have two addresses.  We ate at 40 -42 Bui Thi Xuan Street District 1.  We ordered a starter of fried chicken wrapped in pandan leaves and the masaman chicken curry.  Together with 2 local beers total cost was less than AUD 20 and we couldn't eat anymore.  Food was delicious and service very attentive.  We would come back again.

name: Lesung Sgn
address: 72/1 Tran Quoc Toan, Vo Thi Sau Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam 72/1 Tran Quoc Toan, Ward 8, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Many Malaysian food joints came and gone from Saigon over the years, while those surviving near Ben Thanh Market were simply not good. Appreciate that Lesung Restaurant opened! Finally a quiet and classy place to tuck into delicious Malaysian food again. While the prices could be slightly higher here than other Singaporean/Malaysian food joints in town, but we felt that the authentic flavours, sheer variety of dishes that we missed and the clean enjoyable ambience make it all worthwhile. Ordered classic dishes such as: - Roti Canai - Nasi Lemak - Prawn Otak-Otak - Butter Chicken - Ikan Bakar - Durian Cendol They remembered to include the humble "Keropok" (prawn crackers) and "Achar" (pickled salad) which is rare to find these days. The sambal was great. The creaminess of their butter chicken, Otak-Otak and even the tender fish was awesome. Teh Tarik's pretty authentic too. Hope to try their other dishes next time. Also cute are their Batik-design serviettes, newspaper-style menu, and the story of how this restaurant was named after the founder/chef's grandma's 150-year old mortar., I was looking for Hoi An Garden restaurant. Two different taxi drivers who had this address brought me to what is now Lesung Malaysian restaurant. Was warmly greeted by the Leesung team incldg young Chef Eden Daus. I outlined to him my diet restrictions and described a JackFruit Rendang meal that I had in Yogyakarta in Feb 2023. In a jiffy, he prepared an eggplant meal with Rendang sauce with coconut rice. The coconut water and green mango salad made for a grand Malay meal. The two Vietnamese staff incldg Tamm spoke good English, and ably supported the high quality food that emerged from Chef Eden's kitchen., The full package; great food, delightful venue, friendly helpful staff. This was the 5th time we've been to the restaurant and it's become one of our favorites. The host and head chef and co-owner, Eden, is always welcoming and happy to explain the food and take special requests.

name: Ngoc Suong Seafood & Bar
address: 08 Nguyễn Siêu Phường Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Ngou Suong is a fantastically good restaurant. We made reservations, which is important for two people, and we were seated promptly upon arrival. Every dish that we ordered was excellent. This included steamed clams, morning, glory, shrimp cocktail, fried shrimp, and crab. We both also had the lychee mojito which was very refreshing. Our waiter was outstanding and he kept on replacing our used plates with clean plates. The restaurant is attractive and the clientele looked first rate. For Ho Chi Minh City this restaurant is expensive, but for a special occasion is well worth the cost, I've heard a lot about the reputation of Ngoc Suong restaurant, but only now have I had the opportunity to dine here. Really impressive. I ordered seafood spring rolls, fish salad, ikura cheese baked scallops, steamed grouper, beef marrow, crab hotpot, oysters,... all dishes were fresh and prepared with delicious spices. My friend commented that this restaurant's crab hotpot is the best in Saigon, the lump of crab is huge. Personally, I'm impressed with the steamed grouper fish dish because the fish is extremely fresh and delicious, the steamed water is delicious. Sip it clean without leaving any drops. If you have a chance to visit, I recommend ordering these two dishes. That day, I went with 9 people and the bill was less than 9 million. Because each person was less than 1 million, we had a perfect experience of eating and drinking freely. The staff here are cute and enthusiastic. The VIP room is quite private. When checking in, the room was a bit hot even though the air conditioner was turned on. Later, the staff helped adjust it so points were not deducted for this section. My friends sat down to eat and drink beer until 1 o'clock but the restaurant still welcomed us. Because we had a pretty satisfying experience here, we wanted to share it here so everyone can know about another okie space seafood restaurant in District 1 Saigon., An excellent dining experience awaits at this restaurant, where fresh seafood and a cozy ambiance come together beautifully. The quality of the dishes and the elegance of the setting make it a standout spot. If you're in Ho Chi Minh City, I highly recommend visiting for a memorable meal !
description:

We made reservations, which is important for two people, and we were seated promptly upon arrival.

Every dish that we ordered was excellent. This included steamed clams, morning, glory, shrimp cocktail, fried shrimp, and crab. 

We both also had the lychee mojito which was very refreshing.

Our waiter was outstanding and he kept on replacing our used plates with clean plates.

The restaurant is attractive and the clientele looked first rate. 

For Ho Chi Minh City this restaurant is expensive, but for a special occasion is well worth the cost

name: iSTEAKS Vietnam
address: 99 Nguyen Hue, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1 1st Floor, Saigon Garden, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: iSteak is a fantastic steakhouse located in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City. Their menu features a wide selection of high-quality, expertly cooked steaks sourced from the finest farms. The atmosphere is modern and elegant, with modern decor and attentive service. To start, I enjoyed a delicious carbonara followed by a juicy, flavorful basstrait striploin cooked to perfection. The sides, including onion rings and asparagus, were the perfect complement. For dessert, I sampled their decadent pot de crème - a true highlight of the meal. Overall, iSteak provides an outstanding dining experience that I would highly recommend to any steak lover visiting Ho Chi Minh City. The food, service, and ambiance are all top-notch., We are from Australia and ordered our steaks the way we would order them at home but unfortunately they were all under cooked. The Manager/Waiter could not have been more apologetic. Coleslaw was yummy!! We were offered free deserts because of the stuff ups with our steaks. The cheesecake was to die for. The Manager was extremely helpful recommending restaurants for our next destination (Phu Quac Island). He really went out of his way to make up for everything, Well what can I say, i Steaks 🥩 Ho chi min delivered well beyond expectations ! I’m a bit of a “wine @ dinner” love a steak and have eaten in some of the best restaurants across the world! These boys brought the great meat cooked to perfection, sides did not disappoint….. baked potato was sooooo good. Kids has the spaghetti bolognaise and ate it all. After an amazing 2 weeks eating amazing Vietnamese food it was really nice too have a simple steak & sides done well and it was. Regard The Freeman Family
description: Steakhouse from Singapore with Las Vegas Cinema Theme

name: Quan Thuy
address: 84 Dinh Tien Hoang St., Dist.1,, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Anyway, I think it's worth taking a taxi to this restaurant. It's on the left side, closer to the intersection. The fried spring rolls and soft shell crab are definitely recommended. They also have a Japanese menu, which is easy to understand., all things CRABS! crab soft shell, crab vermicelli, crab fried rice, crab spring rolls, etc. loved everything about it. slightly on the pricey side compared to other eateries but it’s all pure crab meat so i think it’s worth it, I was recommended this restaurant by a local person. I wanted to eat some seafood as that’s m my favourite food and since being in Vietnam I haven’t got on well with the food until now. This place was amazing best food I’ve tasted in a very long time. I had crab with tamarin sauce and crab fried noodles. The staff are very welcoming too. I enjoyed it very much.

name: Tippy's Mexican Food Saigon
address: No 99, Street No 45, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Was pleased to find a Mexican restaurant during our travel and we stopped by this place for lunch on rainy day. We tried chicken, steak and fish tacos. We also tried their chicken quesedia with jalapenos. All the items were pretty good. Can't compare to Mexican food I was used to while living in California but not bad to find it here. There only issue was there was only one person serving and preparing some of the dishes which took a lot of time., Visited both of Tippy's branches in Saigon when I visited and thoroughly enjoyed both. Simple, quality traditional Mexican food offered at reasonable prices. I personally ordered the burritos which are extremely flavorful and fulfilling. Service is excellent - also, the chips and sauces provided after you arrive are addicting!, This place seems to keep getting better over the years. Fast becoming my late night post-workout food spot. Can add extra proteins to everything, side of rice, and great guacamole. Perfect for after the gym.
description: Tippy's Mexican Food is a fun place to catch up with friends, have some tasty and refreshing drinks and enjoy some of Souteast Asia's best Mexican Food! We offer burritos, tacos, enchiladas, nachos, quesadillas, burrito bowls, margaritas, horchata and much much more. No visit to Saigon is complete without a wonderful Tippy's Experience.

name: Yen Sushi & Sake Pub
address: 15 Le Quy Don Street, Ward 6, Dist 3, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: U is heaven, a really lovely and cute restaurant located right on the corner of 15A Le Quy Don street. I thought the price was high, but my family thought the price was okay because the quality of the food and the friendly waiters were completely worth the price. You get what you pay for, everyone., We had a NYE meal here and it was perfect for our group of 2 families. Sushi was delicious and you could watch the sushi chefs make it, which was a highlight for the kids. The sake options were vast and we were really happy with our picks. The restaurant is conveniently located close to our hotel and the service was very attentive., What a memorable birthday dinner we enjoyed. Just call ahead and let the staff know it’s your birthday and they will decor a special table for you for FREE. Wow !!! Beside that, food is absolutely delicious with very reasonable price for any occasion Service is hand down friendly and attentive. Good management obviously
description: U is heaven, a really lovely and cute restaurant located right on the corner of 15A Le Quy Don street. I thought the price was high, but my family thought the price was okay because the quality of the food and the friendly waiters were completely worth the price. You get what you pay for, everyone.

name: Banh Xeo An La Ghien
address: 74 Suong Nguyet Anh Pham Ngu Lao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant was recommended to us by our Vietnamese friend living in Australia. A tour guide she knew in SaiGon also recommended it. He led us there from our hotel with a 8 minutes walk. It’s hidden in a lane away from the main streets. We had to walk up a narrow staircase to the restaurant. Our guide helped us order and the food were delicious. Must try the Banh Xeo., We both had only a Banh Xeo, which was very good. Service was only average. Staff was little absent and not very attentive., This restaurant is very famous for The Southern food, especially rice cake ( bánh xèo) . I took one of my Singapore clients there. He was satisfy with the restaurant service and food Food quality: The food is good quality. The cake case is very crunchy and has strong turmeric flavor. Their “ che” is average quality, not typical taste. Salad tastes is really great, balance Cleanliness: The restaurant is quite clean and spacious. Service: Fast service, good staffs. The temperature should be lower, It was quite hot when I was there. Highly recommend for both Asian an western clients who want to try Saigon food.
description: This restaurant was recommended to us by our Vietnamese friend living in Australia. A tour guide she knew in SaiGon also recommended it. He led us there from our hotel with a 8 minutes walk. It’s hidden in a lane away from the main streets. We had to walk up a narrow staircase to the restaurant. Our guide helped us order and the food were delicious. Must try the Banh Xeo.

name: L’Usine Le Thanh Ton
address: 19 Le Thanh Ton District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: An amazing restaurant, L’Usine Le Thanh Ton delivers. From the moment you step in, youre captivated by the cool, modern ambiance that blend with traditional Vietnamese elements. Then there’s the service. I always say everything starts with the right people, that greatness begins with people that really care, that are really smart, and that passionately deliver the promise of the brand. This team, this group, is top-notch from start to finish. Led by manager (his name is Duc) his staff were friendly, welcoming, and extremely knowledgeable about the menu. They guided me through their offerings, suggesting dishes that showcased the best of Vietnamese cuisine. And for the food—what an absolute treat. Every dish was flavorful, beautifully presented, presentation as stunning as the taste, it was clear that each dish was crafted with care and expertise. L’Usine offers a dining experience not to be missed. The combination of amazing food, a cool staff that delivers impeccable service, and a stylish setting makes this restaurant a true standout. I can’t wait to return to explore more of their delicious menu! Thank you so much Duc and Team!!, We went here three times in three days for lunch. The food and service are very good. My daughter wanted something off the menu and they were very helpful and charged us a very small amount. I would highly recommend this place if you are staying in the hotels nearby as the food is better and the prices are more reasonable., I had a Brunch for one at L’Usine, a favourite place of mine before the pandemic and I was very happy to see it still open on my return to Saigon after over a two year absence. I always like this place for a leisurely brunch in Bến Nghé with lovely, soothing Jazz and chillout music and well prepared food and great coffees and cakes. Normally I would give a five star rating, the reason for the 4 stars is that i was just annoyed that on entry i was just asked to take an empty seat on the ground level which was nearly full without being given the option of sitting upstairs which I prefer and find more relaxing. It would simply have been nice to be asked. Aside from this everything was great, I had their signature big breakfast - this was super tasty, the eggs, spinach and mushrooms especially were delicious, 2 x Vietnamese coffees were fantastic and the orange chocolate cake was perfect. All up just over 400.000 for one person.
description: L’Usine is a purveyor of an essentially modern Vietnamese lifestyle communicated through food, beverage, coffee, product, environment and a general point of view. Check out our new dining concept on the top floor of our new location on Le Thanh Ton. L’Usine Eatery is an informal, casual restaurant with a simple menu serving up some of the chef's current favourites, paired with an adventurous wine list. Open for dinner only, the Eatery is designed for proper yet comfortable dining – the perfect venue for memorable evenings

name: Lubu Restaurant
address: 97b Thao Dien Street, Thao Dien Ward District 2, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: I spied some mixed reviews recently on Trip Advisor for Lubu, so approached it with some trepidation, in spite of the fact that it had been recommended to me by business acquaintances at the British School. I needn't have worried. The service was attentive but unobtrusive and the food delicious. I'll happily call back later in the week to try another dish (or two). Thanks for the hospitality and splendid dinner for this solo traveller., Dining on my own after a session at K1 Gym. Lubu has a pleasantly simple format that carries through to the whole experience. I ordered the crispy skinned salmon - nicely cooked and well presented, the service was attentive and unobtrusive., Had a great lunch with 3 colleagues ( one of whom is regular there) at Lubu which had a lovely ambiance in a very greek style. The set menu for 280,000 vnd ( with no ++added ) with a glass of French white or red (an additional 80,000) was superb. i had the Gazpacho which was really tasty and my friends went for the salad. The chicken cotoletta i had for main was enormous and excellent. My 3 colleagues chose the minute steak, the Morrocan tagine and the gnocchi and licked their plates clean.Although Lubu's panna cotta was the only desert option it was light and tasty . We finished with coffees which are included free of charge. I must compliment the staff who were low key but attentive just the way they should be.
description: Located in the heart of Saigon's Thao Dien area Lubu offers a chance to leave behind the hustle and bustle of the city and enjoy inspired cuisine, fine wines & fantastic service. We use the best quality produce to create a healthy nutritious menu, drawing inspiration from the great cuisines of Europe & The Mediterranean Open Tuesday to Sunday for breakfast, lunch & dinner (8.30am-10pm), or, just a great coffee, a glass of wine a cocktail or an icy cold beer with some tasty tapas.....Lubu is the place to be.

name: Quan Ngon - Hanoi bun cha
address: 209 De Tham, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Surprisingly exquisite!! Specializing in one of the typical dishes of Ho Chi ming. Which Ngon is the best place to taste a tasty Bún Cha soup, with a quiet atmosphere, where they only serve 3 or 4 tables indoors with a very friendly treatment., Cozy restaurant with a very good Bun Cha. Unfortunately, I think that the "soup" was ready to eat when we finished it, that it quickly got cold. The spring roll we got was piping hot which was really good. The staff were extremely friendly and helpful in explaining how to eat Bún Cha. The restaurant is larger than it appears from the street. We sat on the first floor. We bought a Bún Cha + an extra fried spring roll and a beer for 2 people and paid 298,000vnd. All in all, this restaurant is worth a visit., The location is right at the intersection of Peiyuan Pedestrian Street. The dining environment is comfortable, the service is friendly, and the food is delicious. It is worth visiting again. The bún chả (barbecue powder) tastes very authentic to Hanoi. Rice noodles similar to tsukemen, dipped in the sweet and sour hot soup, you can slurp up the rice noodles and vermicelli, paired with barbecue and hamburger-like steaks, which are less common in Taiwan, and delicious~
description: Surprisingly exquisite!! Specializing in one of the typical dishes of Ho Chi ming. Which Ngon is the best place to taste a tasty Bún Cha soup, with a quiet atmosphere, where they only serve 3 or 4 tables indoors with a very friendly treatment.

name: Opera
address: 2 Lam Son Square, District 1 Park Hyatt Saigon, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: After enjoying The Opera restaurant at Park Hyatt Saigon for a decade, I think its very safe to say for a true 5 star fine dining with great ambiance, food and most of all, great service, in Saigon, this one is the best 2. Their Sunday brunch is among the best in the world (not in Vietnam). Their new Family set menu on Friday/ Saturday nights is very good and so plenty for such a great price. If I think of a very elegant dining time - this is the place. And to make it such a great experience, I warmly thank all the talented chefs especially the new one who prepared the Family set menu I’ve had just 2 days ago and : a long standing ovation for Ms. Celia who, over the years, constantly has taken great care of her guests. Nothing is a No for her. She always tries her best to make even impossible things happen to make guests so happy. You are the Gem at Park Hyatt, Celia. And you’ve trained amazing staffs we appreciate all the staffs’ highly professional service where Ms. Anh is the best of them. Thank you all and we will continue dining there for many years to come., I adore risotto. The kitchen and dining area are seamlessly self contained. I was able to observe the chef making the dish. It was divine . I was eating on my own , largely watching footy but they treated me like I was the only person who mattered . That kind of food and service only comes as a result of excellent management. I didn’t meet a manager , why would I ? Whoever you are , HATS !, This restaurant is perfect in every way. First, the food was delicious. Rodolfo is the restaurant chef from Italy, who puts his heart and soul into what he cooks. I mostly interacted with the servers Vu, Tiep, and Tien, who were friendly, professional, and were checking in on me to make sure I was content with the food. Celia, the manger of the restaurant was constantly surveying the restaurant, keeping everything in check. Her work certainly pays off, as the restaurant was unforgettable.
description: Set within the elegant surroundings of Park Hyatt Saigon, Opera restaurant provides an approachable trattoria-style dining experience, perfect for business lunches and leisurely meals with friends and family. Under the expert guidance of Chef Luca Cappellato, Opera embraces the philosophy of sharing, of coming together to create delightful moments through unique dining experiences, including Sunday brunch buffet, weekend family dinner, seasonal tasting menus, and many more. Impeccable service, a refined ambiance, and exceptional cuisine converge to create memorable moments for every guest at Opera.

name: DẠ 夜 Dining
address: 72-74 Nguyen Thi Minh Khai 26F, Centec Tower, Ward 6, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: Best ever. Highly recommend. Best service. Have a lot of funny activities for customers. Best dessert: mango coco- it likes mango sago with the cream on the top- smell so good, Good food. Good service. Ms. Bối is very nice and professional. My family had a great time. Thanks. We will visit Dạ again., This place is amazing, the food& beverages are also amazing, i like XO fried rice the most, staffs are very welcoming and friendly :)
description: Best ever. Highly recommend. Best service. Have a lot of funny activities for customers. Best dessert: mango coco- it likes mango sago with the cream on the top- smell so good

name: D'Maris Premier Buffet Cong Hoa
address: 20 Cong Hoa 5F, Pico Plaza, Ward 12, Tan Binh, Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam
reviews: This place is amazing!!!! Staff is very polite and professional!! The place is very well decorated and it has private rooms as well!! Now to the important stuff...the food...it is an open buffet restaurant..it has meat, seafood, pasta,sushi,sweets...and plenty of choices from each category!food is well cooked and the taste is amazing!!! I totally recomend it!!will deffinately visit it again, Nice service with a variety of tasty foods. I highly recommend to enjoy meals with family or friends!, This place was amazing. Good service with tasty foods and drinks. You can try a variety of food here. Worth to try!!

I totally recomend it!!will deffinately visit it again

name: BROS KOREA 1980s
address: 47 Nguyễn Thị Diệu Phường 6, Quận 3, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: At the beginning of the week, when I went to eat, the restaurant was still very crowded. The food was delicious. Kiet served our table very enthusiastically and served the grilled cheese dish very conscientiously. In the group, there are people born in the year of the cat who also get a discount 😁😁, Fun evening with great food. Staff really looked after us. Even though the place was very busy, they took the time to explain how everything worked and cooking so much delicious food for us. Lots of different meats , all delicious and some seafood consisting of octopus, squid, pawns and a couple of oyster. We were all very full by the end of the meal and that is saying a lot as we have two older teenager boys with big appetites. Restaurant is full of young people and families, not so many tourists like us. Definitely recommend if you are after a fun night ., Authentic Korean Barbecue in the middle of Ho Chi Minh City. Came with the whole family, kids age 10-19. Som minor language difficulties initially, but soon the waiter Zang joined us and followed us and prepared all the meals. Guided us through all the dishes and explained each and every one. We chose the extended buffet and that was just great. My wife needs gluten-free options, and she could eat almost everything. Overall a really nice experience for the whole family!
