name: The Lunch Lady (Nguyen Thi Thanh)
address: 23 Hoang Sa St., District 1 Phuong Da Kao, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: This is a very ordinary street restaurant in Ho Chi Minh. The restaurant is located on the sidewalk of the internal residential area. Personally, the dishes here are also normal, not as special as advertised. Diners do not have enough tables to sit, must be grouped with other guests. This is very inconvenient. Moreover, there are no toilets here, tissues are scattered on the roadway, and the restaurant does not have trash cans. The service price in my opinion is not cheap if compared with other street restaurants, Loved the seafood soup if the day at this outdoor street food restaurant in a courtyard near the canal and zoo. Chock full of shrimp, fried crabcake and squid, plus noodles and very flavorful broth. Sucy a bargain at least than $3 U.S., We went to the Lunch Lady in HCMC, and it’s true what people say - it is a tourist trap. When we got there, they instantly told us to sit down. Then they brought small dishes on the table. We took it as an experience and as an upportunity to taste something new. Then we got the soup which was very good - a sour thai soup. We soup was 50.000 VND. We were two persons and payed 200.000 VND in total while the locals just got their soup. A mixed experience.
description: It's the best hawker/food stall in ho chi minh city!

name: Pasha Restaurant
address: 25 Dong Du Ben Nghe, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Quite welcoming and very conveniently situated. Good atmosphere, even if lighting is very much on the dim side... the pretty lamps make up for it I guess. Had the beef/lamb kebab, and it was very nice. Draught beer in pre-cooled glass was a nice touch. Pricing costs one star, it's really quite expensive compared to similar places. Couldn't fault quality or service though., During the virus they offered a 30% discount for a long time that was the time to enjoy this restaurant 30% off the entire bill was a great deal but now they are back to regular prices so are there are many other options to enjoy better food at better prices most the reviews are correct. Good portions you can get a big beer for 90,000 that is cold. Again with a 30% discount it was great, First of all, let me be very direct. if you are from turkey or have tried 'real' Turkish food on numerous occasions, you will find that this is an average restaurant. If not, you will probably like it. I have read quite a few reviews on this restaurant before heading there myself. We had kebabs and drank Turkish yoghurt drink Ayran. Here is my conclusion: No, they do not have small portions. Yes, this is a genuine Turkish restaurant run by a guy who camps at the entrance holding a hookah. Yes, the inside of the restaurant is reminiscent of the restaurants in Turkey. Yes, this is a pretty expensive restaurant even in District 1 standards. No, they do not have poor service. Btw, you can pay half the price and enjoy similar tasty food in Zeytun (i said similar because the latter is not a real Turkish restaurant, is middle-eastern and the food there has a somewhat different taste and is spicier). All in all, Pasha has high-priced standard quality Turkish food, exceptionally clean bathrooms, and attentive staff.
description: Shisha Cafe & Turkish, Mediterranean, Middle Eastern Cuisine located in the heart of Saigon (near Sheraton Hotel). We have a warm & cozy atmosphere for you to enjoy a fine dining experience with families & friends, have a talk with a cup of Turkish tea, or watch life go by with more than 30 flavors of Shisha. English Live Sports Channels and Free Wi - Fi 4 floors with karaoke available for VIP room. Happy hour, monthly promotions & Kids Eat Free are available throughout the year.

name: Beirut Restaurant - Villa & Pool
address: 43 Tran Ngoc Dien District 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Beirut is one of my top destinations for authentic Lebanese food and entertainment. The ambiance is great, the food is delicious, and the staff is amazing. It’s such a friendly place that you feel welcome from the moment you walk in. I want to thank the Beirut team and the chef for consistently serving authentic and flavorful Lebanese cuisine., Beirut Restaurant is a great place to enjoy authentic Lebanese cuisine along with shisha, bellydance shows, and a cozy atmosphere. The service is exceptional making it perfect for a night out with friends or a romantic dinner. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a taste of Lebanese culture., If you searching for great Lebanese food in hcmc this is place where you find great taste I ordered mixed grill platter and some mezze to share. The hummus was creamy and rich, the falafel perfectly crispy, and the grilled meats were juicy and flavorful with that authentic charcoal aroma If you are looking for halal, this is right place! Highly recommend if you’re in HCMC and looking to try something different. Beirut delivers both flavor and flair—I’ll definitely be back!
description: Located in one of the hottest districts in Ho Chi Minh City, Beirut Villa & Pool has opened its doors to the public in the heart of district 2 offering a variety of traditional Mediterranean dishes, oriental entertainment such as exotic belly dancing and a gorgeous swimming pool uniquely at Beirut D2. OUR DISHES - MIDDLE EASTERN DELICACIES At Beirut Restaurant - Villa & Pool, our Chefs use only the best imported high quality ingredients and spices like our: grains, flavorings, meat and vegetables straight from the areas of the Mediterranean seas. A vast selection of vegetarian and Halal dishes are also available at our restaurant for you to enjoy. BELLY DANCE PERFORMANCES EVERYDAY Not only can you savor your delicious food from our Menu but also enjoy Beirut’s exotic, sexy dance performances such as Belly dancing, latin carnival dances and Live DJ sets from the hottest in town!

name: Padma de fleur
address: 89/12 Hàm Nghi Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: It is a beautiful restaurant where you are in the view:). Surrounded by lovely plants and serving trays decorated beautifully you are besotted from the moment you enter. 150 k for a set meal which included chicken, fish , soup and stir fried morning glory. I preordered vegetarian for one friend which we all agreed was the best. The passion fruit lemon grass juice was also a winner. A beautiful experience that remains with you. I had gone years ago and thought of this for the special ladies I had with me today who were also totally charmed❤️ They are very responsive on Facebook messenger. Do preorder vegetarian meals a day in advance, Gorgeous little boutique cafe & flower, hidden away down a alleyway, and off the beaten track. This beautifully renovated building has a working flower shop on the ground floor, and a cafe upstairs. There’s a good variety of hot & cold beverages, and some pastries on offer. They also do serve lunch, but you need to book this online via their Facebook or Instagram pages. The menu changes daily. This is the most beautiful beverage presentation you will ever see : insta-worthy x100 Our Vietnamese coffees were perfectly made and delicious. Pastries were so light and flaky- best in the city. This is truly an unique experience and definitely worth seeking out. Highly recommended!, This is not your typical place to have a meal since it's inside a florist. We were introduced by a local friend otherwise we would not have known. The food is traditional Vietnamese style and served only during lunchtime. Since it's small - there are not many tables so you have to book in advance to get a seat. It's a very lovely environment for a meal or drink - surrounded by beautiful flowers! Highly recommend!
description: We are wild-at-heart floral artists who create beautiful experience, share them with flower-loving souls, smile and inspire smiles. Cafe.padmadefleur is the space where imagination roams, the place where senses float in the embrace of aromas, of colours and tastes.

name: El Camino Taqueria - District 2
address: 32 Nguyen Duy Hieu street Thao Dien, Quan 2, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: Very casual, great home made Tacos, Burrito's and other great Mexican dishes. would recommend this restaurant to any Mexican food lover., This one is the best tacos in town for me!!! Mexican tacos with Korean inspired sound strange but IT’S WORK!! Sooooo goooood Try POUTINE and FLAMNIN HOT snack too 🍻, Quite good- delicious blend of taste in a very informal but cool atmosphere. Good value for the money. Good overall and worthwhile
description: REAL INGREDIENTS JUST TASTE BETTER El Camino Taqueria is the perfect place to enjoy a delicious Mexican meal with a Korean twist Our menu features a wide variety of Tacos, burritos, quesadilla and moree All made with fresh, high-quality ingredients and love with El Camino soundtrack to put you in the mood day after day We also have a full bar now so you can enjoy your meal with a our signature Margaritas or other Mexican beverage Our friendly and attentive staff is always happy to help you choose the perfect meal and we offer a variety of vegetarian and vegan options. Whether you're looking for a casual lunch with friends or a romantic dinner for two, El Camino Taqueria is the perfect place to enjoy Mexican food in HCMC Visit us today and see for yourself why we're the best taqueria in town!

name: Hummus And Grill Halal Restaurant
address: 175/16 Pham Ngu Lao Street, Pham Ngu Lao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: good Cheap lebanese and Indian food .. big portions good location net to my hotel Best tajine in saigon, Great hummus and salad with a lot of kinds to select from Good location in pham mug Lao Near my hotel Open late in the evening up to 2 am Can deliver halal food any where in Saigon, Nice food and cool restaurant. Love the hummus, falafel amd the fried chicken. Salad was refreshimg. Will sure come back if I visit Ho Chi Minh
description: Hummus And Grill Halal Restaurant is combination of Al sham dishes (Lebanon, Syria, Jordan and Palestine which is almost same Turkish and Farsi , we also serve Halal Indian food and Vietnamese / Asian food) it is mixture of all tastes and rich flavors. You can enjoy our Mediterranean food in Ho Chi Minh city in Vietnam with a chance to taste Hookah / Shisha

name: Italiani's Pizza
address: F5 Diamond Plaza 34 Le Duan, Ben Nghe, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City 70000 Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant's space is cool and pleasant, the music is extremely melodious. Come eat with your family on the weekend with Andrey-Hao, our receptionist and waiter, he's amazing- smile is the winning part, delicate and extremely enthusiastic and thoughtful. Because of that dedication, we will prioritize Italianis restaurant every time we have the opportunity, Top notch wood-fired pizza with lots of local and familiar toppings choices. Service with a big smile was provided graciously by our server, Kate! We enjoyed the margherita and pepperoni pizzas on the outdoor terrace as the evening cooled. Great views of Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon), walkind distance from many of the major hotels, including ours (Sofitel). This was the perfect answer to a casual dinner before getting ready to depart early the next morning. Good beer choices as well, and other Italian favorites if you don't feel like pizza. They have a robust take-out service as well. Again, the experience was enhanced by our lovely and considerate server, Kate!, Venn great service and great food,…… Nice smile with great service. Great pizzas, the x4 cheese pizza was lovely with honey drizzled over it. Iced water was supplied when ever we wanted. Two of us dinning and the ambience was nice. Food came out fast. Relaxing dinner. We came back two nights in a row because location was close. We are from NZ.
description: Italiani’s specializes in beautifully crafted individual wood fired pizzas and Italian-inspired dishes. We poured our hearts into creating a local Pizzeria that provides exceptional food, a welcoming environment for families and business professionals, and a fun date night spot for couples. We use the most flavorful tomatoes, cheeses and other fresh locally-sourced ingredients when possible to make our wood fired pizzas and Italian-inspired dishes. Our pizza dough is also made with “secret” ingredients that are hand worked and tossed to ensure that our pizzas have a deliciously thin crispy crust, with a chewy center, topped with the freshest ingredients. They are then fired to perfection in our authentic wood fired oven to seal in flavor and transform our menu items into fine crafted masterpieces. Our appetizers, salads, homemade gelato, and local craft beers are just a few more reasons to enjoy a meal at Italiani’s Homemade Pizza.

name: LOOP 1 - Cocktail Bar & Kitchen
address: 1st Floor, 39 Ly Tu Trong, Ho Chi Minh City 700000 Vietnam
reviews: The Pub with the style Egypt Vibe I guess haha. Located on the 1st floor of building. We had 2 drinks are made randomly by barista and the taste quite niceeee... 1 cocktail included Bailey, yolk, cream,.... and another is about Soda. However, we ordered 2 dishes but the staff just gave 1 hahah, maybe he missed our order Anyway, the staffs really nice and friendly with us. Always take care of us..... We came here for a drink at happy hour, Cocktails for no more than $7 AUD until 8pm. This place puts a Sydney cocktail bar to shame. Stay for tapas well worth it!! Friendly staff so attentive., My fav place to come in Saigon. Unique Egypt style with good drink, specially Forbiden Fruit. Friendly bartenders, live music per Fri & Sat. Highly recommend 👍

name: Quan Cat Ba Family
address: 180 Một Tháng Tư, Cat Ba Town, Hai Phong, Cat Ba Vietnam
reviews: Good food. It's delicious. The seafood is super. The rice is delicious (garlic rice). Clam, shrimps and ousters grilled in garlic better is fantastic! Prices excellent, shrimp 150, shells and oysters 80 Of the disadvantages, it's impossible to order anything, ladies forget everything they asked for. But I also had enough ordered) very delicious) Another thing, you have to sit outside, only the locals have inside, and there's no air conditioning inside anyway, just fans. So you can only have dinner there, after sunset))), I visited the restaurant with my 2 children (10 & 8). We had seafood (grilled Oysters, squid) + veggies, spring rolls and chicken rice. All food was very good and fresh. The restaurant was quite full and there were many Vietnamese, which of course is a good sign. For fresh seafood and the size of the portions I found the price completely reasonable (we paid 460k VND incl. drinks). We would definitely come back again!, We visited this restaurant four times during our 3-day stay in Cat Ba because it was the best seafood we have ever had, and for a very reasonable price. There is a great range on the menu and definitely something for everyone. The seafood was fresh from the tank. We couldn't recommend this place enough! The family who run it are also very nice and welcoming.

name: The Three M Restaurant
address: 252 đường Một Tháng Tư, Hai Phong, Cat Ba 187310 Vietnam
reviews: Exceptional seafood and great beer! Pretty much every variety of seafood I’ve ever heard of - and more! All of it is fresh, kept in tanks and prepared in the restaurant. We had Thai steamed clams, beer steam shrimp, salt baked mantis shrimp and fried sea bass which was all delicious!! Also they serve local Hà Nội beer on tap a variety of craft beers from a brewery in Ho Chi Minh (7 bridges). Really inexpensive, really good quality food and great service - especially from our waitresses Hien and Bich! Would highly recommend! 🙂, I haven't seen any place as reasonable as my restaurant. My group has 100 guests but the service is still attentive and complete. Fresh seafood tourist area with reasonable prices without being overcharged, the owners and staff are very happy and active. Will come back to this restaurant next time I come to Cat Ba, Great food, cool vibe and excellent service. Hien made some great recommendations and provided excellent service, we enjoyed the pork rib, steamed vegetables and morning glory with garlic. The fish looked fresh as well. We tried the la Palma red wine, it's only 13% and nice and light without being acidic.

name: Secret Garden Cafe And Restaurant
address: 169 Nui Ngoc street, Hai Phong, Cat Ba 180000 Vietnam
reviews: great food, warm service, and a beautiful atmosphere,..... The staff are exceptionally friendly and welcoming, providing top-notch service that makes you feel right at home. They are attentive to your needs, offering recommendations when asked and ensuring you have a pleasant dining experience, Absolutely loved my visit to this charming little pub in Cat Ba! The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, with friendly staff who made us feel right at home. The selection of local craft beers was impressive, and the food was delicious—try the seafood platter for a real treat! The cozy ambiance and stunning views made it the perfect spot to unwind after a day of exploring. Can't wait to be back here!!!, The moment I stepped into the hostel, I immediately felt the freshness and peace of the atmosphere here. The staff were very friendly, warmly welcomed me and gave me the feeling of being home. The food was very tasty, varied and served all day, I also enjoyed the breakfast at night. The price for drinks, especially beers was really cheap and reasonable. The service was good. I would recommend this place to my friends, and come back one day. Really enjoyed the best time here.
description: Secret Garden is a new and unique restaurant located on the tree-lined streets of Cat Ba main town. We focus on fresh, healthy and soul-nourishing food. We strive to ensure quality, great service and great taste. Our menu is full of delicious recipes and flavors not usually found on Cat Ba Island, catering to vegetarians, vegans and non-vegetarians. We offer a range of amazing secret recipes Vegan Burgers, Chicken Burgers, Buddha Bowls, Smoothie Bowls and more. Some of the delicious and unique flavors you can find on our menu are homemade Pesto, Hummus, Guacamole, Peanut Sauce, Vegan..

name: The Little Leaf Restaurant
address: 224 Duong Mot Thang Tu, Hai Phong, Cat Ba 187300 Vietnam
reviews: Very attractive restaurant with nice decoration and seating outside and inside. The menu was very attractive and extensive and the service very friendly and English-speaking (but not always very attentive). We ate there three times because not many restaurants were open during the holidays (Tet). I had a delicious vegetarian teriyaki bowl with cashews, peas, corn, tofu, broccoli, rice, etc. and a ginger tea. My friend had spicy seafood (really spicy) and a coffee. I also tried the vegetarian burger, the tofu with soy sauce and my friend had the vegetarian curry and chicken with fries. We found it very tasty and as a vegetarian I was happy to finally be able to eat something other than spring rolls, fried rice or noodles. I can definitely recommend the vegetarian burger, the bowl and the ginger tea! In addition, the service (a young woman) was able to offer us a bus ride to Ninh Binh directly from the island due to her good English skills. Due to the holidays (Tet), planning the return trip was a bit difficult as many travel agencies were closed., We selected this restaurant according to the great reviews and were absolutely not disappointed with the food and service. We ordered the burrito and mango sticky rice, both were delicious. The burrito is little spicy. You can est on the terrace. Great value for money., I had coffee and breakfast here two days in a row, food was lovely, a berry smoothie bowl and avocado and poached eggs on toast were particularly welcome after two weeks of noodles and rice! Espresso was also great. Excellent and friendly service from Huong, who happily accommodated a couple of substitutions/ additions I asked for.
description: A cozy and beautiful space. The Little Leaf restaurant with an outstanding menu of coffee, tea and healthy dishes, vegetarian food and Vietnamese dishes. A beautiful space to enjoy a wonderful time when visiting Cat Ba island with friends and family. Enjoy an energizing cup of coffee with nutritious breakfast dishes, enjoy Vietnamese dishes, vegetarian dishes, healthy dishes and some European dishes. Read a book, play games with friends and friendly staff.

name: Ladybird Cafeteria And Restaurant
reviews:
The menu offers a wide variety of dishes, all made with fresh ingredients that really shine through. The friendly staff made excellent recommendations, and the generous portions meant we got great value for money. The spacious seating arrangement and clean environment made our dining experience super comfortable., We were looking for a restaurant with vegetarian options in Cat Ba, and the Ladybird delighted us. The relaxed atmosphere and attentive service allowed us to enjoy a delicious meal on the terrace. The flavors were authentic and refined., Espresso, Capuchino, Latte, Americano or just Iced Milk Cafe, it was super good. Our group of 10 people really liked the iced milk coffee here, which is unique and special in Vietnam. At Ladybird, they chose coffee beans well so the quality is superior and well scented. Thank you Nhung for the warm and pleasant welcome. We recommend!!! Nestled in a picturesque spot with stunning views of Cat Ba bay, Ladybird Cafeteria and Restaurant is a haven for those seeking both scenic dining and culinary delight. Guests have called out the exceptional service, highlighting the staff's attentiveness and proficiency in English. It's not just the service that earns rave reviews but also the value, with the restaurant offering a cornucopia of delectable Vietnamese dishes at reasonable prices.

The fusion of local and international flavors, coupled with the fresh ingredients, ensures a memorable gastronomic experience. Moreover, the restaurant's ambiance, with its unique decor and local art, makes for an enchanting atmosphere ideal for a romantic or tranquil meal.
description: The menu offers a wide variety of dishes, all made with fresh ingredients that really shine through. The friendly staff made excellent recommendations, and the generous portions meant we got great value for money. The spacious seating arrangement and clean environment made our dining experience super comfortable.

name: Casa Bonita
address: 82 Nui Ngoc, Hai Phong, Cat Ba 180000 Vietnam
reviews: We had a lovely meal a CASA bonita! We both ordered seafood curry after hearing good things and it did not disappoint! One of the best meals weâ€™ve had on our trip and the spice was jsut perfect! They also had happy hour on cocktails. We got two beers and two curryâ€™s and it was 8 British pound for all, Nice house, as the name suggests. Cozy restaurant with amazing dishes. We ordered the chicken, mango and avocado salad, carbon spaguettis with bacon and potato balls and cheese with sauce, it was all great. We were surprised by the quality and price. Definitely recommended., I was in Cat Ba 3 nights and went to Casa Bonita for 2 of those nights (may have gone for all 3 nights if Iâ€™d discovered it the first day ðŸ˜‰). The food was great and very inexpensive. I had the seafood curry one night and cashew chicken the other - both were very good and were under 100,000 vnd. They also have a selection of baking that you can purchase (banana cake, carrot cake, apple pie, etc). I had the banana cake - it was really good, quite large and only cost 40,000 vnd. And, to top it all off, you may get to cuddle with some adorable kittens while youâ€™re there.
description: With fresh ingredients from CatBa market turned into carefully selected recipes in our clean kitchen, Casa Bonita is guaranteed to delight your tastebuds!

name: Bonne Vie Restaurant
address: 64 Dien Bien Phu Hong Bang, Hai Phong 180000 Vietnam
reviews: I used to go here three times with my sister. This restaurant is very famous for the Western dishes such as beefsteak, french fries, hamburgers and grilled foods. The entire atmosphere was filled with the smells of food. The taste of the food here was beyond my expectation. They were totally up to my standard! The most popular dish in this restaurant was beefsteak which was cooked perfectly with medium well level. What I was really satisfied with at this restaurant was the way the staff and waiters serve us there. especially the female restaurant waitress named Kim Chi. She was very friendly and made us feel that we were our home. Moreover, the relaxing music there really made our dishes taste more flavorful. I will definitely come back to this amazing restaurant more in the future., The restaurant has brought me and my friends a wonderful dining experience. With Thao's subtle instructions on how to choose dishes, she helped us have a dinner that was just enough but still standard and European. Thank you very much for your service., The food here was exquisite. It’s a bit expensive compared to Asian prices but not at all compared to European prices and the food is on a par with a a top European restaurant. I had foie gras which was divine and fish and chips and my husband had the steak. The way it was served was amazing with the chef coming to the table with the steak on a hot plate explaining the origin of it and setting Cointreau alight to make a sauce. All topped off with a delicious creme brûlée. The service was the best we have had anywhere with the staff so kind and attentive. We are so glad we ate here and will always remember it. . I highly recommend this restaurant if you are visiting Haiphong.
description: Bonne Vie Restaurant provides a diversity of F&B service, such as buffet, à la carte, lunch and dinner. The dishes are carefully crafted and delicately cooked in the style of European, Asian and Vietnamese cuisine. At the Manoir Des Arts hotel, our staff members significantly focus on building and implementing organizational culture in order to satisfy customers by providing the best value for customers during their stay.

name: Yi Ling Ling Restaurant
address: Vinhomes Imperia Metropolitan Area, Ha Noi street, Hong Bang district, Hai Phong, Vietnam, Hai Phong 180000 Vietnam
reviews: A beautiful dining experience in an upmarket environment, with really pleasant staff. Our waiter Quyền went out of his way to explain the dishes and the side dishes that would complement them. Food was fresh tasty and authentic. Certainly we will be returning for another visit soon, - Delicious food, reasonable price - Luxurious, sparkling space, although not really Chinese style, there is music to compensate, gentle and relaxing - Serve quickly, thoughtfully, and pay attention to customer experience throughout the process of using the service - Chinese dishes typically have to be prepared meticulously and take time, so you should consult the menu and order before arriving. The menu consultant is very enthusiastic, paying attention to the taste limitations of diners. For example, can't eat spicy foods, are allergic to shrimp/fish,... - Dimsum and Ribs Yi Ling Ling is the best ❤️ - Not to mention the extremely diverse, delicious and beautiful drink menu ❤️, My family and I had the opportunity to visit Hai Phong, so friends suggested a restaurant for dinner. I quite like the space here, luxurious and sophisticated. Delicious food, suitable for taste and reasonable price. What really impressed me was the service style of the staff here. Especially that day, my family received Quyen's enthusiastic advice on the menu, help choosing dishes, and even dinner, he was always warm and friendly. I will definitely come back if I have the chance.
description: A beautiful dining experience in an upmarket environment, with really pleasant staff.  Our waiter Quyền went out of his way to explain the dishes and the side dishes that would complement them.  Food was fresh tasty and authentic.  Certainly we will be returning for another visit soon

name: The Healing Kitchen
address: 229, Mot Thang Tu Street, Cat Ba Town, Hai Phong, Cat Ba 180000 Vietnam
reviews: We had a great dining experience at The Healing Kitchen in Cat Ba. The salmon poke bowl was fresh and full of flavor, a perfect light and satisfying meal. Our server, Kiet, was attentive and friendly, making sure we had everything we needed. We enjoyed it so much that we went back the next night for their espresso martinis, and Kiet made them perfectly. If youâ€™re looking for fresh, delicious food and great drinks in a welcoming atmosphere, this place is definitely worth a visit., I visited Healing Kitchen in Cat Ba town three times during my stay, and each time was a delightful experience. The food is incredibly fresh, made from locally farmed ingredients that really shine through in every dish. My favorites were the chicken poke and the salmon poke, both bursting with flavor and beautifully presented. The team at Healing Kitchen, especially Anni, Hung, and Z, were fantastic. They were warm, welcoming, and provided great recommendations not only about the menu but also about places to explore around Cat Ba. Their hospitality really added to the overall experience. I stayed in Cat Ba for over a month and tried many places, but Healing Kitchen was definitely the best. If youâ€™re looking for fresh, locally sourced food with a warm and friendly atmosphere, this is the place to go!, Love this beautiful little cafe in the heart of Cat Ba town. The people are sweet and kind. The good is amazing, and it's clear that a LOT of love goes into preparing it. We loved the hot steaming ginger tea, coconut coffee, the Rustic Breakfast Bowl, the Poke bowls. It's all delicious and so lovingly prepared. I highly recommend this little hang out joint in the centre of Cat Ba. The energy and ambience is laid back, gentle and relaxing. The music also suits the relaxing atmosphere. Wish we could have gone there more often had we been staying in Cat Ba for longer.
description:
We had a great dining experience at The Healing Kitchen in Cat Ba. The salmon poke bowl was fresh and full of flavor, a perfect light and satisfying meal. Our server, Kiet, was attentive and friendly, making sure we had everything we needed.

We enjoyed it so much that we went back the next night for their espresso martinis, and Kiet made them perfectly. If youâ€™re looking for fresh, delicious food and great drinks in a welcoming atmosphere, this place is definitely worth a visit.

name: Cat Ba Langur's House
address: No 153 Nui Ngoc Street, Cat Ba Town, Cat Hai, Hai Phong 180001 Vietnam
reviews: Dịch Beautiful café with spacious space, modern and warm design. The menu ranges from classic drinks such as coffee and tea to unique creations hard to find elsewhere. The service is extremely professional, with warm and attentive staff, always ready to help guests. What distinguishes this place are its original services, offering a new and interesting experience. It’s really a great place to relax, get together with friends or work. Every visit leaves an unforgettable impression. I love this place!, awesome, chill space, good music, delicious drinks and cakes, everyone here is friendly🫶 Cat Ba island is very beautiful, the sea is clear blue, Cat Ba national park is a place worth experiencing. There are many beautiful caves and there are mountain climbing tours., a rare peaceful space on Cat Ba Island. It is far away from the big construction site. It is an ideal place for me to relax and work. The drinks are great with value beyond my expectations. I sincerely recommend you to come and experience here even just once.
description: Cat Ba Langur's House: A Culinary Oasis with a Conservation Heart Nestled in the beautiful landscape of Cat Ba Island, Cat Ba Langur's House is more than just a restaurant and coffee shop—it's a delightful culinary destination that connects food lovers with local flavors and wildlife conservation. Our Menu Highlights: Fresh, locally sourced Vietnamese cuisine Specialty coffee featuring locally grown beans Unique dishes inspired by Cat Ba's rich culinary traditions Vegetarian and vegan options available What Makes Us Special: Stunning views of the surrounding natural landscape Cozy, welcoming atmosphere Educational displays about the critically endangered Cat Ba langur Supporting local agriculture and conservation efforts with every purchase

name: Lệ Cát Bà Restaurant
address: 198 đường 1/4, Hai Phong, Cat Ba 187300 Vietnam
reviews: Nice informal atmosphere to eat with good seafood meal. Also local viet nam come here to eat later in the evening. After dinner no rush to go and drink some beer, Went here with a bunch of friends. The owner and staff were really nice. They served really fast and helped us cook the food when we were busy eating. We will definitely come back to eat here and recommend it to those who love hotpot style., A really nice little place on the seafront to try some local craft beers, which were delicious. We just had some drinks, chips and even though steamed rice wasn’t on the menu, my friend was craving it and they provided. Service was great despite some minor language barriers which we worked through with Google Translate.

name: Nah Thai Bistro
address: Số 239, Đường Một Tháng Tư Cát Bà, Cát Hải, Hải Phòng, Hai Phong, Cat Ba 05406 Vietnam
reviews: A nice place to have dinner, the food is really tasty ! We came in family and had the grilled chicken with herbs, a stir fried chiken with cashew nuts and a Tom Yum soup with the creamy both on the recommandation of Thanh the waitress! Follow her advices she is really nice and with lot of attentions for you to have a great moment ! Cảm ơn again Thanh !!, We were looking for a place to dine along the coast of Cat ba and noticed this place that immediately impressed us. We entered and were seated at the table. The food was great, I got the shrimp pad thai and it was the end of the world along with a meat dish served over the fire with really delicious sweet and sour sauce. The waiter Hoang was really nice and helpful. The place is highly recommended and is one of the few where I ate really well on Cat Ba Island, I visited this Thai restaurant on Cat Ba Island, and while the food was decent, the real standout was the service. name: Quiri Cocktail & Restaurant
address: No 135 Tùng Dinh, Cat Ba Town, Hai Phong City, Hai Phong, Cat Ba 187380 Vietnam
reviews: We were taken here by a cab driver who randomly said he knew the perfect place for us to eat dinner— we owe the driver so much. What we found was really great local seafood and incredible drinks. The staff is super friendly and if they recommend a drink at the bar order it (especially the pho cocktail). You will not be disappointed, Sooooo good, we went twice! Our son said the only fault was it's not in our city back in England. We had the yummy chicken lemongrass, gorgeous grilled fish with rice paper rolls, delicious vegetarian curry, sweet and sour pork, divine cocktails and the loveliest waiters who are family to the chefs. Such beaming, welcoming smiles! Oh, and it's lovely to sit out or almost out with the doors open., This one was tricky for us to grade , accommodation was very nice and also clean , as usual the locals are up early and with such a nice prominence on the road side there’s always some one zipping around at all hours ,unsettling to perhaps a good snooze. Terrific staff all with character as in a family business. Meals available but we dined out. Breakfast was very slow and far too lethargic, food needs to be upgraded and main portions are too large , a wrong item came to table , other residents politely fumed . Pho was rustic. On a much better note the Black craft beer on tap is excellent, memorable, a true showcase of local talent. The seating area is lovely to rest in. The wee jack and hill biscuits with the coffees are a nice touch . Needs a few tweaks but you get genuine hospitality.
description: Established in 2018, our family-owned restaurant has proudly achieved 7 consecutive years at the top of TripAdvisor, making it one of the most-visited destinations for international travelers. Over the past 7 years, we’ve delighted 80,000 guests with our exceptional service and warm hospitality. Indulge in the finest traditional cocktails and savor the best local delicacies, crafted with passion and care. ✨ Whether you're here for an unforgettable dining experience or simply to unwind, we promise to make every moment special. ️ Join us and be part of a journey where flavors and memories are made!

name: Yummy Restaurant
address: 140 Nui Ngoc Street, Cat Ba Town, Hai Phong, Cat Ba 180000 Vietnam
reviews: Nice small restaurant in Cat Ba, extensive menu of local cuisine and fresh seafood at very reasonable prices. One of the staff is a native english speaker which helps break the langage barrier! The blue crab in tamarin sauce was a delight, brought directly alive from a nearby fishery before cooking, can't get fresher than that., Cozy little restaurant with a good variety of different Vietnamese dishes. We had 4 different dishes (sweet and sour tofu, spring rolls, pho bo, clams) and everything was really delicious. Prices are comparably high (however acceptable), therfore one star is deducted. Still, great place for streetfood in Cat Ba., We ate at Yummy 2 (there is also a Yummy 1) twice on our visit to Cat Ba. All five (2 parents, 3 tweens/teens) of us LOVED our meals and a great value. The service was wonderful and the food was some of the best we've had. Such a great experience both times.

Nice small restaurant in Cat Ba, extensive menu of local cuisine and fresh seafood at very reasonable prices. One of the staff is a native english speaker which helps break the langage barrier! 
The blue crab in tamarin sauce was a delight, brought directly alive from a nearby fishery before cooking, can't get fresher than that.

name: TexRock Steakhouse
address: 178 Van Cao, Hai Phong 180000 Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant specializes in beef steak, beautiful space, European style decor. Because the restaurant specializes in steak, it is relatively high-end, the price will be a bit high, but the beef steak is very delicious. If you like soft beef, call it fuji beef. The burata fruit salad is extremely delicious and suitable for your taste., What a perfect experience for me ! I never regret paying $100 for this beef steak and main course because it is highly-seasoned and juicy. The starter is extremely flavoured. And the cake for dessert is the perfect combination of sweet and sour. 💁🏻‍♀️ The waitresses served very well. Hightly recommend Steak House!, I would recommend to you especially couples. the restaurant is called tex rock. This is a restaurant serving European dishes.The space is decorated in the style of the American west. Very beautiful and very sophisticated. The food is delicious. The decoration is beautiful. Especially the beef steak. The staff is very friendly and helpful. However the price is a bit high compared to the price. nearby restaurants, but the quality of the food and service is very good.
description:
The restaurant specializes in beef steak, beautiful space, European style decor.
Because the restaurant specializes in steak, it is relatively high-end, the price will be a bit high, but the beef steak is very delicious. If you like soft beef, call it fuji beef. The burata fruit salad is extremely delicious and suitable for your taste.

name: Red Ladybird Banh Mi Restaurant  - Pub With Cold Beers
address: 241 Ben Beo Pier, Hai Phong, Cat Ba 460000 Vietnam
reviews: Stopped here after the cruise for quick lunch with Vietnamese sandwiches known as Banh Mi topped with cheese, omelette and lettuces which were crunchy and delicious. Mangoes and passion fruits smoothies mixed drink here were really fresh and delicious. Thanks Nga for great care of us, We stopped here for lunch before taking our cruise to Lan Ha bay, the Bánh Mi here was very yummy and crunchy with omelette, mushrooms and pork pâté . Thanks Nga for a great care and excellent food quality. Bravo, Nice place for Yummy Banh Mi and black coffee. This small restaurant is a few steps away the Bèo Harbour. Thanks Tran for a great breakfast
description: Red Ladybird Restaurant offers you a authentic local cuisine and excellent coffee with fresh ingredients and organic products selected from our green farmstay in Ao Coi valley. Come to enjoy and experience local savours and oders like no Other !

name: Rooftop Hill Pub And Restaurant
address: No 43, 1/4 Street Cat Ba Town, Hai Phong, Cat Ba 187300 Vietnam
reviews: I had the pleasure of staying and dining at the hotel. I ate some local food, and it was very good. The service was very fast and efficient, and the prices were very reasonable. I recommend this alternative if you want to stay near the hotel. Furthermore there is a very very nice roof top with sea view., The hotel bar was excellent! The staff were friendly, professional, and attentive. The drinks were delicious, and the selection was impressive. The atmosphere was cozy and perfect for relaxing. Highly recommended for anyone staying at the hotel!, Very nice rooftop in the center of Cat ba over the city while seeing the sea and good cocktail I had the passionfruit margarita
description: We’re incredibly proud of our Vietnamese heritage, and proper pub food. With pub classics at the heart of our menus, we’re known across Cat Ba Island and famous for our local dishes and seafood

name: The Bigman Restaurant - Steak House & Fresh Pizza
address: No. 222, 1/4 Street, Hai Phong, Cat Ba 01234 Vietnam
reviews: This place is great! Wonderful service and fantastic drinks. I loved the beautiful decorative plates they used and the owner was nice enough to let me buy one for a good price. Will come back if I’m here again. Thanks again!, My wife and I ate here the other day. It has a western slant on a Vietnamese menu. But you can get burgers and a pint, so a bit of everything really. The staff speaks good English, the prices are written so you can see them, and they give receipts if you ask. It has a western toilet and an upstairs billiard/party room. It is nothing flash, it is a good times bar but perfectly fine to eat at. Give me a helpful vote if you liked my review thanks., We headed to this place because we wanted to watch the women's world cup final and basically never ate anywhere else during our stay as we were so wowed by the food and incredible range of delicious drinks. The raspberry ice crush must be tried. Mark, Sarah Annie and Megan
description: Located at the best location of Cat Ba town with amazing seaview, The Bigman Restaurant provide finest cuisine from Local Specials to Western food & Happy time in the BigMan bar

name: Cat Ba Oasis Bungalow and Restaurant
address: 254 Street 1/4, Hai Phong, Cat Ba 180000 Vietnam
reviews: I got relaxing time at this beautiful Buanglow. I love the site of location, it is near the Beaches, quite and comfortable. I give 5 ⭐ for construction and atmosphere there. All most hotels on Cat Ba island are high building and decorated by small plants or lighting lamps. This Bungalow is different with swimming pool and big giant trees. The staffs are helpful and friendly. They are the useful local guide for your trip! Food and drink are delicious and good price. Highly recommend!, My boyfriend and I are in Vietnam for 3 weeks and we decided to got to Cat Ba for 3 days. We booked at all nights at the Le Pont Bungalow (also amazing spot). While here, we went to the Oasis 2 bar every day for drinks and food (amazing happy hour specials!!). We decided to stay a fourth night in Cat Ba so we could have a night at this incredibly peaceful and gorgeous bungalow. The beds were cozy, heater worked well and the water was hot! I went for a cool dip in the pool before breakfast as a nice wake up after a fun night out! I can’t wait to come back to Cat Ba in the future and stay here!! Thank you to all the friendly staff and thank you for the delicious drinks!!!, We found this little gem whilst walking down town..it was right nxt to our hotel..what a lovely atmosphere and friendly place..the food and drinks were delicious and the staff really made us welcome..all in all a great little restaurant..
description: As its stated name, we are offering guests with variety of choices including accommodation, western food and Vietnamese food menu and a lot of cocktails, mocktail, coffee, fruit juice and smoothies and so on. Located in the center of Cat Ba Town, it features with separated cottage bungalow of 32 rooms, a swimming pool in a very spacious green area. With many years experienced and friendly team, we do hope to provide guests with better services when you come to drink, to eat and to stay. We are hornor to welcome you all and trying to make your stay comfortable and relaxing.

name: Flame Grill & Bar
address: 12 Lach Tray Ngo Quyen District, Hai Phong 180000 Vietnam
reviews: I have eaten at the Mercure's Flame Restaurant a number of times, enjoying the steak or the chicken wrap with dragonfruit for dessert. The food is delicious, service is excellent, and the atmosphere is cozy and clean. I recommend this restaurant for anyone who wants to get off the streets of Haiphong and enjoy good from around the world, whether you are dining on Korean Bibimbab to Western Style Gluten-Free Burgers., The place is amazing. It was my birthday, decoration and stuff where so fantastic. Calm place with friends. Specially Mr.Huy was so friendly and he pay attention to details and see if we need something, he took pictures for us also, and a smile is alwags in his face. All the stuff are friendly. I recommand this place for those who want to have their birthday unmemorable., When searching for Flame and Mercure on Facebook, I thought their signature is steak but their sahbu hotpot is surprisingly exceptional. Beef, vegetables, udon and the broth are so good. I even came to ask Mr Dung and Mr Dat Kitchen for how to make it such amazing. Must try if you are a hotpot lover. Nice service and caring staff too
description: Flame restaurant gets its name from the iconic flower of Hai Phong city, along with the flame-grilled meat that featured prominently on the menu. Flame offers a large selection of flame-grilled meat and seafood in a buffet or a la carte setting. This multi-purpose restaurant offers the finest international cuisines alongside Vietnamese specialties, Korean barbecue, Japanese dishes or Western favourites.

name: No 1986 Coffee
address: 33 Đinh Tien Hoang Hong Bang, Hai Phong 180000 Vietnam
reviews: I am so impressive by the unique architecture of this coffee shop in Hai Phong. I love the taste of delicious cakes though it is kind of costly. I will come back soon. Now they are expanding with two other branches and coffee lovers can have other options of 1986 cafe!, Went during Lunar New year and it was sooo busy. Long queue and ineffective till service. Confusing trying to find table. Card machine not connected to internet and so annoying not able to pay by card. However, polite young staff and with incredible interior. Small menu. Clean and fresh. 4 cold drinks, not fully filled with half content of ice (New Year cheapness?). Tiramisu and velvet cake ok but short bread cake amazing. 511,000VND though ($22)!! Not an everyday coffee shop but more for special occasion kind of meet ups., This coffee shop has very nice decoration inside, the combination of plants and furniture make good atmosphere here. The drinks were good but still limitation for menu, anyway it still has all the basic drink.
description: I am so impressive by the unique architecture of this coffee shop in Hai Phong. I love the taste of delicious cakes though it is kind of costly. I will come back soon. Now they are expanding with two other branches and coffee lovers can have other options of 1986 cafe!

name: Lepont Bar Sunset View
address: GẦN BÃI TẮM CÁT CÒ 3 Mô Vịnh Đồng Hồ, gần bãi tắm Cát Cò 3, thị trấn Cát Hải, Hải Phòng, Hai Phong, Cat Ba 05406 Vietnam
reviews: Lepont is an excellent restaurant just outside the center of Cat Ba. Great service that tries to do everything to make guests happy. The waiter Duong DC was particularly professional, thanks to him we had a nice time there every time. Very tasty meals, lots of choice. The location and decor make it a pleasant time to spend there. Prices similar to other restaurants. The price-quality ratio is very good. you can count on happy hour between 6 p.m. and 8 p.m., We originally stopped here for a drink as it was 1/2 way between Cat Co (beach 3) and our hotel in Cat Ba town. The view is amazing, and the beer's cold. By chance we were lucky enough to catch the sunset which was just beautiful. We noticed that they had fish and seafood in tanks, and decided to come back to eat. We had Grouper (with steamed rice and morning glory) which was just delicious, probably the best meal we had had in our holiday to Vietnam (apart from maybe the Halong Bay cruise). In fact it was so good, we decided to eat here on our last night. This time we had red snapper and prawns, again delicious. The staff are really friendly and helpful and speak great English., Perfect restaurant to enjoy a breathtaking sunset. Staff is super friendly and speaks English. Great value for money. Modern, clean toilets with fresh, small, disposable cotton towels. Highly recommended!
description: Lepont is an excellent restaurant just outside the center of Cat Ba. Great service that tries to do everything to make guests happy. The waiter Duong DC was particularly professional, thanks to him we had a nice time there every time. Very tasty meals, lots of choice. The location and decor make it a pleasant time to spend there. Prices similar to other restaurants. The price-quality ratio is very good. you can count on happy hour between 6 p.m. and 8 p.m.

name: Napoli Pizza - Cafe
address: 86 Núi Ngọc, TT., Cat Ba Town, Hai Phong, Cat Ba Vietnam
reviews: Best food on the island by far, amazing service and lovely staff. Smoothie bowls so nice and fresh, pizza wood fired to perfection and the spaghetti is perfect. Very good prices too, Amazing Italian food: Pizza's made in wood-oven, real olive oil and tabasco on the table. All for Vietnamese prices! What every European needs after a long time of eating local kitchen!, The pizza is really good, although there’s some salt missing. The menu shows 30cm pizzas, but the truth is just 23-24cm. So that’s the point why just 4 points. Beside this I would visit again, nice staff also!
description: Wood fired pizza, salad, burger, spaghetti and local , vegetarian, vegan food. We always prepare fresh ingredient everyday . beside on, we also serverd drinks which included cocktail, soft drink, fresh juice, smoothie and wine .

name: Cat Ba Oasis Bar
address: No. 228 Street 1-4 Cat Ba Town Hai Phong Viet Nam, Hai Phong, Cat Ba 180000 Vietnam
reviews: Really friendly service, half price drinks from 5pm til 12am, good enough food for the price. Good atmosphere with a pool table. Perfect spot for a few drinks and some grub, especially when the Haiphong beer is 10k during Happy Hour. One of our favourite places in Cat Ba for an evening, A definite must when in Cat Ba. Great place for a drink - awesome Happy Hour!! 10,000 dong big beers 5-9PM (think cheapest $1 beers youve ever had) and 50% cocktails 3PM-Midnight. The "Thai gourmet" cocktail is amazing. Mr. Win is great with drink and food suggestions. And if you decide to eat there, Phong is a magician in the kitchen. Ended up coming here 2 nights in a row. Definitely recommend., Nice place with a very, very expanded menu. They serve good food, just don’t try the nachos. We have been here three nights on a row to have a drink on the terrace. They have special actions like 10k VND for a draught beer and 50% off cocktails. From 22:00 to 22:30 the beer was free. They have a pool table inside and play really nice music. Sometimes just a little loud. I would recommend going there!
description: Located right at Cat Ba Welcome Gate, Cat Ba Oasis Bar features itself as the most interesting must come, must see and must experience iconic place in Cat Ba Town. Facing forward to Cat Ba Harbour, it is an ideal viewpoint to see sunset in everyday. With capacity of approximately 150 seats, Cat Ba Oasis Bar is a western styled bar offering western food, international music and DJ, cocktail, mocktail, whisky, smoothies and fruit juice as well as coffee, espresso, capuchino and variety of entertaining international live music performance.

name: Manoir Cafe
address: 16 Lê Đại Hành, Hai Phong 180000 Vietnam
reviews: This is really a nice place that you should drop by. If you wanna go somewhere for a coffee, try this one. You won't ever regret! Not only are the food and service good but the European style and the intimate atmosphere here can also bring about good views. Moreover, it is located on Le Dai Hanh street - right in the heart of the city - and just under 1 km away to the Opera House and the square. It's convenient to discover this city. By the way, I would like to give thanks to staff Lan Anh for her enthusiasm and help while I were enjoying my time there!, My colleagues said having coffee here in the morning was great. They were right. I sat here last Sunday morning, drank coffee and worked on laptop. It was so comfortable that I spent the whole morning here. Oh I had a strong impression on a staff named Minh Hieu. I didn’t take any notice that my scarf had dropped and he picked it up for me in silence as he didn’t want to disturb me. Thank you so much and I hope to meet you the next time., I went around noon, so it was easy to check in. The space is cozy, there is a view everywhere, beautiful and minimalistic design. The tone of the shop with white and black colors creates a comfortable feeling. I recomend that everyone should go early in the morning to have many beautiful pictures. Especially the staff is very enthusiastic, I am impressed with you The Tai
description: Manoir Cafe is home to a wide range of flowers and foliage. The outdoor seating area is an ideal place to unwind after a busy working day in the office. Garden Manoir Cafe is the setting to enjoy our organized outdoor activities as night music or barbecued parties. The place where you can delight in our breath-taking scenery.

name: Ganesh Indian Restaurant
address: 171 Street 1/4, Hai Phong, Cat Ba 180000 Vietnam
reviews: The order of service is a bit unusual. Food is brought to one person while the others wait, but absolutely everything was delicious - fish with Indian spices, lamb curry, and seafood curry. Mango curry with prawns tastes a bit too mild, but that's a matter of taste. Fresh juices, lassi, bread with house cheese... everything was great., The food was amazing 🤩 very authentic Indian cooking with very generous serves. We had butter chicken, lamb Punjabi curry, saffron rice and garlic naan bread. Couldn’t fault 😋 would definitely recommend 😍, Excellent food, very friendly staff and at a reasonable price. We got a starter, two mains, garlic naan, whiskey coke and 4 beers and it came to just over 600k VND. Really tasty food, just as good if not better than at home in expensive restaurants. Nice position on the waterfront but away from the crowds. Some of the best Indian food we have had in Vietnam!
description: the first time come in cat ba island. Incredible variety of food, good vegetarian options!

name: Gia Vien
reviews: Last time I was there, my agency hold a big events in their biggest hall. It was the same hall where my brother got married. The hall was huge and nice with nice decoration, big stage and screen. They have places for small group of guesses, for holding wedding and for big events. The food was nice and delicious. But everytime my agency ordered the same kind so I didn't know what other food tasted like. They were reallt common food such as steamed shrims, chicken soup, sweet rice, roasted duck with honey, steak, etc. I tried to have coffee in the yard and garden area once. The drinks was not really special but it was nice., this restaurant is spread across a vast area and has common hall. besides some private rooms on the second (first) floor, which too are quite spacious.besides, they have a well stacked bar too., This is so large restaurant in this city. Everything sound good from staff to decoration. This also an ideal place to hold party or wedding
