name: Đa:mê Café
address: 34 Chu Van An, Hue 49118 Vietnam
reviews: I walked into this cafe after lunch at a restaurant close by. The ambience was sleek and minimalist, so different from what I have seen so far in a lot of cafes. It was spacious with tables meters apart for privacy. The music played over the sound system was comforting. There was also ample retail space for its merchandise. From a range of beverages on the menu, I ordered a glass of chilled coffee with coconut cream. The cream was thick without being too rich. A slice of burnt cheesecake completed my tea treat. The service was pleasant and natural. What a lovely place to while away the afternoon., In Hue in the bar area there is this place that makes excellent fruit smoothies. You can also find croissants, desserts, coffee, tea and more. The place inside has a relaxing atmosphere and is ideal for leaving the chaos of Hue for a moment., This is a great cafe, coffee is good. Decor nice and has charging points throughout. Great place to sit and charge devices at the same time. No card facilities, cash only. Says it opens at 6.30am, this is when staff arrive, more like open 6.45am-7am for service. Service is friendly and efficient.
description: Đa:mê Coffee Shop is not only about the drinks, but also the atmosphere it brings. The special thing of Đa:mê is the space displays works of art, but can still be used as a place where people can freely meet, chat, work, create and enjoy drinks.

name: Cơm Niêu Khải Hoàn
address: 90 - 94 Lê Lợi, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: We loved this restaurant, the delicious food, the simple but very effective decoration and the music creates a very relaxing atmosphere. The Thai maitre Quuang Hunh attended us very well and translated the dishes for us, us. I help choose our menu. A great hit!!!, This was by far the best food we had the pleasure of eating in Hue. The goose with passionfruit sauce made our taste buds explode, it was so delicious and something we had never eaten before. The tofu in lemongrass was silky and melt in your mouth. The ambience of the restaurant is fresh and inviting and the staff are highly professional with food and drinks arriving together., My family was referred to this restaurant by our taxi driver. Khai Hoan is an amazing restaurant with a large menu of many regional Hue foods. Our Mom is from Hue and it’s impressive to have a restaurant in Hue with the quality of restaurants we have in the U.S. and better. We ordered the combo set for 2 and the family set for 4 and it was more than enough food for our family. Each dish, especially the Banh beo, smoked goose breast, thit heo luoc was DELICIOUS. We loved everything and on top of that the decor and the super friendly service was exceptional. You must try this place when you come to HUE!
description: We loved this restaurant, the delicious food, the simple but very effective decoration and the music creates a very relaxing atmosphere. The Thai maitre Quuang Hunh attended us very well and translated the dishes for us, us. I help choose our menu. A great hit!!!

name: N. Cafe And Restaurant
address: 08 Trần Huy Liệu, Hue 49000 Vietnam
reviews: I read so much about this restaurant that I had to dine there. At the end of my meal, I felt the same as all the reviewers. Overall, it was an excellent dining experience, and the bonus was the view. I had a table that faced the walls of the Citadel. Everything was good, the food, the beverage and the service. I was satisfied with my order. The coconut coffee had just the right amount of ice, unlike some places. The diced chicken, vegetable and rice combination for my main dish was cooked well. The service was prompt and fuss-free. The little touches made a huge difference. Before the meal; it was a packet of wet tissue, to wipe my hands I was pleasantly informed. At the end, the same wait staff presented me with a fruit, saying it was dessert. How unexpected and a lovely surprise indeed. These touches and everything else make me want to recommend this cafe and restaurant to everyone visiting the Imperial City., Nice foods it yummy( delicious ) Friendly great service we went there by accident the restaurant look clean and nice surprise the price is cheap comepare to same level of reataurant We had a few menu Ice coffee nice RECOMMENDED deep fried springrolls The 2 girls very good and attentive you can sit 2nd floor or outside to look at the Hue Palace very top service and ver good prices I will say that High recommend They take credit card., We were recomened by our hotel near by to viait this place. It was just around the corner. N.cafe &food running by family members. Nice location with look on a citadel. First day we eat schrimps noodle, beef noodle and banana roles. The second spring roles, rice with vegetable and noodle. For desert we order Durian ice cream and almond jelly coffe...everything was so delicious that we can't understand the price at the end. I get also a aloa tea with lichi...Njami if you are in Hue go and visit N.cafe&food !
description:
I read so much about this restaurant that I had to dine there. At the end of my meal, I felt the same as all the reviewers. Overall,  it was an excellent dining experience, and the bonus was the view. I had a table that faced the walls of the Citadel. Everything was good, the food, the beverage and the service. 

I was satisfied with my order. The coconut coffee had just the right amount of ice, unlike some places. The diced chicken, vegetable and rice combination for my main dish was cooked well. The service was prompt and fuss-free. 

The little touches made a huge difference. Before the meal; it was a packet of wet tissue, to wipe my hands I was pleasantly informed. At the end, the same wait staff presented me with a fruit, saying it was dessert. How unexpected and a lovely surprise indeed. 

These touches and everything else make me want to recommend this cafe and restaurant to everyone visiting the Imperial City.

name: Risotto Restaurant
address: 69 Võ Thị Sáu Phú Hội, Hue 49000 Vietnam
reviews: Amazing food, beyond tasty. Happy hour is Excellent value, free bruschetta, bottle of local beer and fruit. We ordered a pizza and a risotto, and you get a glass of wine free with the pizza 🍕. The food was gorgeous. The staff were also so lovely. Our waiter Giang was so sweet and friendly. I would definitely recommend coming here!, A real festival for the senses awaits you at Risotto Restaurant! Fresh and local ingredients meet Vietnamese influences creating aromas that dance on the tongue. The presentation is colorful and generous, the service attentive and friendly. Must try: signature seafood risotto with a touch of lemongrass, accompanied by a refreshing Huda beer Cheer !!!🍻🍻🍻 1.2.3 Zo, Absolute gem of a find in Hue. After a little bit of research we opted to have dinner at Al Risotto and what a fantastic choice we made. Waitress was so kind and helpful and helped with the choice for my wife who has an intolerance to garlic. After choosing our mains we were brought complementary bruschetta with tomatoes as well as a free drink each. When our food arrived it was cooked to perfection. Crispy noodles with chicken was the tastiest meal I’ve had since our arrival in Vietnam almost a week ago. My wife had braised vegetables with rice and we shared a lovely freshly prepared Mediterranean salad which were so tasty. To finish off we had more complimentary fruit served. All in all a great food experience in Hue, we have no hesitation in recommending this place to anyone.
description: Amazing food, beyond tasty. Happy hour is Excellent value, free bruschetta, bottle of local beer and fruit. We ordered a pizza and a risotto, and you get a glass of wine free with the pizza 🍕. The food was gorgeous. The staff were also so lovely. Our waiter Giang was so sweet and friendly. I would definitely recommend coming here!

name: Quán Hạnh
address: 11-15 Pho Duc Chinh Phu Hoi, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: We ordered the sampler menu for $150,000 Dong each and it was a great way to be introduced to the unique dishes of this region. YUM!! The staff was great about showing how to eat each dish, what sauces to use, etc. We really enjoyed the entire experience., Not sure what to order so we asked the waiter who recommended several dishes, on the first arrival he showed us how to prepare then eat and so on with rest of the dishes on arrival. The food was excellent as was the service. Highly recommended., Discover this restaurant by reading reviews about our hotel. Crowded restaurant on weekends (when we were there), as many foreigners as Vietnamese. A discovery menu for 6 euros allows you to taste several specialties. The boss speaks a little French and explains how to taste the different dishes. Interessant
description: We ordered the sampler menu for $150,000 Dong each and it was a great way to be introduced to the unique dishes of this region. YUM!! The staff was great about showing how to eat each dish, what sauces to use, etc. We really enjoyed the entire experience.

name: Madam Thu 2
address: 04 Vo Thi Sau, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Recommended by our guide so took advice and booked . When booking be aware there are two so check what you have booked I’m sure both are good The one we went was big full menu had pictures so clear to understand and order When the starter came the waitress explained what to do The starters were delicious as was the chicken main 2 starters 3 mains 3 beers 1 glass wine large water all for under £24 excellent value Food was delicious staff great Good place to eat in Hue, Excellent restaurant located in the center of Hue in the most famous street for its nightlife and for the presence of many restaurants. The restaurant is mainly frequented by tourists. The appearance is very traditional and the environment overall is very welcoming. From the menu with the presence of traditional Vietnamese dishes I chose the great mix of appetizers, and I really appreciated that the waiter explained to us the order in which the individual rolls had to be eaten and above all which sauce they had to accompany them with. Everything was very good and the evening was pleasant, reservations necessary., Had a great meal here on the second night of our stay in Hue. We were sat on the terrace area (I think inside has aircon, but temperature was fine where we were). We both had the set platter (VND190k/£5.60) with some very helpful guidance from the staff on the right ingredients for the pancakes and how to construct them and also how to eat the banana leaf items). Local Huda beer was around 70p. Service was good. Would happily come again.
description: Madam Thu 2 - The branch of The Original Madam Thu Madam Thu 2 is a delightful local restaurant nestled in the picturesque city of Hue, Vietnam. This charming eatery is an extension of the original and renowned Madam Thu, building upon its legacy of exceptional Vietnamese cuisine and warm hospitality. Located in the heart of Hue, Madam Thu 2 welcomes guests with a cozy and inviting ambiance. The restaurant's decor is a blend of traditional and contemporary elements, creating a comfortable setting for diners to enjoy their meal. The soothing color palette and tasteful decorations reflect the rich cultural heritage of the region. Madam Thu 2's menu is a culinary journey through the diverse and flavorful landscape of Vietnamese cuisine. Whether you are a local resident or a traveler exploring Hue, this restaurant offers an authentic taste of the region's culinary traditions. From aromatic bowls of Bun Bo Hue to savory spring rolls and crispy banh xeo, every dish is prepared with meticulous attention to detail and the freshest locally-sourced ingredients. One of the highlights of dining at Madam Thu 2 is the warm and friendly service. The staff takes pride in ensuring that every guest feels at home, providing attentive care and helpful recommendations for those looking to explore the menu. The restaurant's commitment to quality extends beyond its food and service. Madam Thu 2 is also dedicated to sustainable and eco-friendly practices, striving to minimize its environmental footprint while offering a memorable dining experience. Whether you're seeking a taste of authentic Vietnamese cuisine, a friendly atmosphere, or a place to unwind after exploring the historic city of Hue, Madam Thu 2 is the perfect choice. With its dedication to preserving tradition and creating memorable culinary experiences, this local gem is a must-visit destination for anyone looking to savor the flavors of Hue, Vietnam.

name: COZY Restaurant
address: 6/27 Ha Noi, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews:
This is a very nice address in Hue. This little restaurant is definitely worth a visit. The welcome is nice, the dishes (at least the ones we tasted) are delicious, and the note is more than sweet (8.50 euros for 2 people with drinks, starter, dishes and dessert is offered). Our best restaurant since we arrived in Vietnam. Do not hesitate, you will not be disappointed, and at worst you will only have lost a little ten euros....., I came to this place with my family because it was a short walk from the hotel where we stayed during our stay in Hue. The place is minimal but comfortable, the staff super friendly and attentive. We took 5 different dishes to share so we could taste everything and we were impressed by how good they were. Savory and tasty dishes but not heavy and at the end they also offered us dessert (a panna cotta with caramel on top) which was also delicious like everything else. I also highly recommend it because for the 5 dishes we had, plus drinks, the price in the end was very low, so the value for money is also very good., Tucked down a little alley way in Hue there is a hidden gem of a restaurant. Although quite small, the restaurant was always busy; service was quick and the young staff were very friendly and helpful. The food is quite simply the best that weâ€™ve eaten while in Vietnam; tasty typically Vietnamese dishes-great portion size and so, so cheap! We stayed in Hue for 3 nights and although it may seem boring, we chose to eat there each night trying different things from the extensive menu. We were never disappointed! COZY Restaurant has won the hearts of many diners with its friendly and attentive service, often rewarded with compliments on the complimentary desserts. The food is consistently lauded for being both delicious and authentic, offering great quality and quantity at reasonable prices.

While the global decor gives the restaurant an eclectic vibe, guests are charmed by its warm ambiance, adding to the overall good value, especially for the variety of Vietnamese dishes that are frequently highlighted in reviews for their affordability and taste.
description: The meaning of the name is Cozy, with a classical frame with country music, soft light when you come to our shop, wish you a cup of coffee with delicious food, guests are number one when entering the shop. . Our prices are very cheap for tourists, Thank you for coming to my restaurant and vegetarian dishes

name: Bistro La Carambole
address: 18 Vo Thi Sau, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: I loved my visit to Bistro La Carambole. It’s located in the heart of the action in Hue City. The restaurant was busy so there was a great atmosphere and buzz, and the decor is lovely. The genial owner Chris, together with the manager and staff ensure that service is attentive and friendly. Prices are very reasonable and there’s a good balance of western and Vietnamese dishes. I had a delicious French onion soup - very moreish on a rainy night in Hue - followed by very tasty grilled chicken with fries. Portions were generous. We also had soft drinks, wine and beers and the total cost for two was very reasonable. We sat at one of the tables outside to soak up the atmosphere on the street and moved indoors when it became a little too humid. I definitely recommend Bistro La Carambole for anyone visiting Hue., The restaurant was packed when we arrived at 8.45 pm without a booking but we got a table for two. We enjoyed the grilled duck with orange sauce and the chicken in a mushroom cream sauce. The duck was boneless small slices. The chicken was the standout. Two pieces of breast in a rich tasty cream sauce with two types of mushrooms. The mains are served with a choice of rice, mashed potatoes or fries or mixed vegetables. The mixed vegetables were perfectly cooked and seasoned. The fries were hot and crisp, but the mixed vegetables were better. The French Sauvignon Blanc was acceptable for 115K VND per glass. The meals were delivered quickly despite the large number of customers., We were recommended to this restaurant by our tour guide. And it didn’t disappoint! The service is excellent. Both of our meals were delicious (can’t find anything to fault them) my husband’s steak was cooked to perfection. This restaurant is good value too. At the end of the night the staff called us a taxi, and as it was raining they even walked us out to the car under big umbrellas! Definitely worth a visit if you’re visiting Hue
description: romantic restaurant with a large room and two terraces, a la carte menu and also menu for groups, wine list. We speak English, French, Vietnamese, menu in Spanish, ipad menu. Air conditioned room, good music. 18 years of experience, we are waiting for you, see you soon

name: Alma Restaurant
address: 50A Hung Vuong Street, Phu Nhuan Ward Level 33, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Alma Restaurant in Hue is a fantastic dining spot that offers a perfect blend of elegance and comfort. The restaurant features a diverse menu with well-crafted dishes full of rich flavors. The ambiance is sophisticated yet warm, making it an ideal place for romantic dinners or business meetings. One of the highlights of the experience is the excellent service—especially from Quynh, who is exceptionally attentive and friendly, ensuring that every guest feels welcomed and well taken care of. If you’re looking for a high-quality dining experience in Hue, Alma is definitely worth a visit., This dish is absolutely delightful, offering a perfect balance of rich and well-seasoned flavors that truly stand out. The use of fresh, high-quality ingredients enhances its taste, making every bite a pleasure. Moreover, the beautiful presentation showcases great attention to detail, reflecting the artistry and craftsmanship behind its creation. It’s not just a meal; it’s a true culinary masterpiece that excites both the palate and the eyes., During trip to Vietnam we decided we wanted to have a western meal and decided to give this a try as it was based in a Melia hotel (which we had stayed in whilst in Hanoi with a good experience). Stunning views across the city and excellent menu choice. Food was great! My only one criticism is that they brought our main courses when my husband was still eating the last of his starter! Even the bread roll and butter was of a high standard (not doughy and sweet as is so often the case). Went upstairs to the Skybar for after dinner drink which was equally stunning. Photos don’t do it justice. Definitely worth a visit and worth the extra money.
description: Savor Hue's First Steakhouse: Alma at Meliá Vinpearl Hue. Discover our flavourful beefsteaks inspired by local cuisine – from signature Tomahawk steak (1500g), mouthwatering Beef Wellington (1000g) to appetizing salad bowls and desserts. Luxurious atmosphere, modern design and panoramic views, it is perfect for the signature dining and cherished moments with your beloved ones on the floor 33th.

name: Ben Xuan Garden House Theatre
address: Van Thanh Riverside, between ThienMu Pagoda and VanThanh Temple of Literature, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Food is always the top of our list of priorities when travelling and Vietnam is no different ,though some may think of Pho as the all consuming Vietnamese dish. I was looking for a fine dining restaurant to indulge and narrowed down to 2. Ben Xuan Garden House was my choice after reading some positive reviews. I received an email reply from Ngo who said he would be happy to set a table for us. It was all POSITIVE from the word GO ! Ngo called me and suggested the best approach to Ben Xuan was via a 25min boat ride down the perfume river. On arrival , Ngo warmly welcomed the 4 . We were served refreshments. He even helped snap a few Photos ( which he knew) would become a great conversation piece when friends ask about our visit to Hue. He then introduce his very charming wife Camille to us. We could sense that she was someone very special with multi - talented kills in painting , planning and restoring the Garden House to it's glory. After , a tour of the the compounds , Ngo ushered us into the main recital hall. As we did not see other guests, I thought we would be waiting a while for others to arrive. As it turns out it was going to be just the 4 of us ( overwhelming pleasant surprise ) . The "private" recital was like some surreal VIP entertainment . After 30 odd minutes or so, I was eager to savour the special cuisine prepared for us. Each of the dish served was exquisite and we couldn't help but snap enough fotos to fill a small album. A final comment is that Ben Xuan is not your typical fine dining restaurant but an all encompassing experience . We wish Camille and Ngo all the best of health as most Asians cherish a lot and success in their operation and passion in what they enjoy doing. I strongly recommend anyone who is thinking of visiting and meeting Camille and Ngo not to pass up the opportunity . Best wishes to Camille and Ngo . Lilian & Andy ( Singapore) Liz & Gabby ( Melbourne) ., We took a boat to the front gates of this marvelous and interesting home/studio on the banks of the river and it was truly enchanting. We were met by the proprietors Camille and Truang and started with a tour of the amazing property (designed by Camille). We enjoyed an authentic dinner after a performance by Camille and her fellow artist and performers. The music was an interesting mix of north and south Vietnam pieces, juxtaposed with a piece from the southern US. Traung and Camille were the commensurate hosts and could not have made us feel more welcome. This is a great experience for anyone who appreciates the arts (many of Camilles paintings) and music and is an experience off the beaten path., We had the pleasure of attending a recital and dinner at the beautiful home of Camille and Truong on this past Saturday evening. It was indeed the highlight of our trip to Vietnam. The music on ancient instruments and Camille’s beautiful voice were magical. Their home is a masterpiece designed by Camille. She is also an artist. Her art is beautifully displayed in their home. They were so welcoming and the food and wine was divine. Reservations are required and I highly recommend it if you are visiting Hue.
description: VISIT, LUNCH, CONCERT, FINE DINING in the inspiring ambience of BEN XUAN GARDEN HOUSE THEATRE. Ben Xuan is built in royal architectural style, located on the most beautiful site of the Perfume River, and conceptually designed as an East West cultural meeting place. Ben Xuan's owners, Camille Huyền (Artist) and Truong Dinh Ngo (retired Swiss UBS Banker), both of them native of Hue and having lived for more than forty years in Germany, France, and Switzerland, will welcome you personally. The soirée as the highlight of the evening will unfold in the ambience of the Theatre House. The concert program is set up with the repertoire of Camille and accompanied by Ben Xuan's traditional instrument ensemble interpreting Ca Hue Royal Chamber Songs, World lullabies, Vietnamese Art Songs &Folksongs and Western Classical Songs. Enjoy the cultural exchange, chamber music and fine dining at Ben Xuan as the literati, the noble and the royal used to indulge their leisure time. Reservation in advance.

name: Nina's Cafe - Eatery
address: 16/34 Nguyen Tri Phuong Laneway 34, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: After many days eating local food I wanted to try something closer. I chose the spaghetti with tomato and meat. The spaghetti was very good, different meat than what you usually find in Vietnam, it was minced meat with the same flavor that you can have in Spain. For dessert I chose a pancake and vanilla ice cream that tasted amazing. The portions are not very large, taking into account the price, but the treatment of the waitress (she couldn't have been more pleasant and friendly) and the taste of the food make the experience a 10., Fantastic food. Y and Hang greeted us and looked after us. We chose Pork skewers on lemongrass & Vegetable spring rolls to start, with 2 Huda beers. For mains we had Pork caramel clay pot and Pork Yellow curry, both with rice. A bottle of Chilean SB - amazing food, so fresh tasting. Service was amazing by Y and Hang who both practised their English with us and taught us some Vietnamese too. We will be coming back as we are here for 4 nights. Highly recommended. They take visa debit cards and charge an extra 3%. Fantastic value as our meal cost £23 for the two of us. Well done to the team!, Absolutely excellent. The food served was all divine- very likely the best Vietnamese food yet! The grilled fish was superb as was the pork and eggplant fried. The pancake for dessert was quite rubbery so wouldn’t particularly recommend that. Will likely revisit.
description: All our food is made using really fresh ingredients bought daily from the market and supermarket. We make Vietnamese and Western food as well as Huế Specialities. We really recommend trying some of these dishes as they are unique to Huế and very tasty! We also make fruit shakes, hot drinks, cold drinks and numerous alcoholic drinks.As well as food, we can help you to arrange tours whilst you are in Huế. If you have any questions about Hue or Vietnam we will try to help you in any way we can. We want all our visitors to know we are honest and want everyone to have a really happy time while they are at our restaurant.

name: Golden Rice
address: 40 Pham Ngu Lao Street, Hue 47000 Vietnam
reviews: Great first evening in Hue! The restaurant was quiet but had been recommended by our tour guide. Really good value enjoyed several beers the banana flower salad and complimentary spring rolls both of which were delicious. Then had several curry dishes and other stir fries all were excellent. Great value for money and fabulous service from Chan., It was the first time we came to Golden Rice for dinner. We ordered three dishes, including stir-fried water spinach, sweet and sour fish, and braised tofu. The sweet and sour fish was especially delicious. The boss also generously gave us a delicious spring roll, here The dining atmosphere is beautiful, with beautiful lanterns and very tasteful decoration. I want to thank you for the service, professional chefs, staff, and the young ladies in the store. The boys greeted me very kindly, leaving behind wonderful times and memories. I would also like to thank the beautiful phuong mai, le dan, who assisted us in renting a motorcycle and providing detailed information about the tour. I recommend friends who travel here to taste the delicious food and enjoy the friendliness of the people., We initially came here for lunch and enjoyed the food so much that we can back for my sister's birthday dinner. I had pad thai noodles and my sister had a curry dish. An appetizer, two entrees and two smoothies cost us $12. The service was wonderful, the servers were adorable and helped us find new places to go see. The restaurant is centrally located, on a street with many other small, cute, restaurants.
description: Golden rice is there to offer our guests Authentic local fresh and Asian fusion food in a cozy atmosphere , well selection of wine and cocktails are also available.

name: Dmz Bar & Restaurant
address: 60 Le Loi st, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Very good service, nice staff and good food. Love the service from My- she has super energy! Really enjoy the atmosphere in this place!, My favourite bar in Hue - I visited 3 times Morning coffee cappuccinos are great. Also some excellent Vietnamese dishes and some western style food too - I enjoyed all The hudda draught comes in a big chilled glass and goes down a treat. The best part about this bar are the staff; they’re courteous, efficient and cheerful offering a top service to their customers The decor is pretty cool too, Efficient prompt service in English with a smile. Tasty snacks & meals & your beer is replenished before you finish your first one! You can even book a superb DMZ tour while you down a cold draught beer at a price that won’t break the bank. I’ll be back again for more!
description: If you want to drink during your time in Hue, than the DMZ Bar is the place to stay. We are open from 7 am until 2:30 am for drinks and 7 am until midnight for food.

name: La Paix Bistro
address: 57 Vo Thi Sau Phu Hoi, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: The friendly and kind staff make you feel more welcome and family when you enter this restaurant while eating delicious food. Excellent customer service and impressive food service will make you feel special. La Paix Bistro is designed to share the love we have for food. The price is reasonable and the portions are even more buffet eating, it seems like you don't need to mention taxes. Properly fuller on a solid entertainment machine. and leaving the restaurant and being a baccarat poker, but also your satisfaction when visiting La Paix Bistro., From Italian pasta to French and Vietnamese Pho, every dish was a delight to our taste buds. The diverse and well-stocked wine list perfectly complemented our meal. We loved the stylish and creative atmosphere, which added to the overall dining experience. The convenient and easy-to-find location made it a breeze to visit multiple times during our stay in Hue. La Paix Bistro is truly a hidden gem for food lovers!, We took the whole family to La Paix Bistro and were impressed by the professional and experienced chef who created extraordinary dishes. The fusion of Vietnamese and French cuisine is simply delicious! The kids loved the desserts. The only drawback: the service is a bit slow during peak hours. Despite this, we will definitely come back to taste other dishes of their innovative menu.
description: La Paix Bistro is one of the restaurants that bring this bistro breeze into Hue. We are located right on Vo Thi Sau street, a central and busiest street of Hue city. With elegant French style at La Paix, you can experience attractive French-flavored dishes and drinks and enjoy relaxing moments in a typical French romantic space. Forgetting the barriers of formality and style, let's enjoy and experience French cuisine in the style of La Paix Bistro! BRAND PHILOSOPHY At La Paix, we believe that customer satisfaction is the minimum goal a restaurant must achieve. However, La Paix desires more than that. We want to make customers not only stop at enjoying delicious food and attractive drinks but also have an experience imbued with French urbanism - where customers can comfortably enjoy their lifestyle in a romantic space close to nature. DELICIOUS FROM FRANCE CUISINES La Paix Bistro is highly appreciated in the culinary aspect with an attractive menu of dishes that satisfy...

name: Maison Trang Restaurant
address: 24/26 Võ Thị Sáu, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Many vegan & vegetarian options, the best food I ate since arrival. You enter barefoot, pay cash, English spoken, low prices, everyone smiles and teach you how to eat what they serve. Several vegan and vegetarian options, the best I've eaten so far. Access barefoot, payment in cash, speak English, give directions on how to consume food, all smiling, low prices, We came across this very small family-run restaurant by chance. The road to get there, a side street of the nightlife area, is not particularly lit and initially does not inspire much confidence. We have chosen to order "set menus" in which smaller portions of different dishes are served that you can order individually. All dishes were very good and tasty. Value for money highly recommended. Two menus, two beers and a large bottle of water about 180,000 dong/pers. The service is good, one of the owners explained how to prepare and / or eat the various dishes. Small point about cleanliness, we are in Vietnam so we cannot expect the same standards as other countries. It is normal to find cutlery and more on the table in special containers. The place still looks pretty clean. If you want a typical cuisine, not too touristy and convenient... you are in the right place!, This was our best dinner in Hue! Tucked away in a little alley, if we hadn’t have been told about it we would not have found it. Our family of 5 shared 7 different dishes and they were amazing. You have to try the Bun Bo Hue. Fantastic service and the food came out so quick, our boys were happy to have full bellies. The second best part is that our meal and drinks for 5, cost half that of western venues in local area, and we weren’t haggled off the street to eat there. Just great food!
description: Maison Trang has been gaining a reputation for the high quality of authentic regional dishes that you should not miss such as Beo, Nam, Loc cake, grilled pork wrapped wet rice paper, grilled chopped pork with lemon grass and stuffed rice pancake. Our traditional cuisine is so distinctive from other regions and we serve the dishes which are cooked to past emperors and royal Nguyen Dynasty.

name: Aura - Mixology & Karaoke
address: 30 Chu Van An Hue, Hue 49118 Vietnam
reviews: Really cool and unique cocktails in Hue Vietnam! They specialize in making special cocktails with flavors coming from Hue such as lemongrass. I came here with a couple of friends and we ended up ordering like 8 drinks and all of them were so delicious. They were so tasty not overly sweet or bitter. My favorite was their ganh oc which includes light rum, orange juice, lime juice, coconut syrup, lemongrass syrup, fresh lemongrass, lemon leaves, orange bitter and tobacco sauce. The drink was served in this cute little pot with a mini rice hat. So cute! Definitely check them out!, This Bar is a hidden Gem In Hue. A place that must visit if you like cocktail the combination of traditional Vietnamese ingredients and Liquor curated by Owner Mixilogy Tung Nguyen quite sophisticated and unique. The atmosphere is relax and classy., The space is small but just enough, the music is good. The drinks are quite delicious and consistent. My favorite is Imperial City Night, I like both the look and the taste. What impressed me most was that the staff was very attentive and took care of guests from beginning to end and the menu was presented very carefully. Well, there's a small minus point: the air conditioner is a bit cold, probably because I'm sitting right below. The shop is suitable for both dating, friends talking and even going alone, the bartenders are very friendly so you can talk to them.
description: AURA is one of the first Cocktail Bars in Hue, offering you an exciting experience with inspired cocktails. Especially with the "Phong vị Cố Đô" menu – drawing inspiration from the traditional flavors of Hue – it's something you surely don't want to miss. We take pride in being a space where you can radiate your own brilliance, where everything blends to create a unique cocktail feast that awakens all senses.

name: Elegant Restaurant
address: 46 Phạm Ngũ Lão  Phú Hội Ward, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Tasty and delicious food with good service. We had a variety of Vietnamese dishes in this restaurant, the staff were all very helpful and charming, especially Duyen ( see photo ) & the manager Mimi who has good command of English After some weeks in Vietnam we found we were craving some more vibrant flavours, as some dishes in other restaurants were becoming bland .. in this restaurant the flavours were excellent.. the chicken skewers were cooked to perfection and the slow roasted pork ribs in bbq sauce were tender & very tasty!! 🤤 the grilled prawns in tamarind sauce were absolutely delicious so tasty, our favourite!! The alcoholic drink is more expensive than some restaurants. A vodka and Diet Coke (40,000) was 135,000 ( £4.10) and a bottle of dalak wine was double at 399,000 .. whereas last night just around the corner we paid 200,000 a bottle !! A big increase! However the food was good value on the whole we had 4 dishes £18 ( 620,000) .. 2 vodkas one Diet Coke & one huda beer total bill was 885,000 (£26.90), The food here is very nice. The atmosphere is relaxing. We sat for a long time watching local children playing a game of football in the street, none were wearing shoes. It was great entertainment. After we had eaten, two big tour groups arrived and filled the restaurant so I would advise you to go earlier if in doubt. Our waitress was called Thor and she was very attentive and professional. My mixed vegetables with cashews came with rice and was very nice, perhaps too many onions for my taste but plenty of other vegetables too. The garnishes are beautiful. On Friday and Saturday nights I believe that traffic is stopped from using the street so that’s the best time to go., We are on a month long trip in Vietnam and Cambodia and decided to stop in here for dinner while in Hue. We were so warmly received by the staff ( especially MiMi), who not only helped us choose our drinks and meals, but schooled us in the use of chopsticks. My husband had chicken mushroom soup, and he and I both had chicken brochettes with rice, which came with a varied selection of fresh and grilled vegetables. The menu is extensive ( both Western and Vietnamese choices) and one meal was more than I could finish. I highly recommend this restaurant in Hue, with its homey feel and wonderful staff and food.
description: Launched in September 2014, and quickly become a famous restaurant in Hue, owners are group of Tour Leaders and restaurant manager who have worked in Tourism industry for almost over 10 years. Restaurant located right at a tourist area of Hue City, or other way is called Downtown of Hue, Elegant Restaurant offers a warm welcome while dining and drinking in the relaxing atmosphere. It has spacious place with several separate parts; The front airy yard, enjoying quiet and relaxing atmosphere, the cozy comfortable indoor and mezzanine equipped with high end music and combined together to provide our visitors a full service, including Vietnamese food, BBQ food, Fusion food, Italian food, and moreover find great coffee, well popular selection of wine, Ice cream are available to gratify our dear guests. We wish to bring you a wonderful experiences when you are in this beautiful historical City.

name: Family Home Cafe & Restaurant
address: 11/34 Nguyen Tri Phuong, Hue 8454 Vietnam
reviews: The small restaurant is located away from the hustle and bustle in a side street; we ate on the terrace on the first floor, which made it pleasantly quiet. We had papaya salad with shrimp and fish in the claypot - both excellent, especially the quality of the fish! The owner was super friendly and didn't charge us for the extra portion of rice we ordered. The portions weren't the biggest, but they were sufficient and the slightly higher price (around â‚¬10 for both dishes + drinks) was really justified for the quality and taste of the food. The restaurant is definitely worth a visit (or several)., We have been to this restaurant twice during our stay in Hue and it will certainly not be the last! The dishes are excellent and the menu allows you to taste all the typical dishes of Hue at low prices! Special mention for the spring rolls which are excellent, the best we have eaten since our arrival in Vietnam! We are always very well received by our host. She is smiling and gives good advice, she takes the time to explain to us how each dish is eaten, which is very appreciated. The upstairs is very intimate with few tables which allows you to eat in peace. I recommend, you can go there with your eyes closed., Between 2 adults we shared an appetiser of Hue fried spring rolls and pork cooked on lemon grass skewers (to wrap in rice paper) and a main course of crispy noodles with beef. The whole meal was delicious just wish we could have squeezed in more food. Three dishes, one Huda beer and 2 mango smoothies totalled 340K VND. Had to go back a second time for the spring rolls, a chicken curry and Hue noodle with fried pork and vegtable. We highly recommend this restaurant.
description: Greeting from Family Home Restaurant! With the aim of serving our valued guests fresh & delicious dishes,we always buy food daily from the markets and only cook the food right after you order your dishes.( Meanwhile other restaurants may prepare the food in advance and they just rewarm it when you order).Besides, we also put the hygienic standard on the highest importance. Also, we would like to introduce to you several local specialities by guiding you the way of cooking if you prefer ( cooking show). We are pleased to welcome you !

name: Dmz Bar & Restaurant
address: 60 Le Loi st, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Very good service, nice staff and good food. Love the service from My- she has super energy! Really enjoy the atmosphere in this place!, My favourite bar in Hue - I visited 3 times Morning coffee cappuccinos are great. Also some excellent Vietnamese dishes and some western style food too - I enjoyed all The hudda draught comes in a big chilled glass and goes down a treat. The best part about this bar are the staff; they’re courteous, efficient and cheerful offering a top service to their customers The decor is pretty cool too, Efficient prompt service in English with a smile. Tasty snacks & meals & your beer is replenished before you finish your first one! You can even book a superb DMZ tour while you down a cold draught beer at a price that won’t break the bank. I’ll be back again for more!
description: If you want to drink during your time in Hue, than the DMZ Bar is the place to stay. We are open from 7 am until 2:30 am for drinks and 7 am until midnight for food.

name: Pizz.á Restaurant - Italian Cuisine
address: 34 Chu Văn An 2nd Floors, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Spacious, quiet, clean restaurant/pizzeria on the upper floor of a building on a street that's mostly pedestrian in the evening. The waitresses and waiters are extremely nice, going above and beyond to make sure you have everything you need. The food itself... *sigh. I ate here twice in three days. Pizza Margherita first, delicious dough, fresh and tasty ingredients. Then pasta the second time, the vegetable lover spaghetti: the mixed vegetable sauce brought me straight to summer back in Italy, all the flavours were there and just right. Also appreciated the potato wedges or French fries, as the menu says, and the complimentary (thank you!) miso ice-cream was interesting with that spicy mix on top, and itself fresh and good and a nice texture. Were I staying longer in Hue, I'd likely return a third time!, Great service amazing pizza. Really nice surroundings and atmosphere. Really good value for money. Would definitely come back to this place again. Oh did I forget to mention the nice and friendly waiters. If there was one thing to comment on it would be the IGers. (People who take photos for instagram or any other) but overall amazing. As a family and individual it was brilliant. My 10 year old daughter thought it was the best pizza place she had ever been to., As tourists in Hue we spent lovely time in this restaurant and we really enjoyed the pizza here! We really appreciate the relaxed atmosphere and the extremely kind and professional waiters. Si Huy followed us in each step of our dinner: he introduced very well the menu, enhancing the originality of the offer and he took care of us in every part of our pizza experience. We really appreciated the pizza, very tasty and rich in terms of ingredients! A really nice pizza experience in Hue, highly recommended!
description:
Spacious, quiet, clean restaurant/pizzeria on the upper floor of a building on a street that's mostly pedestrian in the evening.
The waitresses and waiters are extremely nice, going above and beyond to make sure you have everything you need.
The food itself... *sigh. I ate here twice in three days. Pizza Margherita first, delicious dough, fresh and tasty ingredients. Then pasta the second time, the vegetable lover spaghetti: the mixed vegetable sauce brought me straight to summer back in Italy, all the flavours were there and just right.
Also appreciated the potato wedges or French fries, as the menu says, and the complimentary (thank you!) miso ice-cream was interesting with that spicy mix on top, and itself fresh and good and a nice texture.
Were I staying longer in Hue, I'd likely return a third time!

name: Hương Ngự Restaurant
address: 12F, 33 Hai Ba Trung street, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: The beautifully presented dishes truly captured the essence of authentic Hue cuisine. The knowledgeable and attentive staff made us feel like royalty, guiding us through a menu that celebrated traditional recipes passed down through generations. It was the perfect setting for our special occasion, and we left with a newfound appreciation for Hue's culinary heritage., The wide-ranging menu catered to all tastes, with unique regional dishes and vegetarian options that didn't disappoint. Each plate was a work of art, showcasing the restaurant's dedication to excellence. It's no wonder they have such an excellent online reputation. We'll definitely be returning for another romantic meal., The atmosphere here was elegant and stylish and perfect for dating. The food was really like a work of art! Each dish was so beautifully plated that it was too late to eat. But the taste was even more amazing. The unique flavours of Vietnamese cuisine were perfectly harmonious. Especially the balance of spices is exquisite, so the taste in the mouth is full.
description: Huong Ngu Restaurant is one of the most renowned and upscale dining venues in Hue city. Located on the 12th floor of the Thanh Lich Royal Boutique Hotel at 33 Hai Ba Trung St., the restaurant stands out with its unique Imperial Hue architecture and offers diners an exceptional culinary experience. IMPERIAL HUE ARCHITECTURE Huong Ngu Restaurant is designed in the traditional style of Hue's imperial architecture. With a spacious, luxurious, and naturally lit environment, the restaurant provides a comfortable and relaxing ambiance for enjoying meals. The Imperial Hue architecture is blended with modern elements, creating a unique and elegant space. From the detailed imperial paintings and traditional cultural performances to the authentic Huế dishes, Huong Ngu offers diners a wonderful cultural and culinary experience of Hue. SOPHISTICATION IN ASIAN-EUROPEAN CUISINE Huong Ngu Restaurant is famous for its rich and diverse menu, harmoniously combining Asian and European...

name: Hạ - Cơm Nấu Lối Huế
address: 01 Nguyễn Sinh Cung Phường Vỹ Dạ, Quận Thuận Hoá, Hue 49000 Vietnam
reviews: Gorgeous spot a few steps away from the main city. Really modern restaurant situated on a small island over a bridge. Stunning space, delicious food, great service. Phuong Trinh was very helpful recommending some great dishes., This restaurant opened only 3 months ago and is very good positioned near the river. Classy experience and very good kitchen. The service lacks experience but this will get better with time. Overall a very good experience.
description: Gorgeous spot a few steps away from the main city. Really modern restaurant situated on a small island over a bridge. Stunning space, delicious food, great service. Phuong Trinh was very helpful recommending some great dishes.

name: La Boulangerie Francaise
address: 46 Nguyen Tri Phuong Street, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Crispy warm pain de chocolate and coffee on the planted balcony was just what I needed. ðŸ˜‹ Tiny front was a little tricky to find but lots of cakes and crusty baguettes available with good coffee and friendly service. Go up the tiny staircase and sit on the upstairs verandah, Visited on an exceptionally wet day for tea and cakes. The selection wasnâ€™t extensive by the time we arrived but we ordered a carrot cake and a banana cake with hot drinks. We were directed to sit upstairs rather than at the counter and found that the stairs were steep and narrow. A lady coming down missed the last step and stumbled heavily into the stools. The cakes were just okay and not particularly large for the price but the ethical nature of the enterprise makes this acceptable., I could have missed this cafe, which occupied a narrow shop space, if not for the cafe sign. I read the reviews and thought I would check it out, since I was in the vicinity. The slice of banana sponge cake paired with a cup of cafe au lait was a welcome teatime snack in the afternoon. The cake was not too sweet, despite having slices of caramelised banana on the top. I found myself a table on the 2nd floor, with its colorful decor. For a quiet afternoon, do give this cafe a visit.
description:
Crispy warm pain de chocolate and coffee on the planted balcony was just what I needed.  ðŸ˜‹

Tiny front was a little tricky to find but lots of cakes and crusty baguettes available with good coffee and friendly service.  Go up the tiny staircase and sit on the upstairs verandah

name: Shino Sushi 2 - Japanese Restaurant - Hue
address: 22 Nguyen Thai Hoc Phu Hoi, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: This is a small sushi place with a huge menu. The sushi & sashimi are so fresh, and the values are great. We had a huge Sushi “boat”” for $20 & then ordered yellowtail & tuna. The yellowtail was so fresh, I could cut it with chopsticks, and it melted in my mouth. Our waitress, Thanh, was constantly keeping an eye on us, & her outgoing friendliness made us feel like we were at home. Cảm ơn, Thanh!, Japanese spectacular, I'd say the best I've ever eaten. Kim is lovely. They served us in an amabilisima way and even invited us to an extra dish that was delicious. The place is very central, we located it on trip Advisor and found it very easy. Quite a hit! Thank you Kim!!!, We love sushi and in our 3 week trip in Vietnam wanted to have the experience. We found this hidden gem in Hue and the experience was great. We tried two tempuras: sweet potato and shrimp and then a boat with 40 pieces of sushi rolls. It was unbelievably served and we think it will be difficult to find other place in the world with such quality and value for money (CAD $35...). We have traveled a lot, and we never tried something so well prepared and presented. When you are in Hue, please, go there and indulge in.
description: Best sushi ever in Hue, Viet Nam. Fresh and tasty. Stuff is very friendly. There is a nice amount to choose from, also deserts and drinks From Tripadvisor Tourist

name: Ta Vet
address: 11 Vo Thi Sau Phu Hoi, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Very good experience in a trendy place frequented by Vietnamese that almost reaches a street. Food your way, extra spicy dishes are reported. They accept card with 2% commission, less than the rest. It allows to try dishes like duck, frog or similar than the rest, more oriented to tourists do not offer. It is more a lively bar than a restaurant, but allows you to live Vietnam and its customs as they are!, This is a very busy and friendly bar. Fantastic value for money and everybody was very helpful. The Huda lager is very good value and it’s amazing to see the locals order by the case. It was somebodies birthday and they had all the bar singing. Amazing atmosphere - and the food was also good!, If you're in Hue Ta Vet is not to be missed. Very busy, very popular, very friendly, great choice of beers. We're going to Vietnam for the 4th time in March 2025 and we rate this place as No.1 for food and drinks. Never miss it when we're in Hue.
description:
Very good experience in a trendy place frequented by Vietnamese that almost reaches a street.

Food your way, extra spicy dishes are reported. They accept card with 2% commission, less than the rest.

It allows to try dishes like duck, frog or similar than the rest, more oriented to tourists do not offer.

It is more a lively bar than a restaurant, but allows you to live Vietnam and its customs as they are!

name: Le Parfum
address: 5 Le Loi Street La Residence Hotel, Hue Vietnam
reviews: The food that we ordered as a party of 6 was cooked to perfection, with some lovely touches. The staff here are exceptional, well trained with an eye for detail. They were also very helpful and knowledgeable about the dishes, which made the choice so much easier. Being low season, the restaurant was quiet, but we made our own entertainment, so as a couple it might lack atmosphere at this time of year. Saying that, the staff make up for it., We went to Le Parfum for the Degustation Experience which had been highly recommended to us . With good reason. It was really beautiful . Seven delicious , perfectly balanced courses beautifully presented. The service was impeccable . Wine list was quite limited but adequate-only two Aussie and two NZ wines on offer. We decided on a French Chardonnay and a Syrah which complemented the food perfectly. The wine however was very expensive. This seems to be a common theme in Vietnam with very little Aussie wine on offer and we have had numerous discussions about how to remedy this. All in all a really top quality offering., Large dining room with terrace looking out at the river. we had the duck and sweet and sour prawns. very pleasant and nice to not have a change from noodles or rice pancakes. couldhave done with another prawn. apple tart with cherry sorbet and a caramelised banana with ice cream finished the meal nicely. not outstanding but very pleasant.
description: Food is a passion at La Residence. At Le Parfum talented Chefs experiment with creative Asian, Vietnamese and European flavours. At the heart of every dish are the very best of Vietnam’s fresh and vibrant produce combined with top quality imported specialty ingredients.

name: Vietnammese Restaurant & Fastfood22
address: 22 Trần Huy Liệu, Hue 49000 Vietnam
reviews: I recently visited a charming restaurant in Hue City, Vietnam, with a beautiful view of the Imperial City. The ambiance was serene, offering a relaxing atmosphere to enjoy a meal while overlooking the historic site. Food: The menu had a variety of classic Vietnamese dishes. I tried the Bun Bo Hue, which was rich and flavorful, offering a perfect balance of spices. The Stir-Fried Noodles with Chicken were cooked to perfection, with tender chicken and fresh vegetables. The Fried Rice with Shrimps was light yet satisfying, and the Chicken Spring Rolls were crispy, with a delightful dipping sauce that tied everything together. Each dish was authentic and delicious, showcasing the best of Vietnamese cuisine. Staff: The staff were extremely nice and friendly, providing excellent service throughout the meal. They were attentive without being intrusive and made us feel very welcome. Should give some tips from my perspective as they made me feel really welcome to their country. They also serve us with some banana at the end of the meal. Price: Surprisingly, the prices were pretty cheap, considering the quality of the food and the stunning view of the Imperial City. It was excellent value for money, making it a great spot for both locals and tourists. Overall: This restaurant in Hue City is a gem, offering delicious food, excellent service, and a memorable view of the Imperial City—all at an affordable price. Highly recommended!, FastFood 22 Huế is one of the ideal spots for those who love quick and convenient dining. Here are some highlights about this restaurant: Ambiance - Design: The restaurant features a modern, spacious, and clean layout. The furniture is arranged thoughtfully, creating a comfortable atmosphere for diners. - Music: Soft music plays in the background, adding to a pleasant dining experience. Menu - Variety: The menu is diverse, offering many delicious local dishes, including fries and other snacks. Notably, the food is prepared fresh and served generously. - Quality: Fresh ingredients are used, and the dishes are carefully prepared. The flavors are rich and well-balanced. Service - Efficiency: The staff is quick and friendly, and the owner is charming and enthusiastic. The wait time for food is minimal, making it perfect for busy individuals. - Cleanliness: The restaurant maintains high hygiene standards, from the dining area to the kitchen. Pricing - Affordability: The prices are quite reasonable compared to the quality of the food. FastFood 22 Huế is a fantastic choice for those who enjoy quick and convenient meals. With its comfortable ambiance, diverse menu, and attentive service, it promises a delightful dining experience. It’s definitely worth a visit if you’re in Huế!, We were in search of a quick Banh Mi lunch to go and found this on Google. We ordered the Vietnamese pork and grilled pork sandwiches, which were slightly more expensive than the typical Banh Mi but more substantive with more meat which they seemed to cook to order and was more saucy and flavorful. While we waited, they gave us wet wipes which they cooled with ice, as well as 2 bottles of water (we must've looked overheated after spending the morning in the Imperial city!). They even moved our scooter out of the sun so it wouldn't be hot.
description: Vietnamese restaurant Local specialties Hue specialty’s Take away restaurant Vegetarians Fresh fruits juice&drink Coffe and cold beer Bánh mỳ việt nam Bún bò Huế Phở bò Seafoods There are 2 air-conditioned rooms with views of Hue Citadel. Free toilet Free luggage storage when visiting Hue imperial city. Welcome you!

name: Y Thao Garden
address: 03 Thach Han, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: To begin with this doesn’t looks like a restaurant. Initially I thought our driver stopped at another attraction. Staffs were great the only problem is the delay after ordering the food. It took more than 30 mins for us to get the food. Price is on the expensive side but the quality is good, I requested my driver to bring us somewhere local for lunch. He recommended us this place. At first glance, I thought it was high-end and expensive, I was thinking street food place and this was where he brought us to. This was a nice restaurant hidden in a garden, many seating areas. It was cozy and very vietnamese in terms of decoration. We were tired after visiting the Imperial City and weren't having much patience looking through the menu. We opted for the Vietnamese sets on the menu, we got two different lunch sets, the two most expensive ones, but I assure you, they are still quite cheap. We didn't regret it. We finished every dish, it was tasty and flavourful. The portions were great, we got to taste so many Vietnamese dishes, we lost count. The selection of drinks were great too. Overall, it is worth the money to dine here. It is certainly not the cheaper selection, but if you want to try many Vietnamese dishes in one seating, this is the go to place, I highly recommend it. We went there after lunch hours, only 1 to 2 tables of customers, very chill place. I don't know whether tour buses of tourists will dine there during lunch hours, if that's the case, this place will be full and service might not be as good. We were there after 2pm, yet service still was slightly on the slow side, I don't know whether it's considered fine- dining, the serving time between dishes is not short! If you want to have an AC place, drink some wine and dine Vietnamese dishes, do give this place a try., Creative presentation of dishes . We ordered 2 set menu for the 3 of us as the portions were quite big. We especially liked the crispy duck , pancake and grilled lemongrass fish. Restaurant is set amidst a lush beautiful garden . However it was rather dark when we arrived for dinner and couldn’t see much of it The restaurant was quite packed and reservation would be advisable
description: To begin with this doesn’t looks like a restaurant. Initially I thought our driver stopped at another attraction. Staffs were great the only problem is the delay after ordering the food. It took more than 30 mins for us to get the food. Price is on the expensive side but the quality is good

name: Ganesh Indian Restaurant
address: 34 Nguyen Tri Phuong Street, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Walked past and asked a young lady eating her view, on her recommendation we tried the restaurant. The young lady who served us was very attentive, the food was excellent, really very tasty. Efficiency service. I would recommend a visit and can’t understand some of the reviews on here., We had good biryani here.We asked the hotel manager to make it spicy and he literally made it spicy. Good taste and enjoyed the spicy food.Was worried if we would experience bad after effects after reading all the reviews.But we did not face any issues., Healthy atmosphere, centrally located and friendly staff! Quantity of food is less as compared to other Indian restaurants in Vietnam, taste was good though it could be better!
description: Walked past and asked a young lady eating her view, on her recommendation we tried the restaurant. The young lady who served us was very attentive, the food was excellent, really very tasty. Efficiency service. I would recommend a visit and can’t understand some of the reviews on here.

name: Tha Om Garden House
address: Hue Vietnam
reviews: We visited this beautiful and unique home, where we were retailed with stories of its family history. The owner of the house explained that tourist diners help to pay for the upkeep of the house, and we were glad to be able to contribute in a small way to keeping its history alive. Then we were served dinner, cooked by the lady of the house and her staff, and ate it by candlelight in the garden surrounded by the sound of crickets. We were the only family there on that evening and it felt truly private and special. Definitely recommend the experience. Something a little different and off the beaten track!, We visited with Scenic and had a wonderful night. The host was entertaining and proudly displayed and explained his house. The meal was served by beautiful attentive girls in traditional dress. We were also entertained by a group of musicians., Absolutely delicious meal in a beautiful traditional home with a history lesson and lovely service. Very beautiful experience that was greatly enjoyed by all!
description:
We visited this beautiful and unique home, where we were retailed with stories of its family history. 

The owner of the house explained that tourist diners help to pay for the upkeep of the house, and we were glad to be able to contribute in a small way to keeping its history alive.

We were the only family there on that evening and it felt truly private and special.

Definitely recommend the experience. Something a little different and off the beaten track!

name: Shiva Shakti Indian Restaurant
address: 27 Vo Thi Sau St, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Extraordinary cooking for the dishes we chose!! Worth a Michelin star: fragrant biriani and aubergine dish, amazing raita,fresh Naan bread and the Thali had to be shared! I travel a lot and this exceptional Indian restaurant in Hue is highly recommended,it beats tasteless noodles and pretentious other European restaurant cuisine. The chef obviously uses the local fresh vegetables and herbs, Bravo 👏👏 My husband went into the kitchen to congratulate the chefs!, The food in this restaurant is succulent, rich, freshly cooked and delicious. We came two nights on the trot. The chilli chicken starter is awesome, the chicken is cooked to perfection and the capsicums and onions have just the right crunch. I would recommend this restaurant to all those curry lovers who enjoy authentic food. Rajesh the host is very friendly and helpful., The restaurants was a bit empty, but as Indian Food lovers we decided to eat here anyway. The food was very good and the youngest waiter who served us was very nice and helpful. He served with a smile and showed some interested, which we really appreciated. Thanks for the great service!
