Extraordinary cooking for the dishes we chose!! Worth a Michelin star: fragrant biriani and aubergine dish, amazing raita,fresh Naan bread and the Thali had to be shared!
I travel a lot and this exceptional Indian restaurant in Hue is highly recommended,it beats tasteless noodles and pretentious
 other European restaurant cuisine.
The chef obviously uses the local fresh vegetables and herbs, Bravo 👏👏
My husband went into the kitchen to congratulate the chefs!

name: Le Soleil De Huế
address: 104/47 Kim Long, Hue Vietnam
reviews: We had a fabulous experience at this restaurant! The setting is very pleasant and tastefully decorated. Our dinner was delicious. We ordered a duck dish and a fish dish and both were well-cooked and balanced. The staff was excellent and very accommodating, especially Thuý! We will be recommending this restaurant to family and friends!, I recently dined at Le Soleil De Hue, and it was fantastic! The restaurant’s cozy and stylish atmosphere really added to the experience. The menu offered a wonderful selection of French dishes, each one crafted with fresh, local ingredients that added a unique touch. The flavors were vibrant and delicious, making each bite a pleasure. The staff were friendly and made sure everything was perfect. If you're in Hue and want to try some amazing French food with a local twist, Le Soleil De Hue is definitely worth a visit!, Authentic French restaurant I really missed French gastronomy. I really recommend this place as the staff and the service were excellent
description: Discover our glasshouse restaurant, adorned with exquisite French colonial and Art Deco-inspired furniture, resembling the elegance and romance of the French Indochina era. ‍ Indulge in the flavors of France as our skilled chef creates gastronomic masterpieces using the finest ingredients. Each dish is a harmonious blend of traditional French techniques and local influences, resulting in a culinary symphony that delights the senses. From classic French dishes to innovative creations, our menu caters to the most discerning palates, offering an unforgettable dining experience. ‍

name: Little Italy Restaurant
address: 10 Nguyễn Thái Học, Hue 53000 Vietnam
reviews: Good pizza and lovely service. Thank you to Ha’! Stopped for a lunch break on a hot afternoon. Restaurant was a perfect stop in ancient town area after touring the Hue Imperial City., Little Italy is amazing! The pasta and pizza are very tasty, upon entering very attentively a small drink with a sandwich on the house. The decoration is beautiful and the host mr.Viet is very attentive. Who made sure we could order dessert that wasn't even on the menu., The food tastes like home which is great when you want a change from all the delicious Vietnamese food you will indulge in. We were here with friends, visited three nights in a row and upon arrival each night we were given a complimentary vodka caramel drink and a complimentary piece of garlic bread each. The food is great, my husband thought the Pizza Supreme was the best he has had in a while, he had steak another night and thought it was cooked to perfection, I had Spaghetti Bolognese and thought it tasty. Chocolate Mousse for dessert was lovely. The food and drink prices here are really reasonable and our Server, Ha was lovely, friendly and attentive.
description: Located in famous tourist area, at 10 Nguyen Thai Hoc street , it is easy to find and experience Little Italy restaurant with bamboo architecture. Besides, the extensive authentic Italian, Western and traditional Vietnamese menu along with a great selection of wines, cocktails, beers, and other beverages both local and foreign might satify the diverse needs of customers. Food is prepared fresh everyday from our highly trained professional chefs. Little Italy is mentioned in guide books, one being Lonely Planet which is widely used by travelers

name: HotTuna Restaurant
address: 37 Vo Thi Sau, Hue 49118 Vietnam
reviews: Nice cozy location at crossroads right in the center. Delicious fresh tuna salad as before, after which very tender and very well prepared meat dish of 1 kilo. Fries and grilled vegetables included. The drinks aren't weak despite the ice cubes. Really recommended to eat. The manager pays close attention to make sure you don't lack anything. Price quality is very good., This restaurant was close to the hotel where I was staying and I dropped in when I was a little hungry. The staff were all in black polo shirts and quick and efficient. One particularly unique male staff member was attentive and attentive. We refreshed ourselves by munching on some duck and drinking draft beer while watching the people passing by on the intersection. The duck was tender and delicious. We went there two days out of our three-day, two-night stay in Hue. It's a restaurant I'd like to visit again next time I'm in Hue., Really good and cheap food. We ended up coming here for all the meals - simply because it was really good. Super cute staff. In the evening you can get up on the terrace and sit - and enjoy the whole street from above. Forret, main dish, drinks for 4 people, for just under 175 kr.
description: HOT TUNA Restaurant & Bar Hue Specialities + Vietnamese Cuisine & Western + Draft & Craft Beer

name: Chez Maïs
address: 67/2 Võ Thị Sáu, Hue Vietnam
reviews: A friendly restaurant in a picturesque little alley in the center, "Chez Maïs" allows you to enjoy, at low prices, not only Vietnamese food but also typical dishes from Hue and its region. Furthermore, thanks to the location of the restaurant, it was away from noisy traffic that we were able to enjoy an excellent meal with my wife. The family atmosphere is welcoming and the service is quality. In addition, the staff speaks several languages including English and French, which greatly facilitates communication. It’s an address that I highly recommend, a must!, The food here was really good, and the owner was very kind in discussing the menu. The fig salad was amazing, the other food was good. Prices were a bit more expensive than some of the very cheap eats we've been finding, but definitely still a very, very affordable meal - about 100K for many menu items. This is a small family restaurant. The seating area is a nice, shaded outdoor space. This place is definitely worth a visit for the fig salad alone! They also provided a really nice rice cracker as an appetizer and a yummy plate of fruit as a standard part of the meal., French friends and others if you pass through Hué do not hesitate to go eat in this friendly little restaurant which will offer you family cuisine prepared with love by a super dynamic and involved team. Moreover Ha with his bright smile will be keen to make you discover your country. Not to be missed.
description:
A friendly restaurant in a picturesque little alley in the center, "Chez Maïs" allows you to enjoy, at low prices, not only Vietnamese food but also typical dishes from Hue and its region. Furthermore, thanks to the location of the restaurant, it was away from noisy traffic that we were able to enjoy an excellent meal with my wife. The family atmosphere is welcoming and the service is quality. In addition, the staff speaks several languages including English and French, which greatly facilitates communication.

It’s an address that I highly recommend, a must!

name: Lạc Thiện Restaurant
address: 6 Dinh Tien Hoang Street, Hue Vietnam
reviews: What a find, the staff were so friendly and helpful, explaining how to prepare the dishes we had ordered and suggesting others (cheaper but better!) than the one we originally chose. Definitely have the Banh Khaoi and Bang Cuon both delicious, Restaurant with a power house of a woman running front of house (and cooking when required). She’s welcoming and lovely - we had a variety of delicious things such as ban kheoi (crispy omelette pancake shrimp / pork) banh cuonh, crispy noodles and more. All washed dow with local beer huda- she opens the. With a karate chop and gives you the opener and hopefully you’ll load up a picture of you and her bottle opener somewhere. Great fun. Great food. Beer and 4 x different things were 175k. If you find the plates small - order more - they’re only like A dollar or 80pence each. Lovely. Come often if you can!!!, Located near gate into imperial Palace we had lunch here before meeting our tour guide. All the staff are part of one family and they create a great vibe in their place - even showing us old photos of the restaurant. Must try the fresh made crispy pancake- WOW so good I wanted more. Local beer at 15k - cheapest we found in Hue. Spring rolls,fresh shrimp rolls ,stir fry vegetables with crispy noodles and banana pancakes with chocolate sauce . Add 3 big ,cold beers and all for 280k. Party trick to open the beers a surprise. Amazing place 👏
description: What a find, the staff were so friendly and helpful, explaining how to prepare the dishes we had ordered and suggesting others (cheaper but better!) than the one we originally chose. Definitely have the Banh Khaoi and Bang Cuon both delicious

name: Zenith SkyBar
address: 50A Hung Vuong Street, Phu Nhuan Ward Level 34, Hue Vietnam
reviews: This place is great for having dinner with your family or going on a date. The food is well served at a reasonable price, and they offer a spectacular view of the city from above. Our waitress, Nga, was extremely friendly and professional. She gave us some really good recommendations. I will come back here when I have a chance!, Beautiful bar and views of Hue. It's a very comfortable place that allows you to have a great time and enjoy a beautiful view of Hue from any vantage point. HUY was very attentive to us, very friendly and warm, always with a big smile, and very good service from everyone at the bar. We thoroughly enjoyed dinner here! - - - Very nice bar, beautiful views of Hue, is a very comfortable place that allows you to have a great time and have from any point a nice view of Hue. HUY was very attentive to us, very friendly and warm, always with a big smile, very good service from everyone at the Bar. We really enjoyed dining here!, Turned up here after dinner on Christmas night. Hue had been wet and misty so when the skies were clear we took our chance! I think if you are in a couple or a group of 4 this is probably a great bar. We were a group of 12 and because of the narrow nature of the bar it was hard for them to seat us, despite it not being that busy. Cocktails took a while to come, again they clearly don't normally do large groups. However they were well executed Cocktails. I had a daiquiri, the other half a long island iced tea. The staff are polite - so polite they waited until 11.10pm to say they had closed at 11pm! We only manged one drink but there was a good view of the city. Best seats are at either end of the bar. Worth a look if the skies are clear. Worth noting that the bar is enclosed.
description: Elevate your spirits to the highest level at Zenith rooftop sky bar, where Hue's beauty unfolds before eyes. Let your soul immediately content with classic cocktails, refined wine and refreshing beverages while dancing the night away to the vibrant beats of our lively DJ from floor 34th at Meliá Vinpearl Hue.

name: An Nhiên Garden Restaurant
address: Kiet 11, Provincial Road 10A, Hue Vietnam
reviews: An evening at An Nhien Garden Vegetarian Cafe is an experience that no matter how long or how far you travel in Vietnam, will likely be the ONE place you just can't get out of your mind. We had the good fortune to meet Nhien who is the co owner with her sister An (thus the name An Nhien which in English sounds like "Onion"). And just like an onion, a meeting with Nhien is one where the complexity of this very special lady is revealed like the peeling of an onion with each layer revealing yet another side of this extraordinary woman. This property has been in the family for over 460 years!!! The idea of opening up this concept came about gradually and includes an entrance that begins at the grand gates which once entered is like coming into a magical world out of time and space. Whatever worries you may have experienced before entering, just melt away as you are instantly transported to a lush garden, expertly lit with subtle mood lights, gorgeous antiques and stunning artwork by an amazing buddhist Monk. All of this happens before you even get to the restaurant which is comfortably tucked into the back of the property like a lotus flower which seemingly opens just for you. Unlike most restaurants, the staff here are not just workers, they are emotionally connected to the purpose of this experience and their joy is as real as their commitment to creating an evening that surpasses your expectations. The food, the presentation, the attention to detail, the whole experience felt much like a Michelin restaurant.. that is if Michelin restaurants offered food that wasn't just a feast for the eyes and a gift to your waiting pallette but, also served with a love from the heart that can not be trained. There are sites to see in Vietnam and places to go but however you travel in Vietnam, if you want to experience something that will be a priceless gift to remember your whole life, come to An Nhien to immerse yourself in a timeless epicurean adventure that will leave you satiated both in body and soul!, I’ve never had such delicious vegetarian food. I didn’t realise Vietnamese people enjoy vegetarian meals. Often times I’ve only had the standard fare of spring rolls and Pho. The food in An Nhien Garden is such a delectable eye opener. Service was good and food even better. We had the hot pot and my goodness, the broth was out of the world. The lotus fried rice was very good. Food portions were just right and service was excellent; they speak French and English so we were never lost in communication. Ambience was calming and the restaurant is within an old bungalow with a lovely garden. Only thing is the pricing was on the pricier end., This restaurant was part of a food experience/ cooking class organized by Intrepid Adventures. The staff and hostess were very knowledgeable and the cooking class was a lot of fun. We were also able to tour the ancestor house and beautiful grounds and artwork around the restaurant which was an old family estate in Hue. We then enjoyed a lovely lunch in the vegetarian restaurant. The hostess went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable and was able to help me with a health concern as well! Thanks Nhien!
description: An Nhien Garden Restaurant stands as a beacon of sustainability, being the first restaurant in Hue city awarded the "Sustainable Tourist Destination" title. Located just 3km from the iconic Truong Tien bridge, it offers a unique dining experience within a historic garden that has been in the hands of one of Hue's first settlers for nearly 500 years and 22 generations. The restaurant's strong commitment to high-quality services, coupled with creativity and innovation, transforms traditional cuisine into an exquisite culinary journey. Experience the essence of Hue's heritage and sustainable dining at An Nhien Garden.

name: Đai Nam – Authentique Cuisine de Hue
address: 02 Doan Thi Diem, Hue 53000 Vietnam
reviews: We happened upon Dai Nam restaurant by accident. It was beautiful and very clean inside. We were a party of 6 just coming from the Citadel and were exhausted and hungry. Our waiter, Dat spoke English and helped us through the menu. We ordered spring rolls for the table and my husband ordered Shaky Beef and I had pork with mushroom and onion. All of the food was fresh and delicious and Dat was super helpful and personable. This was a great choice, Đai Nam restaurant is located in the garden of the lovely Spatel d'Annam, a really attractive boutique hotel across the street from the Hue Citadel. We came across it when we were walking back from the Citadel to our hotel across the river. We really just needed to use the toilet, and there was a WC sign near the front of the hotel, so we went in (with some trepidation). Although we were sweaty and dressed for sightseeing - and it was a very hot day - the hostess was extremely graciously and invited us in to the pretty garden area outside of the hotel, showed us to the facilities, and then showed us around the hotel and restaurant with evident pride. It's a really beautiful place. We came back to the restaurant that night, a little more presentable than earlier in the day. The setting is gorgeous, with seating indoors and outdoors. We ordered Bò Lúc Lắc and "Shaky Prawns" - both delicious. Service was impeccable. A thoroughly enjoyable evening. One of my favorite meals in 3 weeks in Vietnam., Every dish was delicious! Duck with pineapple, beef la lot, banana blossom salad - all were amazingly tasty. Inside an historical building - highly recommend trying this restaurant.
description: The restaurant serves Hue food, Vietnamese and Asian food. The restaurant has Hue old house style of Nguyen dynasty.

name: Ngo Nho Restaurant & Cafe
address: 10/68 Dang Dung, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Delicious food. I chose the set menu and everything was great. The waitress even helped make my rice paper rolls in front of me. The iced chocolate was also very nice and helped cool me down from the searing temperatures outside., Nice restaurant at the end of an alley right in front of our hotel, found thanks to our guide, offers Vietnamese cuisine. Aside from the menu, two set menus are offered, we opted for the less abundant one because the portions are always enormous. Soup with fish, sautéed vegetables, pork with caramelized onions and prawns in tamarind sauce, accompanied by the inevitable white rice. Home cooking at a very affordable price., Wow! We walked down this tiny alley following a sign saying “food” expecting street food. What an amazing find. My lady saw a great looking fish on the counter and said I want that! I chose the set menu. It was more than enough for 2 and each dish was better than the last. There were 7 different items served and each was a dish I’d never had before. We came at 14:00, between lunch and dinner as they were preparing for a large party yet the owner personally brought us each dish I live in Vietnam and usually eat out, anywhere from street food to 5 star. This was the best dining experience I’ve had in all my time in Vietnam.
description: Come to Ngo Nho (Small Lane) to enjoy and feel. We promise to bring you joy and satisfaction with our dedicated and attentive services!

name: Thị's Kitchen
address: 31b Võ Thị Sáu Phường Phú Hội, Hue 49118 Vietnam
reviews: Thi’s kitchen is in a great location with even better food. You are able to sit next to the street and watch the laidback Hue lifestyle. The staff are very friendly and were ready to help, they even gave us free fruit as a dessert. We had a curry and noodle dish, and the curry in particular was very tasty. At £8 total, this was worth stopping by for, We visited Hue a few days ago and were recommended this restaurant by Hue Sweethouse Homestay. We were not disappointed, Thi’s is a fantastic restaurant. The quality of the food was absolutely superb, cooked on the spot for us and totally fresh. The ingredients used were first class and everything was perfectly seasoned. We can particularly recommend the bamboo skewers and had prawns, squid and duck. It was all totally delicious and there was also a choice of quality wine, as well as local draught beer. We would highly recommend this family run restaurant., Had a lovely meal in relaxed atmosphere on balcony, watching the world go by. BBQ skewers were amazing. Sat there for hours, they were happy to serve drinks all night, no rush! Even when it rained, no problem roof was on in seconds.
description: Thi’s kitchen is in a great location with even better food. You are able to sit next to the street and watch the laidback Hue lifestyle. The staff are very friendly and were ready to help, they even gave us free fruit as a dessert. We had a curry and noodle dish, and the curry in particular was very tasty. At £8 total, this was worth stopping by for

name: Ama Restaurant
address: Khai Dinh's Neighbor, An Tay Ward, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Here's the first one I came here to have travel. It's amazing view with well designed and many lovely things. The staffs very lovely, they warmly welcome us and made delicious cocktails go together salty peanuts. We have a great time here, we will be back one more time and highly recommend this restaurant to our friends., A very good and pleasant restaurant with delicate serving and plating. We had 3 course dinner and enjoyed it a lot. Situated in their beautiful garden, I have very enjoy my holiday at Anhill, really great amazing view and sighseeing! Good foods, nice coffee with very good service! Thank you and see you again! Madame Thư.
description: Here's the first one I came here to have travel. It's amazing view with well designed and many lovely things. The staffs very lovely, they warmly welcome us and made delicious cocktails go together salty peanuts. We have a great time here, we will be back one more time and highly recommend this restaurant to our friends.

name: Stella Garden
address: 01 Nguyễn Sinh Cung, Phường Vỹ Dạ, Quận Thuận Hoá, Thành Phố Huế, Hue 50000 Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant is such a gem! It’s located on a small island right by the river, which already makes it feel special. The building itself is beautiful, with a cozy and relaxed vibe that makes you want to stay longer. It’s the perfect spot to escape the hustle and just enjoy some quiet time with amazing food. The menu offers all kind of Vietnamese dishes ranging from multiple choices of protein to vegetable or rice and noodles, and everything we tried was super fresh and full of flavor. The spring rolls were crispy and delicious, and the Beef with pate sauce was one of the best I’ve had. The meat was fresh and tender, the sauce is rich in flavor. You can tell they really care about the quality of their food. What made it even better was the view. Sitting by the river, especially during sunset, was such a treat. The combination of great food, friendly service, and the view made it one of the most memorable meals I’ve had in Vietnam. If you’re in the area, definitely check this place out., Nice and modern new place, opened a month ago, very nice on an islet of Hue. Large spaces with some acoustic problems. It offers a more refined cuisine with a very rich menu. We had beef with pâté, excellent, squid with tamarind sauce, very good, and an appetizer made with shrimp and pork salad that convinced a little less. Very kind and friendly service, excellent premises for a promising future. To try., Food is amazing and staff are even nicer! They were so helpful and kind - especially Phuong Trinh!! We tried lots of dishes and were too full to finish them so they packed them up for us to go! Beautiful location as well right on the Perfume River
description: This is the only restaurant in Hue City situated on its own island along the Huong River, offering guests a unique and scenic dining experience.

name: Gecko Pub - Restaurant
address: 9 Pham Ngu Lao, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: I have good time enjoying food and craft beer in this nice restaurant. Food is really nice , I recommend pizza, smoked meat, spaghetti , beef steak! Craft beer is nice selected for new experienced drinkers. I love this place and will come more often!, Great restaurant with a rooftop terrace - nice setup and decor. A wide range of Vietnamese cuisine, vegetarian options and western options, all very tasty! The staff all spoke English very well, and were all helpful. The food was so amazing that we ate here three nights in a row! Highly recommended!, I recommend this restaurant. Very nice atmosphere! We were at Gecko on August 7. I didn't taste the pizza but my friend loved it. Regarding Hue's specialties , it was very delicious! And we really liked the craft beer. The little waitress was very nice when I asked her to suggest an ancient pagoda to visit near my accommodation.
description: Gecko Pub is located at 9 Pham Ngu Lao Street. This area is the central hangout for Westerners in Hue City. The street are always fun and cozy. The Gecko Pub itself is a great spot to check out while youâ€™re in Hue, with its special decor and warm, friendly atmosphere. You will feel at home here and enjoy good time at your own, or like in a good friendâ€™s home and courtyard. Here you can just relax while we take care of everything for you. When you come to Gecko Pub youâ€™ll be able to enjoy perfect Western dishes as well as have the opportunity to experience many fine examples of our local cuisine. While youâ€™re at it, donâ€™t forget the sweet cocktails and deep glasses of wine, waiting to be served in the comfortable surroundings. Welcome to Gecko Pub ! You will be served the best, at the most reasonable prices.

name: The Cham Craft Beer & Coffee
address: 56 Nguyen Tri Phuong Phu Hoi, Hue Vietnam
reviews: My wife and I popped in on the way past as we are craft beer lovers. This place has a great selection of craft beer, cider and also whiskey from around the world. There is plenty of seating and staff are helpful and attentive. Prices are reasonable and there are choices of glass size from the drinks on tap. We would have had a drink here every night, my wife was also more than likely going to buy one of the cool canvas bags available. However when the bill came we were charged for the "refreshing hand wipes". These were given to us along with a dish of peanuts, we didn't ask for them or need them. They were only 5,000VND so not expensive, but, if something is being charged the customer needs to be informed. Due to this we won't be coming back as it feels like a small scam of getting extra money from a customer., Came here on a Sunday morning lunch after a tiring morning visiting all the sites. They did not have cooked food before 4 pm but had the sausage cheese and olive platter. Binh offered to get food from another ( the Nook) restaurant so we did not have to go looking elsewhere in this heat. The wheat craft beer on tap was great ! My friend sprained her ankle , he even got us a spray from the pharmacy. This is going above and beyond ! Thank you so much !!, I had the opportunity to come here and look forward to coming back again. The atmosphere is great, their beer is varied and has many different flavors. Must try everyone Special thanks to Mr. Vu for giving me many travel experiences as well as delicious places to eat!
description: A cosy, relaxing and interactive space breathing nice architecture, local cuture-history and hi-end music. Quality coffee and Vietnamese Craft Beers.

name: Ngon Burger
address: 48 Chu Van An, Phu Hoi Ward, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Amazing Burgers and Draft Beer in the Heart of Hue Ngon Burger is hands down the best burger spot in Hue when it comes to both quality and price. The ingredients are fresh, the flavors are spot on, and each burger feels carefully crafted—not something you find everywhere. Whether you’re into the classics or want to try something a bit more unique, there’s something on the menu for everyone. What really sets Ngon Burger apart, though, is the fact that they serve draft beer—something surprisingly rare in Hue. It’s the perfect pairing with their delicious burgers and adds to the laid-back, welcoming vibe of the place. If you’re in Hue and craving a great burger (and a cold beer to go with it), Ngon Burger should be your first stop. Highly recommended!, We really enjoyed some 'comfort food' at Ngon burger. Our kids age 11, 9 and 6 loved their burgers and hubby and I had a chicken baguette. It was huge and really tasty. The customer service was exceptional the place had a fun atmosphere and view of all the activity happening in the street. Thanks for having us., Tasty burger with good quality meat. The cheese was similar to usual american burger quality and the sauce was delicous! Pickles were ok, not traditional dill and I think the brine is not quite right. However it was okay. Fries were very good. The owner was very sweet and offered complimentary watermelon afterwards. I highly recommend this place if you want to take a break from vietnamese food for lunch. Also not greasy! So you do not feel to heavy afterwards.
description: Fast food restaurant. Burger and bagguette. We make our own recipe the burger buns and sauce. Currently, we are the one have the biggest buns and bagguette in town so far.

name: Vu Cuisine
address: 6 duong Nguyễn thaï hoc, Hue 99243 Vietnam
reviews: Long stay in Hue, we went four times in January and most recently on February 28, 2024. We tasted the famous pizzas and the crab pasta are excellent, we will come back with pleasure, the staff is professional, attentive (a little word in French) and kind. The relaxing musical atmosphere and best of all the boss is very nice, he even turned the oven back on to make us two pizzas, even though it was closing time. Above all, don't hesitate between one or the other. Choose Vù Cuisine to enjoy yourself, it's not the factory, it's a restaurant, a real Italian., Delicious dishes, excellent pizza, much better than many Italian pizzerias, the pizza was rightly juicy and not dry, not contaminated by local flavours, the gnocchi with delicious fish bisque, the fillet a little small but so soft that it could be "cut with a breadstick" the accompanying vegetables are crunchy but not tough and the puree is excellent. 4 beers. Vanilla ice cream made with whipped cream and vanilla all for $35. What can I say passed with flying colors, Amazing ! If you want to eat burrata, arugula or even truffle, it’s ideal. We feasted. The portions are quite large and the staff are lovely. What a pleasure to find a little bit of Italy in Vietnam! 😍 For the price it’s around €10 per pizza but it’s worth it for our palate!
description: Long stay in Hue, we went four times in January and most recently on February 28, 2024. We tasted the famous pizzas and the crab pasta are excellent, we will come back with pleasure, the staff is professional, attentive (a little word in French) and kind. The relaxing musical atmosphere and best of all the boss is very nice, he even turned the oven back on to make us two pizzas, even though it was closing time. Above all, don't hesitate between one or the other. Choose Vù Cuisine to enjoy yourself, it's not the factory, it's a restaurant, a real Italian.

name: Mr. Pho - Pho Cafe
address: 35 Bui Thi Xuan, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Mr Pho was so so friendly and spotted us as soon as we got dropped at the train station. He greeted us with the biggest smile and hello which made our days! He had a great rate for luggage storage and our things felt very safe. He was very helpful in giving directions and we would highly recommend!, My wife and I were traveling back to Hoi An by train and Mr Pho’s place stood out, it was clean, well organized, and right across from the train station. We bought sodas and bottled water (fair priced and cheaper than all the other places around). Mr. foe is a kind gentleman who came out and attended to us; very polite, articulate, and professional!. Very knowledgeable about Hue and all there is to see and do here. We’ll stop back in on our next visit to Hue, and have a bite to eat too! Still can’t get over how clean and organized Mr Pho’s is! Wish more places were like this). Safe adventures!!, Hopped off the train in Hue was feeling super overwhelmed with all the taxis and people. I say down at Mr Phos place, ordered some food. He was so helpful, and not pushy and face me some great advice. The food was yummy too :) He offered to help sort a scooter rental with luggage drop off for 500d, which I didn't take but in theory I should have as we ended up spending far more with a different company. Later in the day I was wandering around train station like a little lost puppy dog looking for a toilet, he saw me shouted asking if I needed help and let me come over and use his toilet. Anyways. You rock Mr. Pho.
description: Mr Pho was so so friendly and spotted us as soon as we got dropped at the train station. He greeted us with the biggest smile and hello which made our days! He had a great rate for luggage storage and our things felt very safe. He was very helpful in giving directions and we would highly recommend!

name: Cafe on Thu Wheels
address: 3/34 Nguyen Tri Phuong Street, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: This place offers multiple vegetarian dishes including vegetables, rice and tofu or nuts for only 65k Dong. They also have chicken, beef and so on but we were very happy about the vegetarian options. The staff speaks English and are very friendly. They even left out one of the ingredients upon request which I very appreciated., The food truck offers a unique twist on classic dishes, with bold flavors and fresh ingredients. The service is friendly, but sometimes a bit slow during peak hours. Overall, a great spot for a quick bite!, We only had a very light breakfast at Cafe on Thu Wheels (a shake each and a croissant to share). The croissant was the best we’ve tasted in Vietnam! Our shakes were freshly made, very tasty and very reasonably priced. Lots of western or Vietnamese options on the menu. What made it for us was that the service was so lovely, the waitress was really friendly and wanted to sit down and chat with us, which we were very happy to do. Would highly recommend a visit and would return if we were staying longer, wish we’d found CTTW sooner!
description: This place offers multiple vegetarian dishes including vegetables, rice and tofu or nuts for only 65k Dong.  They also have chicken, beef and so on but we were very happy about the vegetarian options. The staff speaks English and are very friendly. They even left out one of the ingredients upon request which I very appreciated.

name: Be Than Restaurant
address: Lang Co Town, Phu Loc District, Hue Vietnam
reviews: We enjoyed having diner here. In this very busy resraurant you still feel welcome, the service is very friendly. The food is standard but good. Funny is the springrolls of which you get the ingredients separately on the table and that you have to roll them yourself., Incredible food. The clay pot pork is amazing and so flavoursome. The oysters are the best we have ever had. Our easyriders took us here as part of our lunch package, they ate with us. Fab experience on the journey from Hoi An to Hue. The views from here are pretty awesome. We didn’t have any interaction from any of the staff, so can’t comment on them., Plenty of options for fresh sea food as you come in which you can view in ponds and tanks. Far too busy and very noisy. Spoils the potential for the expected tranquil location!
description: We enjoyed having diner here. In this very busy resraurant you still feel welcome, the service is very friendly. The food is standard but good. Funny is the springrolls of which you get the ingredients separately on the table and that you have to roll them yourself.

name: Garden Riverside Bar
address: 1 Lane 7 Nguyen Cong Tru str, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Best service I’ve had at any bar or restaurant in the whole of Vietnam. Incredibly friendly staff, free shots every 30 minutes, free fruit plate on arrival, constant stream of salted nuts. The on-site art gallery is breathtaking. Lovely view of the river. The drinks are a bit more expensive than other places but it’s definitely worth it and the cocktails are strong but tasty. We played uno and pool with other games available free of charge. Would definitely recommend., We spent a few nights in Hue and kept coming back here again and again. The setting is beautiful on the bank of the Perfume river, and being providing a refreshing shot and fresh fruit on arrival is a nice touch. However, the best thing here is the staff. They couldn’t have looked after us more. We played pool together and had lots of laughs each night. Many thanks to Tim in particular for being such a great host! I hope we meet again soon!, We really enjoyed stopping by for a few drinks during our vacation. The staff were wonderful and very easy to talk to! The drinks were delicious, and the bar offered several complementary items that were a very nice touch! (A welcome drink/shot, welcome fruit plate and waters for the road). Being right on the river was very relaxing! We did not play any games while there but the bar also had games to play as well. 10/10 would recommend! Variety of people. Good for friend/couples/individuals etc. there was also a family dining while we were there.
description: Warmest greeting from Garden Riverside Bar! The French house under the Green garden overlooks two famous rivers in Hue, the Perfume River and Nhu Y River. Enjoy good cocktails, listen to great music and play fun games. Intimate Chilled Environment.

name: Secret Lounge Hue
address: 15/42 Nguyen Cong Tru, Hue 49000 Vietnam
reviews: The place is super, as is the music, the cocktails and the friendliness of the staff! As soon as you arrive they offer you some fresh fruit to welcome you, a shot (to drink Vietnamese style, if you want to know what that means, go for it! 🤩) and a game to pass the time! Very nice idea, also for giving up your phones every now and then. The only flaw is the location (perhaps a little too secret) and the cocktails which are very, very good, also accompanied by various snacks, but also quite expensive for Vietnamese standards. In any case, don't miss it! ✨✨✨, We randomly found this nice cocktail place. Cocktails are a little more expensive than at other bars (from 150k) but when we sat down at our assigned table, they served a plate of fresh fruit and a welcome shot. Later we got free snacks (pringles), and when we paid everyone got a bottle of water. The staff was very friendly and the cocktails are good, however the White russian is very small., Amazing staff, awesome atmosphere and really great place for drinks! The staff are all so nice, and very friendly, they cannot do enough for you! You also definitely get your value for money with the cocktails as they are absolutely not watered down! Located down a quiet side street it’s definitely worth a visit! During our visit we also got a free fruit platter, nuts and sweets, and fresh table water which was very nice! Along with table games to play such as jenga. Highly recommend! Don’t be put off if it’s quieter than the bars on the main roads, it’s a little hidden away but totally worth it for amazing service, great drinks and the friendliest staff we’ve met in Vietnam!
description: Secret Lounge Hue is an open-air bar within a tropical garden setting, offering budget-conscious travellers a satisfying selection of Shisha, bar snacks, Great music, good Cocktails and fun games. Designed full of moder art by artist Mr.Lucky.

name: Nón Huế- Authentic Hue Food
address: 77 Nguyễn Sinh Cung Vỹ Dạ, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: The bánh nậm here is simply outstanding - wrapped in dong leaves with the perfect ratio of rice flour to shrimp filling. While some dishes were slightly pricier than street food, the quality justifies the cost. The restaurant's elegant atmosphere and attention to detail create an authentic dining experience worth every penny., It was one of the awesome peak experiences of my solo travelling. The diversity of the food, as well as the price was really just affordable and reasonable. The staff named So, also was attentive all the time, showed me how to prepare and eat the food properly with great patience. Very polite, well mannered, and cute as well., Miss 8 offers not only delicious Vietnamese dishes but also a charming atmosphere that enhances the dining experience. The restaurant's decor is tastefully done, creating a cozy and welcoming ambience. The menu features a diverse selection of dishes, and the staff is more than willing to guide you through the culinary journey. Whether you're a local or a visitor, Miss 8 provides a delightful escape into the world of Vietnamese flavors...
description: Each dish at Nón Huế is a masterpiece crafted from fresh ingredients, traditional recipes passed down through generations, and our heartfelt dedication. From the rich bún bò Huế to the delicate bánh bèo and bánh nậm, every bite tells the story of this poetic land. Join us on a culinary journey where every flavor brings you closer to the pure and unique beauty of Huế. “Nón Huế eat for memories, eat for love Hue “

name: Barlab-Rooftop
address: 62 Chu Văn An, phường Phú Hội 3rd Floor, Hue 52000 Vietnam
reviews: This spot is absolutely wonderful for some drinks at night. It is an intimate, cozy and sophisticated spot. The atmosphere was great - the view is wonderful, overlooking the city and lit by some gorgeous light fittings. Our seats were comfy and the place had a nice breeze thanks to the outdoors and the fan. They had a great selection of cocktails and craft beers, which we very much enjoyed. My margarita was excellent! They bring out complementary snacks which they refill throughout which were so more-ish. We tried some the buffalo jerky too which was very tasty and goes down great with a beer. The server Tuan was lovely too and we appreciated his recommendations. I am definitely coming back before I leave Hue!, This is a cosy rooftop bar, very relaxing even within the hustle and bustle of walking street. Drinks are lovely and staff are more than happy to help with drink selection. In particular, our server Toan was very lovely, chatty and made us feel very welcome! Would highly recommend this bar. Views are an added bonus!, Really beautiful bar decorated with stunning chandeliers from Venice and France. Lovely Tiffany lamps. Quite stunning. Also…, really great cocktails. The barman certainly knows his stuff. A lovely classy bar. Highly recommend with a great ambience and comfy chairs. Fabulous music too. Soft jazz vibe.
description: This spot is absolutely wonderful for some drinks at night. It is an intimate, cozy and sophisticated spot. The atmosphere was great - the view is wonderful, overlooking the city and lit by some gorgeous light fittings. Our seats were comfy and the place had a nice breeze thanks to the outdoors and the fan. They had a great selection of cocktails and craft beers, which we very much enjoyed. My margarita was excellent! They bring out complementary snacks which they refill throughout which were so more-ish. We tried some the buffalo jerky too which was very tasty and goes down great with a beer. The server Tuan was lovely too and we appreciated his recommendations. I am definitely coming back before I leave Hue!

name: Sunrise Lounge
address: 33 Hai Bà Trưng St Thanh Lich Royal Boutique Hotel, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Khoa was very kind and friendly, the breakfast was various and delicious, fresh fruit on demand included ! The breakfast room with a view on the town lovely!, Very nice welcome by KHOA HOA. He was very friendly and advised us on visits to the city. We had a great time, Staff and Khoa very accommodating and friendly. Additional fruit was brought. Very thoughtful. Thanks for everything.
description: At the 15th floor of Thanh Lich Royal Boutique Hotel, Sky Bar Sunrise Lounge proudly offers a romantic ambiance and panoramic views of the city, promising to awe you with unforgettable sights. With its open and comfortable space, Sunrise Lounge is the perfect rendezvous for outdoor parties and weekend getaways. Sunrise Lounge pledges to be the most impressive destination for all your memorable moments!

name: Quán nhạu 36
address: 36 Đinh Tiên Hoàng, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Great food, even better service! The waiter brought us out complimentary berries which we’d never tried before - they were delicious. The iced salt coffee is a MUST try, although we couldn’t see it on the menu, ask for it!, Place just outside the Imperial City, brings Cửa Thượng Tứ , tables for 2 people under the plants, some on the canal that runs along the city. A nice breeze accompanied us during a break on the midday where the thermometer marked 35 degrees. Tried fried spaghetti with tofu, and fried rice. All great and very kind staff. Very recommended., We were passing by from the imperial city and came across this little place for lunch. We had a very warm welcome and the food was great and very good value for money. Great spot to sit and have lunch and a beer by the water as well.
description: Quán nhậu bình dân tại Huế A popular restaurant in Hue City

name: Bún Bò Huế Sen
address: 69 B Võ Thị Sáu Phú Hội, Hue 49000 Vietnam
reviews: Very good place to eat Italian or Vietnamese. We were very well received by the hosts of the place, whose service was perfect. After enjoying the complimentary bruschetta, we enjoyed some very good pizza, with thin, crunchy dough and generously garnished. Complimentary passion fruit rounded off a meal without a single false note! I absolutely recommend going through the door of this restaurant with its unbeatable value for money and very welcoming owners!, This restaurant was recommended to us by a friend. It was known for great food and superb friendly staff/owner The restaurant has both Italian and local cuisines for groups with different tastes and choices The foods were great at reasonable prices. It has Happy Hour offers (free beer, free starter and dessert) and the restaurant owner/manager was very accommodating- she was happily accommodating my request (change a desert to non sugary drink). She is always smiling and checking if things are okay We left the restaurant feeling satisfied and happy, We were just looking for a snack and thought we'd give this restaurant a go. We had 3 pizzas which were all cooked perfectly and a salad. The price of these was really reasonable and on top of this we were given some free bruschetta as well as a free beer. The staff were all really attentive and friendly as well. Definitely worth a visit.
description: Open: Monday - Sunday: 7am - 10pm Open: Christmas Eve & Day, New Year's Eve & Day Happy Hours 5PM to 10PM daily: Bruschetta Fruit plates Free 1 glass Dalat wine for 1 pizza

name: Why Not? Bar & Restaurant Hue
address: 19 Pháº¡m NgÅ© LÃ£o, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: We found this restaurant whilst exploring the area and went back for lunch. We were not disappointed. The meals were a great price, even the western food was reasonable and the kids loved it. We had a mix of western and Vietnamese food, Beer cocktails mocktails and juice and it was all amazing. We ended up back again for dinner because the kids enjoyed it so much and the price was so reasonable, Initially we picked this restaurant as it has a snooker table and our son has become really into pool on this holiday. However we were very pleasantly surprised to discover that â€˜Why Notâ€™ also has a great variety menu, very good food and such friendly and professional service. We didnâ€™t feel in any rush to eat- and- run as the ambience is perfect, music isnâ€™t blaring and the facilities are clean which is not a common combination in SE Asian restaurants. We have eaten lunch and dinner out every day for the past 8 weeks travelling through Asia, and this place stands out as a firm favourite. We are now in Hoi An so want to try the restaurant here too., We went here for a late lunch on New Year's Eve. Very welcoming staff, and clearly popular with some regular expats/tourists for its pool tables. An unusual mix of Vietnamese and Mexican food, and we stuck with the Vietnamese food. My choice (beef) was not great, but seemingly just a bad choice; all other members of the group had excellent food.

We ended up back again for dinner because the kids enjoyed it so much and the price was so reasonable

name: Kyodai Japanese Restaurant
address: 66 1, Le Loi Opposite Century Hotel, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: What a wonderful surprise to find a great spot for fresh tasty Japanese sashimi and sushi in Hue. We live in Vancouver, Canada and know our Japanese food pretty well from travel to Japan and our local Japanese restaurants. Kyodai in Hue had exceeded all of our expectations for fresh sashimi in Vietnam. We know Vietnam is great for seafood but hadnâ€™t ventured to a Japanese place over the past three weeks of Vietnam travel here. This was picked on random and could have been a big mistake. It wasnâ€™t!! We ordered one of their Sushi Platters to start that had a variety of sashimi fish on top that was all fresh, firm texture and tasty, their Tempura Prawns were really big prawn pieces and came with a lovely deep fried tempura batter, the Agadashi Tofu came as expected with a creamy soft tofu texture and the last Tobiko fresh fish small roe dish was crunchy and tasty. All in all, 10 out of 10. Weâ€™ll return for a repeat before we leave town in two days!!, Excellent delicious and fresh food, and good service too. The restaurant is down a little alley off the main road, with both and inside and outside space. We had tempura prawns, edamame beans, a sushi platter and udon beef noodle soup. Some of the best food we have had in Vietnam!, Our family of 4 had a delicious meal. The sushi was incredibly fresh, and the Teriyaki Salmon was perfecty cooked. We would absolutely go again!
description: Delicious sushi in Hue city.

name: COCOCLUB RESTAURANT BRASSERIE CAFE
address: 53 Ham Nghi street LE DOMAINE DE COCODO Resort, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant is not in the touristy area, but is definitely worth the 20 min walk or 5 minute taxi ride. We were attracted by the diversity of cuisines; French, Vietnamese, Italian, plus the great reviews. We met the charming owner, Jennes, who is ethnically Vietnamese but was raised and lived in France. The menu is enormous- 50 pages and is as thick as a book. But Jennes guided us to selections that he had the materials for that day and that he thought we would enjoy. We had French cuisine; lamb and chicken dishes with fabulous sauces and side dishes. A huge and delicious Mediterranean salad started the meal with a Chilean Sav Blanc, and Creme Brûlée and Grand Marnier snifters finished it. While expensive compared to the typical Vietnamese meal, it was only $60 USD. I would guess a $200 meal in the US. The location seems dodgy; it’s definitely not in a neighborhood that is touristy. Our GPS told us to walk down some railroad tracks. Just take a taxi. The setting and ambiance is wonderful; open, outside in a large courtyard with quiet seating areas, a pool, great lighting, nice table sets, beautiful bar. It also is a hotel with rooms that look quite inviting. Highly recommend if you’re ready for great options that include fine non-Vietnamese food. I’m sure that the Vietnamese food is great as well - the chef and kitchen clearly know what they are doing. Service was excellent, but hard to really know as there was only one large party of 20, then us. Jennes is charming if you get a chance to meet him. Fun to hear a Vietnamese man with a French accent., We discovered this restaurant for lunch quite be accident, and so glad we did. It's hidden away in a quiet area with a hotel and huge pool. The menu is large and both Vietnamese and western food. So many great choices. Our lunches were wonderful. Service was great. We plan to go back for a dinner., We stumbled across this restaurant and will forever be glad that we did. The owner was incredibly friendly, the menu extensive and there was a lovely atmosphere. I saw on the menu before we visited that they offered gluten free pizza and couldn’t believe my eyes! I have yet to find a restaurant serving gluten free pizza in Hanoi. The gluten free base was crispy but not hard. The pizza was HUGE and the cheese plentiful. I didn’t enquire about cooking methods and cross contamination, but didn’t have a reaction which is fantastic. We would highly recommend this restaurant, particularly if you are a member of the gluten free/celiac club.
description: The restaurant COCOCLUB is an oasis in the center of Hue, the imperial city of Vietnam . The food is authentic VIETNAMESE FUSION using all Vietnamese and Mediterranean herbs . Our specilialites are unique in HUE and this oasis is locates in a RESORT APARTMENT HOTEL ... LE DOMAINE DE COCODO .

name: Duyen Anh Seafood Restaurant
address: Nha Hang Duyen Anh, Hue Vietnam
reviews: It is a very nice place to eat, good fish and sea food. Very recommended!!! It's a mist in the zone. Meat is also available , salads and very good sticky rice, We visited here whilst working in Hue, it was recommended by a colleague. It’s a little out of the way but taxis are reasonable we’ll worth a visit, This is a very stylish and huge restaurant, very famous in the area for seafood. We had a wonderful evening with family and friends, absolutely fantastic for special occasions. Really good seafood, well presented.
description: It is a very nice place to eat, good fish and sea food. Very recommended!!! It's a mist in the zone. Meat is also available , salads and very good sticky rice

name: An Phu Garden Restaurant Hue
address: 11 Nguyễn Thái Học Str, Phú Hội Ward, Huế City, Việt Nam, Hue 0234 Vietnam
reviews: We were two in the restaurant today on the recommendation of our guide and the recommendation has been confirmed 100%. Although we only consumed one small thing, we additionally received a fruit plate.The food was extremely good and very nicely decorated. The service was extremely friendly and accommodating and the prices were very reasonable., First the restaurant setting is exquisite. Beautifully carved wood, inlaid with mother of pearl in the old Vietnamese/ Chinese style. The squash soup with ice cream was rich and luxurious. The presentation of each dish made for a fun meal and the wish you didn’t need to destroy the creations. Finally the service was personal, warm and friendly. If you are in Hue put this gem on your must go list!, Wow! Not only is the restaurant itself the previous home of a royal family, the food is fantastic. The depth of flavor is beyond typical vietnamese fair from much of the country. The food was fresh and beautifully sculptured with attractive vegetables as ducks and dragons. This is a MUST visit in Hue.
description: Located in the city of Hue, Vietnam, An Phu Garden Restaurant is a must-visit destination for anyone seeking an authentic Vietnamese dining experience. The restaurant’s reputation for serving delicious local specialties, particularly from the Hue region, has made it a popular choice among locals and tourists alike. An Phu GardenRestaurant offers a cozy and welcoming atmosphere that is further enhanced by the traditional Vietnamese decor. Whether you’re looking to indulge in classic dishes like Banh Khoai , Banh Beo and Bun Bo Hue or simply want to explore the flavors of Vietnam, our Restaurant is the perfect place to savor the rich and diverse culinary culture of this enchanting country.

name: Com Chay Duong Sinh Lien Hoa
address: 03 Le Quy Don Phu Nhuan, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Google translate was no help at all here! Fried cauliflower was broccoli in sauce, and that was just the beginning. Nevertheless, we pointed and ordered, and what we got was tasty and of course vegetarian, which meant The Vegetarian was able to eat like a true local without fear! Not geared towards tourists, for us this was its charm. Enjoy the adventure!, We did not know where to start from when we wanted to order. We were recommended a set lunch and took it. We did not like the jackfruit, which in fact did not look like jackfruit to us. We liked the "rice paste with green bean filling wrapped", turned out to be something like the "chee chrong fun" we have in Singapore. Delicious. The spring rolls were good. They only have fried ones. Aloe Vera drink must have. We communicated via google translator and the staff was very patient., This place serves up delicious and cheap vegan food in a lovely setting. The menu translations range from quirky (cauliflower turned out to be broccoli) to mysterious (no idea what Twelve Predestined Affinity was). Being all vegan you can’t go wrong with being brave and ordering something adventurous sounding. We were intrigued by Fried Bumps and went for it - it turned out to be bok choy. The crispy fried jackfruit was a standout. A definite must when in the area.
description: Google translate was no help at all here! Fried cauliflower was broccoli in sauce, and that was just the beginning. Nevertheless, we pointed and ordered, and what we got was tasty and of course vegetarian, which meant The Vegetarian was able to eat like a true local without fear! Not geared towards tourists, for us this was its charm. Enjoy the adventure!

name: Tinh Gia Vien
address: 7K/28 Le Thanh Ton, Hue 84 054 Vietnam
reviews: Hidden in an anonymous alley lies the beautiful colonial villa that hosts this restaurant. After being seated on a suggestive terrace surrounded by bonsais and old dusty memorabilia, you will be served the imperial menu. For 15$ per person the amount of food is amazing: seven courses of masterfully presented dishes will nourish your eyes before overwhelming your stomachs. You probably won't be able to finish everything, but it sure is an experience worth having., This restaurant serve food with interesting craft like dragon, phoenix, etc. We need to reserve the place., Finding Tinh Gia Vien wasn't easy, it looks like a normal house with no obvious signage. Once you've found it you select from one of 3 set menus. Here each menu is based on the old imperial cuisine. Each menu has 9 dishes, which I believe because the emporer believe 9 to represent long life. You'll also find each dish is impeccably presented being served as peacocks, chickens and elephants, which is down to the emporer being a picky eater and needing every encouragement to make him finish his dinner. The prepetation for each dish must take some doing and you'll not leave the restaurant without being absolutely bloated. You'll have some photos too.
description: Hidden in an anonymous alley lies the beautiful colonial villa that hosts this restaurant. After being seated on a suggestive terrace surrounded by bonsais and old dusty memorabilia, you will be served the imperial menu. For 15$ per person the amount of food is amazing: seven courses of masterfully presented dishes will nourish your eyes before overwhelming your stomachs. You probably won't be able to finish everything, but it sure is an experience worth having.

name: Sala Restaurant Hue
address: 48-50 Nguyễn Lương Bằng, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: We stayed at the Sala Hotel for 1 night including breakfast in the morning. The staff were really friendly and the hotel is spotless. We were given a fantastic room overlooking the pool. Breakfast was tasty and the staff are happy to take special requests. Would definitely recommend., Truly, five stars clean rooms, cold air conditioning restaurant was great very economical. Good value in my opinion and I’ve travelled the world. Thu sang at the front desk was very accommodating would recommend anyone travelling, Really helpful staff accommodating with issues with our booking and buses, willing to help us sort those issues. Would definitely stay here again if I was in Hue. The rooms are spacious and the pool was lovely. Breakfast was tasty and dinner menu looks extensive.
description: We stayed at the Sala Hotel for 1 night including breakfast in the morning. The staff were really friendly and the hotel is spotless. We were given a fantastic room overlooking the pool. Breakfast was tasty and the staff are happy to take special requests. Would definitely recommend.

name: Tai Phu Restaurant
address: 2 Dien Bien Phu, Hue Vietnam
reviews: I had an absolutely fantastic experience at Hanh Restaurant! The food was simply amazing, and truly showcased the incredible flavors of Hue. Every dish I tried was bursting with authentic local flavors and made with the freshest ingredients. From the crispy banh xeo to the tender bun bo hue, everything was incredibly well-prepared and flavorful. I highly recommend this restaurant for lunch or dinner, as it truly offers a culinary experience to remember., We wanted a fairly quick and simple meal on our first night in Hue, coming after a lot of travelling. This place was only a couple of minutes from the hotel and was a simple local option but it really did the job! Our waitress had enough decent English to help explain how to deal with the specialities - some DIY work needed to put it all together - but then it soon all disappeared. The price was so low we left a good tip and our waitress was happy, and so were we and suggest you try Tai Phu., Tai Phu Restaurant, - Specialized in serving Hue special dishes: pring rolls, delicious cakes , main dishes.... - Delicious food, good taste, quick service. The price is acceptable. - The restaurant is clean, bright, tidy, have guard with motobikes parking. - If I have the opportunity to return to Hue, I will choose this restaurant first for family or friends.
description: I had an absolutely fantastic experience at Hanh Restaurant! The food was simply amazing, and truly showcased the incredible flavors of Hue. Every dish I tried was bursting with authentic local flavors and made with the freshest ingredients. From the crispy banh xeo to the tender bun bo hue, everything was incredibly well-prepared and flavorful. I highly recommend this restaurant for lunch or dinner, as it truly offers a culinary experience to remember.

name: Gem Sushi Bar
address: 6A Võ Thị Sáu, Hue 52000 Vietnam
reviews: A very nice vibe at this restaurant. Very courteous staff. Nice variety of Japanese dishes. We ordered 8 things and the bill was about $20. Our favorite was the salmon belly - delicious. The server made an error and gave us sashimi instead of nigiri for two dishes (more expensive) but since the cost overall was so reasonable, we didn’t complain., After a few days of Vietnamese cuisines, we decided to have a change. We chance upon this corner restaurant and did not disappoint. Service staffs were extremely attentive and we took a glimpse into the kitchen behind the Japanese curtain, it was very clean and neat. We are in safe hands. We ordered some usual bites eg sushi, chawamushi, beef etc, all very yummy and splendid. We highly recommend this place for anyone wanting a different eats in Hue., Walking around looking g for a place to eat, saw Gem. T0 make it quick, I looked at the menu and is a nice menu. Ordered edemame and spicy tuna roll. Was impressed. Ordered another one. I really enjoyed it. The waitress was very pleasant, very quick to take my ordered and very polite. This was yesterday, today I went back and had a shrimp and salmon roll which was delicious. Also had a soft shell crab roll, which pleased my stomach. To drink I had water and all of this for $10.00. The atmosphere was nice considering the restaurant is not too big. The only drawback was the location. It is located in Nguyễn Hue street ( the walking ) full of bars and loud music. However, the food made up for it.
description: A very nice vibe at this restaurant.  Very courteous staff. Nice variety of Japanese dishes.  We ordered 8 things and the bill was about $20.  Our favorite was the salmon belly - delicious.  The server made an error and gave us sashimi instead of nigiri for two dishes (more expensive) but since the cost overall was so reasonable, we didn’t complain.

name: Banh Khoai Hong Mai
address: 110 Dinh Tien Hoang Hue Historic Citadel, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: This restaurant only has two things on the menu (shrimp pancakes and pork skewers), and they do both of these dishes so well. The staff spoke good English and the service was friendly and fast. The dishes were really tasty and the staff showed us how to eat them which was really helpful. Would absolutely recommend this spot, Only two items on the menu - pork satay on lemongrass and Vietnamese pancakes. Awesome little place, really busy every time we walked past. The guy who ran the place was really helpful and showed us how to eat the food. Such a lovely guy. Really tasty and fresh. Definitely worth going to if you are in the area., Two dishes but really well done. Traditional and genuine street food. Their rice crepes are delicious and leave an explosion of very pleasant flavors in the mouth. The frying is light. Very high value for money. Friendly staff and family atmosphere.
description: Banh khoai Hong Mai is family restaurant.

name: Cherish Hue Restaurant
address: 57 Ben Nghe Street 10th floor, Cherish Hotel, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Our tour group stayed here for two nights and we had breakfast at this restaurant every morning. It is one of the biggest breakfast spreads in Vietnam! The fruits are all fresh and plenty of varieties. The egg station is fully stocked with veggies and meats. They even had a huge salad spread and different cooked Veggies. Coffee is very good and fresh., You can see nice view on top of the hotel The rooms are very nice Breakfast is served and the foods are fantastic Nice service and people are friendly, The manager was extremely kind to us. But he is also very professional. He helps us with all of our request. The food is pretty good
description: "For tourists, Hue has conserved the palaces and temples from the ancient Vietnamese capital, and Cherish Restaurant serves the royal cuisine, lunch and dinner, that made ​​by the traditional food chef, who has over 30 years experience in cooking. At Cherish Restaurant, visitors also are presented the fine Western dishes in original and harmonious taste. Located on the 10th floor of Cherish Hotel, the restaurant owns the finest view toward the city, overlooking Ngu Binh Mountain, Perfume River and the Ever-Growing skyline of Hue. Let's come and enjoy your time with Cherish restaurant!"

name: Huyen Anh
address: 52 Kim Long Street, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Huyen Anh Grill Pork Noodles is a hidden gem for food lovers. The restaurant serves mouthwatering grill pork noodles that will leave you craving for more. The flavors are simply delicious, with the tender grilled pork complementing the rich and aromatic broth. The portion sizes are generous, offering great value for money. The restaurant's cozy ambiance and friendly staff add to the overall dining experience. If you're a fan of Vietnamese cuisine, don't miss the opportunity to indulge in the delectable grill pork noodles at Huyen Anh Restaurant., Our local guide brought here here after a visit to the DMZ. It's excellent. The menu is simple - but everything on it is tasty. We ordered BBQ rolls, bake rolls and 2 rice noodles with BBQ meat for lunch. They offer spicy or non-spicy fish sauce (nước mắm) and peanut sauce. They are all tasty in their own way., Cracking gaffe a bit out of town which the locals like. We had tea and an absolutely cracking Banh uot thit nuong. Dip in the fish sauce. Peel a close of garlic. Add some chilli and it’s sweet pork roll delight. Get involved!!!!

The flavors are simply delicious, with the tender grilled pork complementing the rich and aromatic broth. The portion sizes are generous, offering great value for money. The restaurant's cozy ambiance and friendly staff add to the overall dining experience. If you're a fan of Vietnamese cuisine, don't miss the opportunity to indulge in the delectable grill pork noodles at Huyen Anh Restaurant.

name: Khong Gian Xua
address: 205 Dien Bien Phu, Hue Vietnam
reviews: We visited for lunch as our tour guide suggested stopping (probably because they had a free/reduced lunch for guides bringing in tourists). Not my cup of tea personally. Gaudy interior with Vietnamese costume and hats to put on in the restaurant on a fancy ‘throne’. It was busy with large parties having a set buffet lunch which meant our food was slow to arrive (my meal arrived a good ten minutes after my husbands). The fish dish was ok, but the pork in a pot was mainly fat. There are better, more authentic, restaurants in town., This spot looks great online but turned out to be just a tourist trap. The decor is supposed to be traditional Hue style but looked rather garish and more like Chinese to us. The food was mediocre and the service was even worse. We got the request to pay in VND because "the credit card machine is broken". When we came up short on cash, they suggested we could pay in USD but then completely botched up the exchange rate (not sure if that was intentional or not). The manager had to intervene and apologize for the "mathematical error". We came away with a very bad feeling about this place. There are better dining options than this in Hue, e.g. the excellent Com Nieu Chan establishments., Very nice place with quite tasty food and choices. Very good service and atmosphere and very reasonable value for the money

name: Maison Trang 2 Restaurant
address: 94 Huyen Tran Cong Chua, Hue 49000 Vietnam
reviews: We actually went to the Madison Trang in Hue and found ourselves near here today and decided to check it out - it was AMAZING! The food is very reasonably priced, the portions were large, and the food was actually good. The Bun Bo Hue + Bun Thit Nuong was really delicious. Highly recommend, We all tried the set menu, with different Vietnamese food. We had a small taste of everything and It was simply delicious and cheap. Big portions, we almost couldn't finish everything. Thank you to Trang the owner, she is literally one of the sweetest person. Highly recommend it, My, by now 77 years old mother, and me often visit Vietnam. Hue is one of our favourites spots in the whole country. An important part of feeling so well in Hue is Trang, the owner of this Maison Trang 2 Restaurant as well as a very nice guesthouse and a beautiful other location near the beach. She became one of our best friends in Vietnam. The food being served is absolutely amazing. All dishes have the noble touch of the previous emperor cuisine. It is always difficult what to choose since every dish is a culinary story of it's own. However, prices are still very moderate. I recommand Maison Trang 2 as one of the best places to eat in the centre of Hue.
description: Maison Trang has been gaining a reputation for the high quality of authentic regional dishes that you should not miss such as Beo, Nam, Loc cake, grilled pork wrapped wet rice paper, grilled chopped pork with lemon grass and stuffed rice pancake, beef noodle, and vegetable foodâ€¦. Our traditional cuisine is so distinctive from other regions and we serve the dishes which are cooked to past emperors and royal Nguyen Dynasty.

name: San May Vegeterian Restaurant
address: 08 Thanh Tinh Street, Vy Da Ward, Hue Vietnam
reviews: What a surprise, this vegetarian restaurant. In a dark back street you will find this beautiful restaurant with the most delicious dishes. I said a few days ago that I don't often make food surprise me anymore. Well, in that respect, this was a big party. Even the children want to come back here tomorrow (last night Hue). If you are looking for a gem and want to eat delicious food, choose this restaurant. And at least choose the pomelo salad. I could eat that every day., Really delicious vegetarian food with a welcoming family feel! I would recommend ordering a variety of dishes to share between a few people so you can try more as they’re all so good. Tucked away in a quiet peaceful setting. Highly recommend!, Beautiful garden setting and the food was absolutely magnificent! So so so delicious... can't recommend it enough. Reasonably priced, great serving sizes. Worth noting there is no alcohol served here. Ginger lemon and lemongrass tea was recommended by the wait staff instead and was fabulous.

I said a few days ago that I don't often make food surprise me anymore. Well, in that respect, this was a big party. Even the children want to come back here tomorrow (last night Hue). If you are looking for a gem and want to eat delicious food, choose this restaurant. And at least choose the pomelo salad. I could eat that every day.

name: Brown Eyes Bar
address: 56 Chu Văn An, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Attentive service, decent cocktails for the price and fun-loving staff who want you to have a good time. We came here a couple of times for pre-dinner drinks and happy hour was exactly that!, The happy hour drinks are great and we have received some shots and a little snack for free. The staff is very kind. We liked it very much!, You have to visit to experience Brown Eyes. A welcome shot on arrival, followed by 2 for 1 cocktails. Sitting outside playing Jenga all night was a hoot. Seriously good fun and cheap cocktails. A thank you Highway to Help was a spectacle as well. For the drinkers worth while, non drinkers do pay a premium. A good fun place but don't expect too much!
description: Attentive service, decent cocktails for the price and fun-loving staff who want you to have a good time. We came here a couple of times for pre-dinner drinks and happy hour was exactly that!

name: Take Japanese Restaurant
address: 34 Tran Cao Van Str South Bank, Hue Vietnam
reviews: This is a lovely, family style, little restaurant, patronized mostly by locals and almost always full. It was about ten minutes on foot away from my hotel (Melia) and their salmon was much fresher, better tasting and about 50% cheaper than in the hotel's fancy restaurant. I came here three times and always, everything here was fresh, tasty and promptly served. Very much worth giving it a try..., The setting is simple, there are private areas but we were in the main room. The service is efficient and without frills. The menu presents Japanese specialties. The sashimi and maki are delicious, the udon and ramen are decent. The room should be better soundproofed because it is extremely noisy, The best Japanese food I have ever tasted ( and I’ve had a lot!!!). Go go go. Try the rice pancake - yum. I admired the plates and they insisted I go home with one. So lovely. Can’t recommend enough.

It was about ten minutes on foot away from my hotel (Melia) and their salmon was much fresher, better tasting and about 50% cheaper than in the hotel's fancy restaurant. I came here three times and always, everything here was fresh, tasty and promptly served. Very much worth giving it a try...

name: Tropical Garden
address: 27 Chu Văn An, Phú Hội, Thành phố Huế, Thừa Thiên, Hue 53000 Vietnam
reviews: While looking for another restaurant, we discovered the somewhat hidden Tropical Garden. What luck! Extensive menu, local prices but top quality and Huê specialties along with local wine! Unobtrusive welcome and attentive all-round service, including instructions on how to cut up and enjoy the somewhat difficult but very tasty Huê specialties :-), What a discovery!!! We took a set of starters local cuisine (booe). The chef works plants from his “tropical garden”, the room staff - Mrs Vy - introduces us to the garden and the plants used. To do when the crowds at the restaurant allow. Great customer experience - travel in flavors., This nice restaurant offers a relaxing atmosphere. The food was very good and we have had an excellent service. The chicken with lemon gras and the noddles with beef plus garbage with garlic have been freshly cooked. The garden area is also very nice to be seated. As it was raining we preferred to sit inside.
description:
While looking for another restaurant, we discovered the somewhat hidden Tropical Garden. What luck! Extensive menu, local prices but top quality and Huê specialties along with local wine! 
Unobtrusive welcome and attentive all-round service, including instructions on how to cut up and enjoy the somewhat difficult but very tasty Huê specialties :-)

name: Hang Me Me
address: 29 Nguyễn Công Trứ Phú Hội, Hue Vietnam
reviews: We had dinner here and had the mixed banh platter for 240 dong. This was 6 types of rice "cakes" and while the taste was fine and the cakes not heavy, it wasn't enough to fill us. We ordered another type of cake and with drinks it came to 335 dong which we thought was over-priced. We have had similar food for a lot less, so we were disappointed, especially considering we then went to get a banh mi to fill us up. Ok for a snack or v light lunch, but not ok for dinner., We visited quite late in the evening - away from the main strip ( which is horrid and full of badly dressed Europeans) and had the restaurant to ourselves save for a young Vietnamese family who joined as we were leaving. Excellent local dumplings and dipping sauce. The lemongrass pork kebabs were also excellent. Super meal., We come here in the first day in Hue city at 3pm based on the information of our hotel reception. They inform me that this Restaurant in the central area and we can try good traditional cakes and noodles of Hue. This restaurant located in walking are so that after eating you can go around the streets and enjoy some exciting entertainment for example coffee, bars, music ... around there. For the food i think this restaurant is ok and traditional flavor. If you don't want to go to many restaurants to try all kinds of cakes and Hue noodles you should go there. The service is fast and reasonable price.

name: Hue Cuisine & Café
address: 44 Hoàng Quốc Việt Phường An Đông, Tp Huế, Hue 0084 Vietnam
reviews: Enjoy this place for an unreal gastronomic experience. Very friendly staff and ambience. Our elderly group had a ball with the food choices
description: Enjoy this place for an unreal gastronomic experience. Very friendly staff and ambience.  Our elderly group had a ball with the food choices

name: Ngu Yen - Royal Restautant In Hue
address: 01 Floor, 33 Hai Ba Trung St Thanh Lich Royal Boutique Hotel, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: The whole experience came with dressing up in royal costumes and listening to royal music. We were assisted with every royal dish, taking beautiful pictures and videos of our entrance, mimicking the real dinner of a King and Queen. 100% recommend the experience, also the food was top notch👍🏻. Front office manager Hương was especially helpful., Good dîner impérial. Super and so beautiful restaurant. Clother very beautiful .we are look like King and Queen .thank you so much Huong, What is wonderful night! Staff are very helpful and friendly. Royal menu was so delicious and many choice. We recommend this place to all guests ^ ^
