Option
Banh uot I loved - again pancakes
Bun nam mem - crackling good pork on dry noodles which I sorted out with some fish sauce and peanut sauce. 
Get involved.

name: Nhi's Crepe & Pizza
address: 9/25 Hai Bà Trưng, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: We craved some pizza and searched online for a nice place. We came across Nhi’s Pizza & Crepe and decided to give it a try. Definitely worth it! Very friendly staff and they made me a pizza without mozzarella (because of a lactose intolerance) and it was so tasty. The dough is really crispy and everything seemed super fresh. 10/10 recommended if you’re craving a pizza in Hué., Tucked away in a lane way (Ket 25, Hai Ba Trung) just behind the Cinestar is a little place called Nhi's Crepe & Pizza, which is without a doubt one of the best keeped local secrets that only a few tourists know about that I have come across. Although I have not yet tried the crepes the pizza is by far, one of the best pizza places in Hue City. The freshness of the ingredients and the combination of flavours makes you wanting more. With it's friendly staff, curious locals and it's quite unassuming location is hidden and little gem, a must visit on any tourist or locals Hue's must do list. If you are looking for a great pizza and have time to go out of your way stop into Nhi's Crepe & Pizza for the taste of western culture that even the Italian's would find it hard to match. This not a paid post, I genuinely found this place on Google and am glade I came here., So I went here with my family and it was so nice. Delicious food/drinks(I had margarita pizza + pineapple juice but my sister got a hazelnut crepe with strawberry and banana and she said that was delicious too). Staff was friendly and nice!
description: Fresh, hot and delicous! Come and enjoy the defference!

name: Fruit House
address: 32 Dinh Tien Hoang, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: The fried noodle with egg was delicious and for a good price! The restaurant is right next to the Imperial City and the lady who owns the place is very nice and smiley. They also provide free WiFi, I would come here to eat again!, The host is very friendly and food are delicious. We ordered two dishes and they are both great. The price is not expensive, Nice little restaurant with a friendly host. Dishes were very delicious. A small but good selection of vegetarian food is available too! Recommended!
description: Thank you very much for giving me the chance to talk about my favourite restaurant. The name of my favourite restaurant is FRUIT HOUSE (FAST FOOD, HOT POT, VEGETERIAN AND JUICE) and it’s situated in the centre place of the city. I like the serene environment, serves and tasty food. The price is reasonable and food is served quickly. Although space is small but very cozy and stylish, staffs are good and friendly.

name: Hung Vuong Inn
address: 20 D Hung Vuong, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Great location, nice staff and a wonderful menu of a mix between East and West. When in Hue, twice a year, I eat here 2 or 3 times a week and have done so for the past 5 years. The food is reasonably priced and always tasty and I am slowly eating my way through the whole menu. It is also a great place to meet other western tourists and chat about their stay in Hue as well as meeting locals who obviously know a great place to eat. Easy walking distance from most hotels in Hue and easy to find in Hung Vuong Street., Great staff, very good food, may not be traditional Vietnamese architecture, but it's clean and pleasant., Centrally located restaurant with large choice of Vietnamese and European food and drinks. The food is well prepared against reasonable prices. English speaking staff.
description:
Great location, nice staff and a wonderful menu of a mix between East and West.
When in Hue, twice a year, I eat here 2 or 3 times a week and have done so for the past 5 years.  The food is reasonably priced and always tasty and I am slowly eating my way through the whole menu.  It is also a great place to meet other western tourists and chat about their stay in Hue as well as meeting locals who obviously know a great place to eat.  Easy walking distance from most hotels in Hue and easy to find in Hung Vuong Street.

name: 054 Cafe'
address: 35 Nguyen Cong Tru, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Awesome and relaxed bar off the main strip in Hue. Relaxed vibe, good drinks and great staff. Pool is free too!, Not full of tourists. Amazing staff. Cheap beers. Great music. What else can you want?! Great vibe, great staff l, great atmosphere, can't reccomed it highly enough., Friendly staff, great music, good food and cheap beer and pool tables and it's open late! What's not to love?
description: Awesome and relaxed bar off the main strip in Hue. Relaxed vibe, good drinks and great staff. Pool is free too!

name: Di Nhien Tea House
address: 26/3 Nguyen Thien Thuat, Hue City Thuan Hoa, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: This is my second time visiting this place. There is a variety of tea for customers to choose. I love the aroma and the tastes of these teas. The waiters are well-informed and shared with us a lot about Hue culture and tea culture. Worth a visit!!!, I came to Di Nhiên tea house through the introduction of a Hue native friend. Gratifying experience. In the cold winter air and heavy rain all day, Di Nhiên space's warmth and the great tea taste really impressed me. With the attentive service and good tea knowledge of the tea waiter here, I am really satisfied. Reasonable prices are also a strong point of the tea house. I will come back to Di Nhien again when I come to Hue next time., A very peaceful and pleasant place, and the tea (which is collected by the owners) is some of the best I've ever tasted. Very kind staff. We left with several teas as presents for our friends back home.
description: Just some steps from the Imperial city, Di Nhien Tea House is a cosy and peaceful corner for local people and travelers who want to discover the authentic and traditional Vietnamese culture, or just to relax after a long time of working or traveling around Hue. Di Nhien offers not only traditional tea but also other drinks and Vietnamese specialities ("banh khao","com lang Vong",...)

name: Koi Coffee
address: 20/19 Nguyen Thai Hoc, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: This place is wierd. Dont get me wrong they do great coffee's. Went here three times and all times got different size coffee's. All were large take away. One day a small next day a large then a medium but all for the same price. Maybe they ran out of take away cups or maybe thought westerners let's ripped them off!!! When your craving a coffee give them a go!!, Wow this place have a great koi lake. My friend love that fist. So in another time i'll come back here. Thx so much, For all of people who want to work in a nice and relaxing atmosphere, koi coffee is a perfect location ! The WiFi works perfectly, the juice is excellent and the team is very friendly. I want two times during my stay, they prepared the meal according to my preferences and it was delicious. Thank you again to the team and the owner for their kindness :)
description: We have a beautiful koi aquarium over 110 koi fish. Airy space and right in the center of Hue city

name: La Brasserie & Le Bar
address: 105A Hung Vuong street, Phu Hoi ward 1st Floor, Indochine Palace, Hue city, Vietnam, Hue 084234 Vietnam
reviews: Sufficient cuisines to ensure that any international traveller could eat familiar food from home. Should concentrate more on indigenous Vietnamien food Appetisers and mains arrived at the same time- I would order sequentially next time to ensure gaps between courses, After another busy day we were just too tired to go into town to try “authentic” Vietnamese food so decided to dine in our hotel. A first class meal without doubt Vietnamese and served in a comfortable setting only an elevator’s ride to the land of nod. Subtle flavours, attentive and helpful staff who suggested one of the side dishes I was going to order wasn’t the best choice to go with my main course makes such a difference rather than let the customer be always right only for them to believe their choices were ill matched when it’s too late, after the meal. A definite one to recommend., We went there 6 friends to drink something... But the cakes and ice cream cought our eyes. We went in the evening so there was some live classical music playing. Was really nice and delicious. The service was fast and the staff make sure that we won't need to "search" for someone if we need something and was always try to keep in eye contact. Thank you guys for a nice evening.
description: The “La Brasserie” is a full service dining restaurant serving breakfast, lunch and dinner. The elegant hotel’s signature restaurant is overlooking the pool and landscaped gardens; the pleasant ambience reflects the architectural design of the Hotel. The Brasserie features a display kitchen in the centre of the restaurant.

name: Pho Nuong Tokyo BBQ
address: 13 Vo Thi Sau, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: you can order different menu the meat and fish is backed on a bbq in the middle of the table at the inside of a restaurant located in a mall meat quality was medium quiet some fat meat good for a one time experience with our son, We had a very nice lunch after a long morning walking and discovering the city. Service was good, food was okay. I recommend it if you’re hungry and want something to eat quick and good, Amazing food and super service. I have been eating my fair amount of Korean BBQ in China and I will rate this higher than any of the places I have tried in Suzhou(Jiangsu) and Shanghai. The personell is super friendly and over all a great experience, totally recommend it if you are in Hue! @Mr.Thanh is a champ
description: TOKYO BBQ restaurant have 3 floors Floor 1: Street food and local food Floor 2 : Sea food Floor 3: BBQ Japanese food ( Grill at the table )

name: Hoang Anh
address: 140 Kim Long T.p., Hue Vietnam
reviews: We have been pleasantly “stuck“ in Hue for two months because of the pandemic. We live 1 km from this place and decided to give it a try. The food was great and service was fast. They don’t speak English but there are only two menu items to choose from. We went with the “bun thịt nướng” at one USD each. It was well seasoned and delicious. Some Westerners might like it because it is not highly seasoned but is complex of ingredients. We will definitely return. Best time to go is lunch or no later than 8pm., We came here with our family while visiting the three tombs near Hue. Our driver recommended this because we wanted to eat local food. The price is clear, there is not really a menu. The food was simply superb. First fresh spring rolls. Add two types of sauce. Then noodles with meat and vegetables/salad. Local beer, lemon juice, cold green tea. I can't describe how much everyone enjoyed it. But trust me, it's worth a visit!! Absolutely recommended. Driver ordered food by the way, so not sure if they speak English., My taxi driver recommended this place to me. The food is very good and very cheap. it's very close to Thien Mu Pagoda as well. They don't have a big menu but what they offered was tasty.
description: We have been pleasantly “stuck“ in Hue for two months because of the pandemic. We live 1 km from this place and decided to give it a try. The food was great and service was fast. They don’t speak English but there are only two menu items to choose from. We went with the “bun thịt nướng” at one USD each. It was well seasoned and delicious. Some Westerners might like it because it is not highly seasoned but is complex of ingredients. We will definitely return. Best time to go is lunch or no later than 8pm.

name: Royal Park, Hue
address: 38-43 Nguyen Sinh Sac Street, Vi Da, Hue, Hue Vietnam
reviews: We had a fixed menu meal here. The restaurant was fine, food was good. The street (actually an alley) was off-putting because of the construction work being carried out. This, however, did not interfere with a nice evening with a very nice dinner., Wanted to repay new friend for his hospitality whilst in Hue. Asked concierge where would he go for dinner... afterwards, I could see why he recommended it... it was out of his league.. sounded and was EXPENSIVE...therefore presumed that the meal was commensurate with the price! I, on returning afterwards filled him in as to his advice... I don't think that he will repeat his faux par again! A 12 course banquet fit for royalty.. VD, 137,000 for 1/2, ... 750.000 ( for 5+) I could spend a long long critique on (my opinion) on the meal that was put down or 6 people. But I won't waste too much of your valuable reading time, by boring you with the same old, same old.... if a king was to eat it, after the first coupla dishes... they wouldn't. Be around !! Fare: king Dragon of appetizers .. a ballotine of sweetn sour pickle encased withovercooked force meat.. it was so dry/ overcooked, I couldn't work out what it was. A selection of 4 was on the plate.. all were overcooked and dry, and cold! A chicken n vege soup... an over boiled (dry) fish n vege soup: .. a dry and coarse minced pork n crab meat stuffed in a crab shell n deep fried... etc etc... what the???? Served to royalty???? I could go around a few Street cafes , choose the equivalent dish, and they would not be any worse!!!!but cheaper!!l I am sure that Vietnamese cuisine is better than what we were presented with... even the porkfried rice(?), a dish so so simple... was butchered...were the cooks on strike , and the door man took over?. It appeared so!! The only thing that was up to scratch was the Private room, the accompanying musicians/ singers( I don't speak Vietnamese.. so no savvy).. the wait staff service! A Chilean Red at Vn. 515,000.. and 6 x VnD 750,000 , was very very expensive meal! I remembered paying more at Hanoi a coupla years ago( intercontinental hotel). But.. there was no complaints??? I don't like to review / rate Restaurants, etc negatively , but, this is in my humble opinion, and my knowledge of food, Icall it as I eat!!! Remember, I was only trying to repay my gracious host /friend in Hue for his hospitality. I am embarrassed by the result, I paid the money..the restaurant pocketed it, I was left with ???? Rate. Food... 3.5/10 Service... 8/18 Value. 3/10 Return for 2 nds... would you???, We were steered to Royal Park by our hotel concierge when we requested an 'Imperial Meal.' The restaurant is in an out-of-the-way location and had a number of tour buses parked outside - never a good sign, in my experience. I had the vegetarian option while my friend had the regular Imperial Meal. Neither was very good. Most things were deep fried, and perhaps not even that recently. After I finally asked the waiter (who was trying hard and seemed to be a good guy) whether there was anything NOT fried, I was brought some steamed vegetables and then a plate of noodles with vegetables. The 'dessert' was 3 small pieces of fruit and a very tiny round cake. The meal cost 500,000 dong EACH (about $23 U.S.), which is a very high price for what we received. (By comparison, we ate lunch at a vegetarian restaurant and paid the equivalent of $10 for about 6 dishes!) I'm about to write my review of the hotel, which we liked a lot, but they're losing a star for sending us to this place.
description: We are a group of 13 photographers and we visited Hue in July 2012 on a self managed trip.  We engaged the services of a driver to take us around.  He took us to Royal  Park restaurant in Hue for lunch. Upon sitting down, the caption told us that they only serve set meal and was reluctant to let us order ala carte.  First he told us that the set lunch for each person is 300,000 dongs.    We then asked him to show us how the meal look like.  He was unable to show it and merely showed us the list of dishes which numbered about 9.  When we said the set meal was too expensive, he reluctant reduced it to 250,000 dong.  It was equivalent to USD 12.5   We we told that each person will be given a set of meal each.  However to our great shock, the dishes were shared with 4 persons and the portion were very small.  I believe we were taken for a ride and I would like to advise all tourist who travel on their own not to patronise thsi restaurant.

name: Hue Hostel & Sports Bar
address: 10 Pham Ngu Lao Phu Hoi, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Great venue in a quiet town. Hosts Nathan and Eddie make everyone more than welcome. Drinks are cold, cheap and moreish. Good atmosphere and also cheap, good food available at pretty much anytime. Pop in and they will welcome you at the door. Accommodation also available, I am told clean, cheap and great for all backpackers. Give it a try, you won’t be disappointed!, Seems like a great place to chill out. Peoples are friendly bartenders take well care and are fluent in English (which seems common in that area) their payment possibility seems funny at first but as it’s a hostel too it makes absolutely sense... so if you want to chill out meet some backpacker it’s the deal ;-) where else you get toilet and shower the same time, We had dinner here and it was terrible. We ordered a meat lovers pizza but could not eat it. The spring rolls were ok, but the onion rings were also bad. Okay place for a drink but not food
description: Located right in the heart of Hue's Backpacker district, we are the first dedicated sports bar in town. We cater to any and all international sport, AFL, NRL, NFL, NBA, NHL, EPL.... you name it! We are open from 6:30am - 11pm everyday and focus on the essentials, cold beer and pub food at a reasonable price. We also have nightly events, games and pub quizzes so there is always something exciting!

name: Anh Kafe
address: 5 Nguyen Hue Street, Vinh Ninh Ward, Hue Vietnam
reviews: I love everything is this cafeteria. I ordered peach macchiato and unfortunately, I poured all of the cup before I had a taste. However, the waiter quickly came and clean up the mess I made. After a while, he came back with a new cup of peach macchiato and said that this is a free gift from the coffee shop and wished me a nice day! What a kind treatment! Highly recommend this coffee shop for everyone!, We went to ANH KAFE in the afternoon when walking on Nguyen Hue Street (add:5 Nguyen Hue str). Nice decoration, quiet space on 2nd floor. We were introduced to macchiato tea very tasty. Must try tiramisu (sold out when we arrived), Orange Mousse Cake, Profiterole ,. Extremely friendly staff, he helped us use paper cups, and always said thank you. Thanks for a beautiful memories in Hue !, Excellent coffee with delicious deserts and kind stuff. Great place for a short break :) I also like the minimal design here.

name: Com Nieu Gia Dinh 2
address: 26 Ben Nghe, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Our driver brought us here, mainly because the owner spoke English. The food was good for locals and this place was full when we arrived. The quality of the food was acceptable although not as good as other more expensive restaurant. We had crispy chicken, Pho, spring rolls and roast pork., Gad mackrel clay pot style. One small piece of fish,some rice , tomato and cucumber. Also had a papaya juice. All for about $6 Australian. 100k dong, Ordered the fried chicken and rice to go. The chicken was perfectly crispy, and served with a small scoop of rice, a couple slices of tomato and cucumber and fish sauce. I was satisfied with the taste but looking through the menu I noticed the prices are relatively high compared to most other Vietnamese restaurants. But this means I paid $3 instead of $1 so not outrageous or anything.

The quality of the food was acceptable although not as good as other more expensive restaurant. We had crispy chicken, Pho, spring rolls and roast pork.

name: Hoa Nghiem Vegetarian Restaurant
address: 28 Ba Trieu, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: If you are a Vegetarian you must try. If you are not a Vegetarian you must go there too. You will be blown away. You might reconsider your choice to eat meat. We started with the pumpkin soup. Outstanding. We had the mango salad, clay pot meat with salt and pepper. Grilled tofu with chili and lemongrass in piper leaves. (similar to grape leaves) Ask for a local favorite other than what we listed here. It is very easy to try many different dishes as they are priced less than a dollar to about 2 dollars. We left, sampling several choices and beer, with a bill of only $13. Totally full, totally happy! This is a must stop when you are in the City of Hue, Vietnam, This place is a hidden gem!! Ms Ha greeted us with a warm smile. Even though we were the only people for dinner, she gave us enough time to choose food, got us the jasmine tea, made us feel so welcome. The food was just amazing with lots of variety and distinctly tasting, flavourful dishes. It's hard to find a place that offers such kind of fresh and delectable vegetarian food. The restaurant is also very neat and clean. Our best wishes to this place, we hope it grows more popular and continues to offer such great vegetarian food. Special thanks to Ms Ha for her hospitality and care., Great, reasonably priced vegan meal in Huê. Servers Duc and Y were very friendly and accommodating from the start and we were given some complimentary snacks while we waited for our food. There’s an extensive range of food and drinks on the menu.

name: Nhà Hàng Gongwuan Hotpot
address: 14 BẾN NGHÉ, Hue 55000 Vietnam
reviews: A hot pot restaurant with Chinese flavors is considered the best in Hue that I have used. With beautiful and harmonious decor. Especially the service staff are very enthusiastic and support my family at all times. This is a dining spot that everyone should come and experience., A great experience. The very attentive service employee explained the procedure perfectly to us. The ingredients were excellent and we really enjoyed it.

name: Morning Glory Hue - Local Restaurant
address: 44 Đoàn Nhữ Hải, Thủy Xuân, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: This place is amazing! We just wanted something to fill our bellies after visiting Tu Duc Tonb But then we saw this menu and ordered a lot! The prices are very good and it's a good way to try local food without any doubt about hygiene. The staff are super friendly and show you how to eat the dishes properly at your table., Exactly opposite the entrance to the Tomb of Tự Đức. Cute little place, run by a kind and smiling lady. Local food, freshly cooked, excellent quality! To try absolutely: - Bahn Nam; - Bahn Loc; - springrolls (these are served in a special way, with vegetables aside: try them!!!). PS: we happened at 17.30, at the closing time of the monument, when there is no more trace of tourists: priceless atmosphere, at sunset! Grazie Morning Glory Hue!!!, Small, but with the owner extremely nice and sympathetic lady and with very good local food! Strategic and convenient location, right near the entrance to the monumental site. Excellent dry noodles with shrimp! Good service and acceptable prices!

address: 49 Le Loi street, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Best taste and excellent quality, you should try once as you will cherish the taste forever. The quantity is also good, I had an excellent fried rice with shrimps at this place. Friendly staff and quick service. Nothing to complain about, The local food here was good. The pho was particularly tasty. The local drinks were also refreshing. The service was very polite.
description: Dear Traveller, Welcome to Stop and Eat , a local family restaurant, established in 2015, the restaurant is centrally located near the Truong Tien Bridge and The Perfume River. For the adventurous travellers you can stroll from your hotel or for those not yet familiar with the streets of Hue, simply jump into a Taxi. We serve local Vietnamese cuisine and are well known for our signature Hue Banan

address: 142/2 Nguyen Sinh Cung Vy Da Ward, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: The fruit shake drinks really are wonderful. We came back here 5 times before we had to leave Huế, it was that good! And such a good price! The corn salad (which was ok) is a warm, not a cold salad. Note: the restaurant will relocate to the owner’s place (“ Ly’s House” in a month or two. reviews: Regardless what you like for breakfast they got it and it s the best quality. Amazing spread, amazing staff., Efficient welcome service. If you are tired of walking around the city in the constant rain, this restaurant offers a varied menu including dishes, among other things, typically Vietnamese. The dishes ordered were very good.
description: THE BEST BREAKFAST IN TOWN with a superb selection of the freshest ingredients, Rumba restaurant offers a buffet-style breakfast experience to enjoy Vietnamese, Asian and Western cuisine.

name: The Rustic Kitchen & Chill Bar
address: 46 Pham Ngu Lao, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Ate here on the last night in Hue after we stumbled upon the ‘tourist’ area. Great cocktails (£3 and they were on offer at £1.50) and the lovely local food starting for £2.50 per plate. Bargain! One thing you need to get used to, they Vietnamese people don’t have a concept of starters then main courses, whatever you order can come at anytime so be prepared., On the way back from drinks we stopped for a glass of Italian shutdowns wine. Great service and a nice view of young people going for for the next 10 beers, Great cozy place with surprisingly good experienced servers. Food was good but not excellent. The entire atmosphere invites you in. Give it a try.

name: Dong Tam Bakery
address: 122 Le Loi Phu Hoi Ward, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: WE had the very popular Vietnamese sandwich Bahn mi. I got it with pork, you can have chicken , fish, or vegetarian. Bahn mi is the Vietnamese name for bread. In addition to the meat, there is cilantro, cucumber,pickled carrots, pickled daikon, pate, along with jalapeno and mayonnaise. It cost $.50 american. What a deal.
description: Đong Tam bakery is located in 122 Le Loi street. We are very proud of giving a fast food, deliciouss and safe for all guest. you can enjoy many kinds of cakes from our bakery such as: grapes cakes, coconut cakes, suger cakes,batiso, socolate cakes...for sorf meal, or bread, sweeet or grapes sanwich for breakfast, luch or dinner...

address: Feb03 Park Le Loi Street, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Had potential just never reached it. We were only ones in restaurant at 4.30pm so early but no one else around asked for table outside on top deck many tables were set up but they put us at a table not set up. Took a long time to get drinks , although whilst waiting there was a rat scuttling around who seemed quite friendly and didn’t bother us lol, staff hadn’t seen it. At least it showed the restaurant wasn’t going to sink lol. Food arrived then it started raining si were moved down one floor - had sweet and sour pork flavour was lovely pity the pork was full of bones and barely any meat on it pretty inedible but veges nice. Fiancé had beef stir fry which was ok beef chewy flavour ok. Rice was over cooked which was suprising in Vietnam. Also had fish and chips starter which was ok althooogh chips dry and not very nice. Ordered a cocktail Pina Colada was not cold and just tasted like alcohol. The place seemed set up for special occasions but very dated and a lot of staff but all very young. Advice not going here was 700000 nzd $47 for two mains and entree and 3 drinks , so yeah sure cheap by NZ standards but from what else we have had in Vietnam expensive for awful food. Place could be amazing but unf run down and dated and slow service., Nice view with the river and all, but the service was terrible. We just wanted to sit down and get some drinks. We ended up waiting 30 min to get our drinks even though the restaurant were not that busy ( + the drinks was overpriced compared to size and quality). When we wanted to pay the bill, we waited over 15 min after talking to a waiter before they came with the bill. Overall bad service., Thought I’d have my last evening meal in Hue on the Son Hương. I’d had a daytime beer to escape the heat on it a few days ago & the menu looked decent enough. I couldn’t fault the ambience but the food & service was very disappointing to say the least. I was advised that my choice would take 35 minutes but it turned up 10 minutes later & was cold. I already had my table placing whipped away from me prior to my meal being served & when I complained about the meal I was met with a half hearted apology.

address: Alley 33, Le Quy Don Street, Phu Hoi Ward, Hue Vietnam
reviews: This place is pretty local hiding in the alley. No other travelers while we eating. We ordered steak with eggs and cup of coffee. Taste is great. Word of advance: better learn a little bit vietnamese before you go as the locals may not understand english., In America it is very hard to find this dish as well as in Vietnam. My friend Tony took us here for breakfast and after coming to Vietnam 3 times now this is still my favorite breakfast I’ve had. The sauce they cook the egg and meat in was so delicious when dipping the baguette in. The sauce also goes superb with the meat and egg adding a wonderful flavor., I have been there since 2008 and when i came back this July, the taste was still good. You can choose variety dishes for your breakfast as steak, egg or chicken.

address: Duong Vo Thi Sau 53, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Absolutely fabulous food here - traditional Vietnamese, cheap prices. Perfect for our last meal in Hue. Can not recommend this highly enough. Very sweet price for quality. Also recommended for the reception., Amazing place, food is delicious and people are really nice! You can eat a 100% homemade food and take a cooking class. I had a great time learning how to cook Hué pancakes, Fried Spring rolls and chicken with lemongrass. You must try

address: 16th Floor, 08 Hung Vuong Imperial Hotel Hue, Phu Hoi, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: We saw the bar from the floating restaurant and decided to visit on 13th Feb 2023. You can simply walk into the Imperial hotel (which has very nice lobby) and take lift to 16th floor. On a warm evening it was magical with the city lit up at night. Cocktails were $6 and fine and good service by our waitress. The bar offers a selection of light meals so fine for lunch too. We were the only people there and the upper 17th floor is occupied by bonsai a small temple with traditional wooden tables overlooking koi pond (This bit is amazing). This is a real undiscovered gem and the only 'at height' outside bar/restaurant in Hue so we were baffled why it wasn't packed with people but guess few westerners post Covid. It was the same on 14th Feb when we returned for Restaurant (see that review) but suggest stick to bar to avoid disappointment in restaurant. We can't comment on the Imperial Hotel rooms (which were quite reasonable on internet) as we stayed at Pilgramige Village near out of town near Tombs., I visited this rooftop bar (the Imperial Hotel) for a drink. You can sit outside or inside and have a marvelous view of the city. If the weather is good, I recommend sitting outside. You can see the river and the Citadel and it is wonderful to see the lights come on. You have an amazing view of the French Bridge (built by Eiffel) and this bridge lights in a dramatic way in the evening. This is a great place to relax and have a drink.

address: 29 Tran Quang Khai, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: I ate in this restaurant three times while I stayed at the Alba Spa Hotel. Every time I had a meal here the staff were attentive, friendly and professional. The chef is a very good chef, the food was always very good quality, presented beautifully and cooked to perfection. There is a lot of dishes to choose from on the menu and very reasonably priced. The Vietnamese food was very tasty and I tried something from the Western element (the loin pork with mustard sauce) and that too was tasty and a lovely meal. Pineapple flambé for dessert was delicious. I recommend this restaurant highly., We had 7 different traditional Vietnamese dishes - it was very nice, very busy so you will need to book, After our busy morning tour we decided to eat at the restaurant in our hotel before going back out, and what a great decision that was. Our food was nicely presented and tasted absolutely delicious.

address: No 4 Nguyen Binh Khiem Street, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: The best place to eat banh hoi I've ever eaten. The wait was a bit long but extremely worth it. Banh nam is also delicious. I don't understand why this delicious restaurant has so few customers. Shrimp is very fresh. I went to Hanh restaurant (very crowded), went to a few other restaurants but this restaurant is the one I was most satisfied with., A small restaurant, hidden in a not touristic area, with local food, managed by a great and very friendly family. You can choose in between a la carte menu or (as recommended by them and also by us) a set of typical Hue dishes. Especially the "banh beo" was absolutely delicious, definitely recommended! After the lunch they were so kind to help us also with some directions and advices for the city: wonderful! The younger part of the staff speaks English: you must try this place!, We got this place recommended by our tour guide when we asked him to tell us where he would go for dinner with his family. He arranged as well the menu for us as the members of the family that run the restaurant are speking no english. The local Hué food was delicious. We ate all the Hué-dishes that were displayed on the menu except the Pho. Highly recommendable if you are looking for a place with authentic and local Hué food.
description: Huong Cau restaurant business about Hue local special foods. Come with us, you can enjoy tradition foods: Banh Beo, Banh Nam, Banh Loc, Banh Khoai, Cha Tom..with cooking methods was really specie. Restaurant is family restaurant style. You can feel hygiene, safe and was serverd thoughtful. Mrs Hong who owner was invited many time to guide" How to make local food "on Vietnam Television.

name: Garlic & Chives Restaurant
address: 02 Vo Thi Sau street, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: As tired travelers with children we came upon Garlic & Chives and were so delighted. The food was excellent and staff were so accommodating to our large group which included three kids. They sat us upstairs with air conditioning as they could tell we were hot and and the food was very good. I definitely recommend this restaurant., Garlic and Chives is a small family run restaurant with a wonderful menu. The food is delicious and very ethnic. Staff is helpful and speak English. Highly recommended., The environment of the restaurant was very warm and welcoming. Not only was the food incredible, but the service was amazing as well. The waiter was extremely kind and patient with my family and I didn't have to wait long for my food to come out. I would highly recommend this restaurant to everyone and I'm definitely coming back soon!!
description: Located in the heart of Hue at 02 Vo Thi Sau Street, Garlic & Chives Restaurant invites you to experience an extensive fusion of Western and traditional Vietnamese cuisine along with a great selection of wines, cocktails, and beers. Our highly trained professional chefs prepare this unique cuisine daily with special attention to detail at all levels. While at our restaurant, you will be served by a team of professional and friendly staff dedicated to serving both newcomers and locals. In addition to our exciting menu, we have a variety of daily promotions and free wifi. Private dining rooms, air-conditioned rooms, special holiday or party reservations, and other services are also available. ​

name: Vinh Lac Tran
address: 23 Chu Van An Phu Hoi, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: When we first got there it was almost empty, so we chose a place and got a menu and drinks. But not long after we were there the place began to fill up. They started pumping what I think was dry ice out into the street. And it started to get very loud with the music and all the people. By the time we left it was completely full and people were waiting to get a table. Wow, it was a very popular place with the locals and was very noisy., Great choice of good food. Seafood, seashells, shrimps, frogs, meat. The waiters are a little bit chaotic and speak small English. Very nice location., Me and friend accidentally found this palace since there were the boy at the gates that spoke English fluently. Rare occasion, by our opinion. Nonetheless, food were docent and we didn’t have anything too negative to say regards that. But looks like it is hard to get someone to explain you what we ordered or what get any good recommendation. Prices are modest as well. From outside, this restaurant looks fabulous. If we could only eat by looking.

name: Quan Nho
address: 28 Pham Hong Thai, Hue Vietnam
reviews: This small food store is a typical of restaurant in Vietnam, where you can get the best street food at the cheapest price. I usually choose this kind of restaurant on my journey to save my money:), Order Com Hen (top thing on the menu on the wall) add a little of the shrimp paste and a healthy dose of chili. Thank me later. Too strong of a flavor for many westerners, but if you can hack it... this is a taste and texture extravaganza!!
description: This small food store is a typical of restaurant in Vietnam, where you can get the best street food at the cheapest price. I usually choose this kind of restaurant on my journey to save my money:)

name: Century Pub Beer Garden
address: 49 Le Loi Street, Hue Vietnam
reviews: If the wind is in the right direction you can probably hear the music in Hanoi! Technopop with a male and female DJ taking turns at the helm. A lively crowd of all ages. I found it irresistible and went back a few times but can understand why it might not be to everyone's taste. As it is very open you can stand outside and observe what's going and decide whether you want to in or not., This place was massive! We arrived around 10pm and there was a DJ. Although the bar wasn’t full there were enough people to have an atmosphere. It looked fairly boring in the day time but was a great place to go in the night if you are looking for a bit of fun., This place is very conveniently located in the central district of Hue. Not a great place if you're looking for gourmet food but perfect if you're looking for late night hunger-killing bar food. PERFECT if you are looking to socialize, grab a few beers, and listen to some amazing music from around the world. Staff is very friendly, DJs are awesome, and you will not leave disappointed. Drinks are priced very affordably, and so sticker shock is not much of a pain. A MUST-DO for all travelers in the central Hue area that are looking for some down time and relaxation!

address: 57/3 Nguyen Cong Tru street, Hue Vietnam
reviews: The cake is vey delicious and the design is beautiful Having a lot of kinds of drinks to choose in the menu, The restaurant is located in a small alley, attached to the Serene shining hotel. Google threw up some reviews of the place and they didn't disappoint. Vietnamese food can seem a bit unfamiliar if you haven't lived in SE Asia and you need a helping hand. That's where they came in. Katie & Ivy were very helpful - they helped us with recommendations from the menu and patiently answered all our questions about the food., Great services ... All staff were very approachable, sincere and genuinely warm. Vivian, the manager was friendly and chatted with us and Made sure our orders were ok. Love the breakfast menu.
description: We are proud to introduce to you the richness of Vietnamese culture through the many traditional dishes my immigrant mother still prepares at home. We offer the freshest ingredients possible, in order to enhance the taste of our dishes as they should be prepared. Specialty dishes may change seasonally so that we may feature and purchase local produce and meats.

name: Old Money Cafe & Cocktails
address: 26 kiệt 64 Nguyễn Công Trứ Thông kiệt 41 Nguyễn Thái Học, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: We were so lucky to have been recommended Old Money when we arrived in Hue looking for somewhere for a drink... this is genuinely one of the best bars I've been in (and I travel a lot)...unless you've been told where to go, you'd miss it... hence the clientele is mainly locals... firstly the cocktails are sensational, the staff are incredibly welcoming and knowledgable, add to that the soft jazz soundtrack and you start to sense the atmosphere... We were only in Hue three nights but we made sure to return to end our stay... we checked with the owner to ask whether he was happy for us to share his secret as we didn't want to spoil it for the locals... he has an inclusive vision... he wants everyone to enjoy Hue and his wonderful cocktail bar... so please, don't miss this wonderful gem ...

address: 5 Chu Văn An Phú Hội, Hue Vietnam
reviews: The restaurant is big and that makes it cooler inside on a hot day and has plenty of fans. Nice ambience. We had four meals here for good food and convenience. The chef came out to discuss a dish with us and later came to see if we enjoyed it. The menu offers plenty of choice - descriptions are in Vietnamese, French and English. Service is with a smile and excellent. Liked that the first thing we were given upon being seated was a cool, wet towel. Bathrooms available too., I happened to pass by and saw a beautiful restaurant so I stopped in to try some spaghetti. The noodles are fragrant with butter and the sauce is very delicious. If I have a chance, I will stop by again!
description: The restaurant is located on the pedestrian street in the city center, close to tourist attractions, train station, hotels, ... with a variety of dishes, suitable for domestic and foreign tourists.

name: Ba Hoa
address: Truong Dinh st, Hue Vietnam
reviews: We wanted to try Com Hen as recommended as a Hue specialty and oh my it was so delicious! A fantastic clam broth with delicious stir fried baby basket clams, noodles, vegetables and roast peanuts. It tasted rich and flavoursome. The service was friendly and helpful and very inexpensive., Aloha, We were recommended this place by Saigon Morin Hotel just around the corner. It was so good. The space level was great. Found myself wolfing it down and had to slow down. The folks were very nice to us. We also had Bun Hen and Bun Bo Hue, all good. And always cold Huda Beer. This is a repeat on the next visit. Mahalo

name: Hue Riverside Resort and Spa
address: 588 Bui Thi Xuan Street Thuy Bieu District, Hue 053000 Vietnam
reviews: Stayed here for three days, everything was great, especially the rooms with riverview and a bath. Beds were very comfortable. Breakfast was good and plenty., Wonderful place with friendly helpful staff, food was excellent and room was very clean. A peaceful place., The hotel is located at the perfume river and offers the perfect getaway from hectic city life. Very friendly staff and nice, clean rooms. Breakfast buffet is very good.
description: Stayed here for three days, everything was great, especially the rooms with riverview and a bath. Beds were very comfortable. Breakfast was good and plenty.

name: Hue Spring Bar-Restaurant
address: 64 Le Loi, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Tonight we had dinner in the Hue Spring Bar-Restaurant. We ordered the Beef-Curry for both of us. It took 30 minutes and it was okay but too expansive for that manue. The sandwiches on the other tables looked good. And the service seemed to be not really motivated and we had to wave all the time..., Had dinner here tonight and it was above average, nothing great but enough to get a pass. Friendly staff who are attentive. We had spring rolls, calamari and 2 pork dishes. The missus had the meal of the night, it was grilled pork with BBQ sauce. The calamari came battered, I was expecting crumbed, so I guess that's on me for not asking. The calamari itself was ok, but the rings were pretty small under the batter. I had the local pork dish with rice, it was a little too chewy for me and the fat attached to it definitely needed to be cooked longer as to make it not just taste like fat. Total cost of meal was $19 AUD, so not too bad. Give it a try, I guess it's like most places, can be hit and miss depending on what you order., We had a lovely dinner here. The staff were very attentive, maybe they read the last review and have made efforts to improve as we couldn't fault them. The food was delicious, we had the local specialities, they also have an extensive western menu (which we avoided). It wasn't the cheapest place we've eaten but was under 500k for family of 4 including drinks. I'd happily go again.

reviews: I was greeted like an old friend when I arrived at Ruby Bistro. The hostess and owner Thinh and her staff were so helpful and friendly and showed me straight to my room. The bed was comfortable , room simple but great for 250,000 vnd per night and the shower nice and hot. The food here is outstanding . I recommend razor clams in garlic which were sublime . The location is central to the backpacking scene and quite lively at night .Don't expect a very quiet stay. That said I slept like a log.

I had to order a second one!, I was delighted to find this little street side cafe on my evening walk. PEACE sits on a quiet stretch of sidewalk in front of Huong Giang Travel on Le Loi just west of the entrance to the ancient, riverside Walking Street. Food is all cooked to order by friendly, eager-to-please staff. The fare is light.....hot sandwiches, burgers and crepes. Beer is served cold and with lots of ice. Can’t beat the price either. I live here, so I’ll come back often!, What's a tasty hamberger! It's only 1 dollar. Staffs are very cute! The location is easy to find, located on the sidewalk and very cool . After eating, you can go to the "walking street by night" near by 600 meters.

address: 9 Ngo Quyen Street Vinh Ninh Ward, Hue City, Hue Vietnam
reviews: We visited this restaurant 3 times for dinner during our stay in Hue and never ran out of delicious food options! Lots of vegan options. Very low cost for large servings of food! Great service and knowledgeable staff. Lovely Vietnamese cuisine. Would recommend to anyone!, This clean, cool restaurant is found at the back of Park View Hotel. The menu with pictures and English translation is easy to navigate. Enjoyed the thick slurpy mango juice (bit on the sweet side) followed by main course of braised jack fruits and steamed rice. Highly recommended, good food of good value., Amazing vegetarian food for very cheap prices. Service is also very good and the dining area itself is very comfortable. We had tofu sauteed with mushrooms and wheat gluten (sometimes known as seitan) fried with vegetables. Absolutely delicious!
description: We visited this restaurant 3 times for dinner during our stay in Hue and never ran out of delicious food options! Lots of vegan options. Very low cost for large servings of food! Great service and knowledgeable staff. Lovely Vietnamese cuisine. Would recommend to anyone!

name: Pizza Amour
address: 21 Lê Quý Đôn Phú hội, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Very good pizza! Very cheap! We are here with 4 persons, pizza drinks and dessert for about 15 euro. Quality was very good, Average pizzas, i think they might have sugar in the dough, which was different from what i am used to, so maybe not a bad thing, just different. Good smoothies! The menu is not quite clear on whats on the pizzas, like the description on pizza Hawaii is "Five-O" and there are more examples like that, gave me a good laugh while reading the menu though!, We went to try out Pizza Amour our first night in Hue because we were located just down the street. The food was ok. The Japanese noodle with fried soy was simply spaghetti with fried tofu in a sweet tomato sauce. The pizza was small and the cheese (margarita) came with olives and red peppers which is a little out of the ordinary. It too was ok. The deserts (we tried almost all) were ok, with the crepe with lemon taking the win for best dish of the night. As for the service, if you guessed ok, then good job! The staff were friendly enough. After being seated upstairs though, we were pretty well ignored once our food was brought to us. We had to go back down to order desserts and drinks. The price, although cheap, is reflected in the portion size, making it ok. Altogether once was enough and we didn't return. We wouldn't recommend it as there's better places nearby.
description: Very good pizza! Very cheap! We are here with 4 persons, pizza drinks and dessert for about 15 euro. Quality was very good

name: Bigben Coffee - Restaurant
address: 40 Nguyen Tri Phuong, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: This is a friendly family restaurant. The cook is so good I gave him my prescription sun glasses! The waitress is prompt and friendly with very good English. The food is authentic Vietnamese and the beer is cold. Budget priced and a convenient location. I was a solo traveller from Canada and ate there frequently. Wished I could be there now. Spent a pleasant evening during a flood drinking beer with endless gratis peanuts and visiting during the last night in the city, Stumbled across this place when we first arrived in Hue. The food is really cheap and tasty. I would really recommend the pork and veg crispy noodles, some of the best I've had. Service was good, this is a no frills place with awesome food, Went there for dinner and it was full so the staff brought table for us from somewhere on the back. It was busy but waitress took our order quickly and we didn't wait too long for the food. We had pancake with pork and shrimp and pork skewers with rice paper to DIY. Everything was very tasty. Definitely recommend this place.

address: 30/42 Nguyen Cong Tru Street, Hue Vietnam
reviews: On our third day in Hue and just changed accomodation so very close to here. Found Vietnam very disappointing so far outside of Hanoi for food cheap eats. We enjoy a fried rice type of lunch, cheap and fills us up until dinner. Walked passed here after deliberating at a few menus and decided to go in. Completely empty but bearing in mind it’s only 1pm on a Thursday and Hue seems fairly quiet compared to other places we have travelled in the last 6 weeks. I got the chicken fried rice and very happy, well seasoned and tasty. My boyfriend got the pork and shrimp pankcake and thoroughly enjoyed it. Well priced and tasty food. We don’t really expect much in the terms of “service” whilst in Asia, we are backpacking and on a budget, a saved €2 is colossal to us. Service wasn’t bad despite saying that., The food was excellent and the staff was so warm and welcomingm Haooy hour, all kinds of discounts and free fruit platters. Ambient sounds and fishes swimming around. Would go again., We went here after a recommendation from our hotel for a lunch, and even had dinner the day after because it was that good. It was without a doubt the best Vietnamese food we had in Vietnam! Try the chicken with lemongrass, shrimps in garlic and the fresh spring rolls. You will not regret it! Very good quality for the price. Besides: if you go now, you have a chance of seeing the two 4 weekold puppy's, who are adorable. Big thumps up!
description: Opening from 7:00 am to 22:00 pm Local restaurant with real local food Traditional food with friendly service from local people Restaurant with air conditioning Quiet location with nice to talk with local family Vietnam local food with local price The restaurant with nice view & design.it will bring more comfortable for the guests when they stay here

reviews: Not sure, but I went into the Victory Bar for a drink and noticed that I kind of got curious looks. When inside, I noticed that there was nothing but young Vietnamese men there and half were in some kind of uniform. I am not gay, but I have been to gay bars with gay friends and this appeared to be one. No big deal......just prefer women., The bar is so funny, i have 2 night in here. All the guys inside made me crazy and really horrible. And music, too. Not at all, but some guys from their staff were really really really RUDE ! Say never with Victory ! Never.

It was a pleasant break from our interesting but hectic tour. I wouldn't suggest you fly across the Pacific Ocean just to have lunch here, but if you happen to be in the area, you should give it a try., Very friendly service. reviews: A unique Hue specialty restaurant where you can try the tasty Banh Khoai (Hue rice pancake). Also should try their duck dishes as those are really good. The duck meat is tender and moist. Owner is super nice as well., Im already one month in Hue and I needed to find place like this :) Really friendly sfaff, speaking deutsch also. Really good values prices :)

address: 5 Tran Cao Van, Hue Vietnam
reviews: We went there for the famous Bun Bo Hue, but we were not expecting this at all and the meat inside was questionable... But what made us regret our dinner is that they made us pay twice the price we should have payed, just because we are tourists... They are thief!, Bun Bo Hue is one of the defining foods of Hue and this is the place to have it. Just show up at the corner restaurant and you will be shown a seat. No need to struggle with a menu, the hearty soup will just be placed in front of you with a bowl of seasoning herbs to add as you wish. Delicious.

reviews: Wouldn't go back. Small servings and the 'hot pot' is tiny. Search on TA for somewhere better. Atmosphere was good though., Good food. Wide range of options on the menu. name: Anh Cookery
address: 3/11 Võ Thị Sáu, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: If you're looking for an authentic, wholesome and delicious cooking experience I would highly recommend Anh's Cookery! We were graciously invited into Anh's family's home to cook three typical dishes from Hue (the secret food capital of Vietnam). Apart from the delicious food, our highlight was the genuine and interesting conversations we had with Anh. He was a really great chef and cool person!, Anyone who visits the food capital that is Hue, is 100% missing out if they don’t take this class. Such a great experience with a very skilled chef. Learned plenty about food, culture and technique and the food was nothing short of absolutely delicious. Anh is also incredibly knowledgeable and has always been more than helpful in answering any questions we had. Great experience over all! In short: Highly recommended and an absolute must-do for anyone visiting Hue!:-), We're really happy we found Anh's Cookery, it was exactly what we wanted in a cooking class and would highly recommend it. Anh speaks fantastic English and is very personable and talkative. He will pick you up from your hotel and go straight to the market where you can ask him any questions you might have about Hue food and culture as you peruse the vendors. Then he takes you back to his lovely kitchen in a peaceful but central neighborhood in Downtown Hue. There you prepare the food, drink tea and chat about anything and everything. Anh teaches you some practical cooking skills and shows you how to make a variety of dishes. We especially liked the green mango salad and BBQ with homemade peanut sauce. By the end of it we were stuffed and ready for a nap! Overall, highly recommend. We learned how to make some nice Hue dishes and loved Anh's family and kitchen. It was a relaxing, fun experience.
description: Anh Cookery inspire foodies to authentic and traditional Vietnamese food. Anh Cookery is a small local business with passion from local chef to bring foodies all over the world taste flavorful Vietnamese cuisine with love.

reviews: As this is a tour bus place, don't expect haute cuisine. However, the food was very good and plentiful. The drinks are reasonably priced and the service quick and friendly., We had eaten here 2 meals with my Students group I think the food was good, but it's not fit for north person, the food was sweet and spciy, First day we aet Frist Floor and Second day we aet Second floor, I think Reasonable price 100VND for 1 pack., I had a chance to have lunch at this restaurant during my city tour in Hue. Its architecture looks gentle. The best thing, for me, is the friendliness of the staff. They were helpful to give more interesting about the dishes we chose. A nice restaurant!
description: Thang Long city tour company is located in the heart of Hue city, one of companies is leading to organize inbound and outbound tour programs in Hue city. besides, Thang Long city tour company has 1 hotel names City tour Hotel with 25 city view rooms with a lots of supported services and Thang Long city tour restaurant which have just moved to a new site with modern equipment, fresh, airy space ,can contain up to 500 persons.

name: Mama's House Hue
address: 11 Nguyen Cong Tru, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Very tasty food! and very friendly and smart staff. They were helping us a lot. And made some discounts or compliments. So thankful to them! And hello to everyone. your friends from Russia, Gektor and Karina., My husband and I have come here to eat a couple times and the food has been great! The first time, we ordered a 35cm pizza which was NOT 35cm..it was only 25cm (we measured it with a ruler because we were shocked that it was 35cm.. turns out it wasn’t). We asked about the size and it turns out they don’t even make 35cm pizzas because their oven can’t fit a pizza that big.. now that the issue has been addressed, I believe they’ve covered the 35cm option and only serve 25cm. The pizza was one of the better pizzas we’ve had—the crust was crunchy (not soft/mushy/doughy like almost all other places we’ve tried) which was just perfect for us. The second time we ate here we had a burger, which was hands down one of the BEST burgers we’ve eaten in Vietnam! Their burgers seem to be double patties so they are pretty filling, but well worth ordering. Stacked high and topped with melty cheese and fresh garnishes and a small side of fries, the burgers look like they’re straight out of a magazine ..and taste even better! The menu is far too big, however, and their marketing is so so so confusing. They call themselves a burger house but also have pizza, pasta, Vietnamese food, fried chicken, crepes.... if they cleaned up their marketing and served just burgers and lowered their prices, they’d make a killing and would probably jump from #153 to the top 20 or better on the ratings., We had an awesome dinner here, super good food with amazing flavours for an affordable price. Definitely recommended when in Hue.I also was impressed by the friendly staff , especially the manager on duty, Mrs. Ny (Nhi, i don't remember ) always be smile and take care us. I didn't know that it has the hotel, too.
description: Western and vietnamese cuisine.

name: Nam Phuong Restaurant
address: 12/1 Alley 33, Nguyen Cong Tru Street, Hue Vietnam
reviews: We were here for dinner. We ordered a baguette with minced meat with French fries and coleslaw and the Pho with chicken. The baguette was rather tasteless, the French fries and coleslaw very good. The Pho was excellent, good broth, lots of chicken, vegetables and herbs. Both were reasonably priced. For drinks we had a can of local Huda beer, good for 50k dong(2€). A small bottle of water, the Italian brand Panna was an absurd 129k dong(5€). Very friendly service., This is the Nam Phuong hotel restaurant at the Silk Path Hotel in Hue. The food was simply terrific. Very refined, beautifully presented, attentive service. Our favorite dish was the duck sautéed with ginger — amazing! The restaurant itself is simply gorgeous. This meal was the highlight of our 10 days in Vietnam., You have to look for this place as it is hiding down an alley. Once you arrive, you'll be surprised how large of a space it is. A nice open setting. Service was great even though they didn't speak English (French is spoken though). I enjoyed my meal of vegetables and noodles and a smoothy.

name: Be Kem - Banh Trang Kep
address: 29 Ngo Gia Tu, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Banh Trang Kep is a popular Vietnamese street snack known for its crispy texture and flavorful toppings. It’s usually grilled with ingredients like egg, dried beef, and green onions, then served with a tasty dipping sauce. Affordable and delicious, it’s a must-try for street food lovers.

address: 69A Võ Thị Sáu, Hue 53000 Vietnam
reviews: The food was fabulous, with a combination of Italian and a Vietnamese menu. The restaurant also provided free appetiser of bruschetta, (so good) , a soft drink or beer and some fruit after our mains. The waitress Huong was welcoming, polite and attentive which enhanced our first night experience , in Walking Street in Hue. They had some happy hour deals also for the food.

address: 35 Nguyễn Công Trứ Phú Hội, Hue 49000 Vietnam
reviews: I sent my husband and 16 yo son in to kill time while I got haircuts for the other 2, I wish I’d sent my husband for the cuts so I could have more time to chill here! Free pool and the awesome guy working spent half an hour or more playing pool with our 12 yo and teaching him great technique. It was mid-afternoon, so not too busy, but it was a great place to hang out and spend a couple of hours in Hue. Great price on drinks also!, Played a game of pool/billiards, had a coffee and a beer. They gave us a free cup of tea as well. Very chill vibes., Good vibe, local gang put, beer and reasonably priced cocktails, served with enthusiasm. Pool table and good music. Worth a visit

name: Pinetree House Restaurant Huế
address: Cu Chanh 1, Thuy Bang, Hue, Vietnam, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: We were taken to this restaurant while on a tour with the Vietnam-based Legend tour company. This place is a gem and the meal was one of the highlights of our tour. First, we sat outdoors and the ambiance was brilliant. The wait staff was so very attentive. The food (we had a vegetarian lunch) included seven dishes including a vegetarian soup, mushrooms tempura, wrapped tofu, salad and a flan desert all wonderfully tasty. Other members of the group told us that the meat dishes were excellent. I ordered a coconut drink which was a coconut, straw and tiki umbrella. Very retro and spot on! Do go here!

It has a much more extensive menu than Hanh Restaurant- making it an easier place to return to for pescatarians. Very inexpensive too. The squid with lemon leaves blew my mind!, This is a local Hue restaurant with lovely staff (even though they do not speak English) and great food. Good spot to try local specialities! reviews: Very good traditional Bun Bo Hue. The broth was a bit spicy but very nice. Really good value for price, one bowl ranged from 30-50k D. Place is not very attractive, but can highly recommend!, Fantastic beef noodle soup. Their crab balls is a must try. Their broth-heavenly. You don’t know what you’re missing if you don’t try., I came here with my family in the first day of 2021 and I feel it is good flavor and true traditional Hue beef noodles. They open only from 2pm to 6pm but many people come here for afternoon meal. For the full menu it is noodles with beef, fork, steam blood but You can use noodles with beef or fork. It is specal if you can use it with chili. The customer service is good and reasonable price. If you visit Hue and you want to try Traditional noodles you should go there

address: 28/106 Nguyen Lo Trach street Xuan Phu District, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: I ordered shipping to my home, the shop delivered very quickly and reliably. Milk tea and Milo are extremely easy to cook, the milk powder is rich, if you like sweet drinks, you should add more condensed milk 🤩 vegetarian bread is very suitable for my family's taste. Will definitely order food from this shop many times again 🥰, This is a takeaway vegan stall, with some special fast food that is suitable for all ages. I have tried "banh mi nuong" and "vegan pizza" here. It is very tasty. Also, you can try the combo with some fresh and clean drinks such as milk tea, fruit tea, and Vietnamese coffee., I have eaten a lot of things here, and I think it is delicious, the food is clean, the staff is enthusiastic, and the price is affordable. There is also a staff who knows English, which is very convenient. There is a puppy that is so cute. If I have the opportunity, I will definitely come again. I will become a regular here.
description: Take-away F&B service - We provide variety of coffee styles and other beverages served along with unique preparation processes. Besides, we offer fast-food and snack that are totally vegetarian (but you will not feel that it is) that will leverage your appetite. All you need to do is just sitting at where you are and making order, then you can relax, put on makeup, get ready to start the day and receive your food and drinks prepared by us. You can choose to pick-up at our court or get a home-delivery. Quầy đặt đồ ăn chay và thức uống ngon, chất lượng. Có hỗ trợ dịch vụ giao tận nơi nếu bạn không thể đến nhận đơn hàng tại quầy. Nhuận An hướng đến cung cấp trải nghiệm dịch vụ đặt món và lấy tại quầy tiết kiệm thời gian và chi phí. Thực đơn đồ ăn tại quầy hàng của Nhuận An hoàn toàn từ nguyên liệu chay và đảm bảo hương vị đậm đà, thơm ngon. Thức uống tại quán được pha chế từ nguyên liệu tự nhiên, chất lượng với công thức sáng tạo từ chuyên gia qua đào tạo Barista nhiều năm trong nghề.

He is passionate about sharing Hue cuisine and is taking English lessons so he can start teaching and sharing his family recipes with the world. Today he invited us to a very special "off the menu" lunch feast. We tried delicacies he doesn't offer such as jellyfish!!!! A once in a lifetime experience and a real honour! He also makes absolute divine happy water.....the best we've tasted anywhere in S.E. Asia!!! His customers are both vietnamese tourists and foreigners alike!, Overall brilliant the food was great especially the bahn ram it and it was a very peacefull environment to chill out in aswell as this the service was great. Overall amazing

reviews: This is a great spot for solo travelers or a small group. The wings were fantastic and just what I was looking for for a small break from Vietnamese food. The restaurant has a really cool dining area which is indoor/outdoor, and the staff are very kind. On top of the great food, the prices are very reasonable and probably even a little cheaper than the other non-Vietnamese food spots in town. Come check this place out in Hue!, Amazing wings and sauces. It really was delicious. Great atmosphere. Nice decor. Great service! Good prices. This was a great find and worth catching a ‘Grab’ to come and visit!
description: Saucy Hue. The best place in town for your chickenwing cravings! We have a wide range of worldwide sauces that are all homemade. From local home-fermented chilli sauces to Japanese Teriyaki and Dutch Joppie! On the side, we provide garden salads, rice and home-made french fries. To quench your thirst we have a wide range of drinks, going from Fresh fruit juices to soft drinks and cokctails. Come and enjoy!

name: Pizza Kat
address: Nha 43 Kiet 42 Nguyen Cong Tru, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Fab pizza at good prices...clean and modern with fans and some kind of boy band music 😄. There was no beer in so the waitress went and got me some elsewhere., ...really poor service. I've asked twice for fresh chili 🌶️ and still 10 minutes later you have to receive it. I just showed the waiter a picture of chili pepper - let's see if he gets it after a third time. Pizza is undercooked, there's definitely a severe lack of toppings on it. Well I got the chili but it's uncut. I guess I could do that myself with the butter knife. They don't use fresh dough here for the pizza, some kind of prefabricated bread disk that was previously frozen. I am so disappointed my dinner sucks. I only ate a couple pieces, I'm saving room so I can go someplace else and have something else., Decided to have a quick drink but then also ordered pizza and fried banana cake. Delicious and low prices, pina colade mocktails for 25,000 that taste good. Got some free fruit afterwards. Top!

name: Ong Tao
address: 134 Rue Ngo Duc Ke, Hue Vietnam
reviews: If you fancy some old school tradicional Vietnamese food, go to this restaurant. You can order several small portions of everything so you can taste different thighs. The beef rolls with mint leaves are a must! Don't be put off by the lack of westerners!, Not really Hue food because you can see in their menu many dishes of Southern Vietnam. The food is good. The price is reasonable., If you want to taste Hue traditional cakes or fresh noodle like banh loc, banh nam, bún bò ... it's not a good choice. This restaurant serves dishes for daily family lunch and dinner cooked in Hue recipes. Most of dishes are made from chicken, beef, pork and seafood. We ordered a basic Vietnamese lunch: a dish of stir-fried vegetable, roasted shrimp and pork, a bowl of sweet and sour bamboo soup and cooked rice. Really good taste! It was different from the same dishes' favour in the North and much better than in the South. I can't review its space because we chose a table on the terrace at the 1st floor where we could enjoy streets' view while eating. The price was reasonable, we (group of 3) paid around 200.000 dong for all.

reviews: Friendly staff, but they don’t understand a single word of English. Beer was warm. Food OK, but not to western standards (not that we should expect this, but just to share with you). As a matter of fact we had better diner in the middle of the mountains with very local people. Therefore only 2 out of 5., Took a while to find the bar area in Hue and this was the first bar we came across. Good place to sit with a cold beer and see what is happening. Lots of locals were eating and the food looked to be okay but we decided that we wanted more of a restaurant type place to eat so had another beer and headed off., OK to sit at the wooden tables on the footpath and have a well priced Tiger Crystal early on in the night but music gets too loud to be comfortable later on. Near impossible to get the attention of the young male staff who sit around smoking instead of serving customers. Currently busy later in the night when showing the World Cup. Mostly locals. Have not tried the food yet and probably won't from what I've seen. Just OK for a quick beer before moving on elsewhere.

description: BUN CHA (Bún chả) is a Vietnamese dish of grilled pork and noodle, which is thought to have originated from Hanoi, Vietnam. Bún chả is served with grilled fatty pork (chả) over a plate of white rice noodle (bún) and herbs with a side dish of dipping sauce. The dish was described in 1959 by Vietnamese food writer Vu Bang (1913–1984) who described Hanoi as a town “transfixed by bún chả.” Hanoi’s first bún chả restaurant was on Gia Ngư, Hoàn Kiếm District, in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. Bún chả originated and remains very popular in Hanoi. Outside Hanoi, across all regions of Vietnam, a similar dish of rice vermicelli and grilled meat called bún thịt nướng is alternately served. US President Obama and world-renowned culinary expert Anthony Bourdain have enjoyed this dish on the time they in Vietnam The fist time in Hue city, Vietnam had a restaurant inside BUNCHA HOUSE, have “BUN CHA – NEM RAN” (Bún chả – Nem Rán) to server you. We would like to comment all of customer come to Hue city, VN

address: 8 Dinh Tien Hoang Street, Hue Vietnam
reviews: The food is delicious and the prices are right! Chicken, veggies and steamed rice for 70,000 vnd. Spring rolls for 40,000 vnd. Ice tea for 5,000 vnd. The tea is homemade, cold, and unsweetened. There are fans and higher chairs and metal tables. Comfortable street food. Over all we spent three weeks in Hue and are here multiple times even though it was across the bridge from where we were. It was worth the walk. Plus the entrance to the citadel is up the road if the old city is on the list of things to do., A family run gem near the citadel gate entrance. The prices are right. 5000 vnd for a cold ice tea. #42 is chicken with steamed rice and veggies for 70000 vnd. Also tried spring rolls for 40000 vnd. All delicious! The veggie plate is a mixture of carrot, cabbage, onion, tomato, string beans, bamboo shoots and a tasty sauce. They even have homemade chili sauce for those spicy folks out there. Over our three week stint in Hue we ate multiple times here. Highly recommend!, We had a delicious lunch of bun bo hue, banh beo, and bun chay after touring the imperial city, the menu has many seafood and vegetarian options in addition to the meat focused items. We were also able to get our banh beo with just the shrimp and no pork. If you want a sit down restaurant and not just a stool near the palace this is a great option.

reviews: This restaurant was highly recommended both by our guide and the hotel concierge. The restaurant has two locations in Hue. We ended up going to the one in 79 Le Loi st. A disappointment. First off, they said they had AC. Alltough technically correct (there was a split unit on the wall), they didn’t want to turn it on and they brought as a fan. Then came the ordering… We first ordered drinks: Beers for the adults and fantas and water for the young. After 10 minutes they only brought the beers and they told us that they didn’t have fanta and that they had ran out of bottled water… I ended up telling them to go to a store to buy water (which they did, warm water). We ordered plenty of dishes and each time the waiter said they were very good dishes. Some of them came with different ingredients (which they recognised only when yountold them) and some others they ended up saying after a while that they did not habe that dish. Truly a dissappointment. I just hope the original khong gian xua is better than this one. We’ll not go to try it though…., We enjoyed our dinner very much at this restaurant! The manager is very kind and he spoke perfectly English. He helped us to choose the right food as we have to eliminate sugar from our diet! Wonderfully decorated dishes and very tasty food. A lovely small restaurant., This restaurant has bad food and bad service. Too expensive and they trick customers into ordering 1 and getting 2 (see pic). Never come back

name: The Hub Beer - Lounge - Restaurant
address: 8 Hung Vuong Street, Hue Vietnam
reviews: This is so weird as I'm still in this place finishing my beer after not being able to finish my meal - I honestly could not chew it. I'm actually having a giggle as it's my own fault-first night in Hue, not sure of my surroundings!! Stopped at the 1st open air place closest to where I was staying. I was the only customer with 5 or 6 staff and the lovely waitress tried to take my order but spoke no English. I tried to use google translate but it was a bit frustrating. I've never reviewed a place while I'm still at it! To cut a long story short, before I even got my food, my table had been wiped 4 times, sort of like each time I took a sip of my drink. The food was simply the worst meal I have been served in my life! I attempted to chew a calamari ring with no success. You should be able to see it on the plate in the photo. 'Tough as boot leather' comes nowhere near describing this food. Can't wait to experience some of the delicious offerings that Hue has to offer. The staff were hovering around to an uncomfortable extent and I eventually asked the to give me some space. I'm just about to give them some- forever!
description: The hub is the premier venue for great foods, beer and nightlife in Hue city. It is located in the center area of Hue city on Hung Vuong street, about 200 meters (0.1 mile) from the popular tourist spot, Truong Tien bridge. We offer a large variety of hand-crafted cocktails, local and imported draft and bottled beers. We have live DJ music every night of the week. Come and enjoy.

name: King Restaurant
address: 27 Nguyen Sinh Sac, Hue Vietnam
reviews: The King's Panorama Bar is a great place to have a sundowner and watch the sunset over the Perfume River. The place is a good place to unwind and have drinks with friends or family. The drinks are well priced and the snack food are good too. Highly recommend this place., Ok, a re-created Royal Banquet at the Imperial Court could be a little bit hokey if you aren't into it, but...if you let your imagination take over, you can have a really good time at this place. And who knows, you might be selected to wear Imperial Yellow - and impersonate the Emperor or Empress. Once you enter from the street, you are in a small courtyard where staff helps you to select a costume fit for an Imperial Banquet. Most are silk embroidered tunics with matching headdresses and, quite frankly, if you are with friends, it's a photo op. Everybody lines up and forms a procession into the dining room, and once seated, a group of musicians and singers takes over. As I understood, the entertainers are students who are studying traditional instruments and musical technique. They sell a very nice CD of their work; I listened to it a couple of times now and enjoy it. The same CD is on sale at the Imperial Palace. The food isn't bad. Course after course of traditional foods are brought to the table, each dish luxuriously garnished with vegetables carved into fanciful shapes. One dish has a pair of carp cut form carrots; another has a dragon made from another vegetable; another is garnished with kissing doves. There were ten courses in all and I particularly liked the lotus seed soup and the steamed fish with onions and vegetables. If you close your eyes for a minute and just think of how it might have been at court, it works. Relax, settle into the mood, and take a walk on the wild side. You'll be surprised how much fun it is., We had the green mango salad fantastic, the soup also terrific , the fried calamari a bit western and common. Met the owner a wonderful interesting entrepreneur

reviews: My friend told me should enjoy PHO when came to Vietnam. It's traditional food in vietnam. I have a good dinner here, everything is ok but it seem that the price is not fair. It seem that the foreigners must pay more than the local., We did eat pho here many times before when were students at uni. After 10 years, came back, they changed address to Ba Trieu ate, however the pho is not as nice as before. A bit disappointed, If u don't mind seeing the owner walk past with a handful of noodles for your dish to be cooked out the back then you are set. Although we were a little sceptical at first, we ate here and never got ill. It was authentic and full of flavour and the owners were lovely. We had pork in flour soup which was fried wontons on the side of a soup with veggies and beef fried noodles which were the best I've had in Vietnam. We also got a noodle soup which had some great flavour! It's certainly not fancy but if you want local and flavour with a smile, go here!

reviews: Two of us came here for the first time in Oct 8th. I tried a Teriyaki fried chicken, a Tokbokki and fried chicken rice with sweet and sour sauce. I seemed small but we were too full after the meal. The taste is super duper good. Not too salty, not too sweet, it is perfect. The spicies matched perfectly with each other. I was so impressed and surprised!!!!!!!!!!! But the most amazing part isn’t that. When I paid for the whole meal, the price didn’t high. Compare the price with the quality I didn’t believe that it can be that cheap. OMG!!!! Highly recommend for those who have a chance to come to Hue. You must’ve tried the food in this small and cozy Korean chicken restaurant!!! Obviously I will come back whenever I go back to Hue.
