name: Bangkok restaurant
address: 92 Le Viet Luong street, An Dong ward, Hue Vietnam
reviews: After a diet of vietnam food for the past few weeks it was a delight to find this thai restaurant in Hue Although the menu is not in english, the manager took great delight in helping us to choose from an array of Thai food. All staff very friendly and food exceptional. A lively and enegetic place and seems very popular with the young local people. May be a little noisey for some but if you want good Thai food at reasonable prices this is the place to go., Bangkok restaurant is located on a quiet back street five minutes from the tourist center. It is a family run restaurant and the owner is very friendly and speaks some English. He loves Thai culture and Thai food and one of his family members is from Thailand. He shared several tips with us about sights to see in Hue. We came with an appetite to conquer and sampled many items on the menu. The chicken and egg pad thai was exquisite. The noodles were not overcooked and the dish had just the right amount of spice to give it that essential kick. Unlike Pad Thai in the west it was not too sweet. The tofu dish was excellent and tasted even better than it looked on the menu. We also had the seafood noodle dish and it was spicy with lots of Thai seasonings. All of the portions are generous and you will not leave this restaurant hungry. We will definitely revisit Bangkok restaurant again in the future., The food here is good and the Thai chef does a great job. The remodel of this restaurant was for the worse. It was so much better when it was open air. It is unreasonably loud to the point that you can't hear the person across from you talking. It has the acoustics of a tin shed, because that's what it is. After coming in early in the day to reserve a table for dinner for a large group, we were assured that we would get a "special" table. We didn't. I asked them in advance to chill a case of beer. They didn't. When we asked for cold beer we got warm beer. Every table in the restaurant was screaming "mot, hai, ba, yo" and throwing beer cans on the floor. Yeah it's Vietnam and that's normal behavior, I get it, but this place took it to another level. At the table next to us, one guy was passed out laying across the bench seat, with legs and arms dangling on the floor, onto which his dining companion was vomiting. I wouldn't normally blame a restaurant for the behavior of customers but this seemed to be what the owners and management have created, a Vietnamese beer hall full of screaming, red-faced drunks, that happens to have pad Thai noodles and satay. We left after getting appetizers though the fifteen of us planned on staying for dinner but couldn't handle the "ambience." While it wasn't for us, they seem to be doing fine for business. The place was absolutely packed. It's a shame too because the food is good. I won't be back, maybe take out next time.
description: We are only Thai Restaurant in Hue , original Thai's chef and owner from Thailand. We have variety of authentic Thai's food with great atmosphere. name: Villa Hue Resaurant
address: 04 Tran Quang Khai Street, Hue Vietnam
reviews: A group of 5 of us came to this restaurant inside the Villa hotel after a visit to the Citadel hoping to have a good meal in a nice atmosphere. The restaurant was completely empty during the the entire time we were there for lunch. We should have taken it as a sign to go somewhere else from the start. Service was lacking, the food was terrible, and it was so hot - no fans or AC. To top it off, it was one of the most expensive meal we had, almost $700,000 VND with each person ordering either a noodle soup or rice dish only. We wouldn't have minded paying that much for a decent meal but the whole experience was so bad that we felt like we were robbed. After being seated, no one checked if we were ready to order. It took forever for the food to come out and only 3 of us were served first while the other 2 people had to wait another 20 minutes for their food to come out. The 3 of us who ordered pho and bun bo Hue got our bowls of soup first but weren't given any chopsticks. We had to ask and by the time we received the chopsticks, the soups were already cold. It took so long that the noodles had expanded and there was hardly any broth left in the bowl. Instead of offering to make us new soups, the waitress asked if we wanted her to warm up the soups for us. That's unheard of...the noodles would turn into mush so we opted to eat cold soups instead. It was the most disappointing food I tasted in my trip to Vietnam. The flavors were not there. I've had better bun bo Hue in the US. When the rice dishes finally came out, they weren't any better than the noodle soups. My husband who's not a picky eater, didn't even want to touch his plate. Even with the heads left on, the shrimps were tiny and did not look appetizing. He didn't like the taste but ate it anyway because he was hungry. We were never asked about our meals after we were served and no apologies were given for the delay. Total disappointment.

reviews: We had a really enjoyable dinner at this lovely vegetarian restaurant in Hue. The staff were friendly and the food was freshly cooked, plentiful and delicious. There’s no meat at all on the menu, it’s entirely veggie. They don’t serve alcohol which didn’t bother us. The place is not ultra luxurious but is clean throughout and comfy enough, also features a large fishpond in the centre of the main room. There were several tables of locals eating there too, which (as tourists) we always take as a good sign. The staff spoke very little English but there’s free WiFi and they did find a menu in English, so with help from Google Translate and a bit of pointing we were able to order just fine. If you’re looking for tasty vegetarian food in pleasant surroundings with a family-run atmosphere then this place should fit the bill., Very rude service, would not recommend. I would recommend going elsewhere to eat. They are also closed in the afternoon.

reviews: This place has a real local feel- quite off the tourist track. The waitress, An na was very pleasant and was keen to practice her English. We had vegetable noodles with bitter greens, cubic beef and chips (strange translation I think!) and morning glory with pork skin. The food was tasty, though nothing spectacular. With 2 beers and 2 sugar cane juices, it came to a very reasonable 220,000 dong., Was walking and saw this place. It is a place for beer drinking and also serve local food. Ordered fried beef noodle,stirred fried vegetables, fried chicken wing (too salty), another 2 more dishes and 4 bottles of beer. It cost me around $180k dong for 2 persons. I personally like the fried beef noodle. Went there again the next evening. Their staff do not communicate in English, menu in viet. This is the down side., I have vietnamese origins and have traveled quite a lot in the country. I deeply regret that you can't find any real good food in the major cities when you are in the backpackers area (in hoi an, hue, nha trang, dalat...). So, you have to walk a little to find a real local restaurant where you will have REAL recipes with a REAL price :) This one was great, we had dinner one evening and came back the next day (and it's a pity we had to leave Huê the next day). We had different meals including fried frogs with lemon leaf (a delicacy), fried tofu in tomato sauce, sauteed pumpkin leaves, grilled or fried shrimps in tamarind sauce, beef skin sauteed with mustard leaves, etc etc. If you understand vietnamese, ask for the vietnamese menu, it has far more meals than the english menu. Anyway, everything was delicious with a good price. you can have 4 meals for 2 people, for less than 200 000vnd including drinks.

name: An Phuoc Restaurant
address: 31 Nguyen Cong Tru, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Looked grand from the outside, a wide frontage and glimpse of airy up-market interior with good tables and chairs. However, things went downhill from there. Although far from busy, there was one large group of diners who seemed to monopolise the entire staff, so service was abysmal. I ordered stir-fried squid and beef with noodles, and was on my third beer by the time anything arrived. The beef was here, but what about the squid? my question caused the waiter/ manager to first go check I had actually ordered it, then run out into the street ranting on his mobile like a Vietnamese Basil Fawlty. Do they get some food prepared off-site? It arrived about ten minutes later. Really can't say it was anything memorable, I have done better at little 'plastic stool' places on the sidewalk without the thirty minute wait. Unless they were having a really bad night, you can do better than this., This restaurant seems to cater mainly for coach parties, plus occasional couples, families etc. We came with a party of about 25 people and were served immediately on arrival. The food was delicious and consisted of about 8 or so different dishes, including prawns, duck, pork, vegetables and a vegetable soup. This is the 2nd restaurant in this region that serves bananas as fruit, so this seems to be a regional choice, whereas water-melon and dragon fruit is more prevalent in more southern Vietnam. We found the floor greasy and slippery, and the toilet floors were quite wet, but otherwise a good restaurant., Paid 120 thousand Dong for 3 local beers and the food was better looking than it tasted. They did not offer a menu and prices seemed arbitrary. A local would not eat here as we were the only ones there after a long day of travel (2 pm). Avoid.

reviews: This is a great little restaurant just outside the main hub the serves delicious food and good service for a reasonable price. I have been searching Hue for my favourite spicy Hue style noodle soup and on our last day we found it at this restaurant. We have found that most of the restaurants in Vietnam don’t serve spicy and you have to ask. If you don’t like spicy then most of the menu is just great tasting Vietnamese food. Worth a visit when in Hue., We visited for dinner and sat on the second floor so we could people watch from the large windows upstairs. The food was delicious and so well priced. Our waiter was friendly and suggested reducing our order as he felt we wouldn’t be able to eat it all…and he was right! We ordered the local speciality beef soup to share and a main course each with rice , plus a beer and glass of wine and spent around £16 in total which was great! There were loads of prawns in my stir fry prawns and vegetable stir fry and the pak choi, okra, carrots and cabbage were very tasty in a light spicy sauce., Absolutely delightful restaurant serving local specialties (that the wait staff are happy to advise you on!). Sat upstairs overlooking the street. Comfortable and not at all noisy. (this was a real plus given the commotion on the walking streets on a Sunday evening). The menu had delectable vegetarian choices for the friends we were traveling with who had been relegated to rice and steamed vegetables for several days. The food was modestly priced and outstanding (I took their advice on the local specialties, my husband had a clay pot meal- all the dishes were terrific). We REALLY enjoyed chatting with the wait staff, especially Bom who was eager to speak English with us. They were attentive and helpful. Easy to walk here from our hotel via the pedestrian "walking streets" from our hotel
description: Local food- Hue specialites

name: Chan
address: 01 Nguyen Thai Hoc, Hue Vietnam
reviews: This was the best dining experience weve had on our second visit to Hue after 14 years. A beautifully presented restaurant, great atmosphere. The staff are all very professional, friendly and take great care to make you feel welcome. The extensive menu has something for everyone. Vegetable, beef, pork, duck, chicken, seafood and tofu dishes deliver satisfying traditional Vietnamese flavours distinct to Hue. There is also a cafe section at the front for coffees, juices and pastries from 8am in the morning. I recommend trying the caramelised pork belly, the salt roasted chicken dishes and the kumquat and apricot juice but everything on the menu looks and tastes delightful and is very reasonably priced. We have many favourite restaurants in Vietnam and will always return to this one., This restaurant is a wonderful find We were served by sally (Hien) who spoke brilliant English and was really helpful with our choices and the quantities required which is always difficult as the portions vary so much from one restaurant to another The food was the best we experienced in our three week trip in Vietnam and also one of the most reasonably priced We discovered that we were sitting next to the owners and the fact that they eat there speaks volumes There was a really good mix of tourists and locals eating there We would recommend this restaurant to any wanting to eat Vietnamese and specifically Hue style food, I’m visiting Hue for a couple of days and was curious after reading reviews of Chan. I called to make a reservation (I think we may have been able to just walk in, but it seemed around 80% full when we arrived around 7PM on a Sunday). The ambiance is comfortable, with many intriguing artifacts on the walls ( I asked staff about some of it). All the staff, especially our server Ngoc, were genuinely warm and friendly. I was a little surprised when, stepping out of my Grab, somebody smiling appeared with an opened umbrella (it was raining), holding it above me as I walked to the entrance. The menu seems extensive compared to what I’ve seen in most restaurants on my visits to Vietnam; I recognized some of the items but there were many new ones I haven’t seen elsewhere that I think must be local regional dishes. I like to take my time and look at everything on the menu, and the staff didn’t hurry me a bit to order even though the restaurant is quite busy. The Vietnamese friend I was eating with, from a different province in Vietnam, was more excited at the menu and the food as it arrived than I’ve ever seen him before in a restaurant. He kept expressing his delight at the food, and even said that if he lived near this restaurant he would eat there every day. I enjoyed everything we ordered, though I think my favorite was a fried tofu cooked in a tomato based sauce. I highly recommend trying Cham if you are in Hue, whether you are from Vietnam or are a foreign tourist.
description: Chan is a Hue traditional restaurant with cozy atmosphere and serve dishes from a typical family meal of Hue people.

name: Vị Huế Restaurant & Café
address: 61 Võ Thị Sáu, Phú Hội, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Exquisite experience from start to finish. Mong, our waitress, had the warmest smile and made us feel at home. The food was amazing, each dish surprised us with a different, subtle taste. We had the lotus salad, duck, linguine, rice noodles as well as the flambéed banana and sweet soup for dessert. The interior design was gorgeous. This restaurant was Perfection in all aspects. We paid 22 dollars per person (without wine) for what felt like a Michelin meal., If you’re looking for a cozy restaurant with excellent service, Vi Hue is a must-visit. The service is prompt and attentive without being intrusive. The ambiance is charming, with soft lighting and a relaxed vibe that makes you feel at home. The menu offers a wide range of dishes, and each plate is a masterpiece in flavor and presentation. I highly recommend their signature Sous vide duck breast, which is perfectly cooked and rich in taste. And I’m really impressive with good service of Mrs.Dream and Mrs.Vi., Very elegant restaurant and inventive cuisine. The dishes I chose were delicious and very well presented. Vietnamese cuisine of high standard for relatively wise prices. The staff , multilingual is very welcoming and with little care especially Mr.Bach who was very attentive and took care to explain each dish in French! The decor is successful and relaxing. Do not forget to have a cocktail 🍸🍹 they are well made and original. I will definitely return during my stay. Patrick
description: Renowned for its vibrant flavors, fresh ingredients, and artistic presentation, Huế cuisine is a treasure of Vietnam’s culinary heritage. Vị Huế takes this tradition to new heights, blending sustainability and creativity into every dish. From fragrant herbs to delicate spices, every bite reflects the royal essence of Hue, inviting diners on an unforgettable journey of flavors, culture, and refinement!

name: Le Cercle Hue
address: 11 Le Loi Street, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: We had an incredible dining experience at this Vietnamese restaurant. The food was authentic, flavorful, and beautifully presented, offering a true taste of Vietnam. The restaurant’s location provides a stunning view, making the atmosphere even more enjoyable. A special shoutout to Long, our server, who went above and beyond to accommodate our extra requests. His attentiveness, friendly demeanor, and dedication to ensuring we had a perfect meal truly stood out. If you’re looking for delicious Vietnamese food paired with excellent service and a breathtaking setting, this place is a must-visit. Highly recommended!, We heard about this historical building in Hue, it used to be a famous sport club (swimming, rowing boat, tennis, etc.) during the French colonial era. Now it’s a high-end restaurant aptly named Le Cercle Hue. We had dinner here on our first night in Hue. Impressive interior with high ceiling, elegant wooden French doors leading to an outdoor terrace overlooking the Perfume River. Relaxing atmosphere, romantic setting with white table cloth, red rose, candle on every table. The napkin on each plate was folded into the shape of a white tuxedo jacket! We enjoyed our fabulous dinner, especially the traditional Cơm Âm Phủ ( Hell’s rice) and Bánh cuốn thịt nướng (rice crepe with grilled pork skewers). Our waiter Lộc suggested an excellent French white wine to pair with the dishes. He also happily showed us how to fold a napkin into a tuxedo when we told him we loved the look of it. Many thanks also to our waitress Ngọc who recommended the fantastic hibiscus lime ice tea (hibiscus infusion with lime juice and ginger-kumquat syrup). Such unusual, complex flavors yet so refreshing! Highly recommend this place., Excellent location by the Perfume River between two bridges. The local draft beer was very drinkable and the food excellent and reasonably priced given the location. We were served by Long who's English was very good and he was very willing to tell us about the dishes that we had chosen and life in Hue in general. He was very attentive and considerate of our well being given it was a hot day.
description:
We had an incredible dining experience at this Vietnamese restaurant. The food was authentic, flavorful, and beautifully presented, offering a true taste of Vietnam. The restaurant’s location provides a stunning view, making the atmosphere even more enjoyable.

A special shoutout to Long, our server, who went above and beyond to accommodate our extra requests. His attentiveness, friendly demeanor, and dedication to ensuring we had a perfect meal truly stood out.

If you’re looking for delicious Vietnamese food paired with excellent service and a breathtaking setting, this place is a must-visit. Highly recommended!

name: Nook Eatery
address: Alley 42 Nguyễn Công Trứ street Number 33 Hue, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: We chose this restaurant because it was welcoming and original with a very appetizing menu combining Vietnamese tradition and a choice of burgers. The waitresses are adorable and the food is very tasty, made from fresh produce. We had lunch and dinner for three days because this restaurant was close to our hotel but also because we wanted to explore the map. The bill is completely reasonable. A plate of fresh fruit was kindly offered to us during our last meal. The musical atmosphere is also very good, far from the synth covers heard over and over in other places., This is the 3rd time that I have been to Nook over a number of years and it was great to see that the staff still make you feel very welcome as soon as you walk in the door. It had changed location since I'd last been however it didn't make it any easier to find! They have a wide ranging menu, including both Asian and Western dishes, open from 7am for brekky and close at 10pm. As mentioned, the staff were very frindly and great to have a chat to, and they were also very attentive to your needs, especially Min and Ha. The Nook is set out over 2 levels, with the larger seating area up the top and the kitchen/smaller seating area down the bottom. I had the pork spring rolls and a burger. Both dishes were good, although it would have been great if the bun was a little bigger on the burger from the look of the fries, I would probably say it was time to change the oil in their deep fryer. The only negative really is it would have been nice to have empty plates and bottles etc removed from the table a little quicker. Overall, I recommend that if you are in the area to pop in for a bite to eat or have a drink, you will be treated very well by the staff and also, all the food/drink is reasonably priced., Very good restaurant. Though a little off the beaten track there are signs directing you to Nooks. The menu is arguably quite limited and a fair amount of it is "Western" but there are enough Vietnamese dishes to keep your taste buds tingling. Nice friendly service.
description: A cozy, friendly, funky cafe where you can enjoy a deliciously cooked full English breakfast with the works including baked beans and English muffins - Veggie option available. We also serve a range of vegetarian and vegan breakfasts including home made granola, crepes, smoothie bowls and fresh smoothies & juices. Join us for Lunch and Dinner and enjoy Vietnamese & Asian fusion dishes, home made Vegetarian / Vegan burgers, Australian style beef burgers, Asian style curries and Stir Fry Noodle dishes - Vegan options available, fresh salads, snacks and delicious desserts. We offer a full bar with local beers, mixed drinks, cocktails and our well known coconut coffee which many of our guests keep coming back for. As with all of our dishes we take great care when preparing our Vegan / Vegetarian dishes to ensure our customers satisfaction. The team at Nook looks forward to welcoming you.

name: Alma Restaurant
address: 50A Hung Vuong Street, Phu Nhuan Ward Level 33, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Alma Restaurant in Hue is a fantastic dining spot that offers a perfect blend of elegance and comfort. The restaurant features a diverse menu with well-crafted dishes full of rich flavors. The ambiance is sophisticated yet warm, making it an ideal place for romantic dinners or business meetings. One of the highlights of the experience is the excellent service—especially from Quynh, who is exceptionally attentive and friendly, ensuring that every guest feels welcomed and well taken care of. If you’re looking for a high-quality dining experience in Hue, Alma is definitely worth a visit., This dish is absolutely delightful, offering a perfect balance of rich and well-seasoned flavors that truly stand out. The use of fresh, high-quality ingredients enhances its taste, making every bite a pleasure. Moreover, the beautiful presentation showcases great attention to detail, reflecting the artistry and craftsmanship behind its creation. It’s not just a meal; it’s a true culinary masterpiece that excites both the palate and the eyes., During trip to Vietnam we decided we wanted to have a western meal and decided to give this a try as it was based in a Melia hotel (which we had stayed in whilst in Hanoi with a good experience). Stunning views across the city and excellent menu choice. Food was great! My only one criticism is that they brought our main courses when my husband was still eating the last of his starter! Even the bread roll and butter was of a high standard (not doughy and sweet as is so often the case). Went upstairs to the Skybar for after dinner drink which was equally stunning. Photos don’t do it justice. Definitely worth a visit and worth the extra money.
description: Savor Hue's First Steakhouse: Alma at Meliá Vinpearl Hue. Discover our flavourful beefsteaks inspired by local cuisine – from signature Tomahawk steak (1500g), mouthwatering Beef Wellington (1000g) to appetizing salad bowls and desserts. Luxurious atmosphere, modern design and panoramic views, it is perfect for the signature dining and cherished moments with your beloved ones on the floor 33th.

name: Ancient Huế Gallery Cuisine
address: 104/47 Kim Long Ancient Hue Garden Houses, Hue 49000 Vietnam
reviews: It's been the best dinner we've ever had in Vietnam. It is more expensive than other places in the city but with a great value for money. The restaurant is located in a hotel with abundant vegetation and an outdoor pool, with a remarkable and elegant wooden building that already provided an unbeatable environment. We took a Shiraz red wine from the house which for the price is totally recommended and the best we have drunk in Vietnam after many disappointments with much more expensive wines. As for the food we share some Vietnamese prawn rolls, highly recommended. Each one also ordered a later dish: my partner ordered a bò Hue bò (traditional meat and noodle soup, flavored with coriander) and it came out delighted; I ordered a grilled chicken with lime leaf that was delicious, with a magnificent sauce and accompanying vegetables that I also can not fail to recommend. For dessert we had a fruit cake of the right passion but not remarkable and a dessert of chocolate type coulant that was totally worth it. The treatment of the staff was always very cheerful and polite and we had the opportunity to see during the end of the dinner a live concert of 5-6 musicians and music who played typical instruments and sang local songs, enlivening and improving the evening. Definitely a dinner to remember in Hue and all over Vietnam. 100% recommended., I have been to this restaurant during Vietnam trip with my family. We were really satisfied. We were looking for a fairly elegant and well-served restaurant, where we could taste traditional dishes and fortunately we found it! The place remains outside the chaos of the city and presents itself very well. Dispersed in a well-kept "Vietnamese" garden, the restaurant is easily reachable by taxi (cheap). Here you can eat meat, fish, but also children's and vegetarian menus. All served as it should, with tablecloths and cutlery, but without losing the oriental charm. The service is very attentive, the waiters are kind, helpful and attentive. As well as in the kitchen, where they prepare very good and aesthetically fascinating dishes. Price above average here in Vietnam but totally affordable for those coming from the West. Worthy of note if you are looking for a refined restaurant. Great experience!, After so much street food and some "filthy" contexts it is legitimate to indulge in a little luxury. The 32 euros each for the tasting menu are well worth the service offered. The venue, inside the luxury lodge, is truly cared for down to the last detail. Courteous and very attentive service. The phon so praised by books on Vietnam finally takes shape and flavor, it is cooked with great dedication. Everything else is a virtuosity of cooking design and a vague overview of Hué cuisine. The only flaw to point out is the geographical location, not well marked on the maps and difficult to reach even by taxi drivers. If you have difficulty, have the restaurant call. Overall a very nice and refreshing experience.
description: Some feasts were said to have included 300 rare dishes served in over a thousand bowls. ‍ Located in the main Garden House, Kim Long Fine Dining Restaurant mixes local specialties with Asian and European flavors to create memorable, modern-day versions of royal feasts. ‍ Discover this unique space and start your culinary journey sitting at a table with lacquered authentic furniture and surrounded by refined ornamental details. ‍ Continue this gourmet escape by enjoying the artistic vision of the mural painting representing the motifs of an Empress robe and take a look at the antique panels with the four seasons flowers carved in by the mother of pearl shells which reflect Ancient Hue. ‍

name: Le Parfum
address: 5 Le Loi Street La Residence Hotel, Hue Vietnam
reviews: The food that we ordered as a party of 6 was cooked to perfection, with some lovely touches. The staff here are exceptional, well trained with an eye for detail. They were also very helpful and knowledgeable about the dishes, which made the choice so much easier. Being low season, the restaurant was quiet, but we made our own entertainment, so as a couple it might lack atmosphere at this time of year. Saying that, the staff make up for it., We went to Le Parfum for the Degustation Experience which had been highly recommended to us . With good reason. It was really beautiful . Seven delicious , perfectly balanced courses beautifully presented. The service was impeccable . Wine list was quite limited but adequate-only two Aussie and two NZ wines on offer. We decided on a French Chardonnay and a Syrah which complemented the food perfectly. The wine however was very expensive. This seems to be a common theme in Vietnam with very little Aussie wine on offer and we have had numerous discussions about how to remedy this. All in all a really top quality offering., Large dining room with terrace looking out at the river. we had the duck and sweet and sour prawns. very pleasant and nice to not have a change from noodles or rice pancakes. couldhave done with another prawn. apple tart with cherry sorbet and a caramelised banana with ice cream finished the meal nicely. not outstanding but very pleasant.
description: Food is a passion at La Residence. At Le Parfum talented Chefs experiment with creative Asian, Vietnamese and European flavours. At the heart of every dish are the very best of Vietnam’s fresh and vibrant produce combined with top quality imported specialty ingredients.

name: Ben Xuan Garden House Theatre
address: Van Thanh Riverside, between ThienMu Pagoda and VanThanh Temple of Literature, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Food is always the top of our list of priorities when travelling and Vietnam is no different ,though some may think of Pho as the all consuming Vietnamese dish. I was looking for a fine dining restaurant to indulge and narrowed down to 2. Ben Xuan Garden House was my choice after reading some positive reviews. I received an email reply from Ngo who said he would be happy to set a table for us. It was all POSITIVE from the word GO ! Ngo called me and suggested the best approach to Ben Xuan was via a 25min boat ride down the perfume river. On arrival , Ngo warmly welcomed the 4 . We were served refreshments. He even helped snap a few Photos ( which he knew) would become a great conversation piece when friends ask about our visit to Hue. He then introduce his very charming wife Camille to us. We could sense that she was someone very special with multi - talented kills in painting , planning and restoring the Garden House to it's glory. After , a tour of the the compounds , Ngo ushered us into the main recital hall. As we did not see other guests, I thought we would be waiting a while for others to arrive. As it turns out it was going to be just the 4 of us ( overwhelming pleasant surprise ) . The "private" recital was like some surreal VIP entertainment . After 30 odd minutes or so, I was eager to savour the special cuisine prepared for us. Each of the dish served was exquisite and we couldn't help but snap enough fotos to fill a small album. A final comment is that Ben Xuan is not your typical fine dining restaurant but an all encompassing experience . We wish Camille and Ngo all the best of health as most Asians cherish a lot and success in their operation and passion in what they enjoy doing. I strongly recommend anyone who is thinking of visiting and meeting Camille and Ngo not to pass up the opportunity . Best wishes to Camille and Ngo . Lilian & Andy ( Singapore) Liz & Gabby ( Melbourne) ., We took a boat to the front gates of this marvelous and interesting home/studio on the banks of the river and it was truly enchanting. We were met by the proprietors Camille and Truang and started with a tour of the amazing property (designed by Camille). We enjoyed an authentic dinner after a performance by Camille and her fellow artist and performers. The music was an interesting mix of north and south Vietnam pieces, juxtaposed with a piece from the southern US. Traung and Camille were the commensurate hosts and could not have made us feel more welcome. This is a great experience for anyone who appreciates the arts (many of Camilles paintings) and music and is an experience off the beaten path., We had the pleasure of attending a recital and dinner at the beautiful home of Camille and Truong on this past Saturday evening. It was indeed the highlight of our trip to Vietnam. The music on ancient instruments and Camille’s beautiful voice were magical. Their home is a masterpiece designed by Camille. She is also an artist. Her art is beautifully displayed in their home. They were so welcoming and the food and wine was divine. Reservations are required and I highly recommend it if you are visiting Hue.
description: VISIT, LUNCH, CONCERT, FINE DINING in the inspiring ambience of BEN XUAN GARDEN HOUSE THEATRE. Ben Xuan is built in royal architectural style, located on the most beautiful site of the Perfume River, and conceptually designed as an East West cultural meeting place. Ben Xuan's owners, Camille Huyền (Artist) and Truong Dinh Ngo (retired Swiss UBS Banker), both of them native of Hue and having lived for more than forty years in Germany, France, and Switzerland, will welcome you personally. The soirée as the highlight of the evening will unfold in the ambience of the Theatre House. The concert program is set up with the repertoire of Camille and accompanied by Ben Xuan's traditional instrument ensemble interpreting Ca Hue Royal Chamber Songs, World lullabies, Vietnamese Art Songs &Folksongs and Western Classical Songs. Enjoy the cultural exchange, chamber music and fine dining at Ben Xuan as the literati, the noble and the royal used to indulge their leisure time. Reservation in advance.

name: Vu Cuisine
address: 6 duong Nguyễn thaï hoc, Hue 99243 Vietnam
reviews: Long stay in Hue, we went four times in January and most recently on February 28, 2024. We tasted the famous pizzas and the crab pasta are excellent, we will come back with pleasure, the staff is professional, attentive (a little word in French) and kind. The relaxing musical atmosphere and best of all the boss is very nice, he even turned the oven back on to make us two pizzas, even though it was closing time. Above all, don't hesitate between one or the other. Choose Vù Cuisine to enjoy yourself, it's not the factory, it's a restaurant, a real Italian., Delicious dishes, excellent pizza, much better than many Italian pizzerias, the pizza was rightly juicy and not dry, not contaminated by local flavours, the gnocchi with delicious fish bisque, the fillet a little small but so soft that it could be "cut with a breadstick" the accompanying vegetables are crunchy but not tough and the puree is excellent. 4 beers. Vanilla ice cream made with whipped cream and vanilla all for $35. What can I say passed with flying colors, Amazing ! If you want to eat burrata, arugula or even truffle, it’s ideal. We feasted. The portions are quite large and the staff are lovely. What a pleasure to find a little bit of Italy in Vietnam! 😍 For the price it’s around €10 per pizza but it’s worth it for our palate!

name: Ama Restaurant

reviews: Here's the first one I came here to have travel. It's amazing view with well designed and many lovely things. The staffs very lovely, they warmly welcome us and made delicious cocktails go together salty peanuts. We have a great time here, we will be back one more time and highly recommend this restaurant to our friends., A very good and pleasant restaurant with delicate serving and plating. We had 3 course dinner and enjoyed it a lot. Situated in their beautiful garden, I have very enjoy my holiday at Anhill, really great amazing view and sighseeing! Good foods, nice coffee with very good service! Thank you and see you again! Madame Thư.

name: Le Soleil De Huế
address: 104/47 Kim Long, Hue Vietnam
reviews: We had a fabulous experience at this restaurant! The setting is very pleasant and tastefully decorated. Our dinner was delicious. We ordered a duck dish and a fish dish and both were well-cooked and balanced. The staff was excellent and very accommodating, especially Thuý! We will be recommending this restaurant to family and friends!, I recently dined at Le Soleil De Hue, and it was fantastic! The restaurant’s cozy and stylish atmosphere really added to the experience. The menu offered a wonderful selection of French dishes, each one crafted with fresh, local ingredients that added a unique touch. The flavors were vibrant and delicious, making each bite a pleasure. The staff were friendly and made sure everything was perfect. If you're in Hue and want to try some amazing French food with a local twist, Le Soleil De Hue is definitely worth a visit!, Authentic French restaurant I really missed French gastronomy. I really recommend this place as the staff and the service were excellent
description: Discover our glasshouse restaurant, adorned with exquisite French colonial and Art Deco-inspired furniture, resembling the elegance and romance of the French Indochina era. ‍ Indulge in the flavors of France as our skilled chef creates gastronomic masterpieces using the finest ingredients. Each dish is a harmonious blend of traditional French techniques and local influences, resulting in a culinary symphony that delights the senses. From classic French dishes to innovative creations, our menu caters to the most discerning palates, offering an unforgettable dining experience. ‍

name: Đai Nam – Authentique Cuisine de Hue
address: 02 Doan Thi Diem, Hue 53000 Vietnam
reviews: We happened upon Dai Nam restaurant by accident. It was beautiful and very clean inside. We were a party of 6 just coming from the Citadel and were exhausted and hungry. Our waiter, Dat spoke English and helped us through the menu. We ordered spring rolls for the table and my husband ordered Shaky Beef and I had pork with mushroom and onion. All of the food was fresh and delicious and Dat was super helpful and personable. This was a great choice, Đai Nam restaurant is located in the garden of the lovely Spatel d'Annam, a really attractive boutique hotel across the street from the Hue Citadel. We came across it when we were walking back from the Citadel to our hotel across the river. We really just needed to use the toilet, and there was a WC sign near the front of the hotel, so we went in (with some trepidation). Although we were sweaty and dressed for sightseeing - and it was a very hot day - the hostess was extremely graciously and invited us in to the pretty garden area outside of the hotel, showed us to the facilities, and then showed us around the hotel and restaurant with evident pride. It's a really beautiful place. We came back to the restaurant that night, a little more presentable than earlier in the day. The setting is gorgeous, with seating indoors and outdoors. We ordered Bò Lúc Lắc and "Shaky Prawns" - both delicious. Service was impeccable. A thoroughly enjoyable evening. One of my favorite meals in 3 weeks in Vietnam., Every dish was delicious! Duck with pineapple, beef la lot, banana blossom salad - all were amazingly tasty. Inside an historical building - highly recommend trying this restaurant.
description: The restaurant serves Hue food, Vietnamese and Asian food. The restaurant has Hue old house style of Nguyen dynasty.

name: Tha Om Garden House
address: Hue Vietnam
reviews: We visited this beautiful and unique home, where we were retailed with stories of its family history. The owner of the house explained that tourist diners help to pay for the upkeep of the house, and we were glad to be able to contribute in a small way to keeping its history alive. Then we were served dinner, cooked by the lady of the house and her staff, and ate it by candlelight in the garden surrounded by the sound of crickets. We were the only family there on that evening and it felt truly private and special. Definitely recommend the experience. Something a little different and off the beaten track!, We visited with Scenic and had a wonderful night. The host was entertaining and proudly displayed and explained his house. The meal was served by beautiful attentive girls in traditional dress. We were also entertained by a group of musicians., Absolutely delicious meal in a beautiful traditional home with a history lesson and lovely service. Very beautiful experience that was greatly enjoyed by all!

name: Junrei Restaurant
address: 130 Minh Mang Road, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Visually very attractive both inside and out, lots of tasteful decorative elements. It is within the Pilgrimage Village Hotel complex and therefore very nicely situated in the green. In the basement there is a nice jazz bar where you can hear perfectly acceptable standards from the Blue Book, often by Cole Porter. Of the long drinks we only tried the mojito and the gin and tonic, only the latter we really recommend. The staff are very friendly, courteous and attentive throughout and know how to make the guest feel like they are the center of attention. Very nice!!! For the food: The menu is a thick book that is also visually very professionally presented with photos. There is a selection of very nicely presented Vietnamese dishes and some standard international dishes. However, the Vietnamese dishes were quite heterogeneous in terms of quality and we were not always satisfied. However, the international dishes are always well served. We can highly recommend the stylishly decorated and delicious desserts. The restaurant is relatively expensive, in keeping with the tasteful offering. A pizza, for example, costs around €11, which is good value for money by European standards, but by Vietnamese standards it is of course incredibly expensive. However, you have to take into account that the ingredients for such dishes, such as Camembert or mozzarella, are hard to come by in Vietnam and are therefore expensive., Our first night/dinner at The Pilgrimage Village and we’re off to a great start…. the Passionfruit Juice was punchy & the local beer was a winner (& nicely chilled as it should be!). We opted for the A La Carte (there is a half buffet option with an A La Carte for those with huge appetites) and we shared a starter of minced pork skewers which you wrap in rice paper with salad & peanut sauce - delicious if not a bit messy (though a cold towel is on hand). Then for mains we had the deep fried Red Snapper which you similarly prepare and eat in rice paper, though this time with salad & fresh mango slices, then dip in a chilli sauce and also the Beef Curry which was a stand out winner - mild not spicy and the beef was so tender with not an ounce of fat to be seen! All the waiting staff were super friendly, especially Lien who was so polite & sweet. We were going to eat out in town tomorrow evening but I very much suspect we’ll be back in The Junrei to sample more amazing flavours 😋, We had a great time at Junrei restaurant, located in the beautiful Pilgrimage Village. The food was simply delicious, full of local flavors and perfectly prepared. Many thanks to the whole team for their kindness and warm welcome! The waiters have been taking care of us, taking the time to advise us on local specialties, but also on how to taste them to take full advantage of them. A special thank you to Madame Lien, an exceptional waitress whose smile and attentiveness truly brightened our meal. Thanks to her, this culinary experience was even more memorable. Thanks again!

The restaurant is relatively expensive, in keeping with the tasteful offering. name: Ngu Yen - Royal Restautant In Hue
address: 01 Floor, 33 Hai Ba Trung St Thanh Lich Royal Boutique Hotel, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: The whole experience came with dressing up in royal costumes and listening to royal music. We were assisted with every royal dish, taking beautiful pictures and videos of our entrance, mimicking the real dinner of a King and Queen. 100% recommend the experience, also the food was top notch👍🏻. Front office manager Hương was especially helpful., Good dîner impérial. Super and so beautiful restaurant. Clother very beautiful .we are look like King and Queen .thank you so much Huong, What is wonderful night! Staff are very helpful and friendly. Royal menu was so delicious and many choice. We recommend this place to all guests ^ ^

name: Madam Thu Restaurant
address: 45 Vo Thi Sau Street, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: We ended up here via webs and had meals twice here with abs no complaints!! There are 2 outlets and we came by .45. The place is lovely and inviting. We ordered the 10 pieces taster menu and Bahn bo, both were served quite fast. The dished and dips are so flavorful!! Our host Dihn gave exquisite care, went out of his ways to get us some items which are not on the menu, added so much to our appreciation. We were taught to assemble the rolls, every stuffs. I guess we were quite lucky tasting local foods with such reasonable prices. Give it a go when in Hue and see why this place gets great reviews for its food. Thanks the whole team for warm welcome!! Highly recommended!!, If you’re in Hue and want to sample all the best of the local food, this is the place. For about 190000 VND ( about $13 Aust) you can get a set platter that contains all samples of the local cuisine, everything from the hand rolled rice paper rolls to the fresh fruit for dessert. This place is quick, high quality and great value, but the best bit by far was Oanh our waitress, who took the time to explain the process for constructing every bite and was friendly and delightful throughout to a group of Aussies worn out by a day of high humidity touring. If you want to do yourself a serious favour while you’re on tour, drop in here, order the set menu and an ice cold Huda beer, and ask if Oanh is on duty. Truly worth it., There are 2 Madame Thu branches 140 metres apart in the same street. Madame Thu number 1 at 4 Vo This Sau street is the more authentic building but both serve the same menu. We ate very well trying the local delicacies which were delicious - only one slight problem was that starters and mains arrived simultaneously. Notwithstanding this the food was excellent and with mineral water and a bottle of French wine we paid about €14 a head which is exceptional value. Credit cards accepted. Staff very helpful in explaining how best to eat some of the esoteric dishes Highly recommended
description: Madam Thu Restaurant is a local restaurant located in Backpacker Area of Hue City. The name of woman who is owner. Madam Thu Restaurant will offer you Lunch and Diner with some famous Hue Food as Stuffed rice pancake (Banh Khoai), Grilled Chopped Pork (Nem Lui), Grilled Pork Vermicelli, Fried Spring Rolls with other delicious Hue Food with Hue Style. Beside, She will show you “How to Cook Hue Food

reviews: Very good mode and coffee taste very good . We could spend very good time here . Tea also taste very good and many kinds of tea ., We went here with family, it is a gorgeous cafe shop with lots of places to sit and take photos. It is very calm and beautiful. We had drinks, all of which were amazing. Come here if you’re in the area for sure., This place was very pretty, the overall ambience and vibe was very calm and serene. The architecture was very pretty as well. I had a matcha, and it was the best matcha I’ve ever had. I recommended coming here for sure!
description: Very good mode and coffee taste very good . We could spend very good time here . Tea also taste very good and many kinds of tea .

name: Chan - 19 Nguyen Thai Hoc
address: 19 Nguyen Thai Hoc, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: A very patient wait staff who helped our group of 10 take orders then happily spilt bills individually and gave option to pay cash or card +2%. They even reissued a dish after some confusion on orders. Food was lovely and the chan special was real value for money at Vd95k, drinks were also more reasonably priced than other places. Catfish was succulent and little class were very filling., A real delight 😋 10th day in Vietnam and since 3 or 4 days we can no longer get enough of rice and others, we opt for European cuisine. Today we go to this restaurant, to take over the local cuisine, carefully chosen according to notes and reviews. And now, what a joy to reconcile to Vietnamese cuisine! We ask our waitress Huyen for advice on typical Hue dishes. All happiness and flavors... um... for the proposals made. In addition very beautiful setting and a note more than incredible (25€ to 2 with a bottle of wine included) => No hesitation 👍, We ordered the set meal number 4 and it was great. The braised pork was sweet and tender, the soup was tasty, morning glory, and best of all was the fried fish and rice paper pancakes. This was served with fresh watermelon juice and finished with fresh fruit and the subtly delicious dessert. Our waitress was Huyen and she was friendly, spoke very good English and answered our questions about the dishes with enthusiasm. Highly recommended
description: Chan is a Hue traditional restaurant with cozy atmosphere and serve dishes of a typical family meal of Hue people.

name: Dmz Bar & Restaurant
address: 60 Le Loi st, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Very good service, nice staff and good food. Love the service from My- she has super energy! Really enjoy the atmosphere in this place!, My favourite bar in Hue - I visited 3 times Morning coffee cappuccinos are great. Also some excellent Vietnamese dishes and some western style food too - I enjoyed all The hudda draught comes in a big chilled glass and goes down a treat. The best part about this bar are the staff; they’re courteous, efficient and cheerful offering a top service to their customers The decor is pretty cool too, Efficient prompt service in English with a smile. Tasty snacks & meals & your beer is replenished before you finish your first one! You can even book a superb DMZ tour while you down a cold draught beer at a price that won’t break the bank. I’ll be back again for more!
description: If you want to drink during your time in Hue, than the DMZ Bar is the place to stay. We are open from 7 am until 2:30 am for drinks and 7 am until midnight for food.

name: Spice Viet Restaurant
address: 15 Ly Thuong Kiet, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: We forgot making a reservation before coming to the restaurant but didnâ€™t have to wait long, the waiters were very quick to bring out the dishes after only 10-15 minutes ordering. The menu was varied, we ordered a few dishes along with Com Nieu, I have to use the word "excellent" to describe that dinner. The restaurant's space is also charmingly decorated. It's really in the top list of Vietnamese Cuisine Restaurant in Hue., I highly recommend this restaurant for its exceptionally fresh and quality prepared food. The hotel staff in the restaurant had an excellent service for our breakfast buffet and we enjoyed thoroughly many different varieties of fresh fruit, coffee all kinds of different Vietnamese style food and pancakes. The children really loved it and we would come back again especially the hotel and the swimming pool are excellent When you can enjoy the view from the garden from the HOTEL restaurant., I've visited multiple Spice Viet restaurants across Viet Nam, and I always find myself returning for their food and interior designs. The restaurant always deliver amazing vietnamese food while also having choices for western cuisine as well; although it's obvious from the name that Viet food is their specialty. Saying specialty is also an understatement as their cooks deeply understand the cuisine, capable of refining it to perfection. I always recommend Spice Viet to all travelers if they're looking for the best that Vietnamese cuisine has to offer, and with a reasonable price as well.
description: SPICE VIET is a brand-new chain of farm-to-table restaurants showcasing authentic Vietnamese cuisine by using fresh, seasonal ingredients to create dishes that are healthy, green and delicious. Spice Viet Hue is the first in the Spice Viet chain of restaurants. Other location will open throughout Vietnam (Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Hoi An...) and abroad (Europe, Australia...)

name: Eco Restaurant
address: 107 Minh Mang Street, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: We ate here two nights in a row as the food and service is amazing. Everything we had was fabulous. They kindly tailored the crispy pancakes so I could try this local favourite (I do not eat pork/beef which is tricky in some places in Vietnam). I was so grateful that they did this. All the staff were friendly and welcomed us back the second day. The food is also incredibly cheap, our favourite meal for 2 people including beer was less than £10. Give this place a go if you are in the area, you will love it., We were staying at The Pilgrimage across the road from the Eco Restaurant so decided to go for dinner and support the locals. Ha our host was lovely and we really enjoyed talking with her, her restaurant is beautiful and the food was fresh and very very tasty. Highly recommended. Thank you Ha - Linda & Brett from New Zealand, Family run very friendly owner and staff. All food cooked from freshest ingredients to order - excellent quality at very reasonable prices. Local beer very refreshing. Visited several times as menu varied but very happy to just serve you coffee which was welcome after a walk in the surrounding countryside

name: Le Cercle Hue
address: 11 Le Loi Street, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: We had an incredible dining experience at this Vietnamese restaurant. The food was authentic, flavorful, and beautifully presented, offering a true taste of Vietnam. The restaurant’s location provides a stunning view, making the atmosphere even more enjoyable. A special shoutout to Long, our server, who went above and beyond to accommodate our extra requests. His attentiveness, friendly demeanor, and dedication to ensuring we had a perfect meal truly stood out. If you’re looking for delicious Vietnamese food paired with excellent service and a breathtaking setting, this place is a must-visit. Highly recommended!, We heard about this historical building in Hue, it used to be a famous sport club (swimming, rowing boat, tennis, etc.) during the French colonial era. Now it’s a high-end restaurant aptly named Le Cercle Hue. We had dinner here on our first night in Hue. Impressive interior with high ceiling, elegant wooden French doors leading to an outdoor terrace overlooking the Perfume River. Relaxing atmosphere, romantic setting with white table cloth, red rose, candle on every table. The napkin on each plate was folded into the shape of a white tuxedo jacket! We enjoyed our fabulous dinner, especially the traditional Cơm Âm Phủ ( Hell’s rice) and Bánh cuốn thịt nướng (rice crepe with grilled pork skewers). Our waiter Lộc suggested an excellent French white wine to pair with the dishes. He also happily showed us how to fold a napkin into a tuxedo when we told him we loved the look of it. Many thanks also to our waitress Ngọc who recommended the fantastic hibiscus lime ice tea (hibiscus infusion with lime juice and ginger-kumquat syrup). Such unusual, complex flavors yet so refreshing! Highly recommend this place., Excellent location by the Perfume River between two bridges. The local draft beer was very drinkable and the food excellent and reasonably priced given the location. We were served by Long who's English was very good and he was very willing to tell us about the dishes that we had chosen and life in Hue in general. He was very attentive and considerate of our well being given it was a hot day.
description:
We had an incredible dining experience at this Vietnamese restaurant. The food was authentic, flavorful, and beautifully presented, offering a true taste of Vietnam. The restaurant’s location provides a stunning view, making the atmosphere even more enjoyable.

A special shoutout to Long, our server, who went above and beyond to accommodate our extra requests. His attentiveness, friendly demeanor, and dedication to ensuring we had a perfect meal truly stood out.

If you’re looking for delicious Vietnamese food paired with excellent service and a breathtaking setting, this place is a must-visit. Highly recommended!

name: Nina's Cafe - Eatery
address: 16/34 Nguyen Tri Phuong Laneway 34, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: After many days eating local food I wanted to try something closer. I chose the spaghetti with tomato and meat. The spaghetti was very good, different meat than what you usually find in Vietnam, it was minced meat with the same flavor that you can have in Spain. For dessert I chose a pancake and vanilla ice cream that tasted amazing. The portions are not very large, taking into account the price, but the treatment of the waitress (she couldn't have been more pleasant and friendly) and the taste of the food make the experience a 10., Fantastic food. Y and Hang greeted us and looked after us. We chose Pork skewers on lemongrass & Vegetable spring rolls to start, with 2 Huda beers. For mains we had Pork caramel clay pot and Pork Yellow curry, both with rice. A bottle of Chilean SB - amazing food, so fresh tasting. Service was amazing by Y and Hang who both practised their English with us and taught us some Vietnamese too. We will be coming back as we are here for 4 nights. Highly recommended. They take visa debit cards and charge an extra 3%. Fantastic value as our meal cost £23 for the two of us. Well done to the team!, Absolutely excellent. The food served was all divine- very likely the best Vietnamese food yet! The grilled fish was superb as was the pork and eggplant fried. The pancake for dessert was quite rubbery so wouldn’t particularly recommend that. Will likely revisit.
description: All our food is made using really fresh ingredients bought daily from the market and supermarket. We make Vietnamese and Western food as well as Huế Specialities. We really recommend trying some of these dishes as they are unique to Huế and very tasty! We also make fruit shakes, hot drinks, cold drinks and numerous alcoholic drinks.As well as food, we can help you to arrange tours whilst you are in Huế. If you have any questions about Hue or Vietnam we will try to help you in any way we can. We want all our visitors to know we are honest and want everyone to have a really happy time while they are at our restaurant.

description: Very good mode and coffee taste very good . We could spend very good time here . Tea also taste very good and many kinds of tea .

name: Elegant Restaurant
address: 46 Phạm Ngũ Lão  Phú Hội Ward, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Tasty and delicious food with good service. We had a variety of Vietnamese dishes in this restaurant, the staff were all very helpful and charming, especially Duyen ( see photo ) & the manager Mimi who has good command of English After some weeks in Vietnam we found we were craving some more vibrant flavours, as some dishes in other restaurants were becoming bland .. in this restaurant the flavours were excellent.. the chicken skewers were cooked to perfection and the slow roasted pork ribs in bbq sauce were tender & very tasty!! 🤤 the grilled prawns in tamarind sauce were absolutely delicious so tasty, our favourite!! The alcoholic drink is more expensive than some restaurants. A vodka and Diet Coke (40,000) was 135,000 ( £4.10) and a bottle of dalak wine was double at 399,000 .. whereas last night just around the corner we paid 200,000 a bottle !! A big increase! However the food was good value on the whole we had 4 dishes £18 ( 620,000) .. 2 vodkas one Diet Coke & one huda beer total bill was 885,000 (£26.90), The food here is very nice. The atmosphere is relaxing. We sat for a long time watching local children playing a game of football in the street, none were wearing shoes. It was great entertainment. After we had eaten, two big tour groups arrived and filled the restaurant so I would advise you to go earlier if in doubt. Our waitress was called Thor and she was very attentive and professional. My mixed vegetables with cashews came with rice and was very nice, perhaps too many onions for my taste but plenty of other vegetables too. The garnishes are beautiful. On Friday and Saturday nights I believe that traffic is stopped from using the street so that’s the best time to go., We are on a month long trip in Vietnam and Cambodia and decided to stop in here for dinner while in Hue. We were so warmly received by the staff ( especially MiMi), who not only helped us choose our drinks and meals, but schooled us in the use of chopsticks. My husband had chicken mushroom soup, and he and I both had chicken brochettes with rice, which came with a varied selection of fresh and grilled vegetables. The menu is extensive ( both Western and Vietnamese choices) and one meal was more than I could finish. I highly recommend this restaurant in Hue, with its homey feel and wonderful staff and food.
description: Launched in September 2014, and quickly become a famous restaurant in Hue, owners are group of Tour Leaders and restaurant manager who have worked in Tourism industry for almost over 10 years. Restaurant located right at a tourist area of Hue City, or other way is called Downtown of Hue, Elegant Restaurant offers a warm welcome while dining and drinking in the relaxing atmosphere. It has spacious place with several separate parts; The front airy yard, enjoying quiet and relaxing atmosphere, the cozy comfortable indoor and mezzanine equipped with high end music and combined together to provide our visitors a full service, including Vietnamese food, BBQ food, Fusion food, Italian food, and moreover find great coffee, well popular selection of wine, Ice cream are available to gratify our dear guests. We wish to bring you a wonderful experiences when you are in this beautiful historical City.

name: Golden Rice
address: 40 Pham Ngu Lao Street, Hue 47000 Vietnam
reviews: Great first evening in Hue! The restaurant was quiet but had been recommended by our tour guide. Really good value enjoyed several beers the banana flower salad and complimentary spring rolls both of which were delicious. Then had several curry dishes and other stir fries all were excellent. Great value for money and fabulous service from Chan., It was the first time we came to Golden Rice for dinner. We ordered three dishes, including stir-fried water spinach, sweet and sour fish, and braised tofu. The sweet and sour fish was especially delicious. The boss also generously gave us a delicious spring roll, here The dining atmosphere is beautiful, with beautiful lanterns and very tasteful decoration. I want to thank you for the service, professional chefs, staff, and the young ladies in the store. The boys greeted me very kindly, leaving behind wonderful times and memories. I would also like to thank the beautiful phuong mai, le dan, who assisted us in renting a motorcycle and providing detailed information about the tour. I recommend friends who travel here to taste the delicious food and enjoy the friendliness of the people., We initially came here for lunch and enjoyed the food so much that we can back for my sister's birthday dinner. I had pad thai noodles and my sister had a curry dish. An appetizer, two entrees and two smoothies cost us $12. The service was wonderful, the servers were adorable and helped us find new places to go see. The restaurant is centrally located, on a street with many other small, cute, restaurants.
description: Golden rice is there to offer our guests Authentic local fresh and Asian fusion food in a cozy atmosphere , well selection of wine and cocktails are also available.

name: Madam Thu Restaurant
address: 45 Vo Thi Sau Street, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: We ended up here via webs and had meals twice here with abs no complaints!! There are 2 outlets and we came by .45. The place is lovely and inviting. We ordered the 10 pieces taster menu and Bahn bo, both were served quite fast. The dished and dips are so flavorful!! Our host Dihn gave exquisite care, went out of his ways to get us some items which are not on the menu, added so much to our appreciation. We were taught to assemble the rolls, every stuffs. I guess we were quite lucky tasting local foods with such reasonable prices. Give it a go when in Hue and see why this place gets great reviews for its food. Thanks the whole team for warm welcome!! Highly recommended!!, If you’re in Hue and want to sample all the best of the local food, this is the place. For about 190000 VND ( about $13 Aust) you can get a set platter that contains all samples of the local cuisine, everything from the hand rolled rice paper rolls to the fresh fruit for dessert. This place is quick, high quality and great value, but the best bit by far was Oanh our waitress, who took the time to explain the process for constructing every bite and was friendly and delightful throughout to a group of Aussies worn out by a day of high humidity touring. If you want to do yourself a serious favour while you’re on tour, drop in here, order the set menu and an ice cold Huda beer, and ask if Oanh is on duty. Truly worth it., There are 2 Madame Thu branches 140 metres apart in the same street. Madame Thu number 1 at 4 Vo This Sau street is the more authentic building but both serve the same menu. We ate very well trying the local delicacies which were delicious - only one slight problem was that starters and mains arrived simultaneously. Notwithstanding this the food was excellent and with mineral water and a bottle of French wine we paid about €14 a head which is exceptional value. Credit cards accepted. Staff very helpful in explaining how best to eat some of the esoteric dishes Highly recommended
description: Madam Thu Restaurant is a local restaurant located in Backpacker Area of Hue City. The name of woman who is owner. Madam Thu Restaurant will offer you Lunch and Diner with some famous Hue Food as Stuffed rice pancake (Banh Khoai), Grilled Chopped Pork (Nem Lui), Grilled Pork Vermicelli, Fried Spring Rolls with other delicious Hue Food with Hue Style. Beside, She will show you “How to Cook Hue Food

name: Junrei Restaurant
address: 130 Minh Mang Road, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Visually very attractive both inside and out, lots of tasteful decorative elements. It is within the Pilgrimage Village Hotel complex and therefore very nicely situated in the green. In the basement there is a nice jazz bar where you can hear perfectly acceptable standards from the Blue Book, often by Cole Porter. Of the long drinks we only tried the mojito and the gin and tonic, only the latter we really recommend. The staff are very friendly, courteous and attentive throughout and know how to make the guest feel like they are the center of attention. Very nice!!! For the food: The menu is a thick book that is also visually very professionally presented with photos. There is a selection of very nicely presented Vietnamese dishes and some standard international dishes. However, the Vietnamese dishes were quite heterogeneous in terms of quality and we were not always satisfied. However, the international dishes are always well served. We can highly recommend the stylishly decorated and delicious desserts. The restaurant is relatively expensive, in keeping with the tasteful offering. A pizza, for example, costs around €11, which is good value for money by European standards, but by Vietnamese standards it is of course incredibly expensive. However, you have to take into account that the ingredients for such dishes, such as Camembert or mozzarella, are hard to come by in Vietnam and are therefore expensive., Our first night/dinner at The Pilgrimage Village and we’re off to a great start…. the Passionfruit Juice was punchy & the local beer was a winner (& nicely chilled as it should be!). We opted for the A La Carte (there is a half buffet option with an A La Carte for those with huge appetites) and we shared a starter of minced pork skewers which you wrap in rice paper with salad & peanut sauce - delicious if not a bit messy (though a cold towel is on hand). Then for mains we had the deep fried Red Snapper which you similarly prepare and eat in rice paper, though this time with salad & fresh mango slices, then dip in a chilli sauce and also the Beef Curry which was a stand out winner - mild not spicy and the beef was so tender with not an ounce of fat to be seen! All the waiting staff were super friendly, especially Lien who was so polite & sweet. We were going to eat out in town tomorrow evening but I very much suspect we’ll be back in The Junrei to sample more amazing flavours 😋, We had a great time at Junrei restaurant, located in the beautiful Pilgrimage Village. The food was simply delicious, full of local flavors and perfectly prepared. Many thanks to the whole team for their kindness and warm welcome! The waiters have been taking care of us, taking the time to advise us on local specialties, but also on how to taste them to take full advantage of them. A special thank you to Madame Lien, an exceptional waitress whose smile and attentiveness truly brightened our meal. Thanks to her, this culinary experience was even more memorable. Thanks again!

The restaurant is relatively expensive, in keeping with the tasteful offering. name: COZY Restaurant
address: 6/27 Ha Noi, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews:
This is a very nice address in Hue. This little restaurant is definitely worth a visit. The welcome is nice, the dishes (at least the ones we tasted) are delicious, and the note is more than sweet (8.50 euros for 2 people with drinks, starter, dishes and dessert is offered). Our best restaurant since we arrived in Vietnam. Do not hesitate, you will not be disappointed, and at worst you will only have lost a little ten euros....., I came to this place with my family because it was a short walk from the hotel where we stayed during our stay in Hue. The place is minimal but comfortable, the staff super friendly and attentive. We took 5 different dishes to share so we could taste everything and we were impressed by how good they were. Savory and tasty dishes but not heavy and at the end they also offered us dessert (a panna cotta with caramel on top) which was also delicious like everything else. I also highly recommend it because for the 5 dishes we had, plus drinks, the price in the end was very low, so the value for money is also very good., Tucked down a little alley way in Hue there is a hidden gem of a restaurant. Although quite small, the restaurant was always busy; service was quick and the young staff were very friendly and helpful. The food is quite simply the best that weâ€™ve eaten while in Vietnam; tasty typically Vietnamese dishes-great portion size and so, so cheap! We stayed in Hue for 3 nights and although it may seem boring, we chose to eat there each night trying different things from the extensive menu. We were never disappointed! COZY Restaurant has won the hearts of many diners with its friendly and attentive service, often rewarded with compliments on the complimentary desserts. The food is consistently lauded for being both delicious and authentic, offering great quality and quantity at reasonable prices.

While the global decor gives the restaurant an eclectic vibe, guests are charmed by its warm ambiance, adding to the overall good value, especially for the variety of Vietnamese dishes that are frequently highlighted in reviews for their affordability and taste.
description: The meaning of the name is Cozy, with a classical frame with country music, soft light when you come to our shop, wish you a cup of coffee with delicious food, guests are number one when entering the shop. . Our prices are very cheap for tourists, Thank you for coming to my restaurant and vegetarian dishes

name: Zucca Restaurant
address: 15 Chu Văn An, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: If you are looking for a restaurant in Hue that offers an intimate and inviting atmosphere, generous portions and reasonable prices, then Zucca Restaurant is the best choice. With rustic decoration and soft lighting, the restaurant offers a unique and memorable gastronomic experience. The service is very friendly and attentive, and the staff always greet you with a smile. Additionally, the restaurant is located close to the Citadel and other tourist attractions, making it a very convenient location., Superb attention from staff, and their lasagna was absolutely mouthwatering. This Italian/Vietnamese fusion establishment truly impresses. They generously provide a complimentary appetizer, beverage, and fresh fruit platter to finish your meal. The pricing is quite fair considering the quality, and the staff's attentiveness is remarkable throughout the dining experience., The staff creates a warm, inviting atmosphere complemented by delicious, beautifully presented meals. Offering outstanding value, this spot serves fantastic pizza and a great variety of drinks. An absolute must-visit!

Additionally, the restaurant is located close to the Citadel and other tourist attractions, making it a very convenient location.

name: Les Jardins de La Carambole
address: 32, Dang Tran Con, Hue 10000 Vietnam
reviews: A ‘nice’ location with good food. We initially had a nice lunch here, but with a few strange twists and turns. Upon arrival we were asked to place our rental bikes out of sight so that their parking space remained free. That was strange in itself because there was more than enough parking space, but soit; they must have a good reason, we thought. After a delicious starter and main course, the staff started to act a bit weird when we wanted dessert after. This was weird, but we got it. When we had finished dessert and asked again for the menu for a drink when choosing a next activity we were presented with the bill and ordered to leave. When we indicated that we meant the drinks menu, the staff suddenly pretended they could no longer speak English while communication was effortless at first, and they aggressively pushed the bill back in our faces. My tablemate wanted to go to the toilet after checkout but this turned out to be no longer possible. All we can think of is that they wanted our table for the group that just came in, but half the tables were still free. As for hospitality, this restaurant actually deserves a big two, but the food was very tasty and the location looked neat so that's why I'm going for four stars anyway., Our tour guide dropped us here for a pre paid pre booked lunch along side many others people That said the set menu was very tasty and showed off the cuisine very well . Green mango salad was the winner Staff friendly and showed us how to eat some of the dishes Drinks very well priced, This excellent restaurant built in a colonial style serves top class food for a very moderate local price. The service is top class and the owner showed us around his restaurant telling about the many antiques he has collected over the years. We found this restaurant by accident since it was located in the same street as our hotel and we were immediately attracted by the colonial, beautiful style it was built in. The prices of the food were very affordable and a decision was quickly made to have our breakfast then and there and didn't regret it. we also found out from the owner that he owns a second restaurant in Hue City which we visited at night for dinner and deserves a separate review. E. Rouffa A Day.
description: Les Jardins De La Carambole is a new restaurant in Hue serving Vietnamese and French cuisine. It is inside the Citadel, very near the Forbidden City. It's an impressive reconstruction of a French Colonial Villa. Great attention was paid to every detail of the historic reconstruction.

name: Pizz.á Restaurant - Italian Cuisine
address: 34 Chu Văn An 2nd Floors, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Spacious, quiet, clean restaurant/pizzeria on the upper floor of a building on a street that's mostly pedestrian in the evening. The waitresses and waiters are extremely nice, going above and beyond to make sure you have everything you need. The food itself... *sigh. I ate here twice in three days. Pizza Margherita first, delicious dough, fresh and tasty ingredients. Then pasta the second time, the vegetable lover spaghetti: the mixed vegetable sauce brought me straight to summer back in Italy, all the flavours were there and just right. Also appreciated the potato wedges or French fries, as the menu says, and the complimentary (thank you!) miso ice-cream was interesting with that spicy mix on top, and itself fresh and good and a nice texture. Were I staying longer in Hue, I'd likely return a third time!, Great service amazing pizza. Really nice surroundings and atmosphere. Really good value for money. Would definitely come back to this place again. Oh did I forget to mention the nice and friendly waiters. If there was one thing to comment on it would be the IGers. (People who take photos for instagram or any other) but overall amazing. As a family and individual it was brilliant. My 10 year old daughter thought it was the best pizza place she had ever been to., As tourists in Hue we spent lovely time in this restaurant and we really enjoyed the pizza here! We really appreciate the relaxed atmosphere and the extremely kind and professional waiters. Si Huy followed us in each step of our dinner: he introduced very well the menu, enhancing the originality of the offer and he took care of us in every part of our pizza experience. We really appreciated the pizza, very tasty and rich in terms of ingredients! A really nice pizza experience in Hue, highly recommended!
