name: Vị Huế Restaurant & Café
address: 61 Võ Thị Sáu, Phú Hội, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Exquisite experience from start to finish. Mong, our waitress, had the warmest smile and made us feel at home. The food was amazing, each dish surprised us with a different, subtle taste. We had the lotus salad, duck, linguine, rice noodles as well as the flambéed banana and sweet soup for dessert. The interior design was gorgeous. This restaurant was Perfection in all aspects. We paid 22 dollars per person (without wine) for what felt like a Michelin meal., If you’re looking for a cozy restaurant with excellent service, Vi Hue is a must-visit. The service is prompt and attentive without being intrusive. The ambiance is charming, with soft lighting and a relaxed vibe that makes you feel at home. The menu offers a wide range of dishes, and each plate is a masterpiece in flavor and presentation. I highly recommend their signature Sous vide duck breast, which is perfectly cooked and rich in taste. And I’m really impressive with good service of Mrs.Dream and Mrs.Vi., Very elegant restaurant and inventive cuisine. The dishes I chose were delicious and very well presented. Vietnamese cuisine of high standard for relatively wise prices. The staff , multilingual is very welcoming and with little care especially Mr.Bach who was very attentive and took care to explain each dish in French! The decor is successful and relaxing. Do not forget to have a cocktail 🍸🍹 they are well made and original. I will definitely return during my stay. Patrick
description: Renowned for its vibrant flavors, fresh ingredients, and artistic presentation, Huế cuisine is a treasure of Vietnam’s culinary heritage. Vị Huế takes this tradition to new heights, blending sustainability and creativity into every dish. From fragrant herbs to delicate spices, every bite reflects the royal essence of Hue, inviting diners on an unforgettable journey of flavors, culture, and refinement!

name: Bánh Gánh Restaurant
address: 51 Võ Thị Sáu, Hue 49118 Vietnam
reviews: This is a great little restaurant just outside the main hub the serves delicious food and good service for a reasonable price. I have been searching Hue for my favourite spicy Hue style noodle soup and on our last day we found it at this restaurant. We have found that most of the restaurants in Vietnam don’t serve spicy and you have to ask. If you don’t like spicy then most of the menu is just great tasting Vietnamese food. Worth a visit when in Hue., We visited for dinner and sat on the second floor so we could people watch from the large windows upstairs. The food was delicious and so well priced. Our waiter was friendly and suggested reducing our order as he felt we wouldn’t be able to eat it all…and he was right! We ordered the local speciality beef soup to share and a main course each with rice , plus a beer and glass of wine and spent around £16 in total which was great! There were loads of prawns in my stir fry prawns and vegetable stir fry and the pak choi, okra, carrots and cabbage were very tasty in a light spicy sauce., Absolutely delightful restaurant serving local specialties (that the wait staff are happy to advise you on!). Sat upstairs overlooking the street. Comfortable and not at all noisy. (this was a real plus given the commotion on the walking streets on a Sunday evening). The menu had delectable vegetarian choices for the friends we were traveling with who had been relegated to rice and steamed vegetables for several days. The food was modestly priced and outstanding (I took their advice on the local specialties, my husband had a clay pot meal- all the dishes were terrific). We REALLY enjoyed chatting with the wait staff, especially Bom who was eager to speak English with us. They were attentive and helpful. Easy to walk here from our hotel via the pedestrian "walking streets" from our hotel
description: Local food- Hue specialites

name: Chan - 19 Nguyen Thai Hoc
address: 19 Nguyen Thai Hoc, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: A very patient wait staff who helped our group of 10 take orders then happily spilt bills individually and gave option to pay cash or card +2%. They even reissued a dish after some confusion on orders. Food was lovely and the chan special was real value for money at Vd95k, drinks were also more reasonably priced than other places. Catfish was succulent and little class were very filling., A real delight 😋 10th day in Vietnam and since 3 or 4 days we can no longer get enough of rice and others, we opt for European cuisine. Today we go to this restaurant, to take over the local cuisine, carefully chosen according to notes and reviews. And now, what a joy to reconcile to Vietnamese cuisine! We ask our waitress Huyen for advice on typical Hue dishes. All happiness and flavors... um... for the proposals made. In addition very beautiful setting and a note more than incredible (25€ to 2 with a bottle of wine included) => No hesitation 👍, We ordered the set meal number 4 and it was great. The braised pork was sweet and tender, the soup was tasty, morning glory, and best of all was the fried fish and rice paper pancakes. This was served with fresh watermelon juice and finished with fresh fruit and the subtly delicious dessert. Our waitress was Huyen and she was friendly, spoke very good English and answered our questions about the dishes with enthusiasm. Highly recommended
description: Chan is a Hue traditional restaurant with cozy atmosphere and serve dishes of a typical family meal of Hue people.

name: Risotto Restaurant
address: 69 Võ Thị Sáu Phú Hội, Hue 49000 Vietnam
reviews: Amazing food, beyond tasty. Happy hour is Excellent value, free bruschetta, bottle of local beer and fruit. We ordered a pizza and a risotto, and you get a glass of wine free with the pizza 🍕. The food was gorgeous. The staff were also so lovely. Our waiter Giang was so sweet and friendly. I would definitely recommend coming here!, A real festival for the senses awaits you at Risotto Restaurant! Fresh and local ingredients meet Vietnamese influences creating aromas that dance on the tongue. The presentation is colorful and generous, the service attentive and friendly. Must try: signature seafood risotto with a touch of lemongrass, accompanied by a refreshing Huda beer Cheer !!!🍻🍻🍻 1.2.3 Zo, Absolute gem of a find in Hue. After a little bit of research we opted to have dinner at Al Risotto and what a fantastic choice we made. Waitress was so kind and helpful and helped with the choice for my wife who has an intolerance to garlic. After choosing our mains we were brought complementary bruschetta with tomatoes as well as a free drink each. When our food arrived it was cooked to perfection. Crispy noodles with chicken was the tastiest meal I’ve had since our arrival in Vietnam almost a week ago. My wife had braised vegetables with rice and we shared a lovely freshly prepared Mediterranean salad which were so tasty. To finish off we had more complimentary fruit served. All in all a great food experience in Hue, we have no hesitation in recommending this place to anyone.

We ordered a pizza and a risotto, and you get a glass of wine free with the pizza 🍕. The food was gorgeous. The staff were also so lovely. Our waiter Giang was so sweet and friendly. I would definitely recommend coming here!

We ordered a pizza and a risotto, and you get a glass of wine free with the pizza 🍕. The food was gorgeous. The staff were also so lovely. Our waiter Giang was so sweet and friendly. I would definitely recommend coming here!

name: Cơm Niêu Khải Hoàn
address: 90 - 94 Lê Lợi, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: We loved this restaurant, the delicious food, the simple but very effective decoration and the music creates a very relaxing atmosphere. The Thai maitre Quuang Hunh attended us very well and translated the dishes for us, us. I help choose our menu. A great hit!!!, This was by far the best food we had the pleasure of eating in Hue. The goose with passionfruit sauce made our taste buds explode, it was so delicious and something we had never eaten before. The tofu in lemongrass was silky and melt in your mouth. The ambience of the restaurant is fresh and inviting and the staff are highly professional with food and drinks arriving together., My family was referred to this restaurant by our taxi driver. Khai Hoan is an amazing restaurant with a large menu of many regional Hue foods. Our Mom is from Hue and it’s impressive to have a restaurant in Hue with the quality of restaurants we have in the U.S. and better. We ordered the combo set for 2 and the family set for 4 and it was more than enough food for our family. Each dish, especially the Banh beo, smoked goose breast, thit heo luoc was DELICIOUS. We loved everything and on top of that the decor and the super friendly service was exceptional. You must try this place when you come to HUE!

name: Ngo Nho Restaurant & Cafe
address: 10/68 Dang Dung, Hue Vietnam
reviews: Delicious food. I chose the set menu and everything was great. The waitress even helped make my rice paper rolls in front of me. The iced chocolate was also very nice and helped cool me down from the searing temperatures outside., Nice restaurant at the end of an alley right in front of our hotel, found thanks to our guide, offers Vietnamese cuisine. Aside from the menu, two set menus are offered, we opted for the less abundant one because the portions are always enormous. Soup with fish, sautéed vegetables, pork with caramelized onions and prawns in tamarind sauce, accompanied by the inevitable white rice. Home cooking at a very affordable price., Wow! We walked down this tiny alley following a sign saying “food” expecting street food. What an amazing find. My lady saw a great looking fish on the counter and said I want that! I chose the set menu. It was more than enough for 2 and each dish was better than the last. There were 7 different items served and each was a dish I’d never had before. We came at 14:00, between lunch and dinner as they were preparing for a large party yet the owner personally brought us each dish I live in Vietnam and usually eat out, anywhere from street food to 5 star. This was the best dining experience I’ve had in all my time in Vietnam.
description: Come to Ngo Nho (Small Lane) to enjoy and feel. We promise to bring you joy and satisfaction with our dedicated and attentive services!

name: Imperial Craft Bia Brewpub
address: 21/4 Ngo Gia Tu Vinh Ninh, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: We visited on a very quiet Tuesday afternoon (just us in there!). We are suckers for a craft beer place as generally places with nice beer do great food, and we weren’t wrong here. They had a great barman (as well as the owners) on hand to talk through their beers, and even brought out three for my husband to try before he ordered. I had the freshly squeezed lemon juice which was lovely. The food was excellent. My husband had the chicken burger, the bun he described more like a scone like texture but said it was so tasty. I opted for the fish tacos, again these were full of flavour. I imagine when this place has more people in the atmosphere just improves more. We’re really glad we visited!, Fantastic range of craft beers, friendly atmosphere, great happy hour deals and we were fortunate enough to come for Taco Tuesday - carnitas tacos at about $1.50 Australian dollars each were absolutely delicious. Pizzas looked fantastic too although we did not try them. Not in main tourist area but worth a 15min walk or taxi., Amazing NE IPA in the heart of Huề! We are from Boston and this is the closest NEIPA we have had to the greats like Trillium and Treehouse outside of New England. The food was awesome (especially the pizza and ice cream) and our server Lý was so kind to us and our kids. We went back daily during our time in Huề.
description: The best place to drink craft beer in Hue. We got 14 taps of beer brewed on-site in a variety of styles, with Lagers, Pale Ales, and of course IPAs. We also do killer sourdough pizza, beef & chicken burgers on homemade buns and Mexican-style carnitas tacos. Welcome to the brewery!

name: Madam Thu 2
address: 04 Vo Thi Sau, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Recommended by our guide so took advice and booked . When booking be aware there are two so check what you have booked I’m sure both are good The one we went was big full menu had pictures so clear to understand and order When the starter came the waitress explained what to do The starters were delicious as was the chicken main 2 starters 3 mains 3 beers 1 glass wine large water all for under £24 excellent value Food was delicious staff great Good place to eat in Hue, Excellent restaurant located in the center of Hue in the most famous street for its nightlife and for the presence of many restaurants. The restaurant is mainly frequented by tourists. The appearance is very traditional and the environment overall is very welcoming. From the menu with the presence of traditional Vietnamese dishes I chose the great mix of appetizers, and I really appreciated that the waiter explained to us the order in which the individual rolls had to be eaten and above all which sauce they had to accompany them with. Everything was very good and the evening was pleasant, reservations necessary., Had a great meal here on the second night of our stay in Hue. We were sat on the terrace area (I think inside has aircon, but temperature was fine where we were). We both had the set platter (VND190k/£5.60) with some very helpful guidance from the staff on the right ingredients for the pancakes and how to construct them and also how to eat the banana leaf items). Local Huda beer was around 70p. Service was good. Would happily come again.
description: Madam Thu 2 - The branch of The Original Madam Thu Madam Thu 2 is a delightful local restaurant nestled in the picturesque city of Hue, Vietnam. This charming eatery is an extension of the original and renowned Madam Thu, building upon its legacy of exceptional Vietnamese cuisine and warm hospitality. Located in the heart of Hue, Madam Thu 2 welcomes guests with a cozy and inviting ambiance. The restaurant's decor is a blend of traditional and contemporary elements, creating a comfortable setting for diners to enjoy their meal. The soothing color palette and tasteful decorations reflect the rich cultural heritage of the region. Madam Thu 2's menu is a culinary journey through the diverse and flavorful landscape of Vietnamese cuisine. Whether you are a local resident or a traveler exploring Hue, this restaurant offers an authentic taste of the region's culinary traditions. From aromatic bowls of Bun Bo Hue to savory spring rolls and crispy banh xeo, every dish is prepared with meticulous attention to detail and the freshest locally-sourced ingredients. One of the highlights of dining at Madam Thu 2 is the warm and friendly service. The staff takes pride in ensuring that every guest feels at home, providing attentive care and helpful recommendations for those looking to explore the menu. The restaurant's commitment to quality extends beyond its food and service. Madam Thu 2 is also dedicated to sustainable and eco-friendly practices, striving to minimize its environmental footprint while offering a memorable dining experience. Whether you're seeking a taste of authentic Vietnamese cuisine, a friendly atmosphere, or a place to unwind after exploring the historic city of Hue, Madam Thu 2 is the perfect choice. With its dedication to preserving tradition and creating memorable culinary experiences, this local gem is a must-visit destination for anyone looking to savor the flavors of Hue, Vietnam.

name: N. Cafe And Restaurant
address: 08 Trần Huy Liệu, Hue 49000 Vietnam
reviews: I read so much about this restaurant that I had to dine there. At the end of my meal, I felt the same as all the reviewers. Overall, it was an excellent dining experience, and the bonus was the view. I had a table that faced the walls of the Citadel. Everything was good, the food, the beverage and the service. I was satisfied with my order. The coconut coffee had just the right amount of ice, unlike some places. The diced chicken, vegetable and rice combination for my main dish was cooked well. The service was prompt and fuss-free. The little touches made a huge difference. Before the meal; it was a packet of wet tissue, to wipe my hands I was pleasantly informed. At the end, the same wait staff presented me with a fruit, saying it was dessert. How unexpected and a lovely surprise indeed. These touches and everything else make me want to recommend this cafe and restaurant to everyone visiting the Imperial City., Nice foods it yummy( delicious ) Friendly great service we went there by accident the restaurant look clean and nice surprise the price is cheap comepare to same level of reataurant We had a few menu Ice coffee nice RECOMMENDED deep fried springrolls The 2 girls very good and attentive you can sit 2nd floor or outside to look at the Hue Palace very top service and ver good prices I will say that High recommend They take credit card., We were recomened by our hotel near by to viait this place. It was just around the corner. N.cafe &food running by family members. Nice location with look on a citadel. First day we eat schrimps noodle, beef noodle and banana roles. The second spring roles, rice with vegetable and noodle. For desert we order Durian ice cream and almond jelly coffe...everything was so delicious that we can't understand the price at the end. I get also a aloa tea with lichi...Njami if you are in Hue go and visit N.cafe&food !

name: Quán Hạnh
address: 11-15 Pho Duc Chinh Phu Hoi, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: We ordered the sampler menu for $150,000 Dong each and it was a great way to be introduced to the unique dishes of this region. YUM!! The staff was great about showing how to eat each dish, what sauces to use, etc. We really enjoyed the entire experience., Not sure what to order so we asked the waiter who recommended several dishes, on the first arrival he showed us how to prepare then eat and so on with rest of the dishes on arrival. The food was excellent as was the service. Highly recommended., Discover this restaurant by reading reviews about our hotel. Crowded restaurant on weekends (when we were there), as many foreigners as Vietnamese. A discovery menu for 6 euros allows you to taste several specialties. The boss speaks a little French and explains how to taste the different dishes. Interessant

name: Đa:mê Café
address: 34 Chu Van An, Hue 49118 Vietnam
reviews: I walked into this cafe after lunch at a restaurant close by. The ambience was sleek and minimalist, so different from what I have seen so far in a lot of cafes. It was spacious with tables meters apart for privacy. The music played over the sound system was comforting. There was also ample retail space for its merchandise. From a range of beverages on the menu, I ordered a glass of chilled coffee with coconut cream. The cream was thick without being too rich. A slice of burnt cheesecake completed my tea treat. The service was pleasant and natural. What a lovely place to while away the afternoon., In Hue in the bar area there is this place that makes excellent fruit smoothies. You can also find croissants, desserts, coffee, tea and more. The place inside has a relaxing atmosphere and is ideal for leaving the chaos of Hue for a moment., This is a great cafe, coffee is good. Decor nice and has charging points throughout. Great place to sit and charge devices at the same time. No card facilities, cash only. Says it opens at 6.30am, this is when staff arrive, more like open 6.45am-7am for service. Service is friendly and efficient.
description: Đa:mê Coffee Shop is not only about the drinks, but also the atmosphere it brings. The special thing of Đa:mê is the space displays works of art, but can still be used as a place where people can freely meet, chat, work, create and enjoy drinks.

address: Alley 42 Nguyễn Công Trứ street Number 33 Hue, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: We chose this restaurant because it was welcoming and original with a very appetizing menu combining Vietnamese tradition and a choice of burgers. The waitresses are adorable and the food is very tasty, made from fresh produce. We had lunch and dinner for three days because this restaurant was close to our hotel but also because we wanted to explore the map. The bill is completely reasonable. A plate of fresh fruit was kindly offered to us during our last meal. The musical atmosphere is also very good, far from the synth covers heard over and over in other places., This is the 3rd time that I have been to Nook over a number of years and it was great to see that the staff still make you feel very welcome as soon as you walk in the door. It had changed location since I'd last been however it didn't make it any easier to find! They have a wide ranging menu, including both Asian and Western dishes, open from 7am for brekky and close at 10pm. As mentioned, the staff were very frindly and great to have a chat to, and they were also very attentive to your needs, especially Min and Ha. The Nook is set out over 2 levels, with the larger seating area up the top and the kitchen/smaller seating area down the bottom. I had the pork spring rolls and a burger. Both dishes were good, although it would have been great if the bun was a little bigger on the burger from the look of the fries, I would probably say it was time to change the oil in their deep fryer. The only negative really is it would have been nice to have empty plates and bottles etc removed from the table a little quicker. Overall, I recommend that if you are in the area to pop in for a bite to eat or have a drink, you will be treated very well by the staff and also, all the food/drink is reasonably priced., Very good restaurant. Though a little off the beaten track there are signs directing you to Nooks. The menu is arguably quite limited and a fair amount of it is "Western" but there are enough Vietnamese dishes to keep your taste buds tingling. Nice friendly service.
description: A cozy, friendly, funky cafe where you can enjoy a deliciously cooked full English breakfast with the works including baked beans and English muffins - Veggie option available. We also serve a range of vegetarian and vegan breakfasts including home made granola, crepes, smoothie bowls and fresh smoothies & juices. Join us for Lunch and Dinner and enjoy Vietnamese & Asian fusion dishes, home made Vegetarian / Vegan burgers, Australian style beef burgers, Asian style curries and Stir Fry Noodle dishes - Vegan options available, fresh salads, snacks and delicious desserts. We offer a full bar with local beers, mixed drinks, cocktails and our well known coconut coffee which many of our guests keep coming back for. As with all of our dishes we take great care when preparing our Vegan / Vegetarian dishes to ensure our customers satisfaction. The team at Nook looks forward to welcoming you.

name: Zucca Restaurant
address: 15 Chu Văn An, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: If you are looking for a restaurant in Hue that offers an intimate and inviting atmosphere, generous portions and reasonable prices, then Zucca Restaurant is the best choice. With rustic decoration and soft lighting, the restaurant offers a unique and memorable gastronomic experience. The service is very friendly and attentive, and the staff always greet you with a smile. Additionally, the restaurant is located close to the Citadel and other tourist attractions, making it a very convenient location., Superb attention from staff, and their lasagna was absolutely mouthwatering. This Italian/Vietnamese fusion establishment truly impresses. They generously provide a complimentary appetizer, beverage, and fresh fruit platter to finish your meal. The pricing is quite fair considering the quality, and the staff's attentiveness is remarkable throughout the dining experience., The staff creates a warm, inviting atmosphere complemented by delicious, beautifully presented meals. Offering outstanding value, this spot serves fantastic pizza and a great variety of drinks. An absolute must-visit!

address: 22 Nguyen Thai Hoc Phu Hoi, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: This is a small sushi place with a huge menu. The sushi & sashimi are so fresh, and the values are great. We had a huge Sushi “boat”” for $20 & then ordered yellowtail & tuna. The yellowtail was so fresh, I could cut it with chopsticks, and it melted in my mouth. Our waitress, Thanh, was constantly keeping an eye on us, & her outgoing friendliness made us feel like we were at home. Cảm ơn, Thanh!, Japanese spectacular, I'd say the best I've ever eaten. Kim is lovely. They served us in an amabilisima way and even invited us to an extra dish that was delicious. The place is very central, we located it on trip Advisor and found it very easy. Quite a hit! Thank you Kim!!!, We love sushi and in our 3 week trip in Vietnam wanted to have the experience. We found this hidden gem in Hue and the experience was great. We tried two tempuras: sweet potato and shrimp and then a boat with 40 pieces of sushi rolls. It was unbelievably served and we think it will be difficult to find other place in the world with such quality and value for money (CAD $35...). We have traveled a lot, and we never tried something so well prepared and presented. When you are in Hue, please, go there and indulge in.
description: Best sushi ever in Hue, Viet Nam. Fresh and tasty. Stuff is very friendly. There is a nice amount to choose from, also deserts and drinks From Tripadvisor Tourist

name: Shino Sushi & BBQ
address: 35 Nguyen Thai Hoc, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: Stopped into the Shino Sushi &BBQ after a long walk around Hue and entered a restaurant with beautiful decor and friendly staff. I decided on the Vegetable Tempura and Fried Pork noodle dish. The Vegetable Tempura was hot and crispy and the Fried Pork Noodle was both savory and sweet. My server, Ms. Thanh noticed I was fumbling with chopsticks and provided me with a fork, she was both gracious and paid attention to detail without being over attentive. Highly recommend if you’re looking for something slightly different than the local fair in Hue., Totally get the amazing rating. Between the food, service & general ambiance - I would have loved to come back again! Kim Thanh and Loan took such good care of us! The food was insane. Possibly the best tuna I’ve ever had. The salmon and avocado salad was phenomenal, they make their own special dressing —— to die for., Would like to start this off with the staff, the absolute sweetest people ever. It was so easy to make conversation with them and they were so easygoing and open. Next off, the food. The spicy tuna roll was absolutely lovely and just tasted the best, was honestly not expecting it to be that good! Felt like the roll was just melting in your mouth. The avocado salmon that my dad had ordered was absolutely perfect. They have a secret sauce that comes with it and it’s added just the perfect taste to the salad. The fish was perfect, over all… 10/10. Huge shout out to Kim Thanh and Loan, they were absolutely amazing!!
description: Japanese restaurant in Hue Serving Japanese dishes: sushi, sashimi, rice rolls, udon,... With official imported food sources, with clear invoices of origin. The quality of the food is fresh and delicious.

name: Chez Maïs
address: 67/2 Võ Thị Sáu, Hue Vietnam
reviews: A friendly restaurant in a picturesque little alley in the center, "Chez Maïs" allows you to enjoy, at low prices, not only Vietnamese food but also typical dishes from Hue and its region. Furthermore, thanks to the location of the restaurant, it was away from noisy traffic that we were able to enjoy an excellent meal with my wife. The family atmosphere is welcoming and the service is quality. In addition, the staff speaks several languages including English and French, which greatly facilitates communication. It’s an address that I highly recommend, a must!, The food here was really good, and the owner was very kind in discussing the menu. The fig salad was amazing, the other food was good. Prices were a bit more expensive than some of the very cheap eats we've been finding, but definitely still a very, very affordable meal - about 100K for many menu items. This is a small family restaurant. The seating area is a nice, shaded outdoor space. This place is definitely worth a visit for the fig salad alone! They also provided a really nice rice cracker as an appetizer and a yummy plate of fruit as a standard part of the meal., French friends and others if you pass through Hué do not hesitate to go eat in this friendly little restaurant which will offer you family cuisine prepared with love by a super dynamic and involved team. Moreover Ha with his bright smile will be keen to make you discover your country. Not to be missed.

reviews: Many vegan & vegetarian options, the best food I ate since arrival. You enter barefoot, pay cash, English spoken, low prices, everyone smiles and teach you how to eat what they serve. Several vegan and vegetarian options, the best I've eaten so far. Access barefoot, payment in cash, speak English, give directions on how to consume food, all smiling, low prices, We came across this very small family-run restaurant by chance. The road to get there, a side street of the nightlife area, is not particularly lit and initially does not inspire much confidence. We have chosen to order "set menus" in which smaller portions of different dishes are served that you can order individually. All dishes were very good and tasty. Value for money highly recommended. Two menus, two beers and a large bottle of water about 180,000 dong/pers. The service is good, one of the owners explained how to prepare and / or eat the various dishes. Small point about cleanliness, we are in Vietnam so we cannot expect the same standards as other countries. It is normal to find cutlery and more on the table in special containers. The place still looks pretty clean. If you want a typical cuisine, not too touristy and convenient... you are in the right place!, This was our best dinner in Hue! Tucked away in a little alley, if we hadn’t have been told about it we would not have found it. Our family of 5 shared 7 different dishes and they were amazing. You have to try the Bun Bo Hue. Fantastic service and the food came out so quick, our boys were happy to have full bellies. The second best part is that our meal and drinks for 5, cost half that of western venues in local area, and we weren’t haggled off the street to eat there. Just great food!

name: Bistro La Carambole
address: 18 Vo Thi Sau, Hue 530000 Vietnam
reviews: I loved my visit to Bistro La Carambole. It’s located in the heart of the action in Hue City. The restaurant was busy so there was a great atmosphere and buzz, and the decor is lovely. The genial owner Chris, together with the manager and staff ensure that service is attentive and friendly. Prices are very reasonable and there’s a good balance of western and Vietnamese dishes. I had a delicious French onion soup - very moreish on a rainy night in Hue - followed by very tasty grilled chicken with fries. Portions were generous. We also had soft drinks, wine and beers and the total cost for two was very reasonable. We sat at one of the tables outside to soak up the atmosphere on the street and moved indoors when it became a little too humid. I definitely recommend Bistro La Carambole for anyone visiting Hue., The restaurant was packed when we arrived at 8.45 pm without a booking but we got a table for two. We enjoyed the grilled duck with orange sauce and the chicken in a mushroom cream sauce. The duck was boneless small slices. The chicken was the standout. Two pieces of breast in a rich tasty cream sauce with two types of mushrooms. The mains are served with a choice of rice, mashed potatoes or fries or mixed vegetables. The mixed vegetables were perfectly cooked and seasoned. The fries were hot and crisp, but the mixed vegetables were better. The French Sauvignon Blanc was acceptable for 115K VND per glass. The meals were delivered quickly despite the large number of customers., We were recommended to this restaurant by our tour guide. And it didn’t disappoint! The service is excellent. Both of our meals were delicious (can’t find anything to fault them) my husband’s steak was cooked to perfection. This restaurant is good value too. At the end of the night the staff called us a taxi, and as it was raining they even walked us out to the car under big umbrellas! Definitely worth a visit if you’re visiting Hue

address: 41/2 Tran Phu, Da Lat 670000 Vietnam
description:
As my husband and I were looking for a good bbq place to eat, we got dropped off at this place by our taxi driver. Our originally planned place was about 10 mins away from this place, when we passed by, it was empty and the taxi driver said it is because their food is not great. He then suggested to go to a place near Tuyen Lam lake, but we refused to go because it was further than where we intended to go after food. 
He basically dropped us off at the first place he saw. We were hungry so we just went in anyway, hope it might be one of those restaurants that not a lot of people know but it is delicious or something.
It turned out the food was just okay. It took awhile to get on the table for sure. The staff were nice but acted like they don't hear or understand me, I speak Vietnamese fluently, not try to confuse them with English at all. They brought out 4 beers instead of 2 like I asked. They took over 30 mins for food to come to our table, which doesn't make sense because the restaurant wasn't crowded at all, there were maybe 2 other tables beside us. 
Then it wasn't the type I ordered. They grilled for us, yet I told them I wanted to grill by ourselves. They definitely took the fun out of it for me. We just ate them anyway. We got 200K worth of beef and 150k worth of shrimps, but as you can see in my photos, shrimps seems to be more worthy for the what we paid. 
Most the time I didn't see any staff, they all went to the back. I had to go look for them to ask for a check. 
I wouldn't go back to this place or recommend it to anyone.

address: 124 Nguyen Dinh Chieu, Ham Tien, Phan Thiet Vietnam
description:
Went to this little spot because they have a lovely outdoor area facing the ocean. The staff speak zero English, which doesn't bother me as the first day I could easily use my phone to translate what I wanted from Google. Had a veggie omelette with bread and banana smoothie. All went down a treat, even though I was totally forgotten about and left trying to hunt someone down to pay the bill.
2 days later I come back with my boyfriend for the view and breakfast, the waitress gives us menus and stood over us painfully waiting for an order. WiFi? No. Helicoptering above our heads as we scanned the breakfast menu we were finally ready. But oh there's no food today apparently. OK smoothies? No. OK lipton tea for me fine. 20 minutes later still no arrival of tea hunt down the waitress who calmly said oh yeah. After another age waiting, frustrations growing wanting to walk out, the tea arrives with a sincere apology in fairness to her. Tasted like sea water with weird bits (Garlic? Apricots?) floating around. I don't know, I just couldn't drink it.
Went up to the till to just pay for the coffee and met with surprise for not drinking this concoction. Terrible service. Simple waitressing skills lacking, regardless of speaking the same language or not.
Avoid at all costs, it's a aneurism waiting to happen.

name: Biestrsar Restaurant
address: 81b Nguyen Dinh Chieu, Phan Thiet Vietnam
description:
We just went to Biestrsar and were pleasantly surprised! We went there not expecting much but it was close to our resort and it was scorching hot! 

Once we got there, the place was empty but tha's expected for lunch in May ( all restaurants are more or less empty at 1:30). The place looks very family like; brothers, mom, grandma sitting around. The waiter was nice, spoke a little English but enough to get our order right. He seemed a bit uninterested. 

We ordered the fresh spring rolls, Vietnamese Chicken Salad, Lao Xio Beef ( stir fried beef), and a bottle of water ( 1.5L). As with all restaurants in Mui Ne and Vietnam, the food took about 15 minutes to arrive. It was worth the wait! The fresh spring rolls were soft, fress and the sauce was delicious! It also came with lots of Vietnamese basil. The Vietnamese Salad was very fresh and had lots of Vietnamese flavor in it( lemongrass, chilli, fish sauce). The beef was awesome; looked small on the plate but I barely finished it! It was coated in lemongrass, fish sauce, chilli. I loved it. 

So, don't let the low ranking keep you away from this place. We're going back tomorrow. As far as the tour guy is concerned, the waiter asked us if we've booked any tours and gave us a short sales pitch about his tour. We said: "we'll think about it" and he walked away! No problem at all!

name: Bon Bon Boke
address: 116 Nguyen Dinh Chieu, Ham Tien, Phan Thiet Vietnam
description:
The restaurant is right next to the other fish restaurants, such as Bo Ke Vespa or Bo Ke Mr. Crab. It is actually a covered area with a concrete floor and plastic chairs. The restaurant is right by the sea and is very "basic" but very clean (including the toilets). 
The customers are almost exclusively locals and Asian tourists who are not interested in the "snazzy" tourist restaurants in the Mui Ne tourist zone, which often serve seafood from the day before.
The live (!!!!) seafood is presented in around 30 glass containers. You choose what you want and tell us how you want it prepared. This time we were particularly taken with the shrimps. Unfortunately, the restaurant did not have the required amount in stock, so the neighboring fish restaurant helped out with another 300 grams. We also ordered two mixed salads. We are very enthusiastic about this in Vietnam, as mixed salads are hardly known in Southeast Asia and, if they are on offer, are not particularly tasty. Not so in Vietnam, here they are really very good.
The prawns were fabulous. Served on small wooden skewers, they were ideal for "peeling" as you didn't have to touch the hot shells. Conclusion: a great dinner! Everything was fresh and the price/performance ratio, €20 for 2 people, including three drinks, was right too.
The only question that remains is why Bo Ke Bon Bon was rated so poorly on TA. When I read the German review, I almost fell off my chair laughing. Who goes to a designated fish restaurant to order spaghetti bolognese? The other reviews also seem to come from people who haven't traveled much in Asia.
We ate dinner here several times and were always very satisfied.

description:
Went to this little spot because they have a lovely outdoor area facing the ocean. The staff speak zero English, which doesn't bother me as the first day I could easily use my phone to translate what I wanted from Google. Had a veggie omelette with bread and banana smoothie. All went down a treat, even though I was totally forgotten about and left trying to hunt someone down to pay the bill.
2 days later I come back with my boyfriend for the view and breakfast, the waitress gives us menus and stood over us painfully waiting for an order. WiFi? No. Helicoptering above our heads as we scanned the breakfast menu we were finally ready. But oh there's no food today apparently. OK smoothies? No. OK lipton tea for me fine. 20 minutes later still no arrival of tea hunt down the waitress who calmly said oh yeah. After another age waiting, frustrations growing wanting to walk out, the tea arrives with a sincere apology in fairness to her. Tasted like sea water with weird bits (Garlic? Apricots?) floating around. I don't know, I just couldn't drink it.
Went up to the till to just pay for the coffee and met with surprise for not drinking this concoction. Terrible service. Simple waitressing skills lacking, regardless of speaking the same language or not.
Avoid at all costs, it's a aneurism waiting to happen.

address: 81b Nguyen Dinh Chieu, Phan Thiet Vietnam
description:
We just went to Biestrsar and were pleasantly surprised! We went there not expecting much but it was close to our resort and it was scorching hot! 

Once we got there, the place was empty but tha's expected for lunch in May ( all restaurants are more or less empty at 1:30). The place looks very family like; brothers, mom, grandma sitting around. The waiter was nice, spoke a little English but enough to get our order right. He seemed a bit uninterested. 

We ordered the fresh spring rolls, Vietnamese Chicken Salad, Lao Xio Beef ( stir fried beef), and a bottle of water ( 1.5L). As with all restaurants in Mui Ne and Vietnam, the food took about 15 minutes to arrive. It was worth the wait! The fresh spring rolls were soft, fress and the sauce was delicious! It also came with lots of Vietnamese basil. The Vietnamese Salad was very fresh and had lots of Vietnamese flavor in it( lemongrass, chilli, fish sauce). The beef was awesome; looked small on the plate but I barely finished it! It was coated in lemongrass, fish sauce, chilli. I loved it. 

So, don't let the low ranking keep you away from this place. We're going back tomorrow. As far as the tour guy is concerned, the waiter asked us if we've booked any tours and gave us a short sales pitch about his tour. We said: "we'll think about it" and he walked away! No problem at all!

name: Bon Bon Boke
address: 116 Nguyen Dinh Chieu, Ham Tien, Phan Thiet Vietnam
description:
The restaurant is right next to the other fish restaurants, such as Bo Ke Vespa or Bo Ke Mr. Crab. It is actually a covered area with a concrete floor and plastic chairs. The restaurant is right by the sea and is very "basic" but very clean (including the toilets). 
The customers are almost exclusively locals and Asian tourists who are not interested in the "snazzy" tourist restaurants in the Mui Ne tourist zone, which often serve seafood from the day before.
The live (!!!!) seafood is presented in around 30 glass containers. You choose what you want and tell us how you want it prepared. This time we were particularly taken with the shrimps. Unfortunately, the restaurant did not have the required amount in stock, so the neighboring fish restaurant helped out with another 300 grams. We also ordered two mixed salads. We are very enthusiastic about this in Vietnam, as mixed salads are hardly known in Southeast Asia and, if they are on offer, are not particularly tasty. Not so in Vietnam, here they are really very good.
The prawns were fabulous. Served on small wooden skewers, they were ideal for "peeling" as you didn't have to touch the hot shells. Conclusion: a great dinner! Everything was fresh and the price/performance ratio, €20 for 2 people, including three drinks, was right too.
The only question that remains is why Bo Ke Bon Bon was rated so poorly on TA. When I read the German review, I almost fell off my chair laughing. Who goes to a designated fish restaurant to order spaghetti bolognese? The other reviews also seem to come from people who haven't traveled much in Asia.
We ate dinner here several times and were always very satisfied.

reviews: As a tourist, I was eager to try some authentic local food in Nha Trang, and Bun Quay A Ken delivered an excellent experience. Their Bun Quay vermicelli is something special, with fresh vermicelli and seafood cooked to perfection. The squid and prawn patty stood out with their great flavor, and the homemade condiments added an extra layer of taste. The restaurant has a cozy, simple atmosphere, and the staff were welcoming and helpful, guiding me through the menu. I recommend trying their sugarcane juice or kumquat tea—both were refreshing, especially on a hot day. If you’re in Nha Trang and want to experience local flavors, Bun Quay A Ken is definitely a place you should visit. It’s all about great food and friendly service here—well worth a try!, Best bun quay I’ve ever had!!!. Their noodles and soup is very flavourful and well-presented. The ambience was cozy and their service was attentive. Very highly recommended place to go for a warm and nice meal. To avoid waiting, I would suggest to go between 2-5pm(avoid peak hours). Overall a 5/5 experience., i stumbled upon Bun quay a ken while searching fir local food, and it turned out to be one of my best dining experience. as a solo tourist, im always on thenlookout for hidden gems, and i think this restaurant is one of them.Bun quay is something i never tried before, and the experience was so unique and fun. from the moment i walked in, i was impressed by how welcoming and friendly the staff were, even tho the place was busy. the atmosphere is casual and great for a relaxing meal. the food was fantastic, i ordered their number 3 which has squid, prawn and fish patty and some beef. the squid was so fresh...and the prawn patty is super yummy. im able to tell they put alot of care in preparing the food. the broth was light but flavorful. the whole meal is super affordable for local and toursit alike. overall, bun quay a ken exceed my expectations, while writing, im planning to visit them a 2nd time already.

address: 64 Hong Bang, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews: Really glad i found this joint in nha trang. Food was excellent, our server (i think his name was Tho?) was exceptional, very patient and knowledgeable, servers even went above ans beyond in buying us flowers on request because we didnt know the area well! Bar staff gave us complementary drinks on the house as well! Owners are from Canada and xan speak english and vietnamese fluently and are very friendly and easy going. Steaks were delicious along with the mussles and clams we had as sides. Highly recommend visiting and experiencing this place, it feels like a five star western restaurant with Nha Trang prices and warm asian welcoming vibes., After weeks of delicious Vietnamese food, that craving for Western comfort started creeping in. Lucky for us, our friend Brandon introduced us to Secrets Bar & Grill, a steakhouse gem in Nha Trang owned by chef Gerry Nguyen. Tucked near the beach and city center, this place is as inviting as it is impressive—elegant decor, cozy indoor and breezy outdoor seating, plus a full bar with a solid wine list. Gerry sources top-quality meats straight from Australia and Canada, and it shows. We kicked things off with a perfectly shaken margarita and a frozen Bellini—both were spot on. Then came the starters: a classic Caesar salad with anchovies and rich French onion soup. But the star? That ribeye. Cooked to absolute perfection. Secrets Bar & Grill is known for its premium imported steaks, curated wine selection, and relaxed, upscale vibe. Whether you’re celebrating or just need a break from noodles, this is the spot. The secret’s officially out—if you’re in Nha Trang, do yourself a favor and check it out. You won’t be disappointed., This place is a bit expensive compared to Vietnamese prices, but the quality of the food is good enough for the price. Usually, about 300 grams per adult is enough, so I don't know the exact name of the amount and drink, but I ordered two cocktails and ate them with my wife. reviews: Really glad i found this joint in nha trang. Steaks were delicious along with the mussles and clams we had as sides. Highly recommend visiting and experiencing this place, it feels like a five star western restaurant with Nha Trang prices and warm asian welcoming vibes., After weeks of delicious Vietnamese food, that craving for Western comfort started creeping in. Lucky for us, our friend Brandon introduced us to Secrets Bar & Grill, a steakhouse gem in Nha Trang owned by chef Gerry Nguyen. Tucked near the beach and city center, this place is as inviting as it is impressive—elegant decor, cozy indoor and breezy outdoor seating, plus a full bar with a solid wine list. Then came the starters: a classic Caesar salad with anchovies and rich French onion soup. But the star? That ribeye. Cooked to absolute perfection. reviews: I came here yesterday for New Year’s Eve with a couple of friends and family and the food was absolutely Devine it was perfectly cooked and the presentation of it was unbelievable. reviews: Various salad choices, good Vietnamese pancake, noodles and coffee. They serve Kimchi everyday I think, fresh fruits, juices, and kids meals. The buffet has one of the widest varieties of any hotel we’ve every stayed at. We particular liked the fact there were speciality chefs at each station. There was choice of Vietnamese specialities, Asian and European foods. What made it even more special was the fact the staff were extremely friendly, with the chef greeting us everyday. We also had the New Years buffet, which was amazingly thought out. It was perfect for the family. Very well thought out and a great experience. Thanks to you all for a beautiful week., Traveled most of the day but we were not that hungry of we would have opted for the seafood buffet which looked phenomenal! Expensive but choice and quality looked fantastic. My wife had the chicken pho, which was delicious, good flavor, lean chicken. I had the shrimp spring rolls. They had a jumbo shrimp in the center of the roll with the tail sticking out of one end. They were delicious. Around $8 for each item. Expensive for locals but OK for us.

address: Bai Tien, Duong De, Vinh Hoa Ward Villa Le Corail, A Gran Melia Hotel, Ground Floor, Gran Voyage, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews: If you’re looking for an authentic taste of Spain, this restaurant is a fantastic choice. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, with charming décor. The menu offers a great selection of traditional Spanish dishes, perfectly seasoned paella. The ingredients taste fresh, and the flavors are well-balanced, making every bite enjoyable. The service is also a highlight – Ms Tracy supervisor is friendly, knowledgeable, and always ready to recommend the best dishes and explained the ingredients very carefully. Overall, this is a must-visit spot for anyone who loves Spanish cuisine or wants to experience something new. Highly recommended!, I went there to commemorate the anniversary because I heard it was awarded 1 Michelin star. I really enjoy trying new foods and seek out a variety of flavors. The amuse bouche was delicious and all the food was good. In particular, the staff member in charge of us was very friendly and I felt really good. I think she said she was Choi and she said she was famous for the drama Queen of Tears haha. Thank you so much for even gifting us an anniversary dessert! It was a day like a gift❤️, We had the pleasure of dining twice at the Gran Melia Nha Trang's Hispania restaurant (Spanish restaurant). Once à la carte and once with the Chef's testing 5-course menu, and both were incredible experiences! Spanish cuisine has pride of place here, and every dish we tasted was a true delight. Featuring quality products, the authentic and delicate flavors really delighted our taste buds. A huge thank you to the Chef and his brigade, as well as to Ms Jasmin and Ms Trinh. Their service was impeccable, combining professionalism with human warmth. They took the time to explain each dish to us, which enriched our experience. The ambience of the restaurant is equally charming, creating an ideal setting for a memorable meal. We particularly appreciated the attention to detail, both in the presentation of the dishes and in the warm welcome. In short, L'Hispania is a must for those wishing to enjoy authentic Spanish cuisine in a welcoming setting. We'd like to thank the whole team for a fantastic evening, and look forward to coming back for more! Comte G&M
description: LUXURY DINING WITH A SPANISH FLAIR Hispania redefines luxury dining with a harmonious blend of Spanish heritage and vibrant flavours. Led by Michelin-starred Spanish chef Marcos Morán, the menu features signature dishes from the acclaimed Hispania London and Brussels, while incorporating the local fresh seafood of Nha Trang. A truly immersive journey through Spain's most picturesque regions.

reviews: We enjoyed the fresh clean taste of the 3 dishes we shared between 2 adults.. Our favourite was the Special Smoked Duck Rice. It was a deconstructed dish with rice on the bottom, the shredded vegetables piled around the side of the bowl, topped with a fried egg and then slices of smoked duck. You receive a bowl of sauce to mix through the whole dish. We have never tasted anything quite like it. Highly recommend it for originality of flavour. We enjoyed the deep fried chicken Bao and the smoked bacon and chorizo Bao. The home brewed ginger beer was not to our taste., The Bao buns were amazing. Super soft and a variety of filling options. The shrimp with the egg sauce was my favourite. The chicken was a close second. The staff are friendly and speak English so it was easy to communicate. They kindly let us try their homemade ice cream which was Oreo and coconut flavour and it was so creamy and delicious. Will be going back here for sure., Everything is very tasty, BAO burgers are very tasty, the sauces complement perfectly. Very polite staff, clean and comfortable. Large selection of food and drinks, I recommend trying ginger beer

reviews: Having the Catimor Honey French press coffee. Small quaint coffee shop seat about eight and it’s on the second floor. Very good choice of coffee beans and portion sizes. And I enjoy the music. If you’re truly coffee lover please find this place., This place is located above a general shop and accessible by the stairs on the side so it is a little hidden. However it is spectacular. My partner loves coffee but found everywhere seemed to either burn or over brew leaving it tasting bitter. Her eyes lit up as she tasted what the owner recommended saying it was one of the best coffees she has ever had. I personally absolutely hate coffee and prefer tea, but the owner had a perfect suggestion for me too. He gace me a brew made from the fruit of a coffee plant and it tasted delicious. The owner is extremely passionate about what he does and is incredibly knowledgeable. He showed us all his many types of filters (one which takes 2 days) and gave us lots of other brews to try and taught us about different fermenting processes. I can guarantee everyone will love this place., Simply the best coffee I have ever tried in my life, served with love and sophistication. There are various sorts of coffee in paper packs you can buy to bring home at affordable prices!

reviews: The service & ambience here is something one should look forward forward! Great views on the Oceania and is soothing. Sun down time is also beautiful! Service is very personalized and staff explains each & every dish while serving which sets this place apart & is one of its kind. The food was good but the freshness of fish can be looked into! The portion size needs to relooked as compared to the price, We had a delicious sushi dinner at Shibui, a beautiful restaurant with a breathtaking view. We've tried omakase at several restaurants in the U.S., including Nobu, Catch, Shino, Hane, and Kame. Finding this place was a gem! Although we expected more sashimi and sushi pieces for the price, the A5 Wagyu plate was a nice compensation. reviews: Having the Catimor Honey French press coffee. Small quaint coffee shop seat about eight and it’s on the second floor. Very good choice of coffee beans and portion sizes. I can guarantee everyone will love this place., Simply the best coffee I have ever tried in my life, served with love and sophistication. There are various sorts of coffee in paper packs you can buy to bring home at affordable prices!

name: Mámìta Kitchen & Wine
address: 95/1 a Bạch Đằng street, Nha Trang Vietnam
reviews: This hidden gem in a non descript alley is a must visit in Nha Trang! Drawing both timber and inspiration from an old house with a rich Indochinese history, this space offers the perfect balance of tranquility and ambience to enjoy a nice glass of wine and some unique tapas. With ample parking for bikes and even a valet to assist you, the service only gets better from that point onwards. We tried several of their dishes which were perfect for sharing and came back with some friends to check out a few more. The memory of their distinct mushroom hummus still lingers the day after!, Dinner at Mamita Kitchen was a really special experience. The sophisticated dishes, which expressed the local flavour in a concise yet sophisticated way, were artwork in themselves. Despite the reasonable price, the quality of the food was very high, and it felt like eating in a luxury restaurant. Above all, the warm and attentive service of the staff made the taste of the food even more prominent, and it was the moment to fully feel the authenticity of Mamita Kitchen. In a word, the meal here was an unforgettable experience that contained the taste and the mood, and the heart of the people., The atmosphere here was nice and cozy. The servers were knowledgeable, attentive but not overbearing. The natural wine that was suggested paired perfectly with our seafood plates. The octopus was grilled to perfection and the grouper was silky smooth and delicious. I can't wait to visit Nha Trang again and try more of the food and wine they have to offer. This was by far the best meal of my trip in Nha Trang!
description: In the heart of Nha Trang's winding backstreets, a culinary gem awaits - Mámìta Kitchen & Wine. Escape the bustling crowds and step into a charming abode where flavors dance and memories are kindled. Indulge in our ever-evolving tasting menu that pays homage to family recipes and global inspirations. Fresh, seasonal ingredients are masterfully transformed into unique dishes, ensuring an unforgettably intimate and extraordinary dining journey. From cozy ambiance to carefully selected natural wines, every detail is curated to provide a welcoming sanctuary for couples, families, and young professionals seeking an exceptional culinary experience. Unwind, connect, and savor the magic of Mámìta.

name: Livin - Nha Trang
address: 5a Ngo Thoi Nhiem Tan Lap, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews: If you're a brisket enthusiast in Vietnam, look no further than Livin Nha Trang. This hidden gem takes the crown for serving the best brisket in the country, making it a must-visit for meat lovers. The star of the show at Livin Nha Trang is undoubtedly their brisket. Bursting with flavor and tenderness, each bite is a heavenly experience. The succulent, slow-cooked brisket is perfectly seasoned and melts in your mouth, delivering a delightful blend of smoky and savory notes. Combine brisket with the warm tortillas, fresh toppings, and zesty sauces, the brisket tacos become a culinary masterpiece that will leave you craving more. I have had them three times in one week Beyond the brisket tacos, Livin Nha Trang offers a range of other tantalizing dishes that showcase their expertise in meat preparation. The quality and consistency of the brisket are truly remarkable, guaranteeing a memorable dining experience every time. Apart from the outstanding food, Livin Nha Trang provides a welcoming and relaxed atmosphere. The friendly staff members are passionate about their craft and are more than happy to guide you through the menu and recommend the perfect pairing. The cozy and casual setting adds to the overall enjoyment of the meal, making it a great spot to gather with friends or family. While Livin Nha Trang's focus is primarily on their standout brisket dishes, they also offer a decent selection of sides and beverages to complement your meal. Whether you're in the mood for crispy fries, refreshing salads, or a cold craft beer, they have you covered. In terms of value, Livin Nha Trang delivers on both taste and portion sizes. The prices are reasonable considering the high quality of the ingredients and the mouthwatering flavors you'll experience. In conclusion, Livin Nha Trang is a haven for brisket lovers in Vietnam. With their unparalleled brisket tacos and an array of flavorful dishes, they have undoubtedly perfected the art of brisket preparation. Prepare yourself for a taste sensation that will linger on your palate long after your visit. Don't miss the opportunity to savor the best brisket Vietnam has to offer at Livin Nha Trang!, We were recommended this place by our friends, upon arrival it smelt absolutely incredible and the choice on the menu was great! The food from start to finish was honestly some of the nicest and tastiest food weve eaten since visiting Vietnam. The steak was cooked to perfection just how we wanted it and the pulled pork loaded fries for starter were definitely my favourite dish! 10/10 would definitely recommend and return here in the future, We fancied a meat/BBQ selection whilst on our Vietnam trip and came across this place. We were certainly not disappointed! We shared the 2 person meat selection which is served with coleslaw & pickles. The meats were cooked & smoked to absolute perfection and we just didn’t want it to end! We ordered a side of fries to share and there was more than plenty of food. The staff are great, the wine was good and well chilled. The place has a great vibe and quick service. A couple of bits that would make it perfect: -the bathrooms could do with a paint/mini refurb -the restaurant is above another and it’s a little hard to find/misleading at first. More signage would be good! If you are visiting Nha Trang and like your meat - 100% visit here, you will not be disappointed!
description: Established in 2015, LIVIN – Nha Trang is a casual restaurant deep-rooted from the traditions of American barbecue. Balancing between traditions, cultures, and innovation; we hope to create, inspire, and share a wide-range of classic to new-American dishes. Our Mission is to serve our customers an honest, delicious, and an amazing experience.

address: 10/1B Nguyen Thien Thuat Ground floor, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews:

There are cheeses 105 dong, also delicious, but the portion is small, cheeses the size of an elephant's nipple :))) one portion of vryatli is enough for you. Pumpkin soup is delicious, Vietnamese coffee is delicious. We've been here three times already and I love it., We had breakfast here and ordered the zucchini omelette, bruschetta and granola with strawberries. Everything was delicious and the portions were very generous. Our iced latte was also very large, with perfect milk foam and a small delicious cookie. The staff were also super friendly and accommodating!! We'll be happy to come back. Alpaca Homestyle Cafe's inviting atmosphere garners praise for being both cozy and exceptional, a sentiment reflected in the attentive service that guests appreciate, especially the multilingual proficiency of the staff. The cafe's dishes receive mixed reviews, with some guests commending the freshness and presentation, while others find the taste and portions lacking.

Although the food's quality is a point of contention, with opinions divided on whether it justifies the price, the restaurant still stands out for its overall welcoming ambiance and friendly service.

address: 38 Tran Phu Street Rooftop, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews: My visit to Skylight Rooftop in Nha Trang with my family was an exceptional experience. The ambiance, with its stunning panoramic views of the city and coastline, set the perfect backdrop for our evening out. The highlight of our meal was the Tomahawk steak. The meat was incredibly tender and cooked to perfection, offering a delightful blend of flavors that left us all thoroughly impressed. The presentation was equally impressive, making it a feast for both the eyes and the palate. The service was top-notch, with attentive and friendly staff who ensured our dining experience was seamless. They were especially accommodating to our family, making us feel welcome and well cared for. The overall atmosphere, combined with the quality of the food and service, makes Skylight a must-visit destination in Nha Trang. It's an ideal spot for families looking to enjoy a memorable meal with breathtaking views! Highly recommended for anyone visiting Nha Trang with their loved ones, especially if you are a meat lover., Skylight Nha Trang is a vibrant rooftop bar and entertainment venue that offers a truly unforgettable experience. Perched atop the Premier Havana Hotel, it provides 360-degree panoramic views of Nha Trang's coastline, cityscape, and mountains, making it a perfect spot for sunset lovers and nightlife enthusiasts. Paid entrance (includes one welcome drink), 360° view, attentive staff who will show you everything and guide you everywhere. I especially recommend a place with a glass floor. Come at sunset, the views and photos will be great!
description: Don't miss out on the ultimate experience at Skylight Nha Trang! Open Thursday to Sunday from 20:00 to 01:00, come make unforgettable memories and capture those Instagram-worthy photos at Skylight Nha Trang. We look forward to welcoming you to our beach town paradise!

address: 1a Duong Biet Thu, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews: Found this Streetfood Restaurant by chance . My partner is Vietnamese and wanted to try it. I'm so glad we did, everything is cooked fresh to order . They had no wine on the menu so I popped round the corner to a small shopping centre and purchased a lovely bottle of red wine (15% vol) for £3.70 and they charged me a small corkage fee. Peanut our waitress was great fun and ensured we had a fantastic meal except guessing my age as 10 years higher 🙄. A massive thank you to this lovely restaurant near the beach. It was quite busy with tourists and locals alike., We read good reviews about this restaurant and it was up to our expectations and beyond. Don't be fooled by the expression Street Food. This is really excellent food, with an excellent value. Some of the dishes are traditional street food dishes, but with high quality ingredients, and what we had (we went there two times, and will go again) was really tasty and worth every dong and more. The Frog with lemon grass was amazing, the mushroom and broccoli very tasty, Pinapple Rice is excellentSome dishes are good, other are really excellent. One of our favorites, surprisingly, has been Banh Flan: Caramel pudding with a coffee sauce, absolutely exquisite. The staff is very friendly. A must and a repeat., Our first meal in Nha Trang was at Galangal. We loved every bit of it. The staff are absolutely lovely and kind. We ordered their bun bo and bun thit nuong noodles, which both tasted great and had a lot of flavour. The banh mi that we got was good too - you could watch the chef make it at the counter behind our seating, which was nice. The scallops were fresh and tasted very creamy. Very good pricing too. Some may say too touristy, but for us, the taste was perfect.

First the service: the best I have come across in restaurants in Vietnam until now. By far. Highly professional. Impeccable. So discrete and quiet, super efficient and attentive, very customer friendly and respectful. Excellent team coordination & spirit. No time spent on cell phones. No talking, no chat among staff, only a permanent attention on customers. Orders & (special) requests from customers executed and delivered in an impeccable manner. Nothing left to desire. Truly impressive. Second the quality of the food I ordered (as a diabetic person I go systematically for the "simple" top blade steaks) was consistently very good to simply excellent like on my latest visit which impressed me most this evening, Dec. 13 (reason why I am posting this review on TA 😉💜). Though I find the free side to be on the light size of the things (I wish there would be more, yes for sure 😂 especially since it is soooo good) everything is very nicely presented and the meat always exactly cooked as ordered (as it should but in that restaurant it is highly consistent). As local customs might differ from expectations based on experiences at home, I learned that being very specific about what I expect when ordering is ensuring that I will not get disappointed or feel a bit of frustration, at least in that wonderful restaurant, as they will accommodate every special request. More recently I came to realize that I could simply ask for lemon or vinegar and use salt, pepper and oil on the table for a healthier dressing (as I suffer from diabetes). Also I specify to be served the meat only once I am done with the salad 😉 as well as to get every single item on the main plate warm... not cold or luke warm. I even request the plate to be (hot)warm as I am a very slow eater (yes in the end it will get cold but... I can/have to live with that😅). This is definitely my top restaurant in Nha Trang and the wonderful owner & admirable team combined with delicious food and an amazing customer service minded attitude is the reason. reviews: We entered the establishment because there was a queue to enter. Great food, fast and attentive waiters, drinks a little expensive, but beer in a mug from the freezer covers the overprice. We took rice with seafood in pineapple, very tasty! A must visit, Ăn Thôi – A Delicious Surprise in Nha Trang It’s been a long time since we came back to visit Nha Trang. The city has changed quite a bit, and when we asked friends for food recommendations, one name came up: Ăn Thôi. As Vietnamese, we’re used to the traditional look, feel, and taste of our dishes, so we were a little skeptical when we noticed most of the customers were non-Vietnamese tourists. But we gave it a shot—and we’re glad we did. The restaurant is warmly lit with tasteful decor, creating a cozy but not overly quiet vibe. It strikes that nice balance between lively and laid-back. We went all in and ordered a bunch of traditional dishes to put them to the test: • Crispy baby shrimp with lime leaf: A nostalgic hit! It brought back memories from childhood. The lime leaf gave it a fresh, aromatic lift. • Mi Quang (Quang noodles): Spot on. The flavors were authentic and true to the central Vietnamese style we love. Bonus points: they include a little leaflet showing tourists how to eat it properly—Vietnamese-style. Very thoughtful. • Ăn Thôi morning glory: A touch spicy for my taste, but still very flavorful. No wonder it’s a hit with their Korean customers. • Lemongrass pork skewers: Perfectly portioned and prepped with all the ingredients chopped and ready to roll, literally. Just follow the guide and you’re set. We definitely over-ordered for two people—but we didn’t regret a bite. Too often, modern Vietnamese restaurants tone down the flavor to appeal to a broader crowd and end up losing the soul of the dish. Ăn Thôi manages to walk the line beautifully—you get authenticity and approachability in one place. If you’re ever in Nha Trang and craving real Vietnamese food that doesn’t compromise on taste, Ăn Thôi is worth a visit. You won’t be disappointed., I've come for lunch. Well, yesterday I delivered it to you at the Schlanritz, and it's delicious, so today I've come to eat it myself. The staff were very friendly and attentive and I would recommend anyone looking for European western brunch in Nha Trang, Atlas Cafe., A great place for a pleasant time. reviews: Clean and excellent service. The phở isn’t quite the same as the ironical one in Hanoi as it has less green onion but I guess that’s just adjusting to the local taste bud. Still recommended if you’re looking for a taste of Hanoi Phở Thìn, Clean atmosphere. Great Korean. Second visit. I came to remember Korean food. Same as when we arrived in November. description: Pho Tinh Nha Trang is proud to bring the traditional Hanoi pho flavor, famous for its rich, delicious broth simmered from marrow bones for many hours. Combined with tender, sweet beef slices and delicious, chewy pho noodles, each bowl of pho here is a perfect blend of Vietnamese culinary quintessence. The restaurant is located at 64C Nguyen Thi Minh Khai, right in the center of Nha Trang, very convenient for both locals and tourists. We serve from 6am to 9pm, ideal for early breakfast, intimate lunch or relaxing dinner with family and friends. The restaurant space is designed to be spacious, clean, equipped with modern air conditioning to bring maximum comfort to diners. The friendly, professional staff is always ready to serve and bring a great culinary experience. Visit Pho Tinh Nha Trang to feel the authentic traditional pho flavor and enjoy a cozy, intimate Vietnamese culinary space!

name: I Like Buffet
address: 61 Đặng Tất, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews: The buffet was awesome. Everything on charcoal you could grill yourself at the table. The selection was incredibly varied and the staff totally nice and helpful and all for the equivalent of 8.80 € per person including beer or other drinks, Natran's seafood barbecue seafood! You can eat a variety of fresh seafood, and every one of the Vietnamese foods was delicious! I was especially impressed by the employees carefully taking care of how to eat delicious seafood. While busy, the staff asked me if I needed help with a translator in Korean, so I could feel quality and sincerity. If you want to have an unforgettable meal at a affordable price in Natrang, this is the place to go. I like buffet, I love it!, Recently visited a Vietnamese buffet with friends and it was a wonderful experience! The atmosphere of the establishment is very cozy and friendly, which immediately creates a feeling of celebration. The variety of dishes is astonishing, from fresh seafood to fragrant salads to hot dishes. We tried a lot of different snacks, and each one was incredibly delicious and fresh. Service is also at the highest level – attentive waiters were always available to help, that. The desserts were particularly pleasing: light and sweet, they perfectly ended our evening. We had a great time laughing and enjoying the delicious food. Definitely recommend this buffet to anyone who wants to taste authentic Vietnamese cuisine and seafood in the company of friends!

address: 92/20 Hung Vuong Lộc Thọ, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews: iVegan is a hidden gem in Nha Trang! The food is packed with flavor, fresh, and entirely plant-based. With a diverse menu ranging from hearty meals to tasty desserts, there's something for everyone. The cozy ambiance and welcoming staff make it a must-visit for anyone seeking a great vegan experience. Highly recommend!", I really like iVegan because (other than just being really tasty international vegan food) they put the kcal and macros on the menus so you can make a choice based on that. My fav in terms of taste: beyond meat burger. My fav in terms of macros: tofu scramble :) It might be slightly more expensive for the local market, but the prices are still 20-25% of what you'd have to pay in the West. PS: if you leave a review, you can get ANYTHING from the coffee and deserts menu. That's very generous!, After travelling Vietnam for a month this was exactly what I needed, been feeling a bit homesick with food and haven’t been eating very healthy food out of convenience. This has made me feel so refreshed and happy, the portions are super generous and the juice press and coffee is stunning. Recommend this to anyone who’s after some greens!
