name: La Cala
address: 172/16A Bach Dang, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews:
After reading reviews we decided last minute to go here, to find it was very busy. Not expecting a table we still asked and after a few minutes wait were accommodated by the proactive front of house manager upstairs in this overall well fitted out dining space. The waitress Nuc? Was very attentive and engaging and made our night even more enjoyable. The food however was really authentic Italian more so than expected. Wood fired pizza, sensational, the home made pasta, next level and a good choice of imported wines and choice of great desserts. Try the tiramisu! A great spot, highly recommend!!, Words cannot describe the service at this place! Three young servers who had the biggest smiles on their faces, from the time we arrived until we left ☺️ The food was amazing and reasonably priced! The chef also came out and wished us a tasty meal. Love 🌟, The pizza dough here is one of the best I’ve eaten anywhere in the world … rosemary May be the secret ingredient. The staff are wonderfully attentive and not afraid to advise about food portions (they are BIG) in order that you don’t over order. This was matched - so says the husband - by a 9/10 tiramisu. Tucked along a lane away from the evening business that is Nha Trang, come too La Cala and you may as well be in Italy. La Cala has charmed many diners with its inviting atmosphere, which guests liken to a European seaside escape or a snug local haunt. The establishment's authentic Italian fare, particularly the wood-fired pizzas and homemade pasta, garners high praise for its quality, although a handful of patrons have noted inconsistencies in some dishes.

The service at La Cala generally receives accolades for its attentiveness and friendliness, with complimentary offerings often mentioned as a delightful bonus. While most reviews suggest the restaurant offers good value, reflecting generous portions and reasonable pricing, there are occasional remarks about service hiccups.
description: An authentic Italian restaurant run by two Italians who have been missing real Italian food in Nha Trang for too long. We serve hand made pastas, long-leavening Neapolitan pizza cooked in traditional wood fired oven and a wide selection of Italian wines in a pleasant and warm environment to make you feel like you are enjoying your time in Italy on a Mediterranean Island.

name: Mix Greek Restaurant
address: 181 Nguyen Thien Thuat, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews: We decided to give this restaurant a try on our trip to Nha Trang as Greece is literally our 2nd home. And boy we were not disappointed. Met by the owner, Stefanos, we were shown to a beautiful table by the window that gave a great view of the street. Our first impression of the restaurant was how like the many Greek Tavernas we have tried that this place actually was, with original Greek colors and wall art. We chose the local house wine and excitedly perused the extensive menu. Missing all the fresh fish we eat in Greece we asked Stef if we could try a Fish Platter. Excellent choice! (please see pic below and arrive hungry!) As it was going to be all cooked from fresh we were told to expect a wait of at least 35 minutes. Not a problem, just keep the excellent house red topped up in our glasses! And then it arrived! Wow! It was nearly the length of the table! So on the huge platter there were Clams, Mussels Saganaki, Calamari’s, a whole Seabass, Bassa portions accompanied by a bowl of fries, fresh salad adorning each end of the plate, a selection of dips and bread too. So we set to work! Demolishing everything we could see! It was a work in progress in between the wine. Even the owner was surprised we finished it! With this gone we thought we could not manage another morsel! Quickly changed our minds though when we were presented with little chocolate pots to finish off! All in all it was an excellent start to our trip to Nha Trang with excellent food and service which is second to none that we have experienced and will definitely visit again before we leave. Thank you Steve, Makis and the team you certainly deliver 100% in all aspects! Jo and Mart x, I physically cannot explain how good this place is. The best food we’ve had in a long time- and you get a free dessert just because! Everything tastes extremely fresh, the staff strive for perfection and the setting really feels like you’re in Greece. After 6 weeks of backpacking, this place cured my soul. Please go here!, We discovered this restaurant in 2015 and rediscovered it at its new location 9 years later. Food is still fabulous and great value. The portions are generous and the Britzola (pork steak) was enough between two adults. The meat was very flavoursome. We also had a starter of fried saganaki which was very creamy and moreish. Finally, a complimentary dessert – a chocolate brownie type pudding with banana. We highly recommend this restaurant.

name: Dinner at Cim’s
address: Tran Phu, Hem 86B / Villa No. 30 Loc Tho, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews: Best independent restaurant in Nha Trang. Trip Advisor reviews of Dinner at Cims were excellent and so we thought we would give it a go. We arrived early before 6.00pm and were delighted to see this very comfortable restaurant in a quiet back street in Nha Trang. We selected the set menu for couples and quickly discovered the food was amazing. Fresh bread, Scandinavian Prawns on toast, French onion soup, spaghetti carbonara, then tenderloin steak finishing with apple pie and home made ice cream. At around $50 AUD a head it was certainly worth it. Would highly recommend Dinner at Cims as a must do in Nha Trang., The dinner was 10/10!!! For the starters we ordered a tiger prawns and beef tartar - 10/10 the tartar was one of the best I’ve ever tried before. For the main course we ordered the steak platter - 10/10, the beef was so fresh and soft. We have visited a lot of top places here in Nha Trang, this is the must visit place!, Just remembered out of the blue the Steak House in Nha Trang from TA, DMed at the google map for booking(had no idea it did work, yeh it did), came the spot earlier than booking time, which was a nice choice as the Alley to the restaurant was so curtained and not seen by the big big shops around on the main blvd. Kind English speaking Staffs who recommended today's BlackAngus Tenderion and Tigar, the sweet cat, which came for the rich butter-flavored shrimps. Every experience was quite, peaceful and good to be there.
description: Welcome to family Krantz! Home style cooking in our vintage style private villa. Excellent steaks, a refined wine list and resonable prices. Your choice between the dining room, the patio or the garden. Our place is small so we recommend you to book a table.

name: Lousiane Brewhouse Craft Beer & Restaurant - Nha Trang
address: Lô 29 Trần Phú, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews: Here you pay for the atmosphere and beautiful views of the beach with palm trees. Cozy environment, well cooked, but not culinary masterpieces, especially for such money for Vietnam, the establishment is not cheap. Beef languishing in beer + puree 330 dong (1100p +-) large portion enough to eat :) Beer is brewed, very even pretty both dark and fruity, price 500p for 600ml as a whole as in any pub in Moscow. Onion rings 300p portion large. If you don't want to spend too much you can have a beer and rings and sit pretty on +- 1300p. Mussels 1100p per serving, delicious and large, but sauce to them as in any Vietnamese dish that interrupts any taste so that you don't eat :)) in general sat for an hour 2 exactly and it is one of the few establishments where nothing strains, because quiet, beautiful, service is excellent, serving dishes is beautiful., My family and I are at the Louisiane Brewhouse for my birthday dinner while staying in Nha Trang, the food and drinks were reasonably priced and the service was incredible. Whilst eating at the restaurant from our beachfront table at sunset I noticed they also do a brewery tour on premises. The following day my dad and I came back for the most educational and fun brewery tour with the in-house master brewer. At only 800,000 VND for the tour per person the inclusion and experience and are highly recommended. We will be coming back each time I’m in Nha Trang. A must visit restaurant and Brewhouse in Nha Trang and bring your swimmers because the have a resort style in-ground swimming pool and the ocean access with private sun beds 🙌🏼🙌🏼, There is a lot to see around you in this restaurant. The beach is at your feet with all the liveliness that entails. This location has a swimming pool and you can sit quietly on the terrace, which can be quite full at certain times. On the other side you have a view of Vinpearl, where cruise ships regularly moor. They have a lot of tasty drinks and you can choose your own pastries inside. The restaurant is not really cheap.
description: Located on the beachfront of Nha Trang's famous sand beach, Lousiane Brewhouse is a unique craft beer brewery and restaurant, offering exclusive beers brewed on-site and a diverse International cuisine.

name: Bún Quậy A Ken - Nha Trang
address: 1, Đ. Lê Đại Hành, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews: As a tourist, I was eager to try some authentic local food in Nha Trang, and Bun Quay A Ken delivered an excellent experience. Their Bun Quay vermicelli is something special, with fresh vermicelli and seafood cooked to perfection. The squid and prawn patty stood out with their great flavor, and the homemade condiments added an extra layer of taste. The restaurant has a cozy, simple atmosphere, and the staff were welcoming and helpful, guiding me through the menu. I recommend trying their sugarcane juice or kumquat tea—both were refreshing, especially on a hot day. If you’re in Nha Trang and want to experience local flavors, Bun Quay A Ken is definitely a place you should visit. It’s all about great food and friendly service here—well worth a try!, Best bun quay I’ve ever had!!!. Their noodles and soup is very flavourful and well-presented. The ambience was cozy and their service was attentive. Very highly recommended place to go for a warm and nice meal. To avoid waiting, I would suggest to go between 2-5pm(avoid peak hours). Overall a 5/5 experience., i stumbled upon Bun quay a ken while searching fir local food, and it turned out to be one of my best dining experience. as a solo tourist, im always on thenlookout for hidden gems, and i think this restaurant is one of them.Bun quay is something i never tried before, and the experience was so unique and fun. from the moment i walked in, i was impressed by how welcoming and friendly the staff were, even tho the place was busy. the atmosphere is casual and great for a relaxing meal. the food was fantastic, i ordered their number 3 which has squid, prawn and fish patty and some beef. the squid was so fresh...and the prawn patty is super yummy. im able to tell they put alot of care in preparing the food. the broth was light but flavorful. the whole meal is super affordable for local and toursit alike. overall, bun quay a ken exceed my expectations, while writing, im planning to visit them a 2nd time already.
description: Bun Quay A Ken serves Bun Quay, a fresh-to-order noodle dish from Phu Quoc, now available right here! Enjoy a bowl packed with fresh squid, prawn, and fish patties, and personalize your experience by mixing your own dipping sauce at our self-serve station. Perfect for seafood lovers and those seeking an authentic Vietnamese dining experience. Open daily from 6 AM to 10 PM. Discover real coastal cuisine at Bun Quay A Ken!

name: Cafe Culture
address: 120/26 Nguyen Thien Thuat, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews: Thanks to everyone who writes reviews 🙏 Finding something decent and delicious in Nha Trang was not so easy. Moving from the far to the far and in the nooks and crannies and in the central places of tourist gathering, the food is +- the same and the prices do not correspond to the quality of the dishes at all, which is very sad :( It turns out just to stuff the belly just to not starve to death. And if with seafood cooking in general the situation is good, then with pork and beef cooking and even chicken everything is sad, dry and overcooked and rubber meat. And establishments to which you'd like to return twice at all. Generally read the reviews and stopped by for breakfast and cooked :)))) should be in the cafe individual who will then drive you round to the hotel or beach :) Portions are HUGE and delicious, but it is unrealistic to finish all alone :) you can safely take 1 course for two and 2 coffees and will suffice. If you make portions smaller and correspondingly cheaper then there will probably be even more visitors, because it is not realistic to eat everything in one charya, you get food to throw away. In general it was delicious and satisfying, half not finished, cold coffee on coconut with ice cream can be taken in general as dessert ooh delicious :) Pleasant interior, no diner, cool view from the 3rd floor of the street and mountains, everywhere fans and music, comfortable upholstered chairs, staff very friendly and smiley and polite. Many Russian speakers and Europeans, because the kitchen is suitable, not pho bo soup for breakfast, etc. :))) Average price segment, everything in photo 600 dong (+-2000p for breakfast for two). In general the establishment where you want to go again exactly :), This is a must go to for breakfast/lunch/brunch. The staff were very friendly the food was amazing. I had the continental breakfast which had a bit of everything, bacon, poached eggs, sourdough bread, cream cheese with chives, yoghurt, granola, pastry, jam, fruit, coffee and orange juice!! The portion size was massive and everything was fresh and extremely tasty!!!, Fabulous full veggie breakfast, mega sized, eggs, beans, mushrooms, muffin, spinach, hash browns all washed down with a mug of tea. The non- veggie stuff looked good. The owner is a really nice guy and up for a chat about life in Vietnam. Definitely your first choice in Nha Trang if you want a British breakfast.
description: Funky cool urban feel, great food great coffee, relaxed atmosphere, air-conditioned rooftop, rooftop terrace

name: Yashoda Indian Restaurant
address: 119 Nguyen Thien Thuat Street Opposite of The Pizza Company, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews: I have been to this wonderful restaurant many times, on each and every occasion it has been a great meal, wonderful welcomes, friendly owner and staff. Superb food in a typical Vietnam building, it is excellent value as well. The south Indian Roti is the best I have had outside India. I tool several Vietnamese friends and family, they were a bit nervous at first - especially when I said eat with your fingers! but now I always get asked 'when are we going back'? Its a small place and can get busy. The meals are cooked freshly to order and I personally have never waited very long to be served plus they give you free poppadoms and home made pickles whilst you wait. If people want instant food let them go to McDonaldski., Having reopened after temporary closure due to Covid, Yashoda provides a better alternative to other Indian restaurants in Nha Trang. The prices are unbelievably inexpensive, and the food is top notch. Our meal started with complimentary papadam served with three delicious chutneys. We ordered Shahi Paneer, Chicken Saagwala, Kashmiri Pulao, and Aloo Paratha. There were only two of us, but the order could have been enough for 3-4 people. We did find the paratha filling to be overly salty and notified our waiter. The manager came over, apologized, and immediately offered to replace it with a different order. When the bill came the paratha charge was removed and there was no charge for the replacement. Now that is good service! THe interior is elegant and comfortable as well., The most delicious food in two weeks of staying in Nha Trang. I am not a big fan of Indian cuisine, it is just great ingredients and recipes, and large portions. Prices is higher than in other plates, this place is not cheap. $$-$$$
description: Authentic Indian food in Nha Trang . Our menu including vegetarian and non vegetarian Indian food .south Indian Thali meals for lunch is one of our speciality.

Many Russian speakers and Europeans, because the kitchen is suitable, not pho bo soup for breakfast, etc. :))) Average price segment, everything in photo 600 dong (+-2000p for breakfast for two). In general the establishment where you want to go again exactly :), This is a must go to for breakfast/lunch/brunch. The staff were very friendly the food was amazing. I had the continental breakfast which had a bit of everything, bacon, poached eggs, sourdough bread, cream cheese with chives, yoghurt, granola, pastry, jam, fruit, coffee and orange juice!! The portion size was massive and everything was fresh and extremely tasty!!!, Fabulous full veggie breakfast, mega sized, eggs, beans, mushrooms, muffin, spinach, hash browns all washed down with a mug of tea. The non- veggie stuff looked good. The owner is a really nice guy and up for a chat about life in Vietnam. Definitely your first choice in Nha Trang if you want a British breakfast.
description: Funky cool urban feel, great food great coffee, relaxed atmosphere, air-conditioned rooftop, rooftop terrace

name: Yashoda Indian Restaurant
address: 119 Nguyen Thien Thuat Street Opposite of The Pizza Company, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews: I have been to this wonderful restaurant many times, on each and every occasion it has been a great meal, wonderful welcomes, friendly owner and staff. Superb food in a typical Vietnam building, it is excellent value as well. The south Indian Roti is the best I have had outside India. I tool several Vietnamese friends and family, they were a bit nervous at first - especially when I said eat with your fingers! but now I always get asked 'when are we going back'? Its a small place and can get busy. The meals are cooked freshly to order and I personally have never waited very long to be served plus they give you free poppadoms and home made pickles whilst you wait. If people want instant food let them go to McDonaldski., Having reopened after temporary closure due to Covid, Yashoda provides a better alternative to other Indian restaurants in Nha Trang. The prices are unbelievably inexpensive, and the food is top notch. Our meal started with complimentary papadam served with three delicious chutneys. We ordered Shahi Paneer, Chicken Saagwala, Kashmiri Pulao, and Aloo Paratha. There were only two of us, but the order could have been enough for 3-4 people. We did find the paratha filling to be overly salty and notified our waiter. The manager came over, apologized, and immediately offered to replace it with a different order. When the bill came the paratha charge was removed and there was no charge for the replacement. Now that is good service! THe interior is elegant and comfortable as well., The most delicious food in two weeks of staying in Nha Trang. I am not a big fan of Indian cuisine, it is just great ingredients and recipes, and large portions. Prices is higher than in other plates, this place is not cheap. $$-$$$
description: Authentic Indian food in Nha Trang . Our menu including vegetarian and non vegetarian Indian food .south Indian Thali meals for lunch is one of our speciality.

name: Cheers Sports Pub
address: 56A Nguyen Thien Thuat, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews: We felt like “western” food and found this for lunch. The menu is quite large for offering British food. There is a Sunday Roast option as well which I saw a man eating and it was a nice large portion. We ordered the Chicken Schnitzel and a bacon cheeseburger. Both came with chips. We also ordered a beer and the total cost was approx $24 CAD. It was delicious and large portions. This place offers live music sometimes as well as English speaking TV channels for sports and F1. The ladies who worked here the day I visited all speak good English if that’s at all a concern for western travelers. They also offer a good English breakfast as well! Would highly recommend., Best taste of home in Vietnam I didn’t know I needed! My partner and I are from Glasgow and we came here 5 times in the 2 days we were in Nha Trang. The owner is lovely and so are all the staff. They all greeted us with a big smile as soon as they saw us. Service and food were amazing, can’t recommend this place enough whether you’re wanting to enjoy some tasteful British food, a good cold beer or watch some sports games!! Thanks so much for having us!, We don't normally go to English pubs, bars or restaurants on holiday as we like to enjoy the local food. As our hotel served a terrible breakfast and my son was desperate for an English breakfast we decided to give it a go. The English breakfast was delicious and the service was excellent. We have been in 3 times in total and every time we are greeted with a smile by the English owner and his vietnamese staff. The establishment is clean and all the food has been served hot. The cold drinks are very cold, perfect on a hot day. I would not hesitate to recommend Cheers to anyone who fancies a bit if British grub.
description: Please note that our last food orders are at 9:30pm. We aim to provide all your sporting fixture needs, good service, Ice Cold Drinks and Pub Food we are not a 5 establishment.

name: Shantaram Restaurant
address: 3 Pham Ngoc Thach, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews: Without a doubt, one of the best meals we've had in Vietnam. The cooks understand how to balance western flavours, which at the price point is astounding considering other that try the same for much more (and often fail). The only very slight disappointment was the seared sesame tuna, which was a little overcooked to our taste and we found the sesame coating a little thick, which dried out the fish. Everything else was fantastic. The pizza was the best we've had in three years and the baked oysters blew our minds. The cocktails were well mixed and reasonably priced. If you like your drinks strong, order the Long Island as I did. If you like them tasty and not too sweet, go for the strawberry daiquiri, as the Mrs did. We finished the night off with shisha and followed their recommendation. Very happy we did as it was smooth and delicious! If you're reading this looking for something that isn't one of the obviously crap fine dining recommendations for nha trang you can stop searching - this is the spot!, Excellent lunch or dinner spot that never ceases to serve a great meal. The owner and staff are friendly and welcoming. Their new menu offers a huge variety of pizzas, seafood dishes, vegetarian options, and wine/beer/cocktails. Everything on the menu is delicious and there is something for everyone. You cannot go wrong with Shantaram aka “Shanty” as we took to calling it after staying in Nha Trang for a few months., My partner and I ate here last night. On arrival we were struck by the chilled atmosphere and cool music. I had the tuna which was beautifully cooked and my partner had a pizza which was delicious and we shared a vegetable salad which was very tasty. The staff were very friendly and the service was superb. I highly recommend Shantaram if you are in Nha Trang.
description: Some people often ask us why such name - Shantaram? Shantaram is a word on a sansksrit, consists of two words: Shanta (or Shanti) is a place, Ram (or Ra) is a name of God (light joy, happiness). Shantaram - the place of boundless rest and happiness. Also in Vedic culture so call some people who have reached an enlightenment. Also values of this word: "the peaceful person" or "the person bearing the world". Shantaram is a divine rest, the infinite peace in soul. We try to create for you the cozy and sincere atmosphere. Our main task is to make your rest tasty, comfortable and pleasant.

name: Deja Burgers
address: 42/3 Hung Vuong, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews: Deja Brew is a hidden gem in centre Nha Trang. A very friendly atmosphere with great service, this is a lovely spot to just chill out at the end of the day to enjoy good quality pub food and a cold brew. I particularly enjoyed the burger and the chips were among the best I have had in Vietnam. Will definitely be back!, I have lived in Nha Trang for years and I always avoided the busy tourist district down town. But nits its quiet, I found an amazing little place up a quiet alley in the Center of Nha Trang. I bought a Burger as it was the cheapest meal on menu and was pleasantly surprised to get free bacon n cheese with my juicy burger ! I took full advantage of t he happy hour and had a sinful of ice cold San Migs, served by a very Dep Qua Manager! You can also book customized Scuba diving tours here and meet the Instructor, Mr. Tom. I cant recomened this place enough., I actually found Deja Brew just searching around on Google maps. Wrote them a message and ended up having a few chats with the owner's boyfriend, Tom. Had a cheeseburger, fries, a coke and a water and it was 130.000 VND or about $5.60! Great brioche bun and the burger was cooked medium rare just the way I asked for it. The mushroom sauce was nice and no extra charge! Great friendly place for a good burger!!
description: Deja Burgers is a well known brand in the centre of Nha Trangs tourist area. Only 100m down the alley way opposite the night market on Hung Vuong street. We make delicious burgers with homemade recipe, also our signature fries that you won’t find anywhere else.

name: The Cloud Bar
address: 163 Nguyen Thien Thuat, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews: Wonderful place! and the food is delicious and the hookah is great (and I'm very sensitive to it)), went to them almost every night, although many were in other establishments, but if you didn't want to risk it, then definitely in Cloud, it was a win-win! Grilled tuna, delicious burgers and cheese paste are my favorites. Delicious coffee. Special greetings to Diana, Eugene and hookah master Alexei, you made our evenings in Nha Trang beautiful., Best shisha in Nha Trang! Came here with friends by accident. I was pleasantly surprised by the atmosphere, the interior is interesting and thought out to the smallest detail. They offered a choice of hookah flavors based on our preferences. In general, the place is very pleasant and cozy. I would love to visit with my friends!, A wonderful place for a quiet evening and relaxation. Excellent staff - you won't be undermined, the food is delicious - we took the pastas - and a special thank you for them. The hookah is not bad (but I'm not an expert). And also for beer lovers - there are items on the menu from a local craft brewery, which was very pleasing, it was nice to drink something other than the local Bia Saigon. Prices are Moscow :)
description: Temp closed Oldest Nha-Trang shisha lounge. EST. 2014! We are proud to claim that the lounge provides the widest range of hookahs in Vietnam. Check out such brands as Darkside, Daily Hookah, Al Fakher, Fumari, Tangiers, Adalya, Must Have. Enjoy the variety of tastes, ranging from classic to juicy exotic mixes. Big choice of cocktails and drinks.

name: Sam Lor Thai Restaurant - Tuktuk Nha Trang
address: 76 Dong Da Tan Lap, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews: Good food but don't order duck curry dish I visited this place this week and ordered duck curry...that was a mistake. Only around 7 small pieces for one of the most expensive dish in their menu. Quality of duck meat is also questionable.and won't ever repeat that dish... I am visiting this restaurant since 2019 and generally a fan of this place. See Google reviews..., A wonderful place if you want properly prepared Thai food at a reasonable price. Tom Yum is simply better than in many places in Thailand, Pad Thai is standard, I wanted to order a second portion. Mango stick rice is more beautiful than authentic., The food absolutely delicious, with rich and authentic flavors. The staff is welcoming and attentive, making the experience even better. I highly recommend trying the Pad Thai and Mango Sticky Rice—both are amazing! Definitely a must-visit in Nha Trang!

name: Cuppa Coffee
address: 4C Biet Thu Loc Tho, Nha Trang Vietnam
reviews: The coffee is just fine, about 45k for an iced espresso and 55k for an iced mocca. The place in the back is quiet and good to rest up a bit before moving on. I can recommend it if you look for a relative cheap coffee and to get away from the busy traffic and streets!, I visit this place for breakfast most days when I am in Nha Trang, You can get a real Coffee (not Vietnamese) for 30,000 Dong and an Omelette for 70,000 Dong served with the usual poor quality Asian bacon which i give to the local dog. They also give you two nice warm mini baguettes and if you want butter its an extra 5000 Dong. I can recommend this place as pretty good but the staff still haven't learnt how to smile or be friendly to Tourists which is unfortunate., Indeed good coffee but crepes are served cold, no idea why but taste is good. Price is regular. Staff is friendly.

address: 11 Yersin, Nha Trang 65000 Vietnam
reviews: Everything is delicious, clean, beautiful, nice live music. Photos of dishes in the menu correspond to real dishes. Polite staff. Sunday is music, dance and vocal performance., Very tasty food and big portions, grilled dishes are delicious, and much tea for the whole party. Prices are reasonable! We tried grilled goose, squid and chicken curry - perfect!, Oh my, we came back again because the food and the staff were so amazing. Our darling server helped us Canadians dish up our food - Bun Bo hue, because we were rookies. The manager owner? also recognized us and was so grateful for our return business. We had the grilled fish platter with fab salad 1 night, green curry with shrimp and morning glory with garlic. It is one of my most favourite restaurants after a month in Vietnam. Cam on.
description:
Đặt tiệc sinh nhật ngay để được trang trí gói tiêu chuẩn miễn phí và giảm giá 10% trên tổng hóa đơn.
Đặt bàn gọi: 0903669969

name: La Velvet
address: 100/22 Hung Vuong, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews: Stumbled upon this restaurant...absolutely amazing..food awesome and staff so polite and helpful. For 2 people we had bruscetta for starters, chicken ceasar salad and ostrich with char grilled vegetables and portion of potatoes, bottle of wine and was less than £30.00. we have booked to come again in 2days time., Today I had lunch here, in a simple restaurant, small in size, but furnished with such taste as to make it graceful, thanks to the pleasant background music that stimulates conversation. I was alone and, having looked at the menu on my smartphone, I tested Maria, the pretty Russian girl who runs it, with my need for a meal in balance between carbohydrates, proteins and vegetables. Maria satisfied me and the conversation with her while waiting for the dishes was also pleasant., Very good address with original dishes and prices that remain reasonable. Very friendly staff. We took two Virgin mojitos + 1 ostrich dish + tuna dish + 2 desserts = 700 k or 25th for two
description: Cozy restaurant in the center of Nha Trang. . Delicious food and friendly English speaking staff. Welcome to La Velvet Restaurant

name: Happy Noodles Soup
address: 19 Ngo Gia Tu Tan Lap, Nha Trang 650000 Vietnam
reviews: Noodle bomb!!! A cafe with a mono menu of noodles and rolls with meat and vegetables! Served quickly, everything is fresh. The noodles are made from the same place by hand, as you can see. Clean for a street cafe. Came based on reviews, I recommend it. We took fobo and rolls, if you want meat, take the more expensive one in a clay cup, there is raw meat there. We had lunch: 2 fobos and 2 rolls and 2 Saigon and Orange beers for 340 thousand ($14)., The noodles were delicious. The menu was easy to understand, with English explanations and pictures. Many people ordered hot stone pho, which is raw beef heated to your liking, but I ordered regular beef pho. I saw a local woman adding lots of bean sprouts and herbs and lots of seasonings, so I did the same and it was delicious. It has a mild taste without adding anything., had lunch here when i visited nha trang two weeks ago.someone recommended this pho restaurant to me.it is popular among tourists,especially among korean tourists. there is a speciality dish for Korean in the menu,that is called pho in the stone bowl (pho tho da). stone bowls widely used in Korean restaurants. it is my first time to have pho in stone bowl,very unique experience.besides,i ordered orange juice and Quẩy. (fried dough sticks), i always love to put Quẩy inside the bowl,it will become more delicious. pho soup here is not heavy, pho itself is tasty.after the meal, you will become hạnh phúc, which means happy in English,or 행복해 in Korean.worth a visit!
description: Happiness brought to a good meal! There is a dish that is not delicacy of Vietnam but it’s number 1 at the top 40 delicious dishes in the world . It’s PHO (NOODLE SOUP) – the familiar, rustic dish and full of Vietnamese spirit. Our chef grinds flour, coats and slices rice noodles at the counter , fresh ingredients and sweet, tasty broth according to traditional recipes blending with hot brisket and shank which is put in stone bowls. All the flavors in the bowl of Pho mingle together, tasting a small spoon you will feel the harmony in each flavor. The freshness of the meat, the chewy rice noodles , the aroma of vegetables, the spiciness of chilies and a little sourness of lemons. They are the quintessence and cooking secret to make a smell bowl of noodle soup.We engage to serve wholeheartedly, sincerely and extremely proud to be with you to experience great flavors !HANH PHUC (HAPPY) NOODLES SOUP – EATING IS HAPPY
